vulnerability.en: Root causes include trusting token-supplied alg, jwk, jku, x5u, x5c, or kid values, mixing HMAC and asymmetric keys, using low-entropy HMAC keys, or omitting issuer, audience, time, and token-type validation.

exploitation.zh: 先用本地测试 issuer 生成短期有效 token 并访问只读标记，再一次只改变一个算法、key 引用或 claim。验证器必须显式固定允许算法和 key，并记录 issuer、audience、type 与时间检查结果。
exploitation.en: Generate a short-lived valid token from the local test issuer and access the read-only marker, then change exactly one algorithm, key reference, or claim. The verifier must explicitly pin algorithms and keys and log issuer, audience, type, and time checks.

mitigation.zh: 按 token 类型使用互斥验证规则，固定算法与 key 类型，使用高熵 HMAC key；只从 issuer 配置的受信来源解析 key，允许列表化 kid 与 jku/x5u，并严格校验 iss、aud、exp、nbf 和 typ。
mitigation.en: Use mutually exclusive validation rules per token type, pin algorithms and key types, and use high-entropy HMAC keys; resolve keys only from issuer-configured trusted sources, allowlist kid and jku/x5u, and strictly validate iss, aud, exp, nbf, and typ.

name.zh: API 属性级授权边界验证

description.zh: 验证低权限主体提交允许属性与一个服务器管理属性时，API 是否明确拒绝或忽略不可写字段且不发生持久化变化。
description.en: Validate that an API explicitly rejects or ignores one server-managed property submitted alongside an allowed property without persisting unauthorized state.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无持久化副作用的属性契约评估端点，并准备一个允许字段和一个服务器管理字段。
prerequisites.en: Use a side-effect-free property-contract evaluator with one writable field and one server-managed field.

prerequisites.zh: 从 OpenAPI schema 和服务实现确认字段的 readOnly、writeOnly 与角色策略。
prerequisites.en: Confirm read Only, write Only, and role policy from the Open API schema and service implementation.

title.zh: 单一服务器管理属性检查

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/contracts/property/evaluate" -H "Authorization: Bearer lab-user-token" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: api-property-001" --data '{"display_name":"PROPERTY_CANARY_A1","review_tier":"elevated"}' | jq -e '.accepted.display_name == "PROPERTY_CANARY_A1" and (.rejected | index("review_tier"))'

description.zh: 向无副作用契约端点提交允许显示名与一个 review_tier，断言正常字段被接受且管理字段被拒绝。
description.en: Submit an allowed display name and one review_tier to a side-effect-free contract endpoint, asserting that the normal field is accepted and the managed field rejected.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明低权限主体提交的服务器管理属性进入领域或持久化状态。响应回显、schema 中存在字段、未知字段被静默丢弃或类型错误都不能单独证明批量赋值缺陷。
analysis.en: A positive requires a server-managed property submitted by a low-privilege principal to reach domain or persisted state. Reflection, schema visibility, silent dropping, and type errors do not independently prove a mass-assignment flaw.

opsecTips.zh: 使用 evaluate 端点和合成属性，不修改真实角色、密码、余额、配额或租户。
opsecTips.en: Use an evaluation endpoint and synthetic properties; never modify real roles, passwords, balances, quotas, or tenants.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只增加一个服务器管理字段，并保留请求前后状态摘要用于确认无副作用。
opsecTips.en: Add one server-managed property at a time and retain before-and-after state summaries to prove no side effects.

title.zh: 确认字段写入契约

description.zh: 从 schema 与实现记录允许字段、服务器管理字段和预期拒绝行为。
description.en: Record writable fields, server-managed fields, and expected rejection behavior from schema and implementation.

title.zh: 提交单一管理属性

description.zh: 在允许的显示名旁加入 review_tier，并请求无副作用契约评估结果。
description.en: Add review_tier beside an allowed display name and request the side-effect-free contract evaluation result.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/contracts/property/evaluate" -H "Authorization: Bearer lab-user-token" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: api-property-001" --data '{"display_name":"PROPERTY_CANARY_A1","review_tier":"elevated"}' | jq -e '.accepted.display_name == "PROPERTY_CANARY_A1" and (.rejected | index("review_tier"))'

title.zh: 核对映射与持久化边界

description.zh: 确认管理字段进入拒绝列表，并核对领域对象和持久化日志没有状态变化。
description.en: Confirm the managed field appears in the rejection list and no domain or persistence state changed.

title.zh: 应用 DTO 允许列表回归

description.zh: 使用专用 DTO 修复后重放平面、嵌套和类型变化样例，保持正常字段可写。
description.en: After dedicated DTO remediation, replay flat, nested, and type variants while preserving valid writable fields.

overview.zh: 属性级授权关注调用者能否读写对象中的具体字段，而不是能否访问整个对象。测试请求包含一个正常的 display_name 和一个实验用服务器管理 review_tier，服务只返回接受与拒绝字段列表，不修改真实账户。
overview.en: Property-level authorization concerns which fields a caller may read or write, not merely access to the whole object. The test combines an allowed display_name with a lab-only server-managed review_tier and returns accepted and rejected fields without modifying a real account.

vulnerability.zh: 当框架把请求对象自动绑定到持久化模型，或不同更新入口使用不一致的字段允许列表时，客户端可能覆盖角色、配额、租户或内部标志。隐藏字段、前端未展示字段和随机字段名都不是安全控制。
vulnerability.en: Automatic binding of request objects to persistence models, or inconsistent writable-field allowlists across update paths, can let clients overwrite roles, quotas, tenants, or internal flags. Hidden fields and omitted UI controls are not security boundaries.

exploitation.zh: 先提交仅含允许字段的请求，再加入一个服务器管理属性并保持其他值不变。比较 accepted、rejected、type_errors 与服务端映射日志；只有未授权字段真实进入领域对象或持久化层才算确认，返回回显或反序列化错误不算。
exploitation.en: Submit an allowed field first, then add one server-managed property while keeping all other values constant. Compare accepted, rejected, type_errors, and mapping logs. Confirmation requires the unauthorized property to reach the domain or persistence layer; reflection and deserialization errors are not enough.

mitigation.zh: 为每个操作定义专用输入 DTO 和显式可写字段允许列表，在业务层执行主体与属性策略，禁止请求模型直接绑定数据库实体。用 OpenAPI readOnly/writeOnly 标记辅助文档，但以服务端策略为准，并覆盖嵌套属性和类型混淆回归。
mitigation.en: Define operation-specific input DT Os and explicit writable-field allowlists, enforce principal and property policy in the service layer, and never bind request models directly to persistence entities. Treat Open API flags as documentation backed by server policy and regress nested and type-confusion cases.

name.zh: REST 对象级授权边界验证

description.zh: 使用两个固定实验主体和三个合成对象验证 REST 资源读取是否在每次请求中校验主体、租户、对象与操作关系。
description.en: Validate whether REST resource reads enforce principal, tenant, object, and action relationships on every request using two fixed lab identities and three synthetic objects.

prerequisites.zh: 准备两个权限明确的实验账户，并分别创建一个带固定 Canary 的测试对象。
prerequisites.en: Prepare two lab accounts with explicit privileges and create one fixed-canary test object for each account.

prerequisites.zh: 记录所有者读取、他人读取和不存在对象三种响应及对应服务端授权日志。
prerequisites.en: Record owner, non-owner, and missing-object responses together with the matching server authorization logs.

title.zh: 双主体对象读取对照

execution.command: for token in owner-a-token reviewer-b-token; do curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w "$token %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/documents/doc-owner-a" -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" -H "X-Request-ID: bola-boundary-001-$token"; done

description.zh: 以对象所有者和第二个低权限实验主体读取同一合成对象，只比较授权结果、状态与服务端请求 ID。
description.en: Read the same synthetic object as its owner and a second low-privilege lab principal, comparing only authorization outcomes, status, and server request IDs.

analysis.zh: 确认结果必须同时具备低权限主体、非其所有的对象、受保护字段真实返回和服务端授权证据。对象存在性差异、公开字段、缓存响应或统一错误页均不能单独证明 BOLA。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires a low-privilege principal, an object it does not own, actual protected fields, and server authorization evidence. Existence differences, public fields, cached responses, or generic error pages do not independently prove BOLA.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用专用测试租户、合成对象和固定 Canary，不访问任何真实用户对象。
opsecTips.en: Use only a dedicated test tenant, synthetic objects, and fixed canaries; never access real user objects.

opsecTips.zh: 限制为三个已知对象和两个主体，发现越权字段后立即停止并清理测试数据。
opsecTips.en: Limit the matrix to three known objects and two principals, stopping on protected-field disclosure and removing test data afterward.

title.zh: 建立所有者读取基线

description.zh: 由对象所有者读取固定测试对象，记录允许字段、响应状态和授权决策日志。
description.en: Have the owner read the fixed test object and record allowed fields, response status, and authorization-decision logs.

title.zh: 比较第二实验主体

description.zh: 重放受控双主体请求，只改变令牌并保持对象、方法与其他参数完全一致。
description.en: Replay the bounded two-principal request, changing only the token while keeping object, method, and all other parameters identical.

attackChain.payload: for token in owner-a-token reviewer-b-token; do curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w "$token %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/documents/doc-owner-a" -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" -H "X-Request-ID: bola-boundary-001-$token"; done

title.zh: 关联对象与授权证据

description.zh: 比较本人、他人和不存在对象结果，并用请求 ID 关联服务端授权与数据访问日志。
description.en: Compare self, peer, and missing-object results and correlate server authorization and data-access logs by request ID.

title.zh: 统一策略并执行回归

description.zh: 修复后重放四维授权矩阵，确认正常访问保留且所有越权读取稳定拒绝。
description.en: After remediation, replay the authorization matrix to preserve legitimate access and consistently reject unauthorized reads.

overview.zh: 对象级授权验证关注调用者是否有权操作请求中选定的具体对象。测试以所有者请求建立正常基线，再由第二个低权限主体只替换身份或对象标识，保持方法、路径结构和其他参数不变，并关联响应与授权日志。
overview.en: Object-level authorization validation asks whether the caller may act on the specific object selected by the request. Establish an owner baseline, then change only the identity or object identifier for a second low-privilege principal while correlating responses with authorization logs.

vulnerability.zh: 问题通常源于服务端只完成身份认证，随后直接按客户端对象 ID 查询资源，却没有验证对象所有权、租户归属和当前操作权限。可预测 ID 只是发现条件，不是根因；随机 UUID 也不能替代逐对象授权。
vulnerability.en: The issue usually occurs when a server authenticates the caller and then loads a client-selected object without checking ownership, tenant membership, or action permission. Predictable identifiers aid discovery but are not the root cause, and random UUIDs do not replace per-object authorization.

exploitation.zh: 在 localhost Fixture 中依次请求本人对象、另一实验主体对象和不存在对象，每次只改一个变量并保留唯一请求 ID。确认标准是低权限主体获得本应拒绝的对象字段，同时服务端日志显示缺失或错误的授权判定；单独的 200、响应长度差异或公开元数据不构成确认。
exploitation.en: Request a self-owned object, another lab principal's object, and a missing object from the localhost fixture, changing one variable per request and preserving a unique request ID. Confirmation requires unauthorized fields plus server evidence of a missing or incorrect authorization decision; status 200 or response-size differences alone are insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 在业务服务层按主体、租户、对象和操作执行默认拒绝策略，从已验证会话派生主体而不是接收客户端覆盖，并对所有读取和写入入口复用同一策略。为所有者、非所有者、跨租户和不存在对象建立回归矩阵。
mitigation.en: Enforce default-deny principal, tenant, object, and action policy in the business-service layer, derive identity from the verified session, and reuse the policy across every read and write entry point. Maintain owner, non-owner, cross-tenant, and missing-object regression cases.

name.zh: API 输入解释边界验证

description.zh: 使用固定无害 Canary 验证 API 输入是否保持数据语义，并把 SQL、结构化过滤、目录过滤和主机参数的解析编排迁入工具卡。
description.en: Use fixed harmless canaries to validate that API inputs remain data while moving SQL-shaped, structured-filter, directory-filter, and host-parameter orchestration into a tool card.

subCategory.zh: 输入验证与解释器边界

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅返回规范化结果和请求 ID 的 localhost 评估端点，不连接真实数据库或系统命令解释器。
prerequisites.en: Use localhost evaluation endpoints that return normalized input and request IDs without connecting to a real database or command interpreter.

prerequisites.zh: 准备普通字符串对照与固定 INPUT_CANARY，并启用最终查询或参数绑定日志。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a plain-string control and fixed INPUT_CANARY values with final-query or parameter-binding logs enabled.

title.zh: 单值输入解释边界

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/search/evaluate" -H "Authorization: Bearer lab-token" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: api-input-sqlshape-001" --data '{"query":"INPUT_CANARY_APOSTROPHE_A1\u0027"}' | jq -e '.request_id and .normalized_input'

description.zh: 向无副作用本地评估端点提交带单个撇号的固定 Canary，断言请求 ID 与规范化输入均可观察。
description.en: Submit a fixed canary with one apostrophe to a side-effect-free local evaluator and assert that request ID and normalized input are observable.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明输入改变了最终解释结构或后端操作，而不是仅触发错误、转义、拒绝或 WAF 命中。固定 Canary 不包含数据提取、文件路径或系统命令，因此证据聚焦输入边界本身。
analysis.en: A positive requires proof that the input changed the final interpreted structure or backend operation, not merely an error, escape, rejection, or WAF event. The fixed canary contains no extraction query, file path, or system command, keeping evidence focused on the input boundary.

opsecTips.zh: 只对无真实后端副作用的 evaluate 端点发送 Canary，并设置五秒超时。
opsecTips.en: Send canaries only to side-effect-free evaluation endpoints and enforce a five-second timeout.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只改变一个字符或输入形状，禁止附加数据提取和命令执行内容。
opsecTips.en: Change one character or input shape per request and never append data-extraction or command-execution content.

title.zh: 记录普通字符串基线

description.zh: 提交普通 Canary 并保存原始输入、规范化值、绑定参数与请求 ID。
description.en: Submit a plain canary and save raw input, normalized value, bound parameters, and request ID.

title.zh: 提交单一边界字符

description.zh: 重放同一请求，仅在固定 Canary 末尾加入一个撇号形状并观察解释差异。
description.en: Replay the same request with one apostrophe-shaped boundary added to the fixed canary and observe interpretation differences.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/search/evaluate" -H "Authorization: Bearer lab-token" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: api-input-sqlshape-001" --data '{"query":"INPUT_CANARY_APOSTROPHE_A1\u0027"}' | jq -e '.request_id and .normalized_input'

title.zh: 关联最终绑定结构

description.zh: 核对输入是否仍位于单一绑定参数中，并排除错误页、回显和编码差异。
description.en: Verify that the input remains one bound parameter and exclude error pages, reflection, and encoding differences.

title.zh: 参数化修复后复测

description.zh: 应用类型约束和参数绑定后重放普通值与 Canary，确认语义一致且业务输入可用。
description.en: After type constraints and parameter binding, replay the control and canary to confirm stable semantics and valid business input.

overview.zh: 本条只验证一个输入值跨越 API、解析器和后端绑定层时是否仍作为数据处理。使用带单个撇号形状的固定 Canary，与普通字符串基线比较规范化值、绑定参数和响应；其他解释器类型属于工具工作流，不混入同一 Payload。
overview.en: This card validates one input value as it crosses the API, parser, and backend binding layers while remaining data. Compare a fixed apostrophe-shaped canary with a plain control using normalized values, bound parameters, and responses; other interpreter types remain in the tool workflow.

vulnerability.zh: 漏洞根因是应用把不可信输入拼接到查询、过滤器、目录表达式或系统参数，或允许客户端对象直接变成后端操作符。仅出现错误、拒绝或字符被转义并不证明注入；需要看到输入改变最终解释结构或后端行为。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is concatenating untrusted input into queries, filters, directory expressions, or system arguments, or converting client objects directly into backend operators. Errors, rejection, or escaping alone do not prove injection; the input must alter the final interpreted structure or backend behavior.

exploitation.zh: 向本地评估端点分别提交普通值和固定 Canary，保持身份、内容类型与请求体结构不变。比较解析前字节、规范化结果、绑定参数和后端审计事件；禁止查询真实表、读取文件、执行命令或扩大到数据提取。
exploitation.en: Submit a plain value and fixed canary to the local evaluator while keeping identity, content type, and body shape constant. Compare raw bytes, normalization, bound parameters, and backend audit events without querying real tables, reading files, executing commands, or extracting data.

mitigation.zh: 为每个后端使用参数化查询或类型安全 API，按 schema 允许字段和操作符，并把系统调用拆分为固定可执行文件与参数数组。统一内容类型解析和规范化顺序，记录拒绝原因，并为普通值、边界字符和结构化对象建立回归。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries or type-safe APIs for every backend, allowlist schema fields and operators, and separate fixed executables from argument arrays. Unify content-type parsing and normalization order, log rejection reasons, and regress plain values, boundary characters, and structured objects.

name.zh: Spring SpEL 简单求值边界验证
name.en: Spring Sp EL Simple-Evaluation Boundary Validation

description.zh: 在 localhost SimpleEvaluationContext Fixture 中仅计算固定算术表达式，并断言类型访问和方法调用均关闭。
description.en: Evaluate one fixed arithmetic expression in a localhost Simple Evaluation Context fixture and assert that type access and method invocation are disabled.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 SimpleEvaluationContext 或等价最小上下文，关闭类型、方法、Bean 与类加载访问。
prerequisites.en: Use Simple Evaluation Context or an equivalent minimal context with type, method, bean, and class-loading access disabled.

prerequisites.zh: Fixture 只接受固定算术表达式并返回 result 与能力标志。
prerequisites.en: Configure the fixture to accept only a fixed arithmetic expression and return the result plus capability flags.

title.zh: SpEL 简单算术上下文

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/spel/evaluate" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: spel-simple-001" --data '{"expression":"7 * 7","mode":"simple"}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .type_access == false and .method_invocation == false'

description.zh: 在本地 simple 模式计算固定算术，并断言类型访问与方法调用能力均关闭。
description.en: Evaluate fixed arithmetic in local simple mode and assert that type access and method invocation capabilities are both disabled.

analysis.zh: 算术返回 49 只证明存在求值路径。只有不可信输入能访问超出业务需要的类型、方法、Bean 或敏感对象才构成安全问题。本批明确断言高风险能力关闭，并不尝试命令、文件或网络。
analysis.en: Arithmetic result 49 proves an evaluation path only. A security issue requires untrusted input to access types, methods, beans, or sensitive objects beyond business need. This batch asserts risky capabilities are disabled and attempts no command, file, or network action.

opsecTips.zh: 表达式固定为纯算术，禁止类名、方法名、路径、主机、反射或脚本引擎。
opsecTips.en: Keep the expression purely arithmetic with no class names, methods, paths, hosts, reflection, or script engines.

opsecTips.zh: Fixture 五秒超时、无网络出口，并只保存结果与能力标志。
opsecTips.en: Use a five-second no-egress fixture and retain only the result and capability flags.

title.zh: 确认简单求值能力

description.zh: 记录上下文类型、属性访问器和所有禁用的高风险能力。
description.en: Record context type, property accessors, and every disabled high-risk capability.

title.zh: 提交固定算术表达式

description.zh: 向 localhost Fixture 提交 7*7，并要求返回结果和能力标志。
description.en: Submit 7*7 to the localhost fixture and require the result plus capability flags.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/spel/evaluate" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: spel-simple-001" --data '{"expression":"7 * 7","mode":"simple"}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .type_access == false and .method_invocation == false'

title.zh: 核对策略与求值日志

description.zh: 将请求与上下文创建、类型拒绝和方法禁用日志关联。
description.en: Correlate the request with context creation, type rejection, and method-disable logs.

title.zh: 最小上下文回归

description.zh: 更新策略后重放算术与无效类型引用，确认业务计算保留且危险能力拒绝。
description.en: After policy updates, replay arithmetic and an invalid type reference to preserve business evaluation and deny dangerous capabilities.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 只证明业务是否在预期的简单上下文中执行算术，不尝试 Runtime、ProcessBuilder、文件、DNS、反射或 ScriptEngine。结果 49 与两个能力标志共同构成配置证据，不能单凭回显数字判断任意 SpEL 注入。
overview.en: This payload proves only that arithmetic runs in the intended simple context and never attempts Runtime, Process Builder, files, DNS, reflection, or Script Engine. Result 49 plus capability flags provide configuration evidence; a reflected number alone does not establish arbitrary Sp EL injection.

vulnerability.zh: 风险源于将不可信表达式放入 StandardEvaluationContext 或开放类型解析、方法调用、Bean 解析与反射能力。表达式语法被识别只是前提，真正影响取决于可用上下文对象与能力，模板插值和 SpEL 也不能混为一谈。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when untrusted expressions enter Standard Evaluation Context or gain type resolution, method invocation, bean resolution, or reflection. Recognized syntax is only a precondition; impact depends on available context objects and capabilities, and template interpolation should not be conflated with Sp EL.

exploitation.zh: 向本地 evaluate 端点提交固定 7*7 和 mode=simple，断言 result=49、type_access=false、method_invocation=false，并关联策略文件。禁止改为类引用、构造器、系统命令、文件路径、网络主机或混淆表达式。
exploitation.en: Submit fixed 7*7 with mode=simple and assert result=49, type_access=false, and method_invocation=false while correlating the policy file. Do not substitute class references, constructors, system commands, file paths, hosts, or obfuscated expressions.

mitigation.zh: 避免求值不可信表达式；必须支持表达式时使用 SimpleEvaluationContext、受限属性访问器和明确变量，并禁用类型定位、构造器、方法与 Bean 解析。对表达式长度、复杂度和超时设限并记录拒绝。
mitigation.en: Avoid evaluating untrusted expressions. When expressions are required, use Simple Evaluation Context, restricted property accessors, and explicit variables while disabling type location, constructors, methods, and bean resolution. Bound length, complexity, and time and log rejection.

name.zh: Spring Cloud Gateway 管理端点访问验证
name.en: Spring Cloud Gateway Management-Endpoint Access Validation

description.zh: 验证低权限实验主体对 localhost Gateway routes 管理端点的访问是否被拒绝或关闭，不创建、刷新或修改路由。
description.en: Validate that a low-privilege lab principal is denied or cannot reach the localhost Gateway routes management endpoint without creating, refreshing, or changing routes.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定 Spring Cloud Gateway 版本的本地 Fixture，并清空真实后端路由。
prerequisites.en: Use a local fixture with a fixed Spring Cloud Gateway version and no real backend routes.

prerequisites.zh: 准备低权限实验令牌并记录 routes 端点应返回 401、403 或 404。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a low-privilege lab token and record that the routes endpoint should return 401, 403, or 404.

title.zh: Gateway routes 低权限访问检查

execution.command: code=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:18080/actuator/gateway/routes" -H "Authorization: Bearer spring-user-token" -H "X-Request-ID: spring-cloud-gateway-001"); printf '%s\n' "$code"; test "$code" = 401 -o "$code" = 403 -o "$code" = 404

description.zh: 以低权限实验令牌只读请求 routes 管理端点，并断言返回 401、403 或 404。
description.en: Request the routes management endpoint read-only with a low-privilege lab token and assert 401, 403, or 404.

analysis.zh: 401、403 或 404 与授权日志一致时为阴性；200 只说明读取暴露，还需确认内容与写权限才能定级。本批不创建路由、不触发 SpEL，也不验证 RCE，因此结论严格限定为管理端点访问策略。
analysis.en: Consistent 401, 403, or 404 with authorization logs is negative. Status 200 establishes read exposure only and requires content and write-permission analysis. This batch creates no route, triggers no Sp EL, and makes no RCE claim.

opsecTips.zh: 只执行一次 GET，不发送 POST、DELETE、refresh 或任何表达式 Header。
opsecTips.en: 只执行一次 GET，不发送 POST、DELETE、refresh 或任何表达式 Header。

opsecTips.zh: Fixture 不连接真实服务发现和后端路由，令牌仅用于 localhost。
opsecTips.en: Keep the fixture disconnected from real service discovery and backend routes, with a localhost-only token.

title.zh: 记录 Gateway 版本与端点策略
title.en: Record Gateway version and endpoint policy

description.zh: 登记 JAR 版本、routes 暴露配置和低权限角色预期结果。
description.en: Register JAR version, routes exposure configuration, and expected low-privilege outcome.

title.zh: 请求只读 routes 状态

description.zh: 向 localhost 发送一次带低权限令牌的 GET，并断言拒绝或关闭。
description.en: Send one low-privilege GET to localhost and assert denial or endpoint absence.

attackChain.payload: code=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:18080/actuator/gateway/routes" -H "Authorization: Bearer spring-user-token" -H "X-Request-ID: spring-cloud-gateway-001"); printf '%s\n' "$code"; test "$code" = 401 -o "$code" = 403 -o "$code" = 404

title.zh: 关联 Spring Security 决策

description.zh: 将状态码与认证主体、授权规则和访问日志按请求 ID 对齐。
description.en: Align status with principal, authorization rule, and access logs by request ID.

title.zh: 升级并收紧暴露后复测
title.en: Retest after upgrade and exposure hardening

description.zh: 升级组件并限制管理端点后重放请求，确认业务路由不受影响。
description.en: After component upgrade and management hardening, replay the request and confirm business routing remains available.

overview.zh: 该边界只读取 Gateway routes 管理端点的状态，不发送 routing-expression、SpEL、路由 JSON 或 refresh 请求。它用于验证管理端点是否对低权限主体关闭，版本清单与 Actuator 状态由工具卡维护。
overview.en: This boundary reads only the status of the Gateway routes management endpoint and sends no routing expression, Sp EL, route JSON, or refresh request. It validates that low-privilege access is denied while version inventory and Actuator status remain in diagnostics.

vulnerability.zh: Spring Cloud 历史问题通常依赖特定版本、管理端点暴露和危险输入路径。routes 端点存在并不自动等于 RCE；必须有未授权写操作、表达式进入危险求值上下文或其他受影响组件条件。
vulnerability.en: Historical Spring Cloud issues depend on specific versions, exposed management endpoints, and dangerous input paths. A routes endpoint does not automatically imply RCE; unauthorized writes, dangerous expression evaluation, or another affected component condition is required.

exploitation.zh: 以低权限令牌对 localhost routes 端点发送一次 GET，只记录状态码和服务端授权日志。安全预期为 401、403 或 404。禁止创建恶意路由、刷新网关、使用 Runtime 表达式、路径遍历或 Eureka 内网地址。
exploitation.en: Send one GET to the localhost routes endpoint with a low-privilege token and record status plus authorization logs. Expect 401, 403, or 404. Do not create routes, refresh the gateway, use Runtime expressions, traverse paths, or submit internal Eureka addresses.

mitigation.zh: 升级 Spring Cloud 受影响组件，只暴露必要 Actuator 端点，并使用 Spring Security 对 Gateway 管理端点执行最小角色授权。关闭不需要的路由写操作，限制表达式上下文与网络出口，并将版本和端点策略纳入 CI。
mitigation.en: Upgrade affected Spring Cloud components, expose only required Actuator endpoints, and enforce least-privilege Spring Security roles for Gateway management. Disable unnecessary route writes, restrict expression contexts and egress, and regress versions plus endpoint policy in CI.

name.zh: Struts2 OGNL 简单求值边界验证

description.zh: 在 localhost Struts Fixture 中仅提交固定算术 OGNL，验证结果并断言静态方法和进程启动能力关闭。
description.en: Submit one fixed arithmetic OGNL expression to a localhost Struts fixture and validate the result while asserting static-method and process-start capabilities are disabled.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定 Struts2 版本和受限 OGNL Fixture，不加载文件或命令执行辅助类。
prerequisites.en: Use a fixed Struts2 version and restricted OGNL fixture without file or command-execution helper classes.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 excludedClasses、excludedPackageNames 与静态方法访问设置。
prerequisites.en: Record excluded Classes, excluded Package Names, and static-method-access settings.

title.zh: OGNL 算术与能力检查

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/struts-lab/evaluate" -H "X-Request-ID: struts-ognl-simple-001" --data-urlencode 'value=%{7*7}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .static_method_access == false and .process_start == false'

description.zh: 向本地受限求值器提交固定算术，断言结果为 49 且静态方法和进程启动能力关闭。
description.en: Submit fixed arithmetic to the restricted local evaluator and assert result 49 with static-method and process-start capabilities disabled.

analysis.zh: 结果 49 仅说明表达式被求值，不证明可访问 Runtime 或文件系统。阳性需要静态方法、成员访问或危险对象边界被突破；本批明确验证这些能力为 false，并退休所有执行与规避内容。
analysis.en: Result 49 establishes expression evaluation only, not access to Runtime or the filesystem. A positive requires a static-method, member-access, or dangerous-object boundary breach; this batch asserts those capabilities false and retires execution plus evasion material.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用固定算术表达式，不修改 MemberAccess、排除类、响应流或文件。
opsecTips.en: Use one fixed arithmetic expression without changing Member Access, exclusions, response streams, or files.

opsecTips.zh: 容器无网络出口和业务数据，五秒超时后清理求值日志。
opsecTips.en: Keep the container free of egress and business data, enforcing five seconds and clearing evaluation logs.

title.zh: 固定 Struts 与 OGNL 策略

description.zh: 记录 Struts 版本、成员访问、排除类和允许绑定字段。
description.en: Record Struts version, member access, excluded classes, and allowed binding fields.

title.zh: 提交算术 OGNL Canary

description.zh: 向 localhost Fixture 提交 7*7，只读取结果与能力标志。
description.en: Submit 7*7 to the localhost fixture and read only the result and capability flags.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/struts-lab/evaluate" -H "X-Request-ID: struts-ognl-simple-001" --data-urlencode 'value=%{7*7}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .static_method_access == false and .process_start == false'

title.zh: 关联成员访问日志

description.zh: 按请求 ID 核对求值、静态方法拒绝和无进程启动事件。
description.en: Use the request ID to verify evaluation, static-method denial, and absence of process starts.

title.zh: 升级并回归绑定边界

description.zh: 升级后重放正常字段和算术值，确认业务绑定保留且高风险能力关闭。
description.en: After upgrade, replay normal fields and arithmetic to preserve business binding while risky capabilities remain disabled.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 只测试一个 7*7 算术表达式，并要求服务端报告 static_method_access=false 与 process_start=false。它不清除排除类、不替换 MemberAccess、不调用 Runtime、ProcessBuilder、文件或反射。
overview.en: This payload tests one 7*7 arithmetic expression and requires static_method_access=false plus process_start=false. It does not clear exclusions, replace Member Access, or invoke Runtime, Process Builder, files, or reflection.

vulnerability.zh: Struts2 历史 OGNL 问题常由不可信请求值进入表达式求值，加上成员访问或排除策略可被绕过。单纯支持 OGNL 和算术并不等于 RCE；必须证明主体可越过成员访问边界到达危险类型或方法。
vulnerability.en: Historical Struts2 OGNL issues combine untrusted request values reaching evaluation with bypassable member-access or exclusion policy. OGNL support and arithmetic alone are not RCE; the principal must cross member-access boundaries into dangerous types or methods.

exploitation.zh: 向本地 evaluate 端点提交固定算术值，记录 result、静态方法能力、进程启动能力和请求 ID。随后核对策略文件中的版本与排除设置。禁止 MemberAccess 重置、Runtime、文件操作、字符编码变体或反射调用。
exploitation.en: Submit the fixed arithmetic value to the local evaluator and record result, static-method capability, process-start capability, and request ID. Check version and exclusions in the policy file without Member Access resets, Runtime, file operations, encoding variants, or reflection.

mitigation.zh: 升级到 Apache Struts 公告支持版本，避免把不可信字符串作为 OGNL 求值，保持成员访问限制、排除类与包设置，并使用允许字段的数据绑定。对异常表达式、静态方法请求和求值错误建立审计及回归。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to an Apache-supported Struts version, avoid evaluating untrusted strings as OGNL, preserve member-access restrictions and class/package exclusions, and use allowlisted data binding. Audit and regress anomalous expressions, static-method requests, and evaluation errors.

name.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归
name.en: Think PHP Version and Route-Execution Regression

description.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归保留可复现的攻击样例与绕过变体，仅修正已确认失效、占位或事实混淆的内容。所有样例只用于可回滚的授权实验，并要求浏览器、解析器、代理或服务端日志与可见结果一致。
description.en: Think PHP Version and Route-Execution Regression preserves reproducible attack samples and bypass variants while correcting only confirmed obsolete, placeholder, or factually conflated content. Every sample is restricted to a reversible authorized lab and requires browser, parser, proxy, or server logs to agree with the visible result.

subCategory.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归
subCategory.en: Think PHP Version and Route-Execution Regression

prerequisites.zh: 确认 ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Think PHP Version and Route-Execution Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.en: Remove narrative text mixed into the command block while preserving the original Think PHP Version and Route-Execution Regression payload or protocol syntax; use the tutorial and attack chain for prerequisites, evidence, and stop conditions.

description.en: Remove narrative text mixed into the command block while preserving the original Think PHP Version and Route-Execution Regression payload or protocol syntax; use the tutorial and attack chain for prerequisites, evidence, and stop conditions.

analysis.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Think PHP 版本与路由执行回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: 运行 ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归 单一授权样例
title.en: Run One Authorized Think PHP Version and Route-Execution Regression Sample

description.en: Run only the first authorized-lab sample at a time and preserve the raw request, response, final parsed result, and matching logs; validate remaining variants one by one only after establishing the baseline.

title.en: 关联 Think PHP 版本与路由执行回归 的服务端证据

description.zh: 把唯一标记与解析器、代理、应用、数据库或浏览器证据按时间关联，并排除回显、缓存、重试、客户端修改和统一错误页。
description.en: Correlate the unique marker over time with parser, proxy, application, database, or browser evidence while excluding reflection, caching, retries, client modification, and generic error pages.

title.zh: 修复 ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归 并重放基线
title.en: Remediate Think PHP Version and Route-Execution Regression and Replay the Baseline

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归聚焦以下边界：先固定框架版本、路由和补丁状态，再用无害标记验证特定动态调用边界，不泛化到所有 ThinkPHP。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Think PHP Version and Route-Execution Regression focuses on this boundary: Pins framework version, route, and patch status before using a harmless marker on a specific dynamic-call boundary without generalizing to every Think PHP deployment. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 框架名称本身不是漏洞。有效结论必须绑定精确版本、启用组件、路由、配置和补丁状态，并证明不可信输入到达具体的 ORM、调试、签名、模板、反序列化或动态调用边界。不同 CVE 和配置问题不能拼成通用执行链。
vulnerability.en: A framework name is not a vulnerability. A valid conclusion binds the exact version, enabled component, route, configuration, and patch state and proves that untrusted input reaches a specific ORM, debug, signing, template, deserialization, or dynamic-call boundary. Different CVEs and configuration issues cannot be combined into one universal execution chain.

exploitation.zh: 在可回滚框架夹具中记录版本、依赖锁文件、路由与正常响应，再发送只返回 PAYLOADER_FRAMEWORK 标记的单变量样例。阳性需要版本条件、服务端堆栈或审计日志和标记结果一致；错误页、公开版本头或客户端响应修改均不足。
exploitation.en: Record version, dependency lock file, route, and normal response in a reversible framework fixture, then send one single-variable sample that returns only a PAYLOADER_FRAMEWORK marker. A positive result requires matching version prerequisites, server stack or audit logs, and marker output; an error page, public version header, or client-side response edit is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 升级到供应商支持版本并应用安全补丁，关闭生产调试与动态调用，保护签名密钥，限制允许类型、路由参数和静态文件根目录。将依赖版本与安全配置纳入 CI，并使用相同正常和标记请求验证业务保留且边界差异消失。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a vendor-supported release and apply security patches; disable production debug and dynamic calls; protect signing keys; and constrain allowed types, route parameters, and static roots. Gate dependency versions and security settings in CI, then replay the same normal and marker requests to preserve behavior while removing the boundary difference.

description.en: Laravel Configuration and Deserialization Regression preserves reproducible attack samples and bypass variants while correcting only confirmed obsolete, placeholder, or factually conflated content. Every sample is restricted to a reversible authorized lab and requires browser, parser, proxy, or server logs to agree with the visible result.

name.zh: JBoss 管理界面访问边界验证

description.zh: 验证 localhost JBoss 或 WildFly 实验实例的旧 JMX Console 是否关闭或要求认证，并将 Invoker、版本和管理资源诊断迁入工具卡。
description.en: Validate whether a localhost J Boss or Wild Fly lab protects or disables the legacy JMX Console while moving Invoker, version, and management-resource diagnostics into a tool card.

prerequisites.zh: 启动无业务数据的 jboss-lab 容器，并只将实验 HTTP 端口绑定到 127.0.0.1。
prerequisites.en: Start a data-free jboss-lab container and bind its laboratory HTTP port to 127.0.0.1 only.

prerequisites.zh: 记录预期管理路径、认证方式、管理 Realm 和已安装版本。
prerequisites.en: Record expected management paths, authentication method, management realm, and installed version.

title.zh: JMX Console 匿名访问检查

description.zh: 无凭据请求 localhost JMX Console，并只接受 401、403 或 404 作为安全访问基线。
description.en: Request the localhost JMX Console without credentials and accept only 401, 403, or 404 as the secure access baseline.

analysis.zh: 确认风险需要匿名主体可到达受保护管理操作；端点返回 200、产品指纹或登录页都只是暴露线索。401、403、404 与服务端 Realm 日志一致时属于阴性，不能用部署或命令执行去扩大证明。
analysis.en: Risk confirmation requires an anonymous principal to reach a protected management operation. Status 200, a product fingerprint, or a login page is only an exposure lead. Consistent 401, 403, or 404 with realm logs is negative and should not be escalated through deployment or command execution.

opsecTips.zh: 只访问容器根管理路径，不调用任何 deploy、invoke、upload 或脚本接口。
opsecTips.en: Access only root management paths and never call deploy, invoke, upload, or scripting interfaces.

opsecTips.zh: 容器仅绑定 localhost，使用合成 Realm，测试后删除访问日志中的令牌与 Cookie。
opsecTips.en: Bind the container to localhost, use a synthetic realm, and remove tokens and cookies from access logs afterward.

title.zh: 确认管理面实验范围

description.zh: 记录容器端口、管理 Realm、版本和预期关闭或认证的路径。
description.en: Record container port, management realm, version, and paths expected to be disabled or authenticated.

title.zh: 请求 JMX Console 根路径

description.zh: 无凭据请求 localhost JMX Console，只验证访问策略和状态码。
description.en: Request the localhost JMX Console without credentials and evaluate access policy and status only.

attackChain.payload: code=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:18080/jmx-console/" -H "X-Request-ID: jboss-console-001"); printf '%s\n' "$code"; test "$code" = 401 -o "$code" = 403 -o "$code" = 404

title.zh: 关联认证和访问日志

description.zh: 用请求 ID 核对 Realm 决策、重定向和实际处理模块，排除代理默认页。
description.en: Use the request ID to correlate realm decisions, redirects, and the serving module, excluding proxy default pages.

title.zh: 关闭旧应用后复测

description.zh: 移除旧 Console 或启用认证后重放请求，确认管理面不再匿名可达。
description.en: After removing the legacy console or enabling authentication, replay the request and confirm anonymous access is unavailable.

overview.zh: 本条只验证旧 JMX Console 的访问控制状态。请求不携带凭据、不调用部署操作，仅接受 401、403 或 404 作为安全基线，并通过服务端访问日志确认请求到达正确实例。其他 Invoker 与 CLI 信息属于工具诊断。
overview.en: This card validates access control for the legacy JMX Console. It sends no credentials and invokes no deployment operation, accepting 401, 403, or 404 as the secure baseline while correlating the request with server access logs. Invoker and CLI checks belong to diagnostics.

vulnerability.zh: 旧 JBoss 管理与 Invoker 接口若暴露到不受信网络且缺少认证，可能允许管理操作、序列化入口或部署能力。端点存在并不等于可利用，必须确认未认证主体能执行受保护管理动作；版本和模块状态决定具体风险。
vulnerability.en: 旧 JBoss 管理与 Invoker 接口若暴露到不受信网络且缺少认证，可能允许管理操作、序列化入口或部署能力。端点存在并不等于可利用，必须确认未认证主体能执行受保护管理动作；版本和模块状态决定具体风险。

exploitation.zh: 向 localhost 的 jmx-console 根路径发送一次无认证 GET，记录状态码、WWW-Authenticate、重定向和访问日志。不要提交序列化对象、调用 MainDeployer、上传 WAR 或执行 BeanShell。若返回 200，也只继续检查静态登录页而不触发操作。
exploitation.en: Send one unauthenticated GET to the localhost jmx-console root and record status, WWW-Authenticate, redirects, and access logs. Do not submit serialized objects, call Main Deployer, upload WAR files, or run Bean Shell. A 200 response warrants static-page review only.

mitigation.zh: 升级到受支持 WildFly 或 JBoss EAP，删除不需要的旧 Console 与 Invoker 应用，将管理接口绑定专用地址并启用强认证和角色控制。用防火墙限制管理端口，并在每次升级后回归未认证访问和管理操作授权。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to supported Wild Fly or J Boss EAP, remove unused legacy Console and Invoker applications, bind management interfaces to dedicated addresses, and enforce strong authentication plus roles. Restrict management ports and regress unauthenticated access after upgrades.

name.zh: Tomcat Manager 访问控制边界验证

description.zh: 无凭据请求 localhost Tomcat Manager，验证返回 401、403 或 404，并将 AJP 配置和方法策略迁入工具诊断。
description.en: Request the localhost Tomcat Manager without credentials, validate a 401, 403, or 404 response, and move AJP configuration plus method policy into diagnostics.

subCategory.zh: Tomcat 管理与连接器安全

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅含合成应用的 tomcat-lab 容器，并将 HTTP 与 AJP 绑定到本机。
prerequisites.en: Use a tomcat-lab container with synthetic applications and bind HTTP plus AJP to the local host.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 Manager 是否安装、允许来源、认证 Realm 和预期匿名状态。
prerequisites.en: Record whether Manager is installed, allowed sources, authentication realm, and expected anonymous status.

title.zh: Tomcat Manager 匿名访问检查

description.zh: 无凭据请求本地 Manager 根页面，并断言 401、403 或 404，不尝试任何账户。
description.en: Request the local Manager root without credentials and assert 401, 403, or 404 without trying any account.

analysis.zh: 匿名 200 需要进一步确认是否是真实 Manager 和是否提供管理操作；401、403、404 与日志一致时为阴性。本批不尝试凭据、部署、AJP 文件读取、PUT 写入或文件名规避。
analysis.en: Anonymous status 200 requires confirmation that the page is the real Manager and exposes management operations; aligned 401, 403, or 404 is negative. This batch attempts no credentials, deployment, AJP file read, PUT write, or filename evasion.

opsecTips.zh: 不使用用户名、密码、Hydra、WAR、JSP 或 PUT 请求。
opsecTips.en: Use no usernames, passwords, Hydra, WAR, JSP, or PUT requests.

opsecTips.zh: 容器只含合成应用，AJP 配置只读且端口不暴露到外部网络。
opsecTips.en: Keep only synthetic apps in the container, inspect AJP read-only, and expose no AJP port externally.

title.zh: 记录 Manager 与 Realm 基线

description.zh: 登记 Manager 安装状态、允许地址、Realm 和匿名预期结果。
description.en: Register Manager installation, allowed addresses, realm, and expected anonymous outcome.

title.zh: 发送匿名 Manager 请求

description.zh: 只请求 localhost /manager/html，并断言 401、403 或 404。
description.en: Request only localhost /manager/html and assert 401, 403, or 404.

attackChain.payload: code=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:18080/manager/html" -H "X-Request-ID: tomcat-manager-001"); printf '%s\n' "$code"; test "$code" = 401 -o "$code" = 403 -o "$code" = 404

title.zh: 关联 Realm 与访问日志

description.zh: 按请求 ID 核对认证挑战、RemoteAddrValve 和实际 Context。
description.en: Correlate authentication challenge, Remote Addr Valve, and actual Context by request ID.

title.zh: 收紧管理面后复测

description.zh: 移除 Manager 或限制来源后重放匿名与授权管理员两个对照。
description.en: After removing Manager or restricting sources, replay anonymous and authorized-admin controls.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 只验证匿名主体是否能进入 Manager 根页面，不尝试用户名、密码、WAR 上传或部署。安全基线为 401、403 或 404，并需与 Realm 和 RemoteAddrValve 日志一致；AJP 与默认 Servlet 方法属于工具诊断。
overview.en: This payload validates whether an anonymous principal can reach the Manager root without usernames, passwords, WAR upload, or deployment. The secure baseline is 401, 403, or 404 aligned with realm and Remote Addr Valve logs; AJP and Default Servlet methods belong to diagnostics.

vulnerability.zh: Tomcat 风险可能来自 Manager 弱认证、AJP 暴露和错误 secret 配置、或默认 Servlet 写方法开启。它们具有不同根因，不能用一个 WebShell 流程代表。Manager 页面存在也不是漏洞，只有未授权管理能力或弱凭据得到确认才成立。
vulnerability.en: Tomcat risks may involve weak Manager authentication, exposed AJP with incorrect secret settings, or writable Default Servlet methods. These have different causes and cannot be represented by one webshell flow. Manager presence is not a flaw without unauthorized management capability or confirmed weak credentials.

exploitation.zh: 无凭据请求 localhost /manager/html，一次记录状态、认证 Header 和访问日志。不要猜测常见密码、上传 WAR、读取 WEB-INF、发送 PUT 或构造 JSP 文件名。AJP 配置只通过容器内 server.xml 读取。
exploitation.en: Request localhost /manager/html once without credentials and record status, authentication header, and access logs. Do not guess passwords, upload WAR files, read WEB-INF, send PUT, or craft JSP filenames. Inspect AJP through container-local server.xml only.

mitigation.zh: 删除不需要的 Manager，限制到管理网段并使用强认证与最小角色。升级 Tomcat，禁用不需要的 AJP 或绑定回环地址并设置 secretRequired 与随机 secret，保持 DefaultServlet readonly，并按配置回归访问和方法。
mitigation.en: Remove unnecessary Manager, restrict it to management networks, and use strong authentication plus least roles. Upgrade Tomcat, disable unused AJP or bind it to loopback with secret Required and a random secret, keep Default Servlet readonly, and regress access plus methods.

name.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归

description.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归保留可复现的攻击样例与绕过变体，仅修正已确认失效、占位或事实混淆的内容。所有样例只用于可回滚的授权实验，并要求浏览器、解析器、代理或服务端日志与可见结果一致。
description.en: Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression preserves reproducible attack samples and bypass variants while correcting only confirmed obsolete, placeholder, or factually conflated content. Every sample is restricted to a reversible authorized lab and requires browser, parser, proxy, or server logs to agree with the visible result.

subCategory.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Django 版本与安全配置回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.en: Remove narrative text mixed into the command block while preserving the original Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression payload or protocol syntax; use the tutorial and attack chain for prerequisites, evidence, and stop conditions.

analysis.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Django 版本与安全配置回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: 确认 Django 版本与安全配置回归 的适用入口
title.en: Confirm the Applicable Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression Entry Point

description.zh: 记录 Django 版本与安全配置回归 的组件版本、输入位置、执行主体、正常请求与服务端日志，确认当前夹具满足该技术的真实前置条件。
description.en: Record the component version, input location, execution principal, normal request, and server logs for Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression, confirming that the fixture satisfies its actual prerequisites.

title.zh: 运行 Django 版本与安全配置回归 单一授权样例
title.en: Run One Authorized Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression Sample

description.zh: 一次只运行第一条授权实验样例，并保存原始请求、响应、最终解析结果和对应日志；确认基线后再逐个验证其余变体。
description.en: Run only the first authorized-lab sample at a time and preserve the raw request, response, final parsed result, and matching logs; validate remaining variants one by one only after establishing the baseline.

title.zh: 关联 Django 版本与安全配置回归 的服务端证据
title.en: 关联 Django 版本与安全配置回归 的服务端证据

description.zh: 把唯一标记与解析器、代理、应用、数据库或浏览器证据按时间关联，并排除回显、缓存、重试、客户端修改和统一错误页。
description.en: Correlate the unique marker over time with parser, proxy, application, database, or browser evidence while excluding reflection, caching, retries, client modification, and generic error pages.

title.zh: 修复 Django 版本与安全配置回归 并重放基线
title.en: Remediate Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression and Replay the Baseline

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归聚焦以下边界：按具体 Django 版本核对 ORM、DEBUG、签名和静态文件边界，不把不同版本问题拼成通用利用链。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression focuses on this boundary: Checks ORM, DEBUG, signing, and static-file boundaries for a specific Django version without combining unrelated version issues into a universal chain. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 框架名称本身不是漏洞。有效结论必须绑定精确版本、启用组件、路由、配置和补丁状态，并证明不可信输入到达具体的 ORM、调试、签名、模板、反序列化或动态调用边界。不同 CVE 和配置问题不能拼成通用执行链。
vulnerability.en: A framework name is not a vulnerability. A valid conclusion binds the exact version, enabled component, route, configuration, and patch state and proves that untrusted input reaches a specific ORM, debug, signing, template, deserialization, or dynamic-call boundary. Different CVEs and configuration issues cannot be combined into one universal execution chain.

exploitation.zh: 在可回滚框架夹具中记录版本、依赖锁文件、路由与正常响应，再发送只返回 PAYLOADER_FRAMEWORK 标记的单变量样例。阳性需要版本条件、服务端堆栈或审计日志和标记结果一致；错误页、公开版本头或客户端响应修改均不足。
exploitation.en: Record version, dependency lock file, route, and normal response in a reversible framework fixture, then send one single-variable sample that returns only a PAYLOADER_FRAMEWORK marker. A positive result requires matching version prerequisites, server stack or audit logs, and marker output; an error page, public version header, or client-side response edit is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 升级到供应商支持版本并应用安全补丁，关闭生产调试与动态调用，保护签名密钥，限制允许类型、路由参数和静态文件根目录。将依赖版本与安全配置纳入 CI，并使用相同正常和标记请求验证业务保留且边界差异消失。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a vendor-supported release and apply security patches; disable production debug and dynamic calls; protect signing keys; and constrain allowed types, route parameters, and static roots. Gate dependency versions and security settings in CI, then replay the same normal and marker requests to preserve behavior while removing the boundary difference.

name.zh: Flask Jinja 求值边界验证

description.zh: 把宽泛的 Flask 漏洞合集拆成 Jinja 表达式求值 Payload 与 Flask 配置诊断工具，删除 Session 伪造、调试控制台执行和 PIN 推导内容。
description.en: Split the broad Flask vulnerability collection into Jinja expression-evaluation payloads and Flask configuration diagnostics, removing session forgery, debug-console execution, and PIN derivation.

subCategory.zh: Flask 与 Jinja 模板边界

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 Flask Fixture，模板只渲染合成 name 参数并以 JSON 返回结果。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 Flask fixture, rendering only a synthetic name parameter and returning the result as JSON.

prerequisites.zh: 准备可读取配置但不会打印 SECRET_KEY 值的本地应用上下文，并确保 debug=False。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a local application context that can inspect configuration without printing the SECRET_KEY value and ensure debug=False.

title.zh: Jinja 算术求值 Marker

description.zh: 对本地 render Fixture 提交 {{7*7}}，并断言 JSON 返回 49 和匹配的 request_id。
description.en: Submit {{7*7}} to the local render fixture and assert that JSON returns 49 with the matching request_id.

analysis.zh: 只有输入表达式被稳定求值且能关联到模板源构造点时才确认 SSTI 边界。调试器返回 404、SECRET_KEY 已配置或响应出现数字都不是同一结论；每类风险必须有独立证据。
analysis.en: Confirm the SSTI boundary only when input expressions are evaluated consistently and can be mapped to template-source construction. A debugger 404, a configured SECRET_KEY, or a numeric response are not the same finding; each risk needs independent evidence.

opsecTips.zh: Payload 仅使用算术与字符串 marker，禁止对象遍历、文件读取、环境变量访问和命令执行。
opsecTips.en: Payloads use arithmetic and string markers only; object traversal, file reads, environment access, and command execution are excluded.

opsecTips.zh: 配置诊断只输出布尔值、长度和路由名，不打印 SECRET_KEY、Cookie、PIN 或用户数据。
opsecTips.en: Configuration diagnostics output booleans, lengths, and route names only, never SECRET_KEY values, cookies, PINs, or user data.

title.zh: Jinja 字符串拼接 Marker

description.zh: 提交无对象访问的字符串拼接表达式，用第二种语义确认模板求值并排除硬编码响应。
description.en: Submit a string-concatenation expression without object access to confirm evaluation with a second semantic and exclude hard-coded responses.

title.zh: 建立字面输出基线

description.zh: 提交普通 name 值并记录 JSON、request_id 和模板渲染日志的正常结果。
description.en: Submit a plain name value and record normal JSON, request_id, and template-rendering logs.

title.zh: 提交无副作用表达式

description.zh: 使用算术 marker 判断输入被当作模板源还是普通变量，不访问任何对象属性。
description.en: Use an arithmetic marker to distinguish template source from an ordinary variable without accessing object attributes.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -G "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/flask/render" --data-urlencode "name={{7*7}}" -H "X-Request-ID: flask-ssti-a1" | jq -e '.rendered == "49" and .request_id == "flask-ssti-a1"'

title.zh: 复核第二种表达式

description.zh: 用字符串拼接 marker 复核结果，排除应用硬编码 49 或缓存响应造成的误报。
description.en: Confirm with a string-concatenation marker to exclude a hard-coded 49 or cached response.

title.zh: 分离配置风险并修复

description.zh: 单独检查 debug、SECRET_KEY 状态和敏感路由，修复后要求表达式按字面输出。
description.en: Inspect debug, SECRET_KEY state, and sensitive routes separately, then require expressions to render literally after remediation.

overview.zh: Flask 本身不是一个统一的“可利用漏洞”；风险通常来自把非可信字符串交给 render_template_string、泄露 SECRET_KEY、在不受信网络暴露调试器或错误配置扩展。条目只保留算术和字符串拼接两个无副作用 Jinja marker，其余配置检查迁入工具区。
overview.en: Flask is not one uniform exploitable vulnerability. Risk usually comes from passing untrusted strings to render_template_string, exposing SECRET_KEY, publishing the debugger to untrusted networks, or misconfiguring extensions. This entry retains only side-effect-free arithmetic and string-concatenation Jinja markers and moves configuration checks into tools.

vulnerability.zh: 如果应用把请求文本当作模板源解析，Jinja 会计算表达式而不是按字面输出。返回 49 或合成字符串只能证明模板求值边界，不能自动证明文件读取或代码执行。SECRET_KEY 配置和调试器暴露是不同问题，应分别验证、分别报告。
vulnerability.en: When request text becomes template source, Jinja evaluates expressions instead of rendering them literally. Returning 49 or a synthetic string proves only a template-evaluation boundary, not file read or code execution. SECRET_KEY configuration and debugger exposure are separate issues that must be tested and reported independently.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通字符串记录 JSON 响应基线，再提交 {{7*7}} 与字符串拼接 marker。要求服务端返回 request_id，并在日志中定位模板渲染调用；不访问对象继承链、配置对象、文件或进程。随后用工具命令检查 SECRET_KEY 是否配置、debug 状态和敏感路由暴露。
exploitation.en: Start with a plain-string JSON response baseline, then submit the {{7*7}} and string-concatenation markers. Require a request_id and locate the template-rendering call in logs without accessing object inheritance, configuration objects, files, or processes. Then use tool commands to inspect SECRET_KEY presence, debug state, and sensitive route exposure.

mitigation.zh: 不要把用户输入作为模板源传给 render_template_string；使用固定模板文件并把输入作为数据变量传入，让 Jinja 自动转义。生产环境关闭调试器，使用高熵 SECRET_KEY 并通过受控密钥系统轮换；敏感路由需要认证和网络边界。
mitigation.en: Do not pass user input as template source to render_template_string. Use fixed template files and pass input as data so Jinja escaping applies. Disable the debugger in production, use a high-entropy SECRET_KEY managed and rotated through a controlled secret system, and protect sensitive routes with authentication and network boundaries.

name.zh: 完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

subCategory.zh: 完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

title.zh: 完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体主验证命令
title.en: Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier Primary Validation

execution.command:
POST /transport-check HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8080
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

3
id=
10
PAYLOADER_MARKER
0

description.zh: 这些行按审校后的来源逐行守恒；执行前必须把真实账户、文件、网络目标和系统命令替换为隔离 marker，并只在授权实验环境运行。
description.en: These lines are conserved exactly from the reviewed source. Before execution, replace real accounts, files, network targets, and system commands with isolated markers and run only in an authorized lab.

analysis.zh: 完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

title.zh: 限定完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体前提
title.en: Constrain Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier prerequisites

description.zh: 确认完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体对应的实现、版本、语句或传输上下文及隔离证据源均已记录。
description.en: Record the implementation, version, statement or transport context, and isolated evidence source required by Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier.

title.zh: 提交完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体主输入
title.en: Submit the Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier primary input

description.zh: 仅提交 execution[0] 的审校输入，并为本次请求绑定唯一 marker、连接和审计标识。
description.en: Submit only the reviewed execution[0] input and bind a unique marker, connection, and audit identifier to the request.

attackChain.payload:
POST /transport-check HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8080
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

3
id=
10
PAYLOADER_MARKER

title.zh: 关联完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体证据
title.en: Correlate Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier evidence

description.zh: 关联同一 marker 的入口值、解析结果、最终 SQL、响应差分和服务端事件，排除回显、普通错误与其他分支。
description.en: Correlate the same marker across the entry value, parsed result, final SQL, response differential, and server event, excluding reflection, ordinary errors, and other branches.

title.zh: 关闭完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体异常路径
title.en: Close the Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier abnormal path

description.zh: 恢复参数化、严格分帧和最小权限，删除测试 marker 与临时状态，再重放阴性及正常业务基线。
description.en: Restore parameterization, strict framing, and least privilege, remove test markers and temporary state, then replay negative and normal business baselines.

overview.zh: 完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体从原集合中独立出来，因为其成立条件依赖特定语句语义、DBMS 或传输解析链。来源行保持守恒，但只能在隔离环境验证。
overview.en: Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier is isolated because its validity depends on specific statement semantics, a DBMS, or a transport parser chain. Source lines remain conserved but may be validated only in an isolated environment.

vulnerability.zh: 风险成立需要输入在完整 HTTP Chunked Marker 载体路径中越过预期绑定、解析或授权边界，并由同一请求的后端证据确认。HTTP 200、延迟、关键字回显或语法错误本身均不足。
vulnerability.en: A finding requires input to cross the expected binding, parsing, or authorization boundary in the Complete HTTP Chunked Marker Carrier path and be confirmed by backend evidence for the same request. HTTP 200, delay, keyword reflection, or syntax errors alone are insufficient.

exploitation.zh: 先建立固定 marker 对照，再一次只改变一个条件、表达式或载体。延迟限制为一秒，HTTP 载体只发送 localhost marker；在首个充分证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Establish fixed-marker controls first, then change only one condition, expression, or carrier at a time. Limit delays to one second, send HTTP carriers only to a localhost marker endpoint, and stop after the first sufficient proof.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和严格类型 schema，在边缘统一 HTTP 分帧、内容类型和重复参数规则，拒绝歧义编码，并让 WAF 只承担纵深防御。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries and strict type schemas, normalize HTTP framing, content types, and duplicate-parameter rules at the edge, reject ambiguous encodings, and keep the WAF as defense in depth only.

name.zh: HTTP 重复参数载体

description.zh: 将原混合条目中属于HTTP 重复参数载体的每一行独立路由，明确语法或载体前提、证据链与假阳性边界。
description.en: Routes every source line belonging to HTTP Duplicate-Parameter Carrier into one focused card with explicit syntax or carrier prerequisites, evidence chains, and false-positive boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离实例确认HTTP 重复参数载体所需 DBMS、驱动、代理或解析器行为，不跨技术分支推断结果。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the DBMS, driver, proxy, or parser behavior required by HTTP Duplicate-Parameter Carrier in an isolated instance and do not infer results across technique branches.

prerequisites.zh: 准备固定 PAYLOADER_MARKER、阴性/阳性对照、最终语句或原始字节日志及短超时；真实数据和生产流量不得使用。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a fixed PAYLOADER_MARKER, negative and positive controls, final-statement or raw-byte logs, and short timeouts; do not use real data or production traffic.

title.zh: HTTP 重复参数载体主验证命令

description.zh: 这些行按审校后的来源逐行守恒；执行前必须把真实账户、文件、网络目标和系统命令替换为隔离 marker，并只在授权实验环境运行。
description.en: These lines are conserved exactly from the reviewed source. Before execution, replace real accounts, files, network targets, and system commands with isolated markers and run only in an authorized lab.

analysis.zh: HTTP 重复参数载体的阳性必须由同一 marker 的解析差分与最终后端行为共同证明；本地工具输出、普通超时、连接关闭、错误页和另一 DBMS 的成功语句均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive for HTTP Duplicate-Parameter Carrier requires the parsing differential and final backend behavior for the same marker. Local tool output, ordinary timeouts, connection closure, error pages, and successful statements on another DBMS are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 出现连接错位、锁等待、生产数据、真实外连、日志或 CPU 激增、缓存污染或用户流量影响时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately on connection desynchronization, lock waits, production data, real egress, log or CPU spikes, cache contamination, or user-traffic impact.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后排空连接，删除 marker、临时表与抓包，清理代理/WAF/应用缓存，并确认参数化查询和正常请求均已恢复。
opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

opsecTips.en: After testing, drain connections, remove markers, temporary tables, and captures, clear proxy, WAF, and application caches, and confirm parameterized queries and normal requests are restored.

title.zh: 限定Multipart SQL Marker 载体前提

title.zh: 关联Multipart SQL Marker 载体证据
title.en: Correlate Multipart SQL Marker Carrier evidence

description.zh: 关联同一 marker 的入口值、解析结果、最终 SQL、响应差分和服务端事件，排除回显、普通错误与其他分支。
description.en: Correlate the same marker across the entry value, parsed result, final SQL, response differential, and server event, excluding reflection, ordinary errors, and other branches.

title.zh: 关闭Multipart SQL Marker 载体异常路径
title.en: Close the Multipart SQL Marker Carrier abnormal path

description.zh: 恢复参数化、严格分帧和最小权限，删除测试 marker 与临时状态，再重放阴性及正常业务基线。
description.en: Restore parameterization, strict framing, and least privilege, remove test markers and temporary state, then replay negative and normal business baselines.

overview.zh: Multipart SQL Marker 载体从原集合中独立出来，因为其成立条件依赖特定语句语义、DBMS 或传输解析链。来源行保持守恒，但只能在隔离环境验证。
overview.en: Multipart SQL Marker Carrier is isolated because its validity depends on specific statement semantics, a DBMS, or a transport parser chain. Source lines remain conserved but may be validated only in an isolated environment.

vulnerability.zh: 风险成立需要输入在Multipart SQL Marker 载体路径中越过预期绑定、解析或授权边界，并由同一请求的后端证据确认。HTTP 200、延迟、关键字回显或语法错误本身均不足。
vulnerability.en: A finding requires input to cross the expected binding, parsing, or authorization boundary in the Multipart SQL Marker Carrier path and be confirmed by backend evidence for the same request. HTTP 200, delay, keyword reflection, or syntax errors alone are insufficient.

exploitation.zh: 先建立固定 marker 对照，再一次只改变一个条件、表达式或载体。延迟限制为一秒，HTTP 载体只发送 localhost marker；在首个充分证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Establish fixed-marker controls first, then change only one condition, expression, or carrier at a time. Limit delays to one second, send HTTP carriers only to a localhost marker endpoint, and stop after the first sufficient proof.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和严格类型 schema，在边缘统一 HTTP 分帧、内容类型和重复参数规则，拒绝歧义编码，并让 WAF 只承担纵深防御。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries and strict type schemas, normalize HTTP framing, content types, and duplicate-parameter rules at the edge, reject ambiguous encodings, and keep the WAF as defense in depth only.

name.zh: SQL 登录查询边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SQL 登录查询边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SQL 登录查询边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

prerequisites.zh: 准备未认证、普通用户和管理员三类合成主体，并为登录与受保护对象记录正常拒绝和允许基线。
prerequisites.en: Prepare synthetic unauthenticated, regular-user, and administrator principals and record normal deny and allow baselines for login and protected objects.

prerequisites.zh: 确认每个输入最终到达 SQL、MongoDB 查询、PHP 比较、反向代理还是应用路由，禁止跨解释器推断。
prerequisites.en: Identify whether each input reaches SQL, a MongoDB query, PHP comparison, a reverse proxy, or an application route; do not infer behavior across interpreters.

title.zh: SQL 登录查询边界样例 1

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该SQL 登录查询边界样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this SQL Login Query Boundary sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一无权限主体仅改变一个输入后获得已认证主体或读取同一受保护对象，并由应用授权日志、数据库查询或代理到后端的规范化路径共同确认。登录页返回 200、错误文本变化、前端状态被修改、伪造头被回显、语法错误或不同路由返回公开内容都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the same unauthorized principal to gain an authenticated principal or read the same protected object after one input change, corroborated by authorization logs, database queries, or proxy-to-backend canonical paths. HTTP 200 on a login page, changed error text, client-side state edits, reflected spoofed headers, syntax errors, or public content from another route are not bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只读取一个不含敏感字段的固定标记对象；不得调用 DELETE、写入、管理员变更或真实账户操作。
opsecTips.en: Read only one fixed marker object without sensitive fields; do not invoke DELETE, writes, administrator changes, or real-account operations.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试账户与标记对象，清空 Cookie 和代理缓存，恢复可信代理与统一规范化配置，并核对未产生状态变更。
opsecTips.en: Delete test accounts and marker objects, clear cookies and proxy caches, restore trusted-proxy and canonicalization settings, and verify that no state changed.

title.zh: 建立安全基线

description.zh: 为SQL 登录查询边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SQL Login Query Boundary.

title.zh: 提交单变量样例

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
admin'-- -
admin' OR '1'='1'-- -

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 认证绕过不是一个单一语法类别。该集合中的 SQL、NoSQL、PHP 类型、代理头和路由变体由不同组件解释，只有将每组输入绑定到明确的数据流、主体和受保护对象，测试结论才可复现。
overview.en: Authentication bypass is not one syntax class. SQL, NoSQL, PHP type, proxy-header, and route variants are interpreted by different components, so every group must be tied to a specific data flow, principal, and protected object.

vulnerability.zh: 根因可能是字符串拼接查询、把对象当凭证值、松散类型比较、信任未由受控代理写入的转发头，或代理与应用对方法和路径的规范化顺序不同。每种根因需要独立证据，不能用一个 200 响应概括。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include concatenated queries, treating objects as credential values, loose comparison, trusting forwarding headers not set by a controlled proxy, or inconsistent method and path normalization between proxy and application. Each cause needs independent evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先对规范登录和规范受保护路径建立基线，再按原命令索引逐组测试，每次只改变一种输入。将最终 SQL/查询对象、PHP 类型与返回值、代理原始/规范路径和应用主体关联；只有访问同一标记资源且主体不应具有权限时才记为阳性。
exploitation.en: Baseline canonical login and protected paths, then test one source group at a time with one changed variable. Correlate final SQL or query objects, PHP types and return values, proxy raw and canonical paths, and the application principal; record positive only when the same marker resource is reached by an unauthorized principal.

mitigation.zh: 认证查询使用参数绑定和严格字符串 schema；失败时清空安全上下文；只信任由已知代理覆盖的转发头；在边缘与应用采用相同的路径和方法规范化，并对每个受保护对象执行服务端授权。
mitigation.en: 认证查询使用参数绑定和严格字符串 schema；失败时清空安全上下文；只信任由已知代理覆盖的转发头；在边缘与应用采用相同的路径和方法规范化，并对每个受保护对象执行服务端授权。

prerequisites.zh: 确认每个输入最终到达 SQL、MongoDB 查询、PHP 比较、反向代理还是应用路由，禁止跨解释器推断。
prerequisites.en: Identify whether each input reaches SQL, a MongoDB query, PHP comparison, a reverse proxy, or an application route; do not infer behavior across interpreters.

title.zh: NoSQL 凭证操作符边界样例 1

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该NoSQL 凭证操作符边界样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this NoSQL Credential Operator Boundary sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一无权限主体仅改变一个输入后获得已认证主体或读取同一受保护对象，并由应用授权日志、数据库查询或代理到后端的规范化路径共同确认。登录页返回 200、错误文本变化、前端状态被修改、伪造头被回显、语法错误或不同路由返回公开内容都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the same unauthorized principal to gain an authenticated principal or read the same protected object after one input change, corroborated by authorization logs, database queries, or proxy-to-backend canonical paths. HTTP 200 on a login page, changed error text, client-side state edits, reflected spoofed headers, syntax errors, or public content from another route are not bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只读取一个不含敏感字段的固定标记对象；不得调用 DELETE、写入、管理员变更或真实账户操作。
opsecTips.en: Read only one fixed marker object without sensitive fields; do not invoke DELETE, writes, administrator changes, or real-account operations.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试账户与标记对象，清空 Cookie 和代理缓存，恢复可信代理与统一规范化配置，并核对未产生状态变更。
opsecTips.en: Delete test accounts and marker objects, clear cookies and proxy caches, restore trusted-proxy and canonicalization settings, and verify that no state changed.

title.zh: 建立安全基线

description.zh: 为NoSQL 凭证操作符边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for NoSQL Credential Operator Boundary.

title.zh: 提交单变量样例

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload: {"user":"PAYLOADER_MARKER","pass":{"$ne":null}}

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 认证绕过不是一个单一语法类别。该集合中的 SQL、NoSQL、PHP 类型、代理头和路由变体由不同组件解释，只有将每组输入绑定到明确的数据流、主体和受保护对象，测试结论才可复现。
overview.en: Authentication bypass is not one syntax class. SQL, NoSQL, PHP type, proxy-header, and route variants are interpreted by different components, so every group must be tied to a specific data flow, principal, and protected object.

vulnerability.zh: 根因可能是字符串拼接查询、把对象当凭证值、松散类型比较、信任未由受控代理写入的转发头，或代理与应用对方法和路径的规范化顺序不同。每种根因需要独立证据，不能用一个 200 响应概括。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include concatenated queries, treating objects as credential values, loose comparison, trusting forwarding headers not set by a controlled proxy, or inconsistent method and path normalization between proxy and application. Each cause needs independent evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先对规范登录和规范受保护路径建立基线，再按原命令索引逐组测试，每次只改变一种输入。将最终 SQL/查询对象、PHP 类型与返回值、代理原始/规范路径和应用主体关联；只有访问同一标记资源且主体不应具有权限时才记为阳性。
exploitation.en: Baseline canonical login and protected paths, then test one source group at a time with one changed variable. Correlate final SQL or query objects, PHP types and return values, proxy raw and canonical paths, and the application principal; record positive only when the same marker resource is reached by an unauthorized principal.

mitigation.zh: 认证查询使用参数绑定和严格字符串 schema；失败时清空安全上下文；只信任由已知代理覆盖的转发头；在边缘与应用采用相同的路径和方法规范化，并对每个受保护对象执行服务端授权。
mitigation.en: 认证查询使用参数绑定和严格字符串 schema；失败时清空安全上下文；只信任由已知代理覆盖的转发头；在边缘与应用采用相同的路径和方法规范化，并对每个受保护对象执行服务端授权。

title.zh: 方法与路径规范化授权边界样例 1
title.en: Method and Path Normalization Authorization Boundary Sample 1

execution.command:
curl -sS --max-time 5 -X GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 -X HEAD http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 -X OPTIONS http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 --path-as-is http://127.0.0.1:8080/MARKER
curl -sS --max-time 5 --path-as-is http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker/
curl -sS --max-time 5 --path-as-is http://127.0.0.1:8080//marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 --path-as-is http://127.0.0.1:8080/./marker

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该方法与路径规范化授权边界样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。

name.zh: 上传扩展名规范化差异

description.zh: 上传扩展名规范化差异将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：大小写、多扩展名、编码和服务器映射规则对允许扩展产生不同结论。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Upload Extension Normalization Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: case, multiple extensions, encoding, and server mapping rules produce different allowlist decisions. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 上传扩展名规范化差异

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

title.en: Upload Extension Normalization Differential Validation Block 1

execution.command:
PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt.jpg
PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt%00.jpg
PAYLOADER_MARKER.phtml.txt
PAYLOADER_MARKER.php5.txt
PAYLOADER_MARKER.phar.txt
PAYLOADER_MARKER.TxT

description.zh: 该命令块从修正后的来源逐行迁移，仅使用本地 marker 夹具。
description.en: This command block is routed line-for-line from the corrected source and uses only local marker fixtures.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

title.zh: 确认处理边界

description.en: Identify the ingress, canonicalization component, storage layer, or downstream processor for Upload Extension Normalization Differential, and enable request-ID correlation.

title.zh: 建立正常 marker 基线

title.zh: 关联最终证据

description.zh: 入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论，同时用缺失 marker 和正常路径排除缓存、默认文件与其他任务干扰。
description.en: Require that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result, and use missing-marker and normal-path controls to exclude cache, default files, and unrelated jobs.

title.zh: 修复并双向回归

description.zh: 生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，并把上传目录设为不可执行，随后验证异常变体被拒绝且正常上传、下载或解压仍成功。
description.en: 生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，并把上传目录设为不可执行，随后验证异常变体被拒绝且正常上传、下载或解压仍成功。

overview.zh: 上传扩展名规范化差异比较入口值、规范化结果和最终文件操作。状态码或错误页面不是结论，唯一 marker 才能建立可重复对照。
overview.en: Upload Extension Normalization Differential compares the ingress value, canonical result, and final file operation. Status codes or error pages are not conclusions; a unique marker provides the repeatable control.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是大小写、多扩展名、编码和服务器映射规则对允许扩展产生不同结论。只有当差异跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that case, multiple extensions, encoding, and server mapping rules produce different allowlist decisions. Risk is confirmed only when the difference crosses the intended directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 先提交正常 marker 基线并记录请求 ID，再逐一重放本卡命令。阳性证据必须是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论；失败状态、响应时延或规则命中只能作为线索。
exploitation.en: Submit the normal marker baseline and record its request ID, then replay this card one command at a time. Positive evidence requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result; failure status, latency, or a rule match is only a lead.

mitigation.zh: 修复应生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，并把上传目录设为不可执行。之后同时重放异常样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法文件流程保持可用。
mitigation.en: 修复应生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，并把上传目录设为不可执行。之后同时重放异常样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法文件流程保持可用。

title.zh: 关联最终证据

description.zh: 入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论，同时用缺失 marker 和正常路径排除缓存、默认文件与其他任务干扰。
description.en: Require that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result, and use missing-marker and normal-path controls to exclude cache, default files, and unrelated jobs.

title.zh: 修复并双向回归

description.zh: 生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，并把上传目录设为不可执行，随后验证异常变体被拒绝且正常上传、下载或解压仍成功。
description.en: 生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，并把上传目录设为不可执行，随后验证异常变体被拒绝且正常上传、下载或解压仍成功。

overview.zh: 上传 NTFS ADS 文件名比较入口值、规范化结果和最终文件操作。状态码或错误页面不是结论，唯一 marker 才能建立可重复对照。
overview.en: Upload NTFS ADS Filename compares the ingress value, canonical result, and final file operation. Status codes or error pages are not conclusions; a unique marker provides the repeatable control.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用允许冒号文件名，而 NTFS 把后续部分解释为 Alternate Data Stream。只有当差异跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the application permits colons while NTFS interprets the suffix as an Alternate Data Stream. Risk is confirmed only when the difference crosses the intended directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 先提交正常 marker 基线并记录请求 ID，再逐一重放本卡命令。阳性证据必须是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论；失败状态、响应时延或规则命中只能作为线索。
exploitation.en: Submit the normal marker baseline and record its request ID, then replay this card one command at a time. Positive evidence requires that ingress records and the final object name or type correlate repeatably with the unique marker while the normal-file control keeps its expected result; failure status, latency, or a rule match is only a lead.

mitigation.zh: 修复应生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，并把上传目录设为不可执行。之后同时重放异常样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法文件流程保持可用。
mitigation.en: 修复应生成服务端对象名，在目标文件系统语义下统一校验名称、内容和类型，并把上传目录设为不可执行。之后同时重放异常样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法文件流程保持可用。
