name.zh: Web 缓存键与响应变体验证

description.zh: Web 缓存键与响应变体验证保留可复现的攻击样例与绕过变体，仅修正已确认失效、占位或事实混淆的内容。所有样例只用于可回滚的授权实验，并要求浏览器、解析器、代理或服务端日志与可见结果一致。
description.en: Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation preserves reproducible attack samples and bypass variants while correcting only confirmed obsolete, placeholder, or factually conflated content. Every sample is restricted to a reversible authorized lab and requires browser, parser, proxy, or server logs to agree with the visible result.

subCategory.zh: Web 缓存键与响应变体验证

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 缓存键与响应变体验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.en: Run only the first authorized-lab sample at a time and preserve the raw request, response, final parsed result, and matching logs; validate remaining variants one by one only after establishing the baseline.

title.en: 关联 Web 缓存键与响应变体验证 的服务端证据

description.zh: 把唯一标记与解析器、代理、应用、数据库或浏览器证据按时间关联，并排除回显、缓存、重试、客户端修改和统一错误页。
description.en: Correlate the unique marker over time with parser, proxy, application, database, or browser evidence while excluding reflection, caching, retries, client modification, and generic error pages.

title.zh: 修复 Web 缓存键与响应变体验证 并重放基线
title.en: Remediate Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation and Replay the Baseline

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: Web 缓存键与响应变体验证聚焦以下边界：使用唯一无害响应头标记确认未键入输入能否改变共享缓存对象，不注入脚本或影响其他用户。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation focuses on this boundary: Uses a unique harmless response-header marker to test whether an unkeyed input changes a shared cached object without injecting script or affecting other users. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自缓存键和源站响应变体不一致，或缓存层与应用对路径、认证和私有响应的解释不同。单次 X-Cache、Age 或响应变化只能说明缓存行为，只有无会话客户端收到同一标记或私有变体时才构成跨用户影响。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when cache keys omit origin response variants or when the cache and application disagree on paths, authentication, or private responses. One X-Cache, Age, or response change shows caching behavior only; cross-user impact requires a no-session client to receive the same marker or private variant.

exploitation.zh: 为专用测试路由生成唯一 PAYLOADER_CACHE 标记，按 miss、hit、不同会话和无会话顺序请求，并保存 Cache-Control、Vary、Age、缓存键日志和响应哈希。使用不含隐私的固定正文，发现共享污染后立即 purge，禁止影响真实用户。
exploitation.en: Generate a unique PAYLOADER_CACHE marker for a dedicated test route and request it in miss, hit, different-session, and no-session order, preserving Cache-Control, Vary, Age, cache-key logs, and response hashes. Use a privacy-free fixed body, purge immediately on shared contamination, and do not affect real users.

mitigation.zh: 让缓存键覆盖所有影响响应的已规范化输入，拒绝未批准的转发头，对认证和个性化响应设置 private/no-store 并正确使用 Vary。统一 CDN 与源站路径规范化，限制可缓存状态和扩展名，部署后 purge 旧对象并重复多会话回归。
mitigation.en: Include every normalized input that affects the response in the cache key, reject unapproved forwarding headers, mark authenticated and personalized responses private or no-store, and use Vary correctly. Align CDN and origin path normalization, constrain cacheable statuses and extensions, purge old objects after deployment, and repeat multi-session regression.

description.en: HTTP CL-TE Message-Boundary Regression preserves reproducible attack samples and bypass variants while correcting only confirmed obsolete, placeholder, or factually conflated content. Every sample is restricted to a reversible authorized lab and requires browser, parser, proxy, or server logs to agree with the visible result.

prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.zh: 把唯一标记与解析器、代理、应用、数据库或浏览器证据按时间关联，并排除回显、缓存、重试、客户端修改和统一错误页。

title.en: Remediate HTTP CL-TE Message-Boundary Regression and Replay the Baseline

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: HTTP CL-TE 消息边界回归聚焦以下边界：在单用户实验代理链中发送一个带冲突 CL/TE 的固定标记请求，验证两端是否一致拒绝。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: HTTP CL-TE Message-Boundary Regression focuses on this boundary: Sends one fixed-marker request with conflicting CL and TE through a single-user lab proxy chain to verify consistent rejection at both hops. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 请求走私来自同一持久连接上的两个 HTTP 组件对消息长度或字段规范化得出不同边界。RFC 9112 要求 Transfer-Encoding 覆盖 Content-Length，并要求拒绝不可恢复的歧义；一个 curl 状态码、服务器类型或单端超时不能证明前后端不同步。
vulnerability.en: Request smuggling arises when two HTTP components on one persistent connection derive different message boundaries from length or field normalization. RFC 9112 makes Transfer-Encoding override Content-Length and requires rejection of unrecoverable ambiguity; one curl status, server type, or single-hop timeout does not prove desynchronization.

exploitation.zh: 只在单用户实验代理链向 echo 后端发送一个 PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE 标记歧义请求，记录前端、后端和连接级日志以及请求计数。阳性必须证明一个输入在两端被分成不同数量或长度的请求；不发送管理路径，不等待或影响下一位用户请求。
exploitation.en: Send one PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE ambiguity marker only through a single-user lab proxy chain to an echo backend, recording front-end, backend, connection logs, and request counts. A positive result must prove that one input became a different request count or length at the two hops; do not target administrative paths or wait for another user request.

mitigation.zh: 在边缘统一使用严格 HTTP 解析，拒绝重复或冲突的长度字段、非法 Transfer-Encoding 和含糊空白，避免不安全的协议降级，并在转发前重建规范请求。升级所有代理和服务器，修复后重放正常请求与每个歧义阴性样例。
mitigation.en: Use strict HTTP parsing at the edge; reject duplicate or conflicting length fields, invalid Transfer-Encoding, and ambiguous whitespace; avoid unsafe protocol downgrades; and reconstruct canonical requests before forwarding. Upgrade every proxy and server, then replay normal requests and every ambiguity negative case.

name.zh: 基础开放重定向目标解析

description.zh: 使用本地 Fixture 和 `.invalid` 保留域名验证绝对 URL、userinfo、协议相对形式、百分号编码与反斜杠规范化后的最终目标。
description.en: Use a local fixture and the reserved .invalid domain to validate final destinations after parsing absolute URLs, userinfo, protocol-relative forms, percent encoding, and backslashes.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 重定向 Fixture，并关闭客户端自动跟随以便保存原始 Location。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 redirect fixture and disable automatic following so the original Location is preserved.

prerequisites.zh: 外部目标仅使用 redirect-canary.invalid，测试域名不解析也不承载任何服务。
prerequisites.en: Use only redirect-canary.invalid as the external destination; the test domain does not resolve or host a service.

title.zh: 直接跳转

description.zh: 直接跳转到攻击者站点
description.en: Direct redirect to attacker site

title.zh: 绕过验证

description.zh: @符号绕过
description.en: @Symbolnumber Bypass

title.zh: 斜杠绕过

description.zh: //绕过协议

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是最终解析的 scheme、host 或 port 离开明确允许列表，并由 Location 或浏览器导航确认。参数中出现外域、应用返回重定向状态或日志记录告警都只能作为线索。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a final parsed scheme, host, or port outside the explicit allowlist, confirmed by Location or browser navigation. An external domain in the parameter, a redirect status, or a log warning is only a lead.

opsecTips.zh: 所有外部目标使用 `.invalid` 保留域名，关闭自动跟随并避免第三方网络流量。
opsecTips.en: Use the reserved .invalid domain for every external destination, disable automatic following, and avoid third-party network traffic.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只改变一个 URL 变量并保存原始字节，防止代理、框架或浏览器二次编码造成误判。
opsecTips.en: Change one URL variable per request and preserve raw bytes to avoid misattributing proxy, framework, or browser re-encoding.

title.zh: URL编码与双编码绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for Basic Open-Redirect Destination Parsing

description.zh: 通过URL编码、双重URL编码、Unicode同形字、CRLF注入等方式绕过跳转目标地址的白名单或黑名单检测
description.en: Bypass redirect target whitelist/blacklist detection via URL encoding, double URL encoding, Unicode homoglyphs, CRLF injection, etc.

title.zh: 反斜杠与data: URI绕过
title.en: Validation step 2 for Basic Open-Redirect Destination Parsing

description.zh: 利用反斜杠在不同解析器中的差异行为、data: URI协议、多斜杠协议相对URL等方式绕过域名白名单验证
description.en: Bypass domain whitelist validation using backslash behavior differences across parsers, data: URI protocol, multi-slash protocol-relative URLs, etc.

title.zh: 建立同源基线

description.zh: 使用固定相对路径记录正常状态码与 Location，确认重定向端点的预期行为。
description.en: Use a fixed relative path to record normal status and Location and confirm expected endpoint behavior.

attackChain.payload: http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/redirect?next=https://redirect-canary.invalid/basic-a1

title.zh: 逐项提交目标变体
title.en: Submit destination variants one at a time

description.zh: 依次改变 userinfo、协议相对形式、编码和反斜杠，保持端点与身份不变。
description.en: Change userinfo, protocol-relative form, encoding, and backslashes separately while holding endpoint and identity constant.

title.zh: 比较最终解析主机

description.zh: 对照应用日志、Location 与浏览器解析，确认最终 scheme、host 和 port 是否仍受批准。
description.en: Compare application logs, Location, and browser parsing to confirm that final scheme, host, and port remain approved.

title.zh: 修复并重放矩阵

description.zh: 修复后重放五个样例，要求外域全部拒绝或转换为批准的同源路径。
description.en: Replay all five samples after remediation and require every external destination to be rejected or mapped to an approved same-origin path.

overview.zh: 基础开放重定向测试应覆盖最常见的五种 URL 解释：完整绝对 URL、userinfo 分隔、协议相对 URL、百分号编码和反斜杠规范化。每个样例只改变一个组成部分，并记录服务端解析结果与 Location，而不是把多个技巧堆叠在一个字符串里。
overview.en: Basic open-redirect testing should cover five common URL interpretations: absolute URLs, userinfo separators, protocol-relative URLs, percent encoding, and backslash normalization. Each sample changes one component and records server parsing plus Location rather than stacking multiple tricks in one string.

vulnerability.zh: 当应用允许用户控制 Location，或用 startsWith、endsWith、contains 等字符串判断代替标准 URL 解析与精确允许列表时，最终 host 可能离开批准源。只有规范化后的 Location 或浏览器目标指向保留外域时才确认问题；输入看起来像 URL 或响应为 3xx 都不是充分证据。
vulnerability.en: When an application lets users control Location or replaces standard URL parsing and exact allowlists with starts With, ends With, or contains checks, the final host may leave the approved origin. Confirm only when the normalized Location or browser destination points to the reserved external domain; URL-looking input or a 3xx response is insufficient.

exploitation.zh: 先用同源相对路径建立基线，再依次提交五个样例。对每次请求保存原始 next 参数、一次解码后的值、URL 解析器输出、允许列表判定和 Location Header；不使用 curl -L。若目标被拒绝、替换为固定路由或规范化到同源，应作为有效阻断记录。
exploitation.en: Establish a baseline with a same-origin relative path, then submit the five samples in order. Preserve the raw next parameter, value after one decode, URL-parser output, allowlist decision, and Location header without curl -L. Rejection, replacement with a fixed route, or same-origin canonicalization is valid blocking evidence.

mitigation.zh: 优先使用服务端定义的路由标识符或相对路径映射，不接收任意绝对 URL。确需外部跳转时，执行一次明确解码并使用标准 URL 解析器，拒绝 userinfo、控制字符和非 HTTP(S) Scheme，再对规范化的 scheme、host 与 port 做精确允许列表比较。
mitigation.en: 优先使用服务端定义的路由标识符或相对路径映射，不接收任意绝对 URL。确需外部跳转时，执行一次明确解码并使用标准 URL 解析器，拒绝 userinfo、控制字符和非 HTTP(S) Scheme，再对规范化的 scheme、host 与 port 做精确允许列表比较。

name.zh: 点击劫持对齐边界验证

description.zh: 验证敏感页面能否被第三方页面嵌入并与诱导界面对齐，同时区分响应头缺失、浏览器实际拦截和业务操作是否可被触发。
description.en: Validate whether a sensitive page can be embedded and aligned with a decoy interface while distinguishing missing headers, browser enforcement, and actual business-action reachability.

prerequisites.zh: 只使用 127.0.0.1 实验页面，并准备一个不会改变真实数据的确认或预览端点。
prerequisites.en: Use only the 127.0.0.1 lab pages and prepare a confirmation or preview endpoint that cannot change real data.

prerequisites.zh: 在 Chromium 中记录 CSP、X-Frame-Options、控制台消息和点击后的服务端请求日志。
prerequisites.en: Record CSP, X-Frame-Options, browser console messages, and server request logs after interaction in Chromium.

title.zh: 单控件对齐样例

description.zh: 以低透明度显示本地确认页和 marker，验证一次交互的坐标对齐，不连接真实状态变更。
description.en: Display the local confirmation page and marker at low opacity to verify one-interaction alignment without a real state change.

title.zh: 两步交互对齐样例

execution.command: LAB_MARKER_CJ_STEP_B2

description.zh: 用 sandboxed 本地资料预览页验证两步界面定位，页面只呈现合成 marker。
description.en: Use a sandboxed local profile-preview page to validate two-step positioning while rendering synthetic markers only.

title.zh: Pointer 路由对齐样例

execution.command: LAB_MARKER_CJ_POINTER_C3

description.zh: 保留可见定位边界并让 guide 不接收指针，观察事件是否到达本地 consent 预览页。
description.en: Keep visible alignment boundaries while the guide ignores pointer input, observing whether events reach the local consent preview.

analysis.zh: 阳性结论必须同时包含跨站 Frame 成功、认证上下文可用、控件可稳定对齐和状态变更请求四类证据。响应头缺失、页面截图或单次坐标重合都只能作为线索，不能替代浏览器与服务端的关联证据。
analysis.en: A positive conclusion requires evidence for successful cross-site framing, usable authentication context, stable control alignment, and a state-changing request. Missing headers, a screenshot, or one coordinate match is only a lead and cannot replace correlated browser and server evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 实验端点只能写入一次性 marker，不连接生产账号、支付、权限或删除操作。
opsecTips.en: The fixture may write only disposable markers and must not connect to production account, payment, privilege, or deletion actions.

opsecTips.zh: 演示时保持 Frame 可见并限制在本地浏览器会话，结束后清理实验 Cookie 与日志标记。
opsecTips.en: Keep the frame visible and confined to a local browser session, then clear fixture cookies and log markers after testing.

title.zh: 建立 Frame 策略基线

description.zh: 采集本地敏感页面的状态码、CSP frame-ancestors 与 X-Frame-Options，记录缺失和冲突配置。
description.en: Capture status, CSP frame-ancestors, and X-Frame-Options for the local sensitive page and record missing or conflicting policies.

title.zh: 执行可视化对齐样例

description.zh: 以低透明度加载实验页面并保留红色定位边界，确认控件坐标而不隐藏用户界面。
description.en: Load the fixture at low opacity with visible alignment boundaries to verify control coordinates without hiding the interface.

title.zh: 关联交互证据

description.zh: 使用唯一 marker 对照浏览器请求和服务端日志，判断交互是否真正到达业务处理器。
description.en: 使用唯一 marker 对照浏览器请求和服务端日志，判断交互是否真正到达业务处理器。

title.zh: 验证修复回归

description.zh: 启用 Frame 策略后重复浏览器测试，要求页面拒绝嵌入且敏感操作没有请求记录。
description.en: Repeat the browser test after enabling frame policy and require framing refusal with no sensitive-action request.

overview.zh: 点击劫持成立需要三个条件同时出现：目标页面可被跨站 Frame 加载，敏感控件能够与诱导界面稳定对齐，并且用户的一次或多次交互会触发具有安全影响的操作。本条目把浏览器侧演示与响应头审计分开，Payload 只保留本地可视化对齐样例。
overview.en: Clickjacking requires three conditions at once: cross-site framing must succeed, sensitive controls must align reliably with a decoy interface, and one or more user interactions must trigger a security-relevant action. This entry separates browser demonstrations from header auditing and keeps only local visual-alignment samples as payloads.

vulnerability.zh: 仅缺少 X-Frame-Options 不能单独证明漏洞，因为 CSP frame-ancestors、SameSite Cookie、重新认证、CSRF Token 或业务确认步骤仍可能阻断利用。确认问题时应记录 Frame 是否渲染、认证状态是否携带、目标控件坐标是否稳定以及服务端是否收到预期的状态变更请求。
vulnerability.en: A missing X-Frame-Options header alone does not prove vulnerability because CSP frame-ancestors, SameSite cookies, reauthentication, CSRF tokens, or business confirmation steps may still block exploitation. Confirmation requires evidence that the frame renders, authentication state is present, control coordinates remain stable, and the server receives the expected state-changing request.

exploitation.zh: 先对本地实验端点采集响应头基线，再用低透明度 Frame 观察真实布局而不是隐藏页面。逐个执行单按钮、两步交互和 pointer-events 对齐样例，每次只使用唯一 marker，并在浏览器网络面板与服务端日志中核对 marker。若页面被拒绝嵌入或操作没有产生请求，应记录为阻断证据。
exploitation.en: First capture a response-header baseline for the local fixture, then inspect the real layout using a low-opacity frame rather than hiding the page. Run the single-control, two-step, and pointer-events alignment samples one at a time with unique markers, correlating each marker in browser network data and server logs. A refused frame or absent action request is blocking evidence.

mitigation.zh: 优先部署 CSP frame-ancestors 并按兼容性需要补充 X-Frame-Options；对状态变更操作要求 CSRF 防护、重新认证或明确确认；避免仅依赖可被 Frame 环境影响的前端 frame-busting 脚本。自动化回归应同时验证响应头和浏览器实际嵌入结果。
mitigation.en: Deploy CSP frame-ancestors first and add X-Frame-Options where compatibility requires it. Protect state-changing actions with CSRF controls, reauthentication, or explicit confirmation, and do not rely only on client-side frame-busting scripts. Regression tests should verify both response headers and actual browser framing behavior.

name.zh: WebLogic WorkContext 无害输入拒绝验证
name.en: WebLogic Harmless WorkContext Input Rejection Validation

description.zh: 向 localhost WSAT 端点提交仅含合成 marker 的 SOAP WorkContext，验证补丁后拒绝或安全处理，不包含 java、XMLDecoder、对象或方法标签。
description.en: Submit a SOAP WorkContext containing only a synthetic marker to a localhost WSAT endpoint and validate patched rejection or safe handling without java, XMLDecoder, object, or method tags.

prerequisites.zh: 使用已知 WebLogic 版本和 CPU 补丁的 localhost 容器，WSAT 无业务事务数据。
prerequisites.en: Use a localhost container with known WebLogic version and CPU patch and no business transaction data in WSAT.

prerequisites.zh: 启用 XML 解析拒绝、WorkContext 处理和网络出口日志。
prerequisites.en: Enable XML parse rejection, WorkContext handling, and network-egress logs.

title.zh: 无害 WorkContext marker 请求

description.zh: 向本地 WSAT 端点发送只含自定义 marker 的 SOAP，并记录拒绝状态，不包含 Java 对象标签。
description.en: Send SOAP containing only a custom marker to the local WSAT endpoint and record rejection status without Java-object tags.

analysis.zh: HTTP 响应和 SOAP Fault 只能说明请求到达解析路径。安全结论要求危险 Java 对象标签被拒绝、无类加载和无副作用；本批请求根本不含这些标签，因此只验证补丁后的拒绝与观测边界。
analysis.en: HTTP responses and SOAP Faults show only that the request reached parsing. Security conclusions require dangerous Java-object tags to be rejected with no class loading or side effects; this request contains none and validates patched rejection plus observability only.

opsecTips.zh: XML 仅含标准 Envelope、WorkContext 和合成 marker，不含任何 Java 类或方法标签。
opsecTips.en: Keep XML to the standard envelope, WorkContext, and synthetic marker with no Java class or method tags.

opsecTips.zh: 容器禁用外部网络与业务事务，单次请求五秒后清理 SOAP 日志。
opsecTips.en: Disable external networking and business transactions, send one five-second request, and clear SOAP logs afterward.

title.zh: 固定域版本与 WSAT 策略
title.en: Fix domain version and WSAT policy

description.zh: 记录 WebLogic 版本、CPU、WSAT 部署和允许 XML 元素。
description.en: Record WebLogic version, CPU, WSAT deployment, and allowed XML elements.

title.zh: 提交无害 WorkContext marker

description.zh: 向 localhost CoordinatorPortType 发送不含 Java 对象语义的 SOAP。
description.en: Send SOAP without Java-object semantics to the localhost Coordinator Port Type.

attackChain.payload: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType" -H "Content-Type: text/xml" -H "X-Request-ID: weblogic-workcontext-001" --data '<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:work="http://bea.com/2004/06/soap/workarea/" xmlns:lab="urn:payloader:lab"><soapenv:Header><work:WorkContext><lab:marker>WEBLOGIC_XML_CANARY_A1</lab:marker></work:WorkContext></soapenv:Header><soapenv:Body/></soapenv:Envelope>' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n'

title.zh: 核对拒绝与无副作用证据

description.zh: 按请求 ID 对齐 Fault、解析日志和零类加载、进程、文件及网络事件。
description.en: Align Fault, parse logs, and zero class-load, process, file, or network events by request ID.

title.zh: 补丁与元素允许列表回归

description.zh: 应用 CPU 和元素允许列表后重放合法 SOAP 与无害 marker 阴性请求。
description.en: After CPU and element allowlists, replay valid SOAP and the harmless marker negative request.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 只提交标准 SOAP Envelope 和自定义 lab:marker。它刻意不包含 java.beans.XMLDecoder、ProcessBuilder、Runtime、void、object、array 或文件路径，因此只能验证端点对非预期 WorkContext 内容的拒绝与日志行为。
overview.en: This payload submits only a standard SOAP envelope and custom lab:marker. It intentionally contains no java.beans.XMLDecoder, Process Builder, Runtime, void, object, array, or file path, so it validates rejection and logging of unexpected WorkContext content only.

vulnerability.zh: 历史 WebLogic XMLDecoder 问题依赖易受影响端点将攻击者 XML 交给可实例化 Java 对象的方法。端点返回、SOAP Fault 或 WorkContext 解析本身不等于对象实例化；版本、补丁和解析日志必须证明危险标签不可达。
vulnerability.en: Historical WebLogic XMLDecoder issues depended on vulnerable endpoints passing attacker XML into Java-object instantiation. An endpoint response, SOAP Fault, or WorkContext parsing does not equal object instantiation; version, patch, and parse logs must show dangerous tags are unreachable.

exploitation.zh: 发送一次带固定 marker 的无害 SOAP 请求，记录 HTTP 状态、SOAP Fault、解析拒绝和请求 ID。确认没有类加载、进程、文件写入或网络事件。禁止将 marker 替换为 java、XMLDecoder、ProcessBuilder、命令或 CDATA 混淆。
exploitation.en: Send one harmless SOAP request with a fixed marker and record HTTP status, SOAP Fault, parse rejection, and request ID. Confirm no class loading, process, file write, or network event. Never substitute java, XMLDecoder, Process Builder, commands, or CDATA obfuscation.

mitigation.zh: 应用 Oracle CPU，删除或限制不需要的 WSAT 与 AsyncResponseService，使用严格 XML 解析和元素允许列表，拒绝 Java 对象语义标签。将管理服务绑定受控网络，并对解析错误、类加载和出站连接建立监控。
mitigation.en: Apply Oracle CP Us, remove or restrict unused WSAT and Async Response Service, use strict XML parsing and element allowlists, and reject Java-object semantic tags. Bind management services to controlled networks and monitor parse errors, class loading, and egress.

name.zh: 会话固定与登录轮换

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为会话固定与登录轮换验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为会话固定与登录轮换验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个合成账户、隔离浏览器配置和固定无敏感字段标记对象，记录登录前后会话 ID 的哈希与主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic accounts, isolated browser profiles, and a fixed nonsensitive marker object, recording session-ID hashes and principals before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 若检查明文传输，只在自有封闭网络和测试流量中抓包；Cookie 域、路径、SameSite 和浏览器版本必须明确。
prerequisites.en: If reviewing cleartext transport, capture only owned test traffic on an isolated network; document cookie domain, path, SameSite mode, and browser version.

title.zh: 会话固定与登录轮换样例 1
title.en: Session Fixation and Login Rotation Sample 1

execution.command:
curl -sS --max-time 5 -c prelogin.cookies http://127.0.0.1:8080/
pre_hash=$(sha256sum prelogin.cookies | cut -d" " -f1)
curl -sS --max-time 5 -b prelogin.cookies -c postlogin.cookies -d "user=payloader&pass=PAYLOADER_TEST" http://127.0.0.1:8080/login
post_hash=$(sha256sum postlogin.cookies | cut -d" " -f1)
printf "pre=%s post=%s\n" "$pre_hash" "$post_hash"
curl -sS --max-time 5 -b postlogin.cookies http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
# Expected: the authenticated session identifier rotates and only the post-login jar reaches the marker.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该会话固定与登录轮换样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this Session Fixation and Login Rotation sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性会话固定要求登录前受控会话 ID 在登录后未轮换且另一测试客户端可访问同一主体；Cookie Tossing 要求子域可设置的同名 Cookie 被主域安全逻辑选中；SameSite 仅证明凭据随导航发送，不能证明响应可读或状态变更。缺少属性、抓到测试 Cookie 或随机性工具给出低分本身都不是劫持。
analysis.en: Session fixation requires a controlled pre-login ID to survive authentication and authorize the same principal from another test client. Cookie tossing requires a same-name cookie set by a subdomain to be selected by main-domain security logic. SameSite can show credentials sent on navigation but not response readability or state change. A missing attribute, captured test cookie, or low randomness score alone is not hijacking.

opsecTips.zh: 仅复用可撤销的合成会话并读取一个标记对象；不得捕获第三方流量、真实 Cookie 或触发资金与资料变更。
opsecTips.en: Replay only revocable synthetic sessions and read one marker object; do not capture third-party traffic, real cookies, or trigger financial or profile changes.

opsecTips.zh: 注销全部测试会话，删除 Cookie、抓包和临时脚本，清理浏览器站点数据并恢复 HTTPS 与 Cookie 策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out all test sessions, delete cookies, captures, and temporary scripts, clear browser site data, and restore HTTPS and cookie policy.

title.zh: 建立安全基线

description.zh: 为会话固定与登录轮换准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Session Fixation and Login Rotation.

title.zh: 提交单变量样例

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
curl -sS --max-time 5 -c prelogin.cookies http://127.0.0.1:8080/
pre_hash=$(sha256sum prelogin.cookies | cut -d" " -f1)
curl -sS --max-time 5 -b prelogin.cookies -c postlogin.cookies -d "user=payloader&pass=PAYLOADER_TEST" http://127.0.0.1:8080/login
post_hash=$(sha256sum postlogin.cookies | cut -d" " -f1)
printf "pre=%s post=%s\n" "$pre_hash" "$post_hash"
curl -sS --max-time 5 -b postlogin.cookies http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
# Expected: the authenticated session identifier rotates and only the post-login jar reaches the marker.

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 会话安全需要区分服务端 ID 生命周期、传输保护、浏览器 Cookie 选择与跨站导航。原集合的 curl、Wireshark 和 Burp 操作属于工具流程，而 JavaScript 和请求片段需按浏览器与服务端行为分别验证。
overview.en: 会话安全需要区分服务端 ID 生命周期、传输保护、浏览器 Cookie 选择与跨站导航。原集合的 curl、Wireshark 和 Burp 操作属于工具流程，而 Java Script 和请求片段需按浏览器与服务端行为分别验证。

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括认证后不轮换会话、Cookie 作用域过宽、HTTP 明文传输、可预测 ID、同名 Cookie 解析顺序不一致，或把带 Cookie 的顶级导航错误当作已授权状态变更。每个边界的阳性证据不同。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include no post-authentication rotation, overbroad cookie scope, cleartext HTTP, predictable identifiers, inconsistent duplicate-cookie selection, or treating a credentialed top-level navigation as an authorized state change. Each boundary has different evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先记录登录前后 ID 哈希、Set-Cookie 属性和主体，再分别测试固定、受控重放和子域同名 Cookie。SameSite 场景只向无副作用 GET 标记页导航，并通过服务端日志确认 Cookie 是否发送；不能用转账 URL 作为测试样例。
exploitation.en: 先记录登录前后 ID 哈希、Set-Cookie 属性和主体，再分别测试固定、受控重放和子域同名 Cookie。SameSite 场景只向无副作用 GET 标记页导航，并通过服务端日志确认 Cookie 是否发送；不能用转账 URL 作为测试样例。

mitigation.zh: 认证和权限变化后轮换高熵会话 ID，强制 HTTPS、Secure、HttpOnly 与适当 SameSite，使用 host-only 或 __Host- Cookie，拒绝重复敏感 Cookie，并让所有状态变更使用非 GET 与 CSRF 防护。
mitigation.en: Rotate high-entropy session I Ds after authentication and privilege changes, enforce HTTPS, Secure, HttpOnly, and suitable SameSite, prefer host-only or __Host- cookies, reject duplicate sensitive cookies, and protect all state changes with non-GET methods and CSRF controls.

name.zh: Cookie 作用域与同名冲突

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为Cookie 作用域与同名冲突验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

title.zh: Cookie 作用域与同名冲突样例 1
title.en: Cookie Scope and Name Collision Sample 1

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该Cookie 作用域与同名冲突样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。

overview.zh: 会话安全需要区分服务端 ID 生命周期、传输保护、浏览器 Cookie 选择与跨站导航。原集合的 curl、Wireshark 和 Burp 操作属于工具流程，而 JavaScript 和请求片段需按浏览器与服务端行为分别验证。
overview.en: 会话安全需要区分服务端 ID 生命周期、传输保护、浏览器 Cookie 选择与跨站导航。原集合的 curl、Wireshark 和 Burp 操作属于工具流程，而 Java Script 和请求片段需按浏览器与服务端行为分别验证。

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括认证后不轮换会话、Cookie 作用域过宽、HTTP 明文传输、可预测 ID、同名 Cookie 解析顺序不一致，或把带 Cookie 的顶级导航错误当作已授权状态变更。每个边界的阳性证据不同。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include no post-authentication rotation, overbroad cookie scope, cleartext HTTP, predictable identifiers, inconsistent duplicate-cookie selection, or treating a credentialed top-level navigation as an authorized state change. Each boundary has different evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先记录登录前后 ID 哈希、Set-Cookie 属性和主体，再分别测试固定、受控重放和子域同名 Cookie。SameSite 场景只向无副作用 GET 标记页导航，并通过服务端日志确认 Cookie 是否发送；不能用转账 URL 作为测试样例。
exploitation.en: 先记录登录前后 ID 哈希、Set-Cookie 属性和主体，再分别测试固定、受控重放和子域同名 Cookie。SameSite 场景只向无副作用 GET 标记页导航，并通过服务端日志确认 Cookie 是否发送；不能用转账 URL 作为测试样例。

mitigation.zh: 认证和权限变化后轮换高熵会话 ID，强制 HTTPS、Secure、HttpOnly 与适当 SameSite，使用 host-only 或 __Host- Cookie，拒绝重复敏感 Cookie，并让所有状态变更使用非 GET 与 CSRF 防护。
mitigation.en: Rotate high-entropy session I Ds after authentication and privilege changes, enforce HTTPS, Secure, HttpOnly, and suitable SameSite, prefer host-only or __Host- cookies, reject duplicate sensitive cookies, and protect all state changes with non-GET methods and CSRF controls.

name.zh: SameSite 导航边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SameSite 导航边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SameSite 导航边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个合成账户、隔离浏览器配置和固定无敏感字段标记对象，记录登录前后会话 ID 的哈希与主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic accounts, isolated browser profiles, and a fixed nonsensitive marker object, recording session-ID hashes and principals before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 若检查明文传输，只在自有封闭网络和测试流量中抓包；Cookie 域、路径、SameSite 和浏览器版本必须明确。
prerequisites.en: If reviewing cleartext transport, capture only owned test traffic on an isolated network; document cookie domain, path, SameSite mode, and browser version.

title.zh: SameSite 导航边界样例 1

execution.command: Open read-only marker

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该SameSite 导航边界样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this SameSite Navigation Boundary sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性会话固定要求登录前受控会话 ID 在登录后未轮换且另一测试客户端可访问同一主体；Cookie Tossing 要求子域可设置的同名 Cookie 被主域安全逻辑选中；SameSite 仅证明凭据随导航发送，不能证明响应可读或状态变更。缺少属性、抓到测试 Cookie 或随机性工具给出低分本身都不是劫持。
analysis.en: Session fixation requires a controlled pre-login ID to survive authentication and authorize the same principal from another test client. Cookie tossing requires a same-name cookie set by a subdomain to be selected by main-domain security logic. SameSite can show credentials sent on navigation but not response readability or state change. A missing attribute, captured test cookie, or low randomness score alone is not hijacking.

opsecTips.zh: 仅复用可撤销的合成会话并读取一个标记对象；不得捕获第三方流量、真实 Cookie 或触发资金与资料变更。
opsecTips.en: Replay only revocable synthetic sessions and read one marker object; do not capture third-party traffic, real cookies, or trigger financial or profile changes.

opsecTips.zh: 注销全部测试会话，删除 Cookie、抓包和临时脚本，清理浏览器站点数据并恢复 HTTPS 与 Cookie 策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out all test sessions, delete cookies, captures, and temporary scripts, clear browser site data, and restore HTTPS and cookie policy.

title.zh: 建立安全基线

description.zh: 为SameSite 导航边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SameSite Navigation Boundary.

title.zh: 提交单变量样例

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload: Open read-only marker

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

name.zh: 密码重置主机头绑定

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为密码重置主机头绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为密码重置主机头绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有邮件沙箱、两个合成账户和可回滚密码，记录每个重置请求、令牌哈希、账户 ID 与邮件任务 ID。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned mail sandbox, two synthetic accounts, and rollback passwords, recording each reset request, token hash, account ID, and mail-job ID.

prerequisites.zh: 固定应用公开基址和可信代理配置，所有回调域均为自有测试域，且令牌尝试次数受严格预算控制。
prerequisites.en: Fix the application's public base URL and trusted-proxy configuration, use only owned callback domains, and strictly budget token attempts.

title.zh: 密码重置主机头绑定样例 1
title.en: Password Reset Host Header Binding Sample 1

execution.command:
POST /forgot-password HTTP/1.1
Host: callback.example.invalid
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

email=payloader-user%40example.invalid

POST /forgot-password HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.invalid
X-Forwarded-Host: callback.example.invalid
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

email=payloader-user%40example.invalid
# Inspect only the local mail-sandbox link; no real recipient or external collaborator.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该密码重置主机头绑定样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this Password Reset Host Header Binding sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

title.zh: 密码重置主机头绑定样例 2
title.en: Password Reset Host Header Binding Sample 2

execution.command:
curl -sS --max-time 5 -H "Host: app.example.invalid" -d "email=payloader-user@example.invalid" http://127.0.0.1:8080/test/forgot
curl -sS --max-time 5 -H "Host: app.example.invalid" -H "X-Forwarded-Host: callback.example.invalid" -d "email=payloader-user@example.invalid" http://127.0.0.1:8080/test/forgot
curl -sS --max-time 5 --request-target "/test/forgot" -H "Host: app.example.invalid" -d "email=payloader-user@example.invalid" http://127.0.0.1:8080
# Only standards-valid authorities are used; inspect the mail sandbox for the configured public base URL.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该密码重置主机头绑定样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this Password Reset Host Header Binding sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

title.zh: 密码重置主机头绑定样例 3
title.en: Password Reset Host Header Binding Sample 3

execution.command:
curl -sS --max-time 5 -H "Host: callback.example.invalid" -d "email=payloader-user@example.invalid&dry_run=true" http://127.0.0.1:8080/test/reset/request
# Expected: wrong-account, skipped-step, used-token, and untrusted-host controls are rejected without changing a password.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该密码重置主机头绑定样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this Password Reset Host Header Binding sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据分别是邮件中的重置链接被不可信 Host 改写并把测试令牌送到受控域；低权限请求可重置另一合成账户；已用或过期令牌再次改变密码；或令牌在预算内可由已知生成规律预测。邮件未到达、响应 200、链接文本反射、状态码差异或脚本猜中自身生成的值都不是证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an untrusted Host changing a mailed reset link and delivering a test token to an owned domain, an underprivileged request resetting another synthetic account, a used or expired token changing a password again, or a token predicted from a known generation rule within budget. Missing mail, HTTP 200, reflected link text, status differences, or a script matching its own generated value are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只对合成账户执行一次可回滚密码变更；不得向真实收件人发信、遍历完整验证码空间或提交真实令牌。
opsecTips.en: 只对合成账户执行一次可回滚密码变更；不得向真实收件人发信、遍历完整验证码空间或提交真实令牌。

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部测试令牌，恢复合成账户密码，删除邮件、回调日志和临时脚本，并核对没有未完成重置任务。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test tokens, restore synthetic passwords, delete mail, callback logs, and temporary scripts, and verify no reset jobs remain pending.

description.zh: 为密码重置主机头绑定准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Password Reset Host Header Binding.

overview.zh: 安全的密码重置流程必须把请求、令牌、账户、接收通道和最终密码变更绑定起来。Host 生成链接、短验证码、令牌随机性、步骤状态和一次性消费是不同边界，不能共享一个阳性判据。
overview.en: A secure password-reset flow binds request, token, account, delivery channel, and final password change. Host-derived links, short codes, token randomness, workflow state, and one-time consumption are separate boundaries and cannot share one positive criterion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括从不可信请求头构造绝对 URL、令牌熵不足或泄露、未把令牌绑定到账户和用途、跳过验证状态、未原子消费令牌，以及只按可伪造客户端 IP 限流。每项都应有服务端状态证据。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include constructing absolute URLs from untrusted headers, weak or leaked tokens, failing to bind tokens to account and purpose, skipped verification state, non-atomic token consumption, and throttling only by spoofable client IP. Each requires server-state evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先向邮件沙箱申请一次正常重置并完成全流程，随后分别改变 Host、账户绑定、步骤顺序或令牌生命周期。每轮生成新令牌并只改变一个字段；令牌强度测试使用离线合成样本，不对在线端点运行 000000 到 999999。
exploitation.en: Complete one normal reset through the mail sandbox, then independently change Host, account binding, step order, or token lifecycle. Generate a fresh token per run and change one field; assess strength with offline synthetic samples rather than sending 000000 through 999999 online.

mitigation.zh: 从配置生成 HTTPS 重置 URL，使用高熵单次短时令牌并存储其哈希，绑定账户、用途与请求，原子消费后再变更密码；统一响应，按账户和可信网络信号限流，并撤销现有会话。
mitigation.en: Generate HTTPS reset URLs from configuration, use high-entropy single-use short-lived tokens stored as hashes and bound to account, purpose, and request, consume atomically before changing the password, normalize responses, throttle by account and trusted network signals, and revoke existing sessions.

name.zh: 密码重置流程状态

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有邮件沙箱、两个合成账户和可回滚密码，记录每个重置请求、令牌哈希、账户 ID 与邮件任务 ID。

prerequisites.zh: 固定应用公开基址和可信代理配置，所有回调域均为自有测试域，且令牌尝试次数受严格预算控制。
prerequisites.en: Fix the application's public base URL and trusted-proxy configuration, use only owned callback domains, and strictly budget token attempts.

title.zh: 密码重置流程状态样例 1

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该密码重置流程状态样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this Password Reset Flow State sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据分别是邮件中的重置链接被不可信 Host 改写并把测试令牌送到受控域；低权限请求可重置另一合成账户；已用或过期令牌再次改变密码；或令牌在预算内可由已知生成规律预测。邮件未到达、响应 200、链接文本反射、状态码差异或脚本猜中自身生成的值都不是证据。

name.zh: OAuth state 事务绑定

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为OAuth state 事务绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为OAuth state 事务绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有授权服务器、测试客户端、两个合成用户和精确登记的 HTTPS redirect URI，记录授权请求与令牌事件。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned authorization server, test client, two synthetic users, and an exactly registered HTTPS redirect URI, recording authorization and token events.

prerequisites.zh: 每轮使用新的 state、nonce、PKCE verifier 和一次性 code，测试令牌仅包含无敏感字段 scope。
prerequisites.en: Use fresh state, nonce, PKCE verifier, and one-time code for every run, with test tokens limited to nonsensitive scopes.

title.zh: OAuth state 事务绑定样例 1

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该OAuth state 事务绑定样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this OAuth State Transaction Binding sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要证明错误会话可完成账户绑定、未登记 redirect URI 收到可兑换 code/token、未授权 scope 被资源服务器接受，或面向另一个客户端/受众的令牌访问同一标记资源。授权页错误、候选 URI 被反射、浏览器导航、不可兑换 code、fragment 出现在地址栏或资源服务器正确拒绝都不是漏洞证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the wrong session to complete account binding, an unregistered redirect URI to receive a redeemable code or token, an unauthorized scope to be accepted, or a token for another client or audience to access the same marker resource. Authorization errors, reflected candidate URIs, browser navigation, unredeemable codes, fragments in the address bar, or correct resource-server rejection are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用短期测试 code/token 并访问一个只读标记资源；不得使用窃取令牌、管理员 scope 或真实第三方客户端。
opsecTips.en: Use only short-lived test codes and tokens to access one read-only marker resource; do not use stolen tokens, administrator scopes, or real third-party clients.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code、access token 与 refresh token，删除测试绑定和回调日志，恢复客户端登记与 consent 配置。
opsecTips.en: Revoke codes, access tokens, and refresh tokens, delete test bindings and callback logs, and restore client registration and consent configuration.

overview.zh: OAuth 安全结论必须区分浏览器授权请求、授权服务器重定向、客户端 code 交换和资源服务器令牌验证。原集合中的 HTML、参数字典和 curl 流程作用在不同阶段，不能合并为一个“OAuth 绕过”。
overview.en: OAuth findings must distinguish browser authorization, authorization-server redirect, client code exchange, and resource-server token validation. The source HTML, parameter corpus, and curl workflows operate at different stages and cannot be one generic OAuth bypass.

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括授权响应未绑定浏览器会话、redirect URI 非精确匹配、PKCE 或 nonce 缺失、客户端超范围申请未经过 consent，以及资源服务器不校验 issuer、audience、client 和 scope。Token 出现在 URL 本身不等于可利用泄露。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include authorization responses not bound to browser sessions, inexact redirect matching, missing PKCE or nonce, overbroad scopes without consent, and resource servers failing to validate issuer, audience, client, and scope. A token appearing in a URL is not by itself exploitable leakage.

exploitation.zh: 先完成带 state、nonce 和 PKCE 的正常授权码流程，再分别移除或替换一个绑定值。redirect_uri 只使用已登记 URI 与一个自有未登记 URI对照；scope 与 audience 测试仅访问固定标记 API，并关联授权服务器与资源服务器日志。
exploitation.en: Complete a normal authorization-code flow with state, nonce, and PKCE, then remove or replace one binding value at a time. Compare an exactly registered redirect URI with one owned unregistered URI, and test scope and audience only against a fixed marker API with authorization- and resource-server logs.

mitigation.zh: 采用授权码流与 PKCE，state 绑定浏览器事务，OIDC 校验 nonce；redirect URI 精确匹配，禁止开放重定向链；对 issuer、audience、client、scope、过期与 code 单次使用执行严格校验，并轮换 refresh token。
mitigation.en: Use authorization code with PKCE, bind state to the browser transaction, validate OIDC nonce, exactly match redirect URIs, reject open-redirect chains, strictly validate issuer, audience, client, scope, expiry, and one-time codes, and rotate refresh tokens.

redirect_uri=https://client.example.invalid:8443/oauth/callback
redirect_uri=https://client.example.invalid/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Funregistered.example.invalid%2Fmarker
# Expected: exact registered URI is accepted; every other owned, non-resolving control is rejected before issuing a code.

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: OAuth 安全结论必须区分浏览器授权请求、授权服务器重定向、客户端 code 交换和资源服务器令牌验证。原集合中的 HTML、参数字典和 curl 流程作用在不同阶段，不能合并为一个“OAuth 绕过”。
overview.en: OAuth findings must distinguish browser authorization, authorization-server redirect, client code exchange, and resource-server token validation. The source HTML, parameter corpus, and curl workflows operate at different stages and cannot be one generic OAuth bypass.

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括授权响应未绑定浏览器会话、redirect URI 非精确匹配、PKCE 或 nonce 缺失、客户端超范围申请未经过 consent，以及资源服务器不校验 issuer、audience、client 和 scope。Token 出现在 URL 本身不等于可利用泄露。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include authorization responses not bound to browser sessions, inexact redirect matching, missing PKCE or nonce, overbroad scopes without consent, and resource servers failing to validate issuer, audience, client, and scope. A token appearing in a URL is not by itself exploitable leakage.

exploitation.zh: 先完成带 state、nonce 和 PKCE 的正常授权码流程，再分别移除或替换一个绑定值。redirect_uri 只使用已登记 URI 与一个自有未登记 URI对照；scope 与 audience 测试仅访问固定标记 API，并关联授权服务器与资源服务器日志。
exploitation.en: Complete a normal authorization-code flow with state, nonce, and PKCE, then remove or replace one binding value at a time. Compare an exactly registered redirect URI with one owned unregistered URI, and test scope and audience only against a fixed marker API with authorization- and resource-server logs.

mitigation.zh: 采用授权码流与 PKCE，state 绑定浏览器事务，OIDC 校验 nonce；redirect URI 精确匹配，禁止开放重定向链；对 issuer、audience、client、scope、过期与 code 单次使用执行严格校验，并轮换 refresh token。
mitigation.en: Use authorization code with PKCE, bind state to the browser transaction, validate OIDC nonce, exactly match redirect URIs, reject open-redirect chains, strictly validate issuer, audience, client, scope, expiry, and one-time codes, and rotate refresh tokens.

name.zh: OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

subCategory.zh: OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有授权服务器、测试客户端、两个合成用户和精确登记的 HTTPS redirect URI，记录授权请求与令牌事件。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned authorization server, test client, two synthetic users, and an exactly registered HTTPS redirect URI, recording authorization and token events.

prerequisites.zh: 每轮使用新的 state、nonce、PKCE verifier 和一次性 code，测试令牌仅包含无敏感字段 scope。
prerequisites.en: Use fresh state, nonce, PKCE verifier, and one-time code for every run, with test tokens limited to nonsensitive scopes.

title.zh: OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界样例 1
title.en: OAuth Scope and Audience Boundary Sample 1

execution.command:
printf "%s\n" "Fragment negative control: https://client.example.invalid/callback#access_token=PAYLOADER_TEST_TOKEN"
printf "%s\n" "URL fragments are not sent in HTTP requests or Referer headers."
curl -sS --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:8080/oauth/authorize?client_id=payloader-client&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fclient.example.invalid%2Foauth%2Fcallback&response_type=code&scope=openid%20profile&state=PAYLOADER_STATE&code_challenge=PAYLOADER_CHALLENGE&code_challenge_method=S256"
curl -sS --max-time 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer PAYLOADER_TEST_TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 -d "grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=PAYLOADER_TEST_REFRESH&client_id=payloader-client" http://127.0.0.1:8080/oauth/token
# Expected: only consented scope and matching issuer, audience, client, and token binding reach the read-only marker.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this OAuth Scope and Audience Boundary sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要证明错误会话可完成账户绑定、未登记 redirect URI 收到可兑换 code/token、未授权 scope 被资源服务器接受，或面向另一个客户端/受众的令牌访问同一标记资源。授权页错误、候选 URI 被反射、浏览器导航、不可兑换 code、fragment 出现在地址栏或资源服务器正确拒绝都不是漏洞证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the wrong session to complete account binding, an unregistered redirect URI to receive a redeemable code or token, an unauthorized scope to be accepted, or a token for another client or audience to access the same marker resource. Authorization errors, reflected candidate URIs, browser navigation, unredeemable codes, fragments in the address bar, or correct resource-server rejection are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用短期测试 code/token 并访问一个只读标记资源；不得使用窃取令牌、管理员 scope 或真实第三方客户端。
opsecTips.en: Use only short-lived test codes and tokens to access one read-only marker resource; do not use stolen tokens, administrator scopes, or real third-party clients.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code、access token 与 refresh token，删除测试绑定和回调日志，恢复客户端登记与 consent 配置。
opsecTips.en: Revoke codes, access tokens, and refresh tokens, delete test bindings and callback logs, and restore client registration and consent configuration.

title.zh: 建立安全基线

description.zh: 为OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for OAuth Scope and Audience Boundary.

title.zh: 提交单变量样例

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

name.zh: SAML 签名验证边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SAML 签名验证边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SAML 签名验证边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 IdP/SP、测试证书和两个合成主体，记录 Response/Assertion ID、InResponseTo、Audience、Recipient、时间与签名引用。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned Id P and SP, test certificates, and two synthetic principals, recording Response and Assertion I Ds, In Response To, Audience, Recipient, time, and signature references.

prerequisites.zh: XXE 仅使用无文件读取、无外网的本地 canary resolver；签名测试使用专用测试密钥和可销毁 SP。
prerequisites.en: For XXE, use a local canary resolver without file reads or egress; use a dedicated test key and disposable SP for signature tests.

title.zh: SAML 签名验证边界样例 1

execution.command:
xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion saml-response.xml
xmlstarlet ed -d '//*[local-name()="Signature"]' saml-response.xml > saml-unsigned.xml
xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion saml-unsigned.xml
# Expected: the signed synthetic assertion verifies and the unsigned negative control fails.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该SAML 签名验证边界样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this SAML Signature Validation Boundary sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

title.zh: SAML 签名验证边界样例 2

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该SAML 签名验证边界样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this SAML Signature Validation Boundary sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性签名缺陷要求 SP 接受未签名或攻击者签名的断言并建立错误主体；重放要求同一 Assertion ID 在过期或已消费后再次建立会话；XSW 要求业务层使用的断言与签名实际覆盖的节点不同；XXE 要求解析器服务端触发受控 canary。删除 Signature 后报错、XML 可解析、NameID 文本变化、Base64 成功或 DTD 出现在请求中都不是阳性。
analysis.en: A signature flaw requires the SP to accept an unsigned or attacker-signed assertion and create the wrong principal. Replay requires a consumed or expired Assertion ID to create another session. XSW requires business logic to use a node different from the signed node. XXE requires the server parser to trigger a controlled canary. Rejection after Signature removal, parseable XML, changed Name ID text, successful Base64, or a DTD merely present in the request is not positive.

opsecTips.zh: 只建立一个合成低权限会话；不得读取系统文件、外带数据、使用真实 IdP 证书或向生产 ACS 提交断言。
opsecTips.en: Create at most one synthetic low-privilege session; do not read system files, exfiltrate data, use real Id P certificates, or submit assertions to a production ACS.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，撤销测试证书，删除断言、XML、resolver 日志和 Burp 项目，并恢复签名及解析器策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out test sessions, revoke test certificates, delete assertions, XML, resolver logs, and Burp projects, and restore signature and parser policy.

description.zh: 为SAML 签名验证边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。

overview.zh: SAML Response 可能包含 Response 签名、Assertion 签名或两者，SP 还要验证引用节点、Audience、Recipient、InResponseTo 和时间。XML 解析安全与协议签名安全是独立边界，编码步骤只是工具操作。
overview.en: A SAML Response may sign the Response, the Assertion, or both, while the SP also validates referenced nodes, Audience, Recipient, In Response To, and time. XML parser safety and protocol-signature safety are separate boundaries; encoding is only tooling.

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括只检查存在任意签名而未绑定消费节点、允许未签名断言、自签名证书被信任、未缓存 Assertion ID、XML 库允许外部实体，或不同组件对 NameID/XML 节点规范化不一致。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include checking for any signature without binding the consumed node, accepting unsigned assertions, trusting attacker certificates, failing to cache Assertion I Ds, allowing external entities, or inconsistent Name ID and XML-node canonicalization across components.

exploitation.zh: 先保存一个合法测试断言并验证所有协议字段，再一次只改变签名存在性、引用节点、Assertion ID 生命周期或本地实体。使用 XML 解析/签名日志和最终主体关联结果；不运行文件实体、外网 DTD 或命令执行链。
exploitation.en: Preserve one valid test assertion and verify all protocol fields, then change only signature presence, referenced node, Assertion-ID lifecycle, or a local entity. Correlate XML parser and signature logs with the final principal; do not run file entities, external DTDs, or command-execution chains.

mitigation.zh: 使用维护中的 SAML 库并固定可信 IdP 证书，只消费经过验证且由唯一 ID 引用的断言；严格校验 Audience、Recipient、Destination、InResponseTo 与时间，拒绝重放，并全面禁用 DTD、外部实体和 XInclude。
mitigation.en: Use a maintained SAML library with pinned trusted Id P certificates, consume only the uniquely identified validated assertion, strictly validate Audience, Recipient, Destination, In Response To, and time, reject replay, and disable DT Ds, external entities, and X Include.

name.zh: SAML Assertion 重放防护

Rejection after Signature removal, parseable XML, changed Name ID text, successful Base64, or a DTD merely present in the request is not positive.

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括只检查存在任意签名而未绑定消费节点、允许未签名断言、自签名证书被信任、未缓存 Assertion ID、XML 库允许外部实体，或不同组件对 NameID/XML 节点规范化不一致。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include checking for any signature without binding the consumed node, accepting unsigned assertions, trusting attacker certificates, failing to cache Assertion I Ds, allowing external entities, or inconsistent Name ID and XML-node canonicalization across components.

exploitation.zh: 先保存一个合法测试断言并验证所有协议字段，再一次只改变签名存在性、引用节点、Assertion ID 生命周期或本地实体。使用 XML 解析/签名日志和最终主体关联结果；不运行文件实体、外网 DTD 或命令执行链。
exploitation.en: Preserve one valid test assertion and verify all protocol fields, then change only signature presence, referenced node, Assertion-ID lifecycle, or a local entity. Correlate XML parser and signature logs with the final principal; do not run file entities, external DTDs, or command-execution chains.

mitigation.zh: 使用维护中的 SAML 库并固定可信 IdP 证书，只消费经过验证且由唯一 ID 引用的断言；严格校验 Audience、Recipient、Destination、InResponseTo 与时间，拒绝重放，并全面禁用 DTD、外部实体和 XInclude。
mitigation.en: Use a maintained SAML library with pinned trusted Id P certificates, consume only the uniquely identified validated assertion, strictly validate Audience, Recipient, Destination, In Response To, and time, reject replay, and disable DT Ds, external entities, and X Include.

name.zh: SAML XML 签名包装验证基线
name.en: SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SAML XML 签名包装验证基线验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SAML XML 签名包装验证基线验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

subCategory.zh: SAML XML 签名包装验证基线
subCategory.en: SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 IdP/SP、测试证书和两个合成主体，记录 Response/Assertion ID、InResponseTo、Audience、Recipient、时间与签名引用。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned Id P and SP, test certificates, and two synthetic principals, recording Response and Assertion I Ds, In Response To, Audience, Recipient, time, and signature references.

prerequisites.zh: XXE 仅使用无文件读取、无外网的本地 canary resolver；签名测试使用专用测试密钥和可销毁 SP。
prerequisites.en: For XXE, use a local canary resolver without file reads or egress; use a dedicated test key and disposable SP for signature tests.

title.zh: SAML XML 签名包装验证基线样例 1
title.en: SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline Sample 1

execution.command:
xmlsec1 --sign --privkey-pem fixtures/test-idp.key,fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion --output signed-test.xml fixtures/saml-signature-template.xml
xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion signed-test.xml

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该SAML XML 签名包装验证基线样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性签名缺陷要求 SP 接受未签名或攻击者签名的断言并建立错误主体；重放要求同一 Assertion ID 在过期或已消费后再次建立会话；XSW 要求业务层使用的断言与签名实际覆盖的节点不同；XXE 要求解析器服务端触发受控 canary。删除 Signature 后报错、XML 可解析、NameID 文本变化、Base64 成功或 DTD 出现在请求中都不是阳性。
analysis.en: A signature flaw requires the SP to accept an unsigned or attacker-signed assertion and create the wrong principal. Replay requires a consumed or expired Assertion ID to create another session. XSW requires business logic to use a node different from the signed node. XXE requires the server parser to trigger a controlled canary. Rejection after Signature removal, parseable XML, changed Name ID text, successful Base64, or a DTD merely present in the request is not positive.

opsecTips.zh: 只建立一个合成低权限会话；不得读取系统文件、外带数据、使用真实 IdP 证书或向生产 ACS 提交断言。
opsecTips.en: Create at most one synthetic low-privilege session; do not read system files, exfiltrate data, use real Id P certificates, or submit assertions to a production ACS.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，撤销测试证书，删除断言、XML、resolver 日志和 Burp 项目，并恢复签名及解析器策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out test sessions, revoke test certificates, delete assertions, XML, resolver logs, and Burp projects, and restore signature and parser policy.

title.zh: 建立安全基线

description.zh: 为SAML XML 签名包装验证基线准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline.

title.zh: 提交单变量样例

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

title.zh: SAML 解析器外部实体边界样例 1
title.en: SAML Parser External Entity Boundary Sample 1

execution.command:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE samlp:Response [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://127.0.0.1:18080/PAYLOADER_MARKER">]>
<samlp:Response xmlns:samlp="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol">
  <saml:Assertion xmlns:saml="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion">
    <saml:Subject><saml:NameID>&xxe;</saml:NameID></saml:Subject>
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
<!-- Local canary only: no file URI, external host, or data exfiltration. Secure parsers reject the DTD. -->

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SAML Name ID 规范化与身份绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

subCategory.zh: SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定
subCategory.en: SAML Name ID Canonicalization and Identity Binding

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 IdP/SP、测试证书和两个合成主体，记录 Response/Assertion ID、InResponseTo、Audience、Recipient、时间与签名引用。

title.zh: SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定样例 1
title.en: SAML Name ID Canonicalization and Identity Binding Sample 1

execution.command:
printf "%s" "PAYLOADER_TEST_SAML_RESPONSE" | base64 -d > saml-response.xml
xmlstarlet ed -N saml="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion" -u "//saml:NameID" -v "payloader-b@example.invalid" saml-response.xml > saml-modified.xml
base64 -w0 saml-modified.xml > saml-modified.b64

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this SAML Name ID Canonicalization and Identity Binding sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

title.zh: SAML NameID 规范化与身份绑定样例 2
title.en: SAML Name ID Canonicalization and Identity Binding Sample 2

execution.command:
xmlstarlet ed -N saml="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion" -u "//saml:NameID" -v "payloader-marker@example.invalid" signed-test.xml > tampered-test.xml
xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion tampered-test.xml
# Expected: only the fixture signed by the pinned test IdP key verifies; tampering fails.

exploitation.zh: 先保存一个合法测试断言并验证所有协议字段，再一次只改变签名存在性、引用节点、Assertion ID 生命周期或本地实体。使用 XML 解析/签名日志和最终主体关联结果；不运行文件实体、外网 DTD 或命令执行链。
exploitation.en: Preserve one valid test assertion and verify all protocol fields, then change only signature presence, referenced node, Assertion-ID lifecycle, or a local entity. Correlate XML parser and signature logs with the final principal; do not run file entities, external DTDs, or command-execution chains.

mitigation.zh: 使用维护中的 SAML 库并固定可信 IdP 证书，只消费经过验证且由唯一 ID 引用的断言；严格校验 Audience、Recipient、Destination、InResponseTo 与时间，拒绝重放，并全面禁用 DTD、外部实体和 XInclude。
mitigation.en: Use a maintained SAML library with pinned trusted Id P certificates, consume only the uniquely identified validated assertion, strictly validate Audience, Recipient, Destination, In Response To, and time, reject replay, and disable DT Ds, external entities, and X Include.

name.zh: 双因素认证服务端状态强制
name.en: 双因素认证服务端状态强制

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为双因素认证服务端状态强制验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为双因素认证服务端状态强制验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

subCategory.zh: 双因素认证服务端状态强制
subCategory.en: 双因素认证服务端状态强制

prerequisites.zh: 使用启用 2FA 的合成账户、可重置 TOTP secret、一次性恢复码和无敏感字段标记资源。
prerequisites.en: Use a synthetic account with 2FA, a resettable TOTP secret, single-use recovery codes, and a nonsensitive marker resource.

prerequisites.zh: 记录密码验证后、第二因子前后和恢复流程中的服务端认证级别、会话 ID、尝试计数与锁定事件。
prerequisites.en: 记录密码验证后、第二因子前后和恢复流程中的服务端认证级别、会话 ID、尝试计数与锁定事件。

title.zh: 双因素认证服务端状态强制样例 1
title.en: 双因素认证服务端状态强制样例 1

execution.command:
GET /marker HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.invalid
Cookie: session=PAYLOADER_FIRST_FACTOR_ONLY

POST /verify-2fa HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.invalid
Content-Type: application/json

{"otp":"000000","skip":true}
# Expected: the marker and skip flag are rejected unless the server session records a valid second factor.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该双因素认证服务端状态强制样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该双因素认证服务端状态强制样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。

analysis.zh: 阳性强制浏览要求仅完成第一因子的会话读取同一受保护标记对象；响应篡改只有导致服务端认证级别改变才成立；输入 schema 缺陷要求空值、数组或额外标志被服务端当作有效 OTP；恢复码必须证明重复使用或未受限验证。页面跳转、修改本地 JSON、HTTP 200 或一次并发异常都不是绕过。
analysis.en: Forced-browsing is positive only when a first-factor-only session reads the same protected marker. Response tampering matters only if server authentication level changes. An input-schema flaw requires an empty, array, or extra flag to be accepted as a valid OTP. Recovery-code flaws require replay or unthrottled validation. Navigation, local JSON edits, HTTP 200, or one concurrency anomaly are not bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 仅尝试少量预先批准的无效码和一个有效测试码；出现锁定、短信发送、恢复码消费或非预期会话升级立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Try only a few approved invalid codes and one valid test code; stop on lockout, message delivery, recovery-code consumption, or unintended session elevation.

opsecTips.zh: 轮换 TOTP secret 与恢复码，撤销测试会话，恢复尝试计数并删除 Burp 项目和临时响应。
opsecTips.en: Rotate the TOTP secret and recovery codes, revoke test sessions, restore attempt counters, and delete Burp projects and temporary responses.

description.zh: 为双因素认证服务端状态强制准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。

description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 2FA 是服务端认证状态机，而不是一个前端页面。需要分别验证第一因子会话能否访问受保护资源、OTP 输入是否严格、失败计数是否跨端点一致，以及恢复码是否单次使用。
overview.en: 2FA 是服务端认证状态机，而不是一个前端页面。需要分别验证第一因子会话能否访问受保护资源、OTP 输入是否严格、失败计数是否跨端点一致，以及恢复码是否单次使用。

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括受保护端点只检查第一因子、客户端字段决定验证状态、不同 API 未共享认证级别、OTP/恢复码 schema 宽松、限流非原子或只按可伪造 IP。修改响应若不改变服务端状态不构成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include protected endpoints checking only the first factor, client fields controlling verification state, APIs not sharing assurance level, loose OTP or recovery-code schemas, non-atomic throttling, or throttling only by spoofable IP. Response edits without server-state change are not vulnerabilities.

exploitation.zh: 先完成第一因子并记录会话认证级别，直接请求一个只读标记资源作为强制浏览对照。随后分别测试一个无效 OTP、缺失字段和已用恢复码；并发与速率只在极小预算下由工具执行，不枚举完整空间。
exploitation.en: Complete the first factor and record assurance level, then request one read-only marker as the forced-browsing control. Separately test one invalid OTP, a missing field, and a consumed recovery code. Run concurrency and rate checks only through tools with a tiny budget, never a full code space.

mitigation.zh: 把认证级别绑定到服务端会话并在所有受保护端点强制检查，OTP 和恢复码采用严格 schema、常量时间比较、原子单次消费和按账户节流；恢复与停用 2FA 要求重新认证和通知。
mitigation.en: Bind assurance level to the server session and enforce it on every protected endpoint. Apply strict schemas, constant-time comparison, atomic one-time consumption, and account-based throttling to OTPs and recovery codes, and require reauthentication and notification for recovery or 2FA removal.

title.zh: 双因素恢复码原子消费样例 1
title.en: Atomic Two-Factor Recovery Code Consumption Sample 1

execution.command:
import concurrent.futures
import requests
TARGET = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/test/verify-backup-code"
def consume(_):
    return requests.post(TARGET, json={"backup_code": "PAYLOADER_TEST_BACKUP", "session": "PAYLOADER_TEST_SESSION"}, timeout=5).status_code
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    results = list(pool.map(consume, range(2)))
print(results)
# Expected: exactly one request consumes the synthetic code; the other fails atomically.

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为CAPTCHA 挑战与会话绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为CAPTCHA 挑战与会话绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

prerequisites.zh: 使用合成账户、测试 CAPTCHA 提供方或本地固定挑战，并记录挑战 ID、会话、用途、答案哈希与消费状态。
prerequisites.en: Use a synthetic account and a test CAPTCHA provider or local fixed challenge, recording challenge ID, session, purpose, answer hash, and consumption state.

prerequisites.zh: 正常登录、移动 API 和旧 API 均指向同一无敏感字段标记账户，测试不会触发真实密码猜测或第三方识别服务。
prerequisites.en: Normal, mobile, and legacy APIs target the same nonsensitive marker account, and testing does not trigger real password guessing or third-party recognition services.

title.zh: CAPTCHA 挑战与会话绑定样例 1
title.en: CAPTCHA Challenge and Session Binding Sample 1

execution.command:
captcha=PAYLOADER_TEST_CAPTCHA
captcha=
captcha=null
captcha=undefined
captcha[]=
# Replay and malformed values are separate controls and must all be verified in server challenge logs.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该CAPTCHA 挑战与会话绑定样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this CAPTCHA Challenge and Session Binding sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性重放要求一个已消费挑战再次通过服务端验证；schema 缺陷要求空值、null、数组或缺失字段在应强制 CAPTCHA 的同一风险状态下被接受；路由缺陷要求替代 API 绕过同一服务端策略。HTTP 200、验证码图片可 OCR、前端隐藏字段、参数被解析或密码字段变化都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: Replay is positive only when a consumed challenge passes server validation again. A schema flaw requires empty, null, array, or missing input to be accepted under the same risk state. A route flaw requires an alternate API to bypass the same server policy. HTTP 200, OCR-readable images, front-end hidden fields, parsed parameters, or changed password fields are not bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 仅重放一个本地测试挑战并使用固定错误密码；不得运行密码字典、调用真实短信/语音通道或第三方 OCR。
opsecTips.en: Replay one local test challenge with a fixed wrong password; do not run password dictionaries, real SMS or voice channels, or third-party OCR.

opsecTips.zh: 销毁挑战、会话和测试账户状态，删除图片、识别输出和 Burp 项目，并确认挑战计数与风险状态恢复。
opsecTips.en: Destroy challenge, session, and test-account state, delete images, recognition output, and Burp projects, and confirm challenge counters and risk state recover.

title.zh: 建立安全基线

description.zh: 为CAPTCHA 挑战与会话绑定准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for CAPTCHA Challenge and Session Binding.

title.zh: 提交单变量样例

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
captcha=PAYLOADER_TEST_CAPTCHA
captcha=
captcha=null
captcha=undefined
captcha[]=
# Replay and malformed values are separate controls and must all be verified in server challenge logs.

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: CAPTCHA 是服务端风险控制的一部分，必须绑定会话、操作和一次性挑战。原集合的请求片段可验证重放与输入 schema，而 Burp、OCR 和 curl 连续步骤属于工具流程，不能留作 Payload。
overview.en: CAPTCHA 是服务端风险控制的一部分，必须绑定会话、操作和一次性挑战。原集合的请求片段可验证重放与输入 schema，而 Burp、OCR 和 curl 连续步骤属于工具流程，不能留作 Payload。

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括挑战未原子消费、只在前端校验、空值或错误类型走 fail-open 分支、移动/旧 API 未共享策略，或把答案/令牌直接返回客户端。可被机器识别是强度问题，不等于服务端绕过。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include non-atomic challenge consumption, client-only validation, fail-open handling of empty or wrong types, inconsistent mobile or legacy API policy, or returning answers or tokens to clients. Machine readability is a strength issue, not automatically server bypass.

exploitation.zh: 先完成一次本地固定挑战并记录消费状态，随后只重放同一请求一次。再分别提交空、null、缺失和数组值，并在相同风险条件下对比主、移动和旧 API；每轮只用固定错误密码并关联服务端挑战日志。
exploitation.en: Complete one local fixed challenge and record consumption, then replay that request once. Separately submit empty, null, missing, and array values and compare primary, mobile, and legacy APIs under the same risk state, always with a fixed wrong password and correlated challenge logs.

mitigation.zh: 服务端验证并原子消费短期挑战，绑定会话、操作和风险事件；对缺失与错误类型统一失败，所有 API 共用策略，答案不得返回客户端，并把 CAPTCHA 与账户节流、MFA 和异常检测组合使用。
mitigation.en: 服务端验证并原子消费短期挑战，绑定会话、操作和风险事件；对缺失与错误类型统一失败，所有 API 共用策略，答案不得返回客户端，并把 CAPTCHA 与账户节流、MFA 和异常检测组合使用。

curl -sS --max-time 5 -d "username=payloader&password=PAYLOADER_WRONG" http://127.0.0.1:8080/login

name.zh: 持久登录令牌完整性

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为持久登录令牌完整性验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为持久登录令牌完整性验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

prerequisites.zh: 使用可撤销的合成账户和隔离浏览器，记录 Remember-Me Cookie 的名称、属性、服务端令牌记录、设备会话和撤销事件。
prerequisites.en: Use a revocable synthetic account and isolated browser, recording remember-me cookie name, attributes, server token record, device sessions, and revocation events.

prerequisites.zh: Shiro 测试仅在确认版本、cipher mode、密钥配置和可销毁 Java 容器后进行，反序列化链替换为无进程本地 canary。
prerequisites.en: Test Shiro only after confirming version, cipher mode, key configuration, and a disposable Java container, replacing deserialization chains with a process-free local canary.

title.zh: 持久登录令牌完整性样例 1

execution.command:
printf "%s" "cGF5bG9hZGVyOjE5OTk5OTk5OTk6UEFZTE9BREVSX01BUktFUg==" | base64 -d
printf "%s" "payloader:1999999999:PAYLOADER_CHANGED" | base64
curl -sS --max-time 5 -b "remember=PAYLOADER_TAMPERED_VALUE" http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
# Expected: a modified synthetic cookie is rejected; readable encoding alone is not forgery.

analysis.zh: 普通令牌缺陷要求修改或跨设备重放 Cookie 后建立错误主体，且服务端日志确认令牌未正确绑定、签名或撤销。Shiro 缺陷要求目标版本和密钥条件匹配，并由反序列化审计触发无害 canary；deleteMe 响应、Base64 可解码、序列化魔数、默认密钥在字典中或工具生成密文都不是 RCE 证据。

overview.zh: Remember-Me 可以是服务端随机选择器，也可能是框架加密对象。前者关注完整性、过期、轮换和撤销；旧 Shiro 场景关注特定版本、密钥和反序列化边界。编码可读不等于可伪造，更不等于 RCE。
overview.en: Remember-Me 可以是服务端随机选择器，也可能是框架加密对象。前者关注完整性、过期、轮换和撤销；旧 Shiro 场景关注特定版本、密钥和反序列化边界。编码可读不等于可伪造，更不等于 RCE。

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括在 Cookie 中信任可修改身份字段、仅编码不做完整性保护、令牌长期不轮换或不撤销，以及旧框架使用已知密钥解密不可信序列化对象。Cookie 名大小写变化和客户端指纹不稳定不应被当作主要安全机制。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include trusting modifiable identity fields in cookies, encoding without integrity, failing to rotate or revoke long-lived tokens, and legacy frameworks decrypting untrusted serialized objects with known keys. Cookie-name case changes and unstable client fingerprints should not be primary controls.

exploitation.zh: 先用合成账户记录正常 Cookie、服务端令牌记录和注销行为，再一次只测试字段修改、跨设备重放或已撤销令牌。Shiro 分支先确认版本与 deleteMe 行为，再在无网络容器中用无进程 canary 检查解密/反序列化，禁止生成外连命令。
exploitation.en: Record the normal cookie, server token record, and logout behavior for a synthetic account, then test field modification, cross-device replay, or a revoked token one at a time. For Shiro, confirm version and delete Me behavior, then use a process-free canary in a networkless container to test decryption and deserialization without callback commands.

mitigation.zh: 持久登录使用高熵随机 selector/token，服务端存储 token 哈希并支持轮换、过期和全设备撤销；Cookie 设置 Secure、HttpOnly、SameSite 与最小作用域。升级 Shiro、使用唯一随机密钥并禁止反序列化不可信对象。
mitigation.en: 持久登录使用高熵随机 selector/token，服务端存储 token 哈希并支持轮换、过期和全设备撤销；Cookie 设置 Secure、HttpOnly、SameSite 与最小作用域。升级 Shiro、使用唯一随机密钥并禁止反序列化不可信对象。

name.zh: JWT none 算法拒绝

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为JWT none 算法拒绝验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为JWT none 算法拒绝验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 issuer、测试签名密钥、两个合成主体和只读标记 API，记录库版本、允许算法、kid resolver 与 JWKS 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned issuer, test signing keys, two synthetic principals, and a read-only marker API, recording library version, allowed algorithms, kid resolver, and JWKS configuration.

prerequisites.zh: 每个测试令牌具有唯一 jti、短期 exp、固定 iss/aud，弱密钥检查仅对自有离线样本执行。
prerequisites.en: Every test token has a unique jti, short exp, and fixed iss and aud; weak-secret checks run only against owned offline samples.

title.zh: JWT none 算法拒绝样例 1

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json, time
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
header = {"alg": "none", "typ": "JWT"}
payload = {"sub": "PAYLOADER_MARKER", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60, "aud": "payloader-api", "iss": "payloader-test"}
print(encode(header) + "." + encode(payload) + ".")
PY
# Submit only to the localhost fixture; expected result is signature rejection.

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该JWT none 算法拒绝样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this JWT None Algorithm Rejection sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求服务端接受未签名、错误算法、攻击者控制密钥来源或错误 issuer/audience 的测试令牌，并以错误主体读取同一标记资源。解码 payload、生成令牌、hashcat 找到自建弱密钥、JWKS 可访问、kid 字符串被解析、库抛错或令牌仅被网关回显都不是验证绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the server to accept an unsigned token, wrong algorithm, attacker-controlled key source, or wrong issuer or audience and read the same marker as the wrong principal. Decoding a payload, generating a token, finding an intentionally weak local secret, reaching JWKS, parsing a kid string, library errors, or gateway reflection are not validation bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 仅使用测试密钥和低权限 claim；不得破解真实令牌密钥、读取管理员 API、托管恶意公网 JWKS 或复用生产证书。
opsecTips.en: Use only test keys and low-privilege claims; do not crack real token secrets, access administrator APIs, host malicious public JWKS, or reuse production certificates.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销所有测试 jti 和密钥，删除令牌、字典、JWKS 与工具输出，清理 issuer/resource-server 缓存。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test jtis and keys, delete tokens, wordlists, JWKS, and tool output, and clear issuer and resource-server caches.

title.zh: 提交单变量样例

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。

attackChain.payload:
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, json, time
encode = lambda value: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
header = {"alg": "none", "typ": "JWT"}
payload = {"sub": "PAYLOADER_MARKER", "iat": int(time.time()), "exp": int(time.time()) + 60, "aud": "payloader-api", "iss": "payloader-test"}
print(encode(header) + "." + encode(payload) + ".")
PY
# Submit only to the localhost fixture; expected result is signature rejection.

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

overview.zh: JWT 只是令牌格式，安全性取决于验证方固定算法和密钥来源，并校验 issuer、audience、时间与用途。解码和离线密钥审计是工具流程；none、算法混淆、kid 与 jku/jwk 是不同信任边界。
overview.en: JWT is a token format whose security depends on verifier-fixed algorithms and key sources plus issuer, audience, time, and purpose checks. Decoding and offline secret audits are tools; none, algorithm confusion, kid, and jku or jwk are different trust boundaries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括从令牌 alg 动态选择未允许算法、混用 HMAC 与非对称密钥、弱 HMAC secret、把 kid 拼进 SQL/路径、信任任意 jku/jwk，以及未校验 iss、aud、exp、nbf 或 token type。每类都需单独验证。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include selecting unapproved algorithms from token alg, confusing HMAC and asymmetric keys, weak HMAC secrets, concatenating kid into SQL or paths, trusting arbitrary jku or jwk, and omitting iss, aud, exp, nbf, or token-type checks. Validate each separately.

exploitation.zh: 先用测试 issuer 签发一个短期正常令牌并访问标记 API，再一次只改变签名算法、密钥来源、kid 或一个 claim。离线工具只处理自建令牌；服务端测试以主体、验证库日志、选中 key ID 和资源授权日志共同确认。
exploitation.en: Issue one short-lived valid token from the test issuer and access the marker API, then change only algorithm, key source, kid, or one claim. Offline tools process only self-created tokens; server tests correlate principal, verifier logs, selected key ID, and resource authorization logs.

mitigation.zh: 在服务器配置中固定允许算法和每种 token type 的验证规则，隔离 HMAC 与非对称密钥，使用高熵 secret；kid 仅作允许列表键，远程 JWKS 固定 issuer、HTTPS 主机和 key 属性，并严格校验 iss、aud、时间与用途。
mitigation.en: Fix allowed algorithms and validation rules per token type in server configuration, separate HMAC and asymmetric keys, use high-entropy secrets, treat kid only as an allowlisted lookup key, pin remote JWKS to issuer, HTTPS host, and key properties, and strictly validate iss, aud, time, and purpose.
