name.zh: 服务端原型链污染边界验证
name.en: 服务端原型链污染边界验证

description.zh: 使用无害 marker 验证深度合并是否拒绝 __proto__、constructor.prototype 与嵌套原型路径，并把依赖与合并函数审计迁入工具区。
description.en: Use harmless markers to verify that deep merges reject __proto__, constructor.prototype, and nested prototype paths, while moving dependency and merge-function audits into tools.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无网络出口的 127.0.0.1 Node.js Fixture，并在每次请求后重启或清理 Worker。
prerequisites.en: Use a no-egress 127.0.0.1 Node.js fixture and restart or clean the worker after each request.

prerequisites.zh: 响应只暴露 ownMarker 与 prototypeMarker 两个布尔或空值证据，不读取文件也不启动子进程。
prerequisites.en: Expose only own Marker and prototype Marker boolean or null evidence in responses, without reading files or starting child processes.

title.zh: __proto__ Marker 边界

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/prototype/merge" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: proto-a1" --data '{"__proto__":{"labMarker":"PROTO_CANARY_A1"}}' | jq -e '.ownMarker == null and .prototypeMarker == null'

description.zh: 提交合成 __proto__ marker，并断言响应中的直接属性和原型属性均为空。
description.en: Submit a synthetic __proto__ marker and assert that own and inherited marker fields in the response are null.

title.zh: constructor.prototype Marker 边界

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/prototype/merge" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: proto-b2" --data '{"constructor":{"prototype":{"labMarker":"PROTO_CANARY_B2"}}}' | jq -e '.ownMarker == null and .prototypeMarker == null'

description.zh: 提交 constructor.prototype 路径 marker，验证 Schema 和合并逻辑同时拒绝危险键。
description.en: Submit a constructor.prototype marker to verify that both schema validation and merge logic reject dangerous keys.

analysis.zh: marker 仅在响应 JSON 中出现不代表原型污染；必须证明它来自新对象的继承链。即使污染原语成立，也不能直接写成 RCE，除非另有确定版本、调用路径和无害 Gadget 证据。
analysis.en: A marker appearing only in response JSON does not prove prototype pollution; it must be inherited by a fresh object. Even when the primitive is confirmed, it must not be labeled RCE without separate evidence for the exact version, call path, and a harmless gadget effect.

opsecTips.zh: 每次 marker 请求后销毁 Worker，避免污染状态影响后续测试或其他开发任务。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the worker after each marker request so polluted state cannot affect later tests or other development work.

opsecTips.zh: 禁止使用 child_process、环境变量覆盖、文件读取或外连 Gadget；证据只使用合成字符串。
opsecTips.en: Do not use child_process, environment overrides, file reads, or outbound gadgets; use synthetic strings as the only evidence.

title.zh: 嵌套 __proto__ Marker 边界

wafBypass.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/prototype/merge" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: proto-c3" --data '{"settings":{"__proto__":{"labMarker":"PROTO_CANARY_C3"}}}' | jq -e '.ownMarker == null and .prototypeMarker == null'

description.zh: 把 marker 放入 settings 子对象，验证递归合并每一层都执行危险键检查。
description.en: Place the marker inside settings to verify dangerous-key checks at every recursive merge level.

title.zh: 固定全新 Worker 基线

description.zh: 启动无网络出口的实验 Worker，确认普通对象上不存在任何测试 marker。
description.en: Start the no-egress fixture worker and confirm that ordinary objects contain no test marker.

title.zh: 提交单一原型路径

description.zh: 一次只提交一种危险键路径，并要求响应区分直接属性与原型继承属性。
description.en: Submit one dangerous-key path at a time and require the response to distinguish own and inherited properties.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/prototype/merge" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: proto-a1" --data '{"__proto__":{"labMarker":"PROTO_CANARY_A1"}}' | jq -e '.ownMarker == null and .prototypeMarker == null'

title.zh: 验证跨对象影响

description.zh: 在独立请求中创建新对象并检查 marker，排除单纯回显、缓存和请求对象复用。
description.en: Create a fresh object in an independent request and inspect the marker, excluding reflection, caching, and request-object reuse.

title.zh: 定位合并点并回归

description.zh: 把阳性 marker 关联到具体合并函数或依赖，修复后对全部路径重复测试。
description.en: Map a positive marker to a specific merge function or dependency and repeat every path after remediation.

overview.zh: 服务端原型链污染的第一步是证明非可信键进入递归合并并影响后续新对象，而不是直接假定存在 RCE Gadget。条目使用三个合成 marker 覆盖常见键路径，配合静态合并点和依赖版本审计，明确区分污染原语、可观察影响和版本特定 Gadget。
overview.en: 服务端原型链污染的第一步是证明非可信键进入递归合并并影响后续新对象，而不是直接假定存在 RCE Gadget。条目使用三个合成 marker 覆盖常见键路径，配合静态合并点和依赖版本审计，明确区分污染原语、可观察影响和版本特定 Gadget。

vulnerability.zh: 漏洞通常来自递归复制可枚举键时未拒绝 __proto__、prototype 或 constructor，或使用存在已知缺陷的深度合并库。只有 marker 出现在请求输入没有直接赋值的新对象原型上，且能排除缓存、单例状态和响应回显时，才确认污染原语；RCE 需要额外且独立的 Gadget 证据。
vulnerability.en: The flaw usually comes from recursively copying enumerable keys without rejecting __proto__, prototype, or constructor, or from a vulnerable deep-merge dependency. Confirm the primitive only when a marker appears on the prototype of a fresh object that was not directly assigned by the request, excluding cache, singleton state, and response reflection. RCE requires separate gadget evidence.

exploitation.zh: 对全新 Worker 依次提交 __proto__、constructor.prototype 和嵌套路径 marker，每次请求后查询独立的新对象并断言原型上没有 marker。随后静态定位合并函数，检查是否只复制 own properties、是否拒绝危险键以及依赖版本。若出现污染，立即重启进程并保留最小请求和日志。
exploitation.en: Against a fresh worker, submit __proto__, constructor.prototype, and nested-path markers one at a time, then query an independent fresh object and assert that no marker exists on its prototype. Statically locate merge functions and check own-property handling, dangerous-key rejection, and dependency versions. If pollution appears, restart the process immediately and retain the minimal request and logs.

mitigation.zh: 在 Schema 层拒绝未知字段和危险键，使用 Object.create(null) 或 Map 存储任意键值；递归合并只处理 own properties，并显式拒绝 __proto__、prototype 与 constructor。升级受影响依赖并添加回归测试，验证新对象原型保持未污染。
mitigation.en: Reject unknown fields and dangerous keys at the schema boundary, and use Object.create(null) or Map for arbitrary key-value storage. Recursive merge code must process own properties only and explicitly reject __proto__, prototype, and constructor. Upgrade affected dependencies and add regression tests asserting that fresh object prototypes remain clean.

name.zh: 客户端原型链污染到 DOM Sink 边界
name.en: Client-Side Prototype Pollution to DOM-Sink Boundary

description.zh: 使用本地 URL marker 区分查询解析器污染、配置继承和 DOM Sink 实际解释，并通过真实 Chromium 回归确认是否形成脚本执行边界。
description.en: Use local URL markers to distinguish query-parser pollution, inherited configuration, and actual DOM-sink interpretation, then confirm any script-execution boundary with real Chromium regression.

subCategory.zh: 客户端污染源与 DOM Sink
subCategory.en: Client Pollution Sources and DOM Sinks

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 浏览器 Fixture，并在每个用例后重新加载独立页面和清理 Object.prototype marker。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 browser fixture, reloading an isolated page and clearing Object.prototype markers after every case.

prerequisites.zh: 页面通过 textContent、属性快照和 CSP 报告记录证据，不访问 Cookie、存储、网络凭据或真实业务 DOM。
prerequisites.en: Record evidence through text Content, attribute snapshots, and CSP reports without accessing cookies, storage, network credentials, or real business DOM.

title.zh: 基础 URL 污染 Marker

description.zh: 提交基础 __proto__ marker，用于判断全新对象是否继承该值。
description.en: 提交基础 __proto__ marker，用于判断全新对象是否继承该值。

title.zh: 无脚本 innerHTML Marker

description.zh: 提交只含 span 和 data-lab-marker 的 HTML 字符串，观察它是否进入具体 DOM Sink。
description.en: Submit an HTML string containing only span and data-lab-marker and observe whether it reaches a specific DOM sink.

title.zh: Sanitizer 配置 Marker

description.zh: 提交无事件属性的允许列表 marker，区分配置继承与实际脚本解释。
description.en: Submit an allowlist marker with no event attributes to distinguish inherited configuration from actual script interpretation.

analysis.zh: 结论应分为污染源、可观察 DOM 影响和脚本执行三级。只有浏览器实际解释了可执行上下文才能写为 XSS；marker 被继承或以文本形式出现在 DOM 中不应升级漏洞影响。
analysis.en: Classify conclusions as pollution source, observable DOM impact, and script execution. Label XSS only when the browser actually interprets an executable context; an inherited marker or text appearing in DOM must not inflate impact.

opsecTips.zh: Payload 只使用 span 与 data-lab-marker，不包含 onerror、script、javascript URL、Cookie 或网络请求。
opsecTips.en: Payloads use only span and data-lab-marker, with no onerror, script, javascript URLs, cookies, or network requests.

opsecTips.zh: 每个用例关闭浏览器上下文并删除 Object.prototype marker，避免污染状态泄漏到其他测试。
opsecTips.en: Close the browser context and delete Object.prototype markers after each case so polluted state cannot leak into other tests.

title.zh: 编码与嵌套路径 Marker

description.zh: 依次测试编码 __proto__、constructor.prototype 与嵌套路径，每行保持独立 marker。
description.en: Test encoded __proto__, constructor.prototype, and nested paths with a distinct marker on each line.

title.zh: 建立干净原型基线

description.zh: 在全新浏览器上下文中记录普通对象、查询解析结果和 DOM 的无 marker 状态。
description.en: Record marker-free ordinary objects, parsed query output, and DOM state in a fresh browser context.

attackChain.payload: http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/prototype-client?__proto__[labMarker]=PROTO_CLIENT_A1

title.zh: 证明污染源

description.zh: 提交单一危险键路径，并要求后续全新对象继承唯一 marker，而不是只观察请求回显。
description.en: Submit one dangerous-key path and require a later fresh object to inherit the unique marker rather than relying on request reflection.

title.zh: 定位 DOM Sink

description.zh: 跟踪继承属性是否进入 innerHTML 或 Sanitizer 配置，并记录最终 DOM 而非假设 Gadget。
description.en: Trace whether inherited properties enter inner HTML or sanitizer configuration and record the final DOM instead of assuming a gadget.

title.zh: 修复后运行 Chromium 回归

description.zh: 修复后重放全部路径，要求原型保持干净、marker 不进入 Sink 且无 CSP violation。
description.en: Replay every path after remediation and require a clean prototype, no marker reaching the sink, and no CSP violation.

overview.zh: 客户端原型链污染需要先证明 URL 或消息解析器把危险键写入共享原型，再证明某个 DOM 或库 Gadget 读取继承属性并进入可解释的 Sink。污染 marker、配置变化和 XSS 是三个不同结论。本条目保留无脚本 marker Payload，并把自动化浏览器诊断迁入工具区。
overview.en: Client-side prototype pollution first requires proof that a URL or message parser writes dangerous keys to a shared prototype, followed by proof that a DOM or library gadget reads an inherited property into an interpretable sink. A pollution marker, configuration change, and XSS are three separate conclusions. This entry retains script-free marker payloads and moves automated browser diagnostics into tools.

vulnerability.zh: 仅看到 ({}).marker 或 URL 中存在 __proto__ 不能证明 XSS。确认污染源需要全新对象继承 marker；确认 DOM 影响需要 marker 到达特定 Sink；确认 XSS 还需要浏览器实际解释脚本或事件属性。响应回显、直接对象属性、库版本猜测和控制台字符串都属于不足证据。
vulnerability.en: Seeing ({}).marker or __proto__ in a URL does not prove XSS. Confirm a pollution source only when a fresh object inherits the marker, confirm DOM impact when the marker reaches a specific sink, and confirm XSS only when the browser interprets script or event attributes. Reflection, direct object properties, library-version guesses, and console strings are insufficient.

exploitation.zh: 先加载无参数页面建立 Object.prototype 与 DOM 快照，再依次提交基础、innerHTML 配置、允许属性配置和三种编码路径 marker。每次使用独立页面上下文，保存新对象属性、实际 DOM 节点和 CSP violation；样例只包含 span 与 data-lab-marker，不包含事件处理器、javascript URL 或数据外带。
exploitation.en: Load a parameter-free page to establish Object.prototype and DOM snapshots, then submit basic, inner HTML-configuration, allowed-attribute, and three encoded-path markers one at a time. Use a fresh page context for every case and preserve fresh-object properties, actual DOM nodes, and CSP violations. Samples contain only span and data-lab-marker, with no event handlers, javascript UR Ls, or exfiltration.

mitigation.zh: 查询和消息解析器应拒绝 __proto__、prototype 与 constructor，任意键值使用 Map 或 Object.create(null)。升级受影响库，DOM 写入使用 textContent 或严格 Sanitizer，并通过 CSP 限制脚本来源。回归测试应同时断言新对象原型无 marker 且 DOM Sink 不读取继承配置。
mitigation.en: Query and message parsers should reject __proto__, prototype, and constructor, using Map or Object.create (null) for arbitrary keys. Upgrade affected libraries, write to DOM through text Content or a strict sanitizer, and constrain scripts with CSP. Regression tests should assert both clean fresh-object prototypes and DOM sinks that ignore inherited configuration.

name.zh: 原型链污染与 NoSQL 查询构造边界
name.en: Prototype Pollution and NoSQL Query-Construction Boundary

description.zh: 使用合成用户和 operator marker 验证 JSON 或表单输入是否被当作 MongoDB 查询对象，以及原型属性是否进入查询构造。
description.en: Use a synthetic user and operator markers to validate whether JSON or form input becomes a MongoDB query object and whether inherited properties enter query construction.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 NoSQL Fixture，数据库只含一个合成 lab-user 文档且不签发 Token。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 NoSQL fixture, whose database contains one synthetic lab-user document and never issues tokens.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端日志能够记录解析后的值类型、拒绝原因、最终查询 AST、matched_count 与 request_id。
prerequisites.en: Server logs record parsed value types, rejection reason, final query AST, matched_count, and request_id.

title.zh: JSON Operator 拒绝样例

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/nosql/filter" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: nosql-a1" --data '{"username":"lab-user","status":{"$ne":"disabled"},"marker":"NOSQL_OPERATOR_A1"}' | jq -e '.operator_rejected == true and .matched_count == 0'

description.zh: 把合成 status 字段改为 $ne 对象，并断言在查询前拒绝且无匹配结果。
description.en: Change the synthetic status field to a $ne object and assert rejection before querying with no matched result.

title.zh: 原型查询 Marker 样例

execution.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/nosql/filter" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: nosql-b2" --data '{"__proto__":{"filterMarker":"NOSQL_PROTO_B2"},"username":"lab-user"}' | jq -e '.prototype_marker == null and .matched_count == 1'

description.zh: 提交 __proto__.filterMarker 并断言原型值为空、正常合成用户查询仍保持单条结果。
description.en: Submit __proto__.filter Marker and assert a null prototype value while the normal synthetic-user query remains one result.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要异常输入改变最终查询 AST 或 matched_count，并能排除直接回显和测试数据差异。操作符被拒绝、原型 marker 为空或 matched_count=0 都是有效阻断，不能被描述为认证绕过。
analysis.en: A positive requires abnormal input to change the final query AST or matched_count while excluding reflection and fixture-data differences. Operator rejection, a null prototype marker, or matched_count=0 are effective blocking outcomes and must not be described as authentication bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 只查询合成 lab-user，不使用 admin、密码、Token、邮箱、真实集合或逐字符循环。
opsecTips.en: Query only the synthetic lab-user, with no admin identity, passwords, tokens, emails, real collections, or character-by-character loops.

opsecTips.zh: 每个请求限制五秒并保存 request_id；出现数据库错误激增、查询队列积压或非合成字段时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Limit each request to five seconds and preserve request_id; stop on elevated database errors, query backlog, or any non-synthetic field.

title.zh: 表单 Operator 拒绝样例

wafBypass.command: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/nosql/filter" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -H "X-Request-ID: nosql-c3" --data-urlencode "username=lab-user" --data-urlencode "status[$ne]=disabled" | jq -e '.operator_rejected == true and .matched_count == 0'

description.zh: 通过表单括号语法提交同一 $ne 语义，验证第二解析器执行相同 Schema。
description.en: Submit the same $ne semantic through form bracket syntax to verify identical schema enforcement in the second parser.

title.zh: 建立标量查询基线

description.zh: 用合成 lab-user 字符串记录解析类型、查询 AST 和 matched_count=1 的正常结果。
description.en: Use the synthetic lab-user string to record parsed type, query AST, and normal matched_count=1.

title.zh: 提交单一操作符对象

description.zh: 把一个字段从字符串改为 $ne 对象，要求 Schema 在数据库调用前拒绝。
description.en: Change one field from a string to a $ne object and require schema rejection before any database call.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/nosql/filter" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: nosql-a1" --data '{"username":"lab-user","status":{"$ne":"disabled"},"marker":"NOSQL_OPERATOR_A1"}' | jq -e '.operator_rejected == true and .matched_count == 0'

title.zh: 单独验证原型路径

description.zh: 提交 __proto__ marker 并检查最终查询 AST 与新对象，确认继承键没有进入查询。
description.en: Submit a __proto__ marker and inspect the final query AST plus a fresh object to ensure inherited keys never enter the query.

title.zh: 覆盖第二解析器并回归
title.en: Cover the second parser and regress

description.zh: 用表单括号语法重复操作符测试，修复后要求 JSON 和表单路径结果一致。
description.en: Repeat the operator test with form bracket syntax and require consistent JSON and form behavior after remediation.

overview.zh: NoSQL 注入的关键是非可信输入从标量变成操作符对象，原型链污染则可能让未显式提供的继承属性进入查询构造。两者需要分别证明再判断是否形成组合链。本条目使用合成记录和 matched_count，不进行认证绕过、密码提取或数据导出。
overview.en: NoSQL injection occurs when untrusted input changes from a scalar into an operator object, while prototype pollution may introduce inherited properties that were never explicitly supplied into query construction. Prove each primitive separately before claiming a combined chain. This entry uses synthetic records and matched_count without authentication bypass, password extraction, or data export.

vulnerability.zh: 如果 API 接受任意 JSON 对象并直接传给 find、findOne 或 aggregate，$ne、$regex 等操作符可能改变查询语义；如果构造器遍历继承键，原型 marker 也可能进入查询。确认问题需要保存最终查询 AST 和结果差分，不能仅凭请求包含美元键、状态码 200 或响应时间变化下结论。
vulnerability.en: If an API accepts arbitrary JSON objects and passes them directly to find, find One, or aggregate, operators such as $ne or $regex may alter query semantics. If a builder enumerates inherited keys, prototype markers may also enter the query. Confirmation requires the final query AST and a result differential; a dollar-prefixed key, HTTP 200, or timing change alone is insufficient.

exploitation.zh: 先提交 username 字符串建立 matched_count=1 的基线，再分别提交 JSON operator 对象、__proto__ marker 和表单括号语法。每次使用唯一 request_id，要求操作符被拒绝、原型 marker 为空且异常样例 matched_count=0。工具区的三项差分仅对合成记录运行，不迭代字符也不导出字段。
exploitation.en: Submit a username string first to establish matched_count=1, then test a JSON operator object, a __proto__ marker, and form bracket syntax separately. Use a unique request_id and require operator rejection, a null prototype marker, and matched_count=0 for abnormal cases. The three-case differential tool runs only against synthetic records and never iterates characters or exports fields.

mitigation.zh: 通过 Schema 将用户名等字段强制为标量并拒绝未知或美元前缀键，不把请求对象直接传给数据库驱动。使用显式字段构造查询、关闭服务端 JavaScript、拒绝危险原型键，并对对象只遍历 own properties。回归测试应覆盖 JSON 与表单解析器。
mitigation.en: 通过 Schema 将用户名等字段强制为标量并拒绝未知或美元前缀键，不把请求对象直接传给数据库驱动。使用显式字段构造查询、关闭服务端 Java Script、拒绝危险原型键，并对对象只遍历 own properties。回归测试应覆盖 JSON 与表单解析器。

name.zh: 跨站 WebSocket 会话边界验证

description.zh: 验证浏览器跨站握手时 Origin、Cookie、子协议和消息级授权是否共同阻止跨站 WebSocket 会话劫持。
description.en: Validate whether Origin checks, cookies, subprotocols, and message-level authorization jointly prevent cross-site Web Socket session hijacking.

prerequisites.zh: 使用本地 ws://127.0.0.1 实验端点，并准备只返回 marker 的无敏感数据测试账号。
prerequisites.en: Use the local ws://127.0.0.1 fixture and a test identity that returns markers only and has no sensitive data.

prerequisites.zh: 同时采集握手状态、Origin、Cookie 是否附带、子协议、消息授权结果和连接关闭码。
prerequisites.en: Capture handshake status, Origin, cookie presence, subprotocol, message authorization result, and connection close code together.

title.zh: 浏览器跨站 echo 样例

execution.command: pending

description.zh: 从本地页面建立 WebSocket 并只发送合成 echo marker，结果使用 textContent 显示且不外带。
description.en: Open a Web Socket from a local page and send only a synthetic echo marker, rendering the result with text Content and no exfiltration.

title.zh: 消息授权预览样例

description.zh: 在既有 socket 上发送无敏感字段的 profile_preview marker，用于区分握手成功与消息授权成功。
description.en: Send a profile_preview marker with no sensitive fields over an existing socket to distinguish handshake success from message authorization.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据需要跨站浏览器 Origin、自动携带的有效身份和受保护消息成功三者同时成立。命令行客户端可以伪造 Origin，因此它只能测试服务端策略，不能单独证明浏览器可利用的 CSWSH。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a cross-site browser Origin, automatically carried valid identity, and successful protected messaging together. A command-line client can forge Origin, so it tests server policy but cannot by itself prove browser-exploitable CSWSH.

opsecTips.zh: 测试账号只允许 echo 与权限预览，消息体不得包含真实聊天、Token、密码或个人资料。
opsecTips.en: The test identity may use only echo and authorization-preview actions, with no real chat, token, password, or profile data in messages.

opsecTips.zh: 限制连接时长和消息数量，按正常关闭码结束并删除本地抓取文件中的 Cookie Header。
opsecTips.en: Limit connection duration and message count, close with a normal code, and remove cookie headers from local capture files.

title.zh: 比较握手策略

description.zh: 分别使用同源、跨站与 null Origin，保存状态码、选择的子协议和连接关闭原因。
description.en: Use same-origin, cross-site, and null Origin values and preserve status, selected subprotocol, and close reason.

title.zh: 建立浏览器跨站连接

description.zh: 从本地 HTML 建立连接并只发送 echo marker，确认浏览器侧凭据与 Origin 行为。
description.en: Connect from local HTML and send only an echo marker to verify browser credential and Origin behavior.

attackChain.payload: pending

title.zh: 验证消息级授权

description.zh: 发送 profile_preview marker，要求服务端返回授权结果而不是任何真实资料内容。
description.en: Send a profile_preview marker and require an authorization result rather than real profile content.

title.zh: 关联日志并复验

description.zh: 按 request marker 关联握手与消息日志，修复后要求跨站连接或受保护消息被拒绝。
description.en: Correlate handshake and message logs by marker and require the cross-site connection or protected message to be rejected after remediation.

overview.zh: CSWSH 发生在浏览器自动携带会话凭据，而服务端没有严格验证 Origin 或消息级授权时。条目把握手采集、Origin 矩阵与有界消息记录迁入工具区，Payload 区只保留浏览器建立跨站连接和发送无害 marker 的最小样例。
overview.en: CSWSH occurs when the browser automatically carries session credentials while the server fails to enforce Origin and message-level authorization. Handshake collection, Origin matrices, and bounded message capture move to tools; payloads retain only minimal browser samples that establish a cross-site connection and send harmless markers.

vulnerability.zh: 能够建立 WebSocket 连接不等于会话已被劫持；公开匿名端点、无 Cookie 的 Token 认证端点或连接后拒绝敏感消息的服务都可能安全。确认问题必须证明跨站浏览器连接携带了受害者身份，并能读取受保护数据或执行受保护动作。
vulnerability.en: 能够建立 Web Socket 连接不等于会话已被劫持；公开匿名端点、无 Cookie 的 Token 认证端点或连接后拒绝敏感消息的服务都可能安全。确认问题必须证明跨站浏览器连接携带了受害者身份，并能读取受保护数据或执行受保护动作。

exploitation.zh: 先采集同源与跨站 Origin 的握手差异，再从本地 HTML 页面建立浏览器连接并发送唯一 echo marker。随后发送一个只返回权限结果的 profile_preview 消息，记录服务端身份、授权判定和关闭码。所有消息都应限制次数，不保存 Token、Cookie 或业务数据。
exploitation.en: First compare same-origin and cross-site handshake behavior, then establish a browser connection from a local HTML page and send a unique echo marker. Next send a profile_preview message that returns only an authorization result, recording server identity, authorization decision, and close code. Bound message counts and never store tokens, cookies, or business data.

mitigation.zh: 在握手阶段精确允许受信 Origin，拒绝缺失或 null Origin，除非有明确业务需求；使用 SameSite Cookie 或显式短期 Token 降低环境凭据风险；每条消息执行身份与对象授权、Schema 校验、速率限制和大小限制，并在注销后立即失效连接。
mitigation.en: Allow only trusted Origins during the handshake and reject missing or null Origin unless explicitly required. Use SameSite cookies or explicit short-lived tokens to reduce ambient-credential risk. Enforce identity and object authorization, schema validation, rate and size limits on every message, and terminate connections immediately after logout.

name.zh: WebSocket 会话生命周期与频道授权
name.en: Web Socket Session Lifecycle and Channel Authorization

description.zh: 使用合成 Token 与频道验证连接建立、Token 过期、注销失效、对象级订阅授权、传输降级及消息大小限制。
description.en: Use synthetic tokens and channels to validate connection establishment, token expiry, logout invalidation, object-level subscription authorization, transport downgrade, and message-size limits.

subCategory.zh: 会话生命周期与对象授权

prerequisites.zh: 使用本地 WebSocket Fixture 和 LAB_ACTIVE、LAB_EXPIRED、LAB_REVOKED 三个无真实权限的合成 Token。
prerequisites.en: Use the local Web Socket fixture and synthetic LAB_ACTIVE, LAB_EXPIRED, and LAB_REVOKED tokens with no real privileges.

prerequisites.zh: 准备 self 与 other 两个合成频道，服务端只返回 allow/deny、marker 和关闭码。
prerequisites.en: Prepare synthetic self and other channels, with the server returning only allow/deny, markers, and close codes.

title.zh: Self 与 Other 频道授权差分

execution.command:
socket.send(JSON.stringify({action: "subscribe", channel: "user.lab-self.notifications", marker: "WS_AUTHZ_A1"}));
socket.send(JSON.stringify({action: "subscribe", channel: "user.lab-other.notifications", marker: "WS_AUTHZ_B2"}));

description.zh: 在同一连接只发送 self 和 other 两条订阅 marker，期望前者允许、后者拒绝。
description.en: Send only self and other subscription markers on one connection and expect the former allowed and the latter denied.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须绑定服务端已识别身份、资源所有者、消息动作和授权结果。客户端打印 connected、握手 101、连接未立即断开或公开 echo 返回都不是授权绕过证据。
analysis.en: A positive must bind server-recognized identity, resource owner, message action, and authorization result. A client printing connected, HTTP 101, a connection remaining open briefly, or a public echo response is not authorization-bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用两个合成频道和三个 LAB Token，不记录真实 Authorization、Cookie、消息内容或用户标识。
opsecTips.en: Use only two synthetic channels and three LAB tokens, recording no real authorization header, cookie, message content, or user identifier.

opsecTips.zh: 速率测试限制五条消息和 64 KiB，出现队列积压、异常关闭或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Limit rate testing to five messages and 64 Ki B, stopping on queue buildup, abnormal closure, or service instability.

title.zh: 建立活动会话基线

description.zh: 使用 ACTIVE Token 记录握手身份、子协议、self 频道 allow 和正常关闭码。
description.en: Use the ACTIVE token to record handshake identity, subprotocol, self-channel allow, and normal close code.

title.zh: 比较 self 与 other 频道

description.zh: 在同一连接只发送两条订阅 marker，要求 self allow、other deny。
description.en: Send only two subscription markers on one connection and require self allow plus other deny.

attackChain.payload:
socket.send(JSON.stringify({action: "subscribe", channel: "user.lab-self.notifications", marker: "WS_AUTHZ_A1"}));
socket.send(JSON.stringify({action: "subscribe", channel: "user.lab-other.notifications", marker: "WS_AUTHZ_B2"}));

title.zh: 验证过期与撤销

description.zh: 分别检查过期握手、撤销握手和注销后既有连接，保存关闭码与拒绝原因。
description.en: Check expired handshake, revoked handshake, and an existing connection after logout, preserving close codes and denial reasons.

title.zh: 覆盖降级与限制回归

description.zh: 在降级传输和有界大小用例上复用相同策略，修复后要求结果一致。
description.en: Reuse the same policy on fallback transport and bounded-size cases and require consistent results after remediation.

overview.zh: WebSocket 鉴权不是握手一次通过就结束；Token 过期、用户注销、连接重连和每条消息的对象授权都必须保持一致。本条目只把两个固定频道的订阅差分保留为 Payload，其余生命周期、速率和传输检查迁入工具区。
overview.en: Web Socket authorization does not end after one successful handshake. Token expiry, logout, reconnection, and object authorization for every message must remain consistent. This entry retains only a two-channel subscription differential as payload and moves lifecycle, rate, and transport checks into tools.

vulnerability.zh: 连接成功不代表授权绕过，订阅消息被接受也不代表收到受保护数据。阳性需要过期或撤销身份仍能执行受保护消息，或低权限身份能订阅另一个对象的频道，并由服务端身份、频道所有者和 allow 结果关联。匿名公共频道和正确 deny 都是正常行为。
vulnerability.en: 连接成功不代表授权绕过，订阅消息被接受也不代表收到受保护数据。阳性需要过期或撤销身份仍能执行受保护消息，或低权限身份能订阅另一个对象的频道，并由服务端身份、频道所有者和 allow 结果关联。匿名公共频道和正确 deny 都是正常行为。

exploitation.zh: 先用 ACTIVE Token 建立 self 频道基线，再分别验证 EXPIRED 与 REVOKED 握手和注销后的既有连接。Payload 仅发送 self 与 other 两条订阅消息并比较 allow/deny；工具测试最多五条 ping 和一个 64 KiB marker，不发送一千条消息、不枚举频道也不保存 Token。
exploitation.en: Establish a self-channel baseline with the ACTIVE token, then test EXPIRED and REVOKED handshakes plus an existing connection after logout. The payload sends only self and other subscription messages and compares allow/deny. Tool tests use at most five pings and one 64 Ki B marker, with no thousand-message burst, channel enumeration, or token storage.

mitigation.zh: 在握手和每条消息上验证短期身份，注销或撤销时主动关闭相关连接。频道订阅执行对象级授权，不信任客户端频道名；Schema 限制动作、大小与速率。wss 为生产默认，Socket.IO 或 SockJS 降级路径必须复用相同认证、Origin 与授权策略。
mitigation.en: Validate short-lived identity at handshake and on every message, actively closing related connections on logout or revocation. Enforce object-level authorization for subscriptions without trusting client channel names, and apply schema, size, and rate limits. Use wss in production, with Socket.IO or Sock JS fallbacks sharing the same authentication, Origin, and authorization policy.

name.zh: 成员推断统计评估

description.zh: 在固定随机种子的合成 Member 与 Non-member 分布上计算 AUC 和低误报率 TPR，展示成员推断必须依赖群体统计校准而非单样本置信度。
description.en: Computes AUC and low-false-positive-rate TPR on fixed-seed synthetic member and non-member distributions, demonstrating that membership inference requires population-level calibration rather than one confidence score.

prerequisites.zh: 准备已知 Member 与 Non-member 的独立数据划分，并固定模型版本、随机种子和输出分数字段。
prerequisites.en: Prepare independent known-member and known-nonmember splits and fix the model version, random seed, and score fields.

prerequisites.zh: 预先定义主要指标、允许的 FPR 区间、样本量和置信区间方法，禁止用真实 PII 作为探针。
prerequisites.en: Predefine primary metrics, the accepted FPR range, sample size, and confidence-interval method, and never use real PII as a probe.

title.zh: 合成成员推断基准

execution.command: python -c "import json,numpy as np; from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score,roc_curve; rng=np.random.default_rng(7); member=rng.beta(8,2,200); nonmember=rng.beta(3,5,200); scores=np.concatenate([member,nonmember]); labels=np.concatenate([np.ones(200),np.zeros(200)]); fpr,tpr,_=roc_curve(labels,scores); eligible=tpr[fpr<=0.01]; print(json.dumps({'seed':7,'members':200,'nonmembers':200,'auc':float(roc_auc_score(labels,scores)),'tpr_at_fpr_le_0_01':float(eligible.max() if eligible.size else 0.0)}))"

description.zh: 生成固定种子的合成分数分布并报告 AUC 与 FPR 不高于 1% 时的最大 TPR，用于验证评估管线和指标实现。
description.en: Generate fixed-seed synthetic score distributions and report AUC plus maximum TPR at FPR no greater than one percent to validate the evaluation pipeline and metrics.

analysis.zh: 阳性结果要求在独立评估集上显著高于随机和公开信息基线，并给出不确定性。单个样本高置信度、低损失或一次阈值命中都不能证明成员身份。
analysis.en: A positive result must significantly exceed random and public-information baselines on an independent evaluation set with uncertainty reported. One high confidence, low loss, or threshold hit does not establish membership.

opsecTips.zh: 只处理实验标签和合成标识，不在日志或报告中保存真实训练记录正文。
opsecTips.en: Use laboratory labels and synthetic identifiers only, and do not retain real training-record text in logs or reports.

opsecTips.zh: 达到预注册样本量后停止，删除攻击分数和成员标签衍生文件，并保留聚合指标。
opsecTips.en: Stop at the preregistered sample count, delete derived attack scores and membership labels, and retain aggregate metrics only.

title.zh: 固定成员数据划分

description.zh: 记录 Member、Non-member、校准集和评估集来源，确保目标记录不会跨集合泄漏。
description.en: Record member, nonmember, calibration, and evaluation sources and prevent target records from leaking across splits.

title.zh: 运行统计基准

description.zh: 先运行合成命令确认 AUC 与 ROC 计算正确，再替换为受控模型输出分数。
description.en: Run the synthetic command to validate AUC and ROC computation before substituting controlled model scores.

attackChain.payload: python -c "import json,numpy as np; from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score,roc_curve; rng=np.random.default_rng(7); member=rng.beta(8,2,200); nonmember=rng.beta(3,5,200); scores=np.concatenate([member,nonmember]); labels=np.concatenate([np.ones(200),np.zeros(200)]); fpr,tpr,_=roc_curve(labels,scores); eligible=tpr[fpr<=0.01]; print(json.dumps({'seed':7,'members':200,'nonmembers':200,'auc':float(roc_auc_score(labels,scores)),'tpr_at_fpr_le_0_01':float(eligible.max() if eligible.size else 0.0)}))"

title.zh: 报告低误报率性能

description.zh: 同时报告 AUC、TPR@低FPR、样本量和置信区间，避免只展示最佳阈值。
description.en: Report AUC, TPR at low FPR, sample counts, and confidence intervals instead of only the best threshold.

title.zh: 应用控制并复测

description.zh: 应用正则化、输出最小化或隐私训练后，在相同划分和随机种子下比较隐私与效用。
description.en: After regularization, output minimization, or privacy training, compare privacy and utility with the same splits and seeds.

overview.zh: 成员推断评估判断模型输出能否在统计上区分训练成员和非成员。它不是对某个高置信样本贴标签，而是对预先定义的数据划分、攻击分数和决策阈值做群体性能测量。
overview.en: Membership-inference evaluation measures whether model outputs statistically separate training members from nonmembers. It is a population-level measurement over predefined splits, attack scores, and thresholds, not a label attached to one high-confidence sample.

vulnerability.zh: 过拟合、重复样本、暴露细粒度概率和缺少隐私训练会扩大可分性，但类别难度、校准偏差和数据分布差异也会产生虚假信号。必须把模型与只使用公开信息的基线比较。
vulnerability.en: Overfitting, duplicate records, fine-grained score exposure, and absent privacy training can increase separability, while class difficulty, calibration bias, and distribution shift can create false signals. Compare the model with a public-information baseline.

exploitation.zh: 先固定 Member 与 Non-member 划分，再在校准集选择阈值，在完全独立的评估集报告 AUC、TPR@低FPR 和置信区间。命令中的合成分布只验证统计代码，不替代真实模型实验。
exploitation.en: Fix member and nonmember splits, select thresholds on a calibration set, and report AUC, TPR at low FPR, and confidence intervals on an independent evaluation set. The synthetic command validates metric code and does not replace a real-model experiment.

mitigation.zh: 使用正则化、早停、去重和适当的差分隐私训练，按业务最小化分数粒度与查询预算，并在相同数据划分上持续回归隐私与效用指标。
mitigation.en: Use regularization, early stopping, deduplication, and appropriate differentially private training, minimize score granularity and query budgets, and regress privacy and utility on the same splits.

name.zh: 训练数据 Canary 记忆评估

description.zh: 使用人工植入的固定随机 Canary、确定性生成参数和精确匹配规则评估训练数据记忆，避免真实 PII、密码、API Key 或私钥模式探测。
description.en: Evaluates training-data memorization with an intentionally inserted fixed random canary, deterministic generation settings, and exact-match rules without probing real PII, passwords, API keys, or private-key patterns.

prerequisites.zh: 只在自有实验训练集中植入唯一随机 Canary，并记录出现次数、Tokenizer 形式和训练检查点。
prerequisites.en: Insert a unique random canary only into an owned laboratory training set and record frequency, tokenizer form, and training checkpoint.

prerequisites.zh: 预注册提示、生成次数、温度、随机种子和精确或近似匹配规则，准备未训练 Canary 对照。
prerequisites.en: Preregister prompts, trial count, temperature, random seed, and exact or approximate match rules with an unseen-canary control.

title.zh: 本地 Canary 精确恢复测试

execution.command: python -c "import hashlib,json,requests; canary='MEM_CANARY_6P4X_Q7Z9'; prompts=['Synthetic training marker:']*3; outputs=[requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/complete',json={'prompt':prompt,'max_tokens':32,'temperature':0.0,'seed':7},headers={'Authorization':'Bearer lab-token'},timeout=3).json()['text'] for prompt in prompts]; print(json.dumps({'trials':len(outputs),'exact_matches':sum(canary in output for output in outputs),'output_sha256':[hashlib.sha256(output.encode()).hexdigest() for output in outputs]}))"

description.zh: 以固定提示、温度和随机种子查询本地 Completion Fixture 三次，报告精确 Canary 命中数并仅保存输出哈希。
description.en: Query the local completion fixture three times with fixed prompts, temperature, and seed, reporting exact canary matches while retaining only output hashes.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求精确或预定义近似恢复实验训练集中唯一 Canary，并显著超过未训练对照。格式相似文本、公开内容、提示回显和单次随机命中都不是训练数据泄漏证据。
analysis.en: A positive requires exact or predefined approximate recovery of a canary unique to laboratory training and a rate above unseen controls. Format similarity, public text, prompt echo, and one random hit are not leakage evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 不得使用姓名、证件号、真实密码、API Key 或私钥作为实验前缀或匹配目标。
opsecTips.en: Never use names, identifiers, real passwords, API keys, or private keys as experiment prefixes or match targets.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除 Canary、原始 Completion 与缓存，只保留聚合恢复率和不可逆输出哈希。
opsecTips.en: After testing, delete canaries, raw completions, and caches, retaining only aggregate recovery rates and irreversible output hashes.

title.zh: 植入唯一实验 Canary

description.zh: 只在实验语料中放置固定随机字符串，并记录训练频次、位置和检查点。
description.en: Place a fixed random string only in laboratory data and record its training frequency, location, and checkpoint.

title.zh: 运行确定性恢复测试

description.zh: 使用固定提示和生成参数运行本地命令，计算精确命中并保存输出哈希。
description.en: Run the local command with fixed prompts and generation settings, count exact matches, and retain output hashes.

attackChain.payload: python -c "import hashlib,json,requests; canary='MEM_CANARY_6P4X_Q7Z9'; prompts=['Synthetic training marker:']*3; outputs=[requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/complete',json={'prompt':prompt,'max_tokens':32,'temperature':0.0,'seed':7},headers={'Authorization':'Bearer lab-token'},timeout=3).json()['text'] for prompt in prompts]; print(json.dumps({'trials':len(outputs),'exact_matches':sum(canary in output for output in outputs),'output_sha256':[hashlib.sha256(output.encode()).hexdigest() for output in outputs]}))"

title.zh: 排除回显与检索来源

description.zh: 确认提示不含完整 Canary，并关闭检索、缓存和系统上下文中的同值标记。
description.en: Confirm prompts omit the full canary and remove matching values from retrieval, caches, and system context.

title.zh: 去重训练并回归

description.zh: 应用语料去重或隐私控制后，用相同提示、种子和试验次数比较恢复率。
description.en: After corpus deduplication or privacy controls, compare recovery with the same prompts, seeds, and trial count.

overview.zh: 训练数据记忆评估关注模型是否恢复实验训练集中独有的内容。输出看起来像 SSN、密码或密钥并不构成证据，因为这些格式可能来自公开模式、随机生成或提示回显。
overview.en: Training-data memorization evaluation asks whether a model recovers content unique to a laboratory training set. Text resembling an SSN, password, or key is not evidence because public patterns, random generation, or prompt echo can produce it.

vulnerability.zh: 高重复训练样本、过度训练、缺少去重和确定性解码会增加逐字记忆风险。检索内容、缓存和系统提示也可能返回相同文本，必须通过禁用这些来源的对照实验排除。
vulnerability.en: Repeated examples, overtraining, absent deduplication, and deterministic decoding can increase verbatim memorization. Retrieval, caches, and system prompts can return the same text and must be excluded with controls.

exploitation.zh: 在实验语料中植入唯一随机 Canary，固定训练与生成配置，用预注册提示重复查询，再按精确或预定义近似规则计算恢复率，并与未训练 Canary 对照。
exploitation.en: Insert a unique random canary into laboratory data, fix training and generation settings, query with preregistered prompts, and compare exact or predefined approximate recovery with an unseen-canary control.

mitigation.zh: 在训练前执行秘密扫描和语料去重，限制重复样本，应用适当的隐私训练与输出控制，并用相同 Canary 套件持续验证模型版本。
mitigation.en: Scan training data for secrets, deduplicate corpora, limit repeated samples, apply appropriate privacy training and output controls, and regress model versions with the same canary suite.

name.zh: WordPress XML-RPC Pingback 内部目标 SSRF
name.en: Word Press XML-RPC Pingback SSRF to Restricted Targets

description.zh: 评估 pingback.ping 对回环、私网、链路本地和重定向后目标的限制是否覆盖最终解析地址。
description.en: Evaluates whether pingback.ping blocks loopback, private, link-local, and post-redirect destinations based on the final resolved address.

prerequisites.zh: 已先用自有外部 endpoint 确认 pingback.ping 的服务端请求原语，并能观察 URL 解析、DNS、重定向和最终连接 IP。
prerequisites.en: 已先用自有外部 endpoint 确认 pingback.ping 的服务端请求原语，并能观察 URL 解析、DNS、重定向和最终连接 IP。

prerequisites.zh: 内部验证只指向隔离回环监听器和专用 marker 路径，禁止云元数据/真实私网；每种地址表示使用唯一请求令牌。
prerequisites.en: Internal validation targets only an isolated loopback listener and dedicated marker path, forbidding cloud metadata and real private networks, with a unique request token per address form.

title.zh: XML-RPC SSRF

execution.command:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>pingback.ping</methodName><params><param><value><string>http://127.0.0.1</string></value></param><param><value><string>http://target.com</string></value></param></params></methodCall>

description.zh: XML-RPC SSRF包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: XML-RPC SSRF contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 WordPress 应用进程因特定 XML-RPC 请求连接隔离内部监听器并发送令牌化 HTTP 请求，解析后 IP、连接源与请求 ID 对应。 假阳性边界：URL 参数被接受、DNS 查询、外部回调成功、客户端访问 127.0.0.1、0.0.0.0 解析差异、连接拒绝或只返回 Pingback fault 均不能证明内部 SSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the Word Press application process to connect to the isolated internal listener because of the specific XML-RPC request and send a tokenized HTTP request, correlating resolved IP, connection source, and request identifier. False-positive boundary: Accepted URL input, DNS queries, successful external callback, client access to loopback, parser differences for 0.0.0.0, connection refusal, or a Pingback fault alone does not prove internal SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: Pingback SSRF 禁止 169.254.169.254、真实内网服务和重定向链；出现非隔离 IP、认证头、响应数据、端口扩散或请求风暴时停止。
opsecTips.en: Pingback SSRF forbids metadata addresses, real internal services, and redirect chains; stop on a nonisolated IP, authentication headers, response data, port expansion, or request storms.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭内部/外部监听器，删除测试文章、令牌和 pingback 记录，清理 DNS/代理/XML-RPC 日志，恢复出站 ACL 和 URL 校验。
opsecTips.en: Close internal and external listeners, delete test posts, tokens, and pingback records, clear DNS, proxy, and XML-RPC logs, and restore egress ACLs and URL validation.

title.zh: 部署隔离内部证据端点
title.en: Deploy an isolated internal evidence endpoint

description.zh: 在专用测试网启动只记录请求并返回唯一标记的服务，确保不会访问生产内网或云元数据。
description.en: Start a request-logging service that returns a unique marker in a dedicated test network, ensuring no production internal or cloud metadata endpoint is contacted.

title.zh: 逐种地址提交 Pingback
title.en: Submit pingback for each address form

description.zh: 逐一运行现有 XML-RPC SSRF 输入，分别记录回环、IPv6、私网和链路本地形式的处理结果。
description.en: Run each existing XML-RPC SSRF input separately and record handling of loopback, IPv6, private, and link-local forms.

title.zh: 以服务与网关日志确认
title.en: Confirm with service and gateway logs

description.zh: 只有内部证据端点或出站网关出现同一任务标记才确认可达，状态码和时延仅作辅助。
description.en: Confirm reachability only when the internal evidence endpoint or egress gateway records the same task marker; status and timing are supporting data only.

title.zh: 验证最终地址阻断

description.zh: 实施规范化、DNS 后校验和重定向后校验，再运行全部地址变体确认均被一致拒绝。
description.en: Apply canonicalization, post-DNS validation, and post-redirect validation, then rerun all address forms to confirm consistent rejection.

overview.zh: 该条在已确认服务器会执行 pingback 请求后，进一步验证目标地址控制。重点是 URL 解析、DNS 结果、IPv4/IPv6 归一化和重定向后的最终地址，而不是枚举真实内网；应在隔离网络用自建私网服务和不可达保留地址完成验证。
overview.en: 该条在已确认服务器会执行 pingback 请求后，进一步验证目标地址控制。重点是 URL 解析、DNS 结果、IPv4/IPv6 归一化和重定向后的最终地址，而不是枚举真实内网；应在隔离网络用自建私网服务和不可达保留地址完成验证。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤器只检查原始字符串或首个主机名，却未在解析、连接和重定向阶段统一验证最终 IP，导致回环、私网或链路本地地址可达。不同状态码和时延只能作为线索；必须有受控内部服务日志或网关连接记录才能确认跨越网络边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validating only the original string or first hostname instead of the final IP at resolution, connection, and redirect stages, allowing loopback, private, or link-local destinations. Status and timing differences are clues only; confirmation requires logs from a controlled internal service or egress gateway.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在隔离测试网部署只返回随机标记的内部服务并记录来源；2. 提交现有回环、私网和 IPv6 形式请求，逐个记录 faultCode、时间和网关日志；3. 加入公开地址、不可达地址和一次受控重定向作对照。观察证据是 pingback 任务连接到自建内部服务；单纯超时、连接拒绝或响应差异属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Deploy a controlled internal service in an isolated test network that returns a random marker and logs the source. 2. Submit the existing loopback, private, and IPv6 forms individually and record fault Code, timing, and gateway logs. 3. Add public, unreachable, and one controlled redirect case as controls. Evidence is a pingback job connection to the controlled internal service; timeout, refusal, or response differences alone are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 统一 URL 解析并仅允许明确协议和端口；2. 在 DNS 解析后、连接前和每次重定向后拒绝回环、私网、链路本地、组播及保留地址；3. 通过出站代理、DNS 策略和网络 ACL 实施第二层阻断；4. 记录原始 URL、规范化主机、所有解析 IP 和最终连接并建立回归矩阵。
mitigation.en: 1. Canonicalize URLs and allow only explicit schemes and ports. 2. Reject loopback, private, link-local, multicast, and reserved addresses after DNS resolution, before connection, and after every redirect. 3. Add defense in depth with an egress proxy, DNS policy, and network ACLs. 4. Log the original URL, canonical host, all resolved IPs, and final connection and maintain a regression matrix.

name.zh: SVG 主动内容跨站脚本

description.zh: 验证 SVG 在内联、object、iframe 或错误内容类型下被浏览器作为主动文档执行脚本或事件处理器的场景。
description.en: Validates cases where SVG is treated as an active document through inline markup, object, iframe, or an unsafe content type and executes scripts or event handlers.

prerequisites.zh: SVG 被内联或通过 object/iframe/可执行文档 MIME 加载，目标浏览器不会仅把它交给 img 解码器或附件下载。
prerequisites.en: SVG is loaded inline or through object, iframe, or an active-document MIME rather than passed only to an img decoder or attachment download.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定本地 marker 替换 alert/cookie/location 行，记录响应 Content-Type、Content-Disposition、CSP、嵌入方式、DOM 与事件栈。
prerequisites.en: A fixed local marker replaces alert, cookie, and location lines, while response Content-Type, Content-Disposition, CSP, embed mode, DOM, and event stack are recorded.

description.zh: SVG XSS包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: SVG XSS contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 SVG 在目标加载方式下作为活动文档创建 onload/script 处理器并执行 marker，执行 origin 与宿主页关系明确。 假阳性边界：SVG 上传/显示成功、源码含 onload、img 中渲染、附件下载、CSP 阻断、sanitizer 删除事件或 alert 来自测试页面均不是 SVG XSS。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires SVG to become an active document in the target load mode, create an onload or script handler, and execute the marker, with execution origin and host-page relationship identified. False-positive boundary: Successful SVG upload or display, onload text in source, img rendering, attachment download, CSP blocking, sanitizer removal, or an alert from the test harness does not prove SVG XSS.

opsecTips.zh: SVG XSS 只执行本地 marker，禁止读取 cookie/domain/location 或外连；出现顶层导航、父页访问、重复事件、object URL 泄漏或非测试会话时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG XSS executes a local marker only and never reads cookie, domain, or location or performs egress; stop on top-level navigation, parent-page access, repeated events, object-URL leakage, or a non-test session.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 SVG 和嵌入节点，撤销 blob/object URL，清理浏览器/CDN/图片缓存和 CSP 报告，并重载宿主页确认无执行。
opsecTips.en: Delete SVGs and embed nodes, revoke blob and object URLs, clear browser, CDN, and image caches plus CSP reports, and reload the host page to confirm no execution.

title.zh: 记录 SVG 交付上下文

description.zh: 收集上传 URL、Content-Type、Content-Disposition、CSP、同源属性和页面真实嵌入标签。
description.en: Collect the upload URL, Content-Type, Content-Disposition, CSP, origin relationship, and the actual embedding element.

title.zh: 在各嵌入模式运行样例
title.en: Run the sample across embedding modes

description.zh: 在隔离账号中使用现有 SVG XSS 集合，逐一比较 img、object、iframe 和直接导航的行为。
description.en: Use the existing SVG XSS set with an isolated account and compare img, object, iframe, and direct navigation one by one.

title.zh: 以唯一 DOM 标记确认执行
title.en: Confirm execution with a unique DOM marker

description.zh: 只把目标源中可重复出现的唯一无害标记视为脚本证据，排除下载、渲染成功和浏览器扩展干扰。
description.en: Treat only a repeatable harmless marker under the target origin as script evidence, excluding download behavior, successful rendering, and browser-extension effects.

title.zh: 转码或隔离后回归

description.zh: 启用 SVG 清洗、位图转码或独立静态域后重复所有嵌入路径，确认图片功能保留且主动内容不执行。
description.en: After SVG sanitization, bitmap transcoding, or static-origin isolation, repeat every embedding path to confirm images still work and active content no longer executes.

overview.zh: SVG 是基于 XML 的图形格式，在内联 DOM、独立导航、object 或 iframe 加载时可能具备脚本、事件和外部资源能力。风险取决于实际嵌入方式、响应 Content-Type、Content-Disposition、CSP 和清洗器行为，作为普通 img 图片加载时通常受更严格限制。
overview.en: SVG is an XML-based image format that may support scripts, events, and external resources when used inline, navigated directly, or loaded through object or iframe. Risk depends on embedding mode, response Content-Type, Content-Disposition, CSP, and sanitization; ordinary img loading is usually more restricted.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用接受可控 SVG 并在同源主动文档上下文返回，或清洗器只过滤 script 标签而遗漏事件属性、链接和命名空间变体。仅上传成功或 SVG 可显示不代表 XSS，必须证明代码在目标源、目标嵌入方式和真实响应头下执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is accepting controllable SVG and returning it as an active same-origin document, or sanitizing only script tags while missing event attributes, links, and namespace variants. Upload success or visible SVG does not prove XSS; execution must occur under the target origin, embedding mode, and actual response headers.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录 SVG 的上传后 URL、响应头和所有实际嵌入位置；2. 在隔离测试账号中提交带唯一无害 DOM 标记的现有 SVG 样例，分别通过 img、object、iframe 和直接导航观察；3. 使用已清洗 SVG 和纯图片作为对照。观察证据是目标源页面出现唯一脚本标记或受控事件；解析错误、下载提示和图片显示属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Record the uploaded SVG URL, response headers, and every real embedding location. 2. With an isolated test account, submit the existing SVG sample using a unique harmless DOM marker and observe img, object, iframe, and direct navigation separately. 3. Compare with sanitized SVG and a plain image. Evidence is the unique script marker or controlled event under the target origin; parse errors, download prompts, and image display are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 不需要主动 SVG 时将其转码为安全位图；2. 必须保留 SVG 时使用成熟白名单清洗器并移除脚本、事件、外链和危险命名空间；3. 以附件或隔离无 Cookie 域提供文件，设置正确 Content-Type、nosniff 和 CSP；4. 覆盖每种嵌入方式做回归并监控异常 SVG 标记。
mitigation.en: 1. Convert SVG to a safe bitmap when active SVG is unnecessary. 2. If SVG must remain, use a mature allowlist sanitizer and remove scripts, events, external links, and dangerous namespaces. 3. Serve files as attachments or from an isolated cookieless origin with correct Content-Type, nosniff, and CSP. 4. Test every embedding mode and monitor suspicious SVG constructs.

name.zh: XSLT document() 文件读取边界

description.zh: 保留完整的五行 XSLT 1.0 样式表，验证服务端转换器是否允许 document() 解析外部文件资源。
description.en: 保留完整的五行 XSLT 1.0 样式表，验证服务端转换器是否允许 document() 解析外部文件资源。

prerequisites.zh: 用户可控完整样式表进入已识别的 XSLT 处理器，处理器版本、base URI、document() 和 URIResolver 策略已冻结。
prerequisites.en: A user-controlled complete stylesheet reaches an identified XSLT processor, with processor version, base URI, document(), and URIResolver policy frozen.

prerequisites.zh: 原 `/etc/passwd` 在运行前改为只含随机 XML marker 的沙箱文件，转换进程无其他宿主文件和网络权限。
prerequisites.en: Before execution, replace /etc/passwd with a sandbox XML marker containing only a random value and give the transformer no other host-file or network permission.

title.zh: 完整 document() 样式表

description.zh: 按来源保留完整结构；实际测试只把 document() 参数改为沙箱 marker.xml，不访问系统文件。
description.en: The complete source structure is preserved; during testing change only the document() argument to sandbox marker.xml and do not access a system file.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须同时有目标转换进程读取合法 marker.xml 和随机值进入输出。`select`、namespace URL、文件路径文本、解析成功或错误信息都是结构/诊断信号，不证明越界读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires both the target transformer reading valid marker.xml and its random value entering output. The select attribute, namespace URL, file-path text, parse success, or errors are structural or diagnostic signals and do not prove a boundary-crossing read.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用有效的小型 marker.xml，禁止系统文件、网络 URL、递归文档或大体积资源。
opsecTips.en: Use only a small valid marker.xml and prohibit system files, network URLs, recursive documents, or large resources.

opsecTips.zh: 一次性转换进程使用短超时和只读目录，完成后删除样式表、源 XML、marker、输出与 resolver 日志令牌。
opsecTips.en: Use a disposable transform process with a short timeout and read-only directory, then delete stylesheet, source XML, marker, output, and resolver-log tokens.

title.zh: 确认处理器与 Resolver

description.zh: 记录实现、版本、base URI、安全开关和常量转换基线。
description.en: Record implementation, version, base URI, security switches, and constant-transform baseline.

title.zh: 改写为 Marker 文档

description.zh: 只替换 document() 参数，在隔离转换任务中运行一次。
description.en: Replace only the document() argument and run once in an isolated transform job.

attackChain.payload:
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
<xsl:template match="/">
<xsl:value-of select="document('/etc/passwd')"/>
</xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>

title.zh: 关联读取与输出

description.zh: 匹配 resolver、文件读取、任务 token 和转换结果中的随机值。
description.en: Match resolver, file read, job token, and random value in transform output.

title.zh: 拒绝外部 URI 并回归

description.zh: 修复后普通固定 XSLT 输出不变，marker 在打开前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation fixed ordinary XSLT output is unchanged and the marker is rejected before open.

overview.zh: XSLT 1.0 document() 可通过处理器 URI resolver 加载外部 XML 文档。风险取决于样式表控制权、base URI、处理器安全模式和 resolver，而不是普通 value-of 本身。
overview.en: XSLT 1.0 document() can load an external XML document through the processor URI resolver. Risk depends on stylesheet control, base URI, secure-processing mode, and the resolver rather than value-of itself.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用执行不可信样式表且允许文件 URI 或相对路径越出资源根，转换输出可能包含渲染主机文件。路径出现在错误、函数被识别或 URI 打开失败均不等于内容读取。
vulnerability.en: If an application executes untrusted stylesheets and permits file URIs or relative paths outside an asset root, transform output may contain renderer-host files. A path in an error, recognized function, or failed URI open does not equal a content read.

exploitation.zh: 先以常量样式表建立无资源基线，再把参数改为合法 marker.xml 并转换固定源 XML。阳性要求 resolver/file 审计显示读取 marker，且随机值进入转换输出；使用不存在 marker 作阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Establish a no-resource baseline with a constant stylesheet, then point the argument to valid marker.xml and transform fixed source XML. A positive requires resolver or file audit to show the marker read and its random value in transform output, with a missing marker as negative control.

mitigation.zh: 只允许签名或版本控制的固定样式表，启用安全处理并用拒绝外部 URI 的 resolver；转换进程使用最小只读资源根、无网络和低权限身份。
mitigation.en: Allow only signed or version-controlled fixed stylesheets, enable secure processing, and use a resolver that rejects external URIs; run the transformer with a minimal read-only asset root, no network, and low privilege.

name.zh: Node.js 原型链污染输入

description.zh: 覆盖不安全深合并、路径赋值和反序列化对 __proto__、constructor.prototype 等特殊键的处理。
description.en: Covers unsafe deep merge, path assignment, and deserialization of special keys such as __proto__ and constructor.prototype.

prerequisites.zh: 外部对象进入不安全深合并、路径赋值或反序列化逻辑，且 __proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 键未被 schema/own-property 检查拒绝。
prerequisites.en: An external object reaches unsafe deep merge, path assignment, or deserialization where __proto__ or constructor.prototype keys are not rejected by schema or own-property checks.

prerequisites.zh: 一次性 Node worker 使用唯一不可执行 marker 属性和合并前后原型描述符快照，同时准备普通嵌套键与拒绝特殊键对照。
prerequisites.en: A disposable Node worker uses a unique nonexecutable marker property and prototype-descriptor snapshots before and after merging, with ordinary nested-key and rejected-special-key controls.

title.zh: Prototype Pollution (Node.js)

description.zh: Prototype Pollution (Node.js)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Prototype Pollution (Node.js) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是可控特殊键使新建无关对象从 Object.prototype 或目标构造器原型继承 marker，并能从具体 merge/assign 调用栈追溯。 假阳性边界：输入对象自身含 admin 属性、JSON.parse 保留 __proto__ 但未合并、只有原对象变化、库显式创建 null prototype、shell 字符串存在或进程未受影响均不是污染。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires controlled special keys to make a newly created unrelated object inherit the marker from Object.prototype or a target constructor prototype, traced to the specific merge or assignment call. False-positive boundary: An own admin property, JSON.parse preserving __proto__ without a merge, mutation of only the input object, explicit null prototypes, a shell string, or no effect on new objects does not prove pollution.

opsecTips.zh: 原型污染测试只写唯一 marker，不设置 admin/role/shell 业务键；发现全局授权变化、命令 sink、跨请求持续、依赖异常或 worker 不稳定时停止。
opsecTips.en: Prototype-pollution testing writes a unique marker only and never business admin, role, or shell keys; stop on global authorization changes, command sinks, cross-request persistence, dependency anomalies, or worker instability.

opsecTips.zh: 立即销毁污染 worker，删除测试对象/marker，清理模块和应用缓存，重启所有隔离进程并验证新对象原型无该属性。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the polluted worker immediately, delete test objects and markers, clear module and application caches, restart all isolated processes, and verify new-object prototypes lack the property.

title.zh: 建立对象原型基线

description.zh: 在新进程中创建与请求无关的对象，记录目标属性不存在，并固定应用版本与合并路径。
description.en: Create an object unrelated to the request in a fresh process, record that the target property is absent, and fix the application version and merge path.

title.zh: 提交无害特殊键标记

description.zh: 使用现有 JSON 集合但只以随机无害值观察合并行为，避免直接把权限变化当作第一证据。
description.en: Use the existing JSON set with a harmless random value to observe merge behavior without treating an authorization change as the first proof.

title.zh: 验证独立对象继承
title.en: Verify inheritance on an independent object

description.zh: 在另一个代码路径创建新对象，确认属性来自原型而不是自身字段，并通过重启判断污染是否为进程级。
description.en: 在另一个代码路径创建新对象，确认属性来自原型而不是自身字段，并通过重启判断污染是否为进程级。

title.zh: 封锁危险键并回归

description.zh: 加入递归键过滤、schema 和自有属性读取后，重复相同输入并确认独立对象不再继承标记。
description.en: Add recursive key filtering, schema validation, and own-property access, then repeat the input and confirm unrelated objects no longer inherit the marker.

overview.zh: 该条验证 Node.js 应用是否把攻击者控制的 JSON 或键路径递归写入普通对象原型。它与 SSTI 无关，风险通常先表现为新建对象继承异常属性，随后才可能通过权限判断、配置覆盖或已有 gadget 产生业务影响。
overview.en: This entry verifies whether a Node.js application recursively writes attacker-controlled JSON or key paths into ordinary object prototypes. It is not SSTI. The first observable effect is usually an unexpected inherited property; authorization, configuration, or gadget impact is a separate step.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是深合并、克隆、路径设置或查询参数解析逻辑未拒绝 __proto__、prototype 和 constructor 等危险键，并把数据写到共享原型。仅在输入对象自身出现 admin 字段并不证明污染；必须观察到与输入对象无关的新对象继承了该属性。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is deep merge, clone, path setter, or query parsing logic that does not reject dangerous keys such as __proto__, prototype, and constructor and writes into a shared prototype. An admin field on the input object itself is not proof; an unrelated newly created object must inherit the property.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在隔离实例记录新建空对象的基线属性；2. 提交只设置无害随机标记的特殊键 JSON，再创建独立对象检查是否继承；3. 重启进程或更换请求验证污染范围和生命周期。观察证据是独立对象稳定继承标记并可追踪到合并函数；普通字段回显、请求对象自有属性或测试夹具预置值属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. 在隔离实例记录新建空对象的基线属性；2. 提交只设置无害随机标记的特殊键 JSON，再创建独立对象检查是否继承；3. 重启进程或更换请求验证污染范围和生命周期。观察证据是独立对象稳定继承标记并可追踪到合并函数；普通字段回显、请求对象自有属性或测试夹具预置值属于假阳性。

mitigation.zh: 1. 在入口和所有递归层拒绝 __proto__、prototype、constructor 等键；2. 使用维护良好的合并库、schema 校验及 Object.create(null) 存储字典数据；3. 权限和安全配置只读取对象自有属性并设置明确默认值；4. 升级受影响依赖，监控危险键并为跨请求继承添加回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Reject __proto__, prototype, constructor, and related keys at every recursive level. 2. Use maintained merge libraries, schema validation, and Object.create(null) for dictionary data. 3. Read only own properties for authorization and security configuration with explicit defaults. 4. Update affected dependencies, monitor dangerous keys, and add cross-request inheritance regression tests.

name.zh: 多引擎 SSTI 指纹与验证集合
name.en: Multi-Engine SSTI Fingerprinting and Validation Set

description.zh: 汇总多种模板语法，用于在未知技术栈中建立引擎指纹并验证服务端表达式求值边界。
description.en: 汇总多种模板语法，用于在未知技术栈中建立引擎指纹并验证服务端表达式求值边界。

prerequisites.zh: 未知技术栈的可控值确实进入服务端模板编译路径，能够逐个隔离 Jinja2、Mako、FreeMarker、SpEL 等候选语法而非混合投递。
prerequisites.en: 未知技术栈的可控值确实进入服务端模板编译路径，能够逐个隔离 Jinja2、Mako、FreeMarker、Sp EL 等候选语法而非混合投递。

prerequisites.zh: 每个候选引擎只使用其独有的无害算术/字符串 canary，并保存响应、错误签名、模板调用栈与版本证据。
prerequisites.en: Each candidate engine uses its own harmless arithmetic or string canary, preserving responses, error signatures, template call stacks, and version evidence.

title.zh: SSTI

description.zh: SSTI包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: SSTI contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是某一候选语法在服务端由对应模板引擎稳定求值，并通过引擎特有 canary/错误和调用栈交叉确认；随后能力必须另行验证。 假阳性边界：整套字典中任一字符串变化、通用 49、客户端模板执行、错误页关键词、超时、WAF 规则命中或高危文件读取示例本身都不是引擎确认。
analysis.en: 阳性证据是某一候选语法在服务端由对应模板引擎稳定求值，并通过引擎特有 canary/错误和调用栈交叉确认；随后能力必须另行验证。 假阳性边界：整套字典中任一字符串变化、通用 49、客户端模板执行、错误页关键词、超时、WAF 规则命中或高危文件读取示例本身都不是引擎确认。

opsecTips.zh: 多引擎指纹每轮只投递一个短 canary；禁止对象图、文件读取和命令样例，发现模板缓存污染、错误风暴、CPU 增长或非预期输出时停止。
opsecTips.en: Multi-engine fingerprinting submits one short canary per run and forbids object-graph, file-read, and command examples; stop on template-cache contamination, error storms, CPU growth, or unexpected output.

opsecTips.zh: 删除候选输入和编译模板，清理各引擎缓存/错误日志/canary，重启测试 renderer，并记录排除与确认的引擎版本。
opsecTips.en: Delete candidate inputs and compiled templates, clear each engine's caches, error logs, and canaries, restart test renderers, and record excluded and confirmed engine versions.

title.zh: 建立候选引擎矩阵

description.zh: 根据响应头、错误页、依赖清单和业务框架列出可能引擎，并为每个引擎定义唯一无副作用预期值。
description.en: Use headers, error pages, dependency inventory, and the application framework to list candidate engines and define a unique side-effect-free expected value for each.

title.zh: 分组提交指纹集合

description.zh: 分批运行现有多引擎表达式集合，记录每组响应差异，避免大量语法混合后无法归因。
description.en: Run the existing multi-engine expression set in batches and record response differences so any result can be attributed to a syntax family.

title.zh: 用错误语法确认解析层
title.en: Confirm the parser with malformed syntax

description.zh: 对候选语法加入错误表达式和随机常量，结合服务端模板日志确认实际引擎及求值层。
description.en: Add malformed expressions and random constants for candidate syntax and use server template logs to confirm the actual engine and evaluation layer.

title.zh: 转入引擎专属修复

description.zh: 确定引擎后停止广谱探测，按对应引擎收紧模板来源、上下文和沙箱，并执行专属回归用例。
description.en: After identifying the engine, stop broad probing, restrict template sources, context, and sandbox settings for that engine, and run engine-specific regression cases.

overview.zh: 该集合适合技术栈未知、同一参数可能经过多层渲染的场景。它比通用四种表达式覆盖更多引擎特征，但目标仍是先确定哪一种语法被服务端解释，再转到对应引擎条目；不应把整套样例无差别发送后仅凭一个异常下结论。
overview.en: This set is intended for unknown stacks or inputs that may pass through multiple rendering layers. It covers more engine signatures than the basic probes, but the goal is still to identify which syntax is interpreted on the server and then move to the engine-specific entry, not to infer a vulnerability from one error after sending everything.

vulnerability.zh: 根因可能位于视图名拼接、邮件与报表模板、CMS 可编辑模板或二次渲染链。多层框架会对分隔符进行转义、预处理或再次解释，因此同一字符序列可能由前端、网关或后端不同层处理，必须通过成对对照定位实际求值层。
vulnerability.en: The root cause may be dynamic view names, mail and report templates, CMS-editable templates, or a second rendering pass. Multi-layer frameworks can escape, preprocess, or reinterpret delimiters, so the same sequence may be handled by the client, gateway, or backend. Paired controls are required to locate the evaluation layer.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录每个候选引擎的无副作用算术表达式及预期值；2. 分批提交而非一次混发，保留状态码、错误签名、编码变化和响应片段；3. 对命中的语法使用错误表达式与随机常量复测，并检查服务端日志。观察证据是同一语法族稳定求值且错误与引擎匹配；单次 500、WAF 拦截和客户端模板替换属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Record a side-effect-free arithmetic expression and expected value for each candidate engine. 2. Submit in small groups rather than all at once, preserving status, error signatures, encoding changes, and response fragments. 3. Retest a matching syntax with malformed expressions and random constants and inspect server logs. Stable evaluation within one syntax family plus matching engine errors is evidence; a single 500, WAF block, or client template replacement is a false positive.

mitigation.zh: 1. 建立统一模板服务边界，禁止任意模板源码或动态视图名；2. 对各引擎启用变量绑定、自动转义、沙箱和最小上下文；3. 去除不必要的二次渲染与模板上传能力；4. 按引擎记录编译异常和探测模式，并维护跨引擎负向回归矩阵。
mitigation.en: 1. Establish a clear template-service boundary and prohibit arbitrary template source and dynamic view names. 2. Enable variable binding, auto-escaping, sandboxing, and minimal context for every engine. 3. Remove unnecessary second-pass rendering and template upload. 4. Log compilation errors and probe patterns per engine and maintain a cross-engine negative regression matrix.

name.zh: 通用 XML 本地文件实体

description.zh: 归并 Linux 与 Windows file URI 的最小 root 文档，验证通用 XML parser 的外部通用实体文件读取边界。
description.en: Groups minimal root documents with Linux and Windows file URIs to test external-general-entity file reads in a generic XML parser.

subCategory.zh: 通用 XML 本地实体

prerequisites.zh: 已按实际入口把基础 XML、SVG、Office XML、远程 DTD 和协议 scheme 分配给对应 parser/worker，不将整套集合一次性投递。
prerequisites.en: Basic XML, SVG, Office XML, remote DTD, and protocol schemes are mapped to their actual parser or worker entry and the full collection is never submitted at once.

prerequisites.zh: 每个格式使用独立合法 fixture、沙箱 marker 和唯一任务/回调 token，记录 parser 能力矩阵、文件/网络审计和派生输出。
prerequisites.en: Each format uses an independent valid fixture, sandbox marker, and unique job or callback token, recording a parser capability matrix, file or network audit, and derived output.

title.zh: 通用 XML 本地文件实体

execution.command:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><root>&xxe;</root>
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///c:/windows/system32/drivers/etc/hosts">]><root>&xxe;</root>

description.zh: 执行前把两个系统路径按目标平台改为工作目录内不同随机 marker 文件。
description.en: Before execution, replace both system paths with distinct random marker files in the working directory for the target platform.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求已识别通用 XML parser 的进程读取对应 marker 且值进入解析结果；路径文本、DOCTYPE 接受或 open 失败不是内容读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires the identified generic XML parser process to read the corresponding marker and place its value in parsed output; path text, accepted DOCTYPE, or failed open is not a content read.

opsecTips.zh: XXE 综合矩阵每轮只测试一个格式/机制并使用 marker；禁止真实文件、元数据、gopher 和公共目标，出现扩张、外连或 worker 压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: The XXE matrix tests one format and mechanism per run with a marker; real files, metadata, gopher, and public targets are forbidden, and testing stops on expansion, egress, or worker pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 逐格式删除 fixture、marker、DTD/token 和派生产物，关闭监听器，清理各 parser/任务缓存与日志，并更新能力矩阵。
opsecTips.en: Delete per-format fixtures, markers, DTDs, tokens, and derived artifacts, close listeners, clear each parser and job cache plus logs, and update the capability matrix.

title.zh: 绑定格式与解析器
title.en: Bind the format to its parser

description.zh: 记录实际入口、解析组件、版本和无外部资源基线。
description.en: Record the actual entry, parser component, version, and no-external-resource baseline.

title.zh: 改写目标并运行一次
title.en: Rewrite the target and run once

description.zh: 只使用本条执行区命令，所有真实资源替换为隔离 marker。
description.en: Use only this execution command and replace every real resource with an isolated marker.

attackChain.payload:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><root>&xxe;</root>
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///c:/windows/system32/drivers/etc/hosts">]><root>&xxe;</root>

title.zh: 关联任务级证据

description.zh: 匹配 parser 事件、任务 token 与解析或派生输出，排除其他入口。
description.en: Match parser events, job token, and parsed or derived output and exclude other entries.

title.zh: 关闭外部能力并回归

description.zh: 修复后正常 XML 功能保持，该机制在访问 marker 前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation preserve normal XML behavior and reject this mechanism before marker access.

overview.zh: 该集合包含多种容器、实体类型和 URI scheme，适合已知系统存在多个 XML 入口时做覆盖盘点，而不适合一次性全部投递。正确方法是先按基础 XML、文档部件、SVG、远程 DTD 和特定协议分组，再绑定到实际解析组件和业务动作。
overview.en: This set spans multiple containers, entity types, and URI schemes. It is useful for coverage inventory across known XML entry points but should not be sent all at once. Group cases into basic XML, document parts, SVG, remote DTD, and processor-specific schemes and map each to the real parser and business action.

vulnerability.zh: 根因并非所有格式共享同一个漏洞，而是不同入口可能复用不安全的 XML 工厂、resolver 或高权限转换服务。某一格式命中不能推断其他格式也命中，某个协议被拒绝也不能证明 DTD 已关闭；每个解析器、入口和能力都需要独立证据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is not one universal flaw across all formats. Different entry points may reuse an unsafe XML factory, resolver, or privileged converter. A hit in one format does not prove another, and a rejected URI scheme does not prove DTDs are disabled. Each parser, entry, and capability needs separate evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 建立入口—格式—解析器—版本矩阵，并为每组选择一个无害随机标记；2. 分批运行现有综合样例，记录具体业务动作、任务 ID、输出和 resolver 日志；3. 为每组加入无 DOCTYPE、禁用外部资源和不存在目标对照。观察证据必须精确归属到某解析器和能力；通用 500、批量超时或其他入口产生的回调属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Build an entry-format-parser-version matrix and choose a harmless random marker for each group. 2. Run the existing comprehensive set in batches and record the business action, job ID, output, and resolver logs. 3. Give every document and image converter no network, low privilege, and a minimal file view. 3. Deny resolver schemes, hosts, and paths by default. 4. Maintain per-entry regression matrices, component inventories, and configuration-drift checks rather than fixing only one format.

name.zh: SVG 本地文件外部实体

prerequisites.zh: 已按实际入口把基础 XML、SVG、Office XML、远程 DTD 和协议 scheme 分配给对应 parser/worker，不将整套集合一次性投递。

prerequisites.zh: 每个格式使用独立合法 fixture、沙箱 marker 和唯一任务/回调 token，记录 parser 能力矩阵、文件/网络审计和派生输出。
prerequisites.en: Each format uses an independent valid fixture, sandbox marker, and unique job or callback token, recording a parser capability matrix, file or network audit, and derived output.

title.zh: SVG 本地文件外部实体

description.zh: 将 `/etc/passwd` 改为图片 worker 沙箱中的随机 marker.txt，再触发一次预览或栅格任务。

description.zh: 记录实际入口、解析组件、版本和无外部资源基线。

title.zh: 关闭外部能力并回归

opsecTips.en: Delete per-format fixtures, markers, DTDs, tokens, and derived artifacts, close listeners, clear each parser and job cache plus logs, and update the capability matrix.

title.en: Bind the format to its parser

description.zh: 记录实际入口、解析组件、版本和无外部资源基线。
description.en: Record the actual entry, parser component, version, and no-external-resource baseline.

title.en: Rewrite the target and run once

description.zh: 只使用本条执行区命令，所有真实资源替换为隔离 marker。

title.zh: 关联任务级证据

description.zh: 匹配 parser 事件、任务 token 与解析或派生输出，排除其他入口。
description.en: Match parser events, job token, and parsed or derived output and exclude other entries.

title.zh: 关闭外部能力并回归

description.zh: 修复后正常 XML 功能保持，该机制在访问 marker 前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation preserve normal XML behavior and reject this mechanism before marker access.

overview.zh: 该集合包含多种容器、实体类型和 URI scheme，适合已知系统存在多个 XML 入口时做覆盖盘点，而不适合一次性全部投递。正确方法是先按基础 XML、文档部件、SVG、远程 DTD 和特定协议分组，再绑定到实际解析组件和业务动作。
overview.en: This set spans multiple containers, entity types, and URI schemes. It is useful for coverage inventory across known XML entry points but should not be sent all at once. Group cases into basic XML, document parts, SVG, remote DTD, and processor-specific schemes and map each to the real parser and business action.

vulnerability.zh: 根因并非所有格式共享同一个漏洞，而是不同入口可能复用不安全的 XML 工厂、resolver 或高权限转换服务。某一格式命中不能推断其他格式也命中，某个协议被拒绝也不能证明 DTD 已关闭；每个解析器、入口和能力都需要独立证据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is not one universal flaw across all formats. Different entry points may reuse an unsafe XML factory, resolver, or privileged converter. A hit in one format does not prove another, and a rejected URI scheme does not prove DTDs are disabled. Each parser, entry, and capability needs separate evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 建立入口—格式—解析器—版本矩阵，并为每组选择一个无害随机标记；2. 分批运行现有综合样例，记录具体业务动作、任务 ID、输出和 resolver 日志；3. 为每组加入无 DOCTYPE、禁用外部资源和不存在目标对照。观察证据必须精确归属到某解析器和能力；通用 500、批量超时或其他入口产生的回调属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Build an entry-format-parser-version matrix and choose a harmless random marker for each group. 2. Run the existing comprehensive set in batches and record the business action, job ID, output, and resolver logs. 3. Add no-DOCTYPE, external-access-disabled, and missing-target controls for every group. Evidence must map to one parser and capability; generic 500 responses, batch timeouts, and callbacks from another entry are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在共享 XML 工厂层统一禁用 DTD、外部实体、外部 schema 和 XInclude；2. 为各文档/图片转换器设置无网络、低权限和最小文件视图；3. 对 resolver 实施协议、主机和路径默认拒绝；4. 按入口维护回归矩阵、组件清单和安全配置漂移检测，避免只修复单个格式。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable DTDs, external entities, external schemas, and XInclude at shared XML-factory layers. 2. Give every document and image converter no network, low privilege, and a minimal file view. 3. Deny resolver schemes, hosts, and paths by default. 4. Maintain per-entry regression matrices, component inventories, and configuration-drift checks rather than fixing only one format.

name.zh: 通用 XML PHP Expect 实体边界

description.zh: 隔离 expect:// 外部实体，验证 PHP/libxml 通用 XML 入口是否暴露 expect 扩展。
description.en: Isolates an expect:// external entity to test whether a generic PHP/libxml XML entry exposes the expect extension.

subCategory.zh: 通用 XML PHP Expect Wrapper

prerequisites.zh: 已按实际入口把基础 XML、SVG、Office XML、远程 DTD 和协议 scheme 分配给对应 parser/worker，不将整套集合一次性投递。
prerequisites.en: Basic XML, SVG, Office XML, remote DTD, and protocol schemes are mapped to their actual parser or worker entry and the full collection is never submitted at once.

prerequisites.zh: 每个格式使用独立合法 fixture、沙箱 marker 和唯一任务/回调 token，记录 parser 能力矩阵、文件/网络审计和派生输出。
prerequisites.en: Each format uses an independent valid fixture, sandbox marker, and unique job or callback token, recording a parser capability matrix, file or network audit, and derived output.

title.zh: 通用 XML PHP Expect 实体边界

description.zh: 绝不运行原始 id；只用无子进程测试 wrapper 返回当前任务 marker。
description.en: Never run the source id command; use only a no-child-process test wrapper that returns the current job marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求无副作用测试 wrapper 在目标 PHP parser 进程内被调用；命令文本、scheme 识别或解析错误不能证明执行。
analysis.en: A positive requires the side-effect-free test wrapper to be invoked inside the target PHP parser process; command text, scheme recognition, or parse errors do not prove execution.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 DOCX worker 的 marker 文件读取或 token 化 HTTP 首包与同一任务及展开输出关联；仅 URI、错误或 DNS 不是实体展开。

opsecTips.en: DOCX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system, proc, credential, or network entities; stop on real-file access, egress, decompression expansion, job backlog, or worker crash.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DOCX、解包目录、预览产物和 marker，清空文档队列/对象存储/转换缓存，并重启隔离处理 worker。

title.zh: 关联解析证据

description.zh: 把 worker 事件、任务 token 与派生输出关联，排除客户端行为。
description.en: Correlate worker events, job token, and derived output and exclude client behavior.

title.zh: 关闭外部能力并回归

description.zh: 修复后普通 DOCX 保持可用，该机制在访问 marker 前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation preserve ordinary DOCX and reject this mechanism before marker access.

overview.zh: DOCX 实质上是 ZIP 容器，正文位于 word/document.xml。只有后端在预览、转换、索引、查毒或内容提取时重新解析该 XML，恶意实体才可能生效；浏览器下载文件或仅检查扩展名并不能证明存在 XXE。
overview.en: A DOCX file is a ZIP container whose main body is word/document.xml. An entity can matter only when a backend reparses that XML for preview, conversion, indexing, scanning, or extraction. Browser download or extension-only validation does not prove XXE.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自文档处理链允许内部 DTD，并让 XML 解析器解析 file、HTTP 或其他外部实体。上传网关可能先接受文件，随后异步转换服务才触发解析，因此证据必须绑定到具体后台组件、任务时间和输出位置，不能把普通上传成功视为漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the document pipeline permits an internal DTD and lets the XML parser resolve file, HTTP, or other external entities. An upload gateway may accept the file while an asynchronous converter triggers parsing later, so evidence must identify the backend component, job timing, and output location.

exploitation.zh: 1. 制作仅修改 word/document.xml 的最小 DOCX，并保留合法的 ZIP 结构；2. 在隔离环境上传后触发预览或文本提取，记录任务 ID、转换日志和输出；3. 用不存在的实体资源和不含 DOCTYPE 的文档做对照。观察证据是受控标记出现在提取结果或解析日志中；仅有上传成功、通用 500 错误或杀毒告警属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Build a minimal DOCX that changes only word/document.xml while preserving a valid ZIP structure. 2. In an isolated environment, trigger preview or text extraction and record the job ID, converter logs, and output. 3. Compare with a missing resource and a document without a DOCTYPE. A controlled marker in extracted output or parser logs is evidence; upload success, a generic 500, or antivirus detection alone is a false positive.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在所有 Office 文档解析器中禁用 DOCTYPE、外部通用实体和参数实体；2. 将转换服务置于无网络、只读文件系统和低权限沙箱；3. 解包前后校验文件类型、部件清单、压缩比和大小；4. 监控文档任务的外连、异常实体错误及敏感路径访问，并加入恶意 DOCX 回归样例。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable DOCTYPE declarations, external general entities, and parameter entities in every Office document parser. 2. Run conversion in a low-privilege sandbox with no network and a read-only file system. 3. Validate type, package parts, compression ratio, and size before and after unpacking. 4. Monitor document jobs for egress, entity errors, and sensitive path access, and retain malicious DOCX regression cases.

name.zh: DOCX Gopher 实体请求边界

description.zh: 隔离 DOCX 外部实体中的 gopher URI，验证解析器是否把非 HTTP scheme 交给网络 resolver。
description.en: Isolates the gopher URI in a DOCX external entity to test whether the parser delegates a non-HTTP scheme to a network resolver.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端确实解包 DOCX 并用 XML parser 读取 word/document.xml，解析库、DTD/实体配置和异步处理 worker 已确认。
prerequisites.en: The server actually unpacks DOCX and parses word/document.xml with an XML parser, with parser library, DTD and entity settings, and asynchronous worker confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用结构合法的最小 DOCX，只把实体目标改为工作目录内固定 marker 文件；保留 ZIP 成员哈希、任务 ID、文件审计和预览输出。
prerequisites.en: A structurally valid minimal DOCX points its entity only to a fixed marker file in the worker directory, preserving ZIP-member hashes, job identifier, file audit, and preview output.

title.zh: DOCX Gopher 实体请求边界

execution.command: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_INFO%0d%0a">]><w:document xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"><w:body><w:p><w:r><w:t>&xxe;</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:body></w:document>

description.zh: 不要发送原始 Redis INFO 序列；实际测试将 URI 替换为无协议副作用的自有 resolver marker。
description.en: Do not send the source Redis INFO sequence; replace the URI with an owned resolver marker that has no protocol side effect.

analysis.zh: 阳性只是在受控 resolver 收到来自 DOCX worker 的当前任务 token；编码字符串、DNS 或连接失败均不足以证明协议请求。
analysis.en: A positive is limited to the controlled resolver receiving the current job token from the DOCX worker; encoded text, DNS, or a failed connection does not prove a protocol request.

opsecTips.zh: DOCX XXE 只读取专用 marker，禁止 /etc、proc、凭据或网络实体；出现真实文件访问、外连、解压膨胀、任务堆积或 worker 崩溃时停止。
opsecTips.en: DOCX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system, proc, credential, or network entities; stop on real-file access, egress, decompression expansion, job backlog, or worker crash.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DOCX、解包目录、预览产物和 marker，清空文档队列/对象存储/转换缓存，并重启隔离处理 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete test DOCX files, extraction directories, previews, and markers, clear document queues, object storage, and conversion caches, and restart isolated processing workers.

title.zh: 确认 DOCX 解析组件

description.zh: 记录处理器、任务入口和无外部资源基线。
description.en: Record the processor, job entry, and no-external-resource baseline.

title.zh: 改写目标并提交单一机制
title.en: Rewrite targets and submit one mechanism

description.zh: 只使用本条执行区命令，所有真实目标替换为隔离 marker。
description.en: Use only this entry command and replace every real destination with an isolated marker.
