overview.zh: 原集合覆盖 window、self、top、parent、navigator 等大量名称，但部分是不可配置内建属性。可靠测试要以应用自定义全局变量为主，并记录污染前后的类型与属性描述符。
overview.en: The original set includes window, self, top, parent, navigator, and many other names, but some are nonconfigurable built-ins. Reliable testing focuses on application-defined globals and records type and descriptor changes before and after injection.

vulnerability.zh: 当脚本在初始化前从 window 读取尚未定义的全局配置，浏览器命名属性可能让攻击者元素占据该名称，并把 href 或子属性送入危险接收点。无法覆盖内建属性或后续代码重新赋值时，不存在实际影响。
vulnerability.en: When script reads an undefined global configuration from window before initialization, browser named properties may let an attacker element occupy the name and feed href or child properties into a dangerous sink. Non-overridable built-ins or later reassignment prevent impact.

exploitation.zh: 1. 选择应用真实读取且初始未定义的全局名，记录脚本执行顺序；2. 逐项插入原始 window 结构并使用本地无害 URL；3. 通过断点确认值进入具体接收点并记录网络或 DOM 结果。仅 window 上可见元素而无脚本消费属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Select an application-read global that is initially undefined and record script order. 2. Insert original window structures one at a time using a local harmless URL. 3. Use breakpoints to confirm the value reaches a concrete sink and record network or DOM results. An element visible on window without script consumption is a false positive.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在模块作用域显式初始化配置并避免隐式全局变量；2. 对所有动态 HTML 使用可靠净化器并限制命名属性；3. 对关键全局值做类型、来源和 URL 校验，配合 CSP 与 Trusted Types 限制危险接收点。
mitigation.en: 1. Explicitly initialize configuration in module scope and avoid implicit globals. 2. Sanitize all dynamic HTML and restrict named attributes. 3. Validate type, origin, and URLs for critical globals and constrain dangerous sinks with CSP and Trusted Types.

name.zh: 密码重置令牌 Referer 泄露
name.en: Password Reset Token Leakage through Referer

description.zh: 验证重置页面中的令牌是否因外部资源或跳转进入 Referer，从而泄露到第三方服务日志。
description.en: Tests whether a token in a password-reset page leaks through Referer to third-party resource or navigation logs.

prerequisites.zh: 签发短时效、单次使用的合成重置 token 并放入测试重置页 URL，控制所有第三方资源和导航接收端。
prerequisites.en: Issue a short-lived, single-use synthetic reset token in a test reset-page URL, controlling every third-party resource and navigation recipient.

prerequisites.zh: 在真实浏览器中固定 Referrer-Policy，记录接收端原始 Referer、token 完整性和 reset canary 可用性。
prerequisites.en: Pin Referrer-Policy in a real browser and record the recipient's raw Referer, token completeness, and reset-canary usability.

title.zh: 密码重置Token泄露
title.en: Validation step 1 for Password Reset Token Leakage through Referer

execution.command:
Referer: https://evil.com/reset
Referer: http://evil.com/reset
Referer: https://evil.com/password
Referer: http://evil.com/password
Referer: https://evil.com/forgot
Referer: http://evil.com/forgot
Referer: https://evil.com/recover
Referer: http://evil.com/recover
Referer: https://evil.com/change
Referer: http://evil.com/change
Referer: https://evil.com/token
Referer: http://evil.com/token

description.zh: 密码重置Token泄露包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Password Reset Token Leakage through Referer validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求不受信任接收端实际获得完整合成重置 token，并能在有效期内进入对应账户的无副作用 reset canary。语料中的 Referer 只指向 evil 路径但没有 token、浏览器只发送 origin、日志脱敏、token 无效/已用、同源资源接收或仅地址栏含 token 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: 阳性要求不受信任接收端实际获得完整合成重置 token，并能在有效期内进入对应账户的无副作用 reset canary。语料中的 Referer 只指向 evil 路径但没有 token、浏览器只发送 origin、日志脱敏、token 无效/已用、同源资源接收或仅地址栏含 token 都是假阳性。

opsecTips.zh: 一个受控接收端首次获得可用 token 后停止，不提交密码变更或转发给其他域。
opsecTips.en: 一个受控接收端首次获得可用 token 后停止，不提交密码变更或转发给其他域。

opsecTips.zh: 立即撤销 token，删除接收日志、页面与浏览器历史/缓存，并恢复严格 Referrer-Policy 和 URL token 禁止。
opsecTips.en: Immediately revoke the token, delete recipient logs and pages and browser history or caches, and restore a strict Referrer-Policy and prohibition on URL tokens.

title.zh: 签发测试重置事务

description.zh: 为隔离账号生成一次性令牌，记录有效期、用途和服务端事务标识。
description.en: Generate a one-time token for an isolated account and record expiry, purpose, and server transaction identifier.

title.zh: 触发受控外部请求

description.zh: 使用原始 Referer 目标形态让真实浏览器访问自有接收端，不连接第三方。
description.en: Use original Referer target forms to make a real browser contact an owned receiver without involving third parties.

attackChain.payload:
Referer: https://evil.com/reset
Referer: http://evil.com/reset
Referer: https://evil.com/password
Referer: http://evil.com/password
Referer: https://evil.com/forgot
Referer: http://evil.com/forgot
Referer: https://evil.com/recover
Referer: http://evil.com/recover
Referer: https://evil.com/change
Referer: http://evil.com/change
Referer: https://evil.com/token
Referer: http://evil.com/token

title.zh: 核对接收日志与令牌
title.en: Verify receiver logs and token state

description.zh: 检查接收端是否获得完整令牌，并确认该值仍能对应有效重置事务。
description.en: 检查接收端是否获得完整令牌，并确认该值仍能对应有效重置事务。

overview.zh: 原集合是 Referer 请求头样例，目标是检查密码重置令牌在 URL 中时是否随外部导航或资源请求泄露。评估必须使用测试令牌、自有接收端和真实浏览器 Referrer-Policy 行为。
overview.en: The original set contains Referer header examples for checking whether a reset token in a URL leaks during external navigation or resource loading. Assessment uses a test token, an owned receiver, and real-browser Referrer-Policy behavior.

vulnerability.zh: 如果重置令牌位于 URL 查询或路径中，且页面加载第三方资源或允许外跳而未设置严格 Referrer-Policy，完整 URL 可能进入第三方日志。手工伪造 Referer 被服务器接收并不能证明浏览器会泄露令牌。
vulnerability.en: If a reset token appears in a URL path or query and the page loads third-party resources or permits navigation without a strict Referrer-Policy, the full URL may reach third-party logs. A server accepting a forged Referer does not prove browser leakage.

exploitation.zh: 1. 签发一次性测试重置令牌并在隔离浏览器打开重置页；2. 使用原始外部目标形态触发自有接收端的无害图片或链接请求；3. 检查接收端 Referer、浏览器网络记录和令牌状态。仅代理注入头、手工请求或不含令牌的源信息属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Issue a one-time test reset token and open the reset page in an isolated browser. 2. Use original external-target forms to trigger a harmless image or link request to an owned receiver. 3. Inspect receiver Referer, browser network records, and token state. Proxy-injected headers, manual requests, and origins without a token are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 使用短期、一次性、高熵且与用户和用途绑定的重置令牌；2. 在重置页面设置 Referrer-Policy: no-referrer 并禁止第三方资源；3. 成功使用后立即失效令牌，避免将敏感值放入可传播的 URL。
mitigation.en: 1. Use short-lived, one-time, high-entropy reset tokens bound to user and purpose. 2. Set Referrer-Policy: no-referrer on reset pages and prohibit third-party resources. 3. Invalidate tokens immediately after use and keep sensitive values out of propagating URLs.

name.zh: 弱密码重置令牌验证

description.zh: 使用低熵和边界令牌候选检查重置流程是否生成不可预测、一次性且与账号绑定的凭据。
description.en: Uses low-entropy and boundary token candidates to test whether password-reset credentials are unpredictable, single-use, and account-bound.

prerequisites.zh: 为多个合成账户通过隔离通知通道签发重置 token，记录生成、绑定、过期、消费和在线尝试限制。
prerequisites.en: Issue reset tokens for multiple synthetic accounts through an isolated notification channel, recording generation, binding, expiry, consumption, and online attempt limits.

prerequisites.zh: 将短数字、常见词、空值和类型边界分别测试，使用随机基线与无密码变更 canary，避免混合解析和熵结论。
prerequisites.en: Test short numbers, common words, empty values, and type boundaries separately, using a random baseline and no-password-change canary to avoid mixing parser and entropy conclusions.

title.zh: 弱密码重置Token
title.en: Validation step 1 for Weak Password Reset Token Validation

execution.command:
token=123
token=1234
token=12345
token=123456
token=1234567
token=123456789
token=admin
token=root
token=test
token=guest
token=user
token=default
token=secret
token=password
token=token
token=null
token=undefined
token=false
token=true
token=-1
token=[]
token={}
token=""

description.zh: 弱密码重置Token包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Weak Password Reset Token Validation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是未见弱候选显著优于随机地预测有效 token，或空值/类型混淆映射到合成重置事务，并进入正确账户 canary；跨账户、过期或已消费后仍可用也成立。值短/常见、一次 fixture 猜中、错误信息不同、缺少限速、解析报错或 token 被拒绝均不证明弱 token。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an unseen weak candidate predicting a valid token significantly better than random, or an empty or type-confused value mapping to a synthetic reset transaction and reaching the correct account canary; cross-account, expired, or post-consumption use also qualifies. A short or common value, one fixture guess, different errors, absent rate limiting, parse errors, or token rejection does not prove a weak token.

opsecTips.zh: 一个预测或边界值首次进入 reset canary 后停止，不提交新密码或扩大在线尝试。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one predicted or boundary value first reaches the reset canary; do not submit a new password or increase online attempts.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销所有重置 token，清空通知队列和样本，删除合成账户并恢复 CSPRNG、严格类型、绑定和单次使用。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all reset tokens, clear notification queues and samples, delete synthetic accounts, and restore CSPRNG generation, strict typing, binding, and single use.

title.zh: 创建重置事务基线

description.zh: 为两个隔离账号分别生成有效、已用和过期令牌，并记录事务所有者。
description.en: Generate valid, used, and expired tokens for two isolated accounts and record transaction ownership.

title.zh: 低速测试弱令牌候选

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 token 值请求验证接口，保持账号参数与客户端环境一致。
description.en: Request the validation endpoint with original token values one at a time while holding account parameters and client context constant.

attackChain.payload:
token=123
token=1234
token=12345
token=123456
token=1234567
token=123456789
token=admin
token=root
token=test
token=guest
token=user
token=default
token=secret
token=password
token=token
token=null
token=undefined
token=false
token=true
token=-1
token=[]
token={}
token=""

title.zh: 确认事务所有权

description.zh: 从服务端记录核对命中的令牌、账号与用途，避免依据页面文案做结论。
description.en: 从服务端记录核对命中的令牌、账号与用途，避免依据页面文案做结论。

overview.zh: 原集合包含短数字、常见单词、空值和类型边界，适用于测试令牌验证器的熵与解析一致性。评估必须在隔离账号上进行，并区分无效参数、缺失参数和真实有效事务。
overview.en: The original set includes short numbers, common words, empty values, and type boundaries for testing token entropy and parser consistency. Assessment uses isolated accounts and distinguishes invalid, missing, and genuinely valid reset transactions.

vulnerability.zh: 如果重置令牌来源可预测、空间过小、未绑定用户或验证接口允许高频尝试，攻击者可能枚举有效事务并重置他人密码。错误文案差异、参数被解析或返回重置表单都不是成功证据。
vulnerability.en: If reset tokens are predictable, drawn from a small space, not user-bound, or accepted at high request rates, valid transactions may be enumerated and another user's password reset. Different errors, parsed parameters, or a displayed reset form are not success evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 为两个测试账号生成有效与过期令牌并记录服务端事务；2. 低速逐项提交原始候选，保持账号和客户端状态可追踪；3. 仅通过完成无害密码变更或服务端事务绑定确认结果。统一响应、验证码页面和新建匿名事务属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. 为两个测试账号生成有效与过期令牌并记录服务端事务；2. 低速逐项提交原始候选，保持账号和客户端状态可追踪；3. 仅通过完成无害密码变更或服务端事务绑定确认结果。统一响应、验证码页面和新建匿名事务属于误报。

mitigation.zh: 1. 使用密码学安全随机源生成至少 128 位有效熵的令牌；2. 绑定账号、用途和短有效期，首次使用后原子失效；3. 对验证接口限速并返回统一响应，记录枚举模式和跨账号尝试。
mitigation.en: 1. Generate tokens with at least 128 bits of effective entropy from a cryptographically secure source. 2. Bind account, purpose, and short lifetime and invalidate atomically on first use. 3. Rate-limit validation, return uniform responses, and log enumeration and cross-account attempts.

name.zh: Node.js 依赖与包管理文件探测
name.en: Node.js Dependency and Package-Manager File Discovery

description.zh: 检查 package.json、锁文件和包管理配置是否被 Web 根目录意外公开并泄露依赖或私有仓库信息。
description.en: Checks whether package.json, lockfiles, and package-manager configuration are accidentally exposed under the web root and reveal dependencies or private registries.

prerequisites.zh: 限定到自有 Web 根并建立随机不存在路径、SPA fallback 和公开文档样例基线，以低速逐个检查候选。
prerequisites.en: Scope an owned web root and establish random-nonexistent, SPA-fallback, and public-document baselines, checking candidates individually at low rate.

prerequisites.zh: 准备解析器识别 package/lock/npmrc 格式，并定义依赖版本、脚本、私有 registry 和 token 的脱敏规则。
prerequisites.en: Prepare parsers for package, lock, and npmrc formats and define redaction rules for dependency versions, scripts, private registries, and tokens.

title.zh: NPM package.json探测
title.en: Validation step 1 for Node.js Dependency and Package-Manager File Discovery

description.zh: NPM package.json探测包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Node.js Dependency and Package-Manager File Discovery validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求目标路径返回真实、可解析的 Node.js manifest/配置字节且来自部署环境；敏感影响需存在内部依赖、脚本、私有 registry 或凭据。HTTP 200 的 SPA fallback、目录重定向、空响应、公开示例、HTML 错误页、文件名出现在索引或正常公开客户端 package.json 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the target path to return authentic, parseable Node.js manifest or configuration bytes from the deployed environment; sensitive impact additionally requires internal dependencies, scripts, private registries, or credentials. An SPA fallback with HTTP 200, directory redirect, empty response, public sample, HTML error page, filename in an index, or intentionally public client package.json is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认一个真实 manifest 后停止，不递归请求 node_modules 或下载完整项目树。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic manifest; do not recursively request node_modules or download the project tree.

opsecTips.zh: 删除响应副本和解析缓存，清理访问日志中的测试令牌，撤销临时凭据并从 Web 根移除暴露文件。
opsecTips.en: Delete response copies and parser caches, clear test tokens from access logs, revoke temporary credentials, and remove exposed files from the web root.

title.zh: 建立不存在路径基线

description.zh: 请求随机不可存在路径，记录路由回退页面的状态、类型、长度与正文哈希。
description.en: Request a random nonexistent path and record the fallback page's status, type, length, and body hash.

title.zh: 探测 Node.js 清单

description.zh: 逐项使用原始文件名访问授权站点，先检查响应头再读取小型文本文件。
description.en: Use original filenames one at a time against the authorized site, checking headers before reading small text files.

attackChain.payload:
package.json
package-lock.json
yarn.lock
.npmrc
.yarnrc
node_modules
.npm
.yarn

title.zh: 验证文件真实性

description.zh: 解析 JSON 或锁文件结构并确认依赖字段，排除统一 HTML 和示例资源。
description.en: Parse JSON or lockfile structure and verify dependency fields, excluding generic HTML and sample resources.

overview.zh: 原集合是 Node.js 项目清单和包管理路径字典，合理用途是低速内容发现。风险取决于文件是否真实可读以及其中是否包含依赖版本、脚本、令牌占位或私有 registry 信息。
overview.en: The original set is a Node.js project-manifest and package-manager path wordlist for low-rate content discovery. Risk depends on actual readability and disclosure of dependency versions, scripts, token material, or private registry information.

vulnerability.zh: 若构建产物错误包含 package.json、锁文件或 .npmrc，攻击者可获取精确依赖图、内部包名或凭证配置，扩大供应链与已知漏洞攻击面。只返回前端路由 HTML 或空目录页不构成文件泄露。
vulnerability.en: If deployment artifacts expose package.json, lockfiles, or .npmrc, an attacker may learn exact dependency graphs, internal package names, or credential configuration and expand supply-chain risk. A client-route HTML fallback or empty directory page is not disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录不存在随机路径的状态、类型、长度和哈希基线；2. 逐项请求原始文件名，使用 HEAD 后再对小文件执行 GET；3. 验证响应是否能被相应包管理器解析并检查敏感字段。统一 200、错误模板或公开示例文件属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record status, type, length, and hash for a random nonexistent path. 2. Request original filenames one at a time, using HEAD before GET for small files. 3. Verify that responses parse as the expected package format and inspect sensitive fields. Generic 200 pages, error templates, and public example files are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 仅部署编译后的必要静态产物并从 Web 根排除清单、锁文件和配置；2. 在 CI 中扫描发布包与镜像层；3. 将仓库令牌放入密钥存储并轮换任何曾暴露的凭证。
mitigation.en: 1. Deploy only required built assets and exclude manifests, lockfiles, and configuration from the web root. 2. Scan release bundles and image layers in CI. 3. Store registry tokens in a secret manager and rotate any exposed credentials.

name.zh: Python 依赖与环境文件探测
name.en: Python Dependency and Environment File Discovery

description.zh: 检查 requirements、Pipfile、pyproject 与环境清单是否被公开，从而泄露 Python 依赖和部署信息。
description.en: Checks whether requirements, Pipfile, pyproject, and environment manifests are public and disclose Python dependencies or deployment details.

prerequisites.zh: 在自有测试站点以固定 base path 和低速率请求候选，记录 SPA fallback、反向代理错误和静态资源规则。
prerequisites.en: Request candidates at a fixed base path and low rate on an owned test site, recording SPA fallbacks, reverse-proxy errors, and static-resource rules.

prerequisites.zh: 使用对应解析器验证 requirements、Pipfile、Poetry、Conda 和 setup 格式，并预设私有索引/本地路径脱敏。
prerequisites.en: Validate requirements, Pipfile, Poetry, Conda, and setup formats with appropriate parsers, predefining redaction for private indexes and local paths.

title.zh: Python requirements.txt探测
title.en: Validation step 1 for Python Dependency and Environment File Discovery

execution.command:
requirements.txt
requirements.in
Pipfile
Pipfile.lock
setup.py
setup.cfg
pyproject.toml
poetry.lock
conda.yaml
environment.yml

description.zh: Python requirements.txt探测包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Python Dependency and Environment File Discovery validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是服务器公开返回可解析且与部署环境一致的 Python 依赖/环境清单；影响证据是精确版本、私有索引、editable 路径或内部包等非预期信息。文件名命中、统一 200 页面、文档示例、空文件、下载提示无正文、robots 条目或公开开源仓库镜像均不是部署泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the server publicly returning a parseable Python dependency or environment manifest consistent with the deployment; impact evidence is unintended exact versions, private indexes, editable paths, or internal packages. A filename hit, uniform HTTP 200 page, documentation sample, empty file, download prompt without body, robots entry, or public open-source mirror is not deployment exposure.

opsecTips.zh: 一个真实依赖文件被确认后停止，不继续探测虚拟环境、源码目录或私有索引。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic dependency file; do not continue to virtual environments, source directories, or private indexes.

opsecTips.zh: 删除下载与解析结果，清理缓存/访问日志并撤销暴露的测试索引 token，再收紧静态文件白名单。
opsecTips.en: Delete downloads and parse results, clear caches and access logs, revoke exposed test-index tokens, and tighten the static-file allowlist.

title.zh: 指纹化错误响应

description.zh: 采集随机路径、目录路径和不存在扩展名的响应，建立误报对照。
description.en: Collect responses for random paths, directories, and nonexistent extensions to establish false-positive controls.

title.zh: 探测 Python 清单

description.zh: 逐项请求原始 requirements、Pipfile、Poetry 与 Conda 文件名并限制大小。
description.en: Request original requirements, Pipfile, Poetry, and Conda filenames one at a time with a size cap.

attackChain.payload:
requirements.txt
requirements.in
Pipfile
Pipfile.lock
setup.py
setup.cfg
pyproject.toml
poetry.lock
conda.yaml
environment.yml

title.zh: 按格式验证内容

description.zh: 检查依赖约束、区段和锁文件键，确认响应不是 HTML 回退或无关文本。
description.en: Check dependency constraints, sections, and lockfile keys to confirm the response is not HTML fallback or unrelated text.

overview.zh: 原集合覆盖 pip、Poetry、Pipenv、Conda 和传统 setup 文件。验证重点是响应内容是否符合对应语法，以及依赖版本、私有索引 URL、可编辑安装路径或环境变量引用是否敏感。
overview.en: The original set covers pip, Poetry, Pipenv, Conda, and traditional setup files. Validation focuses on format authenticity and whether dependency versions, private index URLs, editable paths, or environment references are sensitive.

vulnerability.zh: 公开 Python 依赖清单可暴露精确版本、内部包、开发路径和私有源配置，为组件漏洞与依赖混淆提供信息。仅文件名匹配、搜索引擎缓存或返回应用首页时，不应报告真实文件暴露。
vulnerability.en: Public Python manifests can reveal exact versions, internal packages, development paths, and private indexes, informing component exploitation or dependency confusion. Filename matches, search caches, and application-homepage responses do not prove file exposure.

exploitation.zh: 1. 为目标记录随机路径和常见错误页指纹；2. 逐项请求原始 Python 清单名称并限制下载大小；3. 使用对应解析规则检查节标题、依赖约束和锁文件结构。响应是 HTML、网关错误或无关文本时判为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record a random-path and common error-page fingerprint for the target. 2. Request original Python manifest names one at a time with a download-size cap. 3. Check section headers, dependency constraints, and lock structures using format-specific rules. HTML, gateway errors, and unrelated text are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 通过构建阶段只复制运行所需产物，不把源码根目录作为静态目录；2. 从发布包排除依赖清单与开发配置，必要公开时移除私有源；3. 使用 SBOM 和内部资产清单替代生产文件暴露。
mitigation.en: 1. Copy only runtime artifacts during builds and never serve the source root as static content. 2. Exclude manifests and development configuration from releases, removing private indexes when publication is necessary. 3. Use SBOMs and internal inventories instead of production exposure.

name.zh: PHP Composer 清单与自动加载文件探测
name.en: PHP Composer Manifest and Autoloader Discovery

description.zh: 检查 composer.json、composer.lock 或 autoload.php 是否被公开并泄露 PHP 包、路径或自动加载结构。
description.en: Checks whether composer.json, composer.lock, or autoload.php is public and discloses PHP packages, paths, or autoload structure.

prerequisites.zh: 在授权 Web 根按固定路径低速检查 Composer 候选，并建立 PHP 正常执行空响应、404 和 SPA fallback 对照。
prerequisites.en: Check Composer candidates at fixed paths and low rate on an authorized web root, establishing controls for normally executed empty PHP responses, HTTP 404, and SPA fallback.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 JSON/lockfile 解析和 PHP 源码特征确认真实性，预先定义包版本、内部仓库、绝对路径与 token 脱敏。
prerequisites.en: Confirm authenticity with JSON or lockfile parsing and PHP source signatures, predefining redaction for package versions, internal repositories, absolute paths, and tokens.

title.zh: PHP composer.json探测
title.en: Validation step 1 for PHP Composer Manifest and Autoloader Discovery

description.zh: PHP composer.json探测包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this PHP Composer Manifest and Autoloader Discovery validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 composer.json/lock 以可解析原文公开，或 autoload.php 源码而非执行结果被返回，并包含部署相关信息。autoload.php 正常执行后的空白、统一 200 错误页、下载重定向、公开开源 manifest、文件名回显、解析失败或只有通用 Composer 文本都不是文件泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires composer.json or composer.lock to be publicly returned as parseable source, or autoload.php source rather than execution output to be disclosed, with deployment-related information. Blank output from normal autoload.php execution, a uniform HTTP 200 error page, download redirect, public open-source manifest, reflected filename, parse failure, or generic Composer text is not file exposure.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认一个真实 Composer 文件后停止，不追踪 vendor 路径或请求其他 PHP 源码。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic Composer file; do not follow vendor paths or request additional PHP source.

opsecTips.zh: 删除响应和解析缓存，清理访问日志，撤销泄露的测试仓库凭据，并从 Web 根移除 manifest/源码。
opsecTips.en: Delete responses and parser caches, clear access logs, revoke exposed test-repository credentials, and remove manifests or source from the web root.

title.zh: 建立 PHP 路径基线

description.zh: 比较不存在的 JSON、lock 和 PHP 文件响应，记录正常执行与源码下载差异。
description.en: Compare responses for nonexistent JSON, lock, and PHP files and record differences between execution and source download.

title.zh: 请求 Composer 文件

description.zh: 逐项使用原始文件名检查状态、类型、正文开头和重定向链。
description.en: Use original filenames one at a time and inspect status, type, body prefix, and redirect chain.

attackChain.payload:
composer.json
composer.lock
autoload.php

title.zh: 确认清单或源码

description.zh: 解析 Composer 包字段，或确认 autoload.php 以文本返回而不是被正常执行。
description.en: Parse Composer package fields or confirm that autoload.php is returned as text rather than executed normally.

overview.zh: 该集合很小但涵盖 Composer 项目清单、锁文件与自动加载入口。清单可用于识别依赖，autoload.php 若被当作文本泄露则还可能暴露服务器路径；若正常执行为空响应则不能据此判定泄露。
overview.en: This compact set covers Composer manifests, lockfiles, and the autoloader entry point. Manifests identify dependencies, while source disclosure of autoload.php may reveal server paths; a normally executed empty response is not disclosure.

vulnerability.zh: Web 根目录公开 Composer 清单可能暴露精确包版本和私有仓库，源码形式返回自动加载文件还会泄露目录结构。文件存在但由 PHP 正常执行、响应为空且无内容泄露时，影响不能按源码暴露计算。
vulnerability.en: Public Composer manifests may reveal exact package versions and private repositories, while source delivery of autoload files can expose directory structure. A file that executes normally and returns no content is not source disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录随机 JSON、lock 和 PHP 路径的错误基线；2. 逐项请求原始名称并检查 Content-Type、正文起始和下载行为；3. 对 JSON 解析包字段，对 PHP 仅在源码文本出现时记录。空响应、重定向首页和统一错误属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record error baselines for random JSON, lock, and PHP paths. 2. Request original names one at a time and inspect Content-Type, body prefix, and download behavior. 3. Parse package fields in JSON and record PHP only when source text appears. Empty responses, homepage redirects, and generic errors are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 将 Web 根指向 public 目录而不是项目根目录；2. 通过服务器规则拒绝 composer 文件和 PHP 源码下载；3. 在部署流水线扫描公开路径与镜像层，并将私有仓库凭证迁移到密钥管理。
mitigation.en: 1. Point the web root to the public directory rather than the project root. 2. Deny Composer files and PHP source downloads at the server. 3. Scan public paths and image layers during deployment and move private-repository credentials to secret management.

name.zh: Ruby Bundler 清单文件探测

description.zh: 检查 Gemfile、Gemfile.lock 和 gemspec 是否被 Web 服务公开并泄露 Ruby 依赖、源地址或内部 gem 信息。
description.en: Checks whether Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, and gemspec files are web-accessible and disclose Ruby dependencies, source URLs, or internal gems.

prerequisites.zh: 在自有测试部署中确认 Ruby 应用 base path、静态服务和 fallback 行为，逐个低速请求 Gemfile 候选。
prerequisites.en: Confirm Ruby application base path, static serving, and fallback behavior in an owned deployment, requesting Gemfile candidates individually at low rate.

prerequisites.zh: 以 Bundler/gemspec 语法解析响应，并预设 source、git、path、精确版本和内部 gem 名称的脱敏规则。
prerequisites.en: Parse responses with Bundler or gemspec syntax and predefine redaction for source, git, path, exact versions, and internal gem names.

title.zh: Ruby Gemfile探测
title.en: Validation step 1 for Ruby Bundler Manifest File Discovery

description.zh: Ruby Gemfile探测包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Ruby Bundler Manifest File Discovery validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是 Web 服务返回真实可解析的 Gemfile、lockfile 或 gemspec，并披露部署使用的依赖或内部源。HTTP 200 的 HTML fallback、仓库公开文档、空响应、错误页包含 Gemfile、目录列表仅显示文件名、样例项目或无法解析的文本都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the web service returning an authentic, parseable Gemfile, lockfile, or gemspec that discloses deployed dependencies or internal sources. An HTML fallback with HTTP 200, public repository documentation, empty response, an error page mentioning Gemfile, a directory list showing only a filename, sample project, or unparsable text is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个真实 Bundler 文件被确认后停止，不继续请求 .bundle、vendor/cache 或应用源码。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic Bundler file; do not continue to .bundle, vendor/cache, or application source.

opsecTips.zh: 删除捕获文件与解析数据，清除缓存/访问日志，撤销测试源凭据并收紧静态路径配置。
opsecTips.en: Delete captured files and parse data, clear caches and access logs, revoke test-source credentials, and tighten static-path configuration.

title.zh: 指纹化 Rails 回退页

description.zh: 记录随机路径、路由错误与静态 404 的状态、长度、标题和正文哈希。
description.en: Record status, length, title, and body hash for random paths, route errors, and static 404 responses.

title.zh: 探测 Bundler 清单

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 Gemfile 与 gemspec 名称，检查响应类型和下载大小。
description.en: Use original Gemfile and gemspec names one at a time and inspect response type and download size.

attackChain.payload:
Gemfile
Gemfile.lock
.gemspec

title.zh: 验证依赖结构

description.zh: 确认 source、GEM 与 DEPENDENCIES 等区段，并判断内容是否属于当前部署。
description.en: 确认 source、GEM 与 DEPENDENCIES 等区段，并判断内容是否属于当前部署。

overview.zh: 原集合对应 Bundler 的依赖声明、锁定解析和 gem 元数据。验证应确认文本结构而非仅看状态码，并重点检查 source、git、path、平台和精确版本是否泄露内部开发信息。
overview.en: The original set covers Bundler dependency declarations, locked resolution, and gem metadata. Validation confirms text structure rather than status alone and reviews source, git, path, platform, and exact-version data for internal details.

vulnerability.zh: 公开 Gemfile 或锁文件可暴露私有 gem 名称、内部 Git 地址和组件版本，为供应链攻击或组件漏洞枚举提供线索。若响应是 Rails 路由页、错误模板或公开开源项目清单，则不能直接报告生产秘密泄露。
vulnerability.en: Public Gemfiles or lockfiles may reveal private gem names, internal Git URLs, and component versions, informing supply-chain attacks or component enumeration. Rails route pages, error templates, and intentionally public open-source manifests are not production-secret leaks.

exploitation.zh: 1. 获取随机路径与 Rails 404 页面指纹；2. 逐项请求原始 Bundler 文件名并限制响应体大小；3. 查验 source、GEM、DEPENDENCIES 和规格字段，结合部署归属确认敏感性。统一页面、源码仓库公开副本或无解析结构属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Fingerprint a random path and the Rails 404 page. 2. Request original Bundler filenames one at a time with a body-size limit. 3. Inspect source, GEM, DEPENDENCIES, and specification fields and assess deployment ownership. Generic pages, public repository copies, and unparseable content are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 只把 Rails public 目录暴露给 Web 服务器；2. 从静态发布物和对象存储排除 Gemfile、锁文件及 gemspec；3. 清理私有源凭据，生成内部 SBOM 并对发布产物做敏感路径检查。
mitigation.en: 1. Expose only the Rails public directory through the web server. 2. Exclude Gemfiles, lockfiles, and gemspec files from static releases and object storage. 3. Remove private-source credentials, generate an internal SBOM, and scan release artifacts for sensitive paths.

name.zh: Java Maven 与 Gradle 构建文件探测
name.en: Java Maven and Gradle Build-File Discovery

description.zh: 检查 pom.xml、Gradle 脚本和属性文件是否可公开访问并泄露 Java 依赖、插件或内部仓库配置。
description.en: Checks whether pom.xml, Gradle scripts, and property files are publicly accessible and disclose Java dependencies, plugins, or internal repositories.

prerequisites.zh: 限定到授权 Java 部署的 Web 根和上下文路径，建立随机路径、默认 servlet 和前端 fallback 基线。
prerequisites.en: Scope the web root and context path of an authorized Java deployment, establishing random-path, default-servlet, and frontend-fallback baselines.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 Maven/Gradle 解析规则确认项目、依赖、插件、仓库和 properties 结构，并定义凭据与内网 URL 脱敏。
prerequisites.en: Confirm project, dependency, plugin, repository, and properties structures with Maven or Gradle parsing rules, defining redaction for credentials and internal URLs.

title.zh: Java pom.xml探测
title.en: Validation step 1 for Java Maven and Gradle Build-File Discovery

execution.command:
pom.xml
build.gradle
settings.gradle
gradle.properties
build.gradle.kts
settings.gradle.kts

description.zh: Java pom.xml探测包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Java Maven and Gradle Build-File Discovery validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 pom.xml 或 Gradle 文件以真实可解析内容公开，并与运行部署的构建坐标/依赖相符；敏感影响需有内部仓库、插件、版本或属性。状态 200、XML 错误页、公开示例、前端 index、空 properties、文件名提示或源码镜像按设计公开都不是部署配置泄露。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires pom.xml or a Gradle file to be publicly returned as authentic, parseable content matching the deployed build coordinates or dependencies; sensitive impact requires internal repositories, plugins, versions, or properties. HTTP 200, an XML error page, public sample, frontend index, empty properties, filename hint, or an intentionally public source mirror is not deployment-configuration exposure.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认一个真实构建文件后停止，不遍历 target、build、仓库缓存或源码路径。
opsecTips.en: Stop after confirming one authentic build file; do not enumerate target, build, repository caches, or source paths.

opsecTips.zh: 删除下载与解析结果，清理 CDN/服务器缓存和访问日志，轮换测试仓库凭据并修正静态资源白名单。
opsecTips.en: Delete downloads and parse results, clear CDN and server caches and access logs, rotate test-repository credentials, and correct the static-resource allowlist.

title.zh: 建立构建文件误报基线

description.zh: 请求随机 XML、Gradle 和属性文件名，记录应用路由与静态错误响应。
description.en: Request random XML, Gradle, and properties filenames and record application-route and static-error responses.

title.zh: 探测 Maven 与 Gradle 文件

description.zh: 逐项使用原始构建文件名进行低速请求，并保留缓存与内容类型信息。
description.en: Use original build filenames one at a time at low rate and retain cache and content-type information.

attackChain.payload:
pom.xml
build.gradle
settings.gradle
gradle.properties
build.gradle.kts
settings.gradle.kts

title.zh: 验证构建元数据

description.zh: 解析依赖、插件和仓库结构，确认文件对应当前部署而非示例内容。
description.en: Parse dependency, plugin, and repository structures and confirm the file belongs to the current deployment rather than sample content.

overview.zh: 该集合同时覆盖 Maven 与 Gradle 项目配置。有效证据应包含可解析的 project、dependencies、plugins 或 repository 结构，并区分实际服务清单与文档示例、源码镜像和前端路由回退。
overview.en: This set covers both Maven and Gradle project configuration. Valid evidence includes parseable project, dependency, plugin, or repository structures and distinguishes deployed manifests from documentation samples, source mirrors, and client-route fallbacks.

vulnerability.zh: 生产站点公开构建文件可能泄露组件精确版本、内部仓库、插件任务和构建属性，帮助识别已知漏洞或供应链边界。只看到 XML 页面、Gradle 关键词或公开示例项目不代表当前应用配置泄露。
vulnerability.en: Public production build files may reveal exact component versions, internal repositories, plugin tasks, and build properties, informing known-vulnerability or supply-chain analysis. An XML page, Gradle keywords, or a public sample project does not prove current-application disclosure.

exploitation.zh: 1. 建立随机 XML、Gradle 和 properties 路径的错误指纹；2. 逐项请求原始文件名，限制响应体并记录缓存来源；3. 使用 Maven 或 Gradle 结构规则验证 group、artifact、dependency 和 repository。通用 XML、文档示例与缓存旧文件属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Fingerprint errors for random XML, Gradle, and properties paths. 2. Request original filenames one at a time, limit body size, and record cache source. 3. Validate group, artifact, dependency, and repository structures using Maven or Gradle rules. Generic XML, documentation examples, and stale cached files are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 将构建上下文与运行时静态目录完全分离；2. 从 WAR、镜像和 CDN 发布清单中排除构建脚本与仓库配置；3. 对依赖信息使用内部 SBOM 管理，并轮换任何暴露的仓库凭证。
mitigation.en: 1. Fully separate build context from runtime static directories. 2. Exclude build scripts and repository configuration from WAR files, images, and CDN manifests. 3. Manage dependency data with internal SBOMs and rotate any exposed repository credentials.

name.zh: JWT 签名验证负向测试

description.zh: 使用缺失或异常签名的 JWT 结构验证服务端是否在解析声明后仍严格执行算法与签名校验。
description.en: Uses JWT structures with missing or abnormal signatures to test whether a server strictly enforces algorithm and signature validation after parsing claims.

prerequisites.zh: 为低权限合成用户签发一枚有效 JWT，固定 issuer、audience、时效、算法、kid 和只读 canary 端点。
prerequisites.en: Issue one valid JWT for a low-privilege synthetic user, pinning issuer, audience, lifetime, algorithm, kid, and a read-only canary endpoint.

prerequisites.zh: 仅移除、截断或异常化签名部分，保持 Header/Payload 与请求上下文一致，并采集解析、验证和授权阶段日志。
prerequisites.en: Only remove, truncate, or abnormalize the signature segment while keeping header, payload, and request context fixed, collecting parsing, validation, and authorization-stage logs.

title.zh: JWT签名验证绕过测试
title.en: Validation step 1 for JWT Signature-Validation Negative Testing

description.zh: JWT签名验证绕过测试包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this JWT Signature-Validation Negative Testing validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求缺失或异常签名的 token 通过服务端验证并以合成主体读取认证 canary，日志显示授权发生在签名成功之前或签名被跳过。Header 可解码、解析器识别 alg、错误信息不同、返回匿名 200、网关接收后资源端拒绝、或合法基线成功都不是签名绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a token with a missing or abnormal signature to pass server validation and read the authenticated canary as the synthetic principal, with logs showing authorization before signature success or skipped verification. A decodable header, parser recognizing alg, different errors, anonymous HTTP 200, gateway acceptance followed by resource-server rejection, or success of the valid baseline is not signature bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个无效签名 token 首次读取只读 canary 后停止，不篡改权限 claims 或调用写接口。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one invalidly signed token first reads the read-only canary; do not tamper with privilege claims or invoke write endpoints.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销测试 token 和账户，清除验证/JWKS 缓存与诊断日志，并恢复签名必需和算法固定。
opsecTips.en: Revoke test tokens and the account, clear validation and JWKS caches and diagnostic logs, and restore mandatory signatures and algorithm pinning.

title.zh: 建立低权限 JWT 基线

description.zh: 使用合法低权限令牌访问受保护接口，记录主体、权限和审计事件。
description.en: Use a valid low-privilege token on a protected endpoint and record principal, permissions, and audit events.

title.zh: 提交异常签名结构

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 JWT 片段进行请求，保持 issuer、audience 与接口不变。
description.en: Use original JWT fragments one at a time while keeping issuer, audience, and endpoint unchanged.

eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.

title.zh: 确认服务端授权结果

description.zh: 从服务端日志核对验签与权限决策，排除仅解析成功或客户端显示变化。
description.en: Verify signature and authorization decisions in server logs, excluding parsing success and client display changes.

overview.zh: 原集合包含仅有头部和空签名的 JWT 片段，适合作为验证器负向输入。测试必须从正常低权限令牌出发，并保持 issuer、audience、时间和请求上下文一致，避免把解析成功误认为验证成功。
overview.en: The original set contains header-only JWT fragments with empty signatures for validator negative testing. Testing starts from a valid low-privilege token and holds issuer, audience, time, and request context constant so parsing is not confused with validation.

vulnerability.zh: 若服务端在缺少有效签名时仍信任 alg、kid 或权限声明，攻击者可伪造身份或提升权限。解码器能显示头部、前端接受字符串或接口返回统一 200 都不代表受保护操作通过。
vulnerability.en: If a server trusts alg, kid, or privilege claims without a valid signature, an attacker may forge identity or escalate privileges. A decoder showing the header, client acceptance, or a generic 200 response does not mean a protected operation succeeded.

exploitation.zh: 1. 用正常低权限 JWT 访问受保护接口并记录拒绝或允许基线；2. 逐项提交原始空签名结构，其他请求条件保持一致；3. 核对服务端主体、授权决策与审计日志。只有伪造令牌获得超出基线的权限才成立，解析错误差异属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Access a protected endpoint with a valid low-privilege JWT and record the authorization baseline. 2. Submit original empty-signature structures one at a time with all other request conditions unchanged. 3. Verify server principal, authorization decision, and audit logs. Confirm only privileges beyond baseline; parser-error differences are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在读取任何声明前验证签名并固定每个客户端允许的算法；2. 严格验证 issuer、audience、时间与密钥用途，禁止从不可信头部直接选取文件或 URL；3. 对空签名、截断令牌和算法混淆建立负向测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Verify the signature before using any claim and fix allowed algorithms per client. 2. Strictly validate issuer, audience, time, and key usage and never select files or URLs directly from untrusted headers. 3. Add negative tests for empty signatures, truncated tokens, and algorithm confusion.

name.zh: 通用正则表达式拒绝服务输入

description.zh: 使用固定长度的近似失败字符串筛查正则匹配路径，并以可重复的资源增长而非单次超时判定 ReDoS。
description.en: 使用固定长度的近似失败字符串筛查正则匹配路径，并以可重复的资源增长而非单次超时判定 Re Do S。

prerequisites.zh: 确认用户输入到达的具体正则、语言引擎和调用路径，在资源受限的独立进程中运行。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the exact regex, language engine, and call path reached by user input, running it in a resource-limited isolated process.

prerequisites.zh: 把固定长度字符串作为初筛后，生成递增长度的失败匹配、成功匹配和随机后缀对照并重复计时。
prerequisites.en: After using fixed-length strings for screening, generate increasing-length failed matches, successful matches, and random-suffix controls and time them repeatedly.

title.zh: 常见ReDoS模式
title.en: Validation step 1 for Generic Regular Expression Denial-of-Service Inputs

description.zh: 常见ReDoS模式包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Generic Regular Expression Denial-of-Service Inputs validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求失败匹配成本随长度可重复地超线性增长，并由 CPU/profile 定位到目标正则；固定样本只能提示候选。一次超时、长度相同输入差异、网络延迟、GC、服务器负载、请求排队、异常处理或安全超时主动终止均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires failed-match cost to grow reproducibly superlinearly with length and CPU profiling to localize it to the target regex; fixed samples only identify candidates. One timeout, differences among equal-length inputs, network latency, garbage collection, server load, request queueing, exception handling, or an active safety timeout is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 曲线首次越过预设 CPU/时延阈值后停止，不发送最大长度或并发请求。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the curve first crosses the predefined CPU or latency threshold; do not send maximum-length or concurrent requests.

opsecTips.zh: 终止隔离进程，清除请求队列、输入和性能 trace，恢复资源限制并替换风险正则。
opsecTips.en: Terminate the isolated process, clear request queues, inputs, and performance traces, restore resource limits, and replace the risky regex.

title.zh: 记录正常匹配成本

description.zh: 采集正常与随机失败输入的正则内部耗时、CPU 和请求端到端延迟。
description.en: Collect internal regex time, CPU, and end-to-end latency for normal and random failed input.

title.zh: 用原始字符串初筛

description.zh: 逐项提交原始固定长度变体，设置严格超时并标记稳定变慢的路径。
description.en: Submit original fixed-length variants one at a time with a strict timeout and flag consistently slower paths.

attackChain.payload:

xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxX
xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx1
xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx@

title.zh: 生成增长曲线确认
title.en: Generate a growth curve for confirmation

description.zh: 对候选路径追加递增长度样本并重复测量，确认资源消耗是否超线性。
description.en: Add increasing-length samples for candidate paths and repeat measurements to confirm superlinear resource growth.

overview.zh: 该集合比 JavaScript 专项条目更通用，提供 x 字符结尾变体以触发失败匹配。由于长度基本固定，它适合初筛，不足以独立绘制复杂度曲线；确认阶段仍需生成递增长度样本。
overview.en: This set is more generic than the Java Script-specific entry and provides x-string suffix variants for failed matches. Because lengths are mostly fixed, it supports screening but not a complete complexity curve; confirmation still requires increasing samples.

vulnerability.zh: 存在嵌套量词、回溯歧义或重叠分支的正则可能在近似输入上消耗大量 CPU 或线程，造成应用层拒绝服务。某个固定字符串慢一次可能来自缓存未命中、网络或下游服务，不能直接定性。
vulnerability.en: Regexes with nested quantifiers, ambiguous backtracking, or overlapping alternatives may consume excessive CPU or threads on near-matching input and cause application denial of service. One slow fixed string may instead reflect cache, network, or downstream behavior.

exploitation.zh: 1. 对正常输入和随机不存在输入记录端到端与正则内部计时；2. 逐项提交原始字符串进行初筛，命中后生成逐级长度样本；3. 重复测量 CPU、线程与延迟斜率并设置停止阈值。单次慢响应、冷启动和限流页面属于误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record end-to-end and internal regex timing for normal and random nonmatching input. 2. Submit original strings one at a time for screening, then generate increasing lengths for candidates. 3. Repeat CPU, thread, and latency-slope measurements with a stop threshold. Single slow responses, cold starts, and throttle pages are false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 简化表达式并优先采用保证线性时间的引擎或解析器；2. 对输入长度、匹配时间和请求并发设置上限；3. 在代码审查与 CI 中检测危险结构，并为高风险端点增加资源斜率回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Simplify expressions and prefer engines or parsers with linear-time guarantees. 2. Cap input length, matching time, and request concurrency. 3. Detect risky structures in review and CI and add resource-slope regression tests for high-risk endpoints.

name.zh: 管理路径规范化绕过

description.zh: 使用大小写、分隔符、参数、编码和路径段变体检查代理与应用是否对同一路径执行一致授权。
description.en: Uses case, separator, parameter, encoding, and path-segment variants to test consistent authorization across proxies and applications.

prerequisites.zh: 为一个合成管理对象保存规范 `/admin` 在未认证与普通用户下的拒绝基线，并固定 Host、方法和查询业务参数。
prerequisites.en: Retain denial baselines for canonical /admin against one synthetic administration object as unauthenticated and regular users, fixing Host, method, and business query parameters.

prerequisites.zh: 在 CDN、代理、框架和路由层记录原始路径、每次解码/规范化结果与最终 handler，每个请求只改变一个变体。
prerequisites.en: Record raw path, every decoding and normalization result, and final handler at CDN, proxy, framework, and router layers, changing one variant per request.

title.zh: 路径变换
title.en: Validation step 1 for Administrative Path Normalization Bypass

description.zh: 路径变换包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Administrative Path Normalization Bypass validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求某一大小写、分隔符、矩阵参数、编码或路径段变体最终路由到与 `/admin` 相同的受保护对象，却绕过该对象授权并返回 canary。404/403 变化、登录页 200、静态扩展页面、重定向、代理拒绝、不同 handler 的公开内容或仅日志中归一化为 admin 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires one case, separator, matrix-parameter, encoding, or path-segment variant to reach the same protected object as /admin while bypassing its authorization and returning the canary. A 404 or 403 change, HTTP 200 login page, static-extension page, redirect, proxy rejection, public content from another handler, or admin normalization only in logs is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 定位到一个最小路径变体并读取一次 canary 后停止，不继续组合编码或遍历其他管理路由。
opsecTips.en: Stop after locating one minimal path variant and reading the canary once; do not combine encodings or enumerate other administration routes.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 canary 和账户，清除各层路由/缓存 trace，并恢复先规范化后授权及唯一规范路径。
opsecTips.en: Delete the canary and accounts, clear routing and cache traces at every tier, and restore normalization before authorization with one canonical path.

title.zh: 建立路径变换与授权基线
title.en: Establish the Path Transformation and Authorization baseline

description.zh: 记录标准 /admin 路径在未认证与低权限会话中的拒绝状态、正文和后端路由，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record status, body, and backend route for the canonical /admin path under unauthenticated and low-privilege sessions, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行路径变换与授权变体
title.en: Execute the Path Transformation and Authorization variants

description.zh: 逐项发送原始路径变体并保留原始请求目标、代理转发路径和框架归一化结果，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Send original path variants one at a time and retain raw request target, proxy-forwarded path, and framework-normalized result, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验管理路径规范化绕过证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Administrative Path Normalization Bypass

description.zh: 确认变体最终命中同一管理处理器并返回仅管理员可见的数据或状态变化；同时排除定制 404、公开登录页、前端路由回退或仅路径回显。
description.en: Confirm that a variant reaches the same administrative handler and returns administrator-only data or state change; also exclude Custom 404 pages, public login pages, client-route fallbacks, or path reflection.

overview.zh: 该空尾 ID 实际保存大量 /admin 路径变体，测试重点是 CDN、代理、框架和文件系统的规范化顺序。本条按HTTP 授权与路由边界审查；应在隔离资源上逐项执行，固定身份、路径、方法和除当前变量外的所有请求条件。
overview.en: This ambiguous trailing ID contains many /admin path variants and targets normalization order across CDN, proxy, framework, and filesystem. This entry is reviewed as a HTTP authorization and routing boundary; Execute one item at a time against an isolated resource while fixing identity, path, method, and every request condition except the tested variable.

vulnerability.zh: 若前置访问控制检查原始路径而后端在解码或折叠后映射到受限路由，攻击者可能绕过路径级授权。确认标准是确认变体最终命中同一管理处理器并返回仅管理员可见的数据或状态变化；定制 404、公开登录页、前端路由回退或仅路径回显不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If edge access control checks the raw path while the backend maps it to a restricted route after decoding or collapsing, path-level authorization may be bypassed. Confirmation requires Confirm that a variant reaches the same administrative handler and returns administrator-only data or state change; Custom 404 pages, public login pages, client-route fallbacks, or path reflection is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录标准 /admin 路径在未认证与低权限会话中的拒绝状态、正文和后端路由；2. 逐项发送原始路径变体并保留原始请求目标、代理转发路径和框架归一化结果；3. 确认变体最终命中同一管理处理器并返回仅管理员可见的数据或状态变化。定制 404、公开登录页、前端路由回退或仅路径回显应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record status, body, and backend route for the canonical /admin path under unauthenticated and low-privilege sessions. 2. Send original path variants one at a time and retain raw request target, proxy-forwarded path, and framework-normalized result. 3. Confirm that a variant reaches the same administrative handler and returns administrator-only data or state change. Treat Custom 404 pages, public login pages, client-route fallbacks, or path reflection as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在授权前采用单一严格路径规范化并拒绝歧义编码；2. 将授权绑定到后端路由和主体而不是边缘字符串规则；3. 对大小写、分号、点段、双重编码和尾分隔符建立回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Apply one strict path normalization before authorization and reject ambiguous encodings. 2. Bind authorization to the backend route and principal rather than edge string rules. 3. Add regression tests for case, semicolons, dot segments, double encoding, and trailing separators.

name.zh: 标准 HTTP 方法授权一致性

description.zh: 用标准 HTTP 动词检查同一路由的读取、写入和元数据处理是否都执行等价授权。
description.en: Uses standard HTTP verbs to check whether read, write, and metadata handling on one route enforce equivalent authorization.

prerequisites.zh: 在测试路由建立每个标准 HTTP 方法的预期 handler、主体权限和副作用矩阵，使用可恢复对象。
prerequisites.en: Define expected handlers, principal permissions, and side effects for every standard HTTP method on a test route, using a recoverable object.

prerequisites.zh: 固定 URI、认证和请求内容，采集代理 method、应用 handler、授权决策及 OPTIONS/HEAD/TRACE 特殊行为。
prerequisites.en: Fix URI, authentication, and request content while collecting proxy method, application handler, authorization decision, and special OPTIONS, HEAD, or TRACE behavior.

title.zh: HTTP方法变换
title.en: Validation step 1 for Standard HTTP Method Authorization Consistency

execution.command:
GET /admin HTTP/1.1
POST /admin HTTP/1.1
PUT /admin HTTP/1.1
PATCH /admin HTTP/1.1
DELETE /admin HTTP/1.1
OPTIONS /admin HTTP/1.1
HEAD /admin HTTP/1.1
TRACE /admin HTTP/1.1
CONNECT /admin HTTP/1.1

description.zh: HTTP方法变换包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Standard HTTP Method Authorization Consistency validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性是无权限主体通过某个方法到达本应受限的同一资源 handler，并读取 canary 或产生可回滚状态变化，服务端审计确认授权缺失。OPTIONS 暴露方法、HEAD 无正文、TRACE 被启用、405、不同方法返回不同错误、公开健康响应或路由未实现都不等于方法级越权。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an unauthorized principal reaching a restricted handler for the same resource through one method and reading the canary or causing a reversible change, with server auditing confirming missing authorization. OPTIONS disclosure, bodyless HEAD, enabled TRACE, HTTP 405, different errors, a public health response, or an unimplemented route is not method-level authorization bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个标准方法首次越权读取或改变 canary 后停止，不继续 CONNECT/TRACE 链或真实资源动作。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one standard method first reads or changes the canary without authorization; do not continue with CONNECT or TRACE chains or real-resource actions.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚对象，删除会话与方法矩阵日志，并恢复每个 handler 的统一服务端授权和允许方法白名单。
opsecTips.en: Roll back the object, delete sessions and method-matrix logs, and restore consistent server authorization and an allowed-method list for every handler.

title.zh: 建立方法级访问控制基线
title.en: Establish the Method-Level Access Control baseline

description.zh: 以管理员和低权限账号分别访问标准管理路由，记录每个允许方法及预期结果，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Access the canonical administrative route as administrator and low-privilege users and record allowed methods and expected outcomes, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行方法级访问控制变体
title.en: Execute the Method-Level Access Control variants

description.zh: 按原始请求行逐个发送方法，使用无副作用测试资源并保持路径与身份一致，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Send methods from the original request lines one at a time against a harmless test resource while holding path and identity constant, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

attackChain.payload:
GET /admin HTTP/1.1
POST /admin HTTP/1.1
PUT /admin HTTP/1.1
PATCH /admin HTTP/1.1
DELETE /admin HTTP/1.1
OPTIONS /admin HTTP/1.1
HEAD /admin HTTP/1.1
TRACE /admin HTTP/1.1
CONNECT /admin HTTP/1.1

title.zh: 核验标准 HTTP 方法授权一致性证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Standard HTTP Method Authorization Consistency

description.zh: 核对有效处理器、响应字段和资源版本，证明低权限请求执行了受限操作；同时排除自动 Allow 头、空 HEAD 正文、通用 OPTIONS 或 TRACE 被边缘拒绝。
description.en: Verify effective handler, response fields, and resource version to prove a restricted operation executed for the low-privilege request; also exclude Automatic Allow headers, empty HEAD bodies, generic OPTIONS, or TRACE blocked at the edge.

overview.zh: 原始请求行覆盖 GET、POST、PUT、PATCH、DELETE、OPTIONS、HEAD、TRACE 和 CONNECT，适合建立方法矩阵。本条按HTTP 授权与路由边界审查；应在隔离资源上逐项执行，固定身份、路径、方法和除当前变量外的所有请求条件。
overview.en: The original request lines cover GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD, TRACE, and CONNECT for a method matrix. This entry is reviewed as a HTTP authorization and routing boundary; Execute one item at a time against an isolated resource while fixing identity, path, method, and every request condition except the tested variable.

vulnerability.zh: 如果只保护常用方法，而备用动词映射到相同处理器或泄露响应头，低权限用户可能获得受限能力。确认标准是核对有效处理器、响应字段和资源版本，证明低权限请求执行了受限操作；自动 Allow 头、空 HEAD 正文、通用 OPTIONS 或 TRACE 被边缘拒绝不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If only common methods are protected while alternate verbs reach the same handler or disclose headers, a low-privilege user may gain restricted capability. Confirmation requires Verify effective handler, response fields, and resource version to prove a restricted operation executed for the low-privilege request; Automatic Allow headers, empty HEAD bodies, generic OPTIONS, or TRACE blocked at the edge is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 以管理员和低权限账号分别访问标准管理路由，记录每个允许方法及预期结果；2. 按原始请求行逐个发送方法，使用无副作用测试资源并保持路径与身份一致；3. 核对有效处理器、响应字段和资源版本，证明低权限请求执行了受限操作。自动 Allow 头、空 HEAD 正文、通用 OPTIONS 或 TRACE 被边缘拒绝应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Access the canonical administrative route as administrator and low-privilege users and record allowed methods and expected outcomes. 2. Send methods from the original request lines one at a time against a harmless test resource while holding path and identity constant. 3. Verify effective handler, response fields, and resource version to prove a restricted operation executed for the low-privilege request. Treat Automatic Allow headers, empty HEAD bodies, generic OPTIONS, or TRACE blocked at the edge as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 为每个路由明确允许的方法并默认拒绝其他动词；2. 在业务处理器内部对所有方法执行相同主体授权；3. 关闭不需要的 TRACE、CONNECT 和 WebDAV 能力并持续测试方法矩阵。
mitigation.en: 1. Explicitly allow methods per route and deny all others by default. 2. Enforce principal authorization inside business handlers for every method. 3. Disable unnecessary TRACE, CONNECT, and Web DAV capabilities and continuously test the method matrix.

name.zh: 代理客户端 IP 头信任绕过

description.zh: 检查应用是否信任外部请求提供的 X-Forwarded-For 等头，从而误判为环回或内网客户端。
description.en: Checks whether an application trusts externally supplied forwarding headers and misclassifies the client as loopback or internal.

prerequisites.zh: 明确唯一可信代理的地址范围及其覆盖规则，准备外部客户端、内部合成客户端和只读 canary 端点。
prerequisites.en: Define the sole trusted proxy range and overwrite rules, with an external client, synthetic internal client, and read-only canary endpoint.

prerequisites.zh: 固定连接源、认证、路径与方法，只改变一个转发 Header/地址编码，并记录代理追加链与应用选取的 client IP。
prerequisites.en: Fix connection source, authentication, path, and method while changing one forwarding header or address encoding, recording the proxy-appended chain and application-selected client IP.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求外部连接仅凭客户端提供的 Header 被应用识别为环回/内网，并因此读取只允许内部主体的 canary，日志显示错误选取位置。Header 被记录、显示的 IP 改变但授权不变、可信代理正确覆盖、地址解析失败、WAF 打标或接口本就公开均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an external connection to be classified as loopback or internal solely from a client-supplied header and consequently read an internal-only canary, with logs showing the wrong selected position. A logged header, changed displayed IP without authorization impact, correct trusted-proxy overwrite, parse failure, WAF tagging, or an intentionally public endpoint is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个内部 canary 首次因伪造 client IP 返回后停止，不访问真实运维或网络管理端点。

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试主体和 canary，清理转发链 trace 与缓存，并恢复入口剥离、可信代理追加和严格 IP 解析。
opsecTips.en: Delete test principals and the canary, clear forwarding-chain traces and caches, and restore ingress stripping, trusted-proxy appending, and strict IP parsing.

title.zh: 建立转发 IP 头伪造基线
title.en: Establish the Forwarded Client-IP Spoofing baseline

description.zh: 记录不带转发头的外部低权限请求在管理接口上的真实客户端地址和拒绝结果，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record the actual client address and denial for an external low-privilege request without forwarding headers, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

description.en: Add original IP headers and values one at a time, covering duplicates, hop order, and alternate loopback forms, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验代理客户端 IP 头信任绕过证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Proxy Client-IP Header Trust Bypass

description.zh: 从边缘与应用日志确认解析出的客户端 IP，并验证权限或限流是否因此改变；同时排除日志字段变化但权限不变、代理统一覆盖或仅调试页面回显。
description.en: Confirm the parsed client IP in edge and application logs and verify whether authorization or throttling changes; also exclude Log-field changes without privilege changes, trusted-proxy overwrites, or debug-page reflection.

overview.zh: 原始集合覆盖多种转发 IP 头、环回编码和多跳列表，目标是识别受信代理边界和取值顺序。本条按HTTP 授权与路由边界审查；应在隔离资源上逐项执行，固定身份、路径、方法和除当前变量外的所有请求条件。
overview.en: The original set covers forwarding headers, loopback encodings, and multi-hop lists to identify trusted-proxy boundaries and selection order. This entry is reviewed as a HTTP authorization and routing boundary; Execute one item at a time against an isolated resource while fixing identity, path, method, and every request condition except the tested variable.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用直接读取攻击者提供的左侧或任意转发值用于授权、限流或审计，外部请求可冒充内部来源。确认标准是从边缘与应用日志确认解析出的客户端 IP，并验证权限或限流是否因此改变；日志字段变化但权限不变、代理统一覆盖或仅调试页面回显不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If an application directly uses attacker-supplied leftmost or arbitrary forwarding values for authorization, rate limits, or auditing, an external request can impersonate an internal source. Confirmation requires Confirm the parsed client IP in edge and application logs and verify whether authorization or throttling changes; Log-field changes without privilege changes, trusted-proxy overwrites, or debug-page reflection is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录不带转发头的外部低权限请求在管理接口上的真实客户端地址和拒绝结果；2. 逐项加入原始 IP 头和值，覆盖重复头、多跳顺序和不同环回表示；3. 从边缘与应用日志确认解析出的客户端 IP，并验证权限或限流是否因此改变。日志字段变化但权限不变、代理统一覆盖或仅调试页面回显应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record the actual client address and denial for an external low-privilege request without forwarding headers. 2. Add original IP headers and values one at a time, covering duplicates, hop order, and alternate loopback forms. 3. Confirm the parsed client IP in edge and application logs and verify whether authorization or throttling changes. Treat Log-field changes without privilege changes, trusted-proxy overwrites, or debug-page reflection as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在入口删除外部转发头并由受信代理重新生成；2. 配置明确的代理跳数与地址允许列表，解析最接近的可信链；3. 禁止基于客户端 IP 单独授予敏感权限，并记录原始与规范化地址。
mitigation.en: 1. Strip external forwarding headers at ingress and rebuild them at a trusted proxy. 2. Configure explicit trusted proxy hops and addresses and parse the nearest trusted chain. 3. Never grant sensitive privileges from client IP alone and log both raw and normalized addresses.

name.zh: Host 头内部虚拟主机绕过

description.zh: 通过内部与环回 Host 值检查反向代理是否把外部请求路由到未公开虚拟主机或管理应用。
description.en: Uses internal and loopback Host values to test whether a reverse proxy routes external requests to unpublished virtual hosts or administrative applications.

prerequisites.zh: 固定目标 IP、TLS SNI、路径和未授权主体，为公开与内部虚拟主机分别配置唯一无敏感 canary。
prerequisites.en: Fix target IP, TLS SNI, path, and unauthorized principal, configuring unique nonsensitive canaries for public and internal virtual hosts.

prerequisites.zh: 记录边缘允许的 authority、上游 Host、后端 vhost 与路由目标，每次只改变一个完整 Host 值。
prerequisites.en: Record ingress-allowed authority, upstream Host, backend virtual host, and route target, changing one complete Host value per request.

analysis.zh: 阳性是外部连接通过内部/环回 Host 被路由到未发布虚拟主机并返回其唯一 canary，代理与后端日志可关联。默认站点内容、Host 被响应回显、TLS 证书错误、400/421、DNS 解析、同一应用品牌页面、缓存旧响应或 SNI 已选择内部站点均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an external connection being routed by an internal or loopback Host to an unpublished virtual host and returning its unique canary, correlated in proxy and backend logs. Default-site content, reflected Host, TLS certificate errors, HTTP 400 or 421, DNS resolution, same-brand pages, stale cache, or SNI already selecting the internal site is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首次读取一个内部虚拟主机 canary 后停止，不枚举其路径、接口或真实服务名。
opsecTips.en: Stop after first reading one internal virtual-host canary; do not enumerate its paths, APIs, or real service names.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 vhost fixture，清理代理/CDN 缓存和请求 trace，并恢复 authority 白名单、SNI/Host 一致性及默认拒绝。
opsecTips.en: Delete virtual-host fixtures, clear proxy and CDN caches and request traces, and restore authority allowlisting, SNI and Host consistency, and default denial.

title.zh: 建立虚拟主机路由信任基线
title.en: Establish the Virtual-Host Routing Trust baseline

description.zh: 用合法外部 Host 和随机不存在 Host 记录默认站点、TLS SNI 与路由拒绝基线，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record default-site, TLS SNI, and routing-denial baselines using the legitimate external Host and a random nonexistent Host, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

description.en: Send original Host values one at a time while fixing target IP, scheme, path, and identity and recording backend service identity, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验Host 头内部虚拟主机绕过证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Host Header Internal Virtual-Host Bypass

description.zh: 确认请求到达未公开虚拟主机并返回该服务独有的受限内容或审计事件；同时排除默认站点、统一错误页、DNS 无关回显或仅证书名称不匹配。
description.en: Confirm that the request reaches an unpublished virtual host and returns service-specific restricted content or audit events; also exclude Default sites, generic error pages, DNS-independent reflection, or certificate-name mismatch alone.

overview.zh: 原始集合直接携带 Host 头和大量内部服务名称，重点是入口允许的 authority 与后端虚拟主机映射。本条按Host/authority 信任边界审查；应固定目标 IP、TLS SNI、身份与路径，逐项比较入口 authority、代理路由和后端虚拟主机。
overview.en: The original set supplies Host headers and many internal service names, focusing on permitted authorities at ingress and backend virtual-host mapping. This entry is reviewed as a Host and authority trust boundary; Fix target IP, TLS SNI, identity, and path and compare ingress authority, proxy routing, and backend virtual host one item at a time.

vulnerability.zh: 若共享入口接受任意 Host 并路由到内部 vhost，外部用户可能访问本应只在内网暴露的管理页面。确认标准是确认请求到达未公开虚拟主机并返回该服务独有的受限内容或审计事件；默认站点、统一错误页、DNS 无关回显或仅证书名称不匹配不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If a shared ingress accepts arbitrary Host values and routes to internal virtual hosts, an external user may reach administrative pages intended only for internal networks. Confirmation requires Confirm that the request reaches an unpublished virtual host and returns service-specific restricted content or audit events; Default sites, generic error pages, DNS-independent reflection, or certificate-name mismatch alone is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 用合法外部 Host 和随机不存在 Host 记录默认站点、TLS SNI 与路由拒绝基线；2. 逐项发送原始 Host 头值，固定目标 IP、协议、路径和身份并记录后端服务标识；3. 确认请求到达未公开虚拟主机并返回该服务独有的受限内容或审计事件。默认站点、统一错误页、DNS 无关回显或仅证书名称不匹配应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record default-site, TLS SNI, and routing-denial baselines using the legitimate external Host and a random nonexistent Host. 2. Send original Host values one at a time while fixing target IP, scheme, path, and identity and recording backend service identity. 3. Confirm that the request reaches an unpublished virtual host and returns service-specific restricted content or audit events. Treat Default sites, generic error pages, DNS-independent reflection, or certificate-name mismatch alone as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 入口严格允许已注册 Host/authority 并拒绝未知值；2. 内部管理虚拟主机使用独立监听地址、网络策略和认证；3. 让 TLS SNI、Host 与代理路由一致并测试默认虚拟主机行为。
mitigation.en: 1. Strictly allow registered Host or authority values at ingress and reject unknown values. 2. Place internal administrative virtual hosts on separate listeners with network policy and authentication. 3. Keep TLS SNI, Host, and proxy routing consistent and test default virtual-host behavior.

name.zh: X-Original-URL/X-Rewrite-URL 路由绕过

description.zh: 验证外部客户端是否能控制代理内部重写头，使后端处理与边缘授权检查不同的路径。
description.en: Tests whether external clients can control internal rewrite headers so the backend handles a path different from the one authorized at the edge.

prerequisites.zh: 建立公开路径与内部管理 canary 的代理/应用路由基线，确认 X-Original-URL 和 X-Rewrite-URL 只应由可信代理生成。
prerequisites.en: Establish proxy and application routing baselines for a public path and internal administration canary, confirming X-Original-URL and X-Rewrite-URL should be generated only by trusted proxies.

prerequisites.zh: 固定外层 URI、方法和无权限会话，分别发送单一重写头并记录边缘授权路径与后端有效路径。
prerequisites.en: Fix outer URI, method, and unauthorized session, sending one rewrite header at a time and recording edge-authorized path and backend-effective path.

title.zh: URL覆盖头
title.en: Validation step 1 for X-Original-URL and X-Rewrite-URL Routing Bypass

description.zh: URL覆盖头包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this X-Original-URL and X-Rewrite-URL Routing Bypass validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求外层公开路径通过客户端重写 Header 被后端改为受保护路径，且边缘授权未重检，最终返回内部 canary。Header 被保留/删除、后端路由到公开页、返回登录页、404、日志显示重写值但 handler 未改变或可信代理主动设置正确值都不是绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires a public outer path to become a protected backend path through a client rewrite header without edge reauthorization, returning the internal canary. A preserved or stripped header, routing to a public page, login response, HTTP 404, logged rewrite value without handler change, or a trusted proxy correctly setting the value is not bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个内部 canary 首次经外层公开路径返回后停止，不测试写方法或更多内部路由。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one internal canary is first returned through the public outer path; do not test write methods or additional internal routes.

opsecTips.zh: 删除路由 fixture 和会话，清除代理/应用 trace 与缓存，并恢复入口剥离内部重写头和最终路径授权。
opsecTips.en: Delete route fixtures and sessions, clear proxy and application traces and caches, and restore ingress stripping of internal rewrite headers and authorization on the final path.

title.zh: 建立内部重写头基线
title.en: Establish the Internal Rewrite Headers baseline

description.zh: 记录公开路径和标准管理路径的边缘路由、后端路径与低权限授权结果，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record edge route, backend path, and low-privilege authorization results for a public path and the canonical administrative path, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行内部重写头变体
title.en: Execute the Internal Rewrite Headers variants

description.zh: 逐项加入原始 URL 覆盖头，保持请求目标为公开路径并记录代理转发内容，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Add original URL override headers one at a time while keeping the request target public and recording proxy forwarding, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验X-Original-URL/X-Rewrite-URL 路由绕过证据
title.en: Verify evidence for X-Original-URL and X-Rewrite-URL Routing Bypass

description.zh: 通过后端路由日志和资源内容确认应用采用了头中的管理路径并绕过授权；同时排除头部回显、代理删除后返回相同页面或公开登录入口。
description.en: Confirm from backend route logs and resource content that the application adopted the administrative path from the header and bypassed authorization; also exclude Header reflection, identical responses after proxy stripping, or a public login entry point.

overview.zh: 原始集合针对 X-Original-URL 与 X-Rewrite-URL 的管理路径变体，关键是这些头应只由受信代理产生。本条按HTTP 授权与路由边界审查；应在隔离资源上逐项执行，固定身份、路径、方法和除当前变量外的所有请求条件。
overview.en: The original set targets administrative path variants in X-Original-URL and X-Rewrite-URL, which should be generated only by trusted proxies. This entry is reviewed as a HTTP authorization and routing boundary; Execute one item at a time against an isolated resource while fixing identity, path, method, and every request condition except the tested variable.

vulnerability.zh: 若边缘按公开路径授权而应用优先采用伪造重写头，攻击者可让请求落到受限处理器。确认标准是通过后端路由日志和资源内容确认应用采用了头中的管理路径并绕过授权；头部回显、代理删除后返回相同页面或公开登录入口不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If the edge authorizes a public path while the application prefers a forged rewrite header, an attacker may reach a restricted handler. Confirmation requires Confirm from backend route logs and resource content that the application adopted the administrative path from the header and bypassed authorization; Header reflection, identical responses after proxy stripping, or a public login entry point is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录公开路径和标准管理路径的边缘路由、后端路径与低权限授权结果；2. 逐项加入原始 URL 覆盖头，保持请求目标为公开路径并记录代理转发内容；3. 通过后端路由日志和资源内容确认应用采用了头中的管理路径并绕过授权。头部回显、代理删除后返回相同页面或公开登录入口应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record edge route, backend path, and low-privilege authorization results for a public path and the canonical administrative path. 2. Add original URL override headers one at a time while keeping the request target public and recording proxy forwarding. 3. Confirm from backend route logs and resource content that the application adopted the administrative path from the header and bypassed authorization. Treat Header reflection, identical responses after proxy stripping, or a public login entry point as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 入口删除所有客户端提供的内部重写头；2. 应用授权最终规范化路由，不信任外部覆盖值；3. 在代理与应用集成测试中覆盖重复头、大小写和路径编码。
mitigation.en: 1. Strip every client-supplied internal rewrite header at ingress. 2. Authorize the final normalized route and never trust external override values. 3. Cover duplicates, casing, and path encoding in proxy-to-application integration tests.

name.zh: CRLF 分隔符编码探测

description.zh: 使用不同大小写、双重编码和换行组合检查输入是否进入 HTTP 响应头并被解码为行分隔符。
description.en: Uses casing, double encoding, and newline combinations to test whether input reaches an HTTP response header and decodes into line separators.

prerequisites.zh: 定位一个会把受控输入写入响应 Header 值的测试 sink，并在代理与应用层记录解码次数和字符集。
prerequisites.en: Locate a test sink that writes controlled input into a response-header value, recording decode count and character set at proxy and application layers.

prerequisites.zh: 使用唯一 `X-Canary` 无害 Header，逐个测试大小写、单/双编码和换行组合，捕获原始响应字节。
prerequisites.en: Use a unique harmless X-Canary header and test case, single or double encoding, and newline combinations individually while capturing raw response bytes.

title.zh: 基础CRLF
title.en: Validation step 1 for CRLF Separator Encoding Probes

description.zh: 基础CRLF包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this CRLF Separator Encoding Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求某个分隔符变体被响应链解码成新的独立 Header 行，原始字节显示 CRLF 边界且客户端解析到 X-Canary。输入出现在请求/日志/正文、Header 值保留百分号文本、代理规范化为空格、浏览器开发者工具折叠显示或响应被拒绝都不构成响应分割。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires one separator variant to be decoded into a separate response-header line, with raw bytes showing the CRLF boundary and the client parsing X-Canary. Input in request, logs, or body, percent text retained in a header value, proxy normalization to spaces, folded developer-tool display, or rejected response is not response splitting.

opsecTips.zh: 一个 X-Canary Header 首次成功分行后停止，不注入 Cookie、Location、正文或缓存控制。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one X-Canary header is first split successfully; do not inject cookies, Location, body content, or cache control.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试输入和原始捕获，清除代理/浏览器缓存，并恢复 Header 编码、单次解码和 CR/LF 拒绝。
opsecTips.en: Delete test input and raw captures, clear proxy and browser caches, and restore header encoding, single decoding, and CR or LF rejection.

title.zh: 建立响应头分割基础输入基线
title.en: Establish the Response-Splitting Base Inputs baseline

description.zh: 确定一个会把测试值写入响应头的授权端点，并记录未编码随机标记的原始响应字节，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Identify an authorized endpoint that writes a test value into a response header and record raw response bytes for an unencoded random marker, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行响应头分割基础输入变体
title.en: Execute the Response-Splitting Base Inputs variants

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 CRLF 编码加上 X-Test-Marker 无害头名，避免注入 Cookie 或脚本，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Use original CRLF encodings one at a time with a harmless X-Test-Marker header name, avoiding cookies or scripts, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验CRLF 分隔符编码探测证据
title.en: Verify evidence for CRLF Separator Encoding Probes

description.zh: 在原始响应字节中确认出现独立的新响应头，并与应用日志中的输入关联；同时排除代理界面折行、浏览器规范化、正文回显或日志转义显示换行。
description.en: Confirm a distinct new response header in raw response bytes and correlate it with the input in application logs; also exclude Proxy UI wrapping, browser normalization, body reflection, or escaped newline display in logs.

overview.zh: 原始集合只包含换行编码与转义形式，必须嵌入明确的响应头接收点并配合无害标记验证。本条按响应头结构边界审查；应在能写入响应头的测试接收点逐项验证，并查看原始响应字节而不是浏览器格式化结果。
overview.en: The original set contains newline encodings and escapes that require a known response-header sink and a harmless marker. This entry is reviewed as a response-header structural boundary; Validate one item at a time at a test sink that writes response headers and inspect raw response bytes rather than browser-formatted output.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用在写入 Location、Set-Cookie 或自定义响应头前解码用户输入，攻击者可能注入新头或拆分响应。确认标准是在原始响应字节中确认出现独立的新响应头，并与应用日志中的输入关联；代理界面折行、浏览器规范化、正文回显或日志转义显示换行不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If an application decodes user input before writing Location, Set-Cookie, or custom response headers, an attacker may inject new headers or split the response. Confirmation requires Confirm a distinct new response header in raw response bytes and correlate it with the input in application logs; Proxy UI wrapping, browser normalization, body reflection, or escaped newline display in logs is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 确定一个会把测试值写入响应头的授权端点，并记录未编码随机标记的原始响应字节；2. 逐项使用原始 CRLF 编码加上 X-Test-Marker 无害头名，避免注入 Cookie 或脚本；3. 在原始响应字节中确认出现独立的新响应头，并与应用日志中的输入关联。代理界面折行、浏览器规范化、正文回显或日志转义显示换行应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Identify an authorized endpoint that writes a test value into a response header and record raw response bytes for an unencoded random marker. 2. Use original CRLF encodings one at a time with a harmless X-Test-Marker header name, avoiding cookies or scripts. 3. Confirm a distinct new response header in raw response bytes and correlate it with the input in application logs. Treat Proxy UI wrapping, browser normalization, body reflection, or escaped newline display in logs as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 禁止任何 CR、LF 和其编码形式进入响应头值；2. 使用框架结构化响应头 API 而不是字符串拼接；3. 在所有解码阶段后再次验证，并测试代理与应用的规范化顺序。
mitigation.en: 1. Reject CR, LF, and encoded equivalents from response-header values. 2. Use framework response-header APIs rather than string concatenation. 3. Revalidate after every decoding stage and test normalization order across proxies and applications.

name.zh: 通用响应 Set-Cookie CRLF 注入

description.zh: 验证可控响应头值是否允许换行后注入 Set-Cookie，并由真实浏览器接受测试 Cookie。
description.en: Tests whether a controllable response-header value permits newline injection of Set-Cookie and whether a real browser accepts a test cookie.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离浏览器 profile 和专用响应 Header sink，选择与任何认证 Cookie 不同的随机 canary 名和值。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated browser profile and dedicated response-header sink, selecting a random canary name and value distinct from every authentication cookie.

prerequisites.zh: 捕获代理/应用原始响应和浏览器 Cookie 存储，配对未编码、编码换行与无换行同值请求。
prerequisites.en: Capture raw proxy and application responses and browser cookie storage, pairing unencoded, encoded-newline, and no-newline requests with the same value.

title.zh: CRLF + Set-Cookie注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for Generic Response Set-Cookie CRLF Injection

description.zh: CRLF + Set-Cookie注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Generic Response Set-Cookie CRLF Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求注入值形成独立 Set-Cookie Header，并由真实浏览器按预期域/路径存储随机 canary，原始响应可证明其来源。语料中的 admin 文本、请求 Header、正文回显、浏览器拒绝非法 Cookie、服务端本来就设置同名 Cookie、仅代理日志出现或 Cookie 未持久化都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the injected value to form a separate Set-Cookie header and a real browser to store the random canary under the expected domain and path, with raw response proving its source. admin text in the corpus, a request header, body reflection, browser rejection, a cookie independently set by the server, proxy-log appearance only, or no persistence is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 随机非权限 canary Cookie 首次存储后停止，不使用 session、role 或真实认证 Cookie 名。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the random nonprivileged canary cookie is first stored; do not use session, role, or real authentication cookie names.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 canary Cookie、测试响应和浏览器 profile，清理缓存/trace，并恢复 Header 输出编码和 Cookie 属性策略。
opsecTips.en: Delete the canary cookie, test responses, and browser profile, clear caches and traces, and restore header output encoding and cookie-attribute policy.

title.zh: 建立Cookie 响应注入基线
title.en: Establish the Cookie Response Injection baseline

description.zh: 在隔离浏览器清空目标域 Cookie，并记录正常响应中不存在随机测试 Cookie，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Clear target-domain cookies in an isolated browser and record that a random test cookie is absent from the normal response, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行Cookie 响应注入变体
title.en: Execute the Cookie Response Injection variants

description.zh: 逐项应用原始 CRLF 结构，但把 Cookie 名值替换为随机、无权限且短期的测试项，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Apply original CRLF structures one at a time while replacing cookie names and values with random, nonprivileged, short-lived test values, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.
