Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: WebSocket 驱动的服务端请求伪造
name.en: Web Socket 驱动的服务端请求伪造

description.zh: 通过 request/fetch/proxy/url/uri/endpoint 等消息字段请求回环、元数据、file 与 gopher 目标，验证 WebSocket 后端是否代发网络或文件请求。
description.en: Uses request, fetch, proxy, url, uri, and endpoint fields for loopback, metadata, file, and gopher targets to test whether a Web Socket backend performs network or file requests.

subCategory.en: Web Socket 服务端请求调度

prerequisites.zh: 已确认某个消息动作会在服务器侧获取 URL，并能区分浏览器自身请求、后端 HTTP 客户端与命令字段执行。
prerequisites.en: 已确认某个消息动作会在服务器侧获取 URL，并能区分浏览器自身请求、后端 HTTP 客户端与命令字段执行。

prerequisites.zh: 部署受控外部与回环标记服务；file、gopher 与云元数据原始目标均替换为无敏感测试资源。
prerequisites.en: Deploy controlled external and loopback marker services and replace source file, gopher, and cloud-metadata targets with nonsensitive test resources.

title.zh: WS SSRF (通过WS代理请求内部服务)
title.en: WS SSRF (通过WS代理请求内部服务)

description.zh: WS SSRF (通过WS代理请求内部服务)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: WS SSRF (通过WS代理请求内部服务)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。

analysis.zh: 0-23 与 28-35 行是不同字段的 URL/scheme SSRF 候选；24-27 的 command= curl/wget 只有在服务器执行完整命令时才是命令执行路径，不能仅凭字符串报告 RCE 或 SSRF。成功必须是服务端实际出站到受控目标，file/gopher/元数据行不能作为初始证明。
analysis.en: Lines 0-23 and 28-35 are URL or scheme SSRF candidates across fields. Command lines 24-27 become command-execution paths only if the server runs the complete curl or wget command; the string alone proves neither RCE nor SSRF. Success requires actual server egress to a controlled target, and file, gopher, or metadata lines are not initial proof.

opsecTips.zh: 首次收到后端回环标记请求后停止，不访问云凭据、真实内部端口、系统文件或 Redis 命令。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first backend request reaches the loopback marker and do not access cloud credentials, real internal ports, system files, or Redis commands.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭标记服务与 WebSocket，清除 DNS/HTTP 缓存和重试队列，删除消息及出站日志中的内部 URL。
opsecTips.en: Close marker services and the Web Socket, clear DNS and HTTP caches and retry queues, and remove internal UR Ls from messages and egress logs.

title.zh: 确认WebSocket 服务端请求调度前置条件
title.en: 确认Web Socket 服务端请求调度前置条件

description.zh: 36 行覆盖多个业务字段和 scheme；核心分类是服务器代发请求，但 command 字段若被 Shell 执行需另按 RCE 证据判断。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: 36 行覆盖多个业务字段和 scheme；核心分类是服务器代发请求，但 command 字段若被 Shell 执行需另按 RCE 证据判断。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。

title.zh: 执行受控WebSocket 服务端请求调度对照
title.en: 执行受控Web Socket 服务端请求调度对照

description.zh: 先用外部标记确认后端请求，再选一个回环标记 URL；逐字段测试且不触碰元数据、真实文件或 Redis。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Confirm backend fetching with an external marker, then select one loopback marker URL, testing one field at a time without touching metadata, real files, or Redis. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

title.zh: 核对WebSocket 服务端请求调度阳性边界
title.en: 核对Web Socket 服务端请求调度阳性边界

description.zh: 阳性要求后端客户端/出站代理和目标服务记录同一令牌；WebSocket ACK、浏览器请求、连接超时或 command 字符串被存储都不够。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Positive evidence requires the backend client or egress proxy and target service to record the same token; a Web Socket acknowledgment, browser request, timeout, or stored command string is insufficient. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归WebSocket 服务端请求调度
title.en: 修复并回归Web Socket 服务端请求调度

description.zh: 对动作和字段做 schema 允许列表，仅允许 HTTPS 目标；解析后阻断内网/回环/链路本地，禁用 file/gopher，并在重定向后重检。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Allowlist actions and fields and permit only HTTPS destinations; block internal, loopback, and link-local addresses after resolution, disable file and gopher, and revalidate redirects. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: WebSocket 驱动的服务端请求伪造聚焦36 行覆盖多个业务字段和 scheme；核心分类是服务器代发请求，但 command 字段若被 Shell 执行需另按 RCE 证据判断。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Web Socket 驱动的服务端请求伪造聚焦36 行覆盖多个业务字段和 scheme；核心分类是服务器代发请求，但 command 字段若被 Shell 执行需另按 RCE 证据判断。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。

vulnerability.zh: WebSocket 消息中的 URL/目标未经过协议、解析后地址和重定向校验，worker 以服务器网络身份访问内部资源。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: URL or target fields in Web Socket messages lack protocol, post-resolution address, and redirect validation, allowing a worker to access internal resources with server network identity. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 先用外部标记确认后端请求，再选一个回环标记 URL；逐字段测试且不触碰元数据、真实文件或 Redis。 阳性要求后端客户端/出站代理和目标服务记录同一令牌；WebSocket ACK、浏览器请求、连接超时或 command 字符串被存储都不够。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Confirm backend fetching with an external marker, then select one loopback marker URL, testing one field at a time without touching metadata, real files, or Redis. Positive evidence requires the backend client or egress proxy and target service to record the same token; a Web Socket acknowledgment, browser request, timeout, or stored command string is insufficient. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 对动作和字段做 schema 允许列表，仅允许 HTTPS 目标；解析后阻断内网/回环/链路本地，禁用 file/gopher，并在重定向后重检。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Allowlist actions and fields and permit only HTTPS destinations; block internal, loopback, and link-local addresses after resolution, disable file and gopher, and revalidate redirects. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: WebSocket 消息级认证与授权绕过
name.en: Web Socket Message-Level Authentication and Authorization Bypass

description.zh: 测试空值、类型混淆、弱凭据和会话字段是否被 WebSocket 消息处理器错误接受，并验证连接后每条消息的主体授权。
description.en: Tests whether empty values, type confusion, weak credentials, and session fields are incorrectly accepted by a Web Socket message handler and whether each message is authorized after connection.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个权限不同的自有测试账号，记录握手认证、消息级 auth/login 状态机和服务端最终主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two owned test accounts with different privileges and record handshake authentication, message-level auth or login state, and the final server principal.

prerequisites.zh: 所有 token/session/cookie 样例替换为测试凭据；禁止使用 `STOLEN_SESSION` 或默认管理员真实口令。
prerequisites.en: Replace all token, session, and cookie samples with test credentials and never use `STOLEN_SESSION` or real default administrator passwords.

title.zh: WS认证绕过
title.en: Validation step 1 for Web Socket Message-Level Authentication and Authorization Bypass

description.zh: WS认证绕过包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Web Socket Message-Level Authentication and Authorization Bypass validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 空字符串、null、`"null"`、0、-1 与 method=none 只用于检测类型/状态机错误；admin/admin 等弱凭据成功是凭据策略问题，不自动等于认证绕过。会话字段必须仅用自有测试会话。只有最终主体或对象权限越界才是阳性。
analysis.en: Empty string, null, `"null"`, zero, minus one, and method=none probe type and state-machine flaws. Success with admin/admin is a credential-policy issue and not automatically an auth bypass. Session fields must use owned test sessions. Only an incorrect final principal or object-authorization boundary is positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首次证明测试低权限账号获得一项越权读取后停止，不修改对象、发送管理消息或尝试真实会话 ID。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the test low-privilege account gains one unauthorized read and do not modify objects, send administrative messages, or try real session IDs.

opsecTips.zh: 注销并撤销所有测试 token/session，关闭套接字，删除 auth 消息日志中的凭据并恢复测试账号权限。
opsecTips.en: Log out and revoke all test tokens and sessions, close sockets, remove credentials from auth-message logs, and restore test-account permissions.

title.zh: 确认WebSocket 消息认证前置条件
title.en: Confirm Web Socket Message Authentication prerequisites

description.zh: 22 行覆盖 token 类型、method、用户名/口令和会话字段，目标是认证状态机与消息授权，不是 XSS。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The 22 lines cover token types, methods, username or password, and session fields and target authentication state and message authorization rather than XSS. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控WebSocket 消息认证对照
title.en: Run a controlled Web Socket Message Authentication comparison

description.zh: 先建立未认证、低权限和高权限基线，再一次测试一种类型/方法变体并读取服务器端主体，最后尝试一项无副作用授权查询。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: 先建立未认证、低权限和高权限基线，再一次测试一种类型/方法变体并读取服务器端主体，最后尝试一项无副作用授权查询。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。

title.zh: 核对WebSocket 消息认证阳性边界
title.en: Verify Web Socket Message Authentication positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性要求无效/低权限输入被绑定为更高权限主体并获得对象访问；auth ACK、连接保持、通用欢迎消息或错误文本变化都不够。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Positive evidence requires invalid or low-privilege input to bind as a more privileged principal and gain object access; an auth acknowledgment, open connection, generic welcome, or changed error text is insufficient. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归WebSocket 消息认证
title.en: Remediate and regress Web Socket Message Authentication

description.zh: 对 schema 和类型严格验证，使用成熟认证流程，轮换会话，并在每条消息按主体、对象和动作执行服务端授权。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: 对 schema 和类型严格验证，使用成熟认证流程，轮换会话，并在每条消息按主体、对象和动作执行服务端授权。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。

overview.zh: WebSocket 消息级认证与授权绕过聚焦22 行覆盖 token 类型、method、用户名/口令和会话字段，目标是认证状态机与消息授权，不是 XSS。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Web Socket Message-Level Authentication and Authorization Bypass focuses on this boundary: The 22 lines cover token types, methods, username or password, and session fields and target authentication state and message authorization rather than XSS. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 处理器对空值/字符串 null/弱凭据做宽松真值转换，或连接建立后未将每条消息重新绑定到已认证主体。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: The handler loosely coerces empty values or string null and weak credentials, or fails to bind every post-connection message to the authenticated principal. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 先建立未认证、低权限和高权限基线，再一次测试一种类型/方法变体并读取服务器端主体，最后尝试一项无副作用授权查询。 阳性要求无效/低权限输入被绑定为更高权限主体并获得对象访问；auth ACK、连接保持、通用欢迎消息或错误文本变化都不够。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: 先建立未认证、低权限和高权限基线，再一次测试一种类型/方法变体并读取服务器端主体，最后尝试一项无副作用授权查询。 阳性要求无效/低权限输入被绑定为更高权限主体并获得对象访问；auth ACK、连接保持、通用欢迎消息或错误文本变化都不够。 关联浏览器 Dev Tools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。

mitigation.zh: 对 schema 和类型严格验证，使用成熟认证流程，轮换会话，并在每条消息按主体、对象和动作执行服务端授权。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: 对 schema 和类型严格验证，使用成熟认证流程，轮换会话，并在每条消息按主体、对象和动作执行服务端授权。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/Web Socket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。

name.zh: WebSocket 消息与 HTTP 边界走私探针
name.en: Web Socket Message and HTTP Boundary-Smuggling Probes

description.zh: 比较同一 WebSocket 帧内连续 JSON 文档与嵌入 HTTP 请求文本，验证网关、消息解析器和后端是否产生边界分歧。
description.en: Compares concatenated JSON documents in one Web Socket frame with embedded HTTP request text to test boundary disagreements among gateways, message parsers, and backends.

subCategory.en: Web Socket and HTTP Message Boundaries

prerequisites.zh: 能够抓取 WebSocket 帧边界、应用 JSON 解析事件与任何 HTTP 网关/后端连接，确认消息是否跨协议转发。
prerequisites.en: 能够抓取 Web Socket 帧边界、应用 JSON 解析事件与任何 HTTP 网关/后端连接，确认消息是否跨协议转发。

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离 `/admin` 测试路由和无副作用操作，后端日志可区分一个帧、两个 JSON 值与一个合法 HTTP 请求。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated `/admin` test route with a side-effect-free action, and backend logs that distinguish one frame, two JSON values, and one valid HTTP request.

title.zh: WS消息走私
title.en: Validation step 1 for Web Socket Message and HTTP Boundary-Smuggling Probes

execution.command:
{"type":"message","content":"msg1"}{"type":"message","content":"msg2"}
POST /admin/preview HTTP/1.1
Host: target.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Length: 13

action=status
GET /admin/preview HTTP/1.1
Host: target.com
Cookie: session=TEST_SESSION

description.zh: WS消息走私包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Web Socket Message and HTTP Boundary-Smuggling Probes validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 只有第 0 行可直接作为 JSON 消息边界探针。第 1、2 行把请求行、Host 与正文粘在一起，缺少 `\r\n` 和头部终止空行，不能产生合规 HTTP 请求；其错误/拒绝是预期负对照。修正建议仅写在 review，源 execution 必须零漂移。
analysis.en: Only line 0 is directly usable as a JSON message-boundary probe. Lines 1 and 2 concatenate the request line, Host, and body without `\r\n` or the terminating empty line, so they cannot form compliant HTTP requests; rejection is the expected negative control. Corrections belong only in review while source execution remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认受控第二 JSON 值被错误解析后停止，不向真实管理路由发送删除动作，也不跨租户连接。
opsecTips.en: Stop after a controlled second JSON value is misparsed and do not send delete actions to real administration routes or cross tenant connections.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭测试 WebSocket/后端连接，删除隔离路由记录，清空代理缓冲与连接池，并确认无半开 HTTP 请求残留。
opsecTips.en: Close test Web Socket and backend connections, delete isolated-route records, drain proxy buffers and pools, and verify no half-open HTTP request remains.

title.zh: 确认WebSocket/HTTP 消息边界前置条件
title.en: Confirm Web Socket and HTTP Message Boundaries prerequisites

description.zh: 第 0 行是同帧连续 JSON 边界测试；第 1-2 行意图表示 HTTP 请求，但缺少必需 CRLF/空行，源文本本身不是合法 HTTP/1.1。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: Line 0 tests concatenated JSON values in one frame; lines 1-2 intend HTTP requests but lack required CRLF separators and the empty line, so the source text is not valid HTTP/1.1. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控WebSocket/HTTP 消息边界对照
title.en: Run a controlled Web Socket and HTTP Message Boundaries comparison

description.zh: 先测试一个合法 JSON 与两个独立帧，再发送第 0 行同帧拼接；HTTP 分支仅使用 review 建议的 CRLF 修正版做隔离协议测试。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Test one valid JSON value and two separate frames before sending line 0 concatenated in one frame; use only the CRLF-corrected review suggestion for isolated HTTP protocol testing. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

attackChain.payload:
{"type":"message","content":"msg1"}{"type":"message","content":"msg2"}
POST /admin/preview HTTP/1.1
Host: target.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Length: 13

action=status
GET /admin/preview HTTP/1.1
Host: target.com
Cookie: session=TEST_SESSION

title.zh: 核对WebSocket/HTTP 消息边界阳性边界
title.en: Verify Web Socket and HTTP Message Boundaries positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性要求两个组件产生可证明的边界分歧并使受控第二消息到达错误上下文；JSON 解析错误、断连、400 或原缺 CRLF 文本不算走私。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Positive evidence requires demonstrable boundary disagreement between components that delivers a controlled second message into the wrong context; JSON parse errors, disconnects, 400 responses, or the source text without CRLF are not smuggling. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归WebSocket/HTTP 消息边界
title.en: Remediate and regress Web Socket and HTTP Message Boundaries

description.zh: 严格按 RFC 6455 帧与应用消息 schema 解析，每帧只接受一个 JSON 值；禁止将消息文本重新解释为原始 HTTP，并统一代理/后端边界。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Parse RFC 6455 frames and the application schema strictly, accept one JSON value per message, never reinterpret message text as raw HTTP, and align proxy and backend boundaries. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: WebSocket 消息与 HTTP 边界走私探针聚焦第 0 行是同帧连续 JSON 边界测试；第 1-2 行意图表示 HTTP 请求，但缺少必需 CRLF/空行，源文本本身不是合法 HTTP/1.1。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Web Socket Message and HTTP Boundary-Smuggling Probes focuses on this boundary: Line 0 tests concatenated JSON values in one frame; lines 1-2 intend HTTP requests but lack required CRLF separators and the empty line, so the source text is not valid HTTP/1.1. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 如果前端按帧、应用按流或代理把 WebSocket 数据重解释为 HTTP，不同组件可能对消息起止位置达成不同结论。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: If a frontend treats frames, an application treats a stream, or a proxy reinterprets Web Socket data as HTTP, components may disagree about message start and end. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 先测试一个合法 JSON 与两个独立帧，再发送第 0 行同帧拼接；HTTP 分支仅使用 review 建议的 CRLF 修正版做隔离协议测试。 阳性要求两个组件产生可证明的边界分歧并使受控第二消息到达错误上下文；JSON 解析错误、断连、400 或原缺 CRLF 文本不算走私。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Test one valid JSON value and two separate frames before sending line 0 concatenated in one frame; use only the CRLF-corrected review suggestion for isolated HTTP protocol testing. Positive evidence requires demonstrable boundary disagreement between components that delivers a controlled second message into the wrong context; JSON parse errors, disconnects, 400 responses, or the source text without CRLF are not smuggling. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 严格按 RFC 6455 帧与应用消息 schema 解析，每帧只接受一个 JSON 值；禁止将消息文本重新解释为原始 HTTP，并统一代理/后端边界。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Parse RFC 6455 frames and the application schema strictly, accept one JSON value per message, never reinterpret message text as raw HTTP, and align proxy and backend boundaries. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: 跨源 opener 导航能力对照

description.zh: 比较对 opener.location 的赋值、href/replace/assign 调用、跨源 document 访问及 data/javascript URL，验证同源策略允许和阻止的能力。
description.en: Compares assignment to opener.location, href, replace, assign, cross-origin document access, and data or javascript URLs to test capabilities allowed and blocked by same-origin policy.

prerequisites.zh: 通过显式 rel=opener 或无 noopener 的脚本 window.open 建立受控 opener，并确认 COOP 未将浏览上下文组分离。
prerequisites.en: Establish a controlled opener through explicit rel=opener or script window.open without noopener and confirm COOP does not separate the browsing context group.

prerequisites.zh: opener 与新页使用不同受控源，导航只指向无害标记页，并捕获 SecurityError、控制台与导航日志。
prerequisites.en: Use different controlled origins for opener and child, navigate only to a harmless marker page, and capture Security Error, console, and navigation logs.

title.zh: window.opener.location 重定?
title.en: Validation step 1 for Cross-Origin Opener Navigation Capability Controls

execution.command:
window.opener.location = "https://phishing.com" window.opener.location.href = "https://phishing.com" window.opener.location.replace("https://phishing.com") window.opener.location.assign("https://phishing.com") window.opener.document.location = "https://phishing.com" window.opener.document.location.href = "https://phishing.com" window.opener.location = "https://phishing.com/login" window.opener.location = "data:text/html,

Please login again

" window.opener.location = "javascript:document.write('

Please login again

')"

description.zh: window.opener.location 重定?包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Cross-Origin Opener Navigation Capability Controls validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 跨源情况下，`window.opener.location =`、`.href =` 与规范暴露的 `replace()` 可作为受控导航候选；`assign()` 并非跨源暴露方法，`window.opener.document.*` 会受 SOP 阻止。data 与 javascript 顶级导航在现代浏览器受到额外限制，不能从字符串存在推断执行。所有测试还要求 opener 非空。
analysis.en: Cross-origin assignment to `window.opener.location`, `.href`, and the exposed `replace()` method are controlled-navigation candidates. `assign()` is not a cross-origin exposed method, and `window.opener.document.*` is blocked by SOP. Top-level data and javascript navigation face additional modern restrictions and cannot be inferred from string presence. Every case also requires a non-null opener.

opsecTips.zh: 原窗口首次导航到本地标记页后停止，不使用钓鱼表单、data 页面、javascript 写入或真实账号会话。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the original window first navigates to a local marker page; do not use phishing forms, data pages, javascript writes, or real account sessions.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭父子窗口，清理历史记录、站点数据和导航日志，恢复 noopener/COOP 并删除临时标记页。
opsecTips.en: Close parent and child windows, clear history, site data, and navigation logs, restore noopener and COOP, and delete the temporary marker page.

title.zh: 确认opener 跨源导航前置条件

description.zh: 前四类语句测试跨源 Location 能力，document.location 需跨过 SOP，data/javascript 还受现代导航安全限制；不是 XSS。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The first forms test cross-origin Location capabilities, document.location crosses SOP, and data or javascript schemes face modern navigation restrictions; this is not XSS. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控opener 跨源导航对照
title.en: Run a controlled Cross-Origin Opener Navigation comparison

description.zh: 先确认 opener 非空，再逐行记录受控导航或 SecurityError；location 赋值/href/replace 与 assign/document/data/javascript 分开判断。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Confirm a non-null opener, then record controlled navigation or Security Error per line, evaluating assignment, href, and replace separately from assign, document, data, and javascript cases. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

attackChain.payload:
window.opener.location = "https://phishing.com" window.opener.location.href = "https://phishing.com" window.opener.location.replace("https://phishing.com") window.opener.location.assign("https://phishing.com") window.opener.document.location = "https://phishing.com" window.opener.document.location.href = "https://phishing.com" window.opener.location = "https://phishing.com/login" window.opener.location = "data:text/html,

Please login again

" window.opener.location = "javascript:document.write('

Please login again

')"

title.zh: 核对opener 跨源导航阳性边界
title.en: Verify Cross-Origin Opener Navigation positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性 Tabnabbing 是子页使 opener 导航到受控标记 URL；能读取 document、执行 javascript 或 data 页面必须有独立证据，异常或静默失败不算。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Positive tabnabbing is the child navigating the opener to a controlled marker URL; document reads, javascript execution, or data-page navigation require independent evidence, and exceptions or silent failure are not positive. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归opener 跨源导航
title.en: Remediate and regress Cross-Origin Opener Navigation

description.zh: 默认切断 opener，使用 noopener/noreferrer 与 COOP；必须通信时仅对受信源使用 postMessage 并严格校验 origin。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Sever opener by default with noopener, noreferrer, and COOP; when communication is required, use post Message only with trusted origins and strict origin validation. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: 跨源 opener 导航能力对照聚焦前四类语句测试跨源 Location 能力，document.location 需跨过 SOP，data/javascript 还受现代导航安全限制；不是 XSS。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Cross-Origin Opener Navigation Capability Controls focuses on this boundary: The first forms test cross-origin Location capabilities, document.location crosses SOP, and data or javascript schemes face modern navigation restrictions; this is not XSS. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 新页保留 opener 时可在有限跨源 WindowProxy/Location 能力内导航原页，但不能读取或任意操作跨源 document。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: When a child retains opener, it can navigate the original page through limited cross-origin Window Proxy or Location capabilities but cannot read or arbitrarily manipulate the cross-origin document. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 先确认 opener 非空，再逐行记录受控导航或 SecurityError；location 赋值/href/replace 与 assign/document/data/javascript 分开判断。 阳性 Tabnabbing 是子页使 opener 导航到受控标记 URL；能读取 document、执行 javascript 或 data 页面必须有独立证据，异常或静默失败不算。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Confirm a non-null opener, then record controlled navigation or Security Error per line, evaluating assignment, href, and replace separately from assign, document, data, and javascript cases. Positive tabnabbing is the child navigating the opener to a controlled marker URL; document reads, javascript execution, or data-page navigation require independent evidence, and exceptions or silent failure are not positive. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 默认切断 opener，使用 noopener/noreferrer 与 COOP；必须通信时仅对受信源使用 postMessage 并严格校验 origin。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Sever opener by default with noopener, noreferrer, and COOP; when communication is required, use post Message only with trusted origins and strict origin validation. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: 反向 Tabnabbing opener 正负对照
name.en: Reverse-Tabnabbing Opener Positive and Negative Controls

description.zh: 比较 rel=opener、冲突 rel 关键字与 window.open feature，验证新页面是否真实持有 opener 并可受控导航原窗口。
description.en: 比较 rel=opener、冲突 rel 关键字与 window.open feature，验证新页面是否真实持有 opener 并可受控导航原窗口。

subCategory.zh: 反向 Tabnabbing opener 控制

prerequisites.zh: 父页、子页和无害导航目标均由授权测试域控制，记录浏览器版本、COOP 与 window.open 返回值。
prerequisites.en: Parent, child, and harmless navigation destination are controlled, with browser version, COOP, and window.open return values recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 子页只检查 opener 是否为空并导航到固定标记页，不显示认证界面或收集用户输入。
prerequisites.en: The child only checks whether opener is null and navigates to a fixed marker page, without authentication UI or user-input collection.

title.zh: 反向tabnabbing payload
title.en: Validation step 1 for Reverse-Tabnabbing Opener Positive and Negative Controls

execution.command: Click here Click here Click here Click here Click here window.open("https://evil.com/tabnabbing", "_blank") window.open("https://evil.com/tabnabbing", "_blank", "noopener") window.open("https://evil.com/tabnabbing", "_blank", "noreferrer") window.open("https://evil.com/tabnabbing", "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")

description.zh: 反向tabnabbing payload包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this Reverse-Tabnabbing Opener Positive and Negative Controls validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 行 0 的 rel=opener 与行 3/5 的无 noopener window.open 是阳性候选；行 1 中 noopener 应压过 opener，行 2 的 noreferrer 蕴含 noopener，行 6-8 明确切断 opener。行 4 从父页执行 `w.opener.location`，实际导航的是父页自身引用，不证明恶意子页控制 opener，应作为逻辑负对照。
analysis.en: Line 0 with rel=opener and lines 3 or 5 using window.open without noopener are positive candidates. Noopener should dominate opener on line 1, noreferrer implies noopener on line 2, and lines 6-8 explicitly sever opener. Line 4 runs `w.opener.location` from the parent and navigates the parent's own reference; it does not prove control by a malicious child and is a logical negative control.

opsecTips.zh: 子页首次把父页导航到本地标记后停止，不生成钓鱼内容、不收集凭据，也不测试真实外部站点。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the child first navigates the parent to a local marker; do not generate phishing content, collect credentials, or test real external sites.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭所有弹窗/标签，清除历史与站点数据，恢复 COOP/链接属性并删除父子测试页及日志。
opsecTips.en: Close all popups and tabs, clear history and site data, restore COOP and link attributes, and delete parent and child test pages and logs.

title.zh: 确认反向 Tabnabbing opener 控制前置条件

description.zh: 九行混合真正的 opener opt-in、noopener/noreferrer 负对照、脚本 window.open 与一条逻辑错误的自我导航示例。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The nine lines mix genuine opener opt-in, noopener or noreferrer negative controls, script window.open, and one logically flawed self-navigation example. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控反向 Tabnabbing opener 控制对照
title.en: Run a controlled Reverse-Tabnabbing Opener Controls comparison

description.zh: 逐行打开受控子页，由子页报告 opener 状态并尝试一次标记导航；分别记录链接 rel 与 window.open feature 的结果。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Open the controlled child per line, have the child report opener state and attempt one marker navigation, and record results for link rel and window.open features separately. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

attackChain.payload: Click here Click here Click here Click here Click here window.open("https://evil.com/tabnabbing", "_blank") window.open("https://evil.com/tabnabbing", "_blank", "noopener") window.open("https://evil.com/tabnabbing", "_blank", "noreferrer") window.open("https://evil.com/tabnabbing", "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")

title.zh: 核对反向 Tabnabbing opener 控制阳性边界
title.en: Verify Reverse-Tabnabbing Opener Controls positive boundaries

description.zh: 阳性必须由子页代码控制父页导航；父页自身 onclick 导航、仅返回 WindowProxy、新标签打开或目标页加载都不是攻击证据。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Positive evidence requires child code to control parent navigation; navigation by the parent's own onclick, a returned Window Proxy, a new tab, or destination loading is not attack evidence. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归反向 Tabnabbing opener 控制
title.en: Remediate and regress Reverse-Tabnabbing Opener Controls

description.zh: 对不受信目标使用 noopener/noreferrer 和 COOP，不混用 opener 与隔离关键字；需要通信时用受限 postMessage。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Use noopener, noreferrer, and COOP for untrusted destinations, do not mix opener with isolation keywords, and use constrained post Message when communication is required. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

overview.zh: 反向 Tabnabbing opener 正负对照聚焦九行混合真正的 opener opt-in、noopener/noreferrer 负对照、脚本 window.open 与一条逻辑错误的自我导航示例。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Reverse-Tabnabbing Opener Positive and Negative Controls focuses on this boundary: The nine lines mix genuine opener opt-in, noopener or noreferrer negative controls, script window.open, and one logically flawed self-navigation example. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 只有子页获得 opener 引用且浏览上下文策略允许导航时，反向 Tabnabbing 才成立；冲突关键字与 COOP 可切断引用。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: Reverse tabnabbing exists only when the child receives an opener reference and browsing-context policy permits navigation; conflicting link types and COOP can sever it. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 逐行打开受控子页，由子页报告 opener 状态并尝试一次标记导航；分别记录链接 rel 与 window.open feature 的结果。 阳性必须由子页代码控制父页导航；父页自身 onclick 导航、仅返回 WindowProxy、新标签打开或目标页加载都不是攻击证据。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Open the controlled child per line, have the child report opener state and attempt one marker navigation, and record results for link rel and window.open features separately. Positive evidence requires child code to control parent navigation; navigation by the parent's own onclick, a returned Window Proxy, a new tab, or destination loading is not attack evidence. Correlate browser Dev Tools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 对不受信目标使用 noopener/noreferrer 和 COOP，不混用 opener 与隔离关键字；需要通信时用受限 postMessage。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Use noopener, noreferrer, and COOP for untrusted destinations, do not mix opener with isolation keywords, and use constrained post Message when communication is required. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or Web Socket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

name.zh: GraphQL 内联片段字段授权验证

description.zh: 验证接口在使用内联片段切换具体对象类型时，是否仍对 Admin、Root、Internal 等类型上的敏感字段执行一致的运行时授权。
description.en: Validate whether the API consistently enforces runtime authorization for sensitive fields on Admin, Root, Internal, and related concrete types selected through inline fragments.

prerequisites.zh: 已获得低权限测试账户，并知道至少一个正常可查询的接口或联合类型。
prerequisites.en: A low-privilege test account and at least one normally queryable interface or union type are available.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录不使用内联片段时的字段可见性、错误结构和解析器日志。
prerequisites.en: Field visibility, error structure, and resolver logs without inline fragments have been recorded.

title.zh: 内联片段绕过授权
title.en: Validation step 1 for GraphQL Inline-Fragment Field Authorization Validation

description.zh: 内联片段绕过授权包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this GraphQL Inline-Fragment Field Authorization Validation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 只有同一低权限主体通过片段路径获得直接路径不可见的真实敏感值，才说明授权不一致；类型名可见、字段为 null 或验证阶段拒绝均不是漏洞。
analysis.en: 只有同一低权限主体通过片段路径获得直接路径不可见的真实敏感值，才说明授权不一致；类型名可见、字段为 null 或验证阶段拒绝均不是漏洞。

opsecTips.zh: 一次只选择一个敏感字段，避免宽查询触发不必要的数据读取。
opsecTips.en: Select one sensitive field at a time to avoid unnecessary broad data access.

opsecTips.zh: 使用测试租户和虚构字段值保存证据，不导出真实密钥或个人信息。
opsecTips.en: Use a test tenant and synthetic field values for evidence; do not export real secrets or personal data.

title.zh: 记录直接字段访问基线

description.zh: 以低权限账户查询公开字段，记录类型名、字段错误和实际调用的解析器。
description.en: Query public fields as a low-privilege user and record type names, field errors, and invoked resolvers.

title.zh: 逐个加入具体类型片段

description.zh: 重放原始内联片段集合，每次只选择一个具体类型和一个敏感字段。
description.en: Replay the original inline-fragment set while selecting only one concrete type and one sensitive field per request.

title.zh: 比较角色与查询路径

description.zh: 用高低权限账户比较直接、Node、搜索和 me 路径，确认差异来自授权而非类型解析。
description.en: Compare direct, Node, search, and me paths across high- and low-privilege accounts to isolate authorization from type resolution.

title.zh: 统一策略并执行 schema 回归
title.en: Unify policy and run schema regression

description.zh: 复用字段授权策略后枚举所有可达路径，确认敏感字段始终拒绝未授权主体。
description.en: After reusing the field policy, enumerate every reachable path and confirm sensitive fields consistently reject unauthorized principals.

overview.zh: 内联片段是 GraphQL 的正常类型选择语法，本身不是绕过手段。本条用同一主体比较直接字段、接口字段和具体类型片段，判断授权是否错误地只绑定在某一查询路径，而敏感类型解析器没有执行同等检查。
overview.en: 内联片段是 GraphQL 的正常类型选择语法，本身不是绕过手段。本条用同一主体比较直接字段、接口字段和具体类型片段，判断授权是否错误地只绑定在某一查询路径，而敏感类型解析器没有执行同等检查。

vulnerability.zh: 问题发生在应用把 schema 可达性或父字段检查误当作最终授权，导致具体类型解析器、Node 接口或搜索结果中的敏感字段没有再次校验主体、租户和字段权限。仅关闭 introspection 不能修复解析器授权缺口。
vulnerability.en: The issue occurs when schema reachability or a parent-field check is mistaken for final authorization, leaving sensitive concrete-type, Node-interface, or search-result fields without principal, tenant, and field checks. Disabling introspection does not repair resolver authorization gaps.

exploitation.zh: 先查询允许的公共字段，再在同一对象上逐个加入内联片段和单一敏感字段。比较 null、字段级错误、完整对象和服务端解析器调用；使用两个角色和两个租户做矩阵验证，避免把类型不存在或对象类型不匹配误判为授权生效。
exploitation.en: Query allowed public fields first, then add one inline fragment and one sensitive field at a time on the same object. Compare nulls, field errors, complete objects, and resolver calls. Use two roles and two tenants to avoid mistaking a type mismatch or missing type for correct authorization.

mitigation.zh: 把授权策略放在业务服务或每个敏感字段解析器中，并对接口、联合类型、Node 查询、搜索和当前用户入口复用同一策略；以默认拒绝的字段权限和多角色 schema 测试覆盖所有可达查询路径。
mitigation.en: Place authorization in the business service or every sensitive-field resolver, reusing the same policy across interfaces, unions, Node lookups, search, and current-user entry points. Use default-deny field policies and multi-role schema tests for every reachable query path.

name.zh: GraphQL Alias 批量操作限流验证

description.zh: 验证服务端是否按一次 HTTP 请求而不是按实际 resolver 操作计数，导致登录、二次验证或对象查询可通过多个 Alias 在单次文档中绕过速率和成本限制。
description.en: Validate whether the server counts only HTTP requests instead of resolver operations, allowing login, second-factor, or object lookups under multiple aliases to bypass rate and cost limits in one document.

prerequisites.zh: 使用专用测试账户和可重置的验证码流程，并获得明确的请求速率上限。
prerequisites.en: Use a dedicated test account and resettable verification flow, with an explicitly approved request-rate ceiling.

prerequisites.zh: 记录单操作请求的计数器、响应扩展、认证日志和锁定行为。
prerequisites.en: Record counters, response extensions, authentication logs, and lockout behavior for a single-operation request.

title.zh: Alias批量查询 (暴力破解绕过)
title.en: Validation step 1 for GraphQL Alias Batch-Operation Rate-Limit Validation

description.zh: Alias批量查询 (暴力破解绕过)包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this GraphQL Alias Batch-Operation Rate-Limit Validation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 确认依据是一次 HTTP 请求实际执行多个敏感 resolver，且后端失败计数或成本只增加一次。仅支持 Alias、返回多个普通查询结果或网关记录一个请求不等于限流绕过。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires one HTTP request to execute multiple sensitive resolvers while backend failure or cost accounting increments only once. Alias support, multiple ordinary results, or one gateway request log alone does not prove a bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用专用账户和少量无效测试值，不进行凭证字典或验证码空间遍历。
opsecTips.en: Use a dedicated account and a few invalid test values; do not traverse credential dictionaries or verification-code spaces.

opsecTips.zh: 设置最大 Alias 数和立即停止阈值，监控锁定与下游调用。
opsecTips.en: Set a maximum alias count and immediate stop threshold while monitoring lockout and downstream calls.

title.zh: 测量单操作计数

description.zh: 发送一个无效测试值，记录账户计数器、解析器调用和锁定阈值。
description.en: Send one invalid test value and record the account counter, resolver calls, and lockout threshold.

title.zh: 提交受限 Alias 集合

description.zh: 使用原始 Alias 请求但限制在批准的少量测试值，观察实际执行操作数。
description.en: Use the original alias request with a small approved set of test values and observe the number of operations actually executed.

title.zh: 关联限流与认证日志

description.zh: 比较 HTTP 请求数、resolver 调用数和失败计数，确认是否存在计费差异。
description.en: Compare HTTP request count, resolver invocation count, and failure counters to identify accounting differences.

title.zh: 加入操作级限制并复测

description.zh: 限制 Alias 和查询成本后重放相同文档，确认每个敏感操作均被独立计数或整体拒绝。
description.en: After limiting aliases and query cost, replay the document and confirm every sensitive operation is metered independently or the document is rejected.

overview.zh: Alias 允许一个 GraphQL 文档多次调用同一字段。风险不在语法本身，而在网关只按 HTTP 请求限流、后端却执行多个认证或查询操作。测试应从两个 Alias 开始，并在严格上限内观察每个 resolver 是否独立计费和审计。
overview.en: Aliases let one GraphQL document invoke a field multiple times. The risk is not the syntax itself, but a gateway that rate-limits by HTTP request while the backend performs multiple authentication or lookup operations. Start with two aliases under a strict ceiling and observe whether each resolver is metered and audited.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是限流、锁定和查询成本模型位于 HTTP 层，未解析 GraphQL 文档中的操作数量、字段权重和身份维度，或认证解析器之间不共享失败计数。多个 Alias 因而可能在一次请求内消耗多次凭证或枚举对象。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is rate limiting, lockout, or query-cost enforcement at the HTTP layer without accounting for operation count, field weight, and identity dimensions in the GraphQL document, or authentication resolvers that do not share failure counters.

exploitation.zh: 以一个错误测试值建立失败计数，再使用两个到五个 Alias 重放同类操作，核对响应中的每个结果、后端调用次数、账户计数器和延迟。不要扩大到字典爆破；若请求整体被拒绝或每个 Alias 都独立计数，则限制有效。
exploitation.en: Establish a failure count with one incorrect test value, then replay two to five aliases and compare each result, backend call count, account counter, and latency. Do not expand into dictionary guessing. Whole-document rejection or per-alias accounting indicates effective control.

mitigation.zh: 在解析和验证阶段限制 Alias、字段数量、深度与复杂度；对认证和验证码解析器按账户、来源与操作独立计数；启用持久化查询或操作允许列表，并让网关和应用共享统一的限流状态与审计事件。
mitigation.en: Limit aliases, field count, depth, and complexity during parsing and validation. Meter authentication and verification resolvers by account, source, and operation; use persisted-query or operation allowlists; and share rate-limit state and audit events between the gateway and application.

name.zh: GraphQL HTTP 批处理策略验证

description.zh: 验证 GraphQL HTTP 端点接受请求数组时，是否对数组内每个操作分别执行认证、授权、成本、事务和速率限制，而不是只检查外层请求。
description.en: Validate whether a GraphQL HTTP endpoint that accepts request arrays applies authentication, authorization, cost, transaction, and rate controls to every enclosed operation rather than only the outer request.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认目标明确支持 GraphQL 批处理，并准备只含测试数据的读写操作。
prerequisites.en: The target explicitly supports GraphQL batching and read/write operations containing test data only are prepared.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录单请求的认证、授权、成本、事务和错误返回基线。
prerequisites.en: Authentication, authorization, cost, transaction, and error baselines for a single request have been recorded.

title.zh: Batch query攻击
title.en: Validation step 1 for GraphQL HTTP Batch Policy Validation

description.zh: Batch query攻击包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this GraphQL HTTP Batch Policy Validation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 接受批请求本身不是漏洞。必须证明某个内部操作绕过了单操作时存在的授权、限流、成本或事务控制，并能通过元素级日志和状态变化重复验证。
analysis.en: Accepting batch requests is not itself a vulnerability. A finding requires an inner operation to bypass authorization, rate, cost, or transaction controls that apply to the same standalone operation, confirmed through element-level logs and state.

opsecTips.zh: 将删除和角色修改示例替换为专用测试对象上的可回滚标记写入。
opsecTips.en: Replace deletion and role-change examples with reversible marker writes on dedicated test objects.

opsecTips.zh: 从两个元素开始并限制总复杂度，观察资源指标后再停止。
opsecTips.en: Start with two elements, cap aggregate complexity, and stop after observing resource metrics.

title.zh: 确认批处理协议与基线

description.zh: 用两个无害查询确认数组格式、元素顺序、错误结构和服务端日志关联方式。
description.en: Use two harmless queries to confirm array format, element ordering, error structure, and server-log correlation.

title.zh: 加入拒绝与可回滚操作
title.en: Add a denial and reversible operation

description.zh: 在测试数据上提交原始批处理形态，逐项观察身份、授权和事务边界。
description.en: Submit the original batch shape against test data and observe identity, authorization, and transaction boundaries per element.

attackChain.payload:
[{"query":"{me{id email role}}"},{"query":"{users{id email role}}"},{"query":"{config{secretKey}}"}]
[{"query":"mutation{login(username:\"admin\",password:\"pass1\"){token}}"},{"query":"mutation{login(username:\"admin\",password:\"pass2\"){token}}"},{"query":"mutation{login(username:\"admin\",password:\"pass3\"){token}}"}]
[{"query":"{admin{secretToken}}"},{"query":"{admin{apiKey}}"},{"query":"{admin{password}}"}]
[{"query":"mutation{deleteUser(id:1){success}}"},{"query":"mutation{deleteUser(id:2){success}}"},{"query":"mutation{deleteUser(id:3){success}}"}]
[{"query":"{users{id email}}"},{"query":"mutation{updateUser(id:1,role:\"admin\"){success}}"},{"query":"mutation{updateUser(id:2,role:\"admin\"){success}}"}]

title.zh: 核对元素级成本与副作用
title.en: Check element-level cost and side effects

description.zh: 比较外层请求计数与内部操作、数据库提交和审计事件，定位控制作用域差异。
description.en: Compare outer-request accounting with inner operations, database commits, and audit events to locate control-scope mismatches.

title.zh: 限制批大小并验证隔离
title.en: Limit batch size and validate isolation

description.zh: 应用数组长度、总成本和元素级授权后重放，确认部分失败不会越权或污染其他元素。
description.en: After applying array-length, aggregate-cost, and per-element authorization controls, replay and confirm partial failures cannot authorize or contaminate other elements.

overview.zh: 批处理扩展不是 GraphQL 核心规范的通用要求，不同服务器语义不同。本条用只读、认证失败和可回滚写操作组合，验证外层 HTTP 请求与内部操作之间的控制一致性，并单独记录每个数组元素的结果。
overview.en: Batching is not a universal GraphQL core requirement, and server semantics vary. This entry combines read-only, authentication-failure, and reversible write operations to validate control consistency between the outer HTTP request and each inner operation, recording every array element separately.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自中间件只对批请求执行一次身份、限流或成本检查，而内部执行器逐项运行；也可能出现一个元素的凭证、事务或错误影响其他元素。真正问题是控制作用域错误，不是端点单纯接受 JSON 数组。
vulnerability.en: Risk arises when middleware authenticates, meters, or costs the batch only once while the executor runs each element, or when credentials, transactions, or errors from one element affect another. The defect is control-scope mismatch, not simple acceptance of a JSON array.

exploitation.zh: 从两个无害只读操作开始，再加入一个预期拒绝的操作和一个可回滚写操作。核对每个元素的身份上下文、授权结果、事务提交、成本计数与日志；禁止直接执行原集合中的删除示例，改用测试对象和等价无害操作。
exploitation.en: Start with two harmless reads, then add one expected denial and one reversible write. Check identity context, authorization, transaction commit, cost accounting, and logs for every element. Do not execute the deletion examples against real objects; use test objects and harmless equivalents.

mitigation.zh: 若业务不需要则关闭批处理；需要时限制数组长度和总复杂度，对每个元素独立执行认证授权与速率计数，并定义清晰的事务隔离和部分失败语义；在日志中保留批 ID 与元素级操作 ID。
mitigation.en: Disable batching when unnecessary. Otherwise limit array length and aggregate complexity, authenticate, authorize, and meter each element independently, define transaction isolation and partial-failure semantics, and log both batch and element operation identifiers.

name.zh: GraphQL Subscription 订阅授权验证

description.zh: 验证 Subscription 在连接建立、订阅注册和每次事件投递阶段是否持续执行主体、租户、主题和字段授权，防止低权限连接接收其他对象的敏感事件。
description.en: Validate whether GraphQL subscriptions continuously enforce principal, tenant, topic, and field authorization during connection setup, subscription registration, and each event delivery.

prerequisites.zh: 准备两个测试租户或用户、隔离的事件源和可识别的非敏感事件值。
prerequisites.en: Prepare two test tenants or users, isolated event sources, and identifiable nonsensitive event values.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 WebSocket 或 SSE 握手、连接参数、订阅确认和事件投递日志。
prerequisites.en: Record Web Socket or SSE handshakes, connection parameters, subscription acknowledgements, and event-delivery logs.

title.zh: Subscription劫持
title.en: Validation step 1 for GraphQL Subscription Authorization Validation

description.zh: Subscription劫持包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this GraphQL Subscription Authorization Validation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 只有低权限连接收到其他主体或租户的真实测试事件，或权限撤销后仍持续收到事件，才确认问题；连接成功、schema 可见或没有事件投递都不足以证明。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires a low-privilege connection to receive another principal's or tenant's real test event, or to continue receiving events after revocation. A successful connection, schema visibility, or absence of delivery is insufficient.

opsecTips.zh: 只发布带随机标记的测试事件，不触发真实支付、文件上传或管理操作。
opsecTips.en: Publish only random-marker test events; do not trigger real payment, file-upload, or administrative actions.

opsecTips.zh: 测试结束后主动关闭连接并清理事件总线中的测试订阅。
opsecTips.en: Close connections explicitly and remove test subscriptions from the event bus after testing.

title.zh: 建立自身事件订阅基线

description.zh: 以低权限账户订阅自身测试事件，记录连接身份、主题过滤和事件字段。
description.en: Subscribe to the account's own test event and record connection identity, topic filtering, and event fields.

title.zh: 注册敏感事件订阅

description.zh: 在隔离环境提交原始订阅集合，但只由测试事件源生成无害标记事件。
description.en: Submit the original subscription set in isolation while generating harmless marker events only from test sources.

title.zh: 交叉主体并撤销权限

description.zh: 由另一主体发布事件并撤销接收者权限，确认连接不会继续接收越权内容。
description.en: Publish from another principal and revoke receiver access, confirming the connection does not continue receiving unauthorized content.

title.zh: 修复事件级授权并复测

description.zh: 加入投递前授权与连接失效后重放，确认自身事件可用且跨主体事件被过滤。
description.en: After adding pre-delivery authorization and connection invalidation, replay to confirm self events remain available and cross-principal events are filtered.

overview.zh: 订阅授权不能只在初次连接时检查。本条用低权限连接注册原始订阅，并由另一个测试主体产生事件，观察服务端是否在主题过滤、对象加载和字段解析阶段持续保留正确身份与租户上下文。
overview.en: Subscription authorization cannot be checked only at connection time. Register the original subscriptions over a low-privilege connection, generate events from another test principal, and observe whether correct identity and tenant context persists through topic filtering, object loading, and field resolution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因常见于连接上下文长期缓存、事件总线只按主题广播、订阅解析器未按对象过滤，或令牌过期和角色变化后连接仍沿用旧权限。字段解析器若信任上游事件，也可能泄露令牌、配置、支付或日志字段。
vulnerability.en: Common causes include long-lived cached connection context, topic-only event broadcasting, missing object filters in subscription resolvers, or stale privileges after token expiry or role changes. Field resolvers may also trust upstream events and expose token, configuration, payment, or log fields.

exploitation.zh: 先订阅自身无害事件建立基线，再用另一测试主体生成同类型事件并比较是否收到；随后测试令牌过期、权限撤销和重连。保存事件 ID、发布主体、接收连接和字段解析日志，避免触发真实支付、文件或管理事件。
exploitation.en: Subscribe to a harmless self-owned event for baseline, then generate the same event type from another test principal and observe delivery. Test token expiry, privilege revocation, and reconnection. Preserve event ID, publishing principal, receiving connection, and field-resolver logs without triggering real payment, file, or administrative events.

mitigation.zh: 在连接和每个订阅操作中验证令牌，并在每次事件投递前按当前主体、租户和对象重新授权；对主题使用不可猜测的服务端映射，对敏感字段复用查询解析器授权，并在权限变更或令牌失效时主动终止连接。
mitigation.en: 在连接和每个订阅操作中验证令牌，并在每次事件投递前按当前主体、租户和对象重新授权；对主题使用不可猜测的服务端映射，对敏感字段复用查询解析器授权，并在权限变更或令牌失效时主动终止连接。

name.zh: GraphQL 指令与字段授权验证

description.zh: 验证 @skip、@include、schema 内省和自定义指令参与查询时，字段解析器是否仍执行授权；同时把不可用于可执行文档的 @deprecated 样例作为验证阶段负对照。
description.en: Validate whether field resolvers still authorize access when @skip, @include, introspection, or custom directives appear, while treating @deprecated in executable documents as a validation-stage negative control.

prerequisites.zh: 已导出目标 schema 中可执行指令及其允许位置，并准备低权限测试主体。
prerequisites.en: Executable directives and their allowed locations in the target schema are known, and a low-privilege test principal is ready.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录不带指令的同字段查询结果、验证错误和解析器授权日志。
prerequisites.en: Results, validation errors, and resolver authorization logs for equivalent fields without directives have been recorded.

title.zh: Directive注入
title.en: Validation step 1 for GraphQL Directive and Field-Authorization Validation

description.zh: Directive注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。
description.en: Run this GraphQL Directive and Field-Authorization Validation validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline.

analysis.zh: 确认标准是某个原本拒绝的敏感字段仅因合法指令组合而返回真实值。验证错误、字段省略、内省只返回名称或未定义自定义指令均属于负对照。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires a sensitive field that is normally denied to return a real value solely because of a valid directive combination. Validation errors, omitted fields, name-only introspection, and undefined custom directives are negative controls.

opsecTips.zh: 先在 schema 副本确认自定义指令语义，不向生产端点盲目枚举未知指令。
opsecTips.en: Confirm custom-directive semantics in a schema copy before testing; do not blindly enumerate unknown directives on production endpoints.

opsecTips.zh: 只选择虚构敏感值，并把非法指令限制为单次验证请求。
opsecTips.en: Select synthetic sensitive values only and limit illegal-directive controls to a single validation request.

title.zh: 识别标准与自定义指令

description.zh: 从 schema 记录指令定义、允许位置和无指令字段授权基线。
description.en: Record directive definitions, allowed locations, and the authorization baseline for fields without directives.

title.zh: 逐种指令重放同一字段
title.en: Replay the same field per directive

description.zh: 提交原始指令集合并一次只观察一种组合，保留非法位置作为负对照。
description.en: Submit the original directive set one combination at a time, retaining illegal locations as negative controls.

title.zh: 关联验证与解析器授权

description.zh: 区分验证阶段拒绝、字段被跳过和解析器实际返回未授权敏感值。
description.en: Distinguish validation rejection, skipped fields, and resolvers that actually return unauthorized sensitive values.

title.zh: 固定授权层并执行组合回归
title.en: Fix the authorization layer and regress combinations

description.zh: 将授权下沉后重放标准、自定义和非法指令，确认允许行为保留且拒绝一致。
description.en: After moving authorization downward, replay standard, custom, and illegal directives to confirm allowed behavior remains and denials are consistent.

overview.zh: 标准 @skip 和 @include 只控制字段是否执行，不应改变授权；@deprecated 是类型系统指令，放在查询字段上通常应在验证阶段拒绝；@auth 仅在 schema 定义时才有语义。本条以这些差异检查验证器和解析器边界，而不是假设任意指令都能绕过权限。
overview.en: Standard @skip and @include directives control field execution, not authorization. @deprecated is a type-system directive and should normally be rejected on executable fields, while @auth has meaning only when defined by the schema. This entry uses those differences to test validator and resolver boundaries without assuming directives inherently bypass access control.

vulnerability.zh: 真正缺陷是自定义指令中间件或字段包装顺序错误，使授权只在无指令路径执行，或内省暴露已弃用敏感字段后解析器仍缺少授权。标准指令被接受、内省返回字段名或验证器拒绝非法位置都属于正常行为。
vulnerability.en: A real defect occurs when custom-directive middleware or wrapper order causes authorization to run only on the no-directive path, or when introspection exposes deprecated sensitive fields whose resolvers lack authorization. Accepting standard directives, returning field names through introspection, or rejecting illegal locations is normal behavior.

exploitation.zh: 对一个允许字段和一个拒绝字段分别测试无指令、@skip(false)、@include(true) 和目标自定义指令，比较验证、解析器调用与返回值。将 @deprecated 行作为必须失败的负对照；若 schema 未定义 @auth，也应记录验证失败而不是漏洞。
exploitation.en: For one allowed and one denied field, compare no directive, @skip(false), @include(true), and the target custom directive across validation, resolver calls, and values. Use @deprecated lines as expected-failure controls. If @auth is undefined, record validation failure rather than a vulnerability.

mitigation.zh: 把授权放在业务服务或字段解析器的不可绕过层，而不是依赖指令顺序；只注册必要的自定义指令并校验适用位置；对已弃用字段继续执行授权直至删除，并为所有指令组合生成 schema 级授权回归测试。
mitigation.en: Place authorization in an unavoidable business-service or field-resolver layer rather than relying on directive order. Register only required custom directives with location validation, continue authorizing deprecated fields until removal, and generate schema-level authorization regression tests for directive combinations.

name.zh: GraphQL 变量到 SQL 查询边界

description.zh: 使用布尔与堆叠 SQL 字符串验证 GraphQL 变量类型校验后是否仍被解析器拼接到数据库查询结构。
description.en: Uses Boolean and stacked SQL strings to test whether GraphQL variables are concatenated into database query structure after schema type validation.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 GraphQL resolver 使用变量访问关系型数据库
prerequisites.en: The target GraphQL resolver uses variables to access a relational database.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 schema、伪用户数据和最终 SQL 审计可用
prerequisites.en: A test schema, synthetic user data, and final SQL audit are available.

title.zh: GraphQL SQL 边界 JSON 请求

execution.command:
{"query":"query($id:Int!){user(id:$id){id email role}}","variables":{"id":"1 OR 1=1"}}
{"query":"query($id:Int!){user(id:$id){id email role}}","variables":{"id":"1' OR '1'='1"}}

description.zh: 逐条发送到隔离 schema；前两行应在 GraphQL Int 强制转换阶段拒绝，第三行只指向可回滚测试表且用事务/只读账户验证，不执行 DROP。
description.en: Send separately to an isolated schema. The first two should fail GraphQL Int coercion; for the third use a rollback-safe test relation and read-only account and do not execute DROP.

analysis.zh: 分层记录 GraphQL 解析、类型强制、resolver 和数据库四个阶段。前两行被 Int 校验拒绝是预期结果，不能因 payload 包含 SQL 关键字判为漏洞。
analysis.en: Record GraphQL parse, coercion, resolver, and database stages separately. Rejection of the first two at Int coercion is expected and must not be labeled vulnerable because the strings contain SQL keywords.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用测试表与只读账户，堆叠语句不执行任何 DROP/写操作。
opsecTips.en: Use only test relations and a read-only account and never execute the DROP or any write operation.

opsecTips.zh: 每次请求限制字段与返回条数，避免同时暴露 email/role 等真实数据。
opsecTips.en: Limit fields and result rows per request and avoid exposing real email or role data.

title.zh: 建立 GraphQL 类型基线

description.zh: 记录合法 Int/String 变量经过 validation、resolver 和数据库的完整路径。
description.en: Record the full validation, resolver, and database path for valid Int and String variables.

title.zh: 逐条提交 SQL 边界 JSON

description.zh: 一次发送一行并保留 GraphQL 错误、resolver 日志和最终 SQL。
description.en: Send one line at a time and retain GraphQL errors, resolver logs, and final SQL.

attackChain.payload:
{"query":"query($id:Int!){user(id:$id){id email role}}","variables":{"id":"1 OR 1=1"}}
{"query":"query($id:Int!){user(id:$id){id email role}}","variables":{"id":"1' OR '1'='1"}}

title.zh: 确认数据库结构是否改变

description.zh: 匹配固定伪数据和最终 SQL，区分 GraphQL 类型拒绝、普通无结果与真实注入。
description.en: Match fixed synthetic data and final SQL to distinguish type rejection, ordinary no-result behavior, and injection.

title.zh: 参数化 Resolver 并回归

description.zh: 修复后重放合法与全部恶意变量，确认 resolver 正常且 SQL 结构固定。
description.en: After remediation replay valid and all malicious variables to confirm normal resolver behavior with fixed SQL structure.

overview.zh: GraphQL 变量与查询文档分离，但这只保证 GraphQL 类型边界，不自动参数化 resolver 内部 SQL。Int 变量收到字符串时应在执行前拒绝；String 变量仍必须由数据库驱动绑定。
overview.en: GraphQL separates variables from the operation document, but that only enforces GraphQL types and does not parameterize SQL inside a resolver. String values supplied to Int variables should be rejected before execution, while String variables still require database binding.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 resolver 把已通过 GraphQL 校验的变量拼接进 SQL，或自定义 scalar/类型转换放宽输入后产生查询片段。GraphQL schema 是一层验证，但数据库语义边界仍由参数化查询决定。
vulnerability.en: The cause is a resolver concatenating GraphQL-validated variables into SQL or a custom scalar or coercion path turning input into query fragments. The schema validates one boundary; parameterized database calls enforce the SQL boundary.

exploitation.zh: 先用合法整数/字符串建立 resolver 和结果基线，逐条提交三行并关联 GraphQL validation、resolver 调用和最终 SQL。使用只读测试账户与事务回滚。只有最终 SQL 结构改变并返回固定伪数据才成立；类型错误是安全结果。
exploitation.en: Baseline valid integer and string variables, submit each line, and correlate GraphQL validation, resolver invocation, and final SQL. Use a read-only test account and transaction rollback. A finding requires altered SQL structure and fixed synthetic output; a coercion error is safe behavior.

mitigation.zh: 保持严格 schema 与标准 scalar，不在 resolver 中动态拼接 SQL；所有值使用数据库参数绑定，动态列/排序映射服务端枚举。应用数据库账户只读/最小权限，记录 validation 与查询审计并回归这三类变量。
mitigation.en: Keep a strict schema and standard scalars, never concatenate SQL in resolvers, bind every value, and map dynamic columns or sorting through server enums. Use least-privilege database accounts, log validation and query audit, and regress all three variable classes.

name.zh: GraphQL 变量文件路径边界

description.zh: 使用父目录字符串验证 GraphQL String 变量是否被 resolver 当作文件名或资源路径并越过服务端根目录。
description.en: Uses a parent-directory string to test whether a GraphQL String variable is treated as a filename or resource path and escapes the server root.

prerequisites.zh: resolver 的 id/String 变量实际参与文件或对象路径解析
prerequisites.en: A resolver's id or String variable actually participates in file or object-path resolution.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离文件根目录外有无敏感标记并启用访问审计
prerequisites.en: A nonsensitive marker exists outside the isolated file root with access auditing.

title.zh: GraphQL 路径变量 JSON

description.zh: 只有在代码/日志确认 id 进入路径 API 时使用，并把系统路径替换为根目录外测试标记；若 id 只是数据库键，该样例应判不适用。
description.en: Use only when code or logs show id reaching a path API and replace the system path with an out-of-root marker; if id is only a database key, mark the sample not applicable.

analysis.zh: 如果 resolver 只做数据库查询，该样例属于 SQL/类型输入而非文件漏洞。报告必须给出路径 API 和真实规范路径，不能从 `../` 字符串下结论。
analysis.en: If the resolver only queries a database, this sample is a type or SQL input, not a file flaw. Report the path API and actual canonical path rather than concluding from ../ text.

opsecTips.zh: 将 `/etc/passwd` 替换为测试标记，禁止读取真实系统文件。
opsecTips.en: Replace /etc/passwd with a test marker and never read a real system file.

opsecTips.zh: 只在确认路径数据流后发送一次，避免无意义探测污染 GraphQL 审计。
opsecTips.en: Send once only after confirming the path data flow to avoid meaningless GraphQL audit noise.

title.zh: 确认变量到路径的数据流

description.zh: 从 GraphQL validation 追踪 id 到 resolver、路径拼接和最终文件 API。
description.en: Trace id from GraphQL validation through resolver, path composition, and final file API.

title.zh: 提交根外标记变量

description.zh: 替换系统目标后发送一次 JSON，并保留规范路径和请求 ID。
description.en: Replace the system target, send the JSON once, and retain canonical path and request ID.

attackChain.payload: {"query":"query($id:String!){user(id:$id){id email role}}","variables":{"id":"../../etc/passwd"}}

title.zh: 确认文件根目录越界

description.zh: 匹配文件审计、标记内容和 resolver 日志，排除数据库键错误。
description.en: Match file audit, marker content, and resolver logs, excluding database-key errors.

title.zh: 改用对象映射并回归
title.en: Switch to object mapping and regress

description.zh: 修复后重放合法 ID 和路径变量，确认前者可用且后者不会触发文件访问。
description.en: After remediation replay valid IDs and path variables to preserve the former without filesystem access from the latter.

overview.zh: GraphQL String 接受路径字符是正常类型行为，安全问题取决于 resolver 的后续用途。只有变量进入文件 API、完全规范化后越过根目录并读取测试标记，才是路径遍历。
overview.en: GraphQL String legitimately accepts path characters; risk depends on resolver use. Path traversal requires the variable to reach a file API, escape the root after full canonicalization, and read a test marker.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 resolver 复用 id 作为文件名、模板或对象路径，直接拼接到目录且只做原始字符串过滤。GraphQL schema 不理解文件系统语义，无法替代规范路径与根目录校验。
vulnerability.en: The cause is a resolver reusing id as a filename, template, or object path and concatenating it to a directory with raw-string filtering. The GraphQL schema does not understand filesystem semantics and cannot replace canonical-path root checks.

exploitation.zh: 先追踪合法 id 到 resolver 和文件 API，用根内标记建立基线，再把样例目标改为根外标记并提交一次。关联规范路径、文件审计和响应。GraphQL 接受变量、返回 null 或数据库错误都不能证明文件访问。
exploitation.en: Trace a valid id through resolver and file API, baseline an in-root marker, then point the sample to an out-of-root marker and submit once. Correlate canonical path, file audit, and response. Variable acceptance, null, or database errors do not prove file access.

mitigation.zh: 把 GraphQL id 映射到服务端对象而非路径；必须处理路径时，完全解码后解析规范绝对路径并强制固定根目录、禁止符号链接越界。文件服务身份最小权限，schema 使用语义明确的 ID scalar。
mitigation.en: 把 GraphQL id 映射到服务端对象而非路径；必须处理路径时，完全解码后解析规范绝对路径并强制固定根目录、禁止符号链接越界。文件服务身份最小权限，schema 使用语义明确的 ID scalar。

name.zh: GraphQL Input 批量赋值越权

description.zh: 使用 role 与 isAdmin 字段验证 mutation input 是否把客户端可控属性直接绑定到用户实体并绕过角色变更授权。
description.en: Uses role and is Admin fields to test whether mutation input is bound directly to a user entity and bypasses authorization for privilege changes.

subCategory.zh: GraphQL 批量赋值与字段授权
subCategory.en: GraphQL Mass Assignment and Field Authorization

prerequisites.zh: 低权限测试用户可调用 updateUser mutation
prerequisites.en: A low-privilege test user can call the update User mutation.

prerequisites.zh: 测试对象可回滚并可读取服务端持久化与审计结果
prerequisites.en: The test object is reversible and persistence and audit results are observable.

title.zh: 特权字段 Mutation JSON

description.zh: 逐条对专用低权限测试用户提交，并把 id 替换为其自身测试对象；每次后检查数据库、最终主体和对象授权并立即回滚。
description.en: Submit separately for a dedicated low-privilege user, replace id with that user's test object, inspect database, final principal, and authorization after each, and immediately roll back.

analysis.zh: 分别检查 schema 是否接受字段、resolver 是否读取、实体是否持久化和授权是否改变。仅接受但忽略字段不构成越权。
analysis.en: Check schema acceptance, resolver consumption, persistence, and authorization separately. Accepting but ignoring a field is not privilege escalation.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用可回滚测试用户和自身对象，不修改真实角色或其他用户。
opsecTips.en: Use only a rollback-safe test user and self-owned object; never alter real roles or another user.

opsecTips.zh: 每次请求后立即回滚实体和身份缓存，确认无权限残留。
opsecTips.en: Roll back the entity and identity cache immediately after each request and verify no privilege remains.

title.zh: 建立允许字段更新基线

description.zh: 用专用普通用户修改一个非敏感字段并记录持久化和审计。
description.en: Use a dedicated normal user to update one nonsensitive field and record persistence and audit.

title.zh: 逐条提交特权字段

description.zh: 一次添加 role 或 isAdmin，只操作自身测试对象。
description.en: Add role or is Admin one at a time and operate only on the caller's test object.

attackChain.payload:
{"query":"mutation($input:UserInput!){updateUser(input:$input){id}}","variables":{"input":{"role":"admin","id":1}}}
{"query":"mutation($input:UserInput!){updateUser(input:$input){id}}","variables":{"input":{"isAdmin":true}}}

title.zh: 确认持久化和授权影响

description.zh: 核对数据库、身份缓存和管理测试操作，排除单纯响应回显。
description.en: Inspect database, identity cache, and administrative test action, excluding response reflection.

title.zh: 实施字段允许列表并回归

description.zh: 修复 DTO 与授权后重放，确认正常字段可改而特权字段拒绝。
description.en: After DTO and authorization fixes replay requests to preserve normal updates while denying privilege fields.

overview.zh: 字段出现在 GraphQL Input 类型中不代表所有调用者都有权修改。批量赋值问题发生在 resolver 将 input 自动映射到实体，未对 role/isAdmin 等字段做服务端字段级授权。
overview.en: 字段出现在 GraphQL Input 类型中不代表所有调用者都有权修改。批量赋值问题发生在 resolver 将 input 自动映射到实体，未对 role/is Admin 等字段做服务端字段级授权。

vulnerability.zh: 根因是复用持久化模型作为输入 DTO，或通用 update/merge 将所有提供字段写入对象。schema 可见性、前端隐藏和字段命名不能替代按主体和字段执行的授权。
vulnerability.en: The cause is reusing a persistence model as an input DTO or a generic update or merge writing every supplied field. Schema visibility, hidden UI, and field naming cannot replace principal- and field-level authorization.

exploitation.zh: 记录普通用户更新允许字段的基线，逐条添加 role 或 isAdmin 并检查 mutation 错误、持久化对象、最终主体及管理测试操作。字段被忽略或验证拒绝是安全结果；只有持久化或真实授权提升成立。
exploitation.en: Baseline an allowed field update, add role or is Admin separately, and inspect mutation errors, persisted object, final principal, and an administrative test action. Ignored or rejected fields are safe; persistence or real authorization elevation confirms the flaw.

mitigation.zh: 为每个 mutation 定义最小专用 Input DTO，resolver 显式复制允许字段并对敏感字段执行独立授权。角色变更使用单独管理 mutation、再认证与审计；持久化层禁止通用客户端对象 merge。
mitigation.en: Define minimal mutation-specific Input DTOs, explicitly copy allowed fields in resolvers, and independently authorize sensitive fields. Use a separate reauthenticated audited administrative mutation for role changes and prohibit generic client-object merges.

name.zh: GraphQL 字符串内结构化过滤注入
name.en: Structured Filter Injection inside a GraphQL String

description.zh: 使用 JSON 字符串形式的 role 过滤器验证 resolver 是否对变量执行第二次结构解析并将未授权谓词传入数据层。
description.en: Uses a JSON-encoded role filter to test whether a resolver parses a variable a second time and forwards unauthorized predicates into the data layer.

prerequisites.zh: users resolver 接受 String filter 并在服务端解析为对象/查询条件
prerequisites.en: users resolver 接受 String filter 并在服务端解析为对象/查询条件

prerequisites.zh: 专用数据集包含普通与管理员伪记录并可审计最终过滤器
prerequisites.en: A dedicated dataset contains synthetic normal and admin records and exposes the final predicate for audit.

title.zh: JSON 编码角色过滤器

description.zh: 只在确认 resolver 二次解析 String 后使用，目标改为专用伪角色并限制一条结果；同时比较普通文本和非法 JSON 对照。
description.en: Use only after confirming second-stage parsing of the String, target a synthetic role, limit output to one row, and compare plain-text and malformed-JSON controls.

analysis.zh: 关键证据是 String 被二次解析成结构并改变最终查询/主体范围。若 resolver 把整个字符串当普通关键词搜索，则样例不适用。
analysis.en: The key evidence is second-stage structural parsing that changes final query or principal scope. If the resolver treats the value as an ordinary search term, the sample is not applicable.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用伪角色与一条伪记录，不枚举真实管理员或邮箱。
opsecTips.en: Use only a synthetic role and one synthetic record; never enumerate real administrators or email addresses.

opsecTips.zh: 限制过滤深度和一次请求，避免通用解析器生成高成本查询。
opsecTips.en: Limit filter depth and use one request to avoid expensive queries from a generic parser.

title.zh: 确认第二阶段过滤解析

description.zh: 从 String 变量追踪到 JSON/DSL 解析器、过滤对象和数据查询。
description.en: Trace the String variable into the JSON or DSL parser, filter object, and data query.

title.zh: 提交专用角色过滤器

description.zh: 使用伪角色和一条结果上限，并与普通/非法输入对照。
description.en: Use a synthetic role and one-row limit and compare with normal and malformed input.

attackChain.payload: {"query":"query($filter:String!){users(filter:$filter){id email}}","variables":{"filter":"{\"role\":\"admin\"}"}}

title.zh: 确认范围或谓词越界

description.zh: 匹配解析对象、最终查询和伪记录，确认服务端主体范围是否被覆盖。
description.en: 匹配解析对象、最终查询和伪记录，确认服务端主体范围是否被覆盖。

title.zh: 改用强类型 FilterInput

description.zh: 修复后重放三组输入，确认允许过滤保留且未知字段/运算符拒绝。
description.en: After remediation replay all controls to preserve allowed filters while rejecting unknown fields or operators.

overview.zh: GraphQL 只把 filter 视为 String，真正语义来自 resolver 的第二次 JSON/DSL 解析。若解析器允许客户端任意字段和运算符，可能绕过预定义搜索范围或对象级授权。
overview.en: GraphQL sees filter only as a String; semantics come from a second JSON or DSL parse in the resolver. If that parser allows arbitrary fields and operators, input may bypass intended search scope or object authorization.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是把自由字符串解析成通用过滤对象，并直接映射到 ORM/数据库查询。字段、运算符、深度和主体作用域缺少允许列表，导致客户端控制查询结构。
vulnerability.en: The cause is parsing a free-form string into a generic filter object and mapping it directly to an ORM or database query. Missing field, operator, depth, and principal-scope allowlists let the client control query structure.

exploitation.zh: 确认二次解析路径后，用普通关键词、非法 JSON 和专用 role 过滤器建立三组对照。记录解析后的 AST/对象、最终查询和返回伪记录。只有未授权 role 谓词被接受并越过主体范围才成立。
exploitation.en: After identifying second-stage parsing, compare a normal keyword, malformed JSON, and dedicated role filter. Record parsed AST or object, final query, and synthetic output. Confirm only if an unauthorized role predicate is accepted and escapes the caller's scope.

mitigation.zh: 使用强类型 GraphQL FilterInput 而非 String 内嵌 DSL，显式允许字段/运算符/深度并在服务端附加不可覆盖的主体范围。ORM 仍使用参数绑定，限制结果、复杂度和查询时间。
mitigation.en: Use a typed GraphQL Filter Input rather than an embedded DSL String, allowlist fields, operators, and depth, and append a server-owned principal scope that input cannot override. Keep ORM parameter binding and cap result size, complexity, and duration.

name.zh: GraphQL 变量到 HTML 输出边界

description.zh: 使用 script 字符串验证 import mutation 的 data 变量是否在存储、预览或管理界面中未经上下文编码进入 HTML。
description.en: Uses a script string to test whether an import mutation's data variable reaches stored, preview, or administrative HTML without context-aware encoding.

subCategory.zh: GraphQL 导入数据存储型 XSS
subCategory.en: Stored XSS through GraphQL Import Data

prerequisites.zh: 授权测试账号可导入数据并在隔离预览/管理视图中查看
prerequisites.en: An authorized test account can import data and view it in an isolated preview or administrative view.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无副作用 DOM 内存标记且可清理测试记录
prerequisites.en: A side-effect-free DOM in-memory marker is used and test records can be removed.

title.zh: GraphQL HTML 数据变量

description.zh: 把 alert 改为设置随机内存标记，在专用记录中提交一次，并检查 API 响应、存储值、渲染 DOM 和 CSP；不读取 Cookie 或外传。
description.en: Replace alert with a random in-memory marker, submit once in a dedicated record, and inspect API response, stored value, rendered DOM, and CSP without cookie access or exfiltration.

analysis.zh: 分别确认 JSON 传输、存储、HTML 解析和脚本执行。GraphQL 层接受 `<script>` 字符串是正常行为，漏洞位于后续未编码消费者。
analysis.en: Confirm JSON transport, persistence, HTML parsing, and script execution separately. GraphQL accepting a script string is normal; the flaw resides in an unencoded downstream consumer.

opsecTips.zh: 只设置随机内存标记，不读取 Cookie、localStorage 或页面数据。
opsecTips.en: Set only a random in-memory marker and never read cookies, local Storage, or page data.

opsecTips.zh: 使用专用记录并在测试后从数据库、缓存和搜索索引中清理。
opsecTips.en: Use a dedicated record and remove it from database, cache, and search index after testing.

title.zh: 绘制导入到渲染数据流

description.zh: 确认 data 经过的存储、转换和所有前端/管理消费者。
description.en: Identify storage, transformations, and every frontend or administrative consumer of data.

title.zh: 提交无害 HTML 标记

description.zh: 替换 alert 后写入专用记录一次，并保留请求与记录 ID。
description.en: Replace alert, write one dedicated record, and retain request and record IDs.

attackChain.payload: {"query":"mutation($data:String!){import(data:$data){success}}","variables":{"data":"<script>alert(1)</script>"}}

title.zh: 确认真实消费者执行
title.en: Confirm execution in a real consumer

description.zh: 匹配存储值、DOM 元素、CSP 事件和内存标记，排除 API 回显。
description.en: Match stored value, DOM element, CSP events, and in-memory marker while excluding API reflection.

title.zh: 编码所有消费者并清理
title.en: Encode every consumer and clean up

description.zh: 删除测试记录、修复渲染后重放普通文本与标记，确认前者可见而后者为文本。
description.en: Delete test data, fix rendering, and replay plain text and the marker to confirm the former renders and the latter is inert text.

overview.zh: GraphQL JSON 正确转义只保护传输格式，不保护数据最终进入 HTML 的上下文。import 成功也不等于 XSS；必须在实际消费者视图看到字符串成为 script 元素并触发无害标记。
overview.en: Correct JSON escaping protects transport syntax, not the later HTML context. A successful import is not XSS; the actual consumer view must turn the string into a script element and trigger a harmless marker.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是导入管线把不可信字符串存储后，在预览、报表或管理页面通过 innerHTML/模板原样渲染，缺少上下文编码或 HTML 消毒。API 与 UI 属于跨组件信任边界。
vulnerability.en: The cause is an import pipeline storing an untrusted string and later rendering it in preview, report, or admin UI through inner HTML or raw templates without context encoding or HTML sanitization. The API-to-UI path is a cross-component trust boundary.

exploitation.zh: 用普通文本建立导入/渲染基线，再提交无害标记版本并在隔离浏览器打开所有实际消费者视图。记录存储值、DOM、CSP 和标记。响应回显、源码文本或 sanitizer 删除标签均不是执行。
exploitation.en: Baseline import and rendering with plain text, submit a harmless marker version, and open every actual consumer view in an isolated browser. Record stored value, DOM, CSP, and marker. Response reflection, source text, or sanitizer removal is not execution.

mitigation.zh: 所有消费者按 HTML/属性/URL/JS 上下文编码，富文本使用成熟消毒器并禁止 script/事件属性；避免 innerHTML，部署 nonce/hash CSP 作为补充。导入 schema 校验数据类型并为 API 到 UI 建立端到端回归。
mitigation.en: Encode at every consumer for HTML, attribute, URL, or Java Script context, use a maintained sanitizer for rich text, block script and event attributes, avoid inner HTML, and deploy nonce or hash CSP as defense in depth. Validate import schemas and add API-to-UI regression.

name.zh: GraphQL 搜索通配与分页成本边界
name.en: GraphQL Search Wildcard and Pagination Cost Boundary

description.zh: 使用通配搜索与超大 first 值验证 resolver 是否缺少分页上限、查询复杂度控制和数据库成本保护。
description.en: Uses wildcard search and an oversized first value to test whether resolvers lack pagination caps, query-complexity controls, and database cost protection.

subCategory.zh: GraphQL 查询成本与资源限制
subCategory.en: GraphQL Query Cost and Resource Limits

prerequisites.zh: 只在性能隔离环境和小型伪数据集验证成本控制
prerequisites.en: Cost controls are tested only in a performance-isolated environment with a small synthetic dataset.

prerequisites.zh: 可观察 resolver、数据库和响应大小指标并设置硬超时
prerequisites.en: Resolver, database, and response-size metrics are observable with hard timeouts.

title.zh: 搜索与分页成本 JSON

description.zh: 在小型伪数据集逐条执行，从低值阶梯增加到策略边界；原 99999 仅用于验证服务器在执行前拒绝/截断，不实际返回该数量。
description.en: Execute separately on a small synthetic dataset and increase from low values to the policy boundary. The original 99999 is only to verify pre-execution rejection or clamping, not to return that many rows.

analysis.zh: 评价放大比而不是只看绝对延迟：输入大小、扫描行、数据库时间、序列化和响应字节。若 99999 被安全截断到上限，应记录为控制有效。
analysis.en: Evaluate amplification across input size, scanned rows, database time, serialization, and response bytes rather than absolute latency alone. Safe clamping of 99999 to a cap is an effective control.

opsecTips.zh: 只在隔离小数据集串行运行，设置硬超时、扫描行和响应字节停止线。
opsecTips.en: Run serially only on an isolated small dataset with hard timeout, scanned-row, and response-byte stop limits.

opsecTips.zh: 不并发、不循环原 99999 请求，取得拒绝/截断证据即停止。
opsecTips.en: Do not parallelize or loop the 99999 request and stop as soon as rejection or clamping is proven.

title.zh: 建立小查询成本基线

description.zh: 在伪数据集记录普通搜索和小页的计划、扫描、时延与响应大小。
description.en: Record plan, scanned rows, latency, and response size for normal search and a small page on synthetic data.

title.zh: 阶梯增加并提交边界样例
title.en: Increase stepwise and submit boundary samples

description.zh: 逐级到上限后分别提交通配与超大分页，达到阈值即停止。
description.en: Increase to the cap, then submit wildcard and oversized pagination separately and stop at the first threshold.

attackChain.payload:
{"query":"query($search:String!){search(query:$search){id name}}","variables":{"search":"*"}}
{"query":"query($limit:Int!){users(first:$limit){id email}}","variables":{"limit":99999}}

title.zh: 确认拒绝、截断或成本放大
title.en: Confirm rejection, clamping, or cost amplification

description.zh: 关联 GraphQL 成本决策、resolver、数据库计划与响应指标，区分安全截断和无界执行。
description.en: Correlate GraphQL cost decisions, resolver, database plan, and response metrics to distinguish safe clamping from unbounded execution.

title.zh: 设置硬上限并回归

description.zh: 修复后重放小查询和边界样例，确认正常使用保留且超限在执行前拒绝。
description.en: After remediation replay small and boundary queries to preserve normal use while rejecting excessive cost before execution.

overview.zh: GraphQL 类型正确不代表查询成本受控。通配搜索可能触发全表/全文扫描，超大分页值可能放大数据库、序列化和网络开销。安全验证应证明服务器在成本执行前限制，而不是压测到资源耗尽。
overview.en: Valid GraphQL types do not guarantee bounded cost. Wildcard search can trigger broad scans and oversized pagination can amplify database, serialization, and network work. Safe validation proves pre-execution controls without driving the service to exhaustion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 resolver 直接把搜索和 first 值交给数据层，缺少最大页大小、搜索语法约束、查询成本预算、超时与速率限制。攻击者可用少量请求制造不成比例工作。
vulnerability.en: The cause is passing search and first values directly to the data layer without maximum page size, search grammar constraints, query-cost budgets, timeouts, or rate limits. A small number of requests can create disproportionate work.

exploitation.zh: 在小型测试集记录普通关键词和小分页基线，逐级增加到配置上限并最终提交原样例一次，观察是否在 resolver/数据库前拒绝或截断。记录执行计划、扫描行、响应字节与时延，达到任一安全阈值立即停止。
exploitation.en: On a small test dataset baseline a normal keyword and small page, increase stepwise to the configured cap, then submit the original sample once to observe pre-resolver or pre-database rejection or clamping. Record plan, scanned rows, bytes, and latency and stop at any safety threshold.

mitigation.zh: 为分页设置服务端硬上限和游标，搜索只允许定义语法并使用有界索引。部署 GraphQL depth/complexity/cost 预算、执行超时、响应字节上限、速率限制和缓存，监控成本与主体关联。
mitigation.en: 为分页设置服务端硬上限和游标，搜索只允许定义语法并使用有界索引。部署 GraphQL depth/complexity/cost 预算、执行超时、响应字节上限、速率限制和缓存，监控成本与主体关联。

name.zh: GraphQL 查询复杂度限制验证

description.zh: 使用受控深度、别名数量和递归关系查询验证服务端是否在执行前限制深度、宽度和估算成本；原样例规模较小，应作为边界探针而非宣称可造成拒绝服务。
description.en: Use bounded depth, alias count, and recursive relationship queries to validate pre-execution depth, breadth, and estimated-cost limits. The source samples are small boundary probes and do not by themselves demonstrate denial of service.

prerequisites.zh: 在隔离环境获得服务端 CPU、内存、解析时长、resolver 数和查询成本指标。
prerequisites.en: Server CPU, memory, parse time, resolver count, and query-cost metrics are available in an isolated environment.
